children.text: Chapter 1
agnim īḍe purohitaṃ yajñasya devam ṛtvijam
children.translated_text: I praise <s>Agni</s>, the household priest, the god of the sacrifice, the officiating priest,

children.text: hotāraṃ ratnadhātamam ||
children.translated_text: the <s>hotṛ</s> (invoking priest), best bestower of treasures.

children.text: agniḥ pūrvebhir ṛṣibhir īḍyo nūtanair uta
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, worthy of praise by the ancient seers and also by the new ones,

children.text: sa devāṁ eha vakṣati ||
children.translated_text: will bring the gods here.

children.text: agninā rayim aśnavat poṣam eva dive dive
children.translated_text: Through <s>Agni</s> one obtains wealth and nourishment day by day,

children.text: yaśasaṃ vīravattamam ||
children.translated_text: glorious, most full of heroes.

children.text: agne yaṃ yajñam adhvaraṃ viśvataḥ paribhūr asi
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, the sacrifice, the rite, which you encompass on every side,

children.text: sa id deveṣu gacchati ||
children.translated_text: that indeed goes among the gods.

children.text: agnir hotā kavikratuḥ satyaś citraśravastamaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, the <s>hotṛ</s>, with a poet's insight, true, of most splendid fame,

children.text: devo devebhir ā gamat ||
children.translated_text: let the god come with the gods.

children.text: yad aṅga dāśuṣe tvam agne bhadraṃ kariṣyasi
children.translated_text: Whatever good, O <s>Agni</s>, you will do for the worshipper,

children.text: tavet tat satyam aṅgiraḥ ||
children.translated_text: that indeed is your truth, O <s>Aṅgiras</s>.

children.text: upa tvāgne dive dive doṣāvastar dhiyā vayam
children.translated_text: To you, O <s>Agni</s>, day by day, by night and by dawn, with thought, we

children.text: namo bharanta emasi ||
children.translated_text: come, bringing homage.

children.text: rājantam adhvarāṇāṃ gopām ṛtasya dīdivim
children.translated_text: Shining as king of the rites, guardian of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), blazing,

children.text: vardhamānaṃ sve dame ||
children.translated_text: growing in your own house.

children.text: sa naḥ piteva sūnave 'gne sūpāyano bhava
children.translated_text: So, like a father to a son, O <s>Agni</s>, be easy of approach for us;

children.text: sacasvā naḥ svastaye ||
children.translated_text: be with us for well-being.

children.text: Chapter 2
vāyav ā yāhi darśateme somā araṃkṛtāḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s>, come, lovely to behold; these <s>soma</s> draughts have been prepared.

children.text: teṣām pāhi śrudhī havam ||
children.translated_text: Drink of them; hear our call.

children.text: vāya ukthebhir jarante tvām acchā jaritāraḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s>, the singers praise you with hymns, turning toward you,

children.text: sutasomā aharvidaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with <s>soma</s> pressed, knowing the day.

children.text: vāyo tava prapṛñcatī dhenā jigāti dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s>, your swelling stream goes to the worshipper,

children.text: urūcī somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: broadly extended for the drinking of <s>soma</s>.

children.text: indravāyū ime sutā upa prayobhir ā gatam
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>, these pressed draughts are here; come near with delights,

children.text: indavo vām uśanti hi ||
children.translated_text: for the drops long for you two.

children.text: vāyav indraś ca cetathaḥ sutānāṃ vājinīvasū
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s> and <s>Indra</s>, rich in steeds, you perceive the pressed draughts;

children.text: tāv ā yātam upa dravat ||
children.translated_text: come here to them, run near.

children.text: vāyav indraś ca sunvata ā yātam upa niṣkṛtam
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s> and <s>Indra</s>, come to the presser, to the prepared place,

children.text: makṣv itthā dhiyā narā ||
children.translated_text: quickly in this way, O heroes, with thought.

children.text: mitraṃ huve pūtadakṣaṃ varuṇaṃ ca riśādasam
children.translated_text: I call <s>Mitra</s>, pure in skill, and <s>Varuṇa</s>, destroyer of foes,

children.text: dhiyaṃ ghṛtācīṃ sādhantā ||
children.translated_text: who perfect the ghee-bright thought.

children.text: ṛtena mitrāvaruṇāv ṛtāvṛdhāv ṛtaspṛśā
children.translated_text: By <s>ṛta</s>, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, increasers of <s>ṛta</s>, touching <s>ṛta</s>,

children.text: kratum bṛhantam āśāthe ||
children.translated_text: you attain the great resolve.

children.text: kavī no mitrāvaruṇā tuvijātā urukṣayā
children.translated_text: The two poets, <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, nobly born, wide-dwelling, for us

children.text: dakṣaṃ dadhāte apasam ||
children.translated_text: establish skill and active power.

children.text: Chapter 3
aśvinā yajvarīr iṣo dravatpāṇī śubhas patī
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, delight in the worshipper's refreshments, swift-handed, lords of beauty,

children.text: purubhujā canasyatam ||
children.translated_text: much-enjoying.

children.text: aśvinā purudaṃsasā narā śavīrayā dhiyā
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, wonder-working, heroic men, with a mighty thought,

children.text: dhiṣṇyā vanataṃ giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: O worthy ones, win the songs.

children.text: dasrā yuvākavaḥ sutā nāsatyā vṛktabarhiṣaḥ
children.translated_text: O wondrous <s>Nāsatyas</s>, youthful poets, the pressed draughts are ready and the sacred grass is spread;

children.text: ā yātaṃ rudravartanī ||
children.translated_text: come, you whose path is ruddy.

children.text: indrā yāhi citrabhāno sutā ime tvāyavaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, come, bright-shining; these pressed draughts are for you,

children.text: aṇvībhis tanā pūtāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: purified through the subtle filter.

children.text: indrā yāhi dhiyeṣito viprajūtaḥ sutāvataḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, come, impelled by thought, urged by the inspired one, to the presser;

children.text: upa brahmāṇi vāghataḥ ||
children.translated_text: come near to the prayers of the chanter.

children.text: indrā yāhi tūtujāna upa brahmāṇi harivaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, come swiftly to the prayers, O bay-horsed one;

children.text: sute dadhiṣva naś canaḥ ||
children.translated_text: at the pressed draught, place our delight.

children.text: omāsaś carṣaṇīdhṛto viśve devāsa ā gata
children.translated_text: Helpful, sustaining peoples, O <s>Viśve Devāḥ</s>, come here,

children.text: dāśvāṃso dāśuṣaḥ sutam ||
children.translated_text: worshippers to the pressed draught of the worshipper.

children.text: viśve devāso apturaḥ sutam ā ganta tūrṇayaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Viśve Devāḥ</s>, active ones, come quickly to the pressed draught,

children.text: usrā iva svasarāṇi ||
children.translated_text: like rays to the days.

children.text: viśve devāso asridha ehimāyāso adruhaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Viśve Devāḥ</s>, unfailing, mighty in wonder, free from deceit,

children.text: medhaṃ juṣanta vahnayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: as carriers, enjoy the offering.

children.text: pāvakā naḥ sarasvatī vājebhir vājinīvatī
children.translated_text: May purifying <s>Sarasvatī</s>, rich in prizes, rich in strength,

children.text: yajñaṃ vaṣṭu dhiyāvasuḥ ||
children.translated_text: desire the sacrifice, wealthy in inspiration.

children.text: codayitrī sūnṛtānāṃ cetantī sumatīnām
children.translated_text: Impeller of true words, awakener of good thoughts,

children.text: yajñaṃ dadhe sarasvatī ||
children.translated_text: <s>Sarasvatī</s> has established the sacrifice.

children.text: maho arṇaḥ sarasvatī pra cetayati ketunā
children.translated_text: <s>Sarasvatī</s>, a great flood, gives clear insight by her sign;

children.text: dhiyo viśvā vi rājati ||
children.translated_text: she shines forth over all thoughts.

children.text: Chapter 4
surūpakṛtnum ūtaye sudughām iva goduhe
children.translated_text: For help we call the maker of fair forms, like a good milch-cow for the milker,

children.text: juhūmasi dyavi dyavi ||
children.translated_text: day after day.

children.text: upa naḥ savanā gahi somasya somapāḥ piba
children.translated_text: Come to our pressings; drink of the <s>soma</s>, O <s>soma</s>-drinker.

children.text: godā id revato madaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The exhilaration of the wealthy one is indeed cow-giving.

children.text: athā te antamānāṃ vidyāma sumatīnām
children.translated_text: Then may we know the innermost of your favoring thoughts;

children.text: mā no ati khya ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: do not pass us by; come here.

children.text: parehi vigram astṛtam indram pṛcchā vipaścitam
children.translated_text: Go forth to the adversary; ask wise <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: yas te sakhibhya ā varam ||
children.translated_text: who is superior to your companions.

children.text: uta bruvantu no nido nir anyataś cid ārata
children.translated_text: And let our revilers speak; drive them away from elsewhere too,

children.text: dadhānā indra id duvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: as they render service to <s>Indra</s> alone.

children.text: uta naḥ subhagāṁ arir voceyur dasma kṛṣṭayaḥ
children.translated_text: And may hostile peoples call us fortunate, O wondrous one;

children.text: syāmed indrasya śarmaṇi ||
children.translated_text: may we be in <s>Indra</s>'s shelter.

children.text: em āśum āśave bhara yajñaśriyaṃ nṛmādanam
children.translated_text: Bring the swift draught to the swift one, the glory of sacrifice, gladdening men,

children.text: patayan mandayatsakham ||
children.translated_text: flying, a friend who gives delight.

children.text: asya pītvā śatakrato ghano vṛtrāṇām abhavaḥ
children.translated_text: Having drunk of this, O hundred-powered one, you became the smasher of obstacles;

children.text: prāvo vājeṣu vājinam ||
children.translated_text: you aided the strong one in contests.

children.text: taṃ tvā vājeṣu vājinaṃ vājayāmaḥ śatakrato
children.translated_text: You, the strong one in contests, we urge to strength, O hundred-powered one,

children.text: dhanānām indra sātaye ||
children.translated_text: for the winning of riches, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yo rāyo 'vanir mahān supāraḥ sunvataḥ sakhā
children.translated_text: He who is a great protection of wealth, easy to cross to, friend of the presser,

children.text: tasmā indrāya gāyata ||
children.translated_text: sing to that <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 5
ā tv etā ni ṣīdatendram abhi pra gāyata
children.translated_text: Sit down here in this place; sing forth around <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: sakhāya stomavāhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O friends who carry hymns of praise.

children.text: purūtamam purūṇām īśānaṃ vāryāṇām
children.translated_text: The most manifold among the manifold, lord of desirable goods,

children.text: indraṃ some sacā sute ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, together with the pressed <s>soma</s>.

children.text: sa ghā no yoga ā bhuvat sa rāye sa purandhyām
children.translated_text: May he be for us in the yoking, he for wealth, he for abundance;

children.text: gamad vājebhir ā sa naḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he come to us with prizes.

children.text: yasya saṃsthe na vṛṇvate harī samatsu śatravaḥ
children.translated_text: At whose station enemies in battles do not choose his two bay steeds,

children.text: tasmā indrāya gāyata ||
children.translated_text: sing to that <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: sutapāvne sutā ime śucayo yanti vītaye
children.translated_text: For the drinker of the pressed draught, these pure pressed <s>soma</s>s go for enjoyment,

children.text: somāso dadhyāśiraḥ ||
children.translated_text: mixed with curds.

children.text: tvaṃ sutasya pītaye sadyo vṛddho ajāyathāḥ
children.translated_text: For drinking the pressed draught you at once grew strong and were born,

children.text: indra jyaiṣṭhyāya sukrato ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, for supremacy, O strong-minded one.

children.text: ā tvā viśantv āśavaḥ somāsa indra girvaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the swift <s>soma</s>s enter you, O <s>Indra</s>, lover of song;

children.text: śaṃ te santu pracetase ||
children.translated_text: may they be auspicious for your wise mind.

children.text: tvāṃ stomā avīvṛdhan tvām ukthā śatakrato
children.translated_text: The praises have strengthened you; the recitations have strengthened you, O hundred-powered one;

children.text: tvāṃ vardhantu no giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: may our songs strengthen you.

children.text: akṣitotiḥ saned imaṃ vājam indraḥ sahasriṇam
children.translated_text: With unfailing help may <s>Indra</s> win this thousandfold prize,

children.text: yasmin viśvāni pauṃsyā ||
children.translated_text: in which are all heroic powers.

children.text: mā no martā abhi druhan tanūnām indra girvaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Let not mortals harm our bodies, O <s>Indra</s>, lover of song;

children.text: īśāno yavayā vadham ||
children.translated_text: as lord, keep violence away.

children.text: Chapter 6
yuñjanti bradhnam aruṣaṃ carantam pari tasthuṣaḥ
children.translated_text: They yoke the bright ruddy one as he moves; the standing ones stand around him.

children.text: rocante rocanā divi ||
children.translated_text: The lights shine in heaven.

children.text: yuñjanty asya kāmyā harī vipakṣasā rathe
children.translated_text: They yoke his desirable two bay horses, broad-winged, to the chariot,

children.text: śoṇā dhṛṣṇū nṛvāhasā ||
children.translated_text: red, bold, carrying men.

children.text: ketuṃ kṛṇvann aketave peśo maryā apeśase
children.translated_text: Making a signal for the signless, form, O young one, for the formless,

children.text: sam uṣadbhir ajāyathāḥ ||
children.translated_text: you have arisen together with the dawns.

children.text: ād aha svadhām anu punar garbhatvam erire
children.translated_text: Then again, according to their own law, they returned to the state of the womb.

children.text: dadhānā nāma yajñiyam ||
children.translated_text: bearing a name worthy of sacrifice.

children.text: vīḍu cid ārujatnubhir guhā cid indra vahnibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Even what was firm he broke open with his powers; even the hidden place, <s>Indra</s>, with his carriers

children.text: avinda usriyā anu ||
children.translated_text: he found, following after the ruddy cows.

children.text: devayanto yathā matim acchā vidadvasuṃ giraḥ
children.translated_text: Seeking the gods, according to their thought, their songs approached the finder of wealth;

children.text: mahām anūṣata śrutam ||
children.translated_text: they praised the great, famed one.

children.text: indreṇa saṃ hi dṛkṣase saṃjagmāno abibhyuṣā
children.translated_text: With <s>Indra</s> indeed you are seen, joined together with the fearless one,

children.text: mandū samānavarcasā ||
children.translated_text: two exhilarated ones of equal brilliance.

children.text: anavadyair abhidyubhir makhaḥ sahasvad arcati
children.translated_text: The mighty rite shines with faultless heavenly aids,

children.text: gaṇair indrasya kāmyaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: with the desirable hosts of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: ataḥ parijmann ā gahi divo vā rocanād adhi
children.translated_text: Therefore, O far-ranging one, come here from the shining realm of heaven,

children.text: sam asminn ṛñjate giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: for the songs are being arranged together in this place.

children.text: ito vā sātim īmahe divo vā pārthivād adhi
children.translated_text: From here we seek gain, or from heaven, or from the earthly realm,

children.text: indram maho vā rajasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: or <s>Indra</s> from the great expanse.

children.text: Chapter 7
indram id gāthino bṛhad indram arkebhir arkiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: The singers have praised <s>Indra</s> greatly; the chanters have praised <s>Indra</s> with their hymns;

children.text: indraṃ vāṇīr anūṣata ||
children.translated_text: the voices have praised <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: indra iddharyoḥ sacā sammiśla ā vacoyujā
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> himself is with the two bay steeds, mingled with them, yoked by the word;

children.text: indro vajrī hiraṇyayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is the golden thunderbolt-bearer.

children.text: indro dīrghāya cakṣasa ā sūryaṃ rohayad divi
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, for far-reaching sight, set the sun high in heaven;

children.text: vi gobhir adrim airayat ||
children.translated_text: with the cows he drove open the rock.

children.text: indra vājeṣu no 'va sahasrapradhaneṣu ca
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, help us in contests and in battles for a thousand prizes,

children.text: ugra ugrābhir ūtibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: O fierce one, with fierce protections.

children.text: indraṃ vayam mahādhana indram arbhe havāmahe
children.translated_text: We call upon <s>Indra</s> for great wealth; we call upon <s>Indra</s> even in the small matter,

children.text: yujaṃ vṛtreṣu vajriṇam ||
children.translated_text: the thunderbolt-bearer as ally in struggles against obstruction.

children.text: sa no vṛṣann amuṃ caruṃ satrādāvann apā vṛdhi
children.translated_text: O bull, giver of the feast, make that pleasing portion grow for us at once,

children.text: asmabhyam apratiṣkutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: unopposed, for our benefit.

children.text: tuñje tuñje ya uttare stomā indrasya vajriṇaḥ
children.translated_text: In every pressing, in each later praise-song of <s>Indra</s> the thunderbolt-bearer,

children.text: na vindhe asya suṣṭutim ||
children.translated_text: I do not fail to find his good praise.

children.text: vṛṣā yūtheva vaṃsagaḥ kṛṣṭīr iyarty ojasā
children.translated_text: Like a bull going to the herd, he sets the peoples in motion by his might,

children.text: īśāno apratiṣkutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: ruling, unopposed.

children.text: ya ekaś carṣaṇīnāṃ vasūnām irajyati
children.translated_text: He alone rules over the peoples and over possessions;

children.text: indraḥ pañca kṣitīnām ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> rules the five settlements.

children.text: indraṃ vo viśvatas pari havāmahe janebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: From every side, for the peoples, we call <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: asmākam astu kevalaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let him belong solely to us.

children.text: Chapter 8
endra sānasiṃ rayiṃ sajitvānaṃ sadāsaham
children.translated_text: Come, <s>Indra</s>; bring wealth that wins, conquers together, and always overcomes,

children.text: varṣiṣṭham ūtaye bhara ||
children.translated_text: the highest wealth, for our protection.

children.text: ni yena muṣṭihatyayā ni vṛtrā ruṇadhāmahai
children.translated_text: With that fist-strike may we beat down the obstructions,

children.text: tvotāso ny arvatā ||
children.translated_text: guarded by you, and may we beat down the hostile horsemen.

children.text: indra tvotāsa ā vayaṃ vajraṃ ghanā dadīmahi
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, guarded by you, we take up the mace, the thunderbolt,

children.text: jayema saṃ yudhi spṛdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: so that in battle we may conquer our rivals.

children.text: vayaṃ śūrebhir astṛbhir indra tvayā yujā vayam
children.translated_text: With heroes who cannot be overthrown, O <s>Indra</s>, with you as ally, we

children.text: sāsahyāma pṛtanyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: would overpower those who fight against us.

children.text: mahāṁ indraḥ paraś ca nu mahitvam astu vajriṇe
children.translated_text: Great is <s>Indra</s>, and greater still; greatness belongs to the thunderbolt-bearer;

children.text: dyaur na prathinā śavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: his power is like heaven in breadth.

children.text: samohe vā ya āśata naras tokasya sanitau
children.translated_text: Whether men have sat down together in assembly for the winning of offspring,

children.text: viprāso vā dhiyāyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: or inspired poets eager in thought,

children.text: yaḥ kukṣiḥ somapātamaḥ samudra iva pinvate
children.translated_text: his belly, most given to drinking soma, swells like the sea,

children.text: urvīr āpo na kākudaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like broad waters at their summit.

children.text: evā hy asya sūnṛtā virapśī gomatī mahī
children.translated_text: So indeed his gracious speech is abundant, rich in cows, and great,

children.text: pakvā śākhā na dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: like a ripe branch for the worshipper.

children.text: evā hi te vibhūtaya ūtaya indra māvate
children.translated_text: So indeed your powers and aids, O <s>Indra</s>, for one like me,

children.text: sadyaś cit santi dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: are present at once for the worshipper.

children.text: evā hy asya kāmyā stoma ukthaṃ ca śaṃsyā
children.translated_text: So indeed his desired praise-song and laudation are to be proclaimed,

children.text: indrāya somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: for <s>Indra</s>, for the drinking of soma.

children.text: Chapter 9
indrehi matsy andhaso viśvebhiḥ somaparvabhiḥ
children.translated_text: Come here, <s>Indra</s>; rejoice in the draught, with all the portions of soma;

children.text: mahāṁ abhiṣṭir ojasā ||
children.translated_text: mighty in strength is your help.

children.text: em enaṃ sṛjatā sute mandim indrāya mandine
children.translated_text: Send this one forth when the soma is pressed, the delight for <s>Indra</s> who delights,

children.text: cakriṃ viśvāni cakraye ||
children.translated_text: the wheel-maker who has made all things.

children.text: matsvā suśipra mandibhi stomebhir viśvacarṣaṇe
children.translated_text: Exult, fair-lipped one, in the delights, with praises, O lord of all peoples;

children.text: sacaiṣu savaneṣv ā ||
children.translated_text: be present at these pressings.

children.text: asṛgram indra te giraḥ prati tvām ud ahāsata
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, your songs have been poured forth; they have risen up toward you,

children.text: ajoṣā vṛṣabham patim ||
children.translated_text: toward the bull, the lord, whom they do not neglect.

children.text: saṃ codaya citram arvāg rādha indra vareṇyam
children.translated_text: Set in motion toward us the wondrous, excellent bounty, O <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: asad it te vibhu prabhu ||
children.translated_text: let your ample power be effective.

children.text: asmān su tatra codayendra rāye rabhasvataḥ
children.translated_text: There, O <s>Indra</s>, impel us toward vigorous wealth,

children.text: tuvidyumna yaśasvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: O much-bright, glorious one.

children.text: saṃ gomad indra vājavad asme pṛthu śravo bṛhat
children.translated_text: Together with cattle and prize-winning strength, O <s>Indra</s>, place in us broad, great fame,

children.text: viśvāyur dhehy akṣitam ||
children.translated_text: unfailing for a full lifetime.

children.text: asme dhehi śravo bṛhad dyumnaṃ sahasrasātamam
children.translated_text: Place in us great fame and splendor that wins a thousand prizes,

children.text: indra tā rathinīr iṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, and those chariot-bearing nourishments.

children.text: vasor indraṃ vasupatiṃ gīrbhir gṛṇanta ṛgmiyam
children.translated_text: With songs they praise <s>Indra</s>, possessor of wealth and lord of wealth, worthy of the Rigvedic hymn,

children.text: homagantāram ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: the one who comes at invocation for protection.

children.text: sute sute nyokase bṛhad bṛhata ed ariḥ
children.translated_text: At every pressing, for him who has taken his seat, the mighty foe of the greater foe

children.text: indrāya śūṣam arcati ||
children.translated_text: sings strength for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 10
gāyanti tvā gāyatriṇo 'rcanty arkam arkiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: The singers of gāyatrī sing you; the chanters worship you with a chant;

children.text: brahmāṇas tvā śatakrata ud vaṃśam iva yemire ||
children.translated_text: the priests, O hundred-powered one, have raised you up like a bamboo pole.

children.text: yat sānoḥ sānum āruhad bhūry aspaṣṭa kartvam
children.translated_text: When he climbed from ridge to ridge, he looked over the many deeds to be done;

children.text: tad indro arthaṃ cetati yūthena vṛṣṇir ejati ||
children.translated_text: then <s>Indra</s> marks the goal, and, like a bull with the herd, he stirs.

children.text: yukṣvā hi keśinā harī vṛṣaṇā kakṣyaprā
children.translated_text: Yoke the two long-maned bay steeds, the vigorous ones that fill the girth;

children.text: athā na indra somapā girām upaśrutiṃ cara ||
children.translated_text: then, O soma-drinking <s>Indra</s>, attend to the hearing of our songs.

children.text: ehi stomāṁ abhi svarābhi gṛṇīhy ā ruva
children.translated_text: Come; resound toward the praises, sing out and roar;

children.text: brahma ca no vaso sacendra yajñaṃ ca vardhaya ||
children.translated_text: and, O good one, be joined with our sacred formulation and increase the sacrifice.

children.text: uktham indrāya śaṃsyaṃ vardhanam puruniṣṣidhe
children.translated_text: The laudation to be proclaimed for <s>Indra</s> is an enlargement for the much-invoked one;

children.text: śakro yathā suteṣu ṇo rāraṇat sakhyeṣu ca ||
children.translated_text: may the strong one delight in our pressings and in our friendships.

children.text: tam it sakhitva īmahe taṃ rāye taṃ suvīrye
children.translated_text: We seek him for friendship, him for wealth, him for heroic strength;

children.text: sa śakra uta naḥ śakad indro vasu dayamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may that strong <s>Indra</s>, bestowing treasure, be able to help us.

children.text: suvivṛtaṃ sunirajam indra tvādātam id yaśaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, the fame given by you is wide-open and easy to drive through;

children.text: gavām apa vrajaṃ vṛdhi kṛṇuṣva rādho adrivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: open the cow-stall of the cows; make bounty for us, O stone-cleaver.

children.text: nahi tvā rodasī ubhe ṛghāyamāṇam invataḥ
children.translated_text: For the two worlds, heaven and earth, do not restrain you when you are pressing forward;

children.text: jeṣaḥ svarvatīr apaḥ saṃ gā asmabhyaṃ dhūnuhi ||
children.translated_text: you will conquer the bright waters; shake the cows loose for us.

children.text: āśrutkarṇa śrudhī havaṃ nū cid dadhiṣva me giraḥ
children.translated_text: O hearer with attentive ears, hear the call; now set my songs in place;

children.text: indra stomam imam mama kṛṣvā yujaś cid antaram ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, make this praise-song of mine closer than even a companion.

children.text: vidmā hi tvā vṛṣantamaṃ vājeṣu havanaśrutam
children.translated_text: For we know you as the most manly bull, hearer of the call in contests;

children.text: vṛṣantamasya hūmaha ūtiṃ sahasrasātamām ||
children.translated_text: we call upon the most powerful aid, one that wins a thousand prizes.

children.text: ā tū na indra kauśika mandasānaḥ sutam piba
children.translated_text: Come to us, O <s>Indra</s> <s>Kauśika</s>; rejoicing, drink the pressed soma;

children.text: navyam āyuḥ pra sū tira kṛdhī sahasrasām ṛṣim ||
children.translated_text: send forth new life; make the seer a winner of a thousand.

children.text: pari tvā girvaṇo gira imā bhavantu viśvataḥ
children.translated_text: O lover of song, may these songs surround you on every side;

children.text: vṛddhāyum anu vṛddhayo juṣṭā bhavantu juṣṭayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may the growths that follow increased life be pleasing, and may the pleasing rites be accepted.

children.text: Chapter 11
indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhan samudravyacasaṃ giraḥ
children.translated_text: The songs have strengthened <s>Indra</s>, whose expanse is like the sea,

children.text: rathītamaṃ rathīnāṃ vājānāṃ satpatim patim ||
children.translated_text: the best charioteer among charioteers, lord and master of prizes.

children.text: sakhye ta indra vājino mā bhema śavasas pate
children.translated_text: In friendship with you, O <s>Indra</s>, possessor of prizes, may we not be afraid, O lord of might;

children.text: tvām abhi pra ṇonumo jetāram aparājitam ||
children.translated_text: we bow down before you as conqueror, unconquered.

children.text: pūrvīr indrasya rātayo na vi dasyanty ūtayaḥ
children.translated_text: The many gifts of <s>Indra</s>, his aids, do not fail,

children.text: yadī vājasya gomata stotṛbhyo maṃhate magham ||
children.translated_text: when he grants cattle-rich bounty to the singers.

children.text: purām bhindur yuvā kavir amitaujā ajāyata
children.translated_text: The fort-breaker, the young seer of immeasurable force, was born,

children.text: indro viśvasya karmaṇo dhartā vajrī puruṣṭutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, supporter of every deed, wielder of the thunderbolt, much-praised.

children.text: tvaṃ valasya gomato 'pāvar adrivo bilam
children.translated_text: You opened the pen of cattle-rich <s>Vala</s>, O stone-wielder;

children.text: tvāṃ devā abibhyuṣas tujyamānāsa āviṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the gods, frightened and hard-pressed, came to you for help.

children.text: tavāhaṃ śūra rātibhiḥ praty āyaṃ sindhum āvadan
children.translated_text: By your gifts, O hero, I have come back, proclaiming it to the <s>Sindhu</s>;

children.text: upātiṣṭhanta girvaṇo viduṣ ṭe tasya kāravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O lover of song, the singers, knowing this of yours, stood close by you.

children.text: māyābhir indra māyinaṃ tvaṃ śuṣṇam avātiraḥ
children.translated_text: By your powers of māyā, O <s>Indra</s>, you cast down <s>Śuṣṇa</s>, the wielder of māyā;

children.text: viduṣ ṭe tasya medhirās teṣāṃ śravāṃsy ut tira ||
children.translated_text: the wise know this of yours; raise up their fame.

children.text: indram īśānam ojasābhi stomā anūṣata
children.translated_text: The praises have sung to <s>Indra</s>, ruling by might,

children.text: sahasraṃ yasya rātaya uta vā santi bhūyasīḥ ||
children.translated_text: whose gifts are a thousand, or indeed still more.

children.text: Chapter 12
agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe hotāraṃ viśvavedasam
children.translated_text: We choose <s>Agni</s> as messenger, as <s>hotṛ</s> (sacrificial priest), all-knowing,

children.text: asya yajñasya sukratum ||
children.translated_text: of good resolve for this sacrifice.

children.text: agnim agniṃ havīmabhiḥ sadā havanta viśpatim
children.translated_text: With oblations they always call <s>Agni</s>, <s>Agni</s>, lord of the clan,

children.text: havyavāham purupriyam ||
children.translated_text: carrier of offerings, dear to many.

children.text: agne devāṁ ihā vaha jajñāno vṛktabarhiṣe
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, bring the gods here for him whose sacred grass is strewn;

children.text: asi hotā na īḍyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you are our praiseworthy <s>hotṛ</s> (sacrificial priest).

children.text: tāṁ uśato vi bodhaya yad agne yāsi dūtyam
children.translated_text: Awaken those eager ones, when, O <s>Agni</s>, you go on your embassy;

children.text: devair ā satsi barhiṣi ||
children.translated_text: sit on the sacred grass with the gods.

children.text: ghṛtāhavana dīdivaḥ prati ṣma riṣato daha
children.translated_text: O ghee-invoked shining one, burn against the hostile ones;

children.text: agne tvaṃ rakṣasvinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, burn the malignant beings.

children.text: agnināgniḥ sam idhyate kavir gṛhapatir yuvā
children.translated_text: By <s>Agni</s> is <s>Agni</s> kindled, the young seer and lord of the house,

children.text: havyavāḍ juhvāsyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: carrier of oblations, whose mouth is the ladle.

children.text: kavim agnim upa stuhi satyadharmāṇam adhvare
children.translated_text: Praise <s>Agni</s> the seer, true in law, at the rite,

children.text: devam amīvacātanam ||
children.translated_text: the god who drives away disease.

children.text: yas tvām agne haviṣpatir dūtaṃ deva saparyati
children.translated_text: Whoever, O <s>Agni</s>, as lord of oblation, serves you as messenger, O god,

children.text: tasya sma prāvitā bhava ||
children.translated_text: be indeed his protector.

children.text: yo agniṃ devavītaye haviṣmāṁ āvivāsati
children.translated_text: Whoever, with oblation, attends upon <s>Agni</s> for the coming of the gods,

children.text: tasmai pāvaka mṛḍaya ||
children.translated_text: to him, O purifier, be gracious.

children.text: sa naḥ pāvaka dīdivo 'gne devāṁ ihā vaha
children.translated_text: So, O purifier, shining <s>Agni</s>, bring the gods here for us,

children.text: upa yajñaṃ haviś ca naḥ ||
children.translated_text: to our sacrifice and to our oblation.

children.text: sa na stavāna ā bhara gāyatreṇa navīyasā
children.translated_text: As you are praised, bring to us, by the newest <s>Gāyatrī</s>,

children.text: rayiṃ vīravatīm iṣam ||
children.translated_text: wealth with heroes and nourishment.

children.text: agne śukreṇa śociṣā viśvābhir devahūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, with bright flame and with all invocations of the gods,

children.text: imaṃ stomaṃ juṣasva naḥ ||
children.translated_text: accept this praise of ours.

children.text: Chapter 13
susamiddho na ā vaha devāṁ agne haviṣmate
children.translated_text: Well-kindled, bring the gods to us, O <s>Agni</s>, to the offerer;

children.text: hotaḥ pāvaka yakṣi ca ||
children.translated_text: O <s>hotṛ</s> (sacrificial priest), O purifier, perform the sacrifice too.

children.text: madhumantaṃ tanūnapād yajñaṃ deveṣu naḥ kave
children.translated_text: O <s>Tanūnapāt</s>, O seer, make our honey-sweet sacrifice among the gods

children.text: adyā kṛṇuhi vītaye ||
children.translated_text: today for their enjoyment.

children.text: narāśaṃsam iha priyam asmin yajña upa hvaye
children.translated_text: I call here beloved <s>Narāśaṃsa</s> in this sacrifice,

children.text: madhujihvaṃ haviṣkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: honey-tongued, prepared for oblation.

children.text: agne sukhatame rathe devāṁ īḍita ā vaha
children.translated_text: O praised <s>Agni</s>, bring the gods in the most comfortable chariot;

children.text: asi hotā manurhitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you are the <s>hotṛ</s> (sacrificial priest) established by <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: stṛṇīta barhir ānuṣag ghṛtapṛṣṭham manīṣiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Spread the sacred grass in order, ghee-backed, O thoughtful ones,

children.text: yatrāmṛtasya cakṣaṇam ||
children.translated_text: where there is the sight of immortality.

children.text: vi śrayantām ṛtāvṛdho dvāro devīr asaścataḥ
children.translated_text: Let the divine doors, increasers of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), open wide, unfailing,

children.text: adyā nūnaṃ ca yaṣṭave ||
children.translated_text: today and now for sacrifice.

children.text: naktoṣāsā supeśasāsmin yajña upa hvaye
children.translated_text: I call fair-formed <s>Night</s> and <s>Dawn</s> to this sacrifice;

children.text: idaṃ no barhir āsade ||
children.translated_text: let this sacred grass of ours be their seat.

children.text: tā sujihvā upa hvaye hotārā daivyā kavī
children.translated_text: I call the two divine <s>hotṛs</s> (sacrificial priests), good-tongued seers;

children.text: yajñaṃ no yakṣatām imam ||
children.translated_text: let them sacrifice this sacrifice of ours.

children.text: iḍā sarasvatī mahī tisro devīr mayobhuvaḥ
children.translated_text: Let <s>Iḍā</s>, <s>Sarasvatī</s>, and <s>Mahī</s>, the three joy-giving goddesses,

children.text: barhiḥ sīdantv asridhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: sit on the sacred grass, unharming.

children.text: iha tvaṣṭāram agriyaṃ viśvarūpam upa hvaye
children.translated_text: Here I call foremost <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, of all forms;

children.text: asmākam astu kevalaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he be solely ours.

children.text: ava sṛjā vanaspate deva devebhyo haviḥ
children.translated_text: Send forth the oblation, O <s>Vanaspati</s>, god, for the gods;

children.text: pra dātur astu cetanam ||
children.translated_text: let the giver's conscious intention go forward.

children.text: svāhā yajñaṃ kṛṇotanendrāya yajvano gṛhe
children.translated_text: With <s>svāhā</s> make the sacrifice in the sacrificer's house for <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: tatra devāṁ upa hvaye ||
children.translated_text: there I call the gods.

children.text: Chapter 14
aibhir agne duvo giro viśvebhiḥ somapītaye
children.translated_text: With these acts of worship and songs, O <s>Agni</s>, with all the gods for <s>Soma</s>-drinking,

children.text: devebhir yāhi yakṣi ca ||
children.translated_text: come and perform the sacrifice.

children.text: ā tvā kaṇvā ahūṣata gṛṇanti vipra te dhiyaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Kaṇvas</s> have called you here; your inspired thoughts praise you, O sage;

children.text: devebhir agna ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Agni</s>, with the gods.

children.text: indravāyū bṛhaspatim mitrāgnim pūṣaṇam bhagam
children.translated_text: They call <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>, <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, <s>Pūṣan</s> and <s>Bhaga</s>,

children.text: ādityān mārutaṃ gaṇam ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Ādityas</s> and the host of <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: pra vo bhriyanta indavo matsarā mādayiṣṇavaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Soma</s> drops are brought forward for you, exhilarating and gladdening,

children.text: drapsā madhvaś camūṣadaḥ ||
children.translated_text: drops of honey, seated in the bowls.

children.text: īḍate tvām avasyavaḥ kaṇvāso vṛktabarhiṣaḥ
children.translated_text: The aid-seeking <s>Kaṇvas</s>, with sacred grass strewn,

children.text: haviṣmanto araṅkṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: worship you, bearing oblations and well prepared.

children.text: ghṛtapṛṣṭhā manoyujo ye tvā vahanti vahnayaḥ
children.translated_text: The flame-bearers, ghee-backed and yoked by thought, who carry you,

children.text: ā devān somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: bring you to the gods for <s>Soma</s>-drinking.

children.text: tān yajatrāṁ ṛtāvṛdho 'gne patnīvatas kṛdhi
children.translated_text: Make those worshipful increasers of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), O <s>Agni</s>, accompanied by their wives;

children.text: madhvaḥ sujihva pāyaya ||
children.translated_text: O good-tongued one, make them drink the honey.

children.text: ye yajatrā ya īḍyās te te pibantu jihvayā
children.translated_text: Those who are worshipful, who are praiseworthy, let them drink with your tongue

children.text: madhor agne vaṣaṭkṛti ||
children.translated_text: of the honey, O <s>Agni</s>, at the <s>vaṣaṭ</s>-call.

children.text: ākīṃ sūryasya rocanād viśvān devāṁ uṣarbudhaḥ
children.translated_text: From the shining realm of the sun, all the gods awakened with the dawn,

children.text: vipro hoteha vakṣati ||
children.translated_text: the inspired <s>hotṛ</s> (sacrificial priest) will bring here.

children.text: viśvebhiḥ somyam madhv agna indreṇa vāyunā
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, with all the gods, with <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>,

children.text: pibā mitrasya dhāmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: drink the <s>Soma</s>-honey in the ordinances of <s>Mitra</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ hotā manurhito 'gne yajñeṣu sīdasi
children.translated_text: You are the <s>hotṛ</s> (sacrificial priest) established by <s>Manu</s>, O <s>Agni</s>; you sit in the sacrifices;

children.text: semaṃ no adhvaraṃ yaja ||
children.translated_text: perform this rite of ours.

children.text: yukṣvā hy aruṣī rathe harito deva rohitaḥ
children.translated_text: Yoke to the chariot the ruddy mares, the bay and red ones, O god;

children.text: tābhir devāṁ ihā vaha ||
children.translated_text: with them bring the gods here.

children.text: Chapter 15
indra somam piba ṛtunā tvā viśantv indavaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, drink <s>Soma</s> in due season; let the drops enter you,

children.text: matsarāsas tadokasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the exhilarating ones, whose home is there.

children.text: marutaḥ pibata ṛtunā potrād yajñam punītana
children.translated_text: O <s>Maruts</s>, drink in due season; from the purifier cleanse the sacrifice;

children.text: yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā sudānavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for you are good givers.

children.text: abhi yajñaṃ gṛṇīhi no gnāvo neṣṭaḥ piba ṛtunā
children.translated_text: Sing over our sacrifice; O divine wives, O <s>Neṣṭṛ</s>, drink in due season;

children.text: tvaṃ hi ratnadhā asi ||
children.translated_text: for you are the treasure-holder.

children.text: agne devāṁ ihā vaha sādayā yoniṣu triṣu
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, bring the gods here; seat them in the three wombs;

children.text: pari bhūṣa piba ṛtunā ||
children.translated_text: adorn all around; drink in due season.

children.text: brāhmaṇād indra rādhasaḥ pibā somam ṛtūṃr anu
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, through the Brāhmaṇa's bounty, drink <s>Soma</s> according to the seasons;

children.text: taveddhi sakhyam astṛtam ||
children.translated_text: for your friendship is unbroken.

children.text: yuvaṃ dakṣaṃ dhṛtavrata mitrāvaruṇa dūḍabham
children.translated_text: You two, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, firm in vows, seek unfailing skill;

children.text: ṛtunā yajñam āśāthe ||
children.translated_text: in due season you two approach the sacrifice.

children.text: draviṇodā draviṇaso grāvahastāso adhvare
children.translated_text: The wealth-bestowers, rich in bounty, with pressing-stones in hand at the rite,

children.text: yajñeṣu devam īḍate ||
children.translated_text: praise the god in the sacrifices.

children.text: draviṇodā dadātu no vasūni yāni śṛṇvire
children.translated_text: Let the wealth-bestower give us the treasures that are famed;

children.text: deveṣu tā vanāmahe ||
children.translated_text: among the gods we would win those gifts.

children.text: draviṇodāḥ pipīṣati juhota pra ca tiṣṭhata
children.translated_text: The wealth-bestower longs to drink; pour the oblation and stand forth.

children.text: neṣṭrād ṛtubhir iṣyata ||
children.translated_text: Let him be sent from the <s>Neṣṭṛ</s> priest with the proper seasons.

children.text: yat tvā turīyam ṛtubhir draviṇodo yajāmahe
children.translated_text: When, O wealth-bestower, we worship you as the fourth with the seasons,

children.text: adha smā no dadir bhava ||
children.translated_text: then indeed become a giver for us.

children.text: aśvinā pibatam madhu dīdyagnī śucivratā
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, drink the honeyed Soma; O bright-vowed <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: ṛtunā yajñavāhasā ||
children.translated_text: with the season, you two bear the sacrifice.

children.text: gārhapatyena santya ṛtunā yajñanīr asi
children.translated_text: Being of the household fire, O abiding one, you are the leader of the sacrifice in due season;

children.text: devān devayate yaja ||
children.translated_text: sacrifice to the gods for the man who seeks the gods.

children.text: Chapter 16
ā tvā vahantu harayo vṛṣaṇaṃ somapītaye
children.translated_text: Let the bay steeds bring you, the mighty bull, for the drinking of Soma;

children.text: indra tvā sūracakṣasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, they are sun-eyed and yours.

children.text: imā dhānā ghṛtasnuvo harī ihopa vakṣataḥ
children.translated_text: These grains, dripping with ghee, let the two bay steeds convey here

children.text: indraṃ sukhatame rathe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> in the most comfortable chariot.

children.text: indram prātar havāmaha indram prayaty adhvare
children.translated_text: We call <s>Indra</s> in the morning; we call <s>Indra</s> as the rite advances,

children.text: indraṃ somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> for the drinking of Soma.

children.text: upa naḥ sutam ā gahi haribhir indra keśibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Come near to our pressed Soma with your tawny-maned bays, O <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: sute hi tvā havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: for when it is pressed, we call you.

children.text: semaṃ na stomam ā gahy upedaṃ savanaṃ sutam
children.translated_text: Come to this praise of ours; come to this pressed libation.

children.text: gauro na tṛṣitaḥ piba ||
children.translated_text: Like a thirsty bull, drink.

children.text: ime somāsa indavaḥ sutāso adhi barhiṣi
children.translated_text: These Soma-drops have been pressed and set upon the sacred grass;

children.text: tāṁ indra sahase piba ||
children.translated_text: drink them for strength, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: ayaṃ te stomo agriyo hṛdispṛg astu śantamaḥ
children.translated_text: May this foremost praise of yours, touching the heart, be most peaceful;

children.text: athā somaṃ sutam piba ||
children.translated_text: then drink the pressed Soma.

children.text: viśvam it savanaṃ sutam indro madāya gacchati
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> goes to every pressed libation for exhilaration,

children.text: vṛtrahā somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, for the drinking of Soma.

children.text: semaṃ naḥ kāmam ā pṛṇa gobhir aśvaiḥ śatakrato
children.translated_text: Fill this desire of ours with cows and horses, O hundred-powered one;

children.text: stavāma tvā svādhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we, skilled in praise, laud you.

children.text: Chapter 17
indrāvaruṇayor ahaṃ samrājor ava ā vṛṇe
children.translated_text: I choose the aid of <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, the two sovereigns;

children.text: tā no mṛḍāta īdṛśe ||
children.translated_text: may they be gracious to us in such a need.

children.text: gantārā hi stho 'vase havaṃ viprasya māvataḥ
children.translated_text: For you two are comers to the call for help, to the summons of the inspired poet who would be guarded,

children.text: dhartārā carṣaṇīnām ||
children.translated_text: upholders of the peoples.

children.text: anukāmaṃ tarpayethām indrāvaruṇa rāya ā
children.translated_text: Satisfy us according to our desire, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, with wealth;

children.text: tā vāṃ nediṣṭham īmahe ||
children.translated_text: we seek that closest favor of yours.

children.text: yuvāku hi śacīnāṃ yuvāku sumatīnām
children.translated_text: May we be sharers in your powers, sharers in your good intentions,

children.text: bhūyāma vājadāvnām ||
children.translated_text: and in the gifts of those who bestow the prize.

children.text: indraḥ sahasradāvnāṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃsyānām
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> becomes the resolve of those who give a thousand, and <s>Varuṇa</s> of those worthy of praise,

children.text: kratur bhavaty ukthyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: a power fit to be celebrated in hymns.

children.text: tayor id avasā vayaṃ sanema ni ca dhīmahi
children.translated_text: By the aid of those two may we win and firmly possess;

children.text: syād uta prarecanam ||
children.translated_text: may there also be surpassing abundance.

children.text: indrāvaruṇa vām ahaṃ huve citrāya rādhase
children.translated_text: I call you, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, for splendid bounty;

children.text: asmān su jigyuṣas kṛtam ||
children.translated_text: make us good conquerors.

children.text: indrāvaruṇa nū nu vāṃ siṣāsantīṣu dhīṣv ā
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, now, amid the thoughts that seek to win you,

children.text: asmabhyaṃ śarma yacchatam ||
children.translated_text: grant shelter to us.

children.text: pra vām aśnotu suṣṭutir indrāvaruṇa yāṃ huve
children.translated_text: Let the well-spoken praise reach you, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, which I call forth,

children.text: yām ṛdhāthe sadhastutim ||
children.translated_text: the joint praise that you two prosper.

children.text: Chapter 18
somānaṃ svaraṇaṃ kṛṇuhi brahmaṇas pate
children.translated_text: Make the Soma sound forth, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>,

children.text: kakṣīvantaṃ ya auśijaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the Soma of <s>Kakṣīvant</s>, son of <s>Uśij</s>.

children.text: yo revān yo amīvahā vasuvit puṣṭivardhanaḥ
children.translated_text: He who is wealthy, who drives away disease, finder of goods, increaser of nourishment,

children.text: sa naḥ siṣaktu yas turaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may that swift one attend us.

children.text: mā naḥ śaṃso araruṣo dhūrtiḥ praṇaṅ martyasya
children.translated_text: Let not the curse of the hostile mortal, nor his deceit, reach us;

children.text: rakṣā ṇo brahmaṇas pate ||
children.translated_text: protect us, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>.

children.text: sa ghā vīro na riṣyati yam indro brahmaṇas patiḥ
children.translated_text: That hero does not come to harm, the mortal whom <s>Indra</s>, <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>,

children.text: somo hinoti martyam ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Soma</s> impel onward.

children.text: tvaṃ tam brahmaṇas pate soma indraś ca martyam
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, and <s>Soma</s> and <s>Indra</s>, protect that mortal;

children.text: dakṣiṇā pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let the sacrificial gift guard him from distress.

children.text: sadasas patim adbhutam priyam indrasya kāmyam
children.translated_text: I have sought the wondrous lord of the seat, dear and desirable to <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: sanim medhām ayāsiṣam ||
children.translated_text: as a winning of insight and wisdom.

children.text: yasmād ṛte na sidhyati yajño vipaścitaś cana
children.translated_text: Without whom the sacrifice of even the wise man does not succeed,

children.text: sa dhīnāṃ yogam invati ||
children.translated_text: he furthers the harnessing of thoughts.

children.text: ād ṛdhnoti haviṣkṛtim prāñcaṃ kṛṇoty adhvaram
children.translated_text: Then he prospers the preparation of the oblation and makes the rite move forward;

children.text: hotrā deveṣu gacchati ||
children.translated_text: the priestly office goes among the gods.

children.text: narāśaṃsaṃ sudhṛṣṭamam apaśyaṃ saprathastamam
children.translated_text: I saw <s>Narāśaṃsa</s>, most bold, most widely extended,

children.text: divo na sadmamakhasam ||
children.translated_text: as one whose seat and feast are like heaven.

children.text: Chapter 19
prati tyaṃ cārum adhvaraṃ gopīthāya pra hūyase
children.translated_text: For protection of cattle you are called toward that lovely rite;

children.text: marudbhir agna ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Agni</s>, with the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: nahi devo na martyo mahas tava kratum paraḥ
children.translated_text: For neither god nor mortal is beyond your great insight;

children.text: marudbhir agna ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Agni</s>, with the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: ye maho rajaso vidur viśve devāso adruhaḥ
children.translated_text: Those great, undeceiving gods, all of them, know the wide region;

children.text: marudbhir agna ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Agni</s>, with the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: ya ugrā arkam ānṛcur anādhṛṣṭāsa ojasā
children.translated_text: Those fierce ones who have chanted the hymn, irresistible in their force,

children.text: marudbhir agna ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Agni</s>, with the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: ye śubhrā ghoravarpasaḥ sukṣatrāso riśādasaḥ
children.translated_text: Those bright ones, terrible in form, strong-ruling, man-slaying,

children.text: marudbhir agna ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Agni</s>, with the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: ye nākasyādhi rocane divi devāsa āsate
children.translated_text: Those gods who sit in heaven upon the shining height of the firmament,

children.text: marudbhir agna ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Agni</s>, with the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: ya īṅkhayanti parvatān tiraḥ samudram arṇavam
children.translated_text: Those who shake the mountains and cross over the billowing sea,

children.text: marudbhir agna ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Agni</s>, with the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: ā ye tanvanti raśmibhis tiraḥ samudram ojasā
children.translated_text: Those who stretch themselves with rays, by their force, across the sea,

children.text: marudbhir agna ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Agni</s>, with the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: abhi tvā pūrvapītaye sṛjāmi somyam madhu
children.translated_text: For your first drinking I pour out the Soma-honey for you;

children.text: marudbhir agna ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Agni</s>, with the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: Chapter 20
ayaṃ devāya janmane stomo viprebhir āsayā
children.translated_text: This praise, fashioned by inspired poets with their mouth, has been made for the divine race,

children.text: akāri ratnadhātamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: most rich in treasures.

children.text: ya indrāya vacoyujā tatakṣur manasā harī
children.translated_text: Those who, with speech yoked to thought, fashioned the two bay horses for <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: śamībhir yajñam āśata ||
children.translated_text: reached the sacrifice through their labors.

children.text: takṣan nāsatyābhyām parijmānaṃ sukhaṃ ratham
children.translated_text: They fashioned for the <s>Nāsatyas</s> a well-running chariot that goes around,

children.text: takṣan dhenuṃ sabardughām ||
children.translated_text: and they fashioned the cow that milks all together.

children.text: yuvānā pitarā punaḥ satyamantrā ṛjūyavaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Ṛbhus</s>, true in counsel and straight in purpose, made their aged parents young again

children.text: ṛbhavo viṣṭy akrata ||
children.translated_text: in the service.

children.text: saṃ vo madāso agmatendreṇa ca marutvatā
children.translated_text: Let your exhilarations come together with <s>Indra</s>, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: ādityebhiś ca rājabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: and with the kingly <s>Ādityas</s>.

children.text: uta tyaṃ camasaṃ navaṃ tvaṣṭur devasya niṣkṛtam
children.translated_text: And that new cup, made by the god <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>,

children.text: akarta caturaḥ punaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you made again into four.

children.text: te no ratnāni dhattana trir ā sāptāni sunvate
children.translated_text: Place treasures for us, three times seven, for the Soma-presser,

children.text: ekam ekaṃ suśastibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: each one accompanied by fair praises.

children.text: adhārayanta vahnayo 'bhajanta sukṛtyayā
children.translated_text: The bearers upheld it and, through good work, shared out

children.text: bhāgaṃ deveṣu yajñiyam ||
children.translated_text: the sacrificial portion among the gods.

children.text: Chapter 21
ihendrāgnī upa hvaye tayor it stomam uśmasi
children.translated_text: Here I call <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> near; we desire praise for those two.

children.text: tā somaṃ somapātamā ||
children.translated_text: May those two, the best Soma-drinkers, drink the Soma.

children.text: tā yajñeṣu pra śaṃsatendrāgnī śumbhatā naraḥ
children.translated_text: Praise those two in the sacrifices; adorn <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, O men.

children.text: tā gāyatreṣu gāyata ||
children.translated_text: Sing those two in the Gāyatra chants.

children.text: tā mitrasya praśastaya indrāgnī tā havāmahe
children.translated_text: Those two are the praised ones of <s>Mitra</s>; we call those two, <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: somapā somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: the Soma-drinkers, for the drinking of Soma.

children.text: ugrā santā havāmaha upedaṃ savanaṃ sutam
children.translated_text: Though fierce, we call upon you; come near to this pressed soma-libation,

children.text: indrāgnī eha gacchatām ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, come here.

children.text: tā mahāntā sadaspatī indrāgnī rakṣa ubjatam
children.translated_text: You two great lords of the sacred seat, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, drive away the demons;

children.text: aprajāḥ santv atriṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let the devourers be without offspring.

children.text: tena satyena jāgṛtam adhi pracetune pade
children.translated_text: By that truth, keep watch in the station appointed for the mindful one;

children.text: indrāgnī śarma yacchatam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, grant shelter.

children.text: Chapter 22
prātaryujā vi bodhayāśvināv eha gacchatām
children.translated_text: Awaken the two <s>Aśvins</s>, yoked at dawn; let them come here,

children.text: asya somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: to drink this soma.

children.text: yā surathā rathītamobhā devā divispṛśā
children.translated_text: Those two with good chariots, best of charioteers, both gods touching heaven,

children.text: aśvinā tā havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: those <s>Aśvins</s> we call upon.

children.text: yā vāṃ kaśā madhumaty aśvinā sūnṛtāvatī
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, with that honey-sweet whip of yours, rich in kindly speech,

children.text: tayā yajñam mimikṣatam ||
children.translated_text: sprinkle and enliven the sacrifice.

children.text: nahi vām asti dūrake yatrā rathena gacchathaḥ
children.translated_text: For there is no far distance for you, wherever you go with your chariot,

children.text: aśvinā somino gṛham ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, to the house of the soma-presser.

children.text: hiraṇyapāṇim ūtaye savitāram upa hvaye
children.translated_text: For aid I call upon <s>Savitṛ</s> of the golden hands;

children.text: sa cettā devatā padam ||
children.translated_text: he knows the divine station.

children.text: apāṃ napātam avase savitāram upa stuhi
children.translated_text: For help, praise <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s> and <s>Savitṛ</s>;

children.text: tasya vratāny uśmasi ||
children.translated_text: we desire his ordinances.

children.text: vibhaktāraṃ havāmahe vasoś citrasya rādhasaḥ
children.translated_text: We call upon the distributor of wondrous, splendid wealth,

children.text: savitāraṃ nṛcakṣasam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Savitṛ</s>, who beholds men.

children.text: sakhāya ā ni ṣīdata savitā stomyo nu naḥ
children.translated_text: Friends, sit down here; <s>Savitṛ</s> is now worthy of our hymn;

children.text: dātā rādhāṃsi śumbhati ||
children.translated_text: as giver, he adorns the bounties.

children.text: agne patnīr ihā vaha devānām uśatīr upa
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, bring here the wives of the gods, the eager ones,

children.text: tvaṣṭāraṃ somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, for the drinking of soma.

children.text: ā gnā agna ihāvase hotrāṃ yaviṣṭha bhāratīm
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, youngest one, bring the divine ladies here for help: <s>Bhāratī</s> with the priestly invocation,

children.text: varūtrīṃ dhiṣaṇāṃ vaha ||
children.translated_text: <s>Varūtrī</s>, and <s>Dhiṣaṇā</s>.

children.text: abhi no devīr avasā mahaḥ śarmaṇā nṛpatnīḥ
children.translated_text: May the goddesses, with aid and with great shelter, the wives of the lords, come toward us,

children.text: acchinnapatrāḥ sacantām ||
children.translated_text: with unbroken wings, and attend us.

children.text: ihendrāṇīm upa hvaye varuṇānīṃ svastaye
children.translated_text: Here I call upon <s>Indrāṇī</s> for favor, upon <s>Varuṇānī</s> for well-being,

children.text: agnāyīṃ somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: and upon <s>Agnāyī</s> for the drinking of soma.

children.text: mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca na imaṃ yajñam mimikṣatām
children.translated_text: May mighty Heaven and Earth join and enrich this sacrifice for us;

children.text: pipṛtāṃ no bharīmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: may they fill us with their nourishments.

children.text: tayor id ghṛtavat payo viprā rihanti dhītibhiḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired priests lick up the ghee-rich milk of those two with their thoughts,

children.text: gandharvasya dhruve pade ||
children.translated_text: in the fixed station of the <s>Gandharva</s>.

children.text: syonā pṛthivi bhavānṛkṣarā niveśanī
children.translated_text: Be kindly for us, O Earth, free from thorns and a place of dwelling;

children.text: yacchā naḥ śarma saprathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: grant us broad shelter.

children.text: ato devā avantu no yato viṣṇur vicakrame
children.translated_text: From there may the gods help us, from where <s>Viṣṇu</s> strode out,

children.text: pṛthivyāḥ sapta dhāmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: with the seven stations of the earth.

children.text: idaṃ viṣṇur vi cakrame tredhā ni dadhe padam
children.translated_text: This <s>Viṣṇu</s> strode forth; in three ways he set down his step,

children.text: samūḍham asya pāṃsure ||
children.translated_text: his trace gathered in the dust.

children.text: trīṇi padā vi cakrame viṣṇur gopā adābhyaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the guardian, the undeceivable one, strode out three steps,

children.text: ato dharmāṇi dhārayan ||
children.translated_text: and from there upheld the ordinances.

children.text: viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata yato vratāni paspaśe
children.translated_text: Behold the deeds of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, from which he has measured out the sacred ordinances,

children.text: indrasya yujyaḥ sakhā ||
children.translated_text: he who is <s>Indra</s>'s fitting companion and friend.

children.text: tad viṣṇoḥ paramam padaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ
children.translated_text: The seers always behold that highest station of <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: divīva cakṣur ātatam ||
children.translated_text: like an eye stretched out in heaven.

children.text: tad viprāso vipanyavo jāgṛvāṃsaḥ sam indhate
children.translated_text: The inspired, praising poets, ever wakeful, kindle and make manifest

children.text: viṣṇor yat paramam padam ||
children.translated_text: that highest station of <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

children.text: Chapter 23
tīvrāḥ somāsa ā gahy āśīrvantaḥ sutā ime
children.translated_text: The strong somas have been pressed, rich with blessings; come to them,

children.text: vāyo tān prasthitān piba ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s>; drink them as they are set forth.

children.text: ubhā devā divispṛśendravāyū havāmahe
children.translated_text: We call upon both gods who touch heaven, <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>,

children.text: asya somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: to drink this soma.

children.text: indravāyū manojuvā viprā havanta ūtaye
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>, swift as thought, the inspired priests call you for aid,

children.text: sahasrākṣā dhiyas patī ||
children.translated_text: thousand-eyed lords of insight.

children.text: mitraṃ vayaṃ havāmahe varuṇaṃ somapītaye
children.translated_text: We call upon <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> for the drinking of soma,

children.text: jajñānā pūtadakṣasā ||
children.translated_text: born with purified skill.

children.text: ṛtena yāv ṛtāvṛdhāv ṛtasya jyotiṣas patī
children.translated_text: Those two who, by truth, increase truth, lords of the light of truth,

children.text: tā mitrāvaruṇā huve ||
children.translated_text: those <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> I invoke.

children.text: varuṇaḥ prāvitā bhuvan mitro viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Varuṇa</s> be a helper; may <s>Mitra</s>, with all aids,

children.text: karatāṃ naḥ surādhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: make us rich in excellent gifts.

children.text: marutvantaṃ havāmaha indram ā somapītaye
children.translated_text: We call upon <s>Indra</s> accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, here for the drinking of soma;

children.text: sajūr gaṇena tṛmpatu ||
children.translated_text: let him be satisfied together with the troop.

children.text: indrajyeṣṭhā marudgaṇā devāsaḥ pūṣarātayaḥ
children.translated_text: May the hosts of the <s>Maruts</s>, with <s>Indra</s> as chief, the gods whose gifts are from <s>Pūṣan</s>,

children.text: viśve mama śrutā havam ||
children.translated_text: all hear my call.

children.text: hata vṛtraṃ sudānava indreṇa sahasā yujā
children.translated_text: Slay <s>Vṛtra</s>, O generous ones, joined with <s>Indra</s>'s force;

children.text: mā no duḥśaṃsa īśata ||
children.translated_text: let no evil-speaking foe have power over us.

children.text: viśvān devān havāmahe marutaḥ somapītaye
children.translated_text: We call upon all the gods and the <s>Maruts</s> for the drinking of soma,

children.text: ugrā hi pṛśnimātaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: for they are mighty, the sons of <s>Pṛśni</s>.

children.text: jayatām iva tanyatur marutām eti dhṛṣṇuyā
children.translated_text: Like a conqueror's thunder, the roar of the <s>Maruts</s> comes with bold force,

children.text: yacchubhaṃ yāthanā naraḥ ||
children.translated_text: when, O heroes, you go in splendor.

children.text: haskārād vidyutas pary ato jātā avantu naḥ
children.translated_text: Born from the flash of lightning and from its cry, may they help us from there;

children.text: maruto mṛḍayantu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: may the <s>Maruts</s> be gracious to us.

children.text: ā pūṣañcitrabarhiṣam āghṛṇe dharuṇaṃ divaḥ
children.translated_text: O radiant <s>Pūṣan</s>, bring here <s>Citrabarhis</s>, the support of heaven,

children.text: ājā naṣṭaṃ yathā paśum ||
children.translated_text: as one brings back a lost animal.

children.text: pūṣā rājānam āghṛṇir apagūḍhaṃ guhā hitam
children.translated_text: Radiant <s>Pūṣan</s> found King <s>Citrabarhis</s>,

children.text: avindac citrabarhiṣam ||
children.translated_text: hidden away and placed in a secret place.

children.text: uto sa mahyam indubhiḥ ṣaḍ yuktāṁ anuseṣidhat
children.translated_text: And he, with drops of soma, set six yoked ones following for me;

children.text: gobhir yavaṃ na carkṛṣat ||
children.translated_text: with cows he plowed up barley, as it were.

children.text: ambayo yanty adhvabhir jāmayo adhvarīyatām
children.translated_text: The mothers go along their paths, the sisters of those performing the rite,

children.text: pṛñcatīr madhunā payaḥ ||
children.translated_text: mixing the milk with honey.

children.text: amūr yā upa sūrye yābhir vā sūryaḥ saha
children.translated_text: Those waters that are near the sun, and those with which the sun is together,

children.text: tā no hinvantv adhvaram ||
children.translated_text: may they impel our rite.

children.text: apo devīr upa hvaye yatra gāvaḥ pibanti naḥ
children.translated_text: I call upon the divine waters, where our cows drink;

children.text: sindhubhyaḥ kartvaṃ haviḥ ||
children.translated_text: an oblation is to be made to the rivers.

children.text: apsv antar amṛtam apsu bheṣajam apām uta praśastaye
children.translated_text: In the waters is nectar; in the waters is medicine; for the praise of the waters,

children.text: devā bhavata vājinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O gods, become vigorous for us.

children.text: apsu me somo abravīd antar viśvāni bheṣajā
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> told me: within the waters are all remedies,

children.text: agniṃ ca viśvaśambhuvam āpaś ca viśvabheṣajīḥ ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Agni</s>, beneficent to all, and the waters, healers of all.

children.text: āpaḥ pṛṇīta bheṣajaṃ varūthaṃ tanve mama
children.translated_text: O waters, fill me with medicine, a protection for my body,

children.text: jyok ca sūryaṃ dṛśe ||
children.translated_text: so that I may see the sun for a long time.

children.text: idam āpaḥ pra vahata yat kiṃ ca duritam mayi
children.translated_text: O waters, carry away whatever evil is in me,

children.text: yad vāham abhidudroha yad vā śepa utānṛtam ||
children.translated_text: whether I have acted treacherously, or whether I have sworn a false oath.

children.text: āpo adyānv acāriṣaṃ rasena sam agasmahi
children.translated_text: Today I have gone down to the waters; we have joined with their essence.

children.text: payasvān agna ā gahi tam mā saṃ sṛja varcasā ||
children.translated_text: Come here, O <s>Agni</s>, rich in nourishment; join me with splendor.

children.text: sam māgne varcasā sṛja sam prajayā sam āyuṣā
children.translated_text: Join me, O <s>Agni</s>, with splendor; join me with offspring and with length of life.

children.text: vidyur me asya devā indro vidyāt saha ṛṣibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the gods know this of me; may <s>Indra</s> know it together with the seers.

children.text: Chapter 24
kasya nūnaṃ katamasyāmṛtānām manāmahe cāru devasya nāma
children.translated_text: Whose now, which lovely name of which god among the immortals shall we call to mind?

children.text: ko no mahyā aditaye punar dāt pitaraṃ ca dṛśeyam mātaraṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: Who will give us back to great <s>Aditi</s>, so that I may see father and mother?

children.text: agner vayam prathamasyāmṛtānām manāmahe cāru devasya nāma
children.translated_text: We call to mind the lovely name of <s>Agni</s>, the first among the immortals;

children.text: sa no mahyā aditaye punar dāt pitaraṃ ca dṛśeyam mātaraṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: may he give us back to great <s>Aditi</s>, so that I may see father and mother.

children.text: abhi tvā deva savitar īśānaṃ vāryāṇām
children.translated_text: To you, O god <s>Savitar</s>, lord of desirable things,

children.text: sadāvan bhāgam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: O constant giver, we appeal for a share.

children.text: yaś ciddhi ta itthā bhagaḥ śaśamānaḥ purā nidaḥ
children.translated_text: For whatever share of yours, O <s>Bhaga</s>, is thus praised before censure,

children.text: adveṣo hastayor dadhe ||
children.translated_text: I have placed it in my two hands, free from hostility.

children.text: bhagabhaktasya te vayam ud aśema tavāvasā
children.translated_text: By your aid may we, devoted to <s>Bhaga</s>, rise up;

children.text: mūrdhānaṃ rāya ārabhe ||
children.translated_text: I lay hold of the head of wealth.

children.text: nahi te kṣatraṃ na saho na manyuṃ vayaś canāmī patayanta āpuḥ
children.translated_text: Neither your sovereign power, nor your might, nor your wrath have the birds in flight attained,

children.text: nemā āpo animiṣaṃ carantīr na ye vātasya praminanty abhvam ||
children.translated_text: nor these waters moving sleeplessly, nor those who diminish the force of the wind.

children.text: abudhne rājā varuṇo vanasyordhvaṃ stūpaṃ dadate pūtadakṣaḥ
children.translated_text: King <s>Varuṇa</s>, pure in insight, has set the top of the forest upward in the bottomless space;

children.text: nīcīnā sthur upari budhna eṣām asme antar nihitāḥ ketavaḥ syuḥ ||
children.translated_text: their roots stand downward above; may their rays be set within us.

children.text: uruṃ hi rājā varuṇaś cakāra sūryāya panthām anvetavā u
children.translated_text: For King <s>Varuṇa</s> made a wide path for the sun to follow;

children.text: apade pādā pratidhātave 'kar utāpavaktā hṛdayāvidhaś cit ||
children.translated_text: for the footless one he made feet to set down, and he is an averter even of the heart-piercing one.

children.text: śataṃ te rājan bhiṣajaḥ sahasram urvī gabhīrā sumatiṣ ṭe astu
children.translated_text: A hundred are your healers, O king, a thousand; may your favor be broad and deep.

children.text: bādhasva dūre nirṛtim parācaiḥ kṛtaṃ cid enaḥ pra mumugdhy asmat ||
children.translated_text: Drive ruin far away; release from us even the sin that has been committed.

children.text: amī ya ṛkṣā nihitāsa uccā naktaṃ dadṛśre kuha cid diveyuḥ
children.translated_text: Those stars set high are seen at night; where do they go by day?

children.text: adabdhāni varuṇasya vratāni vicākaśac candramā naktam eti ||
children.translated_text: The ordinances of <s>Varuṇa</s> are undeceived; the moon shines clearly and goes by night.

children.text: tat tvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānas tad ā śāste yajamāno havirbhiḥ
children.translated_text: To you I come with sacred formulation, worshipping; this the sacrificer seeks with oblations.

children.text: aheḍamāno varuṇeha bodhy uruśaṃsa mā na āyuḥ pra moṣīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Not angered, be mindful here, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, widely praised one; do not steal away our lifetime.

children.text: tad in naktaṃ tad divā mahyam āhus tad ayaṃ keto hṛda ā vi caṣṭe
children.translated_text: This they tell me by night and this by day; this sign speaks clearly in my heart.

children.text: śunaḥśepo yam ahvad gṛbhītaḥ so asmān rājā varuṇo mumoktu ||
children.translated_text: May King <s>Varuṇa</s> release us, whom <s>Śunaḥśepa</s>, seized fast, invoked.

children.text: śunaḥśepo hy ahvad gṛbhītas triṣv ādityaṃ drupadeṣu baddhaḥ
children.translated_text: For <s>Śunaḥśepa</s>, seized and bound to three stakes, called upon the <s>Āditya</s>.

children.text: avainaṃ rājā varuṇaḥ sasṛjyād vidvāṁ adabdho vi mumoktu pāśān ||
children.translated_text: Let King <s>Varuṇa</s> release him; knowing and undeceived, let him loosen the bonds.

children.text: ava te heḍo varuṇa namobhir ava yajñebhir īmahe havirbhiḥ
children.translated_text: With reverences we turn away your anger, O <s>Varuṇa</s>; with sacrifices and oblations we seek to turn it away.

children.text: kṣayann asmabhyam asura pracetā rājann enāṃsi śiśrathaḥ kṛtāni ||
children.translated_text: Dwelling with us, O <s>Asura</s> of insight, O king, loosen the sins we have committed.

children.text: ud uttamaṃ varuṇa pāśam asmad avādhamaṃ vi madhyamaṃ śrathāya
children.translated_text: Loosen from us, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, the upper noose; untie the lower and the middle one.

children.text: athā vayam āditya vrate tavānāgaso aditaye syāma ||
children.translated_text: Then, O <s>Āditya</s>, under your vow, may we be guiltless before <s>Aditi</s>.

children.text: Chapter 25
yacciddhi te viśo yathā pra deva varuṇa vratam
children.translated_text: Even if, like common people, O god <s>Varuṇa</s>, we have transgressed your vow,

children.text: minīmasi dyavi dyavi ||
children.translated_text: day after day,

children.text: mā no vadhāya hatnave jihīḍānasya rīradhaḥ
children.translated_text: do not hand us over to death, to the weapon, while you are angered;

children.text: mā hṛṇānasya manyave ||
children.translated_text: nor to the wrath of one who is enraged.

children.text: vi mṛḍīkāya te mano rathīr aśvaṃ na saṃditam
children.translated_text: For mercy we fasten your mind with songs, O <s>Varuṇa</s>,

children.text: gīrbhir varuṇa sīmahi ||
children.translated_text: as a charioteer fastens a tethered horse.

children.text: parā hi me vimanyavaḥ patanti vasyaiṣṭaye
children.translated_text: For my resentful thoughts fly far away for the winning of wealth,

children.text: vayo na vasatīr upa ||
children.translated_text: like birds toward their resting places.

children.text: kadā kṣatraśriyaṃ naram ā varuṇaṃ karāmahe
children.translated_text: When shall we bring near <s>Varuṇa</s>, the man of royal splendor,

children.text: mṛḍīkāyorucakṣasam ||
children.translated_text: the wide-seeing one, for mercy?

children.text: tad it samānam āśāte venantā na pra yucchataḥ
children.translated_text: The two who desire the same thing do not neglect him,

children.text: dhṛtavratāya dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: the giver who holds firmly to his vows.

children.text: vedā yo vīnām padam antarikṣeṇa patatām
children.translated_text: He knows the track of birds flying through the midspace;

children.text: veda nāvaḥ samudriyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he knows the boats that are upon the sea.

children.text: veda māso dhṛtavrato dvādaśa prajāvataḥ
children.translated_text: The firm-vowed one knows the twelve months with their offspring;

children.text: vedā ya upajāyate ||
children.translated_text: he knows the one that is born besides.

children.text: veda vātasya vartanim uror ṛṣvasya bṛhataḥ
children.translated_text: He knows the path of the wind, broad, lofty, and great;

children.text: vedā ye adhyāsate ||
children.translated_text: he knows those who sit above.

children.text: ni ṣasāda dhṛtavrato varuṇaḥ pastyāsv ā
children.translated_text: Firm-vowed <s>Varuṇa</s>, wise in purpose, has sat down in the dwellings,

children.text: sāmrājyāya sukratuḥ ||
children.translated_text: for sovereignty.

children.text: ato viśvāny adbhutā cikitvāṁ abhi paśyati
children.translated_text: From there, knowing, he looks upon all wonders,

children.text: kṛtāni yā ca kartvā ||
children.translated_text: the deeds already done and those yet to be done.

children.text: sa no viśvāhā sukratur ādityaḥ supathā karat
children.translated_text: May that wise <s>Āditya</s> guide us by good paths on every day;

children.text: pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat ||
children.translated_text: may he carry our lifetimes forward.

children.text: bibhrad drāpiṃ hiraṇyayaṃ varuṇo vasta nirṇijam
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s> wears a golden mantle; he has clothed himself in a shining garment;

children.text: pari spaśo ni ṣedire ||
children.translated_text: his spies have seated themselves all around.

children.text: na yaṃ dipsanti dipsavo na druhvāṇo janānām
children.translated_text: The deceivers do not deceive him, nor the treacherous ones among people,

children.text: na devam abhimātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: nor hostile plots against the god.

children.text: uta yo mānuṣeṣv ā yaśaś cakre asāmy ā
children.translated_text: And he who among human beings has made unsurpassed fame,

children.text: asmākam udareṣv ā ||
children.translated_text: has made it also within our bodies.

children.text: parā me yanti dhītayo gāvo na gavyūtīr anu
children.translated_text: My thoughts go forth like cows along the pasture lands,

children.text: icchantīr urucakṣasam ||
children.translated_text: seeking the wide-seeing one.

children.text: saṃ nu vocāvahai punar yato me madhv ābhṛtam
children.translated_text: Now let us speak together again, from where sweetness has been brought to me;

children.text: hoteva kṣadase priyam ||
children.translated_text: like a hotṛ priest you consume what is dear.

children.text: darśaṃ nu viśvadarśataṃ darśaṃ ratham adhi kṣami
children.translated_text: Now I have seen the one visible to all; I have seen the chariot upon the earth.

children.text: etā juṣata me giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Accept these songs of mine.

children.text: imam me varuṇa śrudhī havam adyā ca mṛḍaya
children.translated_text: Hear this call of mine, O <s>Varuṇa</s>; today be gracious.

children.text: tvām avasyur ā cake ||
children.translated_text: Seeking aid, I call upon you.

children.text: tvaṃ viśvasya medhira divaś ca gmaś ca rājasi
children.translated_text: You, wise one, rule over the whole world, over heaven and over earth;

children.text: sa yāmani prati śrudhi ||
children.translated_text: in your course, hear us in return.

children.text: ud uttamam mumugdhi no vi pāśam madhyamaṃ cṛta
children.translated_text: Free from us the upper noose; loosen the middle one;

children.text: avādhamāni jīvase ||
children.translated_text: set down the lower ones, so that we may live.

children.text: Chapter 26
vasiṣvā hi miyedhya vastrāṇy ūrjām pate
children.translated_text: Put on garments, O worthy one, O lord of nourishment;

children.text: semaṃ no adhvaraṃ yaja ||
children.translated_text: perform this our rite.

children.text: ni no hotā vareṇyaḥ sadā yaviṣṭha manmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: Let the chosen hotṛ sit down for us, always, O youngest one, with thoughts,

children.text: agne divitmatā vacaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, with heaven-bright speech.

children.text: ā hi ṣmā sūnave pitāpir yajaty āpaye
children.translated_text: For as a father for his son, he sacrifices for a kinsman and for a companion,

children.text: sakhā sakhye vareṇyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: a friend in friendship, the chosen one.

children.text: ā no barhī riśādaso varuṇo mitro aryamā
