children.translated_text: Let <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>, destroyers of harm,

children.text: sīdantu manuṣo yathā ||
children.translated_text: sit upon our barhis, as at <s>Manu</s>'s rite.

children.text: pūrvya hotar asya no mandasva sakhyasya ca
children.translated_text: Ancient hotṛ, rejoice in this friendship of ours,

children.text: imā u ṣu śrudhī giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: and listen well to these songs.

children.text: yacciddhi śaśvatā tanā devaṃ devaṃ yajāmahe
children.translated_text: For though, from age-old lineage, we worship god after god,

children.text: tve iddhūyate haviḥ ||
children.translated_text: in you alone the oblation is poured.

children.text: priyo no astu viśpatir hotā mandro vareṇyaḥ
children.translated_text: May the lord of the settlement, the hotṛ, delightful and chosen, be dear to us;

children.text: priyāḥ svagnayo vayam ||
children.translated_text: may we, with good fires, be dear.

children.text: svagnayo hi vāryaṃ devāso dadhire ca naḥ
children.translated_text: For the gods with good fires have bestowed the desirable thing on us,

children.text: svagnayo manāmahe ||
children.translated_text: and we think upon those with good fires.

children.text: athā na ubhayeṣām amṛta martyānām
children.translated_text: Then, O immortal one, may the praises of both, of immortals and of mortals,

children.text: mithaḥ santu praśastayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: be mutual.

children.text: viśvebhir agne agnibhir imaṃ yajñam idaṃ vacaḥ
children.translated_text: With all fires, O <s>Agni</s>, give delight to this sacrifice and this utterance,

children.text: cano dhāḥ sahaso yaho ||
children.translated_text: O son of strength.

children.text: Chapter 27
aśvaṃ na tvā vāravantaṃ vandadhyā agniṃ namobhiḥ
children.translated_text: Like a richly covered horse, we would praise you with reverences, O <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: saṃrājantam adhvarāṇām ||
children.translated_text: sovereign over the rites.

children.text: sa ghā naḥ sūnuḥ śavasā pṛthupragāmā suśevaḥ
children.translated_text: May that son, broad-ranging through his might and gracious,

children.text: mīḍhvāṁ asmākam babhūyāt ||
children.translated_text: the liberal one, become ours.

children.text: sa no dūrāc cāsāc ca ni martyād aghāyoḥ
children.translated_text: May he protect us from afar and from nearby, from the harmful mortal,

children.text: pāhi sadam id viśvāyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: always, he whose life is complete.

children.text: imam ū ṣu tvam asmākaṃ saniṃ gāyatraṃ navyāṃsam
children.translated_text: This winning, newer gāyatra hymn of ours

children.text: agne deveṣu pra vocaḥ ||
children.translated_text: proclaim, O <s>Agni</s>, among the gods.

children.text: ā no bhaja parameṣv ā vājeṣu madhyameṣu
children.translated_text: Apportion us a share among the highest prizes, and among the middle ones;

children.text: śikṣā vasvo antamasya ||
children.translated_text: teach us the inmost wealth.

children.text: vibhaktāsi citrabhāno sindhor ūrmā upāka ā
children.translated_text: You are the distributor, O bright-radiant one; near at hand like a wave of the <s>Sindhu</s>,

children.text: sadyo dāśuṣe kṣarasi ||
children.translated_text: you flow at once for the worshipper.

children.text: yam agne pṛtsu martyam avā vājeṣu yaṃ junāḥ
children.translated_text: The mortal whom, O <s>Agni</s>, you help in battles, and whom you urge on in contests,

children.text: sa yantā śaśvatīr iṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he becomes the guide of lasting nourishments.

children.text: nakir asya sahantya paryetā kayasya cit
children.translated_text: No overpowering assailant of his, no one at all,

children.text: vājo asti śravāyyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: can go around him; his prize is worthy of fame.

children.text: sa vājaṃ viśvacarṣaṇir arvadbhir astu tarutā
children.translated_text: May he, who belongs to all peoples, cross to the prize with coursers;

children.text: viprebhir astu sanitā ||
children.translated_text: may he be the winner with inspired priests.

children.text: jarābodha tad viviḍḍhi viśe viśe yajñiyāya
children.translated_text: O awakener, know this for the sacrificial one in every clan:

children.text: stomaṃ rudrāya dṛśīkam ||
children.translated_text: a visible praise-song for <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: sa no mahāṁ animāno dhūmaketuḥ puruścandraḥ
children.translated_text: May he, great, without measure, smoke-bannered, and much-bright,

children.text: dhiye vājāya hinvatu ||
children.translated_text: impel us toward inspired thought and toward the prize.

children.text: sa revāṁ iva viśpatir daivyaḥ ketuḥ śṛṇotu naḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s>, rich like a lord of the people, the divine beacon, hear us,

children.text: ukthair agnir bṛhadbhānuḥ ||
children.translated_text: great-radiant through our hymns.

children.text: namo mahadbhyo namo arbhakebhyo namo yuvabhyo nama āśinebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Homage to the great, homage to the small, homage to the young, homage to those seated in age.

children.text: yajāma devān yadi śaknavāma mā jyāyasaḥ śaṃsam ā vṛkṣi devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: We worship the gods if we are able; O gods, may I not cut short the praise of the greater one.

children.text: Chapter 28
yatra grāvā pṛthubudhna ūrdhvo bhavati sotave
children.translated_text: Where the pressing stone, broad-bottomed and upright, is ready for pressing,

children.text: ulūkhalasutānām aved v indra jalgulaḥ ||
children.translated_text: there, O <s>Indra</s>, drink with a gulp of the soma pressed in mortars.

children.text: yatra dvāv iva jaghanādhiṣavaṇyā kṛtā
children.translated_text: Where the two pressing boards are made like two haunches,

children.text: ulūkhalasutānām aved v indra jalgulaḥ ||
children.translated_text: there, O <s>Indra</s>, drink with a gulp of the soma pressed in mortars.

children.text: yatra nāry apacyavam upacyavaṃ ca śikṣate
children.translated_text: Where the woman learns both the downward thrust and the upward thrust,

children.text: ulūkhalasutānām aved v indra jalgulaḥ ||
children.translated_text: there, O <s>Indra</s>, drink with a gulp of the soma pressed in mortars.

children.text: yatra manthāṃ vibadhnate raśmīn yamitavā iva
children.translated_text: Where they fasten the churning staff like reins for one who restrains,

children.text: ulūkhalasutānām aved v indra jalgulaḥ ||
children.translated_text: there, O <s>Indra</s>, drink with a gulp of the soma pressed in mortars.

children.text: yacciddhi tvaṃ gṛhe gṛha ulūkhalaka yujyase
children.translated_text: Even though, little mortar, you are yoked in house after house,

children.text: iha dyumattamaṃ vada jayatām iva dundubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: speak here most brilliantly, like a drum of the victors.

children.text: uta sma te vanaspate vāto vi vāty agram it
children.translated_text: And, O lord of the forest, the wind blows over your very top;

children.text: atho indrāya pātave sunu somam ulūkhala ||
children.translated_text: then, O mortar, press the soma for <s>Indra</s> to drink.

children.text: āyajī vājasātamā tā hy uccā vijarbhṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: Those two are most prize-winning, for they have been lifted high;

children.text: harī ivāndhāṃsi bapsatā ||
children.translated_text: like two bay horses they devour the draughts.

children.text: tā no adya vanaspatī ṛṣvāv ṛṣvebhiḥ sotṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: Today let those two forest-lords, lofty with lofty pressers,

children.text: indrāya madhumat sutam ||
children.translated_text: press the honey-sweet soma for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: ucchiṣṭaṃ camvor bhara somam pavitra ā sṛja
children.translated_text: Carry the remnant from the two vats; send the soma through the filter;

children.text: ni dhehi gor adhi tvaci ||
children.translated_text: set it down upon the cow-hide.

children.text: Chapter 29
yacciddhi satya somapā anāśastā iva smasi
children.translated_text: Even if, O true soma-drinker, we are as though without praise,

children.text: ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣv aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Indra</s>, make us renowned among cows, horses, bright possessions, and thousands, O very bountiful one.

children.text: śiprin vājānām pate śacīvas tava daṃsanā
children.translated_text: O <s>Śiprin</s>, lord of prizes, rich in power are your mighty acts;

children.text: ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣv aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Indra</s>, make us renowned among cows, horses, bright possessions, and thousands, O very bountiful one.

children.text: ni ṣvāpayā mithūdṛśā sastām abudhyamāne
children.translated_text: Put to sleep the pair that look at each other; let them sleep without waking;

children.text: ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣv aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Indra</s>, make us renowned among cows, horses, bright possessions, and thousands, O very bountiful one.

children.text: sasantu tyā arātayo bodhantu śūra rātayaḥ
children.translated_text: Let those hostile ones sleep; let gifts awaken, O hero;

children.text: ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣv aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Indra</s>, make us renowned among cows, horses, bright possessions, and thousands, O very bountiful one.

children.text: sam indra gardabham mṛṇa nuvantam pāpayāmuyā
children.translated_text: Crush, O <s>Indra</s>, the braying donkey with the most evil weapon;

children.text: ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣv aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Indra</s>, make us renowned among cows, horses, bright possessions, and thousands, O very bountiful one.

children.text: patāti kuṇḍṛṇācyā dūraṃ vāto vanād adhi
children.translated_text: By <s>Kuṇḍṛṇācī</s> may the wind fly far away from the forest;

children.text: ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣv aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Indra</s>, make us renowned among cows, horses, bright possessions, and thousands, O very bountiful one.

children.text: sarvam parikrośaṃ jahi jambhayā kṛkadāśvam
children.translated_text: Strike down all the shouting around us; make <s>Kṛkadāśva</s> numb;

children.text: ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣv aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Indra</s>, make us renowned among cows, horses, bright possessions, and thousands, O very bountiful one.

children.text: Chapter 30
ā va indraṃ kriviṃ yathā vājayantaḥ śatakratum
children.translated_text: Pour in <s>Indra</s>, as into a skin, as you strive for the prize, the hundred-powered one;

children.text: maṃhiṣṭhaṃ siñca indubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: sprinkle the most bounteous one with soma drops.

children.text: śataṃ vā yaḥ śucīnāṃ sahasraṃ vā samāśirām
children.translated_text: Whether a hundred pure drops, or a thousand mixed with milk,

children.text: ed u nimnaṃ na rīyate ||
children.translated_text: he does not at all flow down to the low place.

children.text: saṃ yan madāya śuṣmiṇa enā hy asyodare
children.translated_text: When this has gathered for exhilaration for the powerful one, there in his belly

children.text: samudro na vyaco dadhe ||
children.translated_text: it has set breadth like the sea.

children.text: ayam u te sam atasi kapota iva garbhadhim
children.translated_text: This one comes together for you like a dove to its nest;

children.text: vacas tac cin na ohase ||
children.translated_text: even that word of ours you do not heed.

children.text: stotraṃ rādhānām pate girvāho vīra yasya te
children.translated_text: O lord of gifts, song-loving hero, may the praise-song

children.text: vibhūtir astu sūnṛtā ||
children.translated_text: be your truthful manifestation.

children.text: ūrdhvas tiṣṭhā na ūtaye 'smin vāje śatakrato
children.translated_text: Stand upright for our help in this contest, O hundred-powered one;

children.text: sam anyeṣu bravāvahai ||
children.translated_text: let us speak together among the others.

children.text: yoge yoge tavastaraṃ vāje vāje havāmahe
children.translated_text: At every yoking, at every prize, we call upon the stronger one,

children.text: sakhāya indram ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: we friends upon <s>Indra</s> for aid.

children.text: ā ghā gamad yadi śravat sahasriṇībhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: May he indeed come, if he has heard, with thousandfold aids,

children.text: vājebhir upa no havam ||
children.translated_text: with prizes, to our invocation.

children.text: anu pratnasyaukaso huve tuvipratiṃ naram
children.translated_text: I call after the man of ancient dwelling, mighty in resistance,

children.text: yaṃ te pūrvam pitā huve ||
children.translated_text: whom your father invoked before.

children.text: taṃ tvā vayaṃ viśvavārā śāsmahe puruhūta
children.translated_text: You, desired by all, we address, O much-invoked one,

children.text: sakhe vaso jaritṛbhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O friend, O good one, for the singers.

children.text: asmākaṃ śipriṇīnāṃ somapāḥ somapāvnām
children.translated_text: Of us, the soma-drinkers and soma-pressers,

children.text: sakhe vajrin sakhīnām ||
children.translated_text: be the friend, O <s>Vajrin</s>, of your friends.

children.text: tathā tad astu somapāḥ sakhe vajrin tathā kṛṇu
children.translated_text: So let that be, O soma-drinker; O friend, O <s>Vajrin</s>, make it so,

children.text: yathā ta uśmasīṣṭaye ||
children.translated_text: as we desire you for aid.

children.text: revatīr naḥ sadhamāda indre santu tuvivājāḥ
children.translated_text: May rich shared feasts with <s>Indra</s>, abounding in prizes, be ours,

children.text: kṣumanto yābhir madema ||
children.translated_text: possessing food, by which we may rejoice.

children.text: ā gha tvāvān tmanāpta stotṛbhyo dhṛṣṇav iyānaḥ
children.translated_text: Come indeed, strong as you are, self-attained, boldly advancing to the praisers;

children.text: ṛṇor akṣaṃ na cakryoḥ ||
children.translated_text: loosen the axle, as of two wheels.

children.text: ā yad duvaḥ śatakratav ā kāmaṃ jaritṝṇām
children.translated_text: When, O hundred-powered one, you come to the service and to the desire of the singers,

children.text: ṛṇor akṣaṃ na śacībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: loosen the axle, as with your powers.

children.text: śaśvad indraḥ popruthadbhir jigāya nānadadbhiḥ śāśvasadbhir dhanāni
children.translated_text: Again and again <s>Indra</s> has won the riches with snorting, roaring, rushing powers;

children.text: sa no hiraṇyarathaṃ daṃsanāvān sa naḥ sanitā sanaye sa no 'dāt ||
children.translated_text: may he of the golden chariot and mighty acts be our winner; may he give it to us for winning.

children.text: āśvināv aśvāvatyeṣā yātaṃ śavīrayā
children.translated_text: Come, O <s>Aśvins</s>, to this horse-rich offering with strong heroism,

children.text: gomad dasrā hiraṇyavat ||
children.translated_text: rich in cows, O wondrous ones, and rich in gold.

children.text: samānayojano hi vāṃ ratho dasrāv amartyaḥ
children.translated_text: For the immortal chariot yoked in common for you two, O wonder-workers,

children.text: samudre aśvineyate ||
children.translated_text: goes to the <s>Aśvins</s> upon the sea.

children.text: ny aghnyasya mūrdhani cakraṃ rathasya yemathuḥ
children.translated_text: On the head of the cow not to be slain you two have held the wheel of the chariot;

children.text: pari dyām anyad īyate ||
children.translated_text: the other one goes around heaven.

children.text: kas ta uṣaḥ kadhapriye bhuje marto amartye
children.translated_text: Who, O <s>Uṣas</s>, lover of delight, what mortal, O immortal one, shares in your bounty?

children.text: kaṃ nakṣase vibhāvari ||
children.translated_text: Whom do you seek out, O radiant one?

children.text: vayaṃ hi te amanmahy āntād ā parākāt
children.translated_text: For we have thought of you from near and from far,

children.text: aśve na citre aruṣi ||
children.translated_text: as of a bright ruddy mare.

children.text: tvaṃ tyebhir ā gahi vājebhir duhitar divaḥ
children.translated_text: Come with those prizes, O daughter of heaven,

children.text: asme rayiṃ ni dhāraya ||
children.translated_text: and set wealth down for us.

children.text: Chapter 31
tvam agne prathamo aṅgirā ṛṣir devo devānām abhavaḥ śivaḥ sakhā
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, first <s>Aṅgiras</s>, seer and god, became the auspicious friend of the gods.

children.text: tava vrate kavayo vidmanāpaso 'jāyanta maruto bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Under your command the inspired poets, wise in their works, were born as <s>Maruts</s> of gleaming appearance.

children.text: tvam agne prathamo aṅgirastamaḥ kavir devānām pari bhūṣasi vratam
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, first and most <s>Aṅgiras</s>-like, as poet adorn the ordinance of the gods.

children.text: vibhur viśvasmai bhuvanāya medhiro dvimātā śayuḥ katidhā cid āyave ||
children.translated_text: Wide-reaching and wise for the whole world, with two mothers, you rest in many ways for living man.

children.text: tvam agne prathamo mātariśvana āvir bhava sukratūyā vivasvate
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, first revealed yourself to <s>Mātariśvan</s>, through good purpose, for <s>Vivasvat</s>.

children.text: arejetāṃ rodasī hotṛvūrye 'saghnor bhāram ayajo maho vaso ||
children.translated_text: The two worlds trembled at the might of the Hotṛ; unfailing, O great good one, you bore the burden and performed sacrifice.

children.text: tvam agne manave dyām avāśayaḥ purūravase sukṛte sukṛttaraḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, made heaven shine for <s>Manu</s>; for <s>Purūravas</s>, the doer of good, you did still better.

children.text: śvātreṇa yat pitror mucyase pary ā tvā pūrvam anayann āparam punaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When you are released by the swift one from your two parents, they led you first around and then back again.

children.text: tvam agne vṛṣabhaḥ puṣṭivardhana udyatasruce bhavasi śravāyyaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are the bull who increases nourishment, with upraised flame, worthy of fame.

children.text: ya āhutim pari vedā vaṣaṭkṛtim ekāyur agre viśa āvivāsasi ||
children.translated_text: Knowing the oblation and the vaṣaṭ-call, of single life, at the forefront you attend upon the peoples.

children.text: tvam agne vṛjinavartaniṃ naraṃ sakman piparṣi vidathe vicarṣaṇe
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, carry the man on the crooked path all together through the gathering, O one attentive to people,

children.text: yaḥ śūrasātā paritakmye dhane dabhrebhiś cit samṛtā haṃsi bhūyasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the man who, in the winning of heroes and in the circling prize, strikes down the many assembled even with few allies.

children.text: tvaṃ tam agne amṛtatva uttame martaṃ dadhāsi śravase dive dive
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, place that mortal in highest immortality, in glory day by day,

children.text: yas tātṛṣāṇa ubhayāya janmane mayaḥ kṛṇoṣi praya ā ca sūraye ||
children.translated_text: the one who thirsts for both births; you make delight and nourishment for the inspired man.

children.text: tvaṃ no agne sanaye dhanānāṃ yaśasaṃ kāruṃ kṛṇuhi stavānaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, praised by us, make the singer famous for the winning of riches.

children.text: ṛdhyāma karmāpasā navena devair dyāvāpṛthivī prāvataṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we prosper through new work and labor; O <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, protect us together with the gods.

children.text: tvaṃ no agne pitror upastha ā devo deveṣv anavadya jāgṛviḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are in the lap of the two parents, a god among the gods, blameless and wakeful.

children.text: tanūkṛd bodhi pramatiś ca kārave tvaṃ kalyāṇa vasu viśvam opiṣe ||
children.translated_text: Be maker of the body and wise guidance for the singer; you, auspicious one, encompass all wealth.

children.text: tvam agne pramatis tvam pitāsi nas tvaṃ vayaskṛt tava jāmayo vayam
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are our guiding thought; you are our father; you are maker of vigor, and we are your kin.

children.text: saṃ tvā rāyaḥ śatinaḥ saṃ sahasriṇaḥ suvīraṃ yanti vratapām adābhya ||
children.translated_text: Riches in hundreds and in thousands come together to you, rich in good heroes, O undeceived guardian of the ordinance.

children.text: tvām agne prathamam āyum āyave devā akṛṇvan nahuṣasya viśpatim
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, the gods made the first life for <s>Āyu</s>, the house-lord of <s>Nahuṣa</s>.

children.text: iḍām akṛṇvan manuṣasya śāsanīm pitur yat putro mamakasya jāyate ||
children.translated_text: They made <s>Iḍā</s> the instructress of <s>Manu</s>, when the son of his own father is born.

children.text: tvaṃ no agne tava deva pāyubhir maghono rakṣa tanvaś ca vandya
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, with your protections, O god, guard the generous man and our body, O praiseworthy one.

children.text: trātā tokasya tanaye gavām asy animeṣaṃ rakṣamāṇas tava vrate ||
children.translated_text: As protector of child, offspring, and cattle, you guard without blinking within your ordinance.

children.text: tvam agne yajyave pāyur antaro 'niṣaṅgāya caturakṣa idhyase
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are kindled as the inner guardian for the sacrificer and for the unarmed man, four-eyed one;

children.text: yo rātahavyo 'vṛkāya dhāyase kīreś cin mantram manasā vanoṣi tam ||
children.translated_text: you attend in mind even to the singer's hymn, to him whose oblations are given and who is unharmed.

children.text: tvam agna uruśaṃsāya vāghate spārhaṃ yad rekṇaḥ paramaṃ vanoṣi tat
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, win for the widely praised singer that desirable thing, the supreme treasure.

children.text: ādhrasya cit pramatir ucyase pitā pra pākaṃ śāssi pra diśo viduṣṭaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even of the needy man you are called guidance and father; you instruct the simple one and the quarters, being wiser.

children.text: tvam agne prayatadakṣiṇaṃ naraṃ varmeva syūtam pari pāsi viśvataḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, protect on every side the man who gives prepared gifts, like sewn armor,

children.text: svādukṣadmā yo vasatau syonakṛj jīvayājaṃ yajate sopamā divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the one who, having a sweet dwelling and making the home pleasant, worships with a life-giving sacrifice, having heaven as his likeness.

children.text: imām agne śaraṇim mīmṛṣo na imam adhvānaṃ yam agāma dūrāt
children.translated_text: Look kindly, O <s>Agni</s>, on this refuge of ours, on this road by which we have come from afar.

children.text: āpiḥ pitā pramatiḥ somyānām bhṛmir asy ṛṣikṛn martyānām ||
children.translated_text: You are friend, father, and guiding thought of the Soma-pressers; you are the supporter and maker of seers among mortals.

children.text: manuṣvad agne aṅgirasvad aṅgiro yayātivat sadane pūrvavacchuce
children.translated_text: Like <s>Manu</s>, like <s>Aṅgiras</s>, O <s>Agni</s> <s>Aṅgiras</s>, like <s>Yayāti</s>, in the ancient seat, O shining one,

children.text: accha yāhy ā vahā daivyaṃ janam ā sādaya barhiṣi yakṣi ca priyam ||
children.translated_text: come hither; bring the divine people; seat them on the sacred grass and sacrifice to the beloved one.

children.text: etenāgne brahmaṇā vāvṛdhasva śaktī vā yat te cakṛmā vidā vā
children.translated_text: By this sacred formulation, O <s>Agni</s>, grow strong, whether by power or by knowledge we have made it for you.

children.text: uta pra ṇeṣy abhi vasyo asmān saṃ naḥ sṛja sumatyā vājavatyā ||
children.translated_text: And lead us onward toward better fortune; join us with favorable, prize-winning thought.

children.text: Chapter 32
indrasya nu vīryāṇi pra vocaṃ yāni cakāra prathamāni vajrī
children.translated_text: Now I shall proclaim the heroic deeds of <s>Indra</s>, the first ones that the wielder of the vajra (thunderbolt) performed:

children.text: ahann ahim anv apas tatarda pra vakṣaṇā abhinat parvatānām ||
children.translated_text: he slew the serpent, pierced open the waters, and split apart the bellies of the mountains.

children.text: ahann ahim parvate śiśriyāṇaṃ tvaṣṭāsmai vajraṃ svaryaṃ tatakṣa
children.translated_text: He slew the serpent lying upon the mountain; <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> fashioned for him the resounding vajra (thunderbolt).

children.text: vāśrā iva dhenavaḥ syandamānā añjaḥ samudram ava jagmur āpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like lowing cows, the waters, streaming, went straight down to the ocean.

children.text: vṛṣāyamāṇo 'vṛṇīta somaṃ trikadrukeṣv apibat sutasya
children.translated_text: Acting like a bull, he chose the Soma; at the three libations he drank of the pressed Soma.

children.text: ā sāyakam maghavādatta vajram ahann enam prathamajām ahīnām ||
children.translated_text: The bountiful one took up the missile, the vajra (thunderbolt); he slew this first-born of the serpents.

children.text: yad indrāhan prathamajām ahīnām ān māyinām amināḥ prota māyāḥ
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indra</s>, you slew the first-born of the serpents, then you destroyed the spells of the spell-makers;

children.text: āt sūryaṃ janayan dyām uṣāsaṃ tādītnā śatruṃ na kilā vivitse ||
children.translated_text: then, bringing forth the sun, heaven, and dawn, you found no enemy at all thereafter.

children.text: ahan vṛtraṃ vṛtrataraṃ vyaṃsam indro vajreṇa mahatā vadhena
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> slew <s>Vṛtra</s>, the more Vṛtra-like, shoulderless one, with the great deadly blow of the vajra (thunderbolt).

children.text: skandhāṃsīva kuliśenā vivṛkṇāhiḥ śayata upapṛk pṛthivyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like branches cut apart by an axe, the serpent lay pressed against the earth.

children.text: ayoddheva durmada ā hi juhve mahāvīraṃ tuvibādham ṛjīṣam
children.translated_text: Like a poor fighter, over-mad, he challenged the great hero, the mighty and impetuous one.

children.text: nātārīd asya samṛtiṃ vadhānāṃ saṃ rujānāḥ pipiṣa indraśatruḥ ||
children.translated_text: He did not withstand the clash of his weapons; shattered, the enemy of <s>Indra</s> was crushed.

children.text: apād ahasto apṛtanyad indram āsya vajram adhi sānau jaghāna
children.translated_text: Footless and handless, he fought against <s>Indra</s>; <s>Indra</s> struck the vajra (thunderbolt) upon his ridge.

children.text: vṛṣṇo vadhriḥ pratimānam bubhūṣan purutrā vṛtro aśayad vyastaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Wishing to become the match of the virile one, the gelded <s>Vṛtra</s> lay scattered in many places.

children.text: nadaṃ na bhinnam amuyā śayānam mano ruhāṇā ati yanty āpaḥ
children.translated_text: The waters, rising in mind, pass over him as he lies there, like a broken reed by that stream;

children.text: yāś cid vṛtro mahinā paryatiṣṭhat tāsām ahiḥ patsutaḥśīr babhūva ||
children.translated_text: those waters around which <s>Vṛtra</s> had stood with his greatness: the serpent became one lying at their feet.

children.text: nīcāvayā abhavad vṛtraputrendro asyā ava vadhar jabhāra
children.translated_text: Brought low became the son of <s>Vṛtra</s>; <s>Indra</s> cast down his weapon.

children.text: uttarā sūr adharaḥ putra āsīd dānuḥ śaye sahavatsā na dhenuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The mother was above and the son below; <s>Dānu</s> lay like a cow together with her calf.

children.text: atiṣṭhantīnām aniveśanānāṃ kāṣṭhānām madhye nihitaṃ śarīram
children.translated_text: Among the standing, homeless channels his body was laid in the midst of the streams;

children.text: vṛtrasya niṇyaṃ vi caranty āpo dīrghaṃ tama āśayad indraśatruḥ ||
children.translated_text: the waters move about the hidden place of <s>Vṛtra</s>; the enemy of <s>Indra</s> lay in long darkness.

children.text: dāsapatnīr ahigopā atiṣṭhan niruddhā āpaḥ paṇineva gāvaḥ
children.translated_text: The waters, wives of the Dāsa and guarded by the serpent, stood imprisoned like cows by the <s>Paṇi</s>;

children.text: apām bilam apihitaṃ yad āsīd vṛtraṃ jaghanvāṁ apa tad vavāra ||
children.translated_text: when the opening of the waters had been closed up, having slain <s>Vṛtra</s>, he opened it out.

children.text: aśvyo vāro abhavas tad indra sṛke yat tvā pratyahan deva ekaḥ
children.translated_text: You became, O <s>Indra</s>, the horse's tail when the one god struck back at you with his tusk;

children.text: ajayo gā ajayaḥ śūra somam avāsṛjaḥ sartave sapta sindhūn ||
children.translated_text: you won the cows, O hero, you won the Soma; you released the seven rivers to flow.

children.text: nāsmai vidyun na tanyatuḥ siṣedha na yām miham akiraddhrāduniṃ ca
children.translated_text: Lightning did not check him, nor thunder, nor the mist and hail-storm that he scattered;

children.text: indraś ca yad yuyudhāte ahiś cotāparībhyo maghavā vi jigye ||
children.translated_text: when <s>Indra</s> and the serpent fought, the bountiful one won even over those attacks.

children.text: aher yātāraṃ kam apaśya indra hṛdi yat te jaghnuṣo bhīr agacchat
children.translated_text: What avenger of the serpent did you see, O <s>Indra</s>, when fear came into your heart after you had struck him,

children.text: nava ca yan navatiṃ ca sravantīḥ śyeno na bhīto ataro rajāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: so that, like a frightened falcon, you crossed the ninety-nine flowing rivers and the spaces?

children.text: indro yāto 'vasitasya rājā śamasya ca śṛṅgiṇo vajrabāhuḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, with the thunderbolt in his arm, is king of what moves, of what rests, and of the horned creature;

children.text: sed u rājā kṣayati carṣaṇīnām arān na nemiḥ pari tā babhūva ||
children.translated_text: he alone rules as king over the peoples; like the felly about the spokes, he has encompassed them.

children.text: Chapter 33
etāyāmopa gavyanta indram asmākaṃ su pramatiṃ vāvṛdhāti
children.translated_text: In this desire for cows, approach <s>Indra</s>; may he greatly increase our good favor.

children.text: anāmṛṇaḥ kuvid ād asya rāyo gavāṃ ketam param āvarjate naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Unharmed, may he turn toward us, perhaps, the sign of his riches and of cattle at the highest place.

children.text: uped ahaṃ dhanadām apratītaṃ juṣṭāṃ na śyeno vasatim patāmi
children.translated_text: I approach the wealth-giver, the irresistible one; like a beloved falcon I fly to his dwelling,

children.text: indraṃ namasyann upamebhir arkair ya stotṛbhyo havyo asti yāman ||
children.translated_text: honoring <s>Indra</s> with lofty songs, he who is to be invoked by singers on the way.

children.text: ni sarvasena iṣudhīṃr asakta sam aryo gā ajati yasya vaṣṭi
children.translated_text: He has fastened down all the arrow-quivers; he drives together the Arya's cows, as he wishes.

children.text: coṣkūyamāṇa indra bhūri vāmam mā paṇir bhūr asmad adhi pravṛddha ||
children.translated_text: Being stirred, O <s>Indra</s>, grant much that is lovely; let the <s>Paṇi</s>, grown great, not become lord over us.

children.text: vadhīr hi dasyuṃ dhaninaṃ ghanenaṁ ekaś carann upaśākebhir indra
children.translated_text: For you struck down the wealthy Dasyu with your mace, O <s>Indra</s>, going alone with your companions;

children.text: dhanor adhi viṣuṇak te vy āyann ayajvānaḥ sanakāḥ pretim īyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: from the bow your scattered enemies went apart; the ancient non-sacrificers went to their end.

children.text: parā cicchīrṣā vavṛjus ta indrāyajvāno yajvabhi spardhamānāḥ
children.translated_text: Even with their heads turned away, O <s>Indra</s>, the non-sacrificers, competing with the sacrificers, yielded;

children.text: pra yad divo hariva sthātar ugra nir avratāṁ adhamo rodasyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: when from heaven, O bay-horsed, mighty one, you stood forth and cast the vowless ones down from the two worlds.

children.text: ayuyutsann anavadyasya senām ayātayanta kṣitayo navagvāḥ
children.translated_text: The Navagva clans, wishing to fight, set in motion the army of the blameless one;

children.text: vṛṣāyudho na vadhrayo niraṣṭāḥ pravadbhir indrāc citayanta āyan ||
children.translated_text: like weapon-bearing bulls, not geldings, driven out, they came, making <s>Indra</s> aware with their cries.

children.text: tvam etān rudato jakṣataś cāyodhayo rajasa indra pāre
children.translated_text: You fought those who were crying and gnashing, O <s>Indra</s>, beyond the region;

children.text: avādaho diva ā dasyum uccā pra sunvata stuvataḥ śaṃsam āvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you burned the Dasyu down from heaven on high, and you aided the praise of the Soma-presser who lauded you.

children.text: cakrāṇāsaḥ parīṇaham pṛthivyā hiraṇyena maṇinā śumbhamānāḥ
children.translated_text: Making a circuit around the breadth of the earth, adorned with a golden jewel,

children.text: na hinvānāsas titirus ta indram pari spaśo adadhāt sūryeṇa ||
children.translated_text: though they rushed on, they did not overcome <s>Indra</s>; he set watchers around with the sun.

children.text: pari yad indra rodasī ubhe abubhojīr mahinā viśvataḥ sīm
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indra</s>, you encompassed both heaven and earth on every side with your greatness,

children.text: amanyamānāṁ abhi manyamānair nir brahmabhir adhamo dasyum indra ||
children.translated_text: then, confronting those who thought themselves mighty, O <s>Indra</s>, you drove the Dasyu down with sacred utterances.

children.text: na ye divaḥ pṛthivyā antam āpur na māyābhir dhanadām paryabhūvan
children.translated_text: Those who did not reach the end of heaven and earth, and did not outdo the wealth-giver with their magic powers,

children.text: yujaṃ vajraṃ vṛṣabhaś cakra indro nir jyotiṣā tamaso gā adukṣat ||
children.translated_text: against them <s>Indra</s>, the bull, made the thunderbolt his ally; with light he milked the cows out of darkness.

children.text: anu svadhām akṣarann āpo asyāvardhata madhya ā nāvyānām
children.translated_text: The waters flowed according to his own law; he grew strong in the midst of the navigable streams.

children.text: sadhrīcīnena manasā tam indra ojiṣṭhena hanmanāhann abhi dyūn ||
children.translated_text: With a mind turned the same way, O <s>Indra</s>, you struck him through the days with the mightiest blow.

children.text: ny āvidhyad ilībiśasya dṛḍhā vi śṛṅgiṇam abhinacchuṣṇam indraḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> pierced the firm holds of <s>Ilībiśa</s> and split apart horned <s>Śuṣṇa</s>;

children.text: yāvat taro maghavan yāvadojo vajreṇa śatrum avadhīḥ pṛtanyum ||
children.translated_text: as far as your reach, O bountiful one, as far as your strength, with the thunderbolt you slew the hostile foe.

children.text: abhi sidhmo ajigād asya śatrūn vi tigmena vṛṣabheṇā puro 'bhet
children.translated_text: The fire-brand advanced against his enemies; with the sharp bull he broke apart the strongholds.

children.text: saṃ vajreṇāsṛjad vṛtram indraḥ pra svām matim atiracchāśadānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With the thunderbolt <s>Indra</s> shattered <s>Vṛtra</s>, and, eager for praise, he stretched his own thought forward.

children.text: āvaḥ kutsam indra yasmiñcākan prāvo yudhyantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ daśadyum
children.translated_text: You aided <s>Kutsa</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, in the contest he desired; you aided the fighting bull <s>Daśadyu</s>.

children.text: śaphacyuto reṇur nakṣata dyām ucchvaitreyo nṛṣāhyāya tasthau ||
children.translated_text: Dust shaken from the hoof reached the sky; the descendant of <s>Ucchvaitra</s> stood for manly victory.

children.text: āvaḥ śamaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tugryāsu kṣetrajeṣe maghavañchvitryaṃ gām
children.translated_text: You aided <s>Śama</s>, the bull, among the <s>Tugryas</s>, and, O bountiful one, the white cow for winning fields.

children.text: jyok cid atra tasthivāṃso akrañchatrūyatām adharā vedanākaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even those who had long stood there cried out; you made the hostile ones' perceptions lower.

children.text: Chapter 34
triś cin no adyā bhavataṃ navedasā vibhur vāṃ yāma uta rātir aśvinā
children.translated_text: Three times today be near to us with guidance; wide is your course and your gift, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: yuvor hi yantraṃ himyeva vāsaso 'bhyāyaṃsenyā bhavatam manīṣibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: For your vehicle, like clothing in winter, becomes stretched around and near through the thoughtful ones.

children.text: trayaḥ pavayo madhuvāhane rathe somasya venām anu viśva id viduḥ
children.translated_text: Three fellies are on your honey-bearing chariot; all know the stream of Soma,

children.text: traya skambhāsa skabhitāsa ārabhe trir naktaṃ yāthas trir v aśvinā divā ||
children.translated_text: three supports are fixed for holding on; three times by night and three times by day you travel, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: samāne ahan trir avadyagohanā trir adya yajñam madhunā mimikṣatam
children.translated_text: On the same day, three times hiding what is blameworthy, three times today mix the sacrifice with honey.

children.text: trir vājavatīr iṣo aśvinā yuvaṃ doṣā asmabhyam uṣasaś ca pinvatam ||
children.translated_text: Three times, O <s>Aśvins</s>, swell for us at evening and at dawn the nourishing foods rich in prize-winning strength.

children.text: trir vartir yātaṃ trir anuvrate jane triḥ suprāvye tredheva śikṣatam
children.translated_text: Three times travel your course, three times among the people obedient to the vow; instruct us threefold for easy crossing.

children.text: trir nāndyaṃ vahatam aśvinā yuvaṃ triḥ pṛkṣo asme akṣareva pinvatam ||
children.translated_text: Three times, O <s>Aśvins</s>, bring refreshment for rejoicing; three times swell the nourishments for us like imperishable waters.

children.text: trir no rayiṃ vahatam aśvinā yuvaṃ trir devatātā trir utāvataṃ dhiyaḥ
children.translated_text: Three times, O <s>Aśvins</s>, bring us wealth; three times at the divine rite, and three times, protect our thoughts.

children.text: triḥ saubhagatvaṃ trir uta śravāṃsi nas triṣṭhaṃ vāṃ sūre duhitā ruhad ratham ||
children.translated_text: Three times may prosperity, and three times renown, be ours; may the daughter of <s>Sūrya</s> mount your three-seated chariot.

children.text: trir no aśvinā divyāni bheṣajā triḥ pārthivāni trir u dattam adbhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Three times, O <s>Aśvins</s>, give us heavenly medicines, three times earthly ones, and three times those from the waters.

children.text: omānaṃ śaṃ yor mamakāya sūnave tridhātu śarma vahataṃ śubhas patī ||
children.translated_text: Bring protection and well-being for my own son; carry here threefold shelter, O lords of beauty.

children.text: trir no aśvinā yajatā dive dive pari tridhātu pṛthivīm aśāyatam
children.translated_text: Three times for us, O worshipful <s>Aśvins</s>, day by day, stretch your threefold protection around the earth.

children.text: tisro nāsatyā rathyā parāvata ātmeva vātaḥ svasarāṇi gacchatam ||
children.translated_text: From three distant chariot-roads, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, go to your own stations like the wind to its own domain.

children.text: trir aśvinā sindhubhiḥ saptamātṛbhis traya āhāvās tredhā haviṣ kṛtam
children.translated_text: Three times, O <s>Aśvins</s>, with the rivers, with the seven mothers; three are the invocations, and the oblation has been prepared in three ways.

children.text: tisraḥ pṛthivīr upari pravā divo nākaṃ rakṣethe dyubhir aktubhir hitam ||
children.translated_text: You guard the three earths above, the forward course of heaven, the summit set in place by days and nights.

children.text: kva trī cakrā trivṛto rathasya kva trayo vandhuro ye sanīḍāḥ
children.translated_text: Where are the three wheels of the threefold chariot? Where are the three chariot-seats that share one dwelling?

children.text: kadā yogo vājino rāsabhasya yena yajñaṃ nāsatyopayāthaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When will the yoking of the prize-winning donkey be, by which you, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, come near to the sacrifice?

children.text: ā nāsatyā gacchataṃ hūyate havir madhvaḥ pibatam madhupebhir āsabhiḥ
children.translated_text: Come here, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>; the oblation is being called. Drink the honeyed draught with honey-drinking cups.

children.text: yuvor hi pūrvaṃ savitoṣaso ratham ṛtāya citraṃ ghṛtavantam iṣyati ||
children.translated_text: For first of all <s>Savitar</s> and <s>Uṣas</s> send forth your bright, ghee-rich chariot for the truth.

children.text: ā nāsatyā tribhir ekādaśair iha devebhir yātam madhupeyam aśvinā
children.translated_text: Come here, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>, with the three elevens of gods, to drink the honey.

children.text: prāyus tāriṣṭaṃ nī rapāṃsi mṛkṣataṃ sedhataṃ dveṣo bhavataṃ sacābhuvā ||
children.translated_text: Carry life forward; wipe away injuries; drive off hatred; be companions who bring aid.

children.text: ā no aśvinā trivṛtā rathenārvāñcaṃ rayiṃ vahataṃ suvīram
children.translated_text: Bring to us, O <s>Aśvins</s>, wealth rich in heroes, coming hither on your threefold chariot.

children.text: śṛṇvantā vām avase johavīmi vṛdhe ca no bhavataṃ vājasātau ||
children.translated_text: Hearing you, I call on you for help; be for our increase and in the winning of prizes.

children.text: Chapter 35
hvayāmy agnim prathamaṃ svastaye hvayāmi mitrāvaruṇāv ihāvase
children.translated_text: I call <s>Agni</s> first for well-being; I call <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> here for aid.

children.text: hvayāmi rātrīṃ jagato niveśanīṃ hvayāmi devaṃ savitāram ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: I call Night, the one who settles the world; I call the god <s>Savitar</s> for assistance.

children.text: ā kṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayann amṛtam martyaṃ ca
children.translated_text: Moving through the dark realm, setting to rest both the immortal and the mortal,

children.text: hiraṇyayena savitā rathenā devo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan ||
children.translated_text: the god <s>Savitar</s> goes with his golden chariot, beholding all beings.

children.text: yāti devaḥ pravatā yāty udvatā yāti śubhrābhyāṃ yajato haribhyām
children.translated_text: The god goes down the slopes, he goes up the heights; the worshipful one goes with his two shining bay steeds.

children.text: ā devo yāti savitā parāvato 'pa viśvā duritā bādhamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The god <s>Savitar</s> comes from afar, driving away all evils.

children.text: abhīvṛtaṃ kṛśanair viśvarūpaṃ hiraṇyaśamyaṃ yajato bṛhantam
children.translated_text: The worshipful, lofty one, many-formed, wrapped in dark-hued ornaments, with a golden pole,

children.text: āsthād rathaṃ savitā citrabhānuḥ kṛṣṇā rajāṃsi taviṣīṃ dadhānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Savitar</s> of wondrous radiance has mounted his chariot, putting on power amid the dark spaces.

children.text: vi janāñchyāvāḥ śitipādo akhyan rathaṃ hiraṇyapraugaṃ vahantaḥ
children.translated_text: The dark-brown, white-footed horses have looked over the peoples, drawing the chariot with golden forepart.

children.text: śaśvad viśaḥ savitur daivyasyopasthe viśvā bhuvanāni tasthuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Forever all peoples, all beings, have stood in the lap of divine <s>Savitar</s>.

children.text: tisro dyāvaḥ savitur dvā upasthāṁ ekā yamasya bhuvane virāṣāṭ
children.translated_text: There are three heavens of <s>Savitar</s>, and two laps; one, ruling widely, is in the world of <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: āṇiṃ na rathyam amṛtādhi tasthur iha bravītu ya u tac ciketat ||
children.translated_text: They have stood upon the immortal like a pin upon a chariot; let him who truly understands this speak here.

children.text: vi suparṇo antarikṣāṇy akhyad gabhīravepā asuraḥ sunīthaḥ
children.translated_text: The fair-winged one has looked across the midspaces, deep-stirring, mighty, and well-guiding.

children.text: kvedānīṃ sūryaḥ kaś ciketa katamāṃ dyāṃ raśmir asyā tatāna ||
children.translated_text: Where now is the sun? Who understands? To which heaven has his ray extended?

children.text: aṣṭau vy akhyat kakubhaḥ pṛthivyās trī dhanva yojanā sapta sindhūn
children.translated_text: He has looked over the eight regions of the earth, the three deserts, the leagues, and the seven rivers.

children.text: hiraṇyākṣaḥ savitā deva āgād dadhad ratnā dāśuṣe vāryāṇi ||
children.translated_text: The golden-eyed god <s>Savitar</s> has come, bringing desirable treasures for the worshipper.

children.text: hiraṇyapāṇiḥ savitā vicarṣaṇir ubhe dyāvāpṛthivī antar īyate
children.translated_text: Golden-handed <s>Savitar</s>, lord of peoples, moves between both heaven and earth.

children.text: apāmīvām bādhate veti sūryam abhi kṛṣṇena rajasā dyām ṛṇoti ||
children.translated_text: He drives away sickness; he approaches the sun; with the dark realm he reaches up to heaven.

children.text: hiraṇyahasto asuraḥ sunīthaḥ sumṛḍīkaḥ svavāṁ yātv arvāṅ
children.translated_text: Golden-handed, mighty, well-guiding, gracious, and rich in good things, may he come hither.

children.text: apasedhan rakṣaso yātudhānān asthād devaḥ pratidoṣaṃ gṛṇānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Driving away demons and sorcerers, the god has taken his stand at evening, being praised.

children.text: ye te panthāḥ savitaḥ pūrvyāso 'reṇavaḥ sukṛtā antarikṣe
children.translated_text: Those ancient paths of yours, O <s>Savitar</s>, dustless, well-made in the midspace,

children.text: tebhir no adya pathibhiḥ sugebhī rakṣā ca no adhi ca brūhi deva ||
children.translated_text: by those easy paths today protect us, O god, and speak in our favor.

children.text: Chapter 36
pra vo yahvam purūṇāṃ viśāṃ devayatīnām
children.translated_text: For you I set forth the mighty one of the many peoples who turn to the gods.

children.text: agniṃ sūktebhir vacobhir īmahe yaṃ sīm id anya īḍate ||
children.translated_text: With hymns and words we seek <s>Agni</s>, whom each other worshipper praises.

children.text: janāso agniṃ dadhire sahovṛdhaṃ haviṣmanto vidhema te
children.translated_text: The peoples have established <s>Agni</s>, strength-increasing; with oblations we would serve you.

children.text: sa tvaṃ no adya sumanā ihāvitā bhavā vājeṣu santya ||
children.translated_text: So today, well-disposed, be our helper here in the contests, O beneficent one.

children.text: pra tvā dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe hotāraṃ viśvavedasam
children.translated_text: We choose you as messenger, the hotṛ-priest who knows all things.

children.text: mahas te sato vi caranty arcayo divi spṛśanti bhānavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Your flames, as you are great, range widely; your beams touch heaven.

children.text: devāsas tvā varuṇo mitro aryamā saṃ dūtam pratnam indhate
children.translated_text: The gods, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>, kindle you together as the ancient messenger.

children.text: viśvaṃ so agne jayati tvayā dhanaṃ yas te dadāśa martyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: That mortal who worships you, O <s>Agni</s>, wins all wealth through you.

children.text: mandro hotā gṛhapatir agne dūto viśām asi
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, you are the gladdening hotṛ-priest, the house-lord, the messenger of the clans.

children.text: tve viśvā saṃgatāni vratā dhruvā yāni devā akṛṇvata ||
children.translated_text: In you are gathered all the firm ordinances that the gods have made.

children.text: tve id agne subhage yaviṣṭhya viśvam ā hūyate haviḥ
children.translated_text: In you, O fortunate and youngest <s>Agni</s>, every oblation is called together.

children.text: sa tvaṃ no adya sumanā utāparaṃ yakṣi devān suvīryā ||
children.translated_text: So today, well-disposed, and hereafter too, worship the gods for us with strong power.

children.text: taṃ ghem itthā namasvina upa svarājam āsate
children.translated_text: Him indeed, in this way, the reverent ones sit near as the self-ruler.

children.text: hotrābhir agnim manuṣaḥ sam indhate titirvāṃso ati sridhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Men kindle <s>Agni</s> with priestly offices, having crossed beyond the snares.

children.text: ghnanto vṛtram ataran rodasī apa uru kṣayāya cakrire
children.translated_text: Slaying <s>Vṛtra</s>, they crossed the two worlds and the waters; they made broad room for dwelling.

children.text: bhuvat kaṇve vṛṣā dyumny āhutaḥ krandad aśvo gaviṣṭiṣu ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Kaṇva</s> the bull, splendid when invoked, became present, like a neighing horse in the searches for cows.

children.text: saṃ sīdasva mahāṁ asi śocasva devavītamaḥ
children.translated_text: Sit down together; you are great. Shine forth, most god-inviting one.

children.text: vi dhūmam agne aruṣam miyedhya sṛja praśasta darśatam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, send out your ruddy, well-kindled smoke, praiseworthy and fair to see.

children.text: yaṃ tvā devāso manave dadhur iha yajiṣṭhaṃ havyavāhana
children.translated_text: You whom the gods placed here for <s>Manu</s> as the best worshipper and carrier of oblations,

children.text: yaṃ kaṇvo medhyātithir dhanaspṛtaṃ yaṃ vṛṣā yam upastutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you whom <s>Kaṇva</s> <s>Medhyātithi</s> placed for the winning of wealth, whom the bull praised,

children.text: yam agnim medhyātithiḥ kaṇva īdha ṛtād adhi
children.translated_text: that <s>Agni</s> whom <s>Medhyātithi</s> <s>Kaṇva</s> kindled from the truth,

children.text: tasya preṣo dīdiyus tam imā ṛcas tam agniṃ vardhayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: his commands have shone out; these verses magnify that <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: rāyas pūrdhi svadhāvo 'sti hi te 'gne deveṣv āpyam
children.translated_text: Fill us with wealth, O self-ruling one; for there is kinship for you among the gods, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ vājasya śrutyasya rājasi sa no mṛḍa mahāṁ asi ||
children.translated_text: You rule over the prize worthy of fame; be gracious to us, for you are great.

children.text: ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaye tiṣṭhā devo na savitā
children.translated_text: Stand upright for our aid, like the god <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: ūrdhvo vājasya sanitā yad añjibhir vāghadbhir vihvayāmahe ||
children.translated_text: Upright, a winner of the prize, when we call on you with adorned praise-singers.

children.text: ūrdhvo naḥ pāhy aṃhaso ni ketunā viśvaṃ sam atriṇaṃ daha
children.translated_text: Upright, protect us from distress; with your sign burn up every devourer completely.

children.text: kṛdhī na ūrdhvāñcarathāya jīvase vidā deveṣu no duvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Make us upright, for movement by chariot and for life; find service for us among the gods.

children.text: pāhi no agne rakṣasaḥ pāhi dhūrter arāvṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Protect us, O <s>Agni</s>, from the demon; protect us from deceit, from the ungenerous one.

children.text: pāhi rīṣata uta vā jighāṃsato bṛhadbhāno yaviṣṭhya ||
children.translated_text: Protect us from the injurer and from him who would slay us, O broad-shining youngest one.

children.text: ghaneva viṣvag vi jahy arāvṇas tapurjambha yo asmadhruk
children.translated_text: Like a mace, strike down the ungenerous ones on every side, O scorching-jawed one, whoever harms us.

children.text: yo martyaḥ śiśīte aty aktubhir mā naḥ sa ripur īśata ||
children.translated_text: Whatever mortal sharpens himself through the nights, let that enemy not gain power over us.

children.text: agnir vavne suvīryam agniḥ kaṇvāya saubhagam
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has won heroic strength; <s>Agni</s> has won good fortune for <s>Kaṇva</s>.

children.text: agniḥ prāvan mitrota medhyātithim agniḥ sātā upastutam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> protected <s>Mitra</s> and also <s>Medhyātithi</s>; <s>Agni</s> protected the praised one in the winning.

children.text: agninā turvaśaṃ yadum parāvata ugrādevaṃ havāmahe
children.translated_text: By <s>Agni</s> we call from afar <s>Turvaśa</s>, <s>Yadu</s>, and <s>Ugradeva</s>.

children.text: agnir nayan navavāstvam bṛhadrathaṃ turvītiṃ dasyave sahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> led <s>Navavāstva</s>, <s>Bṛhadratha</s>, and <s>Turvīti</s> to power against the <s>Dasyu</s>.

children.text: ni tvām agne manur dadhe jyotir janāya śaśvate
children.translated_text: <s>Manu</s> set you down, O <s>Agni</s>, as a light for enduring mankind.

children.text: dīdetha kaṇva ṛtajāta ukṣito yaṃ namasyanti kṛṣṭayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You shone forth, O truth-born one, rich with offering, whom the peoples revere.

children.text: tveṣāso agner amavanto arcayo bhīmāso na pratītaye
children.translated_text: Bright and forceful are the flames of <s>Agni</s>, terrible to confront.

children.text: rakṣasvinaḥ sadam id yātumāvato viśvaṃ sam atriṇaṃ daha ||
children.translated_text: Burn up completely the demon-possessors, the sorcery-bearing ones, every devourer.

children.text: Chapter 37
krīḍaṃ vaḥ śardho mārutam anarvāṇaṃ ratheśubham
children.translated_text: Sing of the sportive <s>Marut</s> host, unconquered and splendid with chariot-spears.

children.text: kaṇvā abhi pra gāyata ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Kaṇvas</s>, sing forth to them.

children.text: ye pṛṣatībhir ṛṣṭibhiḥ sākaṃ vāśībhir añjibhiḥ
children.translated_text: They were born with speckled mares, with spears, together with axes and ornaments.

children.text: ajāyanta svabhānavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They were born self-luminous.

children.text: iheva śṛṇva eṣāṃ kaśā hasteṣu yad vadān
children.translated_text: Here indeed the crack of their whips is heard, when they sound in their hands.

children.text: ni yāmañ citram ṛñjate ||
children.translated_text: They adorn their wondrous course.

children.text: pra vaḥ śardhāya ghṛṣvaye tveṣadyumnāya śuṣmiṇe
children.translated_text: For your eager host, bright in splendor and powerful,

children.text: devattam brahma gāyata ||
children.translated_text: sing the god-given <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation).

children.text: pra śaṃsā goṣv aghnyaṃ krīḍaṃ yacchardho mārutam
children.translated_text: Proclaim among the cows the inviolable, sportive <s>Marut</s> host.

children.text: jambhe rasasya vāvṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: It has grown strong in the mouth of the draught.

children.text: ko vo varṣiṣṭha ā naro divaś ca gmaś ca dhūtayaḥ
children.translated_text: Who among you, O men, is greatest, shakers of heaven and earth,

children.text: yat sīm antaṃ na dhūnutha ||
children.translated_text: when you shake them like a boundary?

children.text: ni vo yāmāya mānuṣo dadhra ugrāya manyave
children.translated_text: For your course, for your fierce wrath, the human mountain yields.

children.text: jihīta parvato giriḥ ||
children.translated_text: The mountain, the hill, gives way.

children.text: yeṣām ajmeṣu pṛthivī jujurvāṁ iva viśpatiḥ
children.translated_text: At their contests the earth, like an aging lord of the clans,

children.text: bhiyā yāmeṣu rejate ||
children.translated_text: trembles in fear at their courses.

children.text: sthiraṃ hi jānam eṣāṃ vayo mātur niretave
children.translated_text: Firm indeed is their birth, their vigor, for going forth from the mother,

children.text: yat sīm anu dvitā śavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when their power follows in a double way.

children.text: ud u tye sūnavo giraḥ kāṣṭhā ajmeṣv atnata
children.translated_text: Upward those sons stretched their voices to the limits in the contests,

children.text: vāśrā abhijñu yātave ||
children.translated_text: roaring, bending forward to go.

children.text: tyaṃ cid ghā dīrgham pṛthum miho napātam amṛdhram
children.translated_text: Even that long, broad, unassailable child of the mist

children.text: pra cyāvayanti yāmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: they set in motion with their courses.

children.text: maruto yaddha vo balaṃ janāṁ acucyavītana
children.translated_text: O <s>Maruts</s>, when indeed your force shook men,

children.text: girīṃr acucyavītana ||
children.translated_text: you shook the mountains.

children.text: yaddha yānti marutaḥ saṃ ha bruvate 'dhvann ā
children.translated_text: When the <s>Maruts</s> go, they speak together upon the road.

children.text: śṛṇoti kaścid eṣām ||
children.translated_text: Someone hears them.

children.text: pra yāta śībham āśubhiḥ santi kaṇveṣu vo duvaḥ
children.translated_text: Go forth swiftly with the swift ones; your service is among the <s>Kaṇvas</s>.

children.text: tatro ṣu mādayādhvai ||
children.translated_text: There then take delight.

children.text: asti hi ṣmā madāya vaḥ smasi ṣmā vayam eṣām
children.translated_text: For there is indeed exhilaration for you; we are theirs,

children.text: viśvaṃ cid āyur jīvase ||
children.translated_text: for living through the whole span of life.

children.text: Chapter 38
kaddha nūnaṃ kadhapriyaḥ pitā putraṃ na hastayoḥ
children.translated_text: When now, O beloved ones, like a father holding a son in his hands,

children.text: dadhidhve vṛktabarhiṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: will you take up us who have strewn the sacred grass?

children.text: kva nūnaṃ kad vo arthaṃ gantā divo na pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: Where now, and to what purpose of yours, will you go, from heaven or from earth?

children.text: kva vo gāvo na raṇyanti ||
children.translated_text: Where do your cows delight?

children.text: kva vaḥ sumnā navyāṃsi marutaḥ kva suvitā
children.translated_text: Where are your newest favors, O <s>Maruts</s>; where are your good guidances?

children.text: kvo viśvāni saubhagā ||
children.translated_text: Where are all your blessings?

children.text: yad yūyam pṛśnimātaro martāsaḥ syātana
children.translated_text: If you, sons of <s>Pṛśni</s>, were mortals,

children.text: stotā vo amṛtaḥ syāt ||
children.translated_text: your praiser would become immortal.

children.text: mā vo mṛgo na yavase jaritā bhūd ajoṣyaḥ
children.translated_text: Let your singer not be like a beast in pasture, unwelcome.

children.text: pathā yamasya gād upa ||
children.translated_text: Let him not go upon the path of <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: mo ṣu ṇaḥ parā parā nirṛtir durhaṇā vadhīt
children.translated_text: Let destructive <s>Nirṛti</s> not strike us far, far away.

children.text: padīṣṭa tṛṣṇayā saha ||
children.translated_text: Let her fall away together with thirst.

children.text: satyaṃ tveṣā amavanto dhanvañ cid ā rudriyāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Truly, bright and forceful, O <s>Rudriyas</s>, even in the dry waste

children.text: mihaṃ kṛṇvanty avātām ||
children.translated_text: you make rain without wind.

children.text: vāśreva vidyun mimāti vatsaṃ na mātā siṣakti
children.translated_text: Like a lowing cow the lightning bellows; like a mother she follows her calf

children.text: yad eṣāṃ vṛṣṭir asarji ||
children.translated_text: when their rain has been released.

children.text: divā cit tamaḥ kṛṇvanti parjanyenodavāhena
children.translated_text: Even by day they make darkness with the rain-cloud carrying water,

children.text: yat pṛthivīṃ vyundanti ||
children.translated_text: when they moisten the earth.

children.text: adha svanān marutāṃ viśvam ā sadma pārthivam
children.translated_text: Then, at the sound of the <s>Maruts</s>, every earthly dwelling

children.text: arejanta pra mānuṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: and the human beings trembled.

children.text: maruto vīḍupāṇibhiś citrā rodhasvatīr anu
children.translated_text: O <s>Maruts</s>, with firm hands, along the variegated streams with banks,

children.text: yātem akhidrayāmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: go with courses that do not falter.

children.text: sthirā vaḥ santu nemayo rathā aśvāsa eṣām
children.translated_text: May your wheel-rims be firm; may their chariots and horses be firm,

children.text: susaṃskṛtā abhīśavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and their well-fashioned reins.

children.text: acchā vadā tanā girā jarāyai brahmaṇaspatim
children.translated_text: Address with an extended song, for praise, <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>,

children.text: agnim mitraṃ na darśatam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, lovely like <s>Mitra</s>.

children.text: mimīhi ślokam āsye parjanya iva tatanaḥ
children.translated_text: Fashion a verse in your mouth, spreading it like <s>Parjanya</s>.

children.text: gāya gāyatram ukthyam ||
children.translated_text: Sing the laudable <s>gāyatra</s> (hymnic song).

children.text: vandasva mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ tveṣam panasyum arkiṇam
children.translated_text: Praise the <s>Marut</s> troop, bright, wondrous, and singing.

children.text: asme vṛddhā asann iha ||
children.translated_text: May they be increased for us here.

children.text: Chapter 39
pra yad itthā parāvataḥ śocir na mānam asyatha
children.translated_text: When in this way, from afar, you cast forth your flame like a measure,

children.text: kasya kratvā marutaḥ kasya varpasā kaṃ yātha kaṃ ha dhūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: by whose will, O <s>Maruts</s>, by whose form, to whom do you go, to whom indeed, O shakers?

children.text: sthirā vaḥ santv āyudhā parāṇude vīḍū uta pratiṣkabhe
children.translated_text: May your weapons be firm, to drive away and to brace, firm also against opposition.

children.text: yuṣmākam astu taviṣī panīyasī mā martyasya māyinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May your might be most praiseworthy; let it not be that of a deceitful mortal.

children.text: parā ha yat sthiraṃ hatha naro vartayathā guru
children.translated_text: When you, O men, strike what is fixed and turn aside what is heavy,

children.text: vi yāthana vaninaḥ pṛthivyā vy āśāḥ parvatānām ||
children.translated_text: you scatter the forests of the earth and the quarters of the mountains.

children.text: nahi vaḥ śatrur vivide adhi dyavi na bhūmyāṃ riśādasaḥ
children.translated_text: No enemy has been found for you in heaven or on earth, O destroyers of harm.

children.text: yuṣmākam astu taviṣī tanā yujā rudrāso nū cid ādhṛṣe ||
children.translated_text: May your inborn might be yours, O <s>Rudras</s>, unassailable even now.

children.text: pra vepayanti parvatān vi viñcanti vanaspatīn
children.translated_text: They make the mountains tremble; they tear apart the forest trees.

children.text: pro ārata maruto durmadā iva devāsaḥ sarvayā viśā ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Maruts</s> have advanced, like overbold powers, gods with the whole clan.

children.text: upo ratheṣu pṛṣatīr ayugdhvam praṣṭir vahati rohitaḥ
children.translated_text: You have yoked the dappled mares to the chariots; the red one carries the side-horse.

children.text: ā vo yāmāya pṛthivī cid aśrod abībhayanta mānuṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: For your journey even the earth has listened; human beings trembled in fear.

children.text: ā vo makṣū tanāya kaṃ rudrā avo vṛṇīmahe
children.translated_text: Quickly, for offspring, O <s>Rudras</s>, we choose your protection.

children.text: gantā nūnaṃ no 'vasā yathā puretthā kaṇvāya bibhyuṣe ||
children.translated_text: Come now to us with aid, as before you came here to <s>Kaṇva</s> when he was afraid.

children.text: yuṣmeṣito maruto martyeṣita ā yo no abhva īṣate
children.translated_text: O <s>Maruts</s>, whatever danger presses upon us, whether sent by you or sent by a mortal,

children.text: vi taṃ yuyota śavasā vy ojasā vi yuṣmākābhir ūtibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: drive that away with might, drive it away with strength, drive it away with your protections.

children.text: asāmi hi prayajyavaḥ kaṇvaṃ dada pracetasaḥ
children.translated_text: For you are unequalled, O thoughtful ones worthy of worship; you gave favor to <s>Kaṇva</s>.

children.text: asāmibhir maruta ā na ūtibhir gantā vṛṣṭiṃ na vidyutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Come to us, O <s>Maruts</s>, with unequalled aids, like rain with lightning.

children.text: asāmy ojo bibhṛthā sudānavo 'sāmi dhūtayaḥ śavaḥ
children.translated_text: You bear unequalled force, O generous givers; your impelling powers and strength are unequalled.

children.text: ṛṣidviṣe marutaḥ parimanyava iṣuṃ na sṛjata dviṣam ||
children.translated_text: O wrathful <s>Maruts</s>, against the hater of seers release your hostile force like an arrow.

children.text: Chapter 40
ut tiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate devayantas tvemahe
children.translated_text: Rise up, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>; seeking the gods, we call upon you.

children.text: upa pra yantu marutaḥ sudānava indra prāśūr bhavā sacā ||
children.translated_text: Let the generous <s>Maruts</s> come forward here; O <s>Indra</s>, be ready together with them.

children.text: tvām iddhi sahasas putra martya upabrūte dhane hite
children.translated_text: For you alone, O son of strength, the mortal invokes when wealth is set as the prize.

children.text: suvīryam maruta ā svaśvyaṃ dadhīta yo va ācake ||
children.translated_text: May the one who calls upon you, O <s>Maruts</s>, gain heroic power and good horses.

children.text: praitu brahmaṇaspatiḥ pra devy etu sūnṛtā
children.translated_text: Let <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> go forward; let divine kindly speech go forward.

children.text: acchā vīraṃ naryam paṅktirādhasaṃ devā yajñaṃ nayantu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the gods lead our sacrifice toward the manly hero, rich in gifts and fit for men.

children.text: yo vāghate dadāti sūnaraṃ vasu sa dhatte akṣiti śravaḥ
children.translated_text: He who gives good wealth to the singer secures imperishable fame.

children.text: tasmā iḍāṃ suvīrām ā yajāmahe supratūrtim anehasam ||
children.translated_text: For him we perform the offering of <s>Iḍā</s>, rich in heroes, safely crossing over and unharmed.

children.text: pra nūnam brahmaṇaspatir mantraṃ vadaty ukthyam
children.translated_text: Now <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> proclaims the sacred formula worthy of recitation,

children.text: yasminn indro varuṇo mitro aryamā devā okāṃsi cakrire ||
children.translated_text: in which <s>Indra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, and the gods have made their dwellings.

children.text: tam id vocemā vidatheṣu śambhuvam mantraṃ devā anehasam
children.translated_text: Let us speak that welfare-bringing, unharming formula in the assemblies, O gods.

children.text: imāṃ ca vācam pratiharyathā naro viśved vāmā vo aśnavat ||
children.translated_text: Accept this speech in return, O heroes; every desirable good will reach you.

children.text: ko devayantam aśnavaj janaṃ ko vṛktabarhiṣam
children.translated_text: Who will overcome the god-seeking people? Who will overcome those whose sacred grass is spread?

children.text: pra pra dāśvān pastyābhir asthitāntarvāvat kṣayaṃ dadhe ||
children.translated_text: The generous worshipper has gone forth with his households and has established a dwelling with inner strength.

children.text: upa kṣatram pṛñcīta hanti rājabhir bhaye cit sukṣitiṃ dadhe
children.translated_text: He joins himself to dominion; with kings he smites, and even in fear he establishes a good settlement.

children.text: nāsya vartā na tarutā mahādhane nārbhe asti vajriṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: No restrainer and no overcomer of him exists, O wielder of the <s>vajra</s>, in great prize or small.

children.text: Chapter 41
yaṃ rakṣanti pracetaso varuṇo mitro aryamā
children.translated_text: The person whom the wise ones protect, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>,

children.text: nū cit sa dabhyate janaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that man is not harmed even now.

children.text: yam bāhuteva piprati pānti martyaṃ riṣaḥ
children.translated_text: The mortal whom they sustain as if with arms, protecting him from injury,

children.text: ariṣṭaḥ sarva edhate ||
children.translated_text: unharmed, he prospers in every way.

children.text: vi durgā vi dviṣaḥ puro ghnanti rājāna eṣām
children.translated_text: Their kings shatter the difficult places, the enemies, and the strongholds,

children.text: nayanti duritā tiraḥ ||
children.translated_text: and they lead one beyond evils.

children.text: sugaḥ panthā anṛkṣara ādityāsa ṛtaṃ yate
children.translated_text: Easy and free from obstruction is the path, O <s>Ādityas</s>, for the one who goes according to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: nātrāvakhādo asti vaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There is no pitfall there for you.

children.text: yaṃ yajñaṃ nayathā nara ādityā ṛjunā pathā
children.translated_text: The sacrifice which you lead, O heroes, O <s>Ādityas</s>, by the straight path,

children.text: pra vaḥ sa dhītaye naśat ||
children.translated_text: may that come forward for your inspired thought.

children.text: sa ratnam martyo vasu viśvaṃ tokam uta tmanā
children.translated_text: That mortal, unobstructed, goes toward treasure, wealth, every offspring, and his own self,

children.text: acchā gacchaty astṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and comes to them unharmed.

children.text: kathā rādhāma sakhāya stomam mitrasyāryamṇaḥ
children.translated_text: How, friends, may we accomplish the praise-song of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Aryaman</s>,

children.text: mahi psaro varuṇasya ||
children.translated_text: and the great wide domain of <s>Varuṇa</s>?

children.text: mā vo ghnantam mā śapantam prati voce devayantam
children.translated_text: May I not answer back the god-seeking man, whether he strikes or curses,

children.text: sumnair id va ā vivāse ||
children.translated_text: but with favors alone I seek to win you.

children.text: caturaś cid dadamānād bibhīyād ā nidhātoḥ
children.translated_text: One should be wary even of the giver of four, and of the hoarder,

children.text: na duruktāya spṛhayet ||
children.translated_text: and should not long for abusive speech.

children.text: Chapter 42
sam pūṣann adhvanas tira vy aṃho vimuco napāt
children.translated_text: O <s>Pūṣan</s>, carry us altogether beyond the roads, away from distress, O child of release.

children.text: sakṣvā deva pra ṇas puraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Accompany us, O god, before us.

children.text: yo naḥ pūṣann agho vṛko duḥśeva ādideśati
children.translated_text: That evil wolf, hard to deal with, who points us out, O <s>Pūṣan</s>,

children.text: apa sma tam patho jahi ||
children.translated_text: drive him away from the path.

children.text: apa tyam paripanthinam muṣīvāṇaṃ huraścitam
children.translated_text: Drive away that waylayer, that thieving, crafty one,

children.text: dūram adhi sruter aja ||
children.translated_text: far away from the track.

children.text: tvaṃ tasya dvayāvino 'ghaśaṃsasya kasyacit
children.translated_text: Upon any double-dealing speaker of evil,

children.text: padābhi tiṣṭha tapuṣim ||
children.translated_text: set your burning foot.

children.text: ā tat te dasra mantumaḥ pūṣann avo vṛṇīmahe
children.translated_text: For that aid of yours, O wondrous <s>Pūṣan</s>, full of insight, we choose you,

children.text: yena pitṝn acodayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the aid with which you urged on the Fathers.

children.text: adhā no viśvasaubhaga hiraṇyavāśīmattama
children.translated_text: Then, O all-fortunate one, best possessor of the golden axe,

children.text: dhanāni suṣaṇā kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: make riches easy for us to win.

children.text: ati naḥ saścato naya sugā naḥ supathā kṛṇu
children.translated_text: Lead us past those who pursue; make our ways easy and our paths good.

children.text: pūṣann iha kratuṃ vidaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Pūṣan</s>, find skillful purpose here.

children.text: abhi sūyavasaṃ naya na navajvāro adhvane
children.translated_text: Lead us to good pasture; let there be no fresh trouble on the road.

children.text: pūṣann iha kratuṃ vidaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Pūṣan</s>, find skillful purpose here.

children.text: śagdhi pūrdhi pra yaṃsi ca śiśīhi prāsy udaram
children.translated_text: Give power, fill us, and bestow gifts; sharpen us and fill the belly.

children.text: pūṣann iha kratuṃ vidaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Pūṣan</s>, find skillful purpose here.

children.text: na pūṣaṇam methāmasi sūktair abhi gṛṇīmasi
children.translated_text: We do not neglect <s>Pūṣan</s>; with well-spoken hymns we praise him.

children.text: vasūni dasmam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: We ask the wondrous one for riches.

children.text: Chapter 43
kad rudrāya pracetase mīḍhuṣṭamāya tavyase
children.translated_text: When shall we speak to <s>Rudra</s>, the wise, most bountiful and mighty one,

children.text: vocema śantamaṃ hṛde ||
children.translated_text: what is most soothing to his heart?

children.text: yathā no aditiḥ karat paśve nṛbhyo yathā gave
children.translated_text: May <s>Aditi</s> make this <s>Rudra</s>-favor for us, for the beast, for men, and for the cow,

children.text: yathā tokāya rudriyam ||
children.translated_text: and likewise for the child.

children.text: yathā no mitro varuṇo yathā rudraś ciketati
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> recognize us, and may <s>Rudra</s> recognize us,

children.text: yathā viśve sajoṣasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and may all the gods do so in common accord.

children.text: gāthapatim medhapatiṃ rudraṃ jalāṣabheṣajam
children.translated_text: We ask <s>Rudra</s>, lord of chants, lord of the sacrificial share, whose medicine brings cooling relief,

children.text: tacchaṃyoḥ sumnam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: for the favor that brings welfare and ease.

children.text: yaḥ śukra iva sūryo hiraṇyam iva rocate
children.translated_text: He shines like the bright sun, like gold,

children.text: śreṣṭho devānāṃ vasuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the best treasure of the gods.

children.text: śaṃ naḥ karaty arvate sugam meṣāya meṣye
children.translated_text: May he make well-being for our steed, an easy way for ram and ewe,

children.text: nṛbhyo nāribhyo gave ||
children.translated_text: for men, for women, and for the cow.

children.text: asme soma śriyam adhi ni dhehi śatasya nṛṇām
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, place splendor in us, the strength of a hundred men,

children.text: mahi śravas tuvinṛmṇam ||
children.translated_text: great fame and abundant heroic power.

children.text: mā naḥ somaparibādho mārātayo juhuranta
children.translated_text: Let neither oppressors of <s>Soma</s> nor hostile enemies turn us away.

children.text: ā na indo vāje bhaja ||
children.translated_text: O drop, bring us into a share of the prize.

children.text: yās te prajā amṛtasya parasmin dhāmann ṛtasya
children.translated_text: Those offspring of yours, of immortality, in the farthest realm of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order),

children.text: mūrdhā nābhā soma vena ābhūṣantīḥ soma vedaḥ ||
children.translated_text: adorning the head and the navel, O <s>Soma</s>, the longing ones know; O <s>Soma</s>, you know them.

children.text: Chapter 44
agne vivasvad uṣasaś citraṃ rādho amartya
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, immortal <s>Jātavedas</s>, bring the splendid gift of <s>Vivasvat</s> and of the dawns,

children.text: ā dāśuṣe jātavedo vahā tvam adyā devāṁ uṣarbudhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and today bring the gods awakened at dawn to the worshipper.

children.text: juṣṭo hi dūto asi havyavāhano 'gne rathīr adhvarāṇām
children.translated_text: For you are the beloved messenger, the carrier of oblations, O <s>Agni</s>, the charioteer of the rites.

children.text: sajūr aśvibhyām uṣasā suvīryam asme dhehi śravo bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: Together with the <s>Aśvins</s> and <s>Uṣas</s>, place in us heroic power and broad fame.

children.text: adyā dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe vasum agnim purupriyam
children.translated_text: Today we choose as messenger <s>Agni</s>, the good one, much beloved.

children.text: dhūmaketum bhāṛjīkaṃ vyuṣṭiṣu yajñānām adhvaraśriyam ||
children.translated_text: the smoke-bannered, shining one at the dawns, the adornment of the sacrifices and rites.

children.text: śreṣṭhaṃ yaviṣṭham atithiṃ svāhutaṃ juṣṭaṃ janāya dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: The best, the youngest, the well-invoked guest, dear to the generous worshipper,

children.text: devāṁ acchā yātave jātavedasam agnim īḍe vyuṣṭiṣu ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jātavedas</s>, <s>Agni</s>, who goes toward the gods, I praise at the dawns.

children.text: staviṣyāmi tvām ahaṃ viśvasyāmṛta bhojana
children.translated_text: I will praise you, O immortal one, at every meal,

children.text: agne trātāram amṛtam miyedhya yajiṣṭhaṃ havyavāhana ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, immortal protector, worthy of worship, best sacrificer, carrier of oblations.

children.text: suśaṃso bodhi gṛṇate yaviṣṭhya madhujihvaḥ svāhutaḥ
children.translated_text: Be well-praised for the singer, O youngest one, honey-tongued and well-invoked.

children.text: praskaṇvasya pratirann āyur jīvase namasyā daivyaṃ janam ||
children.translated_text: Extending <s>Praskaṇva</s>'s life for living, honor the divine people.

children.text: hotāraṃ viśvavedasaṃ saṃ hi tvā viśa indhate
children.translated_text: For you are the hotṛ-priest who knows all; the clans kindle you together.

children.text: sa ā vaha puruhūta pracetaso 'gne devāṁ iha dravat ||
children.translated_text: So bring here, O much-invoked, discerning <s>Agni</s>, the gods swiftly.

children.text: savitāram uṣasam aśvinā bhagam agniṃ vyuṣṭiṣu kṣapaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Savitar</s>, <s>Uṣas</s>, the <s>Aśvins</s>, <s>Bhaga</s>, and <s>Agni</s> at the dawns and nights,

children.text: kaṇvāsas tvā sutasomāsa indhate havyavāhaṃ svadhvara ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Kaṇvas</s>, with soma pressed, kindle you, O oblation-carrier, performer of good rites.

children.text: patir hy adhvarāṇām agne dūto viśām asi
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Agni</s>, are the lord of the rites, the messenger of the clans.

children.text: uṣarbudha ā vaha somapītaye devāṁ adya svardṛśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Awakening with the dawn, bring the gods who behold the light today to drink the soma.

children.text: agne pūrvā anūṣaso vibhāvaso dīdetha viśvadarśataḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, before the dawns, O radiant one, you have shone out, visible to all.

children.text: asi grāmeṣv avitā purohito 'si yajñeṣu mānuṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are the protector in the villages, the household priest; you are the human one in sacrifices.

children.text: ni tvā yajñasya sādhanam agne hotāram ṛtvijam
children.translated_text: We set you down, O <s>Agni</s>, as the accomplisher of the sacrifice, the hotṛ-priest and ṛtvij,

children.text: manuṣvad deva dhīmahi pracetasaṃ jīraṃ dūtam amartyam ||
children.translated_text: as men did of old, O god, the discerning, active, immortal messenger.

children.text: yad devānām mitramahaḥ purohito 'ntaro yāsi dūtyam
children.translated_text: When, O friend of the gods, as household priest you go between them on your embassy,

children.text: sindhor iva prasvanitāsa ūrmayo 'gner bhrājante arcayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the flames of <s>Agni</s> blaze like the roaring waves of the river.

children.text: śrudhi śrutkarṇa vahnibhir devair agne sayāvabhiḥ
children.translated_text: Hear, O <s>Agni</s> of listening ear, with the carriers, with the gods who come together.

children.text: ā sīdantu barhiṣi mitro aryamā prātaryāvāṇo adhvaram ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Aryaman</s>, journeying in the morning, sit upon the sacred grass for the rite.

children.text: śṛṇvantu stomam marutaḥ sudānavo 'gnijihvā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the generous <s>Maruts</s>, whose tongues are <s>Agni</s> and who increase truth, hear the praise.

children.text: pibatu somaṃ varuṇo dhṛtavrato 'śvibhyām uṣasā sajūḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Varuṇa</s>, firm in his vow, drink the soma, together with the <s>Aśvins</s> and <s>Uṣas</s>.

children.text: Chapter 45
tvam agne vasūṃr iha rudrāṁ ādityāṁ uta
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, worship here the <s>Vasus</s>, the <s>Rudras</s>, and also the <s>Ādityas</s>.
