children.text: yajā svadhvaraṃ janam manujātaṃ ghṛtapruṣam ||
children.translated_text: Worship the people of good rites, born from <s>Manu</s>, sprinkled with ghee.

children.text: śruṣṭīvāno hi dāśuṣe devā agne vicetasaḥ
children.translated_text: For the discerning gods, O <s>Agni</s>, are quick to hear the generous worshipper.

children.text: tān rohidaśva girvaṇas trayastriṃśatam ā vaha ||
children.translated_text: Bring them here, O red-horsed, song-loving one, the thirty-three gods.

children.text: priyamedhavad atrivaj jātavedo virūpavat
children.translated_text: As for <s>Priyamedha</s>, as for <s>Atri</s>, as for <s>Virūpa</s>, O <s>Jātavedas</s>,

children.text: aṅgirasvan mahivrata praskaṇvasya śrudhī havam ||
children.translated_text: as for <s>Aṅgiras</s>, O mighty in ordinance, hear <s>Praskaṇva</s>'s call.

children.text: mahikerava ūtaye priyamedhā ahūṣata
children.translated_text: The <s>Priyamedhas</s> have called for help upon <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: rājantam adhvarāṇām agniṃ śukreṇa śociṣā ||
children.translated_text: the king of rites, shining with bright flame.

children.text: ghṛtāhavana santyemā u ṣu śrudhī giraḥ
children.translated_text: O one to whom ghee is offered, now hear these songs well,

children.text: yābhiḥ kaṇvasya sūnavo havante 'vase tvā ||
children.translated_text: with which the sons of <s>Kaṇva</s> call upon you for aid.

children.text: tvāṃ citraśravastama havante vikṣu jantavaḥ
children.translated_text: You, most famed and wondrous, creatures among the peoples call upon,

children.text: śociṣkeśam purupriyāgne havyāya voḍhave ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> with flame for hair, much beloved, to carry the oblations.

children.text: ni tvā hotāram ṛtvijaṃ dadhire vasuvittamam
children.translated_text: They have set you down as hotṛ-priest and ṛtvij, richest finder of treasure,

children.text: śrutkarṇaṃ saprathastamaṃ viprā agne diviṣṭiṣu ||
children.translated_text: wide-renowned, with listening ear, O <s>Agni</s>, in the heavenly contests.

children.text: ā tvā viprā acucyavuḥ sutasomā abhi prayaḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired ones with soma pressed have urged you hither toward the offering,

children.text: bṛhad bhā bibhrato havir agne martāya dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: bearing lofty splendor and the oblation, O <s>Agni</s>, for the mortal worshipper.

children.text: prātaryāvṇaḥ sahaskṛta somapeyāya santya
children.translated_text: O mighty one, O present one, bring those who travel in the morning to drink soma.

children.text: ihādya daivyaṃ janam barhir ā sādayā vaso ||
children.translated_text: Here today, O good one, seat the divine people upon the sacred grass.

children.text: arvāñcaṃ daivyaṃ janam agne yakṣva sahūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, worship the divine people turned hither, with their shared invocations.

children.text: ayaṃ somaḥ sudānavas tam pāta tiroahnyam ||
children.translated_text: This soma is for the generous gods; drink it as the drink of the day just past.

children.text: Chapter 46
eṣo uṣā apūrvyā vy ucchati priyā divaḥ
children.translated_text: This unprecedented <s>Uṣas</s>, dear daughter of heaven, shines forth,

children.text: stuṣe vām aśvinā bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: and I praise you two greatly, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: yā dasrā sindhumātarā manotarā rayīṇām
children.translated_text: You two wondrous ones, whose mother is the river, most mindful of riches,

children.text: dhiyā devā vasuvidā ||
children.translated_text: gods who know treasure by insight,

children.text: vacyante vāṃ kakuhāso jūrṇāyām adhi viṣṭapi
children.translated_text: the high songs are spoken for you upon the aged summit,

children.text: yad vāṃ ratho vibhiṣ patāt ||
children.translated_text: when your chariot flies with the birds.

children.text: haviṣā jāro apām piparti papurir narā
children.translated_text: The lover of the waters, the bountiful hero, sustains with oblation,

children.text: pitā kuṭasya carṣaṇiḥ ||
children.translated_text: the father of the house, the man among peoples.

children.text: ādāro vām matīnāṃ nāsatyā matavacasā
children.translated_text: O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, support of inspired thoughts, praised by thoughtful speech,

children.text: pātaṃ somasya dhṛṣṇuyā ||
children.translated_text: drink the soma boldly.

children.text: yā naḥ pīparad aśvinā jyotiṣmatī tamas tiraḥ
children.translated_text: That luminous refreshment, O <s>Aśvins</s>, which will carry us across the darkness,

children.text: tām asme rāsāthām iṣam ||
children.translated_text: grant that nourishment to us.

children.text: ā no nāvā matīnāṃ yātam pārāya gantave
children.translated_text: Come to us with the boat of inspired thoughts, to go to the far shore.

children.text: yuñjāthām aśvinā ratham ||
children.translated_text: Yoke the chariot, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: aritraṃ vāṃ divas pṛthu tīrthe sindhūnāṃ rathaḥ
children.translated_text: Your broad oar from heaven, your chariot at the ford of the rivers,

children.text: dhiyā yuyujra indavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the soma drops have yoked by inspired thought.

children.text: divas kaṇvāsa indavo vasu sindhūnām pade
children.translated_text: The soma drops of the <s>Kaṇvas</s> from heaven, at the rich place of the rivers,

children.text: svaṃ vavriṃ kuha dhitsathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: where do you two wish to set your own covering?

children.text: abhūd u bhā u aṃśave hiraṇyam prati sūryaḥ
children.translated_text: The sun has appeared with golden light for the soma-shoot,

children.text: vy akhyaj jihvayāsitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the dark one has made himself manifest with his tongue.

children.text: abhūd u pāram etave panthā ṛtasya sādhuyā
children.translated_text: The path of truth has appeared, easy to follow, for going to the farther shore.

children.text: adarśi vi srutir divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The stream from heaven has been seen spreading out.

children.text: tat tad id aśvinor avo jaritā prati bhūṣati
children.translated_text: The singer adorns each and every aid of the <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: made somasya pipratoḥ ||
children.translated_text: while the two swell with the exhilaration of soma.

children.text: vāvasānā vivasvati somasya pītyā girā
children.translated_text: Longing at the home of <s>Vivasvat</s> for the drinking of soma, with song,

children.text: manuṣvacchambhū ā gatam ||
children.translated_text: come like human benefactors, bringers of happiness.

children.text: yuvor uṣā anu śriyam parijmanor upācarat
children.translated_text: <s>Uṣas</s> has followed the beauty of you two as you range around.

children.text: ṛtā vanatho aktubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: You win the truths through the nights.

children.text: ubhā pibatam aśvinobhā naḥ śarma yacchatam
children.translated_text: Drink, both of you, O <s>Aśvins</s>; both of you grant us shelter,

children.text: avidriyābhir ūtibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: with helps that do not fail.

children.text: Chapter 47
ayaṃ vām madhumattamaḥ sutaḥ soma ṛtāvṛdhā
children.translated_text: This sweetest pressed soma is yours, O increasers of truth.

children.text: tam aśvinā pibataṃ tiroahnyaṃ dhattaṃ ratnāni dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: Drink it, O <s>Aśvins</s>, as the drink of the day just past, and place treasures for the worshipper.

children.text: trivandhureṇa trivṛtā supeśasā rathenā yātam aśvinā
children.translated_text: Come, O <s>Aśvins</s>, with your well-fashioned three-seated, threefold chariot.

children.text: kaṇvāso vām brahma kṛṇvanty adhvare teṣāṃ su śṛṇutaṃ havam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Kaṇvas</s> make prayer for you at the rite; listen well to their call.

children.text: aśvinā madhumattamam pātaṃ somam ṛtāvṛdhā
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, drink the sweetest soma, O increasers of truth.

children.text: athādya dasrā vasu bibhratā rathe dāśvāṃsam upa gacchatam ||
children.translated_text: Then today, O wondrous ones, bearing goods in your chariot, come to the giver.

children.text: triṣadhasthe barhiṣi viśvavedasā madhvā yajñam mimikṣatam
children.translated_text: On the three-seated sacred grass, O all-knowing ones, mingle the sacrifice with sweetness.

children.text: kaṇvāso vāṃ sutasomā abhidyavo yuvāṃ havante aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Kaṇvas</s>, with soma pressed and turned toward the gods, call upon you two, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: yābhiḥ kaṇvam abhiṣṭibhiḥ prāvataṃ yuvam aśvinā
children.translated_text: With those aids by which you two protected <s>Kaṇva</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: tābhiḥ ṣv asmāṁ avataṃ śubhas patī pātaṃ somam ṛtāvṛdhā ||
children.translated_text: With those aids protect us, lords of splendor; drink the soma, you who increase <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: sudāse dasrā vasu bibhratā rathe pṛkṣo vahatam aśvinā
children.translated_text: For <s>Sudās</s>, O wonder-workers, bearing wealth in your chariot, O <s>Aśvins</s>, bring refreshment.

children.text: rayiṃ samudrād uta vā divas pary asme dhattam puruspṛham ||
children.translated_text: Set for us wealth from the ocean, or else from heaven, much desired by many.

children.text: yan nāsatyā parāvati yad vā stho adhi turvaśe
children.translated_text: Whether, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, you are in the distance, or whether you are stationed over <s>Turvaśa</s>,

children.text: ato rathena suvṛtā na ā gataṃ sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: from there come to us with your well-rolling chariot, together with the rays of <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: arvāñcā vāṃ saptayo 'dhvaraśriyo vahantu savaned upa
children.translated_text: May your steeds, splendid in the sacrifice, bring you hither to the soma-pressing,

children.text: iṣam pṛñcantā sukṛte sudānava ā barhiḥ sīdataṃ narā ||
children.translated_text: filling refreshment for the good worker, O good givers; sit down upon the sacred grass, O men.

children.text: tena nāsatyā gataṃ rathena sūryatvacā
children.translated_text: With that chariot come, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, the one clothed in the sun,

children.text: yena śaśvad ūhathur dāśuṣe vasu madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: with which you always bring wealth to the worshipper, to drink the sweetness of the soma.

children.text: ukthebhir arvāg avase purūvasū arkaiś ca ni hvayāmahe
children.translated_text: With praises and with songs we call you hither for help, O possessors of abundant wealth,

children.text: śaśvat kaṇvānāṃ sadasi priye hi kaṃ somam papathur aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: for always, O <s>Aśvins</s>, in the beloved seat of the <s>Kaṇvas</s>, you have drunk soma.

children.text: Chapter 48
saha vāmena na uṣo vy ucchā duhitar divaḥ
children.translated_text: Together with bounty for us, O <s>Uṣas</s>, shine forth, daughter of Heaven,

children.text: saha dyumnena bṛhatā vibhāvari rāyā devi dāsvatī ||
children.translated_text: together with great brilliance, O radiant goddess, bestowing wealth.

children.text: aśvāvatīr gomatīr viśvasuvido bhūri cyavanta vastave
children.translated_text: Let horse-rich, cow-rich, all-finding riches stream forth in abundance for our dwelling.

children.text: ud īraya prati mā sūnṛtā uṣaś coda rādho maghonām ||
children.translated_text: Raise them up toward me, gracious <s>Uṣas</s>; impel the bounty of the generous.

children.text: uvāsoṣā ucchāc ca nu devī jīrā rathānām
children.translated_text: <s>Uṣas</s> has shone; and now the goddess has shone forth, swift among chariots,

children.text: ye asyā ācaraṇeṣu dadhrire samudre na śravasyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: which, eager for fame, have been set in her courses like ships upon the sea.

children.text: uṣo ye te pra yāmeṣu yuñjate mano dānāya sūrayaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, those patrons who yoke their mind to giving in your processions,

children.text: atrāha tat kaṇva eṣāṃ kaṇvatamo nāma gṛṇāti nṛṇām ||
children.translated_text: there <s>Kaṇva</s>, most <s>Kaṇva</s>-like of them, sings the name of these men.

children.text: ā ghā yoṣeva sūnary uṣā yāti prabhuñjatī
children.translated_text: Now <s>Uṣas</s> comes like a young woman, a fair one, making herself manifest.

children.text: jarayantī vṛjanam padvad īyata ut pātayati pakṣiṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Making the mortal host grow old, she goes like one on foot; she makes the birds fly up.

children.text: vi yā sṛjati samanaṃ vy arthinaḥ padaṃ na vety odatī
children.translated_text: She scatters the assembly; she scatters those seeking gain; rising, she does not miss her path.

children.text: vayo nakiṣ ṭe paptivāṃsa āsate vyuṣṭau vājinīvati ||
children.translated_text: The birds that have flown do not sit still at your dawning, O prize-winning one.

children.text: eṣāyukta parāvataḥ sūryasyodayanād adhi
children.translated_text: This fortunate <s>Uṣas</s> has yoked from far away, from the rising-place of <s>Sūrya</s>;

children.text: śataṃ rathebhiḥ subhagoṣā iyaṃ vi yāty abhi mānuṣān ||
children.translated_text: with a hundred chariots she goes out among human beings.

children.text: viśvam asyā nānāma cakṣase jagaj jyotiṣ kṛṇoti sūnarī
children.translated_text: All that moves bows to her for sight; the fair lady makes light.

children.text: apa dveṣo maghonī duhitā diva uṣā ucchad apa sridhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O generous daughter of Heaven, <s>Uṣas</s>, shine away hatreds; shine away deceits.

children.text: uṣa ā bhāhi bhānunā candreṇa duhitar divaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, shine here with your bright and lovely radiance, daughter of Heaven,

children.text: āvahantī bhūry asmabhyaṃ saubhagaṃ vyucchantī diviṣṭiṣu ||
children.translated_text: bringing much good fortune to us as you dawn in the heavenly regions.

children.text: viśvasya hi prāṇanaṃ jīvanaṃ tve vi yad ucchasi sūnari
children.translated_text: For in you is the breathing and life of all, when you shine forth, fair one.

children.text: sā no rathena bṛhatā vibhāvari śrudhi citrāmaghe havam ||
children.translated_text: So, radiant one rich in varied gifts, hear our call with your great chariot.

children.text: uṣo vājaṃ hi vaṃsva yaś citro mānuṣe jane
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, win the prize that is splendid among the human people;

children.text: tenā vaha sukṛto adhvarāṁ upa ye tvā gṛṇanti vahnayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with it bring to the sacrifices the good workers, the callers who praise you.

children.text: viśvān devāṁ ā vaha somapītaye 'ntarikṣād uṣas tvam
children.translated_text: Bring all the gods from the midspace for the drinking of soma, O <s>Uṣas</s>.

children.text: sāsmāsu dhā gomad aśvāvad ukthyam uṣo vājaṃ suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: Place among us, O <s>Uṣas</s>, a laudable prize rich in cows, rich in horses, and full of heroic strength.

children.text: yasyā ruśanto arcayaḥ prati bhadrā adṛkṣata
children.translated_text: She whose reddish beams have appeared auspiciously before us,

children.text: sā no rayiṃ viśvavāraṃ supeśasam uṣā dadātu sugmyam ||
children.translated_text: may that <s>Uṣas</s> give us desirable wealth, chosen by all, beautifully adorned and easy to attain.

children.text: ye ciddhi tvām ṛṣayaḥ pūrva ūtaye juhūre 'vase mahi
children.translated_text: For even the former seers called upon you for aid, for great help;

children.text: sā na stomāṁ abhi gṛṇīhi rādhasoṣaḥ śukreṇa śociṣā ||
children.translated_text: so, O <s>Uṣas</s>, with bright flame, favor our praises for bounty.

children.text: uṣo yad adya bhānunā vi dvārāv ṛṇavo divaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, when today with your radiance you open wide the two doors of heaven,

children.text: pra no yacchatād avṛkam pṛthu cchardiḥ pra devi gomatīr iṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: grant us, O goddess, broad shelter free from wolves; grant us cow-rich refreshments.

children.text: saṃ no rāyā bṛhatā viśvapeśasā mimikṣvā sam iḍābhir ā
children.translated_text: Mingle yourself for us with great wealth, adorned in every form; come together with nourishments.

children.text: saṃ dyumnena viśvaturoṣo mahi saṃ vājair vājinīvati ||
children.translated_text: Come together with brilliance that overcomes all, O mighty <s>Uṣas</s>, together with prizes, O prize-winning one.

children.text: Chapter 49
uṣo bhadrebhir ā gahi divaś cid rocanād adhi
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, come here with auspicious gifts, even from the shining realm of heaven.

children.text: vahantv aruṇapsava upa tvā somino gṛham ||
children.translated_text: Let the ruddy ones with bright forms carry you to the house of the soma-pressers.

children.text: supeśasaṃ sukhaṃ rathaṃ yam adhyasthā uṣas tvam
children.translated_text: The well-formed, easy-running chariot that you have mounted, O <s>Uṣas</s>,

children.text: tenā suśravasaṃ janam prāvādya duhitar divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with that protect today the man of good fame, daughter of Heaven.

children.text: vayaś cit te patatriṇo dvipac catuṣpad arjuni
children.translated_text: Even the winged birds, and the two-footed and four-footed creatures, O bright one,

children.text: uṣaḥ prārann ṛtūṃr anu divo antebhyas pari ||
children.translated_text: have gone forth at your dawnings, according to their seasons, from the ends of heaven.

children.text: vyucchantī hi raśmibhir viśvam ābhāsi rocanam
children.translated_text: For dawning with your rays, you illumine the whole luminous realm.

children.text: tāṃ tvām uṣar vasūyavo gīrbhiḥ kaṇvā ahūṣata ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Kaṇvas</s>, desiring wealth, have called upon you, O <s>Uṣas</s>, with songs.

children.text: Chapter 50
ud u tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ
children.translated_text: The beacons carry up that <s>Jātavedas</s>, the god,

children.text: dṛśe viśvāya sūryam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Sūrya</s>, for all to see.

children.text: apa tye tāyavo yathā nakṣatrā yanty aktubhiḥ
children.translated_text: Like thieves, those stars go away with the nights

children.text: sūrāya viśvacakṣase ||
children.translated_text: before <s>Sūrya</s>, the all-seeing.

children.text: adṛśram asya ketavo vi raśmayo janāṁ anu
children.translated_text: His beacons have become visible; his rays have spread among the peoples,

children.text: bhrājanto agnayo yathā ||
children.translated_text: shining like fires.

children.text: taraṇir viśvadarśato jyotiṣkṛd asi sūrya
children.translated_text: O <s>Sūrya</s>, you are the swift one, visible to all, maker of light.

children.text: viśvam ā bhāsi rocanam ||
children.translated_text: You illumine the whole luminous realm.

children.text: pratyaṅ devānāṃ viśaḥ pratyaṅṅ ud eṣi mānuṣān
children.translated_text: Facing the tribes of the gods, facing human beings, you rise;

children.text: pratyaṅ viśvaṃ svar dṛśe ||
children.translated_text: facing the whole heavenly light, for sight.

children.text: yenā pāvaka cakṣasā bhuraṇyantaṃ janāṁ anu
children.translated_text: With that purifying eye by which, following the restless peoples,

children.text: tvaṃ varuṇa paśyasi ||
children.translated_text: you, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, see.

children.text: vi dyām eṣi rajas pṛthv ahā mimāno aktubhiḥ
children.translated_text: You traverse heaven and the broad midspace, measuring the days with nights,

children.text: paśyañ janmāni sūrya ||
children.translated_text: watching the births, O <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: sapta tvā harito rathe vahanti deva sūrya
children.translated_text: Seven bay mares carry you in the chariot, O god <s>Sūrya</s>,

children.text: śociṣkeśaṃ vicakṣaṇa ||
children.translated_text: flame-haired and far-seeing.

children.text: ayukta sapta śundhyuvaḥ sūro rathasya naptyaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Sūrya</s> has yoked the seven bright daughters of the chariot;

children.text: tābhir yāti svayuktibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: with them, self-yoked, he goes.

children.text: ud vayaṃ tamasas pari jyotiṣ paśyanta uttaram
children.translated_text: We have come up beyond the darkness, seeing the higher light;

children.text: devaṃ devatrā sūryam aganma jyotir uttamam ||
children.translated_text: we have reached <s>Sūrya</s>, god among the gods, the highest light.

children.text: udyann adya mitramaha ārohann uttarāṃ divam
children.translated_text: Rising today, O you of <s>Mitra</s>'s greatness, climbing the upper heaven,

children.text: hṛdrogam mama sūrya harimāṇaṃ ca nāśaya ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Sūrya</s>, destroy my heart disease and the jaundice.

children.text: śukeṣu me harimāṇaṃ ropaṇākāsu dadhmasi
children.translated_text: My jaundice we place among the parrots and among the <s>ropaṇākās</s>;

children.text: atho hāridraveṣu me harimāṇaṃ ni dadhmasi ||
children.translated_text: and likewise among the <s>hāridravas</s> we lay my jaundice.

children.text: ud agād ayam ādityo viśvena sahasā saha
children.translated_text: This <s>Āditya</s> has risen with all his power.

children.text: dviṣantam mahyaṃ randhayan mo ahaṃ dviṣate radham ||
children.translated_text: making the hostile one subject to me; may I not be subject to the hostile one.

children.text: Chapter 51
abhi tyam meṣam puruhūtam ṛgmiyam indraṃ gīrbhir madatā vasvo arṇavam
children.translated_text: Gladden with songs that ram-like, much-invoked, hymn-worthy <s>Indra</s>, the ocean of wealth,

children.text: yasya dyāvo na vicaranti mānuṣā bhuje maṃhiṣṭham abhi vipram arcata ||
children.translated_text: whose human worshippers do not stray like the heavens; praise the inspired one, greatest for enjoyment.

children.text: abhīm avanvan svabhiṣṭim ūtayo 'ntarikṣaprāṃ taviṣībhir āvṛtam
children.translated_text: The aids came toward him with good favor, filling the midspace, enveloped with powers.

children.text: indraṃ dakṣāsa ṛbhavo madacyutaṃ śatakratuṃ javanī sūnṛtāruhat ||
children.translated_text: The skillful <s>Ṛbhus</s> and swift truthful speech mounted <s>Indra</s>, from whom exhilaration flows, the hundred-powered one.

children.text: tvaṃ gotram aṅgirobhyo 'vṛṇor apotātraye śatadureṣu gātuvit
children.translated_text: You opened the cow-stall for the <s>Aṅgirases</s>; you found a path for <s>Atri</s> through the hundred-doored places.

children.text: sasena cid vimadāyāvaho vasv ājāv adriṃ vāvasānasya nartayan ||
children.translated_text: With an army you brought wealth even for <s>Vimada</s>; in the contest you made the rock dance for the one who longed for it.

children.text: tvam apām apidhānāvṛṇor apādhārayaḥ parvate dānumad vasu
children.translated_text: You opened the enclosures of the waters; you held up on the mountain the wealth possessed by <s>Dānu</s>.

children.text: vṛtraṃ yad indra śavasāvadhīr ahim ād it sūryaṃ divy ārohayo dṛśe ||
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indra</s>, with might you slew <s>Vṛtra</s>, the serpent, then you raised the sun in heaven for sight.

children.text: tvam māyābhir apa māyino 'dhamaḥ svadhābhir ye adhi śuptāv ajuhvata
children.translated_text: With your powers of illusion you drove away the illusion-makers, who by their own laws had made offerings over sleep.

children.text: tvam pipror nṛmaṇaḥ prārujaḥ puraḥ pra ṛjiśvānaṃ dasyuhatyeṣv āvitha ||
children.translated_text: You broke open the forts of <s>Pipru</s>, O manly-minded one; you aided <s>Ṛjiśvan</s> in the slayings of the <s>Dasyus</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ kutsaṃ śuṣṇahatyeṣv āvithārandhayo 'tithigvāya śambaram
children.translated_text: You aided <s>Kutsa</s> in the slayings of <s>Śuṣṇa</s>; you subdued <s>Śambara</s> for <s>Atithigva</s>.

children.text: mahāntaṃ cid arbudaṃ ni kramīḥ padā sanād eva dasyuhatyāya jajñiṣe ||
children.translated_text: Even great <s>Arbuda</s> you trampled down with your foot; from of old you were born for the slaying of the <s>Dasyus</s>.

children.text: tve viśvā taviṣī sadhryagghitā tava rādhaḥ somapīthāya harṣate
children.translated_text: In you all powers are set together; your gift rejoices for the drinking of <s>soma</s>.

children.text: tava vajraś cikite bāhvor hito vṛścā śatror ava viśvāni vṛṣṇyā ||
children.translated_text: Your <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt), set in your arms, is recognized; cut down all the enemy's powers, O bull.

children.text: vi jānīhy āryān ye ca dasyavo barhiṣmate randhayā śāsad avratān
children.translated_text: Distinguish the <s>Āryas</s> and those who are <s>Dasyus</s>; subdue them for the one who has strewn the sacred grass, and chastise the vowless.

children.text: śākī bhava yajamānasya coditā viśvet tā te sadhamādeṣu cākana ||
children.translated_text: Be strong, the sacrificer's impeller; all those powers of yours have pleased us in the common feasts.

children.text: anuvratāya randhayann apavratān ābhūbhir indraḥ śnathayann anābhuvaḥ
children.translated_text: For the keeper of the rite, <s>Indra</s> subdues the rite-less, shattering the unreal with real powers.

children.text: vṛddhasya cid vardhato dyām inakṣata stavāno vamro vi jaghāna saṃdihaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even as <s>Vamra</s> praised the grown and still-growing one, they reached heaven; he struck apart the bonds.

children.text: takṣad yat ta uśanā sahasā saho vi rodasī majmanā bādhate śavaḥ
children.translated_text: When <s>Uśanā</s> fashioned force upon force for you with might, your power presses heaven and earth apart by its greatness.

children.text: ā tvā vātasya nṛmaṇo manoyuja ā pūryamāṇam avahann abhi śravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: To you, as you were being filled, the manly powers, yoked with thought like the wind, brought renown.

children.text: mandiṣṭa yad uśane kāvye sacāṁ indro vaṅkū vaṅkutarādhi tiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: Most gladdening, when together with <s>Uśanā Kāvya</s>, <s>Indra</s> stands over the crooked one, more crooked than the crooked.

children.text: ugro yayiṃ nir apaḥ srotasāsṛjad vi śuṣṇasya dṛṃhitā airayat puraḥ ||
children.translated_text: The fierce mover released the waters from their stream, and shook apart the firm forts of <s>Śuṣṇa</s>.

children.text: ā smā rathaṃ vṛṣapāṇeṣu tiṣṭhasi śāryātasya prabhṛtā yeṣu mandase
children.translated_text: You mount the chariot among the bull-pressers, where you are gladdened by the offerings of <s>Śāryāta</s>.

children.text: indra yathā sutasomeṣu cākano 'narvāṇaṃ ślokam ā rohase divi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, just as you delight in the pressed <s>somas</s>, you mount unconquered fame in heaven.

children.text: adadā arbhām mahate vacasyave kakṣīvate vṛcayām indra sunvate
children.translated_text: You gave the small <s>Vṛcayā</s> to great <s>Kakṣīvat</s>, the eloquent soma-presser, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: menābhavo vṛṣaṇaśvasya sukrato viśvet tā te savaneṣu pravācyā ||
children.translated_text: You became <s>Menā</s> for <s>Vṛṣaṇaśva</s>, O wise one; all those deeds of yours are to be proclaimed at the pressings.

children.text: indro aśrāyi sudhyo nireke pajreṣu stomo duryo na yūpaḥ
children.translated_text: The well-minded hymn to <s>Indra</s> has been set firm among the <s>Pajras</s>, like a sacrificial post at the doorway.

children.text: aśvayur gavyū rathayur vasūyur indra id rāyaḥ kṣayati prayantā ||
children.translated_text: Desiring horses, cows, chariots, and wealth, the giver <s>Indra</s> alone rules over riches.

children.text: idaṃ namo vṛṣabhāya svarāje satyaśuṣmāya tavase 'vāci
children.translated_text: This homage has been spoken to the bull, the self-ruler, true in force and mighty.

children.text: asminn indra vṛjane sarvavīrāḥ smat sūribhis tava śarman syāma ||
children.translated_text: In this contest, O <s>Indra</s>, may we, rich in all heroes, together with our patrons, be in your shelter.

children.text: Chapter 52
tyaṃ su meṣam mahayā svarvidaṃ śataṃ yasya subhvaḥ sākam īrate
children.translated_text: Magnify for me that ram-like finder of light, whose fair powers rise together by the hundred.

children.text: atyaṃ na vājaṃ havanasyadaṃ ratham endraṃ vavṛtyām avase suvṛktibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like a racehorse, a prize-winning chariot eager for invocation, I would turn <s>Indra</s> here for help with fair praises.

children.text: sa parvato na dharuṇeṣv acyutaḥ sahasramūtis taviṣīṣu vāvṛdhe
children.translated_text: He, like a mountain unshaken in its foundations, has grown in his powers, furnished with a thousand aids.

children.text: indro yad vṛtram avadhīn nadīvṛtam ubjann arṇāṃsi jarhṛṣāṇo andhasā ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Indra</s> slew <s>Vṛtra</s>, who enclosed the rivers, he pressed out the floods, rejoicing in the <s>soma</s>.

children.text: sa hi dvaro dvariṣu vavra ūdhani candrabudhno madavṛddho manīṣibhiḥ
children.translated_text: For he, enclosed at the doors and at the udder, with shining base, is increased by exhilaration among the inspired poets.

children.text: indraṃ tam ahve svapasyayā dhiyā maṃhiṣṭharātiṃ sa hi paprir andhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I call that <s>Indra</s> with a thought seeking good work, the giver of greatest gifts, for he has filled himself with the <s>soma</s> draught.

children.text: ā yam pṛṇanti divi sadmabarhiṣaḥ samudraṃ na subhvaḥ svā abhiṣṭayaḥ
children.translated_text: As the fair invocations fill him in heaven at the seat of the sacred grass, like their own desires filling the ocean,

children.text: taṃ vṛtrahatye anu tasthur ūtayaḥ śuṣmā indram avātā ahrutapsavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the aids stood by him in the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>; his forces stood by <s>Indra</s>, unturned, with unfailing brilliance.

children.text: abhi svavṛṣṭim made asya yudhyato raghvīr iva pravaṇe sasrur ūtayaḥ
children.translated_text: Toward his own rain, in his exhilaration as he fought, the swift aids streamed like waters down a slope.

children.text: indro yad vajrī dhṛṣamāṇo andhasā bhinad valasya paridhīṃr iva tritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Indra</s>, bearing the <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt) and made bold by the <s>soma</s>, broke the enclosures of <s>Vala</s>, as <s>Trita</s> did.

children.text: parīṃ ghṛṇā carati titviṣe śavo 'po vṛtvī rajaso budhnam āśayat
children.translated_text: His glowing might moves around; having enclosed the waters, it lay at the bottom of the airy realm.

children.text: vṛtrasya yat pravaṇe durgṛbhiśvano nijaghantha hanvor indra tanyatum ||
children.translated_text: When, on the slope of hard-to-grasp, bellowing <s>Vṛtra</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, you struck the thunder from his jaws.

children.text: hradaṃ na hi tvā nyṛṣanty ūrmayo brahmāṇīndra tava yāni vardhanā
children.translated_text: The hymns that strengthen you, O <s>Indra</s>, do not drag you down, just as waves do not overwhelm a lake.

children.text: tvaṣṭā cit te yujyaṃ vāvṛdhe śavas tatakṣa vajram abhibhūtyojasam ||
children.translated_text: Even <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> increased your fitting strength; he fashioned the <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt) of overpowering force.

children.text: jaghanvāṁ u haribhiḥ sambhṛtakratav indra vṛtram manuṣe gātuyann apaḥ
children.translated_text: Having slain <s>Vṛtra</s> with your bay horses and gathered resolve, O <s>Indra</s>, you made the waters a path for man.

children.text: ayacchathā bāhvor vajram āyasam adhārayo divy ā sūryaṃ dṛśe ||
children.translated_text: You stretched the iron <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt) in your arms; you held up the sun in heaven for sight.

children.text: bṛhat svaścandram amavad yad ukthyam akṛṇvata bhiyasā rohaṇaṃ divaḥ
children.translated_text: When they made the great, bright, strong, praiseworthy power, the ascent of heaven came through fear.

children.text: yan mānuṣapradhanā indram ūtayaḥ svar nṛṣāco maruto 'madann anu ||
children.translated_text: When the helps that lead men, and the <s>Maruts</s> following after, gladdened <s>Indra</s> for the heavenly light.

children.text: dyauś cid asyāmavāṁ aheḥ svanād ayoyavīd bhiyasā vajra indra te
children.translated_text: Even heaven, mighty as it is, recoiled in fear from the serpent's roar, from your <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt), O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: vṛtrasya yad badbadhānasya rodasī made sutasya śavasābhinacchiraḥ ||
children.translated_text: When, with the power of the pressed <s>soma</s>, you smashed the head of <s>Vṛtra</s> as he bound heaven and earth.

children.text: yad in nv indra pṛthivī daśabhujir ahāni viśvā tatananta kṛṣṭayaḥ
children.translated_text: When now, O <s>Indra</s>, the ten-armed earth and all peoples stretched out all the days,

children.text: atrāha te maghavan viśrutaṃ saho dyām anu śavasā barhaṇā bhuvat ||
children.translated_text: then, O <s>Maghavan</s>, your widely famed force, through might and greatness, became equal to heaven.

children.text: tvam asya pāre rajaso vyomanaḥ svabhūtyojā avase dhṛṣanmanaḥ
children.translated_text: You, with your own being and strength, O bold-minded one, made yourself for aid beyond this expanse, beyond the heaven of space.

children.text: cakṛṣe bhūmim pratimānam ojaso 'paḥ svaḥ paribhūr eṣy ā divam ||
children.translated_text: You made the earth a counterpart of your might; encompassing the waters and the solar realm, you go up to heaven.

children.text: tvam bhuvaḥ pratimānam pṛthivyā ṛṣvavīrasya bṛhataḥ patir bhūḥ
children.translated_text: You became the counterpart of earth, the lord of the lofty, heroic, vast realm.

children.text: viśvam āprā antarikṣam mahitvā satyam addhā nakir anyas tvāvān ||
children.translated_text: By your greatness you filled the whole midspace. Truly, in truth, there is no other like you.

children.text: na yasya dyāvāpṛthivī anu vyaco na sindhavo rajaso antam ānaśuḥ
children.translated_text: The two worlds, heaven and earth, have not reached the end of his breadth, nor have the rivers reached the end of the airy region.

children.text: nota svavṛṣṭim made asya yudhyata eko anyac cakṛṣe viśvam ānuṣak ||
children.translated_text: Nor, in his exhilaration, do they contend with his own rain-power. Alone you have made all else in order.

children.text: ārcann atra marutaḥ sasminn ājau viśve devāso amadann anu tvā
children.translated_text: Here in that battle the <s>Maruts</s> sang; all the gods rejoiced after you.

children.text: vṛtrasya yad bhṛṣṭimatā vadhena ni tvam indra praty ānaṃ jaghantha ||
children.translated_text: When, with the crushing weapon used against <s>Vṛtra</s>, you, O <s>Indra</s>, struck down the opposing serpent.

children.text: Chapter 53
ny ū ṣu vācam pra mahe bharāmahe gira indrāya sadane vivasvataḥ
children.translated_text: Now let us bring forth speech for the great one, songs for <s>Indra</s> in the dwelling of <s>Vivasvat</s>.

children.text: nū ciddhi ratnaṃ sasatām ivāvidan na duṣṭutir draviṇodeṣu śasyate ||
children.translated_text: For even now they have found treasure, as if among those lying asleep; poor praise is not commended among givers of wealth.

children.text: duro aśvasya dura indra gor asi duro yavasya vasuna inas patiḥ
children.translated_text: You are the gate of the horse, O <s>Indra</s>, the gate of the cow, the gate of barley; you are lord of wealth and master.

children.text: śikṣānaraḥ pradivo akāmakarśanaḥ sakhā sakhibhyas tam idaṃ gṛṇīmasi ||
children.translated_text: A helper of men from of old, not tormenting the desire, a friend to friends: him we now praise.

children.text: śacīva indra purukṛd dyumattama taved idam abhitaś cekite vasu
children.translated_text: Powerful, O <s>Indra</s>, doer of many deeds, most brilliant, this wealth of yours is perceived on every side.

children.text: ataḥ saṃgṛbhyābhibhūta ā bhara mā tvāyato jarituḥ kāmam ūnayīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Therefore gather it together and, as conqueror, bring it here. Do not diminish the singer's desire while he seeks you.

children.text: ebhir dyubhiḥ sumanā ebhir indubhir nirundhāno amatiṃ gobhir aśvinā
children.translated_text: With these bright days, with these <s>soma</s> drops, being gracious, warding off want with cattle, O horse-rich one,

children.text: indreṇa dasyuṃ darayanta indubhir yutadveṣasaḥ sam iṣā rabhemahi ||
children.translated_text: with <s>Indra</s>, splitting the <s>Dasyu</s> by the <s>soma</s> drops, hating those who hate us, may we seize refreshment together.

children.text: sam indra rāyā sam iṣā rabhemahi saṃ vājebhiḥ puruścandrair abhidyubhiḥ
children.translated_text: Together, O <s>Indra</s>, may we seize wealth; together may we seize refreshment; together may we seize prizes, many-bright, shining around.

children.text: saṃ devyā pramatyā vīraśuṣmayā goagrayāśvāvatyā rabhemahi ||
children.translated_text: Together may we seize them with divine insight, with heroic strength, foremost in cattle and possessed of horses.

children.text: te tvā madā amadan tāni vṛṣṇyā te somāso vṛtrahatyeṣu satpate
children.translated_text: Those exhilarations exhilarated you, those manly powers, those <s>soma</s> draughts in the slayings of <s>Vṛtra</s>, O true lord,

children.text: yat kārave daśa vṛtrāṇy aprati barhiṣmate ni sahasrāṇi barhayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when for the singer seated on the sacred grass you felled ten unopposed <s>Vṛtras</s> and thousands.

children.text: yudhā yudham upa ghed eṣi dhṛṣṇuyā purā puraṃ sam idaṃ haṃsy ojasā
children.translated_text: From battle to battle you come near with boldness; with your might you shatter fortress after fortress.

children.text: namyā yad indra sakhyā parāvati nibarhayo namuciṃ nāma māyinam ||
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indra</s>, by friendship in the distance you bowed down the wily one named <s>Namuci</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ karañjam uta parṇayaṃ vadhīs tejiṣṭhayātithigvasya vartanī
children.translated_text: You slew <s>Karañja</s> and also <s>Parṇaya</s> with the sharpest track of <s>Atithigva</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ śatā vaṅgṛdasyābhinat puro 'nānudaḥ pariṣūtā ṛjiśvanā ||
children.translated_text: You broke open a hundred fortresses of <s>Vaṅgṛda</s>; with <s>Ṛjiśvan</s> you drove out those hemmed in and unyielding.

children.text: tvam etāñ janarājño dvir daśābandhunā suśravasopajagmuṣaḥ
children.translated_text: You, famed one, by your chariot wheel drove down those people-kings, twice ten, who had come near with the bondless <s>Suśravas</s>,

children.text: ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrā navatiṃ nava śruto ni cakreṇa rathyā duṣpadāvṛṇak ||
children.translated_text: sixty thousand, ninety, and nine, hard to overcome on the chariot path.

children.text: tvam āvitha suśravasaṃ tavotibhis tava trāmabhir indra tūrvayāṇam
children.translated_text: You aided <s>Suśravas</s> with your helps; with your protections, O <s>Indra</s>, you aided <s>Tūrvayāṇa</s>.

children.text: tvam asmai kutsam atithigvam āyum mahe rājñe yūne arandhanāyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For this great youthful king, <s>Arandhana</s>, you won <s>Kutsa</s>, <s>Atithigva</s>, and <s>Āyu</s>.

children.text: ya udṛcīndra devagopāḥ sakhāyas te śivatamā asāma
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, may we be your friends, upward-looking, guarded by the gods, and most auspicious.

children.text: tvāṃ stoṣāma tvayā suvīrā drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let us praise you; through you, rich in heroes, holding a longer and further-reaching life.

children.text: Chapter 54
mā no asmin maghavan pṛtsv aṃhasi nahi te antaḥ śavasaḥ parīṇaśe
children.translated_text: Do not leave us, O bountiful one, in distress amid these battles; for the end of your force is not to be reached.

children.text: akrandayo nadyo roruvad vanā kathā na kṣoṇīr bhiyasā sam ārata ||
children.translated_text: You made the rivers cry out, the forests roar. How did the lands not come together in fear?

children.text: arcā śakrāya śākine śacīvate śṛṇvantam indram mahayann abhi ṣṭuhi
children.translated_text: Sing to the mighty, powerful, strength-possessing one; extol <s>Indra</s>, who hears and is magnified.

children.text: yo dhṛṣṇunā śavasā rodasī ubhe vṛṣā vṛṣatvā vṛṣabho nyṛñjate ||
children.translated_text: He who, with bold force, both worlds, heaven and earth, the bull in his bull-power, causes to bow down.

children.text: arcā dive bṛhate śūṣyaṃ vacaḥ svakṣatraṃ yasya dhṛṣato dhṛṣan manaḥ
children.translated_text: Sing to great heaven a mighty word of praise; his is sovereign power, bold is his bold mind.

children.text: bṛhacchravā asuro barhaṇā kṛtaḥ puro haribhyāṃ vṛṣabho ratho hi ṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Of great fame, mighty in exaltation, he has been made strong; for he is the bull whose chariot is drawn by the two bay steeds.

children.text: tvaṃ divo bṛhataḥ sānu kopayo 'va tmanā dhṛṣatā śambaram bhinat
children.translated_text: You shook the ridge of great heaven; by your own bold self you shattered <s>Śambara</s> down below.

children.text: yan māyino vrandino mandinā dhṛṣacchitāṃ gabhastim aśanim pṛtanyasi ||
children.translated_text: When, with the exhilarating one, you fight the sorcerer, the binder, the thunderbolt held in your bold hand.

children.text: ni yad vṛṇakṣi śvasanasya mūrdhani śuṣṇasya cid vrandino roruvad vanā
children.translated_text: When you strike down upon the head of the snorting one, even of roaring, binding <s>Śuṣṇa</s>, amid the forests,

children.text: prācīnena manasā barhaṇāvatā yad adyā cit kṛṇavaḥ kas tvā pari ||
children.translated_text: with forward-facing mind and exalted strength, what you do even today, who can encompass you?

children.text: tvam āvitha naryaṃ turvaśaṃ yaduṃ tvaṃ turvītiṃ vayyaṃ śatakrato
children.translated_text: You aided manly <s>Turvaśa</s> and <s>Yadu</s>; you aided <s>Turvīti Vayya</s>, O hundred-powered one.

children.text: tvaṃ ratham etaśaṃ kṛtvye dhane tvam puro navatiṃ dambhayo nava ||
children.translated_text: You aided <s>Etaśa</s>'s chariot in the contest for wealth; you broke down ninety-nine fortresses.

children.text: sa ghā rājā satpatiḥ śūśuvaj jano rātahavyaḥ prati yaḥ śāsam invati
children.translated_text: That man is indeed king and true lord, the one with offered oblations, who follows your command.

children.text: ukthā vā yo abhigṛṇāti rādhasā dānur asmā uparā pinvate divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Or the one who praises hymns with a gift: for him the generous cloud of heaven swells up above.

children.text: asamaṃ kṣatram asamā manīṣā pra somapā apasā santu neme
children.translated_text: Unequalled is your rule, unequalled your insight. Let these men, O <s>soma</s>-drinker, be foremost through their work,

children.text: ye ta indra daduṣo vardhayanti mahi kṣatraṃ sthaviraṃ vṛṣṇyaṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: who, O <s>Indra</s>, increase the great, firm, manly dominion of the giver.

children.text: tubhyed ete bahulā adridugdhāś camūṣadaś camasā indrapānāḥ
children.translated_text: For you these many cups, milked from the stones, sitting in the bowls, are for <s>Indra</s>'s drinking.

children.text: vy aśnuhi tarpayā kāmam eṣām athā mano vasudeyāya kṛṣva ||
children.translated_text: Drink them widely; satisfy their desire. Then set your mind on giving wealth.

children.text: apām atiṣṭhad dharuṇahvaraṃ tamo 'ntar vṛtrasya jaṭhareṣu parvataḥ
children.translated_text: The mountain stood amid the waters, in the darkness of the crooked hollow, within the bellies of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: abhīm indro nadyo vavriṇā hitā viśvā anuṣṭhāḥ pravaṇeṣu jighnate ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> struck the rivers, enclosed by the covering, and all of them, set in place, rushed along the slopes.

children.text: sa śevṛdham adhi dhā dyumnam asme mahi kṣatraṃ janāṣāḍ indra tavyam
children.translated_text: Place that glory, rich in prosperity, upon us: great dominion over peoples, O <s>Indra</s>, mighty one.

children.text: rakṣā ca no maghonaḥ pāhi sūrīn rāye ca naḥ svapatyā iṣe dhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Protect us, the bountiful ones; guard our patrons. For wealth, good offspring, and refreshment, establish us.

children.text: Chapter 55
divaś cid asya varimā vi papratha indraṃ na mahnā pṛthivī cana prati
children.translated_text: Even the breadth of heaven has spread out from his greatness; not even the earth matches <s>Indra</s> in greatness.

children.text: bhīmas tuviṣmāñ carṣaṇibhya ātapaḥ śiśīte vajraṃ tejase na vaṃsagaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Terrible, very mighty, a heat for peoples, he sharpens the thunderbolt for brilliance, like a vigorous one.

children.text: so arṇavo na nadyaḥ samudriyaḥ prati gṛbhṇāti viśritā varīmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: He, like an oceanic flood, receives the outspread rivers with wide embraces;

children.text: indraḥ somasya pītaye vṛṣāyate sanāt sa yudhma ojasā panasyate ||
children.translated_text: for the drinking of soma <s>Indra</s> acts like a bull; from of old, battle-strong, he is praised for his might.

children.text: tvaṃ tam indra parvataṃ na bhojase maho nṛmṇasya dharmaṇām irajyasi
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, rule over that mountain as over enjoyment, over the ordinances of great manly power;

children.text: pra vīryeṇa devatāti cekite viśvasmā ugraḥ karmaṇe purohitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: by your heroic strength you are manifest in divine service, fierce, set in front for every deed.

children.text: sa id vane namasyubhir vacasyate cāru janeṣu prabruvāṇa indriyam
children.translated_text: He indeed is addressed by reverent men, lovely, proclaiming his Indra-power among peoples;

children.text: vṛṣā chandur bhavati haryato vṛṣā kṣemeṇa dhenām maghavā yad invati ||
children.translated_text: a bull, eager and impetuous, he becomes a bull when the bounteous one drives the milch-cow with security.

children.text: sa in mahāni samithāni majmanā kṛṇoti yudhma ojasā janebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: He indeed, by greatness, makes great contests for the people, battle-strong through might;

children.text: adhā cana śraddadhati tviṣīmata indrāya vajraṃ nighanighnate vadham ||
children.translated_text: then they put their trust in the brilliant one; for <s>Indra</s> they strike down the deadly weapon, the thunderbolt.

children.text: sa hi śravasyuḥ sadanāni kṛtrimā kṣmayā vṛdhāna ojasā vināśayan
children.translated_text: For he, seeking fame, growing upon the earth by strength, destroys the fashioned dwellings;

children.text: jyotīṃṣi kṛṇvann avṛkāṇi yajyave 'va sukratuḥ sartavā apaḥ sṛjat ||
children.translated_text: making harmless lights for the worshipper, the wise one released the waters to run down.

children.text: dānāya manaḥ somapāvann astu te 'rvāñcā harī vandanaśrud ā kṛdhi
children.translated_text: O soma-drinker, let your mind be set on giving; turn your two bay steeds hither, hearing praise,

children.text: yamiṣṭhāsaḥ sārathayo ya indra te na tvā ketā ā dabhnuvanti bhūrṇayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: those most guiding charioteers of yours, O <s>Indra</s>; no swift signs deceive you.

children.text: aprakṣitaṃ vasu bibharṣi hastayor aṣāḍhaṃ sahas tanvi śruto dadhe
children.translated_text: You carry inexhaustible wealth in your hands; irresistible force is lodged, famed, in your body;

children.text: āvṛtāso 'vatāso na kartṛbhis tanūṣu te kratava indra bhūrayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: covered and protected as if by makers, many are your powers in your bodies, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 56
eṣa pra pūrvīr ava tasya camriṣo 'tyo na yoṣām ud ayaṃsta bhurvaṇiḥ
children.translated_text: This restless one has driven forth his former coverings, like a stallion a mare; the sustainer has risen up;

children.text: dakṣam mahe pāyayate hiraṇyayaṃ ratham āvṛtyā hariyogam ṛbhvasam ||
children.translated_text: he refreshes the great golden power, turning around the skillfully made chariot yoked with bay horses.

children.text: taṃ gūrtayo nemanniṣaḥ parīṇasaḥ samudraṃ na saṃcaraṇe saniṣyavaḥ
children.translated_text: Songs and gain-seeking praises surround him, as men range around the sea;

children.text: patiṃ dakṣasya vidathasya nū saho giriṃ na venā adhi roha tejasā ||
children.translated_text: now, O strength, lord of skill and of the assembly, ascend with brilliance like a seer upon the mountain.

children.text: sa turvaṇir mahāṁ areṇu pauṃsye girer bhṛṣṭir na bhrājate tujā śavaḥ
children.translated_text: He is victorious, great, dustless in manly power; his impetuous might shines like a peak of the mountain;

children.text: yena śuṣṇam māyinam āyaso made dudhra ābhūṣu rāmayan ni dāmani ||
children.translated_text: with it, in the exhilaration of soma, he drove down deceitful <s>Śuṣṇa</s>, iron-like, amid the peoples, into his bonds.

children.text: devī yadi taviṣī tvāvṛdhotaya indraṃ siṣakty uṣasaṃ na sūryaḥ
children.translated_text: When divine might, with growing aids, attends you, <s>Indra</s>, as the sun attends <s>Uṣas</s>,

children.text: yo dhṛṣṇunā śavasā bādhate tama iyarti reṇum bṛhad arhariṣvaṇiḥ ||
children.translated_text: he who with bold force drives away darkness sends up the dust, loudly resounding in the broad space.

children.text: vi yat tiro dharuṇam acyutaṃ rajo 'tiṣṭhipo diva ātāsu barhaṇā
children.translated_text: When you set firm the high, unshaken realm beyond the atmosphere, in the expanses of heaven,

children.text: svarmīḍhe yan mada indra harṣyāhan vṛtraṃ nir apām aubjo arṇavam ||
children.translated_text: when, in the exhilaration of soma, O <s>Indra</s>, rejoicing in the light, you struck <s>Vṛtra</s> and thrust out the flood of waters.

children.text: tvaṃ divo dharuṇaṃ dhiṣa ojasā pṛthivyā indra sadaneṣu māhinaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, by strength established the support of heaven and, in the seats of earth, its greatness;

children.text: tvaṃ sutasya made ariṇā apo vi vṛtrasya samayā pāṣyārujaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you, in the exhilaration of the pressed soma, released the waters and broke apart the enclosing sides of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 57
pra maṃhiṣṭhāya bṛhate bṛhadraye satyaśuṣmāya tavase matim bhare
children.translated_text: I bring a thought to the most bounteous, great, rich in greatness, true in force and mighty;

children.text: apām iva pravaṇe yasya durdharaṃ rādho viśvāyu śavase apāvṛtam ||
children.translated_text: his life-long gift, like water on a slope, is irresistible and opened out for power.

children.text: adha te viśvam anu hāsad iṣṭaya āpo nimneva savanā haviṣmataḥ
children.translated_text: Then all offerings will follow after you, like waters to low ground, the libations rich in oblation;

children.text: yat parvate na samaśīta haryata indrasya vajraḥ śnathitā hiraṇyayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when desirable <s>Indra</s>'s golden thunderbolt, the splitter, came to rest as on the mountain.

children.text: asmai bhīmāya namasā sam adhvara uṣo na śubhra ā bharā panīyase
children.translated_text: To this fearsome one, with reverence at the rite, bring bright praise, like <s>Uṣas</s>, for the one worthy of lauding;

children.text: yasya dhāma śravase nāmendriyaṃ jyotir akāri harito nāyase ||
children.translated_text: for whose glory and fame the Indra-name and light have been made, for the bay steeds to lead.

children.text: ime ta indra te vayam puruṣṭuta ye tvārabhya carāmasi prabhūvaso
children.translated_text: These are yours, O much-praised <s>Indra</s>; we are those who move taking hold of you, O lord of much wealth;

children.text: nahi tvad anyo girvaṇo giraḥ saghat kṣoṇīr iva prati no harya tad vacaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for no other than you, O lover of song, can unite the songs; like lands, take pleasure in this speech of ours.

children.text: bhūri ta indra vīryaṃ tava smasy asya stotur maghavan kāmam ā pṛṇa
children.translated_text: Great is your heroic power, O <s>Indra</s>; we are yours; fulfill this singer's desire, O bounteous one.

children.text: anu te dyaur bṛhatī vīryam mama iyaṃ ca te pṛthivī nema ojase ||
children.translated_text: The broad heaven has measured itself after your heroic power, and this earth of yours bows to your strength.

children.text: tvaṃ tam indra parvatam mahāṁ uruṃ vajreṇa vajrin parvaśaś cakartitha
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, O wielder of the thunderbolt, cut that great, broad mountain limb by limb with the thunderbolt;

children.text: avāsṛjo nivṛtāḥ sartavā apaḥ satrā viśvaṃ dadhiṣe kevalaṃ sahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you released the pent-up waters to flow; altogether you alone hold universal strength.

children.text: Chapter 58
nū cit sahojā amṛto ni tundate hotā yad dūto abhavad vivasvataḥ
children.translated_text: Even now the immortal, born of power, is stirred, when he became the hotṛ-priest, messenger of <s>Vivasvat</s>;

children.text: vi sādhiṣṭhebhiḥ pathibhī rajo mama ā devatātā haviṣā vivāsati ||
children.translated_text: by the most favorable paths he has measured out the midspace; with oblation he makes his way to the gods.

children.text: ā svam adma yuvamāno ajaras tṛṣv aviṣyann ataseṣu tiṣṭhati
children.translated_text: Growing at his own food, undecaying, thirsty, not losing hold, he stands among the thickets;

children.text: atyo na pṛṣṭham pruṣitasya rocate divo na sānu stanayann acikradat ||
children.translated_text: like a horse the back of the sprinkled one shines; like a ridge of heaven, thundering, he has roared.

children.text: krāṇā rudrebhir vasubhiḥ purohito hotā niṣatto rayiṣāḍ amartyaḥ
children.translated_text: Acting with the <s>Rudras</s> and <s>Vasus</s>, set in front as hotṛ-priest, the immortal sits, winning riches;

children.text: ratho na vikṣv ṛñjasāna āyuṣu vy ānuṣag vāryā deva ṛṇvati ||
children.translated_text: like a chariot among the clans, speeding through lifetimes, the god continually attains desirable goods.

children.text: vi vātajūto ataseṣu tiṣṭhate vṛthā juhūbhiḥ sṛṇyā tuviṣvaṇiḥ
children.translated_text: Driven by the wind he stands among the thickets, with freely stretched flames, strong-sounding;

children.text: tṛṣu yad agne vanino vṛṣāyase kṛṣṇaṃ ta ema ruśadūrme ajara ||
children.translated_text: when, O <s>Agni</s>, you rush like a bull among dry brush and forest trees, your black track is edged with bright waves, undecaying one.

children.text: tapurjambho vana ā vātacodito yūthe na sāhvāṁ ava vāti vaṃsagaḥ
children.translated_text: With burning jaws, driven by the wind in the wood, like a champion in the herd, the bamboo-born one blows down;

children.text: abhivrajann akṣitam pājasā raja sthātuś caratham bhayate patatriṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: advancing over the unfailing expanse with force, he frightens what stands and moves, the winged creatures.

children.text: dadhuṣ ṭvā bhṛgavo mānuṣeṣv ā rayiṃ na cāruṃ suhavaṃ janebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Bhṛgus</s> set you among human beings, like lovely wealth, easy to invoke for the people,

children.text: hotāram agne atithiṃ vareṇyam mitraṃ na śevaṃ divyāya janmane ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, as hotṛ-priest, as a guest most worthy of choice, like a kindly friend for the heavenly birth.

children.text: hotāraṃ sapta juhvo yajiṣṭhaṃ yaṃ vāghato vṛṇate adhvareṣu
children.translated_text: The seven ladles choose him as hotṛ-priest, most fit for sacrifice, whom the inspired singers choose at the rites;

children.text: agniṃ viśveṣām aratiṃ vasūnāṃ saparyāmi prayasā yāmi ratnam ||
children.translated_text: I worship <s>Agni</s>, steward of all riches, and with zeal I approach the treasure.

children.text: acchidrā sūno sahaso no adya stotṛbhyo mitramahaḥ śarma yaccha
children.translated_text: Today, O son of strength, O friend of great power, grant unbroken shelter to us singers;

children.text: agne gṛṇantam aṃhasa uruṣyorjo napāt pūrbhir āyasībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, protect the one who praises from distress, O child of strength, with iron strongholds.

children.text: bhavā varūthaṃ gṛṇate vibhāvo bhavā maghavan maghavadbhyaḥ śarma
children.translated_text: Be a shelter for the singer, O radiant one; be protection, O bountiful one, for the bountiful.

children.text: uruṣyāgne aṃhaso gṛṇantam prātar makṣū dhiyāvasur jagamyāt ||
children.translated_text: Protect the singer from distress, O <s>Agni</s>; may the wealth-giving one come quickly in the morning with inspiration.

children.text: Chapter 59
vayā id agne agnayas te anye tve viśve amṛtā mādayante
children.translated_text: For your flames, O <s>Agni</s>, are indeed other fires; in you all the immortals rejoice.

children.text: vaiśvānara nābhir asi kṣitīnāṃ sthūṇeva janāṁ upamid yayantha ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, you are the navel of the dwellers on earth; like a pillar you have supported the peoples.

children.text: mūrdhā divo nābhir agniḥ pṛthivyā athābhavad aratī rodasyoḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> became the head of heaven, the navel of earth, and then the mediator of the two worlds.

children.text: taṃ tvā devāso 'janayanta devaṃ vaiśvānara jyotir id āryāya ||
children.translated_text: The gods generated you, a god, O <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, as light for the noble one.

children.text: ā sūrye na raśmayo dhruvāso vaiśvānare dadhire 'gnā vasūni
children.translated_text: As firm rays are set in the sun, so riches have been placed in <s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s>.

children.text: yā parvateṣv oṣadhīṣv apsu yā mānuṣeṣv asi tasya rājā ||
children.translated_text: Whatever is on the mountains, in the plants, in the waters, and among human beings, of that you are king.

children.text: bṛhatī iva sūnave rodasī giro hotā manuṣyo na dakṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Like the broad heaven and earth for their son, the songs have gone forth to the priest, skillful like a man,

children.text: svarvate satyaśuṣmāya pūrvīr vaiśvānarāya nṛtamāya yahvīḥ ||
children.translated_text: many, mighty, most manly, for <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, whose power is true and who brings heaven's light.

children.text: divaś cit te bṛhato jātavedo vaiśvānara pra ririce mahitvam
children.translated_text: Even beyond lofty heaven your greatness has overflowed, O <s>Jātavedas Vaiśvānara</s>.

children.text: rājā kṛṣṭīnām asi mānuṣīṇāṃ yudhā devebhyo varivaś cakartha ||
children.translated_text: You are king of human peoples; by battle you have made broad space for the gods.

children.text: pra nū mahitvaṃ vṛṣabhasya vocaṃ yam pūravo vṛtrahaṇaṃ sacante
children.translated_text: Now I shall proclaim the greatness of the bull whom the <s>Pūrus</s> attend, the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: vaiśvānaro dasyum agnir jaghanvāṁ adhūnot kāṣṭhā ava śambaram bhet ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s>, having slain the <s>Dasyu</s>, shook the ends of the world and split open <s>Śambara</s>.

children.text: vaiśvānaro mahimnā viśvakṛṣṭir bharadvājeṣu yajato vibhāvā
children.translated_text: <s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s>, lord of all peoples by his greatness, worthy of worship among the <s>Bharadvājas</s>, radiant,

children.text: śātavaneye śatinībhir agniḥ puruṇīthe jarate sūnṛtāvān ||
children.translated_text: is praised among the <s>Śātavaneyas</s> with hundreds, among those of many invocations, rich in good words.

children.text: Chapter 60
vahniṃ yaśasaṃ vidathasya ketuṃ suprāvyaṃ dūtaṃ sadyoartham
children.translated_text: The bearer, famed, the signal of the assembly, easy to send onward, the messenger who quickly accomplishes the aim,

children.text: dvijanmānaṃ rayim iva praśastaṃ rātim bharad bhṛgave mātariśvā ||
children.translated_text: the twice-born one, praised like wealth, the gift: <s>Mātariśvan</s> brought him to <s>Bhṛgu</s>.

children.text: asya śāsur ubhayāsaḥ sacante haviṣmanta uśijo ye ca martāḥ
children.translated_text: Both kinds obey his command: those who possess oblations and the inspired ones who are mortals.

children.text: divaś cit pūrvo ny asādi hotāpṛcchyo viśpatir vikṣu vedhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The priest, first even from heaven, has sat down, to be consulted, lord of the clan and sage among the settlements.

children.text: taṃ navyasī hṛda ā jāyamānam asmat sukīrtir madhujihvam aśyāḥ
children.translated_text: May good praise from us reach that one, newly born in the heart, honey-tongued,

children.text: yam ṛtvijo vṛjane mānuṣāsaḥ prayasvanta āyavo jījananta ||
children.translated_text: whom the human ritual priests, the striving Āyus, generated in the enclosure with offerings.

children.text: uśik pāvako vasur mānuṣeṣu vareṇyo hotādhāyi vikṣu
children.translated_text: The inspired, purifying, excellent treasure, the chosen priest, was placed among human settlements.

children.text: damūnā gṛhapatir dama āṃ agnir bhuvad rayipatī rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, dwelling in the house, lord of the house in the home, became lord of riches and of wealth.

children.text: taṃ tvā vayam patim agne rayīṇām pra śaṃsāmo matibhir gotamāsaḥ
children.translated_text: We <s>Gotamas</s> praise you, O <s>Agni</s>, as lord of riches, with our thoughts,

children.text: āśuṃ na vājambharam marjayantaḥ prātar makṣū dhiyāvasur jagamyāt ||
children.translated_text: polishing you like a swift prize-bearing horse; may the wealth-giving one come quickly in the morning with inspiration.

children.text: Chapter 61
asmā id u pra tavase turāya prayo na harmi stomam māhināya
children.translated_text: For this strong, impetuous, mighty one I offer, like a delight in the house, a hymn of praise,

children.text: ṛcīṣamāyādhrigava oham indrāya brahmāṇi rātatamā ||
children.translated_text: for the brilliant, unassailable, irresistible <s>Indra</s>; I have made the prayers most liberal.

children.text: asmā id u praya iva pra yaṃsi bharāmy āṅgūṣam bādhe suvṛkti
children.translated_text: For him indeed I send forth, as it were, delights; with fair praise I bear a chant that drives away opposition.

children.text: indrāya hṛdā manasā manīṣā pratnāya patye dhiyo marjayanta ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s>, with heart, mind, and insight, the thoughts polish themselves for the ancient lord.

children.text: asmā id u tyam upamaṃ svarṣām bharāmy āṅgūṣam āsyena
children.translated_text: For him indeed, the matchless sun-winning one, I bear the chant with my mouth,

children.text: maṃhiṣṭham acchoktibhir matīnāṃ suvṛktibhiḥ sūriṃ vāvṛdhadhyai ||
children.translated_text: to make grow, with best utterances and fair praises, the most bountiful lord of inspired thoughts.

children.text: asmā id u stomaṃ saṃ hinomi rathaṃ na taṣṭeva tatsināya
children.translated_text: For him indeed I set the praise in motion, like a carpenter fashioning a chariot for the mighty one.

children.text: giraś ca girvāhase suvṛktīndrāya viśvaminvam medhirāya ||
children.translated_text: And the songs, with fair praises, go to <s>Indra</s>, lover of song, all-moving and wise.

children.text: asmā id u saptim iva śravasyendrāyārkaṃ juhvā sam añje
children.translated_text: For him indeed, as one would adorn a courser for fame, I anoint the chant with my tongue for <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: vīraṃ dānaukasaṃ vandadhyai purāṃ gūrtaśravasaṃ darmāṇam ||
children.translated_text: to praise the hero whose dwelling is generosity, whose fame is lauded in fortresses, the supporter.

children.text: asmā id u tvaṣṭā takṣad vajraṃ svapastamaṃ svaryaṃ raṇāya
children.translated_text: For him indeed <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> fashioned the thunderbolt, most skillfully made, heavenly, for battle,

children.text: vṛtrasya cid vidad yena marma tujann īśānas tujatā kiyedhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: with which, striking, the ruling one pierced even the vital point of <s>Vṛtra</s>, however great.

children.text: asyed u mātuḥ savaneṣu sadyo mahaḥ pitum papivāñ cārv annā
children.translated_text: He indeed, at once at his mother's pressings, drank the great nourishment, the pleasant food.

children.text: muṣāyad viṣṇuḥ pacataṃ sahīyān vidhyad varāhaṃ tiro adrim astā ||
children.translated_text: Mighty <s>Viṣṇu</s> stole the cooked offering; he pierced the boar through the mountain and hurled it away.

children.text: asmā id u gnāś cid devapatnīr indrāyārkam ahihatya ūvuḥ
children.translated_text: For him indeed even the divine wives, the goddesses, wove a song for <s>Indra</s> at the serpent-slaying.

children.text: pari dyāvāpṛthivī jabhra urvī nāsya te mahimānam pari ṣṭaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The broad heaven and earth he enclosed around; no one has reached around his greatness.

children.text: asyed eva pra ririce mahitvaṃ divas pṛthivyāḥ pary antarikṣāt
children.translated_text: His greatness alone has overflowed beyond heaven, earth, and the midspace.

children.text: svarāḍ indro dama ā viśvagūrtaḥ svarir amatro vavakṣe raṇāya ||
children.translated_text: Self-ruling <s>Indra</s>, universally praised in the house, independent and immeasurable, has grown strong for battle.

children.text: asyed eva śavasā śuṣantaṃ vi vṛścad vajreṇa vṛtram indraḥ
children.translated_text: By his own force <s>Indra</s> split apart <s>Vṛtra</s>, who was drying things up, with the thunderbolt.

children.text: gā na vrāṇā avanīr amuñcad abhi śravo dāvane sacetāḥ ||
children.translated_text: He released the streams, like imprisoned cows, the low-lying waters, mindful of giving fame.

children.text: asyed u tveṣasā ranta sindhavaḥ pari yad vajreṇa sīm ayacchat
children.translated_text: At his fierce power the rivers were stilled, when he checked them around with the thunderbolt.

children.text: īśānakṛd dāśuṣe daśasyan turvītaye gādhaṃ turvaṇiḥ kaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Making himself lord, doing service for the worshipper, the conqueror made a ford for <s>Turvīti</s>.

children.text: asmā id u pra bharā tūtujāno vṛtrāya vajram īśānaḥ kiyedhāḥ
children.translated_text: For him indeed, rushing onward, bring forth the thunderbolt, O ruling one, however great, against <s>Vṛtra</s>,

children.text: gor na parva vi radā tiraśceṣyann arṇāṃsy apāṃ caradhyai ||
children.translated_text: as if breaking apart the joint of a cow, intending to cross the floods of the waters and move through them.

children.text: asyed u pra brūhi pūrvyāṇi turasya karmāṇi navya ukthaiḥ
children.translated_text: Of him indeed proclaim the ancient deeds of the impetuous one with new hymns.

children.text: yudhe yad iṣṇāna āyudhāny ṛghāyamāṇo niriṇāti śatrūn ||
children.translated_text: When, eager for battle, brandishing weapons, he hurls down the enemies who are rushing at him.

children.text: asyed u bhiyā girayaś ca dṛḍhā dyāvā ca bhūmā januṣas tujete
children.translated_text: At fear of him even the firm mountains, heaven and earth, tremble from their birth.

children.text: upo venasya joguvāna oṇiṃ sadyo bhuvad vīryāya nodhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Nodhā</s>, calling near the favor of the winsome one, at once became ready for heroic power.

children.text: asmā id u tyad anu dāyy eṣām eko yad vavne bhūrer īśānaḥ
children.translated_text: Of him indeed this deed among them should be told, when alone, as lord of much, he won it.

children.text: praitaśaṃ sūrye paspṛdhānaṃ sauvaśvye suṣvim āvad indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> aided <s>Etaśa</s>, who was contending with the sun, in the winning of good horses, the strong one.

children.text: evā te hāriyojanā suvṛktīndra brahmāṇi gotamāso akran
children.translated_text: Thus, O <s>Indra</s> of the bay steeds, the <s>Gotamas</s> have made these fair praises and prayers for you.

children.text: aiṣu viśvapeśasaṃ dhiyaṃ dhāḥ prātar makṣū dhiyāvasur jagamyāt ||
children.translated_text: Place among them a thought of every form; may the wealth-giving one come quickly in the morning with inspiration.

children.text: Chapter 62
pra manmahe śavasānāya śūṣam āṅgūṣaṃ girvaṇase aṅgirasvat
children.translated_text: We set forth a thought and a chant, as the <s>Aṅgirases</s> did, for the mighty one who loves song.

children.text: suvṛktibhi stuvata ṛgmiyāyārcāmārkaṃ nare viśrutāya ||
children.translated_text: With well-fashioned hymns praise him; let us sing a song worthy of the ṛc for the renowned hero.

children.text: pra vo mahe mahi namo bharadhvam āṅgūṣyaṃ śavasānāya sāma
children.translated_text: Bring forth great homage for your great one, a resounding <s>sāman</s> for the mighty one,

children.text: yenā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ padajñā arcanto aṅgiraso gā avindan ||
children.translated_text: by which our former fathers, knowing the path, the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, found the cows as they worshipped.

children.text: indrasyāṅgirasāṃ ceṣṭau vidat saramā tanayāya dhāsim
children.translated_text: In the exertion of <s>Indra</s> and the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, <s>Saramā</s> found sustenance for her offspring.

children.text: bṛhaspatir bhinad adriṃ vidad gāḥ sam usriyābhir vāvaśanta naraḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s> split the rock and found the cows; the men shouted together with the ruddy cows.

children.text: sa suṣṭubhā sa stubhā sapta vipraiḥ svareṇādriṃ svaryo navagvaiḥ
children.translated_text: He, with excellent praise, with chant, with seven inspired singers, with sound, and with the <s>Navagvas</s>, opened the heavenly rock.

children.text: saraṇyubhiḥ phaligam indra śakra valaṃ raveṇa darayo daśagvaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: With the pursuing bands, O <s>Indra Śakra</s>, with the <s>Daśagvas</s>, you shattered <s>Phaliga</s> and <s>Vala</s> by your roar.

children.text: gṛṇāno aṅgirobhir dasma vi var uṣasā sūryeṇa gobhir andhaḥ
children.translated_text: Being praised by the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, wondrous one, you opened the darkness with dawn, with the sun, and with the cows.

children.text: vi bhūmyā aprathaya indra sānu divo raja uparam astabhāyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You spread out the ridge of the earth, O <s>Indra</s>; you propped up the far upper realm of heaven.

children.text: tad u prayakṣatamam asya karma dasmasya cārutamam asti daṃsaḥ
children.translated_text: That is the most marvellous work of this wondrous one; it is his fairest wonder,

children.text: upahvare yad uparā apinvan madhvarṇaso nadyaś catasraḥ ||
children.translated_text: when, in the hidden place, the four honey-colored rivers swelled up above.

children.text: dvitā vi vavre sanajā sanīḍe ayāsya stavamānebhir arkaiḥ
children.translated_text: Twice he opened what was enclosed, ancient and sharing one seat, while <s>Ayāsya</s> was praising with songs.

children.text: bhago na mene parame vyomann adhārayad rodasī sudaṃsāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like <s>Bhaga</s> in the highest heaven, the well-working one upheld the two worlds, heaven and earth.

children.text: sanād divam pari bhūmā virūpe punarbhuvā yuvatī svebhir evaiḥ
children.translated_text: From of old the two broad, unlike, ever-renewed young women move around heaven by their own ways,

children.text: kṛṣṇebhir aktoṣā ruśadbhir vapurbhir ā carato anyānyā ||
children.translated_text: with black appearances by night and bright forms by day, going each after the other.

children.text: sanemi sakhyaṃ svapasyamānaḥ sūnur dādhāra śavasā sudaṃsāḥ
children.translated_text: From of old, performing good work in friendship, the son upheld it by might, the well-working one.

children.text: āmāsu cid dadhiṣe pakvam antaḥ payaḥ kṛṣṇāsu ruśad rohiṇīṣu ||
children.translated_text: Even among the unripe you placed the ripe within, milk among the black, bright, and ruddy cows.

children.text: sanāt sanīḍā avanīr avātā vratā rakṣante amṛtāḥ sahobhiḥ
children.translated_text: From of old the waters, sharing one seat and without wind, immortal, guard the ordinances with their powers.

children.text: purū sahasrā janayo na patnīr duvasyanti svasāro ahrayāṇam ||
children.translated_text: Many thousands, like women and wives, the sisters reverently serve the one who does not stray.

children.text: sanāyuvo namasā navyo arkair vasūyavo matayo dasma dadruḥ
children.translated_text: Ancient, seeking life, seeking goods, thoughts ran to the wondrous one with reverence and with new songs.

children.text: patiṃ na patnīr uśatīr uśantaṃ spṛśanti tvā śavasāvan manīṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like eager wives touching an eager husband, inspired prayers touch you, O possessor of might.

children.text: sanād eva tava rāyo gabhastau na kṣīyante nopa dasyanti dasma
children.translated_text: From of old the riches in your hands do not waste away, nor do they fail, wondrous one.

children.text: dyumāṁ asi kratumāṁ indra dhīraḥ śikṣā śacīvas tava naḥ śacībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are brilliant, wise, and steadfast, O <s>Indra</s>; instruct us with your powers, O powerful one.

children.text: sanāyate gotama indra navyam atakṣad brahma hariyojanāya
children.translated_text: <s>Gotama</s> fashioned a new sacred utterance for you, O <s>Indra</s>, for the one yoked with bay steeds.

children.text: sunīthāya naḥ śavasāna nodhāḥ prātar makṣū dhiyāvasur jagamyāt ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Nodhas</s>, rich in insight, come swiftly in the morning for our good guidance, O mighty one.

children.text: Chapter 63
tvam mahāṁ indra yo ha śuṣmair dyāvā jajñānaḥ pṛthivī ame dhāḥ
children.translated_text: You are great, O <s>Indra</s>, who, born with powers, held heaven and earth apart.

children.text: yaddha te viśvā girayaś cid abhvā bhiyā dṛḍhāsaḥ kiraṇā naijan ||
children.translated_text: When all the mountains, though firm, shook with fear at your tremendous force, as if loosened rays.

children.text: ā yaddharī indra vivratā ver ā te vajraṃ jaritā bāhvor dhāt
children.translated_text: When your two bay steeds turned toward you, O <s>Indra</s>, the singer placed the thunderbolt in your arms,

children.text: yenāviharyatakrato amitrān pura iṣṇāsi puruhūta pūrvīḥ ||
children.translated_text: with which, of unconfused will, O much-invoked one, you drive away enemies and many fortresses.

children.text: tvaṃ satya indra dhṛṣṇur etān tvam ṛbhukṣā naryas tvaṃ ṣāṭ
children.translated_text: You are true, O <s>Indra</s>, bold; you are skillful, manly; you are the conqueror.

children.text: tvaṃ śuṣṇaṃ vṛjane pṛkṣa āṇau yūne kutsāya dyumate sacāhan ||
children.translated_text: You overcame <s>Śuṣṇa</s> in the enclosure, in the contest, in the battle, together with young, brilliant <s>Kutsa</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ ha tyad indra codīḥ sakhā vṛtraṃ yad vajrin vṛṣakarmann ubhnāḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, truly urged that deed as a friend, when, O thunderbolt-bearer and bull-worker, you struck down <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: yaddha śūra vṛṣamaṇaḥ parācair vi dasyūṃr yonāv akṛto vṛthāṣāṭ ||
children.translated_text: When, O hero, bull-minded, you turned the <s>Dasyus</s> away and made them strike vainly in their own place.

children.text: tvaṃ ha tyad indrāriṣaṇyan dṛḍhasya cin martānām ajuṣṭau
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, unharmed, stood even amid the hostility of strong mortals.

children.text: vy asmad ā kāṣṭhā arvate var ghaneva vajriñchnathihy amitrān ||
children.translated_text: Drive the hostile ones away from us to the farthest bounds; like a club, O thunderbolt-bearer, crush the enemies.

children.text: tvāṃ ha tyad indrārṇasātau svarmīḍhe nara ājā havante
children.translated_text: Men call upon you, O <s>Indra</s>, in the winning of waters, in the sun-bright contest.

children.text: tava svadhāva iyam ā samarya ūtir vājeṣv atasāyyā bhūt ||
children.translated_text: May this help of yours, self-powered, become unsurpassed in battles and in prizes.

children.text: tvaṃ ha tyad indra sapta yudhyan puro vajrin purukutsāya dardaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, fighting with the thunderbolt, broke the seven fortresses for <s>Purukutsa</s>.

children.text: barhir na yat sudāse vṛthā varg aṃho rājan varivaḥ pūrave kaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When, as at the sacred grass for <s>Sudās</s>, O king, you made broad space out of distress for <s>Pūru</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ tyāṃ na indra deva citrām iṣam āpo na pīpayaḥ parijman
children.translated_text: You, O divine <s>Indra</s>, made that wondrous nourishment swell for us, like waters flowing around.

children.text: yayā śūra praty asmabhyaṃ yaṃsi tmanam ūrjaṃ na viśvadha kṣaradhyai ||
children.translated_text: By it, O hero, you grant strength to us in return, like energy set flowing everywhere.

children.text: akāri ta indra gotamebhir brahmāṇy oktā namasā haribhyām
children.translated_text: Hymns have been made for you by the <s>Gotamas</s>, O <s>Indra</s>; sacred utterances have been spoken with reverence for your two bay steeds.

children.text: supeśasaṃ vājam ā bharā naḥ prātar makṣū dhiyāvasur jagamyāt ||
children.translated_text: Bring us a well-formed prize; may the insight-rich one come swiftly in the morning.

children.text: Chapter 64
vṛṣṇe śardhāya sumakhāya vedhase nodhaḥ suvṛktim pra bharā marudbhyaḥ
children.translated_text: For the bull-like host, generous and skillful, <s>Nodhas</s> brings forth a well-fashioned praise to the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: apo na dhīro manasā suhastyo giraḥ sam añje vidatheṣv ābhuvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like a thoughtful, good-handed man with water, I adorn the songs with my mind in the assemblies, being present.

children.text: te jajñire diva ṛṣvāsa ukṣaṇo rudrasya maryā asurā arepasaḥ
children.translated_text: They were born from heaven, lofty bulls, young heroes of <s>Rudra</s>, lordly and spotless.

children.text: pāvakāsaḥ śucayaḥ sūryā iva satvāno na drapsino ghoravarpasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Purifying and bright like suns, active like warriors, dripping, and terrible in form.

children.text: yuvāno rudrā ajarā abhogghano vavakṣur adhrigāvaḥ parvatā iva
children.translated_text: Young <s>Rudras</s>, ageless, unbending, they have grown, irresistible like mountains.

children.text: dṛḍhā cid viśvā bhuvanāni pārthivā pra cyāvayanti divyāni majmanā ||
children.translated_text: They shake all firm earthly beings, and the heavenly ones too, by their greatness.

children.text: citrair añjibhir vapuṣe vy añjate vakṣassu rukmāṁ adhi yetire śubhe
children.translated_text: With bright ornaments they adorn themselves for beauty; they have set golden plates upon their chests for splendor.

children.text: aṃseṣv eṣāṃ ni mimṛkṣur ṛṣṭayaḥ sākaṃ jajñire svadhayā divo naraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Their spears seem to glitter upon their shoulders; together these men were born by the self-power of heaven.

children.text: īśānakṛto dhunayo riśādaso vātān vidyutas taviṣībhir akrata
children.translated_text: Making lordship, shakers and assailants, with winds and lightnings they have fashioned their mighty powers.

children.text: duhanty ūdhar divyāni dhūtayo bhūmim pinvanti payasā parijrayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The shakers milk the heavenly udders; with encircling milk they make the earth swell.

children.text: pinvanty apo marutaḥ sudānavaḥ payo ghṛtavad vidatheṣv ābhuvaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Maruts</s>, good givers, make the waters swell, milk rich with ghee, being present in the assemblies.

children.text: atyaṃ na mihe vi nayanti vājinam utsaṃ duhanti stanayantam akṣitam ||
children.translated_text: They lead out the racing steed as through rain; they milk the inexhaustible, thundering spring.

children.text: mahiṣāso māyinaś citrabhānavo girayo na svatavaso raghuṣyadaḥ
children.translated_text: Like buffaloes, wonder-workers, bright with varied light, self-strong like mountains, swift in onset,

children.text: mṛgā iva hastinaḥ khādathā vanā yad āruṇīṣu taviṣīr ayugdhvam ||
children.translated_text: like wild beasts, like elephants, you devour the forests when you yoke your powers among the ruddy clouds.

children.text: siṃhā iva nānadati pracetasaḥ piśā iva supiśo viśvavedasaḥ
children.translated_text: Like lions the wise ones roar aloud; like dappled ones, beautifully adorned, all-knowing;

children.text: kṣapo jinvantaḥ pṛṣatībhir ṛṣṭibhiḥ sam it sabādhaḥ śavasāhimanyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: enlivening the nights with their dappled mares and spears, all together overpowering by force, fierce in wrath.

children.text: rodasī ā vadatā gaṇaśriyo nṛṣācaḥ śūrāḥ śavasāhimanyavaḥ
children.translated_text: Call hither heaven and earth for the troop splendid in host, companions of men, heroes fierce in might;

children.text: ā vandhureṣv amatir na darśatā vidyun na tasthau maruto ratheṣu vaḥ ||
