children.translated_text: like a visible impulse in the chariot-seats, like lightning, O <s>Maruts</s>, it has stood upon your chariots.

children.text: viśvavedaso rayibhiḥ samokasaḥ sammiślāsas taviṣībhir virapśinaḥ
children.translated_text: All-knowing, dwelling together with riches, mingled together, vast with their powers,

children.text: astāra iṣuṃ dadhire gabhastyor anantaśuṣmā vṛṣakhādayo naraḥ ||
children.translated_text: the men of inexhaustible force, wearing bull-ornaments, have placed the arrow in their hands.

children.text: hiraṇyayebhiḥ pavibhiḥ payovṛdha ujjighnanta āpathyo na parvatān
children.translated_text: With golden wheel-rims, swelling with rain, they shake upward the mountains by the paths, like waters;

children.text: makhā ayāsaḥ svasṛto dhruvacyuto dudhrakṛto maruto bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: mighty, tireless, self-streaming, shaking what is fixed, making tremors, the <s>Maruts</s> of flashing spears.

children.text: ghṛṣum pāvakaṃ vaninaṃ vicarṣaṇiṃ rudrasya sūnuṃ havasā gṛṇīmasi
children.translated_text: We praise with invocation the eager, purifying, forest-dwelling son of <s>Rudra</s>, wide-ranging among men;

children.text: rajasturaṃ tavasam mārutaṃ gaṇam ṛjīṣiṇaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ saścata śriye ||
children.translated_text: attend for splendor the strong <s>Marut</s> troop, rushing through the midspace, rich in power, bull-like.

children.text: pra nū sa martaḥ śavasā janāṁ ati tasthau va ūtī maruto yam āvata
children.translated_text: Now the mortal whom you aid, O <s>Maruts</s>, has stood by force beyond the peoples;

children.text: arvadbhir vājam bharate dhanā nṛbhir āpṛcchyaṃ kratum ā kṣeti puṣyati ||
children.translated_text: with steeds he wins booty, with men he wins wealth; gaining desirable insight, he prospers and flourishes.

children.text: carkṛtyam marutaḥ pṛtsu duṣṭaraṃ dyumantaṃ śuṣmam maghavatsu dhattana
children.translated_text: O <s>Maruts</s>, set among the bounteous ones a power hard to overcome in battles, bright and constantly active;

children.text: dhanaspṛtam ukthyaṃ viśvacarṣaṇiṃ tokam puṣyema tanayaṃ śataṃ himāḥ ||
children.translated_text: wealth-winning, praiseworthy, belonging to all peoples; may we nourish offspring and descendants for a hundred winters.

children.text: nū ṣṭhiram maruto vīravantam ṛtīṣāhaṃ rayim asmāsu dhatta
children.translated_text: Now, O <s>Maruts</s>, place among us firm wealth, rich in heroes and overcoming attacks;

children.text: sahasriṇaṃ śatinaṃ śūśuvāṃsam prātar makṣū dhiyāvasur jagamyāt ||
children.translated_text: thousandfold, hundredfold, swelling; may it come quickly in the morning, rich through inspired thought.

children.text: Chapter 65
paśvā na tāyuṃ guhā catantaṃ namo yujānaṃ namo vahantam ||
children.translated_text: Like trackers after a cattle-thief hidden in secret, they yoke reverence and carry reverence.

children.text: sajoṣā dhīrāḥ padair anu gmann upa tvā sīdan viśve yajatrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Sharing one delight, the wise ones followed by his tracks; all the worshipful gods sat down near you.

children.text: ṛtasya devā anu vratā gur bhuvat pariṣṭir dyaur na bhūma ||
children.translated_text: The gods followed the ordinances of <s>rta</s> (cosmic order); an enclosure surrounded them, as heaven surrounds earth.

children.text: vardhantīm āpaḥ panvā suśiśvim ṛtasya yonā garbhe sujātam ||
children.translated_text: The waters, increasing and well-swelling, tended the well-born one in the womb of <s>rta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: puṣṭir na raṇvā kṣitir na pṛthvī girir na bhujma kṣodo na śambhu ||
children.translated_text: Like delightful nourishment, like broad dwelling-place, like a mountain as support, like a flood as blessing,

children.text: atyo nājman sargaprataktaḥ sindhur na kṣodaḥ ka īṃ varāte ||
children.translated_text: like a racehorse on the course, let loose in the rush, like the river's roaring flood: who can restrain him?

children.text: jāmiḥ sindhūnām bhrāteva svasrām ibhyān na rājā vanāny atti ||
children.translated_text: Kinsman of the rivers, like a brother of sisters, like a king with retainers, he consumes the forests.

children.text: yad vātajūto vanā vy asthād agnir ha dāti romā pṛthivyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When, impelled by wind, <s>Agni</s> has spread through the forests, he shaves the hair of the earth.

children.text: śvasity apsu haṃso na sīdan kratvā cetiṣṭho viśām uṣarbhut ||
children.translated_text: He breathes in the waters, sitting like a swan; by skill he is most perceptive, awakening among the clans at dawn.

children.text: somo na vedhā ṛtaprajātaḥ paśur na śiśvā vibhur dūrebhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like <s>Soma</s>, a disposer born of <s>rta</s> (cosmic order), like a young animal, all-pervading and seen from afar.

children.text: Chapter 66
rayir na citrā sūro na saṃdṛg āyur na prāṇo nityo na sūnuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like bright wealth, like the sun as a common sight, like life, like breath, constant like a son,

children.text: takvā na bhūrṇir vanā siṣakti payo na dhenuḥ śucir vibhāvā ||
children.translated_text: like a swift courser, restless, he clings to the forests; like milk from a cow, he is pure and far-shining.

children.text: dādhāra kṣemam oko na raṇvo yavo na pakvo jetā janānām ||
children.translated_text: He has upheld security, delightful like a home; like ripened barley, he is conqueror of peoples.

children.text: ṛṣir na stubhvā vikṣu praśasto vājī na prīto vayo dadhāti ||
children.translated_text: Like a seer with praise-song, renowned among the clans, like a pleased steed, he bestows vital strength.

children.text: durokaśociḥ kratur na nityo jāyeva yonāv araṃ viśvasmai ||
children.translated_text: Shining in distant places, constant like insight, like a wife in the womb-seat, he is sufficient for all.

children.text: citro yad abhrāṭ chveto na vikṣu ratho na rukmī tveṣaḥ samatsu ||
children.translated_text: When the bright one has flashed, white among the clans, like a chariot adorned with gold, brilliant in battles,

children.text: seneva sṛṣṭāmaṃ dadhāty astur na didyut tveṣapratīkā ||
children.translated_text: like an army let loose he holds the onslaught; like the lightning of an archer, he has a brilliant face.

children.text: yamo ha jāto yamo janitvaṃ jāraḥ kanīnām patir janīnām ||
children.translated_text: A twin he is born, a twin by birth, lover of maidens, husband of wives.

children.text: taṃ vaś carāthā vayaṃ vasatyāstaṃ na gāvo nakṣanta iddham ||
children.translated_text: Him we have gone about with dwelling-places; the cows have reached him when he is kindled.

children.text: sindhur na kṣodaḥ pra nīcīr ainon navanta gāvaḥ svar dṛśīke ||
children.translated_text: Like the river's flood, the lowing cows flow down toward him at the sight of the sun.

children.text: Chapter 67
vaneṣu jāyur marteṣu mitro vṛṇīte śruṣṭiṃ rājevājuryam ||
children.translated_text: Born in the forests, a friend among mortals, he chooses obedience, like a king who does not grow old.

children.text: kṣemo na sādhuḥ kratur na bhadro bhuvat svādhīr hotā havyavāṭ ||
children.translated_text: Like beneficent security, like good insight, the self-ruling hotr-priest, bearer of oblations, has come to be.

children.text: haste dadhāno nṛmṇā viśvāny ame devān dhād guhā niṣīdan ||
children.translated_text: Holding all heroic powers in his hand, he sat hidden in secret among the gods.

children.text: vidantīm atra naro dhiyaṃdhā hṛdā yat taṣṭān mantrāṁ aśaṃsan ||
children.translated_text: Here the thoughtful men found the inspired thought when with their heart they proclaimed the fashioned mantras.

children.text: ajo na kṣāṃ dādhāra pṛthivīṃ tastambha dyām mantrebhiḥ satyaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like the unborn one, he upheld the earth and propped up heaven with true mantras.

children.text: priyā padāni paśvo ni pāhi viśvāyur agne guhā guhaṃ gāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Guard the beloved tracks of the beast; O all-living <s>Agni</s>, you have gone from secret place to secret place.

children.text: ya īṃ ciketa guhā bhavantam ā yaḥ sasāda dhārām ṛtasya ||
children.translated_text: He who has perceived him existing in secret, and he who has sat down at the stream of <s>rta</s> (cosmic order),

children.text: vi ye cṛtanty ṛtā sapanta ād id vasūni pra vavācāsmai ||
children.translated_text: those who open out and seek the <s>rta</s> (cosmic order): to him then he has proclaimed the treasures.

children.text: vi yo vīrutsu rodhan mahitvota prajā uta prasūṣv antaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He who, by greatness, is within the plants, within the enclosures, within offspring and births,

children.text: cittir apāṃ dame viśvāyuḥ sadmeva dhīrāḥ saṃmāya cakruḥ ||
children.translated_text: perception in the house of the waters, all-living: the wise fashioned him as a dwelling by their measure.

children.text: Chapter 68
śrīṇann upa sthād divam bhuraṇyu sthātuś caratham aktūn vy ūrṇot ||
children.translated_text: Roaring, active, he stood near heaven; he uncovered the nights of what stands and what moves.

children.text: pari yad eṣām eko viśveṣām bhuvad devo devānām mahitvā ||
children.translated_text: When he alone among all of them became, by greatness, the god of the gods,

children.text: ād it te viśve kratuṃ juṣanta śuṣkād yad deva jīvo janiṣṭhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: then all accepted your purpose, O god, when the living one was born from dry wood.

children.text: bhajanta viśve devatvaṃ nāma ṛtaṃ sapanto amṛtam evaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: All share the name of godhead, seeking <s>rta</s> (cosmic order), the immortal one through their courses.

children.text: ṛtasya preṣā ṛtasya dhītir viśvāyur viśve apāṃsi cakruḥ ||
children.translated_text: The impulse of <s>rta</s> (cosmic order), the thought of <s>rta</s>, all-living, has accomplished all works.

children.text: yas tubhyaṃ dāśād yo vā te śikṣāt tasmai cikitvān rayiṃ dayasva ||
children.translated_text: Whoever will serve you, or whoever will attend upon you, to him, knowing one, grant wealth.

children.text: hotā niṣatto manor apatye sa cin nv āsām patī rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: The hotr-priest is seated among <s>Manu</s>'s offspring; he indeed is lord of these riches.

children.text: icchanta reto mithas tanūṣu saṃ jānata svair dakṣair amūrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeking seed in one another's bodies, the unconfused ones came to know through their own insights.

children.text: pitur na putrāḥ kratuṃ juṣanta śroṣan ye asya śāsaṃ turāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like sons of a father, they accepted his purpose; the swift ones listened to his command.

children.text: vi rāya aurṇod duraḥ purukṣuḥ pipeśa nākaṃ stṛbhir damūnāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Rich in many goods, he has opened the doors to wealth; household-minded, he has adorned the vault of heaven with stars.

children.text: Chapter 69
śukraḥ śuśukvāṁ uṣo na jāraḥ paprā samīcī divo na jyotiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bright, he has shone forth like the lover of <s>Uṣas</s>; he has filled the meeting spaces like the light of heaven.

children.text: pari prajātaḥ kratvā babhūtha bhuvo devānām pitā putraḥ san ||
children.translated_text: Born forth all around, you have become so by insight; though a son, you have become father of the gods.

children.text: vedhā adṛpto agnir vijānann ūdhar na gonāṃ svādmā pitūnām ||
children.translated_text: The fashioner, undeceived <s>Agni</s>, knowing well, is like the udder of cows, the sweetness of foods.

children.text: jane na śeva āhūryaḥ san madhye niṣatto raṇvo duroṇe ||
children.translated_text: Being like blessing among people, fit to be invoked, he sits in the middle, delightful in the house.

children.text: putro na jāto raṇvo duroṇe vājī na prīto viśo vi tārīt ||
children.translated_text: Like a son born, delightful in the house, like a pleased steed, he would carry the clans across.

children.text: viśo yad ahve nṛbhiḥ sanīḍā agnir devatvā viśvāny aśyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When I call the clans, dwelling together with men, may <s>Agni</s>, in his godhead, attain all things.

children.text: nakiṣ ṭa etā vratā minanti nṛbhyo yad ebhyaḥ śruṣṭiṃ cakartha ||
children.translated_text: None violate these ordinances of yours, when for these men you have made ready hearkening.

children.text: tat tu te daṃso yad ahan samānair nṛbhir yad yukto vive rapāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: That indeed is your wondrous deed, that when yoked with men as your equals you have driven apart the hostile acts.

children.text: uṣo na jāro vibhāvosraḥ saṃjñātarūpaś ciketad asmai ||
children.translated_text: Like the lover of <s>Uṣas</s>, O widely shining one, bright with the dawn, known in form, he has taken notice for this man.

children.text: tmanā vahanto duro vy ṛṇvan navanta viśve svar dṛśīke ||
children.translated_text: Bearing themselves along, they opened the doors; all renewed the sun to be seen.

children.text: Chapter 70
vanema pūrvīr aryo manīṣā agniḥ suśoko viśvāny aśyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we win many Aryan goods through inspired thought; may <s>Agni</s>, beautifully shining, attain all things.

children.text: ā daivyāni vratā cikitvān ā mānuṣasya janasya janma ||
children.translated_text: Knowing, he has perceived the divine ordinances and the birth of the human people.

children.text: garbho yo apāṃ garbho vanānāṃ garbhaś ca sthātāṃ garbhaś carathām ||
children.translated_text: He is the embryo of the waters, the embryo of the forests, the embryo of what stands still and the embryo of what moves.

children.text: adrau cid asmā antar duroṇe viśāṃ na viśvo amṛtaḥ svādhīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even in the rock, within the house, he is immortal, thoughtful, universal like one among the clans.

children.text: sa hi kṣapāvāṁ agnī rayīṇāṃ dāśad yo asmā araṃ sūktaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: For he, <s>Agni</s>, abiding through the nights, is lord of riches; whoever is ready for him with hymns will give worship.

children.text: etā cikitvo bhūmā ni pāhi devānāṃ janma martāṃś ca vidvān ||
children.translated_text: Knowing these domains, protect the births of the gods and mortals too, being aware of them.

children.text: vardhān yam pūrvīḥ kṣapo virūpā sthātuś ca ratham ṛtapravītam ||
children.translated_text: Increase him whom many nights, varied in form, have nourished, and the chariot of what stands, driven by <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: arādhi hotā svar niṣattaḥ kṛṇvan viśvāny apāṃsi satyā ||
children.translated_text: The hotṛ-priest has been satisfied, seated in the light, making all works true.

children.text: goṣu praśastiṃ vaneṣu dhiṣe bharanta viśve baliṃ svar ṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I place praise among the cows and in the forests; all bring tribute to us like the sun.

children.text: vi tvā naraḥ purutrā saparyan pitur na jivrer vi vedo bharanta ||
children.translated_text: Men worship you in many places; as to an aged father, they bring their knowledge and gifts.

children.text: sādhur na gṛdhnur asteva śūro yāteva bhīmas tveṣaḥ samatsu ||
children.translated_text: Like a skilled eager one, like an archer he sits; like a hero, like a fearsome traveler, he is fierce in battles.

children.text: Chapter 71
upa pra jinvann uśatīr uśantam patiṃ na nityaṃ janayaḥ sanīḍāḥ
children.translated_text: The kindred women, stirring forward, approach the longing one who longs, like wives approach their constant lord.

children.text: svasāraḥ śyāvīm aruṣīm ajuṣrañ citram ucchantīm uṣasaṃ na gāvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The sisters have enjoyed the dark and ruddy, many-colored, dawning <s>Uṣas</s>, as cows enjoy the dawn.

children.text: vīḍu cid dṛḍhā pitaro na ukthair adriṃ rujann aṅgiraso raveṇa
children.translated_text: Even the firm rock, like fathers with hymns, the <s>Aṅgirases</s> broke with their roar;

children.text: cakrur divo bṛhato gātum asme ahaḥ svar vividuḥ ketum usrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: they made a path for us to broad heaven; the bright ones found the day, the sun, the sign.

children.text: dadhann ṛtaṃ dhanayann asya dhītim ād id aryo didhiṣvo vibhṛtrāḥ
children.translated_text: Upholding <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), enriching his inspired thought, then the noble ones, seeking gain, as sustainers,

children.text: atṛṣyantīr apaso yanty acchā devāñ janma prayasā vardhayantīḥ ||
children.translated_text: the unthirsting waters go toward him, increasing the birth of the gods with refreshment.

children.text: mathīd yad īṃ vibhṛto mātariśvā gṛhe gṛhe śyeto jenyo bhūt
children.translated_text: When <s>Mātariśvan</s>, bearing him, rubbed him forth, the white, victorious one came to be in every house;

children.text: ād īṃ rājñe na sahīyase sacā sann ā dūtyam bhṛgavāṇo vivāya ||
children.translated_text: then the <s>Bhṛgus</s> brought him near as companion for a stronger king, for the work of messengership.

children.text: mahe yat pitra īṃ rasaṃ dive kar ava tsarat pṛśanyaś cikitvān
children.translated_text: When for the great father, for heaven, he made this sap, the wise son of <s>Pṛśni</s> flowed forth;

children.text: sṛjad astā dhṛṣatā didyum asmai svāyāṃ devo duhitari tviṣiṃ dhāt ||
children.translated_text: he released the missile boldly for him from the archer; the god placed radiance in his own daughter.

children.text: sva ā yas tubhyaṃ dama ā vibhāti namo vā dāśād uśato anu dyūn
children.translated_text: He who shines for you in his own home, or offers homage day after day to the willing one,

children.text: vardho agne vayo asya dvibarhā yāsad rāyā sarathaṃ yaṃ junāsi ||
children.translated_text: grow, O <s>Agni</s>, as the sustenance of this man, doubly high; let him whom you urge go with wealth in the same chariot.

children.text: agniṃ viśvā abhi pṛkṣaḥ sacante samudraṃ na sravataḥ sapta yahvīḥ
children.translated_text: All refreshments attach themselves to <s>Agni</s>, like the seven mighty streams flowing to the ocean;

children.text: na jāmibhir vi cikite vayo no vidā deveṣu pramatiṃ cikitvān ||
children.translated_text: Our vigor is not discerned merely by kinsmen; knowing well, find favor for us among the gods.

children.text: ā yad iṣe nṛpatiṃ teja ānaṭ chuci reto niṣiktaṃ dyaur abhīke
children.translated_text: When your brightness reached the lord of men for nourishment, the bright seed was poured in the face of heaven;

children.text: agniḥ śardham anavadyaṃ yuvānaṃ svādhyaṃ janayat sūdayac ca ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> generated the blameless, youthful host, self-ordained, and set it in motion.

children.text: mano na yo 'dhvanaḥ sadya ety ekaḥ satrā sūro vasva īśe
children.translated_text: He who, like thought, goes alone at once over the paths, truly as the sun is lord of wealth;

children.text: rājānā mitrāvaruṇā supāṇī goṣu priyam amṛtaṃ rakṣamāṇā ||
children.translated_text: the two kings <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, fair-handed, guard the beloved immortal among the cows.

children.text: mā no agne sakhyā pitryāṇi pra marṣiṣṭhā abhi viduṣ kaviḥ san
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, do not neglect our ancestral friendships, being a wise poet in the presence of those who know;

children.text: nabho na rūpaṃ jarimā mināti purā tasyā abhiśaster adhīhi ||
children.translated_text: old age diminishes beauty as mist diminishes form; before that curse comes, take thought for us.

children.text: Chapter 72
ni kāvyā vedhasaḥ śaśvatas kar haste dadhāno naryā purūṇi
children.translated_text: Holding in his hand the poems of the everlasting fashioner and many manly powers,

children.text: agnir bhuvad rayipatī rayīṇāṃ satrā cakrāṇo amṛtāni viśvā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has become lord of wealth among riches, at once fashioning all immortal things.

children.text: asme vatsam pari ṣantaṃ na vindann icchanto viśve amṛtā amūrāḥ
children.translated_text: All the undeceived immortals, seeking him, did not find him, like a calf hidden among us;

children.text: śramayuvaḥ padavyo dhiyandhās tasthuḥ pade parame cārv agneḥ ||
children.translated_text: the eager trackers, intent on thought, stood at the lovely highest station of <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: tisro yad agne śaradas tvām icchuciṃ ghṛtena śucayaḥ saparyān
children.translated_text: When for three autumns, O <s>Agni</s>, the pure ones worshipped you, pure, with ghee,

children.text: nāmāni cid dadhire yajñiyāny asūdayanta tanvaḥ sujātāḥ ||
children.translated_text: they even took sacrificial names; they set in motion their well-born bodies.

children.text: ā rodasī bṛhatī vevidānāḥ pra rudriyā jabhrire yajñiyāsaḥ
children.translated_text: The great Heaven and Earth, understanding, bore forward the Rudrian ones fit for sacrifice;

children.text: vidan marto nemadhitā cikitvān agnim pade parame tasthivāṃsam ||
children.translated_text: the knowing mortal, at the division of the shares, found <s>Agni</s> standing in the highest station.

children.text: saṃjānānā upa sīdann abhijñu patnīvanto namasyaṃ namasyan
children.translated_text: Recognizing him, they sat near, bending the knee; with wives, honoring the one worthy of honor,

children.text: ririkvāṃsas tanvaḥ kṛṇvata svāḥ sakhā sakhyur nimiṣi rakṣamāṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: having emptied their bodies, they made them their own, guarding in an instant the friendship of a friend.

children.text: triḥ sapta yad guhyāni tve it padāvidan nihitā yajñiyāsaḥ
children.translated_text: When the sacrificial ones found the thrice-seven secret stations placed in you,

children.text: tebhī rakṣante amṛtaṃ sajoṣāḥ paśūñ ca sthātṝñ carathaṃ ca pāhi ||
children.translated_text: with them, in one accord, they guard immortality; protect the cattle, what stands, and what moves.

children.text: vidvāṁ agne vayunāni kṣitīnāṃ vy ānuṣak churudho jīvase dhāḥ
children.translated_text: Knowing the ways of the peoples, O <s>Agni</s>, you have opened the enclosures in order for life;

children.text: antarvidvāṁ adhvano devayānān atandro dūto abhavo havirvāṭ ||
children.translated_text: knowing within the god-going paths, unwearied, you became the messenger, the carrier of oblation.

children.text: svādhyo diva ā sapta yahvī rāyo duro vy ṛtajñā ajānan
children.translated_text: The seven mighty, self-disposed ones from heaven, knowing <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), opened the doors of wealth;

children.text: vidad gavyaṃ saramā dṛḍham ūrvaṃ yenā nu kam mānuṣī bhojate viṭ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Saramā</s> found the firm, wide cow-pasture, by which the human clan now enjoys sustenance.

children.text: ā ye viśvā svapatyāni tasthuḥ kṛṇvānāso amṛtatvāya gātum
children.translated_text: Those who have taken their stand over all good offspring, making a path to immortality,

children.text: mahnā mahadbhiḥ pṛthivī vi tasthe mātā putrair aditir dhāyase veḥ ||
children.translated_text: with great greatness the earth spread herself out; mother <s>Aditi</s>, with her sons, comes for nurture.

children.text: adhi śriyaṃ ni dadhuś cārum asmin divo yad akṣī amṛtā akṛṇvan
children.translated_text: They set lovely splendor upon this one, when the immortal ones made the eyes of heaven;

children.text: adha kṣaranti sindhavo na sṛṣṭāḥ pra nīcīr agne aruṣīr ajānan ||
children.translated_text: then the streams flow like ones set loose; the ruddy ones, O <s>Agni</s>, knew the downward paths.

children.text: Chapter 73
rayir na yaḥ pitṛvitto vayodhāḥ supraṇītiś cikituṣo na śāsuḥ
children.translated_text: Like wealth inherited from the fathers, bestowing vigor, of good guidance, like the command of one who understands,

children.text: syonaśīr atithir na prīṇāno hoteva sadma vidhato vi tārīt ||
children.translated_text: pleasant-headed, like a guest giving delight, he would extend the house for the worshipper, like a <s>hotṛ</s>.

children.text: devo na yaḥ savitā satyamanmā kratvā nipāti vṛjanāni viśvā
children.translated_text: Like the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, true-minded, by his will he protects all enclosures;

children.text: purupraśasto amatir na satya ātmeva śevo didhiṣāyyo bhūt ||
children.translated_text: much-praised, like a true inspired thought, like one's own self benign, he became worth seeking.

children.text: devo na yaḥ pṛthivīṃ viśvadhāyā upakṣeti hitamitro na rājā
children.translated_text: Like a god, he dwells near the all-sustaining earth, like a kindly king;

children.text: puraḥsadaḥ śarmasado na vīrā anavadyā patijuṣṭeva nārī ||
children.translated_text: like faultless heroes sitting in front and dwelling in shelter, like a woman beloved by her husband.

children.text: taṃ tvā naro dama ā nityam iddham agne sacanta kṣitiṣu dhruvāsu
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, ever kindled in the house, men attend among the firm settlements;

children.text: adhi dyumnaṃ ni dadhur bhūry asmin bhavā viśvāyur dharuṇo rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: they placed abundant glory upon this one; be life for all, the support of riches.

children.text: vi pṛkṣo agne maghavāno aśyur vi sūrayo dadato viśvam āyuḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, may the bountiful men gain refreshments; may the generous patrons who give gain the whole span of life.

children.text: sanema vājaṃ samitheṣv aryo bhāgaṃ deveṣu śravase dadhānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we win the prize in the battles of the noble one, setting a share among the gods for fame.

children.text: ṛtasya hi dhenavo vāvaśānāḥ smadūdhnīḥ pīpayanta dyubhaktāḥ
children.translated_text: For the cows of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), lowing, rich in milk and apportioned by the day, made him swell;

children.text: parāvataḥ sumatim bhikṣamāṇā vi sindhavaḥ samayā sasrur adrim ||
children.translated_text: seeking favor from afar, the rivers streamed together around the rock.

children.text: tve agne sumatim bhikṣamāṇā divi śravo dadhire yajñiyāsaḥ
children.translated_text: In you, O <s>Agni</s>, the worshipful ones, seeking favor, placed fame in heaven;

children.text: naktā ca cakrur uṣasā virūpe kṛṣṇaṃ ca varṇam aruṇaṃ ca saṃ dhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: night and dawn, of different forms, they fashioned; they set together the black color and the ruddy one.

children.text: yān rāye martān suṣūdo agne te syāma maghavāno vayaṃ ca
children.translated_text: The mortals whom you have urged on to wealth, O <s>Agni</s>, may we too be among those bountiful ones;

children.text: chāyeva viśvam bhuvanaṃ sisakṣy āpaprivān rodasī antarikṣam ||
children.translated_text: like shade you seek to embrace the whole world, having filled heaven and earth and the midspace.

children.text: arvadbhir agne arvato nṛbhir nṝn vīrair vīrān vanuyāmā tvotāḥ
children.translated_text: With steeds, O <s>Agni</s>, may we, helped by you, win steeds; with men, men; with heroes, heroes;

children.text: īśānāsaḥ pitṛvittasya rāyo vi sūrayaḥ śatahimā no aśyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: may the generous patrons, masters of ancestral wealth, may the inspired ones, attain a hundred winters for us.

children.text: etā te agna ucathāni vedho juṣṭāni santu manase hṛde ca
children.translated_text: These praises of yours, O <s>Agni</s> the ordainer, may they be pleasing to your mind and heart;

children.text: śakema rāyaḥ sudhuro yamaṃ te 'dhi śravo devabhaktaṃ dadhānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: may we be able to hold your well-yoked riches, placing god-apportioned fame upon ourselves.

children.text: Chapter 74
upaprayanto adhvaram mantraṃ vocemāgnaye
children.translated_text: Approaching the <s>adhvara</s> (sacrifice), let us speak the mantra to <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: āre asme ca śṛṇvate ||
children.translated_text: so that he may hear, whether far away or among us.

children.text: yaḥ snīhitīṣu pūrvyaḥ saṃjagmānāsu kṛṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: He who, ancient in close conflicts, when the peoples had come together,

children.text: arakṣad dāśuṣe gayam ||
children.translated_text: protected life for the worshipper.

children.text: uta bruvantu jantava ud agnir vṛtrahājani
children.translated_text: And let creatures proclaim: '<s>Agni</s>, the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, has been born,

children.text: dhanañjayo raṇe raṇe ||
children.translated_text: winner of wealth in every battle.'

children.text: yasya dūto asi kṣaye veṣi havyāni vītaye
children.translated_text: You are the messenger in the dwelling of the one whose oblations you seek for enjoyment;

children.text: dasmat kṛṇoṣy adhvaram ||
children.translated_text: you make the <s>adhvara</s> (sacrifice) wondrous.

children.text: tam it suhavyam aṅgiraḥ sudevaṃ sahaso yaho
children.translated_text: Him, easy to invoke, O <s>Aṅgiras</s>, good to the gods, mighty son of strength,

children.text: janā āhuḥ subarhiṣam ||
children.translated_text: people call well-strewn with sacred grass.

children.text: ā ca vahāsi tāṁ iha devāṁ upa praśastaye
children.translated_text: And you bring those gods here for praise,

children.text: havyā suścandra vītaye ||
children.translated_text: and the oblations, O brightly shining one, for enjoyment.

children.text: na yor upabdir aśvyaḥ śṛṇve rathasya kac cana
children.translated_text: No neighing of horses or sound of the chariot is heard at all

children.text: yad agne yāsi dūtyam ||
children.translated_text: when, O <s>Agni</s>, you go on your embassy.

children.text: tvoto vājy ahrayo 'bhi pūrvasmād aparaḥ
children.translated_text: Protected by you, the eager prize-winner, one after another,

children.text: pra dāśvāṁ agne asthāt ||
children.translated_text: the worshipper has advanced, O <s>Agni</s>, beyond the former one.

children.text: uta dyumat suvīryam bṛhad agne vivāsasi
children.translated_text: And you make bright, heroic, great might shine forth, O <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: devebhyo deva dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: for the gods, O god, and for the worshipper.

children.text: Chapter 75
juṣasva saprathastamaṃ vaco devapsarastamam
children.translated_text: Accept the widest-spreading word, most god-reaching,

children.text: havyā juhvāna āsani ||
children.translated_text: as the oblations are being offered in the mouth.

children.text: athā te aṅgirastamāgne vedhastama priyam
children.translated_text: Then, O most <s>Aṅgiras</s>-like <s>Agni</s>, most ordaining, a dear

children.text: vocema brahma sānasi ||
children.translated_text: prayer we would speak to you, one that wins gain.

children.text: kas te jāmir janānām agne ko dāśvadhvaraḥ
children.translated_text: Who is your kinsman among men, O <s>Agni</s>? Who performs the gift-sacrifice?

children.text: ko ha kasminn asi śritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Who are you, and on whom do you depend?

children.text: tvaṃ jāmir janānām agne mitro asi priyaḥ
children.translated_text: You are the kinsman of men, O <s>Agni</s>; you are <s>Mitra</s>, beloved,

children.text: sakhā sakhibhya īḍyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: a friend praiseworthy for friends.

children.text: yajā no mitrāvaruṇā yajā devāṁ ṛtam bṛhat
children.translated_text: Sacrifice for us to <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; sacrifice to the gods, to the great <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order);

children.text: agne yakṣi svaṃ damam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, worship your own house.

children.text: Chapter 76
kā ta upetir manaso varāya bhuvad agne śantamā kā manīṣā
children.translated_text: What approach of your mind will be best for choosing, O <s>Agni</s>? What thought will be most peaceful?

children.text: ko vā yajñaiḥ pari dakṣaṃ ta āpa kena vā te manasā dāśema ||
children.translated_text: Or who by sacrifices has encompassed your skill? With what mind shall we serve you?

children.text: ehy agna iha hotā ni ṣīdādabdhaḥ su puraetā bhavā naḥ
children.translated_text: Come here, O <s>Agni</s>; sit here as <s>hotṛ</s> (invoking priest), unharmed; be our very foremost guide.

children.text: avatāṃ tvā rodasī viśvaminve yajā mahe saumanasāya devān ||
children.translated_text: Let heaven and earth, all-impelling, aid you; sacrifice to the gods for great good-mindedness.

children.text: pra su viśvān rakṣaso dhakṣy agne bhavā yajñānām abhiśastipāvā
children.translated_text: Burn away all the <s>rakṣases</s>, O <s>Agni</s>; be protector of the sacrifices from curses.

children.text: athā vaha somapatiṃ haribhyām ātithyam asmai cakṛmā sudāvne ||
children.translated_text: Then bring the lord of <s>Soma</s> with his bay horses; we have made hospitality for this liberal giver.

children.text: prajāvatā vacasā vahnir āsā ca huve ni ca satsīha devaiḥ
children.translated_text: With speech rich in offspring, with the mouth as bearer, I call you here and seat you here with the gods;

children.text: veṣi hotram uta potraṃ yajatra bodhi prayantar janitar vasūnām ||
children.translated_text: you seek the office of <s>hotṛ</s> and also of <s>potṛ</s>, O worshipful one; know yourself as the impeller, the begetter of goods.

children.text: yathā viprasya manuṣo havirbhir devāṁ ayajaḥ kavibhiḥ kaviḥ san
children.translated_text: As, being a seer, you sacrificed to the gods for the inspired man <s>Manu</s> with oblations and with poets,

children.text: evā hotaḥ satyatara tvam adyāgne mandrayā juhvā yajasva ||
children.translated_text: so, O <s>hotṛ</s>, truer one, you today, O <s>Agni</s>, sacrifice with your gladdening tongue.

children.text: Chapter 77
kathā dāśemāgnaye kāsmai devajuṣṭocyate bhāmine gīḥ
children.translated_text: How shall we serve <s>Agni</s>? For what god-loving, shining one is the song spoken?

children.text: yo martyeṣv amṛta ṛtāvā hotā yajiṣṭha it kṛṇoti devān ||
children.translated_text: He who, immortal among mortals, upholding <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), as the best-sacrificing <s>hotṛ</s>, makes the gods present.

children.text: yo adhvareṣu śantama ṛtāvā hotā tam ū namobhir ā kṛṇudhvam
children.translated_text: He who in <s>adhvaras</s> (sacrifices), most peaceful and upholding <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), is <s>hotṛ</s>: make him favorable with reverences.

children.text: agnir yad ver martāya devān sa cā bodhāti manasā yajāti ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Agni</s> knows the gods for a mortal, he both awakens and worships with his mind.

children.text: sa hi kratuḥ sa maryaḥ sa sādhur mitro na bhūd adbhutasya rathīḥ
children.translated_text: For he is will, he is the young hero, he is the effective one; like <s>Mitra</s>, he became charioteer of the wondrous one.

children.text: tam medheṣu prathamaṃ devayantīr viśa upa bruvate dasmam ārīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Him, wondrous, first in the assemblies, the god-seeking clans, the active ones, address.

children.text: sa no nṛṇāṃ nṛtamo riśādā agnir giro 'vasā vetu dhītim
children.translated_text: May he, <s>Agni</s>, most manly among men, foe-destroyer, come to our songs with help and to our thought;

children.text: tanā ca ye maghavānaḥ śaviṣṭhā vājaprasūtā iṣayanta manma ||
children.translated_text: and may those bountiful, mightiest ones, stirred by the prize, quicken our hymn with offspring.

children.text: evāgnir gotamebhir ṛtāvā viprebhir astoṣṭa jātavedāḥ
children.translated_text: Thus <s>Agni Jātavedas</s>, upholding <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), has been praised by the inspired <s>Gotamas</s>.

children.text: sa eṣu dyumnam pīpayat sa vājaṃ sa puṣṭiṃ yāti joṣam ā cikitvān ||
children.translated_text: He makes splendor swell among these; knowing favor, he goes to the prize and to nourishment.

children.text: Chapter 78
abhi tvā gotamā girā jātavedo vicarṣaṇe
children.translated_text: O <s>Jātavedas</s>, discerner of peoples, the <s>Gotamas</s> approach you with song;

children.text: dyumnair abhi pra ṇonumaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with splendors we praise you forth.

children.text: tam u tvā gotamo girā rāyaskāmo duvasyati
children.translated_text: The <s>Gotama</s>, desiring wealth, worships that very you with song;

children.text: dyumnair abhi pra ṇonumaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with splendors we praise you forth.

children.text: tam u tvā vājasātamam aṅgirasvaddhavāmahe
children.translated_text: That very you, best winner of prizes, we invoke in the manner of the <s>Aṅgirases</s>;

children.text: dyumnair abhi pra ṇonumaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with splendors we praise you forth.

children.text: tam u tvā vṛtrahantamaṃ yo dasyūṃr avadhūnuṣe
children.translated_text: That very you, greatest slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, who shake away the <s>Dasyus</s>;

children.text: dyumnair abhi pra ṇonumaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with splendors we praise you forth.

children.text: avocāma rahūgaṇā agnaye madhumad vacaḥ
children.translated_text: We, the <s>Rahūgaṇas</s>, have spoken honeyed speech to <s>Agni</s>;

children.text: dyumnair abhi pra ṇonumaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with splendors we praise you forth.

children.text: Chapter 79
hiraṇyakeśo rajaso visāre 'hir dhunir vāta iva dhrajīmān
children.translated_text: Golden-haired in the spreading of the midspace, the roaring serpent rushes like the wind, bearing a banner;

children.text: śucibhrājā uṣaso navedā yaśasvatīr apasyuvo na satyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: with pure brilliance he announces the dawns, glorious, active, and true.

children.text: ā te suparṇā aminantaṃ evaiḥ kṛṣṇo nonāva vṛṣabho yadīdam
children.translated_text: Toward you the well-winged ones hasten with their approaches; the black bull bellows when this happens.

children.text: śivābhir na smayamānābhir āgāt patanti miha stanayanty abhrā ||
children.translated_text: He has come as if with auspicious smiling ones; the clouds fall, thundering, as rain.

children.text: yad īm ṛtasya payasā piyāno nayann ṛtasya pathibhī rajiṣṭhaiḥ
children.translated_text: When this one, drinking the milk of truth, leads by the straightest paths of truth,

children.text: aryamā mitro varuṇaḥ parijmā tvacam pṛñcanty uparasya yonau ||
children.translated_text: <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, the all-traversing one, moisten the skin in the womb of the lower realm.

children.text: agne vājasya gomata īśānaḥ sahaso yaho
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, lord of the cattle-rich prize, mighty son of strength,

children.text: asme dhehi jātavedo mahi śravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: place great fame in us, O <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: sa idhāno vasuṣ kavir agnir īḍenyo girā
children.translated_text: Kindled, that <s>Agni</s>, rich in goods, a sage, praiseworthy with song,

children.text: revad asmabhyam purvaṇīka dīdihi ||
children.translated_text: shine richly for us, O one with ancient faces.

children.text: kṣapo rājann uta tmanāgne vastor utoṣasaḥ
children.translated_text: O king of nights, and by your own power, O <s>Agni</s>, of morning and of dawn,

children.text: sa tigmajambha rakṣaso daha prati ||
children.translated_text: you with sharp jaws, burn the demons away.

children.text: avā no agna ūtibhir gāyatrasya prabharmaṇi
children.translated_text: Come down to us, O <s>Agni</s>, with your aids, at the presentation of the <s>Gāyatra</s>;

children.text: viśvāsu dhīṣu vandya ||
children.translated_text: you are worthy of praise in all inspired thoughts.

children.text: ā no agne rayim bhara satrāsāhaṃ vareṇyam
children.translated_text: Bring us wealth, O <s>Agni</s>, choice wealth that overcomes all at once,

children.text: viśvāsu pṛtsu duṣṭaram ||
children.translated_text: hard to overcome in every battle.

children.text: ā no agne sucetunā rayiṃ viśvāyupoṣasam
children.translated_text: Bring us, O <s>Agni</s>, wealth with good understanding, nourishing all life;

children.text: mārḍīkaṃ dhehi jīvase ||
children.translated_text: set kindness for us, that we may live.

children.text: pra pūtās tigmaśociṣe vāco gotamāgnaye
children.translated_text: O <s>Gotamas</s>, for <s>Agni</s> of sharp flame,

children.text: bharasva sumnayur giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: bring purified speeches, songs that seek his favor.

children.text: yo no agne 'bhidāsaty anti dūre padīṣṭa saḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever assails us, O <s>Agni</s>, whether near or far, may he fall down;

children.text: asmākam id vṛdhe bhava ||
children.translated_text: be for our increase alone.

children.text: sahasrākṣo vicarṣaṇir agnī rakṣāṃsi sedhati
children.translated_text: Thousand-eyed, discerning peoples, <s>Agni</s> drives the demons away;

children.text: hotā gṛṇīta ukthyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: as <s>Hotar</s>, worthy of hymns, he is praised.

children.text: Chapter 80
itthā hi soma in made brahmā cakāra vardhanam
children.translated_text: For thus, O <s>Soma</s>, in exhilaration the sacred utterance made an increase;

children.text: śaviṣṭha vajrinn ojasā pṛthivyā niḥ śaśā ahim arcann anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: O strongest thunderbolt-bearer, with might you struck the serpent down from the earth, singing after sovereignty.

children.text: sa tvāmadad vṛṣā madaḥ somaḥ śyenābhṛtaḥ sutaḥ
children.translated_text: That bull-like exhilaration gladdened you: <s>Soma</s>, pressed and brought by the eagle;

children.text: yenā vṛtraṃ nir adbhyo jaghantha vajrinn ojasārcann anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: with it, O thunderbolt-bearer, you struck <s>Vṛtra</s> away from the waters with might, singing after sovereignty.

children.text: prehy abhīhi dhṛṣṇuhi na te vajro ni yaṃsate
children.translated_text: Go forth, go against him, be bold; your thunderbolt will not be restrained.

children.text: indra nṛmṇaṃ hi te śavo hano vṛtraṃ jayā apo 'rcann anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, manly power and force are yours: strike <s>Vṛtra</s>, win the waters, singing after sovereignty.

children.text: nir indra bhūmyā adhi vṛtraṃ jaghantha nir divaḥ
children.translated_text: From the earth, O <s>Indra</s>, you struck down <s>Vṛtra</s>; from heaven you struck him down.

children.text: sṛjā marutvatīr ava jīvadhanyā imā apo 'rcann anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: Release downward these waters, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, life-sustaining and rich in grain, singing after sovereignty.

children.text: indro vṛtrasya dodhataḥ sānuṃ vajreṇa hīḍitaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, with the hurled thunderbolt, struck the ridge of quivering <s>Vṛtra</s>;

children.text: abhikramyāva jighnate 'paḥ sarmāya codayann arcann anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: stepping upon him, he struck him down, urging the waters to their flow, singing after sovereignty.

children.text: adhi sānau ni jighnate vajreṇa śataparvaṇā
children.translated_text: Upon the ridge he struck him down with the hundred-jointed thunderbolt;

children.text: mandāna indro andhasaḥ sakhibhyo gātum icchaty arcann anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: exhilarated by the draught, <s>Indra</s> seeks a path for his friends, singing after sovereignty.

children.text: indra tubhyam id adrivo 'nuttaṃ vajrin vīryam
children.translated_text: For you alone, O <s>Indra</s>, O lord of stones, O thunderbolt-bearer, there is unsurpassed heroism,

children.text: yaddha tyam māyinam mṛgaṃ tam u tvam māyayāvadhīr arcann anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: since you slew that crafty beast by craft, singing after sovereignty.

children.text: vi te vajrāso asthiran navatiṃ nāvyā anu
children.translated_text: Your thunderbolts were set apart along the ninety streams;

children.text: mahat ta indra vīryam bāhvos te balaṃ hitam arcann anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: great is your heroism, O <s>Indra</s>; strength is placed in your two arms, singing after sovereignty.

children.text: sahasraṃ sākam arcata pari ṣṭobhata viṃśatiḥ
children.translated_text: A thousand chant together; twenty shout around;

children.text: śatainam anv anonavur indrāya brahmodyatam arcann anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: hundreds have roared after this sacred utterance raised for <s>Indra</s>, singing after sovereignty.

children.text: indro vṛtrasya taviṣīṃ nir ahan sahasā sahaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> struck away the might of <s>Vṛtra</s>, forcefully overcoming force;

children.text: mahat tad asya pauṃsyaṃ vṛtraṃ jaghanvāṁ asṛjad arcann anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: great is his manly deed: having slain <s>Vṛtra</s>, he released the waters, singing after sovereignty.

children.text: ime cit tava manyave vepete bhiyasā mahī
children.translated_text: Even these two great worlds tremble with fear at your wrath,

children.text: yad indra vajrinn ojasā vṛtram marutvāṁ avadhīr arcann anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: when, O <s>Indra</s>, thunderbolt-bearer, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, you slew <s>Vṛtra</s> with might, singing after sovereignty.

children.text: na vepasā na tanyatendraṃ vṛtro vi bībhayat
children.translated_text: <s>Vṛtra</s> did not frighten <s>Indra</s> with trembling or with thunder;

children.text: abhy enaṃ vajra āyasaḥ sahasrabhṛṣṭir āyatārcann anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: the iron thunderbolt, thousand-pointed and stretched out, came upon him, singing after sovereignty.

children.text: yad vṛtraṃ tava cāśaniṃ vajreṇa samayodhayaḥ
children.translated_text: When you matched your lightning against <s>Vṛtra</s> with the thunderbolt,

children.text: ahim indra jighāṃsato divi te badbadhe śavo 'rcann anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, as you wished to slay the serpent, your force resounded in heaven, singing after sovereignty.

children.text: abhiṣṭane te adrivo yat sthā jagac ca rejate
children.translated_text: At your roaring, O lord of stones, whatever stands and whatever moves shakes;

children.text: tvaṣṭā cit tava manyava indra vevijyate bhiyārcann anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: even <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> trembles in fear at your wrath, O <s>Indra</s>, singing after sovereignty.

children.text: nahi nu yād adhīmasīndraṃ ko vīryā paraḥ
children.translated_text: For now indeed we know of no one beyond <s>Indra</s> in heroic power;

children.text: tasmin nṛmṇam uta kratuṃ devā ojāṃsi saṃ dadhur arcann anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: in him the gods placed manliness, insight, and strengths, singing after sovereignty.

children.text: yām atharvā manuṣ pitā dadhyaṅ dhiyam atnata
children.translated_text: The thought that <s>Atharvan</s>, father <s>Manu</s>, and <s>Dadhyañc</s> stretched out:

children.text: tasmin brahmāṇi pūrvathendra ukthā sam agmatārcann anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: in it, as before, the prayers and hymns came together for <s>Indra</s>, singing after sovereignty.

children.text: Chapter 81
indro madāya vāvṛdhe śavase vṛtrahā nṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, grew through men for exhilaration and for strength;

children.text: tam in mahatsv ājiṣūtem arbhe havāmahe sa vājeṣu pra no 'viṣat ||
children.translated_text: we invoke him in great contests and also in small ones; may he help us in the prizes.

children.text: asi hi vīra senyo 'si bhūri parādadiḥ
children.translated_text: For you are a hero fit for the army; you are one who gives away much;

children.text: asi dabhrasya cid vṛdho yajamānāya śikṣasi sunvate bhūri te vasu ||
children.translated_text: you are the increaser even of the small man; you instruct the sacrificer, the Soma-presser; much wealth is yours.

children.text: yad udīrata ājayo dhṛṣṇave dhīyate dhanā
children.translated_text: When contests rise up and riches are set out for the bold one,

children.text: yukṣvā madacyutā harī kaṃ hanaḥ kaṃ vasau dadho 'smāṁ indra vasau dadhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: yoke your two bay steeds that do not let the exhilaration fall. Whom will you strike? Whom will you place in wealth? Place us, O <s>Indra</s>, in wealth.

children.text: kratvā mahāṁ anuṣvadham bhīma ā vāvṛdhe śavaḥ
children.translated_text: By his insight, mighty according to his own law, the terrible one's strength has greatly increased.

children.text: śriya ṛṣva upākayor ni śiprī harivān dadhe hastayor vajram āyasam ||
children.translated_text: The lofty, splendid, fair-jawed bearer of bay steeds set the iron thunderbolt in his two hands.

children.text: ā paprau pārthivaṃ rajo badbadhe rocanā divi
children.translated_text: He filled the earthly realm; he made the lights firm in heaven.

children.text: na tvāvāṁ indra kaścana na jāto na janiṣyate 'ti viśvaṃ vavakṣitha ||
children.translated_text: No one like you, O <s>Indra</s>, has been born, nor will one be born; you have surpassed the whole world.

children.text: yo aryo martabhojanam parādadāti dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: He gives the Arya's food for mortals to the generous worshipper.

children.text: indro asmabhyaṃ śikṣatu vi bhajā bhūri te vasu bhakṣīya tava rādhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> bestow it on us; distribute it. Your wealth is abundant; may I enjoy your bounty.

children.text: made made hi no dadir yūthā gavām ṛjukratuḥ
children.translated_text: For in every exhilaration the straight-minded one has given us herds of cows.

children.text: saṃ gṛbhāya purū śatobhayāhastyā vasu śiśīhi rāya ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: Gather many hundreds, wealth for both hands; sharpen it, and bring riches here.

children.text: mādayasva sute sacā śavase śūra rādhase
children.translated_text: Exhilarate yourself together with the pressed soma, for strength, O hero, and for bounty.

children.text: vidmā hi tvā purūvasum upa kāmān sasṛjmahe 'thā no 'vitā bhava ||
children.translated_text: For we know you as rich in many goods; we have sent forth our desires toward you. So be our helper.

children.text: ete ta indra jantavo viśvam puṣyanti vāryam
children.translated_text: These creatures of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, cause all desirable wealth to prosper.

children.text: antar hi khyo janānām aryo vedo adāśuṣāṃ teṣāṃ no veda ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: For you, the noble one, look within among men and know the wealth of the ungenerous; bring that knowledge to us.

children.text: Chapter 82
upo ṣu śṛṇuhī giro maghavan mātathā iva
children.translated_text: Come near now and hear our songs, O bountiful one, as a mother would.

children.text: yadā naḥ sūnṛtāvataḥ kara ād arthayāsa id yojā nv indra te harī ||
children.translated_text: When you would favor us who speak good truth, and would seek gain, then yoke your two bay steeds, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: akṣann amīmadanta hy ava priyā adhūṣata
children.translated_text: They have eaten; they have rejoiced; for the beloved ones have shaken themselves free.

children.text: astoṣata svabhānavo viprā naviṣṭhayā matī yojā nv indra te harī ||
children.translated_text: The self-radiant seers have praised you with their newest thought; yoke your two bay steeds, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: susaṃdṛśaṃ tvā vayam maghavan vandiṣīmahi
children.translated_text: We would praise you, O bountiful one, lovely to behold.

children.text: pra nūnam pūrṇavandhura stuto yāhi vaśāṁ anu yojā nv indra te harī ||
children.translated_text: Now, fully praised and with a full chariot-seat, come according to your will; yoke your two bay steeds, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: sa ghā taṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ ratham adhi tiṣṭhāti govidam
children.translated_text: Indeed he mounts that bull-like chariot, the finder of cows,

children.text: yaḥ pātraṃ hāriyojanam pūrṇam indra ciketati yojā nv indra te harī ||
children.translated_text: who keeps in mind the cup yoked with bay steeds and filled, O <s>Indra</s>; yoke your two bay steeds, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yuktas te astu dakṣiṇa uta savyaḥ śatakrato
children.translated_text: Let your right-hand steed be yoked, and also the left, O you of a hundred powers.

children.text: tena jāyām upa priyām mandāno yāhy andhaso yojā nv indra te harī ||
children.translated_text: With them, exhilarated by the soma-drink, come to your dear wife; yoke your two bay steeds, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yunajmi te brahmaṇā keśinā harī upa pra yāhi dadhiṣe gabhastyoḥ
children.translated_text: With prayer I yoke your two maned bay steeds; come near, for you hold them in your hands.

children.text: ut tvā sutāso rabhasā amandiṣuḥ pūṣaṇvān vajrin sam u patnyāmadaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The pressed juices have roused you with force; together with <s>Pūṣan</s>, O thunderbolt-bearer, rejoice with your wife.

children.text: Chapter 83
aśvāvati prathamo goṣu gacchati suprāvīr indra martyas tavotibhiḥ
children.translated_text: The mortal whom you aid, O <s>Indra</s>, first goes among horses and cattle, rich in good heroes.

children.text: tam it pṛṇakṣi vasunā bhavīyasā sindhum āpo yathābhito vicetasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You fill him with still greater wealth, as the discerning waters fill the river from both sides.

children.text: āpo na devīr upa yanti hotriyam avaḥ paśyanti vitataṃ yathā rajaḥ
children.translated_text: Like divine waters they approach the hotṛ's office; the helps look down on the spread-out expanse like the atmosphere.

children.text: prācair devāsaḥ pra ṇayanti devayum brahmapriyaṃ joṣayante varā iva ||
children.translated_text: The gods lead the god-seeking man forward by forward paths; they delight the lover of prayer like suitors a bride.

children.text: adhi dvayor adadhā ukthyaṃ vaco yatasrucā mithunā yā saparyataḥ
children.translated_text: Upon the two you placed the laudable word, while the pair worship with the offering-ladle.

children.text: asaṃyatto vrate te kṣeti puṣyati bhadrā śaktir yajamānāya sunvate ||
children.translated_text: Unrestrained under your vow he dwells and prospers; auspicious is the power for the sacrificer who presses soma.

children.text: ād aṅgirāḥ prathamaṃ dadhire vaya iddhāgnayaḥ śamyā ye sukṛtyayā
children.translated_text: Then the <s>Aṅgirases</s> first assumed vital strength, kindling fires through their good work with the kindling-sticks.

children.text: sarvam paṇeḥ sam avindanta bhojanam aśvāvantaṃ gomantam ā paśuṃ naraḥ ||
children.translated_text: The men found all the food of <s>Paṇi</s> together, horses, cattle, and livestock.

children.text: yajñair atharvā prathamaḥ pathas tate tataḥ sūryo vratapā vena ājani
children.translated_text: By sacrifices <s>Atharvan</s> first stretched out the paths; then <s>Sūrya</s>, <s>Vena</s>, guardian of the vow, was born.

children.text: ā gā ājad uśanā kāvyaḥ sacā yamasya jātam amṛtaṃ yajāmahe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Uśanā Kāvya</s> drove the cows here; together we worship the immortal one born of <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: barhir vā yat svapatyāya vṛjyate 'rko vā ślokam āghoṣate divi
children.translated_text: Whether the sacrificial grass is strewn for good offspring, or the chant resounds as a verse in heaven,

children.text: grāvā yatra vadati kārur ukthyas tasyed indro abhipitveṣu raṇyati ||
children.translated_text: where the pressing stone speaks, the praiseworthy singer, there <s>Indra</s> delights at the drink-offerings.

children.text: Chapter 84
asāvi soma indra te śaviṣṭha dhṛṣṇav ā gahi
children.translated_text: The soma has been pressed for you, O <s>Indra</s>, strongest and bold one; come here.

children.text: ā tvā pṛṇaktv indriyaṃ rajaḥ sūryo na raśmibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May your power fill you, as the sun fills the realm with rays.

children.text: indram iddharī vahato 'pratidhṛṣṭaśavasam
children.translated_text: The two bay steeds carry <s>Indra</s>, whose force cannot be withstood,

children.text: ṛṣīṇāṃ ca stutīr upa yajñaṃ ca mānuṣāṇām ||
children.translated_text: to the praises of the seers and to the sacrifice of human beings.

children.text: ā tiṣṭha vṛtrahan rathaṃ yuktā te brahmaṇā harī
children.translated_text: Mount the chariot, O <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer; your two bay steeds are yoked by prayer.

children.text: arvācīnaṃ su te mano grāvā kṛṇotu vagnunā ||
children.translated_text: May the pressing stone, with its sound, make your mind well turned hither.

children.text: imam indra sutam piba jyeṣṭham amartyam madam
children.translated_text: Drink this pressed soma, O <s>Indra</s>, the foremost immortal exhilaration.

children.text: śukrasya tvābhy akṣaran dhārā ṛtasya sādane ||
children.translated_text: The shining streams have flowed toward you in the seat of truth.

children.text: indrāya nūnam arcatokthāni ca bravītana
children.translated_text: Now sing to <s>Indra</s>, and speak the hymns.

children.text: sutā amatsur indavo jyeṣṭhaṃ namasyatā sahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The pressed drops have exhilarated him; reverence the foremost strength.

children.text: nakiṣ ṭvad rathītaro harī yad indra yacchase
children.translated_text: No charioteer is greater than you when you harness the two bay steeds, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: nakiṣ ṭvānu majmanā nakiḥ svaśva ānaśe ||
children.translated_text: No one has overtaken you in majesty; no one with fine horses has reached you.

children.text: ya eka id vidayate vasu martāya dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: He alone finds wealth for the generous mortal,

children.text: īśāno apratiṣkuta indro aṅga ||
children.translated_text: the irresistible lord, <s>Indra</s> indeed.

children.text: kadā martam arādhasam padā kṣumpam iva sphurat
children.translated_text: When will <s>Indra</s> trample the ungenerous mortal with his foot, like a mushroom?

children.text: kadā naḥ śuśravad gira indro aṅga ||
children.translated_text: When indeed will <s>Indra</s> hear our songs?

children.text: yaś ciddhi tvā bahubhya ā sutāvāṁ āvivāsati
children.translated_text: For even if one who has pressed soma eagerly serves you among many,

children.text: ugraṃ tat patyate śava indro aṅga ||
children.translated_text: that fierce might becomes lordly, <s>Indra</s> indeed.

children.text: svādor itthā viṣūvato madhvaḥ pibanti gauryaḥ
children.translated_text: From the sweet, well-mixed honeyed drink the tawny ones drink,

children.text: yā indreṇa sayāvarīr vṛṣṇā madanti śobhase vasvīr anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: those who, moving together with bull-like <s>Indra</s>, rejoice for beauty, rich ones, after sovereignty.

children.text: tā asya pṛśanāyuvaḥ somaṃ śrīṇanti pṛśnayaḥ
children.translated_text: Those dappled ones, fond of his dappled beauty, mix the soma for him;

children.text: priyā indrasya dhenavo vajraṃ hinvanti sāyakaṃ vasvīr anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: dear milch-cows of <s>Indra</s>, they urge on the thunderbolt, the missile, rich ones, after sovereignty.

children.text: tā asya namasā sahaḥ saparyanti pracetasaḥ
children.translated_text: Those mindful ones worship his might with reverence;

children.text: vratāny asya saścire purūṇi pūrvacittaye vasvīr anu svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: they have attended upon his many ordinances for ancient insight, rich ones, after sovereignty.

children.text: indro dadhīco asthabhir vṛtrāṇy apratiṣkutaḥ
children.translated_text: With the bones of <s>Dadhīci</s>, <s>Indra</s>, irresistible,

children.text: jaghāna navatīr nava ||
children.translated_text: struck down the ninety-nine <s>Vṛtras</s>.

children.text: icchann aśvasya yacchiraḥ parvateṣv apaśritam
children.translated_text: Seeking the head of the horse, which was hidden away in the mountains,

children.text: tad vidaccharyaṇāvati ||
children.translated_text: he found it in <s>Śaryaṇāvat</s>.

children.text: atrāha gor amanvata nāma tvaṣṭur apīcyam
children.translated_text: There they recognized the secret name of the cow, of <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>,

children.text: itthā candramaso gṛhe ||
children.translated_text: thus in the house of the moon.

children.text: ko adya yuṅkte dhuri gā ṛtasya śimīvato bhāmino durhṛṇāyūn
children.translated_text: Who today yokes to the pole the cattle of <s>ṛta</s>, laboring, shining, and hard to provoke?

children.text: āsanniṣūn hṛtsvaso mayobhūn ya eṣām bhṛtyām ṛṇadhat sa jīvāt ||
children.translated_text: May those arrows near at hand, heart-refreshing and bringing delight, be favorable; he who secures their service shall live.

children.text: ka īṣate tujyate ko bibhāya ko maṃsate santam indraṃ ko anti
children.translated_text: Who has power? Who is impelled? Who is afraid? Who thinks of mighty <s>Indra</s>? Who is near him?

children.text: kas tokāya ka ibhāyota rāye 'dhi bravat tanve ko janāya ||
children.translated_text: Who will speak on behalf of offspring, who for cattle, and also for wealth, who for the body and who for the people?

children.text: ko agnim īṭṭe haviṣā ghṛtena srucā yajātā ṛtubhir dhruvebhiḥ
children.translated_text: Who praises <s>Agni</s> with oblation and ghee, with the sacrificial ladle, with fixed seasons fit for worship?

children.text: kasmai devā ā vahān āśu homa ko maṃsate vītihotraḥ sudevaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For whom shall I quickly bring the gods to the offering? Who, as a good god, thinks of the bearer of oblations?

children.text: tvam aṅga pra śaṃsiṣo devaḥ śaviṣṭha martyam
children.translated_text: You indeed, O god, mightiest one, will proclaim the mortal aloud.

children.text: na tvad anyo maghavann asti marḍitendra bravīmi te vacaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There is no other merciful one than you, O bountiful <s>Indra</s>; I speak this word to you.

children.text: mā te rādhāṃsi mā ta ūtayo vaso 'smān kadācanā dabhan
children.translated_text: Let not your gifts, let not your aids, O good one, ever fail us.

children.text: viśvā ca na upamimīhi mānuṣa vasūni carṣaṇibhya ā ||
children.translated_text: And measure out to us all human riches, goods for the peoples.

children.text: Chapter 85
pra ye śumbhante janayo na saptayo yāman rudrasya sūnavaḥ sudaṃsasaḥ
children.translated_text: Those who adorn themselves like swift mares, the skillful sons of <s>Rudra</s>, when they go forth,

children.text: rodasī hi marutaś cakrire vṛdhe madanti vīrā vidatheṣu ghṛṣvayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for the <s>Maruts</s> have made heaven and earth grow; the heroes rejoice in the assemblies, eager and exultant.

children.text: ta ukṣitāso mahimānam āśata divi rudrāso adhi cakrire sadaḥ
children.translated_text: They, bedewed, attained greatness; the <s>Rudras</s> established their seat in heaven.

children.text: arcanto arkaṃ janayanta indriyam adhi śriyo dadhire pṛśnimātaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Singing the chant, they generated power; the sons of <s>Pṛśni</s>, their mother, set splendors upon themselves.

children.text: gomātaro yacchubhayante añjibhis tanūṣu śubhrā dadhire virukmataḥ
children.translated_text: When, having cows as mothers, they shine with adornments, they have placed bright gold ornaments on their bodies.

children.text: bādhante viśvam abhimātinam apa vartmāny eṣām anu rīyate ghṛtam ||
children.translated_text: They drive away every hostile assault; along their paths ghee flows onward.

children.text: vi ye bhrājante sumakhāsa ṛṣṭibhiḥ pracyāvayanto acyutā cid ojasā
children.translated_text: When the well-sacrificing ones flash with spears, shaking even the unshaken by their might,

children.text: manojuvo yan maruto ratheṣv ā vṛṣavrātāsaḥ pṛṣatīr ayugdhvam ||
children.translated_text: swift as thought, O <s>Maruts</s>, when you yoked the dappled mares to your chariots, bull-banded together.

children.text: pra yad ratheṣu pṛṣatīr ayugdhvaṃ vāje adrim maruto raṃhayantaḥ
children.translated_text: When you yoked the dappled mares to the chariots, O <s>Maruts</s>, speeding the stone in the contest,

children.text: utāruṣasya vi ṣyanti dhārāś carmevodabhir vy undanti bhūma ||
children.translated_text: then the streams of the ruddy one burst forth; they soak the ground with waters as a hide is soaked.

children.text: ā vo vahantu saptayo raghuṣyado raghupatvānaḥ pra jigāta bāhubhiḥ
children.translated_text: Let your swift coursers, eager to run, bring you here; come forth with rapid strength in your arms.

children.text: sīdatā barhir uru vaḥ sadas kṛtam mādayadhvam maruto madhvo andhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Sit down upon the sacred grass; a broad seat has been made for you. Gladden yourselves, O <s>Maruts</s>, with the sweet Soma-juice.

children.text: te 'vardhanta svatavaso mahitvanā nākaṃ tasthur uru cakrire sadaḥ
children.translated_text: They grew by their own power and greatness; they stood upon the vault of heaven and made a broad seat.

children.text: viṣṇur yaddhāvad vṛṣaṇam madacyutaṃ vayo na sīdann adhi barhiṣi priye ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Viṣṇu</s> strode to the vigorous, exhilaration-pouring one, they settled like birds upon the beloved sacred grass.

children.text: śūrā ived yuyudhayo na jagmayaḥ śravasyavo na pṛtanāsu yetire
children.translated_text: Like heroes, indeed, they went forth as fighters; like men seeking fame, they advanced in battles.

children.text: bhayante viśvā bhuvanā marudbhyo rājāna iva tveṣasaṃdṛśo naraḥ ||
children.translated_text: All beings fear the <s>Maruts</s>; like kings, the men are terrible to behold.

children.text: tvaṣṭā yad vajraṃ sukṛtaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ sahasrabhṛṣṭiṃ svapā avartayat
children.translated_text: When <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, skilled in work, turned the well-made golden thunderbolt with a thousand edges,

children.text: dhatta indro nary apāṃsi kartave 'han vṛtraṃ nir apām aubjad arṇavam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> took manly deeds upon himself to perform; he slew <s>Vṛtra</s> and thrust forth the flood of waters.

children.text: ūrdhvaṃ nunudre 'vataṃ ta ojasā dādṛhāṇaṃ cid bibhidur vi parvatam
children.translated_text: Upward he drove the well, by his might; they split apart even the firm mountain.

children.text: dhamanto vāṇam marutaḥ sudānavo made somasya raṇyāni cakrire ||
children.translated_text: Blowing the reed-pipe, the bounteous <s>Maruts</s> made delights in the exhilaration of <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: jihmaṃ nunudre 'vataṃ tayā diśāsiñcann utsaṃ gotamāya tṛṣṇaje
children.translated_text: He drove the crooked well in that direction, pouring out the spring for thirsty <s>Gotama</s>.

children.text: ā gacchantīm avasā citrabhānavaḥ kāmaṃ viprasya tarpayanta dhāmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Coming with aid, O bright-shining ones, they satisfied the desire of the inspired poet with their abodes.

children.text: yā vaḥ śarma śaśamānāya santi tridhātūni dāśuṣe yacchatādhi
children.translated_text: Whatever shelters of yours exist for the one who praises, grant those threefold protections to the worshipper.

children.text: asmabhyaṃ tāni maruto vi yanta rayiṃ no dhatta vṛṣaṇaḥ suvīram ||
children.translated_text: Send those to us, O <s>Maruts</s>; bestow on us wealth, O bulls, rich in heroes.

children.text: Chapter 86
maruto yasya hi kṣaye pāthā divo vimahasaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Maruts</s>, in whose dwelling you, vast in majesty, protect the course of heaven,

children.text: sa sugopātamo janaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that people is most securely guarded.

children.text: yajñair vā yajñavāhaso viprasya vā matīnām
children.translated_text: Whether through sacrifices, O bearers of sacrifice, or through the thoughts of the inspired poet,

children.text: marutaḥ śṛṇutā havam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Maruts</s>, hear the call.

children.text: uta vā yasya vājino 'nu vipram atakṣata
children.translated_text: Or the man whose strong horses fashioned the inspired poet in their train,

children.text: sa gantā gomati vraje ||
children.translated_text: he shall go to a cattle-rich enclosure.

children.text: asya vīrasya barhiṣi sutaḥ somo diviṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: On the sacred grass of this hero, in the heavenly rites, the pressed <s>Soma</s>

children.text: uktham madaś ca śasyate ||
children.translated_text: is praised, along with the hymn and exhilaration.

children.text: asya śroṣantv ā bhuvo viśvā yaś carṣaṇīr abhi
children.translated_text: May all the beings around hear of him, and all the peoples,

children.text: sūraṃ cit sasruṣīr iṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and the flowing refreshments, even for the hero.

children.text: pūrvībhir hi dadāśima śaradbhir maruto vayam
children.translated_text: For through many autumns, O <s>Maruts</s>, we have served you

children.text: avobhiś carṣaṇīnām ||
children.translated_text: with the protections of the peoples.

children.text: subhagaḥ sa prayajyavo maruto astu martyaḥ
children.translated_text: May that fortunate mortal be yours, O <s>Maruts</s>, ready for sacrifice,

children.text: yasya prayāṃsi parṣatha ||
children.translated_text: whose offerings you carry across.

children.text: śaśamānasya vā naraḥ svedasya satyaśavasaḥ
children.translated_text: Or, O men, know the desire of the praising man, of the true-strong one,

children.text: vidā kāmasya venataḥ ||
children.translated_text: of the one who longs for his own good.

children.text: yūyaṃ tat satyaśavasa āviṣ karta mahitvanā
children.translated_text: You, O true-strong ones, make that manifest by your greatness;

children.text: vidhyatā vidyutā rakṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: strike the demon with lightning.

children.text: gūhatā guhyaṃ tamo vi yāta viśvam atriṇam
children.translated_text: Hide the hidden darkness; drive away every devouring enemy.

children.text: jyotiṣ kartā yad uśmasi ||
children.translated_text: Make light, for that is what we desire.

children.text: Chapter 87
pratvakṣasaḥ pratavaso virapśino 'nānatā avithurā ṛjīṣiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Conspicuous, powerful, widely spreading, unbent, unhurt, and straight-rushing,

children.text: juṣṭatamāso nṛtamāso añjibhir vy ānajre kecid usrā iva stṛbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: most pleasing and most manly, some have adorned themselves with ornaments like rays at dawn.

children.text: upahvareṣu yad acidhvaṃ yayiṃ vaya iva marutaḥ kenacit pathā
children.translated_text: When, in hidden places, O <s>Maruts</s>, you have marked out the traveler by some path, like birds,

children.text: ścotanti kośā upa vo ratheṣv ā ghṛtam ukṣatā madhuvarṇam arcate ||
children.translated_text: the vessels drip upon your chariots; sprinkle ghee, honey-colored, for the singer.

children.text: praiṣām ajmeṣu vithureva rejate bhūmir yāmeṣu yaddha yuñjate śubhe
children.translated_text: Before them, in their contests, the earth trembles like a scattered thing, when they yoke themselves for splendid courses.

children.text: te krīḍayo dhunayo bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ svayam mahitvam panayanta dhūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They are playful, shaking, bright-speared; the shaking ones themselves proclaim their greatness.

children.text: sa hi svasṛt pṛṣadaśvo yuvā gaṇo 'yā īśānas taviṣībhir āvṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: For this young troop, self-ruling, with dappled horses, is surrounded by powers and commands this way.

children.text: asi satya ṛṇayāvānedyo 'syā dhiyaḥ prāvitāthā vṛṣā gaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are true, debt-paying, and worthy of praise; you are the protector of this thought, and then a bull-like troop.

children.text: pituḥ pratnasya janmanā vadāmasi somasya jihvā pra jigāti cakṣasā
children.translated_text: By the birth of the ancient father we speak; the tongue of <s>Soma</s> goes forth with sight.

children.text: yad īm indraṃ śamy ṛkvāṇa āśatād in nāmāni yajñiyāni dadhire ||
children.translated_text: When the hymn-singers attained <s>Indra</s> in peace, then they assumed the worshipful names.

children.text: śriyase kam bhānubhiḥ sam mimikṣire te raśmibhis ta ṛkvabhiḥ sukhādayaḥ
children.translated_text: For beauty they mingled themselves with beams; with their rays and their hymns they were makers of ease.

children.text: te vāśīmanta iṣmiṇo abhīravo vidre priyasya mārutasya dhāmnaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those bearers of axes, impetuous and loudly roaring, have known the beloved domain of the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: Chapter 88
ā vidyunmadbhir marutaḥ svarkai rathebhir yāta ṛṣṭimadbhir aśvaparṇaiḥ
children.translated_text: Come, O <s>Maruts</s>, with lightning-flashing, radiant chariots, with spear-bearing steeds winged like birds.

children.text: ā varṣiṣṭhayā na iṣā vayo na paptatā sumāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Come to us with the most abundant refreshment; like birds, fly here, you of good powers.

children.text: te 'ruṇebhir varam ā piśaṅgaiḥ śubhe kaṃ yānti rathatūrbhir aśvaiḥ
children.translated_text: With tawny red and ruddy horses, strong as chariot-racers, they go toward beauty.

children.text: rukmo na citraḥ svadhitīvān pavyā rathasya jaṅghananta bhūma ||
children.translated_text: Like a shining gold ornament, furnished with a cleaver, the rim of the chariot pounds upon the earth.

children.text: śriye kaṃ vo adhi tanūṣu vāśīr medhā vanā na kṛṇavanta ūrdhvā
children.translated_text: For beauty, the axes are upon your bodies; like forests, the wise ones make them stand upright.

children.text: yuṣmabhyaṃ kam marutaḥ sujātās tuvidyumnāso dhanayante adrim ||
children.translated_text: For you, O well-born <s>Maruts</s>, the greatly shining ones split open the rock for treasure.

children.text: ahāni gṛdhrāḥ pary ā va āgur imāṃ dhiyaṃ vārkāryāṃ ca devīm
children.translated_text: The eager days have come around you, and this inspired thought, fit for praise, divine.

children.text: brahma kṛṇvanto gotamāso arkair ūrdhvaṃ nunudra utsadhim pibadhyai ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Gotamas</s>, making prayer with songs, have thrust the spring upward for drinking.

children.text: etat tyan na yojanam aceti sasvar ha yan maruto gotamo vaḥ
children.translated_text: That yoked course of yours has been noticed; he has sounded out, when <s>Gotama</s> saw you, O <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: paśyan hiraṇyacakrān ayodaṃṣṭrān vidhāvato varāhūn ||
children.translated_text: running like boars, with golden wheels and iron tusks.

children.text: eṣā syā vo maruto 'nubhartrī prati ṣṭobhati vāghato na vāṇī
children.translated_text: This attendant voice of yours, O <s>Maruts</s>, resounds in answer like the singer's speech.

children.text: astobhayad vṛthāsām anu svadhāṃ gabhastyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: It made sound after the unrestrained ones, according to their own law, within the two hands.

children.text: Chapter 89
ā no bhadrāḥ kratavo yantu viśvato 'dabdhāso aparītāsa udbhidaḥ
children.translated_text: May auspicious purposes come to us from every side, unharmed, undefeated, and breakthrough-bringing.

children.text: devā no yathā sadam id vṛdhe asann aprāyuvo rakṣitāro dive dive ||
children.translated_text: May the gods always be with us for increase, unfailing protectors day by day.

children.text: devānām bhadrā sumatir ṛjūyatāṃ devānāṃ rātir abhi no ni vartatām
children.translated_text: May the good favor of the gods, tending straight, come to us; may the gift of the gods turn toward us.

children.text: devānāṃ sakhyam upa sedimā vayaṃ devā na āyuḥ pra tirantu jīvase ||
children.translated_text: We would approach the friendship of the gods; may the gods extend our life so that we may live.

children.text: tān pūrvayā nividā hūmahe vayam bhagam mitram aditiṃ dakṣam asridham
children.translated_text: With the ancient invocation we call them: <s>Bhaga</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, and faultless <s>Dakṣa</s>,

children.text: aryamaṇaṃ varuṇaṃ somam aśvinā sarasvatī naḥ subhagā mayas karat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Soma</s>, the <s>Aśvins</s>; may fortunate <s>Sarasvatī</s> make happiness for us.

children.text: tan no vāto mayobhu vātu bheṣajaṃ tan mātā pṛthivī tat pitā dyauḥ
children.translated_text: May that wind blow healing and happiness for us; may mother earth and father heaven do the same.

children.text: tad grāvāṇaḥ somasuto mayobhuvas tad aśvinā śṛṇutaṃ dhiṣṇyā yuvam ||
children.translated_text: May the soma-pressed stones be happiness-bringing; O worthy young <s>Aśvins</s>, listen to that.

children.text: tam īśānaṃ jagatas tasthuṣas patiṃ dhiyañjinvam avase hūmahe vayam
children.translated_text: We call for aid that ruling lord of the moving and the standing, the master who quickens thought.

children.text: pūṣā no yathā vedasām asad vṛdhe rakṣitā pāyur adabdhaḥ svastaye ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Pūṣan</s> be the increaser of our wealth, an unharmed guardian and protector for well-being.

children.text: svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> of growing fame grant us well-being; may <s>Pūṣan</s>, who knows all, grant us well-being.

children.text: svasti nas tārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatir dadhātu ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Tārkṣya</s> of unbroken wheel grant us well-being; may <s>Bṛhaspati</s> grant us well-being.

children.text: pṛṣadaśvā marutaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ śubhaṃyāvāno vidatheṣu jagmayaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Maruts</s>, with speckled horses, sons of <s>Pṛśni</s>, going in splendor, have come to the assemblies.

children.text: agnijihvā manavaḥ sūracakṣaso viśve no devā avasā gamann iha ||
children.translated_text: Tongued with fire, mindful, sun-eyed, may all the gods come here to us with help.

children.text: bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadram paśyemākṣabhir yajatrāḥ
children.translated_text: May we hear what is auspicious with our ears, O gods; may we see what is auspicious with our eyes, O worshipful ones.

children.text: sthirair aṅgais tuṣṭuvāṃsas tanūbhir vy aśema devahitaṃ yad āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Praising you with firm limbs and bodies, may we pass through the life-span allotted by the gods.

children.text: śatam in nu śarado anti devā yatrā naś cakrā jarasaṃ tanūnām
children.translated_text: A hundred autumns are before us among the gods, where the aging of our bodies comes upon us.

children.text: putrāso yatra pitaro bhavanti mā no madhyā rīriṣatāyur gantoḥ ||
children.translated_text: Where sons become fathers, let our life not be cut off in the middle before reaching its course.

children.text: aditir dyaur aditir antarikṣam aditir mātā sa pitā sa putraḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Aditi</s> is heaven; <s>Aditi</s> is the midspace; <s>Aditi</s> is mother, father, and son.

children.text: viśve devā aditiḥ pañca janā aditir jātam aditir janitvam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Aditi</s> is all the gods and the five peoples; <s>Aditi</s> is what is born and the source of birth.

children.text: Chapter 90
ṛjunītī no varuṇo mitro nayatu vidvān
children.translated_text: May <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Mitra</s>, knowing the straight-guiding path, lead us.

children.text: aryamā devaiḥ sajoṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Aryaman</s> lead us, in harmony with the gods.

children.text: te hi vasvo vasavānās te apramūrā mahobhiḥ
children.translated_text: For they are possessors of goods, wealthy, and unconfounded in their greatness.

children.text: vratā rakṣante viśvāhā ||
children.translated_text: They guard the vows at all times.

children.text: te asmabhyaṃ śarma yaṃsann amṛtā martyebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: May those immortal ones extend shelter to us mortals,

children.text: bādhamānā apa dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: driving away hatreds from us.

children.text: vi naḥ pathaḥ suvitāya ciyantv indro marutaḥ
children.translated_text: May they mark out our paths for easy going: <s>Indra</s> and the <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: pūṣā bhago vandyāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pūṣan</s>, <s>Bhaga</s>, and the praiseworthy ones.

children.text: uta no dhiyo goagrāḥ pūṣan viṣṇav evayāvaḥ
children.translated_text: And may our thoughts, with cows in front, O <s>Pūṣan</s>, O <s>Viṣṇu</s>, O vigorous ones,

children.text: kartā naḥ svastimataḥ ||
children.translated_text: make us possessed of well-being.

children.text: madhu vātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ
children.translated_text: Sweetly may the winds blow for the follower of <s>ṛta</s>; sweetly may the rivers stream.

children.text: mādhvīr naḥ santv oṣadhīḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the plants be sweet for us.

children.text: madhu naktam utoṣaso madhumat pārthivaṃ rajaḥ
children.translated_text: Sweet be the night and the dawns; sweet be the earthly realm.

children.text: madhu dyaur astu naḥ pitā ||
children.translated_text: Sweet be father heaven for us.

children.text: madhumān no vanaspatir madhumāṁ astu sūryaḥ
children.translated_text: Sweet for us be the forest tree; sweet be the sun.
