children.text: mādhvīr gāvo bhavantu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the cows be sweet for us.

children.text: śaṃ no mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃ no bhavatv aryamā
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s> be favorable to us; may <s>Varuṇa</s> be favorable; may <s>Aryaman</s> be favorable to us.

children.text: śaṃ na indro bṛhaspatiḥ śaṃ no viṣṇur urukramaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> and <s>Bṛhaspati</s> be favorable to us; may wide-striding <s>Viṣṇu</s> be favorable to us.

children.text: Chapter 91
tvaṃ soma pra cikito manīṣā tvaṃ rajiṣṭham anu neṣi panthām
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Soma</s>, have clear understanding through insight; you lead along the straightest path.

children.text: tava praṇītī pitaro na indo deveṣu ratnam abhajanta dhīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: By your guidance, O drop, the wise fathers obtained treasure among the gods.

children.text: tvaṃ soma kratubhiḥ sukratur bhūs tvaṃ dakṣaiḥ sudakṣo viśvavedāḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Soma</s>, have become wise in purposes through wise powers; through skills you are highly skilled, all-knowing.

children.text: tvaṃ vṛṣā vṛṣatvebhir mahitvā dyumnebhir dyumny abhavo nṛcakṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are a bull through bull-like powers; by greatness and by splendors you have become splendid, seeing men.

children.text: rājño nu te varuṇasya vratāni bṛhad gabhīraṃ tava soma dhāma
children.translated_text: Now yours are the ordinances of king <s>Varuṇa</s>; great and deep is your domain, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: śuciṣ ṭvam asi priyo na mitro dakṣāyyo aryamevāsi soma ||
children.translated_text: You are pure, dear like <s>Mitra</s>; you are skillful like <s>Aryaman</s>, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: yā te dhāmāni divi yā pṛthivyāṃ yā parvateṣv oṣadhīṣv apsu
children.translated_text: Those domains of yours that are in heaven, on earth, in the mountains, in the plants, and in the waters,

children.text: tebhir no viśvaiḥ sumanā aheḍan rājan soma prati havyā gṛbhāya ||
children.translated_text: with all of them, well-minded and without anger toward us, O king <s>Soma</s>, receive our oblations.

children.text: tvaṃ somāsi satpatis tvaṃ rājota vṛtrahā
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Soma</s>, are the good lord; you are king and also the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: tvam bhadro asi kratuḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are a good power of resolve.

children.text: tvaṃ ca soma no vaśo jīvātuṃ na marāmahe
children.translated_text: And you, O <s>Soma</s>, are under our control for life, so that we may not die.

children.text: priyastotro vanaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Dear to praise, you are the lord of the forest.

children.text: tvaṃ soma mahe bhagaṃ tvaṃ yūna ṛtāyate
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Soma</s>, bestow great fortune; you bestow vigor on the young man who follows <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: dakṣaṃ dadhāsi jīvase ||
children.translated_text: You place skill in him, so that he may live.

children.text: tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvato rakṣā rājann aghāyataḥ
children.translated_text: Protect us from every side, O king <s>Soma</s>, from the wrongdoer.

children.text: na riṣyet tvāvataḥ sakhā ||
children.translated_text: May the friend who has you as helper not be harmed.

children.text: soma yās te mayobhuva ūtayaḥ santi dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, those aids of yours that bring happiness are for the worshipper.

children.text: tābhir no 'vitā bhava ||
children.translated_text: With them be our protector.

children.text: imaṃ yajñam idaṃ vaco jujuṣāṇa upāgahi
children.translated_text: Come near, taking pleasure in this sacrifice and this utterance;

children.text: soma tvaṃ no vṛdhe bhava ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, be for our increase.

children.text: soma gīrbhiṣ ṭvā vayaṃ vardhayāmo vacovidaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, we who know the word magnify you with songs;

children.text: sumṛḍīko na ā viśa ||
children.translated_text: enter us as one very gracious.

children.text: gayasphāno amīvahā vasuvit puṣṭivardhanaḥ
children.translated_text: Expanding life, driving away sickness, finding wealth, increasing nourishment,

children.text: sumitraḥ soma no bhava ||
children.translated_text: be our good friend, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: soma rārandhi no hṛdi gāvo na yavaseṣv ā
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, settle richly in our heart, like cows among pastures,

children.text: marya iva sva okye ||
children.translated_text: like a young man in his own home.

children.text: yaḥ soma sakhye tava rāraṇad deva martyaḥ
children.translated_text: O divine <s>Soma</s>, the mortal who delights in your friendship,

children.text: taṃ dakṣaḥ sacate kaviḥ ||
children.translated_text: skill and inspired insight attend him.

children.text: uruṣyā ṇo abhiśasteḥ soma ni pāhy aṃhasaḥ
children.translated_text: Protect us from imprecation, O <s>Soma</s>; guard us from distress.

children.text: sakhā suśeva edhi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Be our friend, easy to favor.

children.text: ā pyāyasva sam etu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam
children.translated_text: Swell full; let your virile power come together from every side, O <s>Soma</s>;

children.text: bhavā vājasya saṃgathe ||
children.translated_text: be present at the gathering of strength.

children.text: ā pyāyasva madintama soma viśvebhir aṃśubhiḥ
children.translated_text: Swell full, most exhilarating <s>Soma</s>, with all your shoots;

children.text: bhavā naḥ suśravastamaḥ sakhā vṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: be most famed for us, a friend for our growth.

children.text: saṃ te payāṃsi sam u yantu vājāḥ saṃ vṛṣṇyāny abhimātiṣāhaḥ
children.translated_text: Let your milks come together, and let strengths come together, and powers that overcome hostility;

children.text: āpyāyamāno amṛtāya soma divi śravāṃsy uttamāni dhiṣva ||
children.translated_text: as you swell, O <s>Soma</s>, for immortality, place the highest glories in heaven.

children.text: yā te dhāmāni haviṣā yajanti tā te viśvā paribhūr astu yajñam
children.translated_text: Those abodes of yours that they worship with oblation: may all of them, surrounding, encompass the sacrifice for you.

children.text: gayasphānaḥ prataraṇaḥ suvīro 'vīrahā pra carā soma duryān ||
children.translated_text: Expanding life, carrying across, rich in good heroes, not harming heroes, go forth through our houses, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: somo dhenuṃ somo arvantam āśuṃ somo vīraṃ karmaṇyaṃ dadāti
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> gives the milch-cow; <s>Soma</s> gives the swift horse; <s>Soma</s> gives the active hero,

children.text: sādanyaṃ vidathyaṃ sabheyam pitṛśravaṇaṃ yo dadāśad asmai ||
children.translated_text: fit to sit, fit for the assembly, fit for the council, bringing ancestral fame, to the one who worships him.

children.text: aṣāḍhaṃ yutsu pṛtanāsu papriṃ svarṣām apsāṃ vṛjanasya gopām
children.translated_text: Unconquered in battles and conflicts, filling, winning the sun, guardian of waters and of the enclosure,

children.text: bhareṣujāṃ sukṣitiṃ suśravasaṃ jayantaṃ tvām anu madema soma ||
children.translated_text: born in contests, dwelling well, famed, victorious: after you may we rejoice, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: tvam imā oṣadhīḥ soma viśvās tvam apo ajanayas tvaṃ gāḥ
children.translated_text: You generated all these plants, O <s>Soma</s>; you generated the waters and the cows;

children.text: tvam ā tatanthorv antarikṣaṃ tvaṃ jyotiṣā vi tamo vavartha ||
children.translated_text: you stretched out the wide midspace; you uncovered the darkness with light.

children.text: devena no manasā deva soma rāyo bhāgaṃ sahasāvann abhi yudhya
children.translated_text: With divine mind, O god <s>Soma</s>, win for us the share of wealth, O powerful one;

children.text: mā tvā tanad īśiṣe vīryasyobhayebhyaḥ pra cikitsā gaviṣṭau ||
children.translated_text: let no one stretch you away from command of strength; make us known to both sides in the quest for cows.

children.text: Chapter 92
etā u tyā uṣasaḥ ketum akrata pūrve ardhe rajaso bhānum añjate
children.translated_text: These dawns have made their signal; in the former half of the realm they adorn their brightness.

children.text: niṣkṛṇvānā āyudhānīva dhṛṣṇavaḥ prati gāvo 'ruṣīr yanti mātaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like bold warriors making ready their weapons, the ruddy mother-cows go forth.

children.text: ud apaptann aruṇā bhānavo vṛthā svāyujo aruṣīr gā ayukṣata
children.translated_text: The red beams have flown up freely; the ruddy cows, self-yoked, have been yoked.

children.text: akrann uṣāso vayunāni pūrvathā ruśantam bhānum aruṣīr aśiśrayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The dawns have performed their wonted courses as before; the ruddy ones have rested on the shining brightness.

children.text: arcanti nārīr apaso na viṣṭibhiḥ samānena yojanenā parāvataḥ
children.translated_text: Like women at work with their services, they shine forth from afar by a common yoking,

children.text: iṣaṃ vahantīḥ sukṛte sudānave viśved aha yajamānāya sunvate ||
children.translated_text: bearing refreshment to the good worker, the generous giver, to every sacrificer who presses soma.

children.text: adhi peśāṃsi vapate nṛtūr ivāporṇute vakṣa usreva barjaham
children.translated_text: She puts on ornaments like a dancer; she uncovers her breast like a cow its udder.

children.text: jyotir viśvasmai bhuvanāya kṛṇvatī gāvo na vrajaṃ vy uṣā āvar tamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Making light for the whole world, <s>Uṣas</s> opens the darkness like cows opening their stall.

children.text: praty arcī ruśad asyā adarśi vi tiṣṭhate bādhate kṛṣṇam abhvam
children.translated_text: Her gleaming ray has appeared facing us; she stands apart and drives away the black abomination.

children.text: svaruṃ na peśo vidatheṣv añjañcitraṃ divo duhitā bhānum aśret ||
children.translated_text: Like an adornment at the rites, the daughter of heaven has anointed her bright form and rested upon the wondrous light.

children.text: atāriṣma tamasas pāram asyoṣā ucchantī vayunā kṛṇoti
children.translated_text: We have crossed beyond this darkness; <s>Uṣas</s>, shining forth, makes clear the paths.

children.text: śriye chando na smayate vibhātī supratīkā saumanasāyājīgaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Gleaming for beauty like a hymn, fair-faced, she has awakened for good-mindedness.

children.text: bhāsvatī netrī sūnṛtānāṃ diva stave duhitā gotamebhiḥ
children.translated_text: Radiant leader of true words, daughter of heaven, you are praised by the <s>Gotamas</s>.

children.text: prajāvato nṛvato aśvabudhyān uṣo goagrāṁ upa māsi vājān ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, bring near to me rewards rich in offspring, rich in men, awakening horses, with cows in front.

children.text: uṣas tam aśyāṃ yaśasaṃ suvīraṃ dāsapravargaṃ rayim aśvabudhyam
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, may I obtain that famous wealth, rich in good heroes, driving away the Dāsas, awakening horses,

children.text: sudaṃsasā śravasā yā vibhāsi vājaprasūtā subhage bṛhantam ||
children.translated_text: the great wealth with good power and renown, which you make shine forth, O fortunate one, impelled by strength.

children.text: viśvāni devī bhuvanābhicakṣyā pratīcī cakṣur urviyā vi bhāti
children.translated_text: O goddess, looking upon all beings, facing us, you shine widely as an eye.

children.text: viśvaṃ jīvaṃ carase bodhayantī viśvasya vācam avidan manāyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: Awakening every living thing to motion, you have found the speech of every thoughtful one.

children.text: punaḥ punar jāyamānā purāṇī samānaṃ varṇam abhi śumbhamānā
children.translated_text: Born again and again, ancient, adorning the same color,

children.text: śvaghnīva kṛtnur vija āminānā martasya devī jarayanty āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: like a skilled hunter cutting down the birds, the goddess makes the life of the mortal grow old.

children.text: vyūrṇvatī divo antāṁ abodhy apa svasāraṃ sanutar yuyoti
children.translated_text: Uncovering the ends of heaven, she has awakened; she drives her sister far away.

children.text: praminatī manuṣyā yugāni yoṣā jārasya cakṣasā vi bhāti ||
children.translated_text: Shortening the ages of human beings, the young woman shines with the gaze of her lover.

children.text: paśūn na citrā subhagā prathānā sindhur na kṣoda urviyā vy aśvait
children.translated_text: Bright and fortunate, spreading like cattle, she has shone widely like the flood of a river,

children.text: aminatī daivyāni vratāni sūryasya ceti raśmibhir dṛśānā ||
children.translated_text: not violating the divine ordinances, becoming visible by the rays of the sun.

children.text: uṣas tac citram ā bharāsmabhyaṃ vājinīvati
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, rich in prizes, bring that wondrous thing to us,

children.text: yena tokaṃ ca tanayaṃ ca dhāmahe ||
children.translated_text: by which we may establish both child and descendant.

children.text: uṣo adyeha gomaty aśvāvati vibhāvari
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, today, here, rich in cows, rich in horses, brightly shining,

children.text: revad asme vy uccha sūnṛtāvati ||
children.translated_text: dawn upon us with wealth and with true words.

children.text: yukṣvā hi vājinīvaty aśvāṁ adyāruṇāṁ uṣaḥ
children.translated_text: For, O prize-rich <s>Uṣas</s>, yoke today your ruddy horses;

children.text: athā no viśvā saubhagāny ā vaha ||
children.translated_text: then bring all blessings to us.

children.text: aśvinā vartir asmad ā gomad dasrā hiraṇyavat
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, O wondrous ones, turn your path toward us, rich in cows and golden;

children.text: arvāg rathaṃ samanasā ni yacchatam ||
children.translated_text: drive your chariot hither with one mind.

children.text: yāv itthā ślokam ā divo jyotir janāya cakrathuḥ
children.translated_text: You two who in this way made a hymn and light from heaven for humankind,

children.text: ā na ūrjaṃ vahatam aśvinā yuvam ||
children.translated_text: bring nourishment to us, O young <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: eha devā mayobhuvā dasrā hiraṇyavartanī
children.translated_text: Come here, divine givers of joy, wondrous ones with golden tracks;

children.text: uṣarbudho vahantu somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: let the awakeners of dawn carry you for the drinking of soma.

children.text: Chapter 93
agnīṣomāv imaṃ su me śṛṇutaṃ vṛṣaṇā havam
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni-Soma</s>, two bulls, listen well to this call of mine;

children.text: prati sūktāni haryatam bhavataṃ dāśuṣe mayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: take pleasure in the hymns; be happiness for the worshipper.

children.text: agnīṣomā yo adya vām idaṃ vacaḥ saparyati
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni-Soma</s>, for the one who today honors this utterance addressed to you,

children.text: tasmai dhattaṃ suvīryaṃ gavām poṣaṃ svaśvyam ||
children.translated_text: grant him good heroic strength, increase of cows, and excellent horses.

children.text: agnīṣomā ya āhutiṃ yo vāṃ dāśāddhaviṣkṛtim
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni-Soma</s>, whoever offers an oblation, whoever gives you the prepared offering,

children.text: sa prajayā suvīryaṃ viśvam āyur vy aśnavat ||
children.translated_text: he shall attain, with offspring and good heroic strength, the whole span of life.

children.text: agnīṣomā ceti tad vīryaṃ vāṃ yad amuṣṇītam avasam paṇiṃ gāḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, this was your heroic deed: you stole the cows, the sustenance, away from <s>Paṇi</s>.

children.text: avātiratam bṛsayasya śeṣo 'vindataṃ jyotir ekam bahubhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You carried off what was left of <s>Bṛsaya</s>; you found the one light for the many.

children.text: yuvam etāni divi rocanāny agniś ca soma sakratū adhattam
children.translated_text: You two, <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, of one resolve, set these shining lights in heaven.

children.text: yuvaṃ sindhūṃr abhiśaster avadyād agnīṣomāv amuñcataṃ gṛbhītān ||
children.translated_text: You, <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, released the rivers that had been seized, from curse and disgrace.

children.text: ānyaṃ divo mātariśvā jabhārāmathnād anyam pari śyeno adreḥ
children.translated_text: One of you <s>Mātariśvan</s> brought from heaven; the eagle churned the other out from the rock.

children.text: agnīṣomā brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānoruṃ yajñāya cakrathur u lokam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, strengthened by sacred utterance, you made a broad space for the sacrifice.

children.text: agnīṣomā haviṣaḥ prasthitasya vītaṃ haryataṃ vṛṣaṇā juṣethām
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, come to the oblation that has been set forth; delight in it, long for it, O bulls, and accept it.

children.text: suśarmāṇā svavasā hi bhūtam athā dhattaṃ yajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ ||
children.translated_text: For you are of good shelter and good aid; then bestow blessing and welfare upon the sacrificer.

children.text: yo agnīṣomā haviṣā saparyād devadrīcā manasā yo ghṛtena
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, whoever worships you with oblation, with a mind turned toward the gods, and with ghee,

children.text: tasya vrataṃ rakṣatam pātam aṃhaso viśe janāya mahi śarma yacchatam ||
children.translated_text: guard his vow; protect him from distress, and grant great shelter to the people and the clan.

children.text: agnīṣomā savedasā sahūtī vanataṃ giraḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, knowing together and invoked together, win our songs.

children.text: saṃ devatrā babhūvathuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Together you two have come into being among the gods.

children.text: agnīṣomāv anena vāṃ yo vāṃ ghṛtena dāśati
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, whoever worships you two with this offering, or with ghee,

children.text: tasmai dīdayatam bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: for him make a great light shine.

children.text: agnīṣomāv imāni no yuvaṃ havyā jujoṣatam
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, may you two gladly accept these oblations of ours.

children.text: ā yātam upa naḥ sacā ||
children.translated_text: Come here to us together.

children.text: agnīṣomā pipṛtam arvato na ā pyāyantām usriyā havyasūdaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, fill up our horses; let the milch cows, pourers of oblation, swell with plenty.

children.text: asme balāni maghavatsu dhattaṃ kṛṇutaṃ no adhvaraṃ śruṣṭimantam ||
children.translated_text: Place strengths among us, among the generous; make our rite attentive and well heard.

children.text: Chapter 94
imaṃ stomam arhate jātavedase ratham iva sam mahemā manīṣayā
children.translated_text: This praise for worthy <s>Jātavedas</s> we would fashion with thought, as one fashions a chariot.

children.text: bhadrā hi naḥ pramatir asya saṃsady agne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
children.translated_text: For his favor is auspicious for us in the assembly; O <s>Agni</s>, may we not suffer harm in your friendship.

children.text: yasmai tvam āyajase sa sādhaty anarvā kṣeti dadhate suvīryam
children.translated_text: The one for whom you sacrifice succeeds; unopposed he dwells and obtains heroic strength.

children.text: sa tūtāva nainam aśnoty aṃhatir agne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
children.translated_text: He grows strong, and distress does not reach him; O <s>Agni</s>, may we not suffer harm in your friendship.

children.text: śakema tvā samidhaṃ sādhayā dhiyas tve devā havir adanty āhutam
children.translated_text: May we be able to kindle you; direct our thoughts, for in you the gods eat the offered oblation.

children.text: tvam ādityāṁ ā vaha tān hy uśmasy agne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
children.translated_text: Bring here the <s>Ādityas</s>; for we desire them. O <s>Agni</s>, may we not suffer harm in your friendship.

children.text: bharāmedhmaṃ kṛṇavāmā havīṃṣi te citayantaḥ parvaṇā parvaṇā vayam
children.translated_text: Let us bring fuel; let us make offerings for you, attending carefully at each appointed season.

children.text: jīvātave prataraṃ sādhayā dhiyo 'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
children.translated_text: Guide our thoughts further, toward life; O <s>Agni</s>, may we not suffer harm in your friendship.

children.text: viśāṃ gopā asya caranti jantavo dvipac ca yad uta catuṣpad aktubhiḥ
children.translated_text: Creatures move as this guardian of peoples, both two-footed and four-footed, through the nights.

children.text: citraḥ praketa uṣaso mahāṁ asy agne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
children.translated_text: Bright is his sign, great at the dawns; O <s>Agni</s>, may we not suffer harm in your friendship.

children.text: tvam adhvaryur uta hotāsi pūrvyaḥ praśāstā potā januṣā purohitaḥ
children.translated_text: You are the ancient <s>adhvaryu</s> and also the <s>hotṛ</s>, the director, the purifier, priest by birth.

children.text: viśvā vidvāṁ ārtvijyā dhīra puṣyasy agne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
children.translated_text: Wise one, knowing all priestly offices, you sustain them; O <s>Agni</s>, may we not suffer harm in your friendship.

children.text: yo viśvataḥ supratīkaḥ sadṛṅṅ asi dūre cit san taḍid ivāti rocase
children.translated_text: You are fair-faced on every side, looking alike everywhere; even from afar you shine beyond like lightning.

children.text: rātryāś cid andho ati deva paśyasy agne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
children.translated_text: Even through the darkness of night, O god, you see; O <s>Agni</s>, may we not suffer harm in your friendship.

children.text: pūrvo devā bhavatu sunvato ratho 'smākaṃ śaṃso abhy astu dūḍhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the chariot of the pressing worshipper be foremost among the gods; let our praise prevail over the hostile man.

children.text: tad ā jānītota puṣyatā vaco 'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
children.translated_text: Know this, and strengthen our word; O <s>Agni</s>, may we not suffer harm in your friendship.

children.text: vadhair duḥśaṃsāṁ apa dūḍhyo jahi dūre vā ye anti vā kecid atriṇaḥ
children.translated_text: With your weapons strike away evil-speakers and hostile men, whether far away or near, whoever the devourers are.

children.text: athā yajñāya gṛṇate sugaṃ kṛdhy agne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
children.translated_text: Then make an easy path for the sacrifice and for the singer; O <s>Agni</s>, may we not suffer harm in your friendship.

children.text: yad ayukthā aruṣā rohitā rathe vātajūtā vṛṣabhasyeva te ravaḥ
children.translated_text: When you have yoked the ruddy and red horses to the chariot, wind-driven, your roar is like that of a bull.

children.text: ād invasi vanino dhūmaketunāgne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
children.translated_text: Then with your smoke-banner you advance upon the trees; O <s>Agni</s>, may we not suffer harm in your friendship.

children.text: adha svanād uta bibhyuḥ patatriṇo drapsā yat te yavasādo vy asthiran
children.translated_text: Then at your sound even the birds are frightened, when the drops of you, grass-eating, have scattered apart.

children.text: sugaṃ tat te tāvakebhyo rathebhyo 'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
children.translated_text: May there be an easy path for your own chariots; O <s>Agni</s>, may we not suffer harm in your friendship.

children.text: ayam mitrasya varuṇasya dhāyase 'vayātām marutāṃ heḍo adbhutaḥ
children.translated_text: This wondrous one is set for the support of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; let him turn away the anger of the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: mṛḍā su no bhūtv eṣām manaḥ punar agne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
children.translated_text: Be gracious to us, and let their mind turn back to favor; O <s>Agni</s>, may we not suffer harm in your friendship.

children.text: devo devānām asi mitro adbhuto vasur vasūnām asi cārur adhvare
children.translated_text: You are the god, the wondrous <s>Mitra</s> of the gods; you are the wealth of the wealthy, lovely in the rite.

children.text: śarman syāma tava saprathastame 'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
children.translated_text: May we be in your widest shelter; O <s>Agni</s>, may we not suffer harm in your friendship.

children.text: tat te bhadraṃ yat samiddhaḥ sve dame somāhuto jarase mṛḍayattamaḥ
children.translated_text: This is your blessed power: when kindled in your own house, invoked with <s>Soma</s>, you grow old as most gracious.

children.text: dadhāsi ratnaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dāśuṣe 'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
children.translated_text: You set treasure and wealth for the worshipper; O <s>Agni</s>, may we not suffer harm in your friendship.

children.text: yasmai tvaṃ sudraviṇo dadāśo 'nāgāstvam adite sarvatātā
children.translated_text: For the one to whom you, rich in good wealth, give, there is guiltlessness, O <s>Aditi</s>, in every way.

children.text: yam bhadreṇa śavasā codayāsi prajāvatā rādhasā te syāma ||
children.translated_text: The one whom you impel with auspicious might, with reward rich in offspring: may we belong to that bounty of yours.

children.text: sa tvam agne saubhagatvasya vidvān asmākam āyuḥ pra tireha deva
children.translated_text: So you, O <s>Agni</s>, knowing prosperity, extend our lifetime here, O god.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, the river, earth, and heaven make that great for us.

children.text: Chapter 95
dve virūpe carataḥ svarthe anyānyā vatsam upa dhāpayete
children.translated_text: Two beings of different form move for their own purpose; each in turn suckles the calf.

children.text: harir anyasyām bhavati svadhāvāñchukro anyasyāṃ dadṛśe suvarcāḥ ||
children.translated_text: In one of them the tawny one becomes self-powered; in the other the bright one appears, radiant.

children.text: daśemaṃ tvaṣṭur janayanta garbham atandrāso yuvatayo vibhṛtram
children.translated_text: Ten tireless young women generate this embryo of <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, the one to be borne in different ways.

children.text: tigmānīkaṃ svayaśasaṃ janeṣu virocamānam pari ṣīṃ nayanti ||
children.translated_text: They lead him around among people, sharp-faced, self-renowned, and shining forth.

children.text: trīṇi jānā pari bhūṣanty asya samudra ekaṃ divy ekam apsu
children.translated_text: Three births adorn him all around: one in the ocean, one in heaven, and one in the waters.

children.text: pūrvām anu pra diśam pārthivānām ṛtūn praśāsad vi dadhāv anuṣṭhu ||
children.translated_text: Following the eastern direction of earthly beings, he has run forth, governing the seasons in proper order.

children.text: ka imaṃ vo niṇyam ā ciketa vatso mātṝr janayata svadhābhiḥ
children.translated_text: Who among you has perceived this secret? The calf has generated his mothers by his own powers.

children.text: bahvīnāṃ garbho apasām upasthān mahān kavir niś carati svadhāvān ||
children.translated_text: As the embryo of many waters, in the lap of the waters, the great inspired one moves out, self-powered.

children.text: āviṣṭyo vardhate cārur āsu jihmānām ūrdhvaḥ svayaśā upasthe
children.translated_text: He grows fair among these kindlings, entering them; upright among the crooked, self-renowned in their lap.

children.text: ubhe tvaṣṭur bibhyatur jāyamānāt pratīcī siṃham prati joṣayete ||
children.translated_text: Both were afraid of him as he was being born from <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>; turning toward him, they welcome the lion.

children.text: ubhe bhadre joṣayete na mene gāvo na vāśrā upa tasthur evaiḥ
children.translated_text: Both gracious ones delight in him, not rejecting him; like lowing cows, they have stood near with their approaches.

children.text: sa dakṣāṇāṃ dakṣapatir babhūvāñjanti yaṃ dakṣiṇato havirbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: He has become the lord of skill among the skillful, whom they worship from the south with oblations.

children.text: ud yaṃyamīti saviteva bāhū ubhe sicau yatate bhīma ṛñjan
children.translated_text: He lifts up both arms like <s>Savitṛ</s>; terrible, he stretches out both ladles, gleaming as he moves.

children.text: ucchukram atkam ajate simasmān navā mātṛbhyo vasanā jahāti ||
children.translated_text: He drives his bright garment upward from all around; born anew, he leaves his old coverings to the mothers.

children.text: tveṣaṃ rūpaṃ kṛṇuta uttaraṃ yat saṃpṛñcānaḥ sadane gobhir adbhiḥ
children.translated_text: He makes his form blazing, that higher form, as he mingles in his seat with cows and waters.

children.text: kavir budhnam pari marmṛjyate dhīḥ sā devatātā samitir babhūva ||
children.translated_text: The inspired poet wipes clean the depth; the sacred thought has become an assembly for divine worship.

children.text: uru te jrayaḥ pary eti budhnaṃ virocamānam mahiṣasya dhāma
children.translated_text: Your wide course goes around the base, the shining station of the mighty one.

children.text: viśvebhir agne svayaśobhir iddho 'dabdhebhiḥ pāyubhiḥ pāhy asmān ||
children.translated_text: Kindled with all your self-renowned and uninjured guardians, O <s>Agni</s>, protect us.

children.text: dhanvan srotaḥ kṛṇute gātum ūrmiṃ śukrair ūrmibhir abhi nakṣati kṣām
children.translated_text: In the dry land he makes a stream, a path, a wave; with bright waves he reaches the earth.

children.text: viśvā sanāni jaṭhareṣu dhatte 'ntar navāsu carati prasūṣu ||
children.translated_text: He holds all ancient treasures in his bellies; within the new mothers he moves among the births.

children.text: evā no agne samidhā vṛdhāno revat pāvaka śravase vi bhāhi
children.translated_text: So, O <s>Agni</s>, growing through the fuel, O purifying one, shine splendidly for our fame.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Sindhu</s>, <s>Pṛthivī</s>, and <s>Dyauḥ</s> not harm that for us.

children.text: Chapter 96
sa pratnathā sahasā jāyamānaḥ sadyaḥ kāvyāni baḍ adhatta viśvā
children.translated_text: Born at once with ancient force, he immediately established all poetic inspirations.

children.text: āpaś ca mitraṃ dhiṣaṇā ca sādhan devā agniṃ dhārayan draviṇodām ||
children.translated_text: The waters, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Dhiṣaṇā</s> brought him to fulfillment; the gods upheld <s>Agni</s>, giver of wealth.

children.text: sa pūrvayā nividā kavyatāyor imāḥ prajā ajanayan manūnām
children.translated_text: By the former invitation, for the two poetic seers, he generated these peoples of the Manus.

children.text: vivasvatā cakṣasā dyām apaś ca devā agniṃ dhārayan draviṇodām ||
children.translated_text: With the eye of <s>Vivasvat</s> he generated heaven and the waters; the gods upheld <s>Agni</s>, giver of wealth.

children.text: tam īḍata prathamaṃ yajñasādhaṃ viśa ārīr āhutam ṛñjasānam
children.translated_text: Praise him, the first accomplisher of sacrifice, the clans' invited one, made radiant by the offering.

children.text: ūrjaḥ putram bharataṃ sṛpradānuṃ devā agniṃ dhārayan draviṇodām ||
children.translated_text: The son of strength, Bharata, liberal in gifts: the gods upheld <s>Agni</s>, giver of wealth.

children.text: sa mātariśvā puruvārapuṣṭir vidad gātuṃ tanayāya svarvit
children.translated_text: That <s>Mātariśvan</s>, nourished by many favors, found a path for the son, rich in sunlight.

children.text: viśāṃ gopā janitā rodasyor devā agniṃ dhārayan draviṇodām ||
children.translated_text: Guardian of the peoples, generator of heaven and earth: the gods upheld <s>Agni</s>, giver of wealth.

children.text: naktoṣāsā varṇam āmemyāne dhāpayete śiśum ekaṃ samīcī
children.translated_text: Night and Dawn, taking on their colors, together suckle the one child in harmony.

children.text: dyāvākṣāmā rukmo antar vi bhāti devā agniṃ dhārayan draviṇodām ||
children.translated_text: The golden ornament shines out between heaven and earth; the gods upheld <s>Agni</s>, giver of wealth.

children.text: rāyo budhnaḥ saṃgamano vasūnāṃ yajñasya ketur manmasādhano veḥ
children.translated_text: He is the foundation of wealth, the gathering-place of goods, the banner of sacrifice, accomplishing thought and desire.

children.text: amṛtatvaṃ rakṣamāṇāsa enaṃ devā agniṃ dhārayan draviṇodām ||
children.translated_text: Guarding immortality for him, the gods upheld <s>Agni</s>, giver of wealth.

children.text: nū ca purā ca sadanaṃ rayīṇāṃ jātasya ca jāyamānasya ca kṣām
children.translated_text: Now and formerly he is the seat of riches, the ground of what has been born and what is being born.

children.text: sataś ca gopām bhavataś ca bhūrer devā agniṃ dhārayan draviṇodām ||
children.translated_text: Guardian of what exists and of what is becoming abundant: the gods upheld <s>Agni</s>, giver of wealth.

children.text: draviṇodā draviṇasas turasya draviṇodāḥ sanarasya pra yaṃsat
children.translated_text: May the wealth-giver grant the wealth of the swift one; may the wealth-giver bestow the wealth of the noble man.

children.text: draviṇodā vīravatīm iṣaṃ no draviṇodā rāsate dīrgham āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the wealth-giver give us heroic nourishment; may the wealth-giver bestow long life.

children.text: evā no agne samidhā vṛdhāno revat pāvaka śravase vi bhāhi
children.translated_text: So, O <s>Agni</s>, growing through the fuel, O purifying one, shine splendidly for our fame.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Sindhu</s>, <s>Pṛthivī</s>, and <s>Dyauḥ</s> not harm that for us.

children.text: Chapter 97
apa naḥ śośucad agham agne śuśugdhy ā rayim
children.translated_text: Let our sin burn away, O <s>Agni</s>; shine wealth toward us.

children.text: apa naḥ śośucad agham ||
children.translated_text: Let our sin burn away from us.

children.text: sukṣetriyā sugātuyā vasūyā ca yajāmahe
children.translated_text: We sacrifice for good fields, good paths, and the winning of goods.

children.text: apa naḥ śośucad agham ||
children.translated_text: Let our sin burn away from us.

children.text: pra yad bhandiṣṭha eṣām prāsmākāsaś ca sūrayaḥ
children.translated_text: When the best praisers among them advance, and our patrons advance as well,

children.text: apa naḥ śośucad agham ||
children.translated_text: let our sin burn away from us.

children.text: pra yat te agne sūrayo jāyemahi pra te vayam
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Agni</s>, we may be born as your patrons, and we ourselves go forward for you,

children.text: apa naḥ śośucad agham ||
children.translated_text: let our sin burn away from us.

children.text: pra yad agneḥ sahasvato viśvato yanti bhānavaḥ
children.translated_text: When the rays of mighty <s>Agni</s> go forth on every side,

children.text: apa naḥ śośucad agham ||
children.translated_text: let our sin burn away from us.

children.text: tvaṃ hi viśvatomukha viśvataḥ paribhūr asi
children.translated_text: For you, facing all directions, surround everything on every side.

children.text: apa naḥ śośucad agham ||
children.translated_text: Let our sin burn away from us.

children.text: dviṣo no viśvatomukhāti nāveva pāraya
children.translated_text: Facing all directions, carry us beyond hatred, as in a boat.

children.text: apa naḥ śośucad agham ||
children.translated_text: Let our sin burn away from us.

children.text: sa naḥ sindhum iva nāvayāti parṣā svastaye
children.translated_text: May he ferry us across as across a river, with a boat, for well-being.

children.text: apa naḥ śośucad agham ||
children.translated_text: Let our sin burn away from us.

children.text: Chapter 98
vaiśvānarasya sumatau syāma rājā hi kam bhuvanānām abhiśrīḥ
children.translated_text: May we be in the good favor of <s>Vaiśvānara</s>; for he is king, the splendor over beings.

children.text: ito jāto viśvam idaṃ vi caṣṭe vaiśvānaro yatate sūryeṇa ||
children.translated_text: Born from here, <s>Vaiśvānara</s> looks out over all this; he strives together with the sun.

children.text: pṛṣṭo divi pṛṣṭo agniḥ pṛthivyām pṛṣṭo viśvā oṣadhīr ā viveśa
children.translated_text: Praised in heaven, praised on earth, <s>Agni</s> has entered all the plants.

children.text: vaiśvānaraḥ sahasā pṛṣṭo agniḥ sa no divā sa riṣaḥ pātu naktam ||
children.translated_text: Praised with power, <s>Vaiśvānara Agni</s> shall protect us by day and from harm by night.

children.text: vaiśvānara tava tat satyam astv asmān rāyo maghavānaḥ sacantām
children.translated_text: O <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, let that truth of yours be real; may generous givers attach themselves to us with riches.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Sindhu</s>, <s>Pṛthivī</s>, and <s>Dyauḥ</s> not harm that for us.

children.text: Chapter 99
jātavedase sunavāma somam arātīyato ni dahāti vedaḥ
children.translated_text: For <s>Jātavedas</s> we press <s>Soma</s>; may the knowing one burn down what is hostile.

children.text: sa naḥ parṣad ati durgāṇi viśvā nāveva sindhuṃ duritāty agniḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s> carry us across all difficult passages, beyond misfortune, as a boat carries one across a river.

children.text: Chapter 100
sa yo vṛṣā vṛṣṇyebhiḥ samokā maho divaḥ pṛthivyāś ca samrāṭ
children.translated_text: He who, a bull with bullish powers, dwells together, the sovereign of great heaven and earth,

children.text: satīnasatvā havyo bhareṣu marutvān no bhavatv indra ūtī ||
children.translated_text: called upon in battles by the true and the untrue alike: may <s>Indra</s> with the <s>Maruts</s> be ours for aid.

children.text: yasyānāptaḥ sūryasyeva yāmo bhare bhare vṛtrahā śuṣmo asti
children.translated_text: Whose irresistible course is like the sun's, whose strength as <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer exists in every battle,

children.text: vṛṣantamaḥ sakhibhiḥ svebhir evair marutvān no bhavatv indra ūtī ||
children.translated_text: most bull-like with his own companions and approaches: may <s>Indra</s> with the <s>Maruts</s> be ours for aid.

children.text: divo na yasya retaso dughānāḥ panthāso yanti śavasāparītāḥ
children.translated_text: Whose paths, like milkers of heaven's seed, go forth, driven on by might,

children.text: taraddveṣāḥ sāsahiḥ pauṃsyebhir marutvān no bhavatv indra ūtī ||
children.translated_text: overcoming hatred, overpowering through manly powers: may <s>Indra</s> with the <s>Maruts</s> be ours for aid.

children.text: so aṅgirobhir aṅgirastamo bhūd vṛṣā vṛṣabhiḥ sakhibhiḥ sakhā san
children.translated_text: He became the most <s>Aṅgiras</s>-like with the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, a bull with bulls, being a friend with friends.

children.text: ṛgmibhir ṛgmī gātubhir jyeṣṭho marutvān no bhavatv indra ūtī ||
children.translated_text: A hymn-singer with hymn-singers, chief through paths of song: may <s>Indra</s> with the <s>Maruts</s> be ours for aid.

children.text: sa sūnubhir na rudrebhir ṛbhvā nṛṣāhye sāsahvāṁ amitrān
children.translated_text: May he, like a mighty one with his sons, with the <s>Rudras</s>, overcoming hostile men,

children.text: sanīﾱebhiḥ śravasyāni tūrvan marutvān no bhavatv indra ūtī ||
children.translated_text: winning fame with his own bands, O <s>Indra</s> accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, be ours with aid.

children.text: sa manyumīḥ samadanasya kartāsmākebhir nṛbhiḥ sūryaṃ sanat
children.translated_text: He is the maker of inspired wrath in the battle; with our men may he win the sun.

children.text: asminn ahan satpatiḥ puruhūto marutvān no bhavatv indra ūtī ||
children.translated_text: On this day, the good lord, much-invoked, O <s>Indra</s> accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, be ours with aid.

children.text: tam ūtayo raṇayañchūrasātau taṃ kṣemasya kṣitayaḥ kṛṇvata trām
children.translated_text: The aids rouse him in the contest for heroes; the dwellings make him guardian of security.

children.text: sa viśvasya karuṇasyeśa eko marutvān no bhavatv indra ūtī ||
children.translated_text: He alone is lord of all active power; O <s>Indra</s> accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, be ours with aid.

children.text: tam apsanta śavasa utsaveṣu naro naram avase taṃ dhanāya
children.translated_text: Men seek him at the stirrings of strength, the man for help, him for wealth.

children.text: so andhe cit tamasi jyotir vidan marutvān no bhavatv indra ūtī ||
children.translated_text: He found light even in blind darkness; O <s>Indra</s> accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, be ours with aid.

children.text: sa savyena yamati vrādhataś cit sa dakṣiṇe saṃgṛbhītā kṛtāni
children.translated_text: With his left hand he restrains even the swelling enemy; in his right hand the deeds are firmly grasped.

children.text: sa kīriṇā cit sanitā dhanāni marutvān no bhavatv indra ūtī ||
children.translated_text: Even by the singer he is the winner of riches; O <s>Indra</s> accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, be ours with aid.

children.text: sa grāmebhiḥ sanitā sa rathebhir vide viśvābhiḥ kṛṣṭibhir nv adya
children.translated_text: With villages he is a winner, and with chariots; today he is known by all peoples.

children.text: sa pauṃsyebhir abhibhūr aśastīr marutvān no bhavatv indra ūtī ||
children.translated_text: With manly powers he overcomes hostile utterances; O <s>Indra</s> accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, be ours with aid.

children.text: sa jāmibhir yat samajāti mīḍhe 'jāmibhir vā puruhūta evaiḥ
children.translated_text: When he contends in the prize with kinsmen, or with non-kinsmen, the much-invoked one with his advances,

children.text: apāṃ tokasya tanayasya jeṣe marutvān no bhavatv indra ūtī ||
children.translated_text: he prevails for the waters, for offspring, and for descendants; O <s>Indra</s> accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, be ours with aid.

children.text: sa vajrabhṛd dasyuhā bhīma ugraḥ sahasracetāḥ śatanītha ṛbhvā
children.translated_text: He bears the thunderbolt, slays the <s>Dasyu</s>, terrible, fierce, thousand-minded, leading a hundred hosts, powerful.

children.text: camrīṣo na śavasā pāñcajanyo marutvān no bhavatv indra ūtī ||
children.translated_text: Like a <s>Pāñcajanya</s> bull in strength, O <s>Indra</s> accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, be ours with aid.

children.text: tasya vajraḥ krandati smat svarṣā divo na tveṣo ravathaḥ śimīvān
children.translated_text: His thunderbolt roars, winning heaven, like the glaring, thundering crash of heaven, rich in force.

children.text: taṃ sacante sanayas taṃ dhanāni marutvān no bhavatv indra ūtī ||
children.translated_text: Victories attend him, riches attend him; O <s>Indra</s> accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, be ours with aid.

children.text: yasyājasraṃ śavasā mānam uktham paribhujad rodasī viśvataḥ sīm
children.translated_text: Whose praise, with unceasing strength, embraces the measure of earth and heaven on every side,

children.text: sa pāriṣat kratubhir mandasāno marutvān no bhavatv indra ūtī ||
children.translated_text: may he carry us across with his powers, exhilarated; O <s>Indra</s> accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, be ours with aid.

children.text: na yasya devā devatā na martā āpaś cana śavaso antam āpuḥ
children.translated_text: Neither the gods in their godhead, nor mortals, nor even the waters have reached the end of his strength.

children.text: sa prarikvā tvakṣasā kṣmo divaś ca marutvān no bhavatv indra ūtī ||
children.translated_text: He surpasses earth and heaven by his skill; O <s>Indra</s> accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, be ours with aid.

children.text: rohicchyāvā sumadaṃśur lalāmīr dyukṣā rāya ṛjrāśvasya
children.translated_text: The reddish-bay mares, dark and well-adorned, marked with frontlets, shining in heaven, for the wealth of <s>Ṛjrāśva</s>,

children.text: vṛṣaṇvantam bibhratī dhūrṣu ratham mandrā ciketa nāhuṣīṣu vikṣu ||
children.translated_text: bearing the virile chariot on the poles, were joyfully noticed among the <s>Nāhuṣa</s> clans.

children.text: etat tyat ta indra vṛṣṇa ukthaṃ vārṣāgirā abhi gṛṇanti rādhaḥ
children.translated_text: This very hymn of yours, O bull-like <s>Indra</s>, the <s>Vārṣāgiras</s> sing in praise of bounty:

children.text: ṛjrāśvaḥ praṣṭibhir ambarīṣaḥ sahadevo bhayamānaḥ surādhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Ṛjrāśva</s>, with the <s>Praṣṭis</s>, <s>Ambarīṣa</s>, <s>Sahadeva</s>, <s>Bhayamāna</s>, and <s>Surādhas</s>.

children.text: dasyūñchimyūṃś ca puruhūta evair hatvā pṛthivyāṃ śarvā ni barhīt
children.translated_text: Having struck down the <s>Dasyus</s> and <s>Śimyus</s>, O much-invoked one, by your advances, lay the arrows low upon the earth.

children.text: sanat kṣetraṃ sakhibhiḥ śvitnyebhiḥ sanat sūryaṃ sanad apaḥ suvajraḥ ||
children.translated_text: With your white friends, O good-thunderbolted one, win the field, win the sun, win the waters.

children.text: viśvāhendro adhivaktā no astv aparihvṛtāḥ sanuyāma vājam
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> be our advocate for all things; may we, unassailed, win the prize.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, the river, earth, and heaven not harm that of ours.

children.text: Chapter 101
pra mandine pitumad arcatā vaco yaḥ kṛṣṇagarbhā nirahann ṛjiśvanā
children.translated_text: Sing forth a nourishing word to the exhilarated one, who with <s>Ṛjiśvan</s> drove out those with black wombs.

children.text: avasyavo vṛṣaṇaṃ vajradakṣiṇam marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: Seeking help, we call the bull, whose right hand bears the thunderbolt, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, for friendship.

children.text: yo vyaṃsaṃ jāhṛṣāṇena manyunā yaḥ śambaraṃ yo ahan piprum avratam
children.translated_text: Who, with wrath stirred to exultation, struck down <s>Vyaṃsa</s>, who struck down <s>Śambara</s>, who struck down lawless <s>Pipru</s>,

children.text: indro yaḥ śuṣṇam aśuṣaṃ ny āvṛṇaṅ marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, who enclosed parching <s>Śuṣṇa</s>; we call him, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, for friendship.

children.text: yasya dyāvāpṛthivī pauṃsyam mahad yasya vrate varuṇo yasya sūryaḥ
children.translated_text: Whose great manly power belongs to heaven and earth, whose command <s>Varuṇa</s> follows, whose command the sun follows,

children.text: yasyendrasya sindhavaḥ saścati vratam marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: whose command the rivers attend, that <s>Indra</s> accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s> we call for friendship.

children.text: yo aśvānāṃ yo gavāṃ gopatir vaśī ya āritaḥ karmaṇi karmaṇi sthiraḥ
children.translated_text: Who is lord and master of horses, who is lord and master of cattle, who is firm in every task when called upon,

children.text: vīﾱoś cid indro yo asunvato vadho marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, who is the slayer of the non-presser even in the stronghold, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, we call for friendship.

children.text: yo viśvasya jagataḥ prāṇatas patir yo brahmaṇe prathamo gā avindat
children.translated_text: Who is lord of all that moves and breathes, who first found the cows for the prayer-maker,

children.text: indro yo dasyūṃr adharāṁ avātiran marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, who drove the <s>Dasyus</s> downward, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, we call for friendship.

children.text: yaḥ śūrebhir havyo yaś ca bhīrubhir yo dhāvadbhir hūyate yaś ca jigyubhiḥ
children.translated_text: Who is to be invoked by heroes and by the fearful, who is called by those who run and by those who have won,

children.text: indraṃ yaṃ viśvā bhuvanābhi saṃdadhur marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Indra</s> on whom all beings have settled, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, we call for friendship.

children.text: rudrāṇām eti pradiśā vicakṣaṇo rudrebhir yoṣā tanute pṛthu jrayaḥ
children.translated_text: He goes, discerning, through the regions of the <s>Rudras</s>; with the <s>Rudras</s> his consort stretches out broad swiftness.

children.text: indram manīṣā abhy arcati śrutam marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: Inspired thought praises renowned <s>Indra</s>; accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, we call him for friendship.

children.text: yad vā marutvaḥ parame sadhasthe yad vāvame vṛjane mādayāse
children.translated_text: Whether, O <s>Marut</s>-accompanied one, you rejoice in the highest seat, or in the lowest enclosure,

children.text: ata ā yāhy adhvaraṃ no acchā tvāyā haviś cakṛmā satyarādhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: come from there toward our rite; for you, O true-giver, we have prepared the oblation.

children.text: tvāyendra somaṃ suṣumā sudakṣa tvāyā haviś cakṛmā brahmavāhaḥ
children.translated_text: For you, O skillful <s>Indra</s>, we have pressed the <s>Soma</s>; for you, bearer of prayer, we have prepared the oblation.

children.text: adhā niyutvaḥ sagaṇo marudbhir asmin yajñe barhiṣi mādayasva ||
children.translated_text: Then, rich in teams, together with your troop and with the <s>Maruts</s>, take delight on the sacred grass in this sacrifice.

children.text: mādayasva haribhir ye ta indra vi ṣyasva śipre vi sṛjasva dhene
children.translated_text: Take delight with the bay horses that are yours, O <s>Indra</s>; loosen your cheeks, release your jaws.

children.text: ā tvā suśipra harayo vahantūśan havyāni prati no juṣasva ||
children.translated_text: May the bay horses bring you here, O fair-cheeked one; desiring them, accept our oblations.

children.text: marutstotrasya vṛjanasya gopā vayam indreṇa sanuyāma vājam
children.translated_text: Guardians of the singer of the <s>Maruts</s>, guardians of the enclosure, may we win the prize with <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, the river, earth, and heaven not harm that of ours.

children.text: Chapter 102
imāṃ te dhiyam pra bhare maho mahīm asya stotre dhiṣaṇā yat ta ānaje
children.translated_text: I bring forth for you this great and mighty thought, the inspiration of this praise, which has adorned you.

children.text: tam utsave ca prasave ca sāsahim indraṃ devāsaḥ śavasāmadann anu ||
children.translated_text: Him, the overcomer in the festival and in the impulse, <s>Indra</s>, the gods exhilarated with strength.

children.text: asya śravo nadyaḥ sapta bibhrati dyāvākṣāmā pṛthivī darśataṃ vapuḥ
children.translated_text: The seven rivers bear his fame; heaven and earth, the two world-halves, bear his visible form.

children.text: asme sūryācandramasābhicakṣe śraddhe kam indra carato vitarturam ||
children.translated_text: For us the Sun and Moon are there to be seen; in faith, O <s>Indra</s>, what two move as those who cross beyond?

children.text: taṃ smā ratham maghavan prāva sātaye jaitraṃ yaṃ te anumadāma saṃgame
children.translated_text: That chariot, O bountiful one, you have protected for winning, the victorious one which we approve for you in the encounter;

children.text: ājā na indra manasā puruṣṭuta tvāyadbhyo maghavañcharma yaccha naḥ ||
children.translated_text: come to us, O <s>Indra</s>, much-praised, with your mind; O bountiful one, grant us shelter for those who belong to you.

children.text: vayaṃ jayema tvayā yujā vṛtam asmākam aṃśam ud avā bhare bhare
children.translated_text: May we, yoked with you, win the enclosure; in every contest raise up our share.

children.text: asmabhyam indra varivaḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi pra śatrūṇām maghavan vṛṣṇyā ruja ||
children.translated_text: For us, O <s>Indra</s>, make wide room and an easy path; O bountiful one, break the virile power of the enemies.

children.text: nānā hi tvā havamānā janā ime dhanānāṃ dhartar avasā vipanyavaḥ
children.translated_text: For these various peoples, calling on you, O holder of treasures, praise you eagerly for aid.

children.text: asmākaṃ smā ratham ā tiṣṭha sātaye jaitraṃ hīndra nibhṛtam manas tava ||
children.translated_text: Mount our chariot for winning; for, O <s>Indra</s>, your mind is firmly set on the victorious one.

children.text: gojitā bāhū amitakratuḥ simaḥ karman karmañchatamūtiḥ khajaṅkaraḥ
children.translated_text: With cow-winning arms, immeasurable in resolve, giving a hundred aids in every deed, making the prize,

children.text: akalpa indraḥ pratimānam ojasāthā janā vi hvayante siṣāsavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> has become beyond comparison by his might; then the peoples call upon him, desiring to win.

children.text: ut te śatān maghavann uc ca bhūyasa ut sahasrād ririce kṛṣṭiṣu śravaḥ
children.translated_text: Your fame, O bountiful one, has risen above hundreds and still more; among the peoples it has surpassed a thousand.

children.text: amātraṃ tvā dhiṣaṇā titviṣe mahy adhā vṛtrāṇi jighnase purandara ||
children.translated_text: Insight has made you shine as measureless and great; therefore you strike down the obstructions, O fort-breaker.

children.text: triviṣṭidhātu pratimānam ojasas tisro bhūmīr nṛpate trīṇi rocanā
children.translated_text: With the triple expanse as your foundation, a measure of might, O lord of men, you have the three earths and the three luminous realms.

children.text: atīdaṃ viśvam bhuvanaṃ vavakṣithāśatrur indra januṣā sanād asi ||
children.translated_text: You have grown beyond this whole world of beings; by birth from of old, O <s>Indra</s>, you are without enemy.

children.text: tvāṃ deveṣu prathamaṃ havāmahe tvam babhūtha pṛtanāsu sāsahiḥ
children.translated_text: We call upon you first among the gods; you have become the overcomer in battles.

children.text: semaṃ naḥ kārum upamanyum udbhidam indraḥ kṛṇotu prasave ratham puraḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, at the urging, set this singer, <s>Upamanyu Udbhida</s>, as a chariot in front for us.

children.text: tvaṃ jigetha na dhanā rurodhithārbheṣv ājā maghavan mahatsu ca
children.translated_text: You have conquered; you have not held back the riches, O bountiful one, in small battles and in great ones.

children.text: tvām ugram avase saṃ śiśīmasy athā na indra havaneṣu codaya ||
children.translated_text: We sharpen you, the fierce one, for aid; then, O <s>Indra</s>, impel us in the invocations.

children.text: viśvāhendro adhivaktā no astv aparihvṛtāḥ sanuyāma vājam
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> be our advocate in every way; may we win the prize, unturned aside.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Sindhu</s>, Earth, and Heaven not injure that of ours.

children.text: Chapter 103
tat ta indriyam paramam parācair adhārayanta kavayaḥ puredam
children.translated_text: That highest power of yours the seers of old upheld, looking beyond.

children.text: kṣamedam anyad divy anyad asya sam ī pṛcyate samaneva ketuḥ ||
children.translated_text: One part of it is here on earth, another in heaven; it is joined together like a signal in the assembly.

children.text: sa dhārayat pṛthivīm paprathac ca vajreṇa hatvā nir apaḥ sasarja
children.translated_text: He upheld the earth and spread it out; striking with the <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt), he released the waters.

children.text: ahann ahim abhinad rauhiṇaṃ vy ahan vyaṃsam maghavā śacībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: He slew the serpent; he split <s>Rauhiṇa</s>; the bountiful one, by his powers, struck <s>Vyaṃsa</s> apart.

children.text: sa jātūbharmā śraddadhāna ojaḥ puro vibhindann acarad vi dāsīḥ
children.translated_text: He, taking up native, trusted strength, went about breaking the forts and scattering the Dāsa strongholds.

children.text: vidvān vajrin dasyave hetim asyāryaṃ saho vardhayā dyumnam indra ||
children.translated_text: Knowing, O bearer of the <s>vajra</s>, hurl this weapon at the Dasyu; increase the strength and splendor of the Ārya, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: tad ūcuṣe mānuṣemā yugāni kīrtenyam maghavā nāma bibhrat
children.translated_text: For the one who speaks, through these human ages, the bountiful one bears a name worthy of praise.

children.text: upaprayan dasyuhatyāya vajrī yaddha sūnuḥ śravase nāma dadhe ||
children.translated_text: The <s>vajra</s>-bearer advanced for the slaying of the Dasyu, when the son took a name for fame.

children.text: tad asyedam paśyatā bhūri puṣṭaṃ śrad indrasya dhattana vīryāya
children.translated_text: Look at this abundant nourishment of his; put faith in the heroic power of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: sa gā avindat so avindad aśvān sa oṣadhīḥ so apaḥ sa vanāni ||
children.translated_text: He found the cows; he found the horses; he found the plants, the waters, and the forests.

children.text: bhūrikarmaṇe vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe satyaśuṣmāya sunavāma somam
children.translated_text: Let us press <s>soma</s> (the sacrificial drink) for the bull, the vigorous one, rich in deeds and true in force,

children.text: ya ādṛtyā paripanthīva śūro 'yajvano vibhajann eti vedaḥ ||
children.translated_text: who, bold like a hero, having overcome the waylayer, comes distributing the wealth of the non-sacrificers.

children.text: tad indra preva vīryaṃ cakartha yat sasantaṃ vajreṇābodhayo 'him
children.translated_text: This, O <s>Indra</s>, you did as a heroic deed, when with the <s>vajra</s> you awakened the sleeping serpent.

children.text: anu tvā patnīr hṛṣitaṃ vayaś ca viśve devāso amadann anu tvā ||
children.translated_text: Your wives and the creatures followed you in excitement; all the gods rejoiced after you.

children.text: śuṣṇam pipruṃ kuyavaṃ vṛtram indra yadāvadhīr vi puraḥ śambarasya
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indra</s>, you slew <s>Śuṣṇa</s>, <s>Pipru</s>, <s>Kuyava</s>, and <s>Vṛtra</s>, and broke apart the forts of <s>Śambara</s>,

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Sindhu</s>, Earth, and Heaven not injure that of ours.

children.text: Chapter 104
yoniṣ ṭa indra niṣade akāri tam ā ni ṣīda svāno nārvā
children.translated_text: Your seat, O <s>Indra</s>, has been made for sitting; sit down upon it, neighing like a horse.

children.text: vimucyā vayo 'vasāyāśvān doṣā vastor vahīyasaḥ prapitve ||
children.translated_text: Unharness the horses for rest, at evening, at morning, and at the start of the journey, O most conveying one.

children.text: o tye nara indram ūtaye gur nū cit tān sadyo adhvano jagamyāt
children.translated_text: Those men have called <s>Indra</s> for aid; even now may he at once travel those roads.

children.text: devāso manyuṃ dāsasya ścamnan te na ā vakṣan suvitāya varṇam ||
children.translated_text: The gods crushed the wrath of the Dāsa; may they bring us a fair brightness for good welfare.

children.text: ava tmanā bharate ketavedā ava tmanā bharate phenam udan
children.translated_text: By himself the knower of signs bears it down; by himself he bears down the foam upon the water.

children.text: kṣīreṇa snātaḥ kuyavasya yoṣe hate te syātām pravaṇe śiphāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bathed in milk are the wives of <s>Kuyava</s>; when he is slain, may those two be at the slope of <s>Śiphā</s>.

children.text: yuyopa nābhir uparasyāyoḥ pra pūrvābhis tirate rāṣṭi śūraḥ
children.translated_text: The navel of the upper <s>Āyu</s> has joined; the hero stretches across with the former ones as ruler.

children.text: añjasī kuliśī vīrapatnī payo hinvānā udabhir bharante ||
children.translated_text: <s>Añjasī</s> and <s>Kuliśī</s>, wives of heroes, impelling the milk, bring it with the waters.

children.text: prati yat syā nīthādarśi dasyor oko nācchā sadanaṃ jānatī gāt
children.translated_text: When that guiding path of the Dasyu was seen, she went toward the house, knowing the nearby dwelling.

children.text: adha smā no maghavañ carkṛtād in mā no magheva niṣṣapī parā dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, O bountiful one, keep acting for us; do not give us away to deprivation, as if we had no share.

children.text: sa tvaṃ na indra sūrye so apsv anāgāstva ā bhaja jīvaśaṃse
children.translated_text: So you, O <s>Indra</s>, allot to us in the sun and in the waters, in sinlessness, in living praise.

children.text: māntarām bhujam ā rīriṣo naḥ śraddhitaṃ te mahata indriyāya ||
children.translated_text: Do not injure our inner support; we have put faith in your great Indra-power.

children.text: adhā manye śrat te asmā adhāyi vṛṣā codasva mahate dhanāya
children.translated_text: Then, I think, faith has been placed in this one of yours; as a bull, impel yourself for great wealth.

children.text: mā no akṛte puruhūta yonāv indra kṣudhyadbhyo vaya āsutiṃ dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Do not, O much-invoked <s>Indra</s>, place us in an unmade womb; do not give our sustenance to the hungry.

children.text: mā no vadhīr indra mā parā dā mā naḥ priyā bhojanāni pra moṣīḥ
children.translated_text: Do not kill us, O <s>Indra</s>; do not abandon us; do not rob us of our dear enjoyments.

children.text: āṇḍā mā no maghavañchakra nir bhen mā naḥ pātrā bhet sahajānuṣāṇi ||
children.translated_text: Do not break our eggs, O bountiful strong one; do not break our vessels that are born with us.

children.text: arvāṅ ehi somakāmaṃ tvāhur ayaṃ sutas tasya pibā madāya
children.translated_text: Come hereward; they call you desiring <s>soma</s>. This has been pressed; drink of it for exhilaration.

children.text: uruvyacā jaṭhara ā vṛṣasva piteva naḥ śṛṇuhi hūyamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O widely spacious one, fill your belly; like a father, hear us as we call.

children.text: Chapter 105
candramā apsv antar ā suparṇo dhāvate divi
children.translated_text: The moon, within the waters, the fair-winged one, runs in heaven.

children.text: na vo hiraṇyanemayaḥ padaṃ vindanti vidyuto vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: Your golden-rimmed ones, the lightnings, do not find his track; know this of me, O Heaven and Earth.

children.text: artham id vā u arthina ā jāyā yuvate patim
children.translated_text: Indeed for a purpose, for the one seeking a purpose, a wife weds a husband.

children.text: tuñjāte vṛṣṇyam payaḥ paridāya rasaṃ duhe vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: They press the bull-strengthening milk; having enclosed the sap, they milk out the essence. Know this of me, O heaven and earth.

children.text: mo ṣu devā adaḥ svar ava pādi divas pari
children.translated_text: O gods, let that sun not fall down away from heaven.

children.text: mā somyasya śambhuvaḥ śūne bhūma kadācana vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: May we never be deprived of the bliss-bringing <s>Soma</s>. Know this of me, O heaven and earth.

children.text: yajñam pṛcchāmy avamaṃ sa tad dūto vi vocati
children.translated_text: I ask after the nearest sacrifice; as messenger let him proclaim that clearly.

children.text: kva ṛtam pūrvyaṃ gataṃ kas tad bibharti nūtano vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: Where has the ancient <s>ṛta</s> (truth-order) gone? Who now bears it anew? Know this of me, O heaven and earth.

children.text: amī ye devā sthana triṣv ā rocane divaḥ
children.translated_text: You gods who stand there in the three luminous realms of heaven,

children.text: kad va ṛtaṃ kad anṛtaṃ kva pratnā va āhutir vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: when is your <s>ṛta</s>, when is untruth? Where is your ancient invocation? Know this of me, O heaven and earth.

children.text: kad va ṛtasya dharṇasi kad varuṇasya cakṣaṇam
children.translated_text: Where is the support of <s>ṛta</s>? Where is the sight of <s>Varuṇa</s>?

children.text: kad aryamṇo mahas pathāti krāmema dūḍhyo vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: By what great path of <s>Aryaman</s> may we pass beyond hostile hardships? Know this of me, O heaven and earth.

children.text: ahaṃ so asmi yaḥ purā sute vadāmi kānicit
children.translated_text: I am that one who formerly, at the soma-pressing, used to speak certain words.

children.text: tam mā vyanty ādhyo vṛko na tṛṣṇajam mṛgaṃ vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: Anxieties consume me, as a wolf consumes a thirsty wild beast. Know this of me, O heaven and earth.

children.text: sam mā tapanty abhitaḥ sapatnīr iva parśavaḥ
children.translated_text: They burn me on every side like rival co-wives, like ribs pressing in.

children.text: mūṣo na śiśnā vy adanti mādhya stotāraṃ te śatakrato vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: Like mice they gnaw at my middle, your singer, O <s>Śatakratu</s>. Know this of me, O heaven and earth.

children.text: amī ye sapta raśmayas tatrā me nābhir ātatā
children.translated_text: Those seven rays there: there my navel is stretched out.

children.text: tritas tad vedāptyaḥ sa jāmitvāya rebhati vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: <s>Trita Āptya</s> knows that; he cries out for kinship. Know this of me, O heaven and earth.

children.text: amī ye pañcokṣaṇo madhye tasthur maho divaḥ
children.translated_text: Those five bulls there have taken their stand in the middle of great heaven.

children.text: devatrā nu pravācyaṃ sadhrīcīnā ni vāvṛtur vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: What must be proclaimed among the gods: they have turned together in one direction. Know this of me, O heaven and earth.

children.text: suparṇā eta āsate madhya ārodhane divaḥ
children.translated_text: These fair-winged ones sit in the middle stronghold of heaven.

children.text: te sedhanti patho vṛkaṃ tarantaṃ yahvatīr apo vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: They drive the wolf from the paths as he crosses the mighty waters. Know this of me, O heaven and earth.

children.text: navyaṃ tad ukthyaṃ hitaṃ devāsaḥ supravācanam
children.translated_text: That new hymn has been set forth, worthy of praise, easy for the gods to proclaim.

children.text: ṛtam arṣanti sindhavaḥ satyaṃ tātāna sūryo vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: The rivers stream according to <s>ṛta</s>; <s>Sūrya</s> has stretched out truth. Know this of me, O heaven and earth.

children.text: agne tava tyad ukthyaṃ deveṣv asty āpyam
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, that praiseworthy bond of yours exists among the gods.

children.text: sa naḥ satto manuṣvad ā devān yakṣi viduṣṭaro vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: Seated among us as among the people of <s>Manu</s>, bring the gods here for us, you who know best. Know this of me, O heaven and earth.

children.text: satto hotā manuṣvad ā devāṁ acchā viduṣṭaraḥ
children.translated_text: Seated as the <s>Hotṛ</s>, as among the people of <s>Manu</s>, knowing best, toward the gods,

children.text: agnir havyā suṣūdati devo deveṣu medhiro vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, the god wise among the gods, duly conveys the oblations. Know this of me, O heaven and earth.

children.text: brahmā kṛṇoti varuṇo gātuvidaṃ tam īmahe
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s> makes the sacred formulation that finds the path; we seek him.

children.text: vy ūrṇoti hṛdā matiṃ navyo jāyatām ṛtaṃ vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: With his heart he unfolds the thought; let a new <s>ṛta</s> be born. Know this of me, O heaven and earth.

children.text: asau yaḥ panthā ādityo divi pravācyaṃ kṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: That path of the <s>Āditya</s> in heaven has been made worthy of proclamation.

children.text: na sa devā atikrame tam martāso na paśyatha vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: The gods do not transgress it; you mortals do not see it. Know this of me, O heaven and earth.

children.text: tritaḥ kūpe 'vahito devān havata ūtaye
children.translated_text: <s>Trita</s>, cast down into the well, called upon the gods for help.

children.text: tacchuśrāva bṛhaspatiḥ kṛṇvann aṃhūraṇād uru vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s> heard that, making a wide space out of narrow distress. Know this of me, O heaven and earth.

children.text: aruṇo mā sakṛd vṛkaḥ pathā yantaṃ dadarśa hi
children.translated_text: The ruddy wolf saw me once as I was going along the path.

children.text: uj jihīte nicāyyā taṣṭeva pṛṣṭyāmayī vittam me asya rodasī ||
children.translated_text: He rises up from below after being noticed, like a craftsman with a painful back. Know this of me, O heaven and earth.

children.text: enāṅgūṣeṇa vayam indravanto 'bhi ṣyāma vṛjane sarvavīrāḥ
children.translated_text: With this cry of praise, possessing <s>Indra</s>, may we overcome in the contest, rich in all heroes.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Sindhu</s>, <s>Pṛthivī</s>, and <s>Dyauḥ</s> make that great for us.

children.text: Chapter 106
indram mitraṃ varuṇam agnim ūtaye mārutaṃ śardho aditiṃ havāmahe
children.translated_text: For help we call <s>Indra</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Agni</s>, the host of the <s>Maruts</s>, and <s>Aditi</s>.

children.text: rathaṃ na durgād vasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmān no aṃhaso niṣ pipartana ||
children.translated_text: O good givers, O <s>Vasus</s>, carry us out of every distress as one carries a chariot out of difficult ground.

children.text: ta ādityā ā gatā sarvatātaye bhūta devā vṛtratūryeṣu śambhuvaḥ
children.translated_text: Come here, O <s>Ādityas</s>, for full protection; be bliss-bringing gods in battles against obstruction.

children.text: rathaṃ na durgād vasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmān no aṃhaso niṣ pipartana ||
children.translated_text: O good givers, O <s>Vasus</s>, carry us out of every distress as one carries a chariot out of difficult ground.

children.text: avantu naḥ pitaraḥ supravācanā uta devī devaputre ṛtāvṛdhā
children.translated_text: Let the Fathers, easy to invoke, protect us, and also the two goddesses, daughters of gods, who strengthen <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: rathaṃ na durgād vasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmān no aṃhaso niṣ pipartana ||
children.translated_text: O good givers, O <s>Vasus</s>, carry us out of every distress as one carries a chariot out of difficult ground.

children.text: narāśaṃsaṃ vājinaṃ vājayann iha kṣayadvīram pūṣaṇaṃ sumnair īmahe
children.translated_text: Here, with favors, we seek <s>Narāśaṃsa</s>, prize-winning and winning prizes, and <s>Pūṣan</s>, whose heroes dwell secure.

children.text: rathaṃ na durgād vasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmān no aṃhaso niṣ pipartana ||
children.translated_text: O good givers, O <s>Vasus</s>, carry us out of every distress as one carries a chariot out of difficult ground.

children.text: bṛhaspate sadam in naḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi śaṃ yor yat te manurhitaṃ tad īmahe
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, always make an easy path for us; we seek that blessing of yours which <s>Manu</s> established.

children.text: rathaṃ na durgād vasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmān no aṃhaso niṣ pipartana ||
children.translated_text: O good givers, O <s>Vasus</s>, carry us out of every distress as one carries a chariot out of difficult ground.

children.text: indraṃ kutso vṛtrahaṇaṃ śacīpatiṃ kāṭe nibāﾱha ṛṣir ahvad ūtaye
children.translated_text: The seer <s>Kutsa</s>, tightly constrained in the pit, called on <s>Indra Vṛtrahan</s>, lord of power, for help.

children.text: rathaṃ na durgād vasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmān no aṃhaso niṣ pipartana ||
children.translated_text: O good givers, O <s>Vasus</s>, carry us out of every distress as one carries a chariot out of difficult ground.

children.text: devair no devy aditir ni pātu devas trātā trāyatām aprayucchan
children.translated_text: May divine <s>Aditi</s>, together with the gods, protect us; may the god who is a savior save us without neglect.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Sindhu</s>, <s>Pṛthivī</s>, and <s>Dyauḥ</s> make that great for us.

children.text: Chapter 107
yajño devānām praty eti sumnam ādityāso bhavatā mṛﾱayantaḥ
children.translated_text: The sacrifice goes forth to meet the gods' favor; O <s>Ādityas</s>, be merciful.

children.text: ā vo 'rvācī sumatir vavṛtyād aṃhoś cid yā varivovittarāsat ||
children.translated_text: May your good will turn hither to us, the one that can bring broad room even out of distress.

children.text: upa no devā avasā gamantv aṅgirasāṃ sāmabhi stūyamānāḥ
children.translated_text: May the gods come near us with help, praised by the chants of the <s>Aṅgirases</s>.

children.text: indra indriyair maruto marudbhir ādityair no aditiḥ śarma yaṃsat ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> with his powers, the <s>Maruts</s> with the <s>Maruts</s>, and <s>Aditi</s> with the <s>Ādityas</s> grant us shelter.

children.text: tan na indras tad varuṇas tad agnis tad aryamā tat savitā cano dhāt
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> grant that to us, and <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Agni</s>; may <s>Aryaman</s> and <s>Savitṛ</s> grant us that delight.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Sindhu</s>, <s>Pṛthivī</s>, and <s>Dyauḥ</s> make that great for us.

children.text: Chapter 108
ya indrāgnī citratamo ratho vām abhi viśvāni bhuvanāni caṣṭe
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, that most wondrous chariot of yours looks out over all beings.

children.text: tenā yātaṃ sarathaṃ tasthivāṃsāthā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
children.translated_text: Come with that, standing on the same chariot; then drink of the pressed <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: yāvad idam bhuvanaṃ viśvam asty uruvyacā varimatā gabhīram
children.translated_text: As far as this whole world extends, wide-reaching, broad, and deep,

children.text: tāvāṁ ayam pātave somo astv aram indrāgnī manase yuvabhyām ||
children.translated_text: so may this <s>Soma</s> be sufficient for your drinking, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, suited to the minds of you both.

children.text: cakrāthe hi sadhryaṅ nāma bhadraṃ sadhrīcīnā vṛtrahaṇā uta sthaḥ
children.translated_text: For you two have made together an auspicious name; you stand together, O slayers of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: tāv indrāgnī sadhryañcā niṣadyā vṛṣṇaḥ somasya vṛṣaṇā vṛṣethām ||
children.translated_text: Sitting down together, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, O virile ones, may you grow strong with the bull-like soma.

children.text: samiddheṣv agniṣv ānajānā yatasrucā barhir u tistirāṇā
children.translated_text: When the fires are kindled, when the ladles are set in motion and the sacred grass is spread out,

children.text: tīvraiḥ somaiḥ pariṣiktebhir arvāg endrāgnī saumanasāya yātam ||
children.translated_text: come hither, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, for good cheer, with the sharp soma-draughts poured all around.

children.text: yānīndrāgnī cakrathur vīryāṇi yāni rūpāṇy uta vṛṣṇyāni
children.translated_text: Whatever heroic deeds you two have performed, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, whatever forms and bull-like powers are yours,

children.text: yā vām pratnāni sakhyā śivāni tebhiḥ somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
children.translated_text: with those ancient, auspicious bonds of friendship of yours, drink of the pressed soma.

children.text: yad abravam prathamaṃ vāṃ vṛṇāno 'yaṃ somo asurair no vihavyaḥ
children.translated_text: When, choosing you two, I first said, 'This soma of ours is to be specially invoked among the mighty ones,'

children.text: tāṃ satyāṃ śraddhām abhy ā hi yātam athā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
children.translated_text: come now to that true trust; then drink of the pressed soma.

children.text: yad indrāgnī madathaḥ sve duroṇe yad brahmaṇi rājani vā yajatrā
children.translated_text: If, O worshipful <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, you rejoice in your own home, or in the sacred formulation, or with the king,

children.text: ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāv ā hi yātam athā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
children.translated_text: come from there, O virile pair; then drink of the pressed soma.

children.text: yad indrāgnī yaduṣu turvaśeṣu yad druhyuṣv anuṣu pūruṣu sthaḥ
children.translated_text: If, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, you are among the <s>Yadus</s> and <s>Turvaśas</s>, among the <s>Druhyus</s>, <s>Anus</s>, or <s>Pūrus</s>,

children.text: ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāv ā hi yātam athā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
children.translated_text: come from there, O virile pair; then drink of the pressed soma.

children.text: yad indrāgnī avamasyām pṛthivyām madhyamasyām paramasyām uta sthaḥ
children.translated_text: If, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, you are on the lowest earth, or the middle, or the highest,

children.text: ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāv ā hi yātam athā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
children.translated_text: come from there, O virile pair; then drink of the pressed soma.

children.text: yad indrāgnī paramasyām pṛthivyām madhyamasyām avamasyām uta sthaḥ
children.translated_text: If, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, you are on the highest earth, or the middle, or the lowest,

children.text: ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāv ā hi yātam athā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
children.translated_text: come from there, O virile pair; then drink of the pressed soma.

children.text: yad indrāgnī divi ṣṭho yat pṛthivyāṃ yat parvateṣv oṣadhīṣv apsu
children.translated_text: If, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, you are in heaven, or on earth, or among the mountains, plants, or waters,

children.text: ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāv ā hi yātam athā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
children.translated_text: come from there, O virile pair; then drink of the pressed soma.

children.text: yad indrāgnī uditā sūryasya madhye divaḥ svadhayā mādayethe
children.translated_text: If, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, at the rising of the sun, in the middle of heaven, you delight by your own power,

children.text: ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāv ā hi yātam athā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
children.translated_text: come from there, O virile pair; then drink of the pressed soma.

children.text: evendrāgnī papivāṃsā sutasya viśvāsmabhyaṃ saṃ jayataṃ dhanāni
children.translated_text: Thus, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, having drunk of the pressed soma, win all riches for us.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, the river, earth, and heaven not harm that of ours.

children.text: Chapter 109
vi hy akhyam manasā vasya icchann indrāgnī jñāsa uta vā sajātān
children.translated_text: For I have looked around with my mind, desiring good, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, among acquaintances and among kinsmen.

children.text: nānyā yuvat pramatir asti mahyaṃ sa vāṃ dhiyaṃ vājayantīm atakṣam ||
children.translated_text: There is no other guiding thought for me apart from you; so I have fashioned for you a prize-winning insight.

children.text: aśravaṃ hi bhūridāvattarā vāṃ vijāmātur uta vā ghā syālāt
children.translated_text: For I have heard that you two are still more liberal givers than a son-in-law, or even than a brother-in-law.

children.text: athā somasya prayatī yuvabhyām indrāgnī stomaṃ janayāmi navyam ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, at the soma-offering for you two, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, I generate a new hymn.

children.text: mā chedma raśmīṃr iti nādhamānāḥ pitṝṇāṃ śaktīr anuyacchamānāḥ
children.translated_text: 'Let us not cut the reins,' say the beseeching ones, following after the powers of the fathers.

children.text: indrāgnibhyāṃ kaṃ vṛṣaṇo madanti tā hy adrī dhiṣaṇāyā upasthe ||
