children.translated_text: The bull-like ones rejoice for <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>; for the two pressing-stones are in the lap of <s>Dhiṣaṇā</s>.

children.text: yuvābhyāṃ devī dhiṣaṇā madāyendrāgnī somam uśatī sunoti
children.translated_text: For you two, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, the goddess <s>Dhiṣaṇā</s>, eager for exhilaration, presses the soma.

children.text: tāv aśvinā bhadrahastā supāṇī ā dhāvatam madhunā pṛṅktam apsu ||
children.translated_text: You two, like the <s>Aśvins</s>, fair-handed and good-palmed, come running; mix it with honey in the waters.

children.text: yuvām indrāgnī vasuno vibhāge tavastamā śuśrava vṛtrahatye
children.translated_text: You two, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, are the mightiest in the apportioning of wealth, famed in the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: tāv āsadyā barhiṣi yajñe asmin pra carṣaṇī mādayethāṃ sutasya ||
children.translated_text: Sitting down on the sacred grass in this sacrifice, O lords of peoples, delight in the pressed soma.

children.text: pra carṣaṇibhyaḥ pṛtanāhaveṣu pra pṛthivyā riricāthe divaś ca
children.translated_text: You have surpassed the peoples in battle-calls; you have surpassed earth and heaven,

children.text: pra sindhubhyaḥ pra giribhyo mahitvā prendrāgnī viśvā bhuvanāty anyā ||
children.translated_text: surpassed the rivers and the mountains in greatness, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, and all other beings.

children.text: ā bharataṃ śikṣataṃ vajrabāhū asmāṁ indrāgnī avataṃ śacībhiḥ
children.translated_text: Bring to us, bestow upon us, O thunderbolt-armed ones; protect us, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, with your powers.

children.text: ime nu te raśmayaḥ sūryasya yebhiḥ sapitvam pitaro na āsan ||
children.translated_text: These indeed are the rays of the sun by which our fathers gained kinship.

children.text: purandarā śikṣataṃ vajrahastāsmāṁ indrāgnī avatam bhareṣu
children.translated_text: O fortress-breakers, bestow upon us, O thunderbolt-handed ones; protect us, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, in the contests.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, the river, earth, and heaven not harm that of ours.

children.text: Chapter 110
tatam me apas tad u tāyate punaḥ svādiṣṭhā dhītir ucathāya śasyate
children.translated_text: My work has been stretched out, and it is stretched again; the sweetest insight is proclaimed for the hymn.

children.text: ayaṃ samudra iha viśvadevyaḥ svāhākṛtasya sam u tṛpṇuta ṛbhavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: This sea here belongs to all the gods; O <s>Ṛbhus</s>, be fully satisfied with what has been offered with svāhā.

children.text: ābhogayam pra yad icchanta aitanāpākāḥ prāñco mama kecid āpayaḥ
children.translated_text: When they wished to enjoy it, they went forth; some of my kinsmen, still unripe, turned eastward and away.

children.text: saudhanvanāsaś caritasya bhūmanāgacchata savitur dāśuṣo gṛham ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Saudhanvanas</s>, by the greatness of your course, come to the house of the worshiper of <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: tat savitā vo 'mṛtatvam āsuvad agohyaṃ yacchravayanta aitana
children.translated_text: May <s>Savitṛ</s> impel immortality for you, that unconcealed reward which they proclaimed as you went.

children.text: tyaṃ cic camasam asurasya bhakṣaṇam ekaṃ santam akṛṇutā caturvayam ||
children.translated_text: Even that cup, the portion of the mighty one, though it was single, you made fourfold.

children.text: viṣṭvī śamī taraṇitvena vāghato martāsaḥ santo amṛtatvam ānaśuḥ
children.translated_text: Having acted with skill and swiftness, the singers, though mortal, attained immortality.

children.text: saudhanvanā ṛbhavaḥ sūracakṣasaḥ saṃvatsare sam apṛcyanta dhītibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Saudhanvanas</s>, the <s>Ṛbhus</s>, sun-eyed, came together in the year with their insights.

children.text: kṣetram iva vi mamus tejanenaṃ ekam pātram ṛbhavo jehamānam
children.translated_text: Like a field with a measuring-rod, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>, they measured out that single cup that was being desired.

children.text: upastutā upamaṃ nādhamānā amartyeṣu śrava icchamānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Praised and beseeching the highest, they sought fame among the immortals.

children.text: ā manīṣām antarikṣasya nṛbhyaḥ sruceva ghṛtaṃ juhavāma vidmanā
children.translated_text: Let us knowingly pour inspired thought for the men of the midspace, like ghee with a ladle.

children.text: taraṇitvā ye pitur asya saścira ṛbhavo vājam aruhan divo rajaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Ṛbhus</s>, who through swiftness attended this father, mounted the prize and the heavenly region.

children.text: ṛbhur na indraḥ śavasā navīyān ṛbhur vājebhir vasubhir vasur dadiḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Ṛbhu</s>, like <s>Indra</s>, be newer for us through might; <s>Ṛbhu</s>, wealthy with prizes and goods, is a giver of wealth.

children.text: yuṣmākaṃ devā avasāhani priye 'bhi tiṣṭhema pṛtsutīr asunvatām ||
children.translated_text: By your aid, O gods, on beloved days, may we stand over the battle-lines of the non-pressers.

children.text: niś carmaṇa ṛbhavo gām apiṃśata saṃ vatsenāsṛjatā mātaram punaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Ṛbhus</s>, from the hide you fashioned the cow; with the calf you released the mother again.

children.text: saudhanvanāsaḥ svapasyayā naro jivrī yuvānā pitarākṛṇotana ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Saudhanvanas</s>, men of good workmanship, you made your aged parents young.

children.text: vājebhir no vājasātāv aviḍḍhy ṛbhumāṁ indra citram ā darṣi rādhaḥ
children.translated_text: Help us with prizes in the winning of prizes; O <s>Indra</s> rich in <s>Ṛbhus</s>, a wondrous gift has appeared.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Sindhu</s>, Earth, and Heaven not harm that of ours.

children.text: Chapter 111
takṣan rathaṃ suvṛtaṃ vidmanāpasas takṣan harī indravāhā vṛṣaṇvasū
children.translated_text: They fashioned the well-rolling chariot, skillful in workmanship; they fashioned the two bay steeds that carry <s>Indra</s>, rich in virile wealth.

children.text: takṣan pitṛbhyām ṛbhavo yuvad vayas takṣan vatsāya mātaraṃ sacābhuvam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Ṛbhus</s> fashioned youth for the two parents; they fashioned for the calf a mother to be with it.

children.text: ā no yajñāya takṣata ṛbhumad vayaḥ kratve dakṣāya suprajāvatīm iṣam
children.translated_text: Fashion for our sacrifice, O possessors of <s>Ṛbhu</s>-skill, vigor, nourishment rich in good offspring, for resolve and for skill.

children.text: yathā kṣayāma sarvavīrayā viśā tan naḥ śardhāya dhāsathā sv indriyam ||
children.translated_text: So that we may dwell with a clan rich in every hero, place that own lordly power for our host.

children.text: ā takṣata sātim asmabhyam ṛbhavaḥ sātiṃ rathāya sātim arvate naraḥ
children.translated_text: Fashion gain for us, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>, gain for the chariot, gain for the racing horse, O men.

children.text: sātiṃ no jaitrīṃ sam maheta viśvahā jāmim ajāmim pṛtanāsu sakṣaṇim ||
children.translated_text: May we magnify a conquering gain for ourselves every day, one that secures both kinsman and non-kinsman in battles.

children.text: ṛbhukṣaṇam indram ā huva ūtaya ṛbhūn vājān marutaḥ somapītaye
children.translated_text: I call <s>Indra</s>, lord of the <s>Ṛbhus</s>, for aid, and the <s>Ṛbhus</s>, the <s>Vājas</s>, and the <s>Maruts</s> for the drinking of <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: ubhā mitrāvaruṇā nūnam aśvinā te no hinvantu sātaye dhiye jiṣe ||
children.translated_text: May both <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, and now the <s>Aśvins</s>, impel us toward gain, toward insight, and toward victory.

children.text: ṛbhur bharāya saṃ śiśātu sātiṃ samaryajid vājo asmāṁ aviṣṭu
children.translated_text: Let <s>Ṛbhu</s> sharpen gain for the contest; let <s>Vāja</s>, winner in the assembly-strife, aid us.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Sindhu</s>, Earth, and Heaven not harm that of ours.

children.text: Chapter 112
īﾱe dyāvāpṛthivī pūrvacittaye 'gniṃ gharmaṃ surucaṃ yāmann iṣṭaye
children.translated_text: I praise Heaven and Earth for their ancient thought, and <s>Agni</s>, the hot offering, bright-shining, on the way to worship.

children.text: yābhir bhare kāram aṃśāya jinvathas tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: With the aids by which, in the contest, you quicken the singer for his share, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yuvor dānāya subharā asaścato ratham ā tasthur vacasaṃ na mantave
children.translated_text: For your gift the unfailing, easy-bearing chariot has mounted up, like a word for contemplation.

children.text: yābhir dhiyo 'vathaḥ karmann iṣṭaye tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: With the aids by which you help inspired thoughts in the work for worship, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yuvaṃ tāsāṃ divyasya praśāsane viśāṃ kṣayatho amṛtasya majmanā
children.translated_text: You two rule over those peoples under the command of the heavenly immortal, by its greatness.

children.text: yābhir dhenum asvam pinvatho narā tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: With the aids by which you swell the milk-cow and the horse, O men, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhiḥ parijmā tanayasya majmanā dvimātā tūrṣu taraṇir vibhūṣati
children.translated_text: With the aids by which the all-circling one, the two-mothered swift one among the swift, adorns himself by the greatness of the son,

children.text: yābhis trimantur abhavad vicakṣaṇas tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with which <s>Trimantu</s> became clear-sighted, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhī rebhaṃ nivṛtaṃ sitam adbhya ud vandanam airayataṃ svar dṛśe
children.translated_text: With the aids by which you raised <s>Rebha</s>, shut in and bound, from the waters, and <s>Vandana</s>, so that he might see the sunlight,

children.text: yābhiḥ kaṇvam pra siṣāsantam āvataṃ tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with which you protected <s>Kaṇva</s> as he sought to advance, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhir antakaṃ jasamānam āraṇe bhujyuṃ yābhir avyathibhir jijinvathuḥ
children.translated_text: With the aids by which you revived <s>Antaka</s>, wasting away in the wilderness, and by which you strengthened <s>Bhujyu</s> with uninjuring helps,

children.text: yābhiḥ karkandhuṃ vayyaṃ ca jinvathas tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with which you quicken <s>Karkandhu</s> and <s>Vayya</s>, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhiḥ śucantiṃ dhanasāṃ suṣaṃsadaṃ taptaṃ gharmam omyāvantam atraye
children.translated_text: With the aids by which, for <s>Atri</s>, you made the glowing, prize-winning, well-praised, heated <s>gharma</s> offering full of refreshment,

children.text: yābhiḥ pṛśnigum purukutsam āvataṃ tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with which you protected <s>Pṛśnigu</s> and <s>Purukutsa</s>, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhiḥ śacībhir vṛṣaṇā parāvṛjam prāndhaṃ śroṇaṃ cakṣasa etave kṛthaḥ
children.translated_text: With the powers by which, O bulls, you made the cast-off blind and lame man go forward to sight,

children.text: yābhir vartikāṃ grasitām amuñcataṃ tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with which you released <s>Vartikā</s> when she had been swallowed, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhiḥ sindhum madhumantam asaścataṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ yābhir ajarāv ajinvatam
children.translated_text: With the aids by which you attended the honeyed <s>Sindhu</s>, and by which, ageless ones, you quickened <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>,

children.text: yābhiḥ kutsaṃ śrutaryaṃ naryam āvataṃ tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with which you protected <s>Kutsa</s>, <s>Śrutarya</s>, and <s>Narya</s>, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhir viśpalāṃ dhanasām atharvyaṃ sahasramīﾱha ājāv ajinvatam
children.translated_text: With the aids by which you strengthened <s>Viśpalā</s>, prize-winning and Atharvanian, in battle rich in a thousand rewards,

children.text: yābhir vaśam aśvyam preṇim āvataṃ tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with which you protected <s>Vaśa</s>, <s>Aśvya</s>, and <s>Preṇi</s>, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhiḥ sudānū auśijāya vaṇije dīrghaśravase madhu kośo akṣarat
children.translated_text: With the aids by which, O bounteous ones, the honeyed vessel flowed for the trader <s>Dīrghaśravas</s>, son of <s>Auśija</s>,

children.text: kakṣīvantaṃ stotāraṃ yābhir āvataṃ tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with which you protected <s>Kakṣīvant</s> the singer, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhī rasāṃ kṣodasodnaḥ pipinvathur anaśvaṃ yābhī ratham āvataṃ jiṣe
children.translated_text: With the aids by which you filled the <s>Rasā</s> with flood-water, and by which you protected the horseless chariot for victory,

children.text: yābhis triśoka usriyā udājata tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with which <s>Triśoka</s> drove up the ruddy cows, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhiḥ sūryam pariyāthaḥ parāvati mandhātāraṃ kṣaitrapatyeṣv āvatam
children.translated_text: With the aids by which you two go around the sun in the far distance, and protected <s>Mandhātṛ</s> among lordships of the field,

children.text: yābhir vipram pra bharadvājam āvataṃ tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with which you protected the inspired <s>Bharadvāja</s>, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhir mahām atithigvaṃ kaśojuvaṃ divodāsaṃ śambarahatya āvatam
children.translated_text: With the aids by which you protected great <s>Atithigva</s>, <s>Kaśoju</s>, and <s>Divodāsa</s> in the slaying of <s>Śambara</s>,

children.text: yābhiḥ pūrbhidye trasadasyum āvataṃ tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with which you protected <s>Trasadasyu</s> for the breaking of strongholds, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhir vamraṃ vipipānam upastutaṃ kaliṃ yābhir vittajāniṃ duvasyathaḥ
children.translated_text: With the aids by which you served <s>Vamra</s>, drinking deeply and praised, and by which you attended <s>Kali</s>, knower of wealth,

children.text: yābhir vyaśvam uta pṛthim āvataṃ tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with which you protected <s>Vyaśva</s> and also <s>Pṛthi</s>, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhir narā śayave yābhir atraye yābhiḥ purā manave gātum īṣathuḥ
children.translated_text: With the aids by which, O men, you sought a path for <s>Śayu</s>, for <s>Atri</s>, and of old for <s>Manu</s>,

children.text: yābhiḥ śārīr ājataṃ syūmaraśmaye tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with which you made <s>Śārī</s> arise for <s>Syūmaraśmi</s>, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhiḥ paṭharvā jaṭharasya majmanāgnir nādīdec cita iddho ajmann ā
children.translated_text: With the aids by which <s>Paṭharvan</s>, by the greatness of the belly, blazed like kindled <s>Agni</s> at birth,

children.text: yābhiḥ śaryātam avatho mahādhane tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with which you protected <s>Śaryāta</s> in the great prize-contest, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhir aṅgiro manasā niraṇyatho 'graṃ gacchatho vivare goarṇasaḥ
children.translated_text: With the aids by which, like <s>Aṅgiras</s> in mind, you found a way out, and go to the forefront in the opening of the cow-filled flood,

children.text: yābhir manuṃ śūram iṣā samāvataṃ tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with which you fully protected heroic <s>Manu</s> with refreshment, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhiḥ patnīr vimadāya nyūhathur ā gha vā yābhir aruṇīr aśikṣatam
children.translated_text: With the aids by which you brought wives to <s>Vimada</s>, and by which indeed you instructed the ruddy mares,

children.text: yābhiḥ sudāsa ūhathuḥ sudevyaṃ tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with which you carried <s>Sudās</s> to good divine fortune, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhiḥ śantātī bhavatho dadāśuṣe bhujyuṃ yābhir avatho yābhir adhrigum
children.translated_text: With the aids by which you bring peace to the worshiper, and by which you helped <s>Bhujyu</s> and <s>Adhrigu</s>,

children.text: omyāvatīṃ subharām ṛtastubhaṃ tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with the refreshing, easy-bearing, truth-praising aid, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here.

children.text: yābhiḥ kṛśānum asane duvasyatho jave yābhir yūno arvantam āvatam
children.translated_text: With the aids by which you serve <s>Kṛśānu</s> at the shot, and by which you protected the young racehorse in speed.

children.text: madhu priyam bharatho yat saraḍbhyas tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: Bring the dear honey, O <s>Bharatas</s>, for the autumns; with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here quickly.

children.text: yābhir naraṃ goṣuyudhaṃ nṛṣāhye kṣetrasya sātā tanayasya jinvathaḥ
children.translated_text: With those aids by which, O men, you quicken the man who fights for cattle in man-winning struggle, for the gain of a field and of offspring,

children.text: yābhī rathāṁ avatho yābhir arvatas tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: by which you helped chariots, by which you helped racing horses, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here quickly.

children.text: yābhiḥ kutsam ārjuneyaṃ śatakratū pra turvītim pra ca dabhītim āvatam
children.translated_text: With which, O hundred-powered ones, you aided <s>Kutsa</s> <s>Ārjuneya</s>, and furthered <s>Turvīti</s> and <s>Dabhīti</s>,

children.text: yābhir dhvasantim puruṣantim āvataṃ tābhir ū ṣu ūtibhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: with which you aided <s>Dhvasanti</s> and <s>Puruṣanti</s>, with those aids, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here quickly.

children.text: apnasvatīm aśvinā vācam asme kṛtaṃ no dasrā vṛṣaṇā manīṣām
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, make for us a productive speech; O wondrous, virile ones, make our inspired thought fruitful.

children.text: adyūtye 'vase ni hvaye vāṃ vṛdhe ca no bhavataṃ vājasātau ||
children.translated_text: In the unlighted time I call you two down for help, and for our growth; be with us in the winning of prize.

children.text: dyubhir aktubhiḥ pari pātam asmān ariṣṭebhir aśvinā saubhagebhiḥ
children.translated_text: By days and by nights guard us all around, O <s>Aśvins</s>, with unharmed and fortunate protections.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Sindhu</s>, earth, and heaven not harm that of ours.

children.text: Chapter 113
idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotir āgāc citraḥ praketo ajaniṣṭa vibhvā
children.translated_text: This best light of lights has come; bright, far-seeing, widely powerful, it has been born.

children.text: yathā prasūtā savituḥ savāyaṁ evā rātry uṣase yonim āraik ||
children.translated_text: As, sent forth by the impulse of <s>Savitṛ</s>, night has yielded her womb to <s>Uṣas</s>.

children.text: ruśadvatsā ruśatī śvetyāgād āraig u kṛṣṇā sadanāny asyāḥ
children.translated_text: The shining one with bright calves has come in white array; the dark one has yielded her dwellings to her.

children.text: samānabandhū amṛte anūcī dyāvā varṇaṃ carata āmināne ||
children.translated_text: The two immortal sisters, of common kin and following one another, heaven-born, move on, exchanging their colors.

children.text: samāno adhvā svasror anantas tam anyānyā carato devaśiṣṭe
children.translated_text: The path of the two sisters is the same and endless; one after another they move, appointed by the gods.

children.text: na methete na tasthatuḥ sumeke naktoṣāsā samanasā virūpe ||
children.translated_text: They do not clash, nor do they stand still, well-fashioned: night and dawn, of one mind though different in form.

children.text: bhāsvatī netrī sūnṛtānām aceti citrā vi duro na āvaḥ
children.translated_text: Shining, leader of fair truths, bright <s>Uṣas</s> has been perceived; open our doors wide.

children.text: prārpyā jagad vy u no rāyo akhyad uṣā ajīgar bhuvanāni viśvā ||
children.translated_text: Having set the moving world in motion, she has revealed wealth for us; <s>Uṣas</s> has awakened all beings.

children.text: jihmaśye caritave maghony ābhogaya iṣṭaye rāya u tvam
children.translated_text: For the crooked one to move, O bountiful one, for enjoyment, for desire, and for wealth, you awaken him.

children.text: dabhram paśyadbhya urviyā vicakṣa uṣā ajīgar bhuvanāni viśvā ||
children.translated_text: Seeing the small for those who see, with wide vision, <s>Uṣas</s> has awakened all beings.

children.text: kṣatrāya tvaṃ śravase tvam mahīyā iṣṭaye tvam artham iva tvam ityai
children.translated_text: You awaken one for rule, one for fame, one for greatness, one for desire, one for a goal, as it were, and one for going forth.

children.text: visadṛśā jīvitābhipracakṣa uṣā ajīgar bhuvanāni viśvā ||
children.translated_text: Discerning the unlike lives, <s>Uṣas</s> has awakened all beings.

children.text: eṣā divo duhitā praty adarśi vyucchantī yuvatiḥ śukravāsāḥ
children.translated_text: This daughter of heaven has appeared, shining out, a young woman clothed in brightness.

children.text: viśvasyeśānā pārthivasya vasva uṣo adyeha subhage vy uccha ||
children.translated_text: Mistress of all earthly treasure, O fortunate <s>Uṣas</s>, shine forth here today.

children.text: parāyatīnām anv eti pātha āyatīnām prathamā śaśvatīnām
children.translated_text: She follows the path of those who have gone away, the first of those coming on, the everlasting dawns.

children.text: vyucchantī jīvam udīrayanty uṣā mṛtaṃ kaṃ cana bodhayantī ||
children.translated_text: Shining out, stirring the living, <s>Uṣas</s> does not awaken anyone who is dead.

children.text: uṣo yad agniṃ samidhe cakartha vi yad āvaś cakṣasā sūryasya
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, when you have kindled <s>Agni</s>, when you have opened the way with the eye of the sun,

children.text: yan mānuṣān yakṣyamāṇāṁ ajīgas tad deveṣu cakṛṣe bhadram apnaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when, intending sacrifice, you have roused human beings, then you have performed a blessed work among the gods.

children.text: kiyāty ā yat samayā bhavāti yā vyūṣur yāś ca nūnaṃ vyucchān
children.translated_text: How long will it be between the dawns that have shone, and those that now are shining?

children.text: anu pūrvāḥ kṛpate vāvaśānā pradīdhyānā joṣam anyābhir eti ||
children.translated_text: Longing for the former ones, blazing forth, she follows in order and goes gladly with the others.

children.text: īyuṣ ṭe ye pūrvatarām apaśyan vyucchantīm uṣasam martyāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Gone are the mortals who saw you before, when you shone forth as earlier <s>Uṣas</s>.

children.text: asmābhir ū nu praticakṣyābhūd o te yanti ye aparīṣu paśyān ||
children.translated_text: Now she has become visible to us; and those who will see her in later times are coming on.

children.text: yāvayaddveṣā ṛtapā ṛtejāḥ sumnāvarī sūnṛtā īrayantī
children.translated_text: Driving hatred away, guardian of truth, born of truth, rich in favor, setting fair truths in motion,

children.text: sumaṅgalīr bibhratī devavītim ihādyoṣaḥ śreṣṭhatamā vy uccha ||
children.translated_text: bearing auspicious blessings and divine invitation, O <s>Uṣas</s>, shine forth here today as the best of all.

children.text: śaśvat puroṣā vy uvāsa devy atho adyedaṃ vy āvo maghonī
children.translated_text: The goddess has shone forth from of old; and today, too, the bountiful one has opened this world.

children.text: atho vy ucchād uttarāṁ anu dyūn ajarāmṛtā carati svadhābhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: And she will shine forth through the days to come; ageless and immortal, she moves according to her own law.

children.text: vy añjibhir diva ātāsv adyaud apa kṛṣṇāṃ nirṇijaṃ devy āvaḥ
children.translated_text: With her ornaments from the edges of heaven she has shone today; the goddess has cast off the dark garment.

children.text: prabodhayanty aruṇebhir aśvair oṣā yāti suyujā rathena ||
children.translated_text: Awakening all with her ruddy horses, <s>Uṣas</s> comes with a well-yoked chariot.

children.text: āvahantī poṣyā vāryāṇi citraṃ ketuṃ kṛṇute cekitānā
children.translated_text: Bringing things to be nourished and desirable goods, the knowing one makes a bright signal.

children.text: īyuṣīṇām upamā śaśvatīnāṃ vibhātīnām prathamoṣā vy aśvait ||
children.translated_text: The likeness of those gone and of the everlasting shining dawns, first among the radiant ones, <s>Uṣas</s> has shone forth.

children.text: ud īrdhvaṃ jīvo asur na āgād apa prāgāt tama ā jyotir eti
children.translated_text: Rise up: life and breath have come to us; darkness has gone away, and light comes forward.

children.text: āraik panthāṃ yātave sūryāyāganma yatra pratiranta āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: She has cleared a path for the sun to travel; we have come where men extend their lifetime.

children.text: syūmanā vāca ud iyarti vahni stavāno rebha uṣaso vibhātīḥ
children.translated_text: The kindler, praising the shining dawns, sends up a well-woven voice, a resounding song.

children.text: adyā tad uccha gṛṇate maghony asme āyur ni didīhi prajāvat ||
children.translated_text: Shine forth today for the singer, O bountiful one; set down for us a life rich in offspring.

children.text: yā gomatīr uṣasaḥ sarvavīrā vyucchanti dāśuṣe martyāya
children.translated_text: Those dawns rich in cattle and all heroes that shine forth for the mortal worshiper,

children.text: vāyor iva sūnṛtānām udarke tā aśvadā aśnavat somasutvā ||
children.translated_text: like the outflow of <s>Vāyu</s>, may the <s>Soma</s>-presser obtain those bestowers of horses and fair truths.

children.text: mātā devānām aditer anīkaṃ yajñasya ketur bṛhatī vi bhāhi
children.translated_text: Mother of the gods, face of <s>Aditi</s>, signal of sacrifice, great one, shine widely.

children.text: praśastikṛd brahmaṇe no vy ucchā no jane janaya viśvavāre ||
children.translated_text: Maker of praise, shine forth for our sacred formulation; among our people, O all-desired one, generate blessing.

children.text: yac citram apna uṣaso vahantījānāya śaśamānāya bhadram
children.translated_text: That bright work of yours, O <s>Uṣas</s>, which you bear as good for the one who worships and praises,

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Sindhu</s>, earth, and heaven not harm that of ours.

children.text: Chapter 114
imā rudrāya tavase kapardine kṣayadvīrāya pra bharāmahe matīḥ
children.translated_text: These thoughts we offer to mighty <s>Rudra</s>, the braided-haired one, lord of settled heroes.

children.text: yathā śam asad dvipade catuṣpade viśvam puṣṭaṃ grāme asminn anāturam ||
children.translated_text: So that there may be welfare for biped and quadruped, and everything in this village may be thriving and free from sickness.

children.text: mṛﾱā no rudrota no mayas kṛdhi kṣayadvīrāya namasā vidhema te
children.translated_text: Be gracious to us, O <s>Rudra</s>, and make us happy; we worship you with homage, lord of settled heroes.

children.text: yac chaṃ ca yoś ca manur āyeje pitā tad aśyāma tava rudra praṇītiṣu ||
children.translated_text: That welfare and refreshment which our father <s>Manu</s> won by sacrifice, may we obtain that under your guidance, O <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: aśyāma te sumatiṃ devayajyayā kṣayadvīrasya tava rudra mīḍhvaḥ
children.translated_text: May we obtain your favor through worship of the gods, O generous <s>Rudra</s>, lord of settled heroes.

children.text: sumnāyann id viśo asmākam ā carāriṣṭavīrā juhavāma te haviḥ ||
children.translated_text: Coming in favor to our clans, we call upon you with an oblation, with our heroes unharmed.

children.text: tveṣaṃ vayaṃ rudraṃ yajñasādhaṃ vaṅkuṃ kavim avase ni hvayāmahe
children.translated_text: We call down for help fierce <s>Rudra</s>, accomplisher of sacrifice, the curved and inspired one.

children.text: āre asmad daivyaṃ heﾱo asyatu sumatim id vayam asyā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: Let him cast far away from us the divine wrath; we choose only his favor.

children.text: divo varāham aruṣaṃ kapardinaṃ tveṣaṃ rūpaṃ namasā ni hvayāmahe
children.translated_text: We call down with reverence the ruddy boar of heaven, the braided one, fierce in form.

children.text: haste bibhrad bheṣajā vāryāṇi śarma varma cchardir asmabhyaṃ yaṃsat ||
children.translated_text: Bearing in his hand desirable remedies, may he extend to us shelter, armor, and protection.

children.text: idam pitre marutām ucyate vacaḥ svādoḥ svādīyo rudrāya vardhanam
children.translated_text: This word is spoken for the father of the <s>Maruts</s>, a strengthening sweeter than sweet for <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: rāsvā ca no amṛta martabhojanaṃ tmane tokāya tanayāya mṛﾱa ||
children.translated_text: And grant us, O immortal one, food for mortals; be gracious to our self, to our children, and to our descendants.

children.text: mā no mahāntam uta mā no arbhakam mā na ukṣantam uta mā na ukṣitam
children.translated_text: Do not harm our great one, nor our small one; do not harm the growing one, nor the one already grown.

children.text: mā no vadhīḥ pitaram mota mātaram mā naḥ priyās tanvo rudra rīriṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Do not strike down our father or our mother; do not injure our dear bodies, O <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: mā nas toke tanaye mā na āyau mā no goṣu mā no aśveṣu rīriṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Do not injure us in our children, in our descendants, or in our lifetime; do not injure us among our cattle or among our horses.

children.text: vīrān mā no rudra bhāmito vadhīr haviṣmantaḥ sadam it tvā havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: Do not, in anger, strike down our heroes, O <s>Rudra</s>; with oblations we always call upon you.

children.text: upa te stomān paśupā ivākaraṃ rāsvā pitar marutāṃ sumnam asme
children.translated_text: I have fashioned hymns for you as a herdsman does for his herd; grant us favor, O father of the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: bhadrā hi te sumatir mṛﾱayattamāthā vayam ava it te vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: For your good will is auspicious and most merciful; therefore we choose this protection of yours.

children.text: āre te goghnam uta pūruṣaghnaṃ kṣayadvīra sumnam asme te astu
children.translated_text: Let your cow-slaying and man-slaying weapon be far away; O destroyer of heroes, let your favor be ours.

children.text: mṛﾱā ca no adhi ca brūhi devādhā ca naḥ śarma yaccha dvibarhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Be gracious to us and speak on our behalf, O god; then grant us shelter, twofold and broad.

children.text: avocāma namo asmā avasyavaḥ śṛṇotu no havaṃ rudro marutvān
children.translated_text: We have spoken reverence to him, seeking help; may <s>Rudra</s>, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, hear our call.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Sindhu</s>, <s>Pṛthivī</s>, and <s>Dyauḥ</s> make that great for us.

children.text: Chapter 115
citraṃ devānām ud agād anīkaṃ cakṣur mitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ
children.translated_text: The brilliant face of the gods has risen, the eye of <s>Mitra</s>, of <s>Varuṇa</s>, and of <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatas tasthuṣaś ca ||
children.translated_text: <s>Sūrya</s> has filled heaven and earth and the midspace; he is the self of what moves and what stands.

children.text: sūryo devīm uṣasaṃ rocamānām maryo na yoṣām abhy eti paścāt
children.translated_text: <s>Sūrya</s> follows the shining goddess <s>Uṣas</s>, as a young man follows a woman.

children.text: yatrā naro devayanto yugāni vitanvate prati bhadrāya bhadram ||
children.translated_text: There men who honor the gods stretch out their yokes, good after good, for blessed fortune.

children.text: bhadrā aśvā haritaḥ sūryasya citrā etagvā anumādyāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Auspicious are the bay horses of <s>Sūrya</s>, bright, dappled, worthy of praise.

children.text: namasyanto diva ā pṛṣṭham asthuḥ pari dyāvāpṛthivī yanti sadyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Doing reverence, they have mounted to the back of heaven; at once they go around heaven and earth.

children.text: tat sūryasya devatvaṃ tan mahitvam madhyā kartor vitataṃ saṃ jabhāra
children.translated_text: That is the godhead of <s>Sūrya</s>, that his greatness: in the midst of work he has drawn back what was stretched out.

children.text: yaded ayukta haritaḥ sadhasthād ād rātrī vāsas tanute simasmai ||
children.translated_text: When he has unyoked his bay horses from their common station, then Night spreads out her garment over all this.

children.text: tan mitrasya varuṇasyābhicakṣe sūryo rūpaṃ kṛṇute dyor upasthe
children.translated_text: For the sight of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Sūrya</s> makes his form in the lap of heaven.

children.text: anantam anyad ruśad asya pājaḥ kṛṣṇam anyad dharitaḥ sam bharanti ||
children.translated_text: One of his powers is endless and bright; another, black, the bay horses carry together.

children.text: adyā devā uditā sūryasya nir aṃhasaḥ pipṛtā nir avadyāt
children.translated_text: Today, O gods, at the rising of <s>Sūrya</s>, carry us beyond distress and beyond blame.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Sindhu</s>, <s>Pṛthivī</s>, and <s>Dyauḥ</s> make that great for us.

children.text: Chapter 116
nāsatyābhyām barhir iva pra vṛñje stomāṁ iyarmy abhriyeva vātaḥ
children.translated_text: For the two <s>Nāsatyas</s> I spread out praises as one spreads sacred grass; I send forth hymns like the wind driving clouds.

children.text: yāv arbhagāya vimadāya jāyāṃ senājuvā nyūhatū rathena ||
children.translated_text: They brought, by chariot, a wife for young <s>Vimada</s>, driving through the battle-host.

children.text: vīﾱupatmabhir āśuhemabhir vā devānāṃ vā jūtibhiḥ śāśadānā
children.translated_text: With firm-footed and swiftly-moving powers, or with the impulsions of the gods, ever victorious,

children.text: tad rāsabho nāsatyā sahasram ājā yamasya pradhane jigāya ||
children.translated_text: that donkey of yours, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, won a thousand in the contest, in the decisive race of <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: tugro ha bhujyum aśvinodameghe rayiṃ na kaścin mamṛvāṁ avāhāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Tugra</s>, indeed, sent <s>Bhujyu</s> forth for the <s>Aśvins</s> in the cloudless sea, as one dead abandons wealth.

children.text: tam ūhathur naubhir ātmanvatībhir antarikṣaprudbhir apodakābhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: You carried him with self-possessed boats, crossing the midspace, waterless.

children.text: tisraḥ kṣapas trir ahātivrajadbhir nāsatyā bhujyum ūhathuḥ pataṅgaiḥ
children.translated_text: For three nights and three days, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, with flying coursers you carried <s>Bhujyu</s> beyond the transgressions.

children.text: samudrasya dhanvann ārdrasya pāre tribhī rathaiḥ śatapadbhiḥ ṣaﾱaśvaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Beyond the wet expanse of the sea, with three chariots, hundred-footed and six-horsed.

children.text: anārambhaṇe tad avīrayethām anāsthāne agrabhaṇe samudre
children.translated_text: In the sea without support, without resting-place, without something to grasp, you showed your heroism there,

children.text: yad aśvinā ūhathur bhujyum astaṃ śatāritrāṃ nāvam ātasthivāṃsam ||
children.translated_text: when, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you carried <s>Bhujyu</s> home as he had mounted a ship with a hundred oars.

children.text: yam aśvinā dadathuḥ śvetam aśvam aghāśvāya śaśvad it svasti
children.translated_text: The white horse that you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, gave to <s>Aghāśva</s>, always bringing welfare,

children.text: tad vāṃ dātram mahi kīrtenyam bhūt paidvo vājī sadam id dhavyo aryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that gift of yours became great and worthy of praise: <s>Paidva</s>, the prize-winning steed, always to be invoked by the noble one.

children.text: yuvaṃ narā stuvate pajriyāya kakṣīvate aradatam purandhim
children.translated_text: You two men opened abundance for the praising <s>Pajriya</s>, for <s>Kakṣīvat</s>.

children.text: kārotarāc chaphād aśvasya vṛṣṇaḥ śataṃ kumbhāṁ asiñcataṃ surāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: From the hoof of the strong horse you poured out a hundred jars of liquor.

children.text: himenāgniṃ ghraṃsam avārayethām pitumatīm ūrjam asmā adhattam
children.translated_text: With cold you warded off the scorching fire; you placed nourishing strength with food for him.

children.text: ṛbīse atrim aśvināvanītam un ninyathuḥ sarvagaṇaṃ svasti ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, you brought <s>Atri</s> up from the pit, rescued, together with all his band, for welfare.

children.text: parāvataṃ nāsatyānudethām uccābudhnaṃ cakrathur jihmabāram
children.translated_text: You drove away the distant enemy, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>; you made the crookedly-bearing one deep at the top and high-bottomed.

children.text: kṣarann āpo na pāyanāya rāye sahasrāya tṛṣyate gotamasya ||
children.translated_text: The waters streamed out, like drink for refreshment, for wealth of a thousand for thirsty <s>Gotama</s>.

children.text: jujuruṣo nāsatyota vavrim prāmuñcataṃ drāpim iva cyavānāt
children.translated_text: O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, you freed the aged <s>Cyavāna</s> from his covering, as one removes a garment.

children.text: prātirataṃ jahitasyāyur dasrād it patim akṛṇutaṃ kanīnām ||
children.translated_text: O wondrous ones, you prolonged the life of the abandoned man; you made him the husband of maidens.

children.text: tad vāṃ narā śaṃsyaṃ rādhyaṃ cābhiṣṭiman nāsatyā varūtham
children.translated_text: That praiseworthy, attainable, desired protection of yours, O men, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>,

children.text: yad vidvāṃsā nidhim ivāpagūﾱham ud darśatād ūpathur vandanāya ||
children.translated_text: when, as knowing ones, you brought up for <s>Vandana</s> what was hidden like a treasure, to be seen.

children.text: tad vāṃ narā sanaye daṃsa ugram āviṣkṛṇomi tanyatur na vṛṣṭim
children.translated_text: That fierce wondrous deed of yours, O men, I make manifest for gain, like thunder revealing rain.

children.text: dadhyaṅ ha yan madhv ātharvaṇo vām aśvasya śīrṣṇā pra yad īm uvāca ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Dadhyañc Ātharvaṇa</s> spoke the honey to you with the head of a horse.

children.text: ajohavīn nāsatyā karā vām mahe yāman purubhujā purandhiḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Purandhi</s>, rich in many enjoyments, called out to you, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, for a great journey.

children.text: śrutaṃ tac chāsur iva vadhrimatyā hiraṇyahastam aśvināv adattam ||
children.translated_text: You heard that; like rescuers for <s>Vadhrimatī</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you gave her the golden-handed son.

children.text: āsno vṛkasya vartikām abhīke yuvaṃ narā nāsatyāmumuktam
children.translated_text: From the mouth of the wolf, in close peril, you two men, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, released <s>Vartikā</s>.

children.text: uto kavim purubhujā yuvaṃ ha kṛpamāṇam akṛṇutaṃ vicakṣe ||
children.translated_text: And you two, rich in many enjoyments, made the distressed poet see clearly.

children.text: caritraṃ hi ver ivācchedi parṇam ājā khelasya paritakmyāyām
children.translated_text: For, like a bird's wing, the leg of <s>Khela</s> had been cut off in the circling battle.

children.text: sadyo jaṅghām āyasīṃ viśpalāyai dhane hite sartave praty adhattam ||
children.translated_text: At once you attached an iron leg for <s>Viśpalā</s>, so that she might run when the prize was set.

children.text: śatam meṣān vṛkye cakṣadānam ṛjrāśvaṃ tam pitāndhaṃ cakāra
children.translated_text: For the she-wolf he gave a hundred sheep to be eaten; his father made <s>Ṛjrāśva</s> blind.

children.text: tasmā akṣī nāsatyā vicakṣa ādhattaṃ dasrā bhiṣajāv anarvan ||
children.translated_text: For him, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, you set eyes that could see, O wondrous, unwearied physicians.

children.text: ā vāṃ rathaṃ duhitā sūryasya kārṣmevātiṣṭhad arvatā jayantī
children.translated_text: The daughter of <s>Sūrya</s> mounted your chariot as at the goal, winning with the coursing steed.

children.text: viśve devā anv amanyanta hṛdbhiḥ sam u śriyā nāsatyā sacethe ||
children.translated_text: All the gods approved it in their hearts; with splendor, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, you two were joined together.

children.text: yad ayātaṃ divodāsāya vartir bharadvājāyāśvinā hayantā
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you drove the course for <s>Divodāsa</s>, for <s>Bharadvāja</s>, urging onward,

children.text: revad uvāha sacano ratho vāṃ vṛṣabhaś ca śiṃśumāraś ca yuktā ||
children.translated_text: your rich chariot, coming in companionship, carried it; the bull and the <s>Śiṃśumāra</s> were yoked.

children.text: rayiṃ sukṣatraṃ svapatyam āyuḥ suvīryaṃ nāsatyā vahantā
children.translated_text: Bearing wealth with good rule, good offspring, life, and heroic strength, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>,

children.text: ā jahnāvīṃ samanasopa vājais trir ahno bhāgaṃ dadhatīm ayātam ||
children.translated_text: you came to <s>Jahnāvī</s> with one mind, with prizes, as she bestowed the share three times a day.

children.text: pariviṣṭaṃ jāhuṣaṃ viśvataḥ sīṃ sugebhir naktam ūhathū rajobhiḥ
children.translated_text: You carried <s>Jāhuṣa</s>, hemmed in on every side, through the nights by easy paths across the regions.

children.text: vibhindunā nāsatyā rathena vi parvatāṁ ajarayū ayātam ||
children.translated_text: With your cleaving chariot, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, you ageless ones went apart through the mountains.

children.text: ekasyā vastor āvataṃ raṇāya vaśam aśvinā sanaye sahasrā
children.translated_text: In one dwelling you aided <s>Vaśa</s> for battle, O <s>Aśvins</s>, for the winning of thousands.

children.text: nir ahataṃ ducchunā indravantā pṛthuśravaso vṛṣaṇāv arātīḥ ||
children.translated_text: With <s>Indra</s> beside you, O bulls, you struck down the hostile powers of <s>Ducchunā</s> for <s>Pṛthuśravas</s>.

children.text: śarasya cid ārcatkasyāvatād ā nīcād uccā cakrathuḥ pātave vāḥ
children.translated_text: Even for <s>Śara Ārcatka</s>, from the low place you made him high, that he might be protected by you.

children.text: śayave cin nāsatyā śacībhir jasuraye staryam pipyathur gām ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Śayu</s> too, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, by your powers, for <s>Jasurī</s>, you made the barren cow swell with milk.

children.text: avasyate stuvate kṛṣṇiyāya ṛjūyate nāsatyā śacībhiḥ
children.translated_text: For the needy singer <s>Kṛṣṇiya</s>, for the straight-going one, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, by your powers,

children.text: paśuṃ na naṣṭam iva darśanāya viṣṇāpvaṃ dadathur viśvakāya ||
children.translated_text: you gave <s>Viṣṇāpu</s> to <s>Viśvaka</s>, to be seen like a lost animal brought back into sight.

children.text: daśa rātrīr aśivenā nava dyūn avanaddhaṃ śnathitam apsv antaḥ
children.translated_text: For ten nights and nine days he was bound by a hostile power, loosened and broken apart within the waters.

children.text: viprutaṃ rebham udani pravṛktam un ninyathuḥ somam iva sruveṇa ||
children.translated_text: <s>Rebha</s>, drenched, cast into the water and thrown down, you lifted up as one lifts <s>Soma</s> with a ladle.

children.text: pra vāṃ daṃsāṃsy aśvināv avocam asya patiḥ syāṃ sugavaḥ suvīraḥ
children.translated_text: I have proclaimed your wondrous deeds, O <s>Aśvins</s>; may I be lord of this, rich in good cows and good heroes.

children.text: uta paśyann aśnuvan dīrgham āyur astam ivej jarimāṇaṃ jagamyām ||
children.translated_text: And, seeing and enjoying long life, may I go to old age as one goes home.

children.text: Chapter 117
madhvaḥ somasyāśvinā madāya pratno hotā vivāsate vām
children.translated_text: The ancient <s>Hotṛ</s> woos you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, for exhilaration from the sweet <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: barhiṣmatī rātir viśritā gīr iṣā yātaṃ nāsatyopa vājaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: The gift is spread upon the sacred grass, the song opened wide; come with nourishment and prizes, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>.

children.text: yo vām aśvinā manaso javīyān rathaḥ svaśvo viśa ājigāti
children.translated_text: Your chariot, O <s>Aśvins</s>, swifter than thought, rich in good horses, approaches the settlements.

children.text: yena gacchathaḥ sukṛto duroṇaṃ tena narā vartir asmabhyaṃ yātam ||
children.translated_text: By it you go to the dwelling of the pious; by that route, O men, come to us.

children.text: ṛṣiṃ narāv aṃhasaḥ pāñcajanyam ṛbīsād atrim muñcatho gaṇena
children.translated_text: O men, you release the seer <s>Atri</s>, of the five peoples, from distress, from the pit, with your company,

children.text: minantā dasyor aśivasya māyā anupūrvaṃ vṛṣaṇā codayantā ||
children.translated_text: breaking one after another the illusions of the hostile <s>Dasyu</s>, urging onward, O bulls.

children.text: aśvaṃ na gūﾱham aśvinā durevair ṛṣiṃ narā vṛṣaṇā rebham apsu
children.translated_text: Like a horse hidden away by evil men, O <s>Aśvins</s>, the seer <s>Rebha</s> was in the waters, O men, O bulls.

children.text: saṃ taṃ riṇītho viprutaṃ daṃsobhir na vāṃ jūryanti pūrvyā kṛtāni ||
children.translated_text: You set him free, drenched, by your wondrous powers; your ancient deeds do not grow old.

children.text: suṣupvāṃsaṃ na nirṛter upasthe sūryaṃ na dasrā tamasi kṣiyantam
children.translated_text: Like one sleeping in the lap of <s>Nirṛti</s>, O wondrous ones, like the sun dwelling in darkness,

children.text: śubhe rukmaṃ na darśataṃ nikhātam ud ūpathur aśvinā vandanāya ||
children.translated_text: like a beautiful golden ornament buried in the ground, you drew him up for <s>Vandana</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: tad vāṃ narā śaṃsyam pajriyeṇa kakṣīvatā nāsatyā parijman
children.translated_text: That deed of yours is to be praised by <s>Kakṣīvat Pajriya</s>, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, O far-ranging men.

children.text: śaphād aśvasya vājino janāya śataṃ kumbhāṁ asiñcatam madhūnām ||
children.translated_text: From the hoof of the swift horse you poured out for the people a hundred jars of honey.

children.text: yuvaṃ narā stuvate kṛṣṇiyāya viṣṇāpvaṃ dadathur viśvakāya
children.translated_text: You two, O men, gave <s>Viṣṇāpu</s> to the praising <s>Kṛṣṇiya</s>, to <s>Viśvaka</s>.

children.text: ghoṣāyai cit pitṛṣade duroṇe patiṃ jūryantyā aśvināv adattam ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Ghoṣā</s> too, growing old in her father's house, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you gave a husband.

children.text: yuvaṃ śyāvāya ruśatīm adattam mahaḥ kṣoṇasyāśvinā kaṇvāya
children.translated_text: You gave the ruddy one to <s>Śyāva</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>, for <s>Kaṇva</s> over the great earth.

children.text: pravācyaṃ tad vṛṣaṇā kṛtaṃ vāṃ yan nārṣadāya śravo adhyadhattam ||
children.translated_text: That famed deed of yours is to be proclaimed, O bulls: you bestowed renown upon <s>Nārṣada</s>.

children.text: purū varpāṃsy aśvinā dadhānā ni pedava ūhathur āśum aśvam
children.translated_text: Assuming many forms, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you brought to <s>Pedu</s> the swift horse,

children.text: sahasrasāṃ vājinam apratītam ahihanaṃ śravasyaṃ tarutram ||
children.translated_text: winning a thousand prizes, strong, irresistible, serpent-slaying, renowned, and overcoming.

children.text: etāni vāṃ śravasyā sudānū brahmāṅgūṣaṃ sadanaṃ rodasyoḥ
children.translated_text: These fame-winning prayers are for you, O generous ones: a solemn utterance, a seat within heaven and earth.

children.text: yad vām pajrāso aśvinā havante yātam iṣā ca viduṣe ca vājam ||
children.translated_text: Since the <s>Pajras</s> call upon you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come with refreshment and with the prize for the knowing man.

children.text: sūnor mānenāśvinā gṛṇānā vājaṃ viprāya bhuraṇā radantā
children.translated_text: Praising you in the manner of a son, O <s>Aśvins</s>, granting strength to the inspired poet,

children.text: agastye brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānā saṃ viśpalāṃ nāsatyāriṇītam ||
children.translated_text: strengthened by the sacred formulation at <s>Agastya</s>'s side, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, you joined <s>Viśpalā</s> together again.

children.text: kuha yāntā suṣṭutiṃ kāvyasya divo napātā vṛṣaṇā śayutrā
children.translated_text: Where are you going, to the fine praise of <s>Kāvya</s>, O sons of heaven, O bulls, resting there?

children.text: hiraṇyasyeva kalaśaṃ nikhātam ud ūpathur daśame aśvināhan ||
children.translated_text: Like a golden jar buried in the ground, you drew him up on the tenth day, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: yuvaṃ cyavānam aśvinā jarantam punar yuvānaṃ cakrathuḥ śacībhiḥ
children.translated_text: You made aged <s>Cyavāna</s> young again, O <s>Aśvins</s>, by your powers.

children.text: yuvo rathaṃ duhitā sūryasya saha śriyā nāsatyāvṛṇīta ||
children.translated_text: The daughter of <s>Sūrya</s> chose your chariot, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, together with splendor.

children.text: yuvaṃ tugrāya pūrvyebhir evaiḥ punarmanyāv abhavataṃ yuvānā
children.translated_text: For <s>Tugra</s>, by your ancient aids, you two became young again in renewed resolve.

children.text: yuvam bhujyum arṇaso niḥ samudrād vibhir ūhathur ṛjrebhir aśvaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: You carried <s>Bhujyu</s> out of the flood, out of the sea, with birds and with straight-running horses.

children.text: ajohavīd aśvinā taugryo vām proﾱhaḥ samudram avyathir jaganvān
children.translated_text: The son of <s>Tugra</s>, cast into the sea, called on you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, having gone there without trembling.

children.text: niṣ ṭam ūhathuḥ suyujā rathena manojavasā vṛṣaṇā svasti ||
children.translated_text: You carried him out with a well-yoked, thought-swift chariot, O bulls, to safety.

children.text: ajohavīd aśvinā vartikā vām āsno yat sīm amuñcataṃ vṛkasya
children.translated_text: <s>Vartikā</s> called upon you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, when you released her from the wolf's mouth.

children.text: vi jayuṣā yayathuḥ sānv adrer jātaṃ viṣvāco ahataṃ viṣeṇa ||
children.translated_text: With victory you went apart over the ridge of the mountain; you struck down <s>Viṣvāc</s> with poison.

children.text: śatam meṣān vṛkye māmahānaṃ tamaḥ praṇītam aśivena pitrā
children.translated_text: He honored the she-wolf with a hundred sheep, after being led into darkness by his hostile father.

children.text: ākṣī ṛjrāśve aśvināv adhattaṃ jyotir andhāya cakrathur vicakṣe ||
children.translated_text: You set eyes in <s>Ṛjrāśva</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>; for the blind man you made light, so that he could see.

children.text: śunam andhāya bharam ahvayat sā vṛkīr aśvinā vṛṣaṇā nareti
children.translated_text: She, the she-wolf, called you <s>Aśvins</s>, bullish men, for provision for the blind man, crying, 'O men!',

children.text: jāraḥ kanīna iva cakṣadāna ṛjrāśvaḥ śatam ekaṃ ca meṣān ||
children.translated_text: for <s>Ṛjrāśva</s>, like a lover to a maiden, had given her one hundred and one sheep to eat.

children.text: mahī vām ūtir aśvinā mayobhūr uta srāmaṃ dhiṣṇyā saṃ riṇīthaḥ
children.translated_text: Great is your aid, O <s>Aśvins</s>, bringing happiness; and, O worthy ones, you set what was damaged together again.

children.text: athā yuvām id ahvayat purandhir āgacchataṃ sīṃ vṛṣaṇāv avobhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Purandhi</s> called upon you; come here to her with your helps, O bulls.

children.text: adhenuṃ dasrā staryaṃ viṣaktām apinvataṃ śayave aśvinā gām
children.translated_text: O wonder-working <s>Aśvins</s>, you made the cow, no milch-cow, aged and bound fast, swell with milk for <s>Śayu</s>.

children.text: yuvaṃ śacībhir vimadāya jāyāṃ ny ūhathuḥ purumitrasya yoṣām ||
children.translated_text: With your powers you brought a bride to <s>Vimada</s>, the young woman of <s>Purumitra</s>.

children.text: yavaṃ vṛkeṇāśvinā vapanteṣaṃ duhantā manuṣāya dasrā
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, wonder-workers, sowing barley with the wolf and milking nourishment for <s>Manu</s>,

children.text: abhi dasyum bakureṇā dhamantoru jyotiś cakrathur āryāya ||
children.translated_text: you blew away the <s>Dasyu</s> with <s>Bakura</s>; you made broad light for the <s>ārya</s> (noble insider).

children.text: ātharvaṇāyāśvinā dadhīce 'śvyaṃ śiraḥ praty airayatam
children.translated_text: For <s>Dadhīci Ātharvaṇa</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you set in motion again the horse's head.

children.text: sa vām madhu pra vocad ṛtāyan tvāṣṭraṃ yad dasrāv apikakṣyaṃ vām ||
children.translated_text: He spoke honey to you, following truth, when the secret thing of <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, O wonder-workers, was with you.

children.text: sadā kavī sumatim ā cake vāṃ viśvā dhiyo aśvinā prāvatam me
children.translated_text: Always, O sages, I have called upon your favor; O <s>Aśvins</s>, protect all my thoughts.

children.text: asme rayiṃ nāsatyā bṛhantam apatyasācaṃ śrutyaṃ rarāthām ||
children.translated_text: For us, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, bestow broad wealth, accompanied by offspring and worthy of fame.

children.text: hiraṇyahastam aśvinā rarāṇā putraṃ narā vadhrimatyā adattam
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, O men, giving freely, you gave <s>Vadhrimatī</s> a son, <s>Hiraṇyahasta</s>.

children.text: tridhā ha śyāvam aśvinā vikastam uj jīvasa airayataṃ sudānū ||
children.translated_text: O bountiful <s>Aśvins</s>, you raised <s>Śyāva</s>, cut into three parts, up to life again.

children.text: etāni vām aśvinā vīryāṇi pra pūrvyāṇy āyavo 'vocan
children.translated_text: These heroic deeds of yours, O <s>Aśvins</s>, the ancient <s>Āyus</s> have proclaimed.

children.text: brahma kṛṇvanto vṛṣaṇā yuvabhyāṃ suvīrāso vidatham ā vadema ||
children.translated_text: Making the sacred formulation for you, O vigorous ones, may we, rich in good heroes, speak at the assembly.

children.text: Chapter 118
ā vāṃ ratho aśvinā śyenapatvā sumṛﾱīkaḥ svavāṁ yātv arvāṅ
children.translated_text: May your chariot, O <s>Aśvins</s>, with falcon-flight, gracious and self-possessed, come hither,

children.text: yo martyasya manaso javīyān trivandhuro vṛṣaṇā vātaraṃhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the one swifter than a mortal's thought, three-seated, O vigorous ones, rushing like the wind.

children.text: trivandhureṇa trivṛtā rathena tricakreṇa suvṛtā yātam arvāk
children.translated_text: Come hither with the three-seated, triple-made chariot, three-wheeled and well-turning.

children.text: pinvataṃ gā jinvatam arvato no vardhayatam aśvinā vīram asme ||
children.translated_text: Swell our cows; enliven our horses; O <s>Aśvins</s>, increase the hero among us.

children.text: pravadyāmanā suvṛtā rathena dasrāv imaṃ śṛṇutaṃ ślokam adreḥ
children.translated_text: Proceeding with your well-turning chariot, O wonder-workers, hear this praise-song of <s>Adri</s>.

children.text: kim aṅga vām praty avartiṃ gamiṣṭhāhur viprāso aśvinā purājāḥ ||
children.translated_text: What return of yours is most ready to come? The inspired seers of old have declared it, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: ā vāṃ śyenāso aśvinā vahantu rathe yuktāsa āśavaḥ pataṅgāḥ
children.translated_text: May falcons bring you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, swift flying ones yoked to the chariot,

children.text: ye apturo divyāso na gṛdhrā abhi prayo nāsatyā vahanti ||
children.translated_text: those that, quick through the waters, heavenly like vultures, carry the offering to you, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>.

children.text: ā vāṃ rathaṃ yuvatis tiṣṭhad atra juṣṭvī narā duhitā sūryasya
children.translated_text: Here the young woman, the daughter of <s>Sūrya</s>, gladly took her stand upon your chariot, O men.

children.text: pari vām aśvā vapuṣaḥ pataṅgā vayo vahantv aruṣā abhīke ||
children.translated_text: May your horses, beautiful flying ones, ruddy birds, carry you near in beauty.

children.text: ud vandanam airataṃ daṃsanābhir ud rebhaṃ dasrā vṛṣaṇā śacībhiḥ
children.translated_text: With your wondrous acts you raised up <s>Vandana</s>; with your powers, O wonder-working bulls, you raised up <s>Rebha</s>.

children.text: niṣ ṭaugryam pārayathaḥ samudrāt punaś cyavānaṃ cakrathur yuvānam ||
children.translated_text: You carried <s>Tāugrya</s> safely from the sea; you made <s>Cyavāna</s> young again.

children.text: yuvam atraye 'vanītāya taptam ūrjam omānam aśvināv adhattam
children.translated_text: For <s>Atri</s>, who had been shut in and heated, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you set sustaining nourishment and protection.

children.text: yuvaṃ kaṇvāyāpiriptāya cakṣuḥ praty adhattaṃ suṣṭutiṃ jujuṣāṇā ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Kaṇva</s>, who had been overwhelmed, you restored sight, accepting his fine praise.

children.text: yuvaṃ dhenuṃ śayave nādhitāyāpinvatam aśvinā pūrvyāya
children.translated_text: For ancient <s>Śayu</s>, who was in need, you made the cow swell with milk, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: amuñcataṃ vartikām aṃhaso niḥ prati jaṅghāṃ viśpalāyā adhattam ||
children.translated_text: You released the quail from distress; you set a leg back on <s>Viśpalā</s>.

children.text: yuvaṃ śvetam pedava indrajūtam ahihanam aśvinādattam aśvam
children.translated_text: For <s>Pedu</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you gave the white horse, urged by <s>Indra</s>, slayer of serpents,

children.text: johūtram aryo abhibhūtim ugraṃ sahasrasāṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vīḍvaṅgam ||
children.translated_text: summoned by the noble man, overpowering, fierce, winning thousands, virile, and firm-limbed.

children.text: tā vāṃ narā sv avase sujātā havāmahe aśvinā nādhamānāḥ
children.translated_text: You two men, well-born <s>Aśvins</s>, we call for good help as we stand in need.

children.text: ā na upa vasumatā rathena giro juṣāṇā suvitāya yātam ||
children.translated_text: Come to us for well-being with your wealth-bearing chariot, accepting our songs.

children.text: ā śyenasya javasā nūtanenāsme yātaṃ nāsatyā sajoṣāḥ
children.translated_text: Come to us now with the speed of a falcon, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, in one accord.

children.text: have hi vām aśvinā rātahavyaḥ śaśvattamāyā uṣaso vyuṣṭau ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Rātahavya</s> calls you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, at the ever most constant breaking of dawn.

children.text: Chapter 119
ā vāṃ ratham purumāyam manojuvaṃ jīrāśvaṃ yajñiyaṃ jīvase huve
children.translated_text: I call your chariot, rich in many arts, swift as thought, with lively horses, fit for sacrifice, for life,

children.text: sahasraketuṃ vaninaṃ śatadvasuṃ śruṣṭīvānaṃ varivodhām abhi prayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: thousand-bannered, winning, rich in a hundred treasures, obedient, and clearing wide space toward refreshment.

children.text: ūrdhvā dhītiḥ praty asya prayāmany adhāyi śasman sam ayanta ā diśaḥ
children.translated_text: The thought has been lifted upward at its departure; then, at the chant, the quarters have come together.

children.text: svadāmi gharmam prati yanty ūtaya ā vām ūrjānī ratham aśvināruhat ||
children.translated_text: I savor the hot offering; helps come toward us; the nourishing powers have mounted your chariot, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: saṃ yan mithaḥ paspṛdhānāso agmata śubhe makhā amitā jāyavo raṇe
children.translated_text: When those competing together have come to splendor, the boundless, victorious contestants to the contest,

children.text: yuvor aha pravaṇe cekite ratho yad aśvinā vahathaḥ sūrim ā varam ||
children.translated_text: your chariot, O <s>Aśvins</s>, is perceived on the slope, when you carry the generous patron to a blessing.

children.text: yuvam bhujyum bhuramāṇaṃ vibhir gataṃ svayuktibhir nivahantā pitṛbhya ā
children.translated_text: You went to <s>Bhujyu</s>, who was tossing about, with birds; with self-yoked ones you carried him home to his fathers.

children.text: yāsiṣṭaṃ vartir vṛṣaṇā vijenyaṃ divodāsāya mahi ceti vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You traveled the winning course, O vigorous ones; your help became great and manifest for <s>Divodāsa</s>.

children.text: yuvor aśvinā vapuṣe yuvāyujaṃ rathaṃ vāṇī yematur asya śardhyam
children.translated_text: For your beauty, O <s>Aśvins</s>, the voices have guided your youthful chariot, worthy of this host.

children.text: ā vām patitvaṃ sakhyāya jagmuṣī yoṣāvṛṇīta jenyā yuvām patī ||
children.translated_text: The maiden, having come to you for lordship and friendship, chose you two, conquerors, as husbands.

children.text: yuvaṃ rebham pariṣūter uruṣyatho himena gharmam paritaptam atraye
children.translated_text: You rescue <s>Rebha</s> from confinement; for <s>Atri</s>, heated all around, you made warmth against the cold.

children.text: yuvaṃ śayor avasam pipyathur gavi pra dīrgheṇa vandanas tāry āyuṣā ||
children.translated_text: You made the support of <s>Śayu</s> swell in the cow; through you <s>Vandana</s> crossed over to long life.

children.text: yuvaṃ vandanaṃ nirṛtaṃ jaraṇyayā rathaṃ na dasrā karaṇā sam invathaḥ
children.translated_text: You set <s>Vandana</s>, worn out by old age, in motion, O wonder-workers, as craftsmen set a chariot in order.

children.text: kṣetrād ā vipraṃ janatho vipanyayā pra vām atra vidhate daṃsanā bhuvat ||
children.translated_text: From the field you generated the inspired singer by your insight; here your wondrous deed has come forth for the worshiper.

children.text: agacchataṃ kṛpamāṇam parāvati pituḥ svasya tyajasā nibādhitam
children.translated_text: You came to the lamenting one in the distance, pressed down by the abandonment of his own father.

children.text: svarvatīr ita ūtīr yuvor aha citrā abhīke abhavann abhiṣṭayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thereupon your bright, sun-bright aids became wonderful desired helps near at hand.

children.text: uta syā vām madhuman makṣikārapan made somasyauśijo huvanyati
children.translated_text: And that honeyed fly of yours made its sound; in the exhilaration of <s>Soma</s>, the son of <s>Uśij</s> calls.

children.text: yuvaṃ dadhīco mana ā vivāsatho 'thā śiraḥ prati vām aśvyaṃ vadat ||
children.translated_text: You two attended to the mind of <s>Dadhīci</s>; then the horse's head spoke for you.

children.text: yuvam pedave puruvāram aśvinā spṛdhāṃ śvetaṃ tarutāraṃ duvasyathaḥ
children.translated_text: For <s>Pedu</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you tended the much-prized white horse, surpassing rivals,

children.text: śaryair abhidyum pṛtanāsu duṣṭaraṃ carkṛtyam indram iva carṣaṇīsaham ||
children.translated_text: hard to overcome in battles, blazing with arrows, whirling, and conquering peoples like <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 120
kā rādhaddhotrāśvinā vāṃ ko vāṃ joṣa ubhayoḥ
children.translated_text: What invocation can satisfy you, O <s>Aśvins</s>? What pleasure belongs to you both?

children.text: kathā vidhāty apracetāḥ ||
children.translated_text: How can an unthinking man perform the rite?

children.text: vidvāṃsāv id duraḥ pṛcched avidvān itthāparo acetāḥ
children.translated_text: Only a knowing man should ask after the doors; the unknowing, the other one, is thus without understanding.

children.text: nū cin nu marte akrau ||
children.translated_text: Even now among mortals he has accomplished nothing.

children.text: tā vidvāṃsā havāmahe vāṃ tā no vidvāṃsā manma vocetam adya
children.translated_text: We call upon you two as knowing ones; may you two knowing ones speak our thought today.

children.text: prārcad dayamāno yuvākuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The young worshiper, seeking your favor, has sung forth.

children.text: vi pṛcchāmi pākyā na devān vaṣaṭkṛtasyādbhutasya dasrā
children.translated_text: I ask the gods, as it were, about the cooked offering, O wondrous <s>Dasras</s>, about the vaṣaṭ-call.

children.text: pātaṃ ca sahyaso yuvaṃ ca rabhyaso naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Protect us from the overpowering one, and you two protect us from the assailant.

children.text: pra yā ghoṣe bhṛgavāṇe na śobhe yayā vācā yajati pajriyo vām
children.translated_text: With the cry that shines like a <s>Bhṛgu</s> in proclamation, with the speech by which <s>Pajriya</s> worships you two,

children.text: praiṣayur na vidvān ||
children.translated_text: the knowing sender has sent it forth.

children.text: śrutaṃ gāyatraṃ takavānasyāhaṃ ciddhi rirebhāśvinā vām
children.translated_text: I have heard the gāyatra-song of <s>Takavān</s>; indeed, O <s>Aśvins</s>, the praise is for you two.

children.text: ākṣī śubhas patī dan ||
children.translated_text: The eyes have given it, O lords of splendor.

children.text: yuvaṃ hy āstam maho ran yuvaṃ vā yan niratataṃsatam
children.translated_text: For you two were there in the greatness; and you two, indeed, stretched it out.

children.text: tā no vasū sugopā syātam pātaṃ no vṛkād aghāyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: Be good guardians for us, O rich ones; protect us from the harmful wolf.

children.text: mā kasmai dhātam abhy amitriṇe no mākutrā no gṛhebhyo dhenavo guḥ
children.translated_text: Do not hand us over to any hostile one; let our cows not go away anywhere from our houses,

children.text: stanābhujo aśiśvīḥ ||
children.translated_text: those udder-drinkers, still without calves.

children.text: duhīyan mitradhitaye yuvāku rāye ca no mimītaṃ vājavatyai
children.translated_text: For the friendly-minded young worshiper, milk them; measure out for us wealth rich in prize-winning strength,

children.text: iṣe ca no mimītaṃ dhenumatyai ||
children.translated_text: and measure out for us nourishment rich in milch cows.

children.text: aśvinor asanaṃ ratham anaśvaṃ vājinīvatoḥ
children.translated_text: I sat in the chariot of the <s>Aśvins</s>, the horseless chariot of the two possessors of steeds.

children.text: tenāham bhūri cākana ||
children.translated_text: By that chariot I desired abundance.

children.text: ayaṃ samaha mā tanūhyāte janāṁ anu
children.translated_text: This pleasant chariot for soma-drinking comes close to my body among the people.

children.text: somapeyaṃ sukho rathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: It is a comfortable chariot for drinking soma.

children.text: adha svapnasya nir vide 'bhuñjataś ca revataḥ
children.translated_text: Then I find a release from sleep, and from the prosperous man who does not partake.

children.text: ubhā tā basri naśyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Both of those, like barren cows, perish.

children.text: Chapter 121
kad itthā nṝṃḥ pātraṃ devayatāṃ śravad giro aṅgirasāṃ turaṇyan
children.translated_text: When, indeed, will the vessel of men who seek the gods hear the songs of the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, hastening onward?

children.text: pra yad ānaḍ viśa ā harmyasyoru kraṃsate adhvare yajatraḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the worshipful one has reached the clans, he strides broadly through the dwelling at the sacrifice.

children.text: stambhīddha dyāṃ sa dharuṇam pruṣāyad ṛbhur vājāya draviṇaṃ naro goḥ
children.translated_text: He propped up heaven; as a support he showered down; <s>Ṛbhu</s>, for the prize, won the cow's wealth for men.

children.text: anu svajām mahiṣaś cakṣata vrām menām aśvasya pari mātaraṃ goḥ ||
children.translated_text: The buffalo looked after his own-born one, the great cow, the mare-like female, mother of the horse and of the cow.

children.text: nakṣaddhavam aruṇīḥ pūrvyaṃ rāṭ turo viśām aṅgirasām anu dyūn
children.translated_text: He reached the ruddy ones, the ancient lord, the swift ruler of the clans, following the days of the <s>Aṅgirases</s>.

children.text: takṣad vajraṃ niyutaṃ tastambhad dyāṃ catuṣpade naryāya dvipāde ||
children.translated_text: He fashioned the thunderbolt, the appointed weapon; he propped up heaven for the four-footed and for man, the two-footed.

children.text: asya made svaryaṃ dā ṛtāyāpīvṛtam usriyāṇām anīkam
children.translated_text: In his exhilaration, for the sake of truth, he gave the heavenly light and the enclosed face of the cows.

children.text: yaddha prasarge trikakum nivartad apa druho mānuṣasya duro vaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When, at the outpouring, the three-peaked one turned back, he drove away the deceits and doors of the human foe.

children.text: tubhyam payo yat pitarāv anītāṃ rādhaḥ suretas turaṇe bhuraṇyū
children.translated_text: For you the two parents brought milk, rich favor, well-seeded, O swift and eager one.

children.text: śuci yat te rekṇa āyajanta sabardughāyāḥ paya usriyāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When they offered you the bright treasure, the milk of the ever-milking cow.

children.text: adha pra jajñe taraṇir mamattu pra rocy asyā uṣaso na sūraḥ
children.translated_text: Then the swift one was born forth; he rejoiced, shining out like the sun from that dawn.

children.text: indur yebhir āṣṭa sveduhavyaiḥ sruveṇa siñcañ jaraṇābhi dhāma ||
children.translated_text: The drop, with the well-offered oblations by which he was strengthened, poured with the ladle over the songs and the dwelling.

children.text: svidhmā yad vanadhitir apasyāt sūro adhvare pari rodhanā goḥ
children.translated_text: When the kindling-stick and the forest-axe were seen, the sun at the sacrifice was around the enclosure of the cow.

children.text: yaddha prabhāsi kṛtvyāṁ anu dyūn anarviśe paśviṣe turāya ||
children.translated_text: When you shine forth after the works through the days, for the man without injury, for the possessor of cattle, for the swift one.

children.text: aṣṭā maho diva ādo harī iha dyumnāsāham abhi yodhāna utsam
children.translated_text: From the great heaven you drove the two bays here, O conqueror of brightness, against the battling spring.

children.text: hariṃ yat te mandinaṃ dukṣan vṛdhe gorabhasam adribhir vātāpyam ||
children.translated_text: When the stones milked for your increase the tawny, exhilarating, cow-strong, wind-swift drink.

children.text: tvam āyasam prati vartayo gor divo aśmānam upanītam ṛbhvā
children.translated_text: You turned back the iron thing of the cow, the stone of heaven brought near, O <s>Ṛbhvan</s>.

children.text: kutsāya yatra puruhūta vanvañchuṣṇam anantaiḥ pariyāsi vadhaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: When, O much-invoked one, winning for <s>Kutsa</s>, you surrounded <s>Śuṣṇa</s> with endless weapons.

children.text: purā yat sūras tamaso apītes tam adrivaḥ phaligaṃ hetim asya
children.translated_text: When before, O stone-wielder, the sun was hidden in darkness, that missile of his became a splitter.

children.text: śuṣṇasya cit parihitaṃ yad ojo divas pari sugrathitaṃ tad ādaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even the strength of <s>Śuṣṇa</s>, which had been set around and firmly bound from heaven, you took away.

children.text: anu tvā mahī pājasī acakre dyāvākṣāmā madatām indra karman
children.translated_text: The two great powers, heaven and earth, attended upon you; let them rejoice in your deed, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ vṛtram āśayānaṃ sirāsu maho vajreṇa siṣvapo varāhum ||
children.translated_text: With your great thunderbolt you made <s>Vṛtra</s>, lying in the streams, sleep like a boar.

children.text: tvam indra naryo yāṁ avo nṝn tiṣṭhā vātasya suyujo vahiṣṭhān
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, are the manly aid by which you stand by men, the best carriers, well-yoked like the wind.

children.text: yaṃ te kāvya uśanā mandinaṃ dād vṛtrahaṇam pāryaṃ tatakṣa vajram ||
children.translated_text: The inspiring <s>Uśanā</s> gave you that exhilarating thunderbolt, the <s>Vṛtra</s>-slaying, far-reaching weapon, and fashioned it.

children.text: tvaṃ sūro harito rāmayo nṝn bharac cakram etaśo nāyam indra
children.translated_text: You set the sun's tawny horses in motion for men; <s>Etaśa</s> bore the wheel, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: prāsya pāraṃ navatiṃ nāvyānām api kartam avartayo 'yajyūn ||
children.translated_text: You turned the ninety navigable streams beyond their farther bank, and the non-sacrificers into the pit.

children.text: tvaṃ no asyā indra durhaṇāyāḥ pāhi vajrivo duritād abhīke
children.translated_text: Protect us, O <s>Indra</s>, wielder of the thunderbolt, from this hard-to-overcome distress, from evil close at hand.

children.text: pra no vājān rathyo aśvabudhyān iṣe yandhi śravase sūnṛtāyai ||
children.translated_text: Set forward for us prizes, chariot-winning and awakening the horses, for nourishment, fame, and kindly speech.

children.text: mā sā te asmat sumatir vi dasad vājapramahaḥ sam iṣo varanta
children.translated_text: Let that gracious thought of yours not be severed from us; may the prize-winning powers together choose our nourishments.

children.text: ā no bhaja maghavan goṣv aryo maṃhiṣṭhās te sadhamādaḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: Share with us, O bountiful one, among the cows of the noble man; may we be your most generous companions in the feast.

children.text: Chapter 122
pra vaḥ pāntaṃ raghumanyavo 'ndho yajñaṃ rudrāya mīﾱhuṣe bharadhvam
children.translated_text: Forward your swift-minded drink; bring the offering to bountiful <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: divo astoṣy asurasya vīrair iṣudhyeva maruto rodasyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: I will praise the mighty lord from heaven with his heroes, the <s>Maruts</s>, like an archer between the two worlds.

children.text: patnīva pūrvahūtiṃ vāvṛdhadhyā uṣāsānaktā purudhā vidāne
children.translated_text: Like a wife, may <s>Uṣasānaktā</s>, dawn and night, increase the first invocation, being known in many ways.

children.text: starīr nātkaṃ vyutaṃ vasānā sūryasya śriyā sudṛśī hiraṇyaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Clothing themselves in an outspread woven garment, fair to see with the sun's beauty and with golden ornaments.

children.text: mamattu naḥ parijmā vasarhā mamattu vāto apāṃ vṛṣaṇvān
children.translated_text: May the all-surrounding one, the winner of the day, rejoice in us; may the wind, rich in the waters' virility, rejoice in us.

children.text: śiśītam indrāparvatā yuvaṃ nas tan no viśve varivasyantu devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Sharpen us, you two, <s>Indra</s> and <s>Parvata</s>; may all the gods open wide space for us.

children.text: uta tyā me yaśasā śvetanāyai vyantā pāntauśijo huvadhyai
children.translated_text: And those two famous ones of mine, bright for <s>Śvetanā</s>, the two <s>Auśijas</s>, are to be invoked for protection.

children.text: pra vo napātam apāṃ kṛṇudhvam pra mātarā rāspinasyāyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: Proclaim for yourselves the offspring of the waters; proclaim the two mothers of the flowing race.

children.text: ā vo ruvaṇyum auśijo huvadhyai ghoṣeva śaṃsam arjunasya naṃśe
children.translated_text: I call the roaring <s>Auśija</s> for you; with a cry like a proclamation, I praise the share of the bright one.

children.text: pra vaḥ pūṣṇe dāvana āṃ acchā voceya vasutātim agneḥ ||
children.translated_text: I would speak for you toward generous <s>Pūṣan</s>; I would speak toward the wealth-giving of <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: śrutam me mitrāvaruṇā havemota śrutaṃ sadane viśvataḥ sīm
children.translated_text: Hear my call, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; hear it too in the seat, on every side.

children.text: śrotu naḥ śroturātiḥ suśrotuḥ sukṣetrā sindhur adbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May good hearing, the gift of hearing, hear us well; may <s>Sindhu</s>, rich in good fields, hear us with the waters.

children.text: stuṣe sā vāṃ varuṇa mitra rātir gavāṃ śatā pṛkṣayāmeṣu pajre
children.translated_text: I praise that gift of yours, O <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Mitra</s>, of a hundred cows among the mixed offerings for <s>Pajra</s>.

children.text: śrutarathe priyarathe dadhānāḥ sadyaḥ puṣṭiṃ nirundhānāso agman ||
children.translated_text: Bearing immediate prosperity in the well-heard chariot and the beloved chariot, they have come, restraining want.

children.text: asya stuṣe mahimaghasya rādhaḥ sacā sanema nahuṣaḥ suvīrāḥ
children.translated_text: I praise the gift of this very bounteous one; together may we win good heroes among the <s>Nahuṣas</s>,

children.text: jano yaḥ pajrebhyo vājinīvān aśvāvato rathino mahyaṃ sūriḥ ||
children.translated_text: the man who is rich in prizes for the <s>Pajras</s>, with horses and chariots, a generous patron for me.

children.text: jano yo mitrāvaruṇāv abhidhrug apo na vāṃ sunoty akṣṇayādhruk
children.translated_text: The man who is treacherous toward you, O <s>Mitra-Varuṇa</s>, crooked, does not press the waters for you, crooked in his sight;

children.text: svayaṃ sa yakṣmaṃ hṛdaye ni dhatta āpa yad īṃ hotrābhir ṛtāvā ||
children.translated_text: he himself sets wasting sickness in his heart, when the truth-keeper has won the waters through the priestly rites.

children.text: sa vrādhato nahuṣo daṃsujūtaḥ śardhastaro narāṃ gūrtaśravāḥ
children.translated_text: That <s>Nahuṣa</s>, impelled by the liberal giver, surpassing the hosts of men, famed by loud praise,

children.text: visṛṣṭarātir yāti bāﾱhasṛtvā viśvāsu pṛtsu sadam icchūraḥ ||
children.translated_text: goes with gifts released, with strong impulse, ever a hero in all battles.

children.text: adha gmantā nahuṣo havaṃ sūreḥ śrotā rājāno amṛtasya mandrāḥ
children.translated_text: Then come to the call of the patron among the <s>Nahuṣas</s>, O delightful kings, hearers of the immortal one,

children.text: nabhojuvo yan niravasya rādhaḥ praśastaye mahinā rathavate ||
children.translated_text: when the sky-born ones bring forth the gift of the destitute man for praise, with greatness, to the charioted lord.

children.text: etaṃ śardhaṃ dhāma yasya sūrer ity avocan daśatayasya naṃśe
children.translated_text: "This is the host, this is the dwelling of that patron," they said at the share of <s>Daśataya</s>;

children.text: dyumnāni yeṣu vasutātī rāran viśve sanvantu prabhṛtheṣu vājam ||
children.translated_text: among them they have granted splendors in the winning of goods; may all win the prize at the offerings.

children.text: mandāmahe daśatayasya dhāser dvir yat pañca bibhrato yanty annā
children.translated_text: We rejoice in the support of <s>Daśataya</s>, when twice five, bearing food, go forth;

children.text: kim iṣṭāśva iṣṭaraśmir eta īśānāsas taruṣa ṛñjate nṝn ||
children.translated_text: what are these lords, with desired horses and desired reins, doing as they stir men to conquest?

children.text: hiraṇyakarṇam maṇigrīvam arṇas tan no viśve varivasyantu devāḥ
children.translated_text: The golden-eared, jewel-necked flood: may all the gods make that wide space for us;

children.text: aryo giraḥ sadya ā jagmuṣīr osrāś cākantūbhayeṣv asme ||
children.translated_text: may the noble songs that have come at once, and the bright cows, be pleased with both portions for us.

children.text: catvāro mā maśarśārasya śiśvas trayo rājña āyavasasya jiṣṇoḥ
children.translated_text: Four young ones of <s>Maśarśāra</s> are mine, and three of victorious king <s>Āyavasa</s>;

children.text: ratho vām mitrāvaruṇā dīrghāpsāḥ syūmagabhastiḥ sūro nādyaut ||
