children.translated_text: your chariot, O <s>Mitra-Varuṇa</s>, broad in course, with a well-guiding hand, has shone like the sun.

children.text: Chapter 123
pṛthū ratho dakṣiṇāyā ayojy ainaṃ devāso amṛtāso asthuḥ
children.translated_text: The broad chariot was yoked for the sacrificial gift; the immortal gods stood by it;

children.text: kṛṣṇād ud asthād aryā vihāyāś cikitsantī mānuṣāya kṣayāya ||
children.translated_text: the noble one has risen from the black darkness, clearly perceiving the human dwelling.

children.text: pūrvā viśvasmād bhuvanād abodhi jayantī vājam bṛhatī sanutrī
children.translated_text: Before every being she has awakened, victorious, prize-winning, lofty, ever renewed;

children.text: uccā vy akhyad yuvatiḥ punarbhūr oṣā agan prathamā pūrvahūtau ||
children.translated_text: looking out on high, the young woman born again, <s>Uṣas</s>, has come first at the early invocation.

children.text: yad adya bhāgaṃ vibhajāsi nṛbhya uṣo devi martyatrā sujāte
children.translated_text: When today you apportion the share among men, O goddess <s>Uṣas</s>, well-born among mortals,

children.text: devo no atra savitā damūnā anāgaso vocati sūryāya ||
children.translated_text: may god <s>Savitṛ</s>, lord of the house, declare us here sinless to <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: gṛhaṃ gṛham ahanā yāty acchā dive dive adhi nāmā dadhānā
children.translated_text: House after house she goes each day, day after day taking names upon herself;

children.text: siṣāsantī dyotanā śaśvad āgād agram agram id bhajate vasūnām ||
children.translated_text: eager to win, shining, she has come forever; she takes the first portion of treasures.

children.text: bhagasya svasā varuṇasya jāmir uṣaḥ sūnṛte prathamā jarasva
children.translated_text: Sister of <s>Bhaga</s>, kinswoman of <s>Varuṇa</s>, O truthful <s>Uṣas</s>, be praised first;

children.text: paścā sa daghyā yo aghasya dhātā jayema taṃ dakṣiṇayā rathena ||
children.translated_text: let him who is the maker of evil burn afterward; may we conquer him with a chariot rich in sacrificial gifts.

children.text: ud īratāṃ sūnṛtā ut purandhīr ud agnayaḥ śuśucānāso asthuḥ
children.translated_text: Let true words rise up, and rich thoughts; let the fires, blazing brightly, stand up;

children.text: spārhā vasūni tamasāpagūﾱhāviṣkṛṇvanty uṣaso vibhātīḥ ||
children.translated_text: the shining dawns reveal the desirable goods that were hidden away by darkness.

children.text: apānyad ety abhy anyad eti viṣurūpe ahanī saṃ carete
children.translated_text: One goes away, another comes toward us; the two days, different in form, move together;

children.text: parikṣitos tamo anyā guhākar adyaud uṣāḥ śośucatā rathena ||
children.translated_text: one has made bounded darkness its secret place; <s>Uṣas</s> has shone with her radiant chariot.

children.text: sadṛśīr adya sadṛśīr id u śvo dīrghaṃ sacante varuṇasya dhāma
children.translated_text: Alike today and indeed alike tomorrow, they long accompany the ordinance of <s>Varuṇa</s>;

children.text: anavadyās triṃśataṃ yojanāny ekaikā kratum pari yanti sadyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: blameless, each one at once passes around thirty yojanas by its resolve.

children.text: jānaty ahnaḥ prathamasya nāma śukrā kṛṣṇād ajaniṣṭa śvitīcī
children.translated_text: She knows the name of the first day; bright and shining white, she was born from the black;

children.text: ṛtasya yoṣā na mināti dhāmāhar ahar niṣkṛtam ācarantī ||
children.translated_text: the young woman of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) does not violate its ordinances, going forth day after day according to what is established.

children.text: kanyeva tanvā śāśadānāṃ eṣi devi devam iyakṣamāṇam
children.translated_text: Like a maiden adorning her body, you go, O goddess, wishing to meet the god;

children.text: saṃsmayamānā yuvatiḥ purastād āvir vakṣāṃsi kṛṇuṣe vibhātī ||
children.translated_text: smiling, a young woman in front, shining, you lay bare your breasts.

children.text: susaṃkāśā mātṛmṛṣṭeva yoṣāvis tanvaṃ kṛṇuṣe dṛśe kam
children.translated_text: Easy to behold, like a woman cleansed by her mother, you reveal your body for sight;

children.text: bhadrā tvam uṣo vitaraṃ vy uccha na tat te anyā uṣaso naśanta ||
children.translated_text: auspicious are you, O <s>Uṣas</s>; shine farther out. Other dawns have not attained what is yours.

children.text: aśvāvatīr gomatīr viśvavārā yatamānā raśmibhiḥ sūryasya
children.translated_text: Rich in horses, rich in cows, all-desirable, striving with the rays of <s>Sūrya</s>,

children.text: parā ca yanti punar ā ca yanti bhadrā nāma vahamānā uṣāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the dawns go away and come back again, bearing an auspicious name.

children.text: ṛtasya raśmim anuyacchamānā bhadram bhadraṃ kratum asmāsu dhehi
children.translated_text: Following the ray of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), place good and still better resolve in us;

children.text: uṣo no adya suhavā vy ucchāsmāsu rāyo maghavatsu ca syuḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, easily invoked, shine forth for us today; may riches be among us and among the generous.

children.text: Chapter 124
uṣā ucchantī samidhāne agnā udyan sūrya urviyā jyotir aśret
children.translated_text: As <s>Uṣas</s> shines while <s>Agni</s> is kindled, as <s>Sūrya</s> rises, light has spread widely;

children.text: devo no atra savitā nv artham prāsāvīd dvipat pra catuṣpad ityai ||
children.translated_text: may god <s>Savitṛ</s> now impel our purpose here, so that biped and quadruped may go forth.

children.text: aminatī daivyāni vratāni praminatī manuṣyā yugāni
children.translated_text: Not violating the divine ordinances, yet diminishing the generations of human beings,

children.text: īyuṣīṇām upamā śaśvatīnām āyatīnām prathamoṣā vy adyaut ||
children.translated_text: <s>Uṣas</s>, the likeness of those that have gone, the first of the eternal ones and of those to come, has shone out.

children.text: eṣā divo duhitā praty adarśi jyotir vasānā samanā purastāt
children.translated_text: This daughter of heaven has appeared, clothed in light, standing alike in front;

children.text: ṛtasya panthām anv eti sādhu prajānatīva na diśo mināti ||
children.translated_text: she follows well the path of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order); knowing the regions, as it were, she does not transgress them.

children.text: upo adarśi śundhyuvo na vakṣo nodhā ivāvir akṛta priyāṇi
children.translated_text: She has shown herself like the breast of a woman made pure; like a singer she has made her beloved forms manifest.

children.text: admasan na sasato bodhayantī śaśvattamāgāt punar eyuṣīṇām ||
children.translated_text: Awakening those who sleep, she has come, the most constant of those who return again.

children.text: pūrve ardhe rajaso aptyasya gavāṃ janitry akṛta pra ketum
children.translated_text: In the former half of the watery midspace, the mother of the cows has made her signal;

children.text: vy u prathate vitaraṃ varīya obhā pṛṇantī pitror upasthā ||
children.translated_text: she spreads out wider and broader, filling both laps of her two parents.

children.text: eved eṣā purutamā dṛśe kaṃ nājāmiṃ na pari vṛṇakti jāmim
children.translated_text: Thus this most manifold one is for seeing; she does not reject the stranger, nor does she reject the kinsman;

children.text: arepasā tanvā śāśadānā nārbhād īṣate na maho vibhātī ||
children.translated_text: shining with unstained body, she does not disdain the small nor the great.

children.text: abhrāteva puṃsa eti pratīcī gartārug iva sanaye dhanānām
children.translated_text: Like a brotherless maiden she comes facing a man, like one climbing from a pit for the winning of wealth;

children.text: jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsā uṣā hasreva ni riṇīte apsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like a wife desirous of her husband, well-robed, <s>Uṣas</s>, smiling, reveals her beauty.

children.text: svasā svasre jyāyasyai yonim āraig apaity asyāḥ praticakṣyeva
children.translated_text: The sister has yielded the place to her elder sister; she departs as if seen face to face by her;

children.text: vyucchantī raśmibhiḥ sūryasyāñjy aṅkte samanagā iva vrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: dawning with the rays of <s>Sūrya</s>, she adorns herself, like women going together.

children.text: āsām pūrvāsām ahasu svasṝṇām aparā pūrvām abhy eti paścāt
children.translated_text: Of these earlier sister dawns in the days, the later one follows the earlier from behind.

children.text: tāḥ pratnavan navyasīr nūnam asme revad ucchantu sudinā uṣāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May these dawns, ancient in manner yet newer now, shine for us richly as good days, O <s>Uṣases</s>.

children.text: pra bodhayoṣaḥ pṛṇato maghony abudhyamānāḥ paṇayaḥ sasantu
children.translated_text: Awaken the liberal giver, O bountiful <s>Uṣas</s>; let the unawakened <s>Paṇis</s> sleep on.

children.text: revad uccha maghavadbhyo maghoni revat stotre sūnṛte jārayantī ||
children.translated_text: Shine richly for the wealthy, O bountiful one; richly, O true-speaking one, stir the singer to life.

children.text: aveyam aśvaid yuvatiḥ purastād yuṅkte gavām aruṇānām anīkam
children.translated_text: This young woman has come forward with horses; she yokes the front rank of the ruddy cows.

children.text: vi nūnam ucchād asati pra ketur gṛhaṃ gṛham upa tiṣṭhāte agniḥ ||
children.translated_text: Now she will shine out; the sign will appear. <s>Agni</s> takes his stand at house after house.

children.text: ut te vayaś cid vasater apaptan naraś ca ye pitubhājo vyuṣṭau
children.translated_text: Even the birds have flown up from their dwelling, and the men who share in food at the daybreak.

children.text: amā sate vahasi bhūri vāmam uṣo devi dāśuṣe martyāya ||
children.translated_text: At home you carry much desirable wealth for the giving mortal, O goddess <s>Uṣas</s>.

children.text: astoḍhvaṃ stomyā brahmaṇā me 'vīvṛdhadhvam uśatīr uṣāsaḥ
children.translated_text: You have been praised; with my laudable sacred utterance you have grown strong, O eager dawns.

children.text: yuṣmākaṃ devīr avasā sanema sahasriṇaṃ ca śatinaṃ ca vājam ||
children.translated_text: By your aid, O goddesses, may we win a prize of thousands and of hundreds.

children.text: Chapter 125
prātā ratnam prātaritvā dadhāti taṃ cikitvān pratigṛhyā ni dhatte
children.translated_text: In the morning the early comer gives treasure; the discerning one receives it and lays it away.

children.text: tena prajāṃ vardhayamāna āyū rāyas poṣeṇa sacate suvīraḥ ||
children.translated_text: With it, increasing offspring and length of life, he is joined with the nurture of wealth, rich in heroes.

children.text: sugur asat suhiraṇyaḥ svaśvo bṛhad asmai vaya indro dadhāti
children.translated_text: May he be easy to approach, rich in gold and rich in horses; <s>Indra</s> grants him broad vigor,

children.text: yas tvāyantaṃ vasunā prātaritvo mukṣījayeva padim utsināti ||
children.translated_text: when, O early comer, he cuts loose with wealth the one who comes to you, as one releases a man from a foot-fetter.

children.text: āyam adya sukṛtam prātar icchann iṣṭeḥ putraṃ vasumatā rathena
children.translated_text: May this man today, seeking good action in the morning, come to the sacrifice with a wealth-bearing chariot, as a son of worship.

children.text: aṃśoḥ sutam pāyaya matsarasya kṣayadvīraṃ vardhaya sūnṛtābhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Give him to drink the pressed, exhilarating draught of <s>Soma</s>; increase the lord rich in heroes with fair praises.

children.text: upa kṣaranti sindhavo mayobhuva ījānaṃ ca yakṣyamāṇaṃ ca dhenavaḥ
children.translated_text: The joy-bringing rivers flow near, and the milch cows near the man who has sacrificed and who is about to sacrifice.

children.text: pṛṇantaṃ ca papuriṃ ca śravasyavo ghṛtasya dhārā upa yanti viśvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Toward the one who fills and is filled, seeking renown, streams of ghee come from every side.

children.text: nākasya pṛṣṭhe adhi tiṣṭhati śrito yaḥ pṛṇāti sa ha deveṣu gacchati
children.translated_text: He who gives stands established upon the back of heaven; he indeed goes among the gods.

children.text: tasmā āpo ghṛtam arṣanti sindhavas tasmā iyaṃ dakṣiṇā pinvate sadā ||
children.translated_text: For him the waters and rivers pour ghee; for him this <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial gift) swells forever.

children.text: dakṣiṇāvatām id imāni citrā dakṣiṇāvatāṃ divi sūryāsaḥ
children.translated_text: These bright things belong to those with <s>dakṣiṇā</s>; the suns in heaven belong to those with <s>dakṣiṇā</s>.

children.text: dakṣiṇāvanto amṛtam bhajante dakṣiṇāvantaḥ pra tiranta āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those with <s>dakṣiṇā</s> share in immortality; those with <s>dakṣiṇā</s> extend their span of life.

children.text: mā pṛṇanto duritam ena āran mā jāriṣuḥ sūrayaḥ suvratāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the givers not come into this evil; let the well-vowed patrons not fall into decay.

children.text: anyas teṣām paridhir astu kaś cid apṛṇantam abhi saṃ yantu śokāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let some other boundary be theirs; let sorrows come together against the one who does not give.

children.text: Chapter 126
amandān stomān pra bhare manīṣā sindhāv adhi kṣiyato bhāvyasya
children.translated_text: With inspired thought I bring unwearied hymns for <s>Bhāvya</s>, who dwells beside the <s>Sindhu</s>,

children.text: yo me sahasram amimīta savān atūrto rājā śrava icchamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the unconquered king who measured out a thousand rewards for me, desiring renown.

children.text: śataṃ rājño nādhamānasya niṣkāñchatam aśvān prayatān sadya ādam
children.translated_text: At once I received a hundred necklaces from king <s>Nādhamāna</s>, a hundred well-presented horses,

children.text: śataṃ kakṣīvāṁ asurasya gonāṃ divi śravo 'jaram ā tatāna ||
children.translated_text: and a hundred cows of the lordly one; <s>Kakṣīvān</s> stretched imperishable fame up to heaven.

children.text: upa mā śyāvāḥ svanayena dattā vadhūmanto daśa rathāso asthuḥ
children.translated_text: Ten dark-colored chariots, given by <s>Svanaya</s> and furnished with brides, stood near me.

children.text: ṣaṣṭiḥ sahasram anu gavyam āgāt sanat kakṣīvāṁ abhipitve ahnām ||
children.translated_text: Sixty thousand followed as cattle wealth; <s>Kakṣīvān</s> of old came at the close of the days.

children.text: catvāriṃśad daśarathasya śoṇāḥ sahasrasyāgre śreṇiṃ nayanti
children.translated_text: Forty red horses of <s>Daśaratha</s> lead the line in front of the thousand.

children.text: madacyutaḥ kṛśanāvato atyān kakṣīvanta ud amṛkṣanta pajrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The exhilarating coursers of <s>Kṛśanāvat</s> were rubbed down by the <s>Pajras</s>, by the <s>Kakṣīvants</s>.

children.text: pūrvām anu prayatim ā dade vas trīn yuktāṁ aṣṭāv aridhāyaso gāḥ
children.translated_text: Following the former offering, I received from you three yoked teams and eight cows that were not to be checked.

children.text: subandhavo ye viśyā iva vrā anasvantaḥ śrava aiṣanta pajrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those good kinsmen, like clans set loose, the wagon-bearing <s>Pajras</s>, sought renown.

children.text: āgadhitā parigadhitā yā kaśīkeva jaṅgahe
children.translated_text: She who is clasped, enclosed, who clings like a <s>Kaśīkā</s>,

children.text: dadāti mahyaṃ yādurī yāśūnām bhojyā śatā ||
children.translated_text: that <s>Yādurī</s> gives me hundreds, the enjoyable wealth of the swift ones.

children.text: upopa me parā mṛśa mā me dabhrāṇi manyathāḥ
children.translated_text: Come close to me; touch me all over. Do not think my small parts insignificant.

children.text: sarvāham asmi romaśā gandhārīṇām ivāvikā ||
children.translated_text: I am hairy all over, like a ewe among the <s>Gandhārīs</s>.

children.text: Chapter 127
agniṃ hotāram manye dāsvantaṃ vasuṃ sūnuṃ sahaso jātavedasaṃ vipraṃ na jātavedasam
children.translated_text: I regard <s>Agni</s> as the <s>Hotṛ</s> (ritual priest), the giving wealth, the son of strength, <s>Jātavedas</s>, an inspired one like <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: ya ūrdhvayā svadhvaro devo devācyā kṛpā
children.translated_text: He is the god of good rites, with upward, godward form;

children.text: ghṛtasya vibhrāṣṭim anu vaṣṭi śociṣājuhvānasya sarpiṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with his flame he longs for the gleam of ghee, for the clarified butter being poured.

children.text: yajiṣṭhaṃ tvā yajamānā huvema jyeṣṭham aṅgirasāṃ vipra manmabhir viprebhiḥ śukra manmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: You, most fit for sacrifice, may we sacrificers invoke with our thoughts, the eldest of the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, O inspired, bright one, with inspired thoughts.

children.text: parijmānam iva dyāṃ hotāraṃ carṣaṇīnām
children.translated_text: You circle around like heaven, the <s>Hotṛ</s> of the peoples,

children.text: śociṣkeśaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ yam imā viśaḥ prāvantu jūtaye viśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: flame-haired and virile; may these clans impel you for help, the clans for strong urging.

children.text: sa hi purū cid ojasā virukmatā dīdyāno bhavati druhantaraḥ paraśur na druhantaraḥ
children.translated_text: For by his power, shining with many ornaments, he becomes a cleaver of wood, like an axe, a cleaver of wood.

children.text: vīﾱu cid yasya samṛtau śruvad vaneva yat sthiram
children.translated_text: In his onrush even the solid thing is heard, like what is firm in a forest.

children.text: niḥṣahamāṇo yamate nāyate dhanvāsahā nāyate ||
children.translated_text: Overpowering, he stretches out; he is not led away. With the bow he is unconquered; he is not led away.

children.text: dṛﾱhā cid asmā anu dur yathā vide tejiṣṭhābhir araṇibhir dāṣṭy avase 'gnaye dāṣṭy avase
children.translated_text: Even hard things, as is known, he bites through with the sharpest fire-sticks for aid, he bites through for <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: pra yaḥ purūṇi gāhate takṣad vaneva śociṣā
children.translated_text: He who plunges through many things, cutting with flame as through a forest,

children.text: sthirā cid annā ni riṇāty ojasā ni sthirāṇi cid ojasā ||
children.translated_text: drives down even firm foods by his force, even firm things by his force.

children.text: tam asya pṛkṣam uparāsu dhīmahi naktaṃ yaḥ sudarśataro divātarād aprāyuṣe divātarāt
children.translated_text: We set this nourishment of his in the upper places, for by night he is fairer to behold than by day, fairer than by day for the one whose life is not spent.

children.text: ād asyāyur grabhaṇavad vīﾱu śarma na sūnave
children.translated_text: Then his life has a firm shelter, like a grasping hold, for the son.

children.text: bhaktam abhaktam avo vyanto ajarā agnayo vyanto ajarāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The ageless fires spread protection over both the apportioned and the unapportioned share.

children.text: sa hi śardho na mārutaṃ tuviṣvaṇir apnasvatīṣūrvarāsv iṣṭanir ārtanāsv iṣṭaniḥ
children.translated_text: For he, like the host of the <s>Maruts</s>, is mighty in sound, striking in fertile fields, striking in battles.

children.text: ādaddhavyāny ādadir yajñasya ketur arhaṇā
children.translated_text: He takes the oblations; he takes them up, the signal of the sacrifice, worthy of honor.

children.text: adha smāsya harṣato hṛṣīvato viśve juṣanta panthāṃ naraḥ śubhe na panthām ||
children.translated_text: Then all men gladly accept the path of him who rejoices and thrills, as a fair path.

children.text: dvitā yad īṃ kīstāso abhidyavo namasyanta upavocanta bhṛgavo mathnanto dāśā bhṛgavaḥ
children.translated_text: When, in two ways, the bright and pious ones worshiped him and spoke to him, the <s>Bhṛgus</s>, rubbing him forth, the serving <s>Bhṛgus</s>,

children.text: agnir īśe vasūnāṃ śucir yo dharṇir eṣām
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> rules over riches, the pure one who is their support.

children.text: priyāṁ apidhīṃr vaniṣīṣṭa medhira ā vaniṣīṣṭa medhiraḥ ||
children.translated_text: The wise one would win the dear hidden covering; he would win it for himself, the wise one.

children.text: viśvāsāṃ tvā viśām patiṃ havāmahe sarvāsāṃ samānaṃ dampatim bhuje satyagirvāhasam bhuje
children.translated_text: We call upon you as lord of all clans, as the common master of every settlement, for enjoyment, bearer of true songs, for enjoyment.

children.text: atithim mānuṣāṇām pitur na yasyāsayā
children.translated_text: We call you the guest of human beings, like a father, by whose mouth

children.text: amī ca viśve amṛtāsa ā vayo havyā deveṣv ā vayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: all these immortals come to the oblations among the gods, like birds coming to food.

children.text: tvam agne sahasā sahantamaḥ śuṣmintamo jāyase devatātaye rayir na devatātaye
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are born with might, mightiest and most vigorous, for the service of the gods, like wealth for the service of the gods.

children.text: śuṣmintamo hi te mado dyumnintama uta kratuḥ
children.translated_text: For your exhilaration is most vigorous, and your insight too is most splendid.

children.text: adha smā te pari caranty ajara śruṣṭīvāno nājara ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, O undecaying one, the obedient ones attend upon you like ageless beings.

children.text: pra vo mahe sahasā sahasvata uṣarbudhe paśuṣe nāgnaye stomo babhūtv agnaye
children.translated_text: Let your hymn go forth to great, mighty <s>Agni</s>, strong in might, awakened at dawn, watchful like a herdsman, to <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: prati yad īṃ haviṣmān viśvāsu kṣāsu joguve
children.translated_text: When the oblation-bearing man calls repeatedly to him in all dwellings,

children.text: agre rebho na jarata ṛṣūṇāṃ jūrṇir hota ṛṣūṇām ||
children.translated_text: at the forefront, like a singer, the hotar of the seers chants, an aged priest of the seers.

children.text: sa no nediṣṭhaṃ dadṛśāna ā bharāgne devebhiḥ sacanāḥ sucetunā maho rāyaḥ sucetunā
children.translated_text: Seen by us, bring us the nearest great wealth, O <s>Agni</s>, in fellowship with the gods and with good understanding, great wealth with good understanding.

children.text: mahi śaviṣṭha nas kṛdhi saṃcakṣe bhuje asyai
children.translated_text: Make us great, O mightiest one, for common vision and for this enjoyment.

children.text: mahi stotṛbhyo maghavan suvīryam mathīr ugro na śavasā ||
children.translated_text: Make great heroic strength for the singers, O bountiful one; overpower with force like a fierce one with might.

children.text: Chapter 128
ayaṃ jāyata manuṣo dharīmaṇi hotā yajiṣṭha uśijām anu vratam agniḥ svam anu vratam
children.translated_text: This <s>Agni</s> was born in the place held by man, the best-sacrificing hotar, according to the ordinance of the eager ones, according to his own ordinance.

children.text: viśvaśruṣṭiḥ sakhīyate rayir iva śravasyate
children.translated_text: Obeyed by all, he seeks friendship; like wealth, he seeks renown.

children.text: adabdho hotā ni ṣadad iﾱas pade parivīta iﾱas pade ||
children.translated_text: The unassailable hotar sat down in the place of <s>Iḷā</s>, enclosed in the place of <s>Iḷā</s>.

children.text: taṃ yajñasādham api vātayāmasy ṛtasya pathā namasā haviṣmatā devatātā haviṣmatā
children.translated_text: Him, the accomplisher of sacrifice, we set in motion along the path of truth, with reverence and with oblation, in the service of the gods with oblation.

children.text: sa na ūrjām upābhṛty ayā kṛpā na jūryati
children.translated_text: Bringing nourishment near to us, by this favor he does not grow old.

children.text: yam mātariśvā manave parāvato devam bhāḥ parāvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: He whom <s>Mātariśvan</s> brought from afar for <s>Manu</s>, the shining god from afar.

children.text: evena sadyaḥ pary eti pārthivam muhurgī reto vṛṣabhaḥ kanikradad dadhad retaḥ kanikradat
children.translated_text: In this very way he at once circles the earthly realm, bellowing again and again, the bull depositing seed, depositing seed as he bellows.

children.text: śataṃ cakṣāṇo akṣabhir devo vaneṣu turvaṇiḥ
children.translated_text: The god, seeing with a hundred eyes in the woods, is an overcomer with his eyes.

children.text: sado dadhāna upareṣu sānuṣv agniḥ pareṣu sānuṣu ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> takes his seat on the higher ridges, on the farthest ridges.

children.text: sa sukratuḥ purohito dame dame 'gnir yajñasyādhvarasya cetati kratvā yajñasya cetati
children.translated_text: He, of good insight, the household purohita in every house, <s>Agni</s>, perceives the sacrifice and the rite with his will, perceives the sacrifice with will.

children.text: kratvā vedhā iṣūyate viśvā jātāni paspaśe
children.translated_text: With will the ordainer is impelled; he has touched all created beings.

children.text: yato ghṛtaśrīr atithir ajāyata vahnir vedhā ajāyata ||
children.translated_text: From there the ghee-bright guest was born, the carrier, the ordainer, was born.

children.text: kratvā yad asya taviṣīṣu pṛñcate 'gner aveṇa marutāṃ na bhojyeṣirāya na bhojyā
children.translated_text: When, by his will, his force mingles among strengths, <s>Agni</s>'s aid is like a share at the feast of the <s>Maruts</s>, an impelling aid at the feast.

children.text: sa hi ṣmā dānam invati vasūnāṃ ca majmanā
children.translated_text: For by greatness he urges on the gift of riches.

children.text: sa nas trāsate duritād abhihrutaḥ śaṃsād aghād abhihrutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He protects us from hostile evil, from blame and harmful sin turned against us.

children.text: viśvo vihāyā aratir vasur dadhe haste dakṣiṇe taraṇir na śiśrathacchravasyayā na śiśrathat
children.translated_text: The all-pervading benefactor, the good one, has taken his place in the right hand; like a swift deliverer he did not slacken in pursuit of renown.

children.text: viśvasmā id iṣudhyate devatrā havyam ohiṣe
children.translated_text: For every person he is made sharp; you carry the oblation to the gods.

children.text: viśvasmā it sukṛte vāram ṛṇvaty agnir dvārā vy ṛṇvati ||
children.translated_text: For every well-doer <s>Agni</s> opens the chosen boon; he opens the doors.

children.text: sa mānuṣe vṛjane śantamo hito 'gnir yajñeṣu jenyo na viśpatiḥ priyo yajñeṣu viśpatiḥ
children.translated_text: He, <s>Agni</s>, set in the human settlement as the most peaceful one, is victorious in sacrifices like a lord of the clans, beloved in sacrifices, a lord of the clans.

children.text: sa havyā mānuṣāṇām iﾱā kṛtāni patyate
children.translated_text: He rules over the oblations of human beings, the offerings made with <s>Iḷā</s>.

children.text: sa nas trāsate varuṇasya dhūrter maho devasya dhūrteḥ ||
children.translated_text: He protects us from the deceit of <s>Varuṇa</s>, from the deceit of the great god.

children.text: agniṃ hotāram īﾱate vasudhitim priyaṃ cetiṣṭham aratiṃ ny erire havyavāhaṃ ny erire
children.translated_text: They seek <s>Agni</s> as hotar, the dear treasure-giver, the most attentive messenger; they have set down the oblation-bearer.

children.text: viśvāyuṃ viśvavedasaṃ hotāraṃ yajataṃ kavim
children.translated_text: They have set down the all-living, all-knowing, worshipful hotar, the sage.

children.text: devāso raṇvam avase vasūyavo gīrbhī raṇvaṃ vasūyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The gods, desiring riches, call the delightful one for aid with songs, the wealth-seeking ones call the delightful one with songs.

children.text: Chapter 129
yaṃ tvaṃ ratham indra medhasātaye 'pākā santam iṣira praṇayasi prānavadya nayasi
children.translated_text: The chariot that you, O <s>Indra</s>, guide for the winning of the prize, O impelling one, though it is far away, you lead it faultlessly onward.

children.text: sadyaś cit tam abhiṣṭaye karo vaśaś ca vājinam
children.translated_text: At once you make it obedient for the desired gain and rich in steeds.

children.text: sāsmākam anavadya tūtujāna vedhasām imāṃ vācaṃ na vedhasām ||
children.translated_text: May it, O blameless one, rushing for us, attend to this speech as to the speech of inspired makers.

children.text: sa śrudhi yaḥ smā pṛtanāsu kāsu cid dakṣāyya indra bharahūtaye nṛbhir asi pratūrtaye nṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: Hear him who, in any battles whatever, O <s>Indra</s>, fit for strength and summoned for the prize, is with men for swift advance, with men.

children.text: yaḥ śūraiḥ svaḥ sanitā yo viprair vājaṃ tarutā
children.translated_text: He who with heroes wins the sun, who with inspired poets overcomes the prize,

children.text: tam īśānāsa iradhanta vājinam pṛkṣam atyaṃ na vājinam ||
children.translated_text: the ruling powers have gained that vigorous steed, the prize, like a racing courser.

children.text: dasmo hi ṣmā vṛṣaṇam pinvasi tvacaṃ kaṃ cid yāvīr araruṃ śūra martyam parivṛṇakṣi martyam
children.translated_text: For, wondrous one, you swell the strong one's covering; O hero, you drive away some hostile mortal, you hem in the mortal.

children.text: indrota tubhyaṃ tad dive tad rudrāya svayaśase
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, this I have spoken to you, to heaven, and to self-renowned <s>Rudra</s>,

children.text: mitrāya vocaṃ varuṇāya saprathaḥ sumṛﾱīkāya saprathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: to <s>Mitra</s>, to <s>Varuṇa</s> the far-extending, to the very gracious far-extending one.

children.text: asmākaṃ va indram uśmasīṣṭaye sakhāyaṃ viśvāyum prāsahaṃ yujaṃ vājeṣu prāsahaṃ yujam
children.translated_text: We desire <s>Indra</s> of ours for help, a friend, all-living, overpowering ally, an overpowering ally in contests.

children.text: asmākam brahmotaye 'vā pṛtsuṣu kāsu cit
children.translated_text: For the protection of our prayer, aid us in whatever battles there may be.

children.text: nahi tvā śatru starate stṛṇoṣi yaṃ viśvaṃ śatruṃ stṛṇoṣi yam ||
children.translated_text: No enemy overcomes you; you strike down every enemy whom you strike down.

children.text: ni ṣū namātimatiṃ kayasya cit tejiṣṭhābhir araṇibhir notibhir ugrābhir ugrotibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Now bend down the hostile thought of anyone, with your sharpest supports, with protections, with fierce and mighty protections.

children.text: neṣi ṇo yathā purānenāḥ śūra manyase
children.translated_text: Lead us as you did before, O hero; you regard us as free from guilt.

children.text: viśvāni pūror apa parṣi vahnir āsā vahnir no accha ||
children.translated_text: Carry us past all the forts; as carrier with your mouth, O carrier, come toward us.

children.text: pra tad voceyam bhavyāyendave havyo na ya iṣavān manma rejati rakṣohā manma rejati
children.translated_text: I would proclaim that to the beneficent <s>Indu</s>; like an invoked archer, the thought of the demon-slayer trembles, his thought trembles.

children.text: svayaṃ so asmad ā nido vadhair ajeta durmatim
children.translated_text: He himself, with blows, has conquered for us the reviler and the ill-minded one.

children.text: ava sraved aghaśaṃso 'vataram ava kṣudram iva sravet ||
children.translated_text: Let the evil-speaker flow down lower; let the petty one flow away as if downward.

children.text: vanema taddhotrayā citantyā vanema rayiṃ rayivaḥ suvīryaṃ raṇvaṃ santaṃ suvīryam
children.translated_text: May we win that through thoughtful priestly service; may we win wealth, O wealthy one, heroic strength, delightful and present, heroic strength.

children.text: durmanmānaṃ sumantubhir em iṣā pṛcīmahi
children.translated_text: With good thoughts let us encounter the ill-minded one; let us seek refreshment.

children.text: ā satyābhir indraṃ dyumnahūtibhir yajatraṃ dyumnahūtibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: With true, brilliant invocations, O <s>Indra</s>, we call the worshipful one, with brilliant invocations.

children.text: pra prā vo asme svayaśobhir ūtī parivarga indro durmatīnāṃ darīman durmatīnām
children.translated_text: Send forth, send to us your self-renowned aids; <s>Indra</s> is the remover of evil thoughts, the splitter of evil thoughts.

children.text: svayaṃ sā riṣayadhyai yā na upeṣe atraiḥ
children.translated_text: She herself goes to be harmed, she who does not attend upon us with protections.

children.text: hatem asan na vakṣati kṣiptā jūrṇir na vakṣati ||
children.translated_text: May she be struck down; she will not carry on. Cast away like a worn-out thing, she will not carry on.

children.text: tvaṃ na indra rāyā parīṇasā yāhi pathāṃ anehasā puro yāhy arakṣasā
children.translated_text: Come to us, O <s>Indra</s>, with encompassing wealth, by paths free from injury; go before us on a path free from demons.

children.text: sacasva naḥ parāka ā sacasvāstamīka ā
children.translated_text: Be joined with us when we are far away; be joined with us when we are close to home.

children.text: pāhi no dūrād ārād abhiṣṭibhiḥ sadā pāhy abhiṣṭibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Protect us from far and from near with your aids; always protect us with your aids.

children.text: tvaṃ na indra rāyā tarūṣasograṃ cit tvā mahimā sakṣad avase mahe mitraṃ nāvase
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, come to us with wealth that carries across; even your greatness can overpower the fierce one for our great aid, like a friend for aid.

children.text: ojiṣṭha trātar avitā rathaṃ kaṃ cid amartya
children.translated_text: O strongest protector, helper, immortal one, do not let any chariot or any foe prevail.

children.text: anyam asmad ririṣeḥ kaṃ cid adrivo ririkṣantaṃ cid adrivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Drive away from us any other man, O stone-wielder, even one who wishes to harm us, O stone-wielder.

children.text: pāhi na indra suṣṭuta sridho 'vayātā sadam id durmatīnāṃ devaḥ san durmatīnām
children.translated_text: Protect us, O well-praised <s>Indra</s>, from the attack that brings ruin, always from the evil thoughts of the ill-minded, being a god, from their evil thoughts.

children.text: hantā pāpasya rakṣasas trātā viprasya māvataḥ
children.translated_text: You are the slayer of the evil demon, the protector of the inspired singer who seeks help.

children.text: adhā hi tvā janitā jījanad vaso rakṣohaṇaṃ tvā jījanad vaso ||
children.translated_text: For your begetter begot you, O <s>Vasu</s>; he begot you as a demon-slayer, O <s>Vasu</s>.

children.text: Chapter 130
endra yāhy upa naḥ parāvato nāyam acchā vidathānīva satpatir astaṃ rājeva satpatiḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, come near to us from afar, toward this man, like a good lord to the assemblies, like a king to his home, a good lord.

children.text: havāmahe tvā vayam prayasvantaḥ sute sacā
children.translated_text: We call upon you, bringing offerings, together with the pressed soma.

children.text: putrāso na pitaraṃ vājasātaye maṃhiṣṭhaṃ vājasātaye ||
children.translated_text: Like sons calling a father for the winning of the prize, we call the most bountiful one for the winning of the prize.

children.text: pibā somam indra suvānam adribhiḥ kośena siktam avataṃ na vaṃsagas tātṛṣāṇo na vaṃsagaḥ
children.translated_text: Drink the soma, O <s>Indra</s>, pressed by the stones, sprinkled with the vessel like water in a well, thirsting like one at the trough.

children.text: madāya haryatāya te tuviṣṭamāya dhāyase
children.translated_text: It is for your exhilaration, for your delight, for the draught of you who are mightiest.

children.text: ā tvā yacchantu harito na sūryam ahā viśveva sūryam ||
children.translated_text: Let the tawny horses bring you here as they bring the sun, day by day like the sun.

children.text: avindad divo nihitaṃ guhā nidhiṃ ver na garbham parivītam aśmany anante antar aśmani
children.translated_text: He found the hidden treasure of heaven, set in secret, like the bird's embryo wrapped in stone, within the endless stone.

children.text: vrajaṃ vajrī gavām iva siṣāsann aṅgirastamaḥ
children.translated_text: The thunderbolt-bearer, most like an <s>Angiras</s>, seeking to win the cow-stall,

children.text: apāvṛṇod iṣa indraḥ parīvṛtā dvāra iṣaḥ parīvṛtāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> opened the enclosed doors of nourishment, the doors of nourishment that had been shut around.

children.text: dādṛhāṇo vajram indro gabhastyoḥ kṣadmeva tigmam asanāya saṃ śyad ahihatyāya saṃ śyat
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, holding the thunderbolt in his hands, whetted it like a sharp blade for hurling; he whetted it for serpent-slaying.

children.text: saṃvivyāna ojasā śavobhir indra majmanā
children.translated_text: He wrapped himself in force, with powers and with might, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: taṣṭeva vṛkṣaṃ vanino ni vṛścasi paraśveva ni vṛścasi ||
children.translated_text: Like a carpenter cutting a forest tree, you cut it down; like with an axe, you cut it down.

children.text: tvaṃ vṛthā nadya indra sartave 'cchā samudram asṛjo rathāṁ iva vājayato rathāṁ iva
children.translated_text: Freely, O <s>Indra</s>, you released the rivers to run toward the sea, like chariots, like prize-winning chariots.

children.text: ita ūtīr ayuñjata samānam artham akṣitam
children.translated_text: From here the aids were yoked to one unfailing purpose.

children.text: dhenūr iva manave viśvadohaso janāya viśvadohasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They were like all-milking cows for <s>Manu</s>, all-milking for humankind.

children.text: imāṃ te vācaṃ vasūyanta āyavo rathaṃ na dhīraḥ svapā atakṣiṣuḥ sumnāya tvām atakṣiṣuḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Ayus</s>, seeking wealth, fashioned this speech for you as a skilful craftsman fashions a chariot; they fashioned you for favor.

children.text: śumbhanto jenyaṃ yathā vājeṣu vipra vājinam
children.translated_text: They adorned the conqueror as one adorns, in contests, a prize-winning steed, O inspired one.

children.text: atyam iva śavase sātaye dhanā viśvā dhanāni sātaye ||
children.translated_text: Like a courser for might and for the winning of wealth, for the winning of all treasures.

children.text: bhinat puro navatim indra pūrave divodāsāya mahi dāśuṣe nṛto vajreṇa dāśuṣe nṛto
children.translated_text: You broke ninety forts, O <s>Indra</s>, for <s>Puru</s>, for great, generous <s>Divodasa</s>, O dancer, with the thunderbolt for the generous man.

children.text: atithigvāya śambaraṃ girer ugro avābharat
children.translated_text: For <s>Atithigva</s>, the fierce one brought <s>Sambara</s> down from the mountain.

children.text: maho dhanāni dayamāna ojasā viśvā dhanāny ojasā ||
children.translated_text: He distributed great treasures with his force, all treasures with his force.

children.text: indraḥ samatsu yajamānam āryam prāvad viśveṣu śatamūtir ājiṣu svarmīﾱheṣv ājiṣu
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, with a hundred aids, protected the Aryan sacrificer in battles, in all contests, in the contests for winning the light.

children.text: manave śāsad avratān tvacaṃ kṛṣṇām arandhayat
children.translated_text: For <s>Manu</s> he chastised the vowless ones; he subdued the dark skin.

children.text: dakṣan na viśvaṃ tatṛṣāṇam oṣati ny arśasānam oṣati ||
children.translated_text: Like one who is able, he burns up every thirsty foe; he burns down the one who cries out.

children.text: sūraś cakram pra vṛhaj jāta ojasā prapitve vācam aruṇo muṣāyatīśāna ā muṣāyati
children.translated_text: The sun, born with force, rolled forth the wheel; at the going forth the ruddy one steals away speech, the lord steals it away.

children.text: uśanā yat parāvato 'jagann ūtaye kave
children.translated_text: When <s>Usana</s>, the sage, came from afar for aid,

children.text: sumnāni viśvā manuṣeva turvaṇir ahā viśveva turvaṇiḥ ||
children.translated_text: he brought all favors for man like an overcomer, day by day like an overcomer.

children.text: sa no navyebhir vṛṣakarmann ukthaiḥ purāṃ dartaḥ pāyubhiḥ pāhi śagmaiḥ
children.translated_text: With newer hymns, O bull-worker, breaker of forts, protect us with auspicious protections.

children.text: divodāsebhir indra stavāno vāvṛdhīthā ahobhir iva dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: Being praised through the <s>Divodasas</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, you grew through the days like heaven.

children.text: Chapter 131
indrāya hi dyaur asuro anamnatendrāya mahī pṛthivī varīmabhir dyumnasātā varīmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: For before <s>Indra</s> heaven, the mighty one, bent down; for <s>Indra</s> the broad earth bent with her expanses, for the winning of brightness with her expanses.

children.text: indraṃ viśve sajoṣaso devāso dadhire puraḥ
children.translated_text: All the gods, with one accord, placed <s>Indra</s> in front.

children.text: indrāya viśvā savanāni mānuṣā rātāni santu mānuṣā ||
children.translated_text: Let all human soma-pressings be given to <s>Indra</s>, the human offerings.

children.text: viśveṣu hi tvā savaneṣu tuñjate samānam ekaṃ vṛṣamaṇyavaḥ pṛthak svaḥ saniṣyavaḥ pṛthak
children.translated_text: For in all soma-pressings they urge you on, separately, the same single bull-minded one, separately seeking to win the sun-world.

children.text: taṃ tvā nāvaṃ na parṣaṇiṃ śūṣasya dhuri dhīmahi
children.translated_text: We set you, like a ship for crossing, at the yoke of strength.

children.text: indraṃ na yajñaiś citayanta āyava stomebhir indram āyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Ayus</s> make <s>Indra</s> known with sacrifices, <s>Indra</s> with songs, the <s>Ayus</s> do.

children.text: vi tvā tatasre mithunā avasyavo vrajasya sātā gavyasya niḥsṛjaḥ sakṣanta indra niḥsṛjaḥ
children.translated_text: The paired ones who need help have spread themselves toward you for winning the cattle-stall; release the outlets of the cattle, let them attain them, O <s>Indra</s>, release them.

children.text: yad gavyantā dvā janā svar yantā samūhasi
children.translated_text: When, seeking cattle, the two peoples, seeking the sun-world, you gather together,

children.text: āviṣ karikrad vṛṣaṇaṃ sacābhuvaṃ vajram indra sacābhuvam ||
children.translated_text: make manifest, with a cry, the virile companion-born thunderbolt, O <s>Indra</s>, the companion-born one.

children.text: viduṣ ṭe asya vīryasya pūravaḥ puro yad indra śāradīr avātiraḥ sāsahāno avātiraḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Puravas</s> know this heroic deed of yours, when, O <s>Indra</s>, you overthrew the autumnal forts; conquering, you overthrew them.

children.text: śāsas tam indra martyam ayajyuṃ śavasas pate
children.translated_text: Chastise that mortal, O <s>Indra</s>, the non-sacrificer, O lord of might.

children.text: mahīm amuṣṇāḥ pṛthivīm imā apo mandasāna imā apaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Rejoicing, you seized the great earth and these waters, these waters.

children.text: ād it te asya vīryasya carkiran madeṣu vṛṣann uśijo yad āvitha sakhīyato yad āvitha
children.translated_text: Then they proclaimed this heroic deed of yours in the exhilarations, O bull, when you aided the <s>Usijs</s>, when you aided your companions.

children.text: cakartha kāram ebhyaḥ pṛtanāsu pravantave
children.translated_text: You made the singer ready for them to advance in battles.

children.text: te anyām anyāṃ nadyaṃ saniṣṇata śravasyantaḥ saniṣṇata ||
children.translated_text: Seeking fame, they won one river after another; seeking fame, they won them.

children.text: uto no asyā uṣaso juṣeta hy arkasya bodhi haviṣo havīmabhiḥ svarṣātā havīmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: And may he be pleased with this dawn of ours; awaken to the chant and to the oblation through our calls, in the winning of sunlight through our calls.

children.text: yad indra hantave mṛdho vṛṣā vajriñciketasi
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indra</s>, bull and thunderbolt-wielder, you attend to the smiting of foes,

children.text: ā me asya vedhaso navīyaso manma śrudhi navīyasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: hear this newer thought of mine, this newer inspired utterance of the poet.

children.text: tvaṃ tam indra vāvṛdhāno asmayur amitrayantaṃ tuvijāta martyaṃ vajreṇa śūra martyam
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, growing strong for us, strike that mortal who acts as an enemy, that hostile, strongly-born mortal, O hero, with the thunderbolt.

children.text: jahi yo no aghāyati śṛṇuṣva suśravastamaḥ
children.translated_text: Strike the one who seeks to harm us; hear us, O most renowned.

children.text: riṣṭaṃ na yāmann apa bhūtu durmatir viśvāpa bhūtu durmatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let hostile thought be far away on the journey; let every hostile thought be gone.

children.text: Chapter 132
tvayā vayam maghavan pūrvye dhana indra tvotāḥ sāsahyāma pṛtanyato vanuyāma vanuṣyataḥ
children.translated_text: Through you, O bountiful <s>Indra</s>, protected by you, may we overcome those who fight over the ancient wealth; may we win against those who would win.

children.text: nediṣṭhe asminn ahany adhi vocā nu sunvate
children.translated_text: On this nearest day, speak forth for the soma-presser.

children.text: asmin yajñe vi cayemā bhare kṛtaṃ vājayanto bhare kṛtam ||
children.translated_text: In this sacrifice, in the contest, may we apportion the prize that has been made, striving for the prize that has been made.

children.text: svarjeṣe bhara āprasya vakmany uṣarbudhaḥ svasminn añjasi krāṇasya svasminn añjasi
children.translated_text: For the winning of the sun, in the contest, in the utterance of the one who presses and wakes at dawn, in his own course, in the action of the one who works, in his own course.

children.text: ahann indro yathā vide śīrṣṇā śīrṣṇopavācyaḥ
children.translated_text: As <s>Indra</s> struck, so let it be known; head by head he is to be invoked.

children.text: asmatrā te sadhryak santu rātayo bhadrā bhadrasya rātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let your gifts be directed toward us, good gifts of the good one.

children.text: tat tu prayaḥ pratnathā te śuśukvanaṃ yasmin yajñe vāram akṛṇvata kṣayam ṛtasya vār asi kṣayam
children.translated_text: That former dear offering of yours has shone forth, in which, at the sacrifice, they made an abode, a refuge; you are the refuge of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: vi tad vocer adha dvitāntaḥ paśyanti raśmibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Proclaim that distinctly; then those within see by the rays.

children.text: sa ghā vide anv indro gaveṣaṇo bandhukṣidbhyo gaveṣaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then indeed <s>Indra</s> is known as a seeker of cattle, a seeker of cattle for those who dwell with their kin.

children.text: nū itthā te pūrvathā ca pravācyaṃ yad aṅgirobhyo 'vṛṇor apa vrajam indra śikṣann apa vrajam
children.translated_text: Now this deed of yours, as before, is to be proclaimed: when, O <s>Indra</s>, teaching the <s>Angirases</s>, you opened the enclosure, opened the cattle-pen.

children.text: aibhyaḥ samānyā diśāsmabhyaṃ jeṣi yotsi ca
children.translated_text: Win and fight for them, and for us, along the same direction.

children.text: sunvadbhyo randhayā kaṃ cid avrataṃ hṛṇāyantaṃ cid avratam ||
children.translated_text: For the soma-pressers make subject any vowless man, even an angry vowless man.

children.text: saṃ yaj janān kratubhiḥ śūra īkṣayad dhane hite taruṣanta śravasyavaḥ pra yakṣanta śravasyavaḥ
children.translated_text: When the hero, with his counsels, surveyed the peoples in the appointed prize, the fame-seekers crossed beyond; the fame-seekers advanced.

children.text: tasmā āyuḥ prajāvad id bādhe arcanty ojasā
children.translated_text: For him, in the struggle, the inspired hymns chant with strength for life rich in offspring.

children.text: indra okyaṃ didhiṣanta dhītayo devāṁ acchā na dhītayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The thoughts seek a dwelling with <s>Indra</s>, like inspired thoughts going toward the gods.

children.text: yuvaṃ tam indrāparvatā puroyudhā yo naḥ pṛtanyād apa taṃ tam iddhataṃ vajreṇa taṃ tam iddhatam
children.translated_text: You two, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Parvata</s>, fighting in the forefront, burn down whoever battles against us, each one of them; burn each one with the thunderbolt.

children.text: dūre cattāya cchantsad gahanaṃ yad inakṣat
children.translated_text: Let him sit far away for the one cast down, if he has gone into the thicket.

children.text: asmākaṃ śatrūn pari śūra viśvato darmā darṣīṣṭa viśvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: O hero, may the smasher shatter our enemies from every side, may he split them from every side.

children.text: Chapter 133
ubhe punāmi rodasī ṛtena druho dahāmi sam mahīr anindrāḥ
children.translated_text: I purify both heaven and earth with <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order); I burn up deceits, the great godless powers, together.

children.text: abhivlagya yatra hatā amitrā vailasthānam pari tṛﾱhā aśeran ||
children.translated_text: Where the slain enemies, driven around, lay near the vailasthāna, tightly bound.

children.text: abhivlagyā cid adrivaḥ śīrṣā yātumatīnām
children.translated_text: Even when they are driven around, O stone-wielder, cut off the heads of the sorceresses.

children.text: chindhi vaṭūriṇā padā mahāvaṭūriṇā padā ||
children.translated_text: Cut them off with your crushing foot, with your great crushing foot.

children.text: avāsām maghavañ jahi śardho yātumatīnām
children.translated_text: O <s>Maghavan</s>, strike down the helpless host of sorceresses.

children.text: vailasthānake armake mahāvailasthe armake ||
children.translated_text: In the little vailasthāna hollow, in the pit; in the great vailastha hollow, in the pit.

children.text: yāsāṃ tisraḥ pañcāśato 'bhivlaṅgair apāvapaḥ
children.translated_text: Of those whom, fifty-three in number, you scattered with pursuers,

children.text: tat su te manāyati takat su te manāyati ||
children.translated_text: that is pleasing to you; that indeed is pleasing to you.

children.text: piśaṅgabhṛṣṭim ambhṛṇam piśācim indra sam mṛṇa
children.translated_text: Crush the yellow-backed <s>Ambhṛṇā</s>, the <s>piśācī</s> (ghoulish demoness), O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: sarvaṃ rakṣo ni barhaya ||
children.translated_text: Drive down every <s>rakṣas</s> (demonic force).

children.text: avar maha indra dādṛhi śrudhī naḥ śuśoca hi dyauḥ kṣā na bhīṣāṁ adrivo ghṛṇān na bhīṣāṁ adrivaḥ
children.translated_text: Come to us, great <s>Indra</s>; hold firm, hear us, for heaven has blazed, and earth from fear, O stone-wielder, as if from heat, from fear, O stone-wielder.

children.text: śuṣmintamo hi śuṣmibhir vadhair ugrebhir īyase
children.translated_text: For, most powerful, you move with powerful weapons, with fierce blows.

children.text: apūruṣaghno apratīta śūra satvabhis trisaptaiḥ śūra satvabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Not a slayer of men, irresistible, O hero, you come with thrice-seven strong companions, O hero, with strong companions.

children.text: vanoti hi sunvan kṣayam parīṇasaḥ sunvāno hi ṣmā yajaty ava dviṣo devānām ava dviṣaḥ
children.translated_text: For the soma-presser wins a secure dwelling; pressing soma, he sacrifices, warding off foes, warding off the foes of the gods.

children.text: sunvāna it siṣāsati sahasrā vājy avṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: The soma-presser seeks to win thousands, an unimpeded prize.

children.text: sunvānāyendro dadāty ābhuvaṃ rayiṃ dadāty ābhuvam ||
children.translated_text: To the soma-presser <s>Indra</s> gives abundant wealth; he gives abundance.

children.text: Chapter 134
ā tvā juvo rārahāṇā abhi prayo vāyo vahantv iha pūrvapītaye somasya pūrvapītaye
children.translated_text: Let the swift ones, gladly hastening, carry you here to refreshment, O <s>Vāyu</s>, for the first drinking of soma, for the first drinking of soma.

children.text: ūrdhvā te anu sūnṛtā manas tiṣṭhatu jānatī
children.translated_text: Let the knowing, well-spoken thought stand upright after you.

children.text: niyutvatā rathenā yāhi dāvane vāyo makhasya dāvane ||
children.translated_text: Come with your team-drawn chariot for giving, O <s>Vāyu</s>, for the giving of the rite.

children.text: mandantu tvā mandino vāyav indavo 'smat krāṇāsaḥ sukṛtā abhidyavo gobhiḥ krāṇā abhidyavaḥ
children.translated_text: May the exhilarating drops exhilarate you, O <s>Vāyu</s>, prepared by us, well made, bright toward heaven, prepared with milk, bright toward heaven.

children.text: yaddha krāṇā iradhyai dakṣaṃ sacanta ūtayaḥ
children.translated_text: When the prepared ones, seeking refreshment, attach themselves to skill, the aids accompany them.

children.text: sadhrīcīnā niyuto dāvane dhiya upa bruvata īṃ dhiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The team-horses, moving together, speak the thoughts toward giving; the thoughts speak to him.

children.text: vāyur yuṅkte rohitā vāyur aruṇā vāyū rathe ajirā dhuri voﾱhave vahiṣṭhā dhuri voﾱhave
children.translated_text: <s>Vāyu</s> yokes the red ones, <s>Vāyu</s> the ruddy ones; to <s>Vāyu</s>'s chariot they are swiftest at the pole for carrying, at the pole for carrying.

children.text: pra bodhayā purandhiṃ jāra ā sasatīm iva
children.translated_text: Awaken abundant bounty, like a lover awakening a sleeping woman.

children.text: pra cakṣaya rodasī vāsayoṣasaḥ śravase vāsayoṣasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Make heaven and earth visible; clothe the dawns for fame, clothe the dawns.

children.text: tubhyam uṣāsaḥ śucayaḥ parāvati bhadrā vastrā tanvate daṃsu raśmiṣu citrā navyeṣu raśmiṣu
children.translated_text: For you the bright <s>Uṣases</s>, from afar, stretch out auspicious garments in their rays, variegated in their new rays.

children.text: tubhyaṃ dhenuḥ sabardughā viśvā vasūni dohate
children.translated_text: For you the cow, milking together, milks all treasures.

children.text: ajanayo maruto vakṣaṇābhyo diva ā vakṣaṇābhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You generated the <s>Maruts</s> from the wombs, from the wombs of heaven.

children.text: tubhyaṃ śukrāsaḥ śucayas turaṇyavo madeṣūgrā iṣaṇanta bhurvaṇy apām iṣanta bhurvaṇi
children.translated_text: For you the bright, pure, swift ones, fierce in exhilarations, stir themselves in refreshment, in the refreshment of the waters.

children.text: tvāṃ tsārī dasamāno bhagam īṭṭe takvavīye
children.translated_text: <s>Tsārī</s>, serving, invokes you as <s>Bhaga</s> for swift aid.

children.text: tvaṃ viśvasmād bhuvanāt pāsi dharmaṇāsuryāt pāsi dharmaṇā ||
children.translated_text: By <s>dharma</s> (sacred order) you protect from every world, and by <s>dharma</s> you protect from asurian power.

children.text: tvaṃ no vāyav eṣām apūrvyaḥ somānām prathamaḥ pītim arhasi sutānām pītim arhasi
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Vāyu</s>, first of these somas, deserve the drinking of the pressed ones, deserve the drinking.

children.text: uto vihutmatīnāṃ viśāṃ vavarjuṣīṇām
children.translated_text: And also of the loudly invoked peoples who have chosen you.

children.text: viśvā it te dhenavo duhra āśiraṃ ghṛtaṃ duhrata āśiram ||
children.translated_text: All your cows milk the admixture; they milk ghee as the admixture.

children.text: Chapter 135
stīrṇam barhir upa no yāhi vītaye sahasreṇa niyutā niyutvate śatinībhir niyutvate
children.translated_text: The barhis has been strewn; come to us for the feast, with a thousand teams, O team-possessor, with hundreds of teams.

children.text: tubhyaṃ hi pūrvapītaye devā devāya yemire
children.translated_text: For to you, the god, the gods have sent it for the first drinking.

children.text: pra te sutāso madhumanto asthiran madāya kratve asthiran ||
children.translated_text: The pressed, honey-sweet draughts have stood ready for you, for exhilaration and for inspired power.

children.text: tubhyāyaṃ somaḥ paripūto adribhi spārhā vasānaḥ pari kośam arṣati śukrā vasāno arṣati
children.translated_text: For you this soma, purified all around by the pressing stones, clothed in desirable forms, flows round the vat; clothed in brightness it flows.

children.text: tavāyam bhāga āyuṣu somo deveṣu hūyate
children.translated_text: This soma is your share among living beings; among the gods it is invoked.

children.text: vaha vāyo niyuto yāhy asmayur juṣāṇo yāhy asmayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bring your teams, O <s>Vāyu</s>; come, desiring us. Enjoying it, come, desiring us.

children.text: ā no niyudbhiḥ śatinībhir adhvaraṃ sahasriṇībhir upa yāhi vītaye vāyo havyāni vītaye
children.translated_text: Come to our rite with teams in their hundreds and thousands, for drinking, O <s>Vāyu</s>, for drinking the offerings.

children.text: tavāyam bhāga ṛtviyaḥ saraśmiḥ sūrye sacā
children.translated_text: This timely share of yours, accompanied by rays, is with the sun.

children.text: adhvaryubhir bharamāṇā ayaṃsata vāyo śukrā ayaṃsata ||
children.translated_text: Being borne by the adhvaryu priests, the bright ones have set forth; O <s>Vāyu</s>, the bright ones have set forth.

children.text: ā vāṃ ratho niyutvān vakṣad avase 'bhi prayāṃsi sudhitāni vītaye vāyo havyāni vītaye
children.translated_text: May your chariot, furnished with teams, carry you two here for aid, toward the well-prepared refreshments, for drinking, O <s>Vāyu</s>, for drinking the offerings.

children.text: pibatam madhvo andhasaḥ pūrvapeyaṃ hi vāṃ hitam
children.translated_text: Drink of the sweet draught, for the first drinking has been assigned to you two.

children.text: vāyav ā candreṇa rādhasā gatam indraś ca rādhasā gatam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s>, come with lovely bounty; and <s>Indra</s> too, come with bounty.

children.text: ā vāṃ dhiyo vavṛtyur adhvarāṁ upemam indum marmṛjanta vājinam āśum atyaṃ na vājinam
children.translated_text: The devotions have turned toward you two; in this rite they cleanse this drop, the prize-winning, swift one, like a swift prize-winning steed.

children.text: teṣām pibatam asmayū ā no gantam ihotyā
children.translated_text: Drink of them, desiring us; come here to us with aid.

children.text: indravāyū sutānām adribhir yuvam madāya vājadā yuvam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>, you two, givers of prize, are for exhilaration over the soma-pressings pressed by the stones.

children.text: ime vāṃ somā apsv ā sutā ihādhvaryubhir bharamāṇā ayaṃsata vāyo śukrā ayaṃsata
children.translated_text: These somas for you two, pressed in the waters, borne here by the adhvaryu priests, have set forth; O <s>Vāyu</s>, the bright ones have set forth.

children.text: ete vām abhy asṛkṣata tiraḥ pavitram āśavaḥ
children.translated_text: These swift ones have been sent forth toward you two, across the filter.

children.text: yuvāyavo 'ti romāṇy avyayā somāso aty avyayā ||
children.translated_text: The somas, desiring you two, pass over the woolen fleeces; the somas pass over the wool.

children.text: ati vāyo sasato yāhi śaśvato yatra grāvā vadati tatra gacchataṃ gṛham indraś ca gacchatam
children.translated_text: Pass beyond those who lie asleep, O <s>Vāyu</s>, beyond those who are forever still; where the pressing stone speaks, go there. And <s>Indra</s>, go to the house.

children.text: vi sūnṛtā dadṛśe rīyate ghṛtam ā pūrṇayā niyutā yātho adhvaram indraś ca yātho adhvaram ||
children.translated_text: Gracious speech is seen; the ghee streams forth. With a full team you come to the rite, and <s>Indra</s> too, you come to the rite.

children.text: atrāha tad vahethe madhva āhutiṃ yam aśvattham upatiṣṭhanta jāyavo 'sme te santu jāyavaḥ
children.translated_text: Here indeed you two carry that sweet oblation, which the victorious ones attend beside the aśvattha tree; may those victorious ones be ours.

children.text: sākaṃ gāvaḥ suvate pacyate yavo na te vāya upa dasyanti dhenavo nāpa dasyanti dhenavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Together the cows press out milk; the barley is cooked. Your milch cows, O <s>Vāyu</s>, will not fail you; the milch cows will not fail.

children.text: ime ye te su vāyo bāhvojaso 'ntar nadī te patayanty ukṣaṇo mahi vrādhanta ukṣaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: These mighty-armed ones of yours, O <s>Vāyu</s>, the great bulls, fly for you within the river, growing strong as bulls.

children.text: dhanvañ cid ye anāśavo jīrāś cid agiraukasaḥ
children.translated_text: Even those in the wasteland who are not slow, even the swift ones whose home is on the mountain,

children.text: sūryasyeva raśmayo durniyantavo hastayor durniyantavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like the rays of the sun, are hard to restrain, hard to hold in the hands.

children.text: Chapter 136
pra su jyeṣṭhaṃ nicirābhyām bṛhan namo havyam matim bharatā mṛﾱayadbhyāṃ svādiṣṭham mṛﾱayadbhyām
children.translated_text: Offer forth the highest, great homage, the oblation and inspired thought, to the two with unfailing reins, to the gracious pair, the sweetest gift to the gracious pair.

children.text: tā samrājā ghṛtāsutī yajñe yajña upastutā
children.translated_text: Those two sovereigns, rich in ghee and soma, are praised at sacrifice after sacrifice.

children.text: athainoḥ kṣatraṃ na kutaś canādhṛṣe devatvaṃ nū cid ādhṛṣe ||
children.translated_text: Then the dominion of these two is not to be assailed from anywhere; even now their godhead is not to be assailed.

children.text: adarśi gātur urave varīyasī panthā ṛtasya sam ayaṃsta raśmibhiś cakṣur bhagasya raśmibhiḥ
children.translated_text: A path has been seen, broader for the wide expanse; the path of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) has been set together with rays, the eye of <s>Bhaga</s> with rays.

children.text: dyukṣam mitrasya sādanam aryamṇo varuṇasya ca
children.translated_text: The bright seat of <s>Mitra</s>, and of <s>Aryaman</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>,

children.text: athā dadhāte bṛhad ukthyaṃ vaya upastutyam bṛhad vayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: then they assume great praiseworthy strength, great strength worthy of praise.

children.text: jyotiṣmatīm aditiṃ dhārayatkṣitiṃ svarvatīm ā sacete dive dive jāgṛvāṃsā dive dive
children.translated_text: They attend, day by day, upon luminous <s>Aditi</s>, who upholds settlements and is rich in sunlight, waking day by day.

children.text: jyotiṣmat kṣatram āśāte ādityā dānunas patī
children.translated_text: The <s>Ādityas</s>, lords of giving, seek luminous sovereignty.

children.text: mitras tayor varuṇo yātayajjano 'ryamā yātayajjanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s> among them guides the people, <s>Varuṇa</s> guides them, and <s>Aryaman</s> guides the people.

children.text: ayam mitrāya varuṇāya śantamaḥ somo bhūtv avapāneṣv ābhago devo deveṣv ābhagaḥ
children.translated_text: This soma, most peaceful for <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, has become a share in the drinking-places, a god as a share among the gods.

children.text: taṃ devāso juṣerata viśve adya sajoṣasaḥ
children.translated_text: May all the gods, of one accord, enjoy it today.

children.text: tathā rājānā karatho yad īmaha ṛtāvānā yad īmahe ||
children.translated_text: So, O kings, you act when we seek you, O keepers of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), when we seek you.

children.text: yo mitrāya varuṇāyāvidhaj jano 'narvāṇaṃ tam pari pāto aṃhaso dāśvāṃsam martam aṃhasaḥ
children.translated_text: The man who has served <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, protect that unassailable, generous mortal from distress, the giver from distress.

children.text: tam aryamābhi rakṣaty ṛjūyantam anu vratam
children.translated_text: <s>Aryaman</s> protects him as he goes straight according to the vow.

children.text: ukthair ya enoḥ paribhūṣati vrataṃ stomair ābhūṣati vratam ||
children.translated_text: He who adorns the vow of these two with hymns, adorns their vow with chants.

children.text: namo dive bṛhate rodasībhyām mitrāya vocaṃ varuṇāya mīﾱhuṣe sumṛﾱīkāya mīﾱhuṣe
children.translated_text: I speak homage to great heaven and to the two worlds, to <s>Mitra</s> and to bountiful <s>Varuṇa</s>, to the gracious bountiful one.

children.text: indram agnim upa stuhi dyukṣam aryamaṇam bhagam
children.translated_text: Praise <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, bright <s>Aryaman</s> and <s>Bhaga</s>.

children.text: jyog jīvantaḥ prajayā sacemahi somasyotī sacemahi ||
children.translated_text: Living long, may we be joined with offspring; may we be joined with the aid of soma.

children.text: ūtī devānāṃ vayam indravanto maṃsīmahi svayaśaso marudbhiḥ
children.translated_text: May we, having <s>Indra</s> with us, think ourselves under the aid of the gods, self-famous, together with the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: agnir mitro varuṇaḥ śarma yaṃsan tad aśyāma maghavāno vayaṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s> extend shelter; may we generous ones attain that.

children.text: Chapter 137
suṣumā yātam adribhir gośrītā matsarā ime somāso matsarā ime
children.translated_text: Come well-pressed by the stones; these exhilarating somas, mixed with milk, are exhilarating indeed.

children.text: ā rājānā divispṛśāsmatrā gantam upa naḥ
children.translated_text: O kings touching heaven, come here to us.

children.text: ime vām mitrāvaruṇā gavāśiraḥ somāḥ śukrā gavāśiraḥ ||
children.translated_text: These bright somas mixed with milk are for you, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; they are bright and mixed with milk.

children.text: ima ā yātam indavaḥ somāso dadhyāśiraḥ sutāso dadhyāśiraḥ
children.translated_text: Come to these drops, the somas pressed and mixed with curds, pressed and mixed with curds.

children.text: uta vām uṣaso budhi sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ
children.translated_text: And may awakening come for you at dawn, together with the rays of the sun.

children.text: suto mitrāya varuṇāya pītaye cārur ṛtāya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: The lovely soma has been pressed for <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> to drink, for <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) to drink.

children.text: tāṃ vāṃ dhenuṃ na vāsarīm aṃśuṃ duhanty adribhiḥ somaṃ duhanty adribhiḥ
children.translated_text: They milk your stalk like a milch cow with the stones; they milk soma with the stones.

children.text: asmatrā gantam upa no 'rvāñcā somapītaye
children.translated_text: Come here to us, turned toward us, for soma-drinking.

children.text: ayaṃ vām mitrāvaruṇā nṛbhiḥ sutaḥ soma ā pītaye sutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: This soma for you, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, has been pressed by men; it has been pressed for drinking.

children.text: Chapter 138
pra pra pūṣṇas tuvijātasya śasyate mahitvam asya tavaso na tandate stotram asya na tandate
children.translated_text: Again and again the greatness of strong-born <s>Pūṣan</s> is praised; the greatness of this mighty one does not weary, his hymn does not weary.

children.text: arcāmi sumnayann aham antyūtim mayobhuvam
children.translated_text: Seeking his favor, I praise the nearest aid, the one who brings well-being.

children.text: viśvasya yo mana āyuyuve makho deva āyuyuve makhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The god <s>Makha</s>, who has set in motion the mind of all, has set it in motion.

children.text: pra hi tvā pūṣann ajiraṃ na yāmani stomebhiḥ kṛṇva ṛṇavo yathā mṛdha uṣṭro na pīparo mṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: For, O <s>Pūṣan</s>, I make you swift on the journey with praises; as one overcomes hostilities, you cross the hostilities like a camel.

children.text: huve yat tvā mayobhuvaṃ devaṃ sakhyāya martyaḥ
children.translated_text: I call upon you, the joy-bringing god, when a mortal seeks you for friendship.

children.text: asmākam āṅgūṣān dyumninas kṛdhi vājeṣu dyumninas kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: Make our chants glorious in the contests; make them glorious in the contests.

children.text: yasya te pūṣan sakhye vipanyavaḥ kratvā cit santo 'vasā bubhujrira iti kratvā bubhujrire
children.translated_text: In your friendship, O <s>Pūṣan</s>, the inspired praisers, being mindful even in their resolve, have enjoyed help; by their resolve they have enjoyed it.

children.text: tām anu tvā navīyasīṃ niyutaṃ rāya īmahe
children.translated_text: Following that newest team of yours, we ask you for wealth.

children.text: aheﾱamāna uruśaṃsa sarī bhava vāje vāje sarī bhava ||
children.translated_text: Unangered, widely praised one, be a companion; in every contest be a companion.

children.text: asyā ū ṣu ṇa upa sātaye bhuvo 'heﾱamāno rarivāṁ ajāśva śravasyatām ajāśva
children.translated_text: For the gaining of this, be near us, unangered, generous, goat-horsed one; be so for those who seek fame, goat-horsed one.

children.text: o ṣu tvā vavṛtīmahi stomebhir dasma sādhubhiḥ
children.translated_text: Now we turn you hither with fitting hymns, O wondrous one.

children.text: nahi tvā pūṣann atimanya āghṛṇe na te sakhyam apahnuve ||
children.translated_text: For I do not slight you, O <s>Pūṣan</s>, radiant one; I do not deny your friendship.

children.text: Chapter 139
astu śrauṣaṭ puro agnīṃ dhiyā dadha ā nu tacchardho divyaṃ vṛṇīmaha indravāyū vṛṇīmahe
children.translated_text: Let the śrauṣaṭ-call be; place <s>Agni</s> in front with thought. Then we choose that heavenly host; we choose <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: yaddha krāṇā vivasvati nābhā saṃdāyi navyasī
children.translated_text: When the newer power, active, was joined at the navel of <s>Vivasvat</s>,

children.text: adha pra sū na upa yantu dhītayo devāṁ acchā na dhītayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: then let our thoughts go forward toward the gods; let our inspired thoughts go toward the gods.

children.text: yaddha tyan mitrāvaruṇāv ṛtād adhy ādadāthe anṛtaṃ svena manyunā dakṣasya svena manyunā
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, from the ṛta you took away falsehood by your own wrath, by the own wrath of insight,

children.text: yuvor itthādhi sadmasv apaśyāma hiraṇyayam
children.translated_text: then in your seats we saw the golden one.

children.text: dhībhiś cana manasā svebhir akṣabhiḥ somasya svebhir akṣabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: With thoughts, with mind, and with our own eyes, with the own eyes of soma.

children.text: yuvāṃ stomebhir devayanto aśvināśrāvayanta iva ślokam āyavo yuvāṃ havyābhy āyavaḥ
children.translated_text: Seeking the gods, the <s>Āyus</s> have made you two, O <s>Aśvins</s>, hear with hymns as though a song; with oblations the <s>Āyus</s> call you two.

children.text: yuvor viśvā adhi śriyaḥ pṛkṣaś ca viśvavedasā
children.translated_text: All splendors and nourishments are placed in you two, all-knowing ones.

children.text: pruṣāyante vām pavayo hiraṇyaye rathe dasrā hiraṇyaye ||
children.translated_text: The rims of your golden chariot glisten, O wonder-workers, of your golden chariot.

children.text: aceti dasrā vy u nākam ṛṇvatho yuñjate vāṃ rathayujo diviṣṭiṣv adhvasmāno diviṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: It has been perceived, O wonder-workers: you traverse the vault of heaven. Your chariot-yokers are yoked in the heavenly stations, path-goers in the heavenly stations.

children.text: adhi vāṃ sthāma vandhure rathe dasrā hiraṇyaye
children.translated_text: Your standing-place is upon the chariot-seat, O wonder-workers, on the golden chariot.

children.text: patheva yantāv anuśāsatā rajo 'ñjasā śāsatā rajaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Going as on a path, you rule the midspace; by the straight way you rule the midspace.

children.text: śacībhir naḥ śacīvasū divā naktaṃ daśasyatam
children.translated_text: With your powers, O possessors of power, serve us by day and by night.

children.text: mā vāṃ rātir upa dasat kadā canāsmad rātiḥ kadā cana ||
children.translated_text: May your gift never fail us at any time; may your gift never fail us at any time.

children.text: vṛṣann indra vṛṣapāṇāsa indava ime sutā adriṣutāsa udbhidas tubhyaṃ sutāsa udbhidaḥ
children.translated_text: O bull <s>Indra</s>, these soma-drops, bull-strong draughts, pressed out, pressed by stones, bursting forth, have been pressed for you, bursting forth.

children.text: te tvā mandantu dāvane mahe citrāya rādhase
children.translated_text: Let them exhilarate you for giving, for great, brilliant bounty.

children.text: gīrbhir girvāha stavamāna ā gahi sumṛﾱīko na ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: Praised with songs, O song-lover, come here; kindly disposed, come to us.

children.text: o ṣū ṇo agne śṛṇuhi tvam īﾱito devebhyo bravasi yajñiyebhyo rājabhyo yajñiyebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Now hear us, O <s>Agni</s>, you who are invoked; speak to the worshipful gods, to the worshipful kings.

children.text: yaddha tyām aṅgirobhyo dhenuṃ devā adattana
children.translated_text: When, O gods, you gave that cow to the <s>Angirases</s>,

children.text: vi tāṃ duhre aryamā kartarī sacāṃ eṣa tāṃ veda me sacā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Aryaman</s> milked her apart together with the cutters; this companion of mine knows her.

children.text: mo ṣu vo asmad abhi tāni pauṃsyā sanā bhūvan dyumnāni mota jāriṣur asmat purota jāriṣuḥ
children.translated_text: Let those manly powers of yours not be against us; let the ancient glories not grow old away from us, nor decay apart from us.

children.text: yad vaś citraṃ yuge yuge navyaṃ ghoṣād amartyam
children.translated_text: Whatever bright, ever-new, immortal power of yours is proclaimed age after age,

children.text: asmāsu tan maruto yac ca duṣṭaraṃ didhṛtā yac ca duṣṭaram ||
children.translated_text: establish that among us, O <s>Maruts</s>, and whatever is hard to cross; hold firm whatever is hard to cross.

children.text: dadhyaṅ ha me januṣam pūrvo aṅgirāḥ priyamedhaḥ kaṇvo atrir manur vidus te me pūrve manur viduḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Dadhyañc</s>, born of old, the <s>Angirases</s>, <s>Priyamedha</s>, <s>Kaṇva</s>, <s>Atri</s>, and <s>Manu</s> know my birth; those former ones, <s>Manu</s>, know it.

children.text: teṣāṃ deveṣv āyatir asmākaṃ teṣu nābhayaḥ
children.translated_text: Their approach is among the gods; our kinship is among them.

children.text: teṣām padena mahy ā name girendrāgnī ā name girā ||
children.translated_text: By their track I bow down with mighty song; to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> I bow with song.

children.text: hotā yakṣad vanino vanta vāryam bṛhaspatir yajati vena ukṣabhiḥ puruvārebhir ukṣabhiḥ
children.translated_text: Let the Hotṛ worship the desirous ones who win the desirable prize; <s>Bṛhaspati</s> sacrifices to <s>Vena</s> with bulls, with much-desired bulls.

children.text: jagṛbhmā dūraādiśaṃ ślokam adrer adha tmanā
children.translated_text: We have grasped the far-directed call, the song from the stone, then by ourselves.

children.text: adhārayad ararindāni sukratuḥ purū sadmāni sukratuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The wise one upheld the unpierced things, many seats; the wise one upheld them.

children.text: ye devāso divy ekādaśa stha pṛthivyām adhy ekādaśa stha
children.translated_text: You gods who are eleven in heaven, who are eleven upon the earth,

children.text: apsukṣito mahinaikādaśa stha te devāso yajñam imaṃ juṣadhvam ||
children.translated_text: and who dwell in the waters, eleven in majesty: those gods, enjoy this sacrifice.

children.text: Chapter 140
vediṣade priyadhāmāya sudyute dhāsim iva pra bharā yonim agnaye
children.translated_text: Bring forward, as if nourishment, a seat for <s>Agni</s>, who sits on the altar, dear in his abode, bright-shining.

children.text: vastreṇeva vāsayā manmanā śuciṃ jyotīrathaṃ śukravarṇaṃ tamohanam ||
children.translated_text: Clothe the pure one with thought as with a garment, the light-charioted, bright-colored dispeller of darkness.

children.text: abhi dvijanmā trivṛd annam ṛjyate saṃvatsare vāvṛdhe jagdham ī punaḥ
children.translated_text: The twice-born, threefold one stretches toward food; in the year he has grown again after what was eaten.

children.text: anyasyāsā jihvayā jenyo vṛṣā ny anyena vanino mṛṣṭa vāraṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With the tongue of one, the victorious bull is born; with another he cleans the woods, the guardian.

children.text: kṛṣṇaprutau vevije asya sakṣitā ubhā tarete abhi mātarā śiśum
children.translated_text: His two dark courses tremble as witnesses; both mothers pass over the child.

children.text: prācājihvaṃ dhvasayantaṃ tṛṣucyutam ā sācyaṃ kupayaṃ vardhanam pituḥ ||
children.translated_text: They attend the forward-tongued one as he shakes, thirst-falling, friendly, stirring, the increaser of the father.

children.text: mumukṣvo manave mānavasyate raghudruvaḥ kṛṣṇasītāsa ū juvaḥ
children.translated_text: Eager to be released for <s>Manu</s>, serving man, swift-running, black-backed, the quick ones have sped.

children.text: asamanā ajirāso raghuṣyado vātajūtā upa yujyanta āśavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Unequalled, agile, swift-going, wind-driven, the swift ones are yoked near.

children.text: ād asya te dhvasayanto vṛtherate kṛṣṇam abhvam mahi varpaḥ karikrataḥ
children.translated_text: Then, as they shake him, they turn about his black, immense, formless body, fashioning it.

children.text: yat sīm mahīm avanim prābhi marmṛśad abhiśvasan stanayann eti nānadat ||
children.translated_text: When he has touched the great earth, breathing upon it, thundering, he goes roaring.

children.text: bhūṣan na yo 'dhi babhrūṣu namnate vṛṣeva patnīr abhy eti roruvat
children.translated_text: Like an adornment he bends over the brown ones; roaring like a bull, he approaches his wives.

children.text: ojāyamānas tanvaś ca śumbhate bhīmo na śṛṅgā davidhāva durgṛbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Growing strong, he adorns his bodies; fearsome and hard to seize, he tosses his horns.

children.text: sa saṃstiro viṣṭiraḥ saṃ gṛbhāyati jānann eva jānatīr nitya ā śaye
children.translated_text: He, gathering and spreading out, seizes them together; knowing, he lies always among the knowing ones.

children.text: punar vardhante api yanti devyam anyad varpaḥ pitroḥ kṛṇvate sacā ||
children.translated_text: They grow again and go to the divine one; together they make another form for the two parents.

children.text: tam agruvaḥ keśinīḥ saṃ hi rebhira ūrdhvās tasthur mamruṣīḥ prāyave punaḥ
children.translated_text: The foremost, long-haired ones have resounded around him; standing upright, though wasting away, they rise again for continued life.

children.text: tāsāṃ jarām pramuñcann eti nānadad asum paraṃ janayañ jīvam astṛtam ||
children.translated_text: Releasing their old age, he goes roaring, generating the further breath, a living life unhurt.

children.text: adhīvāsam pari mātū rihann aha tuvigrebhiḥ satvabhir yāti vi jrayaḥ
children.translated_text: Licking around the mother's covering, with very mighty forces he goes forth each day, widely victorious.

children.text: vayo dadhat padvate rerihat sadānu śyenī sacate vartanīr aha ||
children.translated_text: Bestowing vigor on the footed one, he keeps licking; like a female eagle he follows the paths each day.

children.text: asmākam agne maghavatsu dīdihy adha śvasīvān vṛṣabho damūnāḥ
children.translated_text: For us, O <s>Agni</s>, shine among the bountiful; then, mighty, a bull dwelling in the house,

children.text: avāsyā śiśumatīr adīder varmeva yutsu parijarbhurāṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you blazed for aid among the child-bearing women, enclosing them in battles like armor.

children.text: idam agne sudhitaṃ durdhitād adhi priyād u cin manmanaḥ preyo astu te
children.translated_text: This well-laid offering of ours, O <s>Agni</s>, rather than the ill-laid one, let it be dearer to you than even a dear thought.

children.text: yat te śukraṃ tanvo rocate śuci tenāsmabhyaṃ vanase ratnam ā tvam ||
children.translated_text: With that bright, pure radiance of your body which shines, may you win treasure for us yourself.

children.text: rathāya nāvam uta no gṛhāya nityāritrām padvatīṃ rāsy agne
children.translated_text: For the chariot, and also for our house, grant us, O <s>Agni</s>, a ship ever furnished with oars and feet,

children.text: asmākaṃ vīrāṁ uta no maghono janāṃś ca yā pārayāccharma yā ca ||
children.translated_text: one that will carry across our heroes, our bountiful men, and the people, and that will give shelter.

children.text: abhī no agna uktham ij juguryā dyāvākṣāmā sindhavaś ca svagūrtāḥ
children.translated_text: May our utterance, O <s>Agni</s>, be guarded by heaven and earth and by the well-invoked rivers.
