children.translated_text: You two of fair face uphold immortality; O <s>Dyāvā</s> and <s>Pṛthivī</s>, protect us from misfortune.

children.text: urvī pṛthvī bahule dūreante upa bruve namasā yajñe asmin
children.translated_text: Wide, broad, abundant, and far-extending, I address you with reverence in this sacrifice.

children.text: dadhāte ye subhage supratūrtī dyāvā rakṣatam pṛthivī no abhvāt ||
children.translated_text: You fortunate ones who bestow good passage, O <s>Dyāvā</s> and <s>Pṛthivī</s>, protect us from misfortune.

children.text: devān vā yac cakṛmā kaccid āgaḥ sakhāyaṃ vā sadam ij jāspatiṃ vā
children.translated_text: Whatever offense we have committed against the gods, or against a friend, or ever against the lord of the house,

children.text: iyaṃ dhīr bhūyā avayānam eṣāṃ dyāvā rakṣatam pṛthivī no abhvāt ||
children.translated_text: may this thought become an atonement for them; O <s>Dyāvā</s> and <s>Pṛthivī</s>, protect us from misfortune.

children.text: ubhā śaṃsā naryā mām aviṣṭām ubhe mām ūtī avasā sacetām
children.translated_text: May both noble praises protect me; may both aids accompany me with their help.

children.text: bhūri cid aryaḥ sudāstarāyeṣā madanta iṣayema devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even the many noble ones rejoice for the very generous gift; may we refresh and impel the gods.

children.text: ṛtaṃ dive tad avocam pṛthivyā abhiśrāvāya prathamaṃ sumedhāḥ
children.translated_text: I have spoken this <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic truth) first for Heaven and Earth, wise-minded, for proclamation.

children.text: pātām avadyād duritād abhīke pitā mātā ca rakṣatām avobhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May father and mother protect us with their aids from blame and from evil close at hand.

children.text: idaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī satyam astu pitar mātar yad ihopabruve vām
children.translated_text: Let this be true, O Heaven and Earth, O father and mother, what I here declare to you two.

children.text: bhūtaṃ devānām avame avobhir vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||
children.translated_text: Be present with the gods' nearest aids; may we obtain nourishment, a secure dwelling, and life-giving bounty.

children.text: Chapter 186
ā na iﾱābhir vidathe suśasti viśvānaraḥ savitā deva etu
children.translated_text: May the god <s>Savitṛ</s> <s>Viśvānara</s> come to us in the assembly with invocations to <s>Iḷā</s> and with good praise.

children.text: api yathā yuvāno matsathā no viśvaṃ jagad abhipitve manīṣā ||
children.translated_text: So that, as youthful ones, you may be gladdened by us, by inspired thought, over the whole moving world at the approach.

children.text: ā no viśva āskrā gamantu devā mitro aryamā varuṇaḥ sajoṣāḥ
children.translated_text: May all the gods come to us from every side: <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s> in common accord.

children.text: bhuvan yathā no viśve vṛdhāsaḥ karan suṣāhā vithuraṃ na śavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May all of them become increasers for us; may they make our force easy to bear and not scattered.

children.text: preṣṭhaṃ vo atithiṃ gṛṇīṣe 'gniṃ śastibhis turvaṇiḥ sajoṣāḥ
children.translated_text: I praise your dearest guest, <s>Agni</s>, with hymns, the conquering one, together with willing powers.

children.text: asad yathā no varuṇaḥ sukīrtir iṣaś ca parṣad arigūrtaḥ sūriḥ ||
children.translated_text: So may <s>Varuṇa</s>, of good renown, be ours; may the inspired patron, uninjured by foes, carry us to nourishment.

children.text: upa va eṣe namasā jigīṣoṣāsānaktā sudugheva dhenuḥ
children.translated_text: I approach you with reverence, eager to win, O Dawn and Night, like a cow rich in milk.

children.text: samāne ahan vimimāno arkaṃ viṣurūpe payasi sasminn ūdhan ||
children.translated_text: On the same day you measure out the chant, of different forms, in one milk and in the same udder.

children.text: uta no 'hir budhnyo mayas kaḥ śiśuṃ na pipyuṣīva veti sindhuḥ
children.translated_text: And may <s>Ahi Budhnya</s> make delight for us; like a cow swollen with milk for her calf, the river comes on.

children.text: yena napātam apāṃ junāma manojuvo vṛṣaṇo yaṃ vahanti ||
children.translated_text: By him we quicken the Child of the Waters, whom the mind-swift, virile powers carry.

children.text: uta na īṃ tvaṣṭā gantv acchā smat sūribhir abhipitve sajoṣāḥ
children.translated_text: And may <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> come hither to us, together with the patrons, in harmony at the approach.

children.text: ā vṛtrahendraś carṣaṇiprās tuviṣṭamo narāṃ na iha gamyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, lord of peoples and mightiest one, come here to us men.

children.text: uta na īm matayo 'śvayogāḥ śiśuṃ na gāvas taruṇaṃ rihanti
children.translated_text: And may our thoughts, yoked like horses, lick him as cows lick a young calf.

children.text: tam īṃ giro janayo na patnīḥ surabhiṣṭamaṃ narāṃ nasanta ||
children.translated_text: Him our songs, like wives as women of the household, seek, the most fragrant one among men.

children.text: uta na īm maruto vṛddhasenāḥ smad rodasī samanasaḥ sadantu
children.translated_text: And may the <s>Maruts</s>, with growing hosts, sit here with us, and <s>Rodasī</s> of one mind.

children.text: pṛṣadaśvāso 'vanayo na rathā riśādaso mitrayujo na devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Spotted-horsed, not failing like chariots, harm-repelling, and joined with <s>Mitra</s> like gods.

children.text: pra nu yad eṣām mahinā cikitre pra yuñjate prayujas te suvṛkti
children.translated_text: Now, when their greatness is perceived, those well-invoked teams yoke the yoked horses forth.

children.text: adha yad eṣāṃ sudine na śarur viśvam eriṇam pruṣāyanta senāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, when on their fair day their spear is set loose, their hosts sprinkle the whole barren expanse.

children.text: pro aśvināv avase kṛṇudhvam pra pūṣaṇaṃ svatavaso hi santi
children.translated_text: Make help manifest, O <s>Aśvins</s>; make <s>Pūṣan</s> manifest, for they possess their own strength.

children.text: adveṣo viṣṇur vāta ṛbhukṣā acchā sumnāya vavṛtīya devān ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Viṣṇu</s>, free from hatred, <s>Vāta</s>, and <s>Ṛbhukṣan</s> turn the gods hither for favor.

children.text: iyaṃ sā vo asme dīdhitir yajatrā apiprāṇī ca sadanī ca bhūyāḥ
children.translated_text: May this insight of yours be here for us, O worshipful ones, both life-giving and abiding in its seat.

children.text: ni yā deveṣu yatate vasūyur vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||
children.translated_text: She who strives among the gods, desiring wealth, may she settle here; may we obtain nourishment, a secure dwelling, and life-giving bounty.

children.text: Chapter 187
pituṃ nu stoṣam maho dharmāṇaṃ taviṣīm
children.translated_text: Now I will praise <s>Pitu</s>, the food, the mighty ordinance and powerful strength.

children.text: yasya trito vy ojasā vṛtraṃ viparvam ardayat ||
children.translated_text: By whose force <s>Trita</s> crushed <s>Vṛtra</s>, whose joints were loosened apart.

children.text: svādo pito madho pito vayaṃ tvā vavṛmahe
children.translated_text: Sweet <s>Pitu</s>, honeyed <s>Pitu</s>, we have chosen you.

children.text: asmākam avitā bhava ||
children.translated_text: Be the protector of us.

children.text: upa naḥ pitav ā cara śivaḥ śivābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Come near to us, O <s>Pitu</s>, auspicious with auspicious helps.

children.text: mayobhur adviṣeṇyaḥ sakhā suśevo advayāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bringing delight, not hateful, a good friend, easy to serve, and without deceit.

children.text: tava tye pito rasā rajāṃsy anu viṣṭhitāḥ
children.translated_text: Those juices of yours, O <s>Pitu</s>, are spread through the realms.

children.text: divi vātā iva śritāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They are established in heaven like the winds.

children.text: tava tye pito dadatas tava svādiṣṭha te pito
children.translated_text: Those gifts of yours, O <s>Pitu</s>, are yours; yours, O <s>Pitu</s>, are the sweetest things.

children.text: pra svādmāno rasānāṃ tuvigrīvā iverate ||
children.translated_text: The sweet flavors of the juices rise up like strong-necked ones.

children.text: tve pito mahānāṃ devānām mano hitam
children.translated_text: In you, O <s>Pitu</s>, the mind of the great gods has been placed.

children.text: akāri cāru ketunā tavāhim avasāvadhīt ||
children.translated_text: By your lovely sign it was made; by your help he slew the serpent.

children.text: yad ado pito ajagan vivasva parvatānām
children.translated_text: When you came here, O <s>Pitu</s>, from that place of <s>Vivasvat</s>, from the mountains,

children.text: atrā cin no madho pito 'ram bhakṣāya gamyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: then even here, O honeyed <s>Pitu</s>, may you come near us enough for eating.

children.text: yad apām oṣadhīnām pariṃśam āriśāmahe
children.translated_text: When we take our share of the waters and the plants,

children.text: vātāpe pīva id bhava ||
children.translated_text: be fattening indeed in wind and heat.

children.text: yat te soma gavāśiro yavāśiro bhajāmahe
children.translated_text: When we partake of your <s>Soma</s> mixed with milk and mixed with barley,

children.text: vātāpe pīva id bhava ||
children.translated_text: be fattening indeed in wind and heat.

children.text: karambha oṣadhe bhava pīvo vṛkka udārathiḥ
children.translated_text: Become porridge, O plant; become fat, swelling in the belly.

children.text: vātāpe pīva id bhava ||
children.translated_text: Be fattening indeed in wind and heat.

children.text: taṃ tvā vayam pito vacobhir gāvo na havyā suṣūdima
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Pitu</s>, we have sweetened with our words, as cows sweeten the oblation.

children.text: devebhyas tvā sadhamādam asmabhyaṃ tvā sadhamādam ||
children.translated_text: You for companionship at the feast with the gods, you for companionship at the feast with us.

children.text: Chapter 188
samiddho adya rājasi devo devaiḥ sahasrajit
children.translated_text: Kindled today, you shine as the god together with the gods, winning a thousand prizes.

children.text: dūto havyā kavir vaha ||
children.translated_text: As messenger and seer, carry the oblations.

children.text: tanūnapād ṛtaṃ yate madhvā yajñaḥ sam ajyate
children.translated_text: <s>Tanūnapāt</s>, the sacrifice that goes according to <s>ṛta</s> is anointed with sweetness.

children.text: dadhat sahasriṇīr iṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: It sets in place thousandfold nourishments.

children.text: ājuhvāno na īḍyo devāṁ ā vakṣi yajñiyān
children.translated_text: Being invoked, bring to us the worshipful gods, worthy of praise.

children.text: agne sahasrasā asi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, you are the winner of a thousand.

children.text: prācīnam barhir ojasā sahasravīram astṛṇan
children.translated_text: With strength they have strewn the ancient sacred grass, rich in a thousand heroes.

children.text: yatrādityā virājatha ||
children.translated_text: There, O <s>Ādityas</s>, you shine forth.

children.text: virāṭ samrāḍ vibhvīḥ prabhvīr bahvīś ca bhūyasīś ca yāḥ
children.translated_text: The sovereign, the universal ruler, the far-reaching, the powerful, the many and the still more numerous doors

children.text: duro ghṛtāny akṣaran ||
children.translated_text: have poured out the ghee.

children.text: surukme hi supeśasādhi śriyā virājataḥ
children.translated_text: For, adorned with good gold and fair form, you two shine with splendor.

children.text: uṣāsāv eha sīdatām ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Uṣas</s> sit down here.

children.text: prathamā hi suvācasā hotārā daivyā kavī
children.translated_text: For the two divine <s>Hotars</s>, first and eloquent seers,

children.text: yajñaṃ no yakṣatām imam ||
children.translated_text: shall worship this sacrifice of ours.

children.text: bhāratīﾱe sarasvati yā vaḥ sarvā upabruve
children.translated_text: O <s>Bhāratī</s>, <s>Iḷā</s>, and <s>Sarasvatī</s>, all of you whom I invoke,

children.text: tā naś codayata śriye ||
children.translated_text: impel us toward prosperity.

children.text: tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi hi prabhuḥ paśūn viśvān samānaje
children.translated_text: For <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, master of forms, fashions all the animals.

children.text: teṣāṃ na sphātim ā yaja ||
children.translated_text: Sacrifice for us their increase.

children.text: upa tmanyā vanaspate pātho devebhyaḥ sṛja
children.translated_text: Come near of yourself, O forest lord; release the paths for the gods.

children.text: agnir havyāni siṣvadat ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Agni</s> make the oblations tasty.

children.text: purogā agnir devānāṃ gāyatreṇa sam ajyate
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, going before the gods, is anointed with the <s>Gāyatrī</s>.

children.text: svāhākṛtīṣu rocate ||
children.translated_text: He shines among the cries of <s>svāhā</s>.

children.text: Chapter 189
agne naya supathā rāye asmān viśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, lead us by a good path to wealth, O god who know all ways.

children.text: yuyodhy asmaj juhurāṇam eno bhūyiṣṭhāṃ te namauktiṃ vidhema ||
children.translated_text: Remove from us the crooked sin; we shall offer you the fullest speech of homage.

children.text: agne tvam pārayā navyo asmān svastibhir ati durgāṇi viśvā
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, as the newest one, carry us across all hardships with well-being.

children.text: pūś ca pṛthvī bahulā na urvī bhavā tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ ||
children.translated_text: Be for us a broad, ample city and a wide earth, for the welfare of child and offspring.

children.text: agne tvam asmad yuyodhy amīvā anagnitrā abhy amanta kṛṣṭīḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, drive away from us sickness and the peoples who come against us without fire.

children.text: punar asmabhyaṃ suvitāya deva kṣāṃ viśvebhir amṛtebhir yajatra ||
children.translated_text: Again, O worshipful god, together with all the immortals, give us earth for good fortune.

children.text: pāhi no agne pāyubhir ajasrair uta priye sadana ā śuśukvān
children.translated_text: Protect us, O <s>Agni</s>, with unfailing protections, and blaze forth in the beloved dwelling.

children.text: mā te bhayaṃ jaritāraṃ yaviṣṭha nūnaṃ vidan māparaṃ sahasvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let no fear now find your singer, O youngest one; do not hand him over to another power, O mighty one.

children.text: mā no agne 'va sṛjo aghāyāviṣyave ripave ducchunāyai
children.translated_text: Do not cast us away, O <s>Agni</s>, to the harmful one, to the enemy who seeks to injure, to misfortune.

children.text: mā datvate daśate mādate no mā rīṣate sahasāvan parā dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Do not give us over to one who would cut, bite, or consume us; do not give us over to harm, O powerful one.

children.text: vi gha tvāvāṁ ṛtajāta yaṃsad gṛṇāno agne tanve varūtham
children.translated_text: For the one who praises you, O <s>Agni</s> born of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), may your shelter spread wide for the body,

children.text: viśvād ririkṣor uta vā ninitsor abhihrutām asi hi deva viṣpaṭ ||
children.translated_text: away from every assailant and from the reviler; for you, O god, are lord of the clan against those who plot harm.

children.text: tvaṃ tāṁ agna ubhayān vi vidvān veṣi prapitve manuṣo yajatra
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, knowing both conditions, attend man on the forward way, O worshipful one,

children.text: abhipitve manave śāsyo bhūr marmṛjenya uśigbhir nākraḥ ||
children.translated_text: and on the way back you became a guide for <s>Manu</s>, to be brightened by the eager ones like a strong creature.

children.text: avocāma nivacanāny asmin mānasya sūnuḥ sahasāne agnau
children.translated_text: In this mighty <s>Agni</s> we have spoken words of appeal, we sons of <s>Māna</s>.

children.text: vayaṃ sahasram ṛṣibhiḥ sanema vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||
children.translated_text: May we, with the seers, win a thousand; may we find refreshment, a secure dwelling, and life-giving bounty.

children.text: Chapter 190
anarvāṇaṃ vṛṣabham mandrajihvam bṛhaspatiṃ vardhayā navyam arkaiḥ
children.translated_text: With new songs magnify <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, the unresisted bull with joyful tongue.

children.text: gāthānyaḥ suruco yasya devā āśṛṇvanti navamānasya martāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The gods hear his fair-shining chants, and mortals hear him as he is praised anew.

children.text: tam ṛtviyā upa vācaḥ sacante sargo na yo devayatām asarji
children.translated_text: Timely voices attend him, like a stream released by those who seek the gods.

children.text: bṛhaspatiḥ sa hy añjo varāṃsi vibhvābhavat sam ṛte mātariśvā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, for he has plainly become supreme in breadth, together with <s>Mātariśvan</s> in accordance with <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: upastutiṃ namasa udyatiṃ ca ślokaṃ yaṃsat saviteva pra bāhū
children.translated_text: Let him extend praise, reverent uplifting, and song, like <s>Savitṛ</s> stretching out his arms.

children.text: asya kratvāhanyo yo asti mṛgo na bhīmo arakṣasas tuviṣmān ||
children.translated_text: By his will he is not to be struck down; fearsome like a wild beast, free from demons, he is very mighty.

children.text: asya śloko divīyate pṛthivyām atyo na yaṃsad yakṣabhṛd vicetāḥ
children.translated_text: His song resounds in heaven and on earth; like a steed the discerning bearer of wonder stretches forth.

children.text: mṛgāṇāṃ na hetayo yanti cemā bṛhaspater ahimāyāṁ abhi dyūn ||
children.translated_text: And these missiles of <s>Bṛhaspati</s> go like those of wild beasts through the days against deceitful wiles.

children.text: ye tvā devosrikam manyamānāḥ pāpā bhadram upajīvanti pajrāḥ
children.translated_text: Those evil, feeble ones who, thinking you a god of ruddy brightness, live upon the good,

children.text: na dūḍhye anu dadāsi vāmam bṛhaspate cayasa it piyārum ||
children.translated_text: you do not give the desirable treasure to the deceiver, O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>; you discern what is dear.

children.text: supraituḥ sūyavaso na panthā durniyantuḥ pariprīto na mitraḥ
children.translated_text: Like a good-going road rich in pasture, like a friend who is fully gracious and hard to lead astray,

children.text: anarvāṇo abhi ye cakṣate no 'pīvṛtā aporṇuvanto asthuḥ ||
children.translated_text: may the unopposed powers that look upon us stand open, uncovering what had been closed.

children.text: saṃ yaṃ stubho 'vanayo na yanti samudraṃ na sravato rodhacakrāḥ
children.translated_text: As praises come together like streams to the lowlands, like flowing waters to the ocean with encircling banks,

children.text: sa vidvāṁ ubhayaṃ caṣṭe antar bṛhaspatis tara āpaś ca gṛdhraḥ ||
children.translated_text: so wise <s>Bṛhaspati</s> sees both what is within and what is beyond: the waters and the grasping one.

children.text: evā mahas tuvijātas tuviṣmān bṛhaspatir vṛṣabho dhāyi devaḥ
children.translated_text: Thus the great, mightily born, mighty <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, the bull, has been established as god.

children.text: sa na stuto vīravad dhātu gomad vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||
children.translated_text: Praised, may he bestow on us wealth with heroes and with cows; may we find refreshment, a secure dwelling, and life-giving bounty.

children.text: Chapter 191
kaṅkato na kaṅkato 'tho satīnakaṅkataḥ
children.translated_text: Not <s>kaṅkata</s>, not <s>kaṅkata</s>, and also truly not <s>kaṅkata</s>.

children.text: dvāv iti pluṣī iti ny adṛṣṭā alipsata ||
children.translated_text: Two of them, saying, 'pluṣi, pluṣi,' have clung down unseen.

children.text: adṛṣṭān hanty āyaty atho hanti parāyatī
children.translated_text: Unseen, it kills when coming, and it kills when going away.

children.text: atho avaghnatī hanty atho pinaṣṭi piṃṣatī ||
children.translated_text: It kills while striking down, and it crushes while being crushed.

children.text: śarāsaḥ kuśarāso darbhāsaḥ sairyā uta
children.translated_text: The arrows, the reed-arrows, the darbha grasses, and also the sairya grasses,

children.text: mauñjā adṛṣṭā vairiṇāḥ sarve sākaṃ ny alipsata ||
children.translated_text: the muñja grasses, unseen enemies, all together have clung down.

children.text: ni gāvo goṣṭhe asadan ni mṛgāso avikṣata
children.translated_text: The cows have settled in the cowshed; the wild animals have withdrawn.

children.text: ni ketavo janānāṃ ny adṛṣṭā alipsata ||
children.translated_text: The signs of people have settled; the unseen ones have clung down.

children.text: eta u tye praty adṛśran pradoṣaṃ taskarā iva
children.translated_text: These here appeared at dusk like thieves.

children.text: adṛṣṭā viśvadṛṣṭāḥ pratibuddhā abhūtana ||
children.translated_text: Unseen, yet seen by all, you have awakened.

children.text: dyaur vaḥ pitā pṛthivī mātā somo bhrātāditiḥ svasā
children.translated_text: Heaven is your father, earth your mother, <s>Soma</s> your brother, and <s>Aditi</s> your sister.

children.text: adṛṣṭā viśvadṛṣṭās tiṣṭhatelayatā su kam ||
children.translated_text: O unseen ones, seen by all, stand still; remain quiet and well at ease.

children.text: ye aṃsyā ye aṅgyāḥ sūcīkā ye prakaṅkatāḥ
children.translated_text: Those of the shoulders, those of the limbs, the needle-like ones, and those called <s>prakaṅkata</s>,

children.text: adṛṣṭāḥ kiṃ caneha vaḥ sarve sākaṃ ni jasyata ||
children.translated_text: O unseen ones, whatever of you are here, all of you together sink down.

children.text: ut purastāt sūrya eti viśvadṛṣṭo adṛṣṭahā
children.translated_text: In front the sun rises, all-seeing, slayer of the unseen.

children.text: adṛṣṭān sarvāñ jambhayan sarvāś ca yātudhānyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He crushes all the unseen ones and all the demonesses.

children.text: ud apaptad asau sūryaḥ puru viśvāni jūrvan
children.translated_text: That sun has flown up, driving away many things, indeed all things.

children.text: ādityaḥ parvatebhyo viśvadṛṣṭo adṛṣṭahā ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Āditya</s> has risen from the mountains, all-seeing, slayer of the unseen.

children.text: sūrye viṣam ā sajāmi dṛtiṃ surāvato gṛhe
children.translated_text: I fasten the poison in the sun, like a leather bag in the house of the liquor-maker.

children.text: so cin nu na marāti no vayam marāmāre asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra ||
children.translated_text: Even that one does not die, nor do we die. Far away is its bond; the yellow one made you honey, the honey-maker made you honey.

children.text: iyattikā śakuntikā sakā jaghāsa te viṣam
children.translated_text: This tiny bird, together with its mate, has eaten your poison.

children.text: so cin nu na marāti no vayam marāmāre asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra ||
children.translated_text: Even that one does not die, nor do we die. Far away is its bond; the yellow one made you honey, the honey-maker made you honey.

children.text: triḥ sapta viṣpuliṅgakā viṣasya puṣyam akṣan
children.translated_text: Three times seven little sparks have eaten the flower of the poison.

children.text: tāś cin nu na maranti no vayam marāmāre asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra ||
children.translated_text: Even they do not die, nor do we die. Far away is its bond; the yellow one made you honey, the honey-maker made you honey.

children.text: navānāṃ navatīnāṃ viṣasya ropuṣīṇām
children.translated_text: Of the ninety-nine swelling forms of poison,

children.text: sarvāsām agrabhaṃ nāmāre asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra ||
children.translated_text: I have seized the name of them all. Far away is its bond; the yellow one made you honey, the honey-maker made you honey.

children.text: triḥ sapta mayūryaḥ sapta svasāro agruvaḥ
children.translated_text: Three times seven peahens, seven unmarried sisters,

children.text: tās te viṣaṃ vi jabhrira udakaṃ kumbhinīr iva ||
children.translated_text: have carried your poison away like women bearing water in jars.

children.text: iyattakaḥ kuṣumbhakas takam bhinadmy aśmanā
children.translated_text: This tiny <s>kuṣumbhaka</s> I split with a stone.

children.text: tato viṣam pra vāvṛte parācīr anu saṃvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: From that the poison has turned away, following the receding seasons.

children.text: kuṣumbhakas tad abravīd gireḥ pravartamānakaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>kuṣumbhaka</s>, rolling down from the mountain, said this:

children.text: vṛścikasyārasaṃ viṣam arasaṃ vṛścika te viṣam ||
children.translated_text: 'The scorpion's poison is sapless; sapless, O scorpion, is your poison.'

children.text: Chapter 192
tvam agne dyubhis tvam āśuśukṣaṇis tvam adbhyas tvam aśmanas pari
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are born from the lights; you are the swift-glowing one, from the waters and from around the stone.

children.text: tvaṃ vanebhyas tvam oṣadhībhyas tvaṃ nṛṇāṃ nṛpate jāyase śuciḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are born pure from the forests, from the plants, and among men, O king of men.

children.text: tavāgne hotraṃ tava potram ṛtviyaṃ tava neṣṭraṃ tvam agnid ṛtāyataḥ
children.translated_text: Yours, O <s>Agni</s>, is the office of <s>hotar</s> (invoking priest); yours is the office of <s>potar</s> (purifying priest), duly timed; yours is the office of <s>neṣṭar</s> (guiding priest); you are the <s>agnīdh</s> (fire-kindler), serving <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: tava praśāstraṃ tvam adhvarīyasi brahmā cāsi gṛhapatiś ca no dame ||
children.translated_text: Yours is the office of <s>praśāstar</s> (directing priest); you perform the <s>adhvaryu</s>'s work; and you are the <s>brahman</s> (supervising priest) and the lord of the house in our home.

children.text: tvam agna indro vṛṣabhaḥ satām asi tvaṃ viṣṇur urugāyo namasyaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are <s>Indra</s>, the bull of those who exist; you are <s>Viṣṇu</s>, wide-striding and worthy of homage.

children.text: tvam brahmā rayivid brahmaṇaspate tvaṃ vidhartaḥ sacase purandhyā ||
children.translated_text: You are the <s>brahman</s> (priest), finder of wealth, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>; you, O ordainer, accompany inspired wisdom.

children.text: tvam agne rājā varuṇo dhṛtavratas tvam mitro bhavasi dasma īḍyaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are king <s>Varuṇa</s>, firm in vows; you become <s>Mitra</s>, wondrous and praiseworthy.

children.text: tvam aryamā satpatir yasya saṃbhujaṃ tvam aṃśo vidathe deva bhājayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are <s>Aryaman</s>, lord of the good, with whom there is fellowship; you are <s>Aṃśa</s>, O god, the apportioner in the assembly.

children.text: tvam agne tvaṣṭā vidhate suvīryaṃ tava gnāvo mitramahaḥ sajātyam
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, granting good heroic strength to the worshipper; yours is the kinship of the goddesses, O great friend.

children.text: tvam āśuhemā rariṣe svaśvyaṃ tvaṃ narāṃ śardho asi purūvasuḥ ||
children.translated_text: You swiftly bestow good horses; you are the host of men, rich in many goods.

children.text: tvam agne rudro asuro maho divas tvaṃ śardho mārutam pṛkṣa īśiṣe
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are <s>Rudra</s>, the mighty <s>asura</s> of great heaven; you rule the <s>Marut</s> host and its nourishment.

children.text: tvaṃ vātair aruṇair yāsi śaṅgayas tvam pūṣā vidhataḥ pāsi nu tmanā ||
children.translated_text: You go with the ruddy winds, bringing well-being; you are <s>Pūṣan</s>, and by yourself you protect the worshipper.

children.text: tvam agne draviṇodā araṅkṛte tvaṃ devaḥ savitā ratnadhā asi
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are <s>Draviṇodas</s> for the one who has made ready; you are the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, the placer of treasures.

children.text: tvam bhago nṛpate vasva īśiṣe tvam pāyur dame yas te 'vidhat ||
children.translated_text: You are <s>Bhaga</s>, lord of men; you rule over wealth, and you are the protector in the house of the one who has worshipped you.

children.text: tvām agne dama ā viśpatiṃ viśas tvāṃ rājānaṃ suvidatram ṛñjate
children.translated_text: The clans adorn you, O <s>Agni</s>, in the house as lord of the people; they adorn you as king, the good giver.

children.text: tvaṃ viśvāni svanīka patyase tvaṃ sahasrāṇi śatā daśa prati ||
children.translated_text: You, fair-faced one, have mastery over all things; you receive thousands, hundreds, and tens.

children.text: tvām agne pitaram iṣṭibhir naras tvām bhrātrāya śamyā tanūrucam
children.translated_text: Men approach you, O <s>Agni</s>, as a father with offerings, and you as a brother through their labor, shining in body.

children.text: tvam putro bhavasi yas te 'vidhat tvaṃ sakhā suśevaḥ pāsy ādhṛṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You become the son of the one who has worshipped you; you are a gracious friend and an unconquerable guardian.

children.text: tvam agna ṛbhur āke namasyas tvaṃ vājasya kṣumato rāya īśiṣe
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are the nearby <s>Ṛbhu</s>, worthy of reverence; you rule over the prize and over abundant wealth.

children.text: tvaṃ vi bhāsy anu dakṣi dāvane tvaṃ viśikṣur asi yajñam ātaniḥ ||
children.translated_text: You shine forth for giving after the offering; you are the instructor who stretches out the sacrifice.

children.text: tvam agne aditir deva dāśuṣe tvaṃ hotrā bhāratī vardhase girā
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are <s>Aditi</s> for the worshipper; you are the <s>Hotrā Bhāratī</s>, growing through song.

children.text: tvam iḍā śatahimāsi dakṣase tvaṃ vṛtrahā vasupate sarasvatī ||
children.translated_text: You are <s>Iḍā</s>, lasting for a hundred winters, for skill; you are <s>Vṛtrahan</s>, lord of goods, and <s>Sarasvatī</s>.

children.text: tvam agne subhṛta uttamaṃ vayas tava spārhe varṇa ā saṃdṛśi śriyaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O well-borne <s>Agni</s>, are the highest vigor; in your desirable color there is splendor to behold.

children.text: tvaṃ vājaḥ prataraṇo bṛhann asi tvaṃ rayir bahulo viśvatas pṛthuḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are the prize, great and carrying across; you are wealth, abundant and broad on every side.

children.text: tvām agna ādityāsa āsyaṃ tvāṃ jihvāṃ śucayaś cakrire kave
children.translated_text: The <s>Ādityas</s> made you their mouth, and the pure ones made you their tongue, O poet.

children.text: tvāṃ rātiṣāco adhvareṣu saścire tve devā havir adanty āhutam ||
children.translated_text: Those who win gifts attend you in the sacrifices; in you the gods eat the offered oblation.

children.text: tve agne viśve amṛtāso adruha āsā devā havir adanty āhutam
children.translated_text: In you, O <s>Agni</s>, all the undeceiving immortal gods eat the offered oblation with their mouths.

children.text: tvayā martāsaḥ svadanta āsutiṃ tvaṃ garbho vīrudhāṃ jajñiṣe śuciḥ ||
children.translated_text: Through you mortals taste the pressed offering; you are born pure as the embryo of the plants.

children.text: tvaṃ tān saṃ ca prati cāsi majmanāgne sujāta pra ca deva ricyase
children.translated_text: You encompass those and face them by your greatness, O well-born <s>Agni</s>; as god you surpass them.

children.text: pṛkṣo yad atra mahinā vi te bhuvad anu dyāvāpṛthivī rodasī ubhe ||
children.translated_text: When nourishment here becomes manifest through your greatness, <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, both worlds, follow after it.

children.text: ye stotṛbhyo goagrām aśvapeśasam agne rātim upasṛjanti sūrayaḥ
children.translated_text: The generous patrons who release for the singers a gift headed by cattle and adorned with horses, O <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: asmāñ ca tāṃś ca pra hi neṣi vasya ā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: lead us and them onward to better wealth; may we speak aloud in the assembly, rich in heroes.

children.text: Chapter 193
yajñena vardhata jātavedasam agniṃ yajadhvaṃ haviṣā tanā girā
children.translated_text: Increase <s>Jātavedas</s> by sacrifice; worship <s>Agni</s> with oblation, with offspring, and with song.

children.text: samidhānaṃ suprayasaṃ svarṇaraṃ dyukṣaṃ hotāraṃ vṛjaneṣu dhūrṣadam ||
children.translated_text: Worship him kindled, very bountiful, golden, bright, the <s>hotar</s> (sacrificial priest), seated at the front in contests.

children.text: abhi tvā naktīr uṣaso vavāśire 'gne vatsaṃ na svasareṣu dhenavaḥ
children.translated_text: The nights and dawns have called out to you, O <s>Agni</s>, like milk-cows to a calf in their stalls.

children.text: diva ived aratir mānuṣā yugā kṣapo bhāsi puruvāra saṃyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like the messenger of heaven through human generations, you shine through the nights, much-desired and held in order.

children.text: taṃ devā budhne rajasaḥ sudaṃsasaṃ divaspṛthivyor aratiṃ ny erire
children.translated_text: The gods set him, skillful, at the base of the midspace, the messenger of heaven and earth.

children.text: ratham iva vedyaṃ śukraśociṣam agnim mitraṃ na kṣitiṣu praśaṃsyam ||
children.translated_text: They set <s>Agni</s>, with bright flame, knowable like a chariot, praiseworthy among peoples like <s>Mitra</s>.

children.text: tam ukṣamāṇaṃ rajasi sva ā dame candram iva surucaṃ hvāra ā dadhuḥ
children.translated_text: They placed him, being sprinkled, in his own realm, in the house, shining like the moon with fair light in the enclosure.

children.text: pṛśnyāḥ pataraṃ citayantam akṣabhiḥ pātho na pāyuṃ janasī ubhe anu ||
children.translated_text: They set him, the wing of <s>Pṛśni</s>, perceiving with his eyes, like a guardian of the path, following both peoples.

children.text: sa hotā viśvam pari bhūtv adhvaraṃ tam u havyair manuṣa ṛñjate girā
children.translated_text: He, the <s>hotar</s>, having encompassed the whole rite, is adorned by men with oblations and with song.

children.text: hiriśipro vṛdhasānāsu jarbhurad dyaur na stṛbhiś citayad rodasī anu ||
children.translated_text: Tawny-lipped, crackling among the growing plants, like heaven with stars he lights up the two worlds.

children.text: sa no revat samidhānaḥ svastaye saṃdadasvān rayim asmāsu dīdihi
children.translated_text: Kindled richly for our welfare, joining wealth to us, shine forth among us.

children.text: ā naḥ kṛṇuṣva suvitāya rodasī agne havyā manuṣo deva vītaye ||
children.translated_text: Make <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, Heaven and Earth, favorable for our good course, O <s>Agni</s>; O god, receive the human oblations for enjoyment.

children.text: dā no agne bṛhato dāḥ sahasriṇo duro na vājaṃ śrutyā apā vṛdhi
children.translated_text: Give us, O <s>Agni</s>, from the great and from the thousandfold; open the door to the prize through renown.

children.text: prācī dyāvāpṛthivī brahmaṇā kṛdhi svar ṇa śukram uṣaso vi didyutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With prayer make <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, Heaven and Earth, face eastward, gleaming like bright dawns with the sun.

children.text: sa idhāna uṣaso rāmyā anu svar ṇa dīded aruṣeṇa bhānunā
children.translated_text: Kindled along the lovely dawns, he shines like the sun with ruddy radiance.

children.text: hotrābhir agnir manuṣaḥ svadhvaro rājā viśām atithiś cārur āyave ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, with priestly offices and good rites among men, is king of the clans and a lovely guest for <s>Āyu</s>.

children.text: evā no agne amṛteṣu pūrvya dhīṣ pīpāya bṛhaddiveṣu mānuṣā
children.translated_text: Thus for us, O <s>Agni</s>, ancient one among the immortals, let human insight swell in the great days.

children.text: duhānā dhenur vṛjaneṣu kārave tmanā śatinam pururūpam iṣaṇi ||
children.translated_text: Like a milking cow in the settlements for the singer, by herself she impels hundredfold and manifold nourishment.

children.text: vayam agne arvatā vā suvīryam brahmaṇā vā citayemā janāṁ ati
children.translated_text: May we, O <s>Agni</s>, by a courser, or by heroic strength, or by prayer, surpass these peoples.

children.text: asmākaṃ dyumnam adhi pañca kṛṣṭiṣūccā svar ṇa śuśucīta duṣṭaram ||
children.translated_text: May our splendor among the five tribes shine high like the sun, hard to overcome.

children.text: sa no bodhi sahasya praśaṃsyo yasmin sujātā iṣayanta sūrayaḥ
children.translated_text: Be for us, mighty one, worthy of praise, in whom the well-born patrons seek nourishment.

children.text: yam agne yajñam upayanti vājino nitye toke dīdivāṃsaṃ sve dame ||
children.translated_text: To whom, O <s>Agni</s>, the vigorous come for the sacrifice, shining constantly in their own house for offspring.

children.text: ubhayāso jātavedaḥ syāma te stotāro agne sūrayaś ca śarmaṇi
children.translated_text: O <s>Jātavedas</s>, may we be both your praisers, O <s>Agni</s>, and generous patrons within your protection.

children.text: vasvo rāyaḥ puruścandrasya bhūyasaḥ prajāvataḥ svapatyasya śagdhi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Grant us wealth, much-shining and abundant, rich in offspring and good children.

children.text: ye stotṛbhyo goagrām aśvapeśasam agne rātim upasṛjanti sūrayaḥ
children.translated_text: The generous patrons who release for the singers a gift headed by cattle and adorned with horses, O <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: asmāñ ca tāṃś ca pra hi neṣi vasya ā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: lead us and them onward to better wealth; may we speak aloud in the assembly, rich in heroes.

children.text: Chapter 194
samiddho agnir nihitaḥ pṛthivyām pratyaṅ viśvāni bhuvanāny asthāt
children.translated_text: Kindled <s>Agni</s>, placed in the earth, has stood facing all beings.

children.text: hotā pāvakaḥ pradivaḥ sumedhā devo devān yajatv agnir arhan ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Agni</s>, the purifying <s>hotar</s> (sacrificial priest), wise from of old, the worthy god, worship the gods.

children.text: narāśaṃsaḥ prati dhāmāny añjan tisro divaḥ prati mahnā svarciḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Narāśaṃsa</s>, anointing the stations, shines toward the three heavens by his greatness;

children.text: ghṛtapruṣā manasā havyam undan mūrdhan yajñasya sam anaktu devān ||
children.translated_text: with ghee-sprinkling mind he moistens the oblation; at the head of the sacrifice may he anoint the gods.

children.text: īḍito agne manasā no arhan devān yakṣi mānuṣāt pūrvo adya
children.translated_text: Praised, O <s>Agni</s>, worthy in our thought, sacrifice today to the gods before the human worshipper;

children.text: sa ā vaha marutāṃ śardho acyutam indraṃ naro barhiṣadaṃ yajadhvam ||
children.translated_text: bring here the unfailing host of the <s>Maruts</s>; O men, worship <s>Indra</s> seated on the sacred grass.

children.text: deva barhir vardhamānaṃ suvīraṃ stīrṇaṃ rāye subharaṃ vedy asyām
children.translated_text: O divine <s>barhis</s> (sacrificial grass), growing, rich in heroes, spread on this altar, easy to bear for wealth;

children.text: ghṛtenāktaṃ vasavaḥ sīdatedaṃ viśve devā ādityā yajñiyāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: anointed with ghee, sit on it, O <s>Vasus</s>, all you gods and worshipful <s>Ādityas</s>.

children.text: vi śrayantām urviyā hūyamānā dvāro devīḥ suprāyaṇā namobhiḥ
children.translated_text: Let the divine doors, invoked with reverence, open out widely and offer an easy passage;

children.text: vyacasvatīr vi prathantām ajuryā varṇam punānā yaśasaṃ suvīram ||
children.translated_text: wide-spreading and ageless, let them extend, purifying their color, with glorious heroic power.

children.text: sādhv apāṃsi sanatā na ukṣite uṣāsānaktā vayyeva raṇvite
children.translated_text: The <s>Dawn</s> and <s>Night</s>, from of old doing their works well, well-moistened for us, delight like two weavers;

children.text: tantuṃ tataṃ saṃvayantī samīcī yajñasya peśaḥ sudughe payasvatī ||
children.translated_text: weaving together the stretched thread in harmony, they make the sacrifice's bright form, good-milking and rich in milk.

children.text: daivyā hotārā prathamā viduṣṭara ṛju yakṣataḥ sam ṛcā vapuṣṭarā
children.translated_text: The two divine <s>hotars</s> (sacrificial priests), first and most knowing, sacrifice straightly, joined with the hymn and most beautiful in form;

children.text: devān yajantāv ṛtuthā sam añjato nābhā pṛthivyā adhi sānuṣu triṣu ||
children.translated_text: sacrificing to the gods in due season, they anoint themselves at the navel of the earth and on the three heights.

children.text: sarasvatī sādhayantī dhiyaṃ na iḍā devī bhāratī viśvatūrtiḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Sarasvatī</s>, accomplishing our inspired thought, the goddess <s>Iḍā</s>, and all-surpassing <s>Bhāratī</s>,

children.text: tisro devīḥ svadhayā barhir edam acchidram pāntu śaraṇaṃ niṣadya ||
children.translated_text: these three goddesses, by their own power, sitting on this sacred grass, protect the shelter without breach.

children.text: piśaṅgarūpaḥ subharo vayodhāḥ śruṣṭī vīro jāyate devakāmaḥ
children.translated_text: Brown in form, easy to bear, bestowing vigor, the swift hero is born, longing for the gods;

children.text: prajāṃ tvaṣṭā vi ṣyatu nābhim asme athā devānām apy etu pāthaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> extend offspring and the central bond for us; then may he enter the path of the gods.

children.text: vanaspatir avasṛjann upa sthād agnir haviḥ sūdayāti pra dhībhiḥ
children.translated_text: The forest-lord has stood near, releasing; <s>Agni</s> prepares the oblation with inspired thoughts.

children.text: tridhā samaktaṃ nayatu prajānan devebhyo daivyaḥ śamitopa havyam ||
children.translated_text: Knowing well, let the divine preparer lead the thrice-anointed offering to the gods, near with the oblation.

children.text: ghṛtam mimikṣe ghṛtam asya yonir ghṛte śrito ghṛtam v asya dhāma
children.translated_text: I mix the ghee; ghee is its womb; in ghee it rests, and ghee indeed is its abode.

children.text: anuṣvadham ā vaha mādayasva svāhākṛtaṃ vṛṣabha vakṣi havyam ||
children.translated_text: Bring it according to its proper share; rejoice; O bull, carry the oblation made with <s>svāhā</s>.

children.text: Chapter 195
huve vaḥ sudyotmānaṃ suvṛktiṃ viśām agnim atithiṃ suprayasam
children.translated_text: I call for you <s>Agni</s>, brightly shining, well praised, the guest of the clans, rich in good offerings,

children.text: mitra iva yo didhiṣāyyo bhūd deva ādeve jane jātavedāḥ ||
children.translated_text: who, like <s>Mitra</s>, became worthy to be cherished, <s>Jātavedas</s>, a god among a godless people.

children.text: imaṃ vidhanto apāṃ sadhasthe dvitādadhur bhṛgavo vikṣv āyoḥ
children.translated_text: Serving him in the seat of the waters, the <s>Bhṛgus</s> placed him a second time among the peoples of <s>Āyu</s>.

children.text: eṣa viśvāny abhy astu bhūmā devānām agnir aratir jīrāśvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May this <s>Agni</s>, the gods' swift-horsed messenger, stand over all the wide realms.

children.text: agniṃ devāso mānuṣīṣu vikṣu priyaṃ dhuḥ kṣeṣyanto na mitram
children.translated_text: The gods set dear <s>Agni</s> among human settlements, as dwellers set a friend in their home.

children.text: sa dīdayad uśatīr ūrmyā ā dakṣāyyo yo dāsvate dama ā ||
children.translated_text: He shone forth over the eager waves, skilful and effective, coming into the house for the giver.

children.text: asya raṇvā svasyeva puṣṭiḥ saṃdṛṣṭir asya hiyānasya dakṣoḥ
children.translated_text: His joyous sight is like one's own prosperity; the vision of him rushing onward is strength.

children.text: vi yo bharibhrad oṣadhīṣu jihvām atyo na rathyo dodhavīti vārān ||
children.translated_text: He sets his tongue moving among the plants; like a racehorse on the road he shakes out his hair.

children.text: ā yan me abhvaṃ vanadaḥ panantośigbhyo nāmimīta varṇam
children.translated_text: When the forest-eating one, roaring toward me, measured out his color for those who longed for him,

children.text: sa citreṇa cikite raṃsu bhāsā jujurvāṁ yo muhur ā yuvā bhūt ||
children.translated_text: he was recognized by his bright, variegated radiance, he who, though old, again and again becomes young.

children.text: ā yo vanā tātṛṣāṇo na bhāti vār ṇa pathā rathyeva svānīt
children.translated_text: He who, thirsting for the forests, shines like water, has guided his own course like a chariot on the road.

children.text: kṛṣṇādhvā tapū raṇvaś ciketa dyaur iva smayamāno nabhobhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: With black path, blazing and delightful, he has appeared like heaven smiling with clouds.

children.text: sa yo vy asthād abhi dakṣad urvīm paśur naiti svayur agopāḥ
children.translated_text: He who has spread apart and burned over the broad earth goes like a beast, self-guided, without a herdsman.

children.text: agniḥ śociṣmāṁ atasāny uṣṇan kṛṣṇavyathir asvadayan na bhūma ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, flame-bright, heating the brushwood, blackening his track, gives the ground no delight.

children.text: nū te pūrvasyāvaso adhītau tṛtīye vidathe manma śaṃsi
children.translated_text: Now, in reciting your former aid, at the third rite I proclaim a hymn,

children.text: asme agne saṃyadvīram bṛhantaṃ kṣumantaṃ vājaṃ svapatyaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: that you may give us, O <s>Agni</s>, great wealth with united heroes, rich in land, prize, and good offspring.

children.text: tvayā yathā gṛtsamadāso agne guhā vanvanta uparāṁ abhi ṣyuḥ
children.translated_text: Through you, as the <s>Gṛtsamadas</s>, O <s>Agni</s>, winning in secret, pressed on toward the farther spaces,

children.text: suvīrāso abhimātiṣāhaḥ smat sūribhyo gṛṇate tad vayo dhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: rich in heroes and overcoming assaults, so bestow that vigor on us and on the patrons who praise.

children.text: Chapter 196
hotājaniṣṭa cetanaḥ pitā pitṛbhya ūtaye
children.translated_text: The conscious <s>hotar</s> (sacrificial priest) has been born, a father for the aid of the fathers,

children.text: prayakṣañ jenyaṃ vasu śakema vājino yamam ||
children.translated_text: offering the wealth to be won; may we be able to master the prize of the coursers.

children.text: ā yasmin sapta raśmayas tatā yajñasya netari
children.translated_text: In him the seven rays are stretched out, in the leader of the sacrifice;

children.text: manuṣvad daivyam aṣṭamam potā viśvaṃ tad invati ||
children.translated_text: the divine eighth <s>potar</s> (purifying priest), acting like <s>Manu</s>, impels all that.

children.text: dadhanve vā yad īm anu vocad brahmāṇi ver u tat
children.translated_text: Whether he stretched himself out, or one spoke the sacred formulas after him, that very power

children.text: pari viśvāni kāvyā nemiś cakram ivābhavat ||
children.translated_text: became encompassing all inspired works, like the rim around a wheel.

children.text: sākaṃ hi śucinā śuciḥ praśāstā kratunājani
children.translated_text: For together with the bright one, himself bright, he was born as commander through insight;

children.text: vidvāṁ asya vratā dhruvā vayā ivānu rohate ||
children.translated_text: knowing his firm ordinances, he climbs after them like branches.

children.text: tā asya varṇam āyuvo neṣṭuḥ sacanta dhenavaḥ
children.translated_text: The living cows follow his color at the guidance of the <s>neṣṭṛ</s> (ritual leader);

children.text: kuvit tisṛbhya ā varaṃ svasāro yā idaṃ yayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: perhaps the sisters who have come here from the three have chosen the better share.

children.text: yadī mātur upa svasā ghṛtam bharanty asthita
children.translated_text: When the sisters of the mother bring ghee to him as he stands near,

children.text: tāsām adhvaryur āgatau yavo vṛṣṭīva modate ||
children.translated_text: at their arrival the <s>adhvaryu</s> (ritual officiant) rejoices like barley in the rain.

children.text: svaḥ svāya dhāyase kṛṇutām ṛtvig ṛtvijam
children.translated_text: Let each make one of his own kind for his own nourishment, each priest a priest;

children.text: stomaṃ yajñaṃ cād araṃ vanemā rarimā vayam ||
children.translated_text: may we win praise and sacrifice enough, and may we bestow bounty.

children.text: yathā vidvāṁ araṃ karad viśvebhyo yajatebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: As the knowing one will make it sufficient for all those worthy of worship,

children.text: ayam agne tve api yaṃ yajñaṃ cakṛmā vayam ||
children.translated_text: so, O <s>Agni</s>, this sacrifice too, which we have performed, is placed in you.

children.text: Chapter 197
imām me agne samidham imām upasadaṃ vaneḥ
children.translated_text: Accept this kindling-stick of mine, O <s>Agni</s>, accept this attendance;

children.text: imā u ṣu śrudhī giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: listen well to these songs.

children.text: ayā te agne vidhemorjo napād aśvamiṣṭe
children.translated_text: With this, O <s>Agni</s>, child of strength, who delights in horses, we serve you;

children.text: enā sūktena sujāta ||
children.translated_text: with this well-born hymn.

children.text: taṃ tvā gīrbhir girvaṇasaṃ draviṇasyuṃ draviṇodaḥ
children.translated_text: You, lover of songs, desiring wealth, O giver of wealth,

children.text: saparyema saparyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we, your attendants, would honor with songs.

children.text: sa bodhi sūrir maghavā vasupate vasudāvan
children.translated_text: Awaken for us as a wise patron, a bountiful lord of goods and giver of goods;

children.text: yuyodhy asmad dveṣāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: drive hostile hatreds away from us.

children.text: sa no vṛṣṭiṃ divas pari sa no vājam anarvāṇam
children.translated_text: May he bring us rain from heaven; may he bring us unobstructed prize;

children.text: sa naḥ sahasriṇīr iṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he bring us thousandfold nourishment.

children.text: īḍānāyāvasyave yaviṣṭha dūta no girā
children.translated_text: For the one who praises and seeks help, O youngest messenger, by our song,

children.text: yajiṣṭha hotar ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: come here, O most worshipful <s>hotar</s> (sacrificial priest).

children.text: antar hy agna īyase vidvāñ janmobhayā kave
children.translated_text: For within, O <s>Agni</s>, you move, knowing both births, O seer;

children.text: dūto janyeva mitryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you are like a friendly messenger among the people.

children.text: sa vidvāṁ ā ca piprayo yakṣi cikitva ānuṣak
children.translated_text: As the knowing one, gratify us, and, discerning, worship in due order;

children.text: ā cāsmin satsi barhiṣi ||
children.translated_text: and sit here upon this sacrificial grass.

children.text: Chapter 198
śreṣṭhaṃ yaviṣṭha bhāratāgne dyumantam ā bhara
children.translated_text: O youngest <s>Agni</s> of the Bharatas, bring the best, shining wealth,

children.text: vaso puruspṛhaṃ rayim ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Vasu</s>, wealth much desired by many.

children.text: mā no arātir īśata devasya martyasya ca
children.translated_text: Let no hostility, whether of a god or of a mortal, rule over us;

children.text: parṣi tasyā uta dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: carry us across that, and also across hatred.

children.text: viśvā uta tvayā vayaṃ dhārā udanyā iva
children.translated_text: Together with you may we pass beyond all hatreds,

children.text: ati gāhemahi dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like streams rushing toward water.

children.text: śuciḥ pāvaka vandyo 'gne bṛhad vi rocase
children.translated_text: Pure, purifying, worthy of praise, O <s>Agni</s>, you shine widely,

children.text: tvaṃ ghṛtebhir āhutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when you have been invoked with ghee.

children.text: tvaṃ no asi bhāratāgne vaśābhir ukṣabhiḥ
children.translated_text: You are ours, O Bharata <s>Agni</s>, invoked with cows and bulls,

children.text: aṣṭāpadībhir āhutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: invoked with eight-footed ones.

children.text: drvannaḥ sarpirāsutiḥ pratno hotā vareṇyaḥ
children.translated_text: Wood-eating, with ghee as his drink, the ancient chosen <s>hotar</s> (invoking priest),

children.text: sahasas putro adbhutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the wondrous son of strength.

children.text: Chapter 199
vājayann iva nū rathān yogāṁ agner upa stuhi
children.translated_text: As if yoking prize-winning chariots now, praise the yokings of <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: yaśastamasya mīḍhuṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: of the most renowned, bountiful one.

children.text: yaḥ sunītho dadāśuṣe 'juryo jarayann arim
children.translated_text: He who, a good guide for the giver, unaging, makes the enemy grow old,

children.text: cārupratīka āhutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: beautiful-faced when invoked.

children.text: ya u śriyā dameṣv ā doṣoṣasi praśasyate
children.translated_text: He who by splendor in the homes is praised at evening and at dawn,

children.text: yasya vrataṃ na mīyate ||
children.translated_text: whose ordinance is not diminished.

children.text: ā yaḥ svar ṇa bhānunā citro vibhāty arciṣā
children.translated_text: He who, like the sun, variegated with his radiance, shines with flame,

children.text: añjāno ajarair abhi ||
children.translated_text: anointing himself with undecaying beams.

children.text: atrim anu svarājyam agnim ukthāni vāvṛdhuḥ
children.translated_text: Following <s>Atri</s>'s self-rule, the hymns strengthened <s>Agni</s>;

children.text: viśvā adhi śriyo dadhe ||
children.translated_text: he placed upon himself all splendors.

children.text: agner indrasya somasya devānām ūtibhir vayam
children.translated_text: With the aids of <s>Agni</s>, <s>Indra</s>, <s>Soma</s>, and the gods,

children.text: ariṣyantaḥ sacemahy abhi ṣyāma pṛtanyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: may we, unharmed, keep company; may we prevail over those who fight against us.

children.text: Chapter 200
ni hotā hotṛṣadane vidānas tveṣo dīdivāṁ asadat sudakṣaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>hotar</s> (invoking priest), knowing, fierce, shining, and skillful, has sat down in the hotar's seat;

children.text: adabdhavratapramatir vasiṣṭhaḥ sahasrambharaḥ śucijihvo agniḥ ||
children.translated_text: unbeguiled in vow and mindfulness, most wealthy, bright-tongued <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ dūtas tvam u naḥ paraspās tvaṃ vasya ā vṛṣabha praṇetā
children.translated_text: You are the messenger, and you are our protector from afar; you, O bull, are the leader toward wealth.

children.text: agne tokasya nas tane tanūnām aprayucchan dīdyad bodhi gopāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, guarding our offspring, our line, and our bodies without negligence, shining, be our protector.

children.text: vidhema te parame janmann agne vidhema stomair avare sadhasthe
children.translated_text: We worship you in your highest birth, O <s>Agni</s>; we worship with praises in the lower seat.

children.text: yasmād yoner udārithā yaje tam pra tve havīṃṣi juhure samiddhe ||
children.translated_text: From whatever womb you have arisen, worship that; to you, when kindled, the oblations have been offered.

children.text: agne yajasva haviṣā yajīyāñchruṣṭī deṣṇam abhi gṛṇīhi rādhaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, sacrifice with the oblation, more worthy of sacrifice; with ready hearing proclaim the desirable gift and bounty.

children.text: tvaṃ hy asi rayipatī rayīṇāṃ tvaṃ śukrasya vacaso manotā ||
children.translated_text: For you are the lord of riches among riches; you are the inspirer of the bright word.

children.text: ubhayaṃ te na kṣīyate vasavyaṃ dive dive jāyamānasya dasma
children.translated_text: Both kinds of wealth belonging to you do not diminish, O wondrous one, as you are born day by day;

children.text: kṛdhi kṣumantaṃ jaritāram agne kṛdhi patiṃ svapatyasya rāyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: make the singer full of food, O <s>Agni</s>; make him lord of wealth with good offspring.

children.text: sainānīkena suvidatro asme yaṣṭā devāṁ āyajiṣṭhaḥ svasti
children.translated_text: With your host, O good giver, be for us the sacrificer who worships the gods most worshipfully, for well-being;

children.text: adabdho gopā uta naḥ paraspā agne dyumad uta revad didīhi ||
children.translated_text: unharmed as guardian and also our protector from afar, O <s>Agni</s>, shine with brightness and wealth.

children.text: Chapter 201
johūtro agniḥ prathamaḥ piteveḍas pade manuṣā yat samiddhaḥ
children.translated_text: Invoked, <s>Agni</s> is first, like a father, kindled by men in the place of worship;

children.text: śriyaṃ vasāno amṛto vicetā marmṛjenyaḥ śravasyaḥ sa vājī ||
children.translated_text: clothed in splendor, immortal, discerning, to be cleansed, renowned, he is a prize-winning steed.

children.text: śrūyā agniś citrabhānur havam me viśvābhir gīrbhir amṛto vicetāḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s> of varied light, immortal and discerning, hear my call with all my songs;

children.text: śyāvā rathaṃ vahato rohitā votāruṣāha cakre vibhṛtraḥ ||
children.translated_text: dark-bay ones carry his chariot, or red and ruddy ones; he has made himself a broad bearer.

children.text: uttānāyām ajanayan suṣūtam bhuvad agniḥ purupeśāsu garbhaḥ
children.translated_text: They generated <s>Agni</s>, well-born, in the outstretched one; he became an embryo among the many-hued mothers.

children.text: śiriṇāyāṃ cid aktunā mahobhir aparīvṛto vasati pracetāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even in the night, by his great powers, the wise one dwells uncovered in what is withered.

children.text: jigharmy agniṃ haviṣā ghṛtena pratikṣiyantam bhuvanāni viśvā
children.translated_text: I sprinkle <s>Agni</s> with oblation and ghee, as he dwells facing all beings,

children.text: pṛthuṃ tiraścā vayasā bṛhantaṃ vyaciṣṭham annai rabhasaṃ dṛśānam ||
children.translated_text: broad crosswise, great in vitality, widest, visible, and impetuous with foods.

children.text: ā viśvataḥ pratyañcaṃ jigharmy arakṣasā manasā taj juṣeta
children.translated_text: From every side I sprinkle the one turned toward us; with a demon-free mind may he enjoy that.

children.text: maryaśrī spṛhayadvarṇo agnir nābhimṛśe tanvā jarbhurāṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having the beauty of a young man and a desirable color, <s>Agni</s>, licking with his body, is not to be touched.

children.text: jñeyā bhāgaṃ sahasāno vareṇa tvādūtāso manuvad vadema
children.translated_text: May we know our share by chosen strength; as your messengers, like <s>Manu</s>, may we speak.

children.text: anūnam agniṃ juhvā vacasyā madhupṛcaṃ dhanasā johavīmi ||
children.translated_text: I call upon undiminished <s>Agni</s> with a tongue rich in speech, honey-mixed, winning wealth.

children.text: Chapter 202
śrudhī havam indra mā riṣaṇyaḥ syāma te dāvane vasūnām
children.translated_text: Hear my call, O <s>Indra</s>; do not harm us. May we be yours for the giving of goods.

children.text: imā hi tvām ūrjo vardhayanti vasūyavaḥ sindhavo na kṣarantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For these powers, seeking wealth, increase you, flowing like rivers.

children.text: sṛjo mahīr indra yā apinvaḥ pariṣṭhitā ahinā śūra pūrvīḥ
children.translated_text: Release, O mighty <s>Indra</s>, the great waters, many and held fast, which had stood enclosed by the serpent.

children.text: amartyaṃ cid dāsam manyamānam avābhinad ukthair vāvṛdhānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Growing strong through hymns, you split open even the Dāsa who thought himself immortal.

children.text: uktheṣv in nu śūra yeṣu cākan stomeṣv indra rudriyeṣu ca
children.translated_text: Indeed, in the hymns in which, O hero, you have taken pleasure, and in the chants, O <s>Indra</s>, and in the Rudrian songs,

children.text: tubhyed etā yāsu mandasānaḥ pra vāyave sisrate na śubhrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: for you these songs, in which you rejoice, stream forth like bright ones for <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: śubhraṃ nu te śuṣmaṃ vardhayantaḥ śubhraṃ vajram bāhvor dadhānāḥ
children.translated_text: Increasing now your bright force, placing the bright thunderbolt in your arms,

children.text: śubhras tvam indra vāvṛdhāno asme dāsīr viśaḥ sūryeṇa sahyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: you, bright, O <s>Indra</s>, growing for us, conquered the Dāsa peoples along with the sun.

children.text: guhā hitaṃ guhyaṃ gūḍham apsv apīvṛtam māyinaṃ kṣiyantam
children.translated_text: Hidden in the secret place, concealed, covered in the waters, the wily one dwelling there,

children.text: uto apo dyāṃ tastabhvāṃsam ahann ahiṃ śūra vīryeṇa ||
children.translated_text: and also the one holding back the waters and supporting heaven: you slew the serpent, O hero, with heroic power.

children.text: stavā nu ta indra pūrvyā mahāny uta stavāma nūtanā kṛtāni
children.translated_text: Now I will praise your ancient great deeds, O <s>Indra</s>, and we will praise the new deeds done.

children.text: stavā vajram bāhvor uśantaṃ stavā harī sūryasya ketū ||
children.translated_text: I will praise the thunderbolt eager in your arms; I will praise the two bay horses, the signs of the sun.

children.text: harī nu ta indra vājayantā ghṛtaścutaṃ svāram asvārṣṭām
children.translated_text: Now your two bay horses, O <s>Indra</s>, striving for the prize, have sent forth the ghee-dripping song.

children.text: vi samanā bhūmir aprathiṣṭāraṃsta parvataś cit sariṣyan ||
children.translated_text: The common earth spread out; even the mountains came to rest, though ready to move.

children.text: ni parvataḥ sādy aprayucchan sam mātṛbhir vāvaśāno akrān
children.translated_text: The mountain sat down without neglect; lowing together with the mothers, it strode forth.

children.text: dūre pāre vāṇīṃ vardhayanta indreṣitāṃ dhamanim paprathan ni ||
children.translated_text: Far beyond, spreading the voice, they extended the channel impelled by <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: indro mahāṁ sindhum āśayānam māyāvinaṃ vṛtram asphuran niḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> violently shook loose the great river lying there, the wily <s>Vṛtra</s>;

children.text: arejetāṃ rodasī bhiyāne kanikradato vṛṣṇo asya vajrāt ||
children.translated_text: the two worlds trembled in fear at the roaring thunderbolt of that bull.

children.text: aroravīd vṛṣṇo asya vajro 'mānuṣaṃ yan mānuṣo nijūrvāt
children.translated_text: The thunderbolt of that bull roared when the human hero crushed the non-human one;

children.text: ni māyino dānavasya māyā apādayat papivān sutasya ||
children.translated_text: having drunk of the pressed Soma, he cast down the wiles of the wily Dānava.

children.text: pibā pibed indra śūra somam mandantu tvā mandinaḥ sutāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Drink; let him drink, O heroic <s>Indra</s>, the <s>soma</s>; may the exhilarating pressed draughts gladden you.

children.text: pṛṇantas te kukṣī vardhayantv itthā sutaḥ paura indram āva ||
children.translated_text: Filling your two bellies, may they increase you; thus the pressed drink has helped mighty <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: tve indrāpy abhūma viprā dhiyaṃ vanema ṛtayā sapantaḥ
children.translated_text: In you, O <s>Indra</s>, we inspired poets have found ourselves; may we win insight, pursuing it with truth.

children.text: avasyavo dhīmahi praśastiṃ sadyas te rāyo dāvane syāma ||
children.translated_text: Seeking aid, may we meditate on praise; at once may we be yours for the giving of riches.

children.text: syāma te ta indra ye ta ūtī avasyava ūrjaṃ vardhayantaḥ
children.translated_text: May we be those of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, those under your aid, seeking help and increasing strength.

children.text: śuṣmintamaṃ yaṃ cākanāma devāsme rayiṃ rāsi vīravantam ||
children.translated_text: That most powerful wealth which we desire, O god, grant to us, rich in heroes.

children.text: rāsi kṣayaṃ rāsi mitram asme rāsi śardha indra mārutaṃ naḥ
children.translated_text: Grant us a dwelling; grant us friendship, O <s>Indra</s>; grant us the <s>Marut</s> host.

children.text: sajoṣaso ye ca mandasānāḥ pra vāyavaḥ pānty agraṇītim ||
children.translated_text: Those who are of one accord and exhilarated, the forward winds, protect our leadership.

children.text: vyantv in nu yeṣu mandasānas tṛpat somam pāhi drahyad indra
children.translated_text: Let them move now, among whom you, exhilarated, are satisfied; drink the <s>soma</s>, stand firm, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: asmān su pṛtsv ā tarutrāvardhayo dyām bṛhadbhir arkaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Make us true crossers in battles; with great songs you have made heaven grow.

children.text: bṛhanta in nu ye te tarutrokthebhir vā sumnam āvivāsān
children.translated_text: Great indeed are those who, O crosser, seek your favor with hymns and songs of praise.

children.text: stṛṇānāso barhiḥ pastyāvat tvotā id indra vājam agman ||
children.translated_text: Spreading the sacred grass in the household, protected by you, O <s>Indra</s>, they have reached the prize.

children.text: ugreṣv in nu śūra mandasānas trikadrukeṣu pāhi somam indra
children.translated_text: Among the fierce pressings, O hero, exhilarated, drink the <s>soma</s> at the <s>Trikadrukas</s>, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: pradodhuvacchmaśruṣu prīṇāno yāhi haribhyāṃ sutasya pītim ||
children.translated_text: Shaking your beard and taking delight, come with the two bay steeds to drink the pressed draught.

children.text: dhiṣvā śavaḥ śūra yena vṛtram avābhinad dānum aurṇavābham
children.translated_text: Set on your might, O hero, by which you split <s>Vṛtra</s>, <s>Dānu</s>'s son <s>Aurṇavābha</s>.

children.text: apāvṛṇor jyotir āryāya ni savyataḥ sādi dasyur indra ||
children.translated_text: You opened the light for the <s>Ārya</s>; from the left the <s>Dasyu</s> sank down, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: sanema ye ta ūtibhis taranto viśvā spṛdha āryeṇa dasyūn
children.translated_text: May we win, crossing all rivalries by your aids, overcoming the <s>Dasyus</s> with <s>Ārya</s> power.

children.text: asmabhyaṃ tat tvāṣṭraṃ viśvarūpam arandhayaḥ sākhyasya tritāya ||
children.translated_text: For us, for friendship with <s>Trita</s>, you subdued that <s>Tvāṣṭra</s>, the many-formed <s>Viśvarūpa</s>.

children.text: asya suvānasya mandinas tritasya ny arbudaṃ vāvṛdhāno astaḥ
children.translated_text: For this pressed, exhilarating draught of <s>Trita</s>, growing strong, you cast <s>Arbuda</s> down.

children.text: avartayat sūryo na cakram bhinad valam indro aṅgirasvān ||
children.translated_text: Like the sun a wheel, <s>Indra</s>, accompanied by the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, rolled it down and split <s>Vala</s>.

children.text: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyad indra dakṣiṇā maghonī
children.translated_text: Now may that generous gift of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, be milked out in return as a boon for the singer.

children.text: śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhag bhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Instruct the praisers; let <s>Bhaga</s> not deceive us; may we speak loudly in the assembly, rich in heroes.

children.text: Chapter 203
yo jāta eva prathamo manasvān devo devān kratunā paryabhūṣat
children.translated_text: He who, just born, was first, full of spirit, a god who encompassed the gods by his power,

children.text: yasya śuṣmād rodasī abhyasetāṃ nṛmṇasya mahnā sa janāsa indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: at whose force the two worlds trembled through the greatness of his manly strength: he, O peoples, is <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yaḥ pṛthivīṃ vyathamānām adṛṃhad yaḥ parvatān prakupitāṁ aramṇāt
children.translated_text: He who made firm the trembling earth, who brought the raging mountains to rest,

children.text: yo antarikṣaṃ vimame varīyo yo dyām astabhnāt sa janāsa indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: who measured out the broader midspace, who propped up heaven: he, O peoples, is <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yo hatvāhim ariṇāt sapta sindhūn yo gā udājad apadhā valasya
children.translated_text: He who, having slain the serpent, released the seven rivers; who drove out the cows by opening <s>Vala</s>,

children.text: yo aśmanor antar agniṃ jajāna saṃvṛk samatsu sa janāsa indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: who generated fire between the two stones, the gatherer in battles: he, O peoples, is <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yenemā viśvā cyavanā kṛtāni yo dāsaṃ varṇam adharaṃ guhākaḥ
children.translated_text: By whom all these moving things were made, who hid the <s>Dāsa</s> color below,

children.text: śvaghnīva yo jigīvāṃl lakṣam ādad aryaḥ puṣṭāni sa janāsa indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: who, like a victorious gamester, seized the stake and the prosperities of the <s>Ārya</s>: he, O peoples, is <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yaṃ smā pṛcchanti kuha seti ghoram utem āhur naiṣo astīty enam
children.translated_text: The terrible one about whom they ask, 'Where is he?' and of whom they even say, 'He does not exist,'

children.text: so aryaḥ puṣṭīr vija ivā mināti śrad asmai dhatta sa janāsa indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: he diminishes the enemy's prosperities as if in a game; place your faith in him: he, O peoples, is <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yo radhrasya coditā yaḥ kṛśasya yo brahmaṇo nādhamānasya kīreḥ
children.translated_text: He who is the impeller of the poor man, who of the lean man, who of the priest, of the supplicating singer,

children.text: yuktagrāvṇo yo 'vitā suśipraḥ sutasomasya sa janāsa indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: who, fair-cheeked, protects the one whose pressing-stones are yoked and whose <s>soma</s> is pressed: he, O peoples, is <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yasyāśvāsaḥ pradiśi yasya gāvo yasya grāmā yasya viśve rathāsaḥ
children.translated_text: He whose horses are in every direction, whose cows, whose villages, whose all chariots are there,

children.text: yaḥ sūryaṃ ya uṣasaṃ jajāna yo apāṃ netā sa janāsa indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: who generated the sun and the dawn, who is leader of the waters: he, O peoples, is <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yaṃ krandasī saṃyatī vihvayete pare 'vara ubhayā amitrāḥ
children.translated_text: The one whom the two roaring sides call upon when joined in battle, both the farther and the nearer, both hostile forces,

children.text: samānaṃ cid ratham ātasthivāṃsā nānā havete sa janāsa indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: even those standing on the same chariot call upon him separately: he, O peoples, is <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yasmān na ṛte vijayante janāso yaṃ yudhyamānā avase havante
children.translated_text: Without whom peoples do not conquer, whom fighters call upon for aid in battle,

children.text: yo viśvasya pratimānam babhūva yo acyutacyut sa janāsa indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: who became the measure of the whole world, who makes the unshaken shake: he, O peoples, is <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yaḥ śaśvato mahy eno dadhānān amanyamānāñcharvā jaghāna
children.translated_text: He who struck down with his arrow those who from of old bore great guilt and did not acknowledge him,

children.text: yaḥ śardhate nānudadāti śṛdhyāṃ yo dasyor hantā sa janāsa indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: who does not give way to the arrogant defier, who is the slayer of the <s>Dasyu</s>: he, O peoples, is <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yaḥ śambaram parvateṣu kṣiyantaṃ catvāriṃśyāṃ śarady anvavindat
children.translated_text: He who found <s>Śambara</s> dwelling in the mountains in the fortieth autumn,

children.text: ojāyamānaṃ yo ahiṃ jaghāna dānuṃ śayānaṃ sa janāsa indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: who slew the swelling serpent, the lying <s>Dānu</s>: he, O peoples, is <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yaḥ saptaraśmir vṛṣabhas tuviṣmān avāsṛjat sartave sapta sindhūn
children.translated_text: He who, a seven-rayed bull, very mighty, released the seven rivers to run,

children.text: yo rauhiṇam asphurad vajrabāhur dyām ārohantaṃ sa janāsa indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: who, thunderbolt-armed, shattered <s>Rauhiṇa</s> as he climbed to heaven: he, O peoples, is <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: dyāvā cid asmai pṛthivī namete śuṣmāc cid asya parvatā bhayante
children.translated_text: Even heaven and earth bow to him; even the mountains are afraid of his force.

children.text: yaḥ somapā nicito vajrabāhur yo vajrahastaḥ sa janāsa indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: He who drinks <s>soma</s>, the discerning thunderbolt-armed one, who holds the thunderbolt in his hand: he, O peoples, is <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yaḥ sunvantam avati yaḥ pacantaṃ yaḥ śaṃsantaṃ yaḥ śaśamānam ūtī
children.translated_text: He who protects with aid the <s>soma</s>-presser, who the cooker, who the reciter, who the praising one,

children.text: yasya brahma vardhanaṃ yasya somo yasyedaṃ rādhaḥ sa janāsa indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: whose prayer is strengthening, whose is the <s>soma</s>, whose is this bounty: he, O peoples, is <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yaḥ sunvate pacate dudhra ā cid vājaṃ dardarṣi sa kilāsi satyaḥ
children.translated_text: You indeed are true, you who discern the prize for the presser and the cooker, even in what is difficult.

children.text: vayaṃ ta indra viśvaha priyāsaḥ suvīrāso vidatham ā vadema ||
children.translated_text: May we, O <s>Indra</s>, always dear to you and rich in heroes, speak aloud in the assembly.

children.text: Chapter 204
ṛtur janitrī tasyā apas pari makṣū jāta āviśad yāsu vardhate
children.translated_text: The season was his mother; around her were the waters, and, quickly born, he entered those in which he grows.

children.text: tad āhanā abhavat pipyuṣī payo 'ṃśoḥ pīyūṣam prathamaṃ tad ukthyam ||
children.translated_text: That became the day, swollen with milk; that first nectar of the stalk was worthy of praise.

children.text: sadhrīm ā yanti pari bibhratīḥ payo viśvapsnyāya pra bharanta bhojanam
children.translated_text: Together they come, bearing milk around; for the all-possessing one they bring nourishment forward.

children.text: samāno adhvā pravatām anuṣyade yas tākṛṇoḥ prathamaṃ sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: A common path is followed along the streams; the one whom you first made is therefore worthy of praise.

children.text: anv eko vadati yad dadāti tad rūpā minan tadapā eka īyate
children.translated_text: One after another speaks when he gives; measuring out forms, one goes to the waters.

children.text: viśvā ekasya vinudas titikṣate yas tākṛṇoḥ prathamaṃ sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: All beings seek to drive away the one man; the one whom you first made, he is worthy of praise.

children.text: prajābhyaḥ puṣṭiṃ vibhajanta āsate rayim iva pṛṣṭham prabhavantam āyate
children.translated_text: They sit distributing nourishment among the people, like wealth, like a broad backing that grows for the one who comes.

children.text: asinvan daṃṣṭraiḥ pitur atti bhojanaṃ yas tākṛṇoḥ prathamaṃ sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With gnashing tusks he eats his father's food; the one whom you first made, he is worthy of praise.

children.text: adhākṛṇoḥ pṛthivīṃ saṃdṛśe dive yo dhautīnām ahihann āriṇak pathaḥ
children.translated_text: Then you made the earth visible to heaven; you who slew the serpent of the streams opened the paths.

children.text: taṃ tvā stomebhir udabhir na vājinaṃ devaṃ devā ajanan sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The gods generated you, that god, with praises as if with waters, a prize-winner; he is worthy of praise.

children.text: yo bhojanaṃ ca dayase ca vardhanam ārdrād ā śuṣkam madhumad dudohitha
children.translated_text: You who distribute both food and growth, you have milked the honey-sweet from the moist and from the dry.

children.text: sa śevadhiṃ ni dadhiṣe vivasvati viśvasyaika īśiṣe sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You have set the treasure in <s>Vivasvat</s>; you alone rule over all. He is worthy of praise.

children.text: yaḥ puṣpiṇīś ca prasvaś ca dharmaṇādhi dāne vy avanīr adhārayaḥ
children.translated_text: You who, according to <s>dharma</s> (sacred order), upheld the flowering and the fertile earths in their giving,

children.text: yaś cāsamā ajano didyuto diva urur ūrvāṃ abhitaḥ sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and who generated the matchless flashes of heaven, wide on every side: he is worthy of praise.

children.text: yo nārmaraṃ sahavasuṃ nihantave pṛkṣāya ca dāsaveśāya cāvahaḥ
children.translated_text: You brought down <s>Nārmara</s> and wealthy <s>Sahavasu</s> for destruction, and for <s>Pṛkṣa</s> and <s>Dāsaveśa</s>.

children.text: ūrjayantyā apariviṣṭam āsyam utaivādya purukṛt sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Strengthening, today too, O much-acting one, you made an unenclosed mouth; he is worthy of praise.

children.text: śataṃ vā yasya daśa sākam ādya ekasya śruṣṭau yaddha codam āvitha
children.translated_text: Whether a hundred or ten together, when at the command of one man you aided the impulse,

children.text: arajjau dasyūn sam unab dabhītaye suprāvyo abhavaḥ sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you bound the rope-less <s>Dasyus</s> for <s>Dabhīti</s>; you became easy to cross. He is worthy of praise.

children.text: viśved anu rodhanā asya pauṃsyaṃ dadur asmai dadhire kṛtnave dhanam
children.translated_text: All the enclosures followed his manly power; they gave to him and placed wealth for the skillful one.

children.text: ṣaḍ astabhnā viṣṭiraḥ pañca saṃdṛśaḥ pari paro abhavaḥ sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You propped apart the six expanses and the five visible realms; you became beyond what is further. He is worthy of praise.

children.text: supravācanaṃ tava vīra vīryaṃ yad ekena kratunā vindase vasu
children.translated_text: Your heroic deed is well proclaimed, O hero, when by a single resolve you win wealth.

children.text: jātūṣṭhirasya pra vayaḥ sahasvato yā cakartha sendra viśvāsy ukthyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The strength of firm-born, overpowering <s>Jātūṣṭhira</s>, which you accomplished with <s>Indra</s>, is all worthy of praise.

children.text: aramayaḥ sarapasas tarāya kaṃ turvītaye ca vayyāya ca srutim
children.translated_text: You made a current for <s>Sarapas</s> to cross, and for <s>Turvīti</s> and <s>Vayya</s> to pass through.

children.text: nīcā santam ud anayaḥ parāvṛjam prāndhaṃ śroṇaṃ śravayan sāsy ukthyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You raised up the low-lying, the outcast; you made the blind and lame hear. He is worthy of praise.

children.text: asmabhyaṃ tad vaso dānāya rādhaḥ sam arthayasva bahu te vasavyam
children.translated_text: For us, O good one, make that gift ready for giving; much desirable wealth is yours.

children.text: indra yac citraṃ śravasyā anu dyūn bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, what splendid fame-bringing gift lasts through the days: may we speak it aloud in the assembly, rich in heroes.

children.text: Chapter 205
adhvaryavo bharatendrāya somam āmatrebhiḥ siñcatā madyam andhaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryus</s>, bring <s>soma</s> (pressed ritual drink) for <s>Indra</s>; pour the intoxicating draught with vessels.

children.text: kāmī hi vīraḥ sadam asya pītiṃ juhota vṛṣṇe tad id eṣa vaṣṭi ||
children.translated_text: For the hero always desires to drink it; offer it to the bull, for he wants precisely this.

children.text: adhvaryavo yo apo vavrivāṃsaṃ vṛtraṃ jaghānāśanyeva vṛkṣam
children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryus</s>, he who slew <s>Vṛtra</s>, who had enclosed the waters, as lightning strikes a tree,

children.text: tasmā etam bharata tadvaśāyaṁ eṣa indro arhati pītim asya ||
children.translated_text: for him bring this drink according to his wish; this <s>Indra</s> deserves to drink it.

children.text: adhvaryavo yo dṛbhīkaṃ jaghāna yo gā udājad apa hi valaṃ vaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryus</s>, he who slew <s>Dṛbhīka</s>, who drove out the cows and opened <s>Vala</s> for you,

children.text: tasmā etam antarikṣe na vātam indraṃ somair orṇuta jūr na vastraiḥ ||
children.translated_text: cover that <s>Indra</s> with <s>somas</s>, like wind in the midspace, like an aged man with garments.

children.text: adhvaryavo ya uraṇaṃ jaghāna nava cakhvāṃsaṃ navatiṃ ca bāhūn
