children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryus</s>, he who slew <s>Uraṇa</s>, the ninety-armed one with nine eyes,

children.text: yo arbudam ava nīcā babādhe tam indraṃ somasya bhṛthe hinota ||
children.translated_text: who hurled <s>Arbuda</s> down below: impel that <s>Indra</s> to the bearing of <s>soma</s>.

children.text: adhvaryavo yaḥ sv aśnaṃ jaghāna yaḥ śuṣṇam aśuṣaṃ yo vyaṃsam
children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryus</s>, he who slew <s>Svaśna</s>, who slew <s>Śuṣṇa</s> the parcher, who slew <s>Vyaṃsa</s>,

children.text: yaḥ pipruṃ namuciṃ yo rudhikrāṃ tasmā indrāyāndhaso juhota ||
children.translated_text: who slew <s>Pipru</s>, <s>Namuci</s>, and <s>Rudhikrā</s>: offer the draught to that <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: adhvaryavo yaḥ śataṃ śambarasya puro bibhedāśmaneva pūrvīḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryus</s>, he who broke the hundred ancient forts of <s>Śambara</s>, as with a stone,

children.text: yo varcinaḥ śatam indraḥ sahasram apāvapad bharatā somam asmai ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, who scattered the hundred and thousand of <s>Varcin</s>: bring <s>soma</s> for him.

children.text: adhvaryavo yaḥ śatam ā sahasram bhūmyā upasthe 'vapaj jaghanvān
children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryus</s>, he who, having slain, cast down a hundred and a thousand in the lap of the earth,

children.text: kutsasyāyor atithigvasya vīrān ny āvṛṇag bharatā somam asmai ||
children.translated_text: who enveloped the heroes of <s>Kutsa</s>, <s>Āyu</s>, and <s>Atithigva</s>: bring <s>soma</s> for him.

children.text: adhvaryavo yan naraḥ kāmayādhve śruṣṭī vahanto naśathā tad indre
children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryus</s>, whatever you men desire, carrying eager service, you shall obtain that in <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: gabhastipūtam bharata śrutāyendrāya somaṃ yajyavo juhota ||
children.translated_text: Bring the <s>soma</s>, purified by the hands, for famous <s>Indra</s>; O sacrificers, offer it to him.

children.text: adhvaryavaḥ kartanā śruṣṭim asmai vane nipūtaṃ vana un nayadhvam
children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryus</s>, perform eager service for him; lift up the forest-born, purified in the forest.

children.text: juṣāṇo hastyam abhi vāvaśe va indrāya somam madiraṃ juhota ||
children.translated_text: Accepting it, he has eagerly desired your hand-held offering; offer the exhilarating <s>soma</s> to <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: adhvaryavaḥ payasodhar yathā goḥ somebhir īm pṛṇatā bhojam indram
children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryus</s>, as with the milk-bearing udder of a cow, fill bountiful <s>Indra</s> with <s>somas</s>.

children.text: vedāham asya nibhṛtam ma etad ditsantam bhūyo yajataś ciketa ||
children.translated_text: I know this hidden thing of his: as he wishes to give more, he has recognized the worshipper.

children.text: adhvaryavo yo divyasya vasvo yaḥ pārthivasya kṣamyasya rājā
children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryus</s>, he who is king of heavenly wealth, of earthly wealth, and of what belongs to the ground,

children.text: tam ūrdaraṃ na pṛṇatā yavenendraṃ somebhis tad apo vo astu ||
children.translated_text: fill that <s>Indra</s> with <s>somas</s>, as one fills a belly with barley; let that be your work.

children.text: asmabhyaṃ tad vaso dānāya rādhaḥ sam arthayasva bahu te vasavyam
children.translated_text: For us, O good one, make that gift ready for giving; much desirable wealth is yours.

children.text: indra yac citraṃ śravasyā anu dyūn bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, what splendid fame-bringing gift lasts through the days: may we speak it aloud in the assembly, rich in heroes.

children.text: Chapter 206
pra ghā nv asya mahato mahāni satyā satyasya karaṇāni vocam
children.translated_text: Now I will proclaim the great deeds of this great one, the true acts of the true one.

children.text: trikadrukeṣv apibat sutasyāsya made ahim indro jaghāna ||
children.translated_text: At the <s>Trikadrukas</s> he drank of the pressed <s>soma</s>; in its exhilaration <s>Indra</s> slew the serpent.

children.text: avaṃśe dyām astabhāyad bṛhantam ā rodasī apṛṇad antarikṣam
children.translated_text: He propped up the great heaven in its unsupported place; he filled the two worlds and the midspace.

children.text: sa dhārayat pṛthivīm paprathac ca somasya tā mada indraś cakāra ||
children.translated_text: He held the earth firm and spread it out; in the exhilaration of <s>soma</s> <s>Indra</s> did these things.

children.text: sadmeva prāco vi mimāya mānair vajreṇa khāny atṛṇan nadīnām
children.translated_text: Like a dwelling he measured out the eastern regions with measures; with the thunderbolt he cut open the channels of the rivers.

children.text: vṛthāsṛjat pathibhir dīrghayāthaiḥ somasya tā mada indraś cakāra ||
children.translated_text: He released them freely on their long courses along the paths; in the exhilaration of <s>soma</s> <s>Indra</s> did these things.

children.text: sa pravoḍhṝn parigatyā dabhīter viśvam adhāg āyudham iddhe agnau
children.translated_text: He went around the drivers for <s>Dabhīti</s> and burned every weapon in the kindled fire.

children.text: saṃ gobhir aśvair asṛjad rathebhiḥ somasya tā mada indraś cakāra ||
children.translated_text: He released them with cows, horses, and chariots; in the exhilaration of <s>soma</s> <s>Indra</s> did these things.

children.text: sa īm mahīṃ dhunim etor aramṇāt so asnātṝn apārayat svasti
children.translated_text: He stilled the great roaring stream for <s>Etora</s>; he carried the non-swimmers safely across.

children.text: ta utsnāya rayim abhi pra tasthuḥ somasya tā mada indraś cakāra ||
children.translated_text: They advanced toward wealth for the spring; those acts the exhilarations of <s>Soma</s> made <s>Indra</s> do.

children.text: sodañcaṃ sindhum ariṇān mahitvā vajreṇāna uṣasaḥ sam pipeṣa
children.translated_text: By his greatness he drove the <s>Sindhu</s> upward; with the <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt) he crushed the Dawns together.

children.text: ajavaso javinībhir vivṛścan somasya tā mada indraś cakāra ||
children.translated_text: Cutting apart the unstriving with the swift ones, those acts the exhilarations of <s>Soma</s> made <s>Indra</s> do.

children.text: sa vidvāṁ apagohaṃ kanīnām āvir bhavann ud atiṣṭhat parāvṛk
children.translated_text: Knowing the hidden place of the maidens, becoming manifest, he rose up, driving away the covering one.

children.text: prati śroṇa sthād vy anag acaṣṭa somasya tā mada indraś cakāra ||
children.translated_text: He stood facing the lame one and looked out unhindered; those acts the exhilarations of <s>Soma</s> made <s>Indra</s> do.

children.text: bhinad valam aṅgirobhir gṛṇāno vi parvatasya dṛṃhitāny airat
children.translated_text: Praised together with the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, he split <s>Vala</s>; he opened apart the firm fastenings of the mountain.

children.text: riṇag rodhāṃsi kṛtrimāṇy eṣāṃ somasya tā mada indraś cakāra ||
children.translated_text: He broke apart their artificial barriers; those acts the exhilarations of <s>Soma</s> made <s>Indra</s> do.

children.text: svapnenābhyupyā cumuriṃ dhuniṃ ca jaghantha dasyum pra dabhītim āvaḥ
children.translated_text: Overcoming <s>Cumuri</s> and <s>Dhuni</s> with sleep, you slew the <s>Dasyu</s> and protected <s>Dabhīti</s>.

children.text: rambhī cid atra vivide hiraṇyaṃ somasya tā mada indraś cakāra ||
children.translated_text: Even <s>Rambhī</s> found gold there; those acts the exhilarations of <s>Soma</s> made <s>Indra</s> do.

children.text: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyad indra dakṣiṇā maghonī
children.translated_text: Now may that bounteous gift of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, milk out a chosen boon for the singer.

children.text: śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhag bhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bestow it on the praisers; let not <s>Bhaga</s> cheat us. May we speak greatly in the assembly, rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 207
pra vaḥ satāṃ jyeṣṭhatamāya suṣṭutim agnāv iva samidhāne havir bhare
children.translated_text: For you I bring forth a fair praise to the greatest of the true, like an oblation into kindled <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: indram ajuryaṃ jarayantam ukṣitaṃ sanād yuvānam avase havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: We call ageless <s>Indra</s>, ever young from of old, strengthened, for aid.

children.text: yasmād indrād bṛhataḥ kiṃcanem ṛte viśvāny asmin saṃbhṛtādhi vīryā
children.translated_text: Apart from that great <s>Indra</s>, there is nothing at all; in him all heroic powers are gathered.

children.text: jaṭhare somaṃ tanvī saho maho haste vajram bharati śīrṣaṇi kratum ||
children.translated_text: In his belly he bears <s>Soma</s>, in his body great force and might, in his hand the <s>vajra</s>, and in his head inspired resolve.

children.text: na kṣoṇībhyām paribhve ta indriyaṃ na samudraiḥ parvatair indra te rathaḥ
children.translated_text: Your Indra-power is not encompassed by the lands, nor is your chariot, O <s>Indra</s>, by seas or mountains.

children.text: na te vajram anv aśnoti kaścana yad āśubhiḥ patasi yojanā puru ||
children.translated_text: No one reaches after your <s>vajra</s> when you fly with swift steeds across many yojanas.

children.text: viśve hy asmai yajatāya dhṛṣṇave kratum bharanti vṛṣabhāya saścate
children.translated_text: For all the worshipful ones bring inspired resolve to him, the bold bull, and it clings to him.

children.text: vṛṣā yajasva haviṣā viduṣṭaraḥ pibendra somaṃ vṛṣabheṇa bhānunā ||
children.translated_text: As a bull, sacrifice with the oblation, most discerning one; drink the <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, with bull-like radiance.

children.text: vṛṣṇaḥ kośaḥ pavate madhva ūrmir vṛṣabhānnāya vṛṣabhāya pātave
children.translated_text: The bull's vessel flows, a wave of sweetness, for the bull's food and for the bull to drink.

children.text: vṛṣaṇādhvaryū vṛṣabhāso adrayo vṛṣaṇaṃ somaṃ vṛṣabhāya suṣvati ||
children.translated_text: The bull-like <s>adhvaryu</s> priests and the bull-like pressing stones press bull-like <s>Soma</s> for the bull.

children.text: vṛṣā te vajra uta te vṛṣā ratho vṛṣaṇā harī vṛṣabhāṇy āyudhā
children.translated_text: Bull-like is your <s>vajra</s>, and bull-like your chariot; bull-like are your two bay horses and bull-like your weapons.

children.text: vṛṣṇo madasya vṛṣabha tvam īśiṣa indra somasya vṛṣabhasya tṛpṇuhi ||
children.translated_text: O bull, you are lord of the bull's exhilaration; O <s>Indra</s>, be satisfied with the bull-like <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: pra te nāvaṃ na samane vacasyuvam brahmaṇā yāmi savaneṣu dādhṛṣiḥ
children.translated_text: Like a boat at a meeting, eager for speech, I come to you with sacred utterance, steadfast at the Soma-pressings.

children.text: kuvin no asya vacaso nibodhiṣad indram utsaṃ na vasunaḥ sicāmahe ||
children.translated_text: Perhaps he will take notice of this word of ours; we pour <s>Indra</s> forth like a spring of treasure.

children.text: purā sambādhād abhy ā vavṛtsva no dhenur na vatsaṃ yavasasya pipyuṣī
children.translated_text: Before distress closes in, turn back toward us, like a cow filled with fodder toward her calf.

children.text: sakṛt su te sumatibhiḥ śatakrato sam patnībhir na vṛṣaṇo nasīmahi ||
children.translated_text: Once, O <s>Śatakratu</s>, may we come together with you through your good favor, like bulls with their mates.

children.text: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyad indra dakṣiṇā maghonī
children.translated_text: Now may that bounteous gift of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, milk out a chosen boon for the singer.

children.text: śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhag bhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bestow it on the praisers; let not <s>Bhaga</s> cheat us. May we speak greatly in the assembly, rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 208
tad asmai navyam aṅgirasvad arcata śuṣmā yad asya pratnathodīrate
children.translated_text: Sing to him a new song in the manner of the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, when his powers rise up as in ancient time.

children.text: viśvā yad gotrā sahasā parīvṛtā made somasya dṛṃhitāny airayat ||
children.translated_text: When, in the exhilaration of <s>Soma</s>, he surrounded all the cow-pens with force and opened what was held fast.

children.text: sa bhūtu yo ha prathamāya dhāyasa ojo mimāno mahimānam ātirat
children.translated_text: May he be that one who, for the first draught, measuring out vigor, surpassed greatness.

children.text: śūro yo yutsu tanvam parivyata śīrṣaṇi dyām mahinā praty amuñcata ||
children.translated_text: The hero who in battles girded his body about and, by his greatness, set heaven upon his head.

children.text: adhākṛṇoḥ prathamaṃ vīryam mahad yad asyāgre brahmaṇā śuṣmam airayaḥ
children.translated_text: Then you performed the first great heroic act, when at the beginning you stirred up his might with sacred utterance.

children.text: ratheṣṭhena haryaśvena vicyutāḥ pra jīrayaḥ sisrate sadhryak pṛthak ||
children.translated_text: With the chariot-standing, bay-horsed one, the loosened streams rushed forth together and apart.

children.text: adhā yo viśvā bhuvanābhi majmaneśānakṛt pravayā abhy avardhata
children.translated_text: Then he, becoming lord over all beings by his force, grew mighty with advancing powers.

children.text: ād rodasī jyotiṣā vahnir ātanot sīvyan tamāṃsi dudhitā sam avyayat ||
children.translated_text: Then the bearer spread heaven and earth with light and, as if stitching, wrapped away the darknesses that were ill-set.

children.text: sa prācīnān parvatān dṛṃhad ojasādharācīnam akṛṇod apām apaḥ
children.translated_text: With his strength he fixed the eastern mountains and made the course of the waters flow downward.

children.text: adhārayat pṛthivīṃ viśvadhāyasam astabhnān māyayā dyām avasrasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He upheld the all-nourishing earth; with power he propped up heaven from falling.

children.text: sāsmā aram bāhubhyāṃ yam pitākṛṇod viśvasmād ā januṣo vedasas pari
children.translated_text: This was made ready for him by the father with both arms, from every birth of the knowing one.

children.text: yenā pṛthivyāṃ ni kriviṃ śayadhyai vajreṇa hatvy avṛṇak tuviṣvaṇiḥ ||
children.translated_text: With that, having struck with the <s>vajra</s>, the mighty-sounding one laid <s>Krivi</s> down upon the earth.

children.text: amājūr iva pitroḥ sacā satī samānād ā sadasas tvām iye bhagam
children.translated_text: Like a young woman staying together with her parents, from the common seat I seek you for a share.

children.text: kṛdhi praketam upa māsy ā bhara daddhi bhāgaṃ tanvo yena māmahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Make clear knowledge; bring it here to me. Grant a portion of the body by which we may grow mighty.

children.text: bhojaṃ tvām indra vayaṃ huvema dadiṣ ṭvam indrāpāṃsi vājān
children.translated_text: We would call upon you, O <s>Indra</s>, as a generous giver; may you, O <s>Indra</s>, grant powers and prizes.

children.text: aviḍḍhīndra citrayā na ūtī kṛdhi vṛṣann indra vasyaso naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Help us, O <s>Indra</s>, with splendid aid; make us wealthier, O bullish <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyad indra dakṣiṇā maghonī
children.translated_text: Now may that bounteous gift of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, milk out a chosen boon for the singer.

children.text: śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhag bhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bestow it on the praisers; let not <s>Bhaga</s> cheat us. May we speak greatly in the assembly, rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 209
prātā ratho navo yoji sasniś caturyugas trikaśaḥ saptaraśmiḥ
children.translated_text: At morning the new chariot was yoked, victorious, four-yoked, three-lashed, seven-reined.

children.text: daśāritro manuṣyaḥ svarṣāḥ sa iṣṭibhir matibhī raṃhyo bhūt ||
children.translated_text: With ten oars, human, winning the sun, it became swift through offerings and inspired thoughts.

children.text: sāsmā aram prathamaṃ sa dvitīyam uto tṛtīyam manuṣaḥ sa hotā
children.translated_text: This first was made ready for him, and the second, and also the third; he is the <s>hotar</s> of <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: anyasyā garbham anya ū jananta so anyebhiḥ sacate jenyo vṛṣā ||
children.translated_text: One generated the embryo of another; he, a conquerable bull, accompanies the others.

children.text: harī nu kaṃ ratha indrasya yojam āyai sūktena vacasā navena
children.translated_text: Now I yoke the bay horses to <s>Indra</s>'s chariot for his coming, with a new hymn and speech.

children.text: mo ṣu tvām atra bahavo hi viprā ni rīraman yajamānāso anye ||
children.translated_text: Let not many poets here, other sacrificers, hold you back at all.

children.text: ā dvābhyāṃ haribhyām indra yāhy ā caturbhir ā ṣaḍbhir hūyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: Come, O <s>Indra</s>, with two bay horses; come when called with four, come with six.

children.text: āṣṭābhir daśabhiḥ somapeyam ayaṃ sutaḥ sumakha mā mṛdhas kaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With eight or ten teams, come to the Soma-drinking; this pressed draught is here, O good sacrificer; let no foe harm me.

children.text: ā viṃśatyā triṃśatā yāhy arvāṅ ā catvāriṃśatā haribhir yujānaḥ
children.translated_text: With twenty or thirty, come hither, yoking your bay horses;

children.text: ā pañcāśatā surathebhir indrā ṣaṣṭyā saptatyā somapeyam ||
children.translated_text: with fifty well-charioted ones, O <s>Indra</s>, with sixty or seventy, come to the Soma-drinking.

children.text: āśītyā navatyā yāhy arvāṅ ā śatena haribhir uhyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: With eighty or ninety, come hither; with a hundred bay horses be borne here.

children.text: ayaṃ hi te śunahotreṣu soma indra tvāyā pariṣikto madāya ||
children.translated_text: For this Soma has been poured out for you among the good invokers, O <s>Indra</s>, for your exhilaration.

children.text: mama brahmendra yāhy acchā viśvā harī dhuri dhiṣvā rathasya
children.translated_text: Come toward my sacred utterance, O <s>Indra</s>; set both bay horses in every way to the pole of the chariot.

children.text: purutrā hi vihavyo babhūthāsmiñchūra savane mādayasva ||
children.translated_text: For in many places you have become one to be invoked; in this pressing, O hero, take delight.

children.text: na ma indreṇa sakhyaṃ vi yoṣad asmabhyam asya dakṣiṇā duhīta
children.translated_text: Let not my friendship with <s>Indra</s> be severed; may his generous reward milk out benefits for us.

children.text: upa jyeṣṭhe varūthe gabhastau prāye prāye jigīvāṃsaḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: Under the eldest shelter, in the hand, may we be victorious in every contest, again and again.

children.text: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyad indra dakṣiṇā maghonī
children.translated_text: Now may that bounteous reward of yours be milked out for the singer, O <s>Indra</s>, rich in gifts.

children.text: śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhag bhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Teach the singers; let not our share deceive us. May we speak greatly in the assembly, rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 210
apāyy asyāndhaso madāya manīṣiṇaḥ suvānasya prayasaḥ
children.translated_text: The invigorating draught of this pressed Soma, the offering of the thoughtful men, has been drunk for exhilaration,

children.text: yasminn indraḥ pradivi vāvṛdhāna oko dadhe brahmaṇyantaś ca naraḥ ||
children.translated_text: in which <s>Indra</s>, growing mighty from the beginning, made his home, and the men desiring sacred utterance as well.

children.text: asya mandāno madhvo vajrahasto 'him indro arṇovṛtaṃ vi vṛścat
children.translated_text: Rejoicing in this sweetness, the thunderbolt-handed <s>Indra</s> split apart the serpent who enclosed the flood.

children.text: pra yad vayo na svasarāṇy acchā prayāṃsi ca nadīnāṃ cakramanta ||
children.translated_text: When, like birds toward their own nests, the courses and streams of the rivers set themselves in motion.

children.text: sa māhina indro arṇo apām prairayad ahihācchā samudram
children.translated_text: That mighty <s>Indra</s> drove the flood of the waters from the serpent-slayer toward the ocean.

children.text: ajanayat sūryaṃ vidad gā aktunāhnāṃ vayunāni sādhat ||
children.translated_text: He generated the sun; he found the cows; by night and day he established the ordered ways.

children.text: so apratīni manave purūṇīndro dāśad dāśuṣe hanti vṛtram
children.translated_text: That <s>Indra</s> gave many irresistible gifts to <s>Manu</s>, to the worshipper who gives; he slays <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: sadyo yo nṛbhyo atasāyyo bhūt paspṛdhānebhyaḥ sūryasya sātau ||
children.translated_text: At once he became unsurpassable for men, when they contended for the winning of the sun.

children.text: sa sunvata indraḥ sūryam ā devo riṇaṅ martyāya stavān
children.translated_text: That god <s>Indra</s> brought the sun to the Soma-presser, to the mortal who praises him.

children.text: ā yad rayiṃ guhadavadyam asmai bharad aṃśaṃ naitaśo daśasyan ||
children.translated_text: When he carried wealth, faultless and hidden, to him, honoring him like a share of the oblation.

children.text: sa randhayat sadivaḥ sārathaye śuṣṇam aśuṣaṃ kuyavaṃ kutsāya
children.translated_text: He subdued <s>Śuṣṇa</s>, son of <s>Sadivas</s>, the parcher, and <s>Kuyava</s> for the charioteer <s>Kutsa</s>.

children.text: divodāsāya navatiṃ ca navendraḥ puro vy airacchambarasya ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Divodāsa</s>, <s>Indra</s> tore apart ninety and nine forts of <s>Śambara</s>.

children.text: evā ta indrocatham ahema śravasyā na tmanā vājayantaḥ
children.translated_text: Thus, O <s>Indra</s>, may we utter a hymn to you, seeking fame, striving for the prize with our own strength.

children.text: aśyāma tat sāptam āśuṣāṇā nanamo vadhar adevasya pīyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we, eager, attain that seventh prize; may we not bow to the weapon of the godless, malignant one.

children.text: evā te gṛtsamadāḥ śūra manmāvasyavo na vayunāni takṣuḥ
children.translated_text: Thus the <s>Gṛtsamadas</s>, O hero, fashioned thoughts for you like helpers, according to their insights.

children.text: brahmaṇyanta indra te navīya iṣam ūrjaṃ sukṣitiṃ sumnam aśyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Desiring sacred utterance, O <s>Indra</s>, may they attain for you new refreshment, strength, good dwelling, and favor.

children.text: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyad indra dakṣiṇā maghonī
children.translated_text: Now may that bounteous reward of yours be milked out for the singer, O <s>Indra</s>, rich in gifts.

children.text: śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhag bhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Teach the singers; let not our share deceive us. May we speak greatly in the assembly, rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 211
vayaṃ te vaya indra viddhi ṣu ṇaḥ pra bharāmahe vājayur na ratham
children.translated_text: We are yours, O <s>Indra</s>; know us as such. We bring you forward like a prize-seeking chariot.

children.text: vipanyavo dīdhyato manīṣā sumnam iyakṣantas tvāvato nṝn ||
children.translated_text: Inspired singers, shining with thought, seeking the favor of men like you.

children.text: tvaṃ na indra tvābhir ūtī tvāyato abhiṣṭipāsi janān
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, with your own aids, protect the people who seek you in their need for help.

children.text: tvam ino dāśuṣo varūtetthādhīr abhi yo nakṣati tvā ||
children.translated_text: You are the strong shelter of the giver, just as you are the wise one over the man who comes to you.

children.text: sa no yuvendro johūtraḥ sakhā śivo narām astu pātā
children.translated_text: May that youthful <s>Indra</s>, much-invoked, be our friend, gracious, the protector of men,

children.text: yaḥ śaṃsantaṃ yaḥ śaśamānam ūtī pacantaṃ ca stuvantaṃ ca praṇeṣat ||
children.translated_text: he who with aid leads forward the praising man, the reciting man, the one who prepares the offering, and the one who lauds.

children.text: tam u stuṣa indraṃ taṃ gṛṇīṣe yasmin purā vāvṛdhuḥ śāśaduś ca
children.translated_text: I praise that <s>Indra</s>; I sing of him in whom the people of old grew strong and prevailed.

children.text: sa vasvaḥ kāmam pīparad iyāno brahmaṇyato nūtanasyāyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: Coming to the one devoted to sacred utterance, to the man of the present age, may he fulfill the desire for wealth.

children.text: so aṅgirasām ucathā jujuṣvān brahmā tūtod indro gātum iṣṇan
children.translated_text: He, delighting in the praises of the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, the inspired priest, <s>Indra</s>, urged on the path, seeking passage.

children.text: muṣṇann uṣasaḥ sūryeṇa stavān aśnasya cicchiśnathat pūrvyāṇi ||
children.translated_text: Praising with the sun, he robbed the dawns; he shattered even the ancient strongholds of the devourer.

children.text: sa ha śruta indro nāma deva ūrdhvo bhuvan manuṣe dasmatamaḥ
children.translated_text: He is renowned by name as the god <s>Indra</s>, upright among beings, most wondrous for man.

children.text: ava priyam arśasānasya sāhvāñchiro bharad dāsasya svadhāvān ||
children.translated_text: Overcoming the beloved one of the hostile shouter, the self-powerful one carried off the head of the <s>Dāsa</s>.

children.text: sa vṛtrahendraḥ kṛṣṇayonīḥ purandaro dāsīr airayad vi
children.translated_text: That <s>Indra</s>, <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer and fort-breaker, drove apart the dark-wombed <s>Dāsa</s> women.

children.text: ajanayan manave kṣām apaś ca satrā śaṃsaṃ yajamānasya tūtot ||
children.translated_text: He generated earth and waters for <s>Manu</s>; together he furthered the praise of the sacrificer.

children.text: tasmai tavasyam anu dāyi satrendrāya devebhir arṇasātau
children.translated_text: To that mighty <s>Indra</s>, at the winning of the flood, power was granted together with the gods.

children.text: prati yad asya vajram bāhvor dhur hatvī dasyūn pura āyasīr ni tārīt ||
children.translated_text: When he placed his thunderbolt upon his arms, slew the <s>Dasyus</s>, and brought down the iron forts.

children.text: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyad indra dakṣiṇā maghonī
children.translated_text: Now may that bounteous reward of yours be milked out for the singer, O <s>Indra</s>, rich in gifts.

children.text: śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhag bhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Teach the singers; let not our share deceive us. May we speak greatly in the assembly, rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 212
viśvajite dhanajite svarjite satrājite nṛjita urvarājite
children.translated_text: To the all-conqueror, wealth-conqueror, heaven-conqueror, complete conqueror, man-conqueror, field-conqueror,

children.text: aśvajite gojite abjite bharendrāya somaṃ yajatāya haryatam ||
children.translated_text: horse-conqueror, cow-conqueror, water-conqueror, bring the Soma; make it desirable for worshipful <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: abhibhuve 'bhibhaṅgāya vanvate 'ṣāḍhāya sahamānāya vedhase
children.translated_text: To the overpowering one, the breaker, the winning one, the unconquered, the enduring, the wise creator,

children.text: tuvigraye vahnaye duṣṭarītave satrāsāhe nama indrāya vocata ||
children.translated_text: to the strong-grasping, the carrier, the hard-to-cross, the all-overcoming one, speak homage to <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: satrāsāho janabhakṣo janaṃsahaś cyavano yudhmo anu joṣam ukṣitaḥ
children.translated_text: The all-overcoming one, people-devouring, people-subduing, shaking, battle-ready, anointed according to his pleasure,

children.text: vṛtañcayaḥ sahurir vikṣv ārita indrasya vocam pra kṛtāni vīryā ||
children.translated_text: the encircler of foes, the overpowerer, active among the clans: I proclaim the heroic deeds accomplished by <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: anānudo vṛṣabho dodhato vadho gambhīra ṛṣvo asamaṣṭakāvyaḥ
children.translated_text: Unrebuked, a bull, whose weapon makes the tremblers shake, deep, lofty, of incomparable wisdom,

children.text: radhracodaḥ śnathano vīḍitas pṛthur indraḥ suyajña uṣasaḥ svar janat ||
children.translated_text: impeller of the poor, shatterer, firmly set, broad: <s>Indra</s>, well worshipped, generated the dawns and the sun.

children.text: yajñena gātum apturo vividrire dhiyo hinvānā uśijo manīṣiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: By sacrifice the active ones found the path, impelling thoughts, the eager inspired sages.

children.text: abhisvarā niṣadā gā avasyava indre hinvānā draviṇāny āśata ||
children.translated_text: Singing aloud, sitting down, seeking help and driving the cows toward <s>Indra</s>, they gained riches.

children.text: indra śreṣṭhāni draviṇāni dhehi cittiṃ dakṣasya subhagatvam asme
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, place in us the best riches, understanding, skill, and good fortune.

children.text: poṣaṃ rayīṇām ariṣṭiṃ tanūnāṃ svādmānaṃ vācaḥ sudinatvam ahnām ||
children.translated_text: nourishment for riches, freedom from harm for bodies, sweetness of speech, and fair days among the days.

children.text: Chapter 213
trikadrukeṣu mahiṣo yavāśiraṃ tuviśuṣmas tṛpat somam apibad viṣṇunā sutaṃ yathāvaśat
children.translated_text: At the <s>Trikadrukas</s> the buffalo, mighty in force, drank the barley-mixed <s>soma</s> pressed with <s>Viṣṇu</s>, as he wished.

children.text: sa īm mamāda mahi karma kartave mahām uruṃ sainaṃ saścad devo devaṃ satyam indraṃ satya induḥ ||
children.translated_text: He was exhilarated to perform a great deed, a great and broad one; that true drop, a god, accompanied this true god, the true <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: adha tviṣīmāṁ abhy ojasā kriviṃ yudhābhavad ā rodasī apṛṇad asya majmanā pra vāvṛdhe
children.translated_text: Then, shining with force, he overcame the <s>Krivi</s> in battle; he filled the two worlds with his greatness and grew forth.

children.text: adhattānyaṃ jaṭhare prem aricyata sainaṃ saścad devo devaṃ satyam indraṃ satya induḥ ||
children.translated_text: He placed the other in his belly and overflowed far beyond; that true drop, a god, accompanied this true god, the true <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: sākaṃ jātaḥ kratunā sākam ojasā vavakṣitha sākaṃ vṛddho vīryaiḥ sāsahir mṛdho vicarṣaṇiḥ
children.translated_text: Born together with resolve, together with might, you grew; grown together in heroic powers, you overcame foes, O lord among peoples.

children.text: dātā rādha stuvate kāmyaṃ vasu sainaṃ saścad devo devaṃ satyam indraṃ satya induḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are the giver of desirable wealth as a gift to the singer; that true drop, a god, accompanied this true god, the true <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: tava tyan naryaṃ nṛto 'pa indra prathamam pūrvyaṃ divi pravācyaṃ kṛtam
children.translated_text: Yours, O manly leader, O <s>Indra</s>, is that first, ancient deed, done in heaven and worthy to be proclaimed.

children.text: yad devasya śavasā prāriṇā asuṃ riṇann apaḥ
children.translated_text: When by the god's might you drove out the life-breath, cleaving open and releasing the waters,

children.text: bhuvad viśvam abhy ādevam ojasā vidād ūrjaṃ śatakratur vidād iṣam ||
children.translated_text: everything godless was overpowered by your might; <s>Śatakratu</s> found strength, and he found refreshment.

children.text: Chapter 214
gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmahe kaviṃ kavīnām upamaśravastamam
children.translated_text: We call upon you as lord of the hosts, the poet of poets, most famous beyond compare,

children.text: jyeṣṭharājam brahmaṇām brahmaṇaspata ā naḥ śṛṇvann ūtibhiḥ sīda sādanam ||
children.translated_text: the eldest king of sacred formulations, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>; hearing us with your aids, sit down in the seat.

children.text: devāś cit te asurya pracetaso bṛhaspate yajñiyam bhāgam ānaśuḥ
children.translated_text: Even the gods, O mighty and far-seeing <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, have obtained the sacrificial share from you.

children.text: usrā iva sūryo jyotiṣā maho viśveṣām ij janitā brahmaṇām asi ||
children.translated_text: Like the sun with its light, you are the great radiance; indeed you are the begetter of all sacred formulations.

children.text: ā vibādhyā parirāpas tamāṃsi ca jyotiṣmantaṃ ratham ṛtasya tiṣṭhasi
children.translated_text: Driving away revilers and the darknesses, you mount the radiant chariot of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: bṛhaspate bhīmam amitradambhanaṃ rakṣohaṇaṃ gotrabhidaṃ svarvidam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, you are terrible, crusher of foes, slayer of demons, breaker of the cow-stall, finder of the sunlit world.

children.text: sunītibhir nayasi trāyase janaṃ yas tubhyaṃ dāśān na tam aṃho aśnavat
children.translated_text: With good guidance you lead and protect the person who gives to you; distress does not reach him.

children.text: brahmadviṣas tapano manyumīr asi bṛhaspate mahi tat te mahitvanam ||
children.translated_text: You are the burner of those who hate prayer, the stirrer of wrath; O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, great is that greatness of yours.

children.text: na tam aṃho na duritaṃ kutaścana nārātayas titirur na dvayāvinaḥ
children.translated_text: No distress, no misdeed from anywhere, no enemies, and no double-dealers overcome him.

children.text: viśvā id asmād dhvaraso vi bādhase yaṃ sugopā rakṣasi brahmaṇaspate ||
children.translated_text: You drive all deceits away from the one whom, as a good guardian, you protect, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ no gopāḥ pathikṛd vicakṣaṇas tava vratāya matibhir jarāmahe
children.translated_text: You are our guardian, path-maker, and discerning one; under your command we grow old with our thoughts of praise.

children.text: bṛhaspate yo no abhi hvaro dadhe svā tam marmartu ducchunā harasvatī ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, whoever has set deceit against us, let his own malicious, blazing harm strike him down.

children.text: uta vā yo no marcayād anāgaso 'rātīvā martaḥ sānuko vṛkaḥ
children.translated_text: And whatever mortal would harm us though we are guiltless, whether an enemy, a man with kin, or a wolf-like foe,

children.text: bṛhaspate apa taṃ vartayā pathaḥ sugaṃ no asyai devavītaye kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, turn him away from the path; make this road easy for us for the coming of the gods.

children.text: trātāraṃ tvā tanūnāṃ havāmahe 'vaspartar adhivaktāram asmayum
children.translated_text: We call on you as protector of our bodies, rescuer from distress, advocate, and helper on our side.

children.text: bṛhaspate devanido ni barhaya mā durevā uttaraṃ sumnam un naśan ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, strike down the reviler of the gods; let not evil-minded men attain the higher favor.

children.text: tvayā vayaṃ suvṛdhā brahmaṇaspate spārhā vasu manuṣyā dadīmahi
children.translated_text: Through you, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, may we, well strengthened, obtain desirable wealth as men.

children.text: yā no dūre taḍito yā arātayo 'bhi santi jambhayā tā anapnasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whatever attacks are far from us, and whatever hostilities press close, crush those powerless ones.

children.text: tvayā vayam uttamaṃ dhīmahe vayo bṛhaspate papriṇā sasninā yujā
children.translated_text: Through you, O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, with a nourishing and victorious ally, we set our thought on the highest span of life.

children.text: mā no duḥśaṃso abhidipsur īśata pra suśaṃsā matibhis tāriṣīmahi ||
children.translated_text: Let no evil speaker or would-be deceiver master us; with favorable praises may we pass beyond.

children.text: anānudo vṛṣabho jagmir āhavaṃ niṣṭaptā śatrum pṛtanāsu sāsahiḥ
children.translated_text: The unbending bull has come to the call, heated through, overcoming the enemy in battles.

children.text: asi satya ṛṇayā brahmaṇaspata ugrasya cid damitā vīḍuharṣiṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are true, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, a requiter of debt, tamer even of the fierce and hard-resisting one.

children.text: adevena manasā yo riṣaṇyati śāsām ugro manyamāno jighāṃsati
children.translated_text: The one who, with godless mind, seeks to injure us, who thinks himself a harsh ruler and wishes to kill,

children.text: bṛhaspate mā praṇak tasya no vadho ni karma manyuṃ durevasya śardhataḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, let his blow not reach us; bend down the anger of the hostile, evil-minded troop.

children.text: bhareṣu havyo namasopasadyo gantā vājeṣu sanitā dhanaṃ dhanam
children.translated_text: Invoked in battles, to be approached with homage, coming in contests, you win wealth after wealth.

children.text: viśvā id aryo abhidipsvo mṛdho bṛhaspatir vi vavarhā rathāṁ iva ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s> has split apart all the hostile attacks of the foe who seeks to deceive, as one breaks chariots.

children.text: tejiṣṭhayā tapanī rakṣasas tapa ye tvā nide dadhire dṛṣṭavīryam
children.translated_text: With your sharpest burning heat, burn the demons who have set you up for blame, O one of manifest strength.

children.text: āvis tat kṛṣva yad asat ta ukthyam bṛhaspate vi parirāpo ardaya ||
children.translated_text: Make visible whatever in you is worthy of praise; O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, crush the revilers on every side.

children.text: bṛhaspate ati yad aryo arhād dyumad vibhāti kratumaj janeṣu
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, when, worthy beyond the foe, your splendid wisdom shines among people,

children.text: yad dīdayacchavasa ṛtaprajāta tad asmāsu draviṇaṃ dhehi citram ||
children.translated_text: when that power born of <s>ṛta</s> and strength has blazed forth, place that varied treasure among us.

children.text: mā na stenebhyo ye abhi druhas pade nirāmiṇo ripavo 'nneṣu jāgṛdhuḥ
children.translated_text: Let us not fall among thieves, enemies who, set in the place of treachery and making no offering, keep watch over our food.

children.text: ā devānām ohate vi vrayo hṛdi bṛhaspate na paraḥ sāmno viduḥ ||
children.translated_text: The wide range of the gods he carries in his heart; O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, they do not know the far limit of the chant.

children.text: viśvebhyo hi tvā bhuvanebhyas pari tvaṣṭājanat sāmnaḥ sāmnaḥ kaviḥ
children.translated_text: For from all the worlds <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, the poet, generated you, chant after chant.

children.text: sa ṛṇacid ṛṇayā brahmaṇaspatir druho hantā maha ṛtasya dhartari ||
children.translated_text: That <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, requiting debt with debt, is the slayer of treachery in the great support of <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: tava śriye vy ajihīta parvato gavāṃ gotram udasṛjo yad aṅgiraḥ
children.translated_text: For your splendor the mountain opened itself, when, O <s>Aṅgiras</s>, you released the cow-stall of the cows.

children.text: indreṇa yujā tamasā parīvṛtam bṛhaspate nir apām aubjo arṇavam ||
children.translated_text: With <s>Indra</s> as ally, O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, you thrust out the flood of waters that had been enclosed by darkness.

children.text: brahmaṇaspate tvam asya yantā sūktasya bodhi tanayaṃ ca jinva
children.translated_text: O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, be the guide of this hymn; be awake, and quicken our offspring.

children.text: viśvaṃ tad bhadraṃ yad avanti devā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: All that is auspicious which the gods favor: may we speak it aloud in the assembly, rich in heroes.

children.text: Chapter 215
semām aviḍḍhi prabhṛtiṃ ya īśiṣe 'yā vidhema navayā mahā girā
children.translated_text: Protect this offering, which you rule; with this new, great song let us worship.

children.text: yathā no mīḍhvān stavate sakhā tava bṛhaspate sīṣadhaḥ sota no matim ||
children.translated_text: So that your generous friend may praise you, O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, strengthen us and impel our thought.

children.text: yo nantvāny anaman ny ojasotādardar manyunā śambarāṇi vi
children.translated_text: He bent the unbending things with might, and with anger he split apart the strongholds of <s>Śambara</s>.

children.text: prācyāvayad acyutā brahmaṇaspatir ā cāviśad vasumantaṃ vi parvatam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> made the immovable things tremble and entered the mountain rich in goods.

children.text: tad devānāṃ devatamāya kartvam aśrathnan dṛḍhāvradanta vīḍitā
children.translated_text: For him, the most divine among the gods, they loosened the deed; they made firm what had been compact and strengthened.

children.text: ud gā ājad abhinad brahmaṇā valam agūhat tamo vy acakṣayat svaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He drove up the cows; with sacred utterance he split <s>Vala</s>, uncovered the darkness, and made the heavenly light visible.

children.text: aśmāsyam avatam brahmaṇaspatir madhudhāram abhi yam ojasātṛṇat
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, by his force, split open the stone-mouthed well, the one with a stream of honey.

children.text: tam eva viśve papire svardṛśo bahu sākaṃ sisicur utsam udriṇam ||
children.translated_text: All the heaven-seeing ones drank of that very well; together they poured out much from the stony spring.

children.text: sanā tā kācid bhuvanā bhavītvā mādbhiḥ śaradbhir duro varanta vaḥ
children.translated_text: Those beings, becoming ancient, in some way shut your doors through waters and autumns.

children.text: ayatantā carato anyad anyad id yā cakāra vayunā brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Unwearied, they move, each in a different way, according to the insight that <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> has made.

children.text: abhinakṣanto abhi ye tam ānaśur nidhim paṇīnām paramaṃ guhā hitam
children.translated_text: Pressing near, those who reached it found the supreme treasure of the <s>Paṇis</s>, set in a secret cave.

children.text: te vidvāṃsaḥ praticakṣyānṛtā punar yata u āyan tad ud īyur āviśam ||
children.translated_text: Those wise ones, seeing the falsehood again in reply, rose up openly from the place to which they had come.

children.text: ṛtāvānaḥ praticakṣyānṛtā punar āta ā tasthuḥ kavayo mahas pathaḥ
children.translated_text: Keeping <s>ṛta</s> (truthful order), again seeing the falsehood in reply, the poets then took their stand upon the great path.

children.text: te bāhubhyāṃ dhamitam agnim aśmani nakiḥ ṣo asty araṇo jahur hi tam ||
children.translated_text: With their arms they kindled the fire hidden in the stone; no one is without kindling, for they have released it.

children.text: ṛtajyena kṣipreṇa brahmaṇaspatir yatra vaṣṭi pra tad aśnoti dhanvanā
children.translated_text: With the <s>ṛta</s>-strung, swift bow, <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> reaches, with the bowstring, wherever he wishes.

children.text: tasya sādhvīr iṣavo yābhir asyati nṛcakṣaso dṛśaye karṇayonayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Good are his arrows with which he shoots; having human sight, they are born from the ears for seeing.

children.text: sa saṃnayaḥ sa vinayaḥ purohitaḥ sa suṣṭutaḥ sa yudhi brahmaṇaspatiḥ
children.translated_text: He is the leader together, he is the guide, the <s>purohita</s> (domestic priest); well-praised in battle, he is <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>.

children.text: cākṣmo yad vājam bharate matī dhanād it sūryas tapati tapyatur vṛthā ||
children.translated_text: When the inspired thought wins the prize from treasure, the sun burns in vain against the one who burns.

children.text: vibhu prabhu prathamam mehanāvato bṛhaspateḥ suvidatrāṇi rādhyā
children.translated_text: Wide-ruling, powerful, the first bounties of mighty <s>Bṛhaspati</s> are to be won.

children.text: imā sātāni venyasya vājino yena janā ubhaye bhuñjate viśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: These gains belong to the desirable, prize-winning one, by whom both peoples and clans enjoy their portions.

children.text: yo 'vare vṛjane viśvathā vibhur mahāṁ u raṇvaḥ śavasā vavakṣitha
children.translated_text: You who in the lower enclosure are all-pervading, great and delightful, have grown by your power.

children.text: sa devo devān prati paprathe pṛthu viśved u tā paribhūr brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: That god, vast, has spread himself toward the gods; <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> is wholly encompassing all these.

children.text: viśvaṃ satyam maghavānā yuvor id āpaś cana pra minanti vrataṃ vām
children.translated_text: All truth belongs to you two bounteous ones; even the waters do not transgress your two vows.

children.text: acchendrābrahmaṇaspatī havir no 'nnaṃ yujeva vājinā jigātam ||
children.translated_text: Come here to our oblation, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, to the food, like prize-winning horses to the yoke.

children.text: utāśiṣṭhā anu śṛṇvanti vahnayaḥ sabheyo vipro bharate matī dhanā
children.translated_text: The best kindled fires hear in order; the assembly-worthy sage bears inspired thoughts as treasures.

children.text: vīḍudveṣā anu vaśa ṛṇam ādadiḥ sa ha vājī samithe brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Hostile to the stronghold, under command you have taken the debt; he indeed is the prize-winner in battle, <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>.

children.text: brahmaṇaspater abhavad yathāvaśaṃ satyo manyur mahi karmā kariṣyataḥ
children.translated_text: The true wrath of <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, who will perform a great deed, came into being according to his will.

children.text: yo gā udājat sa dive vi cābhajan mahīva rītiḥ śavasāsarat pṛthak ||
children.translated_text: He who drove up the cows distributed them for heaven; like a mighty stream, by his power he flowed forth separately.

children.text: brahmaṇaspate suyamasya viśvahā rāyaḥ syāma rathyo vayasvataḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, may we every day be easy to guide, chariot-borne, and rich in vigorous wealth.

children.text: vīreṣu vīrāṁ upa pṛṅdhi nas tvaṃ yad īśāno brahmaṇā veṣi me havam ||
children.translated_text: Among heroes, fill us with heroic strength, when, as lord, you come through sacred utterance to my call.

children.text: brahmaṇaspate tvam asya yantā sūktasya bodhi tanayaṃ ca jinva
children.translated_text: O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, be the guide of this hymn; know it, and quicken our offspring.

children.text: viśvaṃ tad bhadraṃ yad avanti devā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: All that is auspicious which the gods protect is ours; may we speak greatly in the assembly, rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 216
indhāno agniṃ vanavad vanuṣyataḥ kṛtabrahmā śūśuvad rātahavya it
children.translated_text: Kindling <s>Agni</s>, he will win against the assailant; having fashioned sacred utterance, he will swell, for the oblation has been given.

children.text: jātena jātam ati sa pra sarsṛte yaṃ yaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: By birth he surpasses what is born, whatever ally <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> makes for himself.

children.text: vīrebhir vīrān vanavad vanuṣyato gobhī rayim paprathad bodhati tmanā
children.translated_text: With heroes he will win heroes from the assailant; with cows he will spread wealth, and he awakens by himself.

children.text: tokaṃ ca tasya tanayaṃ ca vardhate yaṃ yaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: His child and his offspring grow, whatever ally <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> makes for himself.

children.text: sindhur na kṣodaḥ śimīvāṁ ṛghāyato vṛṣeva vadhrīṃr abhi vaṣṭy ojasā
children.translated_text: Like the flood of a river, rich in force, he presses upon the one who attacks, with strength like a bull upon barren cows.

children.text: agner iva prasitir nāha vartave yaṃ yaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like the onset of <s>Agni</s>, he cannot be turned back, whatever ally <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> makes for himself.

children.text: tasmā arṣanti divyā asaścataḥ sa satvabhiḥ prathamo goṣu gacchati
children.translated_text: For him the heavenly, unceasing streams flow; with his strong ones he goes first among the cows.

children.text: anibhṛṣṭataviṣir hanty ojasā yaṃ yaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: With unshaken force he strikes by his strength, whatever ally <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> makes for himself.

children.text: tasmā id viśve dhunayanta sindhavo 'cchidrā śarma dadhire purūṇi
children.translated_text: For him all the rivers set themselves in motion; they have established many unbroken shelters.

children.text: devānāṃ sumne subhagaḥ sa edhate yaṃ yaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: In the favor of the gods, he, fortunate, prospers, whatever ally <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> makes for himself.

children.text: Chapter 217
ṛjur icchaṃso vanavad vanuṣyato devayann id adevayantam abhy asat
children.translated_text: Seeking what is straight, he will win against the assailant; worshipping the gods, he will overcome the one who does not worship the gods.

children.text: suprāvīr id vanavat pṛtsu duṣṭaraṃ yajved ayajyor vi bhajāti bhojanam ||
children.translated_text: Well-protected, he will win the hard-to-cross enemy in battles; the sacrificer divides food from the non-sacrificer.

children.text: yajasva vīra pra vihi manāyato bhadram manaḥ kṛṇuṣva vṛtratūrye
children.translated_text: Sacrifice, O hero; advance against the malicious one. Make your mind auspicious in the conquest of obstruction.

children.text: haviṣ kṛṇuṣva subhago yathāsasi brahmaṇaspater ava ā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: Prepare the oblation, fortunate as you are; we choose the aid of <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>.

children.text: sa ij janena sa viśā sa janmanā sa putrair vājam bharate dhanā nṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: With people, with the clan, by birth, with sons and with men, he wins prize and wealth.

children.text: devānāṃ yaḥ pitaram āvivāsati śraddhāmanā haviṣā brahmaṇaspatim ||
children.translated_text: He who serves the father of the gods, <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, with faithful mind and oblation, does so.

children.text: yo asmai havyair ghṛtavadbhir avidhat pra tam prācā nayati brahmaṇaspatiḥ
children.translated_text: The one who has worshipped him with ghee-rich offerings, <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> leads him forward and onward.

children.text: uruṣyatīm aṃhaso rakṣatī riṣo 'ṃhoś cid asmā urucakrir adbhutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Protecting him from distress and guarding him from harm, the wondrous one has made broad space for him even out of narrow trouble.

children.text: Chapter 218
imā gira ādityebhyo ghṛtasnūḥ sanād rājabhyo juhvā juhomi
children.translated_text: These ghee-flowing songs I offer with my tongue to the <s>Ādityas</s>, the kings from of old.

children.text: śṛṇotu mitro aryamā bhago nas tuvijāto varuṇo dakṣo aṃśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, and <s>Bhaga</s> hear us, and <s>Varuṇa</s> of strong birth, <s>Dakṣa</s>, and <s>Aṃśa</s>.

children.text: imaṃ stomaṃ sakratavo me adya mitro aryamā varuṇo juṣanta
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s>, having shared powers, accept this praise of mine today.

children.text: ādityāsaḥ śucayo dhārapūtā avṛjinā anavadyā ariṣṭāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the pure <s>Ādityas</s>, cleansed by the stream, free from crookedness, blameless, and unharmed, accept it.

children.text: ta ādityāsa uravo gabhīrā adabdhāso dipsanto bhūryakṣāḥ
children.translated_text: Those <s>Ādityas</s> are wide and deep, undeceived, seeking to discern, with many eyes.

children.text: antaḥ paśyanti vṛjinota sādhu sarvaṃ rājabhyaḥ paramā cid anti ||
children.translated_text: They see within both crookedness and what is right; all things, even the furthest, are near to the kings.

children.text: dhārayanta ādityāso jagat sthā devā viśvasya bhuvanasya gopāḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Ādityas</s> uphold the moving world and what stands still; the gods are guardians of the whole creation.

children.text: dīrghādhiyo rakṣamāṇā asuryam ṛtāvānaś cayamānā ṛṇāni ||
children.translated_text: With far-reaching thoughts, guarding lordship, true to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), and discerning obligations.

children.text: vidyām ādityā avaso vo asya yad aryaman bhaya ā cin mayobhu
children.translated_text: May I know this aid of yours, O <s>Ādityas</s>; when there is fear, O <s>Aryaman</s>, you are still joy-bringing.

children.text: yuṣmākam mitrāvaruṇā praṇītau pari śvabhreva duritāni vṛjyām ||
children.translated_text: Under your guidance, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, may I go around evils as around a pit.

children.text: sugo hi vo aryaman mitra panthā anṛkṣaro varuṇa sādhur asti
children.translated_text: For your path, O <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s>, is easy to travel, free from thorns, and good.

children.text: tenādityā adhi vocatā no yacchatā no duṣparihantu śarma ||
children.translated_text: By that path, O <s>Ādityas</s>, speak on our behalf; grant us shelter hard for an enemy to harm.

children.text: pipartu no aditī rājaputrāti dveṣāṃsy aryamā sugebhiḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Aditi</s>, with the kingly sons, and <s>Aryaman</s> carry us beyond hatreds by easy paths.

children.text: bṛhan mitrasya varuṇasya śarmopa syāma puruvīrā ariṣṭāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we come near the broad shelter of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, rich in heroes and unharmed.

children.text: tisro bhūmīr dhārayan trīṃr uta dyūn trīṇi vratā vidathe antar eṣām
children.translated_text: They uphold the three earths and also the three heavens; three ordinances are within their sacred assembly.

children.text: ṛtenādityā mahi vo mahitvaṃ tad aryaman varuṇa mitra cāru ||
children.translated_text: By <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), O <s>Ādityas</s>, your greatness is great; that is lovely, O <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Mitra</s>.

children.text: trī rocanā divyā dhārayanta hiraṇyayāḥ śucayo dhārapūtāḥ
children.translated_text: They uphold the three heavenly realms of light, golden, bright, and purified by the stream.

children.text: asvapnajo animiṣā adabdhā uruśaṃsā ṛjave martyāya ||
children.translated_text: Sleepless, unwinking, undeceived, and widely praised, they are so for the upright mortal.

children.text: tvaṃ viśveṣāṃ varuṇāsi rājā ye ca devā asura ye ca martāḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, are king of all, of those who are gods, O <s>Asura</s>, and of those who are mortals.

children.text: śataṃ no rāsva śarado vicakṣe 'śyāmāyūṃṣi sudhitāni pūrvā ||
children.translated_text: Grant us a hundred autumns to behold; may we attain the former lifespans, well established.

children.text: na dakṣiṇā vi cikite na savyā na prācīnam ādityā nota paścā
children.translated_text: We have not discerned right or left, nor the eastern direction, O <s>Ādityas</s>, nor the western.

children.text: pākyā cid vasavo dhīryā cid yuṣmānīto abhayaṃ jyotir aśyām ||
children.translated_text: Whether unknowing or thoughtful, O <s>Vasus</s>, may we, guided by you, attain fearless light from here.

children.text: yo rājabhya ṛtanibhyo dadāśa yaṃ vardhayanti puṣṭayaś ca nityāḥ
children.translated_text: The one who has made offering to the kings who follow <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), whom prosperities and nourishments always increase,

children.text: sa revān yāti prathamo rathena vasudāvā vidatheṣu praśastaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that wealthy man goes first with his chariot, a giver of goods, praised in the sacred assemblies.

children.text: śucir apaḥ sūyavasā adabdha upa kṣeti vṛddhavayāḥ suvīraḥ
children.translated_text: Pure, with waters and good pasture, unharmed, he dwells near, advanced in years and rich in heroes.

children.text: nakiṣ ṭaṃ ghnanty antito na dūrād ya ādityānām bhavati praṇītau ||
children.translated_text: No one strikes him, either from near or from far, who is under the guidance of the <s>Ādityas</s>.

children.text: adite mitra varuṇota mṛḍa yad vo vayaṃ cakṛmā kaccid āgaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s>, be gracious if we have committed any offense against you.

children.text: urv aśyām abhayaṃ jyotir indra mā no dīrghā abhi naśan tamisrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May I attain broad, fearless light, O <s>Indra</s>; may long darknesses not come upon us.

children.text: ubhe asmai pīpayataḥ samīcī divo vṛṣṭiṃ subhago nāma puṣyan
children.translated_text: Both concordant realms make him swell; the fortunate one nourishes his name and the rain from heaven.

children.text: ubhā kṣayāv ājayan yāti pṛtsūbhāv ardhau bhavataḥ sādhū asmai ||
children.translated_text: Having conquered both dwellings, he goes into battles; both halves become favorable to him.

children.text: yā vo māyā abhidruhe yajatrāḥ pāśā ādityā ripave vicṛttāḥ
children.translated_text: Those snares of yours, O worshipful <s>Ādityas</s>, your powers set apart for the treacherous enemy,

children.text: aśvīva tāṁ ati yeṣaṃ rathenāriṣṭā urāv ā śarman syāma ||
children.translated_text: may we pass over them as with a horse and chariot; unharmed, may we be in broad shelter.

children.text: māham maghono varuṇa priyasya bhūridāvna ā vidaṃ śūnam āpeḥ
children.translated_text: Let me not, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, be without the dear friendship of the bounteous, richly giving patron.

children.text: mā rāyo rājan suyamād ava sthām bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let me not, O king, fall away from well-yoked wealth. May we speak greatly in the assembly, rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 219
idaṃ kaver ādityasya svarājo viśvāni sānty abhy astu mahnā
children.translated_text: This sovereignty of the inspired <s>Āditya</s>, the self-ruling one, encompasses all things by its greatness.

children.text: ati yo mandro yajathāya devaḥ sukīrtim bhikṣe varuṇasya bhūreḥ ||
children.translated_text: The joyful god surpasses others for worship; I seek the abundant good fame of <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: tava vrate subhagāsaḥ syāma svādhyo varuṇa tuṣṭuvāṃsaḥ
children.translated_text: In your ordinance, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, may we be fortunate, self-directed, and praising you.

children.text: upāyana uṣasāṃ gomatīnām agnayo na jaramāṇā anu dyūn ||
children.translated_text: At the coming of the cow-rich dawns, may we, like fires, grow old through the days.

children.text: tava syāma puruvīrasya śarmann uruśaṃsasya varuṇa praṇetaḥ
children.translated_text: May we be in the shelter of you, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, guide of wide renown and rich in heroes.

children.text: yūyaṃ naḥ putrā aditer adabdhā abhi kṣamadhvaṃ yujyāya devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: You, undeceived gods, sons of <s>Aditi</s>, be forgiving toward us for fellowship.

children.text: pra sīm ādityo asṛjad vidhartāṃ ṛtaṃ sindhavo varuṇasya yanti
children.translated_text: The <s>Āditya</s>, the establisher, has set them in motion; the rivers go according to the <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) of <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: na śrāmyanti na vi mucanty ete vayo na paptū raghuyā parijman ||
children.translated_text: They do not grow weary and do not loosen themselves; like birds they fly swiftly around the circuit.

children.text: vi macchrathāya raśanām ivāga ṛdhyāma te varuṇa khām ṛtasya
children.translated_text: Loosen wrongdoing from me as one loosens a strap; may we prosper in your track of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), O <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: mā tantuś chedi vayato dhiyam me mā mātrā śāry apasaḥ pura ṛtoḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let not the thread be cut while I weave my thought; let not the measure break before the work is done.

children.text: apo su myakṣa varuṇa bhiyasam mat samrāḍ ṛtāvo 'nu mā gṛbhāya
children.translated_text: Drive fear away from me, O <s>Varuṇa</s>; O sovereign, true to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), take hold of me.

children.text: dāmeva vatsād vi mumugdhy aṃho nahi tvad āre nimiṣaś caneśe ||
children.translated_text: Release distress from me as a tether from a calf; for apart from you no one has power even for a blink.

children.text: mā no vadhair varuṇa ye ta iṣṭāv enaḥ kṛṇvantam asura bhrīṇanti
children.translated_text: Do not harm us with those weapons of yours, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, which, O <s>Asura</s>, strike one who commits sin.

children.text: mā jyotiṣaḥ pravasathāni ganma vi ṣū mṛdhaḥ śiśratho jīvase naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we not go away from the dwellings of light; scatter hostilities far off so that we may live.

children.text: namaḥ purā te varuṇota nūnam utāparaṃ tuvijāta bravāma
children.translated_text: Homage we proclaim to you, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, formerly, now, and also hereafter, O mighty-born one.

children.text: tve hi kam parvate na śritāny apracyutāni dūḍabha vratāni ||
children.translated_text: For in you, as upon a mountain, rest your unshaken, hard-to-deceive ordinances.

children.text: para ṛṇā sāvīr adha matkṛtāni māhaṃ rājann anyakṛtena bhojam
children.translated_text: Set far away the debts, the brave ones and those made by me; let me not, O king, suffer for what another has done.

children.text: avyuṣṭā in nu bhūyasīr uṣāsa ā no jīvān varuṇa tāsu śādhi ||
children.translated_text: Many dawns have not yet dawned; in them, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, rule over us while we are living.

children.text: yo me rājan yujyo vā sakhā vā svapne bhayam bhīrave mahyam āha
children.translated_text: Whoever, O king, whether yoke-fellow or friend, has spoken fear to me, the fearful one, in a dream,

children.text: steno vā yo dipsati no vṛko vā tvaṃ tasmād varuṇa pāhy asmān ||
children.translated_text: or the thief or wolf who seeks to harm us, from him, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, protect us.

children.text: māham maghono varuṇa priyasya bhūridāvna ā vidaṃ śūnam āpeḥ
children.translated_text: Let me not, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, be without the dear friendship of the bounteous, richly giving patron.

children.text: mā rāyo rājan suyamād ava sthām bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let me not, O king, fall away from well-yoked wealth. May we speak greatly in the assembly, rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 220
dhṛtavratā ādityā iṣirā āre mat karta rahasūr ivāgaḥ
children.translated_text: Firm in vows and swift, O <s>Ādityas</s>, keep sin far from me, as one keeps a secret thing away.

children.text: śṛṇvato vo varuṇa mitra devā bhadrasya vidvāṁ avase huve vaḥ ||
children.translated_text: As you listen, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and gods, knowing the auspicious good, I call on you for aid.

children.text: yūyaṃ devāḥ pramatir yūyam ojo yūyaṃ dveṣāṃsi sanutar yuyota
children.translated_text: You gods are wise guidance; you are strength. Drive hatreds far away.

children.text: abhikṣattāro abhi ca kṣamadhvam adyā ca no mṛḍayatāparaṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: Strike against those who assail us, and be forgiving toward us; today and hereafter be gracious to us.

children.text: kim ū nu vaḥ kṛṇavāmāpareṇa kiṃ sanena vasava āpyena
children.translated_text: What more shall we now do for you? What shall we do with old, familiar kinship, O <s>Vasus</s>?

children.text: yūyaṃ no mitrāvaruṇādite ca svastim indrāmaruto dadhāta ||
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Aditi</s>, and you, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Maruts</s>, grant us well-being.

children.text: haye devā yūyam id āpaya stha te mṛḍata nādhamānāya mahyam
children.translated_text: O gods, you indeed are helpers; be gracious to me as I supplicate in distress.

children.text: mā vo ratho madhyamavāḍ ṛte bhūn mā yuṣmāvatsv āpiṣu śramiṣma ||
children.translated_text: Let your chariot not pass us by midway, apart from <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order); may we not grow weary among your allies.

children.text: pra va eko mimaya bhūry āgo yan mā piteva kitavaṃ śaśāsa
children.translated_text: One has measured out much offense before you, when he has chastised me like a father chastising a gambler.

children.text: āre pāśā āre aghāni devā mā mādhi putre vim iva grabhīṣṭa ||
children.translated_text: Far away be the snares, far away the evils, O gods. Do not seize me wrongly in regard to son and offspring, as if with a noose.

children.text: arvāñco adyā bhavatā yajatrā ā vo hārdi bhayamāno vyayeyam
children.translated_text: Come hither today, O worshipful ones; in my heart, fearing, I would unfold myself to you.

children.text: trādhvaṃ no devā nijuro vṛkasya trādhvaṃ kartād avapado yajatrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Protect us, O gods, from the wolf who bends down; protect us, O worshipful ones, from the pit-maker, from the falling place.

children.text: māham maghono varuṇa priyasya bhūridāvna ā vidaṃ śūnam āpeḥ
children.translated_text: May I not, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, be without the dear help of the generous, much-giving patron.

children.text: mā rāyo rājan suyamād ava sthām bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May I not, O king, fall away from well-guided wealth. May we speak greatly in the assembly, rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 221
ṛtaṃ devāya kṛṇvate savitra indrāyāhighne na ramanta āpaḥ
children.translated_text: They make the truth for the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, for <s>Indra</s>; the waters do not rest, like an eager steed.

children.text: ahar ahar yāty aktur apāṃ kiyāty ā prathamaḥ sarga āsām ||
children.translated_text: Day by day it goes through the darkness; how great is the first outpouring of these waters?

children.text: yo vṛtrāya sinam atrābhariṣyat pra taṃ janitrī viduṣa uvāca
children.translated_text: When the mother who knew said this to him who was to bring the food against <s>Vṛtra</s>,

children.text: patho radantīr anu joṣam asmai dive dive dhunayo yanty artham ||
children.translated_text: the streams, cutting out paths according to their pleasure for him, go day by day to their goal.

children.text: ūrdhvo hy asthād adhy antarikṣe 'dhā vṛtrāya pra vadhaṃ jabhāra
children.translated_text: For he stood upright over the midspace; then he carried the weapon forward against <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: mihaṃ vasāna upa hīm adudrot tigmāyudho ajayacchatrum indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Clothed in mist, he rushed upon him; with sharpened weapons <s>Indra</s> conquered the enemy.

children.text: bṛhaspate tapuṣāśneva vidhya vṛkadvaraso asurasya vīrān
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, pierce with heat, as with a burning stone, the heroes of the demon whose doors are like wolves.

children.text: yathā jaghantha dhṛṣatā purā cid evā jahi śatrum asmākam indra ||
children.translated_text: As you slew him boldly long ago, so, O <s>Indra</s>, slay our enemy.

children.text: ava kṣipa divo aśmānam uccā yena śatrum mandasāno nijūrvāḥ
children.translated_text: Cast down from heaven the lofty stone with which, exhilarated, you will crush the enemy.

children.text: tokasya sātau tanayasya bhūrer asmāṁ ardhaṃ kṛṇutād indra gonām ||
children.translated_text: In the winning of sons and abundant offspring, O <s>Indra</s>, make us sharers in the cows.

children.text: pra hi kratuṃ vṛhatho yaṃ vanutho radhrasya stho yajamānasya codau
children.translated_text: For you two strengthen the resolve that you favor; you two stand as impellers of the poor sacrificer.

children.text: indrāsomā yuvam asmāṁ aviṣṭam asmin bhayasthe kṛṇutam u lokam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, protect us; in this place of fear make room for us.

children.text: na mā taman na śraman nota tandran na vocāma mā sunoteti somam
children.translated_text: Neither exhaustion, nor weariness, nor drowsiness shall make me say, 'Do not press the Soma.'

children.text: yo me pṛṇād yo dadad yo nibodhād yo mā sunvantam upa gobhir āyat ||
children.translated_text: The one who fills me, who gives, who notices, who comes to me, the Soma-presser, with cows, is mine.

children.text: sarasvati tvam asmāṁ aviḍḍhi marutvatī dhṛṣatī jeṣi śatrūn
children.translated_text: O <s>Sarasvatī</s>, help us; accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, bold, you conquer enemies.

children.text: tyaṃ cicchardhantaṃ taviṣīyamāṇam indro hanti vṛṣabhaṃ śaṇḍikānām ||
children.translated_text: Even that one who boasts and swells in might, <s>Indra</s>, the bull, strikes down among the <s>Śaṇḍikas</s>.

children.text: yo naḥ sanutya uta vā jighatnur abhikhyāya taṃ tigitena vidhya
children.translated_text: Whoever would secretly harm us, or whoever would openly attack us, strike him with the sharp weapon when you see him.

children.text: bṛhaspata āyudhair jeṣi śatrūn druhe rīṣantam pari dhehi rājan ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, conquer enemies with your weapons; O king, enclose the deceitful one who seeks to injure us.

children.text: asmākebhiḥ satvabhiḥ śūra śūrair vīryā kṛdhi yāni te kartvāni
children.translated_text: With our strong men, O hero, with heroes, perform the heroic deeds that are yours to do.

children.text: jyog abhūvann anudhūpitāso hatvī teṣām ā bharā no vasūni ||
children.translated_text: After they have long been driven away and destroyed, bring their riches to us.

children.text: taṃ vaḥ śardham mārutaṃ sumnayur giropa bruve namasā daivyaṃ janam
children.translated_text: Seeking favor for you, I address with song and homage that divine people, the <s>Marut</s> host.

children.text: yathā rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ naśāmahā apatyasācaṃ śrutyaṃ dive dive ||
children.translated_text: So that we may attain wealth with all heroes, accompanied by offspring, famed day by day.

children.text: Chapter 222
asmākam mitrāvaruṇāvataṃ ratham ādityai rudrair vasubhiḥ sacābhuvā
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, with the <s>Ādityas</s>, the <s>Rudras</s>, and the <s>Vasus</s>, attend our chariot together,

children.text: pra yad vayo na paptan vasmanas pari śravasyavo hṛṣīvanto vanarṣadaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when, like birds, they flew from their dwelling, fame-seeking, bristling with delight, seated in the woods.

children.text: adha smā na ud avatā sajoṣaso rathaṃ devāso abhi vikṣu vājayum
children.translated_text: Then may the gods, of one accord, raise up for us the prize-winning chariot among the clans,

children.text: yad āśavaḥ padyābhis titrato rajaḥ pṛthivyāḥ sānau jaṅghananta pāṇibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: when the swift ones, crossing the dust with their feet, strike the ridge of the earth with their hands.

children.text: uta sya na indro viśvacarṣaṇir divaḥ śardhena mārutena sukratuḥ
children.translated_text: And may that <s>Indra</s>, lord of all peoples, the wise one from heaven, stand by with the <s>Marut</s> host,

children.text: anu nu sthāty avṛkābhir ūtibhī ratham mahe sanaye vājasātaye ||
children.translated_text: with unharming aids, for the great winning and acquisition of the prize-winning chariot.

children.text: uta sya devo bhuvanasya sakṣaṇis tvaṣṭā gnābhiḥ sajoṣā jūjuvad ratham
children.translated_text: And may the god <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, guardian of the world, together with the divine women, gladly urge on the chariot.

children.text: iḍā bhago bṛhaddivota rodasī pūṣā purandhir aśvināv adhā patī ||
children.translated_text: <s>Iḍā</s>, <s>Bhaga</s>, wide-shining <s>Heaven</s> and <s>Earth</s>, <s>Pūṣan</s>, <s>Purandhi</s>, and then the two <s>Aśvins</s> as lords.

children.text: uta tye devī subhage mithūdṛśoṣāsānaktā jagatām apījuvā
children.translated_text: And those two blessed goddesses, seeing each other, <s>Dawn</s> and <s>Night</s>, who set the moving world in motion,

children.text: stuṣe yad vām pṛthivi navyasā vaca sthātuś ca vayas trivayā upastire ||
children.translated_text: I praise you two with a newer word, O <s>Earth</s>; for the standing and the moving, your threefold protection has been spread out.

children.text: uta vaḥ śaṃsam uśijām iva śmasy ahirbudhnyo 'ja ekapād uta
children.translated_text: And we seek your praise, as if the praise of inspired ones: <s>Ahirbudhnya</s> and <s>Aja Ekapād</s> as well.

children.text: trita ṛbhukṣāḥ savitā cano dadhe 'pāṃ napād āśuhemā dhiyā śami ||
children.translated_text: <s>Trita</s>, <s>Ṛbhukṣan</s>, and <s>Savitṛ</s> have given delight; <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s>, swift-handed, has set the thought to work.

children.text: etā vo vaśmy udyatā yajatrā atakṣann āyavo navyase sam
children.translated_text: These uplifted praises of yours, O worshipful ones, the living men have fashioned together for something new.

children.text: śravasyavo vājaṃ cakānāḥ saptir na rathyo aha dhītim aśyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeking fame and desiring the prize, like a racehorse for the chariot, may I today attain inspired thought.

children.text: Chapter 223
asya me dyāvāpṛthivī ṛtāyato bhūtam avitrī vacasaḥ siṣāsataḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Heaven</s> and <s>Earth</s>, be protectresses of this word of mine, of me who follows truth and desires to win.

children.text: yayor āyuḥ prataraṃ te idam pura upastute vasūyur vām maho dadhe ||
children.translated_text: Before you two, whose life is broader, I place this great praise, desiring wealth from you.

children.text: mā no guhyā ripa āyor ahan dabhan mā na ābhyo rīradho ducchunābhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Let not hidden enemies among men strike us down; let no evil-minded women deprive us of these things.

children.text: mā no vi yauḥ sakhyā viddhi tasya naḥ sumnāyatā manasā tat tvemahe ||
children.translated_text: Do not part us from friendship; know this of us. With a kindly mind we strive toward that favor of yours.

children.text: aheḍatā manasā śruṣṭim ā vaha duhānāṃ dhenum pipyuṣīm asaścatam
children.translated_text: With unangered mind bring obedience here: an inexhaustible milch cow, rich in milk.

children.text: padyābhir āśuṃ vacasā ca vājinaṃ tvāṃ hinomi puruhūta viśvahā ||
children.translated_text: With steps and with speech I impel you, the swift prize-winning one, O much-invoked one, at every time.

children.text: rākām ahaṃ suhavāṃ suṣṭutī huve śṛṇotu naḥ subhagā bodhatu tmanā
children.translated_text: I call upon well-invoked, well-praised <s>Rākā</s>; let the fortunate one hear us and notice us in herself.

children.text: sīvyatv apaḥ sūcyācchidyamānayā dadātu vīraṃ śatadāyam ukthyam ||
children.translated_text: Let her sew the work with an unbroken needle; let her give a hero, worthy of praise, endowed with a hundred gifts.

children.text: yās te rāke sumatayaḥ supeśaso yābhir dadāsi dāśuṣe vasūni
children.translated_text: Those favorable thoughts of yours, O <s>Rākā</s>, well-formed, by which you give goods to the worshipper,

children.text: tābhir no adya sumanā upāgahi sahasrapoṣaṃ subhage rarāṇā ||
children.translated_text: with those, well-minded, come to us today, O fortunate one, gladly granting thousandfold prosperity.

children.text: sinīvāli pṛthuṣṭuke yā devānām asi svasā
children.translated_text: O <s>Sinīvālī</s>, broad-hipped one, you who are the sister of the gods,

children.text: juṣasva havyam āhutam prajāṃ devi didiḍḍhi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: accept the oblation that has been offered; O goddess, cause offspring to shine forth for us.

children.text: yā subāhuḥ svaṅguriḥ suṣūmā bahusūvarī
children.translated_text: She who has fair arms, fair fingers, bears well, and gives birth to many,

children.text: tasyai viśpatnyai haviḥ sinīvālyai juhotana ||
children.translated_text: to her, the mistress of the people, to <s>Sinīvālī</s>, offer the oblation.

children.text: yā guṅgūr yā sinīvālī yā rākā yā sarasvatī
children.translated_text: She who is <s>Guṅgū</s>, she who is <s>Sinīvālī</s>, she who is <s>Rākā</s>, she who is <s>Sarasvatī</s>,

children.text: indrāṇīm ahva ūtaye varuṇānīṃ svastaye ||
children.translated_text: I have called <s>Indrāṇī</s> for aid and <s>Varuṇānī</s> for well-being.

children.text: Chapter 224
ā te pitar marutāṃ sumnam etu mā naḥ sūryasya saṃdṛśo yuyothāḥ
children.translated_text: May your favor come to us, O father of the <s>Maruts</s>; do not separate us from the sight of the sun.

children.text: abhi no vīro arvati kṣameta pra jāyemahi rudra prajābhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the hero spare us in the course of the steed; O <s>Rudra</s>, may we be born forth with offspring.

children.text: tvādattebhī rudra śantamebhiḥ śataṃ himā aśīya bheṣajebhiḥ
children.translated_text: By the most peaceful remedies given by you, O <s>Rudra</s>, may I reach a hundred winters.

children.text: vy asmad dveṣo vitaraṃ vy aṃho vy amīvāś cātayasvā viṣūcīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Drive hatred away from us, drive distress far away, and drive sicknesses away in every direction.

children.text: śreṣṭho jātasya rudra śriyāsi tavastamas tavasāṃ vajrabāho
children.translated_text: O <s>Rudra</s>, you are the best in glory among what is born, the strongest of the strong, O thunderbolt-armed one.

children.text: parṣi ṇaḥ pāram aṃhasaḥ svasti viśvā abhītī rapaso yuyodhi ||
children.translated_text: Carry us across to the far shore of distress with well-being; ward off from us all assaults of injury.

children.text: mā tvā rudra cukrudhāmā namobhir mā duṣṭutī vṛṣabha mā sahūtī
children.translated_text: Let us not anger you, O <s>Rudra</s>, with our reverences, nor with poor praise, O bull, nor with a bad invocation.

children.text: un no vīrāṁ arpaya bheṣajebhir bhiṣaktamaṃ tvā bhiṣajāṃ śṛṇomi ||
children.translated_text: Raise up our heroes with your remedies; I hear that you are the best healer among healers.

children.text: havīmabhir havate yo havirbhir ava stomebhī rudraṃ diṣīya
children.translated_text: The one who calls with oblations, who calls with offerings, with hymns, may I direct <s>Rudra</s> downward in favor.

children.text: ṛdūdaraḥ suhavo mā no asyai babhruḥ suśipro rīradhan manāyai ||
children.translated_text: May the tender-bellied, easily invoked, tawny, fair-lipped one not hand us over to this hostile intention.

children.text: un mā mamanda vṛṣabho marutvān tvakṣīyasā vayasā nādhamānam
children.translated_text: May the bull accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s> gladden me, though I am brought low, with the most vigorous strength.

children.text: ghṛṇīva cchāyām arapā aśīyā vivāseyaṃ rudrasya sumnam ||
children.translated_text: Like one scorched by heat, may I obtain shade and remain unharmed; I would win the favor of <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: kva sya te rudra mṛḍayākur hasto yo asti bheṣajo jalāṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Where is that gracious hand of yours, O <s>Rudra</s>, the healing and soothing one?

children.text: apabhartā rapaso daivyasyābhī nu mā vṛṣabha cakṣamīthāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Remover of divine injury, now be merciful to me, O bull.

children.text: pra babhrave vṛṣabhāya śvitīce maho mahīṃ suṣṭutim īrayāmi
children.translated_text: For the tawny bull, the bright-white one, I send forth a great, mighty praise.

children.text: namasyā kalmalīkinaṃ namobhir gṛṇīmasi tveṣaṃ rudrasya nāma ||
children.translated_text: With reverences we praise the dark-spotted, blazing name of <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: sthirebhir aṅgaiḥ pururūpa ugro babhruḥ śukrebhiḥ pipiśe hiraṇyaiḥ
children.translated_text: With firm limbs, manifold and fierce, the tawny one has adorned himself with bright golden ornaments.

children.text: īśānād asya bhuvanasya bhūrer na vā u yoṣad rudrād asuryam ||
children.translated_text: From the lord of this abundant world, indeed, divine sovereignty does not depart from <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: arhan bibharṣi sāyakāni dhanvārhan niṣkaṃ yajataṃ viśvarūpam
children.translated_text: Worthy one, you bear arrows and a bow; worthy one, you wear the venerable necklace of every form.

children.text: arhann idaṃ dayase viśvam abhvaṃ na vā ojīyo rudra tvad asti ||
children.translated_text: Worthy one, you hold power over this whole vast world; indeed, O <s>Rudra</s>, there is none stronger than you.

children.text: stuhi śrutaṃ gartasadaṃ yuvānam mṛgaṃ na bhīmam upahatnum ugram
children.translated_text: Praise the renowned one seated in the chariot, young, fierce like a dreadful beast, attacking and powerful.

children.text: mṛḍā jaritre rudra stavāno 'nyaṃ te asman ni vapantu senāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Being praised, O <s>Rudra</s>, be gracious to the singer; let your armies strike down someone other than us.

children.text: kumāraś cit pitaraṃ vandamānam prati nānāma rudropayantam
