children.translated_text: Even as a young son bows to his father when he comes near in reverence, so I bow to <s>Rudra</s> as he approaches.

children.text: bhūrer dātāraṃ satpatiṃ gṛṇīṣe stutas tvam bheṣajā rāsy asme ||
children.translated_text: I praise the giver of abundance, the good lord; when praised, may you grant us remedies.

children.text: yā vo bheṣajā marutaḥ śucīni yā śantamā vṛṣaṇo yā mayobhu
children.translated_text: Those remedies of yours, O <s>Maruts</s>, that are pure, those that are most peaceful, O bulls, those that bring delight,

children.text: yāni manur avṛṇītā pitā nas tā śaṃ ca yoś ca rudrasya vaśmi ||
children.translated_text: those which <s>Manu</s>, our father, chose: I desire those remedies of <s>Rudra</s> for welfare and relief.

children.text: pari ṇo hetī rudrasya vṛjyāḥ pari tveṣasya durmatir mahī gāt
children.translated_text: May the missile of <s>Rudra</s> turn aside around us; may the great ill will of the blazing one go around us.

children.text: ava sthirā maghavadbhyas tanuṣva mīḍhvas tokāya tanayāya mṛḍa ||
children.translated_text: Unstring the firm bow away from the generous; O bounteous one, be gracious to child and descendant.

children.text: evā babhro vṛṣabha cekitāna yathā deva na hṛṇīṣe na haṃsi
children.translated_text: Thus, O tawny bull, O knowing god, do not be angry and do not slay.

children.text: havanaśrun no rudreha bodhi bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Here, O <s>Rudra</s>, be one who hears our invocation; may we speak greatly in the assembly, rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 225
dhārāvarā maruto dhṛṣṇvojaso mṛgā na bhīmās taviṣībhir arcinaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Maruts</s>, bearing streams and bold in strength, like dreadful beasts, shine with their powers.

children.text: agnayo na śuśucānā ṛjīṣiṇo bhṛmiṃ dhamanto apa gā avṛṇvata ||
children.translated_text: Like blazing fires, straight-rushing and blowing with a roar, they opened up the cows.

children.text: dyāvo na stṛbhiś citayanta khādino vy abhriyā na dyutayanta vṛṣṭayaḥ
children.translated_text: Like heavens with stars, the ornamented ones gleam; like cloud-born showers, they flash out.

children.text: rudro yad vo maruto rukmavakṣaso vṛṣājani pṛśnyāḥ śukra ūdhani ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Rudra</s> begot you, O <s>Maruts</s>, golden-breasted ones, as a bull in the bright udder of <s>Pṛśni</s>,

children.text: ukṣante aśvāṁ atyāṁ ivājiṣu nadasya karṇais turayanta āśubhiḥ
children.translated_text: they sprinkle the racers like horses in contests, hastening them with swift ones and with the ears of the roaring one.

children.text: hiraṇyaśiprā maruto davidhvataḥ pṛkṣaṃ yātha pṛṣatībhiḥ samanyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Golden-jawed <s>Maruts</s>, shaking, of one accord, you go to nourishment with your speckled mares.

children.text: pṛkṣe tā viśvā bhuvanā vavakṣire mitrāya vā sadam ā jīradānavaḥ
children.translated_text: For that nourishment all beings have grown strong, or for <s>Mitra</s> always, O ever-giving ones.

children.text: pṛṣadaśvāso anavabhrarādhasa ṛjipyāso na vayuneṣu dhūrṣadaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With speckled horses and unobscured gifts, straight-going, they sit at the pole in their skilled ways.

children.text: indhanvabhir dhenubhī rapśadūdhabhir adhvasmabhiḥ pathibhir bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ
children.translated_text: With kindling powers and cows whose udders drip, on unworn paths, they are bright in appearance.

children.text: ā haṃsāso na svasarāṇi gantana madhor madāya marutaḥ samanyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Come like swans to your own resting places, for the exhilaration of sweetness, O <s>Maruts</s>, of one accord.

children.text: ā no brahmāṇi marutaḥ samanyavo narāṃ na śaṃsaḥ savanāni gantana
children.translated_text: Come to our sacred utterances, O <s>Maruts</s>, of one accord, and to the pressings, like praise among men.

children.text: aśvām iva pipyata dhenum ūdhani kartā dhiyaṃ jaritre vājapeśasam ||
children.translated_text: Swell the cow at the udder as one fattens a mare; make the inspired thought prize-adorned for the singer.

children.text: taṃ no dāta maruto vājinaṃ ratha āpānam brahma citayad dive dive
children.translated_text: Give us that prize-winning chariot, O <s>Maruts</s>, a draught that awakens sacred speech day by day,

children.text: iṣaṃ stotṛbhyo vṛjaneṣu kārave sanim medhām ariṣṭaṃ duṣṭaraṃ sahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: food for the praisers in contests, gain for the singer, wisdom, uninjured and hard-to-cross strength.

children.text: yad yuñjate maruto rukmavakṣaso 'śvān ratheṣu bhaga ā sudānavaḥ
children.translated_text: When the <s>Maruts</s>, golden-breasted and generous, yoke the horses to the chariots for fortune,

children.text: dhenur na śiśve svasareṣu pinvate janāya rātahaviṣe mahīm iṣam ||
children.translated_text: the cow swells like one with a calf in her stalls, with great nourishment for the man who has offered oblations.

children.text: yo no maruto vṛkatāti martyo ripur dadhe vasavo rakṣatā riṣaḥ
children.translated_text: The mortal enemy who has set wolfish harm against us, O good <s>Maruts</s>, protect us from injury.

children.text: vartayata tapuṣā cakriyābhi tam ava rudrā aśaso hantanā vadhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With your burning, wheel-like weapons turn him away; O <s>Rudras</s>, strike down the blow of the infamous one.

children.text: citraṃ tad vo maruto yāma cekite pṛśnyā yad ūdhar apy āpayo duhuḥ
children.translated_text: Wondrous is that course of yours, O <s>Maruts</s>, when they milked the water-rich udder of <s>Pṛśni</s>.

children.text: yad vā nide navamānasya rudriyās tritaṃ jarāya juratām adābhyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Or when, O invincible <s>Rudriyas</s>, you dealt with <s>Trita</s> amid the reproach of the reviler, as the injurers grew old.

children.text: tān vo maho maruta evayāvno viṣṇor eṣasya prabhṛthe havāmahe
children.translated_text: We call upon those great, swiftly moving <s>Maruts</s> at the onset of rushing <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

children.text: hiraṇyavarṇān kakuhān yatasruco brahmaṇyantaḥ śaṃsyaṃ rādha īmahe ||
children.translated_text: Golden-colored, high-crested, self-guided, delighting in sacred utterance, we ask for praiseworthy bounty.

children.text: te daśagvāḥ prathamā yajñam ūhire te no hinvantūṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: Those <s>Daśagvas</s> first bore the sacrifice; may they impel us at the breakings of dawn.

children.text: uṣā na rāmīr aruṇair aporṇute maho jyotiṣā śucatā goarṇasā ||
children.translated_text: Like <s>Uṣas</s>, unveiling the dark nights with ruddy rays, with great shining light and cow-bright radiance.

children.text: te kṣoṇībhir aruṇebhir nāñjibhī rudrā ṛtasya sadaneṣu vāvṛdhuḥ
children.translated_text: Those <s>Rudras</s>, with ruddy, shining hosts, have grown in the seats of <s>ṛta</s> (truthful order).

children.text: nimeghamānā atyena pājasā suścandraṃ varṇaṃ dadhire supeśasam ||
children.translated_text: Thundering with overpowering force, they have taken on a lovely, bright, well-fashioned color.

children.text: tāṁ iyāno mahi varūtham ūtaya upa ghed enā namasā gṛṇīmasi
children.translated_text: Going to that great shelter for aid, we praise her here with reverence.

children.text: trito na yān pañca hotṝn abhiṣṭaya āvavartad avarāñ cakriyāvase ||
children.translated_text: As <s>Trita</s>, for help, turned back the five <s>hotṛs</s> (invoking priests) that moved downward, so may she act for us.

children.text: yayā radhram pārayathāty aṃho yayā nido muñcatha vanditāram
children.translated_text: By the help with which you carry the weak man across distress, by which you release the praiser from revilers,

children.text: arvācī sā maruto yā va ūtir o ṣu vāśreva sumatir jigātu ||
children.translated_text: let that aid of yours, O <s>Maruts</s>, come hither; let your favor hasten here like a lowing cow.

children.text: Chapter 226
upem asṛkṣi vājayur vacasyāṃ cano dadhīta nādyo giro me
children.translated_text: I have sent forth, as one seeking prize, a speech of praise; may my river-like songs set down delight.

children.text: apāṃ napād āśuhemā kuvit sa supeśasas karati joṣiṣaddhi ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s>, swift in impulse, perhaps make them beautiful, for he will gladly receive them.

children.text: imaṃ sv asmai hṛda ā sutaṣṭam mantraṃ vocema kuvid asya vedat
children.translated_text: Let us speak for him this well-fashioned mantra from the heart; perhaps he will notice it.

children.text: apāṃ napād asuryasya mahnā viśvāny aryo bhuvanā jajāna ||
children.translated_text: By the greatness of his lordly power, <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s> has generated all noble beings.

children.text: sam anyā yanty upa yanty anyāḥ samānam ūrvaṃ nadyaḥ pṛṇanti
children.translated_text: Some streams go together, others come near; the rivers fill one common wide expanse.

children.text: tam ū śuciṃ śucayo dīdivāṃsam apāṃ napātam pari tasthur āpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The pure waters have stood around that pure, shining <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s> who blazes brightly.

children.text: tam asmerā yuvatayo yuvānam marmṛjyamānāḥ pari yanty āpaḥ
children.translated_text: The waters, like smiling young women, go around that young one as he is being cleansed.

children.text: sa śukrebhiḥ śikvabhī revad asme dīdāyānidhmo ghṛtanirṇig apsu ||
children.translated_text: With bright flames, rich for us, he shines in the waters, without fuel, clothed in ghee.

children.text: asmai tisro avyathyāya nārīr devāya devīr didhiṣanty annam
children.translated_text: For him, the uninjured god, three divine women desire to give food.

children.text: kṛtā ivopa hi prasarsre apsu sa pīyūṣaṃ dhayati pūrvasūnām ||
children.translated_text: As if prepared, he has stretched himself out in the waters; he sucks the rich milk of those first-born ones.

children.text: aśvasyātra janimāsya ca svar druho riṣaḥ saṃpṛcaḥ pāhi sūrīn
children.translated_text: Protect the patrons here from the birth of the horse and of this sun, from malice, harm, and close attack.

children.text: āmāsu pūrṣu paro apramṛṣyaṃ nārātayo vi naśan nānṛtāni ||
children.translated_text: Among raw dwellings, what is beyond reach, let enemies and falsehoods disappear far away.

children.text: sva ā dame sudughā yasya dhenuḥ svadhām pīpāya subhv annam atti
children.translated_text: In his own house is the well-milking cow; she has swelled with nourishment, and he eats fair food.

children.text: so apāṃ napād ūrjayann apsv antar vasudeyāya vidhate vi bhāti ||
children.translated_text: That <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s>, strengthening within the waters, shines forth for the worshipper who gives wealth.

children.text: yo apsv ā śucinā daivyena ṛtāvājasra urviyā vibhāti
children.translated_text: He who, in the waters, pure with divine brightness, true to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), shines widely and unceasingly,

children.text: vayā id anyā bhuvanāny asya pra jāyante vīrudhaś ca prajābhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: from him, indeed, other beings and plants are born forth with their offspring.

children.text: apāṃ napād ā hy asthād upasthaṃ jihmānām ūrdhvo vidyutaṃ vasānaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s> has taken his place in the lap of the winding waters, standing upright and clothed in lightning.

children.text: tasya jyeṣṭham mahimānaṃ vahantīr hiraṇyavarṇāḥ pari yanti yahvīḥ ||
children.translated_text: The mighty waters, golden-colored, go around him, bearing his highest greatness.

children.text: hiraṇyarūpaḥ sa hiraṇyasaṃdṛg apāṃ napāt sed u hiraṇyavarṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Golden in form, golden in appearance, <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s> is indeed golden-colored.

children.text: hiraṇyayāt pari yoner niṣadyā hiraṇyadā dadaty annam asmai ||
children.translated_text: Sitting down from his golden womb, moving in gold, the givers of gold give food to him.

children.text: tad asyānīkam uta cāru nāmāpīcyaṃ vardhate naptur apām
children.translated_text: This is his face, and his lovely secret name grows, that of the offspring of the waters.

children.text: yam indhate yuvatayaḥ sam itthā hiraṇyavarṇaṃ ghṛtam annam asya ||
children.translated_text: The young women kindle him together in this way, golden-colored; ghee is his food.

children.text: asmai bahūnām avamāya sakhye yajñair vidhema namasā havirbhiḥ
children.translated_text: For him, the lowest friend of many, for the god, let us worship with sacrifices, reverence, and oblations.

children.text: saṃ sānu mārjmi didhiṣāmi bilmair dadhāmy annaiḥ pari vanda ṛgbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: I wipe his ridge together; I desire to nourish him with kindling-sticks; I place food before him and praise him with verses.

children.text: sa īṃ vṛṣājanayat tāsu garbhaṃ sa īṃ śiśur dhayati taṃ rihanti
children.translated_text: He, the bull, placed an embryo in them; he, the child, sucks, and they lick him.

children.text: so apāṃ napād anabhimlātavarṇo 'nyasyeveha tanvā viveṣa ||
children.translated_text: That <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s>, whose color does not fade, has entered here in the body of another, as it were.

children.text: asmin pade parame tasthivāṃsam adhvasmabhir viśvahā dīdivāṃsam
children.translated_text: Standing in this highest place, shining every day with unfailing paths,

children.text: āpo naptre ghṛtam annaṃ vahantīḥ svayam atkaiḥ pari dīyanti yahvīḥ ||
children.translated_text: the waters, bearing ghee and food for their offspring, themselves fly around him with their garments, the mighty ones.

children.text: ayāṃsam agne sukṣitiṃ janāyāyāṃsam u maghavadbhyaḥ suvṛktim
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, I have won a good dwelling for the people; I have also won good praise for the generous ones.

children.text: viśvaṃ tad bhadraṃ yad avanti devā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: All that is auspicious which the gods protect is ours; may we speak greatly in the assembly, rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 227
tubhyaṃ hinvāno vasiṣṭa gā apo 'dhukṣan sīm avibhir adribhir naraḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, men have urged the cows and milked out the waters for you with sheep and pressing stones.

children.text: pibendra svāhā prahutaṃ vaṣaṭkṛtaṃ hotrād ā somam prathamo ya īśiṣe ||
children.translated_text: Drink, O <s>Indra</s>, with the svāhā-call, the offered, vaṣaṭ-consecrated Soma; you who first have mastery, drink the Soma from the <s>hotṛ</s>'s station.

children.text: yajñaiḥ sammiślāḥ pṛṣatībhir ṛṣṭibhir yāmañchubhrāso añjiṣu priyā uta
children.translated_text: Mixed with sacrifices, with speckled mares and spears, the bright sons of <s>Bharata</s>, dear in their adornments, go on their course.

children.text: āsadyā barhir bharatasya sūnavaḥ potrād ā somam pibatā divo naraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having sat down on the sacred grass, O men of heaven, drink the Soma from the <s>potṛ</s>'s station.

children.text: ameva naḥ suhavā ā hi gantana ni barhiṣi sadatanā raṇiṣṭana
children.translated_text: Come here to us, kindly invoked; sit down upon the sacred grass and rejoice.

children.text: athā mandasva jujuṣāṇo andhasas tvaṣṭar devebhir janibhiḥ sumadgaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, O <s>Tvaṣṭar</s>, delighting in the draught, rejoice with the gods and with the divine births, amid the well-exulting troop.

children.text: ā vakṣi devāṁ iha vipra yakṣi cośan hotar ni ṣadā yoniṣu triṣu
children.translated_text: Bring the gods here, O inspired one; worship them; and you, O <s>Hotar</s>, sit down in the three wombs.

children.text: prati vīhi prasthitaṃ somyam madhu pibāgnīdhrāt tava bhāgasya tṛpṇuhi ||
children.translated_text: Go to meet the prepared Soma-honey; drink from the <s>agnīdh</s>'s station and be satisfied with your share.

children.text: eṣa sya te tanvo nṛmṇavardhanaḥ saha ojaḥ pradivi bāhvor hitaḥ
children.translated_text: This here, strengthening manly power in your body, is strength and force placed from of old in your two arms.

children.text: tubhyaṃ suto maghavan tubhyam ābhṛtas tvam asya brāhmaṇād ā tṛpat piba ||
children.translated_text: For you it is pressed, O bounteous one; for you it is brought. You, at this sacred utterance, drink of it until satisfied.

children.text: juṣethāṃ yajñam bodhataṃ havasya me satto hotā nividaḥ pūrvyā anu
children.translated_text: May you two enjoy the sacrifice; heed my call. The seated <s>hotṛ</s> follows the ancient invitatory formulas.

children.text: acchā rājānā nama ety āvṛtam praśāstrād ā pibataṃ somyam madhu ||
children.translated_text: Reverence goes toward you two kings, fully prepared; drink the Soma-honey from the <s>praśāstṛ</s>'s station.

children.text: Chapter 228
mandasva hotrād anu joṣam andhaso 'dhvaryavaḥ sa pūrṇāṃ vaṣṭy āsicam
children.translated_text: Rejoice according to your pleasure in the draught from the <s>hotṛ</s>'s station; the <s>adhvaryus</s> fill the vessel for him, which he desires.

children.text: tasmā etam bharata tadvaśo dadir hotrāt somaṃ draviṇodaḥ piba ṛtubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bring this for him, for they have given it according to his will; O <s>Draviṇodas</s>, drink the Soma from the <s>hotṛ</s>'s station in due seasons.

children.text: yam u pūrvam ahuve tam idaṃ huve sed u havyo dadir yo nāma patyate
children.translated_text: Him whom I invoked before, him I invoke now; he indeed is to be invoked, the giver, who rules by name.

children.text: adhvaryubhiḥ prasthitaṃ somyam madhu potrāt somaṃ draviṇodaḥ piba ṛtubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: The Soma-honey set forth by the <s>adhvaryus</s>: O <s>Draviṇodas</s>, drink the Soma from the <s>potṛ</s>'s station in due seasons.

children.text: medyantu te vahnayo yebhir īyase 'riṣaṇyan vīḍayasvā vanaspate
children.translated_text: May your fires be exhilarated, those by which you travel; without harm, make yourself firm, O <s>Vanaspati</s>.

children.text: āyūyā dhṛṣṇo abhigūryā tvaṃ neṣṭrāt somaṃ draviṇodaḥ piba ṛtubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: With life, O bold one, after being invoked, drink the Soma from the <s>neṣṭṛ</s>'s station in due seasons, O <s>Draviṇodas</s>.

children.text: apāddhotrād uta potrād amattota neṣṭrād ajuṣata prayo hitam
children.translated_text: He has enjoyed the placed delight from the <s>hotṛ</s>'s station, from the <s>potṛ</s>'s station, and also from the <s>neṣṭṛ</s>'s station.

children.text: turīyam pātram amṛktam amartyaṃ draviṇodāḥ pibatu drāviṇodasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Draviṇodas</s>, the bestower of wealth, drink the fourth, untaken, immortal cup.

children.text: arvāñcam adya yayyaṃ nṛvāhaṇaṃ rathaṃ yuñjāthām iha vāṃ vimocanam
children.translated_text: Yoke today your ready, man-bearing chariot turned hither; here is the place where you two shall unyoke.

children.text: pṛṅktaṃ havīṃṣi madhunā hi kaṃ gatam athā somam pibataṃ vājinīvasū ||
children.translated_text: Mix the oblations with sweetness, for surely you have come; then drink the Soma, O possessors of prize-winning wealth.

children.text: joṣy agne samidhaṃ joṣy āhutiṃ joṣi brahma janyaṃ joṣi suṣṭutim
children.translated_text: Take pleasure, O <s>Agni</s>, in the kindling-stick; take pleasure in the offering. Take pleasure in the prayer born among men; take pleasure in the good praise.

children.text: viśvebhir viśvāṁ ṛtunā vaso maha uśan devāṁ uśataḥ pāyayā haviḥ ||
children.translated_text: With all the gods and with every proper season, O <s>Vasu</s>, desiring greatness, make the willing gods drink the oblation.

children.text: Chapter 229
ud u ṣya devaḥ savitā savāya śaśvattamaṃ tadapā vahnir asthāt
children.translated_text: Up has arisen this god <s>Savitṛ</s> for his impelling; that most enduring bearer has stood forth apart from the waters.

children.text: nūnaṃ devebhyo vi hi dhāti ratnam athābhajad vītihotraṃ svastau ||
children.translated_text: Now he apportions treasure for the gods; then, in well-being, he has assigned the share fit for the invited offering.

children.text: viśvasya hi śruṣṭaye deva ūrdhvaḥ pra bāhavā pṛthupāṇiḥ sisarti
children.translated_text: For the god, lifted high for the obedience of the whole world, stretches forth his arms, broad-handed.

children.text: āpaś cid asya vrata ā nimṛgrā ayaṃ cid vāto ramate parijman ||
children.translated_text: Even the waters are bent down beneath his command; even this wind comes to rest within his circuit.

children.text: āśubhiś cid yān vi mucāti nūnam arīramad atamānaṃ cid etoḥ
children.translated_text: Those whom with swift powers he now releases, he has set at rest even the one not resting from his course.

children.text: ahyarṣūṇāṃ cin ny ayāṁ aviṣyām anu vrataṃ savitur moky āgāt ||
children.translated_text: Even among the serpent-like streams I have come to this protection; following the command of <s>Savitṛ</s>, the releaser has arrived.

children.text: punaḥ sam avyad vitataṃ vayantī madhyā kartor ny adhācchakma dhīraḥ
children.translated_text: Again the wise one has wrapped together the stretched-out weaving woman; in the middle of the work he has set down his power.

children.text: ut saṃhāyāsthād vy ṛtūṃr adardhar aramatiḥ savitā deva āgāt ||
children.translated_text: Rising after the gathering, he has upheld the seasons separately; <s>Savitṛ</s>, the god of ready aid, has come.

children.text: nānaukāṃsi duryo viśvam āyur vi tiṣṭhate prabhavaḥ śoko agneḥ
children.translated_text: Different dwellings and doors extend over the whole span of life; the flame of <s>Agni</s> has its own source.

children.text: jyeṣṭham mātā sūnave bhāgam ādhād anv asya ketam iṣitaṃ savitrā ||
children.translated_text: The mother has placed the eldest share for her son, following his sign, impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: samāvavarti viṣṭhito jigīṣur viśveṣāṃ kāmaś caratām amābhūt
children.translated_text: He has turned round, set in place and eager to win; the desire of all that moves has come home.

children.text: śaśvāṁ apo vikṛtaṃ hitvy āgād anu vrataṃ savitur daivyasya ||
children.translated_text: Leaving behind the continually altered waters, he has come, following the command of divine <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: tvayā hitam apyam apsu bhāgaṃ dhanvānv ā mṛgayaso vi tasthuḥ
children.translated_text: The share placed by you in the waters, even that hidden one, the hunters have spread out over the dry land.

children.text: vanāni vibhyo nakir asya tāni vratā devasya savitur minanti ||
children.translated_text: The forests, for the birds, do not violate those ordinances of the god <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: yādrādhyaṃ varuṇo yonim apyam aniśitaṃ nimiṣi jarbhurāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: The unsharpened one, blinking and swallowing, has gone to the watery womb which <s>Varuṇa</s> has made ready.

children.text: viśvo mārtāṇḍo vrajam ā paśur gāt sthaśo janmāni savitā vy ākaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Every mortal creature, like cattle, has gone to the enclosure; <s>Savitṛ</s> has made manifest the births in their places.

children.text: na yasyendro varuṇo na mitro vratam aryamā na minanti rudraḥ
children.translated_text: Neither <s>Indra</s>, nor <s>Varuṇa</s>, nor <s>Mitra</s>, nor <s>Aryaman</s>, nor <s>Rudra</s> violate his command.

children.text: nārātayas tam idaṃ svasti huve devaṃ savitāraṃ namobhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Nor do hostile powers violate it. I call with reverence on that god <s>Savitṛ</s> for this well-being.

children.text: bhagaṃ dhiyaṃ vājayantaḥ purandhiṃ narāśaṃso gnāspatir no avyāḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Bhaga</s>, inspired thought, prize-winning <s>Purandhi</s>, <s>Narāśaṃsa</s>, and the lord of divine women protect us.

children.text: āye vāmasya saṃgathe rayīṇām priyā devasya savituḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: At the coming together of desirable riches, may we be dear to the god <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: asmabhyaṃ tad divo adbhyaḥ pṛthivyās tvayā dattaṃ kāmyaṃ rādha ā gāt
children.translated_text: May that desirable gift, given by you from heaven, from the waters, and from the earth, come to us.

children.text: śaṃ yat stotṛbhya āpaye bhavāty uruśaṃsāya savitar jaritre ||
children.translated_text: May it become a blessing for the praising singers, for the helper, O far-famed <s>Savitṛ</s>, for the chanter.

children.text: Chapter 230
grāvāṇeva tad id arthaṃ jarethe gṛdhreva vṛkṣaṃ nidhimantam accha
children.translated_text: Like pressing-stones you two are invoked for that purpose, like vultures toward a tree that holds treasure.

children.text: brahmāṇeva vidatha ukthaśāsā dūteva havyā janyā purutrā ||
children.translated_text: Like priests at the assembly, directors of hymns, like messengers bearing oblations born in many places.

children.text: prātaryāvāṇā rathyeva vīrājeva yamā varam ā sacethe
children.translated_text: Like morning travelers, like heroes on a chariot-road, like twin kings you two follow the best thing.

children.text: mene iva tanvā śumbhamāne dampatīva kratuvidā janeṣu ||
children.translated_text: Like two women adorning their bodies, like a married pair who know their purpose among people.

children.text: śṛṅgeva naḥ prathamā gantam arvāk chaphāv iva jarbhurāṇā tarobhiḥ
children.translated_text: Like two horns, come first toward us; like two hooves, trampling with your crossings.

children.text: cakravākeva prati vastor usrārvāñcā yātaṃ rathyeva śakrā ||
children.translated_text: Like two cakravāka birds at each dawn, come hither with the bright morning light, O mighty ones, like chariot-warriors.

children.text: nāveva naḥ pārayataṃ yugeva nabhyeva na upadhīva pradhīva
children.translated_text: Like a boat, carry us across; like a yoke, like a nave, like supports and rims, uphold us.

children.text: śvāneva no ariṣaṇyā tanūnāṃ khṛgaleva visrasaḥ pātam asmān ||
children.translated_text: Like two dogs protecting our bodies from harm, like two crutches, guard us from collapse.

children.text: vātevājuryā nadyeva rītir akṣī iva cakṣuṣā yātam arvāk
children.translated_text: Like wind with swift motion, like the current of a river, come hither with sight, as two eyes do.

children.text: hastāv iva tanve śambhaviṣṭhā pādeva no nayataṃ vasyo accha ||
children.translated_text: Like two hands, most helpful for the body, like two feet, lead us toward what is better.

children.text: oṣṭhāv iva madhv āsne vadantā stanāv iva pipyataṃ jīvase naḥ
children.translated_text: Like two lips speaking sweetness at the mouth, like two breasts, swell with nourishment for our life.

children.text: nāseva nas tanvo rakṣitārā karṇāv iva suśrutā bhūtam asme ||
children.translated_text: Like two noses, guardians of our body, like two ears well-hearing, be present for us.

children.text: hasteva śaktim abhi saṃdadī naḥ kṣāmeva naḥ sam ajataṃ rajāṃsi
children.translated_text: Like two hands, place strength upon us; like earth and heaven, join the realms for us.

children.text: imā giro aśvinā yuṣmayantīḥ kṣṇotreṇeva svadhitiṃ saṃ śiśītam ||
children.translated_text: These songs, longing for you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, sharpen as with a whetstone the axe with its edge.

children.text: etāni vām aśvinā vardhanāni brahma stomaṃ gṛtsamadāso akran
children.translated_text: These are your strengthenings, O <s>Aśvins</s>; the <s>Gṛtsamadas</s> have made this prayer and praise-song.

children.text: tāni narā jujuṣāṇopa yātam bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Taking pleasure in them, O men, come near. May we speak loftily in the assembly, rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 231
somāpūṣaṇā jananā rayīṇāṃ jananā divo jananā pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> and <s>Pūṣan</s> are generators of riches, generators of heaven, generators of earth.

children.text: jātau viśvasya bhuvanasya gopau devā akṛṇvann amṛtasya nābhim ||
children.translated_text: Born as guardians of the whole world, the gods made them the navel of immortality.

children.text: imau devau jāyamānau juṣantemau tamāṃsi gūhatām ajuṣṭā
children.translated_text: These two gods, being born, take pleasure here; these two have hidden away the unwelcome darknesses.

children.text: ābhyām indraḥ pakvam āmāsv antaḥ somāpūṣabhyāṃ janad usriyāsu ||
children.translated_text: By these two, by <s>Soma</s> and <s>Pūṣan</s>, <s>Indra</s> generated the ripe one among the unripe cows.

children.text: somāpūṣaṇā rajaso vimānaṃ saptacakraṃ ratham aviśvaminvam
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s> and <s>Pūṣan</s>, the measure of the midspace, the seven-wheeled chariot that injures none,

children.text: viṣūvṛtam manasā yujyamānaṃ taṃ jinvatho vṛṣaṇā pañcaraśmim ||
children.translated_text: turned in all directions, yoked by the mind: impel that five-reined one, O bulls.

children.text: divy anyaḥ sadanaṃ cakra uccā pṛthivyām anyo adhy antarikṣe
children.translated_text: One has made his seat high in heaven; the other is upon earth and in the midspace.

children.text: tāv asmabhyam puruvāram purukṣuṃ rāyas poṣaṃ vi ṣyatāṃ nābhim asme ||
children.translated_text: May those two release for us here the navel of wealth's growth, rich in many boons and much nourishment.

children.text: viśvāny anyo bhuvanā jajāna viśvam anyo abhicakṣāṇa eti
children.translated_text: One has generated all beings; the other goes on, watching over the whole world.

children.text: somāpūṣaṇāv avataṃ dhiyam me yuvābhyāṃ viśvāḥ pṛtanā jayema ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s> and <s>Pūṣan</s>, protect my inspired thought; with you two may we conquer all battles.

children.text: dhiyam pūṣā jinvatu viśvaminvo rayiṃ somo rayipatir dadhātu
children.translated_text: May <s>Pūṣan</s>, impeller of all, quicken inspired thought; may <s>Soma</s>, lord of wealth, set wealth in place.

children.text: avatu devy aditir anarvā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May divine <s>Aditi</s>, unharmed, protect us. May we speak loftily in the assembly, rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 232
vāyo ye te sahasriṇo rathāsas tebhir ā gahi
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s>, those thousandfold chariots of yours, come here with them,

children.text: niyutvān somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: rich in teams, for the drinking of Soma.

children.text: niyutvān vāyav ā gahy ayaṃ śukro ayāmi te
children.translated_text: Come here, O <s>Vāyu</s>, rich in teams; this bright Soma I send forth to you.

children.text: gantāsi sunvato gṛham ||
children.translated_text: You will come to the house of the Soma-presser.

children.text: śukrasyādya gavāśira indravāyū niyutvataḥ
children.translated_text: To the bright one mixed with milk today, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>, rich in teams,

children.text: ā yātam pibataṃ narā ||
children.translated_text: come here and drink, O men.

children.text: ayaṃ vām mitrāvaruṇā sutaḥ soma ṛtāvṛdhā
children.translated_text: This Soma has been pressed for you, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, increasers of truth.

children.text: mamed iha śrutaṃ havam ||
children.translated_text: Hear my call here, indeed.

children.text: rājānāv anabhidruhā dhruve sadasy uttame
children.translated_text: The two kings, unharming, in the highest firm seat,

children.text: sahasrasthūṇa āsāte ||
children.translated_text: sit upon a thousand-pillared throne.

children.text: tā samrājā ghṛtāsutī ādityā dānunas patī
children.translated_text: Those universal sovereigns, whose draught is ghee, the <s>Ādityas</s>, lords of bounty,

children.text: sacete anavahvaram ||
children.translated_text: attend unfalteringly.

children.text: gomad ū ṣu nāsatyāśvāvad yātam aśvinā
children.translated_text: Rich in cattle, rich in horses, come to us, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>;

children.text: vartī rudrā nṛpāyyam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Rudras</s>, turn onto the path fit for men.

children.text: na yat paro nāntara ādadharṣad vṛṣaṇvasū
children.translated_text: That which no outsider and no one within has dared to assail, O possessors of bull-like wealth,

children.text: duḥśaṃso martyo ripuḥ ||
children.translated_text: no evil-speaking mortal enemy or foe.

children.text: tā na ā voḍham aśvinā rayim piśaṅgasaṃdṛśam
children.translated_text: Bring that wealth to us, O <s>Aśvins</s>, tawny in appearance,

children.text: dhiṣṇyā varivovidam ||
children.translated_text: O worthy ones, finding broad room.

children.text: indro aṅga mahad bhayam abhī ṣad apa cucyavat
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, indeed, has driven away the great fear on every side;

children.text: sa hi sthiro vicarṣaṇiḥ ||
children.translated_text: for he is firm, watching over the peoples.

children.text: indraś ca mṛḍayāti no na naḥ paścād aghaṃ naśat
children.translated_text: And may <s>Indra</s> be gracious to us; let no evil reach us from behind.

children.text: bhadram bhavāti naḥ puraḥ ||
children.translated_text: May what is good be before us.

children.text: indra āśābhyas pari sarvābhyo abhayaṃ karat
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> make fearlessness for us from the quarters, from all directions,

children.text: jetā śatrūn vicarṣaṇiḥ ||
children.translated_text: the conqueror of enemies, watching over the peoples.

children.text: viśve devāsa ā gata śṛṇutā ma imaṃ havam
children.translated_text: All you gods, come here; listen to this call of mine.

children.text: edam barhir ni ṣīdata ||
children.translated_text: Sit down upon this <s>barhis</s> (sacrificial grass).

children.text: tīvro vo madhumāṁ ayaṃ śunahotreṣu matsaraḥ
children.translated_text: This sharp, sweet intoxicating draught is for you among the <s>Śunahotras</s>;

children.text: etam pibata kāmyam ||
children.translated_text: drink this desirable one.

children.text: indrajyeṣṭhā marudgaṇā devāsaḥ pūṣarātayaḥ
children.translated_text: Gods with <s>Indra</s> as eldest, hosts of <s>Maruts</s>, those whose gifts are with <s>Pūṣan</s>,

children.text: viśve mama śrutā havam ||
children.translated_text: all of you, hear my call.

children.text: ambitame nadītame devitame sarasvati
children.translated_text: Best of mothers, best of rivers, best of goddesses, O <s>Sarasvatī</s>,

children.text: apraśastā iva smasi praśastim amba nas kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: we are as if unpraised; O mother, make renown for us.

children.text: tve viśvā sarasvati śritāyūṃṣi devyām
children.translated_text: In you, O divine <s>Sarasvatī</s>, all lives are sheltered.

children.text: śunahotreṣu matsva prajāṃ devi didiḍḍhi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Rejoice among the <s>Śunahotras</s>; O goddess, make our offspring shine.

children.text: imā brahma sarasvati juṣasva vājinīvati
children.translated_text: Accept these prayers, O <s>Sarasvatī</s>, rich in steeds,

children.text: yā te manma gṛtsamadā ṛtāvari priyā deveṣu juhvati ||
children.translated_text: the thoughts that the <s>Gṛtsamadas</s>, O truth-bearing one, dear among the gods, offer to you.

children.text: pretāṃ yajñasya śambhuvā yuvām id ā vṛṇīmahe
children.translated_text: Go forth as benefactors of the sacrifice; we choose you two indeed,

children.text: agniṃ ca havyavāhanam ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Agni</s>, the carrier of oblations.

children.text: dyāvā naḥ pṛthivī imaṃ sidhram adya divispṛśam
children.translated_text: May <s>Heaven</s> and <s>Earth</s> bring this ready, heaven-touching sacrifice of ours today

children.text: yajñaṃ deveṣu yacchatām ||
children.translated_text: to the gods.

children.text: ā vām upastham adruhā devāḥ sīdantu yajñiyāḥ
children.translated_text: May the worshipful gods sit in your lap, O undeceiving two,

children.text: ihādya somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: here today for the drinking of <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: Chapter 233
kanikradaj januṣam prabruvāṇa iyarti vācam ariteva nāvam
children.translated_text: Crying out, proclaiming its birth, it sends forth speech like a rower a boat.

children.text: sumaṅgalaś ca śakune bhavāsi mā tvā kācid abhibhā viśvyā vidat ||
children.translated_text: Auspicious indeed you are, O bird; may no overpowering force from anywhere find you.

children.text: mā tvā śyena ud vadhīn mā suparṇo mā tvā vidad iṣumān vīro astā
children.translated_text: Let not the falcon slay you, nor the eagle; let no arrow-bearing hero strike you.

children.text: pitryām anu pradiśaṃ kanikradat sumaṅgalo bhadravādī vadeha ||
children.translated_text: Crying along the ancestral direction, speak here auspiciously, speaking good.

children.text: ava kranda dakṣiṇato gṛhāṇāṃ sumaṅgalo bhadravādī śakunte
children.translated_text: Cry out from the right side of the houses, auspicious, speaking good, O bird.

children.text: mā na stena īśata māghaśaṃso bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let no thief master us, nor any evil-speaker; may we speak loudly in the assembly, rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 234
pradakṣiṇid abhi gṛṇanti kāravo vayo vadanta ṛtuthā śakuntayaḥ
children.translated_text: The singers praise on the right; the birds speak at the proper season.

children.text: ubhe vācau vadati sāmagā iva gāyatraṃ ca traiṣṭubhaṃ cānu rājati ||
children.translated_text: It utters both voices like a <s>Sāman</s>-singer; it follows the <s>Gāyatra</s> and the <s>Triṣṭubh</s>.

children.text: udgāteva śakune sāma gāyasi brahmaputra iva savaneṣu śaṃsasi
children.translated_text: Like an <s>Udgātṛ</s>, O bird, you sing the <s>Sāman</s>; like a Brahman's son you recite at the pressings.

children.text: vṛṣeva vājī śiśumatīr apītyā sarvato naḥ śakune bhadram ā vada viśvato naḥ śakune puṇyam ā vada ||
children.translated_text: Like a vigorous stallion going to mares with young, speak good to us from every side, O bird; speak blessing to us from every side, O bird.

children.text: āvadaṃs tvaṃ śakune bhadram ā vada tūṣṇīm āsīnaḥ sumatiṃ cikiddhi naḥ
children.translated_text: Speaking, O bird, speak what is good; sitting silent, discern good will for us.

children.text: yad utpatan vadasi karkarir yathā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When, flying up, you speak like a <s>karkari</s> (lute), may we speak loudly in the assembly, rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 235
somasya mā tavasaṃ vakṣy agne vahniṃ cakartha vidathe yajadhyai
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, carry me to the mighty one of <s>Soma</s>; you have made yourself the bearer for worship in the assembly.

children.text: devāṁ acchā dīdyad yuñje adriṃ śamāye agne tanvaṃ juṣasva ||
children.translated_text: Shining toward the gods, I yoke the pressing-stone for appeasement; O <s>Agni</s>, enjoy your own body.

children.text: prāñcaṃ yajñaṃ cakṛma vardhatāṃ gīḥ samidbhir agniṃ namasā duvasyan
children.translated_text: We have made the sacrifice face forward; let the song grow, as one serves <s>Agni</s> with fuel and homage.

children.text: divaḥ śaśāsur vidathā kavīnāṃ gṛtsāya cit tavase gātum īṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The rites of the poets have ruled from heaven; they have sought a path even for powerful <s>Gṛtsamada</s>.

children.text: mayo dadhe medhiraḥ pūtadakṣo divaḥ subandhur januṣā pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: The wise one, of purified skill, set delight in place, a good kinsman of heaven and by birth of earth.

children.text: avindann u darśatam apsv antar devāso agnim apasi svasṝṇām ||
children.translated_text: The gods found visible <s>Agni</s> within the waters, in the work of the sister-streams.

children.text: avardhayan subhagaṃ sapta yahvīḥ śvetaṃ jajñānam aruṣam mahitvā
children.translated_text: The seven mighty ones increased the fortunate one, white at birth and ruddy in greatness.

children.text: śiśuṃ na jātam abhy ārur aśvā devāso agniṃ janiman vapuṣyan ||
children.translated_text: Like a newborn child, the gods approached <s>Agni</s> at birth, making him beautiful.

children.text: śukrebhir aṅgai raja ātatanvān kratum punānaḥ kavibhiḥ pavitraiḥ
children.translated_text: Stretching out the midspace with bright limbs, purifying his insight with the poets' strainers,

children.text: śocir vasānaḥ pary āyur apāṃ śriyo mimīte bṛhatīr anūnāḥ ||
children.translated_text: wearing flame, he measures out around the life of the waters great and undiminished beauties.

children.text: vavrājā sīm anadatīr adabdhā divo yahvīr avasānā anagnāḥ
children.translated_text: The great ones of heaven, unfailing, unharmed, sounding, have enclosed him, covering him, not naked.

children.text: sanā atra yuvatayaḥ sayonīr ekaṃ garbhaṃ dadhire sapta vāṇīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Here from of old the young women of one womb, the seven voices, held one embryo.

children.text: stīrṇā asya saṃhato viśvarūpā ghṛtasya yonau sravathe madhūnām
children.translated_text: His strewn and compacted forms, all-shaped, are in the womb of ghee, in the flowing of sweets.

children.text: asthur atra dhenavaḥ pinvamānā mahī dasmasya mātarā samīcī ||
children.translated_text: Here the swelling cows stood; the two great mothers of the wondrous one came together.

children.text: babhrāṇaḥ sūno sahaso vy adyaud dadhānaḥ śukrā rabhasā vapūṃṣi
children.translated_text: The son of strength has shone out today, bearing bright, forceful forms.

children.text: ścotanti dhārā madhuno ghṛtasya vṛṣā yatra vāvṛdhe kāvyena ||
children.translated_text: Streams of honey and ghee drip where the bull has grown through inspired poetry.

children.text: pituś cid ūdhar januṣā viveda vy asya dhārā asṛjad vi dhenāḥ
children.translated_text: By birth he recognized even the father's udder; he released its streams and released the milch cows.

children.text: guhā carantaṃ sakhibhiḥ śivebhir divo yahvībhir na guhā babhūva ||
children.translated_text: Moving in secret with gracious friends, he did not remain hidden from the great ones of heaven.

children.text: pituś ca garbhaṃ janituś ca babhre pūrvīr eko adhayat pīpyānāḥ
children.translated_text: He has borne the embryo of the father and of the begetter; alone he has sucked many swelling ones.

children.text: vṛṣṇe sapatnī śucaye sabandhū ubhe asmai manuṣye ni pāhi ||
children.translated_text: For this bull, bright and with his kin, the two companion powers guard him among human beings.

children.text: urau mahāṁ anibādhe vavardhāpo agniṃ yaśasaḥ saṃ hi pūrvīḥ
children.translated_text: In a broad, great, unobstructed space the many waters together increased glorious <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: ṛtasya yonāv aśayad damūnā jāmīnām agnir apasi svasṝṇām ||
children.translated_text: The house-lord <s>Agni</s> lay in the womb of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), in the work of his sister-streams.

children.text: akro na babhriḥ samithe mahīnāṃ didṛkṣeyaḥ sūnave bhāṛjīkaḥ
children.translated_text: Like a tawny one in the contest of the great, the bright-faced son is desirable to see.

children.text: ud usriyā janitā yo jajānāpāṃ garbho nṛtamo yahvo agniḥ ||
children.translated_text: The father who generated him brought forth the shining cows; <s>Agni</s>, embryo of the waters, is most manly and mighty.

children.text: apāṃ garbhaṃ darśatam oṣadhīnāṃ vanā jajāna subhagā virūpam
children.translated_text: The fortunate forests generated the visible embryo of the waters and of the plants, varied in form.

children.text: devāsaś cin manasā saṃ hi jagmuḥ paniṣṭhaṃ jātaṃ tavasaṃ duvasyan ||
children.translated_text: Even the gods have come together in mind, serving the most praiseworthy, mighty one who has been born.

children.text: bṛhanta id bhānavo bhāṛjīkam agniṃ sacanta vidyuto na śukrāḥ
children.translated_text: The great radiances, like bright lightnings, accompany <s>Agni</s>, whose brightness is blazing.

children.text: guheva vṛddhaṃ sadasi sve antar apāra ūrve amṛtaṃ duhānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like one grown strong in a hidden place, within his own seat, the immortal one milks in the boundless wide space.

children.text: īḍe ca tvā yajamāno havirbhir īḍe sakhitvaṃ sumatiṃ nikāmaḥ
children.translated_text: I, the sacrificer, praise you with oblations; desiring it, I praise your friendship and good favor.

children.text: devair avo mimīhi saṃ jaritre rakṣā ca no damyebhir anīkaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Together with the gods measure out protection for the singer, and guard us with your household faces of flame.

children.text: upakṣetāras tava supraṇīte 'gne viśvāni dhanyā dadhānāḥ
children.translated_text: Those who dwell near you, O <s>Agni</s>, under your excellent guidance, holding all riches,

children.text: suretasā śravasā tuñjamānā abhi ṣyāma pṛtanāyūṃr adevān ||
children.translated_text: abounding in good seed and impelled by fame, may we overcome the godless battle-seekers.

children.text: ā devānām abhavaḥ ketur agne mandro viśvāni kāvyāni vidvān
children.translated_text: You became the beacon of the gods, O <s>Agni</s>, delightful and knowing all sacred works.

children.text: prati martāṁ avāsayo damūnā anu devān rathiro yāsi sādhan ||
children.translated_text: You made mortals dwell in response; house-lord, as charioteer you go after the gods, accomplishing the rite.

children.text: ni duroṇe amṛto martyānāṃ rājā sasāda vidathāni sādhan
children.translated_text: The immortal king has sat down in the dwelling of mortals, accomplishing the sacred assemblies.

children.text: ghṛtapratīka urviyā vy adyaud agnir viśvāni kāvyāni vidvān ||
children.translated_text: With ghee-bright face, <s>Agni</s> has shone far and wide, knowing all sacred works.

children.text: ā no gahi sakhyebhiḥ śivebhir mahān mahībhir ūtibhiḥ saraṇyan
children.translated_text: Come to us with auspicious friendships, great and mighty helps, you who are ready to protect.

children.text: asme rayim bahulaṃ saṃtarutraṃ suvācam bhāgaṃ yaśasaṃ kṛdhī naḥ ||
children.translated_text: For us make wealth abundant and overcoming, a well-spoken portion, and renown.

children.text: etā te agne janimā sanāni pra pūrvyāya nūtanāni vocam
children.translated_text: These ancient births of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, and the new ones, I have proclaimed for the primeval one.

children.text: mahānti vṛṣṇe savanā kṛtemā janmañjanman nihito jātavedāḥ ||
children.translated_text: These great pressings have been made for the bull; birth after birth, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, you are set within.

children.text: janmañjanman nihito jātavedā viśvāmitrebhir idhyate ajasraḥ
children.translated_text: Birth after birth <s>Jātavedas</s> is set within; he is kindled unceasingly by the <s>Viśvāmitras</s>.

children.text: tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma ||
children.translated_text: May we be in the good favor of that worshipful one, in his gracious and kindly disposition.

children.text: imaṃ yajñaṃ sahasāvan tvaṃ no devatrā dhehi sukrato rarāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: O mighty one, O wise in will, gladly place this sacrifice of ours among the gods.

children.text: pra yaṃsi hotar bṛhatīr iṣo no 'gne mahi draviṇam ā yajasva ||
children.translated_text: Send forth great refreshments for us, O <s>Hotar</s>; O <s>Agni</s>, worship here for great treasure.

children.text: iḍām agne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, accomplish for the one who invokes you <s>Iḍā</s>, rich in wonders, the winning of cattle, most lasting.

children.text: syān naḥ sūnus tanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatir bhūtv asme ||
children.translated_text: May there be for us a son, an offspring rich in descendants; O <s>Agni</s>, may that good favor of yours be ours.

children.text: Chapter 236
vaiśvānarāya dhiṣaṇām ṛtāvṛdhe ghṛtaṃ na pūtam agnaye janāmasi
children.translated_text: For <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, for <s>Agni</s> who increases <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), we generate thought like purified ghee.

children.text: dvitā hotāram manuṣaś ca vāghato dhiyā rathaṃ na kuliśaḥ sam ṛṇvati ||
children.translated_text: The stone, like a chariot by thought, sets in motion the twofold <s>hotar</s>, for men and for the inspired singers.

children.text: sa rocayaj januṣā rodasī ubhe sa mātror abhavat putra īḍyaḥ
children.translated_text: By his birth he made both heaven and earth shine; he became the praiseworthy son of his two mothers.

children.text: havyavāḍ agnir ajaraś canohito dūḍabho viśām atithir vibhāvasuḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, bearer of oblations, undecaying, gladdening, hard to deceive, was the guest of the clans, rich in light.

children.text: kratvā dakṣasya taruṣo vidharmaṇi devāso agniṃ janayanta cittibhiḥ
children.translated_text: By wisdom, the gods generated <s>Agni</s> in the ordinance of skill and victorious power.

children.text: rurucānam bhānunā jyotiṣā mahām atyaṃ na vājaṃ saniṣyann upa bruve ||
children.translated_text: Shining with radiance and mighty light, like a courser about to win the prize, I call him near.

children.text: ā mandrasya saniṣyanto vareṇyaṃ vṛṇīmahe ahrayaṃ vājam ṛgmiyam
children.translated_text: Seeking to win the desirable gift of the delightful one, we choose the unfailing prize praised in verse.

children.text: rātim bhṛgūṇām uśijaṃ kavikratum agniṃ rājantaṃ divyena śociṣā ||
children.translated_text: We choose <s>Agni</s>, the gift of the <s>Bhṛgus</s>, the eager one of inspired will, shining with heavenly flame.

children.text: agniṃ sumnāya dadhire puro janā vājaśravasam iha vṛktabarhiṣaḥ
children.translated_text: The people, with sacred grass spread in front, have set <s>Agni</s> for good favor here, famed for strength.

children.text: yatasrucaḥ surucaṃ viśvadevyaṃ rudraṃ yajñānāṃ sādhadiṣṭim apasām ||
children.translated_text: With outstretched ladles, they set the bright one belonging to all the gods, the <s>Rudra</s> of sacrifices, most successful in works.

children.text: pāvakaśoce tava hi kṣayam pari hotar yajñeṣu vṛktabarhiṣo naraḥ
children.translated_text: O flame-pure <s>Hotar</s>, men with sacred grass spread serve at your dwelling in the sacrifices.

children.text: agne duva icchamānāsa āpyam upāsate draviṇaṃ dhehi tebhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, desiring friendly service, they attend upon you; place wealth for them.

children.text: ā rodasī apṛṇad ā svar mahaj jātaṃ yad enam apaso adhārayan
children.translated_text: He filled heaven and earth and the great sunlight when the waters sustained him at birth.

children.text: so adhvarāya pari ṇīyate kavir atyo na vājasātaye canohitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: That inspired one is led around for the rite, like a courser for the winning of strength, gladdening.

children.text: namasyata havyadātiṃ svadhvaraṃ duvasyata damyaṃ jātavedasam
children.translated_text: Reverence the giver of oblations, good for the rite; serve <s>Jātavedas</s>, the one who dwells in the house.

children.text: rathīr ṛtasya bṛhato vicarṣaṇir agnir devānām abhavat purohitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: As charioteer of the great <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), far-seeing among men, <s>Agni</s> became the priest placed before the gods.

children.text: tisro yahvasya samidhaḥ parijmano 'gner apunann uśijo amṛtyavaḥ
children.translated_text: The immortal inspired ones purified the three kindling-sticks of mighty <s>Agni</s>, who moves around.

children.text: tāsām ekām adadhur martye bhujam u lokam u dve upa jāmim īyatuḥ ||
children.translated_text: One of them they placed as enjoyment among mortals; the other two went to the world and to their kin.

children.text: viśāṃ kaviṃ viśpatim mānuṣīr iṣaḥ saṃ sīm akṛṇvan svadhitiṃ na tejase
children.translated_text: They made him the inspired one of the clans, lord of the clans, and the human refreshments; like an axe for sharpness.

children.text: sa udvato nivato yāti veviṣat sa garbham eṣu bhuvaneṣu dīdharat ||
children.translated_text: He goes eagerly over heights and lowlands; he has held the embryo in these worlds.

children.text: sa jinvate jaṭhareṣu prajajñivān vṛṣā citreṣu nānadan na siṃhaḥ
children.translated_text: Born forth in bellies, he enlivens them; the bull bellows among the bright ones like a lion.

children.text: vaiśvānaraḥ pṛthupājā amartyo vasu ratnā dayamāno vi dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, of broad power, immortal, apportions goods and treasures to the worshipper.

children.text: vaiśvānaraḥ pratnathā nākam āruhad divas pṛṣṭham bhandamānaḥ sumanmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, as in ancient time, mounted the firmament, the back of heaven, honored by good thoughts.

children.text: sa pūrvavaj janayañ jantave dhanaṃ samānam ajmam pary eti jāgṛviḥ ||
children.translated_text: As before, generating wealth for the living creature, the wakeful one goes around the same course.

children.text: ṛtāvānaṃ yajñiyaṃ vipram ukthyam ā yaṃ dadhe mātariśvā divi kṣayam
children.translated_text: We call upon him whom <s>Mātariśvan</s> placed in heaven as his dwelling, true to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), fit for sacrifice, inspired, worthy of hymns.

children.text: taṃ citrayāmaṃ harikeśam īmahe sudītim agniṃ suvitāya navyase ||
children.translated_text: We seek <s>Agni</s>, bright-paced, yellow-haired, brilliantly shining, for new good guidance.

children.text: śuciṃ na yāmann iṣiraṃ svardṛśaṃ ketuṃ divo rocanasthām uṣarbudham
children.translated_text: Pure as he goes, vigorous, seeing the sunlight, the beacon of heaven, stationed in the shining realm, awakening at dawn,

children.text: agnim mūrdhānaṃ divo apratiṣkutaṃ tam īmahe namasā vājinam bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: we seek with reverence <s>Agni</s>, the head of heaven, irresistible, the great prize-winning one.

children.text: mandraṃ hotāraṃ śucim advayāvinaṃ damūnasam ukthyaṃ viśvacarṣaṇim
children.translated_text: We constantly seek the delightful <s>Hotar</s>, pure, free from deceit, dwelling in the house, worthy of praise, belonging to all peoples,

children.text: rathaṃ na citraṃ vapuṣāya darśatam manurhitaṃ sadam id rāya īmahe ||
children.translated_text: like a splendid chariot, visible in beauty, set in place by <s>Manu</s>, for wealth.

children.text: Chapter 237
vaiśvānarāya pṛthupājase vipo ratnā vidhanta dharuṇeṣu gātave
children.translated_text: For <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, of broad power, O inspired ones, bestow treasures in the supports, for the path.

children.text: agnir hi devāṁ amṛto duvasyaty athā dharmāṇi sanatā na dūduṣat ||
children.translated_text: For immortal <s>Agni</s> serves the gods, and he has not damaged the ancient laws.

children.text: antar dūto rodasī dasma īyate hotā niṣatto manuṣaḥ purohitaḥ
children.translated_text: The wondrous messenger moves between heaven and earth, the <s>Hotar</s> seated down, the priest placed before men.

children.text: kṣayam bṛhantam pari bhūṣati dyubhir devebhir agnir iṣito dhiyāvasuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Sent by the gods, rich in insight, <s>Agni</s> adorns the great dwelling with shining lights.

children.text: ketuṃ yajñānāṃ vidathasya sādhanaṃ viprāso agnim mahayanta cittibhiḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired priests magnified <s>Agni</s> with their insights, the beacon of sacrifices and the means of success for the ritual assembly.

children.text: apāṃsi yasminn adhi saṃdadhur giras tasmin sumnāni yajamāna ā cake ||
children.translated_text: In him the songs set down their works; in him the sacrificer seeks gracious favors.

children.text: pitā yajñānām asuro vipaścitāṃ vimānam agnir vayunaṃ ca vāghatām
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is father of sacrifices, lordly among the discerning, the measure and the knowledge of the chanters.

children.text: ā viveśa rodasī bhūrivarpasā purupriyo bhandate dhāmabhiḥ kaviḥ ||
children.translated_text: The sage, broad in form, entered heaven and earth; beloved by many, he shines with his abodes.

children.text: candram agniṃ candrarathaṃ harivrataṃ vaiśvānaram apsuṣadaṃ svarvidam
children.translated_text: The gods placed here bright <s>Agni</s>, bright-charioted, tawny in ordinance, <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, dwelling in the waters and finding the light of heaven,

children.text: vigāhaṃ tūrṇiṃ taviṣībhir āvṛtam bhūrṇiṃ devāsa iha suśriyaṃ dadhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: penetrating, swift, wrapped in powers, active, and beautiful in splendor.

children.text: agnir devebhir manuṣaś ca jantubhis tanvāno yajñam purupeśasaṃ dhiyā
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, together with gods, humans, and living beings, stretches out the many-colored <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice) by thought.

children.text: rathīr antar īyate sādhadiṣṭibhir jīro damūnā abhiśasticātanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: As a charioteer he moves within by successful aids, lively in the house and driving away curses.

children.text: agne jarasva svapatya āyuny ūrjā pinvasva sam iṣo didīhi naḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, grow strong with good offspring and length of life; swell with nourishment and kindle our refreshment all together.

children.text: vayāṃsi jinva bṛhataś ca jāgṛva uśig devānām asi sukratur vipām ||
children.translated_text: Quicken our vital powers and those of the great one, watchful; eager among the gods, you are wise in purpose among the inspired.

children.text: viśpatiṃ yahvam atithiṃ naraḥ sadā yantāraṃ dhīnām uśijaṃ ca vāghatām
children.translated_text: Men continually praise the lord of the settlement, the mighty guest, the guide of thoughts, and the eager one of the chanters,

children.text: adhvarāṇāṃ cetanaṃ jātavedasam pra śaṃsanti namasā jūtibhir vṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: the conscious one of rites, <s>Jātavedas</s>, with homage and invocations, for increase.

children.text: vibhāvā devaḥ suraṇaḥ pari kṣitīr agnir babhūva śavasā sumadrathaḥ
children.translated_text: The far-shining, gracious god, <s>Agni</s>, has become present around the dwellings, strong and well-charioted.

children.text: tasya vratāni bhūripoṣiṇo vayam upa bhūṣema dama ā suvṛktibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we adorn in the house the vows of him who nourishes many, with well-spoken hymns.

children.text: vaiśvānara tava dhāmāny ā cake yebhiḥ svarvid abhavo vicakṣaṇa
children.translated_text: O <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, I behold your abodes, by which, finder of heaven's light, you became discerning.

children.text: jāta āpṛṇo bhuvanāni rodasī agne tā viśvā paribhūr asi tmanā ||
children.translated_text: At birth you filled the worlds, heaven and earth; O <s>Agni</s>, by yourself you encompass all these.

children.text: vaiśvānarasya daṃsanābhyo bṛhad ariṇād ekaḥ svapasyayā kaviḥ
children.translated_text: From the powers of <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, the sage alone opened the great expanse by his own effective work.

children.text: ubhā pitarā mahayann ajāyatāgnir dyāvāpṛthivī bhūriretasā ||
children.translated_text: Magnifying both parents, <s>Agni</s> was born, while heaven and earth were rich in seed.

children.text: Chapter 238
samit samit sumanā bodhy asme śucā śucā sumatiṃ rāsi vasvaḥ
children.translated_text: At each kindling, be well-disposed and awake for us; with each bright flame bestow favorable thought and wealth.

children.text: ā deva devān yajathāya vakṣi sakhā sakhīn sumanā yakṣy agne ||
children.translated_text: O god, bring the gods here for worship; as a well-disposed friend, worship your friends, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: yaṃ devāsas trir ahann āyajante dive dive varuṇo mitro agniḥ
children.translated_text: Him whom the gods worship three times a day, day after day, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: semaṃ yajñam madhumantaṃ kṛdhī nas tanūnapād ghṛtayoniṃ vidhantam ||
children.translated_text: that <s>Tanūnapāt</s>, make this honey-sweet <s>yajña</s> of ours, ghee-born and rightly serving.

children.text: pra dīdhitir viśvavārā jigāti hotāram iḍaḥ prathamaṃ yajadhyai
children.translated_text: The all-desired brightness advances, first, to worship the <s>hotṛ</s> (invoking priest) of <s>Iḍā</s>.

children.text: acchā namobhir vṛṣabhaṃ vandadhyai sa devān yakṣad iṣito yajīyān ||
children.translated_text: It goes with reverences to praise the bull; impelled, he will worship the gods as the one most worthy of sacrifice.

children.text: ūrdhvo vāṃ gātur adhvare akāry ūrdhvā śocīṃṣi prasthitā rajāṃsi
children.translated_text: Your path at the rite has been made upward; upward the flames and the outstretched regions have gone.

children.text: divo vā nābhā ny asādi hotā stṛṇīmahi devavyacā vi barhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Or the <s>hotṛ</s> has been seated at the navel of heaven; we spread wide the sacred grass for the gods.

children.text: sapta hotrāṇi manasā vṛṇānā invanto viśvam prati yann ṛtena
children.translated_text: Choosing the seven <s>hotṛ</s>-offices with their mind, seeking the whole world, proceeding according to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order),

children.text: nṛpeśaso vidatheṣu pra jātā abhīmaṃ yajñaṃ vi caranta pūrvīḥ ||
children.translated_text: the many powers, human-adorned and born forth in the ritual assemblies, move all around this sacrifice from of old.

children.text: ā bhandamāne uṣasā upāke uta smayete tanvā virūpe
children.translated_text: As the two dawns come near while being praised, they smile, alike though different in their bodies,

children.text: yathā no mitro varuṇo jujoṣad indro marutvāṁ uta vā mahobhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: so may <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> favor us, and <s>Indra</s> with the <s>Maruts</s>, or else with their greatnesses.

children.text: daivyā hotārā prathamā ny ṛñje sapta pṛkṣāsaḥ svadhayā madanti
children.translated_text: I anoint the two divine <s>hotṛs</s>, the first ones; the seven speckled ones rejoice by their own power.

children.text: ṛtaṃ śaṃsanta ṛtam it ta āhur anu vrataṃ vratapā dīdhyānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Proclaiming <s>ṛta</s>, they say only <s>ṛta</s>; shining, guardians of the vow, they follow the vow.

children.text: ā bhāratī bhāratībhiḥ sajoṣā iḍā devair manuṣyebhir agniḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Bhāratī</s>, in accord with the <s>Bhāratīs</s>, come here; may <s>Iḍā</s> come with gods and humans, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: sarasvatī sārasvatebhir arvāk tisro devīr barhir edaṃ sadantu ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Sarasvatī</s> come hither with the <s>Sārasvatas</s>; let the three goddesses sit upon this sacred grass.

children.text: tan nas turīpam adha poṣayitnu deva tvaṣṭar vi rarāṇaḥ syasva
children.translated_text: Then, O god <s>Tvaṣṭar</s>, be for us a swift and nourishing bestower, distributing your gift.

children.text: yato vīraḥ karmaṇyaḥ sudakṣo yuktagrāvā jāyate devakāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: From you a heroic son is born, active, skillful, with the pressing-stones yoked, desiring the gods.

children.text: vanaspate 'va sṛjopa devān agnir haviḥ śamitā sūdayāti
children.translated_text: O <s>Vanaspati</s>, release the offering down toward the gods; <s>Agni</s>, the preparer, cooks the oblation.

children.text: sed u hotā satyataro yajāti yathā devānāṃ janimāni veda ||
children.translated_text: He indeed, the truer <s>hotṛ</s>, performs the sacrifice, since he knows the births of the gods.

children.text: ā yāhy agne samidhāno arvāṅ indreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṃ turebhiḥ
children.translated_text: Come here, O <s>Agni</s>, kindled and turned hither, sharing one chariot with <s>Indra</s> and the swift gods.

children.text: barhir na āstām aditiḥ suputrā svāhā devā amṛtā mādayantām ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Aditi</s>, rich in good sons, sit on our sacred grass; with the <s>svāhā</s>-call let the immortal gods rejoice.

children.text: Chapter 239
praty agnir uṣasaś cekitāno 'bodhi vipraḥ padavīḥ kavīnām
children.translated_text: Facing the dawns, <s>Agni</s>, perceiving them, has awakened, the inspired one, to the paths of the poets.

children.text: pṛthupājā devayadbhiḥ samiddho 'pa dvārā tamaso vahnir āvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Kindled by those who seek the gods, broad in radiance, the carrier has opened the doors of darkness.

children.text: pred v agnir vāvṛdhe stomebhir gīrbhi stotṝṇāṃ namasya ukthaiḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has grown forth with chants, with songs, and with the reverent hymns of the praisers.

children.text: pūrvīr ṛtasya saṃdṛśaś cakānaḥ saṃ dūto adyaud uṣaso viroke ||
children.translated_text: Desiring the many visions of <s>ṛta</s>, the messenger has shone today in the gleam of dawn.

children.text: adhāyy agnir mānuṣīṣu vikṣv apāṃ garbho mitra ṛtena sādhan
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has been placed among human peoples, embryo of the waters; O <s>Mitra</s>, he accomplishes by <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: ā haryato yajataḥ sānv asthād abhūd u vipro havyo matīnām ||
children.translated_text: The lovely, worshipful one has stood upon the ridge; the inspired one has become fit to be invoked by thoughts.

children.text: mitro agnir bhavati yat samiddho mitro hotā varuṇo jātavedāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> becomes <s>Mitra</s> when he is kindled; <s>Mitra</s> is the <s>hotṛ</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: mitro adhvaryur iṣiro damūnā mitraḥ sindhūnām uta parvatānām ||
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s> is the eager <s>adhvaryu</s> (officiating priest), the house-lord; <s>Mitra</s> belongs also to the rivers and the mountains.

children.text: pāti priyaṃ ripo agram padaṃ veḥ pāti yahvaś caraṇaṃ sūryasya
children.translated_text: He protects the dear, foremost station of the bird; the mighty one protects the course of the sun.

children.text: pāti nābhā saptaśīrṣāṇam agniḥ pāti devānām upamādam ṛṣvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: At the navel <s>Agni</s> protects the seven-headed one; the lofty one protects the divine exhilaration of the gods.

children.text: ṛbhuś cakra īḍyaṃ cāru nāma viśvāni devo vayunāni vidvān
children.translated_text: The skillful god fashioned the lovely, praiseworthy name, knowing all the inspired skills.

children.text: sasasya carma ghṛtavat padaṃ ves tad id agnī rakṣaty aprayucchan ||
children.translated_text: That very place of the bird, the ghee-rich covering of the resting one, <s>Agni</s> guards without negligence.

children.text: ā yonim agnir ghṛtavantam asthāt pṛthupragāṇam uśantam uśānaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has taken his place in the ghee-rich womb, wide-going, desired, and desiring.

children.text: dīdyānaḥ śucir ṛṣvaḥ pāvakaḥ punaḥ punar mātarā navyasī kaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Shining, pure, lofty, and purifying, he has made his two mothers new again and again.

children.text: sadyo jāta oṣadhībhir vavakṣe yadī vardhanti prasvo ghṛtena
children.translated_text: Just born, he has grown with the plants, when the mothers increase him with ghee.

children.text: āpa iva pravatā śumbhamānā uruṣyad agniḥ pitror upasthe ||
children.translated_text: Like waters gleaming down a slope, <s>Agni</s> protects in the lap of his two parents.

children.text: ud u ṣṭutaḥ samidhā yahvo adyaud varṣman divo adhi nābhā pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: Raised up by the kindling-stick, the mighty one has shone today on the height of heaven, above the navel of earth.

children.text: mitro agnir īḍyo mātariśvā dūto vakṣad yajathāya devān ||
children.translated_text: As <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Agni</s> is worthy of praise; <s>Mātariśvan</s>, the messenger, will convey the gods for worship.

children.text: ud astambhīt samidhā nākam ṛṣvo 'gnir bhavann uttamo rocanānām
children.translated_text: By the kindling-stick the lofty <s>Agni</s> has propped up the firmament, becoming the highest of the lights,

children.text: yadī bhṛgubhyaḥ pari mātariśvā guhā santaṃ havyavāhaṃ samīdhe ||
children.translated_text: when <s>Mātariśvan</s> kindled for the <s>Bhṛgus</s> the oblation-bearer who was hidden in secret.

children.text: iḍām agne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, accomplish for the one who invokes you <s>Iḍā</s>, rich in marvels, the winning of cattle, most lasting.

children.text: syān naḥ sūnus tanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatir bhūtv asme ||
children.translated_text: May there be for us a son, an offspring, rich in descendants; O <s>Agni</s>, may that favorable thought of yours be ours.

children.text: Chapter 240
pra kāravo mananā vacyamānā devadrīcīṃ nayata devayantaḥ
children.translated_text: O singers, speaking with devotion, lead the god-seeking hymn toward the gods.

children.text: dakṣiṇāvāḍ vājinī prācy eti havir bharanty agnaye ghṛtācī ||
children.translated_text: The fee-bearing, prize-winning one goes eastward, carrying the ghee-rich oblation for <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: ā rodasī apṛṇā jāyamāna uta pra rikthā adha nu prayajyo
children.translated_text: Being born, you filled the two worlds; and now, worthy of worship, you have also stretched beyond the inheritances.

children.text: divaś cid agne mahinā pṛthivyā vacyantāṃ te vahnayaḥ saptajihvāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, by greatness surpassing even heaven and earth, let your seven-tongued flames be proclaimed.

children.text: dyauś ca tvā pṛthivī yajñiyāso ni hotāraṃ sādayante damāya
children.translated_text: Heaven and Earth, fit for sacrifice, set you down as <s>hotṛ</s> for the household,

children.text: yadī viśo mānuṣīr devayantīḥ prayasvatīr īḍate śukram arciḥ ||
children.translated_text: when the human clans, seeking the gods and rich in offerings, praise your bright flame.

children.text: mahān sadhasthe dhruva ā niṣatto 'ntar dyāvā māhine haryamāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Great, fixed, seated in the shared seat, between heaven and earth, he is desired for his greatness.

children.text: āskre sapatnī ajare amṛkte sabardughe urugāyasya dhenū ||
children.translated_text: In the vicinity are the two co-wives, unaging and unwounded, the broadly-sung one's cows, milked in common.

children.text: vratā te agne mahato mahāni tava kratvā rodasī ā tatantha
children.translated_text: Great are your ordinances, O <s>Agni</s>, belonging to the great one; by your insight you have stretched out heaven and earth.

children.text: tvaṃ dūto abhavo jāyamānas tvaṃ netā vṛṣabha carṣaṇīnām ||
children.translated_text: You became the messenger as soon as you were born; you, O bull, are the leader of peoples.

children.text: ṛtasya vā keśinā yogyābhir ghṛtasnuvā rohitā dhuri dhiṣva
children.translated_text: Harness the two red, ghee-dripping, maned horses of <s>ṛta</s> with the yoking-gear; place them at the pole.

children.text: athā vaha devān deva viśvān svadhvarā kṛṇuhi jātavedaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then bring all the gods, O god; make the rites well-performed, O <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: divaś cid ā te rucayanta rokā uṣo vibhātīr anu bhāsi pūrvīḥ
children.translated_text: Even the bright spaces of heaven shine toward you; you shine after the many radiant dawns as they appear,

children.text: apo yad agna uśadhag vaneṣu hotur mandrasya panayanta devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: when, O <s>Agni</s>, the gods admired the waters and the herbs in the woods for the joyful <s>hotṛ</s>.

children.text: urau vā ye antarikṣe madanti divo vā ye rocane santi devāḥ
children.translated_text: The gods who rejoice in the wide midspace, or who are in the shining realm of heaven,

children.text: ūmā vā ye suhavāso yajatrā āyemire rathyo agne aśvāḥ ||
children.translated_text: or who, easily invoked and worthy of sacrifice, have set in motion the chariot-horses, O <s>Agni</s>:

children.text: aibhir agne sarathaṃ yāhy arvāṅ nānārathaṃ vā vibhavo hy aśvāḥ
children.translated_text: with these horses, O <s>Agni</s>, come here on one chariot, or on many chariots, for your horses are widely radiant.

children.text: patnīvatas triṃśataṃ trīṃś ca devān anuṣvadham ā vaha mādayasva ||
children.translated_text: Bring here the thirty-three gods with their wives, each according to his own portion, and rejoice.

children.text: sa hotā yasya rodasī cid urvī yajñaṃ yajñam abhi vṛdhe gṛṇītaḥ
children.translated_text: He is the <s>hotṛ</s> whose two broad worlds praise each sacrifice for increase,

children.text: prācī adhvareva tasthatuḥ sumeke ṛtāvarī ṛtajātasya satye ||
children.translated_text: standing forth like two fair-formed attendants at the rite, true to <s>ṛta</s>, in the truth of him who is born from <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: iḍām agne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, accomplish for the one who invokes you <s>Iḍā</s>, rich in marvels, the winning of cattle, most lasting.

children.text: syān naḥ sūnus tanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatir bhūtv asme ||
children.translated_text: May there be for us a son, an offspring, rich in descendants; O <s>Agni</s>, may that favorable thought of yours be ours.

children.text: Chapter 241
pra ya āruḥ śitipṛṣṭhasya dhāser ā mātarā viviśuḥ sapta vāṇīḥ
children.translated_text: The seven voices, when they had mounted the support of the white-backed one's foundation, entered the two mothers.

children.text: parikṣitā pitarā saṃ carete pra sarsrāte dīrgham āyuḥ prayakṣe ||
children.translated_text: The two encompassing parents move together; they stream forward for long life and for worship.

children.text: divakṣaso dhenavo vṛṣṇo aśvā devīr ā tasthau madhumad vahantīḥ
children.translated_text: The heavenly cows, the stallion's mares, the goddesses bearing sweetness, have taken their place,

children.text: ṛtasya tvā sadasi kṣemayantam pary ekā carati vartaniṃ gauḥ ||
children.translated_text: while one cow moves around you on her path as you dwell securely in the seat of <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: ā sīm arohat suyamā bhavantīḥ patiś cikitvān rayivid rayīṇām
children.translated_text: The well-guided ones have mounted up; the knowing lord, rich in goods, is lord of riches.

children.text: pra nīlapṛṣṭho atasasya dhāses tā avāsayat purudhapratīkaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The blue-backed one, with many forms, led them out from the support of the inexhaustible foundation and made them dwell there.

children.text: mahi tvāṣṭram ūrjayantīr ajuryaṃ stabhūyamānaṃ vahato vahanti
children.translated_text: The nourishing, unaging ones carry the great work of <s>Tvaṣṭar</s>, which is being made firm,

children.text: vy aṅgebhir didyutānaḥ sadhastha ekām iva rodasī ā viveśa ||
children.translated_text: and, flashing with his limbs in the shared seat, he entered heaven and earth as if they were one.

children.text: jānanti vṛṣṇo aruṣasya śevam uta bradhnasya śāsane raṇanti
children.translated_text: They know the favor of the ruddy bull; and they exult under the command of the tawny one.

children.text: divorucaḥ suruco rocamānā iḍā yeṣāṃ gaṇyā māhinā gīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those heaven-bright, beautifully shining ones blaze forth; for them the reckonable song is <s>Iḍā</s> through greatness.

children.text: uto pitṛbhyām pravidānu ghoṣam maho mahadbhyām anayanta śūṣam
children.translated_text: And to the two fathers, knowing well, they brought a cry, a mighty force to the two great, mighty ones,

children.text: ukṣā ha yatra pari dhānam aktor anu svaṃ dhāma jaritur vavakṣa ||
children.translated_text: where the bull, around the covering of night, caused the singer to speak according to his own station.

children.text: adhvaryubhiḥ pañcabhiḥ sapta viprāḥ priyaṃ rakṣante nihitam padaṃ veḥ
children.translated_text: With five <s>adhvaryus</s>, the seven inspired priests guard the dear hidden track of the bird.

children.text: prāñco madanty ukṣaṇo ajuryā devā devānām anu hi vratā guḥ ||
children.translated_text: Facing forward, the unaging bulls rejoice, for the gods have gone after the ordinances of the gods.

children.text: daivyā hotārā prathamā ny ṛñje sapta pṛkṣāsaḥ svadhayā madanti
children.translated_text: I adorn the first two divine <s>hotṛs</s>; the seven nourishments rejoice by their own power.

children.text: ṛtaṃ śaṃsanta ṛtam it ta āhur anu vrataṃ vratapā dīdhyānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Proclaiming <s>ṛta</s>, they say that very thing is <s>ṛta</s>; shining, the guardians of the vow follow the vow.

children.text: vṛṣāyante mahe atyāya pūrvīr vṛṣṇe citrāya raśmayaḥ suyāmāḥ
children.translated_text: The many well-guided rays show bull-like power for the great runner, for the bright bull.

children.text: deva hotar mandrataraś cikitvān maho devān rodasī eha vakṣi ||
children.translated_text: O divine <s>Hotṛ</s>, more joyful and knowing, bring the great gods, Heaven and Earth, here.

children.text: pṛkṣaprayajo draviṇaḥ suvācaḥ suketava uṣaso revad ūṣuḥ
children.translated_text: The dawns, rich in goods, bright-bannered, with good speech and preparing offerings, have shone richly.

children.text: uto cid agne mahinā pṛthivyāḥ kṛtaṃ cid enaḥ sam mahe daśasya ||
children.translated_text: And, O <s>Agni</s>, by the greatness of earth, show great favor even to one who has committed sin.

children.text: iḍām agne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, accomplish for the one who invokes you <s>Iḍā</s>, rich in marvels, the winning of cattle, most lasting.

children.text: syān naḥ sūnus tanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatir bhūtv asme ||
children.translated_text: May there be for us a son, an offspring, rich in descendants; O <s>Agni</s>, may that favorable thought of yours be ours.

children.text: Chapter 242
añjanti tvām adhvare devayanto vanaspate madhunā daivyena
children.translated_text: Those seeking the gods anoint you in the rite, O <s>Vanaspati</s>, with divine honey,

children.text: yad ūrdhvas tiṣṭhā draviṇeha dhattād yad vā kṣayo mātur asyā upasthe ||
children.translated_text: whether you stand upright here bestowing wealth, or whether your dwelling is in the lap of this mother.

children.text: samiddhasya śrayamāṇaḥ purastād brahma vanvāno ajaraṃ suvīram
children.translated_text: Resting in front of the kindled one, winning sacred utterance, undecaying and rich in heroes,

children.text: āre asmad amatim bādhamāna uc chrayasva mahate saubhagāya ||
children.translated_text: driving want far away from us, rise up for great good fortune.

children.text: uc chrayasva vanaspate varṣman pṛthivyā adhi
children.translated_text: Rise up, O <s>Vanaspati</s>, upon the height above the earth,

children.text: sumitī mīyamāno varco dhā yajñavāhase ||
children.translated_text: being measured out with good measure; bestow brilliance on the bearer of the sacrifice.

children.text: yuvā suvāsāḥ parivīta āgāt sa u śreyān bhavati jāyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: The youth, well-clothed and wrapped around, has come; as he is born, he becomes more excellent.

children.text: taṃ dhīrāsaḥ kavaya un nayanti svādhyo manasā devayantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The wise, inspired poets raise him up, intent on the gods with well-disposed mind.

children.text: jāto jāyate sudinatve ahnāṃ samarya ā vidathe vardhamānaḥ
children.translated_text: Born, he is born in the good day of days, growing in the contest, in the ritual assembly.

children.text: punanti dhīrā apaso manīṣā devayā vipra ud iyarti vācam ||
children.translated_text: The wise purify him, active through inspired thought; the inspired priest, godward, raises his voice.

children.text: yān vo naro devayanto nimimyur vanaspate svadhitir vā tatakṣa
children.translated_text: Those which god-seeking men have measured out for you, O forest-tree, or which the axe has fashioned,

children.text: te devāsaḥ svaravas tasthivāṃsaḥ prajāvad asme didhiṣantu ratnam ||
children.translated_text: may those divine sacrificial posts, standing upright, wish to bestow on us treasure rich in offspring.

children.text: ye vṛkṇāso adhi kṣami nimitāso yatasrucaḥ
children.translated_text: Those cut down upon the ground, set up, with ladles directed forward,

children.text: te no vyantu vāryaṃ devatrā kṣetrasādhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may they, accomplishing the field for the gods, distribute desirable wealth to us.

children.text: ādityā rudrā vasavaḥ sunīthā dyāvākṣāmā pṛthivī antarikṣam
children.translated_text: May the <s>Ādityas</s>, <s>Rudras</s>, and <s>Vasus</s>, good guides, and <s>Heaven</s>, <s>Earth</s>, the broad earth, and the midspace,

children.text: sajoṣaso yajñam avantu devā ūrdhvaṃ kṛṇvantv adhvarasya ketum ||
children.translated_text: may the gods, of one accord, help the sacrifice and raise high the banner of the rite.

children.text: haṃsā iva śreṇiśo yatānāḥ śukrā vasānāḥ svaravo na āguḥ
