children.translated_text: Like geese going in rows, the bright sacrificial posts, clothed in shining dress, have come to us.

children.text: unnīyamānāḥ kavibhiḥ purastād devā devānām api yanti pāthaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Being lifted up by the poets in front, the gods go upon the paths of the gods.

children.text: śṛṅgāṇīvecchṛṅgiṇāṃ saṃ dadṛśre caṣālavantaḥ svaravaḥ pṛthivyām
children.translated_text: Like the horns of horned beasts, the collared sacrificial posts are seen together upon the earth.

children.text: vāghadbhir vā vihave śroṣamāṇā asmāṁ avantu pṛtanājyeṣu ||
children.translated_text: Listening to the singers at the invocation, may they help us in battles for the prize.

children.text: vanaspate śatavalśo vi roha sahasravalśā vi vayaṃ ruhema
children.translated_text: O forest-tree, grow forth with a hundred branches; may we grow forth with a thousand branches.

children.text: yaṃ tvām ayaṃ svadhitis tejamānaḥ praṇināya mahate saubhagāya ||
children.translated_text: You whom this sharpened axe has led forward for great good fortune.

children.text: Chapter 243
sakhāyas tvā vavṛmahe devam martāsa ūtaye
children.translated_text: O god, we mortals have chosen you as a friend for aid,

children.text: apāṃ napātaṃ subhagaṃ sudīditiṃ supratūrtim anehasam ||
children.translated_text: the fortunate <s>Apām Napāt</s>, bright-shining, swift to help, unharmed.

children.text: kāyamāno vanā tvaṃ yan mātṝr ajagann apaḥ
children.translated_text: Seeking, when you went through the forests and reached the waters, your mothers,

children.text: na tat te agne pramṛṣe nivartanaṃ yad dūre sann ihābhavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that return of yours is not to be forgotten, O <s>Agni</s>, since, though you were far away, you came here.

children.text: ati tṛṣṭaṃ vavakṣithāthaiva sumanā asi
children.translated_text: You have carried yourself beyond thirst; then indeed you are kindly disposed.

children.text: pra prānye yanti pary anya āsate yeṣāṃ sakhye asi śritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Some go forward, others sit around, those in whose friendship you are established.

children.text: īyivāṃsam ati sridhaḥ śaśvatīr ati saścataḥ
children.translated_text: Having gone beyond the enemies, beyond the ever-pursuing foes,

children.text: anv īm avindan nicirāso adruho 'psu siṃham iva śritam ||
children.translated_text: the watchful, guileless ones found him, like a lion lodged in the waters.

children.text: sasṛvāṃsam iva tmanāgnim itthā tirohitam
children.translated_text: They found <s>Agni</s>, hidden in this way, as if he had slipped away by himself.

children.text: ainaṃ nayan mātariśvā parāvato devebhyo mathitam pari ||
children.translated_text: <s>Mātariśvan</s> brought him here from afar, churned forth for the gods.

children.text: taṃ tvā martā agṛbhṇata devebhyo havyavāhana
children.translated_text: You mortals took hold of him, O carrier of oblations for the gods,

children.text: viśvān yad yajñāṁ abhipāsi mānuṣa tava kratvā yaviṣṭhya ||
children.translated_text: when by your will, youngest one, you oversee all human sacrifices.

children.text: tad bhadraṃ tava daṃsanā pākāya cic chadayati
children.translated_text: That deed of yours is auspicious; it shelters even the simple one,

children.text: tvāṃ yad agne paśavaḥ samāsate samiddham apiśarvare ||
children.translated_text: when, O <s>Agni</s>, the cattle gather around you, kindled in the night.

children.text: ā juhotā svadhvaraṃ śīram pāvakaśociṣam
children.translated_text: Offer to the well-ordered, vigorous one of purifying flame;

children.text: āśuṃ dūtam ajiram pratnam īḍyaṃ śruṣṭī devaṃ saparyata ||
children.translated_text: serve at once the swift messenger, the agile, ancient, praiseworthy god.

children.text: trīṇi śatā trī sahasrāṇy agniṃ triṃśac ca devā nava cāsaparyan
children.translated_text: Three hundred, three thousand, thirty, and nine gods worshipped <s>Agni</s>;

children.text: aukṣan ghṛtair astṛṇan barhir asmā ād iddhotāraṃ ny asādayanta ||
children.translated_text: they sprinkled him with ghee, spread the <s>barhis</s> (sacrificial grass) for him, and then seated him as <s>Hotṛ</s>.

children.text: Chapter 244
tvām agne manīṣiṇaḥ samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnām
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, the thoughtful mortals kindle as sovereign of peoples,

children.text: devam martāsa indhate sam adhvare ||
children.translated_text: as a god, together at the rite.

children.text: tvāṃ yajñeṣv ṛtvijam agne hotāram īḍate
children.translated_text: In sacrifices they praise you, O <s>Agni</s>, as the <s>ṛtvij</s> (seasonal priest), the <s>Hotṛ</s>;

children.text: gopā ṛtasya dīdihi sve dame ||
children.translated_text: as guardian of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), shine in your own house.

children.text: sa ghā yas te dadāśati samidhā jātavedase
children.translated_text: He indeed who makes offering to you with fuel, to <s>Jātavedas</s>,

children.text: so agne dhatte suvīryaṃ sa puṣyati ||
children.translated_text: he, O <s>Agni</s>, gains good heroic strength and thrives.

children.text: sa ketur adhvarāṇām agnir devebhir ā gamat
children.translated_text: Let <s>Agni</s>, the banner of the rites, come with the gods,

children.text: añjānaḥ sapta hotṛbhir haviṣmate ||
children.translated_text: anointed, with the seven <s>Hotṛs</s>, to the one who has the oblation.

children.text: pra hotre pūrvyaṃ vaco 'gnaye bharatā bṛhat
children.translated_text: Bring the ancient, lofty word to <s>Agni</s> as <s>Hotṛ</s>,

children.text: vipāṃ jyotīṃṣi bibhrate na vedhase ||
children.translated_text: to the inspired maker, who bears the lights of inspired utterances.

children.text: agniṃ vardhantu no giro yato jāyata ukthyaḥ
children.translated_text: May our songs strengthen <s>Agni</s>, from whom the praiseworthy one was born,

children.text: mahe vājāya draviṇāya darśataḥ ||
children.translated_text: visible for great prize and wealth.

children.text: agne yajiṣṭho adhvare devān devayate yaja
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, best sacrificer at the rite, sacrifice to the gods for the god-loving worshipper;

children.text: hotā mandro vi rājasy ati sridhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: as joyous <s>Hotṛ</s> you shine forth beyond hostile powers.

children.text: sa naḥ pāvaka dīdihi dyumad asme suvīryam
children.translated_text: O purifier, shine for us; place splendid heroic strength among us.

children.text: bhavā stotṛbhyo antamaḥ svastaye ||
children.translated_text: Be nearest to the singers for well-being.

children.text: taṃ tvā viprā vipanyavo jāgṛvāṃsaḥ sam indhate
children.translated_text: The inspired, discerning, watchful ones kindle you together,

children.text: havyavāham amartyaṃ sahovṛdham ||
children.translated_text: the immortal carrier of oblations, increaser of strength.

children.text: Chapter 245
agnir hotā purohito 'dhvarasya vicarṣaṇiḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is <s>Hotṛ</s> and <s>Purohita</s>, the far-seeing priest of the rite;

children.text: sa veda yajñam ānuṣak ||
children.translated_text: he knows the sacrifice in due order.

children.text: sa havyavāﾱ amartya uśig dūtaś canohitaḥ
children.translated_text: He is the immortal oblation-bearer, the eager messenger set in front;

children.text: agnir dhiyā sam ṛṇvati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> brings things together by inspired thought.

children.text: agnir dhiyā sa cetati ketur yajñasya pūrvyaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> perceives by inspired thought, the ancient banner of the sacrifice;

children.text: arthaṃ hy asya taraṇi ||
children.translated_text: for he is the swift furtherer of its purpose.

children.text: agniṃ sūnuṃ sanaśrutaṃ sahaso jātavedasam
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, son of strength, ever-renowned <s>Jātavedas</s>,

children.text: vahniṃ devā akṛṇvata ||
children.translated_text: the gods made him the bearer.

children.text: adābhyaḥ puraetā viśām agnir mānuṣīṇām
children.translated_text: Unassailable, the forerunner of human peoples is <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: tūrṇī rathaḥ sadā navaḥ ||
children.translated_text: a swift chariot, ever new.

children.text: sāhvān viśvā abhiyujaḥ kratur devānām amṛktaḥ
children.translated_text: Overcoming all assailants, the uninjured power of the gods,

children.text: agnis tuviśravastamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is most rich in fame.

children.text: abhi prayāṃsi vāhasā dāśvāṁ aśnoti martyaḥ
children.translated_text: With his conveyance the giving mortal reaches the gifts,

children.text: kṣayam pāvakaśociṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the dwelling of the one with purifying flame.

children.text: pari viśvāni sudhitāgner aśyāma manmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: May we, inspired, obtain all the well-established goods of <s>Agni</s> with our thoughts,

children.text: viprāso jātavedasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: of <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: agne viśvāni vāryā vājeṣu saniṣāmahe
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, may we win all desirable things in the contests;

children.text: tve devāsa erire ||
children.translated_text: in you the gods have set them in motion.

children.text: Chapter 246
indrāgnī ā gataṃ sutaṃ gīrbhir nabho vareṇyam
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, come to the pressed <s>Soma</s>, the excellent heavenly one, with songs;

children.text: asya pātaṃ dhiyeṣitā ||
children.translated_text: drink of this, urged by inspired thought.

children.text: indrāgnī jarituḥ sacā yajño jigāti cetanaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, the living sacrifice goes with the singer;

children.text: ayā pātam imaṃ sutam ||
children.translated_text: drink this pressed <s>Soma</s> with this song.

children.text: indram agniṃ kavicchadā yajñasya jūtyā vṛṇe
children.translated_text: I choose <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, covering the poet, through the impulse of the sacrifice;

children.text: tā somasyeha tṛmpatām ||
children.translated_text: may those two be satisfied here with the <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: tośā vṛtrahaṇā huve sajitvānāparājitā
children.translated_text: I call the two gladdening slayers of <s>Vṛtra</s>, winning together, unconquered,

children.text: indrāgnī vājasātamā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, best at winning the prize.

children.text: pra vām arcanty ukthino nīthāvido jaritāraḥ
children.translated_text: The reciters of hymns, the singers who know the guidings, sing forth to you two;

children.text: indrāgnī iṣa ā vṛṇe ||
children.translated_text: I choose <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> for nourishment.

children.text: indrāgnī navatim puro dāsapatnīr adhūnutam
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, you shook down ninety forts belonging to <s>Dāsa</s> lords,

children.text: sākam ekena karmaṇā ||
children.translated_text: together by a single deed.

children.text: indrāgnī apasas pary upa pra yanti dhītayaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, inspired thoughts go forth around the rites,

children.text: ṛtasya pathyā anu ||
children.translated_text: along the pathways of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: indrāgnī taviṣāṇi vāṃ sadhasthāni prayāṃsi ca
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, your powers, your shared seats, and your onward offerings

children.text: yuvor aptūryaṃ hitam ||
children.translated_text: For you two the swift aid has been set in place.

children.text: indrāgnī rocanā divaḥ pari vājeṣu bhūṣathaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, in contests for prize you adorn the shining realms of heaven.

children.text: tad vāṃ ceti pra vīryam ||
children.translated_text: That proclaims your heroic power.

children.text: Chapter 247
pra vo devāyāgnaye barhiṣṭham arcāsmai
children.translated_text: Sing forth for your god <s>Agni</s>, most worthy of the <s>barhis</s> (sacrificial grass), sing to him.

children.text: gamad devebhir ā sa no yajiṣṭho barhir ā sadat ||
children.translated_text: May he come to us with the gods; may he, most fit for sacrifice, sit upon the <s>barhis</s>.

children.text: ṛtāvā yasya rodasī dakṣaṃ sacanta ūtayaḥ
children.translated_text: He is true to <s>ṛta</s>; heaven and earth attend his skill, and so do the aids.

children.text: haviṣmantas tam īḍate taṃ saniṣyanto 'vase ||
children.translated_text: Those rich in oblations praise him, seeking to win him for help.

children.text: sa yantā vipra eṣāṃ sa yajñānām athā hi ṣaḥ
children.translated_text: He is the guide of these inspired men, and of the sacrifices; for indeed he is so.

children.text: agniṃ taṃ vo duvasyata dātā yo vanitā magham ||
children.translated_text: Serve that <s>Agni</s> for yourselves, the giver who wins bounty.

children.text: sa naḥ śarmāṇi vītaye 'gnir yacchatu śantamā
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s> grant us shelters for enjoyment, most peaceful ones.

children.text: yato naḥ pruṣṇavad vasu divi kṣitibhyo apsv ā ||
children.translated_text: From which wealth, richly streaming, may come to us from heaven, from settlements, and from the waters.

children.text: dīdivāṃsam apūrvyaṃ vasvībhir asya dhītibhiḥ
children.translated_text: The singers kindle the radiant, unprecedented <s>Agni</s> with his rich insights,

children.text: ṛkvāṇo agnim indhate hotāraṃ viśpatiṃ viśām ||
children.translated_text: the <s>hotṛ</s> (officiating priest), the lord of the clans among clans.

children.text: uta no brahmann aviṣa uktheṣu devahūtamaḥ
children.translated_text: And protect us, O inspired priest, in the recitations, you whom the gods most call upon.

children.text: śaṃ naḥ śocā marudvṛdho 'gne sahasrasātamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Shine for our welfare, O <s>Agni</s>, strengthened by the <s>Maruts</s>, best winner of thousands.

children.text: nū no rāsva sahasravat tokavat puṣṭimad vasu
children.translated_text: Now grant us wealth with thousands, with offspring, and with nourishment,

children.text: dyumad agne suvīryaṃ varṣiṣṭham anupakṣitam ||
children.translated_text: bright, O <s>Agni</s>, rich in heroic strength, highest, and undiminished.

children.text: Chapter 248
ā hotā mandro vidathāny asthāt satyo yajvā kavitamaḥ sa vedhāḥ
children.translated_text: The joyful <s>hotṛ</s> has taken his place at the rites, true, a sacrificer, the most poetic, the ordainer.

children.text: vidyudrathaḥ sahasas putro agniḥ śociṣkeśaḥ pṛthivyām pājo aśret ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, with lightning as his chariot, son of strength, flame-haired, has set his power upon the earth.

children.text: ayāmi te namauktiṃ juṣasva ṛtāvas tubhyaṃ cetate sahasvaḥ
children.translated_text: I bring you a reverent utterance; accept it, O you true to <s>ṛta</s>; it is directed to you, mighty one.

children.text: vidvāṁ ā vakṣi viduṣo ni ṣatsi madhya ā barhir ūtaye yajatra ||
children.translated_text: Knowing one, bring the knowing gods here; sit down in the middle on the <s>barhis</s> for help, O worshipful one.

children.text: dravatāṃ ta uṣasā vājayantī agne vātasya pathyābhir accha
children.translated_text: Let the prize-winning dawns hasten toward you, O <s>Agni</s>, along the paths of the wind.

children.text: yat sīm añjanti pūrvyaṃ havirbhir ā vandhureva tasthatur duroṇe ||
children.translated_text: When they anoint the ancient one with oblations, they stand in the house as if at the chariot-seat.

children.text: mitraś ca tubhyaṃ varuṇaḥ sahasvo 'gne viśve marutaḥ sumnam arcan
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, O mighty <s>Agni</s>, and all the <s>Maruts</s> sing favor for you.

children.text: yacchociṣā sahasas putra tiṣṭhā abhi kṣitīḥ prathayan sūryo nṝn ||
children.translated_text: Son of strength, stand with your flame, spreading over the peoples as <s>Sūrya</s> over men.

children.text: vayaṃ te adya rarimā hi kāmam uttānahastā namasopasadya
children.translated_text: Today we have fulfilled your desire, approaching with uplifted hands and homage.

children.text: yajiṣṭhena manasā yakṣi devān asredhatā manmanā vipro agne ||
children.translated_text: With the mind most fit for sacrifice, sacrifice to the gods; with unfailing thought, be the inspired priest, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: tvaddhi putra sahaso vi pūrvīr devasya yanty ūtayo vi vājāḥ
children.translated_text: For from you, son of strength, many aids of the god go forth, and many prizes.

children.text: tvaṃ dehi sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ no 'drogheṇa vacasā satyam agne ||
children.translated_text: Give us thousandfold wealth, O <s>Agni</s>, with truthful, guileless speech.

children.text: tubhyaṃ dakṣa kavikrato yānīmā deva martāso adhvare akarma
children.translated_text: O skillful one of poetic will, whatever rites we mortals have performed for you in the sacrifice, O god,

children.text: tvaṃ viśvasya surathasya bodhi sarvaṃ tad agne amṛta svadeha ||
children.translated_text: know all that, O immortal <s>Agni</s>, as belonging to the well-charioted lord of all; make it your own.

children.text: Chapter 249
vi pājasā pṛthunā śośucāno bādhasva dviṣo rakṣaso amīvāḥ
children.translated_text: Blazing with broad power, drive away foes, demons, and diseases.

children.text: suśarmaṇo bṛhataḥ śarmaṇi syām agner ahaṃ suhavasya praṇītau ||
children.translated_text: May I be within the broad shelter of good protection, under the guidance of <s>Agni</s>, easy to invoke.

children.text: tvaṃ no asyā uṣaso vyuṣṭau tvaṃ sūra udite bodhi gopāḥ
children.translated_text: At the brightening of this dawn, and when the sun has risen, be our guardian.

children.text: janmeva nityaṃ tanayaṃ juṣasva stomam me agne tanvā sujāta ||
children.translated_text: As one accepts a son ever at his birth, accept my praise with your own body, O well-born <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ nṛcakṣā vṛṣabhānu pūrvīḥ kṛṣṇāsv agne aruṣo vi bhāhi
children.translated_text: You, watcher of men, bull-bright, ruddy <s>Agni</s>, shine forth through the many dark nights.

children.text: vaso neṣi ca parṣi cāty aṃhaḥ kṛdhī no rāya uśijo yaviṣṭha ||
children.translated_text: Good one, lead us and carry us across distress; make us eager for wealth, O youngest one.

children.text: aṣāḍho agne vṛṣabho didīhi puro viśvāḥ saubhagā saṃjigīvān
children.translated_text: Unconquered bull, O <s>Agni</s>, shine forth, seeking to win all good fortunes before us.

children.text: yajñasya netā prathamasya pāyor jātavedo bṛhataḥ supraṇīte ||
children.translated_text: Leader of the sacrifice, first guardian of the great rite, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, you of good guidance.

children.text: acchidrā śarma jaritaḥ purūṇi devāṁ acchā dīdyānaḥ sumedhāḥ
children.translated_text: O singer, shining with wise thought toward the gods, bear many unbroken shelters toward us.

children.text: ratho na sasnir abhi vakṣi vājam agne tvaṃ rodasī naḥ sumeke ||
children.translated_text: Like a successful chariot, carry the prize to us; O <s>Agni</s>, make heaven and earth gracious to us.

children.text: pra pīpaya vṛṣabha jinva vājān agne tvaṃ rodasī naḥ sudoghe
children.translated_text: Fill us, O bull; quicken the prizes. O <s>Agni</s>, make heaven and earth good-milking for us.

children.text: devebhir deva surucā rucāno mā no martasya durmatiḥ pari ṣṭhāt ||
children.translated_text: O god, shining beautifully with the gods, may the evil intention of a mortal not surround us.

children.text: iḍām agne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, accomplish for the one who invokes you <s>Iḍā</s>, rich in marvels, the winning of cattle, most lasting.

children.text: syān naḥ sūnus tanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatir bhūtv asme ||
children.translated_text: May there be for us a son, an offspring rich in descendants; O <s>Agni</s>, may that favorable thought of yours be ours.

children.text: Chapter 250
ayam agniḥ suvīryasyeśe mahaḥ saubhagasya
children.translated_text: This <s>Agni</s> has command of good heroic strength and of great good fortune.

children.text: rāya īśe svapatyasya gomata īśe vṛtrahathānām ||
children.translated_text: He has command of wealth, of good offspring, of cattle, and of victories over <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: imaṃ naro marutaḥ saścatā vṛdhaṃ yasmin rāyaḥ śevṛdhāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Men and <s>Maruts</s>, attend this growing one, in whom are riches that increase prosperity.

children.text: abhi ye santi pṛtanāsu dūḍhyo viśvāhā śatrum ādabhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those who are hard to withstand in battles overcome the enemy every day.

children.text: sa tvaṃ no rāyaḥ śiśīhi mīḍhvo agne suvīryasya
children.translated_text: So sharpen wealth for us, O bountiful <s>Agni</s>, and good heroic strength.

children.text: tuvidyumna varṣiṣṭhasya prajāvato 'namīvasya śuṣmiṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O much-radiant one, sharpen the highest wealth for us, rich in offspring, free from disease, and strong.

children.text: cakrir yo viśvā bhuvanābhi sāsahiś cakrir deveṣv ā duvaḥ
children.translated_text: He as maker has overcome all beings; as maker he has established service among the gods.

children.text: ā deveṣu yatata ā suvīrya ā śaṃsa uta nṛṇām ||
children.translated_text: Strive among the gods for good heroic strength, and for the praise of men.

children.text: mā no agne 'mataye māvīratāyai rīradhaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, do not hand us over to thoughtlessness, nor to lack of heroes.

children.text: māgotāyai sahasas putra mā nide 'pa dveṣāṃsy ā kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: Not to lack of cattle, son of strength, not to blame; drive hatreds away.

children.text: śagdhi vājasya subhaga prajāvato 'gne bṛhato adhvare
children.translated_text: Be able, O fortunate <s>Agni</s>, to win the prize rich in offspring in the great sacrifice.

children.text: saṃ rāyā bhūyasā sṛja mayobhunā tuvidyumna yaśasvatā ||
children.translated_text: Join us with greater wealth, joy-bringing, much-radiant, and glorious.

children.text: Chapter 251
samidhyamānaḥ prathamānu dharmā sam aktubhir ajyate viśvavāraḥ
children.translated_text: Being kindled according to the first ordinances, the one desirable to all is anointed with the nights.

children.text: śociṣkeśo ghṛtanirṇik pāvakaḥ suyajño agnir yajathāya devān ||
children.translated_text: Flame-haired, clothed in ghee, purifying, well-sacrificing <s>Agni</s> is anointed to worship the gods.

children.text: yathāyajo hotram agne pṛthivyā yathā divo jātavedaś cikitvān
children.translated_text: As you, O <s>Agni</s>, knowing <s>Jātavedas</s>, offered the priestly rite of earth, as you offered that of heaven,

children.text: evānena haviṣā yakṣi devān manuṣvad yajñam pra tiremam adya ||
children.translated_text: so with this oblation sacrifice to the gods today; extend this sacrifice in the manner of <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: trīṇy āyūṃṣi tava jātavedas tisra ājānīr uṣasas te agne
children.translated_text: Three lifetimes are yours, O <s>Jātavedas</s>; three births are yours; the dawns are yours, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: tābhir devānām avo yakṣi vidvān athā bhava yajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ ||
children.translated_text: With these, knowing one, worship the gods for aid; then become welfare and happiness for the sacrificer.

children.text: agniṃ sudītiṃ sudṛśaṃ gṛṇanto namasyāmas tveḍyaṃ jātavedaḥ
children.translated_text: Praising <s>Agni</s>, of good light and good appearance, we bow to you, praiseworthy <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: tvāṃ dūtam aratiṃ havyavāhaṃ devā akṛṇvann amṛtasya nābhim ||
children.translated_text: The gods made you the messenger, the active servant, the oblation-bearer, the navel of immortality.

children.text: yas tvaddhotā pūrvo agne yajīyān dvitā ca sattā svadhayā ca śambhuḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>hotṛ</s> who was before you, O <s>Agni</s>, more worthy of sacrifice, established in two ways and auspicious by his own power,

children.text: tasyānu dharma pra yajā cikitvo 'tha no dhā adhvaraṃ devavītau ||
children.translated_text: according to his ordinance, O knowing one, perform the sacrifice; then place our <s>adhvara</s> (rite) among the gods' approach.

children.text: Chapter 252
bhavā no agne sumanā upetau sakheva sakhye pitareva sādhuḥ
children.translated_text: Be gracious to us, O <s>Agni</s>, when you come near, like a friend in friendship, like a father, kindly.

children.text: purudruho hi kṣitayo janānām prati pratīcīr dahatād arātīḥ ||
children.translated_text: For the settlements of men are full of many treacheries; burn away the hostile powers facing us from every side.

children.text: tapo ṣv agne antarāṁ amitrān tapā śaṃsam araruṣaḥ parasya
children.translated_text: Burn, O <s>Agni</s>, the enemies within; burn the malicious speech of the other, the hostile man.

children.text: tapo vaso cikitāno acittān vi te tiṣṭhantām ajarā ayāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Burn, O good one, knowing well, the unknowing; let your unaging weapons stand apart.

children.text: idhmenāgna icchamāno ghṛtena juhomi havyaṃ tarase balāya
children.translated_text: Seeking you, O <s>Agni</s>, with fuel and with ghee, I pour the oblation for your force and strength,

children.text: yāvad īśe brahmaṇā vandamāna imāṃ dhiyaṃ śataseyāya devīm ||
children.translated_text: as far as I have power, revering you with sacred utterance, this divine thought for the winning of a hundred.

children.text: ucchociṣā sahasas putra stuto bṛhad vayaḥ śaśamāneṣu dhehi
children.translated_text: Praised with your high flame, O son of strength, set wide vitality among those who praise you.

children.text: revad agne viśvāmitreṣu śaṃ yor marmṛjmā te tanvam bhūri kṛtvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Richly, O <s>Agni</s>, among the <s>Viśvāmitras</s>, we have repeatedly made your body bright for blessing and welfare.

children.text: kṛdhi ratnaṃ susanitar dhanānāṃ sa ghed agne bhavasi yat samiddhaḥ
children.translated_text: Make treasure easy to win, and riches easy to obtain; for this indeed, O <s>Agni</s>, is what you become when kindled.

children.text: stotur duroṇe subhagasya revat sṛprā karasnā dadhiṣe vapūṃṣi ||
children.translated_text: In the house of the fortunate, wealthy singer you take on shining forms, with streaming splendor.

children.text: Chapter 253
agniṃ hotāram pra vṛṇe miyedhe gṛtsaṃ kaviṃ viśvavidam amūram
children.translated_text: At the sacrifice I choose <s>Agni</s> as <s>hotṛ</s>, the skillful seer, the all-knowing, unbewildered sage.

children.text: sa no yakṣad devatātā yajīyān rāye vājāya vanate maghāni ||
children.translated_text: May he, most worthy to sacrifice in the divine service, worship for us and win gifts for wealth and prize.

children.text: pra te agne haviṣmatīm iyarmy acchā sudyumnāṃ rātinīṃ ghṛtācīm
children.translated_text: I send forth toward you, O <s>Agni</s>, the oblation-bearing, splendidly bright, gift-bestowing stream rich in ghee.

children.text: pradakṣiṇid devatātim urāṇaḥ saṃ rātibhir vasubhir yajñam aśret ||
children.translated_text: Moving to the right, desiring the divine service, he has joined the sacrifice with gifts and goods.

children.text: sa tejīyasā manasā tvota uta śikṣa svapatyasya śikṣoḥ
children.translated_text: With a most vigorous mind, aided by you, instruct us; instruct us in the attainment of good offspring.

children.text: agne rāyo nṛtamasya prabhūtau bhūyāma te suṣṭutayaś ca vasvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, in the abundance of wealth from the most manly one, may we be yours, with good praises and with goods.

children.text: bhūrīṇi hi tve dadhire anīkāgne devasya yajyavo janāsaḥ
children.translated_text: For many faces have the worshipping people set upon you, O <s>Agni</s> of the god.

children.text: sa ā vaha devatātiṃ yaviṣṭha śardho yad adya divyaṃ yajāsi ||
children.translated_text: So bring here the divine host, O youngest one, when today you sacrifice the heavenly troop.

children.text: yat tvā hotāram anajan miyedhe niṣādayanto yajathāya devāḥ
children.translated_text: When the gods anointed you as <s>hotṛ</s> at the sacrifice, seating you for worship,

children.text: sa tvaṃ no agne 'viteha bodhy adhi śravāṃsi dhehi nas tanūṣu ||
children.translated_text: then, O <s>Agni</s>, be our helper here; set honors upon our bodies.

children.text: Chapter 254
agnim uṣasam aśvinā dadhikrāṃ vyuṣṭiṣu havate vahnir ukthaiḥ
children.translated_text: At the breakings of dawn the bearer, with hymns, calls <s>Agni</s>, <s>Uṣas</s>, the <s>Aśvins</s>, and <s>Dadhikrā</s>.

children.text: sujyotiṣo naḥ śṛṇvantu devāḥ sajoṣaso adhvaraṃ vāvaśānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the gods of fair light hear us, rejoicing together and longing for the <s>adhvara</s> (rite).

children.text: agne trī te vājinā trī ṣadhasthā tisras te jihvā ṛtajāta pūrvīḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, three are your coursers, three your seats; three are your ancient tongues, born of <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: tisra u te tanvo devavātās tābhir naḥ pāhi giro aprayucchan ||
children.translated_text: And three are your bodies, impelled by the gods; with them protect our songs without negligence.

children.text: agne bhūrīṇi tava jātavedo deva svadhāvo 'mṛtasya nāma
children.translated_text: Many, O <s>Agni Jātavedas</s>, god of your own power, are your names of the immortal one,

children.text: yāś ca māyā māyināṃ viśvaminva tve pūrvīḥ saṃdadhuḥ pṛṣṭabandho ||
children.translated_text: and the wondrous powers of the wonder-workers, all-pervading and many, have been placed in you, O linked-backed one.

children.text: agnir netā bhaga iva kṣitīnāṃ daivīnāṃ deva ṛtupā ṛtāvā
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is the leader of peoples, like <s>Bhaga</s>, a god among the divine ones, keeper of the seasons and true to <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: sa vṛtrahā sanayo viśvavedāḥ parṣad viśvāti duritā gṛṇantam ||
children.translated_text: May he, slayer of obstruction, ancient, all-knowing, carry the singer across all hardships.

children.text: dadhikrām agnim uṣasaṃ ca devīm bṛhaspatiṃ savitāraṃ ca devam
children.translated_text: I call here <s>Dadhikrā</s>, <s>Agni</s>, the goddess <s>Uṣas</s>, <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, the god <s>Savitṛ</s>,

children.text: aśvinā mitrāvaruṇā bhagaṃ ca vasūn rudrāṁ ādityāṁ iha huve ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Aśvins</s>, <s>Mitra-Varuṇa</s>, <s>Bhaga</s>, the <s>Vasus</s>, the <s>Rudras</s>, and the <s>Ādityas</s>.

children.text: Chapter 255
imaṃ no yajñam amṛteṣu dhehīmā havyā jātavedo juṣasva
children.translated_text: Place this sacrifice of ours among the immortals; O <s>Jātavedas</s>, enjoy these oblations.

children.text: stokānām agne medaso ghṛtasya hotaḥ prāśāna prathamo niṣadya ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, O <s>hotṛ</s>, sitting first, consume the drops of fat and ghee.

children.text: ghṛtavantaḥ pāvaka te stokā ścotanti medasaḥ
children.translated_text: O purifier, your drops of fat, rich in ghee, flow down.

children.text: svadharman devavītaye śreṣṭhaṃ no dhehi vāryam ||
children.translated_text: O you of your own law, for the gods' approach, set the best desirable good for us.

children.text: tubhyaṃ stokā ghṛtaścuto 'gne viprāya santya
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Agni</s>, the ghee-dripping drops are present, for the inspired priest.

children.text: ṛṣiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sam idhyase yajñasya prāvitā bhava ||
children.translated_text: As the best seer you are kindled; become the protector of the sacrifice.

children.text: tubhyaṃ ścotanty adhrigo śacīva stokāso agne medaso ghṛtasya
children.translated_text: For you, O uninjurable <s>Agni</s>, the drops of fat and ghee flow down with power.

children.text: kaviśasto bṛhatā bhānunāgā havyā juṣasva medhira ||
children.translated_text: Praised by the poet, with great radiance, come to the oblations and enjoy them, O wise one.

children.text: ojiṣṭhaṃ te madhyato meda udbhṛtam pra te vayaṃ dadāmahe
children.translated_text: We give to you the strongest fat, taken out from the middle.

children.text: ścotanti te vaso stokā adhi tvaci prati tān devaśo vihi ||
children.translated_text: O good one, your drops flow upon the skin; apportion them in return, god by god.

children.text: Chapter 256
ayaṃ so agnir yasmin somam indraḥ sutaṃ dadhe jaṭhare vāvaśānaḥ
children.translated_text: This is that <s>Agni</s> in whom <s>Indra</s>, eager, placed the pressed <s>soma</s> in his belly.

children.text: sahasriṇaṃ vājam atyaṃ na saptiṃ sasavān san stūyase jātavedaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having won thousandfold prize, like a swift racing horse, you are praised, O <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: agne yat te divi varcaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yad oṣadhīṣv apsv ā yajatra
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, whatever brilliance of yours is in heaven, on earth, in the plants, and in the waters, O worshipful one,

children.text: yenāntarikṣam urv ātatantha tveṣaḥ sa bhānur arṇavo nṛcakṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: by which, blazing, you stretched out the broad midspace, that radiance is a flood that sees men.

children.text: agne divo arṇam acchā jigāsy acchā devāṁ ūciṣe dhiṣṇyā ye
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, you seek to go toward the flood of heaven; you speak toward the gods who are seated in their stations,

children.text: yā rocane parastāt sūryasya yāś cāvastād upatiṣṭhanta āpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the waters that stand in the shining realm beyond the sun and those that stand below.

children.text: purīṣyāso agnayaḥ prāvaṇebhiḥ sajoṣasaḥ
children.translated_text: May the fires fit for the altar, with their forward protections, rejoice together,

children.text: juṣantāṃ yajñam adruho 'namīvā iṣo mahīḥ ||
children.translated_text: may they, harmless and free from disease, enjoy the sacrifice and the great nourishments.

children.text: iḍām agne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, accomplish for the one who invokes you <s>Iḍā</s>, rich in marvels, the winning of cattle, most lasting.

children.text: syān naḥ sūnus tanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatir bhūtv asme ||
children.translated_text: May there be for us a son, an offspring rich in descendants; O <s>Agni</s>, may that favorable thought of yours be ours.

children.text: Chapter 257
nirmathitaḥ sudhita ā sadhasthe yuvā kavir adhvarasya praṇetā
children.translated_text: Kindled by friction, well placed in the assembly-seat, young, a poet, the guide of the <s>adhvara</s> (rite),

children.text: jūryatsv agnir ajaro vaneṣv atrā dadhe amṛtaṃ jātavedāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the unaging <s>Agni Jātavedas</s>, among aging woods, was set here as immortal.

children.text: amanthiṣṭām bhāratā revad agniṃ devaśravā devavātaḥ sudakṣam
children.translated_text: The two <s>Bhāratas</s>, <s>Devaśravas</s> and <s>Devavāta</s>, have kindled the richly bright, skillful <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: agne vi paśya bṛhatābhi rāyeṣāṃ no netā bhavatād anu dyūn ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, look widely with great wealth; let him be our leader day after day.

children.text: daśa kṣipaḥ pūrvyaṃ sīm ajījanan sujātam mātṛṣu priyam
children.translated_text: The ten fingers generated him of old, well-born and dear among his mothers.

children.text: agniṃ stuhi daivavātaṃ devaśravo yo janānām asad vaśī ||
children.translated_text: Praise <s>Agni Daivavāta</s>, O <s>Devaśravas</s>, who will be master of peoples.

children.text: ni tvā dadhe vara ā pṛthivyā iḍāyās pade sudinatve ahnām
children.translated_text: I set you down in the chosen place of earth, in the seat of <s>Iḍā</s>, in the good day-brightness of days.

children.text: dṛṣadvatyām mānuṣa āpayāyāṃ sarasvatyāṃ revad agne didīhi ||
children.translated_text: At the <s>Dṛṣadvatī</s>, among men, at the <s>Āpayā</s>, at the <s>Sarasvatī</s>, shine richly, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: iḍām agne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, accomplish for the one who invokes you <s>Iḍā</s>, rich in marvels, the winning of cattle, most lasting.

children.text: syān naḥ sūnus tanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatir bhūtv asme ||
children.translated_text: May there be for us a son, an offspring rich in descendants; O <s>Agni</s>, may that favorable thought of yours be ours.

children.text: Chapter 258
agne sahasva pṛtanā abhimātīr apāsya
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, overcome the battles; drive away the hostile assaults.

children.text: duṣṭaras tarann arātīr varco dhā yajñavāhase ||
children.translated_text: Crossing over the hard-to-cross enmities, place brilliance upon the bearer of sacrifice.

children.text: agna iḍā sam idhyase vītihotro amartyaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, you are kindled with <s>Iḍā</s>, an immortal summoner of the offering.

children.text: juṣasva sū no adhvaram ||
children.translated_text: Accept this rite of ours.

children.text: agne dyumnena jāgṛve sahasaḥ sūnav āhuta
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, watchful with splendor, son of strength, invoked by us,

children.text: edam barhiḥ sado mama ||
children.translated_text: sit here upon this sacrificial grass of mine.

children.text: agne viśvebhir agnibhir devebhir mahayā giraḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, with all the fires and with the gods, magnify our songs,

children.text: yajñeṣu ya u cāyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the songs that are active in the sacrifices.

children.text: agne dā dāśuṣe rayiṃ vīravantam parīṇasam
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, give to the worshipper wealth rich in heroes and abundant,

children.text: śiśīhi naḥ sūnumataḥ ||
children.translated_text: and make us vigorous, with sons.

children.text: Chapter 259
agne divaḥ sūnur asi pracetās tanā pṛthivyā uta viśvavedāḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, you are the son of heaven, far-seeing, the offspring of earth, and all-knowing.

children.text: ṛdhag devāṁ iha yajā cikitvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Knowing well, sacrifice here to the gods, each in his own way.

children.text: agniḥ sanoti vīryāṇi vidvān sanoti vājam amṛtāya bhūṣan
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, knowing, wins heroic powers; adorning himself for immortality, he wins strength.

children.text: sa no devāṁ eha vahā purukṣo ||
children.translated_text: May he, rich in many goods, bring the gods here to us.

children.text: agnir dyāvāpṛthivī viśvajanye ā bhāti devī amṛte amūraḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> shines upon heaven and earth, born for all people, divine, immortal, and unfailing,

children.text: kṣayan vājaiḥ puruścandro namobhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: dwelling amid prizes, much-bright with acts of homage.

children.text: agna indraś ca dāśuṣo duroṇe sutāvato yajñam ihopa yātam
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Indra</s>, come here to the sacrifice in the house of the worshipper who has pressed soma,

children.text: amardhantā somapeyāya devā ||
children.translated_text: unneglecting, O gods, for the drinking of soma.

children.text: agne apāṃ sam idhyase duroṇe nityaḥ sūno sahaso jātavedaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, you are kindled in the dwelling, among the waters, eternal son of strength, <s>Jātavedas</s>,

children.text: sadhasthāni mahayamāna ūtī ||
children.translated_text: being magnified in the common seats with aid.

children.text: Chapter 260
vaiśvānaram manasāgniṃ nicāyyā haviṣmanto anuṣatyaṃ svarvidam
children.translated_text: Having discerned with the mind <s>Vaiśvānara</s> <s>Agni</s>, who follows truth and finds the light, we, bearing oblations,

children.text: sudānuṃ devaṃ rathiraṃ vasūyavo gīrbhī raṇvaṃ kuśikāso havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Kuśikas</s>, seeking wealth, call with songs the generous god, the charioteer, the delightful one.

children.text: taṃ śubhram agnim avase havāmahe vaiśvānaram mātariśvānam ukthyam
children.translated_text: We call that bright <s>Agni</s> for aid, <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, <s>Mātariśvan</s>, worthy of praise,

children.text: bṛhaspatim manuṣo devatātaye vipraṃ śrotāram atithiṃ raghuṣyadam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, the inspired listener, the guest swiftly seated, for the divine service of man.

children.text: aśvo na krandañ janibhiḥ sam idhyate vaiśvānaraḥ kuśikebhir yuge yuge
children.translated_text: Like a horse neighing among its kin, <s>Vaiśvānara</s> is kindled by the <s>Kuśikas</s> age after age.

children.text: sa no agniḥ suvīryaṃ svaśvyaṃ dadhātu ratnam amṛteṣu jāgṛviḥ ||
children.translated_text: May that <s>Agni</s>, wakeful among the immortals, grant us heroic strength, good horses, and treasure.

children.text: pra yantu vājās taviṣībhir agnayaḥ śubhe sammiślāḥ pṛṣatīr ayukṣata
children.translated_text: Let the prize-winning fires go forth with their powers; the dappled mares, yoked together, have been harnessed for beauty.

children.text: bṛhadukṣo maruto viśvavedasaḥ pra vepayanti parvatāṁ adābhyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The great bulls, the <s>Maruts</s>, all-knowing and unassailable, make the mountains tremble.

children.text: agniśriyo maruto viśvakṛṣṭaya ā tveṣam ugram ava īmahe vayam
children.translated_text: We seek the swift and fierce aid of the <s>Maruts</s>, splendid with fire, belonging to all peoples.

children.text: te svānino rudriyā varṣanirṇijaḥ siṃhā na heṣakratavaḥ sudānavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They are the sounding <s>Rudriyas</s>, rain-clad, like lions in their roaring resolve, generous givers.

children.text: vrātaṃ vrātaṃ gaṇaṃ gaṇaṃ suśastibhir agner bhāmam marutām oja īmahe
children.translated_text: Band by band and troop by troop, with good praises, we seek the blaze of <s>Agni</s> and the might of the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: pṛṣadaśvāso anavabhrarādhaso gantāro yajñaṃ vidatheṣu dhīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: With speckled horses and unobscured gifts, they are wise ones who come to the sacrifice in the gatherings.

children.text: agnir asmi janmanā jātavedā ghṛtam me cakṣur amṛtam ma āsan
children.translated_text: I am <s>Agni</s> by birth, <s>Jātavedas</s>; ghee is my eye, and immortality is my mouth.

children.text: arkas tridhātū rajaso vimāno 'jasro gharmo havir asmi nāma ||
children.translated_text: I am the threefold hymn, the measure of the midspace; unfailing heat is my name, the oblation.

children.text: tribhiḥ pavitrair apupoddhy arkaṃ hṛdā matiṃ jyotir anu prajānan
children.translated_text: With three purifiers he has cleansed the song, perceiving with the heart the thought and the light.

children.text: varṣiṣṭhaṃ ratnam akṛta svadhābhir ād id dyāvāpṛthivī pary apaśyat ||
children.translated_text: By his own powers he made the highest treasure; then heaven and earth looked upon it.

children.text: śatadhāram utsam akṣīyamāṇaṃ vipaścitam pitaraṃ vaktvānām
children.translated_text: The hundred-streamed, inexhaustible fountain, the wise father of utterances,

children.text: meḍim madantam pitror upasthe taṃ rodasī pipṛtaṃ satyavācam ||
children.translated_text: the support rejoicing in the parents' lap: fill him, O two worlds, the truth-speaking one.

children.text: Chapter 261
pra vo vājā abhidyavo haviṣmanto ghṛtācyā
children.translated_text: Let your prize-winning, heavenward offerings, rich in oblation, go forth with the ghee-pouring ladle.

children.text: devāñ jigāti sumnayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeking favor, it goes to the gods.

children.text: īḍe agniṃ vipaścitaṃ girā yajñasya sādhanam
children.translated_text: I praise <s>Agni</s>, the inspired one, with song, the accomplisher of the sacrifice,

children.text: śruṣṭīvānaṃ dhitāvānam ||
children.translated_text: quick to hear and rich in thought.

children.text: agne śakema te vayaṃ yamaṃ devasya vājinaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, by your guidance, that of a vigorous god, may we have power;

children.text: ati dveṣāṃsi tarema ||
children.translated_text: may we cross beyond all hostilities.

children.text: samidhyamāno adhvare 'gniḥ pāvaka īḍyaḥ
children.translated_text: Being kindled in the rite, <s>Agni</s>, purifying and worthy of praise,

children.text: śociṣkeśas tam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: flame-haired, is the one we seek.

children.text: pṛthupājā amartyo ghṛtanirṇik svāhutaḥ
children.translated_text: Broad-radiant, immortal, ghee-clad, and well-invoked,

children.text: agnir yajñasya havyavāṭ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is the oblation-bearer of the sacrifice.

children.text: taṃ sabādho yatasruca itthā dhiyā yajñavantaḥ
children.translated_text: The sacrificers, pressed close, with outstretched ladles, in this way and with insight,

children.text: ā cakrur agnim ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: have turned <s>Agni</s> toward themselves for aid.

children.text: hotā devo amartyaḥ purastād eti māyayā
children.translated_text: The divine, immortal <s>Hotṛ</s> goes in front with wondrous power,

children.text: vidathāni pracodayan ||
children.translated_text: impelling the sacred gatherings.

children.text: vājī vājeṣu dhīyate 'dhvareṣu pra ṇīyate
children.translated_text: The prize-winner is set among prizes; he is led forward in the rites,

children.text: vipro yajñasya sādhanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the inspired one, the accomplisher of the sacrifice.

children.text: dhiyā cakre vareṇyo bhūtānāṃ garbham ā dadhe
children.translated_text: By insight he fashioned the desirable one; in his own body he placed the embryo of beings,

children.text: dakṣasya pitaraṃ tanā ||
children.translated_text: the father of skill.

children.text: ni tvā dadhe vareṇyaṃ dakṣasyeḍā sahaskṛta
children.translated_text: I set you down as the desirable one, O <s>Agni</s>, with <s>Dakṣa</s>'s <s>Iḍā</s>, strengthened by force,

children.text: agne sudītim uśijam ||
children.translated_text: bright-flamed and eager for worship.

children.text: agniṃ yanturam apturam ṛtasya yoge vanuṣaḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired priests kindle <s>Agni</s>, the guide, the attainer, the conqueror, in the yoking of <s>ṛta</s>,

children.text: viprā vājaiḥ sam indhate ||
children.translated_text: with prizes.

children.text: ūrjo napātam adhvare dīdivāṃsam upa dyavi
children.translated_text: In the rite I praise <s>Agni</s>, child of nourishment, shining up to heaven,

children.text: agnim īḍe kavikratum ||
children.translated_text: the one whose will is poetic wisdom.

children.text: īḍenyo namasyas tiras tamāṃsi darśataḥ
children.translated_text: Worthy of praise, worthy of homage, visible across the darkness,

children.text: sam agnir idhyate vṛṣā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> the bull is kindled.

children.text: vṛṣo agniḥ sam idhyate 'śvo na devavāhanaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> the bull is kindled, like a horse that carries the gods.

children.text: taṃ haviṣmanta īḍate ||
children.translated_text: The oblation-bearing worshippers praise him.

children.text: vṛṣaṇaṃ tvā vayaṃ vṛṣan vṛṣaṇaḥ sam idhīmahi
children.translated_text: O bull, we, as bulls, kindle you, the bull,

children.text: agne dīdyatam bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, shining broadly and great.

children.text: Chapter 262
agne juṣasva no haviḥ puroḍāśaṃ jātavedaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, <s>Jātavedas</s>, accept our oblation, the <s>puroḍāśa</s>,

children.text: prātaḥsāve dhiyāvaso ||
children.translated_text: at the morning pressing, O you rich in insight.

children.text: puroḍā agne pacatas tubhyaṃ vā ghā pariṣkṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, the cooked <s>puroḍāśa</s> is for you, indeed, well prepared.

children.text: taṃ juṣasva yaviṣṭhya ||
children.translated_text: Accept it, youngest one.

children.text: agne vīhi puroḍāśam āhutaṃ tiroahnyam
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, consume the offered <s>puroḍāśa</s> prepared overnight,

children.text: sahasaḥ sūnur asy adhvare hitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for you, son of strength, are placed in this rite.

children.text: mādhyandine savane jātavedaḥ puroḍāśam iha kave juṣasva
children.translated_text: At the midday pressing, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, sage, accept the <s>puroḍāśa</s> here,

children.text: agne yahvasya tava bhāgadheyaṃ na pra minanti vidatheṣu dhīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>; the wise do not diminish your allotted share in the sacred gatherings of the great one.

children.text: agne tṛtīye savane hi kāniṣaḥ puroḍāśaṃ sahasaḥ sūnav āhutam
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, at the third pressing you indeed desire the offered <s>puroḍāśa</s>, O son of strength,

children.text: athā deveṣv adhvaraṃ vipanyayā dhā ratnavantam amṛteṣu jāgṛvim ||
children.translated_text: Then, among the gods, set the ritual in motion with inspired praise, rich in treasures and watchful among the immortals.

children.text: agne vṛdhāna āhutim puroḍāśaṃ jātavedaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, growing strong, O <s>Jatavedas</s>, accept the oblation, the sacrificial cake

children.text: juṣasva tiroahnyam ||
children.translated_text: offered at the close of the day.

children.text: Chapter 263
astīdam adhimanthanam asti prajananaṃ kṛtam
children.translated_text: Here is this upper churning-stick; here is the prepared means of generation.

children.text: etāṃ viśpatnīm ā bharāgnim manthāma pūrvathā ||
children.translated_text: Bring this mistress of the clans; let us churn <s>Agni</s> as in former times.

children.text: araṇyor nihito jātavedā garbha iva sudhito garbhiṇīṣu
children.translated_text: <s>Jatavedas</s>, placed within the two fire-sticks, is well set like an embryo among pregnant women.

children.text: dive diva īḍyo jāgṛvadbhir haviṣmadbhir manuṣyebhir agniḥ ||
children.translated_text: Day by day <s>Agni</s> is to be praised by wakeful human beings who possess oblations.

children.text: uttānāyām ava bharā cikitvān sadyaḥ pravītā vṛṣaṇaṃ jajāna
children.translated_text: Knowing well, bring him down upon the outstretched one; straightway the prepared female has given birth to the bull.

children.text: aruṣastūpo ruśad asya pāja iﾱāyās putro vayune 'janiṣṭa ||
children.translated_text: With a ruddy crest, his bright force was born; the son of <s>Ila</s> came forth in accordance with the guiding order.

children.text: iﾱāyās tvā pade vayaṃ nābhā pṛthivyā adhi
children.translated_text: At the place of <s>Ila</s>, upon the navel of the earth, we

children.text: jātavedo ni dhīmahy agne havyāya voḍhave ||
children.translated_text: place you, O <s>Jatavedas</s>, O <s>Agni</s>, to carry the oblations.

children.text: manthatā naraḥ kavim advayantam pracetasam amṛtaṃ supratīkam
children.translated_text: Churn forth, men, the sage who is without deceit, far-seeing, immortal, fair-faced.

children.text: yajñasya ketum prathamam purastād agniṃ naro janayatā suśevam ||
children.translated_text: Let men bring forth <s>Agni</s>, the first banner of the sacrifice set in front, gracious and easy to serve.

children.text: yadī manthanti bāhubhir vi rocate 'śvo na vājy aruṣo vaneṣv ā
children.translated_text: When they churn him with their arms, he shines out in the woods like a ruddy prize-winning horse.

children.text: citro na yāmann aśvinor anivṛtaḥ pari vṛṇakty aśmanas tṛṇā dahan ||
children.translated_text: Like a bright one on the path of the <s>Asvins</s>, unobstructed, he burns the grasses and wraps around the stones.

children.text: jāto agnī rocate cekitāno vājī vipraḥ kaviśastaḥ sudānuḥ
children.translated_text: Born, <s>Agni</s> shines, perceptive: a prize-winner, an inspired one, praised by poets, a good giver.

children.text: yaṃ devāsa īḍyaṃ viśvavidaṃ havyavāham adadhur adhvareṣu ||
children.translated_text: The gods placed him in the rites as the praiseworthy one, all-knowing, the carrier of oblations.

children.text: sīda hotaḥ sva u loke cikitvān sādayā yajñaṃ sukṛtasya yonau
children.translated_text: Sit down, O <s>Hotr</s>, in your own place, knowing well; seat the sacrifice in the womb of good action.

children.text: devāvīr devān haviṣā yajāsy agne bṛhad yajamāne vayo dhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O god-loving <s>Agni</s>, you shall worship the gods with oblation; place broad vitality in the sacrificer.

children.text: kṛṇota dhūmaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ sakhāyo 'sredhanta itana vājam accha
children.translated_text: Make smoke, friends, virile and unfailing; go toward the prize.

children.text: ayam agniḥ pṛtanāṣāṭ suvīro yena devāso asahanta dasyūn ||
children.translated_text: This <s>Agni</s> is a conqueror in battles, rich in heroes, by whom the gods overcame the <s>Dasyus</s>.

children.text: ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyo yato jāto arocathāḥ
children.translated_text: This is your seasonable womb, from which, when born, you shone forth.

children.text: taṃ jānann agna ā sīdāthā no vardhayā giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Knowing it, O <s>Agni</s>, sit down here; then make our songs increase.

children.text: tanūnapād ucyate garbha āsuro narāśaṃso bhavati yad vijāyate
children.translated_text: He is called <s>Tanunapat</s>; as an embryo he is mighty, and when born he becomes <s>Narasamsa</s>.

children.text: mātariśvā yad amimīta mātari vātasya sargo abhavat sarīmaṇi ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Matarisvan</s> formed him in the mother, he became the rush of wind in movement.

children.text: sunirmathā nirmathitaḥ sunidhā nihitaḥ kaviḥ
children.translated_text: Well-churned, churned forth, well-laid, placed down, the sage

children.text: agne svadhvarā kṛṇu devān devayate yaja ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, make the rites good; sacrifice to the gods for the god-loving worshipper.

children.text: ajījanann amṛtam martyāso 'sremāṇaṃ taraṇiṃ vīḍujambham
children.translated_text: Mortals generated the immortal, the unwearied, swift one with firm jaws.

children.text: daśa svasāro agruvaḥ samīcīḥ pumāṃsaṃ jātam abhi saṃ rabhante ||
children.translated_text: Ten unwedded sisters, moving together, take hold of the male when he is born.

children.text: pra saptahotā sanakād arocata mātur upasthe yad aśocad ūdhani
children.translated_text: The sevenfold <s>Hotr</s> shone forth from of old when he blazed in the mother's lap, at the udder.

children.text: na ni miṣati suraṇo dive dive yad asurasya jaṭharād ajāyata ||
children.translated_text: The gracious one does not blink day by day, when he was born from the belly of the mighty one.

children.text: amitrāyudho marutām iva prayāḥ prathamajā brahmaṇo viśvam id viduḥ
children.translated_text: Armed against foes, like the troop of the <s>Maruts</s>, first-born of sacred formulation, they know the whole world.

children.text: dyumnavad brahma kuśikāsa erira eka eko dame agniṃ sam īdhire ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Kusikas</s> have raised a luminous sacred utterance; each one in his house has kindled <s>Agni</s> together.

children.text: yad adya tvā prayati yajñe asmin hotaś cikitvo 'vṛṇīmahīha
children.translated_text: Since today, at the opening of this sacrifice, we have chosen you here as <s>Hotr</s>, O knowing one,

children.text: dhruvam ayā dhruvam utāśamiṣṭhāḥ prajānan vidvāṁ upa yāhi somam ||
children.translated_text: firm by this rite, firm also through the most vigorous refreshment, come knowingly and wisely to the <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: Chapter 264
icchanti tvā somyāsaḥ sakhāyaḥ sunvanti somaṃ dadhati prayāṃsi
children.translated_text: Your <s>Soma</s>-loving companions seek you; they press <s>Soma</s> and set forth offerings.

children.text: titikṣante abhiśastiṃ janānām indra tvad ā kaścana hi praketaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They endure the reviling of people; for from you, O <s>Indra</s>, some insight surely comes.

children.text: na te dūre paramā cid rajāṃsy ā tu pra yāhi harivo haribhyām
children.translated_text: Even the farthest realms are not distant for you; come here with the two bays, O master of bay horses.

children.text: sthirāya vṛṣṇe savanā kṛtemā yuktā grāvāṇaḥ samidhāne agnau ||
children.translated_text: These pressings have been prepared for the steadfast bull; the pressing-stones are yoked while <s>Agni</s> is kindled.

children.text: indraḥ suśipro maghavā tarutro mahāvrātas tuvikūrmir ṛghāvān
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, fair-lipped, bountiful, overcoming, great in ordinances, mighty in works, impetuous,

children.text: yad ugro dhā bādhito martyeṣu kva tyā te vṛṣabha vīryāṇi ||
children.translated_text: when, fierce one, you were hard pressed among mortals, where then were those heroic powers of yours, O bull?

children.text: tvaṃ hi ṣmā cyāvayann acyutāny eko vṛtrā carasi jighnamānaḥ
children.translated_text: For you alone, shaking the unshaken, move about striking down the <s>Vrtras</s>.

children.text: tava dyāvāpṛthivī parvatāso 'nu vratāya nimiteva tasthuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Heaven and earth and the mountains stood fixed like measures in obedience to your command.

children.text: utābhaye puruhūta śravobhir eko dṛḍham avado vṛtrahā san
children.translated_text: And with both kinds of fame, O much-invoked one, you alone, being the slayer of <s>Vrtra</s>, broke down the firm thing.

children.text: ime cid indra rodasī apāre yat saṃgṛbhṇā maghavan kāśir it te ||
children.translated_text: Even these two boundless worlds, O <s>Indra</s>, when you grasp them together, O bountiful one, are like ornaments for you.

children.text: pra sū ta indra pravatā haribhyām pra te vajraḥ pramṛṇann etu śatrūn
children.translated_text: Let your bolt go forward down the slope with the two bays, O <s>Indra</s>; let your thunderbolt advance, crushing the enemies.

children.text: jahi pratīco anūcaḥ parāco viśvaṃ satyaṃ kṛṇuhi viṣṭam astu ||
children.translated_text: Strike those facing you, those following behind, and those turned away; make the whole thing true; let what is hostile be scattered.

children.text: yasmai dhāyur adadhā martyāyābhaktaṃ cid bhajate gehyaṃ saḥ
children.translated_text: For the mortal to whom you have given support, he shares even an unshared household good.

children.text: bhadrā ta indra sumatir ghṛtācī sahasradānā puruhūta rātiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Auspicious is your favor, O <s>Indra</s>, rich in ghee, a bounty giving a thousand gifts, O much-invoked one.

children.text: sahadānum puruhūta kṣiyantam ahastam indra sam piṇak kuṇārum
children.translated_text: O much-invoked <s>Indra</s>, you crushed the handless <s>Kunaru</s>, who dwelt with the demon <s>Danu</s>.

children.text: abhi vṛtraṃ vardhamānam piyārum apādam indra tavasā jaghantha ||
children.translated_text: With your might, O <s>Indra</s>, you struck down swelling <s>Vrtra</s>, the footless, greedy one.

children.text: ni sāmanām iṣirām indra bhūmim mahīm apārāṃ sadane sasattha
children.translated_text: You made the eager earth of chants sink down, O <s>Indra</s>, the great and boundless one in its seat.

children.text: astabhnād dyāṃ vṛṣabho antarikṣam arṣantv āpas tvayeha prasūtāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The bull propped up heaven and the midspace; let the waters, released here by you, flow onward.

children.text: alātṛṇo vala indra vrajo goḥ purā hantor bhayamāno vy āra
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, <s>Vala</s>, the enclosure of the cow, opened wide from fear before the smiter.

children.text: sugān patho akṛṇon niraje gāḥ prāvan vāṇīḥ puruhūtaṃ dhamantīḥ ||
children.translated_text: You made easy paths; you drove out the cows; you aided the voices that blew praise toward the much-invoked one.

children.text: eko dve vasumatī samīcī indra ā paprau pṛthivīm uta dyām
children.translated_text: Alone, O <s>Indra</s>, you filled the two wealthy, concordant worlds, earth and heaven.

children.text: utāntarikṣād abhi naḥ samīka iṣo rathīḥ sayujaḥ śūra vājān ||
children.translated_text: And from the midspace, O hero, look toward us with food, chariot-borne prizes, and yoked companions.

children.text: diśaḥ sūryo na mināti pradiṣṭā dive dive haryaśvaprasūtāḥ
children.translated_text: The sun does not transgress the appointed directions, set in motion day by day by the bay horses.

children.text: saṃ yad ānaḍ adhvana ād id aśvair vimocanaṃ kṛṇute tat tv asya ||
children.translated_text: When he has traversed the roads with the horses, only then does he make his unyoking.

children.text: didṛkṣanta uṣaso yāmann aktor vivasvatyā mahi citram anīkam
children.translated_text: Longing to see the Dawns in the course of night, the great, wondrous face of the shining one appears.

children.text: viśve jānanti mahinā yad āgād indrasya karma sukṛtā purūṇi ||
children.translated_text: All know, when he has come in greatness, the many well-made deeds of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: mahi jyotir nihitaṃ vakṣaṇāsv āmā pakvaṃ carati bibhratī gauḥ
children.translated_text: A great light has been set in the cow's udder; bearing the raw and the cooked, the cow moves on.

children.text: viśvaṃ svādma saṃbhṛtam usriyāyāṃ yat sīm indro adadhād bhojanāya ||
children.translated_text: All sweetness was gathered in the ruddy cow, which <s>Indra</s> assigned for nourishment.

children.text: indra dṛhya yāmakośā abhūvan yajñāya śikṣa gṛṇate sakhibhyaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, be firm; the restraining enclosures have arisen. Give skill for the sacrifice to the singer and to your friends.

children.text: durmāyavo durevā martyāso niṣaṅgiṇo ripavo hantvāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Men of evil magic and evil ways, armed with quivers, enemies, are to be slain.

children.text: saṃ ghoṣaḥ śṛṇve 'vamair amitrair jahī ny eṣv aśaniṃ tapiṣṭhām
children.translated_text: The cry is heard among the lower enemies; cast down among them your hottest thunderbolt.

children.text: vṛścem adhastād vi rujā sahasva jahi rakṣo maghavan randhayasva ||
children.translated_text: Cut them off below, break them apart, overpower them; slay the demon, O <s>Maghavan</s>, and subdue it.

children.text: ud vṛha rakṣaḥ sahamūlam indra vṛścā madhyam praty agraṃ śṛṇīhi
children.translated_text: Tear up the demon with its root, O <s>Indra</s>; cut off its middle and shatter its tip.

children.text: ā kīvataḥ salalūkaṃ cakartha brahmadviṣe tapuṣiṃ hetim asya ||
children.translated_text: You have made the chattering hostile one helpless; against the hater of sacred speech let your scorching missile be directed.

children.text: svastaye vājibhiś ca praṇetaḥ saṃ yan mahīr iṣa āsatsi pūrvīḥ
children.translated_text: For welfare, with prize-winning steeds, O leader, when you unite the great and many refreshments,

children.text: rāyo vantāro bṛhataḥ syāmāsme astu bhaga indra prajāvān ||
children.translated_text: may we be winners of great wealth; may our share, O <s>Indra</s>, be rich in offspring.

children.text: ā no bhara bhagam indra dyumantaṃ ni te deṣṇasya dhīmahi prareke
children.translated_text: Bring us brilliant fortune, O <s>Indra</s>; we set ourselves beneath the overflow of your gift.

children.text: ūrva iva paprathe kāmo asme tam ā pṛṇa vasupate vasūnām ||
children.translated_text: Desire has spread wide in us like a broad place; fill it, lord of goods, with goods.

children.text: imaṃ kāmam mandayā gobhir aśvaiś candravatā rādhasā paprathaś ca
children.translated_text: Gladden this desire with cows and horses and with shining largesse, and make it broad.

children.text: svaryavo matibhis tubhyaṃ viprā indrāya vāhaḥ kuśikāso akran ||
children.translated_text: Seeking heaven, the inspired <s>Kuśikas</s> have fashioned, with their thoughts, a bearer of offerings for you, for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: ā no gotrā dardṛhi gopate gāḥ sam asmabhyaṃ sanayo yantu vājāḥ
children.translated_text: Break open the cow-stalls for us, lord of cattle, and release the cows; may gains and prizes come together to us.

children.text: divakṣā asi vṛṣabha satyaśuṣmo 'smabhyaṃ su maghavan bodhi godāḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are sky-dwelling, a bull, true in strength; be gracious to us with cows, O <s>Maghavan</s>.

children.text: śunaṃ huvema maghavānam indram asmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau
children.translated_text: Let us successfully call the bountiful <s>Indra</s> in this contest, the most manly one in the winning of the prize,

children.text: śṛṇvantam ugram ūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||
children.translated_text: the fierce one who hears for aid in battles, who slays the <s>Vṛtras</s>, the conqueror of riches.

children.text: Chapter 265
śāsad vahnir duhitur naptyaṃ gād vidvāṁ ṛtasya dīdhitiṃ saparyan
children.translated_text: The bearer ruled; he went to the daughter's kin, knowing and worshipping the shining of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: pitā yatra duhituḥ sekam ṛñjan saṃ śagmyena manasā dadhanve ||
children.translated_text: There the father, adorning the daughter's seed, joined himself with a propitious mind.

children.text: na jāmaye tānvo riktham āraik cakāra garbhaṃ sanitur nidhānam
children.translated_text: He did not leave the inheritance of his own body to the female kinswoman; he made the womb a deposit for the begetter.

children.text: yadī mātaro janayanta vahnim anyaḥ kartā sukṛtor anya ṛndhan ||
children.translated_text: When the mothers generated the bearer, one was the maker of the good work and another the kindler.

children.text: agnir jajñe juhvā rejamāno mahas putrāṁ aruṣasya prayakṣe
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> was born, trembling upon the tongue, for the offering of the mighty sons of the ruddy one.

children.text: mahān garbho mahy ā jātam eṣām mahī pravṛddharyaśvasya yajñaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Great was the embryo, great the one born among them, great the growth through the sacrifices of <s>Aryaśva</s>.

children.text: abhi jaitrīr asacanta spṛdhānam mahi jyotis tamaso nir ajānan
children.translated_text: The victorious ones attended the contender; they brought the great light out of the darkness.

children.text: taṃ jānatīḥ praty ud āyann uṣāsaḥ patir gavām abhavad eka indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Recognizing him, the dawns came forth to meet him; <s>Indra</s> alone became lord of the cows.

children.text: vīﾱau satīr abhi dhīrā atṛndan prācāhinvan manasā sapta viprāḥ
children.translated_text: Though they were in the stronghold, the wise ones broke through; the seven inspired priests drove forward with their mind.

children.text: viśvām avindan pathyām ṛtasya prajānann it tā namasā viveśa ||
children.translated_text: They found the whole path of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order); knowing those things, he entered with reverence.

children.text: vidad yadī saramā rugṇam adrer mahi pāthaḥ pūrvyaṃ sadhryak kaḥ
children.translated_text: When <s>Saramā</s> found the broken place of the rock, who made straight the great ancient path?

children.text: agraṃ nayat supady akṣarāṇām acchā ravam prathamā jānatī gāt ||
children.translated_text: Knowing first, she went toward the sound; she led the foremost track of the well-footed streams.

children.text: agacchad u vipratamaḥ sakhīyann asūdayat sukṛte garbham adriḥ
children.translated_text: The most inspired one came seeking friendship; the rock yielded its embryo for the good work.

children.text: sasāna maryo yuvabhir makhasyann athābhavad aṅgirāḥ sadyo arcan ||
children.translated_text: The young hero won with young men, delighting in the rite; then at once he became an <s>Aṅgiras</s>, singing.

children.text: sataḥ sataḥ pratimānam purobhūr viśvā veda janimā hanti śuṣṇam
children.translated_text: Foremost one, measure of every being, you know all births and strike down <s>Śuṣṇa</s>.

children.text: pra ṇo divaḥ padavīr gavyur arcan sakhā sakhīṃr amuñcan nir avadyāt ||
children.translated_text: Singing, guide for us from heaven the cow-seeking paths; as friend, release your friends from blame.

children.text: ni gavyatā manasā sedur arkaiḥ kṛṇvānāso amṛtatvāya gātum
children.translated_text: With cow-seeking mind they sat down with hymns, making a path toward immortality.

children.text: idaṃ cin nu sadanam bhūry eṣāṃ yena māsāṁ asiṣāsann ṛtena ||
children.translated_text: Even this seat of theirs is now abundant, by which they ordered the months according to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: saṃpaśyamānā amadann abhi svam payaḥ pratnasya retaso dughānāḥ
children.translated_text: Seeing together, they rejoiced over their own milk, milking the ancient seed.

children.text: vi rodasī atapad ghoṣa eṣāṃ jāte niṣṭhām adadhur goṣu vīrān ||
children.translated_text: Their cry heated the two worlds; when he was born, they set heroes firmly among the cows.

children.text: sa jātebhir vṛtrahā sed u havyair ud usriyā asṛjad indro arkaiḥ
children.translated_text: With those born ones and with oblations, <s>Indra</s>, slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, sat down; with hymns he released the ruddy cows.

children.text: urūcy asmai ghṛtavad bharantī madhu svādma duduhe jenyā gauḥ ||
children.translated_text: For him the winning cow, broad-going and bringing ghee, milked sweet honeyed flavor.

children.text: pitre cic cakruḥ sadanaṃ sam asmai mahi tviṣīmat sukṛto vi hi khyan
children.translated_text: Even for the father they made a dwelling all around; the doers of good disclosed the great gleaming one.

children.text: viṣkabhnanta skambhanenā janitrī āsīnā ūrdhvaṃ rabhasaṃ vi minvan ||
children.translated_text: They propped the mother with a support; sitting, they measured out the upward force.

children.text: mahī yadi dhiṣaṇā śiśnathe dhāt sadyovṛdhaṃ vibhvaṃ rodasyoḥ
children.translated_text: When great <s>Dhiṣaṇā</s> placed support for the immediately growing, all-pervading one in the two worlds,

children.text: giro yasminn anavadyāḥ samīcīr viśvā indrāya taviṣīr anuttāḥ ||
children.translated_text: in whom faultless, harmonious songs and all unsurpassed powers were gathered for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: mahy ā te sakhyaṃ vaśmi śaktīr ā vṛtraghne niyuto yanti pūrvīḥ
children.translated_text: I desire your great friendship and powers; many teams have long come to the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: mahi stotram ava āganma sūrer asmākaṃ su maghavan bodhi gopāḥ ||
children.translated_text: We have come to the great praise and aid of the patron; be our good protector, O <s>Maghavan</s>.

children.text: mahi kṣetram puru ścandraṃ vividvān ād it sakhibhyaś carathaṃ sam airat
children.translated_text: Knowing the great field, broad and bright, he then set the moving course in motion for his friends.

children.text: indro nṛbhir ajanad dīdyānaḥ sākaṃ sūryam uṣasaṃ gātum agnim ||
children.translated_text: Blazing among men, <s>Indra</s> generated together the sun, the dawn, the path, and <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: apaś cid eṣa vibhvo damūnāḥ pra sadhrīcīr asṛjad viśvaścandrāḥ
children.translated_text: This mighty house-lord released even the waters, all-brilliant and flowing together.

children.text: madhvaḥ punānāḥ kavibhiḥ pavitrair dyubhir hinvanty aktubhir dhanutrīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Purifying the sweetness with filters made by seers, they impel the heavenly streams by days and nights.

children.text: anu kṛṣṇe vasudhitī jihāte ubhe sūryasya maṃhanā yajatre
children.translated_text: Along the two dark, treasure-holding ones they hasten, both worshipful through the greatness of the sun.

children.text: pari yat te mahimānaṃ vṛjadhyai sakhāya indra kāmyā ṛjipyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When your desirable, straight-going friends, O <s>Indra</s>, strive to encompass your greatness,

children.text: patir bhava vṛtrahan sūnṛtānāṃ girāṃ viśvāyur vṛṣabho vayodhāḥ
children.translated_text: be lord of true words, O <s>Vṛtrahan</s>, bull of all songs, life-giving through the whole span of life.

children.text: ā no gahi sakhyebhiḥ śivebhir mahān mahībhir ūtibhiḥ saraṇyan ||
children.translated_text: Come to us with auspicious friendships, great one, with great protections, easy to approach.

children.text: tam aṅgirasvan namasā saparyan navyaṃ kṛṇomi sanyase purājām
children.translated_text: Serving him with reverence like an <s>Aṅgiras</s>, I make the ancient-born one new for the kindling.

children.text: druho vi yāhi bahulā adevīḥ svaś ca no maghavan sātaye dhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Drive far away the many godless deceits, and establish our own good for winning, O bountiful one.

children.text: mihaḥ pāvakāḥ pratatā abhūvan svasti naḥ pipṛhi pāram āsām
children.translated_text: The purifying showers have spread forth; carry us safely, in welfare, beyond them.

children.text: indra tvaṃ rathiraḥ pāhi no riṣo makṣū makṣū kṛṇuhi gojito naḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, as charioteer protect us from injury; swiftly, swiftly make us winners of cattle.

children.text: adediṣṭa vṛtrahā gopatir gā antaḥ kṛṣṇāṁ aruṣair dhāmabhir gāt
children.translated_text: The <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer, lord of cows, has shone forth; with ruddy gleams he went among the dark cows.

children.text: pra sūnṛtā diśamāna ṛtena duraś ca viśvā avṛṇod apa svāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Offering gracious speech in accord with <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), he opened all his own doors.

children.text: śunaṃ huvema maghavānam indram asmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau
children.translated_text: May we auspiciously call upon bounteous <s>Indra</s> in this contest, the most manly one in the winning of prize.

children.text: śṛṇvantam ugram ūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||
children.translated_text: May he, fierce, hearing us for aid in battles, slaying the <s>Vṛtras</s>, be the conqueror of wealth.

children.text: Chapter 266
indra somaṃ somapate pibemam mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ cāru yat te
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, lord of <s>Soma</s>, drink this <s>soma</s>, the midday pressing, which is pleasing to you.

children.text: prapruthyā śipre maghavann ṛjīṣin vimucyā harī iha mādayasva ||
children.translated_text: With swelling cheeks, O bountiful one rich in the draught, unyoke your two bay horses here and rejoice.

children.text: gavāśiram manthinam indra śukram pibā somaṃ rarimā te madāya
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, drink the bright <s>soma</s>, mixed with milk and stirred; we have offered it for your exhilaration.

children.text: brahmakṛtā mārutenā gaṇena sajoṣā rudrais tṛpad ā vṛṣasva ||
children.translated_text: Made by prayer, together with the host of <s>Maruts</s> and in harmony with the <s>Rudras</s>, be satisfied and grow strong.

children.text: ye te śuṣmaṃ ye taviṣīm avardhann arcanta indra marutas ta ojaḥ
children.translated_text: Those <s>Maruts</s> who, praising you, O <s>Indra</s>, increased your force, your might, and your strength,

children.text: mādhyandine savane vajrahasta pibā rudrebhiḥ sagaṇaḥ suśipra ||
children.translated_text: at the midday pressing, O vajra-handed one, drink with the <s>Rudras</s> and their troop, O fair-lipped one.

children.text: ta in nv asya madhumad vivipra indrasya śardho maruto ya āsan
children.translated_text: These, indeed, were the honey-sweet, inspired troop of <s>Indra</s>, the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: yebhir vṛtrasyeṣito vivedāmarmaṇo manyamānasya marma ||
children.translated_text: With them, impelled against <s>Vṛtra</s>, he found the vulnerable point of him who thought himself invulnerable.

children.text: manuṣvad indra savanaṃ juṣāṇaḥ pibā somaṃ śaśvate vīryāya
children.translated_text: Like <s>Manu</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, enjoying the pressing, drink <s>soma</s> for enduring heroism.

children.text: sa ā vavṛtsva haryaśva yajñaiḥ saraṇyubhir apo arṇā sisarṣi ||
children.translated_text: Thus turn yourself toward us, O bay-horsed one; with seeking sacrifices you send forth the rushing waters.

children.text: tvam apo yaddha vṛtraṃ jaghanvāṁ atyāṁ iva prāsṛjaḥ sartavājau
children.translated_text: When, having slain <s>Vṛtra</s>, you released the waters to run, like racing mares in a contest,

children.text: śayānam indra caratā vadhena vavrivāṃsam pari devīr adevam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, with your moving weapon you struck the one lying there, who enclosed the divine waters, the godless one.

children.text: yajāma in namasā vṛddham indram bṛhantam ṛṣvam ajaraṃ yuvānam
children.translated_text: With reverence we worship grown, great, lofty <s>Indra</s>, the ageless youth.

children.text: yasya priye mamatur yajñiyasya na rodasī mahimānam mamāte ||
children.translated_text: Of his beloved, sacrificial greatness, the two worlds did not measure the extent.

children.text: indrasya karma sukṛtā purūṇi vratāni devā na minanti viśve
children.translated_text: The well-done many deeds of <s>Indra</s>, his ordinances, all the gods do not transgress.

children.text: dādhāra yaḥ pṛthivīṃ dyām utemāṃ jajāna sūryam uṣasaṃ sudaṃsāḥ ||
children.translated_text: He upheld the earth, the sky, and this midspace; with good skill he generated the sun and dawn.

children.text: adrogha satyaṃ tava tan mahitvaṃ sadyo yaj jāto apibo ha somam
children.translated_text: O undeceiving one, true is that greatness of yours: as soon as you were born, you drank the <s>soma</s>.

children.text: na dyāva indra tavasas ta ojo nāhā na māsāḥ śarado varanta ||
children.translated_text: Neither the heavens, O <s>Indra</s>, nor days, months, or years restrain that strong might of yours.

children.text: tvaṃ sadyo apibo jāta indra madāya somam parame vyoman
children.translated_text: Immediately at birth, O <s>Indra</s>, you drank <s>soma</s> for exhilaration in the highest heaven.

children.text: yaddha dyāvāpṛthivī āviveśīr athābhavaḥ pūrvyaḥ kārudhāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When you entered heaven and earth, then you became the first one for the poet’s support.

children.text: ahann ahim pariśayānam arṇa ojāyamānaṃ tuvijāta tavyān
children.translated_text: You struck the serpent lying around the flood, O mighty one, very strong and of mighty birth.

children.text: na te mahitvam anu bhūd adha dyaur yad anyayā sphigyā kṣām avasthāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Your greatness was not matched by heaven, when with your other flank you propped up the earth.

children.text: yajño hi ta indra vardhano bhūd uta priyaḥ sutasomo miyedhaḥ
children.translated_text: For the sacrifice became your increaser, O <s>Indra</s>, and the pressed <s>soma</s>, measured out, became dear to you.

children.text: yajñena yajñam ava yajñiyaḥ san yajñas te vajram ahihatya āvat ||
children.translated_text: Being worthy of sacrifice, with sacrifice you protected the sacrifice; the sacrifice aided your <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt) in the serpent-slaying.

children.text: yajñenendram avasā cakre arvāg ainaṃ sumnāya navyase vavṛtyām
children.translated_text: By sacrifice he made <s>Indra</s> come hither with aid; I would turn him toward new favor.

children.text: ya stomebhir vāvṛdhe pūrvyebhir yo madhyamebhir uta nūtanebhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: He grew great by ancient praises, by middle ones, and also by recent ones.

children.text: viveṣa yan mā dhiṣaṇā jajāna stavai purā pāryād indram ahnaḥ
children.translated_text: When insight entered me and gave birth to praise, I praised <s>Indra</s> before the farthest day.

children.text: aṃhaso yatra pīparad yathā no nāveva yāntam ubhaye havante ||
children.translated_text: There he carried us across distress, as one traveling in a boat is called upon from both sides.

children.text: āpūrṇo asya kalaśaḥ svāhā sekteva kośaṃ sisice pibadhyai
children.translated_text: His beaker is full; with svāhā, as if pouring into a vessel, it has been filled for drinking.

children.text: sam u priyā āvavṛtran madāya pradakṣiṇid abhi somāsa indram ||
children.translated_text: The dear <s>soma</s>-draughts have turned together toward exhilaration, going rightward around <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: na tvā gabhīraḥ puruhūta sindhur nādrayaḥ pari ṣanto varanta
children.translated_text: Neither the deep river, O much-invoked one, nor the enclosing mountains hold you back.

children.text: itthā sakhibhya iṣito yad indrā dṛﾱhaṃ cid arujo gavyam ūrvam ||
children.translated_text: Thus, sent by your friends, O <s>Indra</s>, you broke open even the firm cow-rich enclosure.

children.text: śunaṃ huvema maghavānam indram asmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau
children.translated_text: May we auspiciously call upon bounteous <s>Indra</s> in this contest, the most manly one in the winning of prize.
