children.text: śṛṇvantam ugram ūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||
children.translated_text: May he, fierce, hearing us for aid in battles, slaying the <s>Vṛtras</s>, be the conqueror of wealth.

children.text: Chapter 267
pra parvatānām uśatī upasthād aśve iva viṣite hāsamāne
children.translated_text: From the lap of the mountains the eager ones came forth, like two mares let loose and neighing.

children.text: gāveva śubhre mātarā rihāṇe vipāṭ chutudrī payasā javete ||
children.translated_text: Like two bright mother cows licking their calf, <s>Vipāś</s> and <s>Śutudrī</s> run swiftly with their waters.

children.text: indreṣite prasavam bhikṣamāṇe acchā samudraṃ rathyeva yāthaḥ
children.translated_text: Impelled by <s>Indra</s>, seeking the onward drive, you go toward the ocean as along a chariot road.

children.text: samārāṇe ūrmibhiḥ pinvamāne anyā vām anyām apy eti śubhre ||
children.translated_text: Joining together, swelling with waves, each of you, bright ones, approaches the other.

children.text: acchā sindhum mātṛtamām ayāsaṃ vipāśam urvīṃ subhagām aganma
children.translated_text: I have come to <s>Sindhu</s>, the most motherly, and we have reached broad, fortunate <s>Vipāś</s>.

children.text: vatsam iva mātarā saṃrihāṇe samānaṃ yonim anu saṃcarantī ||
children.translated_text: Like two mothers licking their calf, they move together along the same womb-channel.

children.text: enā vayam payasā pinvamānā anu yoniṃ devakṛtaṃ carantīḥ
children.translated_text: We, swelling with this water, move along the god-made channel.

children.text: na vartave prasavaḥ sargataktaḥ kiṃyur vipro nadyo johavīti ||
children.translated_text: The impulse, fixed for flowing, is not to be turned back. Why does the inspired sage call upon the rivers?

children.text: ramadhvam me vacase somyāya ṛtāvarīr upa muhūrtam evaiḥ
children.translated_text: Stop for my <s>soma</s>-worthy word, O truth-keeping ones, even for a moment.

children.text: pra sindhum acchā bṛhatī manīṣāvasyur ahve kuśikasya sūnuḥ ||
children.translated_text: With lofty thought, seeking favor, I, the son of <s>Kuśika</s>, have called aloud toward <s>Sindhu</s>.

children.text: indro asmāṁ aradad vajrabāhur apāhan vṛtram paridhiṃ nadīnām
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> of the vajra-arm dug us out; he struck down <s>Vṛtra</s>, the enclosure of the rivers.

children.text: devo 'nayat savitā supāṇis tasya vayam prasave yāma urvīḥ ||
children.translated_text: The god <s>Savitṛ</s>, of good hands, led us onward; at his impulse we go broadly.

children.text: pravācyaṃ śaśvadhā vīryaṃ tad indrasya karma yad ahiṃ vivṛścat
children.translated_text: That heroic deed of <s>Indra</s> must be proclaimed forever: the work by which he cut apart the serpent.

children.text: vi vajreṇa pariṣado jaghānāyann āpo 'yanam icchamānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: With the <s>vajra</s> he smashed the enclosing barriers; the waters went forth, seeking their course.

children.text: etad vaco jaritar māpi mṛṣṭhā ā yat te ghoṣān uttarā yugāni
children.translated_text: O singer, do not neglect this speech of mine, so that your proclamations may reach later generations.

children.text: uktheṣu kāro prati no juṣasva mā no ni kaḥ puruṣatrā namas te ||
children.translated_text: In the hymns, O singer, be pleased with us; do not cast us down in many places. Reverence to you.

children.text: o ṣu svasāraḥ kārave śṛṇota yayau vo dūrād anasā rathena
children.translated_text: Listen well, O sisters, to the singer; he has come to you from afar by wagon and chariot.

children.text: ni ṣū namadhvam bhavatā supārā adhoakṣāḥ sindhavaḥ srotyābhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bend yourselves low; become easy to cross, O rivers, low beneath the axles, with your streams.

children.text: ā te kāro śṛṇavāmā vacāṃsi yayātha dūrād anasā rathena
children.translated_text: O singer, we have heard your words, since you have come from afar by wagon and chariot.

children.text: ni te naṃsai pīpyāneva yoṣā maryāyeva kanyā śaśvacai te ||
children.translated_text: I shall bow down to you like a swelling young woman, like a maiden to a man; I shall always be so toward you.

children.text: yad aṅga tvā bharatāḥ saṃtareyur gavyan grāma iṣita indrajūtaḥ
children.translated_text: When the <s>Bharatas</s>, seeking cattle, the troop urged on and impelled by <s>Indra</s>, shall cross you,

children.text: arṣād aha prasavaḥ sargatakta ā vo vṛṇe sumatiṃ yajñiyānām ||
children.translated_text: then the outflow, driven by its impulse, shall speed on. I choose the good favor of those worthy of sacrifice.

children.text: atāriṣur bharatā gavyavaḥ sam abhakta vipraḥ sumatiṃ nadīnām
children.translated_text: The <s>Bharatas</s>, desirous of cattle, have crossed; the inspired seer has won the good favor of the rivers.

children.text: pra pinvadhvam iṣayantīḥ surādhā ā vakṣaṇāḥ pṛṇadhvaṃ yāta śībham ||
children.translated_text: Swell forth, you rich in gifts, setting us in motion; fill your channels and go swiftly.

children.text: ud va ūrmiḥ śamyā hantv āpo yoktrāṇi muñcata
children.translated_text: Let your wave rise up and strike the yoke-pin; O waters, loosen the harness-straps.

children.text: māduṣkṛtau vyenasāghnyau śūnam āratām ||
children.translated_text: Let the two harmless, sinless draught-animals not come to injury or distress.

children.text: Chapter 268
indraḥ pūrbhid ātirad dāsam arkair vidadvasur dayamāno vi śatrūn
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, breaker of strongholds, overcame the Dāsa with songs; finding wealth, showing mercy, he scattered the enemies.

children.text: brahmajūtas tanvā vāvṛdhāno bhūridātra āpṛṇad rodasī ubhe ||
children.translated_text: Urged by sacred speech, growing strong in his body, the giver of many gifts filled both heaven and earth.

children.text: makhasya te taviṣasya pra jūtim iyarmi vācam amṛtāya bhūṣan
children.translated_text: For your great, vigorous onset I send forth speech, adorning it for the immortal one.

children.text: indra kṣitīnām asi mānuṣīṇāṃ viśāṃ daivīnām uta pūrvayāvā ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, you go foremost among human peoples and also among divine clans.

children.text: indro vṛtram avṛṇocchardhanītiḥ pra māyinām aminād varpaṇītiḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, whose troop is bold, enclosed <s>Vrtra</s>; whose force casts down, he shattered the forms of the sorcerers.

children.text: ahan vyaṃsam uśadhag vaneṣv āvir dhenā akṛṇod rāmyāṇām ||
children.translated_text: He struck the shoulderless one down in the forests; he made manifest the fair streams of the night.

children.text: indraḥ svarṣā janayann ahāni jigāyośigbhiḥ pṛtanā abhiṣṭiḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, winning the sun, generating the days, conquered the battles with eager allies and aid.

children.text: prārocayan manave ketum ahnām avindaj jyotir bṛhate raṇāya ||
children.translated_text: He made the sign of days shine for <s>Manu</s>; he found the light for the great contest.

children.text: indras tujo barhaṇā ā viveśa nṛvad dadhāno naryā purūṇi
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, with power and greatness, entered, holding many manly deeds in manlike fashion.

children.text: acetayad dhiya imā jaritre premaṃ varṇam atiracchukram āsām ||
children.translated_text: He awakened these insights for the singer; he has extended their bright color forward.

children.text: maho mahāni panayanty asyendrasya karma sukṛtā purūṇi
children.translated_text: They praise the great, many, well-done deeds of this mighty <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: vṛjanena vṛjinān sam pipeṣa māyābhir dasyūṃr abhibhūtyojāḥ ||
children.translated_text: With force he crushed the crooked ones; with his powers of illusion he overcame the <s>Dasyus</s> by strength.

children.text: yudhendro mahnā varivaś cakāra devebhyaḥ satpatiś carṣaṇiprāḥ
children.translated_text: In battle <s>Indra</s>, by his greatness, made broad space for the gods, the true lord who fills peoples.

children.text: vivasvataḥ sadane asya tāni viprā ukthebhiḥ kavayo gṛṇanti ||
children.translated_text: In the dwelling of <s>Vivasvat</s>, inspired poets praise those deeds of his with hymns.

children.text: satrāsāhaṃ vareṇyaṃ sahodāṃ sasavāṃsaṃ svar apaś ca devīḥ
children.translated_text: The thoughtful ones rejoice in <s>Indra</s>, the overpowering, choice one, giver of strength, who has won the sun and the divine waters.

children.text: sasāna yaḥ pṛthivīṃ dyām utemām indram madanty anu dhīraṇāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He has won this earth and heaven too; the steadfast singers rejoice after him.

children.text: sasānātyāṁ uta sūryaṃ sasānendraḥ sasāna purubhojasaṃ gām
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> won the racer and the sun; <s>Indra</s> won the cow rich in many enjoyments.

children.text: hiraṇyayam uta bhogaṃ sasāna hatvī dasyūn prāryaṃ varṇam āvat ||
children.translated_text: He won the golden treasure and enjoyment; having slain the <s>Dasyus</s>, he protected the Aryan color.

children.text: indra oṣadhīr asanod ahāni vanaspatīṃr asanod antarikṣam
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> won the plants, the days, the forest trees, and the midspace.

children.text: bibheda valaṃ nunude vivāco 'thābhavad damitābhikratūnām ||
children.translated_text: He split <s>Vala</s>, drove away the loud-voiced ones, and then became the tamer of hostile designs.

children.text: śunaṃ huvema maghavānam indram asmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau
children.translated_text: Let us call well upon bountiful <s>Indra</s>, best of men, in this contest, in the winning of prizes,

children.text: śṛṇvantam ugram ūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||
children.translated_text: the fierce one who listens for aid in battles, slaying the <s>Vrtras</s>, conqueror of wealth.

children.text: Chapter 269
tiṣṭhā harī ratha ā yujyamānā yāhi vāyur na niyuto no accha
children.translated_text: Stand ready, your two bay horses being yoked to the chariot; come to us like <s>Vayu</s> with his teams.

children.text: pibāsy andho abhisṛṣṭo asme indra svāhā rarimā te madāya ||
children.translated_text: Drink the draught poured out for us, O <s>Indra</s>; with svāhā we have given it to you for exhilaration.

children.text: upājirā puruhūtāya saptī harī rathasya dhūrṣv ā yunajmi
children.translated_text: I yoke the swift pair, the two bay steeds, to the poles of the chariot for the much-invoked one.

children.text: dravad yathā sambhṛtaṃ viśvataś cid upemaṃ yajñam ā vahāta indram ||
children.translated_text: Let them run here from every side, as the collected offering runs, and bring <s>Indra</s> to this sacrifice.

children.text: upo nayasva vṛṣaṇā tapuṣpotem ava tvaṃ vṛṣabha svadhāvaḥ
children.translated_text: Lead the two strong, heat-glowing horses near; you, strong bull, self-powerful, set them loose here.

children.text: grasetām aśvā vi muceha śoṇā dive dive sadṛśīr addhi dhānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let the two red horses eat the grains day by day, alike for heaven.

children.text: brahmaṇā te brahmayujā yunajmi harī sakhāyā sadhamāda āśū
children.translated_text: With sacred speech, yoked by sacred speech, I yoke your two bay companions, swift and sharing the same exhilaration.

children.text: sthiraṃ rathaṃ sukham indrādhitiṣṭhan prajānan vidvāṁ upa yāhi somam ||
children.translated_text: Mounted upon the firm, easy-riding chariot, O <s>Indra</s>, come to the <s>Soma</s>, knowing and wise.

children.text: mā te harī vṛṣaṇā vītapṛṣṭhā ni rīraman yajamānāso anye
children.translated_text: Let no other sacrificers hold back your two strong bay horses with broad backs.

children.text: atyāyāhi śaśvato vayaṃ te 'raṃ sutebhiḥ kṛṇavāma somaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Come past them always; we shall make ourselves ready for you with the pressed <s>Somas</s>.

children.text: tavāyaṃ somas tvam ehy arvāṅ chaśvattamaṃ sumanā asya pāhi
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s> is yours; come here, kind-minded, and drink of it forever and ever.

children.text: asmin yajñe barhiṣy ā niṣadyā dadhiṣvemaṃ jaṭhara indum indra ||
children.translated_text: In this sacrifice, sitting down upon the sacred grass, O <s>Indra</s>, place this drop in your belly.

children.text: stīrṇaṃ te barhiḥ suta indra somaḥ kṛtā dhānā attave te haribhyām
children.translated_text: Your sacred grass is spread; the <s>Soma</s> is pressed, O <s>Indra</s>; the grains have been prepared for your two bay horses to eat.

children.text: tadokase puruśākāya vṛṣṇe marutvate tubhyaṃ rātā havīṃṣi ||
children.translated_text: To you, rich in many powers, the bull, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, the oblations have been given for your dwelling.

children.text: imaṃ naraḥ parvatās tubhyam āpaḥ sam indra gobhir madhumantam akran
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Indra</s>, men, mountains, and waters have made this honey-sweet drink together with cows.

children.text: tasyāgatyā sumanā ṛṣva pāhi prajānan vidvāṁ pathyā anu svāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Coming for it, O lofty one, drink with good mind, knowing and wise, along your own paths.

children.text: yāṁ ābhajo maruta indra some ye tvām avardhann abhavan gaṇas te
children.translated_text: Those <s>Maruts</s> whom you took as your share in the <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, who strengthened you and became your host,

children.text: tebhir etaṃ sajoṣā vāvaśāno 'gneḥ piba jihvayā somam indra ||
children.translated_text: with them, rejoicing together and eagerly desiring it, drink this <s>Soma</s> with the tongue of <s>Agni</s>, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: indra piba svadhayā cit sutasyāgner vā pāhi jihvayā yajatra
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, drink by your own power of the pressed drink, or drink with the tongue of <s>Agni</s>, O worshipful one.

children.text: adhvaryor vā prayataṃ śakra hastāddhotur vā yajñaṃ haviṣo juṣasva ||
children.translated_text: Or, O mighty one, accept the sacrifice and oblation offered from the hand of the <s>Adhvaryu</s> or of the <s>Hotr</s>.

children.text: śunaṃ huvema maghavānam indram asmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau
children.translated_text: Let us call well upon bountiful <s>Indra</s>, best of men, in this contest, in the winning of prizes,

children.text: śṛṇvantam ugram ūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||
children.translated_text: the fierce one who listens for aid in battles, slaying the <s>Vrtras</s>, conqueror of wealth.

children.text: Chapter 270
imām ū ṣu prabhṛtiṃ sātaye dhāḥ śaśvacchaśvad ūtibhir yādamānaḥ
children.translated_text: Set this present offering here for gain, you who move forever and ever with aids.

children.text: sute sute vāvṛdhe vardhanebhir yaḥ karmabhir mahadbhiḥ suśruto bhūt ||
children.translated_text: At every pressing he has grown through the things that strengthen him, he who by great deeds has become far-famed.

children.text: indrāya somāḥ pradivo vidānā ṛbhur yebhir vṛṣaparvā vihāyāḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Somas</s>, known from of old, are for <s>Indra</s>; by them <s>Rbhu</s>, bull-jointed, has ranged through the open spaces.

children.text: prayamyamānān prati ṣū gṛbhāyendra piba vṛṣadhūtasya vṛṣṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: As they are being set in motion, grasp them, O <s>Indra</s>; drink of the bull's bull-stirred draught.

children.text: pibā vardhasva tava ghā sutāsa indra somāsaḥ prathamā uteme
children.translated_text: Drink; grow strong. Indeed these pressed <s>Somas</s> are yours, O <s>Indra</s>, the first ones and these here also.

children.text: yathāpibaḥ pūrvyāṁ indra somāṁ evā pāhi panyo adyā navīyān ||
children.translated_text: As you drank the former <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, so drink today, praiseworthy one, the newer one.

children.text: mahāṁ amatro vṛjane virapśy ugraṃ śavaḥ patyate dhṛṣṇv ojaḥ
children.translated_text: Great, unmeasured, in the enclosure, mighty; fierce force and bold vigor hold lordship.

children.text: nāha vivyāca pṛthivī canainaṃ yat somāso haryaśvam amandan ||
children.translated_text: Not even the earth has encompassed him, when the <s>Somas</s> exhilarated the bay-horsed one.

children.text: mahāṁ ugro vāvṛdhe vīryāya samācakre vṛṣabhaḥ kāvyena
children.translated_text: Great and fierce, he grew for heroic power; the bull fashioned things together by poetic wisdom.

children.text: indro bhago vājadā asya gāvaḥ pra jāyante dakṣiṇā asya pūrvīḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is <s>Bhaga</s>, giver of prizes; his cows are born, and his many gifts of dakṣiṇā come forth.

children.text: pra yat sindhavaḥ prasavaṃ yathāyann āpaḥ samudraṃ rathyeva jagmuḥ
children.translated_text: When the rivers went forth according to their impulse, the waters went to the ocean like mares on a chariot-road.

children.text: ataś cid indraḥ sadaso varīyān yad īṃ somaḥ pṛṇati dugdho aṃśuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even from there <s>Indra</s> is wider than his seat, when the milked <s>Soma</s>, the stalk, fills him.

children.text: samudreṇa sindhavo yādamānā indrāya somaṃ suṣutam bharantaḥ
children.translated_text: The rivers, going together with the ocean, bringing the well-pressed <s>Soma</s> for <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: aṃśuṃ duhanti hastino bharitrair madhvaḥ punanti dhārayā pavitraiḥ ||
children.translated_text: milk the stalk with hands and bearers; they cleanse the honey-sweet one with a stream through the filters.

children.text: hradā iva kukṣayaḥ somadhānāḥ sam ī vivyāca savanā purūṇi
children.translated_text: Like pools are the bellies that hold <s>Soma</s>; he has spread out the many pressings.

children.text: annā yad indraḥ prathamā vy āśa vṛtraṃ jaghanvāṁ avṛṇīta somam ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Indra</s> first consumed the foods, having slain <s>Vrtra</s>, he chose the <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: ā tū bhara mākir etat pari ṣṭhād vidmā hi tvā vasupatiṃ vasūnām
children.translated_text: Bring it here; let no one hold this back. For we know you as lord of goods among goods.

children.text: indra yat te māhinaṃ datram asty asmabhyaṃ taddharyaśva pra yandhi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, whatever great gift is yours, give that forth to us, O bay-horsed one.

children.text: asme pra yandhi maghavann ṛjīṣinn indra rāyo viśvavārasya bhūreḥ
children.translated_text: Give forth to us, O bountiful, rich in the <s>Soma</s> draught, O <s>Indra</s>, much wealth desirable to all.

children.text: asme śataṃ śarado jīvase dhā asme vīrāñchaśvata indra śiprin ||
children.translated_text: For us set a hundred autumns for living; for us, O <s>Indra</s> <s>Śiprin</s>, set enduring heroes.

children.text: śunaṃ huvema maghavānam indram asmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau
children.translated_text: Let us call well upon bountiful <s>Indra</s>, best of men, in this contest, in the winning of prizes,

children.text: śṛṇvantam ugram ūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||
children.translated_text: the fierce one who listens for aid in battles, slaying the <s>Vrtras</s>, conqueror of wealth.

children.text: Chapter 271
vārtrahatyāya śavase pṛtanāṣāhyāya ca
children.translated_text: For strength in the slaying of <s>Vrtra</s>, and for the power that overcomes armies,

children.text: indra tvā vartayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: we set you in motion, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: arvācīnaṃ su te mana uta cakṣuḥ śatakrato
children.translated_text: Let your mind be turned toward us, and also your eye, O hundred-powered one;

children.text: indra kṛṇvantu vāghataḥ ||
children.translated_text: let the singers make it so, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: nāmāni te śatakrato viśvābhir gīrbhir īmahe
children.translated_text: Your names, O hundred-powered one, we seek with all songs,

children.text: indrābhimātiṣāhye ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, for overcoming hostile attacks.

children.text: puruṣṭutasya dhāmabhiḥ śatena mahayāmasi
children.translated_text: With the powers of the much-praised one, with a hundred, we magnify

children.text: indrasya carṣaṇīdhṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, the supporter of peoples.

children.text: indraṃ vṛtrāya hantave puruhūtam upa bruve
children.translated_text: I call upon much-invoked <s>Indra</s> for the slaying of <s>Vrtra</s>,

children.text: bhareṣu vājasātaye ||
children.translated_text: in contests, for the winning of prizes.

children.text: vājeṣu sāsahir bhava tvām īmahe śatakrato
children.translated_text: Be a conqueror in the prize-fights; you we seek, O hundred-powered one,

children.text: indra vṛtrāya hantave ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, for the slaying of <s>Vrtra</s>.

children.text: dyumneṣu pṛtanājye pṛtsutūrṣu śravassu ca
children.translated_text: In splendors, in battle-fights, in battle-thrusts, and in fame,

children.text: indra sākṣvābhimātiṣu ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, prevail amid hostile attacks.

children.text: śuṣmintamaṃ na ūtaye dyumninam pāhi jāgṛvim
children.translated_text: For our aid, guard the strongest, shining, wakeful

children.text: indra somaṃ śatakrato ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, hundred-powered one.

children.text: indriyāṇi śatakrato yā te janeṣu pañcasu
children.translated_text: The <s>Indra</s>-powers that are yours among the five peoples,

children.text: indra tāni ta ā vṛṇe ||
children.translated_text: those I choose for you, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: agann indra śravo bṛhad dyumnaṃ dadhiṣva duṣṭaram
children.translated_text: Great fame has come, O <s>Indra</s>; set in place an unconquerable brilliance,

children.text: ut te śuṣmaṃ tirāmasi ||
children.translated_text: and we extend your might.

children.text: arvāvato na ā gahy atho śakra parāvataḥ
children.translated_text: Come to us from nearby, and also, O <s>Śakra</s>, from afar;

children.text: u loko yas te adriva indreha tata ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: and from whatever world is yours, O stone-wielding <s>Indra</s>, come here from there.

children.text: Chapter 272
abhi taṣṭeva dīdhayā manīṣām atyo na vājī sudhuro jihānaḥ
children.translated_text: Like a fashioner with insight I sharpen my thought; like a well-yoked racehorse straining forward,

children.text: abhi priyāṇi marmṛśat parāṇi kavīṃr icchāmi saṃdṛśe sumedhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: may it touch the dear and distant things. Wise-minded, I desire the poets for sight.

children.text: inota pṛccha janimā kavīnām manodhṛtaḥ sukṛtas takṣata dyām
children.translated_text: Urge on and ask after the births of the poets; the well-doers, held by mind, fashioned heaven.

children.text: imā u te praṇyo vardhamānā manovātā adha nu dharmaṇi gman ||
children.translated_text: These praiseworthy ones of yours, growing, swift as thought, have now gone into the order.

children.text: ni ṣīm id atra guhyā dadhānā uta kṣatrāya rodasī sam añjan
children.translated_text: Having set down hidden things here, they also adorned the two world-halves for sovereignty.

children.text: sam mātrābhir mamire yemur urvī antar mahī samṛte dhāyase dhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: With measures they measured them together; they restrained the broad ones; in the great confluence they placed them for support.

children.text: ātiṣṭhantam pari viśve abhūṣañ chriyo vasānaś carati svarociḥ
children.translated_text: All adorned him as he stood above; clothed in splendors, he moves with his own light.

children.text: mahat tad vṛṣṇo asurasya nāmā viśvarūpo amṛtāni tasthau ||
children.translated_text: Great is that name of the bull, of the <s>Asura</s>; taking all forms, he has stood among the immortals.

children.text: asūta pūrvo vṛṣabho jyāyān imā asya śurudhaḥ santi pūrvīḥ
children.translated_text: The former, greater bull has generated; these many ancient strengthenings of his exist.

children.text: divo napātā vidathasya dhībhiḥ kṣatraṃ rājānā pradivo dadhāthe ||
children.translated_text: O two children of heaven, with the inspired thoughts of the rite, you two kings uphold sovereignty from of old.

children.text: trīṇi rājānā vidathe purūṇi pari viśvāni bhūṣathaḥ sadāṃsi
children.translated_text: O two kings, in the rite you adorn the three, the many, all the seats.

children.text: apaśyam atra manasā jaganvān vrate gandharvāṁ api vāyukeśān ||
children.translated_text: Here I saw, going with the mind, in the vow, even the <s>Gandharvas</s> with wind for hair.

children.text: tad in nv asya vṛṣabhasya dhenor ā nāmabhir mamire sakmyaṃ goḥ
children.translated_text: Then indeed, with names, they measured the kinship of this bull's cow,

children.text: anyad anyad asuryaṃ vasānā ni māyino mamire rūpam asmin ||
children.translated_text: clothing themselves in one and another divine power; the artful ones measured out form in him.

children.text: tad in nv asya savitur nakir me hiraṇyayīm amatiṃ yām aśiśret
children.translated_text: Then indeed no one takes from me this golden thought of <s>Savitar</s>, to which he has attached himself.

children.text: ā suṣṭutī rodasī viśvaminve apīva yoṣā janimāni vavre ||
children.translated_text: With good praises I approached the two world-halves, all-moving, as a woman wraps herself in births.

children.text: yuvam pratnasya sādhatho maho yad daivī svastiḥ pari ṇaḥ syātam
children.translated_text: You two accomplish what is ancient and great, when divine well-being may be around us.

children.text: gopājihvasya tasthuṣo virūpā viśve paśyanti māyinaḥ kṛtāni ||
children.translated_text: All the wonder-working ones see the varied works of the standing one whose tongue is a cowherd's.

children.text: śunaṃ huvema maghavānam indram asmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau
children.translated_text: Let us call well upon bountiful <s>Indra</s>, best of men, in this contest, in the winning of prizes,

children.text: śṛṇvantam ugram ūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||
children.translated_text: the fierce one who listens for aid in battles, slaying the <s>Vrtras</s>, conqueror of wealth.

children.text: Chapter 273
indram matir hṛda ā vacyamānācchā patiṃ stomataṣṭā jigāti
children.translated_text: A thought, being spoken from the heart, goes toward <s>Indra</s>, toward the lord, shaped as praise;

children.text: yā jāgṛvir vidathe śasyamānendra yat te jāyate viddhi tasya ||
children.translated_text: she who is wakeful, being lauded in the assembly: O <s>Indra</s>, know what is born for you from her.

children.text: divaś cid ā pūrvyā jāyamānā vi jāgṛvir vidathe śasyamānā
children.translated_text: Born even from heaven from of old, wakeful, being lauded in the assembly,

children.text: bhadrā vastrāṇy arjunā vasānā seyam asme sanajā pitryā dhīḥ ||
children.translated_text: wearing auspicious, white garments: this is our inborn ancestral thought.

children.text: yamā cid atra yamasūr asūta jihvāyā agram patad ā hy asthāt
children.translated_text: Even <s>Yamasū</s> bore <s>Yama</s> here; the tip of the tongue fell down and stood firm.

children.text: vapūṃṣi jātā mithunā sacete tamohanā tapuṣo budhna etā ||
children.translated_text: The forms, born as a pair, follow together; these are darkness-slayers from the root of heat.

children.text: nakir eṣāṃ ninditā martyeṣu ye asmākam pitaro goṣu yodhāḥ
children.translated_text: None among mortals can blame those who were our fathers, warriors for the cows.

children.text: indra eṣāṃ dṛṃhitā māhināvān ud gotrāṇi sasṛje daṃsanāvān ||
children.translated_text: Mighty <s>Indra</s> was their fortifier; powerful in deeds, he released the cow-stalls.

children.text: sakhā ha yatra sakhibhir navagvair abhijñv ā satvabhir gā anugman
children.translated_text: Where, as a friend with friendly <s>Navagvas</s>, with the active ones, he went after the cows, bending forward,

children.text: satyaṃ tad indro daśabhir daśagvaiḥ sūryaṃ viveda tamasi kṣiyantam ||
children.translated_text: that was true: <s>Indra</s>, with the ten <s>Daśagvas</s>, found the sun dwelling in darkness.

children.text: indro madhu saṃbhṛtam usriyāyām padvad viveda śaphavan name goḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> found the honey stored in the ruddy cow, the footed and hoofed name of the cow.

children.text: guhā hitaṃ guhyaṃ gūḍham apsu haste dadhe dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇāvān ||
children.translated_text: Hidden in secret, concealed in the waters, he, rich in gifts, placed it in his right hand.

children.text: jyotir vṛṇīta tamaso vijānann āre syāma duritād abhīke
children.translated_text: Knowing the light apart from darkness, he chose the light; may we be far from evil close at hand.

children.text: imā giraḥ somapāḥ somavṛddha juṣasvendra purutamasya kāroḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, drinker of <s>Soma</s>, strengthened by <s>Soma</s>, accept these songs of the very abundant singer.

children.text: jyotir yajñāya rodasī anu ṣyād āre syāma duritasya bhūreḥ
children.translated_text: May the light follow heaven and earth for the sacrifice; may we be far from abundant evil.

children.text: bhūri ciddhi tujato martyasya supārāso vasavo barhaṇāvat ||
children.translated_text: For even from the much-assailing mortal, O <s>Vasus</s>, you are good ferrymen with protection.

children.text: śunaṃ huvema maghavānam indram asmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau
children.translated_text: Let us call well upon bountiful <s>Indra</s>, best of men, in this contest, in the winning of prizes,

children.text: śṛṇvantam ugram ūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||
children.translated_text: the fierce one who listens for aid in battles, slaying the <s>Vrtras</s>, conqueror of wealth.

children.text: Chapter 274
indra tvā vṛṣabhaṃ vayaṃ sute some havāmahe
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, bull, we call you when the <s>Soma</s> has been pressed;

children.text: sa pāhi madhvo andhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: drink of the sweet draught.

children.text: indra kratuvidaṃ sutaṃ somaṃ harya puruṣṭuta
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, much-praised one, delight in the pressed <s>Soma</s> that knows inspired power;

children.text: pibā vṛṣasva tātṛpim ||
children.translated_text: drink, become strong, and be fully satisfied.

children.text: indra pra ṇo dhitāvānaṃ yajñaṃ viśvebhir devebhiḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, bring forward our inspired sacrifice together with all the gods;

children.text: tira stavāna viśpate ||
children.translated_text: carry it across, O praised lord of the clans.

children.text: indra somāḥ sutā ime tava pra yanti satpate
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, these pressed <s>Somas</s> go forth to you, lord of the good;

children.text: kṣayaṃ candrāsa indavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the bright drops go to your dwelling.

children.text: dadhiṣvā jaṭhare sutaṃ somam indra vareṇyam
children.translated_text: Place the pressed, choice <s>Soma</s> in your belly, O <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: tava dyukṣāsa indavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the shining drops are yours.

children.text: girvaṇaḥ pāhi naḥ sutam madhor dhārābhir ajyase
children.translated_text: O lover of song, drink our pressed <s>Soma</s>; you are anointed with streams of sweetness.

children.text: indra tvādātam id yaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, glory is indeed given by you.

children.text: abhi dyumnāni vanina indraṃ sacante akṣitā
children.translated_text: Unfailing splendors, desirous of gain, attend <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: pītvī somasya vāvṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: having drunk of <s>Soma</s>, he has grown.

children.text: arvāvato na ā gahi parāvataś ca vṛtrahan
children.translated_text: Come to us from nearby and from afar, O slayer of <s>Vrtra</s>;

children.text: imā juṣasva no giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: accept these songs of ours.

children.text: yad antarā parāvatam arvāvataṃ ca hūyase
children.translated_text: When you are called from between the far region and the near,

children.text: indreha tata ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: from there come here, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 275
ā tū na indra madryagghuvānaḥ somapītaye
children.translated_text: Come now to us, O <s>Indra</s>, called hither for the drinking of <s>Soma</s>;

children.text: haribhyāṃ yāhy adrivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with your two bay horses, come, O stone-wielder.

children.text: satto hotā na ṛtviyas tistire barhir ānuṣak
children.translated_text: The <s>Hotr</s> has sat down like one in season; the sacred grass has been spread in order;

children.text: ayujran prātar adrayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the pressing-stones have been yoked in the morning.

children.text: imā brahma brahmavāhaḥ kriyanta ā barhiḥ sīda
children.translated_text: These sacred formulations, bearers of sacred speech, are being made; sit down upon the sacred grass.

children.text: vīhi śūra puroﾱāśam ||
children.translated_text: Drink, O hero, the <s>puroḍāśa</s> (sacrificial cake).

children.text: rārandhi savaneṣu ṇa eṣu stomeṣu vṛtrahan
children.translated_text: Gladden yourself for us at these pressings, in these praises, O slayer of <s>Vrtra</s>;

children.text: uktheṣv indra girvaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: in the recitations, O <s>Indra</s>, lover of song.

children.text: matayaḥ somapām uruṃ rihanti śavasas patim
children.translated_text: The thoughts lick the wide <s>Soma</s>-drinker, the lord of strength,

children.text: indraṃ vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, like mothers licking a calf.

children.text: sa mandasvā hy andhaso rādhase tanvā mahe
children.translated_text: So rejoice in the draught for reward, in your body, for greatness;

children.text: na stotāraṃ nide karaḥ ||
children.translated_text: do not set the singer in contempt.

children.text: vayam indra tvāyavo haviṣmanto jarāmahe
children.translated_text: We, desiring you, O <s>Indra</s>, bearing oblations, praise you into old age;

children.text: uta tvam asmayur vaso ||
children.translated_text: and you, O good one, are desirous of us.

children.text: māre asmad vi mumuco haripriyārvāṅ yāhi
children.translated_text: Do not release yourself far away from us, lover of the bay horses; come hither.

children.text: indra svadhāvo matsveha ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, self-powerful one, rejoice here.

children.text: arvāñcaṃ tvā sukhe rathe vahatām indra keśinā
children.translated_text: Let the two long-maned horses carry you hither in the easy chariot, O <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: ghṛtasnū barhir āsade ||
children.translated_text: to sit upon the ghee-sprinkled sacred grass.

children.text: Chapter 276
upa naḥ sutam ā gahi somam indra gavāśiram
children.translated_text: Come near to our pressed <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, mixed with cow's milk,

children.text: haribhyāṃ yas te asmayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: with your two bay horses that are desirous of us.

children.text: tam indra madam ā gahi barhiṣṭhāṃ grāvabhiḥ sutam
children.translated_text: Come to that exhilaration, O <s>Indra</s>, pressed with stones on the best sacred grass;

children.text: kuvin nv asya tṛpṇavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: perhaps now you will be satisfied with it.

children.text: indram itthā giro mamācchāgur iṣitā itaḥ
children.translated_text: Thus my songs, impelled from here, have gone straight toward <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: āvṛte somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: for the repeated drinking of <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: indraṃ somasya pītaye stomair iha havāmahe
children.translated_text: We call <s>Indra</s> here with praises for the drinking of <s>Soma</s>;

children.text: ukthebhiḥ kuvid āgamat ||
children.translated_text: perhaps he will come with the recitations.

children.text: indra somāḥ sutā ime tān dadhiṣva śatakrato
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, these <s>Somas</s> have been pressed; place them, O hundred-powered one,

children.text: jaṭhare vājinīvaso ||
children.translated_text: in your belly, O possessor of steeds.

children.text: vidmā hi tvā dhanañjayaṃ vājeṣu dadhṛṣaṃ kave
children.translated_text: For we know you as winner of wealth, bold in contests, O poet;

children.text: adhā te sumnam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: therefore we seek your favor.

children.text: imam indra gavāśiraṃ yavāśiraṃ ca naḥ piba
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, drink this <s>Soma</s> of ours, mixed with cow's milk and mixed with barley,

children.text: āgatyā vṛṣabhiḥ sutam ||
children.translated_text: pressed by the bulls after you have come.

children.text: tubhyed indra sva okye somaṃ codāmi pītaye
children.translated_text: For you alone, O <s>Indra</s>, in your own home I stir the <s>Soma</s> for drinking;

children.text: eṣa rārantu te hṛdi ||
children.translated_text: let this delight settle in your heart.

children.text: tvāṃ sutasya pītaye pratnam indra havāmahe
children.translated_text: We <s>Kuśikas</s>, seeking aid, call you, ancient <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: kuśikāso avasyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for the drinking of the pressed <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: Chapter 277
ā yāhy arvāṅ upa vandhureṣṭhās taved anu pradivaḥ somapeyam
children.translated_text: Come hither and take your place on the chariot-seat; the <s>Soma</s>-drinking from ancient days is yours.

children.text: priyā sakhāyā vi mucopa barhis tvām ime havyavāho havante ||
children.translated_text: Release your beloved companions and come to the sacred grass; these oblation-bearers call you.

children.text: ā yāhi pūrvīr ati carṣaṇīr āṃ arya āśiṣa upa no haribhyām
children.translated_text: Come here past many peoples, O noble one, with your bay horses, to our blessings;

children.text: imā hi tvā mataya stomataṣṭā indra havante sakhyaṃ juṣāṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: for these thoughts, fashioned into praise, call you, O <s>Indra</s>, enjoying friendship.

children.text: ā no yajñaṃ namovṛdhaṃ sajoṣā indra deva haribhir yāhi tūyam
children.translated_text: Come quickly to our sacrifice, grown by reverence, with one accord, O god <s>Indra</s>, with your bay horses;

children.text: ahaṃ hi tvā matibhir johavīmi ghṛtaprayāḥ sadhamāde madhūnām ||
children.translated_text: for I call you with my thoughts to the common feast of sweets rich in ghee.

children.text: ā ca tvām etā vṛṣaṇā vahāto harī sakhāyā sudhurā svaṅgā
children.translated_text: And let those two virile bay horses, friendly, well-yoked and fair-limbed, bring you,

children.text: dhānāvad indraḥ savanaṃ juṣāṇaḥ sakhā sakhyuḥ śṛṇavad vandanāni ||
children.translated_text: while <s>Indra</s>, with grain, enjoying the pressing, hears a friend's praises as a friend.

children.text: kuvin mā gopāṃ karase janasya kuvid rājānam maghavann ṛjīṣin
children.translated_text: Perhaps you will make me guardian of the people; perhaps, O bountiful <s>Maghavan</s>, a king rich in <s>Soma</s>;

children.text: kuvin ma ṛṣim papivāṃsaṃ sutasya kuvin me vasvo amṛtasya śikṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: perhaps, after drinking of the pressed <s>Soma</s>, you will make me a seer; perhaps you will grant me immortal wealth.

children.text: ā tvā bṛhanto harayo yujānā arvāg indra sadhamādo vahantu
children.translated_text: Let the great yoked bay horses bring you hither, O <s>Indra</s>, to the common exhilaration,

children.text: pra ye dvitā diva ṛñjanty ātāḥ susaṃmṛṣṭāso vṛṣabhasya mūrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: they who, extended, brighten heaven doubly, the well-groomed steeds of the bull.

children.text: indra piba vṛṣadhūtasya vṛṣṇa ā yaṃ te śyena uśate jabhāra
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, drink of the strong, bull-stirred <s>Soma</s> which the eagle brought to you as you desired;

children.text: yasya made cyāvayasi pra kṛṣṭīr yasya made apa gotrā vavartha ||
children.translated_text: in whose exhilaration you shake the peoples, in whose exhilaration you opened the cow-stalls.

children.text: śunaṃ huvema maghavānam indram asmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau
children.translated_text: Let us call well upon bountiful <s>Indra</s>, best of men, in this contest, in the winning of prizes.

children.text: śṛṇvantam ugram ūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||
children.translated_text: May he, fierce and listening for aid in battles, slaying the <s>Vṛtras</s>, be the conqueror of riches.

children.text: Chapter 278
ayaṃ te astu haryataḥ soma ā haribhiḥ sutaḥ
children.translated_text: Let this exhilarating <s>Soma</s>, pressed with the bay horses, be yours.

children.text: juṣāṇa indra haribhir na ā gahy ā tiṣṭha haritaṃ ratham ||
children.translated_text: Enjoying it, O <s>Indra</s>, come to us with your bay horses; mount the bay-colored chariot.

children.text: haryann uṣasam arcayaḥ sūryaṃ haryann arocayaḥ
children.translated_text: Longing for the dawn, you made it shine; longing for the sun, you made it gleam.

children.text: vidvāṃś cikitvān haryaśva vardhasa indra viśvā abhi śriyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Knowing and discerning, O bay-horsed <s>Indra</s>, grow toward all splendors.

children.text: dyām indro haridhāyasam pṛthivīṃ harivarpasam
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> upheld the sky with its golden hue and the earth with its golden form.

children.text: adhārayaddharitor bhūri bhojanaṃ yayor antar hariś carat ||
children.translated_text: He upheld the abundant food of the two bay ones, between whom the golden one moves.

children.text: jajñāno harito vṛṣā viśvam ā bhāti rocanam
children.translated_text: Born, the tawny bull shines over the whole luminous realm.

children.text: haryaśvo haritaṃ dhatta āyudham ā vajram bāhvor harim ||
children.translated_text: The bay-horsed one takes up the bay weapon, the tawny <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt), in his two arms.

children.text: indro haryantam arjunaṃ vajraṃ śukrair abhīvṛtam
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> took the bright, tawny <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt), surrounded with shining powers.

children.text: apāvṛṇoddharibhir adribhiḥ sutam ud gā haribhir ājata ||
children.translated_text: With the bay stones he opened what had been pressed; with the bay ones he drove forth the cows.

children.text: Chapter 279
ā mandrair indra haribhir yāhi mayūraromabhiḥ
children.translated_text: Come, O <s>Indra</s>, with your gladdening bay horses, whose hair is like a peacock's plumage.

children.text: mā tvā kecin ni yaman viṃ na pāśino 'ti dhanveva tāṁ ihi ||
children.translated_text: Let not any restrainers, like snare-setters, hold you back; cross over them as over a desert.

children.text: vṛtrakhādo valaṃrujaḥ purāṃ darmo apām ajaḥ
children.translated_text: Devourer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, breaker of <s>Vala</s>, shatterer of forts, driver of the waters,

children.text: sthātā rathasya haryor abhisvara indro dṛﾱhā cid ārujaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, standing at the resounding chariot of the two bay horses, breaks even what is firm.

children.text: gambhīrāṁ udadhīṃr iva kratum puṣyasi gā iva
children.translated_text: You strengthen insight, like deep oceans, like cows.

children.text: pra sugopā yavasaṃ dhenavo yathā hradaṃ kulyā ivāśata ||
children.translated_text: As well-guarded cows seek pasture, and as channels seek a lake, so they come forward.

children.text: ā nas tujaṃ rayim bharāṃśaṃ na pratijānate
children.translated_text: Bring us vigorous wealth, a share for the one who acknowledges it.

children.text: vṛkṣam pakvam phalam aṅkīva dhūnuhīndra sampāraṇaṃ vasu ||
children.translated_text: Like a fruit-laden branch shaking a ripe tree, O <s>Indra</s>, shake down wealth that carries us across.

children.text: svayur indra svarāﾱ asi smaddiṣṭiḥ svayaśastaraḥ
children.translated_text: Self-guided, O <s>Indra</s>, you are self-ruling; by your own command you are richer in fame.

children.text: sa vāvṛdhāna ojasā puruṣṭuta bhavā naḥ suśravastamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Growing by strength, O much-praised one, become for us the most renowned.

children.text: Chapter 280
yudhmasya te vṛṣabhasya svarāja ugrasya yūna sthavirasya ghṛṣveḥ
children.translated_text: Of you, the fighting bull, self-ruling, fierce, youthful, old, and bold,

children.text: ajūryato vajriṇo vīryāṇīndra śrutasya mahato mahāni ||
children.translated_text: of the ageless <s>vajra</s>-bearer, O <s>Indra</s>, the powers are famous, great, and mighty.

children.text: mahāṁ asi mahiṣa vṛṣṇyebhir dhanaspṛd ugra sahamāno anyān
children.translated_text: You are great, O mighty bull, with virile powers, seeking wealth, fierce, overpowering others.

children.text: eko viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā sa yodhayā ca kṣayayā ca janān ||
children.translated_text: Alone you are king of the whole world; therefore make people fight and make them settle.

children.text: pra mātrābhī ririce rocamānaḥ pra devebhir viśvato apratītaḥ
children.translated_text: Shining, he surpassed the measures; he surpassed the gods on every side, irresistible.

children.text: pra majmanā diva indraḥ pṛthivyāḥ proror maho antarikṣād ṛjīṣī ||
children.translated_text: By his greatness <s>Indra</s> surpassed heaven and earth, and the broad, mighty midspace, O drinker of Soma's dregs.

children.text: uruṃ gabhīraṃ januṣābhy ugraṃ viśvavyacasam avatam matīnām
children.translated_text: The <s>Somas</s>, pressed from of old, flow toward <s>Indra</s>, vast, deep, fierce by birth, all-pervading, the well of thoughts,

children.text: indraṃ somāsaḥ pradivi sutāsaḥ samudraṃ na sravata ā viśanti ||
children.translated_text: as streams enter the ocean.

children.text: yaṃ somam indra pṛthivīdyāvā garbhaṃ na mātā bibhṛtas tvāyā
children.translated_text: That <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, which earth and heaven bear for you like a mother bears an embryo,

children.text: taṃ te hinvanti tam u te mṛjanty adhvaryavo vṛṣabha pātavā u ||
children.translated_text: that one the <s>adhvaryus</s> impel, that one they cleanse for you to drink, O bull.

children.text: Chapter 281
marutvāṁ indra vṛṣabho raṇāya pibā somam anuṣvadham madāya
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> with the <s>Maruts</s>, bull for the battle, drink <s>Soma</s> according to your portion, for exhilaration.

children.text: ā siñcasva jaṭhare madhva ūrmiṃ tvaṃ rājāsi pradivaḥ sutānām ||
children.translated_text: Pour into your belly the wave of sweetness; you are king from of old over the pressed drinks.

children.text: sajoṣā indra sagaṇo marudbhiḥ somam piba vṛtrahā śūra vidvān
children.translated_text: In harmony, O <s>Indra</s>, together with your troop of <s>Maruts</s>, drink <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer, hero and knowing one.

children.text: jahi śatrūṃr apa mṛdho nudasvāthābhayaṃ kṛṇuhi viśvato naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Strike down the enemies; drive away the scorners, and then make us fearless on every side.

children.text: uta ṛtubhir ṛtupāḥ pāhi somam indra devebhiḥ sakhibhiḥ sutaṃ naḥ
children.translated_text: And, as keeper of the seasons, drink our pressed <s>Soma</s> with the seasons, O <s>Indra</s>, together with the gods, your friends.

children.text: yāṁ ābhajo maruto ye tvānv ahan vṛtram adadhus tubhyam ojaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Maruts</s> whom you joined, who followed you on the day you struck <s>Vṛtra</s>, placed strength in you.

children.text: ye tvāhihatye maghavann avardhan ye śāmbare harivo ye gaviṣṭau
children.translated_text: Those who strengthened you in the serpent-slaying, O bountiful one; those, O bay-horsed one, in the fight with <s>Śambara</s> and in the quest for cows;

children.text: ye tvā nūnam anumadanti viprāḥ pibendra somaṃ sagaṇo marudbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: those inspired ones who now approve you: drink <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, together with your troop of <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: marutvantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vāvṛdhānam akavāriṃ divyaṃ śāsam indram
children.translated_text: Let us call here for new aid that <s>Indra</s> with the <s>Maruts</s>, the bull, growing strong, unassailable, heavenly ruler,

children.text: viśvāsāham avase nūtanāyograṃ sahodām iha taṃ huvema ||
children.translated_text: the all-overpowering, fierce giver of strength.

children.text: Chapter 282
sadyo ha jāto vṛṣabhaḥ kanīnaḥ prabhartum āvad andhasaḥ sutasya
children.translated_text: Just now born, a young bull, he called out to take the pressed draught.

children.text: sādhoḥ piba pratikāmaṃ yathā te rasāśiraḥ prathamaṃ somyasya ||
children.translated_text: Drink, as you desire, from the good first sweetness of the Soma-mixture.

children.text: yaj jāyathās tad ahar asya kāme 'ṃśoḥ pīyūṣam apibo giriṣṭhām
children.translated_text: On the day you were born, for love of it, you drank the mountain-high sap of the stalk.

children.text: taṃ te mātā pari yoṣā janitrī mahaḥ pitur dama āsiñcad agre ||
children.translated_text: Your mother, the young woman who bore you, first poured it for you in the house of the great father.

children.text: upasthāya mātaram annam aiṭṭa tigmam apaśyad abhi somam ūdhaḥ
children.translated_text: Having approached his mother, he asked for food; he saw the sharp <s>Soma</s> at the udder.

children.text: prayāvayann acarad gṛtso anyān mahāni cakre purudhapratīkaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Driving others away, the clever one moved about; many-faced, he performed great deeds.

children.text: ugras turāṣāﾱ abhibhūtyojā yathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ cakra eṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Fierce, victorious, with overpowering strength, he made his body according to his will.

children.text: tvaṣṭāram indro januṣābhibhūyāmuṣyā somam apibac camūṣu ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, overcoming <s>Tvaṣṭar</s> by birth, drank that one's <s>Soma</s> in the bowls.

children.text: śunaṃ huvema maghavānam indram asmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau
children.translated_text: May we auspiciously call upon bounteous <s>Indra</s> in this contest, the most manly one in the winning of prize.

children.text: śṛṇvantam ugram ūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||
children.translated_text: May he, fierce and listening for aid in battles, slaying the <s>Vṛtras</s>, be the conqueror of riches.

children.text: Chapter 283
śaṃsā mahām indraṃ yasmin viśvā ā kṛṣṭayaḥ somapāḥ kāmam avyan
children.translated_text: Proclaim great <s>Indra</s>, in whom all peoples, Soma-drinkers, have fulfilled their desire.

children.text: yaṃ sukratuṃ dhiṣaṇe vibhvataṣṭaṃ ghanaṃ vṛtrāṇāṃ janayanta devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The gods generated him, the skillful one shaped by the two <s>Dhiṣaṇās</s>, the smasher of <s>Vṛtras</s>.

children.text: yaṃ nu nakiḥ pṛtanāsu svarājaṃ dvitā tarati nṛtamaṃ hariṣṭhām
children.translated_text: Him, self-ruling in battles, whom no one overcomes twice, the most manly, best with the bay horses,

children.text: inatamaḥ satvabhir yo ha śūṣaiḥ pṛthujrayā aminād āyur dasyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: the most forceful, who with his powers and broad sweep diminished the life of the <s>Dasyu</s>.

children.text: sahāvā pṛtsu taraṇir nārvā vyānaśī rodasī mehanāvān
children.translated_text: Strong in contests, a crosser like a racehorse, he has spread through heaven and earth, rich in outpouring.

children.text: bhago na kāre havyo matīnām piteva cāruḥ suhavo vayodhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like <s>Bhaga</s> for the singer, he is worthy of invocation by thoughts; like a dear father, easy to call and life-giving.

children.text: dhartā divo rajasas pṛṣṭa ūrdhvo ratho na vāyur vasubhir niyutvān
children.translated_text: Upright, he is the supporter of heaven, of the back of the atmosphere; like a chariot, like <s>Vāyu</s>, he is yoked with the goods.

children.text: kṣapāṃ vastā janitā sūryasya vibhaktā bhāgaṃ dhiṣaṇeva vājam ||
children.translated_text: Clothing the nights, generating the sun, like <s>Dhiṣaṇā</s> he apportions the share and the prize.

children.text: śunaṃ huvema maghavānam indram asmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau
children.translated_text: May we auspiciously call upon bounteous <s>Indra</s> in this contest, the most manly one in the winning of prize.

children.text: śṛṇvantam ugram ūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||
children.translated_text: the fierce one who listens for aid in battles, slaying the <s>Vrtras</s>, conqueror of wealth.

children.text: Chapter 284
indraḥ svāhā pibatu yasya soma āgatyā tumro vṛṣabho marutvān
children.translated_text: Let <s>Indra</s>, with svaha, drink the <s>Soma</s>; having come, the stout bull accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: oruvyacāḥ pṛṇatām ebhir annair āsya havis tanvaḥ kāmam ṛdhyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: wide-ranging, let him be filled with these foods; may the oblation for his mouth and body prosper according to desire.

children.text: ā te saparyū javase yunajmi yayor anu pradivaḥ śruṣṭim āvaḥ
children.translated_text: For your swiftness I yoke to you the worshipful pair, by whom, from of old, you have heeded the call.

children.text: iha tvā dheyur harayaḥ suśipra pibā tv asya suṣutasya cāroḥ ||
children.translated_text: Here let the bay steeds set you down, O fair-lipped one; drink of this well-pressed, pleasant draught.

children.text: gobhir mimikṣuṃ dadhire supāram indraṃ jyaiṣṭhyāya dhāyase gṛṇānāḥ
children.translated_text: Praising, they have set <s>Indra</s>, mingled with milk, easy to bring across, for supremacy and nourishment.

children.text: mandānaḥ somam papivāṁ ṛjīṣin sam asmabhyam purudhā gā iṣaṇya ||
children.translated_text: Exhilarated, having drunk the <s>Soma</s>, O rich in the pressed draught, impel cows and sustenance for us in many ways.

children.text: imaṃ kāmam mandayā gobhir aśvaiś candravatā rādhasā paprathaś ca
children.translated_text: Gladden this desire with cows and horses, and spread yourself out with shining wealth.

children.text: svaryavo matibhis tubhyaṃ viprā indrāya vāhaḥ kuśikāso akran ||
children.translated_text: Desiring heaven, the inspired <s>Kusikas</s> have made an offering with their thoughts for you, for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: śunaṃ huvema maghavānam indram asmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau
children.translated_text: Let us call well upon bountiful <s>Indra</s>, best of men, in this contest, in the winning of prizes,

children.text: śṛṇvantam ugram ūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||
children.translated_text: the fierce one who listens for aid in battles, slaying the <s>Vrtras</s>, conqueror of wealth.

children.text: Chapter 285
carṣaṇīdhṛtam maghavānam ukthyam indraṃ giro bṛhatīr abhy anūṣata
children.translated_text: The lofty songs have sung toward <s>Indra</s>, supporter of peoples, bountiful, worthy of hymns,

children.text: vāvṛdhānam puruhūtaṃ suvṛktibhir amartyaṃ jaramāṇaṃ dive dive ||
children.translated_text: growing through good recitations, much-invoked, immortal, praised day by day.

children.text: śatakratum arṇavaṃ śākinaṃ naraṃ giro ma indram upa yanti viśvataḥ
children.translated_text: My songs go from every side to <s>Indra</s>, the hundred-powered, mighty, capable man, like a flood,

children.text: vājasanim pūrbhidaṃ tūrṇim apturaṃ dhāmasācam abhiṣācaṃ svarvidam ||
children.translated_text: winner of booty, breaker of strongholds, swift, active, companion of the dwelling, overpowering, finder of light.

children.text: ākare vasor jaritā panasyate 'nehasa stubha indro duvasyati
children.translated_text: At the source of wealth the singer praises him; in faultless laudation <s>Indra</s> is served.

children.text: vivasvataḥ sadana ā hi pipriye satrāsāham abhimātihanaṃ stuhi ||
children.translated_text: In the dwelling of <s>Vivasvat</s> he has delighted; praise the conqueror in battle, the slayer of attackers.

children.text: nṛṇām u tvā nṛtamaṃ gīrbhir ukthair abhi pra vīram arcatā sabādhaḥ
children.translated_text: You, best man among men, the hero, praise forth with songs and hymns amid all pressures.

children.text: saṃ sahase purumāyo jihīte namo asya pradiva eka īśe ||
children.translated_text: He rushes forward for strength, rich in many powers; he alone has ruled reverence from primeval time.

children.text: pūrvīr asya niṣṣidho martyeṣu purū vasūni pṛthivī bibharti
children.translated_text: Many are his stores among mortals; the earth bears his many riches.

children.text: indrāya dyāva oṣadhīr utāpo rayiṃ rakṣanti jīrayo vanāni ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s>, heaven, the plants, and the waters guard wealth, as do the swift forests.

children.text: tubhyam brahmāṇi gira indra tubhyaṃ satrā dadhire harivo juṣasva
children.translated_text: For you are the sacred words, the songs, O <s>Indra</s>; for you they have been set down always. O bay-horsed one, enjoy them.

children.text: bodhy āpir avaso nūtanasya sakhe vaso jaritṛbhyo vayo dhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Be mindful of this newest aid; be a helper, O friend, O good one, and grant vitality to the singers.

children.text: indra marutva iha pāhi somaṃ yathā śāryāte apibaḥ sutasya
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> with the <s>Maruts</s>, drink the <s>Soma</s> here, as you drank of the pressed draught at <s>Saryata</s>'s rite.

children.text: tava praṇītī tava śūra śarmann ā vivāsanti kavayaḥ suyajñāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Under your guidance and your shelter, O hero, the wise poets, good sacrificers, eagerly serve.

children.text: sa vāvaśāna iha pāhi somam marudbhir indra sakhibhiḥ sutaṃ naḥ
children.translated_text: Longing for it, drink the <s>Soma</s> here, O <s>Indra</s>, with the <s>Maruts</s>, your friends, our pressed draught,

children.text: jātaṃ yat tvā pari devā abhūṣan mahe bharāya puruhūta viśve ||
children.translated_text: which, when you were born, all the gods adorned for the great prize, O much-invoked one.

children.text: aptūrye maruta āpir eṣo 'mandann indram anu dātivārāḥ
children.translated_text: In the swift course this ally, the <s>Maruts</s>, followed; the liberal givers exhilarated <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: tebhiḥ sākam pibatu vṛtrakhādaḥ sutaṃ somaṃ dāśuṣaḥ sve sadhasthe ||
children.translated_text: Together with them let the devourer of <s>Vrtra</s> drink the pressed <s>Soma</s> of the worshipper in his own seat.

children.text: idaṃ hy anv ojasā sutaṃ rādhānām pate
children.translated_text: For this, O lord of gifts, has indeed been pressed by strength;

children.text: pibā tv asya girvaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: drink of it, O lover of songs.

children.text: yas te anu svadhām asat sute ni yaccha tanvam
children.translated_text: Whatever in the pressed draught is according to your own nature, set that in your body;

children.text: sa tvā mamattu somyam ||
children.translated_text: let that <s>Soma</s> exhilarate you.

children.text: pra te aśnotu kukṣyoḥ prendra brahmaṇā śiraḥ
children.translated_text: Let it reach into your two bellies; let sacred speech reach your head, O <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: pra bāhū śūra rādhase ||
children.translated_text: let it reach your arms for bounty, O hero.

children.text: Chapter 286
dhānāvantaṃ karambhiṇam apūpavantam ukthinam
children.translated_text: Rich in grain, mixed with karambha, furnished with cakes, and accompanied by hymns,

children.text: indra prātar juṣasva naḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, enjoy our morning offering.

children.text: puroﾱāśam pacatyaṃ juṣasvendrā gurasva ca
children.translated_text: Enjoy the cooked purodasa, O <s>Indra</s>, and swallow it down;

children.text: tubhyaṃ havyāni sisrate ||
children.translated_text: the oblations stream toward you.

children.text: puroﾱāśaṃ ca no ghaso joṣayāse giraś ca naḥ
children.translated_text: Eat our purodasa too, and take pleasure also in our songs,

children.text: vadhūyur iva yoṣaṇām ||
children.translated_text: like a bridegroom delighting in a young woman.

children.text: puroﾱāśaṃ sanaśruta prātaḥsāve juṣasva naḥ
children.translated_text: O famed from of old, enjoy our purodasa at the morning pressing;

children.text: indra kratur hi te bṛhan ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, for your power is great.

children.text: mādhyandinasya savanasya dhānāḥ puroﾱāśam indra kṛṣveha cārum
children.translated_text: At the midday pressing, O <s>Indra</s>, make the grain and the purodasa pleasing here,

children.text: pra yat stotā jaritā tūrṇyartho vṛṣāyamāṇa upa gīrbhir īṭṭe ||
children.translated_text: when the praiser, the singer hastening to his aim, calls to you with songs, acting like a bull.

children.text: tṛtīye dhānāḥ savane puruṣṭuta puroﾱāśam āhutam māmahasva naḥ
children.translated_text: At the third pressing, O much-praised one, magnify for us the grain and the offered purodasa;

children.text: ṛbhumantaṃ vājavantaṃ tvā kave prayasvanta upa śikṣema dhītibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: may we, with our thoughts, seek instruction from you, O poet, accompanied by the <s>Rbhus</s>, rich in strength and rich in nourishment.

children.text: pūṣaṇvate te cakṛmā karambhaṃ harivate haryaśvāya dhānāḥ
children.translated_text: For you, together with <s>Pusan</s>, we have made karambha; for you, bay-horsed and having bay steeds, the grains.

children.text: apūpam addhi sagaṇo marudbhiḥ somam piba vṛtrahā śūra vidvān ||
children.translated_text: Eat the cake, together with your troop and the <s>Maruts</s>; drink the <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Vrtra</s>-slaying hero, knowing one.

children.text: prati dhānā bharata tūyam asmai puroﾱāśaṃ vīratamāya nṛṇām
children.translated_text: Bring forth the grains quickly for him, and the purodasa for the most heroic of men;

children.text: dive dive sadṛśīr indra tubhyaṃ vardhantu tvā somapeyāya dhṛṣṇo ||
children.translated_text: day by day, alike for you, O <s>Indra</s>; may they strengthen you for <s>Soma</s>-drinking, O bold one.

children.text: Chapter 287
indrāparvatā bṛhatā rathena vāmīr iṣa ā vahataṃ suvīrāḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Parvata</s>, with your great chariot bring desirable foods rich in heroes;

children.text: vītaṃ havyāny adhvareṣu devā vardhethāṃ gīrbhir iﾱayā madantā ||
children.translated_text: drink the oblations at the sacrifices, O gods; grow through songs, rejoicing with <s>Ila</s>.

children.text: tiṣṭhā su kam maghavan mā parā gāḥ somasya nu tvā suṣutasya yakṣi
children.translated_text: Stay here happily, O bountiful one; do not go away. Now I worship you with the well-pressed <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: pitur na putraḥ sicam ā rabhe ta indra svādiṣṭhayā girā śacīvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like a son I grasp the garment-edge of his father, O powerful <s>Indra</s>, with the sweetest song.

children.text: śaṃsāvādhvaryo prati me gṛṇīhīndrāya vāhaḥ kṛṇavāva juṣṭam
children.translated_text: Praise, O <s>Adhvaryu</s>; answer my song. Let us make an acceptable offering for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: edam barhir yajamānasya sīdāthā ca bhūd uktham indrāya śastam ||
children.translated_text: Sit upon this sacred grass of the sacrificer; then let the hymn be recited for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: jāyed astam maghavan sed u yonis tad it tvā yuktā harayo vahantu
children.translated_text: Your wife is at home, O bountiful one, and there is your proper seat; let the yoked bay steeds carry you there.

children.text: yadā kadā ca sunavāma somam agniṣ ṭvā dūto dhanvāty accha ||
children.translated_text: Whenever we press <s>Soma</s>, let <s>Agni</s> the messenger run toward you.

children.text: parā yāhi maghavann ā ca yāhīndra bhrātar ubhayatrā te artham
children.translated_text: Go away, O bountiful <s>Indra</s>, and come again, brother; in both places there is purpose for you,

children.text: yatrā rathasya bṛhato nidhānaṃ vimocanaṃ vājino rāsabhasya ||
children.translated_text: where the resting place of the great chariot is, the unyoking of the racer and the ass.

children.text: apāḥ somam astam indra pra yāhi kalyāṇīr jāyā suraṇaṃ gṛhe te
children.translated_text: You have drunk the <s>Soma</s>; go home, O <s>Indra</s>. Your fair wife and delight are in your house.

children.text: yatrā rathasya bṛhato nidhānaṃ vimocanaṃ vājino dakṣiṇāvat ||
children.translated_text: where the resting-place of the great chariot is, the unyoking of the prize-winning steed rich in gifts.

children.text: ime bhojā aṅgiraso virūpā divas putrāso asurasya vīrāḥ
children.translated_text: These generous <s>Aṅgirases</s>, manifold in form, sons of heaven, heroic sons of the <s>Asura</s>,

children.text: viśvāmitrāya dadato maghāni sahasrasāve pra tiranta āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: giving splendid gifts to <s>Viśvāmitra</s>, extend their life toward the thousandfold pressing.

children.text: rūpaṃ rūpam maghavā bobhavīti māyāḥ kṛṇvānas tanvam pari svām
children.translated_text: In form after form the bountiful one appears, making powers of illusion around his own body.

children.text: trir yad divaḥ pari muhūrtam āgāt svair mantrair anṛtupā ṛtāvā ||
children.translated_text: When, in a threefold moment, he has gone around heaven, by his own spells, not bound to season yet possessing order.

children.text: mahāṁ ṛṣir devajā devajūto 'stabhnāt sindhum arṇavaṃ nṛcakṣāḥ
children.translated_text: The great seer, born of the gods, urged by the gods, seeing men, held back the oceanic <s>Sindhu</s>,

children.text: viśvāmitro yad avahat sudāsam apriyāyata kuśikebhir indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: when <s>Viśvāmitra</s> carried <s>Sudās</s> across; <s>Indra</s> became favorable with the <s>Kuśikas</s>.

children.text: haṃsā iva kṛṇutha ślokam adribhir madanto gīrbhir adhvare sute sacā
children.translated_text: Like swans, make a hymn with the pressing-stones, rejoicing with songs at the sacrifice beside the pressed draught.

children.text: devebhir viprā ṛṣayo nṛcakṣaso vi pibadhvaṃ kuśikāḥ somyam madhu ||
children.translated_text: With the gods, O inspired seers who see men, drink deeply, O <s>Kuśikas</s>, of the <s>Soma</s>-honey.

children.text: upa preta kuśikāś cetayadhvam aśvaṃ rāye pra muñcatā sudāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Come near, O <s>Kuśikas</s>; rouse yourselves. Release the horse of <s>Sudās</s> for wealth.

children.text: rājā vṛtraṃ jaṅghanat prāg apāg udag athā yajāte vara ā pṛthivyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The king will strike down <s>Vṛtra</s> east, west, and north; then let him sacrifice on the chosen place of the earth.

children.text: ya ime rodasī ubhe aham indram atuṣṭavam
children.translated_text: I, who have praised <s>Indra</s> across both heaven and earth,

children.text: viśvāmitrasya rakṣati brahmedam bhārataṃ janam ||
children.translated_text: this sacred utterance of <s>Viśvāmitra</s> protects the <s>Bhārata</s> people.

children.text: viśvāmitrā arāsata brahmendrāya vajriṇe
children.translated_text: The <s>Viśvāmitras</s> have offered sacred speech to <s>Indra</s>, bearer of the thunderbolt.

children.text: karad in naḥ surādhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May he make us rich in good bounty.

children.text: kiṃ te kṛṇvanti kīkaṭeṣu gāvo nāśiraṃ duhre na tapanti gharmam
children.translated_text: What do the cows among the <s>Kīkaṭas</s> do for you? They do not milk a strengthening draught; they do not heat the warm oblation.

children.text: ā no bhara pramagandasya vedo naicāśākham maghavan randhayā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bring us the wealth of <s>Pramaganda</s>; O bountiful one, make the low-branching one subject to us.

children.text: sasarparīr amatim bādhamānā bṛhan mimāya jamadagnidattā
children.translated_text: <s>Sasarparī</s>, driving away dullness, has roared mightily, given by <s>Jamadagni</s>.

children.text: ā sūryasya duhitā tatāna śravo deveṣv amṛtam ajuryam ||
children.translated_text: The daughter of the sun has stretched immortal, undecaying fame among the gods.

children.text: sasarparīr abharat tūyam ebhyo 'dhi śravaḥ pāñcajanyāsu kṛṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: <s>Sasarparī</s> swiftly brought fame for these among the fivefold peoples,

children.text: sā pakṣyā navyam āyur dadhānā yām me palastijamadagnayo daduḥ ||
children.translated_text: she, winged, placing new life, whom the <s>Palastis</s> and <s>Jamadagnis</s> gave to me.

children.text: sthirau gāvau bhavatāṃ vīﾱur akṣo meṣā vi varhi mā yugaṃ vi śāri
children.translated_text: Let the two oxen be steady; let the axle be firm. Let not the yoke be loosened or split apart.

children.text: indraḥ pātalye dadatāṃ śarītor ariṣṭaneme abhi naḥ sacasva ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Indra</s> give protection to the two drawing animals; with unbroken wheel-rims, accompany us.

children.text: balaṃ dhehi tanūṣu no balam indrānaﾱutsu naḥ
children.translated_text: Place strength in our bodies, strength, O <s>Indra</s>, in our draught-cattle.

children.text: balaṃ tokāya tanayāya jīvase tvaṃ hi baladā asi ||
children.translated_text: Place strength in child and offspring, for life; for you are the giver of strength.

children.text: abhi vyayasva khadirasya sāram ojo dhehi spandane śiṃśapāyām
children.translated_text: Wrap yourself around the core of khadira wood; place vigor in the spandana and the śiṃśapā.

children.text: akṣa vīﾱo vīﾱita vīﾱayasva mā yāmād asmād ava jīhipo naḥ ||
children.translated_text: O axle, strong and strengthened, make yourself firm; do not let us slip down from this journey.

children.text: ayam asmān vanaspatir mā ca hā mā ca rīriṣat
children.translated_text: May this lord of the forest not abandon us and not injure us.

children.text: svasty ā gṛhebhya āvasā ā vimocanāt ||
children.translated_text: With well-being, may he bring us homeward with aid, all the way to the unyoking.

children.text: indrotibhir bahulābhir no adya yācchreṣṭhābhir maghavañchūra jinva
children.translated_text: With many helps, O <s>Indra</s>, aid us today; with the best of them, O bountiful hero, quicken us.

children.text: yo no dveṣṭy adharaḥ sas padīṣṭa yam u dviṣmas tam u prāṇo jahātu ||
children.translated_text: May the one who hates us fall beneath our feet; and whom we hate, may his life-breath abandon him.

children.text: paraśuṃ cid vi tapati śimbalaṃ cid vi vṛścati
children.translated_text: Even the axe heats and splits; even the śimbala tree it cuts apart.

children.text: ukhā cid indra yeṣantī prayastā phenam asyati ||
children.translated_text: Even the pot, O <s>Indra</s>, when set on and boiling over, casts out foam.

children.text: na sāyakasya cikite janāso lodhaṃ nayanti paśu manyamānāḥ
children.translated_text: People do not understand the arrow; they lead a load, thinking it an animal.

children.text: nāvājinaṃ vājinā hāsayanti na gardabham puro aśvān nayanti ||
children.translated_text: Racers do not mock the non-racer, nor do they lead a donkey in front of horses.

children.text: ima indra bharatasya putrā apapitvaṃ cikitur na prapitvam
children.translated_text: These sons of <s>Bharata</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, have known the going away, not the coming near.

children.text: hinvanty aśvam araṇaṃ na nityaṃ jyāvājam pari ṇayanty ājau ||
children.translated_text: They keep urging the untamed horse, as if not always in the wilderness; they lead it around in the contest for the prize won by the bowstring.

children.text: Chapter 288
imam mahe vidathyāya śūṣaṃ śaśvat kṛtva īḍyāya pra jabhruḥ
children.translated_text: They have borne forth this powerful hymn for the great assembly, made forever praiseworthy.

children.text: śṛṇotu no damyebhir anīkaiḥ śṛṇotv agnir divyair ajasraḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s> hear us with his domestic faces; may the unfailing one hear with his heavenly faces.

children.text: mahi mahe dive arcā pṛthivyai kāmo ma icchañcarati prajānan
children.translated_text: For great heaven and great earth I sing; desire, seeking me, moves about with understanding.

children.text: yayor ha stome vidatheṣu devāḥ saparyavo mādayante sacāyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: In the praise of these two, at the assemblies, the worshipful gods rejoice together with their companions.

children.text: yuvor ṛtaṃ rodasī satyam astu mahe ṣu ṇaḥ suvitāya pra bhūtam
children.translated_text: May your truth, O Heaven and Earth, be real; arise widely for our great welfare.

children.text: idaṃ dive namo agne pṛthivyai saparyāmi prayasā yāmi ratnam ||
children.translated_text: This reverence is for heaven and for earth, O <s>Agni</s>; I attend upon them and go with offering toward treasure.

children.text: uto hi vām pūrvyā āvividra ṛtāvarī rodasī satyavācaḥ
children.translated_text: For indeed men of old have known you two, O truth-bearing Heaven and Earth, speakers of truth.

children.text: naraś cid vāṃ samithe śūrasātau vavandire pṛthivi vevidānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even men have praised you in the contest and in heroic winning, O wide-knowing earth.

children.text: ko addhā veda ka iha pra vocad devāṁ acchā pathyā kā sam eti
children.translated_text: Who truly knows, who here will declare what path goes together toward the gods?

children.text: dadṛśra eṣām avamā sadāṃsi pareṣu yā guhyeṣu vrateṣu ||
children.translated_text: Their lower seats are seen; the farther ones are in hidden observances.

children.text: kavir nṛcakṣā abhi ṣīm acaṣṭa ṛtasya yonā vighṛte madantī
children.translated_text: The poet who sees men has looked toward them, rejoicing in the separated womb of truth.

children.text: nānā cakrāte sadanaṃ yathā veḥ samānena kratunā saṃvidāne ||
children.translated_text: They have made their dwelling apart, as a bird does, yet in concord with a common will.

children.text: samānyā viyute dūreante dhruve pade tasthatur jāgarūke
children.translated_text: Common yet separated, at distant ends, they have stood in their fixed station, wakeful.

children.text: uta svasārā yuvatī bhavantī ād u bruvāte mithunāni nāma ||
children.translated_text: And, being youthful sisters, they speak the paired names.

children.text: viśved ete janimā saṃ vivikto maho devān bibhratī na vyathete
children.translated_text: All these births have been distinguished; bearing the greatness of the gods, the two do not tremble.

children.text: ejad dhruvam patyate viśvam ekaṃ carat patatri viṣuṇaṃ vi jātam ||
children.translated_text: One whole, moving and fixed, flying and going, born in diverse ways, is set in motion.

children.text: sanā purāṇam adhy emy ārān mahaḥ pitur janitur jāmi tan naḥ
children.translated_text: I approach the ancient one anew, from nearby: that kinship of the great father and begetter is ours.

children.text: devāso yatra panitāra evair urau pathi vyute tasthur antaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There the gods, praisers with their ways, have stood within the broad, opened path.

children.text: imaṃ stomaṃ rodasī pra bravīmy ṛdūdarāḥ śṛṇavann agnijihvāḥ
children.translated_text: I proclaim this hymn to Heaven and Earth; may the flame-tongued ones with rich bounty hear it.

children.text: mitraḥ samrājo varuṇo yuvāna ādityāsaḥ kavayaḥ paprathānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, the sovereign <s>Varuṇa</s>, the youthful <s>Ādityas</s>, the wise ones who have spread wide, hear it.

children.text: hiraṇyapāṇiḥ savitā sujihvas trir ā divo vidathe patyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: Golden-handed <s>Savitṛ</s>, fair-tongued, presiding three times from heaven at the rite,

children.text: deveṣu ca savitaḥ ślokam aśrer ād asmabhyam ā suva sarvatātim ||
children.translated_text: among the gods, O <s>Savitṛ</s>, you have taken up the hymn; therefore impel complete welfare for us.

children.text: sukṛt supāṇiḥ svavāṁ ṛtāvā devas tvaṣṭāvase tāni no dhāt
children.translated_text: A good maker, fair-handed, self-possessed, keeper of order, the god <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> shall set those things for our aid.

children.text: pūṣaṇvanta ṛbhavo mādayadhvam ūrdhvagrāvāṇo adhvaram ataṣṭa ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Ṛbhus</s>, accompanied by <s>Pūṣan</s>, rejoice; with the pressing stones raised up, you have arranged the sacrifice.

children.text: vidyudrathā maruta ṛṣṭimanto divo maryā ṛtajātā ayāsaḥ
children.translated_text: May the <s>Maruts</s>, whose chariots are lightning, bearing spears, the young heroes of heaven, born of truth, untiring,

children.text: sarasvatī śṛṇavan yajñiyāso dhātā rayiṃ sahavīraṃ turāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and may <s>Sarasvatī</s> hear; may the worshipful ones and <s>Dhātṛ</s> swiftly grant wealth together with heroic sons.

children.text: viṣṇuṃ stomāsaḥ purudasmam arkā bhagasyeva kāriṇo yāmani gman
children.translated_text: The praises and songs have gone to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, wondrous in many ways, as workers go to <s>Bhaga</s> on his course.

children.text: urukramaḥ kakuho yasya pūrvīr na mardhanti yuvatayo janitrīḥ ||
children.translated_text: He is the wide-strider; his many heights the youthful motherly powers do not crush.

children.text: indro viśvair vīryaiḥ patyamāna ubhe ā paprau rodasī mahitvā
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, lordly through all his heroic powers, has filled both heaven and earth with his greatness.

children.text: purandaro vṛtrahā dhṛṣṇuṣeṇaḥ saṃgṛbhyā na ā bharā bhūri paśvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Breaker of forts, slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, with a bold host, seize and bring to us much livestock.

children.text: nāsatyā me pitarā bandhupṛcchā sajātyam aśvinoś cāru nāma
children.translated_text: O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, my fathers, kinsmen to be asked about kinship, fair is the common name of the <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: yuvaṃ hi stho rayidau no rayīṇāṃ dātraṃ rakṣethe akavair adabdhā ||
children.translated_text: For you two are givers of wealth to us among riches; unharmed and unbetrayed by the hostile, you guard the gift.

children.text: mahat tad vaḥ kavayaś cāru nāma yaddha devā bhavatha viśva indre
children.translated_text: Great is that fair name of yours, O inspired ones, when, O gods, you all are present in <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: sakha ṛbhubhiḥ puruhūta priyebhir imāṃ dhiyaṃ sātaye takṣatā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: O much-invoked one, as a friend with the dear <s>Ṛbhus</s>, fashion this thought of ours for winning.

children.text: aryamā ṇo aditir yajñiyāso 'dabdhāni varuṇasya vratāni
children.translated_text: May <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, the worshipful gods, and the unbroken ordinances of <s>Varuṇa</s>

children.text: yuyota no anapatyāni gantoḥ prajāvān naḥ paśumāṁ astu gātuḥ ||
children.translated_text: keep childlessness away from our path; may our going be rich in offspring and rich in cattle.

children.text: devānāṃ dūtaḥ purudha prasūto 'nāgān no vocatu sarvatātā
children.translated_text: May the messenger of the gods, sent forth in many ways, declare us sinless on every side.

children.text: śṛṇotu naḥ pṛthivī dyaur utāpaḥ sūryo nakṣatrair urv antarikṣam ||
children.translated_text: May earth hear us, and heaven and the waters; may the sun with the stars hear, and the broad midspace.

children.text: śṛṇvantu no vṛṣaṇaḥ parvatāso dhruvakṣemāsa iﾱayā madantaḥ
children.translated_text: May the virile mountains hear us, firm in their security and rejoicing with refreshment.

children.text: ādityair no aditiḥ śṛṇotu yacchantu no marutaḥ śarma bhadram ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Aditi</s> with the <s>Ādityas</s> hear us; may the <s>Maruts</s> grant us auspicious shelter.

children.text: sadā sugaḥ pitumāṁ astu panthā madhvā devā oṣadhīḥ sam pipṛkta
children.translated_text: May the path always be easy and full of nourishment; O gods, mix the plants with sweetness.

children.text: bhago me agne sakhye na mṛdhyā ud rāyo aśyāṃ sadanam purukṣoḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, do not injure me in friendship with <s>Bhaga</s>; may I rise to the dwelling of abundant wealth.

children.text: svadasva havyā sam iṣo didīhy asmadryak sam mimīhi śravāṃsi
children.translated_text: Enjoy the oblations; kindle the foods together; measure out fame toward us.

children.text: viśvāṁ agne pṛtsu tāñ jeṣi śatrūn ahā viśvā sumanā dīdihī naḥ ||
children.translated_text: All those enemies in battles, O <s>Agni</s>, you conquer; shine kindly upon us every day.

children.text: Chapter 289
uṣasaḥ pūrvā adha yad vyūṣur mahad vi jajñe akṣaram pade goḥ
children.translated_text: When the former dawns then dawned forth, the great imperishable one was born in the station of the cow.

children.text: vratā devānām upa nu prabhūṣan mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: They adorned the ordinances of the gods: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.
