children.text: mo ṣū ṇo atra juhuranta devā mā pūrve agne pitaraḥ padajñāḥ
children.translated_text: Do not, O gods, abandon us here; let not the former fathers, O <s>Agni</s>, the knowers of the path, fail us.

children.text: purāṇyoḥ sadmanoḥ ketur antar mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: A sign is within the two ancient seats: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.

children.text: vi me purutrā patayanti kāmāḥ śamy acchā dīdye pūrvyāṇi
children.translated_text: My desires fly in many directions; I look toward the ancient things for well-being.

children.text: samiddhe agnāv ṛtam id vadema mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Agni</s> is kindled, may we speak the truth itself: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.

children.text: samāno rājā vibhṛtaḥ purutrā śaye śayāsu prayuto vanānu
children.translated_text: A single king, distributed in many places, lies in resting places, sent forth among the woods.

children.text: anyā vatsam bharati kṣeti mātā mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: Another mother bears the calf and dwells there: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.

children.text: ākṣit pūrvāsv aparā anūrut sadyo jātāsu taruṇīṣv antaḥ
children.translated_text: He has shone among the former and the later, within the young ones born at once and unobstructed.

children.text: antarvatīḥ suvate apravītā mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: Pregnant and unrevealed, they give birth: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.

children.text: śayuḥ parastād adha nu dvimātābandhanaś carati vatsa ekaḥ
children.translated_text: The one calf lies far away, and now, bound to two mothers, he wanders.

children.text: mitrasya tā varuṇasya vratāni mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: Those are the ordinances of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.

children.text: dvimātā hotā vidatheṣu samrāﾱ anv agraṃ carati kṣeti budhnaḥ
children.translated_text: The two-mothered <s>Hotṛ</s>, sovereign in the rites, follows the forefront and dwells in the depth.

children.text: pra raṇyāni raṇyavāco bharante mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: They bring forth delightful things, they of delightful voices: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.

children.text: śūrasyeva yudhyato antamasya pratīcīnaṃ dadṛśe viśvam āyat
children.translated_text: As with the nearest part of a hero fighting, the whole approaching expanse is seen.

children.text: antar matiś carati niṣṣidhaṃ gor mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: Thought moves within the hidden enclosure of the cow: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.

children.text: ni veveti palito dūta āsv antar mahāṃś carati rocanena
children.translated_text: The grey-haired messenger roars among them; the great one moves within the shining realm.

children.text: vapūṃṣi bibhrad abhi no vi caṣṭe mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: Bearing forms, he looks upon us on every side: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.

children.text: viṣṇur gopāḥ paramam pāti pāthaḥ priyā dhāmāny amṛtā dadhānaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the herdsman, guards the highest path, holding the dear immortal abodes.

children.text: agniṣ ṭā viśvā bhuvanāni veda mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> knows all those worlds: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.

children.text: nānā cakrāte yamyā vapūṃṣi tayor anyad rocate kṛṣṇam anyat
children.translated_text: The twin sisters have made various forms; of the two, one shines dark, the other bright.

children.text: śyāvī ca yad aruṣī ca svasārau mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: When the dusky and the ruddy sisters appear: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.

children.text: mātā ca yatra duhitā ca dhenū sabardughe dhāpayete samīcī
children.translated_text: Where mother and daughter, two milch cows, together give milk for the same calf,

children.text: ṛtasya te sadasīﾱe antar mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: there your two seats of truth are within: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.

children.text: anyasyā vatsaṃ rihatī mimāya kayā bhuvā ni dadhe dhenur ūdhaḥ
children.translated_text: Licking another's calf, the cow has lowed; by what power has the cow set down her udder?

children.text: ṛtasya sā payasāpinvateﾱā mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: She swells with the milk of truth: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.

children.text: padyā vaste pururūpā vapūṃṣy ūrdhvā tasthau tryaviṃ rerihāṇā
children.translated_text: The many-formed one clothes herself in many shapes; standing upright, she licks the three-year-old.

children.text: ṛtasya sadma vi carāmi vidvān mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: Knowing, I move through the dwelling of truth: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.

children.text: pade iva nihite dasme antas tayor anyad guhyam āvir anyat
children.translated_text: As if set down in a wondrous place, of the two one is hidden and the other manifest.

children.text: sadhrīcīnā pathyā sā viṣūcī mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: Moving together, that path is also divergent: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.

children.text: ā dhenavo dhunayantām aśiśvīḥ sabardughāḥ śaśayā apradugdhāḥ
children.translated_text: Let the milk-cows shake themselves, calf-less, giving milk together, lying still and unmilked.

children.text: navyā navyā yuvatayo bhavantīr mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: Ever new, ever new, becoming young women: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.

children.text: yad anyāsu vṛṣabho roravīti so anyasmin yūthe ni dadhāti retaḥ
children.translated_text: When the bull bellows among other cows, he places seed in another herd.

children.text: sa hi kṣapāvān sa bhagaḥ sa rājā mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: He is lord of the nights; he is <s>Bhaga</s>; he is king: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.

children.text: vīrasya nu svaśvyaṃ janāsaḥ pra nu vocāma vidur asya devāḥ
children.translated_text: Now, people, let us proclaim the good-horsed power of the hero; the gods know what belongs to him.

children.text: ṣoﾱhā yuktāḥ pañca pañcā vahanti mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: Yoked in six ways, five by five they carry: great is the one <s>asuratva</s> (divine lordship) of the gods.

children.text: devas tvaṣṭā savitā viśvarūpaḥ pupoṣa prajāḥ purudhā jajāna
children.translated_text: The god <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, <s>Savitṛ</s>, of all forms, nourished the creatures and generated them in many ways.

children.text: imā ca viśvā bhuvanāny asya mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: And all these worlds are his; great is the single lordly power of the gods.

children.text: mahī sam airac camvā samīcī ubhe te asya vasunā nyṛṣṭe
children.translated_text: The two great bowls have been brought together, meeting one another; both are set down for him with wealth.

children.text: śṛṇve vīro vindamāno vasūni mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: The hero is heard as he wins treasures; great is the single lordly power of the gods.

children.text: imāṃ ca naḥ pṛthivīṃ viśvadhāyā upa kṣeti hitamitro na rājā
children.translated_text: And this all-supporting earth dwells near for us, like a king whose friend is well placed,

children.text: puraḥsadaḥ śarmasado na vīrā mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: like heroes sitting in front and sitting in shelter; great is the single lordly power of the gods.

children.text: niṣṣidhvarīs ta oṣadhīr utāpo rayiṃ ta indra pṛthivī bibharti
children.translated_text: Your plants that provide a resting-place, and also the waters, and the earth bear wealth for you, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: sakhāyas te vāmabhājaḥ syāma mahad devānām asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: May we be your companions, sharers in good things; great is the single lordly power of the gods.

children.text: Chapter 290
na tā minanti māyino na dhīrā vratā devānām prathamā dhruvāṇi
children.translated_text: Neither the wonder-workers nor the wise violate the first, fixed ordinances of the gods.

children.text: na rodasī adruhā vedyābhir na parvatā niname tasthivāṃsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Neither the guileless Heaven and Earth with their insights, nor the standing mountains, bend down.

children.text: ṣaḍ bhārāṁ eko acaran bibharty ṛtaṃ varṣiṣṭham upa gāva āguḥ
children.translated_text: One, moving about, bears six burdens; the cows have come to the highest <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: tisro mahīr uparās tasthur atyā guhā dve nihite darśy ekā ||
children.translated_text: Three great upper ones stood there; two are hidden in secret, and one is visible.

children.text: tripājasyo vṛṣabho viśvarūpa uta tryudhā purudha prajāvān
children.translated_text: The threefold-strong bull, of every form, three-uddered, manifold, rich in offspring,

children.text: tryanīkaḥ patyate māhināvān sa retodhā vṛṣabhaḥ śaśvatīnām ||
children.translated_text: three-faced, rules with greatness; he is the seed-bearing bull of the eternal ones.

children.text: abhīka āsām padavīr abodhy ādityānām ahve cāru nāma
children.translated_text: The path of these was perceived face to face; I invoked the lovely name of the <s>Ādityas</s>.

children.text: āpaś cid asmā aramanta devīḥ pṛthag vrajantīḥ pari ṣīm avṛñjan ||
children.translated_text: Even the divine waters took pleasure in him; moving separately, they enclosed him all around.

children.text: trī ṣadhasthā sindhavas triḥ kavīnām uta trimātā vidatheṣu samrāṭ
children.translated_text: The rivers are three seats, thrice belonging to the poets; and the sovereign in the assemblies has three mothers.

children.text: ṛtāvarīr yoṣaṇās tisro apyās trir ā divo vidathe patyamānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The three watery maidens, rich in <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), rule three times from heaven in the rite.

children.text: trir ā divaḥ savitar vāryāṇi dive diva ā suva trir no ahnaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Savitṛ</s>, from heaven impel desirable things three times; day by day, three times in the day, impel them for us.

children.text: tridhātu rāya ā suvā vasūni bhaga trātar dhiṣaṇe sātaye dhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: With threefold substance, impel riches and treasures; O <s>Bhaga</s>, protector, O <s>Dhiṣaṇā</s>, set them down for winning.

children.text: trir ā divaḥ savitā soṣavīti rājānā mitrāvaruṇā supāṇī
children.translated_text: Three times from heaven <s>Savitṛ</s> will impel; the two kings <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, fair-handed,

children.text: āpaś cid asya rodasī cid urvī ratnam bhikṣanta savituḥ savāya ||
children.translated_text: even the waters and the two broad worlds beg a jewel for his impulse, for the impulse of <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: trir uttamā dūṇaśā rocanāni trayo rājanty asurasya vīrāḥ
children.translated_text: Three are the highest shining realms, hard to assail; three heroes of the Asura shine forth.

children.text: ṛtāvāna iṣirā dūﾱabhāsas trir ā divo vidathe santu devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Rich in <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), vigorous, hard to deceive, may the gods be present three times from heaven at the rite.

children.text: Chapter 291
pra me vivikvāṁ avidan manīṣāṃ dhenuṃ carantīm prayutām agopām
children.translated_text: My thought has discovered the discerning one, the milk-cow wandering, set loose, without a herdsman.

children.text: sadyaś cid yā duduhe bhūri dhāser indras tad agniḥ panitāro asyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: At once she has yielded much abundance; <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> are her praisers.

children.text: indraḥ su pūṣā vṛṣaṇā suhastā divo na prītāḥ śaśayaṃ duduhre
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> and <s>Pūṣan</s>, the two virile ones with good hands, delighted as from heaven, have milked her as she lay there.

children.text: viśve yad asyāṃ raṇayanta devāḥ pra vo 'tra vasavaḥ sumnam aśyām ||
children.translated_text: When all the gods rejoiced in her, may I here obtain your favor, O <s>Vasus</s>.

children.text: yā jāmayo vṛṣṇa icchanti śaktiṃ namasyantīr jānate garbham asmin
children.translated_text: The sister cows, revering, seek the bull's power; they know the embryo within him.

children.text: acchā putraṃ dhenavo vāvaśānā mahaś caranti bibhrataṃ vapūṃṣi ||
children.translated_text: The cows, lowing toward the son, move mightily, bearing forms.

children.text: acchā vivakmi rodasī sumeke grāvṇo yujāno adhvare manīṣā
children.translated_text: I speak toward Heaven and Earth, well founded, yoking the pressing-stones with thought at the sacrifice.

children.text: imā u te manave bhūrivārā ūrdhvā bhavanti darśatā yajatrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: These, indeed, rich in gifts for <s>Manu</s>, rise upright, visible and worshipful.

children.text: yā te jihvā madhumatī sumedhā agne deveṣūcyata urūcī
children.translated_text: That honeyed, wise tongue of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, which is proclaimed broad among the gods,

children.text: tayeha viśvāṁ avase yajatrān ā sādaya pāyayā cā madhūni ||
children.translated_text: with it bring all the worshipful ones here for aid; seat them and make them drink the sweet draughts.

children.text: yā te agne parvatasyeva dhārā saścantī pīpayad deva citrā
children.translated_text: That stream of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, like a mountain's, accompanying, the wondrous god has made swell,

children.text: tām asmabhyam pramatiṃ jātavedo vaso rāsva sumatiṃ viśvajanyām ||
children.translated_text: grant that favoring insight to us, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, O <s>Vasu</s>, the good thought belonging to all people.

children.text: Chapter 292
dhenuḥ pratnasya kāmyaṃ duhānāntaḥ putraś carati dakṣiṇāyāḥ
children.translated_text: The cow, milking the desired gift of the ancient one, moves within; the son is at the right hand.

children.text: ā dyotaniṃ vahati śubhrayāmoṣasa stomo aśvināv ajīgaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The hymn has awakened the shining one; fair in course, it carries <s>Uṣas</s>; it has roused the <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: suyug vahanti prati vām ṛtenordhvā bhavanti pitareva medhāḥ
children.translated_text: Well-yoked ones carry you two according to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order); thoughts rise upward like fathers.

children.text: jarethām asmad vi paṇer manīṣāṃ yuvor avaś cakṛmā yātam arvāk ||
children.translated_text: Drive away from us the thought of the <s>Paṇi</s>; we have made your aid for ourselves; come hither.

children.text: suyugbhir aśvaiḥ suvṛtā rathena dasrāv imaṃ śṛṇutaṃ ślokam adreḥ
children.translated_text: With well-yoked horses and a well-turned chariot, O wondrous <s>Aśvins</s>, hear this praise of the stone.

children.text: kim aṅga vām praty avartiṃ gamiṣṭhāhur viprāso aśvinā purājāḥ ||
children.translated_text: What, then, is your nearest return? So have the inspired poets said, O ancient-born <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: ā manyethām ā gataṃ kaccid evair viśve janāso aśvinā havante
children.translated_text: Think of us; come surely with your aids; all peoples call upon you, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: imā hi vāṃ goṛjīkā madhūni pra mitrāso na dadur usro agre ||
children.translated_text: For these sweet draughts, strengthened by the cow, your friends have presented to you like the ruddy ones in front.

children.text: tiraḥ purū cid aśvinā rajāṃsy āṅgūṣo vām maghavānā janeṣu
children.translated_text: Through many realms, O <s>Aśvins</s>, your loud call passes among peoples, O bountiful ones.

children.text: eha yātam pathibhir devayānair dasrāv ime vāṃ nidhayo madhūnām ||
children.translated_text: Come here by the god-traveled paths, O wondrous ones; these are your stores of honey.

children.text: purāṇam okaḥ sakhyaṃ śivaṃ vāṃ yuvor narā draviṇaṃ jahnāvyām
children.translated_text: Your ancient home, your auspicious friendship, O men, and your wealth in <s>Jahnāvyā</s>,

children.text: punaḥ kṛṇvānāḥ sakhyā śivāni madhvā madema saha nū samānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: renewing auspicious friendships, may we now rejoice together with honey.

children.text: aśvinā vāyunā yuvaṃ sudakṣā niyudbhiś ca sajoṣasā yuvānā
children.translated_text: O skillful <s>Aśvins</s>, you two young ones, together with <s>Vāyu</s> and with the teams, in one accord,

children.text: nāsatyā tiroahnyaṃ juṣāṇā somam pibatam asridhā sudānū ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, enjoying the overnight <s>soma</s> (pressed offering), drink it, unerring, very bountiful ones.

children.text: aśvinā pari vām iṣaḥ purūcīr īyur gīrbhir yatamānā amṛdhrāḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, many streams of refreshment have gone around you, striving with songs, unharmed.

children.text: ratho ha vām ṛtajā adrijūtaḥ pari dyāvāpṛthivī yāti sadyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For your chariot, born of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) and urged by the stone, goes at once around Heaven and Earth.

children.text: aśvinā madhuṣuttamo yuvākuḥ somas tam pātam ā gataṃ duroṇe
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, this <s>soma</s> (pressed offering), sweetest with honey, is for you; drink it; come to the house.

children.text: ratho ha vām bhūri varpaḥ karikrat sutāvato niṣkṛtam āgamiṣṭhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For your chariot, making many forms, will come most readily to the prepared place of the presser.

children.text: Chapter 293
mitro janān yātayati bruvāṇo mitro dādhāra pṛthivīm uta dyām
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s>, speaking, sets peoples in motion; <s>Mitra</s> has upheld earth and heaven.

children.text: mitraḥ kṛṣṭīr animiṣābhi caṣṭe mitrāya havyaṃ ghṛtavaj juhota ||
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s> watches the peoples with unwinking eyes; pour the ghee-filled oblation for <s>Mitra</s>.

children.text: pra sa mitra marto astu prayasvān yas ta āditya śikṣati vratena
children.translated_text: May that mortal be rich in offerings for <s>Mitra</s>, who serves you, O <s>Āditya</s>, according to the vow.

children.text: na hanyate na jīyate tvoto nainam aṃho aśnoty antito na dūrāt ||
children.translated_text: Protected by you, he is not slain and not overcome; distress reaches him neither from near nor from far.

children.text: anamīvāsa iﾱayā madanto mitajñavo varimann ā pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: Free from sickness, rejoicing with <s>Iḷā</s>, measured in understanding, within the broad space of the earth.

children.text: ādityasya vratam upakṣiyanto vayam mitrasya sumatau syāma ||
children.translated_text: As we dwell under the vow of <s>Āditya</s>, may we be in the good favor of <s>Mitra</s>.

children.text: ayam mitro namasyaḥ suśevo rājā sukṣatro ajaniṣṭa vedhāḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>Mitra</s>, worthy of homage, easy to serve, a king of good rule, was born as the ordainer.

children.text: tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma ||
children.translated_text: May we be in the gracious and kindly mind of that worshipful one.

children.text: mahāṁ ādityo namasopasadyo yātayajjano gṛṇate suśevaḥ
children.translated_text: The great <s>Āditya</s>, approachable with reverence, easy to serve, guides the people for the singer.

children.text: tasmā etat panyatamāya juṣṭam agnau mitrāya havir ā juhota ||
children.translated_text: For him, the most praiseworthy, for beloved <s>Mitra</s>, pour this oblation into the fire.

children.text: mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛto 'vo devasya sānasi
children.translated_text: The aid of <s>Mitra</s>, supporter of peoples, of the god, is winning power,

children.text: dyumnaṃ citraśravastamam ||
children.translated_text: a splendor most rich in wondrous fame.

children.text: abhi yo mahinā divam mitro babhūva saprathāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s>, by his greatness, has extended over heaven, spreading wide,

children.text: abhi śravobhiḥ pṛthivīm ||
children.translated_text: and over the earth with his glories.

children.text: mitrāya pañca yemire janā abhiṣṭiśavase
children.translated_text: Toward <s>Mitra</s> the five peoples have turned, toward him whose power is sought;

children.text: sa devān viśvān bibharti ||
children.translated_text: he bears all the gods.

children.text: mitro deveṣv āyuṣu janāya vṛktabarhiṣe
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s>, among the gods and among living men, for the man whose sacred grass is spread,

children.text: iṣa iṣṭavratā akaḥ ||
children.translated_text: has made nourishment, he whose vows are duly fulfilled.

children.text: Chapter 294
iheha vo manasā bandhutā nara uśijo jagmur abhi tāni vedasā
children.translated_text: Here and there, O men, the eager ones have gone in mind toward those bonds of kinship through their skill,

children.text: yābhir māyābhiḥ pratijūtivarpasaḥ saudhanvanā yajñiyam bhāgam ānaśa ||
children.translated_text: by those powers of craft through which the <s>Saudhanvanas</s>, with rival-impelled form, obtained the sacrificial share.

children.text: yābhiḥ śacībhiś camasāṁ apiṃśata yayā dhiyā gām ariṇīta carmaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: By the powers with which you fashioned the cup, by the thought with which you released the cow from the hide,

children.text: yena harī manasā niratakṣata tena devatvam ṛbhavaḥ sam ānaśa ||
children.translated_text: by the mind with which you carved the two bay horses, by that, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>, you attained godhead.

children.text: indrasya sakhyam ṛbhavaḥ sam ānaśur manor napāto apaso dadhanvire
children.translated_text: The <s>Ṛbhus</s> attained the friendship of <s>Indra</s>; the descendants of <s>Manu</s> took up their works.

children.text: saudhanvanāso amṛtatvam erire viṣṭvī śamībhiḥ sukṛtaḥ sukṛtyayā ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Saudhanvanas</s> reached immortality; skillful through their skills, they did good work by good workmanship.

children.text: indreṇa yātha sarathaṃ sute sacāṃ atho vaśānām bhavathā saha śriyā
children.translated_text: You go with <s>Indra</s> on the same chariot at the soma pressing, and then you become lords of goods together with glory.

children.text: na vaḥ pratimai sukṛtāni vāghataḥ saudhanvanā ṛbhavo vīryāṇi ca ||
children.translated_text: No praising bard can match your good deeds or your heroic powers, O <s>Saudhanvanas</s>, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>.

children.text: indra ṛbhubhir vājavadbhiḥ samukṣitaṃ sutaṃ somam ā vṛṣasvā gabhastyoḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, with the <s>Ṛbhus</s> and the prize-winning ones, drink the pressed <s>soma</s>, sprinkled together, with your hands.

children.text: dhiyeṣito maghavan dāśuṣo gṛhe saudhanvanebhiḥ saha matsvā nṛbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Impelled by thought, O bountiful one, in the house of the giver, rejoice together with the <s>Saudhanvanas</s>, the heroes.

children.text: indra ṛbhumān vājavān matsveha no 'smin savane śacyā puruṣṭuta
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, accompanied by the <s>Ṛbhus</s> and rich in prize, rejoice here for us at this pressing, O much-praised one, with your power.

children.text: imāni tubhyaṃ svasarāṇi yemire vratā devānām manuṣaś ca dharmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: These sisterly ones have turned toward you: the vows of gods and of man, according to their ordinances.

children.text: indra ṛbhubhir vājibhir vājayann iha stomaṃ jaritur upa yāhi yajñiyam
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, with the <s>Ṛbhus</s> and the racers, winning the prize, come here to the worshipful hymn of the singer.

children.text: śataṃ ketebhir iṣirebhir āyave sahasraṇītho adhvarasya homani ||
children.translated_text: With a hundred swift guidances for the living man, thousand-led, come to the offering-call of the rite.

children.text: Chapter 295
uṣo vājena vājini pracetā stomaṃ juṣasva gṛṇato maghoni
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, rich in prize and winner of prize, discerning and bountiful, enjoy the hymn of the singer.

children.text: purāṇī devi yuvatiḥ purandhir anu vrataṃ carasi viśvavāre ||
children.translated_text: Ancient goddess, yet young and generous, you follow the vow, O much-desired one.

children.text: uṣo devy amartyā vi bhāhi candrarathā sūnṛtā īrayantī
children.translated_text: O goddess <s>Uṣas</s>, immortal one, shine forth, with your bright chariot, setting good speech in motion.

children.text: ā tvā vahantu suyamāso aśvā hiraṇyavarṇām pṛthupājaso ye ||
children.translated_text: Let the well-reined horses bring you here, golden-colored, broad in strength.

children.text: uṣaḥ pratīcī bhuvanāni viśvordhvā tiṣṭhasy amṛtasya ketuḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, facing us, you stand upright over all beings, a sign of immortality.

children.text: samānam arthaṃ caraṇīyamānā cakram iva navyasy ā vavṛtsva ||
children.translated_text: Moving along the same course to be traveled, turn yourself onward like a new wheel.

children.text: ava syūmeva cinvatī maghony uṣā yāti svasarasya patnī
children.translated_text: Like one unfastening what has been sewn, bounteous <s>Uṣas</s> goes, mistress of her sister.

children.text: svar janantī subhagā sudaṃsā āntād divaḥ papratha ā pṛthivyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Generating the sunlight, fortunate and skillful, she has spread from the end of heaven to the earth.

children.text: acchā vo devīm uṣasaṃ vibhātīm pra vo bharadhvaṃ namasā suvṛktim
children.translated_text: Bring forward to the shining goddess <s>Uṣas</s>, with reverence, a well-fashioned hymn.

children.text: ūrdhvam madhudhā divi pājo aśret pra rocanā ruruce raṇvasaṃdṛk ||
children.translated_text: Her honey-bearing radiance has risen upward in heaven; the lights have shone forth, lovely to behold.

children.text: ṛtāvarī divo arkair abodhy ā revatī rodasī citram asthāt
children.translated_text: Truth-bearing, she has awakened with songs from heaven; rich and splendid, she has taken her stand between the two worlds.

children.text: āyatīm agna uṣasaṃ vibhātīṃ vāmam eṣi draviṇam bhikṣamāṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, you go toward the approaching, shining <s>Uṣas</s>, seeking desirable wealth.

children.text: ṛtasya budhna uṣasām iṣaṇyan vṛṣā mahī rodasī ā viveśa
children.translated_text: Seeking the impulse of the dawns at the foundation of truth, the bull has entered the great heaven and earth.

children.text: mahī mitrasya varuṇasya māyā candreva bhānuṃ vi dadhe purutrā ||
children.translated_text: Great is the wondrous power of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; like a bright one, she has set out radiance in many places.

children.text: Chapter 296
imā u vām bhṛmayo manyamānā yuvāvate na tujyā abhūvan
children.translated_text: These assaults, though imagined against you two, have not become urgent against your youthful strength.

children.text: kva tyad indrāvaruṇā yaśo vāṃ yena smā sinam bharathaḥ sakhibhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Where, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, is that fame of yours by which you used to bring spoil to your friends?

children.text: ayam u vām purutamo rayīyañchaśvattamam avase johavīti
children.translated_text: This man, most abundant and seeking wealth, calls upon you for aid again and again.

children.text: sajoṣāv indrāvaruṇā marudbhir divā pṛthivyā śṛṇutaṃ havam me ||
children.translated_text: In one accord with the <s>Maruts</s>, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, hear my call from heaven and earth.

children.text: asme tad indrāvaruṇā vasu ṣyād asme rayir marutaḥ sarvavīraḥ
children.translated_text: May that good thing be ours, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; may wealth with all heroes be ours, O <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: asmān varūtrīḥ śaraṇair avantv asmān hotrā bhāratī dakṣiṇābhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the protecting goddesses aid us with shelters; may <s>Hotrā</s> and <s>Bhāratī</s> aid us with gifts.

children.text: bṛhaspate juṣasva no havyāni viśvadevya
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, take pleasure in our oblations, which belong to all the gods.

children.text: rāsva ratnāni dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: Grant treasures to the worshiper.

children.text: śucim arkair bṛhaspatim adhvareṣu namasyata
children.translated_text: Honor pure <s>Bṛhaspati</s> with songs at the rites.

children.text: anāmy oja ā cake ||
children.translated_text: He has made manifest unbending strength.

children.text: vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnāṃ viśvarūpam adābhyam
children.translated_text: The bull of the peoples, of every form, not to be deceived,

children.text: bṛhaspatiṃ vareṇyam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, worthy of choice.

children.text: iyaṃ te pūṣann āghṛṇe suṣṭutir deva navyasī
children.translated_text: This newest, well-spoken praise is for you, O glowing <s>Pūṣan</s>, O god;

children.text: asmābhis tubhyaṃ śasyate ||
children.translated_text: it is recited by us for you.

children.text: tāṃ juṣasva giram mama vājayantīm avā dhiyam
children.translated_text: Take pleasure in that voice of mine, which wins the prize; favor my thought,

children.text: vadhūyur iva yoṣaṇām ||
children.translated_text: as a bridegroom favors a young woman.

children.text: yo viśvābhi vipaśyati bhuvanā saṃ ca paśyati
children.translated_text: He who looks out over all beings and beholds them together,

children.text: sa naḥ pūṣāvitā bhuvat ||
children.translated_text: may that <s>Pūṣan</s> become our helper.

children.text: tat savitur vareṇyam bhargo devasya dhīmahi
children.translated_text: May we meditate on that desirable radiance of the god <s>Savitṛ</s>;

children.text: dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||
children.translated_text: may he impel our thoughts.

children.text: devasya savitur vayaṃ vājayantaḥ purandhyā
children.translated_text: We, striving for the prize with abundant inspiration,

children.text: bhagasya rātim īmahe ||
children.translated_text: ask the gift of <s>Bhaga</s> from the god <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: devaṃ naraḥ savitāraṃ viprā yajñaiḥ suvṛktibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Men, inspired by thought, worship the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, the inspired one,

children.text: namasyanti dhiyeṣitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: with sacrifices and well-fashioned hymns.

children.text: somo jigāti gātuvid devānām eti niṣkṛtam
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> goes forth, knower of the path; he goes to the gods' prepared place,

children.text: ṛtasya yonim āsadam ||
children.translated_text: to sit at the womb of truth.

children.text: somo asmabhyaṃ dvipade catuṣpade ca paśave
children.translated_text: May <s>Soma</s> make for us, for two-footed and four-footed livestock,

children.text: anamīvā iṣas karat ||
children.translated_text: nourishments free from sickness.

children.text: asmākam āyur vardhayann abhimātīḥ sahamānaḥ
children.translated_text: Increasing our lifespan and overcoming hostile powers,

children.text: somaḥ sadhastham āsadat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> has taken his seat in the assembly.

children.text: ā no mitrāvaruṇā ghṛtair gavyūtim ukṣatam
children.translated_text: O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, moisten for us with ghee the path to cattle

children.text: madhvā rajāṃsi sukratū ||
children.translated_text: with sweetness, O you of good insight, the realms.

children.text: uruśaṃsā namovṛdhā mahnā dakṣasya rājathaḥ
children.translated_text: Widely praised, increased by reverence, you two rule by the greatness of skill,

children.text: drāghiṣṭhābhiḥ śucivratā ||
children.translated_text: with the longest courses, O you of pure vows.

children.text: gṛṇānā jamadagninā yonāv ṛtasya sīdatam
children.translated_text: Praised by <s>Jamadagni</s>, sit down in the womb of truth;

children.text: pātaṃ somam ṛtāvṛdhā ||
children.translated_text: drink the Soma, O you who increase truth.

children.text: Chapter 297
tvāṃ hy agne sadam it samanyavo devāso devam aratiṃ nyerira iti kratvā nyerire
children.translated_text: For the like-minded gods have always installed you, O <s>Agni</s>, the god as the divine envoy; by resolve they installed you.

children.text: amartyaṃ yajata martyeṣv ā devam ādevaṃ janata pracetasaṃ viśvam ādevaṃ janata pracetasam ||
children.translated_text: The immortal one, worshipful among mortals, they generated as god, the god, the mindful one; as the all, they generated the god, the mindful one.

children.text: sa bhrātaraṃ varuṇam agna ā vavṛtsva devāṁ acchā sumatī yajñavanasaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ yajñavanasam
children.translated_text: So turn your brother <s>Varuṇa</s> toward us, O <s>Agni</s>; go to the gods with good favor, to the winner of sacrifice, the eldest winner of sacrifice,

children.text: ṛtāvānam ādityaṃ carṣaṇīdhṛtaṃ rājānaṃ carṣaṇīdhṛtam ||
children.translated_text: to the truth-observing <s>Āditya</s>, supporter of peoples, the king, supporter of peoples.

children.text: sakhe sakhāyam abhy ā vavṛtsvāśuṃ na cakraṃ rathyeva raṃhyāsmabhyaṃ dasma raṃhyā
children.translated_text: As a friend, turn toward your friend; speed toward us like a swift wheel on a chariot-track, O wondrous one, speed toward us.

children.text: agne mṛﾱīkaṃ varuṇe sacā vido marutsu viśvabhānuṣu
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, find mercy together with <s>Varuṇa</s>, among the <s>Maruts</s> of universal radiance;

children.text: tokāya tuje śuśucāna śaṃ kṛdhy asmabhyaṃ dasma śaṃ kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: for child and offspring, O shining one, make well-being; for us, O wondrous one, make well-being.

children.text: tvaṃ no agne varuṇasya vidvān devasya heﾱo 'va yāsisīṣṭhāḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, knowing the anger of the god <s>Varuṇa</s>, should avert it from us.

children.text: yajiṣṭho vahnitamaḥ śośucāno viśvā dveṣāṃsi pra mumugdhy asmat ||
children.translated_text: Most fit for worship, best carrier, blazing bright, release all hostilities from us.

children.text: sa tvaṃ no agne 'vamo bhavotī nediṣṭho asyā uṣaso vyuṣṭau
children.translated_text: So be our nearest helper, O <s>Agni</s>, the closest at the shining forth of this dawn.

children.text: ava yakṣva no varuṇaṃ rarāṇo vīhi mṛﾱīkaṃ suhavo na edhi ||
children.translated_text: Being gracious, propitiate <s>Varuṇa</s> for us; seek mercy, and be easy for us to invoke.

children.text: asya śreṣṭhā subhagasya saṃdṛg devasya citratamā martyeṣu
children.translated_text: Of this fortunate god the vision is best, most wondrous among mortals;

children.text: śuci ghṛtaṃ na taptam aghnyāyā spārhā devasya maṃhaneva dhenoḥ ||
children.translated_text: pure, like heated ghee from the inviolate cow, desirable through the god's bounty, like that of a milch cow.

children.text: trir asya tā paramā santi satyā spārhā devasya janimāny agneḥ
children.translated_text: Three are those highest truths of him; desirable are the births of the god <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: anante antaḥ parivīta āgācchuciḥ śukro aryo rorucānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Encompassed within the endless, he has come; pure, bright, noble, he shines forth.

children.text: sa dūto viśved abhi vaṣṭi sadmā hotā hiraṇyaratho raṃsujihvaḥ
children.translated_text: As messenger he calls out over all dwellings, the Hotṛ with golden chariot and joyous tongue;

children.text: rohidaśvo vapuṣyo vibhāvā sadā raṇvaḥ pitumatīva saṃsat ||
children.translated_text: red-horsed, beautiful in form, radiant, always delightful, like an assembly rich in food.

children.text: sa cetayan manuṣo yajñabandhuḥ pra tam mahyā raśanayā nayanti
children.translated_text: He, awakening men and bound to sacrifice, they lead forth with the great rein.

children.text: sa kṣety asya duryāsu sādhan devo martasya sadhanitvam āpa ||
children.translated_text: He dwells as accomplisher in this man's houses; the god has obtained partnership with the mortal.

children.text: sa tū no agnir nayatu prajānann acchā ratnaṃ devabhaktaṃ yad asya
children.translated_text: May that <s>Agni</s>, knowing, lead us toward the treasure of his that is allotted by the gods,

children.text: dhiyā yad viśve amṛtā akṛṇvan dyauṣ pitā janitā satyam ukṣan ||
children.translated_text: which all the immortals made by thought, which father <s>Dyauṣ</s>, the begetter, truly poured out.

children.text: sa jāyata prathamaḥ pastyāsu maho budhne rajaso asya yonau
children.translated_text: He was born first in the homesteads, in the great depth, in the womb of this atmosphere.

children.text: apād aśīrṣā guhamāno antāyoyuvāno vṛṣabhasya nīﾱe ||
children.translated_text: Footless and headless, hiding both ends, he kept moving in the hidden place of the bull.

children.text: pra śardha ārta prathamaṃ vipanyāṃ ṛtasya yonā vṛṣabhasya nīﾱe
children.translated_text: The host first advanced into inspired praise, in the womb of truth, in the hidden place of the bull.

children.text: spārho yuvā vapuṣyo vibhāvā sapta priyāso 'janayanta vṛṣṇe ||
children.translated_text: The desirable youth, beautiful in form and radiant, the seven dear ones generated for the bull.

children.text: asmākam atra pitaro manuṣyā abhi pra sedur ṛtam āśuṣāṇāḥ
children.translated_text: Here our human fathers sat down around truth, striving eagerly.

children.text: aśmavrajāḥ sudughā vavre antar ud usrā ājann uṣaso huvānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Within the stone enclosure the good-milking ruddy cows came out from the pen, calling to the dawns.

children.text: te marmṛjata dadṛvāṃso adriṃ tad eṣām anye abhito vi vocan
children.translated_text: They rubbed and opened the rock, seeing it; others of them proclaimed that on every side.

children.text: paśvayantrāso abhi kāram arcan vidanta jyotiś cakṛpanta dhībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: The cattle-drivers sang toward the call; they found the light and fashioned it with their thoughts.

children.text: te gavyatā manasā dṛdhram ubdhaṃ gā yemānam pari ṣantam adrim
children.translated_text: With a mind desiring cattle, the inspired men surrounded the firm, closed rock that enclosed the cows.

children.text: dṛﾱhaṃ naro vacasā daivyena vrajaṃ gomantam uśijo vi vavruḥ ||
children.translated_text: By divine speech the men, the eager ones, opened the firm cattle-pen rich in cows.

children.text: te manvata prathamaṃ nāma dhenos triḥ sapta mātuḥ paramāṇi vindan
children.translated_text: They conceived the first name of the cow; they found the mother's thrice-seven highest places.

children.text: taj jānatīr abhy anūṣata vrā āvir bhuvad aruṇīr yaśasā goḥ ||
children.translated_text: Knowing that, the herds cried out in response; the ruddy ones became manifest through the glory of the cow.

children.text: neśat tamo dudhitaṃ rocata dyaur ud devyā uṣaso bhānur arta
children.translated_text: The shaken darkness disappeared; heaven shone; the divine radiance of <s>Uṣas</s> arose.

children.text: ā sūryo bṛhatas tiṣṭhad ajrāṁ ṛju marteṣu vṛjinā ca paśyan ||
children.translated_text: <s>Sūrya</s> stood up in the broad unfailing space, seeing straight and crooked things among mortals.

children.text: ād it paścā bubudhānā vy akhyann ād id ratnaṃ dhārayanta dyubhaktam
children.translated_text: Then, awakening afterward, they looked forth; then they held the treasure apportioned by heaven.

children.text: viśve viśvāsu duryāsu devā mitra dhiye varuṇa satyam astu ||
children.translated_text: All gods in all dwellings, O <s>Mitra</s>, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, may truth belong to our thought.

children.text: acchā voceya śuśucānam agniṃ hotāraṃ viśvabharasaṃ yajiṣṭham
children.translated_text: I would speak to the shining <s>Agni</s>, the Hotṛ who sustains all, most fit for sacrifice,

children.text: śucy ūdho atṛṇan na gavām andho na pūtam pariṣiktam aṃśoḥ ||
children.translated_text: with pure udder, like the food of cows, like the purified draught sprinkled around from the Soma-stalk.

children.text: viśveṣām aditir yajñiyānāṃ viśveṣām atithir mānuṣāṇām
children.translated_text: <s>Aditi</s> of all the worshipful ones, the guest of all human beings,

children.text: agnir devānām ava āvṛṇānaḥ sumṛﾱīko bhavatu jātavedāḥ ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Agni Jātavedas</s>, choosing the gods' favor, become very gracious.

children.text: Chapter 298
yo martyeṣv amṛta ṛtāvā devo deveṣv aratir nidhāyi
children.translated_text: He who, immortal among mortals and true to order, has been set as divine envoy, a god among the gods,

children.text: hotā yajiṣṭho mahnā śucadhyai havyair agnir manuṣa īrayadhyai ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, the Hotṛ most fit for sacrifice, by his greatness for shining, to set men in motion with oblations.

children.text: iha tvaṃ sūno sahaso no adya jāto jātāṁ ubhayāṁ antar agne
children.translated_text: Here, O son of strength, O <s>Agni</s>, born today among both born races,

children.text: dūta īyase yuyujāna ṛṣva ṛjumuṣkān vṛṣaṇaḥ śukrāṃś ca ||
children.translated_text: as messenger you go, yoking the lofty, straight-harnessed, virile, and bright ones.

children.text: atyā vṛdhasnū rohitā ghṛtasnū ṛtasya manye manasā javiṣṭhā
children.translated_text: The swelling red ones, dripping with ghee, I think by mind are the swiftest according to truth.

children.text: antar īyase aruṣā yujāno yuṣmāṃś ca devān viśa ā ca martān ||
children.translated_text: You go between, yoking the ruddy ones, toward you gods, and toward the clans and mortals.

children.text: aryamaṇaṃ varuṇam mitram eṣām indrāviṣṇū maruto aśvinota
children.translated_text: <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s> among them, <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the <s>Maruts</s>, and the <s>Aśvins</s> too,

children.text: svaśvo agne surathaḥ surādhā ed u vaha suhaviṣe janāya ||
children.translated_text: O well-horsed <s>Agni</s>, with good chariot and good gifts, bring them here to the people who invoke well.

children.text: gomāṁ agne 'vimāṁ aśvī yajño nṛvatsakhā sadam id apramṛṣyaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, may the sacrifice be rich in cows, rich in sheep, rich in horses, companioned by men, always unassailable.

children.text: iﾱāvāṁ eṣo asura prajāvān dīrgho rayiḥ pṛthubudhnaḥ sabhāvān ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Asura</s> (lord), may this wealth be rich in refreshment and offspring, long-lasting, broad-based, and possessed of an assembly.

children.text: yas ta idhmaṃ jabharat siṣvidāno mūrdhānaṃ vā tatapate tvāyā
children.translated_text: The one who, sweating, brings fuel for you, or heats his head for your sake,

children.text: bhuvas tasya svatavāṁ pāyur agne viśvasmāt sīm aghāyata uruṣya ||
children.translated_text: become his self-strong protector, O <s>Agni</s>; shelter him from every evil-doer.

children.text: yas te bharād anniyate cid annaṃ niśiṣan mandram atithim udīrat
children.translated_text: Whoever brings food for you, even appointed food, sharpening it, has roused the delightful guest.

children.text: ā devayur inadhate duroṇe tasmin rayir dhruvo astu dāsvān ||
children.translated_text: The seeker of the gods kindles him in the dwelling; in that man may firm, generous wealth abide.

children.text: yas tvā doṣā ya uṣasi praśaṃsāt priyaṃ vā tvā kṛṇavate haviṣmān
children.translated_text: Whoever praises you at evening or at dawn, or, rich in oblation, makes you dear,

children.text: aśvo na sve dama ā hemyāvān tam aṃhasaḥ pīparo dāśvāṃsam ||
children.translated_text: like a golden-trapped horse in its own stall, you carry that generous worshipper across distress.

children.text: yas tubhyam agne amṛtāya dāśad duvas tve kṛṇavate yatasruk
children.translated_text: Whoever gives worship to you, O immortal <s>Agni</s>, and performs service for you with ready ladle,

children.text: na sa rāyā śaśamāno vi yoṣan nainam aṃhaḥ pari varad aghāyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: he, rejoicing in wealth, is not separated from it; distress from the evil-doer does not enclose him.

children.text: yasya tvam agne adhvaraṃ jujoṣo devo martasya sudhitaṃ rarāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: The mortal whose well-set sacrifice you, the god, have gladly accepted, O <s>Agni</s>, bestowing favor,

children.text: prīted asaddhotrā sā yaviṣṭhāsāma yasya vidhato vṛdhāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he sit in the beloved priestly offices, O youngest one; may we become increasers for him who worships.

children.text: cittim acittiṃ cinavad vi vidvān pṛṣṭheva vītā vṛjinā ca martān
children.translated_text: Knowing well, may he distinguish understanding from lack of understanding, and the crooked ways of mortals as paths traced on a back.

children.text: rāye ca naḥ svapatyāya deva ditiṃ ca rāsvāditim uruṣya ||
children.translated_text: For wealth and good offspring for us, O god, grant <s>Diti</s> too, and guard spacious <s>Aditi</s>.

children.text: kaviṃ śaśāsuḥ kavayo 'dabdhā nidhārayanto duryāsv āyoḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired, undeceived poets have instructed the poet, setting him in the homes of man.

children.text: atas tvaṃ dṛśyāṁ agna etān paḍbhiḥ paśyer adbhutāṁ arya evaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: From there, O visible <s>Agni</s>, behold these wondrous things with your steps, like an <s>Arya</s> with his courses.

children.text: tvam agne vāghate supraṇītiḥ sutasomāya vidhate yaviṣṭha
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are good guidance for the singer, O youngest one, for the soma-presser and the worshipper.

children.text: ratnam bhara śaśamānāya ghṛṣve pṛthu ścandram avase carṣaṇiprāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bring treasure to the praising, eager man, broad and bright, for aid, O fulfiller of peoples.

children.text: adhā ha yad vayam agne tvāyā paḍbhir hastebhiś cakṛmā tanūbhiḥ
children.translated_text: And so, O <s>Agni</s>, when we through you, with feet, hands, and bodies,

children.text: rathaṃ na kranto apasā bhurijor ṛtaṃ yemuḥ sudhya āśuṣāṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: like craftsmen fashioning a chariot by the work of both arms, have guided the truth, thoughtful and eager,

children.text: adhā mātur uṣasaḥ sapta viprā jāyemahi prathamā vedhaso nṝn
children.translated_text: then may we be born as the seven inspired priests of mother <s>Uṣas</s>, the first skillful men.

children.text: divas putrā aṅgiraso bhavemādriṃ rujema dhaninaṃ śucantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we become sons of heaven, <s>Aṅgirases</s>; shining, may we split the treasure-holding rock.

children.text: adhā yathā naḥ pitaraḥ parāsaḥ pratnāso agna ṛtam āśuṣāṇāḥ
children.translated_text: Then, as our distant fathers, the ancient ones, O <s>Agni</s>, sought the truth,

children.text: śucīd ayan dīdhitim ukthaśāsaḥ kṣāmā bhindanto aruṇīr apa vran ||
children.translated_text: they went bright with radiance, masters of hymns, breaking the ruddy grounds and opening them out.

children.text: sukarmāṇaḥ suruco devayanto 'yo na devā janimā dhamantaḥ
children.translated_text: Doing good works, beautifully shining, devoted to the gods, they blew forth the births of the gods like metal in the furnace.

children.text: śucanto agniṃ vavṛdhanta indram ūrvaṃ gavyam pariṣadanto agman ||
children.translated_text: Shining, they strengthened <s>Agni</s> and <s>Indra</s>; they came and sat around the wide cattle-place.

children.text: ā yūtheva kṣumati paśvo akhyad devānāṃ yaj janimānty ugra
children.translated_text: He appeared among the herd as among prosperous cattle, when the fierce one disclosed the births of the gods.

children.text: martānāṃ cid urvaśīr akṛpran vṛdhe cid arya uparasyāyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: They made wide spaces even for mortals, and for the growth of the noble man in later life.

children.text: akarma te svapaso abhūma ṛtam avasrann uṣaso vibhātīḥ
children.translated_text: We have done your work, O skillful one; we have become yours, as the shining dawns released the truth.

children.text: anūnam agnim purudhā suścandraṃ devasya marmṛjataś cāru cakṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: They cleanse full, manifold, brilliantly bright <s>Agni</s>, the lovely eye of the god.

children.text: etā te agna ucathāni vedho 'vocāma kavaye tā juṣasva
children.translated_text: These hymns of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, O ordainer, we have spoken to the poet; accept them.

children.text: ucchocasva kṛṇuhi vasyaso no maho rāyaḥ puruvāra pra yandhi ||
children.translated_text: Flame up; make us better; send forth great wealth for us, O much-desired one.

children.text: Chapter 299
ā vo rājānam adhvarasya rudraṃ hotāraṃ satyayajaṃ rodasyoḥ
children.translated_text: For yourselves make <s>Agni</s>, king of the rite, <s>Rudra</s>, the <s>Hotṛ</s>, the true sacrificer of heaven and earth,

children.text: agnim purā tanayitnor acittāddhiraṇyarūpam avase kṛṇudhvam ||
children.translated_text: golden in form, your help before the unthinking thunderbolt.

children.text: ayaṃ yoniś cakṛmā yaṃ vayaṃ te jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsāḥ
children.translated_text: This seat we have made for you, as a longing, well-robed wife makes one for her husband.

children.text: arvācīnaḥ parivīto ni ṣīdemā u te svapāka pratīcīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Come hither, sit down enclosed by it; these offerings are turned toward you, O well-kindled one.

children.text: āśṛṇvate adṛpitāya manma nṛcakṣase sumṛﾱīkāya vedhaḥ
children.translated_text: For the hearer of thought, undeceived, seeing men, very gracious, O ordainer,

children.text: devāya śastim amṛtāya śaṃsa grāveva sotā madhuṣud yam īḍe ||
children.translated_text: speak praise to the immortal god; like a pressing stone, as soma-presser, I praise the one from whom sweetness is pressed.

children.text: tvaṃ cin naḥ śamyā agne asyā ṛtasya bodhy ṛtacit svādhīḥ
children.translated_text: You indeed, O <s>Agni</s>, be mindful for us of this truth, O truth-knowing one of good insight.

children.text: kadā ta ukthā sadhamādyāni kadā bhavanti sakhyā gṛhe te ||
children.translated_text: When will your hymns be fit for common feasting? When will friendships be present in your house?

children.text: kathā ha tad varuṇāya tvam agne kathā dive garhase kan na āgaḥ
children.translated_text: How then, O <s>Agni</s>, will you speak to <s>Varuṇa</s>? How will you speak to <s>Dyauṣ</s>? What offense of ours will you reproach?

children.text: kathā mitrāya mīḍhuṣe pṛthivyai bravaḥ kad aryamṇe kad bhagāya ||
children.translated_text: How will you speak to bountiful <s>Mitra</s>, to <s>Pṛthivī</s>? When to <s>Aryaman</s>, and when to <s>Bhaga</s>?

children.text: kad dhiṣṇyāsu vṛdhasāno agne kad vātāya pratavase śubhaṃye
children.translated_text: When, growing in the sacred seats, O <s>Agni</s>, will you speak to powerful, splendid <s>Vāta</s>,

children.text: parijmane nāsatyāya kṣe bravaḥ kad agne rudrāya nṛghne ||
children.translated_text: to <s>Parijman</s>, to <s>Nāsatya</s> in the dwelling? When, O <s>Agni</s>, to man-slaying <s>Rudra</s>?

children.text: kathā mahe puṣṭimbharāya pūṣṇe kad rudrāya sumakhāya havirde
children.translated_text: How to great <s>Pūṣan</s>, bringer of nourishment? When, O giver of oblation, to fair-faced <s>Rudra</s>?

children.text: kad viṣṇava urugāyāya reto bravaḥ kad agne śarave bṛhatyai ||
children.translated_text: When will you speak seed to wide-singing <s>Viṣṇu</s>? When, O <s>Agni</s>, to the great <s>Śarva</s>?

children.text: kathā śardhāya marutām ṛtāya kathā sūre bṛhate pṛcchyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: How to the truthful troop of the <s>Maruts</s>? How, when questioned, to the great <s>Sūrya</s>?

children.text: prati bravo 'ditaye turāya sādhā divo jātavedaś cikitvān ||
children.translated_text: Answer swift <s>Aditi</s>; accomplish it, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, knowing one born of heaven.

children.text: ṛtena ṛtaṃ niyatam īḍa ā gor āmā sacā madhumat pakvam agne
children.translated_text: By truth I praise the truth, fixed at the cow: raw and ripe sweetness together, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: kṛṣṇā satī ruśatā dhāsinaiṣā jāmaryeṇa payasā pīpāya ||
children.translated_text: Though black, she has swelled with shining nurture, with kindred milk.

children.text: ṛtena hi ṣmā vṛṣabhaś cid aktaḥ pumāṁ agniḥ payasā pṛṣṭhyena
children.translated_text: For by truth even the bull was anointed, male <s>Agni</s> with milk from the back.

children.text: aspandamāno acarad vayodhā vṛṣā śukraṃ duduhe pṛśnir ūdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Unshaking, he moved as giver of vigor; the bull milked the bright milk from <s>Pṛśni</s>'s udder.

children.text: ṛtenādriṃ vy asan bhidantaḥ sam aṅgiraso navanta gobhiḥ
children.translated_text: By truth the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, splitting it, broke open the rock; they lowed together with the cows.

children.text: śunaṃ naraḥ pari ṣadann uṣāsam āviḥ svar abhavaj jāte agnau ||
children.translated_text: The men sat happily around <s>Uṣas</s>; the sunlight became manifest when <s>Agni</s> was born.

children.text: ṛtena devīr amṛtā amṛktā arṇobhir āpo madhumadbhir agne
children.translated_text: By truth, O <s>Agni</s>, the divine, immortal, inviolate waters with honey-sweet floods,

children.text: vājī na sargeṣu prastubhānaḥ pra sadam it sravitave dadhanyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: like a racehorse in its starts, sounding forth, set themselves to flow continually.

children.text: mā kasya yakṣaṃ sadam iddhuro gā mā veśasya praminato māpeḥ
children.translated_text: May we not come under anyone's mysterious power, nor that of the ever-yoked bearer of the yoke, nor that of the encroaching neighbor or kinsman.

children.text: mā bhrātur agne anṛjor ṛṇaṃ ver mā sakhyur dakṣaṃ ripor bhujema ||
children.translated_text: May we not, O <s>Agni</s>, suffer the debt of a crooked brother, nor the force of friend or foe.

children.text: rakṣā ṇo agne tava rakṣaṇebhī rārakṣāṇaḥ sumakha prīṇānaḥ
children.translated_text: Protect us, O <s>Agni</s>, with your protections; protecting us, O fair-sacrificing one, be pleased.

children.text: prati ṣphura vi ruja vīḍv aṃho jahi rakṣo mahi cid vāvṛdhānam ||
children.translated_text: Flash back against the foe; break apart firm distress; slay the <s>Rakṣas</s>, even when it has grown great.

children.text: ebhir bhava sumanā agne arkair imān spṛśa manmabhiḥ śūra vājān
children.translated_text: With these songs be well-disposed, O <s>Agni</s>; touch these prizes with our thoughts, O hero.

children.text: uta brahmāṇy aṅgiro juṣasva saṃ te śastir devavātā jareta ||
children.translated_text: And accept the sacred formulations, O <s>Aṅgiras</s>; may your god-inspired praise grow old together with you.

children.text: etā viśvā viduṣe tubhyaṃ vedho nīthāny agne niṇyā vacāṃsi
children.translated_text: All these guiding sayings and hidden words are for you, the knowing one, O ordainer <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: nivacanā kavaye kāvyāny aśaṃsiṣam matibhir vipra ukthaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: As an inspired sage with thoughts and hymns, I have proclaimed poetic utterances for the poet.

children.text: Chapter 300
kṛṇuṣva pājaḥ prasitiṃ na pṛthvīṃ yāhi rājevāmavāṁ ibhena
children.translated_text: Make your force a broad advance like the earth; go like a king, mighty, with an elephant.

children.text: tṛṣvīm anu prasitiṃ drūṇāno 'stāsi vidhya rakṣasas tapiṣṭhaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Following your swift advance, bursting through the woods, stand forth and pierce; burn the <s>rakṣases</s> (demons) with your hottest flames.

children.text: tava bhramāsa āśuyā patanty anu spṛśa dhṛṣatā śośucānaḥ
children.translated_text: Your whirling flames fly swiftly; touch them, blazing, with daring force.

children.text: tapūṃṣy agne juhvā pataṅgān asaṃdito vi sṛja viṣvag ulkāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, with your tongue release scorching sparks, winged flames, unbound, in every direction.

children.text: prati spaśo vi sṛja tūrṇitamo bhavā pāyur viśo asyā adabdhaḥ
children.translated_text: Send out your watchers; be the swiftest, the undeceived guardian of this people.

children.text: yo no dūre aghaśaṃso yo anty agne mākiṣ ṭe vyathir ā dadharṣīt ||
children.translated_text: Whoever speaks evil against us, whether far away or near, O <s>Agni</s>, let no injury from him dare to reach us.

children.text: ud agne tiṣṭha praty ā tanuṣva ny amitrāṁ oṣatāt tigmahete
children.translated_text: Rise up, O <s>Agni</s>; stretch yourself forth; burn down the enemies, sharp-weaponed one.

children.text: yo no arātiṃ samidhāna cakre nīcā taṃ dhakṣy atasaṃ na śuṣkam ||
children.translated_text: Whoever has made hostility against us while you are kindled, burn him low like a dry reed.

children.text: ūrdhvo bhava prati vidhyādhy asmad āviṣ kṛṇuṣva daivyāny agne
children.translated_text: Stand upright; shoot against what comes at us; make your divine powers visible, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: ava sthirā tanuhi yātujūnāṃ jāmim ajāmim pra mṛṇīhi śatrūn ||
children.translated_text: Break apart the firm things of the sorcerers; crush enemies, both kin and not kin.

children.text: sa te jānāti sumatiṃ yaviṣṭha ya īvate brahmaṇe gātum airat
children.translated_text: He knows your good favor, youngest one, who, seeking you, has opened a path for sacred speech.

children.text: viśvāny asmai sudināni rāyo dyumnāny aryo vi duro abhi dyaut ||
children.translated_text: For him all good days of wealth and all the noble splendors shine through the doors.

children.text: sed agne astu subhagaḥ sudānur yas tvā nityena haviṣā ya ukthaiḥ
children.translated_text: That man, O <s>Agni</s>, shall be fortunate and generous, who with constant oblation and hymns

children.text: piprīṣati sva āyuṣi duroṇe viśved asmai sudinā sāsad iṣṭiḥ ||
children.translated_text: seeks to please you in his own lifetime and dwelling; for him every offering shall sit amid good days.

children.text: arcāmi te sumatiṃ ghoṣy arvāk saṃ te vāvātā jaratām iyaṃ gīḥ
children.translated_text: I sing your good favor; may this song be loudly brought here, and may it gladden you as it is sung.

children.text: svaśvās tvā surathā marjayemāsme kṣatrāṇi dhārayer anu dyūn ||
children.translated_text: With good horses and good chariots may we adorn you; sustain powers for us through the days.

children.text: iha tvā bhūry ā cared upa tman doṣāvastar dīdivāṃsam anu dyūn
children.translated_text: Here may a man approach you often for himself, as you shine night and morning through the days.

children.text: krīﾱantas tvā sumanasaḥ sapemābhi dyumnā tasthivāṃso janānām ||
children.translated_text: Rejoicing and of good mind, may we serve you, standing amid the splendors of men.

children.text: yas tvā svaśvaḥ suhiraṇyo agna upayāti vasumatā rathena
children.translated_text: Whoever, with good horses and fine gold, O <s>Agni</s>, approaches you in a wealth-laden chariot,

children.text: tasya trātā bhavasi tasya sakhā yas ta ātithyam ānuṣag jujoṣat ||
children.translated_text: you become his protector and his friend, when he has continually delighted in your hospitality.

children.text: maho rujāmi bandhutā vacobhis tan mā pitur gotamād anv iyāya
children.translated_text: With words I open the great bond of kinship; that has come down to me from my father <s>Gotama</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ no asya vacasaś cikiddhi hotar yaviṣṭha sukrato damūnāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Take notice of this speech of ours, O <s>Hotṛ</s> (invoking priest), youngest one, wise-minded lord of the house.

children.text: asvapnajas taraṇayaḥ suśevā atandrāso 'vṛkā aśramiṣṭhāḥ
children.translated_text: Wakeful, quick to cross over, gracious, untiring, harmless, and most unwearied,

children.text: te pāyavaḥ sadhryañco niṣadyāgne tava naḥ pāntv amūra ||
children.translated_text: may those guardians, sitting together, O <s>Agni</s>, protect us as your own, unbewildered ones.

children.text: ye pāyavo māmateyaṃ te agne paśyanto andhaṃ duritād arakṣan
children.translated_text: Those guardians of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, who, seeing, protected the blind <s>Māmateya</s> from distress,

children.text: rarakṣa tān sukṛto viśvavedā dipsanta id ripavo nāha debhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Viśvavedas</s>, knower of all, protected those doers of good; the enemies seeking to harm them did not deceive them.

children.text: tvayā vayaṃ sadhanyas tvotās tava praṇīty aśyāma vājān
children.translated_text: With you as ally, helped by you, and through your guidance, may we attain the prizes.

children.text: ubhā śaṃsā sūdaya satyatāte 'nuṣṭhuyā kṛṇuhy ahrayāṇa ||
children.translated_text: Make both praises prosper, O true one; make them, according to the hymn, free from shame.

children.text: ayā te agne samidhā vidhema prati stomaṃ śasyamānaṃ gṛbhāya
children.translated_text: With this fuel, O <s>Agni</s>, we would worship you; receive the praise as it is being recited.

children.text: dahāśaso rakṣasaḥ pāhy asmān druho nido mitramaho avadyāt ||
children.translated_text: Burn the malicious <s>rakṣases</s>; protect us from treachery, slander, and blame, O great friend.

children.text: Chapter 301
vaiśvānarāya mīﾱhuṣe sajoṣāḥ kathā dāśemāgnaye bṛhad bhāḥ
children.translated_text: Together for <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, the bountiful <s>Agni</s>, how shall we offer the great brightness?

children.text: anūnena bṛhatā vakṣathenopa stabhāyad upamin na rodhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With his full, broad breast he propped up the barriers without diminishing them.

children.text: mā nindata ya imām mahyaṃ rātiṃ devo dadau martyāya svadhāvān
children.translated_text: Do not blame this gift to me, which the self-powered god gave to a mortal.

children.text: pākāya gṛtso amṛto vicetā vaiśvānaro nṛtamo yahvo agniḥ ||
children.translated_text: To the simple mortal, the wise, immortal, discerning <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, best of men, youthful <s>Agni</s>, gave it.

children.text: sāma dvibarhā mahi tigmabhṛṣṭiḥ sahasraretā vṛṣabhas tuviṣmān
children.translated_text: Like a chant with double support, great, sharp-flaming, thousand-seeded, a bull, very strong,

children.text: padaṃ na gor apagūﾱhaṃ vividvān agnir mahyam pred u vocan manīṣām ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, knowing the hidden track like that of a cow, proclaimed inspired thought for me beforehand.

children.text: pra tāṁ agnir babhasat tigmajambhas tapiṣṭhena śociṣā yaḥ surādhāḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s>, sharp-jawed, devour with his hottest flame those who are hostile to good gifts,

children.text: pra ye minanti varuṇasya dhāma priyā mitrasya cetato dhruvāṇi ||
children.translated_text: those who violate the domain of <s>Varuṇa</s> and the beloved, mindful, fixed ordinances of <s>Mitra</s>.

children.text: abhrātaro na yoṣaṇo vyantaḥ patiripo na janayo durevāḥ
children.translated_text: Like women without brothers, without protectors, like wives hostile to their husbands, ill-disposed,

children.text: pāpāsaḥ santo anṛtā asatyā idam padam ajanatā gabhīram ||
children.translated_text: being sinful, untrue, and false, they have not known this deep station.

children.text: idam me agne kiyate pāvakāminate gurum bhāraṃ na manma
children.translated_text: This thought of mine, O purifying <s>Agni</s>, is for one so great; it is no light burden, but like a heavy load.

children.text: bṛhad dadhātha dhṛṣatā gabhīraṃ yahvam pṛṣṭham prayasā saptadhātu ||
children.translated_text: You have set down the great, bold, deep, mighty back, the sevenfold support, with refreshment.

children.text: tam in nv eva samanā samānam abhi kratvā punatī dhītir aśyāḥ
children.translated_text: To him indeed, the same and like-minded one, may the purifying thought attain with insight.

children.text: sasasya carmann adhi cāru pṛśner agre rupa ārupitaṃ jabāru ||
children.translated_text: On the skin of the spotted one, lovely at the front, the variegated form has been set.

children.text: pravācyaṃ vacasaḥ kim me asya guhā hitam upa niṇig vadanti
children.translated_text: What of this speech of mine is to be proclaimed? They speak of what is hidden, placed in secrecy, concealed nearby,

children.text: yad usriyāṇām apa vār iva vran pāti priyaṃ rupo agram padaṃ veḥ ||
children.translated_text: when he has opened, as it were, the covering of the ruddy cows; he guards the dear foremost track of the form.

children.text: idam u tyan mahi mahām anīkaṃ yad usriyā sacata pūrvyaṃ gauḥ
children.translated_text: This indeed is that great, mighty face, when the ancient cow has followed the ruddy cows.

children.text: ṛtasya pade adhi dīdyānaṃ guhā raghuṣyad raghuyad viveda ||
children.translated_text: Shining upon the station of truth, he, darting swiftly, found what was hidden.

children.text: adha dyutānaḥ pitroḥ sacāsāmanuta guhyaṃ cāru pṛśneḥ
children.translated_text: Then, shining, together with his two parents, he followed the hidden lovely thing of the spotted one.

children.text: mātuṣ pade parame anti ṣad gor vṛṣṇaḥ śociṣaḥ prayatasya jihvā ||
children.translated_text: At the highest place of the mother cow he sat near: the tongue of the bull's purified flame.

children.text: ṛtaṃ voce namasā pṛcchyamānas tavāśasā jātavedo yadīdam
children.translated_text: Asked with reverence, I will speak truth, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, if this is by your command:

children.text: tvam asya kṣayasi yaddha viśvaṃ divi yad u draviṇaṃ yat pṛthivyām ||
children.translated_text: you rule over all this, whatever is in heaven and whatever wealth is on earth.

children.text: kiṃ no asya draviṇaṃ kaddha ratnaṃ vi no voco jātavedaś cikitvān
children.translated_text: What wealth of this is ours, what treasure? Tell us clearly, knowing <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: guhādhvanaḥ paramaṃ yan no asya reku padaṃ na nidānā aganma ||
children.translated_text: Along this hidden path, toward its highest goal, may we come, as to a trace, to the track that is not lost.

children.text: kā maryādā vayunā kaddha vāmam acchā gamema raghavo na vājam
children.translated_text: What is the boundary? What are the ways? What is fair? May we go toward the prize like swift ones.

children.text: kadā no devīr amṛtasya patnīḥ sūro varṇena tatanann uṣāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When will the divine wives of immortality, the <s>Uṣases</s> (Dawns), stretch themselves for us with the color of the sun?

children.text: anireṇa vacasā phalgvena pratītyena kṛdhunātṛpāsaḥ
children.translated_text: With speech that is powerless, paltry, turned back, mean, and unsatisfied...

children.text: adhā te agne kim ihā vadanty anāyudhāsa āsatā sacantām ||
children.translated_text: Then, O <s>Agni</s>, what do they say here to you? Let the weaponless sit down and attach themselves to you.

children.text: asya śriye samidhānasya vṛṣṇo vasor anīkaṃ dama ā ruroca
children.translated_text: For the beauty of this kindled bull, the face of the good one has shone forth in the house.

children.text: ruśad vasānaḥ sudṛśīkarūpaḥ kṣitir na rāyā puruvāro adyaut ||
children.translated_text: Clad in brightness, with a form pleasant to see, like a dwelling rich in wealth, much-invoked, he has gleamed.

children.text: Chapter 302
ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇo adhvarasya hotar agne tiṣṭha devatātā yajīyān
children.translated_text: Stand upright for us, O <s>Agni</s>, <s>Hotṛ</s> (invoking priest) of the rite, most worthy of sacrifice in the divine service.

children.text: tvaṃ hi viśvam abhy asi manma pra vedhasaś cit tirasi manīṣām ||
children.translated_text: For you encompass every inspired thought; you surpass even the wisdom of the skillful makers.

children.text: amūro hotā ny asādi vikṣv agnir mandro vidatheṣu pracetāḥ
children.translated_text: The unfoolish <s>Hotṛ</s> has sat down among the settlements: <s>Agni</s>, gracious, foreknowing in the assemblies.

children.text: ūrdhvam bhānuṃ savitevāśren meteva dhūmaṃ stabhāyad upa dyām ||
children.translated_text: Like <s>Savitṛ</s> he has raised his beam upward; like a builder he has propped his smoke against the sky.

children.text: yatā sujūrṇī rātinī ghṛtācī pradakṣiṇid devatātim urāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: When, well-kindled, liberal, rich in ghee, turning to the right, he has sought the divine service,

children.text: ud u svarur navajā nākraḥ paśvo anakti sudhitaḥ sumekaḥ ||
children.translated_text: then the well-set firebrand, newly born, like a vigorous beast, anoints itself, well fitted and beautifully bright.

children.text: stīrṇe barhiṣi samidhāne agnā ūrdhvo adhvaryur jujuṣāṇo asthāt
children.translated_text: When the sacred grass has been strewn and <s>Agni</s> kindled, the adhvaryu, standing upright and taking pleasure, has risen.

children.text: pary agniḥ paśupā na hotā triviṣṭy eti pradiva urāṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, like a herdsman, as <s>Hotṛ</s>, goes around the threefold station, seeking the ancient heavenly rite.

children.text: pari tmanā mitadrur eti hotāgnir mandro madhuvacā ṛtāvā
children.translated_text: By himself the measured-wood <s>Hotṛ</s> goes around: <s>Agni</s>, gracious, honey-tongued, true to ṛta.

children.text: dravanty asya vājino na śokā bhayante viśvā bhuvanā yad abhrāṭ ||
children.translated_text: His flames run like racers; all beings tremble when he flashes forth.

children.text: bhadrā te agne svanīka saṃdṛg ghorasya sato viṣuṇasya cāruḥ
children.translated_text: Auspicious is your sight, O <s>Agni</s> of fair face, lovely though you are fearful and separate from others.

children.text: na yat te śocis tamasā varanta na dhvasmānas tanvī repa ā dhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: For darkness does not cover your flame, nor do smokes, as they waste away, harm your body with stain.

children.text: na yasya sātur janitor avāri na mātarāpitarā nū cid iṣṭau
children.translated_text: No attacker has checked his begetter, nor even his mother and father when they were sought.

children.text: adhā mitro na sudhitaḥ pāvako 'gnir dīdāya mānuṣīṣu vikṣu ||
children.translated_text: Then, well placed like <s>Mitra</s>, purifying <s>Agni</s> has shone among human settlements.

children.text: dvir yam pañca jījanan saṃvasānāḥ svasāro agnim mānuṣīṣu vikṣu
children.translated_text: Twice five sisters, dwelling together, generated <s>Agni</s> among human settlements,

children.text: uṣarbudham atharyo na dantaṃ śukraṃ svāsam paraśuṃ na tigmam ||
children.translated_text: awakening with the dawn, like <s>Atharvan</s>'s tooth, bright, well-breathing, sharp like an axe.

children.text: tava tye agne harito ghṛtasnā rohitāsa ṛjvañcaḥ svañcaḥ
children.translated_text: Those bay steeds of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, bathed in ghee, the ruddy ones, straight-going and well-directed,

children.text: aruṣāso vṛṣaṇa ṛjumuṣkā ā devatātim ahvanta dasmāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the reddish, virile, straight-driving, wondrous ones, have called you to the divine service.

children.text: ye ha tye te sahamānā ayāsas tveṣāso agne arcayaś caranti
children.translated_text: Those same overpowering, tireless, blazing flames of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, move about.

children.text: śyenāso na duvasanāso arthaṃ tuviṣvaṇaso mārutaṃ na śardhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like falcons seeking their object, like a loud <s>Māruta</s> host, they serve, making a mighty sound.

children.text: akāri brahma samidhāna tubhyaṃ śaṃsāty ukthaṃ yajate vy ū dhāḥ
children.translated_text: The sacred formulation has been made for you as you are kindled; the hymn praises you, and you have opened the worshipper's utterance.

children.text: hotāram agnim manuṣo ni ṣedur namasyanta uśijaḥ śaṃsam āyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: The inspired men, descendants of <s>Manu</s>, reverently set <s>Agni</s> as <s>Hotṛ</s>, the praise of the living man.

children.text: Chapter 303
ayam iha prathamo dhāyi dhātṛbhir hotā yajiṣṭho adhvareṣv īḍyaḥ
children.translated_text: This one was placed here first by the establishers: the <s>Hotṛ</s>, most fit for sacrifice, worthy of praise in the rites.

children.text: yam apnavāno bhṛgavo virurucur vaneṣu citraṃ vibhvaṃ viśe viśe ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Bhṛgus</s>, seeking him, made him shine forth, wondrous and far-spreading in the forests, for every clan.

children.text: agne kadā ta ānuṣag bhuvad devasya cetanam
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, when will the god's perception come to you in due order?

children.text: adhā hi tvā jagṛbhrire martāso vikṣv īḍyam ||
children.translated_text: For mortals have grasped you, worthy of praise among the settlements.

children.text: ṛtāvānaṃ vicetasam paśyanto dyām iva stṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: Seeing him, true to ṛta and far-seeing, like the sky with stars,

children.text: viśveṣām adhvarāṇāṃ haskartāraṃ dame dame ||
children.translated_text: they behold in every house the accomplisher of all sacrifices.

children.text: āśuṃ dūtaṃ vivasvato viśvā yaś carṣaṇīr abhi
children.translated_text: The peoples brought here the swift messenger of <s>Vivasvat</s>, who goes among all tribes,

children.text: ā jabhruḥ ketum āyavo bhṛgavāṇaṃ viśe viśe ||
children.translated_text: the beacon, the one of the <s>Bhṛgus</s>, for each and every clan.

children.text: tam īṃ hotāram ānuṣak cikitvāṃsaṃ ni ṣedire
children.translated_text: They sat him down in due order as <s>Hotṛ</s>, the discerning one,

children.text: raṇvam pāvakaśociṣaṃ yajiṣṭhaṃ sapta dhāmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: delightful, with purifying flame, most worthy of sacrifice, in seven stations.

children.text: taṃ śaśvatīṣu mātṛṣu vana ā vītam aśritam
children.translated_text: Him, hidden in the everlasting mothers, lodged and wrapped in the forest,

children.text: citraṃ santaṃ guhā hitaṃ suvedaṃ kūcidarthinam ||
children.translated_text: bright though he was, placed in secret, easy to know and serving some purpose.

children.text: sasasya yad viyutā sasminn ūdhann ṛtasya dhāman raṇayanta devāḥ
children.translated_text: When the gods made him rejoice in that udder of the sleeping one, in the seat of ṛta,

children.text: mahāṁ agnir namasā rātahavyo ver adhvarāya sadam id ṛtāvā ||
children.translated_text: great <s>Agni</s>, to whom offerings are given with reverence, ever true to ṛta, chose the sacrifice for the rite.

children.text: ver adhvarasya dūtyāni vidvān ubhe antā rodasī saṃcikitvān
children.translated_text: He chose the offices of messenger for the sacrifice, knowing both ends of heaven and earth, fully aware.

children.text: dūta īyase pradiva urāṇo viduṣṭaro diva ārodhanāni ||
children.translated_text: As messenger you go, seeking the ancient heavenly rite, knowing better than others the ascents of heaven.

children.text: kṛṣṇaṃ ta ema ruśataḥ puro bhāś cariṣṇv arcir vapuṣām id ekam
children.translated_text: Your dark track has gone before the shining one; the moving flame is one among forms.

children.text: yad apravītā dadhate ha garbhaṃ sadyaś cij jāto bhavasīd u dūtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the unwedded ones hold the embryo, then, just born, you immediately become the messenger.

children.text: sadyo jātasya dadṛśānam ojo yad asya vāto anuvāti śociḥ
children.translated_text: The power of the one just born is seen when the wind blows along his flame.

children.text: vṛṇakti tigmām ataseṣu jihvāṃ sthirā cid annā dayate vi jambhaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: He lays his sharp tongue among the brushwoods; with his jaws he consumes even firm foods apart.

children.text: tṛṣu yad annā tṛṣuṇā vavakṣa tṛṣuṃ dūtaṃ kṛṇute yahvo agniḥ
children.translated_text: When mighty <s>Agni</s>, with thirst, has carried foods among the dry things, he makes the eager one his messenger.

children.text: vātasya meﾱiṃ sacate nijūrvann āśuṃ na vājayate hinve arvā ||
children.translated_text: Following the wind's course as he rushes downward, he urges on the swift one like a racing horse.

children.text: Chapter 304
dūtaṃ vo viśvavedasaṃ havyavāham amartyam
children.translated_text: I adorn for you with song the immortal messenger, the all-knowing bearer of offerings,

children.text: yajiṣṭham ṛñjase girā ||
children.translated_text: the one most worthy of sacrifice.

children.text: sa hi vedā vasudhitim mahāṁ ārodhanaṃ divaḥ
children.translated_text: For he knows the treasure-place of goods, the great ascent of heaven.

children.text: sa devāṁ eha vakṣati ||
children.translated_text: He will bring the gods here.

children.text: sa veda deva ānamaṃ devāṁ ṛtāyate dame
children.translated_text: He, the god, knows the homage; at home he worships the gods according to ṛta.

children.text: dāti priyāṇi cid vasu ||
children.translated_text: He gives even beloved riches.

children.text: sa hotā sed u dūtyaṃ cikitvāṁ antar īyate
children.translated_text: He indeed, the <s>Hotṛ</s>, discerning, goes between on the embassy.

children.text: vidvāṁ ārodhanaṃ divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He knows the ascent of heaven.

children.text: te syāma ye agnaye dadāśur havyadātibhiḥ
children.translated_text: May we be those who have served <s>Agni</s> with gifts of oblation,

children.text: ya īm puṣyanta indhate ||
children.translated_text: those who nourish him and kindle him.

children.text: te rāyā te suvīryaiḥ sasavāṃso vi śṛṇvire
children.translated_text: They, winning riches and heroic strength, are heard abroad,

children.text: ye agnā dadhire duvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: those who have placed worship in <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: asme rāyo dive dive saṃ carantu puruspṛhaḥ
children.translated_text: To us, day by day, may much-desired riches come together.

children.text: asme vājāsa īratām ||
children.translated_text: To us may prizes be set in motion.

children.text: sa vipraś carṣaṇīnāṃ śavasā mānuṣāṇām
children.translated_text: He, the inspired one among peoples, with the might of men,

children.text: ati kṣipreva vidhyati ||
children.translated_text: shoots beyond like a swift arrow.

children.text: Chapter 305
agne mṛﾱa mahāṁ asi ya īm ā devayuṃ janam
children.translated_text: Be gracious, O <s>Agni</s>; you are great, you who have gone to the god-seeking people,

children.text: iyetha barhir āsadam ||
children.translated_text: to sit upon the sacred grass.

children.text: sa mānuṣīṣu dūﾱabho vikṣu prāvīr amartyaḥ
children.translated_text: Immortal, hard to deceive among human settlements, you have protected them.

children.text: dūto viśveṣām bhuvat ||
children.translated_text: You have become the messenger of all.

children.text: sa sadma pari ṇīyate hotā mandro diviṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: He is led around the seat, the gracious <s>Hotṛ</s> at the heavenly services,

children.text: uta potā ni ṣīdati ||
children.translated_text: and also sits down as <s>Potṛ</s> (purifying priest).

children.text: uta gnā agnir adhvara uto gṛhapatir dame
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is the women at the sacrifice; he is also the householder in the home.

children.text: uta brahmā ni ṣīdati ||
children.translated_text: He also sits down as the <s>Brahman</s> priest.

children.text: veṣi hy adhvarīyatām upavaktā janānām
children.translated_text: For you favor those who perform the rite, the spokesman of peoples,

children.text: havyā ca mānuṣāṇām ||
children.translated_text: and the offerings of human beings.

children.text: veṣīd v asya dūtyaṃ yasya jujoṣo adhvaram
children.translated_text: Accept this messenger-service of his, whose <s>adhvara</s> (sacrificial rite) you have enjoyed,

children.text: havyam martasya voﾱhave ||
children.translated_text: the oblation of the mortal, to be called upon.

children.text: asmākaṃ joṣy adhvaram asmākaṃ yajñam aṅgiraḥ
children.translated_text: Be pleased with our <s>adhvara</s>, be pleased with our <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice), O <s>Aṅgiras</s>;

children.text: asmākaṃ śṛṇudhī havam ||
children.translated_text: listen to our invocation.

children.text: pari te dūﾱabho ratho 'smāṁ aśnotu viśvataḥ
children.translated_text: May your hard-to-assail chariot surround us on every side,

children.text: yena rakṣasi dāśuṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the one with which you protect the worshippers.

children.text: Chapter 306
agne tam adyāśvaṃ na stomaiḥ kratuṃ na bhadraṃ hṛdispṛśam
