children.text: asvāpayad dabhītaye sahasrā triṃśataṃ hathaiḥ
children.translated_text: For <s>Dabhīti</s>, with blows,

children.text: dāsānām indro māyayā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> by his <s>māyā</s> (supernatural power) put to sleep thirty thousand <s>Dāsas</s>.

children.text: sa ghed utāsi vṛtrahan samāna indra gopatiḥ
children.translated_text: You indeed are that same one, O <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer, O <s>Indra</s>, lord of cattle,

children.text: yas tā viśvāni cicyuṣe ||
children.translated_text: who has shaken all those things.

children.text: uta nūnaṃ yad indriyaṃ kariṣyā indra pauṃsyam
children.translated_text: And now, O <s>Indra</s>, whatever lordly power, whatever manly deed you will perform,

children.text: adyā nakiṣ ṭad ā minat ||
children.translated_text: today no one will diminish that.

children.text: vāmaṃ vāmaṃ ta ādure devo dadātv aryamā
children.translated_text: May gracious <s>Aryaman</s>, the god, give you dear gift after dear gift;

children.text: vāmam pūṣā vāmam bhago vāmaṃ devaḥ karūﾱatī ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Pūṣan</s> give favor, may <s>Bhaga</s> give favor, may the god show favor to the singer.

children.text: Chapter 327
kayā naś citra ā bhuvad ūtī sadāvṛdhaḥ sakhā
children.translated_text: By what splendid aid will he come to us, the ever-growing friend?

children.text: kayā śaciṣṭhayā vṛtā ||
children.translated_text: With what most powerful might will he be accompanied?

children.text: kas tvā satyo madānām maṃhiṣṭho matsad andhasaḥ
children.translated_text: Which true one among the exhilarations, which greatest giver, will delight you from the draught?

children.text: dṛﾱhā cid āruje vasu ||
children.translated_text: O good one, he breaks apart even firm things.

children.text: abhī ṣu ṇaḥ sakhīnām avitā jaritṝṇām
children.translated_text: Come near to us as protector of friends and of singers;

children.text: śatam bhavāsy ūtibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: be one with a hundred aids.

children.text: abhī na ā vavṛtsva cakraṃ na vṛttam arvataḥ
children.translated_text: Turn yourself toward us like a wheel turned by a horse,

children.text: niyudbhiś carṣaṇīnām ||
children.translated_text: with the teams of men.

children.text: pravatā hi kratūnām ā hā padeva gacchasi
children.translated_text: For by the downward slope you go to the purposes, as if to a footstep;

children.text: abhakṣi sūrye sacā ||
children.translated_text: you have partaken together with the sun.

children.text: saṃ yat ta indra manyavaḥ saṃ cakrāṇi dadhanvire
children.translated_text: When your rages, O <s>Indra</s>, have joined together and the wheels have been set in motion,

children.text: adha tve adha sūrye ||
children.translated_text: then they are in you, and then in the sun.

children.text: uta smā hi tvām āhur in maghavānaṃ śacīpate
children.translated_text: And surely they call you the bounteous one, O lord of powers,

children.text: dātāram avidīdhayum ||
children.translated_text: a giver, one who does not fail.

children.text: uta smā sadya it pari śaśamānāya sunvate
children.translated_text: And indeed, at once, for the praising presser of Soma,

children.text: purū cin maṃhase vasu ||
children.translated_text: you bestow much wealth for generosity.

children.text: nahi ṣmā te śataṃ cana rādho varanta āmuraḥ
children.translated_text: For not even a hundred foolish men can hold back your gift,

children.text: na cyautnāni kariṣyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: nor can those who act against it make it fall away.

children.text: asmāṁ avantu te śatam asmān sahasram ūtayaḥ
children.translated_text: May your hundred aids protect us; may your thousand aids protect us;

children.text: asmān viśvā abhiṣṭayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may all desirable blessings protect us.

children.text: asmāṁ ihā vṛṇīṣva sakhyāya svastaye
children.translated_text: Choose us here for friendship and for welfare,

children.text: maho rāye divitmate ||
children.translated_text: for great wealth shining from heaven.

children.text: asmāṁ aviḍḍhi viśvahendra rāyā parīṇasā
children.translated_text: Help us on every side, O <s>Indra</s>, with overflowing wealth;

children.text: asmān viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: help us with all your aids.

children.text: asmabhyaṃ tāṁ apā vṛdhi vrajāṁ asteva gomataḥ
children.translated_text: Open for us that cow-rich enclosure, as one opens a cattle-pen,

children.text: navābhir indrotibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: with new aids, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: asmākaṃ dhṛṣṇuyā ratho dyumāṁ indrānapacyutaḥ
children.translated_text: Our bold chariot, luminous and not shaken loose by <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: gavyur aśvayur īyate ||
children.translated_text: goes forth seeking cattle and seeking horses.

children.text: asmākam uttamaṃ kṛdhi śravo deveṣu sūrya
children.translated_text: Make our fame the highest among the gods, O <s>Sūrya</s>,

children.text: varṣiṣṭhaṃ dyām ivopari ||
children.translated_text: loftiest, as if above the sky.

children.text: Chapter 328
ā tū na indra vṛtrahann asmākam ardham ā gahi
children.translated_text: Come now, O <s>Indra</s>, slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, toward our side;

children.text: mahān mahībhir ūtibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: come great, with great aids.

children.text: bhṛmiś cid ghāsi tūtujir ā citra citriṇīṣv ā
children.translated_text: Even the restless one you impel; O wondrous one, among the brilliantly adorned,

children.text: citraṃ kṛṇoṣy ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: you make a wonder for our aid.

children.text: dabhrebhiś cicchaśīyāṃsaṃ haṃsi vrādhantam ojasā
children.translated_text: Even with few companions you strike down, by your might, the stronger one who swells in defiance,

children.text: sakhibhir ye tve sacā ||
children.translated_text: together with the friends who are allied with you.

children.text: vayam indra tve sacā vayaṃ tvābhi nonumaḥ
children.translated_text: We are with you, O <s>Indra</s>; we call upon you with devotion.

children.text: asmāṁ asmāṁ id ud ava ||
children.translated_text: Raise us, us indeed, upward.

children.text: sa naś citrābhir adrivo 'navadyābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Come to us, O stone-holder, with your brilliant, blameless aids,

children.text: anādhṛṣṭābhir ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: with aids that cannot be overpowered.

children.text: bhūyāmo ṣu tvāvataḥ sakhāya indra gomataḥ
children.translated_text: May we now become companions of one like you, O <s>Indra</s>, rich in cattle,

children.text: yujo vājāya ghṛṣvaye ||
children.translated_text: yoked for the prize to be fiercely won.

children.text: tvaṃ hy eka īśiṣa indra vājasya gomataḥ
children.translated_text: For you alone, O <s>Indra</s>, rule over the cow-rich prize;

children.text: sa no yandhi mahīm iṣam ||
children.translated_text: therefore grant us great refreshment.

children.text: na tvā varante anyathā yad ditsasi stuto magham
children.translated_text: They do not restrain you otherwise, when, praised, you wish to give bounty

children.text: stotṛbhya indra girvaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: to the singers, O <s>Indra</s>, lover of hymns.

children.text: abhi tvā gotamā girānūṣata pra dāvane
children.translated_text: The <s>Gotamas</s> have sung toward you with a song, for generous giving,

children.text: indra vājāya ghṛṣvaye ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, for the prize to be fiercely won.

children.text: pra te vocāma vīryā yā mandasāna ārujaḥ
children.translated_text: We shall proclaim your heroic deeds, by which, rejoicing, you broke open

children.text: puro dāsīr abhītya ||
children.translated_text: the forts of the <s>Dāsas</s> after advancing against them.

children.text: tā te gṛṇanti vedhaso yāni cakartha pauṃsyā
children.translated_text: The inspired ones praise those manly deeds of yours

children.text: suteṣv indra girvaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: which you performed at the Soma-pressings, O <s>Indra</s>, lover of hymns.

children.text: avīvṛdhanta gotamā indra tve stomavāhasaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Gotamas</s>, bearers of praise, have strengthened you, O <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: aiṣu dhā vīravad yaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: place heroic glory among them.

children.text: yac ciddhi śaśvatām asīndra sādhāraṇas tvam
children.translated_text: For although you are, O <s>Indra</s>, common to all lasting generations,

children.text: taṃ tvā vayaṃ havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: we call upon that very you.

children.text: arvācīno vaso bhavāsme su matsvāndhasaḥ
children.translated_text: Turn hither, O good one; delight well in our pressed draught,

children.text: somānām indra somapāḥ ||
children.translated_text: in the Somas, O <s>Indra</s>, drinker of Soma.

children.text: asmākaṃ tvā matīnām ā stoma indra yacchatu
children.translated_text: May the praise of our thoughts reach you, O <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: arvāg ā vartayā harī ||
children.translated_text: turn your two bay horses hither.

children.text: puroﾱāśaṃ ca no ghaso joṣayāse giraś ca naḥ
children.translated_text: Eat our sacrificial cake and take pleasure in our songs,

children.text: vadhūyur iva yoṣaṇām ||
children.translated_text: like a suitor in a young woman.

children.text: sahasraṃ vyatīnāṃ yuktānām indram īmahe
children.translated_text: We ask <s>Indra</s> for a thousand harnessed steeds,

children.text: śataṃ somasya khāryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and a hundred vessels of Soma.

children.text: sahasrā te śatā vayaṃ gavām ā cyāvayāmasi
children.translated_text: We set in motion for you hundreds and thousands of cows;

children.text: asmatrā rādha etu te ||
children.translated_text: may your gift come toward us.

children.text: daśa te kalaśānāṃ hiraṇyānām adhīmahi
children.translated_text: We would take possession of ten golden jars of yours;

children.text: bhūridā asi vṛtrahan ||
children.translated_text: you are a giver of much, O slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: bhūridā bhūri dehi no mā dabhram bhūry ā bhara
children.translated_text: O giver of much, give us much; bring much to us, not little;

children.text: bhūri ghed indra ditsasi ||
children.translated_text: for much indeed, O <s>Indra</s>, you wish to give.

children.text: bhūridā hy asi śrutaḥ purutrā śūra vṛtrahan
children.translated_text: For you are famed as a giver of much in many places, O hero, slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>;

children.text: ā no bhajasva rādhasi ||
children.translated_text: share with us in your bounty.

children.text: pra te babhrū vicakṣaṇa śaṃsāmi goṣaṇo napāt
children.translated_text: I proclaim your two tawny horses, O discerning descendant of <s>Goṣaṇa</s>;

children.text: mābhyāṃ gā anu śiśrathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with those two do not let the cows slip away from us.

children.text: kanīnakeva vidradhe nave drupade arbhake
children.translated_text: Like two young maidens in rivalry, upon a new little wooden footboard,

children.text: babhrū yāmeṣu śobhete ||
children.translated_text: the two tawny ones shine on their courses.

children.text: aram ma usrayāmṇe 'ram anusrayāmṇe
children.translated_text: They are ready for my winning of the ruddy cows, ready for following after them;

children.text: babhrū yāmeṣv asridhā ||
children.translated_text: the two tawny ones are unfailing on their courses.

children.text: Chapter 329
pra ṛbhubhyo dūtam iva vācam iṣya upastire śvaitarīṃ dhenum īﾱe
children.translated_text: I send forth speech to the <s>Ṛbhus</s> like a messenger; I praise the white cow spread out before me,

children.text: ye vātajūtās taraṇibhir evaiḥ pari dyāṃ sadyo apaso babhūvuḥ ||
children.translated_text: they who, wind-impelled, with swift impulses at once encompassed heaven through their works.

children.text: yadāram akrann ṛbhavaḥ pitṛbhyām pariviṣṭī veṣaṇā daṃsanābhiḥ
children.translated_text: When the <s>Ṛbhus</s>, with wondrous skills, made what was fitting for their two parents as they lay enclosed by old age,

children.text: ād id devānām upa sakhyam āyan dhīrāsaḥ puṣṭim avahan manāyai ||
children.translated_text: then the wise ones came into friendship with the gods and brought nourishment for inspired thought.

children.text: punar ye cakruḥ pitarā yuvānā sanā yūpeva jaraṇā śayānā
children.translated_text: Those who made their two parents young again, though they had long lain aged like posts,

children.text: te vājo vibhvāṁ ṛbhur indravanto madhupsaraso no 'vantu yajñam ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Vāja</s>, <s>Vibhvan</s>, and <s>Ṛbhu</s>, joined with <s>Indra</s> and dripping sweetness, protect our sacrifice.

children.text: yat saṃvatsam ṛbhavo gām arakṣan yat saṃvatsam ṛbhavo mā apiṃśan
children.translated_text: When for a year the <s>Ṛbhus</s> guarded the cow, when for a year the <s>Ṛbhus</s> fashioned her form,

children.text: yat saṃvatsam abharan bhāso asyās tābhiḥ śamībhir amṛtatvam āśuḥ ||
children.translated_text: when for a year they sustained her bright splendors, by those labors they swiftly attained immortality.

children.text: jyeṣṭha āha camasā dvā kareti kanīyān trīn kṛṇavāmety āha
children.translated_text: The eldest said, 'Let us make two cups'; the younger said, 'Let us make three';

children.text: kaniṣṭha āha caturas kareti tvaṣṭa ṛbhavas tat panayad vaco vaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the youngest said, 'Let us make four'; <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> admired that word of yours, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>.

children.text: satyam ūcur nara evā hi cakrur anu svadhām ṛbhavo jagmur etām
children.translated_text: They spoke truth, and indeed they did it as men; the <s>Ṛbhus</s> followed that innate law.

children.text: vibhrājamānāṃś camasāṁ ahevāvenat tvaṣṭā caturo dadṛśvān ||
children.translated_text: Seeing the four shining cups, <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> looked on them with approval.

children.text: dvādaśa dyūn yad agohyasyātithye raṇann ṛbhavaḥ sasantaḥ
children.translated_text: When, for twelve days, at the hospitality of <s>Agohya</s>, the <s>Ṛbhus</s> rejoiced and rested,

children.text: sukṣetrākṛṇvann anayanta sindhūn dhanvātiṣṭhann oṣadhīr nimnam āpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: they made good fields, led the rivers, occupied the desert, and brought the waters down to the plants.

children.text: rathaṃ ye cakruḥ suvṛtaṃ nareṣṭhāṃ ye dhenuṃ viśvajuvaṃ viśvarūpām
children.translated_text: They who made the well-rolling chariot, most desired among men, and the cow that vivifies all and has every form,

children.text: ta ā takṣantv ṛbhavo rayiṃ naḥ svavasaḥ svapasaḥ suhastāḥ ||
children.translated_text: may those <s>Ṛbhus</s>, strong, skillful, and deft-handed, fashion wealth for us.

children.text: apo hy eṣām ajuṣanta devā abhi kratvā manasā dīdhyānāḥ
children.translated_text: For the gods gladly accepted their works, contemplating them with will and mind;

children.text: vājo devānām abhavat sukarmendrasya ṛbhukṣā varuṇasya vibhvā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vāja</s> became the good worker of the gods, <s>Ṛbhukṣan</s> of <s>Indra</s>, and <s>Vibhvan</s> of <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: ye harī medhayokthā madanta indrāya cakruḥ suyujā ye aśvā
children.translated_text: They who, inspired by wisdom and praise, made for <s>Indra</s> the two bay horses, the well-yoked steeds,

children.text: te rāyas poṣaṃ draviṇāny asme dhatta ṛbhavaḥ kṣemayanto na mitram ||
children.translated_text: may those <s>Ṛbhus</s>, securing us like a friend, place in us wealth, prosperity, and treasures.

children.text: idāhnaḥ pītim uta vo madaṃ dhur na ṛte śrāntasya sakhyāya devāḥ
children.translated_text: Today they have set forth drinking and exhilaration for you; not without the toiler, O gods, is there friendship.

children.text: te nūnam asme ṛbhavo vasūni tṛtīye asmin savane dadhāta ||
children.translated_text: Therefore now, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>, place treasures for us at this third Soma-pressing.

children.text: Chapter 330
ṛbhur vibhvā vāja indro no acchemaṃ yajñaṃ ratnadheyopa yāta
children.translated_text: O <s>Ṛbhu</s>, <s>Vibhvan</s>, <s>Vāja</s>, and <s>Indra</s>, come hither to our sacrifice, to the bestowal of treasures.

children.text: idā hi vo dhiṣaṇā devy ahnām adhāt pītiṃ sam madā agmatā vaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For today the divine <s>Dhiṣaṇā</s> has set down your drink for the days; your exhilarations have come together.

children.text: vidānāso janmano vājaratnā uta ṛtubhir ṛbhavo mādayadhvam
children.translated_text: Knowing your birth, rich in prizes, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>, and in due seasons, rejoice.

children.text: saṃ vo madā agmata sam purandhiḥ suvīrām asme rayim erayadhvam ||
children.translated_text: Your exhilarations have come together, and abundance too; set in motion for us wealth with good heroes.

children.text: ayaṃ vo yajña ṛbhavo 'kāri yam ā manuṣvat pradivo dadhidhve
children.translated_text: This sacrifice has been made for you, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>, which from of old you established in human fashion.

children.text: pra vo 'cchā jujuṣāṇāso asthur abhūta viśve agriyota vājāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those who take delight have stood forth toward you; all of you have become foremost, O <s>Vājas</s>.

children.text: abhūd u vo vidhate ratnadheyam idā naro dāśuṣe martyāya
children.translated_text: Your treasure-bestowal has appeared here for the worshipper, O men, for the mortal giver.

children.text: pibata vājā ṛbhavo dade vo mahi tṛtīyaṃ savanam madāya ||
children.translated_text: Drink, O <s>Vājas</s>, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>; I give to you the great third pressing for exhilaration.

children.text: ā vājā yātopa na ṛbhukṣā maho naro draviṇaso gṛṇānāḥ
children.translated_text: Come, O <s>Vājas</s>; come near us, O <s>Ṛbhukṣans</s>, great men, rich in wealth, while being praised.

children.text: ā vaḥ pītayo 'bhipitve ahnām imā astaṃ navasva iva gman ||
children.translated_text: Let your draughts come at the end of the days; let these, like fresh horses, come home.

children.text: ā napātaḥ śavaso yātanopemaṃ yajñaṃ namasā hūyamānāḥ
children.translated_text: Come here, O sons of might, summoned with reverence to this sacrifice.

children.text: sajoṣasaḥ sūrayo yasya ca stha madhvaḥ pāta ratnadhā indravantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: United in will, bright ones, with whom you stand, drink the sweetness, O treasure-givers, together with <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: sajoṣā indra varuṇena somaṃ sajoṣāḥ pāhi girvaṇo marudbhiḥ
children.translated_text: Together with <s>Varuṇa</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, drink the Soma; together with the <s>Maruts</s>, O lover of song, drink it.

children.text: agrepābhir ṛtupābhiḥ sajoṣā gnāspatnībhī ratnadhābhiḥ sajoṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Together with those who drink first and those who drink in season, together with the wives of the gods and the treasure-giving ones.

children.text: sajoṣasa ādityair mādayadhvaṃ sajoṣasa ṛbhavaḥ parvatebhiḥ
children.translated_text: Together with the <s>Ādityas</s>, rejoice; together with the mountains, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>.

children.text: sajoṣaso daivyenā savitrā sajoṣasaḥ sindhubhī ratnadhebhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Together with divine <s>Savitṛ</s>, together with the treasure-giving rivers.

children.text: ye aśvinā ye pitarā ya ūtī dhenuṃ tatakṣur ṛbhavo ye aśvā
children.translated_text: Those <s>Ṛbhus</s> who fashioned the cow, who fashioned the horses, who are the <s>Aśvins</s>, who are the fathers, who are help itself,

children.text: ye aṃsatrā ya ṛdhag rodasī ye vibhvo naraḥ svapatyāni cakruḥ ||
children.translated_text: who made the two worlds asunder and apart, O <s>Vibhvan</s>, men who made fine offspring.

children.text: ye gomantaṃ vājavantaṃ suvīraṃ rayiṃ dhattha vasumantam purukṣum
children.translated_text: You who set down wealth rich in cows, rich in prizes, rich in heroes, rich in goods, and abundant in men,

children.text: te agrepā ṛbhavo mandasānā asme dhatta ye ca rātiṃ gṛṇanti ||
children.translated_text: those <s>Ṛbhus</s>, drinking first and rejoicing, set that wealth among us, and those too who grant gifts to the singer.

children.text: nāpābhūta na vo 'tītṛṣāmāniḥśastā ṛbhavo yajñe asmin
children.translated_text: Do not be away; let us not be abandoned by you, O unblamed <s>Ṛbhus</s>, at this sacrifice.

children.text: sam indreṇa madatha sam marudbhiḥ saṃ rājabhī ratnadheyāya devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Rejoice together with <s>Indra</s>, together with the <s>Maruts</s>, together with the kings, O gods, for the bestowal of treasure.

children.text: Chapter 331
ihopa yāta śavaso napātaḥ saudhanvanā ṛbhavo māpa bhūta
children.translated_text: Come here, O sons of might, O <s>Saudhanvana</s> <s>Ṛbhus</s>; do not stay away.

children.text: asmin hi vaḥ savane ratnadheyaṃ gamantv indram anu vo madāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For in this pressing there is treasure-bestowal for you; let the exhilarations come, following <s>Indra</s>, toward you.

children.text: āgann ṛbhūṇām iha ratnadheyam abhūt somasya suṣutasya pītiḥ
children.translated_text: Here the treasure-bestowal of the <s>Ṛbhus</s> has come; the drinking of the well-pressed Soma has appeared.

children.text: sukṛtyayā yat svapasyayā caṁ ekaṃ vicakra camasaṃ caturdhā ||
children.translated_text: By your good workmanship and skill, you made the one cup into four.

children.text: vy akṛṇota camasaṃ caturdhā sakhe vi śikṣety abravīta
children.translated_text: He made the cup fourfold, saying, 'Friend, instruct separately.'

children.text: athaita vājā amṛtasya panthāṃ gaṇaṃ devānām ṛbhavaḥ suhastāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, O <s>Vājas</s>, O skill-handed <s>Ṛbhus</s>, you went on the path of immortality to the company of the gods.

children.text: kimmayaḥ svic camasa eṣa āsa yaṃ kāvyena caturo vicakra
children.translated_text: Of what material, then, was this cup which, by poetic skill, he made into four?

children.text: athā sunudhvaṃ savanam madāya pāta ṛbhavo madhunaḥ somyasya ||
children.translated_text: Then press out the pressing for exhilaration; drink, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>, of the honeyed Soma.

children.text: śacyākarta pitarā yuvānā śacyākarta camasaṃ devapānam
children.translated_text: By skill you made your parents young; by skill you made the cup fit for the gods to drink.

children.text: śacyā harī dhanutarāv ataṣṭendravāhāv ṛbhavo vājaratnāḥ ||
children.translated_text: By skill, O prize-rich <s>Ṛbhus</s>, you fashioned the two bay horses, further-extended, bearers of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yo vaḥ sunoty abhipitve ahnāṃ tīvraṃ vājāsaḥ savanam madāya
children.translated_text: Whoever presses for you, O <s>Vājas</s>, at the end of the days, the sharp pressing for exhilaration,

children.text: tasmai rayim ṛbhavaḥ sarvavīram ā takṣata vṛṣaṇo mandasānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: for him, O rejoicing bulls, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>, fashion wealth complete with every hero.

children.text: prātaḥ sutam apibo haryaśva mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ kevalaṃ te
children.translated_text: You drank the morning pressing, O bay-horsed one; the midday pressing is yours alone.

children.text: sam ṛbhubhiḥ pibasva ratnadhebhiḥ sakhīṃr yāṁ indra cakṛṣe sukṛtyā ||
children.translated_text: Drink together with the treasure-giving <s>Ṛbhus</s>, the friends whom you, O <s>Indra</s>, made by good workmanship.

children.text: ye devāso abhavatā sukṛtyā śyenā ived adhi divi niṣeda
children.translated_text: You who became gods through good workmanship, who settled in heaven like falcons,

children.text: te ratnaṃ dhāta śavaso napātaḥ saudhanvanā abhavatāmṛtāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: bestow treasure, O sons of might; O <s>Saudhanvanas</s>, you have become immortal.

children.text: yat tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ ratnadheyam akṛṇudhvaṃ svapasyā suhastāḥ
children.translated_text: That treasure-giving third pressing which, skill-handed ones, you made by your craft,

children.text: tad ṛbhavaḥ pariṣiktaṃ va etat sam madebhir indriyebhiḥ pibadhvam ||
children.translated_text: this has been sprinkled for you, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>; drink it together with exhilarations and powers of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 332
anaśvo jāto anabhīśur ukthyo rathas tricakraḥ pari vartate rajaḥ
children.translated_text: Born without horses, without reins, praised in hymns, the three-wheeled chariot turns around the expanse.

children.text: mahat tad vo devyasya pravācanaṃ dyām ṛbhavaḥ pṛthivīṃ yac ca puṣyatha ||
children.translated_text: Great is that proclamation of your divine power, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>, that you nourish heaven, earth, and what is between.

children.text: rathaṃ ye cakruḥ suvṛtaṃ sucetaso 'vihvarantam manasas pari dhyayā
children.translated_text: You wise-minded ones made the well-rolling chariot, not swerving, by thought encompassing the mind.

children.text: tāṁ ū nv asya savanasya pītaya ā vo vājā ṛbhavo vedayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: For the drinking of this pressing, we now summon you here, O <s>Vājas</s>, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>.

children.text: tad vo vājā ṛbhavaḥ supravācanaṃ deveṣu vibhvo abhavan mahitvanam
children.translated_text: That praiseworthy deed of yours, O <s>Vājas</s>, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>, O <s>Vibhvan</s>, became greatness among the gods.

children.text: jivrī yat santā pitarā sanājurā punar yuvānā carathāya takṣatha ||
children.translated_text: When you fashioned your aged parents, long worn with years, young again for movement.

children.text: ekaṃ vi cakra camasaṃ caturvayaṃ niś carmaṇo gām ariṇīta dhītibhiḥ
children.translated_text: You made one cup fourfold; with your insights you released the cow from the hide.

children.text: athā deveṣv amṛtatvam ānaśa śruṣṭī vājā ṛbhavas tad va ukthyam ||
children.translated_text: Then, through obedience, O <s>Vājas</s>, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>, you attained immortality among the gods; that is your hymn of praise.

children.text: ṛbhuto rayiḥ prathamaśravastamo vājaśrutāso yam ajījanan naraḥ
children.translated_text: The wealth born from <s>Ṛbhu</s> is most famous of all, which the men, famed through <s>Vāja</s>, brought forth.

children.text: vibhvataṣṭo vidatheṣu pravācyo yaṃ devāso 'vathā sa vicarṣaṇiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Fashioned by <s>Vibhvan</s>, to be proclaimed in assemblies, he whom the gods aid is active among men.

children.text: sa vājy arvā sa ṛṣir vacasyayā sa śūro astā pṛtanāsu duṣṭaraḥ
children.translated_text: He is a prize-winning steed; he is a seer through eloquence; he is a hero, an archer hard to overcome in battles.

children.text: sa rāyas poṣaṃ sa suvīryaṃ dadhe yaṃ vājo vibhvāṁ ṛbhavo yam āviṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: He holds increase of wealth and good heroic strength, whom <s>Vāja</s>, <s>Vibhvan</s>, and the <s>Ṛbhus</s> have helped.

children.text: śreṣṭhaṃ vaḥ peśo adhi dhāyi darśataṃ stomo vājā ṛbhavas taṃ jujuṣṭana
children.translated_text: Your best, beautiful form has been set forth; the hymn is placed, O <s>Vājas</s>, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>; take pleasure in it.

children.text: dhīrāso hi ṣṭhā kavayo vipaścitas tān va enā brahmaṇā vedayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: For you are thoughtful sages, inspired poets; we make you known with this sacred formulation.

children.text: yūyam asmabhyaṃ dhiṣaṇābhyas pari vidvāṃso viśvā naryāṇi bhojanā
children.translated_text: You, wise ones, out of the powers of inspiration, allot to us all manly enjoyments.

children.text: dyumantaṃ vājaṃ vṛṣaśuṣmam uttamam ā no rayim ṛbhavas takṣatā vayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Fashion for us, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>, splendid prize, highest bull-strong vigor, wealth, and vital strength.

children.text: iha prajām iha rayiṃ rarāṇā iha śravo vīravat takṣatā naḥ
children.translated_text: Bestowing progeny here, wealth here, and fame with heroes here, fashion these things for us.

children.text: yena vayaṃ citayemāty anyān taṃ vājaṃ citram ṛbhavo dadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: By that splendid prize through which we may surpass others, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>, give that prize to us.

children.text: Chapter 333
upa no vājā adhvaram ṛbhukṣā devā yāta pathibhir devayānaiḥ
children.translated_text: Come near to our rite, O <s>Vājas</s>, O divine <s>Ṛbhukṣans</s>, by the paths that the gods travel.

children.text: yathā yajñam manuṣo vikṣv āsu dadhidhve raṇvāḥ sudineṣv ahnām ||
children.translated_text: As you joyfully established the sacrifice among these peoples of <s>Manu</s> on the good days of the days.

children.text: te vo hṛde manase santu yajñā juṣṭāso adya ghṛtanirṇijo guḥ
children.translated_text: May these sacrifices, pleasing today and clothed in ghee, go to your heart and mind.

children.text: pra vaḥ sutāso harayanta pūrṇāḥ kratve dakṣāya harṣayanta pītāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The pressed Soma-draughts, full and golden, gladden you; when drunk, they exhilarate you for resolve and skill.

children.text: tryudāyaṃ devahitaṃ yathā va stomo vājā ṛbhukṣaṇo dade vaḥ
children.translated_text: I have offered you, O <s>Vājas</s> and <s>Ṛbhukṣans</s>, the god-appointed hymn, as is fitting for you.

children.text: juhve manuṣvad uparāsu vikṣu yuṣme sacā bṛhaddiveṣu somam ||
children.translated_text: In the manner of <s>Manu</s>, among the later peoples, together with you, I call the Soma in the broad heavens.

children.text: pīvoaśvāḥ śucadrathā hi bhūtāyaḥśiprā vājinaḥ suniṣkāḥ
children.translated_text: For you are fat-horsed, bright-charioted, fair-jawed, prize-winning, and well-adorned.

children.text: indrasya sūno śavaso napāto 'nu vaś cety agriyam madāya ||
children.translated_text: O sons of <s>Indra</s>, descendants of strength, the foremost exhilaration follows after you for delight.

children.text: ṛbhum ṛbhukṣaṇo rayiṃ vāje vājintamaṃ yujam
children.translated_text: We call <s>Ṛbhu</s>, O <s>Ṛbhukṣans</s>, as wealth, as the prize, the best prize-winning ally.

children.text: indrasvantaṃ havāmahe sadāsātamam aśvinam ||
children.translated_text: We call him rich in <s>Indra</s>, ever the best winner, furnished with steeds.

children.text: sed ṛbhavo yam avatha yūyam indraś ca martyam
children.translated_text: That mortal whom you, O <s>Ṛbhus</s>, and <s>Indra</s> protect,

children.text: sa dhībhir astu sanitā medhasātā so arvatā ||
children.translated_text: let him be a winner through inspired thoughts, in the winning of wisdom, and by the horse.

children.text: vi no vājā ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ pathaś citana yaṣṭave
children.translated_text: Open the paths for us to sacrifice, O <s>Vājas</s> and <s>Ṛbhukṣans</s>.

children.text: asmabhyaṃ sūraya stutā viśvā āśās tarīṣaṇi ||
children.translated_text: Praised by us, O patrons, open for us all hopes that cross beyond.

children.text: taṃ no vājā ṛbhukṣaṇa indra nāsatyā rayim
children.translated_text: Bring that wealth to us, O <s>Vājas</s>, <s>Ṛbhukṣans</s>, <s>Indra</s>, and <s>Nāsatyas</s>.

children.text: sam aśvaṃ carṣaṇibhya ā puru śasta maghattaye ||
children.translated_text: Bring the horse together for the peoples, much-praised, for generous giving.

children.text: Chapter 334
uto hi vāṃ dātrā santi pūrvā yā pūrubhyas trasadasyur nitośe
children.translated_text: For indeed your ancient gifts exist, those which <s>Trasadasyu</s> obtained from you for the many <s>Pūrus</s>.

children.text: kṣetrāsāṃ dadathur urvarāsāṃ ghanaṃ dasyubhyo abhibhūtim ugram ||
children.translated_text: You gave fields and fertile lands, and a heavy, fierce superiority over the <s>Dasyus</s>.

children.text: uta vājinam puruniṣṣidhvānaṃ dadhikrām u dadathur viśvakṛṣṭim
children.translated_text: And you gave the swift <s>Dadhikrāvan</s>, who repels many, to all the tribes.

children.text: ṛjipyaṃ śyenam pruṣitapsum āśuṃ carkṛtyam aryo nṛpatiṃ na śūram ||
children.translated_text: Straight-flying like a falcon, speckled with drops, rapid and active, he is like a noble lord of men, a hero.

children.text: yaṃ sīm anu pravateva dravantaṃ viśvaḥ pūrur madati harṣamāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: As he runs down a slope, every <s>Pūru</s> rejoices after him, full of delight.

children.text: paḍbhir gṛdhyantam medhayuṃ na śūraṃ rathaturaṃ vātam iva dhrajantam ||
children.translated_text: With his feet eager for the prize, prize-seeking like a hero, chariot-winning, he rushes like the wind.

children.text: yaḥ smārundhāno gadhyā samatsu sanutaraś carati goṣu gacchan
children.translated_text: He, pressing forward in contests and going ever farther, moves among the cows as he goes.

children.text: āvirṛjīko vidathā nicikyat tiro aratim pary āpa āyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: With manifest straight course he has discerned the assemblies; he has passed beyond hostility and through the waters of man.

children.text: uta smainaṃ vastramathiṃ na tāyum anu krośanti kṣitayo bhareṣu
children.translated_text: And in battles the peoples cry after him as after a garment-stealing thief.

children.text: nīcāyamānaṃ jasuriṃ na śyenaṃ śravaś cācchā paśumac ca yūtham ||
children.translated_text: As he swoops downward like a swift falcon, he heads toward fame and a cattle-rich herd.

children.text: uta smāsu prathamaḥ sariṣyan ni veveti śreṇibhī rathānām
children.translated_text: And when he means to run first, he whinnies down along the ranks of chariots.

children.text: srajaṃ kṛṇvāno janyo na śubhvā reṇuṃ rerihat kiraṇaṃ dadaśvān ||
children.translated_text: Making a garland like a bridegroom with ornaments, he licks up the dust and shows his radiance.

children.text: uta sya vājī sahurir ṛtāvā śuśrūṣamāṇas tanvā samarye
children.translated_text: And that prize-steed, mighty and true to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), listens with his body in the fray.

children.text: turaṃ yatīṣu turayann ṛjipyo 'dhi bhruvoḥ kirate reṇum ṛñjan ||
children.translated_text: Straight-flying, hastening among those who hurry, he scatters dust upon his brows and is smeared with it.

children.text: uta smāsya tanyator iva dyor ṛghāyato abhiyujo bhayante
children.translated_text: And those who attack fear him, as they fear the thunder of heaven, when he rushes against them.

children.text: yadā sahasram abhi ṣīm ayodhīd durvartuḥ smā bhavati bhīma ṛñjan ||
children.translated_text: When he has fought against a thousand, hard to turn aside, he becomes terrible, marked with dust.

children.text: uta smāsya panayanti janā jūtiṃ kṛṣṭipro abhibhūtim āśoḥ
children.translated_text: And people praise the swift one's impulse, his lordship over tribes, and his overpowering force.

children.text: utainam āhuḥ samithe viyantaḥ parā dadhikrā asarat sahasraiḥ ||
children.translated_text: And those who contend in battle say of him, '<s>Dadhikrā</s> has sped beyond thousands.'

children.text: ā dadhikrāḥ śavasā pañca kṛṣṭīḥ sūrya iva jyotiṣāpas tatāna
children.translated_text: By his might <s>Dadhikrā</s> has stretched across the five peoples, as the sun spreads over the waters with light.

children.text: sahasrasāḥ śatasā vājy arvā pṛṇaktu madhvā sam imā vacāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: May the thousand-winning, hundred-winning prize-horse fill these words together with sweetness.

children.text: Chapter 335
āśuṃ dadhikrāṃ tam u nu ṣṭavāma divas pṛthivyā uta carkirāma
children.translated_text: That swift <s>Dadhikrā</s> we now praise; we proclaim him of heaven and also of earth.

children.text: ucchantīr mām uṣasaḥ sūdayantv ati viśvāni duritāni parṣan ||
children.translated_text: May the brightening dawns impel me; may they carry us across all hardships.

children.text: mahaś carkarmy arvataḥ kratuprā dadhikrāvṇaḥ puruvārasya vṛṣṇaḥ
children.translated_text: I proclaim the greatness of the steed <s>Dadhikrāvan</s>, rich in resolve, much-desired, a bull.

children.text: yam pūrubhyo dīdivāṃsaṃ nāgniṃ dadathur mitrāvaruṇā taturim ||
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> gave him to the <s>Pūrus</s>, shining like fire and overcoming foes.

children.text: yo aśvasya dadhikrāvṇo akārīt samiddhe agnā uṣaso vyuṣṭau
children.translated_text: Whoever has made praise of the horse <s>Dadhikrāvan</s> at the kindled <s>Agni</s>, at the breaking of dawn,

children.text: anāgasaṃ tam aditiḥ kṛṇotu sa mitreṇa varuṇenā sajoṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Aditi</s>, together in favor with <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, make that man free from guilt.

children.text: dadhikrāvṇa iṣa ūrjo maho yad amanmahi marutāṃ nāma bhadram
children.translated_text: When we have thought on the nourishment, strength, and greatness of <s>Dadhikrāvan</s>, and on the auspicious name of the <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: svastaye varuṇam mitram agniṃ havāmaha indraṃ vajrabāhum ||
children.translated_text: for well-being we call upon <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Agni</s>, and <s>Indra</s> whose arm bears the thunderbolt.

children.text: indram ived ubhaye vi hvayanta udīrāṇā yajñam upaprayantaḥ
children.translated_text: Both sides call separately upon <s>Indra</s>, rising up and approaching the sacrifice.

children.text: dadhikrām u sūdanam martyāya dadathur mitrāvaruṇā no aśvam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> gave us <s>Dadhikrā</s>, the impelling horse, for the mortal.

children.text: dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇor aśvasya vājinaḥ
children.translated_text: I have made praise of <s>Dadhikrāvan</s>, the victorious, prize-winning horse.

children.text: surabhi no mukhā karat pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat ||
children.translated_text: May he make our mouths fragrant; may he carry our lifetimes forward.

children.text: Chapter 336
dadhikrāvṇa id u nu carkirāma viśvā in mām uṣasaḥ sūdayantu
children.translated_text: Now indeed we proclaim <s>Dadhikrāvan</s>; may all the dawns impel me onward.

children.text: apām agner uṣasaḥ sūryasya bṛhaspater āṅgirasasya jiṣṇoḥ ||
children.translated_text: We proclaim the victorious one of the waters, of <s>Agni</s>, of Dawn, of <s>Sūrya</s>, of <s>Bṛhaspati</s> the <s>Āṅgirasa</s>.

children.text: satvā bhariṣo gaviṣo duvanyasacchravasyād iṣa uṣasas turaṇyasat
children.translated_text: Winning strength, winning cattle, seeking worship and fame, winning nourishment, and speeding like the dawns,

children.text: satyo dravo dravaraḥ pataṅgaro dadhikrāveṣam ūrjaṃ svar janat ||
children.translated_text: true in his run, most rapid, bird-like, <s>Dadhikrā</s> has generated refreshment, strength, and the sunlight.

children.text: uta smāsya dravatas turaṇyataḥ parṇaṃ na ver anu vāti pragardhinaḥ
children.translated_text: And as he runs and speeds, the wing-like plume of the eager one streams after him as if it were a bird's.

children.text: śyenasyeva dhrajato aṅkasam pari dadhikrāvṇaḥ sahorjā taritrataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Around the bend of <s>Dadhikrāvan</s>, darting like a falcon, he crosses with might and strength.

children.text: uta sya vājī kṣipaṇiṃ turaṇyati grīvāyām baddho apikakṣa āsani
children.translated_text: And that prize-steed speeds toward the rein, bound at the neck and close against the flanks and mouth.

children.text: kratuṃ dadhikrā anu saṃtavītvat pathām aṅkāṃsy anv āpanīphaṇat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Dadhikrā</s> follows the plan with agreement; he snorts along the bends of the paths.

children.text: haṃsaḥ śuciṣad vasur antarikṣasaddhotā vediṣad atithir duroṇasat
children.translated_text: The swan seated in purity, the Vasu seated in midspace, the Hotṛ seated at the altar, the guest seated in the house,

children.text: nṛṣad varasad ṛtasad vyomasad abjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtam ||
children.translated_text: seated among men, seated among the excellent, seated in <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), seated in heaven; born of the waters, born of cows, born of <s>ṛta</s>, born of the mountain: <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: Chapter 337
indrā ko vāṃ varuṇā sumnam āpa stomo haviṣmāṁ amṛto na hotā
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, what hymn, furnished with oblation like an immortal Hotṛ, has obtained your favor?

children.text: yo vāṃ hṛdi kratumāṁ asmad uktaḥ pasparśad indrāvaruṇā namasvān ||
children.translated_text: That reverent utterance of ours, endowed with insight, has touched your heart, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: indrā ha yo varuṇā cakra āpī devau martaḥ sakhyāya prayasvān
children.translated_text: The mortal who, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, has made you two gods his allies, lavish for friendship,

children.text: sa hanti vṛtrā samitheṣu śatrūn avobhir vā mahadbhiḥ sa pra śṛṇve ||
children.translated_text: he smites the <s>Vṛtras</s> and the enemies in battles, and by your great aids he becomes renowned.

children.text: indrā ha ratnaṃ varuṇā dheṣṭhetthā nṛbhyaḥ śaśamānebhyas tā
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, bestow that treasure in this way upon the men who praise you,

children.text: yadī sakhāyā sakhyāya somaiḥ sutebhiḥ suprayasā mādayaite ||
children.translated_text: when, as friends for friendship, they gladden you with well-offered pressed Somas.

children.text: indrā yuvaṃ varuṇā didyum asminn ojiṣṭham ugrā ni vadhiṣṭaṃ vajram
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, fierce ones, set down in this matter your most powerful flash, your thunderbolt,

children.text: yo no durevo vṛkatir dabhītis tasmin mimāthām abhibhūty ojaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and against the one who is ill-willed toward us, the wolf, the deceiver, measure out overpowering strength.

children.text: indrā yuvaṃ varuṇā bhūtam asyā dhiyaḥ pretārā vṛṣabheva dhenoḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, be the furtherers of this inspired thought, like two bulls of a milch cow.

children.text: sā no duhīyad yavaseva gatvī sahasradhārā payasā mahī gauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May this great cow, going as if to pasture, milk for us with a thousand streams of milk.

children.text: toke hite tanaya urvarāsu sūro dṛśīke vṛṣaṇaś ca pauṃsye
children.translated_text: In offspring set in place, in a son, in fertile fields, in the sight of the sun, and in manly vigor,

children.text: indrā no atra varuṇā syātām avobhir dasmā paritakmyāyām ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, wondrous ones, be here for us with aids in the encircling darkness.

children.text: yuvām iddhy avase pūrvyāya pari prabhūtī gaviṣaḥ svāpī
children.translated_text: For ancient aid, for abundance, and in the quest for cattle, we choose you two as good allies,

children.text: vṛṇīmahe sakhyāya priyāya śūrā maṃhiṣṭhā pitareva śambhū ||
children.translated_text: heroes, most munificent, beneficent like fathers, for dear friendship.

children.text: tā vāṃ dhiyo 'vase vājayantīr ājiṃ na jagmur yuvayūḥ sudānū
children.translated_text: Those inspired thoughts, striving for reward, have gone to your aid like racers to a contest, desiring you, O good givers.

children.text: śriye na gāva upa somam asthur indraṃ giro varuṇam me manīṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like cows for splendor they have approached the Soma; my songs, my thoughts, have approached <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: imā indraṃ varuṇam me manīṣā agmann upa draviṇam icchamānāḥ
children.translated_text: These thoughts of mine have come to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, desiring wealth.

children.text: upem asthur joṣṭāra iva vasvo raghvīr iva śravaso bhikṣamāṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They have drawn near like enjoyers of goods, like swift mares begging for fame.

children.text: aśvyasya tmanā rathyasya puṣṭer nityasya rāyaḥ patayaḥ syāma
children.translated_text: May we be lords of wealth in horses, of wealth in chariots, of nourishment, and of lasting riches.

children.text: tā cakrāṇā ūtibhir navyasībhir asmatrā rāyo niyutaḥ sacantām ||
children.translated_text: Having made these newer aids, may their teams of wealth attach themselves to us.

children.text: ā no bṛhantā bṛhatībhir ūtī indra yātaṃ varuṇa vājasātau
children.translated_text: Come to us, great ones, with great aids, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, in the winning of prizes.

children.text: yad didyavaḥ pṛtanāsu prakrīﾱān tasya vāṃ syāma sanitāra ājeḥ ||
children.translated_text: When missiles play forth in battles, may we be the winners of that contest for you two.

children.text: Chapter 338
mama dvitā rāṣṭraṃ kṣatriyasya viśvāyor viśve amṛtā yathā naḥ
children.translated_text: Mine is the twofold sovereignty of a kṣatriya, over all living beings; all the immortals are as ours.

children.text: kratuṃ sacante varuṇasya devā rājāmi kṛṣṭer upamasya vavreḥ ||
children.translated_text: The gods attend the resolve of <s>Varuṇa</s>; I rule over the peoples from the highest enclosure.

children.text: ahaṃ rājā varuṇo mahyaṃ tāny asuryāṇi prathamā dhārayanta
children.translated_text: I am king <s>Varuṇa</s>; upon me they placed those first lordly powers.

children.text: kratuṃ sacante varuṇasya devā rājāmi kṛṣṭer upamasya vavreḥ ||
children.translated_text: The gods attend the resolve of <s>Varuṇa</s>; I rule over the peoples from the highest enclosure.

children.text: aham indro varuṇas te mahitvorvī gabhīre rajasī sumeke
children.translated_text: I am <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Varuṇa</s>; by greatness the two broad, deep, well-founded realms are mine.

children.text: tvaṣṭeva viśvā bhuvanāni vidvān sam airayaṃ rodasī dhārayaṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: Like <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, knowing all beings, I set the two worlds in motion and held them firm.

children.text: aham apo apinvam ukṣamāṇā dhārayaṃ divaṃ sadana ṛtasya
children.translated_text: I swelled the streaming waters; I upheld heaven in the seat of <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: ṛtena putro aditer ṛtāvota tridhātu prathayad vi bhūma ||
children.translated_text: By <s>ṛta</s>, the son of <s>Aditi</s>, possessed of <s>ṛta</s>, spread the threefold expanse of earth.

children.text: māṃ naraḥ svaśvā vājayanto māṃ vṛtāḥ samaraṇe havante
children.translated_text: Men with good horses, striving for prizes, call upon me; those enclosed in battle call upon me.

children.text: kṛṇomy ājim maghavāham indra iyarmi reṇum abhibhūtyojāḥ ||
children.translated_text: As bountiful <s>Indra</s> I make the contest; with overpowering force I raise the dust.

children.text: ahaṃ tā viśvā cakaraṃ nakir mā daivyaṃ saho varate apratītam
children.translated_text: I have done all those deeds; no one can withstand my divine, irresistible might.

children.text: yan mā somāso mamadan yad ukthobhe bhayete rajasī apāre ||
children.translated_text: When the Somas have exhilarated me and when the hymns have done so, both boundless realms are afraid.

children.text: viduṣ ṭe viśvā bhuvanāni tasya tā pra bravīṣi varuṇāya vedhaḥ
children.translated_text: All beings know that power of yours; you, wise one, proclaim those deeds to <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ vṛtrāṇi śṛṇviṣe jaghanvān tvaṃ vṛtāṁ ariṇā indra sindhūn ||
children.translated_text: You are famed as having slain the <s>Vṛtras</s>; you, O <s>Indra</s>, released the obstructed rivers.

children.text: asmākam atra pitaras ta āsan sapta ṛṣayo daurgahe badhyamāne
children.translated_text: Our fathers were there, the seven seers, when the Daurgaha was being bound.

children.text: ta āyajanta trasadasyum asyā indraṃ na vṛtraturam ardhadevam ||
children.translated_text: They sacrificed <s>Trasadasyu</s> for her, like <s>Indra</s>, the <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer, a half-god.

children.text: purukutsānī hi vām adāśaddhavyebhir indrāvaruṇā namobhiḥ
children.translated_text: For <s>Purukutsānī</s> worshipped you two, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, with oblations and reverences.

children.text: athā rājānaṃ trasadasyum asyā vṛtrahaṇaṃ dadathur ardhadevam ||
children.translated_text: Then you gave her king <s>Trasadasyu</s>, the <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer, the half-god.

children.text: rāyā vayaṃ sasavāṃso madema havyena devā yavasena gāvaḥ
children.translated_text: May we, having won wealth, rejoice, O gods, with oblation, as cows rejoice with pasture.

children.text: tāṃ dhenum indrāvaruṇā yuvaṃ no viśvāhā dhattam anapasphurantīm ||
children.translated_text: That milch cow, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, set for us every day, unfailing.

children.text: Chapter 339
ka u śravat katamo yajñiyānāṃ vandāru devaḥ katamo juṣāte
children.translated_text: Who will hear? Which god among the worshipful, which god who is praised, will accept it?

children.text: kasyemāṃ devīm amṛteṣu preṣṭhāṃ hṛdi śreṣāma suṣṭutiṃ suhavyām ||
children.translated_text: In whose heart among the immortals shall we place this divine, most beloved, well-invoked praise?

children.text: ko mṛﾱāti katama āgamiṣṭho devānām u katamaḥ śambhaviṣṭhaḥ
children.translated_text: Who is gracious? Which of the gods is most ready to come, and which is most beneficent?

children.text: rathaṃ kam āhur dravadaśvam āśuṃ yaṃ sūryasya duhitāvṛṇīta ||
children.translated_text: Which chariot do they call swift, with running horses, the one that <s>Sūryā</s>, the daughter of the Sun, chose?

children.text: makṣū hi ṣmā gacchatha īvato dyūn indro na śaktim paritakmyāyām
children.translated_text: For quickly you go through needy days, like <s>Indra</s> with power in the encircling darkness.

children.text: diva ājātā divyā suparṇā kayā śacīnām bhavathaḥ śaciṣṭhā ||
children.translated_text: Born from heaven, heavenly, fair-winged ones, by which of your powers are you most powerful?

children.text: kā vām bhūd upamātiḥ kayā na āśvinā gamatho hūyamānā
children.translated_text: What was your approach? By what means, O <s>Aśvins</s>, do you come to us when called?

children.text: ko vām mahaś cit tyajaso abhīka uruṣyatam mādhvī dasrā na ūtī ||
children.translated_text: By what great impulse do you protect us nearby with honeyed aid, O wondrous ones?

children.text: uru vāṃ rathaḥ pari nakṣati dyām ā yat samudrād abhi vartate vām
children.translated_text: Your chariot widely traverses heaven when it turns toward you from the ocean.

children.text: madhvā mādhvī madhu vām pruṣāyan yat sīṃ vām pṛkṣo bhurajanta pakvāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Honeyed and sweet, it sprinkles honey for you when the cooked nourishments have fed you.

children.text: sindhur ha vāṃ rasayā siñcad aśvān ghṛṇā vayo 'ruṣāsaḥ pari gman
children.translated_text: The <s>Sindhu</s>, together with the <s>Rasā</s>, sprinkled your horses; the ruddy birds went around with heat.

children.text: tad ū ṣu vām ajiraṃ ceti yānaṃ yena patī bhavathaḥ sūryāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let that swift course of yours now be perceived, by which you become the husbands of <s>Sūryā</s>.

children.text: iheha yad vāṃ samanā papṛkṣe seyam asme sumatir vājaratnā
children.translated_text: Here and here, when this common prayer has mingled for you, may this good favor rich in prizes be ours.

children.text: uruṣyataṃ jaritāraṃ yuvaṃ ha śritaḥ kāmo nāsatyā yuvadrik ||
children.translated_text: Protect the singer, you two; the desire that has taken refuge in you, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, looks toward you.

children.text: Chapter 340
taṃ vāṃ rathaṃ vayam adyā huvema pṛthujrayam aśvinā saṃgatiṃ goḥ
children.translated_text: Today we would call upon that chariot of yours, broad in its course, O <s>Aśvins</s>, at the gathering of cattle.

children.text: yaḥ sūryāṃ vahati vandhurāyur girvāhasam purutamaṃ vasūyum ||
children.translated_text: he who bears <s>Sūryā</s>, whose life is yoked to the bridal car, carrying songs, most abundant in goods.

children.text: yuvaṃ śriyam aśvinā devatā tāṃ divo napātā vanathaḥ śacībhiḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, divine ones, grandsons of heaven, you win that splendor by your powers,

children.text: yuvor vapur abhi pṛkṣaḥ sacante vahanti yat kakuhāso rathe vām ||
children.translated_text: when the nourishments attend your form, and the high-crested horses carry them on your chariot.

children.text: ko vām adyā karate rātahavya ūtaye vā sutapeyāya vārkaiḥ
children.translated_text: Who today will prepare for you the gift-offering with verses, for aid or for the drinking of the pressed Soma?

children.text: ṛtasya vā vanuṣe pūrvyāya namo yemāno aśvinā vavartat ||
children.translated_text: Or, bowing down to the ancient winner of truth, has he turned toward you, O <s>Aśvins</s>?

children.text: hiraṇyayena purubhū rathenemaṃ yajñaṃ nāsatyopa yātam
children.translated_text: O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, rich in many forms, come near this sacrifice with your golden chariot.

children.text: pibātha in madhunaḥ somyasya dadhatho ratnaṃ vidhate janāya ||
children.translated_text: Drink of the honeyed Soma; place treasure for the people who worship.

children.text: ā no yātaṃ divo acchā pṛthivyā hiraṇyayena suvṛtā rathena
children.translated_text: Come to us from heaven and from earth with your golden, well-rolling chariot.

children.text: mā vām anye ni yaman devayantaḥ saṃ yad dade nābhiḥ pūrvyā vām ||
children.translated_text: Let no other god-seeking men hold you back, when your ancient nave has been joined together.

children.text: nū no rayim puruvīram bṛhantaṃ dasrā mimāthām ubhayeṣv asme
children.translated_text: Now, O wondrous ones, measure out for us great wealth rich in many heroes, in both ways, among us,

children.text: naro yad vām aśvinā stomam āvan sadhastutim ājamīﾱhāso agman ||
children.translated_text: when the men, the Ājamīḷhas, have come, O <s>Aśvins</s>, to honor your hymn and shared praise.

children.text: iheha yad vāṃ samanā papṛkṣe seyam asme sumatir vājaratnā
children.translated_text: Here and here, where your common favor has been asked for, let this good will, rich in prizes, be ours.

children.text: uruṣyataṃ jaritāraṃ yuvaṃ ha śritaḥ kāmo nāsatyā yuvadrik ||
children.translated_text: Protect the singer, you two; for desire has taken refuge in you, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, looking toward you.

children.text: Chapter 341
eṣa sya bhānur ud iyarti yujyate rathaḥ parijmā divo asya sānavi
children.translated_text: This shining light rises up; the chariot that circles around is yoked on the ridge of heaven.

children.text: pṛkṣāso asmin mithunā adhi trayo dṛtis turīyo madhuno vi rapśate ||
children.translated_text: In it are three paired nourishments; the fourth skin brims over with honey.

children.text: ud vām pṛkṣāso madhumanta īrate rathā aśvāsa uṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: Your honeyed nourishments rise up, chariots and horses, at the dawns' daybreaks.

children.text: aporṇuvantas tama ā parīvṛtaṃ svar ṇa śukraṃ tanvanta ā rajaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Uncovering the darkness that had enclosed it, they spread the bright sunlight like gold across the realm.

children.text: madhvaḥ pibatam madhupebhir āsabhir uta priyam madhune yuñjāthāṃ ratham
children.translated_text: Drink the honey with honey-drinking mouths, and yoke the dear chariot with honey.

children.text: ā vartanim madhunā jinvathas patho dṛtiṃ vahethe madhumantam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: With honey you enliven the course and the paths; O <s>Aśvins</s>, you carry the honey-filled skin.

children.text: haṃsāso ye vām madhumanto asridho hiraṇyaparṇā uhuva uṣarbudhaḥ
children.translated_text: The honeyed, unfailing swans of yours, golden-winged, called forth and awakened by dawn,

children.text: udapruto mandino mandinispṛśo madhvo na makṣaḥ savanāni gacchathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: water-swelling, gladdening, touching exhilaration, go like bees to the honeyed pressings.

children.text: svadhvarāso madhumanto agnaya usrā jarante prati vastor aśvinā
children.translated_text: The well-sacrificing, honeyed fires are kindled at daybreak toward you, O <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: yan niktahastas taraṇir vicakṣaṇaḥ somaṃ suṣāva madhumantam adribhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: when the swift, clear-sighted one, with washed hands, pressed the honeyed Soma with the stones.

children.text: ākenipāso ahabhir davidhvataḥ svar ṇa śukraṃ tanvanta ā rajaḥ
children.translated_text: The day-attending ones, shaking themselves, spread bright sunlight like gold across the realm.

children.text: sūraś cid aśvān yuyujāna īyate viśvāṁ anu svadhayā cetathas pathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even the sun, yoking his horses, moves on; by your own power you perceive all paths.

children.text: pra vām avocam aśvinā dhiyandhā rathaḥ svaśvo ajaro yo asti
children.translated_text: I have proclaimed for you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, with inspired thought, the chariot that is well-horsed and ageless,

children.text: yena sadyaḥ pari rajāṃsi yātho haviṣmantaṃ taraṇim bhojam accha ||
children.translated_text: with which you at once travel around the realms toward the oblation-bearing, swift, generous man.

children.text: Chapter 342
agram pibā madhūnāṃ sutaṃ vāyo diviṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: Drink first of the honeyed pressed Soma, O <s>Vāyu</s>, at the heavenly stations.

children.text: tvaṃ hi pūrvapā asi ||
children.translated_text: For you are the first drinker.

children.text: śatenā no abhiṣṭibhir niyutvāṁ indrasārathiḥ
children.translated_text: With a hundred aids, accompanied by your teams, with <s>Indra</s> as charioteer,

children.text: vāyo sutasya tṛmpatam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s>, be satisfied with the pressed Soma.

children.text: ā vāṃ sahasraṃ haraya indravāyū abhi prayaḥ
children.translated_text: Let a thousand bay horses carry the offering toward you two, O <s>Indra-Vāyu</s>,

children.text: vahantu somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: for the drinking of Soma.

children.text: rathaṃ hiraṇyavandhuram indravāyū svadhvaram
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra-Vāyu</s>, mount the golden-seated chariot, well fitted for sacrifice,

children.text: ā hi sthātho divispṛśam ||
children.translated_text: for you have taken your place on the one that touches heaven.

children.text: rathena pṛthupājasā dāśvāṃsam upa gacchatam
children.translated_text: Come near the worshipper with your broad-powered chariot;

children.text: indravāyū ihā gatam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra-Vāyu</s>, come here.

children.text: indravāyū ayaṃ sutas taṃ devebhiḥ sajoṣasā
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra-Vāyu</s>, this Soma has been pressed; together with the gods, in shared delight,

children.text: pibataṃ dāśuṣo gṛhe ||
children.translated_text: drink it in the house of the worshipper.

children.text: iha prayāṇam astu vām indravāyū vimocanam
children.translated_text: Let your setting out and your unyoking be here, O <s>Indra-Vāyu</s>;

children.text: iha vāṃ somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: here is the place for your Soma-drinking.

children.text: Chapter 343
vāyo śukro ayāmi te madhvo agraṃ diviṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s>, I bring to you the bright first portion of the honeyed Soma at the heavenly stations.

children.text: ā yāhi somapītaye spārho deva niyutvatā ||
children.translated_text: Come for the drinking of Soma, desirable god, with your teams.

children.text: indraś ca vāyav eṣāṃ somānām pītim arhathaḥ
children.translated_text: You, <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>, deserve the drinking of these Somas,

children.text: yuvāṃ hi yantīndavo nimnam āpo na sadhryak ||
children.translated_text: for the drops go toward you together, like waters toward the hollow.

children.text: vāyav indraś ca śuṣmiṇā sarathaṃ śavasas patī
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s> and <s>Indra</s>, mighty ones, lords of power, sharing one chariot,

children.text: niyutvantā na ūtaya ā yātaṃ somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: come with your teams for our aids, for the drinking of Soma.

children.text: yā vāṃ santi puruspṛho niyuto dāśuṣe narā
children.translated_text: Those many-desired teams of yours that exist for the worshipper, O men,

children.text: asme tā yajñavāhasendravāyū ni yacchatam ||
children.translated_text: send those here to us as bearers of the sacrifice, O <s>Indra-Vāyu</s>.

children.text: Chapter 344
vihi hotrā avītā vipo na rāyo aryaḥ
children.translated_text: Come as guardian of the invocations, like a lord of inspired praises and of riches;

children.text: vāyav ā candreṇa rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s>, come with your lovely chariot for the drinking of the pressed Soma.

children.text: niryuvāṇo aśastīr niyutvāṁ indrasārathiḥ
children.translated_text: Driving away hostilities, accompanied by your teams, with <s>Indra</s> as charioteer,

children.text: vāyav ā candreṇa rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s>, come with your lovely chariot for the drinking of the pressed Soma.

children.text: anu kṛṣṇe vasudhitī yemāte viśvapeśasā
children.translated_text: The two dark, all-beautiful treasure-holders are harnessed after you;

children.text: vāyav ā candreṇa rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s>, come with your lovely chariot for the drinking of the pressed Soma.

children.text: vahantu tvā manoyujo yuktāso navatir nava
children.translated_text: Let the ninety-nine yoked horses, joined by thought, carry you;

children.text: vāyav ā candreṇa rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s>, come with your lovely chariot for the drinking of the pressed Soma.

children.text: vāyo śataṃ harīṇāṃ yuvasva poṣyāṇām
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s>, yoke a hundred of the bay horses that are to be nourished,

children.text: uta vā te sahasriṇo ratha ā yātu pājasā ||
children.translated_text: or let your thousand-horsed chariot come with force.

children.text: Chapter 345
idaṃ vām āsye haviḥ priyam indrābṛhaspatī
children.translated_text: This oblation in the mouth is dear to you two, O <s>Indra-Bṛhaspati</s>;

children.text: uktham madaś ca śasyate ||
children.translated_text: the recitation and the exhilaration are proclaimed.

children.text: ayaṃ vām pari ṣicyate soma indrābṛhaspatī
children.translated_text: This Soma is poured around for you, O <s>Indra-Bṛhaspati</s>,

children.text: cārur madāya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: lovely for exhilaration and for drinking.

children.text: ā na indrābṛhaspatī gṛham indraś ca gacchatam
children.translated_text: Come to our house, O <s>Indra-Bṛhaspati</s>, <s>Indra</s> together with <s>Bṛhaspati</s>,

children.text: somapā somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: Soma-drinkers, for the drinking of Soma.

children.text: asme indrābṛhaspatī rayiṃ dhattaṃ śatagvinam
children.translated_text: For us, O <s>Indra-Bṛhaspati</s>, place wealth of a hundred cows,

children.text: aśvāvantaṃ sahasriṇam ||
children.translated_text: rich in horses, thousandfold.

children.text: indrābṛhaspatī vayaṃ sute gīrbhir havāmahe
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra-Bṛhaspati</s>, when the Soma is pressed we call you with songs,

children.text: asya somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: for the drinking of this Soma.

children.text: somam indrābṛhaspatī pibataṃ dāśuṣo gṛhe
children.translated_text: Drink the Soma, O <s>Indra-Bṛhaspati</s>, in the house of the worshipper;

children.text: mādayethāṃ tadokasā ||
children.translated_text: be exhilarated in that dwelling of yours.

children.text: Chapter 346
yas tastambha sahasā vi jmo antān bṛhaspatis triṣadhastho raveṇa
children.translated_text: He who by force propped apart the ends of the earth, <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, standing in the triple seat, with his roar,

children.text: tam pratnāsa ṛṣayo dīdhyānāḥ puro viprā dadhire mandrajihvam ||
children.translated_text: him the ancient seers, the inspired sages, placed before them, shining, with a gladdening tongue.

children.text: dhunetayaḥ supraketam madanto bṛhaspate abhi ye nas tatasre
children.translated_text: Those who, shaking, with good insight and rejoicing, have stretched themselves out toward us, O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: pṛṣantaṃ sṛpram adabdham ūrvam bṛhaspate rakṣatād asya yonim ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, let him protect this speckled, gliding, unharmed, broad womb.

children.text: bṛhaspate yā paramā parāvad ata ā ta ṛtaspṛśo ni ṣeduḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, from here to that farthest distance of yours, those who touch <s>ṛta</s> have sat down.

children.text: tubhyaṃ khātā avatā adridugdhā madhva ścotanty abhito virapśam ||
children.translated_text: For you the dug wells, milked by stones, drip honey all around in abundance.

children.text: bṛhaspatiḥ prathamaṃ jāyamāno maho jyotiṣaḥ parame vyoman
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, being born first from the great light in the highest heaven,

children.text: saptāsyas tuvijāto raveṇa vi saptaraśmir adhamat tamāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: seven-mouthed, powerfully born, with his roar and seven rays, drove away the darknesses.

children.text: sa suṣṭubhā sa ṛkvatā gaṇena valaṃ ruroja phaligaṃ raveṇa
children.translated_text: With a well-praising, hymn-bearing band he broke open <s>Vala</s>, the enclosure, with his roar.

children.text: bṛhaspatir usriyā havyasūdaḥ kanikradad vāvaśatīr ud ājat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, driving the oblation, bellowing, brought forth the lowing ruddy cows.

children.text: evā pitre viśvadevāya vṛṣṇe yajñair vidhema namasā havirbhiḥ
children.translated_text: Thus with sacrifices, reverence, and oblations let us serve the father, the all-divine bull.

children.text: bṛhaspate suprajā vīravanto vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, may we be rich in good offspring and heroes, lords of riches.

children.text: sa id rājā pratijanyāni viśvā śuṣmeṇa tasthāv abhi vīryeṇa
children.translated_text: He indeed, as king, has stood over all hostile powers with force and manly strength,

children.text: bṛhaspatiṃ yaḥ subhṛtam bibharti valgūyati vandate pūrvabhājam ||
children.translated_text: who bears well-supported <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, delights in him, and worships the one who has the first share.

children.text: sa it kṣeti sudhita okasi sve tasmā iﾱā pinvate viśvadānīm
children.translated_text: He dwells securely in his own well-founded home; for him <s>Ilā</s> swells at all times.

children.text: tasmai viśaḥ svayam evā namante yasmin brahmā rājani pūrva eti ||
children.translated_text: To him the clans bow of themselves, in whose king the sacred formulation goes before.

children.text: apratīto jayati saṃ dhanāni pratijanyāny uta yā sajanyā
children.translated_text: Unopposed, he wins the riches, both those of hostile kin and those of his own kin,

children.text: avasyave yo varivaḥ kṛṇoti brahmaṇe rājā tam avanti devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the king who makes wide space for the one seeking aid, for the sacred formulation; the gods help him.

children.text: indraś ca somam pibatam bṛhaspate 'smin yajñe mandasānā vṛṣaṇvasū
children.translated_text: Drink the Soma, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, rejoicing at this sacrifice, you two rich in bull-like power.

children.text: ā vāṃ viśantv indavaḥ svābhuvo 'sme rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ ni yacchatam ||
children.translated_text: Let the self-formed drops enter you two; bestow on us wealth accompanied by every hero.

children.text: bṛhaspata indra vardhataṃ naḥ sacā sā vāṃ sumatir bhūtv asme
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s> and <s>Indra</s>, make us prosper; may that favor of yours be with us.

children.text: aviṣṭaṃ dhiyo jigṛtam purandhīr jajastam aryo vanuṣām arātīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Help our thoughts, seize the insights, and overpower the hostilities of the hostile and of men.

children.text: Chapter 347
idam u tyat purutamam purastāj jyotis tamaso vayunāvad asthāt
children.translated_text: This most manifold light has now stood forth in front, full of guidance, out of the darkness.

children.text: nūnaṃ divo duhitaro vibhātīr gātuṃ kṛṇavann uṣaso janāya ||
children.translated_text: Now the shining daughters of heaven, the <s>Uṣases</s>, make a path for humankind.

children.text: asthur u citrā uṣasaḥ purastān mitā iva svaravo 'dhvareṣu
children.translated_text: The bright <s>Uṣases</s> have stood in front, like measured posts at sacrifices.

children.text: vy ū vrajasya tamaso dvārocchantīr avrañchucayaḥ pāvakāḥ ||
children.translated_text: As they shine, the pure, cleansing ones have opened wide the doors of the enclosure of darkness.

children.text: ucchantīr adya citayanta bhojān rādhodeyāyoṣaso maghonīḥ
children.translated_text: Shining today, O <s>Uṣases</s>, rich in gifts, awaken the patrons who are to give bounty.

children.text: acitre antaḥ paṇayaḥ sasantv abudhyamānās tamaso vimadhye ||
children.translated_text: Let the <s>Paṇis</s> sleep inside the unlit place, unawakened in the very midst of darkness.

children.text: kuvit sa devīḥ sanayo navo vā yāmo babhūyād uṣaso vo adya
children.translated_text: May your course today, O divine <s>Uṣases</s>, be ancient or new, bringing gain.

children.text: yenā navagve aṅgire daśagve saptāsye revatī revad ūṣa ||
children.translated_text: By it, for the <s>Navagva</s>, the <s>Aṅgiras</s>, the <s>Daśagva</s>, and the seven-mouthed one, rich <s>Uṣas</s> shone richly.

children.text: yūyaṃ hi devīr ṛtayugbhir aśvaiḥ pariprayātha bhuvanāni sadyaḥ
children.translated_text: For you, O divine ones, with horses yoked by <s>ṛta</s>, swiftly travel around the worlds.

children.text: prabodhayantīr uṣasaḥ sasantaṃ dvipāc catuṣpāc carathāya jīvam ||
children.translated_text: Awakening the sleeping, O <s>Uṣases</s>, you set the living, both two-footed and four-footed, in motion.

children.text: kva svid āsāṃ katamā purāṇī yayā vidhānā vidadhur ṛbhūṇām
children.translated_text: Where, indeed, is one of them, and which is the ancient one, by whose ordinances they fashioned the works of the <s>Ṛbhus</s>?

children.text: śubhaṃ yacchubhrā uṣasaś caranti na vi jñāyante sadṛśīr ajuryāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The bright <s>Uṣases</s> move with splendor; alike and ageless, they are not distinguished from one another.

children.text: tā ghā tā bhadrā uṣasaḥ purāsur abhiṣṭidyumnā ṛtajātasatyāḥ
children.translated_text: Those indeed, those gracious <s>Uṣases</s>, were of old, possessed of desired splendor, born of <s>ṛta</s> and true.

children.text: yāsv ījānaḥ śaśamāna ukthai stuvañchaṃsan draviṇaṃ sadya āpa ||
children.translated_text: In them the worshipper, exerting himself with hymns, praising and lauding, at once obtained wealth.

children.text: tā ā caranti samanā purastāt samānataḥ samanā paprathānāḥ
children.translated_text: They come forward alike from the front, equal, spreading out equally.

children.text: ṛtasya devīḥ sadaso budhānā gavāṃ na sargā uṣaso jarante ||
children.translated_text: The goddesses, awakened from the seat of <s>ṛta</s>, the <s>Uṣases</s>, are praised like releases of cows.

children.text: tā in nv eva samanā samānīr amītavarṇā uṣasaś caranti
children.translated_text: Those same <s>Uṣases</s> move alike and uniform, of immeasurable color.

children.text: gūhantīr abhvam asitaṃ ruśadbhiḥ śukrās tanūbhiḥ śucayo rucānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: With bright bodies, shining, pure, and radiant, they hide the black shapeless gloom.

children.text: rayiṃ divo duhitaro vibhātīḥ prajāvantaṃ yacchatāsmāsu devīḥ
children.translated_text: O shining daughters of heaven, O goddesses, grant among us wealth rich in offspring.

children.text: syonād ā vaḥ pratibudhyamānāḥ suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: Awakening happily at your coming, may we be lords of excellent heroic strength.

children.text: tad vo divo duhitaro vibhātīr upa bruva uṣaso yajñaketuḥ
children.translated_text: That I proclaim to you, O shining daughters of heaven, O <s>Uṣases</s>, as one whose sign is sacrifice.

children.text: vayaṃ syāma yaśaso janeṣu tad dyauś ca dhattām pṛthivī ca devī ||
children.translated_text: May we be famed among people; may heaven and divine earth grant that.

children.text: Chapter 348
prati ṣyā sūnarī janī vyucchantī pari svasuḥ
children.translated_text: That gracious woman, shining forth, has appeared before the people, following her sister.

children.text: divo adarśi duhitā ||
children.translated_text: The daughter of heaven has been seen.

children.text: aśveva citrāruṣī mātā gavām ṛtāvarī
children.translated_text: Like a bright ruddy mare, mother of the cows and keeper of <s>ṛta</s>,

children.text: sakhābhūd aśvinor uṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Uṣas</s> has become the companion of the <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: uta sakhāsy aśvinor uta mātā gavām asi
children.translated_text: And you are the companion of the <s>Aśvins</s>; and you are the mother of the cows.

children.text: utoṣo vasva īśiṣe ||
children.translated_text: And, O <s>Uṣas</s>, you rule over wealth.

children.text: yāvayaddveṣasaṃ tvā cikitvit sūnṛtāvari
children.translated_text: To you, who drive hatred away, O discerning one, O possessor of true speech,

children.text: prati stomair abhutsmahi ||
children.translated_text: we have awakened with songs of praise.

children.text: prati bhadrā adṛkṣata gavāṃ sargā na raśmayaḥ
children.translated_text: The gracious rays have appeared like the releases of cows.

children.text: oṣā aprā uru jrayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Uṣas</s> has filled the broad expanse.

children.text: āpapruṣī vibhāvari vy āvar jyotiṣā tamaḥ
children.translated_text: Filling all, O shining one, open out the darkness with light.

children.text: uṣo anu svadhām ava ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, come down according to your own law.

children.text: ā dyāṃ tanoṣi raśmibhir āntarikṣam uru priyam
children.translated_text: You stretch to heaven with your rays, and to the broad, beloved midspace,

children.text: uṣaḥ śukreṇa śociṣā ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, with your bright flame.

children.text: Chapter 349
tad devasya savitur vāryam mahad vṛṇīmahe asurasya pracetasaḥ
children.translated_text: We choose that desirable, great protection of the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, of the wise <s>Asura</s>,

children.text: chardir yena dāśuṣe yacchati tmanā tan no mahāṁ ud ayān devo aktubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: by which he himself grants shelter to the worshipper; may that great god rise for us with his rays.

children.text: divo dhartā bhuvanasya prajāpatiḥ piśaṅgaṃ drāpim prati muñcate kaviḥ
children.translated_text: The holder of heaven, lord of creatures and of the world, the seer puts on a tawny garment.

children.text: vicakṣaṇaḥ prathayann āpṛṇann urv ajījanat savitā sumnam ukthyam ||
children.translated_text: Discerning, spreading out and filling the broad spaces, <s>Savitṛ</s> has generated praiseworthy favor.

children.text: āprā rajāṃsi divyāni pārthivā ślokaṃ devaḥ kṛṇute svāya dharmaṇe
children.translated_text: The god has filled the heavenly and earthly regions; he makes a song for his own <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: pra bāhū asrāk savitā savīmani niveśayan prasuvann aktubhir jagat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Savitṛ</s> has stretched out his arms in the impulsion, setting the world to rest and setting it in motion with the nights.

children.text: adābhyo bhuvanāni pracākaśad vratāni devaḥ savitābhi rakṣate
children.translated_text: Unassailable, the god <s>Savitṛ</s> has looked out over the beings; he guards the vows.

children.text: prāsrāg bāhū bhuvanasya prajābhyo dhṛtavrato maho ajmasya rājati ||
children.translated_text: He has stretched out his arms toward the creatures of the world; firm in vow, he reigns over the great course.

children.text: trir antarikṣaṃ savitā mahitvanā trī rajāṃsi paribhus trīṇi rocanā
children.translated_text: Three times <s>Savitṛ</s>, by his greatness, encompasses the midspace, the three realms, and the three bright regions.

children.text: tisro divaḥ pṛthivīs tisra invati tribhir vratair abhi no rakṣati tmanā ||
children.translated_text: He impels the three heavens and the three earths; by three ordinances he himself protects us on every side.

children.text: bṛhatsumnaḥ prasavītā niveśano jagata sthātur ubhayasya yo vaśī
children.translated_text: Of great favor, the impeller, the establisher, who is lord of both the moving and the standing,

children.text: sa no devaḥ savitā śarma yacchatv asme kṣayāya trivarūtham aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may that god <s>Savitṛ</s> grant us shelter, a threefold defense against distress, for our dwelling.

children.text: āgan deva ṛtubhir vardhatu kṣayaṃ dadhātu naḥ savitā suprajām iṣam
children.translated_text: May the god come with the seasons; may <s>Savitṛ</s> enlarge our dwelling and bestow on us nourishment rich in good offspring.

children.text: sa naḥ kṣapābhir ahabhiś ca jinvatu prajāvantaṃ rayim asme sam invatu ||
children.translated_text: May he quicken us through nights and days; may he send to us wealth accompanied by progeny.

children.text: Chapter 350
abhūd devaḥ savitā vandyo nu na idānīm ahna upavācyo nṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: The god <s>Savitṛ</s> has now become worthy of praise for us, to be addressed by men at this time of day,

children.text: vi yo ratnā bhajati mānavebhyaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ no atra draviṇaṃ yathā dadhat ||
children.translated_text: he who distributes treasures to human beings; may he place the best wealth for us here.

children.text: devebhyo hi prathamaṃ yajñiyebhyo 'mṛtatvaṃ suvasi bhāgam uttamam
children.translated_text: For to the gods, the first sacrificial ones, you set in motion immortality as the highest share.

children.text: ād id dāmānaṃ savitar vy ūrṇuṣe 'nūcīnā jīvitā mānuṣebhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then, O <s>Savitṛ</s>, you uncover the gift, life continuing onward, for human beings.

children.text: acittī yac cakṛmā daivye jane dīnair dakṣaiḥ prabhūtī pūruṣatvatā
children.translated_text: Whatever unwitting offense we have committed among the divine people, through weak judgments, abundance, or human nature,

children.text: deveṣu ca savitar mānuṣeṣu ca tvaṃ no atra suvatād anāgasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: both among gods and among men, O <s>Savitṛ</s>, may you impel us here as guiltless.

children.text: na pramiye savitur daivyasya tad yathā viśvam bhuvanaṃ dhārayiṣyati
children.translated_text: That ordinance of divine <s>Savitṛ</s> does not fail, by which he will uphold the whole world,

children.text: yat pṛthivyā varimann ā svaṅgurir varṣman divaḥ suvati satyam asya tat ||
children.translated_text: when, fair-fingered, he impels from the broadness of earth and from the height of heaven; that of his is true.

children.text: indrajyeṣṭhān bṛhadbhyaḥ parvatebhyaḥ kṣayāṁ ebhyaḥ suvasi pastyāvataḥ
children.translated_text: You impel the dwellings, rich in homesteads, for these great mountains, with <s>Indra</s> as their eldest.

children.text: yathā yathā patayanto viyemira evaiva tasthuḥ savitaḥ savāya te ||
children.translated_text: Just as, flying, they spread apart, so indeed they have stood for your impulse, O <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: ye te trir ahan savitaḥ savāso dive dive saubhagam āsuvanti
children.translated_text: Those impulses of yours, O <s>Savitṛ</s>, three times a day, day by day, bring forth good fortune.

children.text: indro dyāvāpṛthivī sindhur adbhir ādityair no aditiḥ śarma yaṃsat ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> (Heaven-and-Earth), the <s>Sindhu</s> with the waters, and <s>Aditi</s> with the <s>Ādityas</s> extend shelter to us.

children.text: Chapter 351
ko vas trātā vasavaḥ ko varūtā dyāvābhūmī adite trāsīthāṃ naḥ
children.translated_text: Who is your savior, O <s>Vasus</s>? Who is your protector? O <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, O <s>Aditi</s>, protect us.

children.text: sahīyaso varuṇa mitra martāt ko vo 'dhvare varivo dhāti devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Varuṇa</s>, O <s>Mitra</s>, stronger than a mortal, which of you gods grants wide space at the rite?

children.text: pra ye dhāmāni pūrvyāṇy arcān vi yad ucchān viyotāro amūrāḥ
children.translated_text: Those who proclaimed the ancient stations, when the unerring ones shone forth on high,

children.text: vidhātāro vi te dadhur ajasrā ṛtadhītayo rurucanta dasmāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the constant ordainers, with minds set on <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), set them apart; the wondrous ones have shone.

children.text: pra pastyām aditiṃ sindhum arkaiḥ svastim īﾱe sakhyāya devīm
children.translated_text: With songs I call upon <s>Aditi</s>, the <s>Sindhu</s>, and the goddess <s>Svasti</s> in the dwelling, for friendship.

children.text: ubhe yathā no ahanī nipāta uṣāsānaktā karatām adabdhe ||
children.translated_text: May the two, <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Naktā</s>, uninjured, protect both our days.
