children.text: vy aryamā varuṇaś ceti panthām iṣas patiḥ suvitaṃ gātum agniḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Aryaman</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> discern the path; <s>Agni</s>, lord of refreshment, discerns the good road.

children.text: indrāviṣṇū nṛvad u ṣu stavānā śarma no yantam amavad varūtham ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, praised in manly fashion, grant us shelter, a forceful protection.

children.text: ā parvatasya marutām avāṃsi devasya trātur avri bhagasya
children.translated_text: I call hither the aids of the mountain, of the <s>Maruts</s>, of the protecting god, and of open-handed <s>Bhaga</s>.

children.text: pāt patir janyād aṃhaso no mitro mitriyād uta na uruṣyet ||
children.translated_text: May the lord protect us from kin-born distress; may <s>Mitra</s>, through friendship too, set us free.

children.text: nū rodasī ahinā budhnyena stuvīta devī apyebhir iṣṭaiḥ
children.translated_text: Now the two worlds should be praised with <s>Ahi Budhnya</s> and with these desired offerings,

children.text: samudraṃ na saṃcaraṇe saniṣyavo gharmasvaraso nadyo apa vran ||
children.translated_text: as rivers, sounding with heat and seeking gain at a common course, have opened to the ocean.

children.text: devair no devy aditir ni pātu devas trātā trāyatām aprayucchan
children.translated_text: May divine <s>Aditi</s> protect us with the gods; may the protecting god protect us without neglect.

children.text: nahi mitrasya varuṇasya dhāsim arhāmasi pramiyaṃ sānv agneḥ ||
children.translated_text: For we are not able to violate the ordinance of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, nor the summit of <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: agnir īśe vasavyasyāgnir mahaḥ saubhagasya
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has command of wealth; <s>Agni</s> has command of great good fortune.

children.text: tāny asmabhyaṃ rāsate ||
children.translated_text: May he grant those things to us.

children.text: uṣo maghony ā vaha sūnṛte vāryā puru
children.translated_text: O munificent <s>Uṣas</s>, bring many desirable things with fair speech

children.text: asmabhyaṃ vājinīvati ||
children.translated_text: for us, O richly vigorous one.

children.text: tat su naḥ savitā bhago varuṇo mitro aryamā
children.translated_text: May <s>Savitṛ</s>, <s>Bhaga</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s> do that well for us.

children.text: indro no rādhasā gamat ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> come to us with bounty.

children.text: Chapter 352
mahī dyāvāpṛthivī iha jyeṣṭhe rucā bhavatāṃ śucayadbhir arkaiḥ
children.translated_text: Great <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, the two eldest here, be radiant with shining songs,

children.text: yat sīṃ variṣṭhe bṛhatī viminvan ruvaddhokṣā paprathānebhir evaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: when the roaring bull, measuring out the two broad, lofty ones, spread them with his powers.

children.text: devī devebhir yajate yajatrair aminatī tasthatur ukṣamāṇe
children.translated_text: The two goddesses, worshipful among worshipful gods, stand unaging and showering,

children.text: ṛtāvarī adruhā devaputre yajñasya netrī śucayadbhir arkaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: rich in <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), undeceitful daughters of the god, leaders of the sacrifice, with shining songs.

children.text: sa it svapā bhuvaneṣv āsa ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī jajāna
children.translated_text: He indeed was a skillful worker among beings, who begot these <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>,

children.text: urvī gabhīre rajasī sumeke avaṃśe dhīraḥ śacyā sam airat ||
children.translated_text: the wide, deep, well-founded two realms; the wise one, by his power, set them in motion without support.

children.text: nū rodasī bṛhadbhir no varūthaiḥ patnīvadbhir iṣayantī sajoṣāḥ
children.translated_text: Now, O two worlds, with great protections, accompanied by your lords, favoring us together,

children.text: urūcī viśve yajate ni pātaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O wide ones, O all-worshipful pair, protect us; through inspired thought may we always possess chariots.

children.text: pra vām mahi dyavī abhy upastutim bharāmahe
children.translated_text: For you two, O great heavenly ones, we bring forward a lofty praise,

children.text: śucī upa praśastaye ||
children.translated_text: bright, for commendation.

children.text: punāne tanvā mithaḥ svena dakṣeṇa rājathaḥ
children.translated_text: Purifying yourselves in body, each with your own skill, you rule;

children.text: ūhyāthe sanād ṛtam ||
children.translated_text: from of old you uphold <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: mahī mitrasya sādhathas tarantī pipratī ṛtam
children.translated_text: You accomplish the great work of <s>Mitra</s>, crossing over and filling <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order);

children.text: pari yajñaṃ ni ṣedathuḥ ||
children.translated_text: you have sat down around the sacrifice.

children.text: Chapter 353
kṣetrasya patinā vayaṃ hiteneva jayāmasi
children.translated_text: Together with the lord of the field we would conquer, as with a beneficent friend.

children.text: gām aśvam poṣayitnv ā sa no mṛﾱātīdṛśe ||
children.translated_text: Let him nourish cow and horse for us; may he show favor to us for such prosperity.

children.text: kṣetrasya pate madhumantam ūrmiṃ dhenur iva payo asmāsu dhukṣva
children.translated_text: O lord of the field, milk for us a honeyed wave, like a cow its milk,

children.text: madhuścutaṃ ghṛtam iva supūtam ṛtasya naḥ patayo mṛﾱayantu ||
children.translated_text: honey-dripping, well purified like ghee; may the lords of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) show us favor.

children.text: madhumatīr oṣadhīr dyāva āpo madhuman no bhavatv antarikṣam
children.translated_text: May the herbs be honey-sweet, and the heavens and waters; may the midspace be honey-sweet for us.

children.text: kṣetrasya patir madhumān no astv ariṣyanto anv enaṃ carema ||
children.translated_text: May the lord of the field be honey-sweet to us; unharmed may we follow after him.

children.text: śunaṃ vāhāḥ śunaṃ naraḥ śunaṃ kṛṣatu lāṅgalam
children.translated_text: Auspicious be the draft animals; auspicious be the men; auspiciously may the plough till.

children.text: śunaṃ varatrā badhyantāṃ śunam aṣṭrām ud iṅgaya ||
children.translated_text: Auspiciously may the straps be bound; auspiciously raise up the goad.

children.text: śunāsīrāv imāṃ vācaṃ juṣethāṃ yad divi cakrathuḥ payaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Śunāsīra</s>, accept this speech; with the milk that you two have made in heaven,

children.text: tenemām upa siñcatam ||
children.translated_text: sprinkle this one here.

children.text: arvācī subhage bhava sīte vandāmahe tvā
children.translated_text: Come near to us, O fortunate <s>Sītā</s>; we revere you,

children.text: yathā naḥ subhagāsasi yathā naḥ suphalāsasi ||
children.translated_text: so that you may be fortunate for us, so that you may be fruitful for us.

children.text: indraḥ sītāṃ ni gṛhṇātu tām pūṣānu yacchatu
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> take hold of <s>Sītā</s>; may <s>Pūṣan</s> guide her onward.

children.text: sā naḥ payasvatī duhām uttarām uttarāṃ samām ||
children.translated_text: May she, rich in milk, milk for us each succeeding year.

children.text: śunaṃ naḥ phālā vi kṛṣantu bhūmiṃ śunaṃ kīnāśā abhi yantu vāhaiḥ
children.translated_text: May the ploughshares plough the earth auspiciously for us; may the ploughmen go auspiciously with their teams.

children.text: śunam parjanyo madhunā payobhiḥ śunāsīrā śunam asmāsu dhattam ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Parjanya</s>, with honey and waters, be auspicious for us; O <s>Śunāsīrā</s>, place auspiciousness among us.

children.text: Chapter 354
samudrād ūrmir madhumāṁ ud ārad upāṃśunā sam amṛtatvam ānaṭ
children.translated_text: From the ocean the honeyed wave has risen; through the silent draught it has reached immortality.

children.text: ghṛtasya nāma guhyaṃ yad asti jihvā devānām amṛtasya nābhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: It is the hidden name of <s>ghṛta</s> (clarified butter); it is the tongue of the gods, the navel of immortality.

children.text: vayaṃ nāma pra bravāmā ghṛtasyāsmin yajñe dhārayāmā namobhiḥ
children.translated_text: We proclaim the name of <s>ghṛta</s>; in this sacrifice we uphold it with reverences.

children.text: upa brahmā śṛṇavacchasyamānaṃ catuḥśṛṅgo 'vamīd gaura etat ||
children.translated_text: Let the sacred utterance hear it as it is praised: the tawny one with four horns has bellowed this out.

children.text: catvāri śṛṅgā trayo asya pādā dve śīrṣe sapta hastāso asya
children.translated_text: Four are its horns, three are its feet, two are its heads, and seven are its hands.

children.text: tridhā baddho vṛṣabho roravīti maho devo martyāṁ ā viveśa ||
children.translated_text: Bound in three ways, the bull roars; the great god has entered mortals.

children.text: tridhā hitam paṇibhir guhyamānaṃ gavi devāso ghṛtam anv avindan
children.translated_text: The gods found the <s>ghṛta</s>, hidden by the <s>Paṇis</s>, placed threefold in the cow.

children.text: indra ekaṃ sūrya ekaṃ jajāna venād ekaṃ svadhayā niṣ ṭatakṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> produced one, <s>Sūrya</s> produced one; from <s>Vena</s> they fashioned one by their own inherent power.

children.text: etā arṣanti hṛdyāt samudrācchatavrajā ripuṇā nāvacakṣe
children.translated_text: These streams flow from the heart, from the ocean, shut in by a hundred enclosures, not to be seen by the enemy.

children.text: ghṛtasya dhārā abhi cākaśīmi hiraṇyayo vetaso madhya āsām ||
children.translated_text: I gaze upon the streams of <s>ghṛta</s>; the golden reed is in their midst.

children.text: samyak sravanti sarito na dhenā antar hṛdā manasā pūyamānāḥ
children.translated_text: They flow rightly, like rivers, like milch cows, purified within by heart and mind.

children.text: ete arṣanty ūrmayo ghṛtasya mṛgā iva kṣipaṇor īṣamāṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: These waves of <s>ghṛta</s> flow forth, like wild animals fleeing from the archer.

children.text: sindhor iva prādhvane śūghanāso vātapramiyaḥ patayanti yahvāḥ
children.translated_text: Like swift runners on the course of a river, wind-driven, the mighty ones fly onward.

children.text: ghṛtasya dhārā aruṣo na vājī kāṣṭhā bhindann ūrmibhiḥ pinvamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The streams of <s>ghṛta</s>, like a ruddy racehorse, break through the boundaries, swelling with waves.

children.text: abhi pravanta samaneva yoṣāḥ kalyāṇyaḥ smayamānāso agnim
children.translated_text: They advance toward <s>Agni</s> like beautiful, smiling women going to an assembly.

children.text: ghṛtasya dhārāḥ samidho nasanta tā juṣāṇo haryati jātavedāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The streams of <s>ghṛta</s> reach the kindling-sticks; <s>Jātavedas</s>, accepting them, desires them.

children.text: kanyā iva vahatum etavā u añjy añjānā abhi cākaśīmi
children.translated_text: Like maidens going to a wedding procession, anointing themselves and adorned, I gaze upon them.

children.text: yatra somaḥ sūyate yatra yajño ghṛtasya dhārā abhi tat pavante ||
children.translated_text: Where <s>Soma</s> is pressed, where the sacrifice is performed, there the streams of <s>ghṛta</s> purify themselves.

children.text: abhy arṣata suṣṭutiṃ gavyam ājim asmāsu bhadrā draviṇāni dhatta
children.translated_text: Flow toward the well-sung praise, toward the cattle-winning contest; place fair treasures among us.

children.text: imaṃ yajñaṃ nayata devatā no ghṛtasya dhārā madhumat pavante ||
children.translated_text: Lead this sacrifice of ours to the gods; the streams of <s>ghṛta</s> flow honey-sweet.

children.text: dhāman te viśvam bhuvanam adhi śritam antaḥ samudre hṛdy antar āyuṣi
children.translated_text: Upon your station the whole world has rested, within the ocean, in the heart, within life.

children.text: apām anīke samithe ya ābhṛtas tam aśyāma madhumantaṃ ta ūrmim ||
children.translated_text: At the face of the waters, brought together in the assembly, may we attain that honeyed wave of yours.

children.text: Chapter 355
abodhy agniḥ samidhā janānām prati dhenum ivāyatīm uṣāsam
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has awakened at the kindling of men, facing <s>Uṣas</s> like an approaching milch cow.

children.text: yahvā iva pra vayām ujjihānāḥ pra bhānavaḥ sisrate nākam accha ||
children.translated_text: Like great branches rising up, his rays have streamed forth toward the vault of heaven.

children.text: abodhi hotā yajathāya devān ūrdhvo agniḥ sumanāḥ prātar asthāt
children.translated_text: The <s>Hotar</s> (officiating priest) has awakened to sacrifice to the gods; <s>Agni</s>, upright and gracious-minded, has stood forth in the morning.

children.text: samiddhasya ruśad adarśi pājo mahān devas tamaso nir amoci ||
children.translated_text: The shining power of the kindled one has appeared; the great god has been released from darkness.

children.text: yad īṃ gaṇasya raśanām ajīgaḥ śucir aṅkte śucibhir gobhir agniḥ
children.translated_text: When <s>Agni</s> has set the band of the troop in motion, pure, he adorns himself with pure rays.

children.text: ād dakṣiṇā yujyate vājayanty uttānām ūrdhvo adhayaj juhūbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Dakṣiṇā</s> is yoked, winning the prize; upright, he has milked the outstretched one with ladles.

children.text: agnim acchā devayatām manāṃsi cakṣūṃṣīva sūrye saṃ caranti
children.translated_text: The minds of those who seek the gods move toward <s>Agni</s>, as eyes move toward the sun.

children.text: yad īṃ suvāte uṣasā virūpe śveto vājī jāyate agre ahnām ||
children.translated_text: When the two differently formed Dawns give birth to him, a white steed is born at the beginning of the days.

children.text: janiṣṭa hi jenyo agre ahnāṃ hito hiteṣv aruṣo vaneṣu
children.translated_text: For the conqueror was born at the beginning of the days, set in the appointed places, ruddy in the woods.

children.text: dame dame sapta ratnā dadhāno 'gnir hotā ni ṣasādā yajīyān ||
children.translated_text: In every house, holding the seven treasures, <s>Agni</s>, the <s>Hotar</s>, most worthy of sacrifice, has sat down.

children.text: agnir hotā ny asīdad yajīyān upasthe mātuḥ surabhā u loke
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, the <s>Hotar</s>, most worthy of sacrifice, has sat down in his mother's lap, in the fragrant place.

children.text: yuvā kaviḥ puruniṣṭha ṛtāvā dhartā kṛṣṭīnām uta madhya iddhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Young, a sage, dwelling in many places, guardian of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), sustainer of peoples, and kindled in their midst.

children.text: pra ṇu tyaṃ vipram adhvareṣu sādhum agniṃ hotāram īḍate namobhiḥ
children.translated_text: Now with reverences they praise that inspired sage, effective in the rites, <s>Agni</s> the <s>Hotar</s>.

children.text: ā yas tatāna rodasī ṛtena nityam mṛjanti vājinaṃ ghṛtena ||
children.translated_text: He who stretched apart heaven and earth by <s>ṛta</s>; they continually cleanse the prize-winning one with <s>ghṛta</s>.

children.text: mārjālyo mṛjyate sve damūnāḥ kavipraśasto atithiḥ śivo naḥ
children.translated_text: The one to be cleansed is cleansed in his own home, lord of the house, praised by seers, a guest auspicious for us.

children.text: sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabhas tadojā viśvāṁ agne sahasā prāsy anyān ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, thousand-horned bull, with that force you drive away all others by your might.

children.text: pra sadyo agne aty eṣy anyān āvir yasmai cārutamo babhūtha
children.translated_text: At once, O <s>Agni</s>, you pass beyond the others, manifest to the one for whom you have become most lovely,

children.text: īﾱenyo vapuṣyo vibhāvā priyo viśām atithir mānuṣīṇām ||
children.translated_text: praiseworthy, beautiful in form, wide-shining, dear as the guest of human clans.

children.text: tubhyam bharanti kṣitayo yaviṣṭha balim agne antita ota dūrāt
children.translated_text: To you the dwellers bring tribute, O youngest <s>Agni</s>, from near and also from far away.

children.text: ā bhandiṣṭhasya sumatiṃ cikiddhi bṛhat te agne mahi śarma bhadram ||
children.translated_text: Know the gracious thought of the most worshipful one; great, O <s>Agni</s>, is your mighty, blessed shelter.

children.text: ādya ratham bhānumo bhānumantam agne tiṣṭha yajatebhiḥ samantam
children.translated_text: Today, O <s>Agni</s>, mount the radiant, gleaming chariot, surrounded by those who sacrifice.

children.text: vidvān pathīnām urv antarikṣam eha devān haviradyāya vakṣi ||
children.translated_text: Knowing the paths across the wide midspace, bring the gods here to eat the oblation.

children.text: avocāma kavaye medhyāya vaco vandāru vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe
children.translated_text: We have spoken a reverent word to the inspired, pure sage, to the bull, the virile one.

children.text: gaviṣṭhiro namasā stomam agnau divīva rukmam uruvyañcam aśret ||
children.translated_text: Firm in the quest for cattle, he has set the hymn in <s>Agni</s> with reverence, like a golden ornament spread wide in heaven.

children.text: Chapter 356
kumāram mātā yuvatiḥ samubdhaṃ guhā bibharti na dadāti pitre
children.translated_text: The young mother bears the boy, hidden and concealed; she does not give him to the father.

children.text: anīkam asya na minaj janāsaḥ puraḥ paśyanti nihitam aratau ||
children.translated_text: People do not diminish his face; they see him set in front, hidden in the firewood.

children.text: kam etaṃ tvaṃ yuvate kumāram peṣī bibharṣi mahiṣī jajāna
children.translated_text: What is this boy, young woman, whom you carry as an embryo? The queen has given birth to him.

children.text: pūrvīr hi garbhaḥ śarado vavardhāpaśyaṃ jātaṃ yad asūta mātā ||
children.translated_text: For the embryo has grown through many autumns; I saw him born when the mother gave birth.

children.text: hiraṇyadantaṃ śucivarṇam ārāt kṣetrād apaśyam āyudhā mimānam
children.translated_text: From afar, from the field, I saw him, golden-toothed and bright-colored, fashioning weapons.

children.text: dadāno asmā amṛtaṃ vipṛkvat kim mām anindrāḥ kṛṇavann anukthāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Giving him the mingled immortality, what will those without <s>Indra</s>, without hymns, do to me?

children.text: kṣetrād apaśyaṃ sanutaś carantaṃ sumad yūthaṃ na puru śobhamānam
children.translated_text: From the field I saw him moving secretly, splendid like a rich herd.

children.text: na tā agṛbhrann ajaniṣṭa hi ṣaḥ paliknīr id yuvatayo bhavanti ||
children.translated_text: They did not seize those; for he was born. Even the gray-haired ones become young women.

children.text: ke me maryakaṃ vi yavanta gobhir na yeṣāṃ gopā araṇaś cid āsa
children.translated_text: Who are they who drive my young man away with their cattle, those for whom there was not even a cowherd as a stranger?

children.text: ya īṃ jagṛbhur ava te sṛjantv ājāti paśva upa naś cikitvān ||
children.translated_text: Let those who seized him release him; knowing the birth of the herd, let him come near to us.

children.text: vasāṃ rājānaṃ vasatiṃ janānām arātayo ni dadhur martyeṣu
children.translated_text: Hostile men have set down among mortals the lord of dwellings, the dwelling-place of peoples.

children.text: brahmāṇy atrer ava taṃ sṛjantu ninditāro nindyāso bhavantu ||
children.translated_text: Let the sacred utterances of <s>Atri</s> release him; let the revilers themselves become fit for reviling.

children.text: śunaś cicchepaṃ niditaṃ sahasrād yūpād amuñco aśamiṣṭa hi ṣaḥ
children.translated_text: You released <s>Śunaḥśepa</s>, bound, from the thousandfold sacrificial post, for he had won peace.

children.text: evāsmad agne vi mumugdhi pāśān hotaś cikitva iha tū niṣadya ||
children.translated_text: So, O <s>Agni</s>, loose the bonds from us, O knowing Hotar, sitting down here now.

children.text: hṛṇīyamāno apa hi mad aiyeḥ pra me devānāṃ vratapā uvāca
children.translated_text: Being abashed, he indeed went away from me; the guardian of the gods' ordinances spoke forth to me.

children.text: indro vidvāṁ anu hi tvā cacakṣa tenāham agne anuśiṣṭa āgām ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, knowing, looked after you; instructed by him, O <s>Agni</s>, I have come after you.

children.text: vi jyotiṣā bṛhatā bhāty agnir āvir viśvāni kṛṇute mahitvā
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> shines apart with great light; by his greatness he makes all things manifest.

children.text: prādevīr māyāḥ sahate durevāḥ śiśīte śṛṅge rakṣase vinikṣe ||
children.translated_text: He overcomes the godless, evil-working deceits; he sharpens his horns to thrust at the <s>Rakṣas</s>.

children.text: uta svānāso divi ṣantv agnes tigmāyudhā rakṣase hantavā u
children.translated_text: Let <s>Agni</s>'s own roaring powers be in heaven, sharp-weaponed for slaying the <s>Rakṣas</s>.

children.text: made cid asya pra rujanti bhāmā na varante paribādho adevīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even in his exhilaration his flames break forth; the godless obstructions do not hold him back.

children.text: etaṃ te stomaṃ tuvijāta vipro rathaṃ na dhīraḥ svapā atakṣam
children.translated_text: This praise for you, O strongly born one, the inspired poet has fashioned like a chariot, a skillful wise man.

children.text: yadīd agne prati tvaṃ deva haryāḥ svarvatīr apa enā jayema ||
children.translated_text: If you, O god <s>Agni</s>, graciously accept it, may we overcome these offenses with the light-filled powers.

children.text: tuvigrīvo vṛṣabho vāvṛdhāno 'śatrv aryaḥ sam ajāti vedaḥ
children.translated_text: Strong-necked, a bull, growing mighty, he is born as a knowing, noble one without enemies.

children.text: itīmam agnim amṛtā avocan barhiṣmate manave śarma yaṃsad dhaviṣmate manave śarma yaṃsat ||
children.translated_text: Thus the immortals spoke of this <s>Agni</s>; may he grant shelter to <s>Manu</s> with sacred grass, shelter to <s>Manu</s> with oblation.

children.text: Chapter 357
tvam agne varuṇo jāyase yat tvam mitro bhavasi yat samiddhaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, become <s>Varuṇa</s> when you are born; you become <s>Mitra</s> when you are kindled.

children.text: tve viśve sahasas putra devās tvam indro dāśuṣe martyāya ||
children.translated_text: In you, O son of strength, are all the gods; you are <s>Indra</s> for the mortal worshipper who gives.

children.text: tvam aryamā bhavasi yat kanīnāṃ nāma svadhāvan guhyam bibharṣi
children.translated_text: You become <s>Aryaman</s> when, self-lawed one, you bear the secret name of the maidens.

children.text: añjanti mitraṃ sudhitaṃ na gobhir yad dampatī samanasā kṛṇoṣi ||
children.translated_text: They anoint <s>Mitra</s>, well established, as with cows, when you make husband and wife of one mind.

children.text: tava śriye maruto marjayanta rudra yat te janima cāru citram
children.translated_text: For your splendor the <s>Maruts</s> adorn themselves, O <s>Rudra</s>, since your birth is lovely and wondrous.

children.text: padaṃ yad viṣṇor upamaṃ nidhāyi tena pāsi guhyaṃ nāma gonām ||
children.translated_text: When the highest step of <s>Viṣṇu</s> was set down, with that you guard the secret name of the cows.

children.text: tava śriyā sudṛśo deva devāḥ purū dadhānā amṛtaṃ sapanta
children.translated_text: By your splendor, O god, the fair-seeing gods, bearing many things, have reached immortality.

children.text: hotāram agnim manuṣo ni ṣedur daśasyanta uśijaḥ śaṃsam āyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: Men set <s>Agni</s> down as Hotar; the eager <s>Uśijs</s>, serving, set down the praise of <s>Āyu</s>.

children.text: na tvaddhotā pūrvo agne yajīyān na kāvyaiḥ paro asti svadhāvaḥ
children.translated_text: No Hotar before you, O <s>Agni</s>, is more worthy of sacrifice, and none later surpasses you in inspired wisdom, self-lawed one.

children.text: viśaś ca yasyā atithir bhavāsi sa yajñena vanavad deva martān ||
children.translated_text: For the clans of whom you become the guest, he, O god, wins mortals by sacrifice.

children.text: vayam agne vanuyāma tvotā vasūyavo haviṣā budhyamānāḥ
children.translated_text: May we, O <s>Agni</s>, protected by you, desiring goods and awakened by oblation, win abundance.

children.text: vayaṃ samarye vidatheṣv ahnāṃ vayaṃ rāyā sahasas putra martān ||
children.translated_text: May we, in the day's assemblies and battles, with wealth, O son of strength, overcome mortal men.

children.text: yo na āgo abhy eno bharāty adhīd agham aghaśaṃse dadhāta
children.translated_text: Whoever brings offense or sin against us, whoever lays evil upon us with evil speech,

children.text: jahī cikitvo abhiśastim etām agne yo no marcayati dvayena ||
children.translated_text: strike down this curse, O knowing <s>Agni</s>, whoever harms us through double-dealing.

children.text: tvām asyā vyuṣi deva pūrve dūtaṃ kṛṇvānā ayajanta havyaiḥ
children.translated_text: At this dawn, O god, the former ones made you their messenger and worshipped you with oblations.

children.text: saṃsthe yad agna īyase rayīṇāṃ devo martair vasubhir idhyamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When, at the gathering of riches, you go, O <s>Agni</s>, a god kindled by mortals with goods.

children.text: ava spṛdhi pitaraṃ yodhi vidvāṁ putro yas te sahasaḥ sūna ūhe
children.translated_text: Protect the father; contend, knowing one. The son who is yours, O son of strength, has called upon you.

children.text: kadā cikitvo abhi cakṣase no 'gne kadāṃ ṛtacid yātayāse ||
children.translated_text: When, knowing one, will you look upon us? O <s>Agni</s>, when, knower of truth, will you set us on the way?

children.text: bhūri nāma vandamāno dadhāti pitā vaso yadi taj joṣayāse
children.translated_text: The father, praised with many names, bestows wealth, O good one, if you take pleasure in that.

children.text: kuvid devasya sahasā cakānaḥ sumnam agnir vanate vāvṛdhānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Perhaps, eager through the god's might, <s>Agni</s>, growing strong, will win favor.

children.text: tvam aṅga jaritāraṃ yaviṣṭha viśvāny agne duritāti parṣi
children.translated_text: You indeed, O youngest <s>Agni</s>, carry the singer beyond all hardships.

children.text: stenā adṛśran ripavo janāso 'jñātaketā vṛjinā abhūvan ||
children.translated_text: The thieves have appeared, hostile men; lacking clear signs, they have become crooked.

children.text: ime yāmāsas tvadrig abhūvan vasave vā tad id āgo avāci
children.translated_text: These courses have turned toward you; for the sake of wealth, that very offense has been spoken.

children.text: nāhāyam agnir abhiśastaye no na rīṣate vāvṛdhānaḥ parā dāt ||
children.translated_text: This <s>Agni</s> of ours will not give us over to accusation; growing strong, he is not harmed.

children.text: Chapter 358
tvām agne vasupatiṃ vasūnām abhi pra mande adhvareṣu rājan
children.translated_text: I praise you, O <s>Agni</s>, lord of goods and king of riches, in the sacrifices.

children.text: tvayā vājaṃ vājayanto jayemābhi ṣyāma pṛtsutīr martyānām ||
children.translated_text: With you, striving for the prize, may we win the prize; may we overcome the assaults of mortals.

children.text: havyavāﾱ agnir ajaraḥ pitā no vibhur vibhāvā sudṛśīko asme
children.translated_text: Oblation-bearing <s>Agni</s>, ageless, our father, far-pervading, radiant and fair to behold for us,

children.text: sugārhapatyāḥ sam iṣo didīhy asmadryak sam mimīhi śravāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: with good household fires, shine forth our foods; measure out fame toward us.

children.text: viśāṃ kaviṃ viśpatim mānuṣīṇāṃ śucim pāvakaṃ ghṛtapṛṣṭham agnim
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, seer of the clans, lord of human clans, bright, purifying, with back sprinkled with ghee,

children.text: ni hotāraṃ viśvavidaṃ dadhidhve sa deveṣu vanate vāryāṇi ||
children.translated_text: set him down as Hotar, all-knowing; among the gods he wins desirable goods.

children.text: juṣasvāgna iﾱayā sajoṣā yatamāno raśmibhiḥ sūryasya
children.translated_text: Be pleased, O <s>Agni</s>, together with <s>Iḷā</s>, striving with the rays of the sun.

children.text: juṣasva naḥ samidhaṃ jātaveda ā ca devān haviradyāya vakṣi ||
children.translated_text: Be pleased with our kindling, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, and bring the gods here to eat the oblation today.

children.text: juṣṭo damūnā atithir duroṇa imaṃ no yajñam upa yāhi vidvān
children.translated_text: Well pleased, house-lord and guest in the dwelling, come knowingly to this sacrifice of ours.

children.text: viśvā agne abhiyujo vihatyā śatrūyatām ā bharā bhojanāni ||
children.translated_text: Having struck down all attackers, O <s>Agni</s>, bring us the enjoyments of those who act as enemies.

children.text: vadhena dasyum pra hi cātayasva vayaḥ kṛṇvānas tanve svāyai
children.translated_text: With your weapon drive the <s>Dasyu</s> far away, making strength for your own body.

children.text: piparṣi yat sahasas putra devānt so agne pāhi nṛtama vāje asmān ||
children.translated_text: When, O son of strength, you carry the gods across, then, O <s>Agni</s>, best of men, protect us in the prize-contest.

children.text: vayaṃ te agna ukthair vidhema vayaṃ havyaiḥ pāvaka bhadraśoce
children.translated_text: We would serve you, O <s>Agni</s>, with hymns; we would serve with oblations, O purifier of auspicious flame.

children.text: asme rayiṃ viśvavāraṃ sam invāsme viśvāni draviṇāni dhehi ||
children.translated_text: Bring to us wealth desirable to all; place in us all treasures.

children.text: asmākam agne adhvaraṃ juṣasva sahasaḥ sūno triṣadhastha havyam
children.translated_text: Accept our <s>adhvara</s> (sacrificial rite), O <s>Agni</s>, son of strength, dwelling in three seats, and our oblation.

children.text: vayaṃ deveṣu sukṛtaḥ syāma śarmaṇā nas trivarūthena pāhi ||
children.translated_text: May we be doers of good among the gods; protect us with shelter that has threefold defense.

children.text: viśvāni no durgahā jātavedaḥ sindhuṃ na nāvā duritāti parṣi
children.translated_text: Carry us, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, across all difficult passages, across hardships as by a boat across a river.

children.text: agne atrivan namasā gṛṇāno 'smākam bodhy avitā tanūnām ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, praised with reverence like <s>Atri</s>, be the protector of our bodies.

children.text: yas tvā hṛdā kīriṇā manyamāno 'martyam martyo johavīmi
children.translated_text: As a mortal, thinking of you with a devoted singer's heart, I call upon you, the immortal one.

children.text: jātavedo yaśo asmāsu dhehi prajābhir agne amṛtatvam aśyām ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Jātavedas</s>, place renown among us; through offspring, O <s>Agni</s>, may I attain immortality.

children.text: yasmai tvaṃ sukṛte jātaveda u lokam agne kṛṇavaḥ syonam
children.translated_text: For the man of good deeds, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, for whom you make a pleasant world, O <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: aśvinaṃ sa putriṇaṃ vīravantaṃ gomantaṃ rayiṃ naśate svasti ||
children.translated_text: he obtains, in well-being, wealth with horses, with sons, with heroes, and with cattle.

children.text: Chapter 359
susamiddhāya śociṣe ghṛtaṃ tīvraṃ juhotana
children.translated_text: For him who is well kindled, for the flame, offer the sharp ghee,

children.text: agnaye jātavedase ||
children.translated_text: to <s>Agni</s> <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: narāśaṃsaḥ suṣūdatīmaṃ yajñam adābhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Let <s>Narāśaṃsa</s>, irresistible, make this sacrifice very pleasing;

children.text: kavir hi madhuhastyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for he is a seer with honey in his hand.

children.text: īﾱito agna ā vahendraṃ citram iha priyam
children.translated_text: O praised <s>Agni</s>, bring here beloved, splendid <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: sukhai rathebhir ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: with easy chariots, for our aid.

children.text: ūrṇamradā vi prathasvābhy arkā anūṣata
children.translated_text: Spread out, soft as wool; the singers have sung to you with hymns.

children.text: bhavā naḥ śubhra sātaye ||
children.translated_text: Be bright for us, for the winning of goods.

children.text: devīr dvāro vi śrayadhvaṃ suprāyaṇā na ūtaye
children.translated_text: Divine doors, open wide, easy to pass through, for our aid;

children.text: pra pra yajñam pṛṇītana ||
children.translated_text: fill the sacrifice more and more.

children.text: supratīke vayovṛdhā yahvī ṛtasya mātarā
children.translated_text: Fair-faced, increasing life, the two great mothers of truth,

children.text: doṣām uṣāsam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: we seek Night and Dawn.

children.text: vātasya patmann īﾱitā daivyā hotārā manuṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Invoked on the path of the wind, divine hotṛ priests among men,

children.text: imaṃ no yajñam ā gatam ||
children.translated_text: come to this sacrifice of ours.

children.text: iﾱā sarasvatī mahī tisro devīr mayobhuvaḥ
children.translated_text: Let <s>Iḷā</s>, <s>Sarasvatī</s>, and mighty <s>Mahī</s>, the three goddesses who bring delight,

children.text: barhiḥ sīdantv asridhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: sit on the sacred grass, unfailing.

children.text: śivas tvaṣṭar ihā gahi vibhuḥ poṣa uta tmanā
children.translated_text: Auspicious <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, come here, wide-ruling, together with nourishment and with your own power;

children.text: yajñe yajñe na ud ava ||
children.translated_text: help us in each sacrifice.

children.text: yatra vettha vanaspate devānāṃ guhyā nāmāni
children.translated_text: Where you know, O <s>Vanaspati</s>, the secret names of the gods,

children.text: tatra havyāni gāmaya ||
children.translated_text: there convey the oblations.

children.text: svāhāgnaye varuṇāya svāhendrāya marudbhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Svāhā to <s>Agni</s>, to <s>Varuṇa</s>; svāhā to <s>Indra</s> and the <s>Maruts</s>;

children.text: svāhā devebhyo haviḥ ||
children.translated_text: svāhā: the oblation to the gods.

children.text: Chapter 360
agniṃ tam manye yo vasur astaṃ yaṃ yanti dhenavaḥ
children.translated_text: I regard that <s>Agni</s> as the good one, to whose home the milch cows go,

children.text: astam arvanta āśavo 'staṃ nityāso vājina iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: home the swift horses, home the constant steeds; bring food to the singers.

children.text: so agnir yo vasur gṛṇe saṃ yam āyanti dhenavaḥ
children.translated_text: He is <s>Agni</s>, the good one whom I praise, to whom the milch cows come together,

children.text: sam arvanto raghudruvaḥ saṃ sujātāsaḥ sūraya iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: together the quick-running horses, together the well-born patrons; bring food to the singers.

children.text: agnir hi vājinaṃ viśe dadāti viśvacarṣaṇiḥ
children.translated_text: For <s>Agni</s>, whose people are all mankind, gives the prize-winning steed to the clan;

children.text: agnī rāye svābhuvaṃ sa prīto yāti vāryam iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: pleased, <s>Agni</s> goes toward self-born wealth, toward desirable food; bring food to the singers.

children.text: ā te agna idhīmahi dyumantaṃ devājaram
children.translated_text: We kindle for you, O <s>Agni</s>, the radiant, divine, ageless one,

children.text: yaddha syā te panīyasī samid dīdayati dyavīṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: when your most praiseworthy kindling-stick shines in heaven; bring food to the singers.

children.text: ā te agna ṛcā haviḥ śukrasya śociṣas pate
children.translated_text: With a hymn, O <s>Agni</s>, lord of the bright flame, we bring the oblation to you;

children.text: suścandra dasma viśpate havyavāṭ tubhyaṃ hūyata iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: beautifully shining, wondrous lord of the clans, carrier of oblations, you are invoked; bring food to the singers.

children.text: pro tye agnayo 'gniṣu viśvam puṣyanti vāryam
children.translated_text: Those fires among fires further prosper every desirable good;

children.text: te hinvire ta invire ta iṣaṇyanty ānuṣag iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: they are impelled, they are set in motion, they continually seek nourishment; bring food to the singers.

children.text: tava tye agne arcayo mahi vrādhanta vājinaḥ
children.translated_text: Those flames of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, grow greatly, strong and prize-winning,

children.text: ye patvabhiḥ śaphānāṃ vrajā bhuranta gonām iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: which, with their feet, stir up the pens of the cows with their hooves; bring food to the singers.

children.text: navā no agna ā bhara stotṛbhyaḥ sukṣitīr iṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Bring us new, well-settled nourishments, O <s>Agni</s>, for the singers.

children.text: te syāma ya ānṛcus tvādūtāso dame dama iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: May we be those who sing to you, your messengers in every house; bring food to the singers.

children.text: ubhe suścandra sarpiṣo darvī śrīṇīṣa āsani
children.translated_text: O beautifully shining one, you lick both ghee-filled ladles at your mouth;

children.text: uto na ut pupūryā uktheṣu śavasas pata iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: and fill us further in the recitations, O lord of might; bring food to the singers.

children.text: evāṃ agnim ajuryamur gīrbhir yajñebhir ānuṣak
children.translated_text: Thus, with songs and sacrifices, they have continually established undecaying <s>Agni</s>

children.text: dadhad asme suvīryam uta tyad āśvaśvyam iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: as he sets in us good heroic strength, and also that wealth in horses; bring food to the singers.

children.text: Chapter 361
sakhāyaḥ saṃ vaḥ samyañcam iṣaṃ stomaṃ cāgnaye
children.translated_text: Friends, together direct your nourishment and your hymn to <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: varṣiṣṭhāya kṣitīnām ūrjo naptre sahasvate ||
children.translated_text: the highest of dwellers, the child of strength, the mighty one.

children.text: kutrā cid yasya samṛtau raṇvā naro nṛṣadane
children.translated_text: In whatever encounter of his, where men rejoice in the seat of men,

children.text: arhantaś cid yam indhate saṃjanayanti jantavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: even the worthy kindle him, and creatures bring him to birth.

children.text: saṃ yad iṣo vanāmahe saṃ havyā mānuṣāṇām
children.translated_text: When we win nourishment together, and the oblations of human beings together,

children.text: uta dyumnasya śavasa ṛtasya raśmim ā dade ||
children.translated_text: then I take hold also of the ray of splendor, of might, and of truth.

children.text: sa smā kṛṇoti ketum ā naktaṃ cid dūra ā sate
children.translated_text: He makes a signal; even at night it sits far away,

children.text: pāvako yad vanaspatīn pra smā mināty ajaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: when, purifier and ageless, he cuts down the forest trees.

children.text: ava sma yasya veṣaṇe svedam pathiṣu juhvati
children.translated_text: At his rush, as it were, they pour sweat along the paths;

children.text: abhīm aha svajenyam bhūmā pṛṣṭheva ruruhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: against him we mounted the native expanse, like one climbing upon the back of the earth.

children.text: yam martyaḥ puruspṛhaṃ vidad viśvasya dhāyase
children.translated_text: The mortal who finds him, much desired, for the support of all,

children.text: pra svādanam pitūnām astatātiṃ cid āyave ||
children.translated_text: sets forth the savor of foods, even for the traveler.

children.text: sa hi ṣmā dhanvākṣitaṃ dātā na dāty ā paśuḥ
children.translated_text: For he, like a giver, gives inexhaustible wealth, not like a withheld animal;

children.text: hiriśmaśruḥ śucidann ṛbhur anibhṛṣṭataviṣiḥ ||
children.translated_text: golden-bearded, bright-toothed, skillful, with unassailable force.

children.text: śuciḥ ṣma yasmā atrivat pra svadhitīva rīyate
children.translated_text: Pure is he from whom, as for <s>Atri</s>, the sharp axe is sent forth,

children.text: suṣūr asūta mātā krāṇā yad ānaśe bhagam ||
children.translated_text: when the good mother, active, has borne a son and reached a share.

children.text: ā yas te sarpirāsute 'gne śam asti dhāyase
children.translated_text: When there is peace for your ghee-mixture, O <s>Agni</s>, for support,

children.text: aiṣu dyumnam uta śrava ā cittam martyeṣu dhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: place among these mortals splendor, fame, and intention.

children.text: iti cin manyum adhrijas tvādātam ā paśuṃ dade
children.translated_text: Thus, O irresistible one, taking wrath from you, I receive the animal;

children.text: ād agne apṛṇato 'triḥ sāsahyād dasyūn iṣaḥ sāsahyān nṝn ||
children.translated_text: then, O <s>Agni</s>, <s>Atri</s>, though ungiving, would overpower the <s>Dasyus</s>, overpower men for food.

children.text: Chapter 362
tvām agna ṛtāyavaḥ sam īdhire pratnam pratnāsa ūtaye sahaskṛta
children.translated_text: Those who seek truth have kindled you together, O <s>Agni</s>, the ancient ones kindling the ancient one for aid, made by strength,

children.text: puruścandraṃ yajataṃ viśvadhāyasaṃ damūnasaṃ gṛhapatiṃ vareṇyam ||
children.translated_text: much-shining, worthy of worship, sustaining all, dwelling in the house, the household lord to be chosen.

children.text: tvām agne atithim pūrvyaṃ viśaḥ śociṣkeśaṃ gṛhapatiṃ ni ṣedire
children.translated_text: The clans have seated you, O <s>Agni</s>, as the ancient guest, hair of flame, household lord,

children.text: bṛhatketum pururūpaṃ dhanaspṛtaṃ suśarmāṇaṃ svavasaṃ jaradviṣam ||
children.translated_text: with a great banner, many-formed, winning wealth, well-sheltering, of good protection, driving away decay.

children.text: tvām agne mānuṣīr īﾱate viśo hotrāvidaṃ viviciṃ ratnadhātamam
children.translated_text: Human clans praise you, O <s>Agni</s>, knower of priestly rites, discerning, best bestower of treasures,

children.text: guhā santaṃ subhaga viśvadarśataṃ tuviṣvaṇasaṃ suyajaṃ ghṛtaśriyam ||
children.translated_text: hidden, fortunate one, visible to all, loudly resounding, well-sacrificing, adorned with ghee.

children.text: tvām agne dharṇasiṃ viśvadhā vayaṃ gīrbhir gṛṇanto namasopa sedima
children.translated_text: We, praising you with songs and reverence, have approached you, O <s>Agni</s>, firm support in every way.

children.text: sa no juṣasva samidhāno aṅgiro devo martasya yaśasā sudītibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Kindled, O <s>Aṅgiras</s>, god, be gracious to us, to the mortal, with fame and bright lights.

children.text: tvam agne pururūpo viśe viśe vayo dadhāsi pratnathā puruṣṭuta
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, many-formed, for every clan, as of old, bestow vital strength, O much-praised one.

children.text: purūṇy annā sahasā vi rājasi tviṣiḥ sā te titviṣāṇasya nādhṛṣe ||
children.translated_text: By your might you shine over many foods; that brilliance of yours, as you blaze, cannot be overpowered.

children.text: tvām agne samidhānaṃ yaviṣṭhya devā dūtaṃ cakrire havyavāhanam
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, when kindled, O youngest one, the gods made their messenger, the carrier of oblations.

children.text: urujrayasaṃ ghṛtayonim āhutaṃ tveṣaṃ cakṣur dadhire codayanmati ||
children.translated_text: Swift-running, born of ghee, invoked, flashing, they set you as the eye that urges thought.

children.text: tvām agne pradiva āhutaṃ ghṛtaiḥ sumnāyavaḥ suṣamidhā sam īdhire
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, invoked from of old with ghee, those seeking favor have kindled well with good fuel.

children.text: sa vāvṛdhāna oṣadhībhir ukṣito 'bhi jrayāṃsi pārthivā vi tiṣṭhase ||
children.translated_text: Growing strong, sprinkled with the plants, you stand out over the earthly expanses with your flame.

children.text: Chapter 363
tvām agne haviṣmanto devam martāsa īﾱate
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, mortals bearing oblations worship as a god.

children.text: manye tvā jātavedasaṃ sa havyā vakṣy ānuṣak ||
children.translated_text: I regard you as <s>Jātavedas</s>; carry the oblations continuously.

children.text: agnir hotā dāsvataḥ kṣayasya vṛktabarhiṣaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is the hotar of the worshipper, of the household with the sacred grass spread.

children.text: saṃ yajñāsaś caranti yaṃ saṃ vājāsaḥ śravasyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: To him the sacrifices come together, and to him the prize-seeking powers of renown come together.

children.text: uta sma yaṃ śiśuṃ yathā navaṃ janiṣṭāraṇī
children.translated_text: And him, like an infant, new-born from the two fire-sticks,

children.text: dhartāram mānuṣīṇāṃ viśām agniṃ svadhvaram ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, sustainer of the human clans, performer of good rites.

children.text: uta sma durgṛbhīyase putro na hvāryāṇām
children.translated_text: And he is hard to seize, like the son of the elusive ones,

children.text: purū yo dagdhāsi vanāgne paśur na yavase ||
children.translated_text: you who burn many forests, O <s>Agni</s>, like a beast in pasture.

children.text: adha sma yasyārcayaḥ samyak saṃyanti dhūminaḥ
children.translated_text: Then his smoky flames go together in the same direction,

children.text: yad īm aha trito divy upa dhmāteva dhamati śiśīte dhmātarī yathā ||
children.translated_text: when <s>Trita</s>, in heaven, blows upon him like a smelter; he sharpens him as at the bellows.

children.text: tavāham agna ūtibhir mitrasya ca praśastibhiḥ
children.translated_text: With your aids, O <s>Agni</s>, and with the praises of <s>Mitra</s>,

children.text: dveṣoyuto na duritā turyāma martyānām ||
children.translated_text: may we pass beyond the hatreds and the misfortunes of mortals, as men freed from enemies.

children.text: taṃ no agne abhī naro rayiṃ sahasva ā bhara
children.translated_text: Bring that wealth to us, O <s>Agni</s>, overpowering hostile men.

children.text: sa kṣepayat sa poṣayad bhuvad vājasya sātaya utaidhi pṛtsu no vṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: May it drive forward, may it nourish, may it be for the winning of prize; and grow for us in battles, for our increase.

children.text: Chapter 364
agna ojiṣṭham ā bhara dyumnam asmabhyam adhrigo
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, bring most powerful radiance for us, O unharming one.

children.text: pra no rāyā parīṇasā ratsi vājāya panthām ||
children.translated_text: With abundant wealth, open a path for us toward the prize.

children.text: tvaṃ no agne adbhuta kratvā dakṣasya maṃhanā
children.translated_text: You for us, O wondrous <s>Agni</s>, by insight and by the greatness of skill,

children.text: tve asuryam āruhat krāṇā mitro na yajñiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: in you divine power has risen, acting like worshipful <s>Mitra</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ no agna eṣāṃ gayam puṣṭiṃ ca vardhaya
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, increase for us the household and prosperity of these men,

children.text: ye stomebhiḥ pra sūrayo naro maghāny ānaśuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the patrons who, with hymns, have obtained gifts.

children.text: ye agne candra te giraḥ śumbhanty aśvarādhasaḥ
children.translated_text: Those songs of yours, O bright <s>Agni</s>, adorn you, belonging to men rich in horses.

children.text: śuṣmebhiḥ śuṣmiṇo naro divaś cid yeṣām bṛhat sukīrtir bodhati tmanā ||
children.translated_text: Powerful men with powers, whose great good fame, even from heaven, awakens by itself.

children.text: tava tye agne arcayo bhrājanto yanti dhṛṣṇuyā
children.translated_text: Those flames of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, go gleaming boldly,

children.text: parijmāno na vidyutaḥ svāno ratho na vājayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: ranging around like lightnings, sounding like a prize-seeking chariot.

children.text: nū no agna ūtaye sabādhasaś ca rātaye
children.translated_text: Now, O <s>Agni</s>, for our aid and, hard-pressed as we are, for generosity,

children.text: asmākāsaś ca sūrayo viśvā āśās tarīṣaṇi ||
children.translated_text: may our patrons cross through all hopes and expectations.

children.text: tvaṃ no agne aṅgira stuta stavāna ā bhara
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni Aṅgiras</s>, praised and being praised, bring to us,

children.text: hotar vibhvāsahaṃ rayiṃ stotṛbhya stavase ca na utaidhi pṛtsu no vṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: O hotar, wealth that overcomes all, for the singers and for praise; and grow for us in battles, for our increase.

children.text: Chapter 365
janasya gopā ajaniṣṭa jāgṛvir agniḥ sudakṣaḥ suvitāya navyase
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, guardian of the people, wakeful and very skillful, has been born for a newer good guidance.

children.text: ghṛtapratīko bṛhatā divispṛśā dyumad vi bhāti bharatebhyaḥ śuciḥ ||
children.translated_text: Ghee-faced, touching heaven with greatness, brilliant, pure, he shines out for the <s>Bharatas</s>.

children.text: yajñasya ketum prathamam purohitam agniṃ naras triṣadhasthe sam īdhire
children.translated_text: Men have kindled <s>Agni</s>, the first sign of sacrifice, the purohita, in the threefold seat.

children.text: indreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṃ sa barhiṣi sīdan ni hotā yajathāya sukratuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Together with <s>Indra</s> and the gods in one chariot, he sat down on the sacred grass, the wise hotar, for worship.

children.text: asaṃmṛṣṭo jāyase mātroḥ śucir mandraḥ kavir ud atiṣṭho vivasvataḥ
children.translated_text: Unwiped, you are born pure from the two mothers; pleasing, a seer, you have risen up from <s>Vivasvat</s>.

children.text: ghṛtena tvāvardhayann agna āhuta dhūmas te ketur abhavad divi śritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They strengthened you with ghee, O invoked <s>Agni</s>; your smoke became a banner set in heaven.

children.text: agnir no yajñam upa vetu sādhuyāgniṃ naro vi bharante gṛhe gṛhe
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s> come favorably to our sacrifice; men bear <s>Agni</s> in every house.

children.text: agnir dūto abhavaddhavyavāhano 'gniṃ vṛṇānā vṛṇate kavikratum ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> became the messenger, the carrier of oblations; choosing <s>Agni</s>, they choose the one with a seer's insight.

children.text: tubhyedam agne madhumattamaṃ vacas tubhyam manīṣā iyam astu śaṃ hṛde
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Agni</s>, let this sweetest speech be; for you let this inspired thought be pleasing to the heart.

children.text: tvāṃ giraḥ sindhum ivāvanīr mahīr ā pṛṇanti śavasā vardhayanti ca ||
children.translated_text: The songs fill you like great rivers filling the sea, and by their force they strengthen you.

children.text: tvām agne aṅgiraso guhā hitam anv avindañchiśriyāṇaṃ vane vane
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, the <s>Aṅgirases</s> found, hidden in secret, resting in every forest.

children.text: sa jāyase mathyamānaḥ saho mahat tvām āhuḥ sahasas putram aṅgiraḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are born when churned, a great force; they call you the son of strength, O <s>Aṅgiras</s>.

children.text: Chapter 366
prāgnaye bṛhate yajñiyāya ṛtasya vṛṣṇe asurāya manma
children.translated_text: For great <s>Agni</s>, worthy of sacrifice, the bull of ṛta, the mighty lord, I bring the thought.

children.text: ghṛtaṃ na yajña āsye supūtaṃ giram bhare vṛṣabhāya pratīcīm ||
children.translated_text: Like well-purified ghee at the mouth of the sacrifice, I bear a song turned toward the bull.

children.text: ṛtaṃ cikitva ṛtam ic cikiddhy ṛtasya dhārā anu tṛndhi pūrvīḥ
children.translated_text: Knowing ṛta, discern only ṛta; cleave through the many streams of ṛta.

children.text: nāhaṃ yātuṃ sahasā na dvayena ṛtaṃ sapāmy aruṣasya vṛṣṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Not by force, nor by duplicity, do I go the way; I serve the ṛta of the ruddy bull.

children.text: kayā no agna ṛtayann ṛtena bhuvo navedā ucathasya navyaḥ
children.translated_text: By what truth, O <s>Agni</s>, making truth for us through truth, will you become the new knower of the new utterance?

children.text: vedā me deva ṛtupā ṛtūnāṃ nāham patiṃ sanitur asya rāyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The god, guardian of the seasons, knows my seasons; I am not master of the acquisition of this wealth.

children.text: ke te agne ripave bandhanāsaḥ ke pāyavaḥ saniṣanta dyumantaḥ
children.translated_text: What bonds of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, are for the enemy? What shining guardians will win possession?

children.text: ke dhāsim agne anṛtasya pānti ka āsato vacasaḥ santi gopāḥ ||
children.translated_text: What guardians, O <s>Agni</s>, protect the establishment from falsehood? Who are guardians of speech from the unreal?

children.text: sakhāyas te viṣuṇā agna ete śivāsaḥ santo aśivā abhūvan
children.translated_text: These friends of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, are divided; though being auspicious, they have become inauspicious.

children.text: adhūrṣata svayam ete vacobhir ṛjūyate vṛjināni bruvantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: These men themselves have dared with their words, speaking crooked things to the one who seeks straightness.

children.text: yas te agne namasā yajñam īṭṭa ṛtaṃ sa pāty aruṣasya vṛṣṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever worships your sacrifice with homage, O <s>Agni</s>, protects the ṛta of the ruddy bull.

children.text: tasya kṣayaḥ pṛthur ā sādhur etu prasarsrāṇasya nahuṣasya śeṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May his dwelling come forth broad and successful; may a remnant remain of the flowing human line.

children.text: Chapter 367
arcantas tvā havāmahe 'rcantaḥ sam idhīmahi
children.translated_text: Praising you, we call upon you; praising, we kindle you together.

children.text: agne arcanta ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, praising you for aid.

children.text: agne stomam manāmahe sidhram adya divispṛśaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, desirous of divine wealth, today we think upon an effective hymn, heaven-touching,

children.text: devasya draviṇasyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for the god who grants treasure.

children.text: agnir juṣata no giro hotā yo mānuṣeṣv ā
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s>, the hotar who is among human beings, enjoy our songs.

children.text: sa yakṣad daivyaṃ janam ||
children.translated_text: Let him worship the divine people.

children.text: tvam agne saprathā asi juṣṭo hotā vareṇyaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are widely extended, the beloved hotar to be chosen.

children.text: tvayā yajñaṃ vi tanvate ||
children.translated_text: Through you they spread out the sacrifice.

children.text: tvām agne vājasātamaṃ viprā vardhanti suṣṭutam
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, most prize-winning and well-praised, the inspired poets make grow.

children.text: sa no rāsva suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: So grant us good heroic strength.

children.text: agne nemir arāṁ iva devāṃs tvam paribhūr asi
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, like a rim around the spokes, you encompass the gods.

children.text: ā rādhaś citram ṛñjase ||
children.translated_text: You adorn for us a splendid bounty.

children.text: Chapter 368
agniṃ stomena bodhaya samidhāno amartyam
children.translated_text: Awaken <s>Agni</s>, the immortal, with a hymn as he is kindled.

children.text: havyā deveṣu no dadhat ||
children.translated_text: May he set our oblations among the gods.

children.text: tam adhvareṣv īﾱate devam martā amartyam
children.translated_text: Mortals praise him in the rites, the immortal god,

children.text: yajiṣṭham mānuṣe jane ||
children.translated_text: the most worthy of sacrifice among human people.

children.text: taṃ hi śaśvanta īﾱate srucā devaṃ ghṛtaścutā
children.translated_text: For always they praise that god with the ghee-dripping ladle,

children.text: agniṃ havyāya voﾱhave ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, to carry the oblation.

children.text: agnir jāto arocata ghnan dasyūñ jyotiṣā tamaḥ
children.translated_text: Born, <s>Agni</s> shone forth, striking down the <s>Dasyus</s> and darkness with light.

children.text: avindad gā apaḥ svaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He found the cows, the waters, and the sunlit world.

children.text: agnim īﾱenyaṃ kaviṃ ghṛtapṛṣṭhaṃ saparyata
children.translated_text: Worship <s>Agni</s>, worthy of praise, the seer whose back is smeared with ghee.

children.text: vetu me śṛṇavaddhavam ||
children.translated_text: May he come to me; may he hear my call.

children.text: agniṃ ghṛtena vāvṛdhu stomebhir viśvacarṣaṇim
children.translated_text: They have strengthened <s>Agni</s>, whose people are all mankind, with ghee and with hymns,

children.text: svādhībhir vacasyubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: with self-directed songs that long for speech.

children.text: Chapter 369
pra vedhase kavaye vedyāya giram bhare yaśase pūrvyāya
children.translated_text: For the wise seer, for the one to be known, I bring a song for ancient glory.

children.text: ghṛtaprasatto asuraḥ suśevo rāyo dhartā dharuṇo vasvo agniḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, sprinkled with ghee, mighty lord, gracious one, bearer of wealth and support of treasure.

children.text: ṛtena ṛtaṃ dharuṇaṃ dhārayanta yajñasya śāke parame vyoman
children.translated_text: By truth they sustain truth, the firm foundation, in the power of sacrifice in the highest heaven.

children.text: divo dharman dharuṇe seduṣo nṝñ jātair ajātāṁ abhi ye nanakṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those men seated in heaven's law, in the foundation, have reached with the born ones toward the unborn.

children.text: aṃhoyuvas tanvas tanvate vi vayo mahad duṣṭaram pūrvyāya
children.translated_text: Freeing themselves from distress, they stretch out their bodies, a great expanse hard to cross for the ancient one.

children.text: sa saṃvato navajātas tuturyāt siṃhaṃ na kruddham abhitaḥ pari ṣṭhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: May he, newly born at the yearly turning, pass beyond it; they stood around him like an angry lion.

children.text: māteva yad bharase paprathāno janaṃ janaṃ dhāyase cakṣase ca
children.translated_text: Like a mother, when you bear and spread out, you sustain each generation for nourishment and for sight.

children.text: vayo vayo jarase yad dadhānaḥ pari tmanā viṣurūpo jigāsi ||
children.translated_text: Putting age upon age, you go around by yourself, taking on many forms.

children.text: vājo nu te śavasas pātv antam uruṃ doghaṃ dharuṇaṃ deva rāyaḥ
children.translated_text: May the prize at the limit of your might protect the wide, milch foundation of wealth, O god.

children.text: padaṃ na tāyur guhā dadhāno maho rāye citayann atrim aspaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like a thief hiding a track in secret, you made great wealth visible and reached <s>Atri</s>.

children.text: Chapter 370
bṛhad vayo hi bhānave 'rcā devāyāgnaye
children.translated_text: For great strength and for shining light, sing to the god <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: yam mitraṃ na praśastibhir martāso dadhire puraḥ ||
children.translated_text: whom mortals have set before them with praises, like <s>Mitra</s>.

children.text: sa hi dyubhir janānāṃ hotā dakṣasya bāhvoḥ
children.translated_text: For he, with the lights of men, is the hotar at the two arms of skill.

children.text: vi havyam agnir ānuṣag bhago na vāram ṛṇvati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> wins the oblation in an unbroken course, like <s>Bhaga</s> winning the choice share.

children.text: asya stome maghonaḥ sakhye vṛddhaśociṣaḥ
children.translated_text: In friendship with this generous one's hymn, with his flame growing strong,

children.text: viśvā yasmin tuviṣvaṇi sam arye śuṣmam ādadhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: all have gathered their force in him, loud-ringing, amid the noble contest.

children.text: adhā hy agna eṣāṃ suvīryasya maṃhanā
children.translated_text: Therefore, O <s>Agni</s>, through the greatness of their good heroic strength,

children.text: tam id yahvaṃ na rodasī pari śravo babhūvatuḥ ||
children.translated_text: fame has surrounded that mighty one, as the two worlds surround him.

children.text: nū na ehi vāryam agne gṛṇāna ā bhara
children.translated_text: Now come to us, O <s>Agni</s>; as you are praised, bring desirable wealth.

children.text: ye vayaṃ ye ca sūrayaḥ svasti dhāmahe sacotaidhi pṛtsu no vṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: We, and the patrons too, place ourselves in well-being; join us, and grow for our increase in battles.

children.text: Chapter 371
ā yajñair deva martya itthā tavyāṃsam ūtaye
children.translated_text: The mortal comes with sacrifices to you, O god, the stronger one, for aid.

children.text: agniṃ kṛte svadhvare pūrur īﾱītāvase ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pūru</s> praised <s>Agni</s> for protection when the good rite had been prepared.

children.text: asya hi svayaśastara āsā vidharman manyase
children.translated_text: For by his own more glorious mouth you are conceived in the sacred order.

children.text: taṃ nākaṃ citraśociṣam mandram paro manīṣayā ||
children.translated_text: That bright-flamed, delightful height is beyond, reached by thought.

children.text: asya vāsā u arciṣā ya āyukta tujā girā
children.translated_text: He whose garment is flame, who is yoked by the forceful song,

children.text: divo na yasya retasā bṛhacchocanty arcayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: whose broad flames shine by his seed like those of heaven.

children.text: asya kratvā vicetaso dasmasya vasu ratha ā
children.translated_text: By the will of this discerning and wondrous one, wealth is set upon the chariot.

children.text: adhā viśvāsu havyo 'gnir vikṣu pra śasyate ||
children.translated_text: Therefore <s>Agni</s>, worthy of invocation, is praised among all settlements.

children.text: nū na iddhi vāryam āsā sacanta sūrayaḥ
children.translated_text: Now indeed the patrons, attending with their mouths, seek desirable wealth.

children.text: ūrjo napād abhiṣṭaye pāhi śagdhi svastaya utaidhi pṛtsu no vṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: Child of nourishment, guard us for fulfillment; be strong, give well-being, and grow for our increase in battles.

children.text: Chapter 372
prātar agniḥ purupriyo viśa stavetātithiḥ
children.translated_text: In the morning <s>Agni</s>, much beloved, the guest of the clan, shall be praised.

children.text: viśvāni yo amartyo havyā marteṣu raṇyati ||
children.translated_text: He, the immortal, delights in all oblations among mortals.

children.text: dvitāya mṛktavāhase svasya dakṣasya maṃhanā
children.translated_text: For the second offering, to him whose vehicle is cleansed, by the greatness of his own skill,

children.text: induṃ sa dhatta ānuṣak stotā cit te amartya ||
children.translated_text: the singer sets the Soma drop for you continually, O immortal one.

children.text: taṃ vo dīrghāyuśociṣaṃ girā huve maghonām
children.translated_text: I call him for you with song, long-lived in flame, belonging to the generous ones,

children.text: ariṣṭo yeṣāṃ ratho vy aśvadāvann īyate ||
children.translated_text: those whose chariot goes forth unharmed, O giver of horses.

children.text: citrā vā yeṣu dīdhitir āsann ukthā pānti ye
children.translated_text: Among those in whom bright inspiration is present and hymns stand guard,

children.text: stīrṇam barhiḥ svarṇare śravāṃsi dadhire pari ||
children.translated_text: they have spread the ritual grass in the sunlit place and set renowns all around.

children.text: ye me pañcāśataṃ dadur aśvānāṃ sadhastuti
children.translated_text: Those who gave me fifty horses in common praise,

children.text: dyumad agne mahi śravo bṛhat kṛdhi maghonāṃ nṛvad amṛta nṝṇām ||
children.translated_text: O immortal <s>Agni</s>, make the splendid, great fame of the generous men mighty and manly among men.

children.text: Chapter 373
abhy avasthāḥ pra jāyante pra vavrer vavriś ciketa
children.translated_text: The surrounding stations come into being; the enclosed one has perceived the covering.

children.text: upasthe mātur vi caṣṭe ||
children.translated_text: He looks out from the lap of his mother.

children.text: juhure vi citayanto 'nimiṣaṃ nṛmṇam pānti
children.translated_text: They have called out, discerning; unblinking, they guard manly power.

children.text: ā dṛﾱhām puraṃ viviśuḥ ||
children.translated_text: They entered the firm fortress.

children.text: ā śvaitreyasya jantavo dyumad vardhanta kṛṣṭayaḥ
children.translated_text: The creatures of <s>Śvaitreya</s>, the bright tribes, have grown strong.

children.text: niṣkagrīvo bṛhaduktha enā madhvā na vājayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Gold-necklaced <s>Bṛhaduktha</s> has here pressed forward for the prize, as if with honey.

children.text: priyaṃ dugdhaṃ na kāmyam ajāmi jāmyoḥ sacā
children.translated_text: Like dear milk, desirable, it accompanies both kin and non-kin.

children.text: gharmo na vājajaṭharo 'dabdhaḥ śaśvato dabhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like the heated draught with prize in its belly, undeceived, it is the lasting overcomer of deceit.

children.text: krīﾱan no raśma ā bhuvaḥ sam bhasmanā vāyunā vevidānaḥ
children.translated_text: Playing, our ray has come from heaven, well known together with ash and wind.

children.text: tā asya san dhṛṣajo na tigmāḥ susaṃśitā vakṣyo vakṣaṇesthāḥ ||
children.translated_text: These of his are bold, like sharp points, well whetted, standing at the breast and flank.

children.text: Chapter 374
yam agne vājasātama tvaṃ cin manyase rayim
children.translated_text: That wealth, O <s>Agni</s>, most prize-winning, which even you consider worthy,

children.text: taṃ no gīrbhiḥ śravāyyaṃ devatrā panayā yujam ||
children.translated_text: make it ours through songs: renowned, praised among the gods, and joined to us.

children.text: ye agne nerayanti te vṛddhā ugrasya śavasaḥ
children.translated_text: Those powers of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, grown strong with fierce might, drive onward.

children.text: apa dveṣo apa hvaro 'nyavratasya saścire ||
children.translated_text: They have driven away hatred and crookedness from the one of alien vows.

children.text: hotāraṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe 'gne dakṣasya sādhanam
children.translated_text: We choose you as hotar, O <s>Agni</s>, accomplisher of skill.

children.text: yajñeṣu pūrvyaṃ girā prayasvanto havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: Ancient one in sacrifices, we call you with song, bringing offerings.

children.text: itthā yathā ta ūtaye sahasāvan dive dive
children.translated_text: Thus, as for your aid, O mighty one, day by day,

children.text: rāya ṛtāya sukrato gobhiḥ ṣyāma sadhamādo vīraiḥ syāma sadhamādaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may we, wise in intent, share wealth and truth with cows; may we share it with heroes.

children.text: Chapter 375
manuṣvat tvā ni dhīmahi manuṣvat sam idhīmahi
children.translated_text: As <s>Manu</s> did, we set you in place; as <s>Manu</s> did, we kindle you.

children.text: agne manuṣvad aṅgiro devān devayate yaja ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, as <s>Manu</s> did, O <s>Aṅgiras</s>, sacrifice to the gods for the god-loving man.

children.text: tvaṃ hi mānuṣe jane 'gne suprīta idhyase
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Agni</s>, are kindled well pleased among human people.

children.text: srucas tvā yanty ānuṣak sujāta sarpirāsute ||
children.translated_text: The ladles go to you continuously, well-born one, when the ghee has been poured.

children.text: tvāṃ viśve sajoṣaso devāso dūtam akrata
children.translated_text: All the gods, of one accord, made you their messenger;

children.text: saparyantas tvā kave yajñeṣu devam īﾱate ||
children.translated_text: serving you, O seer, at the sacrifices they praise you as the god.

children.text: devaṃ vo devayajyayāgnim īﾱīta martyaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the mortal worship for you the god <s>Agni</s> by sacrifice to the gods;

children.text: samiddhaḥ śukra dīdihy ṛtasya yonim āsadaḥ sasasya yonim āsadaḥ ||
children.translated_text: kindled, O bright one, shine; you have sat in the womb of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), in the womb of what is seated.

children.text: Chapter 376
pra viśvasāmann atrivad arcā pāvakaśociṣe
children.translated_text: With a universal chant, like <s>Atri</s>, sing forth to him whose flame is purifying,

children.text: yo adhvareṣv īḍyo hotā mandratamo viśi ||
children.translated_text: who in the rites is the worshipful <s>hotṛ</s> (invoking priest), most gladdening in the settlement.

children.text: ny agniṃ jātavedasaṃ dadhātā devam ṛtvijam
children.translated_text: Set down <s>Agni</s> Jātavedas, the god, the ritual priest;

children.text: pra yajña etv ānuṣag adyā devavyacastamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let the sacrifice go forward in order today, most widely extending to the gods.

children.text: cikitvinmanasaṃ tvā devam martāsa ūtaye
children.translated_text: You, the god with perceptive mind, mortals seek for aid;

children.text: vareṇyasya te 'vasa iyānāso amanmahi ||
children.translated_text: going toward your desirable help, we have thought upon you.

children.text: agne cikiddhy asya na idaṃ vacaḥ sahasya
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, mark this word of ours, O mighty one;

children.text: taṃ tvā suśipra dampate stomair vardhanty atrayo gīrbhiḥ śumbhanty atrayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you, fair-lipped lord of the house, the <s>Atris</s> magnify with praises; with songs the <s>Atris</s> adorn you.

children.text: Chapter 377
agne sahantam ā bhara dyumnasya prāsahā rayim
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, bring conquering wealth of splendor,

children.text: viśvā yaś carṣaṇīr abhy āsā vājeṣu sāsahat ||
children.translated_text: wealth that overcomes all peoples in contests for the prize.

children.text: tam agne pṛtanāṣahaṃ rayiṃ sahasva ā bhara
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, bring that battle-conquering wealth, O mighty one;

children.text: tvaṃ hi satyo adbhuto dātā vājasya gomataḥ ||
children.translated_text: for you are true, wondrous, the giver of prize-rich wealth with cattle.

children.text: viśve hi tvā sajoṣaso janāso vṛktabarhiṣaḥ
children.translated_text: For all people, of one accord, with the sacrificial grass spread,

children.text: hotāraṃ sadmasu priyaṃ vyanti vāryā puru ||
children.translated_text: approach you in their homes as the beloved <s>hotṛ</s>, for many desirable goods.

children.text: sa hi ṣmā viśvacarṣaṇir abhimāti saho dadhe
children.translated_text: For he, belonging to all peoples, has taken up overpowering might;

children.text: agna eṣu kṣayeṣv ā revan naḥ śukra dīdihi dyumat pāvaka dīdihi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, in these dwellings shine prosperously for us; O bright one, shine, O radiant purifier, shine.

children.text: Chapter 378
agne tvaṃ no antama uta trātā śivo bhavā varūthyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, be nearest to us, and be an auspicious protector, sheltering us.

children.text: vasur agnir vasuśravā acchā nakṣi dyumattamaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is wealth, rich in fame; come near and give most brilliant wealth.

children.text: sa no bodhi śrudhī havam uruṣyā ṇo aghāyataḥ samasmāt ||
children.translated_text: Be aware of us, hear our call; protect us from the evildoer, from every one.

children.text: taṃ tvā śociṣṭha dīdivaḥ sumnāya nūnam īmahe sakhibhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You, most flaming, shining one, we now ask for favor for our friends.

children.text: Chapter 379
acchā vo agnim avase devaṃ gāsi sa no vasuḥ
children.translated_text: Sing toward <s>Agni</s> for your aid, the god; he is our good,

children.text: rāsat putra ṛṣūṇām ṛtāvā parṣati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the son of the strong ones, true to <s>ṛta</s>, who will bestow and carry us across hatreds.

children.text: sa hi satyo yam pūrve cid devāsaś cid yam īdhire
children.translated_text: For he is true, whom even the gods of old kindled,

children.text: hotāram mandrajihvam it sudītibhir vibhāvasum ||
children.translated_text: as the <s>hotṛ</s> with gladdening tongue, richly radiant with bright flames.

children.text: sa no dhītī variṣṭhayā śreṣṭhayā ca sumatyā
children.translated_text: May he, with the broadest insight and the best good will,

children.text: agne rāyo didīhi naḥ suvṛktibhir vareṇya ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, shine wealth upon us, O choice one, through our well-formed hymns.

children.text: agnir deveṣu rājaty agnir marteṣv āviśan
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> rules among the gods; <s>Agni</s> has entered among mortals;

children.text: agnir no havyavāhano 'gniṃ dhībhiḥ saparyata ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is our oblation-carrier; serve <s>Agni</s> with thoughts.

children.text: agnis tuviśravastamaṃ tuvibrahmāṇam uttamam
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, greatest in far-spreading fame, highest with mighty sacred formulation,

children.text: atūrtaṃ śrāvayatpatim putraṃ dadāti dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: unvanquished lord of renown, gives a son to the worshipper.

children.text: agnir dadāti satpatiṃ sāsāha yo yudhā nṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> gives a good lord who has conquered in battle with men;

children.text: agnir atyaṃ raghuṣyadaṃ jetāram aparājitam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> gives a swift, eager horse, a victorious one undefeated.

children.text: yad vāhiṣṭhaṃ tad agnaye bṛhad arca vibhāvaso
children.translated_text: Whatever is widest, sing that great song to <s>Agni</s>, O radiant one;

children.text: mahiṣīva tvad rayis tvad vājā ud īrate ||
children.translated_text: like a queen, wealth comes from you; from you prizes rise up.

children.text: tava dyumanto arcayo grāvevocyate bṛhat
children.translated_text: Your bright flames are proclaimed loudly, like a pressing stone;

children.text: uto te tanyatur yathā svāno arta tmanā divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and your roar, like thunder from heaven, has sounded by itself.

children.text: evāṃ agniṃ vasūyavaḥ sahasānaṃ vavandima
children.translated_text: Thus, seeking riches, we have worshipped <s>Agni</s>, the overpowering one;

children.text: sa no viśvā ati dviṣaḥ parṣan nāveva sukratuḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he, wise in purpose, carry us across all hatreds as by a boat.

children.text: Chapter 380
agne pāvaka rociṣā mandrayā deva jihvayā
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, purifier, with your light and with your gladdening divine tongue,

children.text: ā devān vakṣi yakṣi ca ||
children.translated_text: bring the gods here and sacrifice to them.

children.text: taṃ tvā ghṛtasnav īmahe citrabhāno svardṛśam
children.translated_text: We ask you, ghee-bathed one, O wondrously shining one who sees the sunlight;

children.text: devāṁ ā vītaye vaha ||
children.translated_text: bring the gods here for the feast.

children.text: vītihotraṃ tvā kave dyumantaṃ sam idhīmahi
children.translated_text: You, possessor of the sacrificial call, O seer, bright one, we kindle,

children.text: agne bṛhantam adhvare ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, great one, at the rite.

children.text: agne viśvebhir ā gahi devebhir havyadātaye
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, come with all the gods for the giving of oblations;

children.text: hotāraṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: we choose you as <s>hotṛ</s>.

children.text: yajamānāya sunvata āgne suvīryaṃ vaha
children.translated_text: For the sacrificing soma-presser, O <s>Agni</s>, bring heroic strength;

children.text: devair ā satsi barhiṣi ||
children.translated_text: sit upon the sacred grass with the gods.

children.text: samidhānaḥ sahasrajid agne dharmāṇi puṣyasi
children.translated_text: Being kindled, thousand-conquering <s>Agni</s>, you prosper the <s>dharmāṇi</s> (sacred ordinances),

children.text: devānāṃ dūta ukthyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the praiseworthy messenger of the gods.

children.text: ny agniṃ jātavedasaṃ hotravāhaṃ yaviṣṭhyam
children.translated_text: Set down <s>Agni</s> Jātavedas, the youngest, carrier of the <s>hotṛ</s> office,

children.text: dadhātā devam ṛtvijam ||
children.translated_text: the god, the ritual priest.

children.text: pra yajña etv ānuṣag adyā devavyacastamaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the sacrifice go forward in order today, most widely extending to the gods;

children.text: stṛṇīta barhir āsade ||
children.translated_text: spread the sacred grass for sitting.

children.text: edam maruto aśvinā mitraḥ sīdantu varuṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Here let the <s>Maruts</s>, the <s>Aśvins</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s> sit,

children.text: devāsaḥ sarvayā viśā ||
children.translated_text: the gods with the whole clan.

children.text: Chapter 381
anasvantā satpatir māmahe me gāvā cetiṣṭho asuro maghonaḥ
children.translated_text: The wagonless good lord has honored me; the mighty generous one is mindful of my cows.

children.text: traivṛṣṇo agne daśabhiḥ sahasrair vaiśvānara tryaruṇaś ciketa ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Vaiśvānara</s> <s>Agni</s>, <s>Tryaruṇa</s> Traivṛṣṇa has become known through ten thousands.

children.text: yo me śatā ca viṃśatiṃ ca gonāṃ harī ca yuktā sudhurā dadāti
children.translated_text: He who gives me a hundred and twenty cows and two bay horses harnessed with good yokes,

children.text: vaiśvānara suṣṭuto vāvṛdhāno 'gne yaccha tryaruṇāya śarma ||
children.translated_text: O well-praised, growing <s>Vaiśvānara</s> <s>Agni</s>, grant protection to <s>Tryaruṇa</s>.

children.text: evā te agne sumatiṃ cakāno naviṣṭhāya navamaṃ trasadasyuḥ
children.translated_text: Thus, seeking your favor, O <s>Agni</s>, <s>Trasadasyu</s> has made a ninth hymn for the newest one;

children.text: yo me giras tuvijātasya pūrvīr yuktenābhi tryaruṇo gṛṇāti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Tryaruṇa</s>, with his yoked team, praises my many songs, the songs of the mighty-born one.

children.text: yo ma iti pravocaty aśvamedhāya sūraye
children.translated_text: He who says to me, "This is for me," to <s>Aśvamedha</s>, the noble patron,

children.text: dadad ṛcā saniṃ yate dadan medhām ṛtāyate ||
children.translated_text: giving gain with a verse to the one who seeks it, giving inspired thought to the one who seeks <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: yasya mā paruṣāḥ śatam uddharṣayanty ukṣaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: His hundred speckled bulls lift me up with joy,

children.text: aśvamedhasya dānāḥ somā iva tryāśiraḥ ||
children.translated_text: the gifts of <s>Aśvamedha</s>, like three-headed soma draughts.

children.text: indrāgnī śatadāvny aśvamedhe suvīryam
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, in <s>Aśvamedha</s> preserve hundredfold heroic strength,

children.text: kṣatraṃ dhārayatam bṛhad divi sūryam ivājaram ||
children.translated_text: and broad royal power, undecaying like the sun in heaven.

children.text: Chapter 382
samiddho agnir divi śocir aśret pratyaṅṅ uṣasam urviyā vi bhāti
children.translated_text: Kindled, <s>Agni</s> has raised his flame in heaven; facing us, he shines widely toward <s>Uṣas</s>,

children.text: eti prācī viśvavārā namobhir devāṁ īﾱānā haviṣā ghṛtācī ||
children.translated_text: as she goes eastward, desired by all, with reverences, worshipping the gods with ghee-rich oblation.

children.text: samidhyamāno amṛtasya rājasi haviṣ kṛṇvantaṃ sacase svastaye
children.translated_text: Being kindled, you reign over immortality; you attend the one making oblation for well-being.

children.text: viśvaṃ sa dhatte draviṇaṃ yam invasy ātithyam agne ni ca dhatta it puraḥ ||
children.translated_text: He holds all wealth whom you quicken; O <s>Agni</s>, set hospitality in front.

children.text: agne śardha mahate saubhagāya tava dyumnāny uttamāni santu
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, grow strong for great good fortune; may your highest splendors be ours.

children.text: saṃ jāspatyaṃ suyamam ā kṛṇuṣva śatrūyatām abhi tiṣṭhā mahāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: Make shared household lordship well-guided; stand above the great powers of those who act as enemies.

children.text: samiddhasya pramahaso 'gne vande tava śriyam
children.translated_text: Of the kindled, greatly shining <s>Agni</s>, I praise your splendor.
