children.text: vṛṣabho dyumnavāṁ asi sam adhvareṣv idhyase ||
children.translated_text: You are a bull, rich in brightness; you are kindled together at the sacrifices.

children.text: samiddho agna āhuta devān yakṣi svadhvara
children.translated_text: Kindled, invoked <s>Agni</s>, sacrifice to the gods, O you of good sacrifice;

children.text: tvaṃ hi havyavāﾱ asi ||
children.translated_text: for you are the carrier of oblations.

children.text: ā juhotā duvasyatāgnim prayaty adhvare
children.translated_text: Pour to him; serve <s>Agni</s> in the ordered sacrifice;

children.text: vṛṇīdhvaṃ havyavāhanam ||
children.translated_text: choose him as the bearer of the oblation.

children.text: Chapter 383
try aryamā manuṣo devatātā trī rocanā divyā dhārayanta
children.translated_text: Three lights of heaven upheld <s>Aryaman</s> in the divine ordering of man.

children.text: arcanti tvā marutaḥ pūtadakṣās tvam eṣām ṛṣir indrāsi dhīraḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Maruts</s>, pure in skill, praise you; you are their seer, O <s>Indra</s>, steadfast one.

children.text: anu yad īm maruto mandasānam ārcann indram papivāṃsaṃ sutasya
children.translated_text: When the <s>Maruts</s> praised this delighted <s>Indra</s>, who had drunk of the pressed Soma,

children.text: ādatta vajram abhi yad ahiṃ hann apo yahvīr asṛjat sartavā u ||
children.translated_text: he took up the thunderbolt; when he struck the serpent, he released the mighty waters to run.

children.text: uta brahmāṇo maruto me asyendraḥ somasya suṣutasya peyāḥ
children.translated_text: And the priests, the <s>Maruts</s>, say to me: May <s>Indra</s> drink of the well-pressed Soma.

children.text: taddhi havyam manuṣe gā avindad ahann ahim papivāṁ indro asya ||
children.translated_text: For that oblation found the cows for man; having drunk of it, <s>Indra</s> struck the serpent.

children.text: ād rodasī vitaraṃ vi ṣkabhāyat saṃvivyānaś cid bhiyase mṛgaṃ kaḥ
children.translated_text: Then he propped heaven and earth apart more widely; even the one wrapped round he made a beast for fear.

children.text: jigartim indro apajargurāṇaḥ prati śvasantam ava dānavaṃ han ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, driving off the devourer as it gaped, struck down the snorting <s>Dānava</s>.

children.text: adha kratvā maghavan tubhyaṃ devā anu viśve adaduḥ somapeyam
children.translated_text: Then, O bounteous one, by their insight all the gods assigned the Soma-drinking to you.

children.text: yat sūryasya haritaḥ patantīḥ puraḥ satīr uparā etaśe kaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When you made the tawny steeds of the sun, though they were in front and flying, turn back for <s>Etaśa</s>.

children.text: nava yad asya navatiṃ ca bhogān sākaṃ vajreṇa maghavā vivṛścat
children.translated_text: When the bounteous one, with the thunderbolt, cut apart his ninety-nine enjoyments together,

children.text: arcantīndram marutaḥ sadhasthe traiṣṭubhena vacasā bādhata dyām ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Maruts</s>, praising <s>Indra</s> in the common seat, pressed back heaven with a Triṣṭubh utterance.

children.text: sakhā sakhye apacat tūyam agnir asya kratvā mahiṣā trī śatāni
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, as friend in friendship, quickly cooked for him by his insight three hundred buffaloes;

children.text: trī sākam indro manuṣaḥ sarāṃsi sutam pibad vṛtrahatyāya somam ||
children.translated_text: together <s>Indra</s> drank three lakes of pressed Soma belonging to man, for the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: trī yacchatā mahiṣāṇām agho mās trī sarāṃsi maghavā somyāpāḥ
children.translated_text: When three hundred buffaloes were granted as a portion, and the bounteous one drank three lakes of Soma,

children.text: kāraṃ na viśve ahvanta devā bharam indrāya yad ahiṃ jaghāna ||
children.translated_text: all the gods called him like a singer to the burden, for <s>Indra</s> when he struck the serpent.

children.text: uśanā yat sahasyair ayātaṃ gṛham indra jūjuvānebhir aśvaiḥ
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indra</s>, with mighty, eager horses you and <s>Uśanā</s> came to the house,

children.text: vanvāno atra sarathaṃ yayātha kutsena devair avanor ha śuṣṇam ||
children.translated_text: winning there, you drove on the same chariot with <s>Kutsa</s>; with the gods you aided him against <s>Śuṣṇa</s>.

children.text: prānyac cakram avṛhaḥ sūryasya kutsāyānyad varivo yātave 'kaḥ
children.translated_text: You tore away one wheel of the sun for <s>Kutsa</s>; another you made a free path for his going.

children.text: anāso dasyūṃr amṛṇo vadhena ni duryoṇa āvṛṇaṅ mṛdhravācaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With your weapon you crushed the noseless <s>Dasyus</s>; you enclosed the hostile-voiced ones in their evil dwellings.

children.text: stomāsas tvā gaurivīter avardhann arandhayo vaidathināya piprum
children.translated_text: The praises of <s>Gaurivīti</s> strengthened you; you subdued <s>Pipru</s> for the son of <s>Vidatha</s>.

children.text: ā tvām ṛjiśvā sakhyāya cakre pacan paktīr apibaḥ somam asya ||
children.translated_text: <s>Ṛjiśvan</s> made you his friend; cooking cooked offerings, you drank his Soma.

children.text: navagvāsaḥ sutasomāsa indraṃ daśagvāso abhy arcanty arkaiḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Navagvas</s>, who had pressed Soma, and the <s>Daśagvas</s> praise <s>Indra</s> with songs.

children.text: gavyaṃ cid ūrvam apidhānavantaṃ taṃ cin naraḥ śaśamānā apa vran ||
children.translated_text: Even the cow-rich pen, closed and covered, those men, praising, opened up.

children.text: katho nu te pari carāṇi vidvān vīryā maghavan yā cakartha
children.translated_text: How now, knowing them, shall I recount those heroic deeds of yours, O bounteous one, which you have done,

children.text: yā co nu navyā kṛṇavaḥ śaviṣṭha pred u tā te vidatheṣu bravāma ||
children.translated_text: and those new deeds which you will yet do, O mightiest? We shall proclaim those of yours in the assemblies.

children.text: etā viśvā cakṛvāṁ indra bhūry aparīto januṣā vīryeṇa
children.translated_text: All these many deeds you have done, O <s>Indra</s>, unsurpassed by birth and heroic power.

children.text: yā cin nu vajrin kṛṇavo dadhṛṣvān na te vartā taviṣyā asti tasyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whatever you now do, O wielder of the thunderbolt, acting boldly, there is no opponent of that force of yours.

children.text: indra brahma kriyamāṇā juṣasva yā te śaviṣṭha navyā akarma
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, take pleasure in the sacred formulation being made, the new one that we have made for you, O mightiest.

children.text: vastreva bhadrā sukṛtā vasūyū rathaṃ na dhīraḥ svapā atakṣam ||
children.translated_text: Like a fine, well-made garment for one desiring wealth, like a chariot, I, a skillful worker, have fashioned it well.

children.text: Chapter 384
kva sya vīraḥ ko apaśyad indraṃ sukharatham īyamānaṃ haribhyām
children.translated_text: Where is that hero? Who has seen <s>Indra</s>, driving in an easy chariot with his bay steeds?

children.text: yo rāyā vajrī sutasomam icchan tad oko gantā puruhūta ūtī ||
children.translated_text: The thunderbolt-wielder, seeking the Soma-presser with wealth, the much-invoked one, will come to that dwelling with aid.

children.text: avācacakṣam padam asya sasvar ugraṃ nidhātur anv āyam icchan
children.translated_text: I have heard of his place, seen from below, fierce, and I went after this path of the establisher.

children.text: apṛccham anyāṁ uta te ma āhur indraṃ naro bubudhānā aśema ||
children.translated_text: I asked others, and they told me of you: May we, men who are awakening, attain <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: pra nu vayaṃ sute yā te kṛtānīndra bravāma yāni no jujoṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Now, at the Soma pressing, let us proclaim the deeds you have done, O <s>Indra</s>, those with which you have favored us.

children.text: vedad avidvāñchṛṇavacca vidvān vahate 'yam maghavā sarvasenaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The unknowing one will know, and the knowing one will hear: this bounteous one carries all his host.

children.text: sthiram manaś cakṛṣe jāta indra veṣīd eko yudhaye bhūyasaś cit
children.translated_text: You made your mind firm when you were born, O <s>Indra</s>; alone you chose battle, even against many.

children.text: aśmānaṃ cicchavasā didyuto vi vido gavām ūrvam usriyāṇām ||
children.translated_text: With your force you split even the stone enclosure of the radiant cows and found the broad pen of the bright cattle.

children.text: paro yat tvam parama ājaniṣṭhāḥ parāvati śrutyaṃ nāma bibhrat
children.translated_text: When you were born beyond, in the farthest distance, bearing a name worthy to be heard from afar,

children.text: ataś cid indrād abhayanta devā viśvā apo ajayad dāsapatnīḥ ||
children.translated_text: even then the gods feared <s>Indra</s>; he won all the waters that had the Dāsa as their lord.

children.text: tubhyed ete marutaḥ suśevā arcanty arkaṃ sunvanty andhaḥ
children.translated_text: These gracious <s>Maruts</s> praise a song for you; they press the Soma-draught.

children.text: ahim ohānam apa āśayānam pra māyābhir māyinaṃ sakṣad indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, with his powers, would face the serpent, the sorcerer lying in the waters, practicing sorcery.

children.text: vi ṣū mṛdho januṣā dānam invann ahan gavā maghavan saṃcakānaḥ
children.translated_text: Scatter the conflicts by birth, O bounteous one, impelling the gift; you struck for the cows, desiring them.

children.text: atrā dāsasya namuceḥ śiro yad avartayo manave gātum icchan ||
children.translated_text: There, when you rolled away the head of the <s>Dāsa</s> <s>Namuci</s>, you sought a path for <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: yujaṃ hi mām akṛthā ād id indra śiro dāsasya namucer mathāyan
children.translated_text: For you made me your ally, O <s>Indra</s>, when you crushed the head of the <s>Dāsa</s> <s>Namuci</s>.

children.text: aśmānaṃ cit svaryaṃ vartamānam pra cakriyeva rodasī marudbhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even the heavenly stone, turning, I set in motion like a wheel for the <s>Maruts</s> between heaven and earth.

children.text: striyo hi dāsa āyudhāni cakre kim mā karann abalā asya senāḥ
children.translated_text: For the <s>Dāsa</s> made women his weapons; what could his powerless armies do to me?

children.text: antar hy akhyad ubhe asya dhene athopa praid yudhaye dasyum indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: For he looked between his two mares; then <s>Indra</s> advanced to fight the <s>Dasyu</s>.

children.text: sam atra gāvo 'bhito 'navanteheha vatsair viyutā yad āsan
children.translated_text: Here the cows bellowed together on every side, when they were separated from their calves.

children.text: saṃ tā indro asṛjad asya śākair yad īṃ somāsaḥ suṣutā amandan ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> released them by his powers, when the well-pressed Soma draughts had exhilarated him.

children.text: yad īṃ somā babhrudhūtā amandann aroravīd vṛṣabhaḥ sādaneṣu
children.translated_text: When the tawny-bright Soma draughts had exhilarated him, the bull roared in his seats.

children.text: purandaraḥ papivāṁ indro asya punar gavām adadād usriyāṇām ||
children.translated_text: Having drunk of it, <s>Indra</s>, breaker of strongholds, again gave back the bright cows.

children.text: bhadram idaṃ ruśamā agne akran gavāṃ catvāri dadataḥ sahasrā
children.translated_text: The <s>Ruśamas</s>, O <s>Agni</s>, have done this good deed, giving four thousand cows;

children.text: ṛṇañcayasya prayatā maghāni praty agrabhīṣma nṛtamasya nṛṇām ||
children.translated_text: we have received the offered gifts of <s>Ṛṇañcaya</s>, the most manly of men.

children.text: supeśasam māva sṛjanty astaṃ gavāṃ sahasrai ruśamāso agne
children.translated_text: The <s>Ruśamas</s>, O <s>Agni</s>, send me home richly adorned, with thousands of cows;

children.text: tīvrā indram amamanduḥ sutāso 'ktor vyuṣṭau paritakmyāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the sharp pressed <s>soma</s> (sacred drink) has gladdened <s>Indra</s> at the daybreak after the circling night.

children.text: aucchat sā rātrī paritakmyā yāṃ ṛṇañcaye rājani ruśamānām
children.translated_text: That circling night has dawned, the night at the house of <s>Ṛṇañcaya</s>, king of the <s>Ruśamas</s>;

children.text: atyo na vājī raghur ajyamāno babhruś catvāry asanat sahasrā ||
children.translated_text: like a swift prize-winning courser being driven, the tawny one won four thousand.

children.text: catuḥsahasraṃ gavyasya paśvaḥ praty agrabhīṣma ruśameṣv agne
children.translated_text: We received four thousand head of cattle among the <s>Ruśamas</s>, O <s>Agni</s>;

children.text: gharmaś cit taptaḥ pravṛje ya āsīd ayasmayas tam v ādāma viprāḥ ||
children.translated_text: even the heated iron <s>gharma</s> (ritual vessel) that was in the enclosure, we inspired poets took it.

children.text: Chapter 385
indro rathāya pravataṃ kṛṇoti yam adhyasthān maghavā vājayantam
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> makes a downward course for the chariot on which the bountiful one mounted, seeking the prize;

children.text: yūtheva paśvo vy unoti gopā ariṣṭo yāti prathamaḥ siṣāsan ||
children.translated_text: like a herdsman opening out the herd of cattle, he goes first unharmed, eager to win.

children.text: ā pra drava harivo mā vi venaḥ piśaṅgarāte abhi naḥ sacasva
children.translated_text: Drive here, O tawny-steeded one; do not turn away, O tawny-rayed one; join yourself to us.

children.text: nahi tvad indra vasyo anyad asty amenāṃś cij janivataś cakartha ||
children.translated_text: For, O <s>Indra</s>, there is no better help than you; you have made even the powerless into men of lineage.

children.text: ud yat sahaḥ sahasa ājaniṣṭa dediṣṭa indra indriyāṇi viśvā
children.translated_text: When power was born from power, O <s>Indra</s>, all the powers of <s>Indra</s> shone forth;

children.text: prācodayat sudughā vavre antar vi jyotiṣā saṃvavṛtvat tamo 'vaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he set the well-milking ones in motion within the enclosure, and with light uncovered the enveloping darkness below.

children.text: anavas te ratham aśvāya takṣan tvaṣṭā vajram puruhūta dyumantam
children.translated_text: They fashioned your chariot for the horse, and <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, O much-invoked one, fashioned the shining <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt);

children.text: brahmāṇa indram mahayanto arkair avardhayann ahaye hantavā u ||
children.translated_text: the priests, magnifying <s>Indra</s> with hymns, strengthened him to slay the serpent.

children.text: vṛṣṇe yat te vṛṣaṇo arkam arcān indra grāvāṇo aditiḥ sajoṣāḥ
children.translated_text: When the virile pressing-stones, together with <s>Aditi</s>, sang the chant for you, the virile one, O <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: anaśvāso ye pavayo 'rathā indreṣitā abhy avartanta dasyūn ||
children.translated_text: then the horseless, chariotless wheel-rims, impelled by <s>Indra</s>, turned against the <s>Dasyus</s>.

children.text: pra te pūrvāṇi karaṇāni vocam pra nūtanā maghavan yā cakartha
children.translated_text: I proclaim your former deeds, and also the new ones that you have done, O bountiful one,

children.text: śaktīvo yad vibharā rodasī ubhe jayann apo manave dānucitrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: when, mighty, you held apart both heaven and earth, winning the wonder-rich waters for <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: tad in nu te karaṇaṃ dasma viprāhiṃ yad ghnann ojo atrāmimīthāḥ
children.translated_text: This indeed is your deed, O wondrous one: when, striking the serpent, you measured out your might there;

children.text: śuṣṇasya cit pari māyā agṛbhṇāḥ prapitvaṃ yann apa dasyūṃr asedhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you seized even the wiles of <s>Śuṣṇa</s>, when at the forward rush you drove the <s>Dasyus</s> away.

children.text: tvam apo yadave turvaśāyāramayaḥ sudughāḥ pāra indra
children.translated_text: You made the well-milking waters flow across for <s>Yadu</s> and <s>Turvaśa</s>, O <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: ugram ayātam avaho ha kutsaṃ saṃ ha yad vām uśanāranta devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: you brought fierce <s>Kutsa</s> as he advanced, when the gods together chose you two with <s>Uśanā</s>.

children.text: indrākutsā vahamānā rathenā vām atyā api karṇe vahantu
children.translated_text: Let the coursers, carrying <s>Indra</s> and <s>Kutsa</s> with the chariot, bear you two to the side;

children.text: niḥ ṣīm adbhyo dhamatho niḥ ṣadhasthān maghono hṛdo varathas tamāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: you two blow him out from the waters and out from his seats, and ward the darkness from the heart of the bountiful one.

children.text: vātasya yuktān suyujaś cid aśvān kaviś cid eṣo ajagann avasyuḥ
children.translated_text: This inspired seeker of help has come even to the well-yoked horses, yoked by the wind;

children.text: viśve te atra marutaḥ sakhāya indra brahmāṇi taviṣīm avardhan ||
children.translated_text: all your friends the <s>Maruts</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, have here strengthened the prayers and your force.

children.text: sūraś cid ratham paritakmyāyām pūrvaṃ karad uparaṃ jūjuvāṃsam
children.translated_text: Even <s>Sūrya</s>, in the circling night, made the chariot first, and then the later one pressing on;

children.text: bharac cakram etaśaḥ saṃ riṇāti puro dadhat saniṣyati kratuṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Etaśa</s> bore the wheel and joins it together; setting it in front, he will win our purpose.

children.text: āyaṁ janā abhicakṣe jagāmendraḥ sakhāyaṃ sutasomam icchan
children.translated_text: This <s>Indra</s>, people, has come into sight, seeking his friend who has pressed <s>soma</s> (sacred drink);

children.text: vadan grāvāva vedim bhriyāte yasya jīram adhvaryavaś caranti ||
children.translated_text: the speaking pressing-stone is brought to the altar, around whose swift one the <s>Adhvaryus</s> move.

children.text: ye cākananta cākananta nū te martā amṛta mo te aṃha āran
children.translated_text: The mortals who have pleased you and please you now, O immortal one, may they not fall into distress before you;

children.text: vāvandhi yajyūṃr uta teṣu dhehy ojo janeṣu yeṣu te syāma ||
children.translated_text: guard the worshippers, and place strength in those peoples among whom we may be yours.

children.text: Chapter 386
adardar utsam asṛjo vi khāni tvam arṇavān badbadhānāṁ aramṇāḥ
children.translated_text: You split open the spring; you released the channels; you checked the swelling floods that had been pent up;

children.text: mahāntam indra parvataṃ vi yad vaḥ sṛjo vi dhārā ava dānavaṃ han ||
children.translated_text: when, O <s>Indra</s>, you broke apart the great mountain, released the streams, and struck down the <s>Dānava</s>.

children.text: tvam utsāṁ ṛtubhir badbadhānāṁ araṃha ūdhaḥ parvatasya vajrin
children.translated_text: You, O wielder of the <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt), opened in due seasons the springs, the udder of the mountain, which had been blocked;

children.text: ahiṃ cid ugra prayutaṃ śayānaṃ jaghanvāṁ indra taviṣīm adhatthāḥ ||
children.translated_text: having struck even the serpent lying bound, O fierce <s>Indra</s>, you took on might.

children.text: tyasya cin mahato nir mṛgasya vadhar jaghāna taviṣībhir indraḥ
children.translated_text: With his powers <s>Indra</s> struck the death-blow of that great beast,

children.text: ya eka id apratir manyamāna ād asmād anyo ajaniṣṭa tavyān ||
children.translated_text: who, thinking himself alone and unmatched, then found another born stronger than himself.

children.text: tyaṃ cid eṣāṃ svadhayā madantam miho napātaṃ suvṛdhaṃ tamogām
children.translated_text: Even that one, rejoicing in his own power, child of the mists, well grown, moving in darkness,

children.text: vṛṣaprabharmā dānavasya bhāmaṃ vajreṇa vajrī ni jaghāna śuṣṇam ||
children.translated_text: the <s>vajra</s>-wielder struck down with the <s>vajra</s>: <s>Śuṣṇa</s>, the fury of the <s>Dānava</s>, bull-strong.

children.text: tyaṃ cid asya kratubhir niṣattam amarmaṇo vidad id asya marma
children.translated_text: Even him, settled by his stratagems and seeming without a vulnerable point, he found in his vulnerable point,

children.text: yad īṃ sukṣatra prabhṛtā madasya yuyutsantaṃ tamasi harmye dhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: when, O good ruler, at the onset of exhilaration, you placed him, eager for battle, in the dark stronghold.

children.text: tyaṃ cid itthā katpayaṃ śayānam asūrye tamasi vāvṛdhānam
children.translated_text: Even that <s>Katpaya</s>, lying there and growing in sunless darkness,

children.text: taṃ cin mandāno vṛṣabhaḥ sutasyoccair indro apagūryā jaghāna ||
children.translated_text: even him <s>Indra</s>, the bull exhilarated by the pressed <s>soma</s> (sacred drink), raised himself high and struck down.

children.text: ud yad indro mahate dānavāya vadhar yamiṣṭa saho apratītam
children.translated_text: When <s>Indra</s> raised the irresistible weapon and strength against the great <s>Dānava</s>,

children.text: yad īṃ vajrasya prabhṛtau dadābha viśvasya jantor adhamaṃ cakāra ||
children.translated_text: when at the hurling of the <s>vajra</s> he overwhelmed him, he made him the lowest of all creatures.

children.text: tyaṃ cid arṇam madhupaṃ śayānam asinvaṃ vavram mahy ādad ugraḥ
children.translated_text: Even that honey-drinking flood, lying still within the enclosure, the fierce one seized for himself;

children.text: apādam atram mahatā vadhena ni duryoṇa āvṛṇaṅ mṛdhravācam ||
children.translated_text: with a great weapon he shut in the footless devourer, the hostile-voiced one, in the evil lair.

children.text: ko asya śuṣmaṃ taviṣīṃ varāta eko dhanā bharate apratītaḥ
children.translated_text: Who can check his fury and his might? Alone and irresistible, he wins the prizes;

children.text: ime cid asya jrayaso nu devī indrasyaujaso bhiyasā jihāte ||
children.translated_text: even these divine ones shrink back at his rush, in fear of <s>Indra</s>'s power.

children.text: ny asmai devī svadhitir jihīta indrāya gātur uśatīva yeme
children.translated_text: The divine axe bows down before him; for <s>Indra</s> the path stretches out as if desiring him;

children.text: saṃ yad ojo yuvate viśvam ābhir anu svadhāvne kṣitayo namanta ||
children.translated_text: when he gathers all strength with these powers, the peoples bow after the self-powered one.

children.text: ekaṃ nu tvā satpatim pāñcajanyaṃ jātaṃ śṛṇomi yaśasaṃ janeṣu
children.translated_text: I hear that you alone were born as the true lord of the five peoples, famed among men;

children.text: tam me jagṛbhra āśaso naviṣṭhaṃ doṣā vastor havamānāsa indram ||
children.translated_text: calling on <s>Indra</s> evening and morning, my newest hopes have taken hold of him for me.

children.text: evā hi tvām ṛtuthā yātayantam maghā viprebhyo dadataṃ śṛṇomi
children.translated_text: For indeed I hear of you thus, setting things in motion in due season, giving gifts to the inspired priests.

children.text: kiṃ te brahmāṇo gṛhate sakhāyo ye tvāyā nidadhuḥ kāmam indra ||
children.translated_text: What do your sacred poets, the friends of the house, mean to you, O <s>Indra</s>, they who have set their desire upon you?

children.text: Chapter 387
mahi mahe tavase dīdhye nṝn indrāyetthā tavase atavyān
children.translated_text: For the great, mighty one I kindle men with thought, for <s>Indra</s>, mighty in just this way, not to be overcome.

children.text: yo asmai sumatiṃ vājasātau stuto jane samaryaś ciketa ||
children.translated_text: He, praised among the people, has perceived favor for this man in the winning of prize, in the contest.

children.text: sa tvaṃ na indra dhiyasāno arkair harīṇāṃ vṛṣan yoktram aśreḥ
children.translated_text: So you, O <s>Indra</s>, stirred by our thoughts and songs, O bull, have taken up the yoke-strap of the bay horses.

children.text: yā itthā maghavann anu joṣaṃ vakṣo abhi prāryaḥ sakṣi janān ||
children.translated_text: With those, O bounteous one, according to your pleasure, you will carry the worthy one forward and behold the peoples.

children.text: na te ta indrābhy asmad ṛṣvāyuktāso abrahmatā yad asan
children.translated_text: Those men of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, will not be turned against us, lofty and yoked, even if they are without sacred formulation.

children.text: tiṣṭhā ratham adhi taṃ vajrahastā raśmiṃ deva yamase svaśvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Stand upon that chariot, O god with the thunderbolt in hand; as a good horseman you hold the rein.

children.text: purū yat ta indra santy ukthā gave cakarthorvarāsu yudhyan
children.translated_text: Many are the praises for you, O <s>Indra</s>; you made pasture for the cow while fighting in the fields.

children.text: tatakṣe sūryāya cid okasi sve vṛṣā samatsu dāsasya nāma cit ||
children.translated_text: Even for the sun you fashioned a home of his own; as a bull in battles you cut down the very name of the <s>Dāsa</s>.

children.text: vayaṃ te ta indra ye ca naraḥ śardho jajñānā yātāś ca rathāḥ
children.translated_text: We are yours, O <s>Indra</s>, and so are the men, the troop that has been born and the chariots that have set out.

children.text: āsmāñ jagamyād ahiśuṣma satvā bhago na havyaḥ prabhṛtheṣu cāruḥ ||
children.translated_text: May your strong might come to us like <s>Bhaga</s>, lovely when called upon at the offerings, O slayer of the serpent.

children.text: papṛkṣeṇyam indra tve hy ojo nṛmṇāni ca nṛtamāno amartaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, in you is the strength to be sought and the manly powers, immortal one, strongest of men.

children.text: sa na enīṃ vasavāno rayiṃ dāḥ prārya stuṣe tuvimaghasya dānam ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, rich in good things, give us this wealth; I praise the gift of the very bounteous worthy one.

children.text: evā na indrotibhir ava pāhi gṛṇataḥ śūra kārūn
children.translated_text: Thus, O <s>Indra</s>, protect us with aids, protect the praising singers, O hero.

children.text: uta tvacaṃ dadato vājasātau piprīhi madhvaḥ suṣutasya cāroḥ ||
children.translated_text: And, when giving the hide in the winning of prize, be gladdened with the sweet, well-pressed, lovely Soma.

children.text: uta tye mā paurukutsyasya sūres trasadasyor hiraṇino rarāṇāḥ
children.translated_text: And may those golden gifts of <s>Trasadasyu</s>, the hero descended from <s>Purukutsa</s>, gladdening me, carry me.

children.text: vahantu mā daśa śyetāso asya gairikṣitasya kratubhir nu saśce ||
children.translated_text: May his ten white horses, belonging to the mountain-dweller, attend me now with their powers.

children.text: uta tye mā mārutāśvasya śoṇāḥ kratvāmaghāso vidathasya rātau
children.translated_text: And may those red horses of <s>Mārutāśva</s>, rich in insight and gifts at the distribution, carry me.

children.text: sahasrā me cyavatāno dadāna ānūkam aryo vapuṣe nārcat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Cyavatāna</s>, giving me thousands, has not praised the noble one in due order for mere beauty.

children.text: uta tye mā dhvanyasya juṣṭā lakṣmaṇyasya suruco yatānāḥ
children.translated_text: And may those favored, well-shining mares of <s>Dhvanya</s>, of <s>Lakṣmaṇya</s>, moving onward, carry me.

children.text: mahnā rāyaḥ saṃvaraṇasya ṛṣer vrajaṃ na gāvaḥ prayatā api gman ||
children.translated_text: By the greatness of the wealth of the seer <s>Saṃvaraṇa</s>, they have come in ordered array like cows to the pen.

children.text: Chapter 388
ajātaśatrum ajarā svarvaty anu svadhāmitā dasmam īyate
children.translated_text: The wondrous, unborn foe-slayer, undecaying and sun-bright, moves according to his own law.

children.text: sunotana pacata brahmavāhase puruṣṭutāya prataraṃ dadhātana ||
children.translated_text: Press Soma; cook the offering for the bearer of the sacred formulation; set it forth early for the much-praised one.

children.text: ā yaḥ somena jaṭharam apipratāmandata maghavā madhvo andhasaḥ
children.translated_text: He who filled his belly with Soma, the bounteous one, rejoiced in the sweet draught.

children.text: yad īm mṛgāya hantave mahāvadhaḥ sahasrabhṛṣṭim uśanā vadhaṃ yamat ||
children.translated_text: When, to slay the beast, <s>Uśanā</s> directed the great weapon, the thousand-pointed missile, against him.

children.text: yo asmai ghraṃsa uta vā ya ūdhani somaṃ sunoti bhavati dyumāṁ aha
children.translated_text: Whoever presses Soma for him, whether in the blazing heat or at the udder, becomes splendid that very day.

children.text: apāpa śakras tatanuṣṭim ūhati tanūśubhram maghavā yaḥ kavāsakhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Free from evil, <s>Śakra</s> carries off the wasting sickness; the bounteous one is pure in body, he who is a friend to the poet.

children.text: yasyāvadhīt pitaraṃ yasya mātaraṃ yasya śakro bhrātaraṃ nāta īṣate
children.translated_text: The one whose father he has struck down, whose mother, whose brother <s>Śakra</s> has struck, cannot prevail against him.

children.text: vetīd v asya prayatā yataṅkaro na kilbiṣād īṣate vasva ākaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: He knows this man's ordered work and what has been made; the source of good things does not suffer from guilt.

children.text: na pañcabhir daśabhir vaṣṭy ārabhaṃ nāsunvatā sacate puṣyatā cana
children.translated_text: He does not choose an alliance with five or ten, nor does he join with the non-presser, even if that man prospers.

children.text: jināti ved amuyā hanti vā dhunir ā devayum bhajati gomati vraje ||
children.translated_text: He conquers the knower there, he strikes down the shaker; he favors the god-loving man in the cow-rich enclosure.

children.text: vitvakṣaṇaḥ samṛtau cakramāsajo 'sunvato viṣuṇaḥ sunvato vṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: Wide-seeing in battle, with the wheel fixed on, he is hostile to the non-presser and increaser of the Soma-presser.

children.text: indro viśvasya damitā vibhīṣaṇo yathāvaśaṃ nayati dāsam āryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, tamer of all and terrifying, the noble one, leads the <s>Dāsa</s> according to his will.

children.text: sam īm paṇer ajati bhojanam muṣe vi dāśuṣe bhajati sūnaraṃ vasu
children.translated_text: He drives together the food of the <s>Paṇi</s> for plunder and distributes fair wealth to the generous giver.

children.text: durge cana dhriyate viśva ā puru jano yo asya taviṣīm acukrudhat ||
children.translated_text: Even in difficulty the man who has provoked his mighty force is not sustained, though he be every one and many.

children.text: saṃ yaj janau sudhanau viśvaśardhasāv aved indro maghavā goṣu śubhriṣu
children.translated_text: When, among the two peoples rich in goods and of every host, bounteous <s>Indra</s> found wealth among the bright cows,

children.text: yujaṃ hy anyam akṛta pravepany ud īṃ gavyaṃ sṛjate satvabhir dhuniḥ ||
children.translated_text: then indeed the rushing one made another ally trembling, and with his strong ones he released the cow-rich spoil.

children.text: sahasrasām āgniveśiṃ gṛṇīṣe śatrim agna upamāṃ ketum aryaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, I praise the thousand-winning <s>Agniveśi</s>, the noble <s>Śatri</s>, a matchless beacon.

children.text: tasmā āpaḥ saṃyataḥ pīpayanta tasmin kṣatram amavat tveṣam astu ||
children.translated_text: For him may the assembled waters swell; in him let there be force, powerful and blazing.

children.text: Chapter 389
yas te sādhiṣṭho 'vasa indra kratuṣ ṭam ā bhara
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, bring here for us that resolve of yours which is most effective for aid.

children.text: asmabhyaṃ carṣaṇīsahaṃ sasniṃ vājeṣu duṣṭaram ||
children.translated_text: Bring it to us, conquering men, winning, hard to overcome in contests.

children.text: yad indra te catasro yac chūra santi tisraḥ
children.translated_text: If, O <s>Indra</s>, four aids are yours, or if, O hero, three exist,

children.text: yad vā pañca kṣitīnām avas tat su na ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: or if there are five among the peoples, bring that aid here to us.

children.text: ā te 'vo vareṇyaṃ vṛṣantamasya hūmahe
children.translated_text: We call upon your desirable aid, that of the strongest bull.

children.text: vṛṣajūtir hi jajñiṣa ābhūbhir indra turvaṇiḥ ||
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Indra</s>, were born with bull-like impulse, overcoming by your supports.

children.text: vṛṣā hy asi rādhase jajñiṣe vṛṣṇi te śavaḥ
children.translated_text: For you are a bull for bounty; you were born for bounty, and your force belongs to the bull.

children.text: svakṣatraṃ te dhṛṣan manaḥ satrāham indra pauṃsyam ||
children.translated_text: Your mind is self-ruling and bold, O <s>Indra</s>; your manly power is truly victorious.

children.text: tvaṃ tam indra martyam amitrayantam adrivaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, stone-wielder, rush down with every chariot upon that mortal who acts as an enemy.

children.text: sarvarathā śatakrato ni yāhi śavasas pate ||
children.translated_text: O hundred-powered lord of strength, drive him down.

children.text: tvām id vṛtrahantama janāso vṛktabarhiṣaḥ
children.translated_text: You, most of all a slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, the people with strewn sacred grass call upon.

children.text: ugram pūrvīṣu pūrvyaṃ havante vājasātaye ||
children.translated_text: They call upon you, fierce, ancient among the many ancient ones, for the winning of prize.

children.text: asmākam indra duṣṭaram puroyāvānam ājiṣu
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, aid our chariot, hard to overcome in battles, going in front in contests,

children.text: sayāvānaṃ dhane dhane vājayantam avā ratham ||
children.translated_text: moving with companions in every prize, impelling the contest.

children.text: asmākam indrehi no ratham avā purandhyā
children.translated_text: Come to our chariot, O <s>Indra</s>; aid us with wise understanding.

children.text: vayaṃ śaviṣṭha vāryaṃ divi śravo dadhīmahi divi stomam manāmahe ||
children.translated_text: O mightiest, may we set desirable fame in heaven; in heaven may we establish our praise-song.

children.text: Chapter 390
sa ā gamad indro yo vasūnāṃ ciketad dātuṃ dāmano rayīṇām
children.translated_text: May that <s>Indra</s> come, who knows how to give wealth, the giver of treasures.

children.text: dhanvacaro na vaṃsagas tṛṣāṇaś cakamānaḥ pibatu dugdham aṃśum ||
children.translated_text: Like one wandering in the desert, longing and eager, may he drink the milked Soma-shoot.

children.text: ā te hanū harivaḥ śūra śipre ruhat somo na parvatasya pṛṣṭhe
children.translated_text: May the Soma mount your two jaws, O bay-horsed hero, your lips, as on the back of a mountain.

children.text: anu tvā rājann arvato na hinvan gīrbhir madema puruhūta viśve ||
children.translated_text: Following after you, O king, like horses driven on, may we all rejoice in songs, O much-invoked one.

children.text: cakraṃ na vṛttam puruhūta vepate mano bhiyā me amater id adrivaḥ
children.translated_text: Like a wheel not yet set rolling, O much-invoked one, my mind trembles with fear because of want, O stone-wielder.

children.text: rathād adhi tvā jaritā sadāvṛdha kuvin nu stoṣan maghavan purūvasuḥ ||
children.translated_text: From the chariot the singer calls upon you, ever-growing one; surely now, praising, O <s>Maghavan</s>, possessor of many goods.

children.text: eṣa grāveva jaritā ta indreyarti vācam bṛhad āśuṣāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: This singer, like a pressing stone, sends forth a lofty voice to you, O <s>Indra</s>, eager for favor.

children.text: pra savyena maghavan yaṃsi rāyaḥ pra dakṣiṇiddharivo mā vi venaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With the left hand, O <s>Maghavan</s>, extend riches; with the right, O bay-horsed one, do not withhold them from us.

children.text: vṛṣā tvā vṛṣaṇaṃ vardhatu dyaur vṛṣā vṛṣabhyāṃ vahase haribhyām
children.translated_text: May the bull heaven strengthen you, the bull; as a bull you are borne by your two bull-like bay steeds.

children.text: sa no vṛṣā vṛṣarathaḥ suśipra vṛṣakrato vṛṣā vajrin bhare dhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: As a bull, with a bull-drawn chariot, O fair-lipped one, O bull-willed thunderbolt-bearer, set bounty for us in the contest.

children.text: yo rohitau vājinau vājinīvān tribhiḥ śataiḥ sacamānāv adiṣṭa
children.translated_text: He who appointed the two red prize-winning steeds, rich in prizes and accompanied by three hundred,

children.text: yūne sam asmai kṣitayo namantāṃ śrutarathāya maruto duvoyā ||
children.translated_text: to that young <s>Śrutaratha</s> let the peoples bow; let the <s>Maruts</s> serve him with homage.

children.text: Chapter 391
sam bhānunā yatate sūryasyājuhvāno ghṛtapṛṣṭhaḥ svañcāḥ
children.translated_text: He strives together with the radiance of the sun, offering, ghee-backed and well-directed.

children.text: tasmā amṛdhrā uṣaso vy ucchān ya indrāya sunavāmety āha ||
children.translated_text: For him the unfailing Dawns shine forth, who says, 'Let us press Soma for <s>Indra</s>.'

children.text: samiddhāgnir vanavat stīrṇabarhir yuktagrāvā sutasomo jarāte
children.translated_text: With <s>Agni</s> kindled, with the sacred grass spread, with the stones yoked and the Soma pressed, the singer chants.

children.text: grāvāṇo yasyeṣiraṃ vadanty ayad adhvaryur haviṣāva sindhum ||
children.translated_text: The pressing stones of the man whose eager voice resounds speak out, when the <s>Adhvaryu</s> goes with the oblation like a river.

children.text: vadhūr iyam patim icchanty eti ya īṃ vahāte mahiṣīm iṣirām
children.translated_text: This bride comes desiring a husband, she whom he carries, a mighty, impelling queen.

children.text: āsya śravasyād ratha ā ca ghoṣāt purū sahasrā pari vartayāte ||
children.translated_text: At the fame of her mouth, and at the sound of the chariot, many thousands turn around.

children.text: na sa rājā vyathate yasminn indras tīvraṃ somam pibati gosakhāyam
children.translated_text: That king does not tremble in whom <s>Indra</s> drinks the sharp Soma, accompanied by milk-cows.

children.text: ā satvanair ajati hanti vṛtraṃ kṣeti kṣitīḥ subhago nāma puṣyan ||
children.translated_text: With his strong men he drives forward and slays <s>Vṛtra</s>; fortunate, he dwells among the peoples, making his name thrive.

children.text: puṣyāt kṣeme abhi yoge bhavāty ubhe vṛtau saṃyatī saṃ jayāti
children.translated_text: He prospers in settled peace and in assault; in both contests, when they meet, he conquers.

children.text: priyaḥ sūrye priyo agnā bhavāti ya indrāya sutasomo dadāśat ||
children.translated_text: He becomes dear to <s>Sūrya</s> and dear to <s>Agni</s>, who has offered pressed Soma to <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 392
uroṣ ṭa indra rādhaso vibhvī rātiḥ śatakrato
children.translated_text: Wide is the expanse of your bounty, O <s>Indra</s>; vast is your gift, O hundred-powered one.

children.text: adhā no viśvacarṣaṇe dyumnā sukṣatra maṃhaya ||
children.translated_text: Therefore for us, O lord of all peoples, O good ruler, increase the bright strengths.

children.text: yad īm indra śravāyyam iṣaṃ śaviṣṭha dadhiṣe
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indra</s>, mightiest one, you take up renowned nourishment,

children.text: paprathe dīrghaśruttamaṃ hiraṇyavarṇa duṣṭaram ||
children.translated_text: it spreads far, most widely heard, golden-colored and hard to cross.

children.text: śuṣmāso ye te adrivo mehanā ketasāpaḥ
children.translated_text: Those powers of yours, O stone-wielder, are raining, marked by insight, rich in waters.

children.text: ubhā devāv abhiṣṭaye divaś ca gmaś ca rājathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For our help you two gods rule over both heaven and earth.

children.text: uto no asya kasya cid dakṣasya tava vṛtrahan
children.translated_text: And from whatever skill or power of yours there is, O <s>Vṛtrahan</s>,

children.text: asmabhyaṃ nṛmṇam ā bharāsmabhyaṃ nṛmaṇasyase ||
children.translated_text: bring manly strength to us; for us you desire heroic force.

children.text: nū ta ābhir abhiṣṭibhis tava śarmañchatakrato
children.translated_text: Now, through these helps of yours, in your shelter, O hundred-powered one,

children.text: indra syāma sugopāḥ śūra syāma sugopāḥ ||
children.translated_text: may we be well guarded, O <s>Indra</s>; may we, O hero, be well guarded.

children.text: Chapter 393
yad indra citra mehanāsti tvādātam adrivaḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever wondrous bounty has been given by you, O stone-wielder,

children.text: rādhas tan no vidadvasa ubhayāhasty ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: bring that gift to us, O knowing one, with both hands.

children.text: yan manyase vareṇyam indra dyukṣaṃ tad ā bhara
children.translated_text: Whatever you think choiceworthy, O <s>Indra</s>, bright in heaven, bring that here.

children.text: vidyāma tasya te vayam akūpārasya dāvane ||
children.translated_text: May we come to know that inexhaustible gift of yours for giving.

children.text: yat te ditsu prarādhyam mano asti śrutam bṛhat
children.translated_text: Whatever great and famous mind of yours is to be won among gifts,

children.text: tena dṛﾱhā cid adriva ā vājaṃ darṣi sātaye ||
children.translated_text: with that, O stone-wielder, you reveal even firm wealth for acquisition.

children.text: maṃhiṣṭhaṃ vo maghonāṃ rājānaṃ carṣaṇīnām
children.translated_text: The greatest of the bounteous, the king of peoples,

children.text: indram upa praśastaye pūrvībhir jujuṣe giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, for praise, the songs have gladly approached with many utterances.

children.text: asmā it kāvyaṃ vaca uktham indrāya śaṃsyam
children.translated_text: For him alone is the poetic speech, the hymn to be proclaimed for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: tasmā u brahmavāhase giro vardhanty atrayo giraḥ śumbhanty atrayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For him, the bearer of sacred formulation, the songs of the <s>Atris</s> increase; the songs of the <s>Atris</s> adorn him.

children.text: Chapter 394
ā yāhy adribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ somapate piba
children.translated_text: Come here with the pressing stones; drink the pressed Soma, O lord of Soma,

children.text: vṛṣann indra vṛṣabhir vṛtrahantama ||
children.translated_text: bull <s>Indra</s>, with the bulls, greatest slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: vṛṣā grāvā vṛṣā mado vṛṣā somo ayaṃ sutaḥ
children.translated_text: The pressing stone is a bull, the exhilaration is a bull, this pressed Soma is a bull;

children.text: vṛṣann indra vṛṣabhir vṛtrahantama ||
children.translated_text: bull <s>Indra</s>, with the bulls, greatest slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: vṛṣā tvā vṛṣaṇaṃ huve vajriñ citrābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: As a bull I call you, the bull, O thunderbolt-bearer, with wondrous aids;

children.text: vṛṣann indra vṛṣabhir vṛtrahantama ||
children.translated_text: bull <s>Indra</s>, with the bulls, greatest slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: ṛjīṣī vajrī vṛṣabhas turāṣāṭ chuṣmī rājā vṛtrahā somapāvā
children.translated_text: Rich in Soma-dregs, thunderbolt-bearing, a bull, overcoming swiftly, powerful, king, <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer, Soma-drinker,

children.text: yuktvā haribhyām upa yāsad arvāṅ mādhyandine savane matsad indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: having yoked the two bay horses, let <s>Indra</s> come hither and rejoice at the midday pressing.

children.text: yat tvā sūrya svarbhānus tamasāvidhyad āsuraḥ
children.translated_text: When <s>Svarbhānu</s> the Asura pierced you, O <s>Sūrya</s>, with darkness,

children.text: akṣetravid yathā mugdho bhuvanāny adīdhayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: beings looked bewildered, like one who does not know the field.

children.text: svarbhānor adha yad indra māyā avo divo vartamānā avāhan
children.translated_text: Then, O <s>Indra</s>, when you brought down <s>Svarbhānu</s>'s magic powers that were moving below heaven,

children.text: gūﾱhaṃ sūryaṃ tamasāpavratena turīyeṇa brahmaṇāvindad atriḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Atri</s>, by the fourth sacred formulation, found <s>Sūrya</s> hidden by lawless darkness.

children.text: mā mām imaṃ tava santam atra irasyā drugdho bhiyasā ni gārīt
children.translated_text: Let not the deceiver, hostile in fear, swallow down me who am yours here, O <s>Atri</s>.

children.text: tvam mitro asi satyarādhās tau mehāvataṃ varuṇaś ca rājā ||
children.translated_text: You are <s>Mitra</s>, true in bounty; may both you and king <s>Varuṇa</s> aid me.

children.text: grāvṇo brahmā yuyujānaḥ saparyan kīriṇā devān namasopaśikṣan
children.translated_text: The priest of the pressing stone, yoking the sacred formulation, worshiping and teaching the gods reverence with praise,

children.text: atriḥ sūryasya divi cakṣur ādhāt svarbhānor apa māyā aghukṣat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Atri</s> set the eye of <s>Sūrya</s> in heaven; he drove away <s>Svarbhānu</s>'s magic powers.

children.text: yaṃ vai sūryaṃ svarbhānus tamasāvidhyad āsuraḥ
children.translated_text: That very <s>Sūrya</s> whom <s>Svarbhānu</s> the Asura pierced with darkness,

children.text: atrayas tam anv avindan nahy anye aśaknuvan ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Atris</s> found him; no others were able.

children.text: Chapter 395
ko nu vām mitrāvaruṇāv ṛtāyan divo vā mahaḥ pārthivasya vā de
children.translated_text: Which of you two, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, following <s>ṛta</s> from heaven, or from the greatness of earth,

children.text: ṛtasya vā sadasi trāsīthāṃ no yajñāyate vā paśuṣo na vājān ||
children.translated_text: or in the seat of <s>ṛta</s>, will protect us and the one sacrificing, like prizes from a beast?

children.text: te no mitro varuṇo aryamāyur indra ṛbhukṣā maruto juṣanta
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Āyu</s>, <s>Indra</s>, <s>Ṛbhukṣan</s>, and the <s>Maruts</s> be pleased with us.

children.text: namobhir vā ye dadhate suvṛktiṃ stomaṃ rudrāya mīﾱhuṣe sajoṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: And may those who, with reverent bows, offer a well-turned hymn to generous <s>Rudra</s> be of one accord.

children.text: ā vāṃ yeṣṭhāśvinā huvadhyai vātasya patman rathyasya puṣṭau
children.translated_text: I call upon you two most excellent <s>Aśvins</s> to be invoked, on the path of the wind, in the prosperity of the chariot.

children.text: uta vā divo asurāya manma prāndhāṃsīva yajyave bharadhvam ||
children.translated_text: And carry our thought to the heavenly Asura, like sustenance for the worshiper.

children.text: pra sakṣaṇo divyaḥ kaṇvahotā trito divaḥ sajoṣā vāto agniḥ
children.translated_text: Let the skillful heavenly <s>Kaṇva</s>-hotṛ come forward; let <s>Trita</s> from heaven, <s>Vāta</s>, and <s>Agni</s> come in accord.

children.text: pūṣā bhagaḥ prabhṛthe viśvabhojā ājiṃ na jagmur āśvaśvatamāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pūṣan</s>, <s>Bhaga</s>, and the all-nourishing one at the offering have gone like the best horsemen to the contest.

children.text: pra vo rayiṃ yuktāśvam bharadhvaṃ rāya eṣe 'vase dadhīta dhīḥ
children.translated_text: Bring forth wealth with yoked horses; for wealth and help let inspired thought be set in place.

children.text: suśeva evair auśijasya hotā ye va evā marutas turāṇām ||
children.translated_text: The Hotṛ of <s>Auśija</s> is truly gracious with his aids; such indeed, O <s>Maruts</s>, belongs to the swift ones.

children.text: pra vo vāyuṃ rathayujaṃ kṛṇudhvam pra devaṃ vipram panitāram arkaiḥ
children.translated_text: Set forth for yourselves <s>Vāyu</s>, yoked to his chariot; with hymns set forth the god, the inspired one, the one worthy of praise.

children.text: iṣudhyava ṛtasāpaḥ purandhīr vasvīr no atra patnīr ā dhiye dhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The liberal powers, ready with arrows and guarding <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), the kindly wives, have here placed their good things upon our thought.

children.text: upa va eṣe vandyebhiḥ śūṣaiḥ pra yahvī divaś citayadbhir arkaiḥ
children.translated_text: I approach you with praiseworthy strengths, with hymns that make even the mighty heaven take note.

children.text: uṣāsānaktā viduṣīva viśvam ā hā vahato martyāya yajñam ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Uṣāsānaktā</s>, Dawn and Night, as if knowing all, bring the <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice) here for the mortal.

children.text: abhi vo arce poṣyāvato nṝn vāstoṣpatiṃ tvaṣṭāraṃ rarāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: I sing over you men rich in nurture, honoring <s>Vāstoṣpati</s> and <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>.

children.text: dhanyā sajoṣā dhiṣaṇā namobhir vanaspatīṃr oṣadhī rāya eṣe ||
children.translated_text: With reverences I seek wealth from blessed <s>Dhiṣaṇā</s> in common accord, from the forest-lords and the herbs.

children.text: tuje nas tane parvatāḥ santu svaitavo ye vasavo na vīrāḥ
children.translated_text: May the mountains, whose banners are bright, be for us near at hand, like the <s>Vasus</s>, like heroes.

children.text: panita āptyo yajataḥ sadā no vardhān naḥ śaṃsaṃ naryo abhiṣṭau ||
children.translated_text: May the praised <s>Āptya</s>, always worshipful, increase our song of praise for us, a manly help in our need.

children.text: vṛṣṇo astoṣi bhūmyasya garbhaṃ trito napātam apāṃ suvṛkti
children.translated_text: With a fair hymn I have praised the bull, the child of the earth's womb, <s>Trita</s>, offspring of the waters.

children.text: gṛṇīte agnir etarī na śūṣaiḥ śociṣkeśo ni riṇāti vanā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, with his flaming hair, praises with these strengths and cuts down the forests as with a rushing onset.

children.text: kathā mahe rudriyāya bravāma kad rāye cikituṣe bhagāya
children.translated_text: How shall we speak to the great <s>Rudra</s>, to the fortunate <s>Bhaga</s> who understands wealth?

children.text: āpa oṣadhīr uta no 'vantu dyaur vanā girayo vṛkṣakeśāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the waters and the herbs protect us, and heaven, the forests, the mountains with trees for their hair.

children.text: śṛṇotu na ūrjām patir giraḥ sa nabhas tarīyāṁ iṣiraḥ parijmā
children.translated_text: Let the lord of nourishment hear our voices, he who swiftly crosses the cloud, the vigorous one who ranges around.

children.text: śṛṇvantv āpaḥ puro na śubhrāḥ pari sruco babṛhāṇasyādreḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let the waters hear, bright like fortresses, as they swell around the streams from the growing rock.

children.text: vidā cin nu mahānto ye va evā bravāma dasmā vāryaṃ dadhānāḥ
children.translated_text: Indeed, O great ones such as you, let us know and speak of you, wondrous ones who hold desirable treasure.

children.text: vayaś cana subhva āva yanti kṣubhā martam anuyataṃ vadhasnaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even birds come to the fair sky, while the violent ones pursue the mortal with weapons.

children.text: ā daivyāni pārthivāni janmāpaś cācchā sumakhāya vocam
children.translated_text: I have spoken toward the divine and earthly births, and toward the waters, for the one of good sacrifice.

children.text: vardhantāṃ dyāvo giraś candrāgrā udā vardhantām abhiṣātā arṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let heaven and the songs with shining forefront grow strong; let the hostile floods rise up and grow strong.

children.text: pade pade me jarimā ni dhāyi varūtrī vā śakrā yā pāyubhiś ca
children.translated_text: At every step old age has been set down for me, or else a protectress, strong with her guardians.

children.text: siṣaktu mātā mahī rasā naḥ smat sūribhir ṛjuhasta ṛjuvaniḥ ||
children.translated_text: May mother <s>Rasā</s>, great and nourishing, cling to us; may the straight-handed, straight-winning one be with our patrons.

children.text: kathā dāśema namasā sudānūn evayā maruto acchoktau praśravaso maruto acchoktau
children.translated_text: How shall we serve the generous ones with reverence? Thus, O <s>Maruts</s>, in clear invocation, O far-famed <s>Maruts</s>, in clear invocation.

children.text: mā no 'hir budhnyo riṣe dhād asmākam bhūd upamātivaniḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let not <s>Ahi Budhnya</s> assign us to harm; let there be for us a power that overcomes insult.

children.text: iti cin nu prajāyai paśumatyai devāso vanate martyo va ā devāso vanate martyo vaḥ
children.translated_text: Even so, for progeny rich in cattle, O gods, the mortal wins you; O gods, the mortal wins you.

children.text: atrā śivāṃ tanvo dhāsim asyā jarāṃ cin me nirṛtir jagrasīta ||
children.translated_text: Here, for this body, may I obtain a kindly support; may even destructive old age swallow me up.

children.text: tāṃ vo devāḥ sumatim ūrjayantīm iṣam aśyāma vasavaḥ śasā goḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Vasus</s>, may we attain that favorable thought of yours, strengthening nourishment, and the refreshment praised by the cow.

children.text: sā naḥ sudānur mṛﾱayantī devī prati dravantī suvitāya gamyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May that generous goddess, showing mercy and hastening toward us, come for good guidance.

children.text: abhi na iﾱā yūthasya mātā sman nadībhir urvaśī vā gṛṇātu
children.translated_text: May <s>Iḷā</s>, mother of the herd, praise us together with the rivers, or <s>Urvaśī</s> herself.

children.text: urvaśī vā bṛhaddivā gṛṇānābhyūrṇvānā prabhṛthasyāyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: Or let <s>Urvaśī</s>, daughter of broad heaven, praise us, covering the origin of <s>Āyu</s>.

children.text: siṣaktu na ūrjavyasya puṣṭeḥ ||
children.translated_text: May she attach us to the abundance of nourishing strength.

children.text: Chapter 396
pra śantamā varuṇaṃ dīdhitī gīr mitram bhagam aditiṃ nūnam aśyāḥ
children.translated_text: May my song now reach most peaceful <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Bhaga</s>, and <s>Aditi</s> with its thought.

children.text: pṛṣadyoniḥ pañcahotā śṛṇotv atūrtapanthā asuro mayobhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let the five-hotṛ one, whose womb is speckled, hear: the untiring-path lord, the life-giving <s>Asura</s>, bringer of happiness.

children.text: prati me stomam aditir jagṛbhyāt sūnuṃ na mātā hṛdyaṃ suśevam
children.translated_text: May <s>Aditi</s> accept my praise as a mother accepts her son, dear to the heart and kindly.

children.text: brahma priyaṃ devahitaṃ yad asty aham mitre varuṇe yan mayobhu ||
children.translated_text: May the beloved sacred formulation, set in place by the gods, be mine, whatever is happiness-bringing in <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: ud īraya kavitamaṃ kavīnām unattainam abhi madhvā ghṛtena
children.translated_text: Raise up the most poetic of poets; lift him high with honey and ghee.

children.text: sa no vasūni prayatā hitāni candrāṇi devaḥ savitā suvāti ||
children.translated_text: May the god <s>Savitṛ</s> impel for us the ready, established, shining good things.

children.text: sam indra ṇo manasā neṣi gobhiḥ saṃ sūribhir harivaḥ saṃ svasti
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, bring us together in mind with cattle, together with patrons, O bay-horsed one, together with well-being.

children.text: sam brahmaṇā devahitaṃ yad asti saṃ devānāṃ sumatyā yajñiyānām ||
children.translated_text: Bring us together with the god-given sacred formulation, whatever it is, and with the favorable thought of the worshipful gods.

children.text: devo bhagaḥ savitā rāyo aṃśa indro vṛtrasya saṃjito dhanānām
children.translated_text: May the god <s>Bhaga</s>, <s>Savitṛ</s>, the portion of wealth, and <s>Indra</s>, conqueror of <s>Vṛtra</s> and of treasures, protect us.

children.text: ṛbhukṣā vāja uta vā purandhir avantu no amṛtāsas turāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Ṛbhukṣan</s>, <s>Vāja</s>, and also <s>Purandhi</s>, the immortal and swift ones, protect us.

children.text: marutvato apratītasya jiṣṇor ajūryataḥ pra bravāmā kṛtāni
children.translated_text: Let us proclaim the deeds of the victorious, undecaying one, rich in <s>Maruts</s> and not to be resisted.

children.text: na te pūrve maghavan nāparāso na vīryaṃ nūtanaḥ kaś canāpa ||
children.translated_text: Neither those before you nor those after you, O bounteous one, nor anyone born now, has matched your heroic power.

children.text: upa stuhi prathamaṃ ratnadheyam bṛhaspatiṃ sanitāraṃ dhanānām
children.translated_text: Praise first <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, the bestower of treasures, the winner of riches.

children.text: yaḥ śaṃsate stuvate śambhaviṣṭhaḥ purūvasur āgamaj johuvānam ||
children.translated_text: He is most helpful to the one who recites and praises; rich in many goods, he has come to the caller.

children.text: tavotibhiḥ sacamānā ariṣṭā bṛhaspate maghavānaḥ suvīrāḥ
children.translated_text: With your aids, O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, may the bounteous patrons be joined with us, unharmed and rich in heroes.

children.text: ye aśvadā uta vā santi godā ye vastradāḥ subhagās teṣu rāyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Among those who give horses, or who give cows, or who give garments, among the fortunate, there is wealth.

children.text: visarmāṇaṃ kṛṇuhi vittam eṣāṃ ye bhuñjate apṛṇanto na ukthaiḥ
children.translated_text: Make their wealth flow apart, those who enjoy without giving in response to our hymns.

children.text: apavratān prasave vāvṛdhānān brahmadviṣaḥ sūryād yāvayasva ||
children.translated_text: Drive away from the sun the vowless ones, swelling under impulse, the haters of sacred formulation.

children.text: ya ohate rakṣaso devavītāv acakrebhis tam maruto ni yāta
children.translated_text: Whoever in the gods' rite attacks like a demon, go after him, O <s>Maruts</s>, with wheel-less force.

children.text: yo vaḥ śamīṃ śaśamānasya nindāt tucchyān kāmān karate siṣvidānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whoever censures the work of the one who labors for you, sweating as he pursues empty desires, drive him down.

children.text: tam u ṣṭuhi yaḥ sviṣuḥ sudhanvā yo viśvasya kṣayati bheṣajasya
children.translated_text: Praise him, the excellent archer with the good bow, who rules over every healing remedy.

children.text: yakṣvā mahe saumanasāya rudraṃ namobhir devam asuraṃ duvasya ||
children.translated_text: Sacrifice to <s>Rudra</s> for great favor of mind; honor with reverences the god, the powerful lord.

children.text: damūnaso apaso ye suhastā vṛṣṇaḥ patnīr nadyo vibhvataṣṭāḥ
children.translated_text: The rivers, house-ruling and active, skillful-handed, the wives of the bull, shaped in many ways,

children.text: sarasvatī bṛhaddivota rākā daśasyantīr varivasyantu śubhrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Sarasvatī</s>, daughter of broad heaven, and <s>Rākā</s>, giving gifts, let the bright ones serve us with broad space.

children.text: pra sū mahe suśaraṇāya medhāṃ giram bhare navyasīṃ jāyamānām
children.translated_text: I bring forth a new-born song, a newer utterance, for the great one of good shelter.

children.text: ya āhanā duhitur vakṣaṇāsu rūpā mināno akṛṇod idaṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: He who, in the flanks of his daughter, shaping forms, made this for us when she was approached.

children.text: pra suṣṭuti stanayantaṃ ruvantam iﾱas patiṃ jaritar nūnam aśyāḥ
children.translated_text: O singer, now may you attain with good praise the thundering, roaring lord of <s>Iḷā</s>.

children.text: yo abdimāṁ udanimāṁ iyarti pra vidyutā rodasī ukṣamāṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He who sets in motion this cloud and this flood, sprinkling heaven and earth with lightning.

children.text: eṣa stomo mārutaṃ śardho acchā rudrasya sūnūṃr yuvanyūṃr ud aśyāḥ
children.translated_text: May this praise-song rise toward the <s>Marut</s> host, toward the young sons of <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: kāmo rāye havate mā svasty upa stuhi pṛṣadaśvāṁ ayāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Desire calls for wealth; for well-being praise the tireless ones with dappled horses.

children.text: praiṣa stomaḥ pṛthivīm antarikṣaṃ vanaspatīṃr oṣadhī rāye aśyāḥ
children.translated_text: May this praise-song go forth to earth, midspace, trees, and plants, for the sake of wealth.

children.text: devo devaḥ suhavo bhūtu mahyam mā no mātā pṛthivī durmatau dhāt ||
children.translated_text: May god after god be easy to invoke for me; may mother <s>Pṛthivī</s> not set us in ill favor.

children.text: urau devā anibādhe syāma ||
children.translated_text: O gods, may we be in a broad, unobstructed space.

children.text: sam aśvinor avasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema
children.translated_text: With the new aid of the <s>Aśvins</s>, bringing delight and good guidance, may we go forward.

children.text: ā no rayiṃ vahatam ota vīrān ā viśvāny amṛtā saubhagāni ||
children.translated_text: Bring wealth to us, and heroes too; bring all immortal good fortunes.

children.text: Chapter 397
ā dhenavaḥ payasā tūrṇyarthā amardhantīr upa no yantu madhvā
children.translated_text: May the milk-cows, hastening with milk, unfailing, come near us with sweetness.

children.text: maho rāye bṛhatīḥ sapta vipro mayobhuvo jaritā johavīti ||
children.translated_text: For great wealth the inspired singer calls aloud to the seven great, lofty, joy-bringing ones.

children.text: ā suṣṭutī namasā vartayadhyai dyāvā vājāya pṛthivī amṛdhre
children.translated_text: With fair praise and reverence I would turn <s>Dyāvā-Pṛthivī</s>, heaven and earth, to the prize, the unharming pair.

children.text: pitā mātā madhuvacāḥ suhastā bhare bhare no yaśasāv aviṣṭām ||
children.translated_text: May father and mother, sweet-speaking and good-handed, protect us with glory in every contest.

children.text: adhvaryavaś cakṛvāṃso madhūni pra vāyave bharata cāru śukram
children.translated_text: O <s>Adhvaryus</s>, having prepared the sweet draughts, bring forward for <s>Vāyu</s> the lovely bright one.

children.text: hoteva naḥ prathamaḥ pāhy asya deva madhvo rarimā te madāya ||
children.translated_text: Like the first <s>Hotar</s>, protect this for us, O god; we have offered you the sweetness for your exhilaration.

children.text: daśa kṣipo yuñjate bāhū adriṃ somasya yā śamitārā suhastā
children.translated_text: Ten fingers yoke the pressing-stone, the two arms, those good-handed preparers of the <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: madhvo rasaṃ sugabhastir giriṣṭhāṃ caniścadad duduhe śukram aṃśuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The bright <s>Soma</s> shoot, good-handed and mountain-born, milked out the sweet juice as it dripped.

children.text: asāvi te jujuṣāṇāya somaḥ kratve dakṣāya bṛhate madāya
children.translated_text: The <s>Soma</s> has been pressed for you who delight in it, for insight, skill, and great exhilaration.

children.text: harī rathe sudhurā yoge arvāg indra priyā kṛṇuhi hūyamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Make your two bay steeds, well-harnessed in the chariot-yoke, dear and turned hither, O <s>Indra</s>, as you are invoked.

children.text: ā no mahīm aramatiṃ sajoṣā gnāṃ devīṃ namasā rātahavyām
children.translated_text: Bring to us great <s>Aramati</s>, united in favor, the divine lady honored with reverent oblation.

children.text: madhor madāya bṛhatīm ṛtajñām āgne vaha pathibhir devayānaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: For sweet exhilaration, O <s>Agni</s>, bring the lofty, truth-knowing one by the god-traveled paths.

children.text: añjanti yam prathayanto na viprā vapāvantaṃ nāgninā tapantaḥ
children.translated_text: They anoint him, spreading him out like inspired priests; like something rich in fat, they heat him with fire.

children.text: pitur na putra upasi preṣṭha ā gharmo agnim ṛtayann asādi ||
children.translated_text: Like a son in the lap of his father, the dearest heated vessel, seeking truth, has been set beside <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: acchā mahī bṛhatī śantamā gīr dūto na gantv aśvinā huvadhyai
children.translated_text: Let my mighty, broad, most-peaceful song go forth like a messenger to call the <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: mayobhuvā sarathā yātam arvāg gantaṃ nidhiṃ dhuram āṇir na nābhim ||
children.translated_text: O joy-bringing ones, come hither on one chariot; go to the resting-place, like a linchpin to the nave.

children.text: pra tavyaso namauktiṃ turasyāham pūṣṇa uta vāyor adikṣi
children.translated_text: I have dedicated a reverential utterance to mighty, swift <s>Pūṣan</s>, and also to <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: yā rādhasā coditārā matīnāṃ yā vājasya draviṇodā uta tman ||
children.translated_text: They are the impellers of thoughts by their bounty, the givers of prize and wealth, and powerful in themselves.

children.text: ā nāmabhir maruto vakṣi viśvān ā rūpebhir jātavedo huvānaḥ
children.translated_text: Bring all the <s>Maruts</s> by their names and by their forms, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, as they are invoked.

children.text: yajñaṃ giro jarituḥ suṣṭutiṃ ca viśve ganta maruto viśva ūtī ||
children.translated_text: May all the <s>Maruts</s> come to the sacrifice, to the singer's songs and fair praise, with every aid.

children.text: ā no divo bṛhataḥ parvatād ā sarasvatī yajatā gantu yajñam
children.translated_text: May <s>Sarasvatī</s>, worthy of worship, come to our sacrifice from heaven, from the broad mountain.

children.text: havaṃ devī jujuṣāṇā ghṛtācī śagmāṃ no vācam uśatī śṛṇotu ||
children.translated_text: Accepting the call, rich in ghee, may the willing goddess hear our powerful speech.

children.text: ā vedhasaṃ nīlapṛṣṭham bṛhantam bṛhaspatiṃ sadane sādayadhvam
children.translated_text: Seat in the dwelling <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, the wise maker, dark-backed and great.

children.text: sādadyoniṃ dama ā dīdivāṃsaṃ hiraṇyavarṇam aruṣaṃ sapema ||
children.translated_text: We would serve the golden-colored, ruddy one, shining in the house, firmly seated in his place.

children.text: ā dharṇasir bṛhaddivo rarāṇo viśvebhir gantv omabhir huvānaḥ
children.translated_text: May the supporter from broad heaven, rejoicing and invoked, come with all protections.

children.text: gnā vasāna oṣadhīr amṛdhras tridhātuśṛṅgo vṛṣabho vayodhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Clothed in plants, unharming, the threefold-horned bull is a giver of life.

children.text: mātuṣ pade parame śukra āyor vipanyavo rāspirāso agman
children.translated_text: At the highest station of the mother, in the bright course of life, the attentive, stirring ones have come.

children.text: suśevyaṃ namasā rātahavyāḥ śiśum mṛjanty āyavo na vāse ||
children.translated_text: Worthy of good service and honored with reverent oblation, they cleanse the child as kinsmen cleanse a garment.

children.text: bṛhad vayo bṛhate tubhyam agne dhiyājuro mithunāsaḥ sacanta
children.translated_text: Great strength belongs to the great one, to you, O <s>Agni</s>; the thought-swift pairs attend upon you.

children.text: devo devaḥ suhavo bhūtu mahyam mā no mātā pṛthivī durmatau dhāt ||
children.translated_text: May god after god be easy to invoke for me; may mother <s>Pṛthivī</s> not set us in ill favor.

children.text: urau devā anibādhe syāma ||
children.translated_text: O gods, may we be in a broad, unobstructed space.

children.text: sam aśvinor avasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema
children.translated_text: With the new aid of the <s>Aśvins</s>, bringing delight and good guidance, may we go forward.

children.text: ā no rayiṃ vahatam ota vīrān ā viśvāny amṛtā saubhagāni ||
children.translated_text: Bring wealth to us, and heroes too; bring all immortal good fortunes.

children.text: Chapter 398
tam pratnathā pūrvathā viśvathemathā jyeṣṭhatātim barhiṣadaṃ svarvidam
children.translated_text: Him, as in ancient times, as formerly, in every way, the eldest, seated on the sacred grass, finder of the sun,

children.text: pratīcīnaṃ vṛjanaṃ dohase girāśuṃ jayantam anu yāsu vardhase ||
children.translated_text: turning toward us, the strong one for milking, the swift victorious one: by song you grow in those streams.

children.text: śriye sudṛśīr uparasya yāḥ svar virocamānaḥ kakubhāṁ acodate
children.translated_text: For splendor, the fair-seen regions of the lower heaven shine forth; gleaming, he urges on the quarters.

children.text: sugopā asi na dabhāya sukrato paro māyābhir ṛta āsa nāma te ||
children.translated_text: You are a good herdsman, not to be deceived, O strong-minded one; beyond deceits, truth has become your name.

children.text: atyaṃ haviḥ sacate sac ca dhātu cāriṣṭagātuḥ sa hotā sahobhariḥ
children.translated_text: The oblation follows the racer, and he shall establish it; he is the <s>Hotar</s>, going unharmed and bearing strength.

children.text: prasarsrāṇo anu barhir vṛṣā śiśur madhye yuvājaro visruhā hitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Spreading over the sacred grass, a bull, a child, young and ageless, has been placed in the middle, sending forth.

children.text: pra va ete suyujo yāmann iṣṭaye nīcīr amuṣmai yamya ṛtāvṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: These well-yoked ones go forth on the course for worship; the downward-turned companions, increasers of truth, belong to that one.

children.text: suyantubhiḥ sarvaśāsair abhīśubhiḥ krivir nāmāni pravaṇe muṣāyati ||
children.translated_text: With well-guiding reins and all-commanding bridles, the one called <s>Krivi</s> steals the names on the slope.

children.text: saṃjarbhurāṇas tarubhiḥ sutegṛbhaṃ vayākinaṃ cittagarbhāsu susvaruḥ
children.translated_text: Roaring together among the trees, holding the pressed draught, marked out and clear-sounding in the wombs of thought,

children.text: dhāravākeṣv ṛjugātha śobhase vardhasva patnīr abhi jīvo adhvare ||
children.translated_text: in the streams of speech, O straight-singing one, you shine; grow alive toward the wives in the sacrifice.

children.text: yādṛg eva dadṛśe tādṛg ucyate saṃ chāyayā dadhire sidhrayāpsv ā
children.translated_text: Just as he was seen, so is he spoken of; with a fitting shadow they set him in the waters.

children.text: mahīm asmabhyam uruṣām uru jrayo bṛhat suvīram anapacyutaṃ sahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Grant us great, broad, far-reaching, wide-ranging, heroic, unfailing might.

children.text: vety agrur janivān vā ati spṛdhaḥ samaryatā manasā sūryaḥ kaviḥ
children.translated_text: The foremost-born, or the poet <s>Sūrya</s>, goes beyond rivalries with an eager mind in the contest.

children.text: ghraṃsaṃ rakṣantam pari viśvato gayam asmākaṃ śarma vanavat svāvasuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Guarding brightness and life on every side, rich in his own goods, may he win shelter for us.

children.text: jyāyāṃsam asya yatunasya ketuna ṛṣisvaraṃ carati yāsu nāma te
children.translated_text: Greater by the sign of this active one, the lordly seer moves among those in whom your name is present.

children.text: yādṛśmin dhāyi tam apasyayā vidad ya u svayaṃ vahate so araṃ karat ||
children.translated_text: Whatever form he was placed in, he found by hidden power; the one who carries himself will make it sufficient.

children.text: samudram āsām ava tasthe agrimā na riṣyati savanaṃ yasminn āyatā
children.translated_text: The foremost one of them has taken his stand down upon the sea; the pressing to which they have come does not fail.

children.text: atrā na hārdi kravaṇasya rejate yatrā matir vidyate pūtabandhanī ||
children.translated_text: There the heart of the maker does not tremble, where thought is found with purified bonds.

children.text: sa hi kṣatrasya manasasya cittibhir evāvadasya yajatasya sadhreḥ
children.translated_text: For with the perceptions of the mind of the ruling power, of the very speaking, worshipful companion,

children.text: avatsārasya spṛṇavāma raṇvabhiḥ śaviṣṭhaṃ vājaṃ viduṣā cid ardhyam ||
children.translated_text: let us satisfy, with delights, the strongest prize of <s>Avatsāra</s>, worthy to be increased even by the knowing one.

children.text: śyena āsām aditiḥ kakṣyo mado viśvavārasya yajatasya māyinaḥ
children.translated_text: The falcon among these is <s>Aditi</s>; the exhilaration is hidden, belonging to the all-choosing, worshipful wonder-worker.

children.text: sam anyam anyam arthayanty etave vidur viṣāṇam paripānam anti te ||
children.translated_text: They seek each one after another to go forth; they know the horn, the enclosing drink, near you.

children.text: sadāpṛṇo yajato vi dviṣo vadhīd bāhuvṛktaḥ śrutavit taryo vaḥ sacā
children.translated_text: The ever-filling, worshipful one has struck the haters apart; with bent arms, famed in hearing, he goes across together with you.

children.text: ubhā sa varā praty eti bhāti ca yad īṃ gaṇam bhajate suprayāvabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: He comes to both boons and shines forth, when he takes his share in the troop with good guides.

children.text: sutambharo yajamānasya satpatir viśvāsām ūdhaḥ sa dhiyām udañcanaḥ
children.translated_text: Bearer of the pressed draught, true lord of the sacrificer, udder of all inspirations, lifter-up of thoughts,

children.text: bharad dhenū rasavac chiśriye payo 'nubruvāṇo adhy eti na svapan ||
children.translated_text: he bore milk rich in sap like cows; settled there, he goes on proclaiming, not sleeping.

children.text: yo jāgāra tam ṛcaḥ kāmayante yo jāgāra tam u sāmāni yanti
children.translated_text: The one who stays awake, the <s>ṛc</s> verses desire him; the one who stays awake, the <s>sāman</s> chants go to him.

children.text: yo jāgāra tam ayaṃ soma āha tavāham asmi sakhye nyokāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The one who stays awake, this <s>Soma</s> says to him: I am yours, housed close in friendship.

children.text: agnir jāgāra tam ṛcaḥ kāmayante 'gnir jāgāra tam u sāmāni yanti
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has stayed awake; the <s>ṛc</s> verses desire him. <s>Agni</s> has stayed awake; the <s>sāman</s> chants go to him.

children.text: agnir jāgāra tam ayaṃ soma āha tavāham asmi sakhye nyokāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has stayed awake; this <s>Soma</s> says to him: I am yours, housed close in friendship.

children.text: Chapter 399
vidā divo viṣyann adrim ukthair āyatyā uṣaso arcino guḥ
children.translated_text: Knowing heaven, loosening the rock with hymns, the shining flames of approaching <s>Uṣas</s> have gone forth.

children.text: apāvṛta vrajinīr ut svar gād vi duro mānuṣīr deva āvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The god opened the crooked enclosures and went to the sunlight; he opened wide the human doors.

children.text: vi sūryo amatiṃ na śriyaṃ sād orvād gavām mātā jānatī gāt
children.translated_text: The sun, like splendor from lack of thought, spread apart; the mother of the cows, knowing, went from the wide space.

children.text: dhanvarṇaso nadyaḥ khādoarṇā sthūṇeva sumitā dṛṃhata dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: The rivers, desert-colored and with devouring waves, held heaven firm like a well-measured post.

children.text: asmā ukthāya parvatasya garbho mahīnāṃ januṣe pūrvyāya
children.translated_text: For this hymn, for the birth of the great ones, ancient in the womb of the mountain,

children.text: vi parvato jihīta sādhata dyaur āvivāsanto dasayanta bhūma ||
children.translated_text: the mountain opened wide; heaven accomplished its work, while the worshippers served and subdued the earth.

children.text: sūktebhir vo vacobhir devajuṣṭair indrā nv agnī avase huvadhyai
children.translated_text: With well-spoken, god-beloved words and hymns I now call <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> for aid.

children.text: ukthebhir hi ṣmā kavayaḥ suyajñā āvivāsanto maruto yajanti ||
children.translated_text: For with hymns the wise, good sacrificers, serving them, worship the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: eto nv adya sudhyo bhavāma pra ducchunā minavāmā varīyaḥ
children.translated_text: Come, let us now today become well-minded; let us thrust away the ill-intentioned foe to a wider distance.

children.text: āre dveṣāṃsi sanutar dadhāmāyāma prāñco yajamānam accha ||
children.translated_text: Let us place hatreds far away and hidden; let us go forward toward the sacrificer.

children.text: etā dhiyaṃ kṛṇavāmā sakhāyo 'pa yā mātāṃ ṛṇuta vrajaṃ goḥ
children.translated_text: Let us fashion this inspired thought, friends, that opened the cow-pen as a mother opens it,

children.text: yayā manur viśiśipraṃ jigāya yayā vaṇig vaṅkur āpā purīṣam ||
children.translated_text: by which <s>Manu</s> conquered <s>Viśiśipra</s>, by which the trader <s>Vaṅku</s> obtained nourishment.

children.text: anūnod atra hastayato adrir ārcan yena daśa māso navagvāḥ
children.translated_text: Here the stone, handled by hands, sounded without ceasing, by which the <s>Navagvas</s> of ten months sang.

children.text: ṛtaṃ yatī saramā gā avindad viśvāni satyāṅgirāś cakāra ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Saramā</s>, going according to truth, found the cows, the <s>Aṅgirases</s> made all things true.

children.text: viśve asyā vyuṣi māhināyāḥ saṃ yad gobhir aṅgiraso navanta
children.translated_text: At the shining forth of this mighty dawn, when the <s>Aṅgirases</s> rejoiced together with the cows,

children.text: utsa āsām parame sadhastha ṛtasya pathā saramā vidad gāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the spring of these cows was in the highest assembly-place; by the path of truth <s>Saramā</s> found the cows.

children.text: ā sūryo yātu saptāśvaḥ kṣetraṃ yad asyorviyā dīrghayāthe
children.translated_text: Let <s>Sūrya</s>, seven-horsed, come to the field where, for him, the broad long road stretches.

children.text: raghuḥ śyenaḥ patayad andho acchā yuvā kavir dīdayad goṣu gacchan ||
children.translated_text: Swift as a falcon, the young inspired poet flew toward the blind darkness, shining as he went among the cows.

children.text: ā sūryo aruhac chukram arṇo 'yukta yad dharito vītapṛṣṭhāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Sūrya</s> mounted the bright flood when he yoked the tawny mares with shining backs.

children.text: udnā na nāvam anayanta dhīrā āśṛṇvatīr āpo arvāg atiṣṭhan ||
children.translated_text: The wise led them like a boat through water; the listening waters stood nearer this way.

children.text: dhiyaṃ vo apsu dadhiṣe svarṣāṃ yayātaran daśa māso navagvāḥ
children.translated_text: I set among the waters for you the inspired thought that wins the sunlight, by which the <s>Navagvas</s> of ten months crossed over.

children.text: ayā dhiyā syāma devagopā ayā dhiyā tuturyāmāty aṃhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: By this inspired thought may we be guarded by the gods; by this inspired thought may we pass beyond distress.

children.text: Chapter 400
hayo na vidvāṁ ayuji svayaṃ dhuri tāṃ vahāmi prataraṇīm avasyuvam
children.translated_text: Like a knowing horse, yoked by itself to the pole, I carry that saving, aid-seeking thought onward.

children.text: nāsyā vaśmi vimucaṃ nāvṛtam punar vidvān pathaḥ puraeta ṛju neṣati ||
children.translated_text: I do not wish to release it nor turn it back again; knowing the paths, the leader in front will guide it straight.

children.text: agna indra varuṇa mitra devāḥ śardhaḥ pra yanta mārutota viṣṇo
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, <s>Indra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, gods, and troop of the <s>Maruts</s>, go forth; and you too, <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

children.text: ubhā nāsatyā rudro adha gnāḥ pūṣā bhagaḥ sarasvatī juṣanta ||
children.translated_text: Let both <s>Nāsatyas</s>, <s>Rudra</s>, and the goddesses, <s>Pūṣan</s>, <s>Bhaga</s>, and <s>Sarasvatī</s> be pleased.

children.text: indrāgnī mitrāvaruṇāditiṃ svaḥ pṛthivīṃ dyām marutaḥ parvatāṁ apaḥ
children.translated_text: I call <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, heaven, earth, sky, the <s>Maruts</s>, mountains, and waters,

children.text: huve viṣṇum pūṣaṇam brahmaṇaspatim bhagaṃ nu śaṃsaṃ savitāram ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: I call <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>Pūṣan</s>, <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, <s>Bhaga</s>, <s>Śaṃsa</s>, and <s>Savitṛ</s> for aid.

children.text: uta no viṣṇur uta vāto asridho draviṇodā uta somo mayas karat
children.translated_text: And may <s>Viṣṇu</s> for us, and uninjuring <s>Vāta</s>, the giver of wealth, and <s>Soma</s> make refreshment,

children.text: uta ṛbhava uta rāye no aśvinota tvaṣṭota vibhvānu maṃsate ||
children.translated_text: and may the <s>Ṛbhus</s>, and for our wealth the <s>Aśvins</s>, and <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, and <s>Vibhvan</s> think of us.

children.text: uta tyan no mārutaṃ śardha ā gamad divikṣayaṃ yajatam barhir āsade
