children.translated_text: And may that worshipful host of the <s>Maruts</s>, dwelling in heaven, come to us and sit upon the sacred grass.

children.text: bṛhaspatiḥ śarma pūṣota no yamad varūthyaṃ varuṇo mitro aryamā ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Bṛhaspati</s> and <s>Pūṣan</s> grant us shelter; may <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s> grant protective defense.

children.text: uta tye naḥ parvatāsaḥ suśastayaḥ sudītayo nadyas trāmaṇe bhuvan
children.translated_text: And may those well-praised, brightly shining mountains and rivers be for our rescue.

children.text: bhago vibhaktā śavasāvasā gamad uruvyacā aditiḥ śrotu me havam ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Bhaga</s>, the distributor, come with strength and aid; may wide-reaching <s>Aditi</s> hear my call.

children.text: devānām patnīr uśatīr avantu naḥ prāvantu nas tujaye vājasātaye
children.translated_text: May the eager wives of the gods help us; may they protect us in the charge and in the winning of prize.

children.text: yāḥ pārthivāso yā apām api vrate tā no devīḥ suhavāḥ śarma yacchata ||
children.translated_text: Those who are earthly and those who are also under the vow of the waters, may those well-invoked goddesses grant us shelter.

children.text: uta gnā vyantu devapatnīr indrāṇy agnāyy aśvinī rāṭ
children.translated_text: And let the goddesses come, the wives of the gods: <s>Indrāṇī</s>, <s>Agnāyī</s>, and queenly <s>Aśvinī</s>.

children.text: ā rodasī varuṇānī śṛṇotu vyantu devīr ya ṛtur janīnām ||
children.translated_text: Let the two worlds, and <s>Varuṇānī</s>, hear; let the goddesses come, the season that belongs to women.

children.text: Chapter 401
prayuñjatī diva eti bruvāṇā mahī mātā duhitur bodhayantī
children.translated_text: Setting in motion, speaking, the great mother comes from heaven, awakening her daughter.

children.text: āvivāsantī yuvatir manīṣā pitṛbhya ā sadane johuvānā ||
children.translated_text: The young woman, worshipping with inspired thought, calls again and again toward the fathers in their seat.

children.text: ajirāsas tadapa īyamānā ātasthivāṃso amṛtasya nābhim
children.translated_text: Swift, active ones, coming here, have taken their stand at the navel of immortality.

children.text: anantāsa uravo viśvataḥ sīm pari dyāvāpṛthivī yanti panthāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The endless, broad paths go on every side around heaven and earth.

children.text: ukṣā samudro aruṣaḥ suparṇaḥ pūrvasya yonim pitur ā viveśa
children.translated_text: The bull, the ocean, the ruddy well-winged one, has entered the womb of the former father.

children.text: madhye divo nihitaḥ pṛśnir aśmā vi cakrame rajasas pāty antau ||
children.translated_text: The dappled stone, set in the middle of heaven, has strode wide; he guards the two ends of the midspace.

children.text: catvāra īm bibhrati kṣemayanto daśa garbhaṃ carase dhāpayante
children.translated_text: Four bear him as they bring security; ten cause the embryo to be held for movement.

children.text: tridhātavaḥ paramā asya gāvo divaś caranti pari sadyo antān ||
children.translated_text: His threefold, highest cows move at once around the limits of heaven.

children.text: idaṃ vapur nivacanaṃ janāsaś caranti yan nadyas tasthur āpaḥ
children.translated_text: This is the form, this the utterance, O people, which the rivers move along and the waters have taken their stand.

children.text: dve yad īm bibhṛto mātur anye iheha jāte yamyā sabandhū ||
children.translated_text: When two others bear him from the mother, born here and there as twin kinsmen.

children.text: vi tanvate dhiyo asmā apāṃsi vastrā putrāya mātaro vayanti
children.translated_text: They stretch out thoughts for him, and works; the mothers weave garments for the son.

children.text: upaprakṣe vṛṣaṇo modamānā divas pathā vadhvo yanty accha ||
children.translated_text: Coming near the bulls and rejoicing, the brides go along the path of heaven toward him.

children.text: tad astu mitrāvaruṇā tad agne śaṃ yor asmabhyam idam astu śastam
children.translated_text: Let that be so, O <s>Mitra-Varuṇa</s>; let that be so, O <s>Agni</s>; let this praise be blessing and welfare for us.

children.text: aśīmahi gādham uta pratiṣṭhāṃ namo dive bṛhate sādanāya ||
children.translated_text: May we attain a ford and firm standing; homage to great heaven, the seat.

children.text: Chapter 402
kad u priyāya dhāmne manāmahe svakṣatrāya svayaśase mahe vayam
children.translated_text: When shall we honor the dear abode, the great one, self-ruling and self-famous?

children.text: āmenyasya rajaso yad abhra āṃ apo vṛṇānā vitanoti māyinī ||
children.translated_text: When the cloud of the dark expanse, choosing the waters, spreads itself out, the wonder-working one.

children.text: tā atnata vayunaṃ vīravakṣaṇaṃ samānyā vṛtayā viśvam ā rajaḥ
children.translated_text: They stretched out the guiding insight, nurturing heroes, and with common enclosures the whole expanse.

children.text: apo apācīr aparā apejate pra pūrvābhis tirate devayur janaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He drives the backward waters farther away; the god-loving man crosses over by the former ones.

children.text: ā grāvabhir ahanyebhir aktubhir variṣṭhaṃ vajram ā jigharti māyini
children.translated_text: With pressing stones, by days and nights, he sharpens the most excellent thunderbolt, O wonder-worker.

children.text: śataṃ vā yasya pracaran sve dame saṃvartayanto vi ca vartayann ahā ||
children.translated_text: A hundred of his may move forth in their own house, turning together and turning the days apart.

children.text: tām asya rītim paraśor iva praty anīkam akhyam bhuje asya varpasaḥ
children.translated_text: I saw this course of his, like the edge of an axe, the face of his arm and of his form.

children.text: sacā yadi pitumantam iva kṣayaṃ ratnaṃ dadhāti bharahūtaye viśe ||
children.translated_text: When he sets down treasure for the people of <s>Bharahūti</s>, like a nourishing dwelling rich in food.

children.text: sa jihvayā caturanīka ṛñjate cāru vasāno varuṇo yatann arim
children.translated_text: With his tongue, four-faced, <s>Varuṇa</s> adorns himself; clothed in beauty, he confronts the foe.

children.text: na tasya vidma puruṣatvatā vayaṃ yato bhagaḥ savitā dāti vāryam ||
children.translated_text: We do not know his nature by human measure, whence <s>Bhaga</s> and <s>Savitṛ</s> give desirable wealth.

children.text: Chapter 403
devaṃ vo adya savitāram eṣe bhagaṃ ca ratnaṃ vibhajantam āyoḥ
children.translated_text: Today I seek for you the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, and <s>Bhaga</s>, who divides the treasure of life.

children.text: ā vāṃ narā purubhujā vavṛtyāṃ dive dive cid aśvinā sakhīyan ||
children.translated_text: I would turn you two hither, O men of many enjoyments; day by day, O <s>Aśvins</s>, I seek your friendship.

children.text: prati prayāṇam asurasya vidvān sūktair devaṃ savitāraṃ duvasya
children.translated_text: Knowing the going forth of the <s>Asura</s>, worship the god <s>Savitṛ</s> with hymns.

children.text: upa bruvīta namasā vijānañ jyeṣṭhaṃ ca ratnaṃ vibhajantam āyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let him, discerning, address with homage the eldest one, who divides the treasure of life.

children.text: adatrayā dayate vāryāṇi pūṣā bhago aditir vasta usraḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Pūṣan</s>, <s>Bhaga</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, and the bright Dawn allot desirable goods without betrayal.

children.text: indro viṣṇur varuṇo mitro agnir ahāni bhadrā janayanta dasmāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Agni</s>, the wondrous ones, generate auspicious days.

children.text: tan no anarvā savitā varūthaṃ tat sindhava iṣayanto anu gman
children.translated_text: May unassailable <s>Savitṛ</s> grant us that protection; may the rivers, impelling, follow after it.

children.text: upa yad voce adhvarasya hotā rāyaḥ syāma patayo vājaratnāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When I, the hotṛ of the rite, speak near, may we become lords of wealth, rich in prize-treasures.

children.text: pra ye vasubhya īvad ā namo dur ye mitre varuṇe sūktavācaḥ
children.translated_text: Those who are speakers of good hymns bring reverence from afar to the <s>Vasus</s>, to <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: avaitv abhvaṃ kṛṇutā varīyo divaspṛthivyor avasā madema ||
children.translated_text: Let the formless evil go away; make wider space. May we rejoice in the aid of heaven and earth.

children.text: Chapter 404
viśvo devasya netur marto vurīta sakhyam
children.translated_text: Every mortal should choose the friendship of the divine leader.

children.text: viśvo rāya iṣudhyati dyumnaṃ vṛṇīta puṣyase ||
children.translated_text: Everyone strives for wealth; he chooses splendor for increase.

children.text: te te deva netar ye cemāṁ anuśase
children.translated_text: Those are yours, O divine leader, who follow this command of yours.

children.text: te rāyā te hy āpṛce sacemahi sacathyaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: With that wealth of yours, and with that companionship, may we join you in fellowship.

children.text: ato na ā nṝn atithīn ataḥ patnīr daśasyata
children.translated_text: From here bestow on us men as guests; from here bestow wives.

children.text: āre viśvam patheṣṭhāṃ dviṣo yuyotu yūyuviḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the one who wards off keep every enemy far from the paths.

children.text: yatra vahnir abhihito dudravad droṇyaḥ paśuḥ
children.translated_text: Where the bearer has been set, the stall-bound beast runs forth.

children.text: nṛmaṇā vīrapastyo 'rṇā dhīreva sanitā ||
children.translated_text: Strong-minded, a dwelling of heroes, like a thoughtful winner, like a stream.

children.text: eṣa te deva netā rathaspatiḥ śaṃ rayiḥ
children.translated_text: This, O divine leader, is your lord of the chariot, auspicious wealth.

children.text: śaṃ rāye śaṃ svastaya iṣastuto manāmahe devastuto manāmahe ||
children.translated_text: For welfare in wealth, for welfare and well-being, we honor him, praised by refreshment; we honor him, praised by the gods.

children.text: Chapter 405
agne sutasya pītaye viśvair ūmebhir ā gahi
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, come with all your aids to drink the pressed Soma.

children.text: devebhir havyadātaye ||
children.translated_text: Come with the gods, to receive the oblation.

children.text: ṛtadhītaya ā gata satyadharmāṇo adhvaram
children.translated_text: Come to the rite, you whose thoughts are in accord with ṛta and whose laws are true.

children.text: agneḥ pibata jihvayā ||
children.translated_text: Drink with the tongue of <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: viprebhir vipra santya prātaryāvabhir ā gahi
children.translated_text: O inspired one, come with inspired singers, with those who go forth in the morning.

children.text: devebhiḥ somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: Come with the gods for the drinking of Soma.

children.text: ayaṃ somaś camū suto 'matre pari ṣicyate
children.translated_text: This Soma, pressed in the bowl, is poured around into the vessel.

children.text: priya indrāya vāyave ||
children.translated_text: It is dear to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: vāyav ā yāhi vītaye juṣāṇo havyadātaye
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s>, come for the feast, gladly accepting, to receive the oblation.

children.text: pibā sutasyāndhaso abhi prayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Drink of the pressed draught at the offering.

children.text: indraś ca vāyav eṣāṃ sutānām pītim arhathaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>, you deserve the drinking of these pressed Soma juices.

children.text: tāñ juṣethām arepasāv abhi prayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Enjoy them, you two free from stain, at the offering.

children.text: sutā indrāya vāyave somāso dadhyāśiraḥ
children.translated_text: The Soma juices, pressed for <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>, are mixed with curds.

children.text: nimnaṃ na yanti sindhavo 'bhi prayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They go like rivers to the low place, toward the offering.

children.text: sajūr viśvebhir devebhir aśvibhyām uṣasā sajūḥ
children.translated_text: Together with all the gods, together with the <s>Aśvins</s>, together with <s>Uṣas</s>,

children.text: ā yāhy agne atrivat sute raṇa ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Agni</s>, to the pressed Soma as to <s>Atri</s>, for delight.

children.text: sajūr mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ sajūḥ somena viṣṇunā
children.translated_text: Together with <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, together with <s>Soma</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: ā yāhy agne atrivat sute raṇa ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Agni</s>, to the pressed Soma as to <s>Atri</s>, for delight.

children.text: sajūr ādityair vasubhiḥ sajūr indreṇa vāyunā
children.translated_text: Together with the <s>Ādityas</s> and the <s>Vasus</s>, together with <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>,

children.text: ā yāhy agne atrivat sute raṇa ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Agni</s>, to the pressed Soma as to <s>Atri</s>, for delight.

children.text: svasti no mimītām aśvinā bhagaḥ svasti devy aditir anarvaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: May the <s>Aśvins</s> measure out well-being for us; may <s>Bhaga</s> bring well-being; may divine <s>Aditi</s>, unharmed, bring well-being.

children.text: svasti pūṣā asuro dadhātu naḥ svasti dyāvāpṛthivī sucetunā ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Pūṣan</s>, the lord, grant us well-being; may heaven and earth, well-minded, grant well-being.

children.text: svastaye vāyum upa bravāmahai somaṃ svasti bhuvanasya yas patiḥ
children.translated_text: For well-being we invoke <s>Vāyu</s>, and <s>Soma</s>, who is lord of the world, for well-being.

children.text: bṛhaspatiṃ sarvagaṇaṃ svastaye svastaya ādityāso bhavantu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: For well-being we invoke <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, lord of every host; may the <s>Ādityas</s> be for our well-being.

children.text: viśve devā no adyā svastaye vaiśvānaro vasur agniḥ svastaye
children.translated_text: May all the gods be for our well-being today; may <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, the <s>Vasu</s>, <s>Agni</s>, be for well-being.

children.text: devā avantv ṛbhavaḥ svastaye svasti no rudraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the gods and the <s>Ṛbhus</s> help us for well-being; may <s>Rudra</s> protect us from distress.

children.text: svasti mitrāvaruṇā svasti pathye revati
children.translated_text: Well-being from <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; well-being from rich <s>Pathyā</s>.

children.text: svasti na indraś cāgniś ca svasti no adite kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: Well-being for us from <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>; O <s>Aditi</s>, make well-being for us.

children.text: svasti panthām anu carema sūryācandramasāv iva
children.translated_text: May we follow the path of well-being, like the sun and moon.

children.text: punar dadatāghnatā jānatā saṃ gamemahi ||
children.translated_text: May we come together again with one who gives again, who does not harm, and who knows.

children.text: Chapter 406
pra śyāvāśva dhṛṣṇuyārcā marudbhir ṛkvabhiḥ
children.translated_text: Sing forth, O <s>Śyāvāśva</s>, boldly, with the <s>Maruts</s>, with verses.

children.text: ye adrogham anuṣvadhaṃ śravo madanti yajñiyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They, worthy of sacrifice, rejoice in undeceiving fame according to their own law.

children.text: te hi sthirasya śavasaḥ sakhāyaḥ santi dhṛṣṇuyā
children.translated_text: For they are friends of firm might, bold ones.

children.text: te yāmann ā dhṛṣadvinas tmanā pānti śaśvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: In their course those bold ones protect by their own power forever.

children.text: te syandrāso nokṣaṇo 'ti ṣkandanti śarvarīḥ
children.translated_text: Those streaming, bull-like ones overleap the nights;

children.text: marutām adhā maho divi kṣamā ca manmahe ||
children.translated_text: therefore we hold in mind the greatness of the <s>Maruts</s> in heaven and on earth.

children.text: marutsu vo dadhīmahi stomaṃ yajñaṃ ca dhṛṣṇuyā
children.translated_text: Among the <s>Maruts</s> we place your <s>stoma</s> (song of praise) and <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice) with boldness,

children.text: viśve ye mānuṣā yugā pānti martyaṃ riṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: they who through all human ages protect the mortal from harm.

children.text: arhanto ye sudānavo naro asāmiśavasaḥ
children.translated_text: Those worthy men, generous givers, of unequalled might,

children.text: pra yajñaṃ yajñiyebhyo divo arcā marudbhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: sing forth the sacrifice to the sacrifice-worthy <s>Maruts</s> of heaven.

children.text: ā rukmair ā yudhā nara ṛṣvā ṛṣṭīr asṛkṣata
children.translated_text: The men have let loose their lofty spears, with golden ornaments and weapons;

children.text: anv enāṁ aha vidyuto maruto jajjhatīr iva bhānur arta tmanā divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: after this the light of the <s>Maruts</s> moved by itself from heaven, like flashing lightnings.

children.text: ye vāvṛdhanta pārthivā ya urāv antarikṣa ā
children.translated_text: They who have grown upon earth, and who are in the broad midspace,

children.text: vṛjane vā nadīnāṃ sadhasthe vā maho divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: or in the enclosure of the rivers, or at the seat of great heaven,

children.text: śardho mārutam uc chaṃsa satyaśavasam ṛbhvasam
children.translated_text: proclaim the <s>Marut</s> troop, true in might and skillful,

children.text: uta sma te śubhe naraḥ pra syandrā yujata tmanā ||
children.translated_text: and these splendid men also yoke the streaming steeds by themselves.

children.text: uta sma te paruṣṇyām ūrṇā vasata śundhyavaḥ
children.translated_text: And these bright ones dwell by the <s>Paruṣṇī</s> as if in woolly covering;

children.text: uta pavyā rathānām adrim bhindanty ojasā ||
children.translated_text: and the rims of their chariots split the mountain with force.

children.text: āpathayo vipathayo 'ntaspathā anupathāḥ
children.translated_text: Road-makers, makers of byways, inner paths, and following paths,

children.text: etebhir mahyaṃ nāmabhir yajñaṃ viṣṭāra ohate ||
children.translated_text: by these great names they bear the sacrifice wide for me.

children.text: adhā naro ny ohate 'dhā niyuta ohate
children.translated_text: Then the men bear it down; then the teams bear it down;

children.text: adhā pārāvatā iti citrā rūpāṇi darśyā ||
children.translated_text: then, from afar, they show their wondrous, visible forms.

children.text: chandastubhaḥ kubhanyava utsam ā kīriṇo nṛtuḥ
children.translated_text: Praising with meters, bellowing, the singers have danced at the spring;

children.text: te me kecin na tāyava ūmā āsan dṛśi tviṣe ||
children.translated_text: some of them appeared to me not as thieves, but as shining forms to be seen.

children.text: ya ṛṣvā ṛṣṭividyutaḥ kavayaḥ santi vedhasaḥ
children.translated_text: Those lofty ones, lightning-speared, are poets and wise makers;

children.text: tam ṛṣe mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ namasyā ramayā girā ||
children.translated_text: honor that <s>Marut</s> host, O seer, with a pleasing song.

children.text: accha ṛṣe mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ dānā mitraṃ na yoṣaṇā
children.translated_text: Go toward the <s>Marut</s> host, O seer, as a woman goes to a generous friend;

children.text: divo vā dhṛṣṇava ojasā stutā dhībhir iṣaṇyata ||
children.translated_text: or, O bold ones of heaven, being praised with thoughts, drive us onward by your might.

children.text: nū manvāna eṣāṃ devāṁ acchā na vakṣaṇā
children.translated_text: Now, thinking of these gods, toward them as toward beloved ones,

children.text: dānā saceta sūribhir yāmaśrutebhir añjibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: join with the patrons, with those whose journeys are heard, with their adornments and gifts.

children.text: pra ye me bandhveṣe gāṃ vocanta sūrayaḥ pṛśniṃ vocanta mātaram
children.translated_text: The inspired patrons spoke to me among my kinsmen of the speckled cow, calling her mother;

children.text: adhā pitaram iṣmiṇaṃ rudraṃ vocanta śikvasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: then the skillful ones spoke of the strong father, <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: sapta me sapta śākina ekam ekā śatā daduḥ
children.translated_text: Seven and seven strong ones gave me each one hundred;

children.text: yamunāyām adhi śrutam ud rādho gavyam mṛje ni rādho aśvyam mṛje ||
children.translated_text: that prize of cattle, heard of on the <s>Yamunā</s>, I cleanse forth; that prize of horses I cleanse forth.

children.text: Chapter 407
ko veda jānam eṣāṃ ko vā purā sumneṣv āsa marutām
children.translated_text: Who knows the birth of these? Who was formerly in the favors of the <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: yad yuyujre kilāsyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when the spotted ones were yoked?

children.text: aitān ratheṣu tasthuṣaḥ kaḥ śuśrāva kathā yayuḥ
children.translated_text: Who has heard of these standing upon their chariots, how they went?

children.text: kasmai sasruḥ sudāse anv āpaya iﾱābhir vṛṣṭayaḥ saha ||
children.translated_text: For whose sake did the streams run for <s>Sudās</s>, together with the rains and the corruptedly transmitted offerings?

children.text: te ma āhur ya āyayur upa dyubhir vibhir made
children.translated_text: Those who came to me in exhilaration, with bright days and birds, said to me:

children.text: naro maryā arepasa imān paśyann iti ṣṭuhi ||
children.translated_text: 'Seeing these faultless young men, praise them.'

children.text: ye añjiṣu ye vāśīṣu svabhānavaḥ srakṣu rukmeṣu khādiṣu
children.translated_text: Those who are self-radiant in ornaments, in axes, in garlands, in golden disks, and in bracelets,

children.text: śrāyā ratheṣu dhanvasu ||
children.translated_text: have taken their place in chariots and bows.

children.text: yuṣmākaṃ smā rathāṁ anu mude dadhe maruto jīradānavaḥ
children.translated_text: I set myself for joy after your chariots, O <s>Maruts</s>, generous with swift gifts,

children.text: vṛṣṭī dyāvo yatīr iva ||
children.translated_text: as the moving heavens follow the rains.

children.text: ā yaṃ naraḥ sudānavo dadāśuṣe divaḥ kośam acucyavuḥ
children.translated_text: When the generous men have shaken the heavenly vessel down for the worshipper,

children.text: vi parjanyaṃ sṛjanti rodasī anu dhanvanā yanti vṛṣṭayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: they release <s>Parjanya</s>; the rains go along the two worlds and travel over the dry land.

children.text: tatṛdānāḥ sindhavaḥ kṣodasā rajaḥ pra sasrur dhenavo yathā
children.translated_text: The rivers, piercing through with their flood, have streamed across the realm like milk-cows;

children.text: syannā aśvā ivādhvano vimocane vi yad vartanta enyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like horses at the unyoking at the end of the road, the bright waters turn apart when released.

children.text: ā yāta maruto diva āntarikṣād amād uta
children.translated_text: Come here, O <s>Maruts</s>, from heaven, from the midspace, and from nearby;

children.text: māva sthāta parāvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: do not remain far away.

children.text: mā vo rasānitabhā kubhā krumur mā vaḥ sindhur ni rīramat
children.translated_text: Let neither <s>Rasā</s>, nor <s>Anitabhā</s>, nor <s>Kubhā</s>, nor <s>Krumu</s>, nor <s>Sindhu</s> hold you back;

children.text: mā vaḥ pari ṣṭhāt sarayuḥ purīṣiṇy asme it sumnam astu vaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let not the full-flowing <s>Sarayu</s> stand around you; let your favor be for us alone.

children.text: taṃ vaḥ śardhaṃ rathānāṃ tveṣaṃ gaṇam mārutaṃ navyasīnām
children.translated_text: That fierce troop of yours, the <s>Marut</s> host of chariots and newest songs,

children.text: anu pra yanti vṛṣṭayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the rains follow after.

children.text: śardhaṃ śardhaṃ va eṣāṃ vrātaṃ vrātaṃ gaṇaṃ gaṇaṃ suśastibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Troop after troop of yours, band after band, host after host, with fair praises,

children.text: anu krāmema dhītibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: may we follow with our thoughts.

children.text: kasmā adya sujātāya rātahavyāya pra yayuḥ
children.translated_text: To what well-born one, to what receiver of offered oblations, have they gone today,

children.text: enā yāmena marutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Maruts</s>, with this journey?

children.text: yena tokāya tanayāya dhānyam bījaṃ vahadhve akṣitam
children.translated_text: By that journey on which you carry inexhaustible grain and seed for child and descendant,

children.text: asmabhyaṃ tad dhattana yad va īmahe rādho viśvāyu saubhagam ||
children.translated_text: grant that to us, the wealth, all-life and good fortune, which we ask of you.

children.text: atīyāma nidas tiraḥ svastibhir hitvāvadyam arātīḥ
children.translated_text: May we pass beyond revilers, leaving blame and hostilities behind by your blessings;

children.text: vṛṣṭvī śaṃ yor āpa usri bheṣajaṃ syāma marutaḥ saha ||
children.translated_text: having rained, O radiant ones, may the waters be comfort and healing; may we be with you, O <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: sudevaḥ samahāsati suvīro naro marutaḥ sa martyaḥ
children.translated_text: That mortal man becomes blessed with good gods, rich in heroes, O <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: yaṃ trāyadhve syāma te ||
children.translated_text: whom you protect; may we be such for you.

children.text: stuhi bhojān stuvato asya yāmani raṇan gāvo na yavase
children.translated_text: Praise the bounteous ones in the journey of this singer, as cows low for pasture;

children.text: yataḥ pūrvāṁ iva sakhīṃr anu hvaya girā gṛṇīhi kāminaḥ ||
children.translated_text: therefore, as before, call upon friends with your voice; sing to the desirous ones.

children.text: Chapter 408
pra śardhāya mārutāya svabhānava imāṃ vācam anajā parvatacyute
children.translated_text: For the self-radiant <s>Marut</s> troop, mountain-shaking, send forth this speech with force;

children.text: gharmastubhe diva ā pṛṣṭhayajvane dyumnaśravase mahi nṛmṇam arcata ||
children.translated_text: for the heat-praising one, the back-sacrificer of heaven, rich in glory and fame, sing great manly power.

children.text: pra vo marutas taviṣā udanyavo vayovṛdho aśvayujaḥ parijrayaḥ
children.translated_text: I proclaim to you the <s>Maruts</s>, vigorous, water-seeking, increasers of life, horse-yoking, all-surrounding;

children.text: saṃ vidyutā dadhati vāśati tritaḥ svaranty āpo 'vanā parijrayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: they join with lightning; <s>Trita</s> roars; the waters resound, all-surrounding and flowing downward.

children.text: vidyunmahaso naro aśmadidyavo vātatviṣo marutaḥ parvatacyutaḥ
children.translated_text: The men, the <s>Maruts</s>, great with lightning, stone-flashing, wind-bright, mountain-shaking,

children.text: abdayā cin muhur ā hrādunīvṛta stanayadamā rabhasā udojasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: even in the clouds again and again are wrapped in thunder, roaring, impetuous, strong with water.

children.text: vy aktūn rudrā vy ahāni śikvaso vy antarikṣaṃ vi rajāṃsi dhūtayaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Rudras</s> have shaken apart the nights and the days, O skillful ones; the shakers have shaken apart the midspace and the realms,

children.text: vi yad ajrāṁ ajatha nāva īṃ yathā vi durgāṇi maruto nāha riṣyatha ||
children.translated_text: when you drive the unaging ones apart as a ship; you do not fail, O <s>Maruts</s>, through the difficult places.

children.text: tad vīryaṃ vo maruto mahitvanaṃ dīrghaṃ tatāna sūryo na yojanam
children.translated_text: That heroic power of yours, O <s>Maruts</s>, that greatness, the sun has stretched out long like a course,

children.text: etā na yāme agṛbhītaśociṣo 'naśvadāṃ yan ny ayātanā girim ||
children.translated_text: when, on these journeys, with flames not to be grasped, you went down to the imperishable mountain.

children.text: abhrāji śardho maruto yad arṇasam moṣathā vṛkṣaṃ kapaneva vedhasaḥ
children.translated_text: Your troop flashed forth, O <s>Maruts</s>, when you shook the billowing one, the tree, like a skillful worker shaking a basket.

children.text: adha smā no aramatiṃ sajoṣasaś cakṣur iva yantam anu neṣathā sugam ||
children.translated_text: Then, together in goodwill with <s>Aramati</s>, lead us on an easy path, as sight follows one who goes.

children.text: na sa jīyate maruto na hanyate na sredhati na vyathate na riṣyati
children.translated_text: He is not overcome, O <s>Maruts</s>; he is not slain, he does not slip, he does not tremble, he is not harmed.

children.text: nāsya rāya upa dasyanti notaya ṛṣiṃ vā yaṃ rājānaṃ vā suṣūdatha ||
children.translated_text: His wealth and his helps do not fail, whether he is the seer or the king whom you have well impelled.

children.text: niyutvanto grāmajito yathā naro 'ryamaṇo na marutaḥ kabandhinaḥ
children.translated_text: With teams of steeds, village-winning like men, and bound together like those of <s>Aryaman</s>, O <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: pinvanty utsaṃ yad ināso asvaran vy undanti pṛthivīm madhvo andhasā ||
children.translated_text: the mighty ones swell the spring when they have roared; they moisten the earth with the sweet <s>Soma</s>-draught.

children.text: pravatvatīyam pṛthivī marudbhyaḥ pravatvatī dyaur bhavati prayadbhyaḥ
children.translated_text: This earth becomes sloping before the <s>Maruts</s>; heaven too becomes sloping before them as they advance.

children.text: pravatvatīḥ pathyā antarikṣyāḥ pravatvantaḥ parvatā jīradānavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The paths through the midspace become sloping, and the mountains, rich in swift gifts, become sloping.

children.text: yan marutaḥ sabharasaḥ svarṇaraḥ sūrya udite madathā divo naraḥ
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Maruts</s>, rich in shared strength and shining with light, you exult as men of heaven at the rising of the sun,

children.text: na vo 'śvāḥ śrathayantāha sisrataḥ sadyo asyādhvanaḥ pāram aśnutha ||
children.translated_text: your horses have not tired and have not slipped away; at once you reach the far shore of this journey.

children.text: aṃseṣu va ṛṣṭayaḥ patsu khādayo vakṣassu rukmā maruto rathe śubhaḥ
children.translated_text: On your shoulders are spears, on your feet anklets, on your breasts golden ornaments, O <s>Maruts</s>, and splendor on the chariot.

children.text: agnibhrājaso vidyuto gabhastyoḥ śiprāḥ śīrṣasu vitatā hiraṇyayīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Blazing like fires, with lightning in your hands, golden helmets are stretched out upon your heads.

children.text: taṃ nākam aryo agṛbhītaśociṣaṃ ruśat pippalam maruto vi dhūnutha
children.translated_text: You shake that heavenly summit, O noble <s>Maruts</s>, with ungraspable flame, the bright red pippala tree.

children.text: sam acyanta vṛjanātitviṣanta yat svaranti ghoṣaṃ vitatam ṛtāyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They pour together from the enclosure and flash beyond it, when, lovers of truth, they make the wide-spread roar resound.

children.text: yuṣmādattasya maruto vicetaso rāyaḥ syāma rathyo vayasvataḥ
children.translated_text: May we, O discerning <s>Maruts</s>, possess the chariot-worthy, vigorous wealth that is given by you.

children.text: na yo yucchati tiṣyo yathā divo 'sme rāranta marutaḥ sahasriṇam ||
children.translated_text: The one who does not fail, like <s>Tiṣya</s> from heaven: grant him to us, O <s>Maruts</s>, in a thousandfold form.

children.text: yūyaṃ rayim maruta spārhavīraṃ yūyam ṛṣim avatha sāmavipram
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Maruts</s>, protect wealth rich in desirable heroes; you protect the seer, the chant-wise inspired priest.

children.text: yūyam arvantam bharatāya vājaṃ yūyaṃ dhattha rājānaṃ śruṣṭimantam ||
children.translated_text: You bring the racing horse and the prize for <s>Bharata</s>; you establish the attentive king.

children.text: tad vo yāmi draviṇaṃ sadyaūtayo yenā svar ṇa tatanāma nṝṃr abhi
children.translated_text: I seek from you that treasure, O ever-aiding ones, by which we may stretch out like the light of heaven over men.

children.text: idaṃ su me maruto haryatā vaco yasya tarema tarasā śataṃ himāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Gladly accept this speech of mine, O <s>Maruts</s>, by whose force we may cross beyond a hundred winters.

children.text: Chapter 409
prayajyavo maruto bhrājadṛṣṭayo bṛhad vayo dadhire rukmavakṣasaḥ
children.translated_text: The sacrificial <s>Maruts</s>, bright with spears, have assumed great strength, with golden ornaments on their breasts.

children.text: īyante aśvaiḥ suyamebhir āśubhiḥ śubhaṃ yātām anu rathā avṛtsata ||
children.translated_text: They go with swift, well-reined horses; their chariots turned after their splendid course.

children.text: svayaṃ dadhidhve taviṣīṃ yathā vida bṛhan mahānta urviyā vi rājatha
children.translated_text: Of yourselves you have taken on might, according to your knowledge; great and lofty, you shine widely.

children.text: utāntarikṣam mamire vy ojasā śubhaṃ yātām anu rathā avṛtsata ||
children.translated_text: And by your power you measured out the midspace; their chariots turned after their splendid course.

children.text: sākaṃ jātāḥ subhvaḥ sākam ukṣitāḥ śriye cid ā prataraṃ vāvṛdhur naraḥ
children.translated_text: Born together, well-formed, strengthened together, the men have grown ever further even for beauty.

children.text: virokiṇaḥ sūryasyeva raśmayaḥ śubhaṃ yātām anu rathā avṛtsata ||
children.translated_text: Radiant, like the rays of the sun, their chariots turned after their splendid course.

children.text: ābhūṣeṇyaṃ vo maruto mahitvanaṃ didṛkṣeṇyaṃ sūryasyeva cakṣaṇam
children.translated_text: Your greatness, O <s>Maruts</s>, is worthy of adornment; your sight is worthy to be seen, like the eye of the sun.

children.text: uto asmāṁ amṛtatve dadhātana śubhaṃ yātām anu rathā avṛtsata ||
children.translated_text: Also place us in immortality; their chariots turned after their splendid course.

children.text: ud īrayathā marutaḥ samudrato yūyaṃ vṛṣṭiṃ varṣayathā purīṣiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: You raise up the rain from the ocean, O <s>Maruts</s>; you make the rain, rich in moisture, pour down.

children.text: na vo dasrā upa dasyanti dhenavaḥ śubhaṃ yātām anu rathā avṛtsata ||
children.translated_text: Your wondrous cows do not fail you; their chariots turned after their splendid course.

children.text: yad aśvān dhūrṣu pṛṣatīr ayugdhvaṃ hiraṇyayān praty atkāṁ amugdhvam
children.translated_text: When you yoked the dappled mares to the shafts and put on the golden coverings,

children.text: viśvā it spṛdho maruto vy asyatha śubhaṃ yātām anu rathā avṛtsata ||
children.translated_text: you scatter every contest, O <s>Maruts</s>; their chariots turned after their splendid course.

children.text: na parvatā na nadyo varanta vo yatrācidhvam maruto gacchathed u tat
children.translated_text: Neither mountains nor rivers hold you back; wherever you have set your mind, O <s>Maruts</s>, there indeed you go.

children.text: uta dyāvāpṛthivī yāthanā pari śubhaṃ yātām anu rathā avṛtsata ||
children.translated_text: And you travel around heaven and earth; their chariots turned after their splendid course.

children.text: yat pūrvyam maruto yac ca nūtanaṃ yad udyate vasavo yac ca śasyate
children.translated_text: Whatever is ancient, O <s>Maruts</s>, and whatever is new, whatever is proclaimed, O <s>Vasus</s>, and whatever is praised,

children.text: viśvasya tasya bhavathā navedasaḥ śubhaṃ yātām anu rathā avṛtsata ||
children.translated_text: of all that you are the discoverers; their chariots turned after their splendid course.

children.text: mṛﾱata no maruto mā vadhiṣṭanāsmabhyaṃ śarma bahulaṃ vi yantana
children.translated_text: Be gracious to us, O <s>Maruts</s>; do not slay us. Extend abundant shelter for us.

children.text: adhi stotrasya sakhyasya gātana śubhaṃ yātām anu rathā avṛtsata ||
children.translated_text: Go to the song of praise and to friendship; their chariots turned after their splendid course.

children.text: yūyam asmān nayata vasyo acchā nir aṃhatibhyo maruto gṛṇānāḥ
children.translated_text: Lead us, O <s>Maruts</s>, toward what is better, away from distresses, as we praise you.

children.text: juṣadhvaṃ no havyadātiṃ yajatrā vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: Accept our gift of oblation, O worshipful ones; may we be lords of riches.

children.text: Chapter 410
agne śardhantam ā gaṇam piṣṭaṃ rukmebhir añjibhiḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, bring here the exultant troop, adorned with bright golden ornaments.

children.text: viśo adya marutām ava hvaye divaś cid rocanād adhi ||
children.translated_text: Today I call for the aid of the clans of the <s>Maruts</s>, even from the shining realm of heaven.

children.text: yathā cin manyase hṛdā tad in me jagmur āśasaḥ
children.translated_text: Just as you think in your heart, so my hopes have gone to you.

children.text: ye te nediṣṭhaṃ havanāny āgaman tān vardha bhīmasaṃdṛśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those who have come nearest to your invocations: strengthen those fearsome-looking ones.

children.text: mīﾱhuṣmatīva pṛthivī parāhatā madanty ety asmad ā
children.translated_text: Like the bounteous earth struck from afar, she comes toward us in exhilaration.

children.text: ṛkṣo na vo marutaḥ śimīvāṁ amo dudhro gaur iva bhīmayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Your force, O <s>Maruts</s>, is powerful like a bear, hard to restrain, terrifying like a bull.

children.text: ni ye riṇanty ojasā vṛthā gāvo na durdhuraḥ
children.translated_text: They who with their might set things rushing, like cows hard to hold back,

children.text: aśmānaṃ cit svaryam parvataṃ girim pra cyāvayanti yāmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: drive even the resonant stone, the mountain, the hill from its place by their courses.

children.text: ut tiṣṭha nūnam eṣāṃ stomaiḥ samukṣitānām
children.translated_text: Rise now with songs for these who have been sprinkled together.

children.text: marutām purutamam apūrvyaṃ gavāṃ sargam iva hvaye ||
children.translated_text: I call the most abundant and unprecedented release of the cows of the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: yuṅgdhvaṃ hy aruṣī rathe yuṅgdhvaṃ ratheṣu rohitaḥ
children.translated_text: Yoke the ruddy mares to the chariot; yoke the red horses to the chariots.

children.text: yuṅgdhvaṃ harī ajirā dhuri voﾱhave vahiṣṭhā dhuri voﾱhave ||
children.translated_text: Yoke the two tawny, swift ones to your pole, the best bearers at your pole.

children.text: uta sya vājy aruṣas tuviṣvaṇir iha sma dhāyi darśataḥ
children.translated_text: And that ruddy prize-winning one, loud-roaring and visible, has been set here.

children.text: mā vo yāmeṣu marutaś ciraṃ karat pra taṃ ratheṣu codata ||
children.translated_text: Do not let him delay you on your journeys, O <s>Maruts</s>; drive him forward among the chariots.

children.text: rathaṃ nu mārutaṃ vayaṃ śravasyum ā huvāmahe
children.translated_text: Now we call the chariot of the <s>Maruts</s>, eager for renown.

children.text: ā yasmin tasthau suraṇāni bibhratī sacā marutsu rodasī ||
children.translated_text: In it <s>Rodasī</s> has taken her stand, bearing fair ornaments, accompanying the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: taṃ vaḥ śardhaṃ ratheśubhaṃ tveṣam panasyum ā huve
children.translated_text: I call that troop of yours, bright with chariots, fierce, and worthy of praise.

children.text: yasmin sujātā subhagā mahīyate sacā marutsu mīﾱhuṣī ||
children.translated_text: In whom the well-born, fortunate, bountiful one is magnified together with the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: Chapter 411
ā rudrāsa indravantaḥ sajoṣaso hiraṇyarathāḥ suvitāya gantana
children.translated_text: Come here, O <s>Rudras</s>, accompanied by <s>Indra</s>, of one accord, golden-charioted, for good guidance.

children.text: iyaṃ vo asmat prati haryate matis tṛṣṇaje na diva utsā udanyave ||
children.translated_text: This thought of ours turns eagerly toward you, like a heavenly spring for the thirsty, for one seeking water.

children.text: vāśīmanta ṛṣṭimanto manīṣiṇaḥ sudhanvāna iṣumanto niṣaṅgiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Bearing axes, bearing spears, wise, with good bows, with arrows and with quivers,

children.text: svaśvā stha surathāḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ svāyudhā maruto yāthanā śubham ||
children.translated_text: you are well-horsed, with fair chariots, sons of <s>Pṛśni</s>; with your own weapons, O <s>Maruts</s>, you go to splendor.

children.text: dhūnutha dyām parvatān dāśuṣe vasu ni vo vanā jihate yāmano bhiyā
children.translated_text: You shake heaven and the mountains; for the worshipper you set wealth in motion; the forests bow down before you in fear at your advance.

children.text: kopayatha pṛthivīm pṛśnimātaraḥ śubhe yad ugrāḥ pṛṣatīr ayugdhvam ||
children.translated_text: You make the earth tremble, sons of <s>Pṛśni</s>, when, fierce ones, you yoke the spotted mares for splendor.

children.text: vātatviṣo maruto varṣanirṇijo yamā iva susadṛśaḥ supeśasaḥ
children.translated_text: Wind-bright, O <s>Maruts</s>, rain-clad, like twins, well-matched and beautifully adorned,

children.text: piśaṅgāśvā aruṇāśvā arepasaḥ pratvakṣaso mahinā dyaur ivoravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with tawny horses and ruddy horses, unstained, broad in form, by greatness wide like heaven.

children.text: purudrapsā añjimantaḥ sudānavas tveṣasaṃdṛśo anavabhrarādhasaḥ
children.translated_text: Rich in drops, adorned, bountiful, of blazing appearance, with wealth not overclouded,

children.text: sujātāso januṣā rukmavakṣaso divo arkā amṛtaṃ nāma bhejire ||
children.translated_text: well-born by birth, with golden ornaments on their breasts, as heavenly rays they have received an immortal name.

children.text: ṛṣṭayo vo maruto aṃsayor adhi saha ojo bāhvor vo balaṃ hitam
children.translated_text: Your spears, O <s>Maruts</s>, are upon your shoulders; strength and force are set in your arms.

children.text: nṛmṇā śīrṣasv āyudhā ratheṣu vo viśvā vaḥ śrīr adhi tanūṣu pipiśe ||
children.translated_text: Heroic powers are on your heads, weapons on your chariots; all beauty has been adorned upon your bodies.

children.text: gomad aśvāvad rathavat suvīraṃ candravad rādho maruto dadā naḥ
children.translated_text: Give us, O <s>Maruts</s>, wealth with cattle, with horses, with chariots, rich in good heroes and bright with gold.

children.text: praśastiṃ naḥ kṛṇuta rudriyāso bhakṣīya vo 'vaso daivyasya ||
children.translated_text: Make praise for us, O <s>Rudriyas</s>; may I enjoy a share of your divine aid.

children.text: haye naro maruto mṛﾱatā nas tuvīmaghāso amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ
children.translated_text: Come, O men, O <s>Maruts</s>; be gracious to us, very munificent, immortal, and knowing <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: satyaśrutaḥ kavayo yuvāno bṛhadgirayo bṛhad ukṣamāṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: True to what is heard, poets, young, loud-voiced and swelling greatly.

children.text: Chapter 412
tam u nūnaṃ taviṣīmantam eṣāṃ stuṣe gaṇam mārutaṃ navyasīnām
children.translated_text: Now indeed I praise that mighty troop of theirs, the <s>Marut</s> host, with the newest songs,

children.text: ya āśvaśvā amavad vahanta uteśire amṛtasya svarājaḥ ||
children.translated_text: who, possessing swift horses and bearing might, have ruled as self-sovereigns of immortality.

children.text: tveṣaṃ gaṇaṃ tavasaṃ khādihastaṃ dhunivratam māyinaṃ dātivāram
children.translated_text: That blazing, powerful troop, with bracelets on their hands, whose vow is shaking, skillful and surpassing in gifts,

children.text: mayobhuvo ye amitā mahitvā vandasva vipra tuvirādhaso nṝn ||
children.translated_text: worship, O inspired priest, those bliss-bringing men, immeasurable in greatness and rich in abundant bounty.

children.text: ā vo yantūdavāhāso adya vṛṣṭiṃ ye viśve maruto junanti
children.translated_text: Let the rain-bearing ones come to you today, all the <s>Maruts</s> who set the rain in motion.

children.text: ayaṃ yo agnir marutaḥ samiddha etaṃ juṣadhvaṃ kavayo yuvānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: This <s>Agni</s>, O <s>Maruts</s>, has been kindled; enjoy him, O young poets.

children.text: yūyaṃ rājānam iryaṃ janāya vibhvataṣṭaṃ janayathā yajatrāḥ
children.translated_text: You, worshipful ones, generate for the people the king, skillfully fashioned and far-ruling.

children.text: yuṣmad eti muṣṭihā bāhujūto yuṣmat sadaśvo marutaḥ suvīraḥ ||
children.translated_text: From you comes the fist-striker, born of the arm; from you, O <s>Maruts</s>, the good horse and the good hero.

children.text: arā ived acaramā aheva pra pra jāyante akavā mahobhiḥ
children.translated_text: Like spokes at a rim, like days, they are born forth and forth, unstinted in their greatness.

children.text: pṛśneḥ putrā upamāso rabhiṣṭhāḥ svayā matyā marutaḥ sam mimikṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The sons of <s>Pṛśni</s>, most closely resembling one another, have joined themselves together by their own insight, O <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: yat prāyāsiṣṭa pṛṣatībhir aśvair vīﾱupavibhir maruto rathebhiḥ
children.translated_text: When you set out with spotted mares, with horses and with chariots fitted with bright adornments, O <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: kṣodanta āpo riṇate vanāny avosriyo vṛṣabhaḥ krandatu dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: the waters roar and the forests tremble; the bull of the bright spaces bellows to heaven.

children.text: prathiṣṭa yāman pṛthivī cid eṣām bharteva garbhaṃ svam icchavo dhuḥ
children.translated_text: At their broad advance even the earth, like a bearer, bore her own womb, as those who desired it shook her.

children.text: vātān hy aśvān dhury āyuyujre varṣaṃ svedaṃ cakrire rudriyāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For the <s>Rudriyas</s> yoked the winds as draft-horses and made rain their sweat.

children.text: haye naro maruto mṛﾱatā nas tuvīmaghāso amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ
children.translated_text: Come, O men, O <s>Maruts</s>; be gracious to us, very munificent, immortal, and knowing <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: satyaśrutaḥ kavayo yuvāno bṛhadgirayo bṛhad ukṣamāṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: True to what is heard, poets, young, loud-voiced and swelling greatly.

children.text: Chapter 413
pra va spaﾱ akran suvitāya dāvane 'rcā dive pra pṛthivyā ṛtam bhare
children.translated_text: They have made a path for you for good guidance and for giving; with praise I bring <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) to heaven and earth.

children.text: ukṣante aśvān taruṣanta ā rajo 'nu svam bhānuṃ śrathayante arṇavaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They sprinkle the horses; they cross the midspace; with floods they spread out their own radiance.

children.text: amād eṣām bhiyasā bhūmir ejati naur na pūrṇā kṣarati vyathir yatī
children.translated_text: From fear of them the earth trembles at home; like a full ship she pours out as she goes shaking.

children.text: dūredṛśo ye citayanta emabhir antar mahe vidathe yetire naraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those far-seeing men, who make things visible by their movements, have taken their place in the great assembly.

children.text: gavām iva śriyase śṛṅgam uttamaṃ sūryo na cakṣū rajaso visarjane
children.translated_text: Like the highest horn for the splendor of cows, like the sun, the eye at the release of the mist,

children.text: atyā iva subhvaś cārava sthana maryā iva śriyase cetathā naraḥ ||
children.translated_text: like coursers, beautiful and splendid, you stand; like youths, O men, you appear for beauty.

children.text: ko vo mahānti mahatām ud aśnavat kas kāvyā marutaḥ ko ha pauṃsyā
children.translated_text: Who has attained your great deeds among the great? Who, O <s>Maruts</s>, your inspired works? Who indeed your manly powers?

children.text: yūyaṃ ha bhūmiṃ kiraṇaṃ na rejatha pra yad bharadhve suvitāya dāvane ||
children.translated_text: You make the earth tremble like a beam when you bear onward for good guidance and giving.

children.text: aśvā ived aruṣāsaḥ sabandhavaḥ śūrā iva prayudhaḥ prota yuyudhuḥ
children.translated_text: Like ruddy horses, kinsmen together, like heroes armed for battle, they have fought forth and onward.

children.text: maryā iva suvṛdho vāvṛdhur naraḥ sūryasya cakṣuḥ pra minanti vṛṣṭibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like well-grown youths the men have grown strong; with rains they veil the eye of the sun.

children.text: te ajyeṣṭhā akaniṣṭhāsa udbhido 'madhyamāso mahasā vi vāvṛdhuḥ
children.translated_text: They are neither eldest nor youngest, bursting forth; with no middle ones, they have grown apart in greatness.

children.text: sujātāso januṣā pṛśnimātaro divo maryā ā no acchā jigātana ||
children.translated_text: Well-born by birth, sons of <s>Pṛśni</s>, youths of heaven, come here to us.

children.text: vayo na ye śreṇīḥ paptur ojasāntān divo bṛhataḥ sānunas pari
children.translated_text: Like birds, those ranks have flown with force around the far, broad ridges of heaven.

children.text: aśvāsa eṣām ubhaye yathā viduḥ pra parvatasya nabhanūṃr acucyavuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Their horses know both ways; they have shaken loose the cloud of the mountain.

children.text: mimātu dyaur aditir vītaye naḥ saṃ dānucitrā uṣaso yatantām
children.translated_text: May heaven and <s>Aditi</s> measure out refreshment for us; may the richly variegated Dawns strive together.

children.text: ācucyavur divyaṃ kośam eta ṛṣe rudrasya maruto gṛṇānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: These <s>Maruts</s>, being praised by the seer, have shaken down the heavenly vessel of <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 414
īﾱe agniṃ svavasaṃ namobhir iha prasatto vi cayat kṛtaṃ naḥ
children.translated_text: I implore <s>Agni</s>, possessed of his own aid, with reverences; set here, let him discern what has been done for us.

children.text: rathair iva pra bhare vājayadbhiḥ pradakṣiṇin marutāṃ stomam ṛdhyām ||
children.translated_text: As with prize-winning chariots I bring the hymn forward, going sunwise; may I prosper in the praise of the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: ā ye tasthuḥ pṛṣatīṣu śrutāsu sukheṣu rudrā maruto ratheṣu
children.translated_text: Those <s>Rudra</s> <s>Maruts</s> who have mounted the famed spotted mares in the pleasant chariots,

children.text: vanā cid ugrā jihate ni vo bhiyā pṛthivī cid rejate parvataś cit ||
children.translated_text: even the fierce forests bow down before you in fear; even the earth trembles, and even the mountain.

children.text: parvataś cin mahi vṛddho bibhāya divaś cit sānu rejata svane vaḥ
children.translated_text: Even the mountain, greatly grown, has feared; even the ridge of heaven trembles at your roar,

children.text: yat krīﾱatha maruta ṛṣṭimanta āpa iva sadhryañco dhavadhve ||
children.translated_text: when you play, O spear-bearing <s>Maruts</s>, and run together like waters.

children.text: varā ived raivatāso hiraṇyair abhi svadhābhis tanvaḥ pipiśre
children.translated_text: Like splendid suitors, rich with gold, they adorned their bodies with their own powers.

children.text: śriye śreyāṃsas tavaso ratheṣu satrā mahāṃsi cakrire tanūṣu ||
children.translated_text: For splendor, the more splendid, powerful ones have together made great forms of greatness on their chariots and in their bodies.

children.text: ajyeṣṭhāso akaniṣṭhāsa ete sam bhrātaro vāvṛdhuḥ saubhagāya
children.translated_text: These, neither eldest nor youngest, have grown together as brothers for good fortune.

children.text: yuvā pitā svapā rudra eṣāṃ sudughā pṛśniḥ sudinā marudbhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Their father is young, skillful <s>Rudra</s>; <s>Pṛśni</s>, easy to milk, grants good days for the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: yad uttame maruto madhyame vā yad vāvame subhagāso divi ṣṭha
children.translated_text: Whether, O fortunate <s>Maruts</s>, you stand in the highest, the middle, or the lowest heaven,

children.text: ato no rudrā uta vā nv asyāgne vittāddhaviṣo yad yajāma ||
children.translated_text: from there, O <s>Rudras</s>, and now also from here, O <s>Agni</s>, know this oblation that we offer.

children.text: agniś ca yan maruto viśvavedaso divo vahadhva uttarād adhi ṣṇubhiḥ
children.translated_text: And when <s>Agni</s> and the all-knowing <s>Maruts</s> carry it from the upper heaven with your supports,

children.text: te mandasānā dhunayo riśādaso vāmaṃ dhatta yajamānāya sunvate ||
children.translated_text: then, exhilarated, shaking, and foe-scathing, grant what is dear to the sacrificer who presses soma.

children.text: agne marudbhiḥ śubhayadbhir ṛkvabhiḥ somam piba mandasāno gaṇaśribhiḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, with the bright, hymn-bearing <s>Maruts</s>, drink the soma, rejoicing with the host adorned in splendor,

children.text: pāvakebhir viśvaminvebhir āyubhir vaiśvānara pradivā ketunā sajūḥ ||
children.translated_text: with the purifying, all-moving powers of life, O <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, joined from of old with the beacon.

children.text: Chapter 415
ke ṣṭhā naraḥ śreṣṭhatamā ya eka eka āyaya
children.translated_text: Who are you men, the very best, each one singly, who have come

children.text: paramasyāḥ parāvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: from the farthest distance?

children.text: kva vo 'śvāḥ kvābhīśavaḥ kathaṃ śeka kathā yaya
children.translated_text: Where are your horses? Where are the reins? How did you manage it, and how did you come,

children.text: pṛṣṭhe sado nasor yamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when <s>Yama</s> had his seat upon the back, at the nostrils?

children.text: jaghane coda eṣāṃ vi sakthāni naro yamuḥ
children.translated_text: At their rear the men urged them on; they spread apart their thighs,

children.text: putrakṛthe na janayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like women intent on making a son.

children.text: parā vīrāsa etana maryāso bhadrajānayaḥ
children.translated_text: Go forth, heroes, young men of good birth,

children.text: agnitapo yathāsatha ||
children.translated_text: as you are, heated by fire.

children.text: sanat sāśvyam paśum uta gavyaṃ śatāvayam
children.translated_text: From of old he has enlarged a possession of horses, and also cattle, and a hundred sheep,

children.text: śyāvāśvastutāya yā dor vīrāyopabarbṛhat ||
children.translated_text: for <s>Śyāvāśva</s> the praiser, that gift for the heroic man.

children.text: uta tvā strī śaśīyasī puṃso bhavati vasyasī
children.translated_text: And a woman becomes mightier than a man, more desirable,

children.text: adevatrād arādhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: than the ungodly, giftless one.

children.text: vi yā jānāti jasuriṃ vi tṛṣyantaṃ vi kāminam
children.translated_text: She who discerns the exhausted man, the thirsty one, and the desirous one

children.text: devatrā kṛṇute manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: turns her mind toward the gods.

children.text: uta ghā nemo astutaḥ pumāṁ iti bruve paṇiḥ
children.translated_text: And indeed the unpraised miser says, 'He is a man,'

children.text: sa vairadeya it samaḥ ||
children.translated_text: yet he is only equal to <s>Vairadeya</s>.

children.text: uta me 'rapad yuvatir mamanduṣī prati śyāvāya vartanim
children.translated_text: And the young woman, delighting me, came upon my path for <s>Śyāva</s>;

children.text: vi rohitā purumīﾱhāya yematur viprāya dīrghayaśase ||
children.translated_text: the two red mares drew her toward <s>Purumīḍha</s>, the inspired seer of long fame.

children.text: yo me dhenūnāṃ śataṃ vaidadaśvir yathā dadat
children.translated_text: He, <s>Vaidadaśvi</s>, who gave me a hundred cows, just as he gave,

children.text: taranta iva maṃhanā ||
children.translated_text: was like one crossing over through munificence.

children.text: ya īṃ vahanta āśubhiḥ pibanto madiram madhu
children.translated_text: Those who, carried by swift steeds and drinking the intoxicating honey,

children.text: atra śravāṃsi dadhire ||
children.translated_text: there set down their renowns.

children.text: yeṣāṃ śriyādhi rodasī vibhrājante ratheṣv ā
children.translated_text: By whose splendor the two worlds shine over the chariots,

children.text: divi rukma ivopari ||
children.translated_text: like a golden ornament set above in heaven.

children.text: yuvā sa māruto gaṇas tveṣaratho anedyaḥ
children.translated_text: That young <s>Marut</s> host, with blazing chariots, is irreproachable,

children.text: śubhaṃyāvāpratiṣkutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: going in beauty, unopposed.

children.text: ko veda nūnam eṣāṃ yatrā madanti dhūtayaḥ
children.translated_text: Who now knows where these shakers rejoice,

children.text: ṛtajātā arepasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: born of truth and free from stain?

children.text: yūyam martaṃ vipanyavaḥ praṇetāra itthā dhiyā
children.translated_text: You are discerning leaders of the mortal man, with such inspired thought,

children.text: śrotāro yāmahūtiṣu ||
children.translated_text: listeners at the calls for aid on the journey.

children.text: te no vasūni kāmyā puruścandrā riśādasaḥ
children.translated_text: Those desirable goods, rich in brightness, O foe-scathers,

children.text: ā yajñiyāso vavṛttana ||
children.translated_text: turn toward us, O worshipful ones.

children.text: etam me stomam ūrmye dārbhyāya parā vaha
children.translated_text: Carry this praise of mine, O <s>Ūrmyā</s>, to <s>Dārbhya</s>;

children.text: giro devi rathīr iva ||
children.translated_text: O goddess speech, carry my songs like charioteers.

children.text: uta me vocatād iti sutasome rathavītau
children.translated_text: And say also of me, 'At <s>Sutasoma</s>, at <s>Rathavīti</s>,

children.text: na kāmo apa veti me ||
children.translated_text: my desire does not go away.'

children.text: eṣa kṣeti rathavītir maghavā gomatīr anu
children.translated_text: This <s>Rathavīti</s>, the bounteous one, dwells among cattle-rich places,

children.text: parvateṣv apaśritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: sheltered in the mountains.

children.text: Chapter 416
ṛtena ṛtam apihitaṃ dhruvaṃ vāṃ sūryasya yatra vimucanty aśvān
children.translated_text: Where firm truth is covered by truth, where they unyoke the horses of the sun,

children.text: daśa śatā saha tasthus tad ekaṃ devānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vapuṣām apaśyam ||
children.translated_text: the ten hundreds stood together as one; I saw the best form among the gods.

children.text: tat su vām mitrāvaruṇā mahitvam īrmā tasthuṣīr ahabhir duduhre
children.translated_text: That indeed is your greatness, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>: the moving and standing things were milked through the days;

children.text: viśvāḥ pinvathaḥ svasarasya dhenā anu vām ekaḥ pavir ā vavarta ||
children.translated_text: you fill all the streams of your own sister, while one wheel has turned after you.

children.text: adhārayatam pṛthivīm uta dyām mitrarājānā varuṇā mahobhiḥ
children.translated_text: You upheld earth and heaven, O royal <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, by your great powers;

children.text: vardhayatam oṣadhīḥ pinvataṃ gā ava vṛṣṭiṃ sṛjataṃ jīradānū ||
children.translated_text: you made the plants grow, filled the cows, and released the rain, O swift-giving ones.

children.text: ā vām aśvāsaḥ suyujo vahantu yataraśmaya upa yantv arvāk
children.translated_text: Let well-yoked horses carry you; let the reins come hither toward us.

children.text: ghṛtasya nirṇig anu vartate vām upa sindhavaḥ pradivi kṣaranti ||
children.translated_text: The adornment of ghee follows you; the rivers flow toward you in the primal heaven.

children.text: anu śrutām amatiṃ vardhad urvīm barhir iva yajuṣā rakṣamāṇā
children.translated_text: Following the heard thought, guarding the wide one like sacrificial grass with a formula,

children.text: namasvantā dhṛtadakṣādhi garte mitrāsāthe varuṇeﾱāsv antaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with reverence and firm skill, you protect within the pit, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: akravihastā sukṛte paraspā yaṃ trāsāthe varuṇeﾱāsv antaḥ
children.translated_text: With hands free from raw flesh, protecting the doer of good from the other side, the one whom you protect, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, within the obscured place,

children.text: rājānā kṣatram ahṛṇīyamānā sahasrasthūṇam bibhṛthaḥ saha dvau ||
children.translated_text: you two kings, sustaining unangered sovereignty, together bear the thousand-pillared structure.

children.text: hiraṇyanirṇig ayo asya sthūṇā vi bhrājate divy aśvājanīva
children.translated_text: Its covering is golden, its pillar of iron; it shines in heaven like a horse-goad.

children.text: bhadre kṣetre nimitā tilvile vā sanema madhvo adhigartyasya ||
children.translated_text: Set in the good field, or on the tilvila, may we win the honey from within the pit.

children.text: hiraṇyarūpam uṣaso vyuṣṭāv ayasthūṇam uditā sūryasya
children.translated_text: At the shining of dawn, at the rising of the sun, you mount the golden-formed, iron-pillared pit,

children.text: ā rohatho varuṇa mitra gartam ataś cakṣāthe aditiṃ ditiṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Mitra</s>; from there you behold <s>Aditi</s> and <s>Diti</s>.

children.text: yad baṃhiṣṭhaṃ nātividhe sudānū acchidraṃ śarma bhuvanasya gopā
children.translated_text: With that broadest, unsurpassed, generous, unbroken shelter, O guardians of the world,

children.text: tena no mitrāvaruṇāv aviṣṭaṃ siṣāsanto jigīvāṃsaḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: protect us, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; striving to win, may we be victorious.

children.text: Chapter 417
ṛtasya gopāv adhi tiṣṭhatho rathaṃ satyadharmāṇā parame vyomani
children.translated_text: Guardians of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), true in law, you stand upon the chariot in the highest heaven;

children.text: yam atra mitrāvaruṇāvatho yuvaṃ tasmai vṛṣṭir madhumat pinvate divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the one whom you two help here, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, for him sweet rain swells from heaven.

children.text: samrājāv asya bhuvanasya rājatho mitrāvaruṇā vidathe svardṛśā
children.translated_text: As imperial kings you rule this world, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, sun-seeing at the rite.

children.text: vṛṣṭiṃ vāṃ rādho amṛtatvam īmahe dyāvāpṛthivī vi caranti tanyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: We ask of you rain, favor, and immortality; heaven and earth move apart with the thunders.

children.text: samrājā ugrā vṛṣabhā divas patī pṛthivyā mitrāvaruṇā vicarṣaṇī
children.translated_text: Imperial, mighty bulls, lords of heaven and earth, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, watchers over men,

children.text: citrebhir abhrair upa tiṣṭhatho ravaṃ dyāṃ varṣayatho asurasya māyayā ||
children.translated_text: with variegated clouds you attend the roar; by the power of the <s>asura</s> (mighty lord) you make heaven rain.

children.text: māyā vām mitrāvaruṇā divi śritā sūryo jyotiś carati citram āyudham
children.translated_text: Your wondrous power, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, rests in heaven; the sun moves as light, a brilliant weapon.

children.text: tam abhreṇa vṛṣṭyā gūhatho divi parjanya drapsā madhumanta īrate ||
children.translated_text: You hide him in heaven with cloud and rain; O <s>Parjanya</s>, the honeyed drops are set in motion.

children.text: rathaṃ yuñjate marutaḥ śubhe sukhaṃ śūro na mitrāvaruṇā gaviṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: The <s>Maruts</s> yoke the chariot for beauty and ease, like a hero in quests for cattle, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: rajāṃsi citrā vi caranti tanyavo divaḥ samrājā payasā na ukṣatam ||
children.translated_text: The many-colored lightnings move through the regions; O sovereigns of heaven, sprinkle us as with milk.

children.text: vācaṃ su mitrāvaruṇāv irāvatīm parjanyaś citrāṃ vadati tviṣīmatīm
children.translated_text: O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Parjanya</s> speaks forth a nourishing speech, bright-colored and full of force.

children.text: abhrā vasata marutaḥ su māyayā dyāṃ varṣayatam aruṇām arepasam ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Maruts</s> clothe the clouds with good power; make the ruddy, stainless heaven rain.

children.text: dharmaṇā mitrāvaruṇā vipaścitā vratā rakṣethe asurasya māyayā
children.translated_text: By <s>dharma</s> (law), O discerning <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, you guard the vows by the power of the divine lord.

children.text: ṛtena viśvam bhuvanaṃ vi rājathaḥ sūryam ā dhattho divi citryaṃ ratham ||
children.translated_text: By <s>ṛta</s> (truth-order) you rule the whole world; you set the sun in heaven as a wondrous chariot.

children.text: Chapter 418
varuṇaṃ vo riśādasam ṛcā mitraṃ havāmahe
children.translated_text: With a hymn we call for you <s>Varuṇa</s>, destroyer of foes, and <s>Mitra</s>.

children.text: pari vrajeva bāhvor jaganvāṃsā svarṇaram ||
children.translated_text: They have gone around like an enclosure with their arms, toward the sun-bright realm.

children.text: tā bāhavā sucetunā pra yantam asmā arcate
children.translated_text: Let those two arms, well-minded, go forth for the one who worships us.

children.text: śevaṃ hi jāryaṃ vāṃ viśvāsu kṣāsu joguve ||
children.translated_text: For in all dwelling-places a kindly, praiseworthy power of yours has been sung aloud.

children.text: yan nūnam aśyāṃ gatim mitrasya yāyām pathā
children.translated_text: May I now attain the path of <s>Mitra</s>; may I travel by his road.

children.text: asya priyasya śarmaṇy ahiṃsānasya saścire ||
children.translated_text: In the shelter of this dear one, of the harmless one, they have closely attached themselves.

children.text: yuvābhyām mitrāvaruṇopamaṃ dheyām ṛcā
children.translated_text: With a hymn, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, I would place myself in your incomparable care.

children.text: yaddha kṣaye maghonāṃ stotṝṇāṃ ca spūrdhase ||
children.translated_text: For in the dwelling of the bounteous, and for the singers, you strive in rivalry.

children.text: ā no mitra sudītibhir varuṇaś ca sadhastha ā
children.translated_text: Come to us with bright aids, O <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s> also, to the common seat.

children.text: sve kṣaye maghonāṃ sakhīnāṃ ca vṛdhase ||
children.translated_text: In your own dwelling you come for the increase of the bounteous and of your friends.

children.text: yuvaṃ no yeṣu varuṇa kṣatram bṛhac ca bibhṛthaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Varuṇa</s>, among whom you two bear great and lofty dominion for us,

children.text: uru ṇo vājasātaye kṛtaṃ rāye svastaye ||
children.translated_text: make broad space for us, for the winning of strength, for wealth, and for well-being.

children.text: ucchantyām me yajatā devakṣatre ruśadgavi
children.translated_text: At dawn, O worshipful men, in the divine dominion, with bright cattle,

children.text: sutaṃ somaṃ na hastibhir ā paḍbhir dhāvataṃ narā bibhratāv arcanānasam ||
children.translated_text: come running to the pressed Soma, not with hands but with feet, bearing the object of praise.

children.text: Chapter 419
yaś ciketa sa sukratur devatrā sa bravītu naḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever has perceived it, he, the wise one among the gods, let him tell us.

children.text: varuṇo yasya darśato mitro vā vanate giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: He whose songs beautiful <s>Varuṇa</s>, or <s>Mitra</s>, gladly accepts.

children.text: tā hi śreṣṭhavarcasā rājānā dīrghaśruttamā
children.translated_text: For those two kings are of most excellent brilliance and most far-heard fame.

children.text: tā satpatī ṛtāvṛdha ṛtāvānā jane jane ||
children.translated_text: Those true lords, increasers of <s>ṛta</s>, possessors of <s>ṛta</s>, are present among every people.

children.text: tā vām iyāno 'vase pūrvā upa bruve sacā
children.translated_text: Going to you two for help, I first address you together.

children.text: svaśvāsaḥ su cetunā vājāṁ abhi pra dāvane ||
children.translated_text: With good horses and good understanding, you press forward toward the giving of prizes.

children.text: mitro aṃhoś cid ād uru kṣayāya gātuṃ vanate
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s> wins a broad path for secure dwelling even out of distress.

children.text: mitrasya hi pratūrvataḥ sumatir asti vidhataḥ ||
children.translated_text: For the favor of forward-pressing <s>Mitra</s> belongs to the worshiper.

children.text: vayam mitrasyāvasi syāma saprathastame
children.translated_text: May we be under <s>Mitra</s>'s aid, in the widest expanse.

children.text: anehasas tvotayaḥ satrā varuṇaśeṣasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Unharmed are your protections, always remaining under <s>Varuṇa</s>'s care.

children.text: yuvam mitremaṃ janaṃ yatathaḥ saṃ ca nayathaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Mitra</s>, you two guide this people and lead them together.

children.text: mā maghonaḥ pari khyatam mo asmākam ṛṣīṇāṃ gopīthe na uruṣyatam ||
children.translated_text: Do not overlook the bounteous ones; in guarding our seers, protect us widely.

children.text: Chapter 420
ā cikitāna sukratū devau marta riśādasā
children.translated_text: Recognizing, wise, the two gods who destroy foes, O mortal,

children.text: varuṇāya ṛtapeśase dadhīta prayase mahe ||
children.translated_text: one should set down a great offering for <s>Varuṇa</s>, whose form is <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: tā hi kṣatram avihrutaṃ samyag asuryam āśāte
children.translated_text: For they two occupy unshaken dominion and properly divine lordship.

children.text: adha vrateva mānuṣaṃ svar ṇa dhāyi darśatam ||
children.translated_text: Then the human law, like a vow, has been set down, visible like the sun.

children.text: tā vām eṣe rathānām urvīṃ gavyūtim eṣām
children.translated_text: I seek for you two the wide cattle-pasture belonging to these chariots.

children.text: rātahavyasya suṣṭutiṃ dadhṛk stomair manāmahe ||
children.translated_text: We honor, with hymns, the good praise of <s>Rātahavya</s>.

children.text: adhā hi kāvyā yuvaṃ dakṣasya pūrbhir adbhutā
children.translated_text: For then, through inspired works, you two are wondrous by the strongholds of skill.

children.text: ni ketunā janānāṃ cikethe pūtadakṣasā ||
children.translated_text: With purified skill, by your sign, you two discern the peoples.

children.text: tad ṛtam pṛthivi bṛhac chravaeṣa ṛṣīṇām
children.translated_text: That is the broad <s>ṛta</s>, O earth, the great fame of the seers.

children.text: jrayasānāv aram pṛthv ati kṣaranti yāmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Growing old, the two pour across the broad space with their courses.

children.text: ā yad vām īyacakṣasā mitra vayaṃ ca sūrayaḥ
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Mitra</s>, we and the inspired patrons strive toward you with seeing eyes,

children.text: vyaciṣṭhe bahupāyye yatemahi svarājye ||
children.translated_text: we strive in the broadest, much-protecting self-rule.

children.text: Chapter 421
baﾱ itthā deva niṣkṛtam ādityā yajatam bṛhat
children.translated_text: Indeed thus, O gods, the great, worshipful work has been accomplished, O <s>Ādityas</s>.

children.text: varuṇa mitrāryaman varṣiṣṭhaṃ kṣatram āśāthe ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>, you occupy the highest dominion.

children.text: ā yad yoniṃ hiraṇyayaṃ varuṇa mitra sadathaḥ
children.translated_text: When you two, O <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Mitra</s>, sit in the golden womb,

children.text: dhartārā carṣaṇīnāṃ yantaṃ sumnaṃ riśādasā ||
children.translated_text: as sustainers of peoples, you two who destroy foes guide your favor.

children.text: viśve hi viśvavedaso varuṇo mitro aryamā
children.translated_text: For all-knowing are all of them: <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>.

children.text: vratā padeva saścire pānti martyaṃ riṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They follow the vows like footsteps, and protect the mortal from injury.

children.text: te hi satyā ṛtaspṛśa ṛtāvāno jane jane
children.translated_text: For they are true, touching <s>ṛta</s>, possessed of <s>ṛta</s> among every people.

children.text: sunīthāsaḥ sudānavo 'ṃhoś cid urucakrayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Good guides and good givers, they make broad space even out of distress.

children.text: ko nu vām mitrāstuto varuṇo vā tanūnām
children.translated_text: Who now, praised by <s>Mitra</s>, or by <s>Varuṇa</s>, belongs to your bodies?

children.text: tat su vām eṣate matir atribhya eṣate matiḥ ||
children.translated_text: That thought seeks you two well; the thought seeks you two for the <s>Atris</s>.

children.text: Chapter 422
pra vo mitrāya gāyata varuṇāya vipā girā
children.translated_text: Sing forth for <s>Mitra</s>, for <s>Varuṇa</s>, with inspired utterance and song,

children.text: mahikṣatrāv ṛtam bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: the two of great dominion, the lofty <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: samrājā yā ghṛtayonī mitraś cobhā varuṇaś ca
children.translated_text: The two sovereigns whose womb is ghee, both <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>,

children.text: devā deveṣu praśastā ||
children.translated_text: are praised as gods among the gods.

children.text: tā naḥ śaktam pārthivasya maho rāyo divyasya
children.translated_text: May those two be able to grant us great earthly wealth and heavenly wealth.

children.text: mahi vāṃ kṣatraṃ deveṣu ||
children.translated_text: Great is your dominion among the gods.

children.text: ṛtam ṛtena sapanteṣiraṃ dakṣam āśāte
children.translated_text: They attain <s>ṛta</s> by <s>ṛta</s>; they occupy vigorous skill.

children.text: adruhā devau vardhete ||
children.translated_text: The two guileless gods grow strong.

children.text: vṛṣṭidyāvā rītyāpeṣas patī dānumatyāḥ
children.translated_text: Rain-heavened, with flowing waters, lords of the bounteous stream,

children.text: bṛhantaṃ gartam āśāte ||
children.translated_text: they occupy the great seat.

children.text: Chapter 423
trī rocanā varuṇa trīṃr uta dyūn trīṇi mitra dhārayatho rajāṃsi
children.translated_text: O <s>Varuṇa</s>, three luminous realms and three heavens; O <s>Mitra</s>, you two uphold the three regions.

children.text: vāvṛdhānāv amatiṃ kṣatriyasyānu vrataṃ rakṣamāṇāv ajuryam ||
children.translated_text: Increasing the thought of the ruler, guarding the ageless vow in order.

children.text: irāvatīr varuṇa dhenavo vām madhumad vāṃ sindhavo mitra duhre
children.translated_text: O <s>Varuṇa</s>, your nourishing cows; O <s>Mitra</s>, your honey-sweet rivers are milked.

children.text: trayas tasthur vṛṣabhāsas tisṛṇāṃ dhiṣaṇānāṃ retodhā vi dyumantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Three bulls have stood, radiant seed-bearers of the three inspirations.

children.text: prātar devīm aditiṃ johavīmi madhyandina uditā sūryasya
children.translated_text: In the morning I call on the goddess <s>Aditi</s>; at midday, when the sun has risen,

children.text: rāye mitrāvaruṇā sarvatāteﾱe tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ ||
children.translated_text: for wealth, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, for wholeness, for child and descendant, and for welfare and blessing.

children.text: yā dhartārā rajaso rocanasyotādityā divyā pārthivasya
children.translated_text: You who are sustainers of the region and of the luminous realm, O <s>Ādityas</s>, and also of the heavenly and earthly world,

children.text: na vāṃ devā amṛtā ā minanti vratāni mitrāvaruṇā dhruvāṇi ||
children.translated_text: the immortal gods do not diminish your fixed vows, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: Chapter 424
purūruṇā ciddhy asty avo nūnaṃ vāṃ varuṇa
children.translated_text: For now your help is indeed very spacious, O <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: mitra vaṃsi vāṃ sumatim ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Mitra</s>, we desire your good favor.

children.text: tā vāṃ samyag adruhvāṇeṣam aśyāma dhāyase
children.translated_text: May we rightly attain your guileless refreshment, for sustenance.

children.text: vayaṃ te rudrā syāma ||
children.translated_text: May we be yours, O <s>Rudras</s>.

children.text: pātaṃ no rudrā pāyubhir uta trāyethāṃ sutrātrā
children.translated_text: Protect us, O <s>Rudras</s>, with protections, and save us with good saviors.

children.text: turyāma dasyūn tanūbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we pass beyond the enemies with our bodies unharmed.

children.text: mā kasyādbhutakratū yakṣam bhujemā tanūbhiḥ
children.translated_text: O you of wondrous power, may we not experience any strange harmful force with our bodies,

children.text: mā śeṣasā mā tanasā ||
children.translated_text: nor through what remains, nor through our offspring.

children.text: Chapter 425
ā no gantaṃ riśādasā varuṇa mitra barhaṇā
children.translated_text: Come to us, O <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Mitra</s>, destroyers of foes, mighty ones,

children.text: upemaṃ cārum adhvaram ||
children.translated_text: come near to this lovely <s>adhvara</s> (sacrifice).

children.text: viśvasya hi pracetasā varuṇa mitra rājathaḥ
children.translated_text: For, all-knowing <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Mitra</s>, you rule over the whole world;

children.text: īśānā pipyataṃ dhiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: as sovereigns, make our inspired thoughts swell.

children.text: upa naḥ sutam ā gataṃ varuṇa mitra dāśuṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Come here to our pressed offering, O <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Mitra</s>, to the worshipper,

children.text: asya somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: to drink this <s>soma</s>.

children.text: Chapter 426
ā mitre varuṇe vayaṃ gīrbhir juhumo atrivat
children.translated_text: We call <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> here with songs, as <s>Atri</s> did;

children.text: ni barhiṣi sadataṃ somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: sit down upon the sacred grass to drink <s>soma</s>.

children.text: vratena stho dhruvakṣemā dharmaṇā yātayajjanā
children.translated_text: You stand firm in your vow and security, guiding people by <s>dharma</s> (sacred order);

children.text: ni barhiṣi sadataṃ somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: sit down upon the sacred grass to drink <s>soma</s>.

children.text: mitraś ca no varuṇaś ca juṣetāṃ yajñam iṣṭaye
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> be pleased with our sacrifice for prosperity;

children.text: ni barhiṣi sadatāṃ somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: sit down upon the sacred grass to drink <s>soma</s>.

children.text: Chapter 427
yad adya sthaḥ parāvati yad arvāvaty aśvinā
children.translated_text: Whether today you are far away, or whether you are nearby, O <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: yad vā purū purubhujā yad antarikṣa ā gatam ||
children.translated_text: or whether, much-enjoying ones, you are in many places, or in the midspace, come.

children.text: iha tyā purubhūtamā purū daṃsāṃsi bibhratā
children.translated_text: Here I call those two most manifoldly present, bearing many wondrous works,

children.text: varasyā yāmy adhrigū huve tuviṣṭamā bhuje ||
children.translated_text: unfailing ones of chosen power, the mightiest, for enjoyment and aid.

children.text: īrmānyad vapuṣe vapuś cakraṃ rathasya yemathuḥ
children.translated_text: When for your form you fitted beauty to beauty, and fastened the wheel of the chariot,

children.text: pary anyā nāhuṣā yugā mahnā rajāṃsi dīyathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you fly in greatness around the generations of <s>Nahuṣa</s> and across the realms.

children.text: tad ū ṣu vām enā kṛtaṃ viśvā yad vām anu ṣṭave
children.translated_text: Now that deed of yours is indeed done here, all that I praise concerning you;

children.text: nānā jātāv arepasā sam asme bandhum eyathuḥ ||
children.translated_text: though born in different ways, faultless ones, you have come together into kinship for us.

children.text: ā yad vāṃ sūryā rathaṃ tiṣṭhad raghuṣyadaṃ sadā
children.translated_text: When <s>Sūryā</s> mounted your chariot, ever hastening swiftly,

children.text: pari vām aruṣā vayo ghṛṇā varanta ātapaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the ruddy birds, rays, and heats surrounded you.

children.text: yuvor atriś ciketati narā sumnena cetasā
children.translated_text: <s>Atri</s> recognizes you two here, O men, with a mind seeking your favor,

children.text: gharmaṃ yad vām arepasaṃ nāsatyāsnā bhuraṇyati ||
children.translated_text: when, O faultless <s>Nāsatyas</s>, he urgently prepares your hot milk offering.
