children.text: ugro vāṃ kakuho yayiḥ śṛṇve yāmeṣu saṃtaniḥ
children.translated_text: Your fierce, high-rising course is heard, extending itself on the journeys,

children.text: yad vāṃ daṃsobhir aśvinātrir narāvavartati ||
children.translated_text: when with your wondrous powers, O <s>Aśvins</s>, <s>Atri</s> turns you two back, O men.

children.text: madhva ū ṣu madhūyuvā rudrā siṣakti pipyuṣī
children.translated_text: The honey-seeking, swelling stream of sweetness clings to you, O ruddy ones,

children.text: yat samudrāti parṣathaḥ pakvāḥ pṛkṣo bharanta vām ||
children.translated_text: when you carry ripe nourishments across from the ocean for yourselves.

children.text: satyam id vā u aśvinā yuvām āhur mayobhuvā
children.translated_text: Truly indeed, O <s>Aśvins</s>, they call you two bringers of delight,

children.text: tā yāman yāmahūtamā yāmann ā mṛﾱayattamā ||
children.translated_text: most invoked on every journey, and on the journey most gracious.

children.text: imā brahmāṇi vardhanāśvibhyāṃ santu śantamā
children.translated_text: May these prayers, strengthening and most auspicious, be for the <s>Aśvins</s>;

children.text: yā takṣāma rathāṁ ivāvocāma bṛhan namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like chariots we have fashioned them; we have spoken great homage.

children.text: Chapter 428
kūṣṭho devāv aśvinādyā divo manāvasū
children.translated_text: Where are you today, divine <s>Aśvins</s>, rich in heavenly and human goods?

children.text: tacchravatho vṛṣaṇvasū atrir vām ā vivāsati ||
children.translated_text: Hear that, O bull-strong rich ones; <s>Atri</s> seeks to win you here.

children.text: kuha tyā kuha nu śrutā divi devā nāsatyā
children.translated_text: Where now are those two famed ones, where, O divine <s>Nāsatyas</s>, in heaven?

children.text: kasminn ā yatatho jane ko vāṃ nadīnāṃ sacā ||
children.translated_text: Among what people do you travel here, and by which rivers are you accompanied?

children.text: kaṃ yāthaḥ kaṃ ha gacchathaḥ kam acchā yuñjāthe ratham
children.translated_text: To whom do you go, to whom indeed do you proceed, toward whom do you yoke your chariot?

children.text: kasya brahmāṇi raṇyatho vayaṃ vām uśmasīṣṭaye ||
children.translated_text: In whose prayers do you take delight? We long for you for aid.

children.text: pauraṃ ciddhy udaprutam paura paurāya jinvathaḥ
children.translated_text: You invigorate even <s>Paura</s>, who had plunged down, for the sake of <s>Paura</s>,

children.text: yad īṃ gṛbhītatātaye siṃham iva druhas pade ||
children.translated_text: when he was in the grip of capture, like a lion in the place of treachery.

children.text: pra cyavānāj jujuruṣo vavrim atkaṃ na muñcathaḥ
children.translated_text: From aged <s>Cyavāna</s> you stripped away the enclosing skin as one removes a garment,

children.text: yuvā yadī kṛthaḥ punar ā kāmam ṛṇve vadhvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when you made him young again, so that he might reach the bride he desired.

children.text: asti hi vām iha stotā smasi vāṃ saṃdṛśi śriye
children.translated_text: For here you have a singer; we are in your sight for beauty and splendor.

children.text: nū śrutam ma ā gatam avobhir vājinīvasū ||
children.translated_text: Now hear me and come with protections, O rich in vigorous prize.

children.text: ko vām adya purūṇām ā vavne martyānām
children.translated_text: Who among many mortals has won you today?

children.text: ko vipro vipravāhasā ko yajñair vājinīvasū ||
children.translated_text: Which inspired singer, O bearers of inspired men, which one with sacrifices, O rich in prize?

children.text: ā vāṃ ratho rathānāṃ yeṣṭho yātv aśvinā
children.translated_text: Let your chariot, the best of chariots, come here, O <s>Aśvins</s>;

children.text: purū cid asmayus tira āṅgūṣo martyeṣv ā ||
children.translated_text: let its call pass toward us through many mortals desiring you.

children.text: śam ū ṣu vām madhūyuvāsmākam astu carkṛtiḥ
children.translated_text: May our honey-seeking chant be auspicious for you.

children.text: arvācīnā vicetasā vibhiḥ śyeneva dīyatam ||
children.translated_text: With minds turned hither, fly here on your birds like falcons, O discerning ones.

children.text: aśvinā yaddha karhicicchuśrūyātam imaṃ havam
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, whenever you hear this invocation,

children.text: vasvīr ū ṣu vām bhujaḥ pṛñcanti su vām pṛcaḥ ||
children.translated_text: your fair supports fill up richly, and the pleasing praises are yours.

children.text: Chapter 429
prati priyatamaṃ rathaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vasuvāhanam
children.translated_text: The seer who praises you adorns in turn your beloved chariot,

children.text: stotā vām aśvināv ṛṣi stomena prati bhūṣati mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
children.translated_text: the virile, wealth-bearing chariot, with his hymn, O <s>Aśvins</s>; O sweet ones, hear my call.

children.text: atyāyātam aśvinā tiro viśvā ahaṃ sanā
children.translated_text: Come across all days from of old, O <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: dasrā hiraṇyavartanī suṣumnā sindhuvāhasā mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
children.translated_text: wonder-working ones with golden paths, well-minded and borne by streams; O sweet ones, hear my call.

children.text: ā no ratnāni bibhratāv aśvinā gacchataṃ yuvam
children.translated_text: Come to us, both of you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, bearing treasures;

children.text: rudrā hiraṇyavartanī juṣāṇā vājinīvasū mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
children.translated_text: ruddy ones with golden paths, accepting the praise, rich in prize; O sweet ones, hear my call.

children.text: suṣṭubho vāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū rathe vāṇīcy āhitā
children.translated_text: Well-praised songs have been placed for you on the chariot, O bull-strong rich ones;

children.text: uta vāṃ kakuho mṛgaḥ pṛkṣaḥ kṛṇoti vāpuṣo mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
children.translated_text: and your high-calling, nourishing steed makes beauty for itself; O sweet ones, hear my call.

children.text: bodhinmanasā rathyeṣirā havanaśrutā
children.translated_text: Awakened in mind, hastening on the road, hearers of the invocation,

children.text: vibhiś cyavānam aśvinā ni yātho advayāvinam mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
children.translated_text: with birds you come down to <s>Cyavāna</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>, the man free from deceit; O sweet ones, hear my call.

children.text: ā vāṃ narā manoyujo 'śvāsaḥ pruṣitapsavaḥ
children.translated_text: May the horses yoked by thought, their backs sprinkled with drops, bring you here, O men,

children.text: vayo vahantu pītaye saha sumnebhir aśvinā mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
children.translated_text: like birds, for drinking, together with favors, O <s>Aśvins</s>; O sweet ones, hear my call.

children.text: aśvināv eha gacchataṃ nāsatyā mā vi venatam
children.translated_text: Come here, O <s>Aśvins</s>, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>; do not turn away.

children.text: tiraś cid aryayā pari vartir yātam adābhyā mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
children.translated_text: Even across hostile spaces, travel around here, unconquered ones; O sweet ones, hear my call.

children.text: asmin yajñe adābhyā jaritāraṃ śubhas patī
children.translated_text: In this sacrifice, O unconquered <s>Aśvins</s>, lords of beauty,

children.text: avasyum aśvinā yuvaṃ gṛṇantam upa bhūṣatho mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
children.translated_text: you two adorn the singer who seeks help and praises you; O sweet ones, hear my call.

children.text: abhūd uṣā ruśatpaśur āgnir adhāyy ṛtviyaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Uṣas</s> has appeared with ruddy cattle, and <s>Agni</s>, fit for the rite, has been kindled;

children.text: ayoji vāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū ratho dasrāv amartyo mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
children.translated_text: your immortal chariot has been yoked, O bull-strong rich ones, O wondrous workers; O sweet ones, hear my call.

children.text: Chapter 430
ā bhāty agnir uṣasām anīkam ud viprāṇāṃ devayā vāco asthuḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> shines toward the face of the dawns; the inspired priests' godward voices have risen.

children.text: arvāñcā nūnaṃ rathyeha yātam pīpivāṃsam aśvinā gharmam accha ||
children.translated_text: Come now hither on the chariot, O <s>Aśvins</s>, to the swelling hot milk offering.

children.text: na saṃskṛtam pra mimīto gamiṣṭhānti nūnam aśvinopastuteha
children.translated_text: No unprepared man measures out your most direct path as you come, O praised <s>Aśvins</s>, here now.

children.text: divābhipitve 'vasāgamiṣṭhā praty avartiṃ dāśuṣe śambhaviṣṭhā ||
children.translated_text: By day, at the drinking time, come with help to the worshipper, returning most blessedly.

children.text: utā yātaṃ saṃgave prātar ahno madhyandina uditā sūryasya
children.translated_text: Come also at the morning pressing, at daybreak, at midday, and at the rising of the sun.

children.text: divā naktam avasā śantamena nedānīm pītir aśvinā tatāna ||
children.translated_text: By day and by night come with your most peaceful aid; now the draught has been spread for you, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: idaṃ hi vām pradivi sthānam oka ime gṛhā aśvinedaṃ duroṇam
children.translated_text: For this is your ancient station and dwelling; these are the houses, O <s>Aśvins</s>, this is your home.

children.text: ā no divo bṛhataḥ parvatād ādbhyo yātam iṣam ūrjaṃ vahantā ||
children.translated_text: Come to us from broad heaven, from the mountain, and from the waters, bearing refreshment and strength.

children.text: sam aśvinor avasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema
children.translated_text: With the fresh aid of the <s>Aśvins</s>, bringing delight and good guidance, may we come together.

children.text: ā no rayiṃ vahatam ota vīrān ā viśvāny amṛtā saubhagāni ||
children.translated_text: Bring wealth to us, and also heroes; bring all immortal good fortunes to us.

children.text: Chapter 431
prātaryāvāṇā prathamā yajadhvam purā gṛdhrād araruṣaḥ pibātaḥ
children.translated_text: O early-going <s>Aśvins</s>, be worshipped first; drink before the greedy, hostile one.

children.text: prātar hi yajñam aśvinā dadhāte pra śaṃsanti kavayaḥ pūrvabhājaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For in the morning they set forth the sacrifice for you, O <s>Aśvins</s>; the poets who have the first share proclaim you.

children.text: prātar yajadhvam aśvinā hinota na sāyam asti devayā ajuṣṭam
children.translated_text: Sacrifice to the <s>Aśvins</s> in the morning; impel them here. In the evening the godward rite is not so well accepted.

children.text: utānyo asmad yajate vi cāvaḥ pūrvaḥ pūrvo yajamāno vanīyān ||
children.translated_text: Another sacrificer may draw them away from us; the earlier and earlier worshipper is the more winning.

children.text: hiraṇyatvaṅ madhuvarṇo ghṛtasnuḥ pṛkṣo vahann ā ratho vartate vām
children.translated_text: Your chariot goes forth, golden-skinned, honey-colored, dripping with ghee, carrying nourishment.

children.text: manojavā aśvinā vātaraṃhā yenātiyātho duritāni viśvā ||
children.translated_text: It is swift as thought and rushes like the wind, O <s>Aśvins</s>; with it you pass beyond all hardships.

children.text: yo bhūyiṣṭhaṃ nāsatyābhyāṃ viveṣa caniṣṭham pitvo rarate vibhāge
children.translated_text: Whoever has turned most fully to the <s>Nāsatyas</s>, even with the smallest share of food at the distribution,

children.text: sa tokam asya pīparacchamībhir anūrdhvabhāsaḥ sadam it tuturyāt ||
children.translated_text: may he make his offspring thrive through his works, and may he always pass beyond those whose brightness does not rise.

children.text: sam aśvinor avasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema
children.translated_text: With the fresh aid of the <s>Aśvins</s>, bringing delight and good guidance, may we come together.

children.text: ā no rayiṃ vahatam ota vīrān ā viśvāny amṛtā saubhagāni ||
children.translated_text: Bring wealth to us, and also heroes; bring all immortal good fortunes to us.

children.text: Chapter 432
aśvināv eha gacchataṃ nāsatyā mā vi venatam
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, come here; O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, do not stay away.

children.text: haṃsāv iva patatam ā sutāṁ upa ||
children.translated_text: Like two swans, fly to the pressed <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: aśvinā hariṇāv iva gaurāv ivānu yavasam
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, like two tawny deer, like two bulls following the pasture,

children.text: haṃsāv iva patatam ā sutāṁ upa ||
children.translated_text: like two swans, fly to the pressed <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: aśvinā vājinīvasū juṣethāṃ yajñam iṣṭaye
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, rich in steeds and prizes, accept the sacrifice for our refreshment.

children.text: haṃsāv iva patatam ā sutāṁ upa ||
children.translated_text: Like two swans, fly to the pressed <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: atrir yad vām avarohann ṛbīsam ajohavīn nādhamāneva yoṣā
children.translated_text: When <s>Atri</s>, descending into the pit, called out to you like a helpless woman in distress,

children.text: śyenasya cij javasā nūtanenāgacchatam aśvinā śantamena ||
children.translated_text: with fresh speed, even like that of a falcon, you came, O <s>Aśvins</s>, with your most peaceful aid.

children.text: vi jihīṣva vanaspate yoniḥ sūṣyantyā iva
children.translated_text: Open apart, O forest-tree; the womb is like that of a woman giving birth.

children.text: śrutam me aśvinā havaṃ saptavadhriṃ ca muñcatam ||
children.translated_text: Hear my call, O <s>Aśvins</s>, and release <s>Saptavadhri</s>.

children.text: bhītāya nādhamānāya ṛṣaye saptavadhraye
children.translated_text: For the frightened, pleading seer <s>Saptavadhri</s>,

children.text: māyābhir aśvinā yuvaṃ vṛkṣaṃ saṃ ca vi cācathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you two, O <s>Aśvins</s>, by your wondrous powers opened and closed the tree.

children.text: yathā vātaḥ puṣkariṇīṃ samiṅgayati sarvataḥ
children.translated_text: As the wind stirs a lotus-pond on every side,

children.text: evā te garbha ejatu niraitu daśamāsyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: so may your embryo stir, and may the ten-month child come forth.

children.text: yathā vāto yathā vanaṃ yathā samudra ejati
children.translated_text: As the wind stirs, as the forest stirs, as the ocean stirs,

children.text: evā tvaṃ daśamāsya sahāvehi jarāyuṇā ||
children.translated_text: so you, ten-month child, come forth together with the afterbirth.

children.text: daśa māsāñchaśayānaḥ kumāro adhi mātari
children.translated_text: Having lain ten months as a child in the mother,

children.text: niraitu jīvo akṣato jīvo jīvantyā adhi ||
children.translated_text: let him come forth alive and unharmed, alive from the living woman.

children.text: Chapter 433
mahe no adya bodhayoṣo rāye divitmatī
children.translated_text: Awaken widely for us today, O <s>Uṣas</s>, rich in heavenly light, for the sake of wealth,

children.text: yathā cin no abodhayaḥ satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
children.translated_text: as you once awakened us for <s>Satyashravas Vayya</s>, O well-born one, rich in horses and kindly speech.

children.text: yā sunīthe śaucadrathe vy auccho duhitar divaḥ
children.translated_text: You who dawned forth for <s>Śaucadratha</s> of good guidance, O daughter of Heaven,

children.text: sā vy uccha sahīyasi satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
children.translated_text: dawn forth mightily for <s>Satyashravas Vayya</s>, O well-born one, rich in horses and kindly speech.

children.text: sā no adyābharadvasur vy ucchā duhitar divaḥ
children.translated_text: Bringing wealth, dawn for us today, O daughter of Heaven,

children.text: yo vy aucchaḥ sahīyasi satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
children.translated_text: you who dawned forth mightily for <s>Satyashravas Vayya</s>, O well-born one, rich in horses and kindly speech.

children.text: abhi ye tvā vibhāvari stomair gṛṇanti vahnayaḥ
children.translated_text: Those carriers who praise you, O shining one, with hymns,

children.text: maghair maghoni suśriyo dāmanvantaḥ surātayaḥ sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
children.translated_text: with gifts, O bountiful and beautiful one, possessors of gifts and liberal givers, O well-born one, rich in horses and kindly speech,

children.text: yac ciddhi te gaṇā ime chadayanti maghattaye
children.translated_text: for even these companies of yours attend you here for bounty,

children.text: pari cid vaṣṭayo dadhur dadato rādho ahrayaṃ sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
children.translated_text: and the surrounding settlements have placed unfailing reward upon the giver, O well-born one, rich in horses and kindly speech.

children.text: aiṣu dhā vīravad yaśa uṣo maghoni sūriṣu
children.translated_text: Among these patrons set heroic fame, O bountiful <s>Uṣas</s>,

children.text: ye no rādhāṃsy ahrayā maghavāno arāsata sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
children.translated_text: those generous ones who have bestowed unfailing gifts on us, O well-born one, rich in horses and kindly speech.

children.text: tebhyo dyumnam bṛhad yaśa uṣo maghony ā vaha
children.translated_text: Bring to them splendor and great fame, O bountiful <s>Uṣas</s>,

children.text: ye no rādhāṃsy aśvyā gavyā bhajanta sūrayaḥ sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
children.translated_text: the patrons who apportion to us rewards in horses and cattle, O well-born one, rich in horses and kindly speech.

children.text: uta no gomatīr iṣa ā vahā duhitar divaḥ
children.translated_text: And bring to us cow-rich refreshment, O daughter of Heaven,

children.text: sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ śukraiḥ śocadbhir arcibhiḥ sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
children.translated_text: together with the rays of the sun, with bright and blazing beams, O well-born one, rich in horses and kindly speech.

children.text: vy ucchā duhitar divo mā ciraṃ tanuthā apaḥ
children.translated_text: Dawn forth, O daughter of Heaven; do not long prolong your workings,

children.text: net tvā stenaṃ yathā ripuṃ tapāti sūro arciṣā sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
children.translated_text: lest the Sun scorch you with his beam like a thieving enemy, O well-born one, rich in horses and kindly speech.

children.text: etāvad ved uṣas tvam bhūyo vā dātum arhasi
children.translated_text: So much indeed is yours, O <s>Uṣas</s>, and you are able to give still more,

children.text: yā stotṛbhyo vibhāvary ucchantī na pramīyase sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
children.translated_text: you who, O shining one, while dawning for the singers, are not diminished, O well-born one, rich in horses and kindly speech.

children.text: Chapter 434
dyutadyāmānam bṛhatīm ṛtena ṛtāvarīm aruṇapsuṃ vibhātīm
children.translated_text: Brightly adorned, vast through <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), true to <s>ṛta</s>, ruddy-hued and shining forth,

children.text: devīm uṣasaṃ svar āvahantīm prati viprāso matibhir jarante ||
children.translated_text: the inspired poets praise with their thoughts the goddess <s>Uṣas</s>, who brings the sunlight.

children.text: eṣā janaṃ darśatā bodhayantī sugān pathaḥ kṛṇvatī yāty agre
children.translated_text: She, visible and awakening the people, making easy paths, goes in front.

children.text: bṛhadrathā bṛhatī viśvaminvoṣā jyotir yacchaty agre ahnām ||
children.translated_text: Great-charioted, great, and stirring all, <s>Uṣas</s> gives light at the beginning of the days.

children.text: eṣā gobhir aruṇebhir yujānāsredhantī rayim aprāyu cakre
children.translated_text: She, yoking her ruddy cows, has made wealth uninjured and undecaying.

children.text: patho radantī suvitāya devī puruṣṭutā viśvavārā vi bhāti ||
children.translated_text: Clearing the paths for good passage, the much-praised goddess, desired by all, shines forth.

children.text: eṣā vyenī bhavati dvibarhā āviṣkṛṇvānā tanvam purastāt
children.translated_text: She becomes visible, with a double covering, revealing her body before us.

children.text: ṛtasya panthām anv eti sādhu prajānatīva na diśo mināti ||
children.translated_text: She follows well the path of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order); knowing it, as it were, she does not transgress the directions.

children.text: eṣā śubhrā na tanvo vidānordhveva snātī dṛśaye no asthāt
children.translated_text: She, bright, as if mindful of her body, has stood up for us to see, like one rising from the bath.

children.text: apa dveṣo bādhamānā tamāṃsy uṣā divo duhitā jyotiṣāgāt ||
children.translated_text: Driving away hatreds and darknesses, <s>Uṣas</s>, daughter of Heaven, has come with light.

children.text: eṣā pratīcī duhitā divo nṝn yoṣeva bhadrā ni riṇīte apsaḥ
children.translated_text: She, facing us, daughter of Heaven, like a noble young woman, uncovers her beauties for men.

children.text: vyūrṇvatī dāśuṣe vāryāṇi punar jyotir yuvatiḥ pūrvathākaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Unveiling desirable things for the generous giver, the young woman has made the light again as before.

children.text: Chapter 435
yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiyo viprā viprasya bṛhato vipaścitaḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired priests yoke their mind, and they yoke their thoughts to the inspired, great, far-seeing one.

children.text: vi hotrā dadhe vayunāvid eka in mahī devasya savituḥ pariṣṭutiḥ ||
children.translated_text: He alone, knowing the ways, has assigned the <s>hotṛ</s> (priestly) offices; great is the praise surrounding the god <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: viśvā rūpāṇi prati muñcate kaviḥ prāsāvīd bhadraṃ dvipade catuṣpade
children.translated_text: The seer puts on all forms; he has brought forth what is good for two-footed and four-footed beings.

children.text: vi nākam akhyat savitā vareṇyo 'nu prayāṇam uṣaso vi rājati ||
children.translated_text: The desirable <s>Savitṛ</s> has looked upon the vault of heaven; he shines out after the advance of <s>Uṣas</s>.

children.text: yasya prayāṇam anv anya id yayur devā devasya mahimānam ojasā
children.translated_text: The other gods have followed the course of that god, his greatness, by their strength.

children.text: yaḥ pārthivāni vimame sa etaśo rajāṃsi devaḥ savitā mahitvanā ||
children.translated_text: He, the bright god <s>Savitṛ</s>, by his greatness measured out the earthly realms and the spaces.

children.text: uta yāsi savitas trīṇi rocanota sūryasya raśmibhiḥ sam ucyasi
children.translated_text: And you go, O <s>Savitṛ</s>, through the three shining realms; and you are joined with the rays of the sun.

children.text: uta rātrīm ubhayataḥ parīyasa uta mitro bhavasi deva dharmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: And you pass around night on both sides; and, O god, by your ordinances you become <s>Mitra</s>.

children.text: uteśiṣe prasavasya tvam eka id uta pūṣā bhavasi deva yāmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: And you alone rule over the impulse; and, O god, by your ways you become <s>Pūṣan</s>.

children.text: utedaṃ viśvam bhuvanaṃ vi rājasi śyāvāśvas te savita stomam ānaśe ||
children.translated_text: And you shine forth over this whole world; <s>Śyāvāśva</s> has reached your hymn, O <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: Chapter 436
tat savitur vṛṇīmahe vayaṃ devasya bhojanam
children.translated_text: We choose that bounty of the god <s>Savitṛ</s>,

children.text: śreṣṭhaṃ sarvadhātamaṃ turam bhagasya dhīmahi ||
children.translated_text: the best, all-supporting, swift gift of <s>Bhaga</s>; we set our thought on it.

children.text: asya hi svayaśastaraṃ savituḥ kaccana priyam
children.translated_text: For no one at all diminishes this dear thing of <s>Savitṛ</s>,

children.text: na minanti svarājyam ||
children.translated_text: his more glorious self-rule.

children.text: sa hi ratnāni dāśuṣe suvāti savitā bhagaḥ
children.translated_text: For <s>Savitṛ</s>, as <s>Bhaga</s>, impels treasures for the giver.

children.text: tam bhāgaṃ citram īmahe ||
children.translated_text: We ask for that bright portion.

children.text: adyā no deva savitaḥ prajāvat sāvīḥ saubhagam
children.translated_text: Today, O god <s>Savitṛ</s>, impel for us good fortune rich in offspring.

children.text: parā duṣṣvapnyaṃ suva ||
children.translated_text: Drive away the evil dream.

children.text: viśvāni deva savitar duritāni parā suva
children.translated_text: O god <s>Savitṛ</s>, drive all evils far away.

children.text: yad bhadraṃ tan na ā suva ||
children.translated_text: Whatever is auspicious, bring that to us.

children.text: anāgaso aditaye devasya savituḥ save
children.translated_text: Sinless, in the impulse of the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, for <s>Aditi</s>,

children.text: viśvā vāmāni dhīmahi ||
children.translated_text: we set our thoughts on all lovely things.

children.text: ā viśvadevaṃ satpatiṃ sūktair adyā vṛṇīmahe
children.translated_text: Today with hymns we choose <s>Savitṛ</s>, lord of truth, belonging to all the gods,

children.text: satyasavaṃ savitāram ||
children.translated_text: whose impulse is true.

children.text: ya ime ubhe ahanī pura ety aprayucchan
children.translated_text: He who goes before these two days, never remiss,

children.text: svādhīr devaḥ savitā ||
children.translated_text: the self-governing god <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: ya imā viśvā jātāny āśrāvayati ślokena
children.translated_text: He who makes all these born beings hear by his song,

children.text: pra ca suvāti savitā ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Savitṛ</s> impels them forth.

children.text: Chapter 437
acchā vada tavasaṃ gīrbhir ābhi stuhi parjanyaṃ namasā vivāsa
children.translated_text: Speak toward the mighty one; with these songs praise <s>Parjanya</s>, and honor him with reverence.

children.text: kanikradad vṛṣabho jīradānū reto dadhāty oṣadhīṣu garbham ||
children.translated_text: Bellowing, the bull of lively gift places seed, an embryo, among the plants.

children.text: vi vṛkṣān hanty uta hanti rakṣaso viśvam bibhāya bhuvanam mahāvadhāt
children.translated_text: He shatters the trees, and he shatters the demons; the whole world fears his great weapon.

children.text: utānāgā īṣate vṛṣṇyāvato yat parjanya stanayan hanti duṣkṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even the innocent flee from the powerful one when, O <s>Parjanya</s>, thundering, you strike down the wrongdoers.

children.text: rathīva kaśayāśvāṁ abhikṣipann āvir dūtān kṛṇute varṣyāṁ aha
children.translated_text: Like a charioteer lashing his horses with a whip, he makes his rain-bringing messengers appear.

children.text: dūrāt siṃhasya stanathā ud īrate yat parjanyaḥ kṛṇute varṣyaṃ nabhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: From afar the roars of a lion arise when <s>Parjanya</s> makes the rain-cloud.

children.text: pra vātā vānti patayanti vidyuta ud oṣadhīr jihate pinvate svaḥ
children.translated_text: The winds blow forth, the lightnings fall, the plants rise up, and the heavenly space swells.

children.text: irā viśvasmai bhuvanāya jāyate yat parjanyaḥ pṛthivīṃ retasāvati ||
children.translated_text: Nourishment is born for the whole world when <s>Parjanya</s> impregnates the earth with seed.

children.text: yasya vrate pṛthivī nannamīti yasya vrate śaphavaj jarbhurīti
children.translated_text: Under whose command the earth bows low, under whose command the hoofed animals stir restlessly,

children.text: yasya vrata oṣadhīr viśvarūpāḥ sa naḥ parjanya mahi śarma yaccha ||
children.translated_text: under whose command the plants take every form: may that <s>Parjanya</s> grant us great shelter.

children.text: divo no vṛṣṭim maruto rarīdhvam pra pinvata vṛṣṇo aśvasya dhārāḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Maruts</s>, grant us rain from heaven; make the streams of the virile steed swell full.

children.text: arvāṅ etena stanayitnunehy apo niṣiñcann asuraḥ pitā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Come hither with this thunderbolt, pouring down waters, O <s>Asura</s>, our father.

children.text: abhi kranda stanaya garbham ā dhā udanvatā pari dīyā rathena
children.translated_text: Roar out, thunder, set the embryo in place; drive around with your water-bearing chariot.

children.text: dṛtiṃ su karṣa viṣitaṃ nyañcaṃ samā bhavantūdvato nipādāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Draw the loosened water-skin well downward; let the uplands and lowlands become level together.

children.text: mahāntaṃ kośam ud acā ni ṣiñca syandantāṃ kulyā viṣitāḥ purastāt
children.translated_text: Lift up the great vessel and pour it downward; let the released channels stream forward.

children.text: ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī vy undhi suprapāṇam bhavatv aghnyābhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Moisten heaven and earth with ghee; let there be good drinking for the cows.

children.text: yat parjanya kanikradat stanayan haṃsi duṣkṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Parjanya</s>, bellowing and thundering, you strike the wrongdoers,

children.text: pratīdaṃ viśvam modate yat kiṃ ca pṛthivyām adhi ||
children.translated_text: then this whole world, whatever is upon the earth, rejoices before you.

children.text: avarṣīr varṣam ud u ṣū gṛbhāyākar dhanvāny atyetavā u
children.translated_text: You have rained the rain; now hold it up. You have made the dry lands passable.

children.text: ajījana oṣadhīr bhojanāya kam uta prajābhyo 'vido manīṣām ||
children.translated_text: You have brought forth plants for food; and you have won praise from living creatures.

children.text: Chapter 438
baﾱ itthā parvatānāṃ khidram bibharṣi pṛthivi
children.translated_text: Thus, O <s>Pṛthivī</s>, you bear the broken places of the mountains.

children.text: pra yā bhūmim pravatvati mahnā jinoṣi mahini ||
children.translated_text: When, by your greatness, O mighty one, you urge onward the sloping earth.

children.text: stomāsas tvā vicāriṇi prati ṣṭobhanty aktubhiḥ
children.translated_text: The hymns answer you, O far-ranging one, through the nights.

children.text: pra yā vājaṃ na heṣantam perum asyasy arjuni ||
children.translated_text: They go forth like a prize-neighing steed, O bright one, toward your abundant power.

children.text: dṛﾱhā cid yā vanaspatīn kṣmayā dardharṣy ojasā
children.translated_text: Even the firm forest trees you shake down to the ground with your might,

children.text: yat te abhrasya vidyuto divo varṣanti vṛṣṭayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when the rains from heaven pour down from the lightnings of your cloud.

children.text: Chapter 439
pra samrāje bṛhad arcā gabhīram brahma priyaṃ varuṇāya śrutāya
children.translated_text: Sing aloud a lofty, deep, dear <s>brahman</s> (sacred utterance) for king <s>Varuṇa</s>, the renowned.

children.text: vi yo jaghāna śamiteva carmopastire pṛthivīṃ sūryāya ||
children.translated_text: He spread out the earth for the sun, like a slaughterer stretching a hide.

children.text: vaneṣu vy antarikṣaṃ tatāna vājam arvatsu paya usriyāsu
children.translated_text: In the forests he stretched out the midspace; he set strength in horses and milk in cows.

children.text: hṛtsu kratuṃ varuṇo apsv agniṃ divi sūryam adadhāt somam adrau ||
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s> placed resolve in hearts, <s>Agni</s> in the waters, the sun in heaven, and <s>Soma</s> on the mountain.

children.text: nīcīnabāraṃ varuṇaḥ kabandham pra sasarja rodasī antarikṣam
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s> released the downward-opening vessel, the cloud, into heaven and earth and the midspace.

children.text: tena viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā yavaṃ na vṛṣṭir vy unatti bhūma ||
children.translated_text: With it, as king of the whole world, he moistens the ground as rain moistens barley.

children.text: unatti bhūmim pṛthivīm uta dyāṃ yadā dugdhaṃ varuṇo vaṣṭy ād it
children.translated_text: He moistens the ground, the broad earth and heaven, whenever <s>Varuṇa</s> wishes the milk to be drawn.

children.text: sam abhreṇa vasata parvatāsas taviṣīyantaḥ śrathayanta vīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then the mountains clothe themselves with cloud; the strong powers swell and let loose their force.

children.text: imām ū ṣv āsurasya śrutasya mahīm māyāṃ varuṇasya pra vocam
children.translated_text: Now I proclaim this great wondrous power of the renowned <s>Asura</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: māneneva tasthivāṁ antarikṣe vi yo mame pṛthivīṃ sūryeṇa ||
children.translated_text: Standing in the midspace as if by measure, he measured out the earth with the sun.

children.text: imām ū nu kavitamasya māyām mahīṃ devasya nakir ā dadharṣa
children.translated_text: Now no one has dared to assail this great wondrous power of the most poetic god:

children.text: ekaṃ yad udnā na pṛṇanty enīr āsiñcantīr avanayaḥ samudram ||
children.translated_text: that the rivers, pouring down, do not fill the one ocean with their water.

children.text: aryamyaṃ varuṇa mitryaṃ vā sakhāyaṃ vā sadam id bhrātaraṃ vā
children.translated_text: Whether against a noble kinsman, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, or a <s>Mitra</s>-like friend, or a companion, or ever against a brother,

children.text: veśaṃ vā nityaṃ varuṇāraṇaṃ vā yat sīm āgaś cakṛmā śiśrathas tat ||
children.translated_text: or against a neighbor, always, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, or against a stranger, whatever offense we have committed, loosen that.

children.text: kitavāso yad riripur na dīvi yad vā ghā satyam uta yan na vidma
children.translated_text: When gamblers have cheated at dice, or whatever we have truly done, and whatever we do not know,

children.text: sarvā tā vi ṣya śithireva devādhā te syāma varuṇa priyāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: all those things loosen away like loosened bonds, O god; then may we be dear to you, O <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: Chapter 440
indrāgnī yam avatha ubhā vājeṣu martyam
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, the mortal whom you both aid in the contests,

children.text: dṛﾱhā cit sa pra bhedati dyumnā vāṇīr iva tritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he breaks open even firm things by his powers, as <s>Trita</s> did the enclosures.

children.text: yā pṛtanāsu duṣṭarā yā vājeṣu śravāyyā
children.translated_text: Those powers that are hard to cross in battles, and those that win renown in contests,

children.text: yā pañca carṣaṇīr abhīndrāgnī tā havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: those that extend over the five peoples, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, we call upon them.

children.text: tayor id amavacchavas tigmā didyun maghonoḥ
children.translated_text: Indeed the forceful might of those two bounteous ones is sharp as lightning;

children.text: prati druṇā gabhastyor gavāṃ vṛtraghna eṣate ||
children.translated_text: against the wooden barriers it rushes in their hands, seeking the cows, O slayers of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: tā vām eṣe rathānām indrāgnī havāmahe
children.translated_text: Those two of yours I seek for the chariots; O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, we call upon you,

children.text: patī turasya rādhaso vidvāṃsā girvaṇastamā ||
children.translated_text: lords of swift bounty, knowing ones, most delighted by songs.

children.text: tā vṛdhantāv anu dyūn martāya devāv adabhā
children.translated_text: Those two gods, growing day by day and not deceiving, for the mortal,

children.text: arhantā cit puro dadhe 'ṃśeva devāv arvate ||
children.translated_text: I set before me, worthy as they are, like portions for the swift steed.

children.text: evendrāgnibhyām ahāvi havyaṃ śūṣyaṃ ghṛtaṃ na pūtam adribhiḥ
children.translated_text: Thus an oblation has been offered to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, a strong offering, purified like ghee with the pressing stones.

children.text: tā sūriṣu śravo bṛhad rayiṃ gṛṇatsu didhṛtam iṣaṃ gṛṇatsu didhṛtam ||
children.translated_text: Among the patrons, uphold great fame and wealth for the singers; uphold nourishment for the singers.

children.text: Chapter 441
pra vo mahe matayo yantu viṣṇave marutvate girijā evayāmarut
children.translated_text: Let your thoughts go forth to great <s>Viṣṇu</s>, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, to <s>Evayāmarut</s>, born from the mountains.

children.text: pra śardhāya prayajyave sukhādaye tavase bhandadiṣṭaye dhunivratāya śavase ||
children.translated_text: Let them go forth to the troop worthy of sacrifice, easy to seat, mighty, most blessed, of roaring vow and power.

children.text: pra ye jātā mahinā ye ca nu svayam pra vidmanā bruvata evayāmarut
children.translated_text: They who were born by greatness, and who now of themselves speak forth through knowledge, O <s>Evayāmarut</s>,

children.text: kratvā tad vo maruto nādhṛṣe śavo dānā mahnā tad eṣām adhṛṣṭāso nādrayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: by your resolve, O <s>Maruts</s>, that power of yours is not to be overborne; by gift and greatness, theirs is unassailable like mountains.

children.text: pra ye divo bṛhataḥ śṛṇvire girā suśukvānaḥ subhva evayāmarut
children.translated_text: They who from broad heaven have been heard by the song, brightly shining and fair-formed, O <s>Evayāmarut</s>,

children.text: na yeṣām irī sadhastha īṣṭa āṃ agnayo na svavidyutaḥ pra syandrāso dhunīnām ||
children.translated_text: whose common seat no assault reaches, like fires with their own lightning, the streaming ones among the roarers.

children.text: sa cakrame mahato nir urukramaḥ samānasmāt sadasa evayāmarut
children.translated_text: He, the wide-striding one, strode forth from the great common seat, O <s>Evayāmarut</s>.

children.text: yadāyukta tmanā svād adhi ṣṇubhir viṣpardhaso vimahaso jigāti śevṛdho nṛbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: When he yoked himself from his own nature with his rays, he goes, surpassing rivals, great in greatness, with men who increase welfare.

children.text: svano na vo 'mavān rejayad vṛṣā tveṣo yayis taviṣa evayāmarut
children.translated_text: Your sound, powerful as a bull, the fierce hastening one, shook with force, O <s>Evayāmarut</s>.

children.text: yenā sahanta ṛñjata svarociṣa sthāraśmāno hiraṇyayāḥ svāyudhāsa iṣmiṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: By it the self-radiant ones prevail and set themselves in motion, firm-reined, golden, armed with their own weapons, impetuous.

children.text: apāro vo mahimā vṛddhaśavasas tveṣaṃ śavo 'vatv evayāmarut
children.translated_text: Boundless is your greatness, O you of increasing might; may your fierce power protect us, O <s>Evayāmarut</s>.

children.text: sthātāro hi prasitau saṃdṛśi sthana te na uruṣyatā nidaḥ śuśukvāṃso nāgnayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For you stand in the command and in sight; therefore protect us from revilers, shining like fires.

children.text: te rudrāsaḥ sumakhā agnayo yathā tuvidyumnā avantv evayāmarut
children.translated_text: May those <s>Rudras</s>, well-sacrificing like fires and rich in bright power, aid us, O <s>Evayāmarut</s>.

children.text: dīrgham pṛthu paprathe sadma pārthivaṃ yeṣām ajmeṣv ā mahaḥ śardhāṃsy adbhutainasām ||
children.translated_text: The earthly seat of those whose wondrous hosts are great in the contests has spread long and broad.

children.text: adveṣo no maruto gātum etana śrotā havaṃ jaritur evayāmarut
children.translated_text: Without hatred, O <s>Maruts</s>, come to us with a path; hear the singer's call, O <s>Evayāmarut</s>.

children.text: viṣṇor mahaḥ samanyavo yuyotana smad rathyo na daṃsanāpa dveṣāṃsi sanutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In one accord with great <s>Viṣṇu</s>, ward hatreds away from us, as chariot-fighters ward off hostile acts.

children.text: gantā no yajñaṃ yajñiyāḥ suśami śrotā havam arakṣa evayāmarut
children.translated_text: Come to our sacrifice, O worshipful ones, with good help; hear the call without harm, O <s>Evayāmarut</s>.

children.text: jyeṣṭhāso na parvatāso vyomani yūyaṃ tasya pracetasaḥ syāta durdhartavo nidaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like the eldest mountains in the sky, may you belong to that discerning man, hard for revilers to withstand.

children.text: Chapter 442
tvaṃ hy agne prathamo manotāsyā dhiyo abhavo dasma hotā
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Agni</s>, were the first thinker; you became the wondrous <s>hotṛ</s> (priest) of this thought.

children.text: tvaṃ sīṃ vṛṣann akṛṇor duṣṭarītu saho viśvasmai sahase sahadhyai ||
children.translated_text: You, O bull, made it hard to cross, strength for every strength, so that it might prevail.

children.text: adhā hotā ny asīdo yajīyān iﾱas pada iṣayann īḍyaḥ san
children.translated_text: Then, as the more worshipful <s>hotṛ</s> (priest), you sat down in <s>Iḷā</s>'s place, impelling refreshment while worthy of praise.

children.text: taṃ tvā naraḥ prathamaṃ devayanto maho rāye citayanto anu gman ||
children.translated_text: Men, desiring the gods and seeking great wealth, followed you first.

children.text: vṛteva yantam bahubhir vasavyais tve rayiṃ jāgṛvāṃso anu gman
children.translated_text: Like one turning with many desirable goods, they followed wealth in you, keeping watch for it.

children.text: ruśantam agniṃ darśatam bṛhantaṃ vapāvantaṃ viśvahā dīdivāṃsam ||
children.translated_text: They followed bright <s>Agni</s>, visible, great, rich in form, shining every day.

children.text: padaṃ devasya namasā vyantaḥ śravasyavaḥ śrava āpann amṛktam
children.translated_text: Approaching with homage the footprint of the god, the seekers of fame obtained stainless renown.

children.text: nāmāni cid dadhire yajñiyāni bhadrāyāṃ te raṇayanta saṃdṛṣṭau ||
children.translated_text: They even took on sacrificial names; they rejoiced in your auspicious sight.

children.text: tvāṃ vardhanti kṣitayaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tvāṃ rāya ubhayāso janānām
children.translated_text: The dwellers on earth strengthen you; both kinds of wealth among peoples strengthen you.

children.text: tvaṃ trātā taraṇe cetyo bhūḥ pitā mātā sadam in mānuṣāṇām ||
children.translated_text: You became the savior, to be recognized at the crossing; you are always father and mother of human beings.

children.text: saparyeṇyaḥ sa priyo vikṣv agnir hotā mandro ni ṣasādā yajīyān
children.translated_text: He is to be served, dear among the settlements; <s>Agni</s>, the pleasant <s>hotṛ</s> (priest), sat down, more fit for sacrifice.

children.text: taṃ tvā vayaṃ dama ā dīdivāṃsam upa jñubādho namasā sadema ||
children.translated_text: May we, bending the knee, sit near you at home, blazing, with homage.

children.text: taṃ tvā vayaṃ sudhyo navyam agne sumnāyava īmahe devayantaḥ
children.translated_text: We of good thoughts, seeking favor and desiring the gods, ask you anew, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ viśo anayo dīdyāno divo agne bṛhatā rocanena ||
children.translated_text: You led the peoples, shining brightly, O <s>Agni</s>, with the great light of heaven.

children.text: viśāṃ kaviṃ viśpatiṃ śaśvatīnāṃ nitośanaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnām
children.translated_text: The seer of the clans, lord of the everlasting clans, the vigorous bull of men, driving them on,

children.text: pretīṣaṇim iṣayantam pāvakaṃ rājantam agniṃ yajataṃ rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: the forward-impelling, impelling, purifying, reigning <s>Agni</s>, the worshipful one of riches.

children.text: so agna īje śaśame ca marto yas ta ānaṭ samidhā havyadātim
children.translated_text: That mortal, O <s>Agni</s>, has worshipped and labored, who has brought to you the oblation-gift with kindling wood,

children.text: ya āhutim pari vedā namobhir viśvet sa vāmā dadhate tvotaḥ ||
children.translated_text: who has attended the offering with homages; protected by you, he receives all desirable things.

children.text: asmā u te mahi mahe vidhema namobhir agne samidhota havyaiḥ
children.translated_text: For him, and for you the great one, we would perform great worship with homages, O <s>Agni</s>, with fuel and oblations.

children.text: vedī sūno sahaso gīrbhir ukthair ā te bhadrāyāṃ sumatau yatema ||
children.translated_text: O son of strength, with songs and hymns we would strive toward your auspicious favor.

children.text: ā yas tatantha rodasī vi bhāsā śravobhiś ca śravasyas tarutraḥ
children.translated_text: You who have stretched heaven and earth apart with your shining, conquering with fame and worthy of fame,

children.text: bṛhadbhir vājai sthavirebhir asme revadbhir agne vitaraṃ vi bhāhi ||
children.translated_text: with great, firm, wealth-giving prizes, shine out broadly for us, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: nṛvad vaso sadam id dhehy asme bhūri tokāya tanayāya paśvaḥ
children.translated_text: O good <s>Vasu</s>, place in us always manly strength, much for offspring, descendants, and cattle.

children.text: pūrvīr iṣo bṛhatīr āreaghā asme bhadrā sauśravasāni santu ||
children.translated_text: May many broad refreshments, free from harm, and auspicious renowns be ours.

children.text: purūṇy agne purudhā tvāyā vasūni rājan vasutā te aśyām
children.translated_text: Many goods, O <s>Agni</s>, in many ways are yours; O king, may I attain your treasure-richness.

children.text: purūṇi hi tve puruvāra santy agne vasu vidhate rājani tve ||
children.translated_text: For many choice treasures are in you, O <s>Agni</s>; treasure is in you, the king, for the worshipper.

children.text: Chapter 443
tvaṃ hi kṣaitavad yaśo 'gne mitro na patyase
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Agni</s>, rule over fame that wins dwelling, like <s>Mitra</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ vicarṣaṇe śravo vaso puṣṭiṃ na puṣyasi ||
children.translated_text: You, O treasure, wide-seeing among peoples, foster renown as one fosters nourishment.

children.text: tvāṃ hi ṣmā carṣaṇayo yajñebhir gīrbhir īﾱate
children.translated_text: For the peoples praise you in sacrifices with songs,

children.text: tvāṃ vājī yāty avṛko rajastūr viśvacarṣaṇiḥ ||
children.translated_text: and the unharmful prize-winning steed, traversing the realms, goes to you, O all-observing one.

children.text: sajoṣas tvā divo naro yajñasya ketum indhate
children.translated_text: Together in good will, men kindle you from heaven as the sign of sacrifice,

children.text: yad dha sya mānuṣo janaḥ sumnāyur juhve adhvare ||
children.translated_text: when this human people, desiring favor, calls upon you at the rite.

children.text: ṛdhad yas te sudānave dhiyā martaḥ śaśamate
children.translated_text: The mortal who worships you with insight, O bounteous giver, will prosper.

children.text: ūtī ṣa bṛhato divo dviṣo aṃho na tarati ||
children.translated_text: By the aid from broad heaven he crosses hatreds and distress, as one crosses over danger.

children.text: samidhā yas ta āhutiṃ niśitim martyo naśat
children.translated_text: The mortal who reaches your sharpened oblation with kindling wood

children.text: vayāvantaṃ sa puṣyati kṣayam agne śatāyuṣam ||
children.translated_text: fosters a dwelling rich in vital power, O <s>Agni</s>, one of a hundred years.

children.text: tveṣas te dhūma ṛṇvati divi ṣañ chukra ātataḥ
children.translated_text: Your vehement smoke rises up, stretched bright in heaven.

children.text: sūro na hi dyutā tvaṃ kṛpā pāvaka rocase ||
children.translated_text: Like the sun with its shining, you gleam with beauty, O purifier.

children.text: adhā hi vikṣv īḍyo 'si priyo no atithiḥ
children.translated_text: Therefore you are worthy of praise among the clans, dear to us as a guest.

children.text: raṇvaḥ purīva jūryaḥ sūnur na trayayāyyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Delightful like a city, worthy of being maintained, like a son to be protected threefold.

children.text: kratvā hi droṇe ajyase 'gne vājī na kṛtvyaḥ
children.translated_text: For by will you are anointed in the vessel, O <s>Agni</s>, like a steed fit for action.

children.text: parijmeva svadhā gayo 'tyo na hvāryaḥ śiśuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like one going around by his own power, like a horse not to be checked, a child not to be harmed.

children.text: tvaṃ tyā cid acyutāgne paśur na yavase
children.translated_text: Even those firm stations of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, are like cattle at pasture,

children.text: dhāmā ha yat te ajara vanā vṛścanti śikvasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when your ageless flames cut through the forests.

children.text: veṣi hy adhvarīyatām agne hotā dame viśām
children.translated_text: For you enter among those performing the rite, O <s>Agni</s>, as <s>hotṛ</s> (priest) in the houses of the clans.

children.text: samṛdho viśpate kṛṇu juṣasva havyam aṅgiraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Make them prosperous, O lord of the people; accept the oblation, O <s>Aṅgiras</s>.

children.text: acchā no mitramaho deva devān agne vocaḥ sumatiṃ rodasyoḥ
children.translated_text: O god <s>Agni</s>, great in friendship, speak favorably for us to the gods and win the good will of heaven and earth.

children.text: vīhi svastiṃ sukṣitiṃ divo nṝn dviṣo aṃhāṃsi duritā tarema tā tarema tavāvasā tarema ||
children.translated_text: Go toward well-being and good dwelling, toward the men of heaven; may we cross hatreds, distresses, and evils; may we cross them, may we cross them with your help.

children.text: Chapter 444
agne sa kṣeṣad ṛtapā ṛtejā uru jyotir naśate devayuṣ ṭe
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, the guardian of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), born of <s>ṛta</s>, will dwell securely; the god-loving one will attain wide light from you.

children.text: yaṃ tvam mitreṇa varuṇaḥ sajoṣā deva pāsi tyajasā martam aṃhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The mortal whom you, O god, together with <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, protect by your strength, you shield from distress.

children.text: īje yajñebhiḥ śaśame śamībhir ṛdhadvārāyāgnaye dadāśa
children.translated_text: He has worshipped with sacrifices, labored with acts of service, and given to <s>Agni</s>, whose doors are prosperity.

children.text: evā cana taṃ yaśasām ajuṣṭir nāṃho martaṃ naśate na pradṛptiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thus no lack of fame, no distress, and no arrogance reaches that mortal.

children.text: sūro na yasya dṛśatir arepā bhīmā yad eti śucatas ta ā dhīḥ
children.translated_text: Like the sun, whose sight is stainless, when your terrible thought goes blazing forth,

children.text: heṣasvataḥ śurudho nāyam aktoḥ kutrā cid raṇvo vasatir vanejāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the joyful forest-born one has his dwelling somewhere in the night, with roaring sounds and rushing force.

children.text: tigmaṃ cid ema mahi varpo asya bhasad aśvo na yamasāna āsā
children.translated_text: We approach the sharp and mighty form of this one; like a champing horse with his mouth,

children.text: vijehamānaḥ paraśur na jihvāṃ dravir na drāvayati dāru dhakṣat ||
children.translated_text: his tongue, like an axe swinging wide, like a runner, makes the timber run as it burns.

children.text: sa id asteva prati dhād asiṣyañ chiśīta tejo 'yaso na dhārām
children.translated_text: He sits like an archer, aiming his shaft; he sharpens his blaze like the edge of iron.

children.text: citradhrajatir aratir yo aktor ver na druṣadvā raghupatmajaṃhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: He of bright banner, restless in the night, with birdlike, swift-flying stride, does not injure the wooden posts.

children.text: sa īṃ rebho na prati vasta usrāḥ śociṣā rārapīti mitramahāḥ
children.translated_text: He, roaring like a bellowing one, crackles against the dawns with flame, great in friendship.

children.text: naktaṃ ya īm aruṣo yo divā nṝn amartyo aruṣo yo divā nṝn ||
children.translated_text: By night he is ruddy; by day he is ruddy among men, immortal among men by day.

children.text: divo na yasya vidhato navīnod vṛṣā rukṣa oṣadhīṣu nūnot
children.translated_text: The bull, whose new impulse is for the worshipper from heaven, has bellowed among the trees and plants.

children.text: ghṛṇā na yo dhrajasā patmanā yann ā rodasī vasunā daṃ supatnī ||
children.translated_text: He, going by heat and flashing course like sunshine, has filled both heaven and earth, the fair pair, with wealth.

children.text: dhāyobhir vā yo yujyebhir arkair vidyun na davidyot svebhiḥ śuṣmaiḥ
children.translated_text: Or he flashes like lightning with nourishing powers, with chants that are yoked and with his own strengths.

children.text: śardho vā yo marutāṃ tatakṣa ṛbhur na tveṣo rabhasāno adyaut ||
children.translated_text: Or, like a host of the <s>Maruts</s>, he has been fashioned; like an <s>Ṛbhu</s>, brilliant and impetuous, he has shone.

children.text: Chapter 445
yathā hotar manuṣo devatātā yajñebhiḥ sūno sahaso yajāsi
children.translated_text: As <s>hotṛ</s>, O son of strength, you sacrifice with rites for men at the divine service.

children.text: evā no adya samanā samānān uśann agna uśato yakṣi devān ||
children.translated_text: So today, O willing <s>Agni</s>, sacrifice to the gods, who are of one mind and equally willing for us.

children.text: sa no vibhāvā cakṣaṇir na vastor agnir vandāru vedyaś cano dhāt
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s>, radiant, seeing like the dawn, praiseworthy and knowable, bestow delight on us.

children.text: viśvāyur yo amṛto martyeṣūṣarbhud bhūd atithir jātavedāḥ ||
children.translated_text: He of universal life, immortal among mortals, awakening at dawn, has become the guest, <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: dyāvo na yasya panayanty abhvam bhāsāṃsi vaste sūryo na śukraḥ
children.translated_text: Heaven and earth praise his mighty power; like the sun, he clothes himself in shining lights.

children.text: vi ya inoty ajaraḥ pāvako 'śnasya cic chiśnathat pūrvyāṇi ||
children.translated_text: The ageless purifier who sets all in motion has shattered even the ancient things of the eater.

children.text: vadmā hi sūno asy admasadvā cakre agnir januṣājmānnam
children.translated_text: For we have proclaimed this word of the son of strength: <s>Agni</s> has made his birth-place in the place of food.

children.text: sa tvaṃ na ūrjasana ūrjaṃ dhā rājeva jer avṛke kṣeṣy antaḥ ||
children.translated_text: So you, giver of strength, set strength in us; like a victorious king, dwell unharmed within us.

children.text: nitikti yo vāraṇam annam atti vāyur na rāṣṭry aty ety aktūn
children.translated_text: He who, sharpening himself, eats the enclosing food goes through the nights like the wind through a kingdom.

children.text: turyāma yas ta ādiśām arātīr atyo na hrutaḥ patataḥ parihrut ||
children.translated_text: May we overcome the hostilities that are directed against you, like an unturned horse overcoming those who fly and turn away.

children.text: ā sūryo na bhānumadbhir arkair agne tatantha rodasī vi bhāsā
children.translated_text: Like the sun with radiant hymns, O <s>Agni</s>, you have stretched out heaven and earth with light.

children.text: citro nayat pari tamāṃsy aktaḥ śociṣā patmann auśijo na dīyan ||
children.translated_text: Bright, with flame on your course like an <s>Auśija</s> soaring, you lead around the darknesses of night.

children.text: tvāṃ hi mandratamam arkaśokair vavṛmahe mahi naḥ śroṣy agne
children.translated_text: For with hymns bright as flame we have chosen you, the most pleasing one; hear our great call, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: indraṃ na tvā śavasā devatā vāyum pṛṇanti rādhasā nṛtamāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The best men fill you with gifts, as they fill <s>Indra</s> with might, or the god <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: nū no agne 'vṛkebhiḥ svasti veṣi rāyaḥ pathibhiḥ parṣy aṃhaḥ
children.translated_text: Now, O <s>Agni</s>, come to us with harmless paths of well-being, and carry us across distress to riches.

children.text: tā sūribhyo gṛṇate rāsi sumnam madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Grant those favors to the patrons and to the singer; may we rejoice for a hundred winters, rich in heroes.

children.text: Chapter 446
huve vaḥ sūnuṃ sahaso yuvānam adroghavācam matibhir yaviṣṭham
children.translated_text: I call your young son of strength, youngest, whose speech is not deceitful, with my thoughts.

children.text: ya invati draviṇāni pracetā viśvavārāṇi puruvāro adhruk ||
children.translated_text: He, wise and rich in many choices, the undeceiving one, wins all desirable treasures.

children.text: tve vasūni purvaṇīka hotar doṣā vastor erire yajñiyāsaḥ
children.translated_text: In you, O many-faced <s>hotṛ</s>, the sacrificial riches have been set in motion by night and by day.

children.text: kṣāmeva viśvā bhuvanāni yasmin saṃ saubhagāni dadhire pāvake ||
children.translated_text: As upon the earth, all beings have placed their good fortunes together in the purifier.

children.text: tvaṃ vikṣu pradivaḥ sīda āsu kratvā rathīr abhavo vāryāṇām
children.translated_text: From olden time sit among these clans; by your will you have become the charioteer of desirable goods.

children.text: ata inoṣi vidhate cikitvo vy ānuṣag jātavedo vasūni ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, O knowing <s>Jātavedas</s>, you bring treasures continually to the worshipper.

children.text: yo naḥ sanutyo abhidāsad agne yo antaro mitramaho vanuṣyāt
children.translated_text: Whoever secretly plots against us, O <s>Agni</s>, or whoever from within, O great as <s>Mitra</s>, would attack us,

children.text: tam ajarebhir vṛṣabhis tava svais tapā tapiṣṭha tapasā tapasvān ||
children.translated_text: burn him with your own undecaying bulls, O most burning one, powerful with heat.

children.text: yas te yajñena samidhā ya ukthair arkebhiḥ sūno sahaso dadāśat
children.translated_text: Whoever has served you with sacrifice, kindling, hymns, and songs, O son of strength,

children.text: sa martyeṣv amṛta pracetā rāyā dyumnena śravasā vi bhāti ||
children.translated_text: that discerning mortal shines among mortals, O immortal one, with wealth, splendor, and fame.

children.text: sa tat kṛdhīṣitas tūyam agne spṛdho bādhasva sahasā sahasvān
children.translated_text: Do that eagerly, O <s>Agni</s>; drive away rivals by force, O forceful one.

children.text: yacchasyase dyubhir akto vacobhis taj juṣasva jaritur ghoṣi manma ||
children.translated_text: What you are praised for by day and by night with words, accept that, the singer's resounding thought.

children.text: aśyāma taṃ kāmam agne tavotī aśyāma rayiṃ rayivaḥ suvīram
children.translated_text: May we attain that desire through your aid, O <s>Agni</s>; may we attain wealth rich in heroes, O wealthy one.

children.text: aśyāma vājam abhi vājayanto 'śyāma dyumnam ajarājaraṃ te ||
children.translated_text: May we attain the prize while striving for prizes; may we attain your undecaying splendor, O unaging one.

children.text: Chapter 447
pra navyasā sahasaḥ sūnum acchā yajñena gātum ava icchamānaḥ
children.translated_text: With a new sacrifice he goes toward the son of strength, seeking a path,

children.text: vṛścadvanaṃ kṛṣṇayāmaṃ ruśantaṃ vītī hotāraṃ divyaṃ jigāti ||
children.translated_text: toward the wood-cleaving, black-tracked, shining heavenly <s>Hotṛ</s> for the feast.

children.text: sa śvitānas tanyatū rocanasthā ajarebhir nānadadbhir yaviṣṭhaḥ
children.translated_text: He, thundering, stationed in the bright realm, with unfading and resounding powers, O youngest one,

children.text: yaḥ pāvakaḥ purutamaḥ purūṇi pṛthūny agnir anuyāti bharvan ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, the purifier, most manifold, goes after many broad things as he bears them on.

children.text: vi te viṣvag vātajūtāso agne bhāmāsaḥ śuce śucayaś caranti
children.translated_text: Your blazes, driven by the wind in every direction, O shining <s>Agni</s>, move brightly.

children.text: tuvimrakṣāso divyā navagvā vanā vananti dhṛṣatā rujantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Mighty-flashing, heavenly, nine-tongued, they conquer the forests, breaking them boldly.

children.text: ye te śukrāsaḥ śucayaḥ śuciṣmaḥ kṣāṃ vapanti viṣitāso aśvāḥ
children.translated_text: Your bright, pure, purified horses, set loose, scatter over the earth.

children.text: adha bhramas ta urviyā vi bhāti yātayamāno adhi sānu pṛśneḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then your whirling flame shines widely as it is driven along the ridge of the speckled one.

children.text: adha jihvā pāpatīti pra vṛṣṇo goṣuyudho nāśaniḥ sṛjānā
children.translated_text: Then the tongue of the bulling one darts forth, released like a thunderbolt of one fighting for cattle.

children.text: śūrasyeva prasitiḥ kṣātir agner durvartur bhīmo dayate vanāni ||
children.translated_text: Like a hero's onset, the assault of hard-to-turn <s>Agni</s>, terrible, divides the forests.

children.text: ā bhānunā pārthivāni jrayāṃsi mahas todasya dhṛṣatā tatantha
children.translated_text: With radiance and force you have stretched over the earthly expanses, in the greatness of the impetuous one, boldly.

children.text: sa bādhasvāpa bhayā sahobhi spṛdho vanuṣyan vanuṣo ni jūrva ||
children.translated_text: So drive away fears and rivals with your powers; overcoming the hostile man, crush the enemy.

children.text: sa citra citraṃ citayantam asme citrakṣatra citratamaṃ vayodhām
children.translated_text: O wondrous one, bring to us wonderful wealth, discerning, O wondrous-ruling one, the most wonderful giver of life,

children.text: candraṃ rayim puruvīram bṛhantaṃ candra candrābhir gṛṇate yuvasva ||
children.translated_text: radiant wealth, rich in heroes and great; O radiant one, join it with radiant gifts to the singer.

children.text: Chapter 448
mūrdhānaṃ divo aratim pṛthivyā vaiśvānaram ṛta ā jātam agnim
children.translated_text: The gods generated <s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s>, born according to <s>ṛta</s>, as the head of heaven and the swift one of earth,

children.text: kaviṃ samrājam atithiṃ janānām āsann ā pātraṃ janayanta devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the seer, the sovereign, the guest of peoples, set near as a vessel at the mouth.

children.text: nābhiṃ yajñānāṃ sadanaṃ rayīṇām mahām āhāvam abhi saṃ navanta
children.translated_text: They sang together around <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, the navel of sacrifices, the seat of riches, the great object of invocation,

children.text: vaiśvānaraṃ rathyam adhvarāṇāṃ yajñasya ketuṃ janayanta devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the chariot-leader of rites, the beacon of sacrifice; the gods generated him.

children.text: tvad vipro jāyate vājy agne tvad vīrāso abhimātiṣāhaḥ
children.translated_text: From you the inspired priest is born as a prize-winner, O <s>Agni</s>; from you come heroes who overcome hostile attacks.

children.text: vaiśvānara tvam asmāsu dhehi vasūni rājan spṛhayāyyāṇi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, O king, place among us desirable treasures.

children.text: tvāṃ viśve amṛta jāyamānaṃ śiśuṃ na devā abhi saṃ navante
children.translated_text: All the gods gathered around you, O immortal one, as you were born, like a child.

children.text: tava kratubhir amṛtatvam āyan vaiśvānara yat pitror adīdeḥ ||
children.translated_text: Through your powers they reached immortality, O <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, when you shone from your two parents.

children.text: vaiśvānara tava tāni vratāni mahāny agne nakir ā dadharṣa
children.translated_text: O <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, those great ordinances of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, no one has dared to assail.

children.text: yaj jāyamānaḥ pitror upasthe 'vindaḥ ketuṃ vayuneṣv ahnām ||
children.translated_text: When, being born in the lap of your parents, you found the beacon among the revelations of the days.

children.text: vaiśvānarasya vimitāni cakṣasā sānūni divo amṛtasya ketunā
children.translated_text: The heights of heaven are measured by the eye of <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, by the sign of the immortal one;

children.text: tasyed u viśvā bhuvanādhi mūrdhani vayā iva ruruhuḥ sapta visruhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: upon his head all the worlds have mounted like branches, the seven outspread streams.

children.text: vi yo rajāṃsy amimīta sukratur vaiśvānaro vi divo rocanā kaviḥ
children.translated_text: He of good will measured out the spaces; <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, the seer, measured out the lights of heaven.

children.text: pari yo viśvā bhuvanāni paprathe 'dabdho gopā amṛtasya rakṣitā ||
children.translated_text: He spread around all beings, uninjured, the herdsman and guardian of immortality.

children.text: Chapter 449
pṛkṣasya vṛṣṇo aruṣasya nū sahaḥ pra nu vocaṃ vidathā jātavedasaḥ
children.translated_text: Now let me proclaim in the assemblies the power of the speckled, bull-like, ruddy <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: vaiśvānarāya matir navyasī śuciḥ soma iva pavate cārur agnaye ||
children.translated_text: A new, pure, beautiful thought for <s>Vaiśvānara</s> flows for <s>Agni</s> like <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: sa jāyamānaḥ parame vyomani vratāny agnir vratapā arakṣata
children.translated_text: As he was born in the highest heaven, <s>Agni</s>, guardian of ordinances, protected the ordinances.

children.text: vy antarikṣam amimīta sukratur vaiśvānaro mahinā nākam aspṛśat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, of good will, measured out the midspace; by his greatness he touched the vault of heaven.

children.text: vy astabhnād rodasī mitro adbhuto 'ntarvāvad akṛṇoj jyotiṣā tamaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s>, wondrous, propped apart the two worlds; roaring within, he made darkness into light.

children.text: vi carmaṇīva dhiṣaṇe avartayad vaiśvānaro viśvam adhatta vṛṣṇyam ||
children.translated_text: Like two hides he unfolded the two realms; <s>Vaiśvānara</s> established all virile power.

children.text: apām upasthe mahiṣā agṛbhṇata viśo rājānam upa tasthur ṛgmiyam
children.translated_text: The mighty ones seized him in the lap of the waters; the clans stood near the king worthy of hymns.

children.text: ā dūto agnim abharad vivasvato vaiśvānaram mātariśvā parāvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Mātariśvan</s> brought <s>Agni</s>, the envoy of <s>Vivasvat</s>, <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, from afar.

children.text: yuge yuge vidathyaṃ gṛṇadbhyo 'gne rayiṃ yaśasaṃ dhehi navyasīm
children.translated_text: Age after age, O <s>Agni</s>, give fresh, fame-bringing wealth to those who praise you in the assembly.

children.text: pavyeva rājann aghaśaṃsam ajara nīcā ni vṛśca vaninaṃ na tejasā ||
children.translated_text: Like a felly, O king, O unaging one, cut down the evil-speaker below with your heat, as one cuts down a forest tree.

children.text: asmākam agne maghavatsu dhārayānāmi kṣatram ajaraṃ suvīryam
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, sustain among our liberal patrons unaging lordship and good heroism.

children.text: vayaṃ jayema śatinaṃ sahasriṇaṃ vaiśvānara vājam agne tavotibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we win the hundredfold and thousandfold prize, O <s>Vaiśvānara Agni</s>, through your aids.

children.text: adabdhebhis tava gopābhir iṣṭe 'smākam pāhi triṣadhastha sūrīn
children.translated_text: With your unbetraying protections guard our patrons at the rite, O three-seated one.

children.text: rakṣā ca no daduṣāṃ śardho agne vaiśvānara pra ca tārī stavānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Protect the host of us givers, O <s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s>, and carry us forward as we praise you.

children.text: Chapter 450
ahaś ca kṛṣṇam ahar arjunaṃ ca vi vartete rajasī vedyābhiḥ
children.translated_text: The dark day and the bright day turn apart through the two visible regions.

children.text: vaiśvānaro jāyamāno na rājāvātiraj jyotiṣāgnis tamāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s>, being born like a king, has overcome the darknesses with light.

children.text: nāhaṃ tantuṃ na vi jānāmy otuṃ na yaṃ vayanti samare 'tamānāḥ
children.translated_text: I do not know the warp, nor do I discern the woof, nor what they weave as they move in the contest.

children.text: kasya svit putra iha vaktvāni paro vadāty avareṇa pitrā ||
children.translated_text: Whose son here should speak the sayings? The higher one speaks with the lower father.

children.text: sa it tantuṃ sa vi jānāty otuṃ sa vaktvāny ṛtuthā vadāti
children.translated_text: He indeed knows the warp, he discerns the woof; he speaks the sayings in due season.

children.text: ya īṃ ciketad amṛtasya gopā avaś caran paro anyena paśyan ||
children.translated_text: He who perceived this, the guardian of immortality, moving below, sees the higher by means of another.

children.text: ayaṃ hotā prathamaḥ paśyatemam idaṃ jyotir amṛtam martyeṣu
children.translated_text: This <s>Hotṛ</s> is first; behold this one, this immortal light among mortals.

children.text: ayaṃ sa jajñe dhruva ā niṣatto 'martyas tanvā vardhamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: This one was born, firmly seated here, immortal, growing in his own body.

children.text: dhruvaṃ jyotir nihitaṃ dṛśaye kam mano javiṣṭham patayatsv antaḥ
children.translated_text: A firm light has been set down for sight, desirable, and the mind, swiftest, among things that fly.

children.text: viśve devāḥ samanasaḥ saketā ekaṃ kratum abhi vi yanti sādhu ||
children.translated_text: All the gods, of one mind and with shared perception, go rightly toward a single purpose.

children.text: vi me karṇā patayato vi cakṣur vīdaṃ jyotir hṛdaya āhitaṃ yat
children.translated_text: My ears fly apart, and my eye; this light that is set in the heart flies apart.

children.text: vi me manaś carati dūraādhīḥ kiṃ svid vakṣyāmi kim u nū maniṣye ||
children.translated_text: My mind, thinking far, wanders apart: what indeed shall I say, and what now shall I think?

children.text: viśve devā anamasyan bhiyānās tvām agne tamasi tasthivāṃsam
children.translated_text: All the gods bowed in awe to you, O <s>Agni</s>, as you stood in the darkness,

children.text: vaiśvānaro 'vatūtaye no 'martyo 'vatūtaye naḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, immortal, for our protection, for our protection.

children.text: Chapter 451
puro vo mandraṃ divyaṃ suvṛktim prayati yajñe agnim adhvare dadhidhvam
children.translated_text: Set before you in the sacrifice, in the rite, <s>Agni</s>, the delightful heavenly one, with a well-sung hymn.

children.text: pura ukthebhiḥ sa hi no vibhāvā svadhvarā karati jātavedāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Place him in front with invocations, for he, shining widely, <s>Jātavedas</s>, will make our rites well-performed.

children.text: tam u dyumaḥ purvaṇīka hotar agne agnibhir manuṣa idhānaḥ
children.translated_text: Him, O bright, many-faced <s>hotṛ</s> priest, O <s>Agni</s>, kindled by the fires among men,

children.text: stomaṃ yam asmai mamateva śūṣaṃ ghṛtaṃ na śuci matayaḥ pavante ||
children.translated_text: the thoughts flow for him in praise, like a mother her vigorous child, like pure ghee.

children.text: pīpāya sa śravasā martyeṣu yo agnaye dadāśa vipra ukthaiḥ
children.translated_text: He swelled with fame among mortals, the inspired man who honored <s>Agni</s> with hymns.

children.text: citrābhis tam ūtibhiś citraśocir vrajasya sātā gomato dadhāti ||
children.translated_text: With wondrous aids, the wondrous-flamed one grants him the winning of the cattle-rich enclosure.

children.text: ā yaḥ paprau jāyamāna urvī dūredṛśā bhāsā kṛṣṇādhvā
children.translated_text: He who, as he was born, filled the two wide realms with far-seeing radiance along the black path,

children.text: adha bahu cit tama ūrmyāyās tiraḥ śociṣā dadṛśe pāvakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: then the purifier was seen through even the much darkness of the billowing flood by his flame.

children.text: nū naś citram puruvājābhir ūtī agne rayim maghavadbhyaś ca dhehi
children.translated_text: Now, O <s>Agni</s>, with wondrous, prize-rich aids, set wealth among us and among the bounteous,

children.text: ye rādhasā śravasā cāty anyān suvīryebhiś cābhi santi janān ||
children.translated_text: those who by gift and fame surpass others, and who with heroic powers are beyond other men.

children.text: imaṃ yajñaṃ cano dhā agna uśan yaṃ ta āsāno juhute haviṣmān
children.translated_text: Make this sacrifice pleasing, O <s>Agni</s>, desiring it, which the seated, oblation-bearing man offers to you with his mouth.

children.text: bharadvājeṣu dadhiṣe suvṛktim avīr vājasya gadhyasya sātau ||
children.translated_text: Among the <s>Bharadvājas</s> you have set a well-sung hymn, for the winning of food and attainable strength.

children.text: vi dveṣāṃsīnuhi vardhayeﾱām madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Drive away hostilities; make us prosper. May we rejoice for a hundred winters, rich in heroes.

children.text: Chapter 452
yajasva hotar iṣito yajīyān agne bādho marutāṃ na prayukti
children.translated_text: Sacrifice, O <s>hotṛ</s> priest, impelled and most fit to sacrifice, O <s>Agni</s>; press onward like the driving of the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: ā no mitrāvaruṇā nāsatyā dyāvā hotrāya pṛthivī vavṛtyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Turn <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, the <s>Nāsatyas</s>, heaven, and earth toward our priestly offering.

children.text: tvaṃ hotā mandratamo no adhrug antar devo vidathā martyeṣu
children.translated_text: You are our most delightful <s>hotṛ</s> priest, undeceiving, a god among mortals at the rites,

children.text: pāvakayā juhvā vahnir āsāgne yajasva tanvaṃ tava svām ||
children.translated_text: with your purifying tongue, O carrier, with your mouth; O <s>Agni</s>, sacrifice in your own body.

children.text: dhanyā ciddhi tve dhiṣaṇā vaṣṭi pra devāñ janma gṛṇate yajadhyai
children.translated_text: For blessed insight itself wills, in you, to worship the gods for the singer as he praises their birth.

children.text: vepiṣṭho aṅgirasāṃ yaddha vipro madhu cchando bhanati rebha iṣṭau ||
children.translated_text: When the trembling inspired one of the <s>Aṅgirases</s> chants the sweet meter, roaring at the offering.

children.text: adidyutat sv apāko vibhāvāgne yajasva rodasī urūcī
children.translated_text: You flashed out, wise in working, shining widely. O <s>Agni</s>, sacrifice to the two broad worlds,

children.text: āyuṃ na yaṃ namasā rātahavyā añjanti suprayasam pañca janāḥ ||
children.translated_text: whom the five peoples, with reverence and offered oblations, anoint like <s>Āyu</s>, very gracious.

children.text: vṛñje ha yan namasā barhir agnāv ayāmi srug ghṛtavatī suvṛktiḥ
children.translated_text: When I choose the sacrificial grass with reverence at the fire, my ghee-bearing ladle, my well-sung hymn, goes forth.

children.text: amyakṣi sadma sadane pṛthivyā aśrāyi yajñaḥ sūrye na cakṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: I have anointed the seat in the dwelling-place of the earth; the sacrifice has rested like an eye in the sun.

children.text: daśasyā naḥ purvaṇīka hotar devebhir agne agnibhir idhānaḥ
children.translated_text: Grant us favor, O many-faced <s>hotṛ</s> priest, O <s>Agni</s>, kindled with the gods and with the fires.

children.text: rāyaḥ sūno sahaso vāvasānā ati srasema vṛjanaṃ nāṃhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O son of strength, longing for riches, may we pass beyond the enclosure and beyond distress.

children.text: Chapter 453
madhye hotā duroṇe barhiṣo rāﾱ agnis todasya rodasī yajadhyai
children.translated_text: In the middle of the house, upon the seat of the altar-grass, <s>Agni</s> is the <s>hotṛ</s> priest, kindled to worship heaven and earth.

children.text: ayaṃ sa sūnuḥ sahasa ṛtāvā dūrāt sūryo na śociṣā tatāna ||
children.translated_text: This is that son of strength, true to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order); like the sun from afar, he has stretched himself out with flame.

children.text: ā yasmin tve sv apāke yajatra yakṣad rājan sarvatāteva nu dyauḥ
children.translated_text: In whom, in you, wise-working and worthy of sacrifice, O king, heaven herself, as if all-embracing, will worship,

children.text: triṣadhasthas tataruṣo na jaṃho havyā maghāni mānuṣā yajadhyai ||
children.translated_text: he, seated in the three stations, not to be overcome or pressed down, worships with human oblations and gifts.

children.text: tejiṣṭhā yasyāratir vanerāṭ todo adhvan na vṛdhasāno adyaut
children.translated_text: His assault is sharpest, lord of the wood; impelled along the road, growing, he has shone.

children.text: adrogho na dravitā cetati tmann amartyo 'vartra oṣadhīṣu ||
children.translated_text: The undeceiving, immortal one, not held back, moves knowingly in himself among the plants.

children.text: sāsmākebhir etarī na śūṣair agni ṣṭave dama ā jātavedāḥ
children.translated_text: With these powers of ours, like an eager one, <s>Agni</s> <s>Jātavedas</s> is praised in the house,

children.text: drvanno vanvan kratvā nārvosraḥ piteva jārayāyi yajñaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: breaking and winning by will, like a racer; like a father, he is to be invoked with sacrifices.

children.text: adha smāsya panayanti bhāso vṛthā yat takṣad anuyāti pṛthvīm
children.translated_text: Then they praise his lights, when, having freely fashioned them, he follows over the earth.

children.text: sadyo yaḥ syandro viṣito dhavīyān ṛṇo na tāyur ati dhanvā rāṭ ||
children.translated_text: He who is immediately flowing, released, and very swift, like a debt-thief, rules across the deserts.

children.text: sa tvaṃ no arvan nidāyā viśvebhir agne agnibhir idhānaḥ
children.translated_text: So, O <s>Agni</s>, like a steed, kindled with all the fires for our shelter,

children.text: veṣi rāyo vi yāsi ducchunā madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: you approach riches and drive away misfortune. May we rejoice for a hundred winters, rich in heroes.

children.text: Chapter 454
tvad viśvā subhaga saubhagāny agne vi yanti vanino na vayāḥ
children.translated_text: From you, O fortunate <s>Agni</s>, all good fortunes go forth, like branches from trees.

children.text: śruṣṭī rayir vājo vṛtratūrye divo vṛṣṭir īḍyo rītir apām ||
children.translated_text: Swiftly come wealth and prize in the conquest of <s>Vṛtra</s>, the rain of heaven, and the praiseworthy course of the waters.

children.text: tvam bhago na ā hi ratnam iṣe parijmeva kṣayasi dasmavarcāḥ
children.translated_text: You, like <s>Bhaga</s>, bring treasure to us for nourishment; like one encompassing all around, you dwell with wondrous splendor.

children.text: agne mitro na bṛhata ṛtasyāsi kṣattā vāmasya deva bhūreḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, like <s>Mitra</s>, you are the guardian of vast <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) and of abundant lovely wealth, O god.

children.text: sa satpatiḥ śavasā hanti vṛtram agne vipro vi paṇer bharti vājam
children.translated_text: As true lord, by power he slays <s>Vṛtra</s>; O <s>Agni</s>, the inspired one wins the prize from the <s>Paṇi</s>.

children.text: yaṃ tvam praceta ṛtajāta rāyā sajoṣā naptrāpāṃ hinoṣi ||
children.translated_text: The one whom you, O far-seeing one, born of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), together with <s>Apām Napāt</s>, impel with wealth.

children.text: yas te sūno sahaso gīrbhir ukthair yajñair marto niśitiṃ vedyānaṭ
children.translated_text: The mortal who with songs, hymns, and sacrifices has reached your sharpened edge, O son of strength,

children.text: viśvaṃ sa deva prati vāram agne dhatte dhānyam patyate vasavyaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: he, O god <s>Agni</s>, receives every chosen good and becomes lord for the sake of wealth.

children.text: tā nṛbhya ā sauśravasā suvīrāgne sūno sahasaḥ puṣyase dhāḥ
children.translated_text: Those famous, hero-rich gifts you foster and bestow for men, O <s>Agni</s>, son of strength:

children.text: kṛṇoṣi yacchavasā bhūri paśvo vayo vṛkāyāraye jasuraye ||
children.translated_text: when by your power you make abundant cattle and vital strength, even against the wolfish enemy and the hostile old foe.

children.text: vadmā sūno sahaso no vihāyā agne tokaṃ tanayaṃ vāji no dāḥ
children.translated_text: I speak to you, O son of strength, for our aid: O <s>Agni</s>, give us offspring, descendants, and prize-winning strength.

children.text: viśvābhir gīrbhir abhi pūrtim aśyām madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: With all songs may I attain fulfillment. May we rejoice for a hundred winters, rich in heroes.

children.text: Chapter 455
agnā yo martyo duvo dhiyaṃ jujoṣa dhītibhiḥ
children.translated_text: The mortal who has devoted service to <s>Agni</s> and thought with his insights,

children.text: bhasan nu ṣa pra pūrvya iṣaṃ vurītāvase ||
children.translated_text: he indeed, ancient and shining, chooses nourishment for help.

children.text: agnir iddhi pracetā agnir vedhastama ṛṣiḥ
children.translated_text: For <s>Agni</s> is discerning; <s>Agni</s> is the most ordained seer.

children.text: agniṃ hotāram īﾱate yajñeṣu manuṣo viśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The clans of men invoke <s>Agni</s> as <s>hotṛ</s> (sacrificial priest) in the sacrifices.

children.text: nānā hy agne 'vase spardhante rāyo aryaḥ
