children.translated_text: For in many ways, O <s>Agni</s>, noble men contend for help and for riches;

children.text: tūrvanto dasyum āyavo vrataiḥ sīkṣanto avratam ||
children.translated_text: the striving <s>Āyu</s> people overcome the <s>Dasyu</s>, instructing the lawless one by sacred vows.

children.text: agnir apsām ṛtīṣahaṃ vīraṃ dadāti satpatim
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> grants a hero, a true lord, who conquers hostile acts,

children.text: yasya trasanti śavasaḥ saṃcakṣi śatravo bhiyā ||
children.translated_text: before whose might the enemies tremble when they see him, in fear.

children.text: agnir hi vidmanā nido devo martam uruṣyati
children.translated_text: For <s>Agni</s>, the god, by his wisdom protects the mortal from reproaches;

children.text: sahāvā yasyāvṛto rayir vājeṣv avṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: strong in aid, his unsurpassed wealth is not surpassed in contests for the prize.

children.text: acchā no mitramaho deva devān agne vocaḥ sumatiṃ rodasyoḥ
children.translated_text: O god <s>Agni</s>, great in friendship, speak favorably for us to the gods, and win the good will of heaven and earth.

children.text: vīhi svastiṃ sukṣitiṃ divo nṝn dviṣo aṃhāṃsi duritā tarema tā tarema tavāvasā tarema ||
children.translated_text: Go toward well-being, good dwelling, and the men of heaven; may we cross hatreds, distresses, and evils; may we cross them, may we cross them with your help.

children.text: Chapter 456
imam ū ṣu vo atithim uṣarbudhaṃ viśvāsāṃ viśām patim ṛñjase girā
children.translated_text: Now with song I adorn for you this guest, the awakener at dawn, the lord of all clans.

children.text: vetīd divo januṣā kaccid ā śucir jyok cid atti garbho yad acyutam ||
children.translated_text: By birth from heaven he knows; surely he is pure, and for a long time he consumes what is fixed, when he is the embryo.

children.text: mitraṃ na yaṃ sudhitam bhṛgavo dadhur vanaspatāv īḍyam ūrdhvaśociṣam
children.translated_text: Like <s>Mitra</s> well established, whom the <s>Bhṛgus</s> placed in the tree, worthy of praise and with flame rising upward,

children.text: sa tvaṃ suprīto vītahavye adbhuta praśastibhir mahayase dive dive ||
children.translated_text: so you, wondrous one, well pleased at <s>Vītahavya</s>'s rite, are magnified day by day with praises.

children.text: sa tvaṃ dakṣasyāvṛko vṛdho bhūr aryaḥ parasyāntarasya taruṣaḥ
children.translated_text: So you became the guileless increaser of skill, the noble lord of the farther and the nearer, the overcomer.

children.text: rāyaḥ sūno sahaso martyeṣv ā chardir yaccha vītahavyāya sapratho bharadvājāya saprathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O son of strength, grant broad shelter among mortals to <s>Vītahavya</s>; bring broad shelter to <s>Bharadvāja</s>.

children.text: dyutānaṃ vo atithiṃ svarṇaram agniṃ hotāram manuṣaḥ svadhvaram
children.translated_text: I adorn for you the shining guest, golden in light, <s>Agni</s>, the <s>hotṛ</s> of men, performing the rite by his own law,

children.text: vipraṃ na dyukṣavacasaṃ suvṛktibhir havyavāham aratiṃ devam ṛñjase ||
children.translated_text: an inspired god like one of heavenly speech, the oblation-bearer, the minister, with well-formed hymns.

children.text: pāvakayā yaś citayantyā kṛpā kṣāman ruruca uṣaso na bhānunā
children.translated_text: With purifying, discerning beauty he has shone over the earth, with radiance like the dawns.

children.text: tūrvan na yāmann etaśasya nū raṇa ā yo ghṛṇe na tatṛṣāṇo ajaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Ageless, as if hastening on <s>Etaśa</s>'s course, now in the contest, he does not thirst like one heated by flame.

children.text: agnim agniṃ vaḥ samidhā duvasyata priyaṃ priyaṃ vo atithiṃ gṛṇīṣaṇi
children.translated_text: Serve <s>Agni</s>, each <s>Agni</s>, with kindling; I would praise your dear, dear guest.

children.text: upa vo gīrbhir amṛtaṃ vivāsata devo deveṣu vanate hi vāryaṃ devo deveṣu vanate hi no duvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With your songs worship the immortal one; for the god wins desirable treasure among the gods, and the god wins service for us among the gods.

children.text: samiddham agniṃ samidhā girā gṛṇe śucim pāvakam puro adhvare dhruvam
children.translated_text: I praise kindled <s>Agni</s> with kindling and song, the bright purifier, firm in front of the rite,

children.text: vipraṃ hotāram puruvāram adruhaṃ kaviṃ sumnair īmahe jātavedasam ||
children.translated_text: the inspired <s>hotṛ</s>, rich in choices, undeceiving, the sage <s>Jātavedas</s>, whom we seek with gracious thoughts.

children.text: tvāṃ dūtam agne amṛtaṃ yuge yuge havyavāhaṃ dadhire pāyum īḍyam
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, the immortal messenger and oblation-bearer, they have set age after age as the praiseworthy guardian.

children.text: devāsaś ca martāsaś ca jāgṛviṃ vibhuṃ viśpatiṃ namasā ni ṣedire ||
children.translated_text: Both gods and mortals have sat down in reverence around the watchful, far-reaching lord of the clans.

children.text: vibhūṣann agna ubhayāṁ anu vratā dūto devānāṃ rajasī sam īyase
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, adorning both ordinances, as messenger of the gods you move through the two realms.

children.text: yat te dhītiṃ sumatim āvṛṇīmahe 'dha smā nas trivarūthaḥ śivo bhava ||
children.translated_text: When we choose your inspired thought and good favor, then be auspicious to us with triple protection.

children.text: taṃ supratīkaṃ sudṛśaṃ svañcam avidvāṃso viduṣṭaraṃ sapema
children.translated_text: May we, though unknowing, serve that fair-faced, fair-looking, well-directed one, more knowing than the knowing.

children.text: sa yakṣad viśvā vayunāni vidvān pra havyam agnir amṛteṣu vocat ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Agni</s>, knowing all the wise ways, perform the sacrifice; let him announce the oblation among the immortals.

children.text: tam agne pāsy uta tam piparṣi yas ta ānaṭ kavaye śūra dhītim
children.translated_text: That man you protect, O <s>Agni</s>, and that man you carry across, who has extended inspired thought to you, the poet, O hero;

children.text: yajñasya vā niśitiṃ voditiṃ vā tam it pṛṇakṣi śavasota rāyā ||
children.translated_text: whether it is the completion or the beginning of the sacrifice, him alone you fill with strength and with wealth.

children.text: tvam agne vanuṣyato ni pāhi tvam u naḥ sahasāvann avadyāt
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, protect us from the hostile one; you, O mighty one, protect us from blame.

children.text: saṃ tvā dhvasmanvad abhy etu pāthaḥ saṃ rayi spṛhayāyyaḥ sahasrī ||
children.translated_text: May a path come together toward you with full force; may thousandfold wealth, worthy of desire, come together.

children.text: agnir hotā gṛhapatiḥ sa rājā viśvā veda janimā jātavedāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is the <s>hotṛ</s>, the house-lord; he is king, and <s>Jātavedas</s> knows all births.

children.text: devānām uta yo martyānāṃ yajiṣṭhaḥ sa pra yajatām ṛtāvā ||
children.translated_text: He, most fit to sacrifice for gods and mortals, faithful to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), shall sacrifice for the worshippers.

children.text: agne yad adya viśo adhvarasya hotaḥ pāvakaśoce veṣ ṭvaṃ hi yajvā
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, when today, as <s>hotṛ</s> of the clan's rite, you are here with purifying flame, for you are the sacrificer,

children.text: ṛtā yajāsi mahinā vi yad bhūr havyā vaha yaviṣṭha yā te adya ||
children.translated_text: you sacrifice according to <s>ṛta</s> with greatness when you become expansive; carry the oblations, youngest one, which are yours today.

children.text: abhi prayāṃsi sudhitāni hi khyo ni tvā dadhīta rodasī yajadhyai
children.translated_text: For you have looked upon the well-set fore-offerings; heaven and earth have placed you here for sacrifice.

children.text: avā no maghavan vājasātāv agne viśvāni duritā tarema tā tarema tavāvasā tarema ||
children.translated_text: Help us, O generous one, in the winning of prizes; O <s>Agni</s>, may we cross all evils; may we cross them, may we cross them with your help.

children.text: agne viśvebhiḥ svanīka devair ūrṇāvantam prathamaḥ sīda yonim
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> of fair face, sit first with all the gods upon the wool-covered womb.

children.text: kulāyinaṃ ghṛtavantaṃ savitre yajñaṃ naya yajamānāya sādhu ||
children.translated_text: Lead the nest-holding, ghee-rich sacrifice for <s>Savitṛ</s>, well and duly for the sacrificer.

children.text: imam u tyam atharvavad agnim manthanti vedhasaḥ
children.translated_text: Now the inspired ones churn this <s>Agni</s> in the manner of <s>Atharvan</s>,

children.text: yam aṅkūyantam ānayann amūraṃ śyāvyābhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: whom they brought, crouching, unbewildered, from the dark mares.

children.text: janiṣvā devavītaye sarvatātā svastaye
children.translated_text: Be born for the divine feast, for completeness and for well-being.

children.text: ā devān vakṣy amṛtāṁ ṛtāvṛdho yajñaṃ deveṣu pispṛśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bring here the immortal gods, increasers of <s>ṛta</s>; make the sacrifice reach among the gods.

children.text: vayam u tvā gṛhapate janānām agne akarma samidhā bṛhantam
children.translated_text: We have made you great with kindling, O <s>Agni</s>, house-lord of peoples.

children.text: asthūri no gārhapatyāni santu tigmena nas tejasā saṃ śiśādhi ||
children.translated_text: Let our household fires be unshaken; sharpen us with your keen brilliance.

children.text: Chapter 457
tvam agne yajñānāṃ hotā viśveṣāṃ hitaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, have been set as <s>hotṛ</s> of all sacrifices,

children.text: devebhir mānuṣe jane ||
children.translated_text: with the gods among the human people.

children.text: sa no mandrābhir adhvare jihvābhir yajā mahaḥ
children.translated_text: May he, with his delightful tongues, sacrifice in the rite to the great one;

children.text: ā devān vakṣi yakṣi ca ||
children.translated_text: bring the gods here and worship them.

children.text: vetthā hi vedho adhvanaḥ pathaś ca devāñjasā
children.translated_text: For you know, O ordainer, the roads and the paths straight to the gods,

children.text: agne yajñeṣu sukrato ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> of good resolve, in the sacrifices.

children.text: tvām īﾱe adha dvitā bharato vājibhiḥ śunam
children.translated_text: Now for a second time <s>Bharata</s> invokes you, O <s>Agni</s>, for prosperous gain with steeds;

children.text: īje yajñeṣu yajñiyam ||
children.translated_text: he worships in the sacrifices the one worthy of sacrifice.

children.text: tvam imā vāryā puru divodāsāya sunvate
children.translated_text: You grant these many desirable goods to <s>Divodāsa</s>, who presses Soma,

children.text: bharadvājāya dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: and to <s>Bharadvāja</s>, the worshipping giver.

children.text: tvaṃ dūto amartya ā vahā daivyaṃ janam
children.translated_text: You, immortal messenger, bring here the divine people,

children.text: śṛṇvan viprasya suṣṭutim ||
children.translated_text: listening to the inspired singer's excellent praise.

children.text: tvām agne svādhyo martāso devavītaye
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, mortals of good thought invoke for the divine feast,

children.text: yajñeṣu devam īﾱate ||
children.translated_text: as the god in the sacrifices.

children.text: tava pra yakṣi saṃdṛśam uta kratuṃ sudānavaḥ
children.translated_text: At your worship, the generous ones seek your visible appearance and also your insight;

children.text: viśve juṣanta kāminaḥ ||
children.translated_text: all the desirous ones take delight in them.

children.text: tvaṃ hotā manurhito vahnir āsā viduṣṭaraḥ
children.translated_text: You are the <s>hotṛ</s> set by <s>Manu</s>, the carrier, most knowing with your mouth.

children.text: agne yakṣi divo viśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, worship the clans of heaven.

children.text: agna ā yāhi vītaye gṛṇāno havyadātaye
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, come for the feast, being praised, to receive the oblation;

children.text: ni hotā satsi barhiṣi ||
children.translated_text: sit down as <s>hotṛ</s> on the <s>barhis</s> (sacrificial grass).

children.text: taṃ tvā samidbhir aṅgiro ghṛtena vardhayāmasi
children.translated_text: You, that very one, O <s>Angiras</s>, we strengthen with kindling-sticks and with ghee,

children.text: bṛhacchocā yaviṣṭhya ||
children.translated_text: O youngest one, shining with a great flame.

children.text: sa naḥ pṛthu śravāyyam acchā deva vivāsasi
children.translated_text: O god, you bring near to us broad, fame-worthy renown,

children.text: bṛhad agne suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: and great heroic strength, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: tvām agne puṣkarād adhy atharvā nir amanthata
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, <s>Atharvan</s> drew forth from the lotus,

children.text: mūrdhno viśvasya vāghataḥ ||
children.translated_text: from the head of the singer of all.

children.text: tam u tvā dadhyaṅṅ ṛṣiḥ putra īdhe atharvaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: You indeed the seer <s>Dadhyaṅc</s>, son of <s>Atharvan</s>, kindled,

children.text: vṛtrahaṇam purandaram ||
children.translated_text: the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, the breaker of strongholds.

children.text: tam u tvā pāthyo vṛṣā sam īdhe dasyuhantamam
children.translated_text: You indeed <s>Pāthya Vṛṣan</s> kindled together, the greatest slayer of <s>Dasyus</s>,

children.text: dhanañjayaṃ raṇe raṇe ||
children.translated_text: the winner of wealth in battle after battle.

children.text: ehy ū ṣu bravāṇi te 'gna itthetarā giraḥ
children.translated_text: Come now; I will speak to you, O <s>Agni</s>, these other songs,

children.text: ebhir vardhāsa indubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: so that you may grow through these drops of <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: yatra kva ca te mano dakṣaṃ dadhasa uttaram
children.translated_text: Wherever you set your mind and your highest skill,

children.text: tatrā sadaḥ kṛṇavase ||
children.translated_text: there you make your seat.

children.text: nahi te pūrtam akṣipad bhuvan nemānāṃ vaso
children.translated_text: For your fullness has not been diminished among these beings, O good one;

children.text: athā duvo vanavase ||
children.translated_text: therefore you win worship for yourself.

children.text: āgnir agāmi bhārato vṛtrahā purucetanaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> of the <s>Bharatas</s> has come, slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, richly discerning,

children.text: divodāsasya satpatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: the true lord of <s>Divodāsa</s>.

children.text: sa hi viśvāti pārthivā rayiṃ dāśan mahitvanā
children.translated_text: For by his greatness he has granted all earthly wealth,

children.text: vanvann avāto astṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: winning it, unbent and unstruck.

children.text: sa pratnavan navīyasāgne dyumnena saṃyatā
children.translated_text: As of old, with newer splendor, O <s>Agni</s>, gathered in brilliance,

children.text: bṛhat tatantha bhānunā ||
children.translated_text: you have stretched yourself wide with great radiance.

children.text: pra vaḥ sakhāyo agnaye stomaṃ yajñaṃ ca dhṛṣṇuyā
children.translated_text: Friends, set forth for <s>Agni</s> the hymn and the sacrifice with bold force;

children.text: arca gāya ca vedhase ||
children.translated_text: praise and sing to the wise one.

children.text: sa hi yo mānuṣā yugā sīdaddhotā kavikratuḥ
children.translated_text: For through human generations he has sat as the <s>Hotṛ</s> priest, poet-minded,

children.text: dūtaś ca havyavāhanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and as the messenger, the carrier of oblations.

children.text: tā rājānā śucivratādityān mārutaṃ gaṇam
children.translated_text: Those kings of pure vows, the <s>Ādityas</s>, and the host of the <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: vaso yakṣīha rodasī ||
children.translated_text: O good one, worship here, along with Heaven and Earth.

children.text: vasvī te agne saṃdṛṣṭir iṣayate martyāya
children.translated_text: A fair vision of you, O <s>Agni</s>, is sent forth for the mortal,

children.text: ūrjo napād amṛtasya ||
children.translated_text: O son of strength, toward immortality.

children.text: kratvā dā astu śreṣṭho 'dya tvā vanvan surekṇāḥ
children.translated_text: By inspired will let the giver be best today; O <s>Agni</s>, winning beautiful gifts,

children.text: marta ānāśa suvṛktim ||
children.translated_text: the mortal has attained good praise.

children.text: te te agne tvotā iṣayanto viśvam āyuḥ
children.translated_text: Those protected by you, O <s>Agni</s>, seeking sustenance for their whole life,

children.text: taranto aryo arātīr vanvanto aryo arātīḥ ||
children.translated_text: cross hostile enmities and conquer hostile enmities.

children.text: agnis tigmena śociṣā yāsad viśvaṃ ny atriṇam
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s>, with sharp flame, drive away every devourer down below;

children.text: agnir no vanate rayim ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Agni</s> win wealth for us.

children.text: suvīraṃ rayim ā bhara jātavedo vicarṣaṇe
children.translated_text: Bring wealth rich in heroes, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, discerning among peoples;

children.text: jahi rakṣāṃsi sukrato ||
children.translated_text: slay the demons, O wise-willed one.

children.text: tvaṃ naḥ pāhy aṃhaso jātavedo aghāyataḥ
children.translated_text: Protect us from distress, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, from the evil-doer;

children.text: rakṣā ṇo brahmaṇas kave ||
children.translated_text: guard our sacred utterance, O poet.

children.text: yo no agne dureva ā marto vadhāya dāśati
children.translated_text: Whatever evil-minded mortal, O <s>Agni</s>, gives himself to killing us,

children.text: tasmān naḥ pāhy aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: from that distress protect us.

children.text: tvaṃ taṃ deva jihvayā pari bādhasva duṣkṛtam
children.translated_text: O god, with your tongue drive away on every side that evildoer,

children.text: marto yo no jighāṃsati ||
children.translated_text: the mortal who wishes to harm us.

children.text: bharadvājāya saprathaḥ śarma yaccha sahantya
children.translated_text: For <s>Bharadvāja</s>, O overcoming <s>Agni</s>, grant wide-spreading shelter,

children.text: agne vareṇyaṃ vasu ||
children.translated_text: and choice wealth.

children.text: agnir vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanad draviṇasyur vipanyayā
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, seeking treasure, has smashed the obstacles with inspired insight,

children.text: samiddhaḥ śukra āhutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: kindled, bright, and invoked.

children.text: garbhe mātuḥ pituṣ pitā vididyutāno akṣare
children.translated_text: In the mother's womb, the father of the father, flashing in the imperishable,

children.text: sīdann ṛtasya yonim ā ||
children.translated_text: sat down in the womb of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: brahma prajāvad ā bhara jātavedo vicarṣaṇe
children.translated_text: Bring inspired prayer rich in offspring, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, discerning among peoples,

children.text: agne yad dīdayad divi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, that which shines in heaven.

children.text: upa tvā raṇvasaṃdṛśam prayasvantaḥ sahaskṛta
children.translated_text: To you, lovely to behold, rich in refreshment, made strong by power,

children.text: agne sasṛjmahe giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, we have released our songs.

children.text: upa cchāyām iva ghṛṇer aganma śarma te vayam
children.translated_text: As to shade from heat, we have come to your shelter,

children.text: agne hiraṇyasaṃdṛśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> of golden appearance.

children.text: ya ugra iva śaryahā tigmaśṛṅgo na vaṃsagaḥ
children.translated_text: Like a fierce archer, like a sharp-horned bull of the forest,

children.text: agne puro rurojitha ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, you have broken the strongholds.

children.text: ā yaṃ haste na khādinaṃ śiśuṃ jātaṃ na bibhrati
children.translated_text: They carry him like a bracelet in the hand, like a newborn child,

children.text: viśām agniṃ svadhvaram ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> of the clans, whose sacrifice is good.

children.text: pra devaṃ devavītaye bharatā vasuvittamam
children.translated_text: Bring forth the god for the divine feast, richest in goods;

children.text: ā sve yonau ni ṣīdatu ||
children.translated_text: let him sit down in his own seat.

children.text: ā jātaṃ jātavedasi priyaṃ śiśītātithim
children.translated_text: Make bright the born <s>Jātavedas</s>, the beloved guest,

children.text: syona ā gṛhapatim ||
children.translated_text: the gracious house-lord.

children.text: agne yukṣvā hi ye tavāśvāso deva sādhavaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, yoke those horses of yours, O god, that are effective;

children.text: araṃ vahanti manyave ||
children.translated_text: they carry you readily for inspired zeal.

children.text: acchā no yāhy ā vahābhi prayāṃsi vītaye
children.translated_text: Come here to us; bring the offerings for the feast,

children.text: ā devān somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: and the gods for the drinking of <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: ud agne bhārata dyumad ajasreṇa davidyutat
children.translated_text: Flame up, O <s>Agni Bhārata</s>, radiant, flashing with unceasing blaze;

children.text: śocā vi bhāhy ajara ||
children.translated_text: burn and shine forth, O unaging one.

children.text: vītī yo devam marto duvasyed agnim īﾱītādhvare haviṣmān
children.translated_text: At the rite, the mortal who, with oblation, would honor <s>Agni</s> the god at the feast,

children.text: hotāraṃ satyayajaṃ rodasyor uttānahasto namasā vivāset ||
children.translated_text: should worship the <s>Hotṛ</s>, true in sacrifice between Heaven and Earth, with upraised hands and reverence.

children.text: ā te agna ṛcā havir hṛdā taṣṭam bharāmasi
children.translated_text: To you, O <s>Agni</s>, we bring with a verse an offering shaped by the heart;

children.text: te te bhavantūkṣaṇa ṛṣabhāso vaśā uta ||
children.translated_text: may these become bulls for you, and steers and cows as well.

children.text: agniṃ devāso agriyam indhate vṛtrahantamam
children.translated_text: The gods kindle <s>Agni</s> as foremost, the greatest slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>,

children.text: yenā vasūny ābhṛtā tṛﾱhā rakṣāṃsi vājinā ||
children.translated_text: by whom goods were brought, and the firm demons were overcome by the vigorous one.

children.text: Chapter 458
pibā somam abhi yam ugra tarda ūrvaṃ gavyam mahi gṛṇāna indra
children.translated_text: Drink the <s>Soma</s>, before which, O fierce <s>Indra</s>, praised in song, you opened the great cow-winning enclosure;

children.text: vi yo dhṛṣṇo vadhiṣo vajrahasta viśvā vṛtram amitriyā śavobhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: you who, bold and thunderbolt-handed, slew every hostile <s>Vṛtra</s> with your powers.

children.text: sa īm pāhi ya ṛjīṣī tarutro yaḥ śipravān vṛṣabho yo matīnām
children.translated_text: Protect that one indeed, you who are swift with the dregs, the overcomer, the strong-jawed bull of inspired thoughts,

children.text: yo gotrabhid vajrabhṛd yo hariṣṭhāḥ sa indra citrāṁ abhi tṛndhi vājān ||
children.translated_text: the splitter of the cow-stall, bearer of the thunderbolt, best with the bay horses; that <s>Indra</s>, break open the splendid prizes.

children.text: evā pāhi pratnathā mandatu tvā śrudhi brahma vāvṛdhasvota gīrbhiḥ
children.translated_text: Thus drink as in ancient times; let it gladden you. Hear the prayer, and grow also through the songs;

children.text: āviḥ sūryaṃ kṛṇuhi pīpihīṣo jahi śatrūṃr abhi gā indra tṛndhi ||
children.translated_text: make the sun visible, enrich the eager one; slay the enemies and break open the cows, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: te tvā madā bṛhad indra svadhāva ime pītā ukṣayanta dyumantam
children.translated_text: These exhilarations, once drunk, have swollen you, O great self-powered <s>Indra</s>, and made you radiant,

children.text: mahām anūnaṃ tavasaṃ vibhūtim matsarāso jarhṛṣanta prasāham ||
children.translated_text: the great, undiminished, mighty manifestation; the intoxicating draughts have made you rejoice as overpowering.

children.text: yebhiḥ sūryam uṣasam mandasāno 'vāsayo 'pa dṛﾱhāni dardrat
children.translated_text: With these, exhilarated, you made the sun and the dawns shine forth; you drove away and split the firm places;

children.text: mahām adrim pari gā indra santaṃ nutthā acyutaṃ sadasas pari svāt ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, you shook loose the great mountain enclosing the cows from its ancient, unmoving seat.

children.text: tava kratvā tava tad daṃsanābhir āmāsu pakvaṃ śacyā ni dīdhaḥ
children.translated_text: By your resolve and by those wondrous deeds of yours, with power, you set the ripe thing among the unripe,

children.text: aurṇor dura usriyābhyo vi dṛﾱhod ūrvād gā asṛjo aṅgirasvān ||
children.translated_text: and opened the doors for the ruddy cows; from the firm, wide enclosure you released the cows, O <s>Aṅgiras</s>-like one.

children.text: paprātha kṣām mahi daṃso vy urvīm upa dyām ṛṣvo bṛhad indra stabhāyaḥ
children.translated_text: You spread over the earth with great wondrous power; lofty <s>Indra</s>, you propped up broad heaven;

children.text: adhārayo rodasī devaputre pratne mātarā yahvī ṛtasya ||
children.translated_text: you upheld the two worlds, daughters of the gods, the ancient great mothers of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: adha tvā viśve pura indra devā ekaṃ tavasaṃ dadhire bharāya
children.translated_text: Then all the gods placed you before them, O <s>Indra</s>, the one mighty one, for bearing the burden.

children.text: adevo yad abhy auhiṣṭa devān svarṣātā vṛṇata indram atra ||
children.translated_text: When the godless one attacked the gods, at that winning of the sunlight they chose <s>Indra</s> here.

children.text: adha dyauś cit te apa sā nu vajrād dvitānamad bhiyasā svasya manyoḥ
children.translated_text: Then even heaven drew back from your vajra, doubled over with fear of your own wrath,

children.text: ahiṃ yad indro abhy ohasānaṃ ni cid viśvāyuḥ śayathe jaghāna ||
children.translated_text: when <s>Indra</s>, coming upon <s>Ahi</s> in his swelling force, struck him down, so that the life of all lay low.

children.text: adha tvaṣṭā te maha ugra vajraṃ sahasrabhṛṣṭiṃ vavṛtacchatāśrim
children.translated_text: Then <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, for you, O great and fierce one, fashioned the vajra with a thousand points and a hundred edges,

children.text: nikāmam aramaṇasaṃ yena navantam ahiṃ sam piṇag ṛjīṣin ||
children.translated_text: with which, O <s>Ṛjīṣin</s>, you crushed at will the roaring, restless <s>Ahi</s>.

children.text: vardhān yaṃ viśve marutaḥ sajoṣāḥ pacacchatam mahiṣāṁ indra tubhyam
children.translated_text: All the <s>Maruts</s>, with one accord, strengthened him; they cooked a hundred buffaloes for you, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: pūṣā viṣṇus trīṇi sarāṃsi dhāvan vṛtrahaṇam madiram aṃśum asmai ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pūṣan</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, hastening through the three vessels, prepared for him the exhilarating soma-shoot, the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: ā kṣodo mahi vṛtaṃ nadīnām pariṣṭhitam asṛja ūrmim apām
children.translated_text: You released the great flood of the rivers, enclosed all around, the wave of the waters,

children.text: tāsām anu pravata indra panthām prārdayo nīcīr apasaḥ samudram ||
children.translated_text: and along their downward course, O <s>Indra</s>, you drove the waters rushing down to the ocean.

children.text: evā tā viśvā cakṛvāṃsam indram mahām ugram ajuryaṃ sahodām
children.translated_text: Thus may the new prayer turn for aid toward <s>Indra</s>, who has done all those deeds, the great, fierce, ageless giver of strength,

children.text: suvīraṃ tvā svāyudhaṃ suvajram ā brahma navyam avase vavṛtyāt ||
children.translated_text: toward you, rich in heroes, well-armed, and strong with the good vajra.

children.text: sa no vājāya śravasa iṣe ca rāye dhehi dyumata indra viprān
children.translated_text: For prize, fame, refreshment, and wealth, O radiant <s>Indra</s>, set inspired patrons for us,

children.text: bharadvāje nṛvata indra sūrīn divi ca smaidhi pārye na indra ||
children.translated_text: among the <s>Bharadvājas</s>, O manly <s>Indra</s>, set noble chiefs; be ours in heaven and in the far region, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: ayā vājaṃ devahitaṃ sanema madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: By this may we win the god-given prize; may we rejoice for a hundred winters, rich in heroes.

children.text: Chapter 459
tam u ṣṭuhi yo abhibhūtyojā vanvann avātaḥ puruhūta indraḥ
children.translated_text: Praise him now, <s>Indra</s> the much-invoked, whose force overcomes, winning and unchecked,

children.text: aṣāﾱham ugraṃ sahamānam ābhir gīrbhir vardha vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnām ||
children.translated_text: the unconquered, fierce, prevailing bull of peoples; strengthen him with these songs.

children.text: sa yudhmaḥ satvā khajakṛt samadvā tuvimrakṣo nadanumāṁ ṛjīṣī
children.translated_text: He is warlike, strong, making the path in battle, greatly protective, roaring, and rich in exhilaration,

children.text: bṛhadreṇuś cyavano mānuṣīṇām ekaḥ kṛṣṭīnām abhavat sahāvā ||
children.translated_text: raising vast dust, shaking the human tribes; alone he became the powerful helper of peoples.

children.text: tvaṃ ha nu tyad adamāyo dasyūṃr ekaḥ kṛṣṭīr avanor āryāya
children.translated_text: You indeed then, unconquerable one, subdued the <s>Dasyus</s>; alone you protected the peoples for the <s>Ārya</s>.

children.text: asti svin nu vīryaṃ tat ta indra na svid asti tad ṛtuthā vi vocaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Is that heroic power of yours still there, O <s>Indra</s>, or is it not? Declare it truly at the proper time.

children.text: sad iddhi te tuvijātasya manye sahaḥ sahiṣṭha turatas turasya
children.translated_text: For I think that the strength of you, greatly born, is always the strongest, O impetuous one among the impetuous,

children.text: ugram ugrasya tavasas tavīyo 'radhrasya radhraturo babhūva ||
children.translated_text: and that the fierce power of the fierce and mighty one has become still mightier, a subduer of the hostile.

children.text: tan naḥ pratnaṃ sakhyam astu yuṣme itthā vadadbhir valam aṅgirobhiḥ
children.translated_text: Let that ancient friendship with you be ours, as the <s>Aṅgirases</s> spoke in this way about <s>Vala</s>,

children.text: hann acyutacyud dasmeṣayantam ṛṇoḥ puro vi duro asya viśvāḥ ||
children.translated_text: when, O wondrous one, you struck the unshaken one until he shook, and opened all his doors and strongholds.

children.text: sa hi dhībhir havyo asty ugra īśānakṛn mahati vṛtratūrye
children.translated_text: For he, the fierce one, is to be invoked with thoughts, making lordship in the great conquest of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: sa tokasātā tanaye sa vajrī vitantasāyyo abhavat samatsu ||
children.translated_text: He, the vajra-bearer, became helpful in battles for the winning of offspring and descendants and for far-spreading gain.

children.text: sa majmanā janima mānuṣāṇām amartyena nāmnāti pra sarsre
children.translated_text: By his greatness he has surpassed the birth of men, through his immortal name;

children.text: sa dyumnena sa śavasota rāyā sa vīryeṇa nṛtamaḥ samokāḥ ||
children.translated_text: with splendor, with might, and also with wealth, with heroic power, the manliest one has one dwelling with us.

children.text: sa yo na muhe na mithū jano bhūt sumantunāmā cumuriṃ dhuniṃ ca
children.translated_text: He did not become bewildered or false among men; wise in counsel, he faced <s>Cumuri</s> and <s>Dhuni</s>,

children.text: vṛṇak pipruṃ śambaraṃ śuṣṇam indraḥ purāṃ cyautnāya śayathāya nū cit ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Indra</s> shattered <s>Pipru</s>, <s>Śambara</s>, and <s>Śuṣṇa</s>, to make their forts fall and lie low, even now.

children.text: udāvatā tvakṣasā panyasā ca vṛtrahatyāya ratham indra tiṣṭha
children.translated_text: With helping craft and praiseworthy power, O <s>Indra</s>, mount the chariot for the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: dhiṣva vajraṃ hasta ā dakṣiṇatrābhi pra manda purudatra māyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Place the vajra in your right hand; rejoicing, strike straight against the many hostile māyās (deceptive powers).

children.text: agnir na śuṣkaṃ vanam indra hetī rakṣo ni dhakṣy aśanir na bhīmā
children.translated_text: Like <s>Agni</s> burning a dry forest with his missile, O <s>Indra</s>, burn down the demon, like a terrifying thunderbolt.

children.text: gambhīraya ṛṣvayā yo rurojādhvānayad duritā dambhayacca ||
children.translated_text: With the deep and lofty force that shattered, made the paths resound, and crushed the evils, act against them.

children.text: ā sahasram pathibhir indra rāyā tuvidyumna tuvivājebhir arvāk
children.translated_text: Come hither, O <s>Indra</s>, by a thousand paths, with wealth, O much-radiant one, with abundant prizes,

children.text: yāhi sūno sahaso yasya nū cid adeva īśe puruhūta yotoḥ ||
children.translated_text: O son of strength, whom even now no godless one is able to hinder, O much-invoked one.

children.text: pra tuvidyumnasya sthavirasya ghṛṣver divo rarapśe mahimā pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: Forth is proclaimed the greatness of the much-radiant, firm, impetuous one, from heaven and from earth.

children.text: nāsya śatrur na pratimānam asti na pratiṣṭhiḥ purumāyasya sahyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: He has no enemy, no equal, and no counter-station, the irresistible one of many powers.

children.text: pra tat te adyā karaṇaṃ kṛtam bhūt kutsaṃ yad āyum atithigvam asmai
children.translated_text: Let that deed of yours be accomplished today, when for this singer you aided <s>Kutsa</s>, <s>Āyu</s>, and <s>Atithigva</s>,

children.text: purū sahasrā ni śiśā abhi kṣām ut tūrvayāṇaṃ dhṛṣatā ninetha ||
children.translated_text: when you sharpened many thousands across the earth and boldly led <s>Tūrvayāṇa</s> upward.

children.text: anu tvāhighne adha deva devā madan viśve kavitamaṃ kavīnām
children.translated_text: After you, O slayer of <s>Ahi</s>, all the gods then rejoiced in the god, the wisest of poets,

children.text: karo yatra varivo bādhitāya dive janāya tanve gṛṇānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when, praising, you made wide space for the one hemmed in, for the heavenly people and for your own body.

children.text: anu dyāvāpṛthivī tat ta ojo 'martyā jihata indra devāḥ
children.translated_text: Following you, O <s>Indra</s>, heaven and earth and the immortal gods stirred at that might of yours.

children.text: kṛṣvā kṛtno akṛtaṃ yat te asty ukthaṃ navīyo janayasva yajñaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: O skillful one, make what of yours is unmade into something made; bring forth a newer hymn through sacrifices.

children.text: Chapter 460
mahāṁ indro nṛvad ā carṣaṇiprā uta dvibarhā aminaḥ sahobhiḥ
children.translated_text: Great <s>Indra</s>, manly and filling the peoples, doubly exalted and undiminished by his powers,

children.text: asmadryag vāvṛdhe vīryāyoruḥ pṛthuḥ sukṛtaḥ kartṛbhir bhūt ||
children.translated_text: has grown broad toward us in heroic might; may he become wide, spacious, and well fashioned by the makers.

children.text: indram eva dhiṣaṇā sātaye dhād bṛhantam ṛṣvam ajaraṃ yuvānam
children.translated_text: Insight itself set <s>Indra</s> in place for attainment, the great, lofty, ageless, youthful one,

children.text: aṣāﾱhena śavasā śūśuvāṃsaṃ sadyaś cid yo vāvṛdhe asāmi ||
children.translated_text: swollen with unconquerable might, who at once has grown unequalled.

children.text: pṛthū karasnā bahulā gabhastī asmadryak sam mimīhi śravāṃsi
children.translated_text: With broad hands and many arms, measure out fame for us, bending toward us.

children.text: yūtheva paśvaḥ paśupā damūnā asmāṁ indrābhy ā vavṛtsvājau ||
children.translated_text: Like a herdsman of cattle in his herd at home, turn toward us, O <s>Indra</s>, in the contest.

children.text: taṃ va indraṃ catinam asya śākair iha nūnaṃ vājayanto huvema
children.translated_text: That <s>Indra</s> of yours, discerning and strong through his powers, we would call here now as we seek the prize,

children.text: yathā cit pūrve jaritāra āsur anedyā anavadyā ariṣṭāḥ ||
children.translated_text: just as the former singers were blameless, faultless, and unharmed.

children.text: dhṛtavrato dhanadāḥ somavṛddhaḥ sa hi vāmasya vasunaḥ purukṣuḥ
children.translated_text: Firm in vow, giver of wealth, increased by soma, he indeed is rich in desirable treasure,

children.text: saṃ jagmire pathyā rāyo asmin samudre na sindhavo yādamānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: and the pathways of wealth have come together in him, like rivers moving toward the ocean.

children.text: śaviṣṭhaṃ na ā bhara śūra śava ojiṣṭham ojo abhibhūta ugram
children.translated_text: Bring to us the strongest strength, O hero: force, the most forceful, overpowering and fierce power.

children.text: viśvā dyumnā vṛṣṇyā mānuṣāṇām asmabhyaṃ dā harivo mādayadhyai ||
children.translated_text: Give to us all the radiant, virile powers of men, O <s>Harivan</s>, for our exhilaration.

children.text: yas te madaḥ pṛtanāṣāﾱ amṛdhra indra taṃ na ā bhara śūśuvāṃsam
children.translated_text: That exhilarating power of yours which smashes battles and is unharmed, O <s>Indra</s>, bring it to us, swollen strong.

children.text: yena tokasya tanayasya sātau maṃsīmahi jigīvāṃsas tvotāḥ ||
children.translated_text: With it, aided by you and eager to conquer, may we take part in the winning of offspring and descendants.

children.text: ā no bhara vṛṣaṇaṃ śuṣmam indra dhanaspṛtaṃ śūśuvāṃsaṃ sudakṣam
children.translated_text: Bring to us, O vigorous <s>Indra</s>, your swelling might, wealth-winning, grown strong, and skillful.

children.text: yena vaṃsāma pṛtanāsu śatrūn tavotibhir uta jāmīṃr ajāmīn ||
children.translated_text: With it may we overcome enemies in battles, through your protections, both kinsmen and strangers.

children.text: ā te śuṣmo vṛṣabha etu paścād ottarād adharād ā purastāt
children.translated_text: Let your might, O bull, come from behind, from the north, from below, and from the front.

children.text: ā viśvato abhi sam etv arvāṅ indra dyumnaṃ svarvad dhehy asme ||
children.translated_text: Let it come near from every side; O <s>Indra</s>, place splendor with sunlight for us.

children.text: nṛvat ta indra nṛtamābhir ūtī vaṃsīmahi vāmaṃ śromatebhiḥ
children.translated_text: With your manly, most manly aids, O <s>Indra</s>, may we win the lovely prize by our renowned praises.

children.text: īkṣe hi vasva ubhayasya rājan dhā ratnam mahi sthūram bṛhantam ||
children.translated_text: For I look to the wealth of both kinds, O king; set down for us great, solid, broad treasure.

children.text: marutvantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vāvṛdhānam akavāriṃ divyaṃ śāsam indram
children.translated_text: Let us call here for new aid <s>Indra</s>, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, the bull, ever growing, irresistible, heavenly, commanding.

children.text: viśvāsāham avase nūtanāyograṃ sahodām iha taṃ huvema ||
children.translated_text: Let us call that fierce one, overcoming all, the giver of strength, here for new help.

children.text: janaṃ vajrin mahi cin manyamānam ebhyo nṛbhyo randhayā yeṣv asmi
children.translated_text: O wielder of the <s>vajra</s>, subdue for these men among whom I am the people who think themselves mighty.

children.text: adhā hi tvā pṛthivyāṃ śūrasātau havāmahe tanaye goṣv apsu ||
children.translated_text: For then, in the winning of heroes on earth, we call on you for sons, for cattle, and for waters.

children.text: vayaṃ ta ebhiḥ puruhūta sakhyaiḥ śatroḥ śatror uttara it syāma
children.translated_text: O much-invoked one, through these friendships with you may we be ever superior to each enemy.

children.text: ghnanto vṛtrāṇy ubhayāni śūra rāyā madema bṛhatā tvotāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Striking down both sorts of obstacles, O hero, may we, aided by you, rejoice in abundant wealth.

children.text: Chapter 461
dyaur na ya indrābhi bhūmāryas tasthau rayiḥ śavasā pṛtsu janān
children.translated_text: Like heaven over the earth, that Aryan wealth stood over peoples in battles by its power, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: taṃ naḥ sahasrabharam urvarāsāṃ daddhi sūno sahaso vṛtraturam ||
children.translated_text: Give that to us, O son of strength: wealth bearing thousands, rich in fields, and conquering <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: divo na tubhyam anv indra satrāsuryaṃ devebhir dhāyi viśvam
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Indra</s>, the whole dominion of the sun in heaven was established with the gods.

children.text: ahiṃ yad vṛtram apo vavrivāṃsaṃ hann ṛjīṣin viṣṇunā sacānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When, O impetuous one, joined with <s>Viṣṇu</s>, you struck the serpent <s>Vṛtra</s>, who had enclosed the waters.

children.text: tūrvann ojīyān tavasas tavīyān kṛtabrahmendro vṛddhamahāḥ
children.translated_text: Overcoming, stronger than the strong and mightier than the mighty, <s>Indra</s>, for whom the hymn was fashioned, grew great in greatness.

children.text: rājābhavan madhunaḥ somyasya viśvāsāṃ yat purāṃ dartnum āvat ||
children.translated_text: He became king of the honeyed <s>Soma</s> when he came to shatter all the forts.

children.text: śatair apadran paṇaya indrātra daśoṇaye kavaye 'rkasātau
children.translated_text: By hundreds the <s>Paṇis</s> fled here from <s>Indra</s>, for the poet <s>Daśoṇi</s> in the winning of praise.

children.text: vadhaiḥ śuṣṇasyāśuṣasya māyāḥ pitvo nārirecīt kiṃcana pra ||
children.translated_text: With his weapons he did not leave even a little of the illusions of dry, hostile <s>Śuṣṇa</s> beyond the food.

children.text: maho druho apa viśvāyu dhāyi vajrasya yat patane pādi śuṣṇaḥ
children.translated_text: The great deceiver was wholly set aside, O all-living one, when <s>Śuṣṇa</s> fell at the descent of the <s>vajra</s>.

children.text: uru ṣa sarathaṃ sārathaye kar indraḥ kutsāya sūryasya sātau ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Indra</s> made broad room for chariot and charioteer, for <s>Kutsa</s> in the winning of the sun.

children.text: pra śyeno na madiram aṃśum asmai śiro dāsasya namucer mathāyan
children.translated_text: Like a falcon, he pressed out the intoxicating stalk for him, crushing the head of the slave <s>Namuci</s>.

children.text: prāvan namīṃ sāpyaṃ sasantam pṛṇag rāyā sam iṣā saṃ svasti ||
children.translated_text: He helped sleeping <s>Namī Sāpya</s>, filling him with wealth, nourishment, and well-being.

children.text: vi pipror ahimāyasya dṛﾱhāḥ puro vajriñchavasā na dardaḥ
children.translated_text: O wielder of the <s>vajra</s>, by your power you split apart the firm forts of wily <s>Pipru</s>.

children.text: sudāman tad rekṇo apramṛṣyam ṛjiśvane dātraṃ dāśuṣe dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: That inviolable wealth, O generous one, you gave as a gift to the worshipper <s>Ṛjiśvan</s>.

children.text: sa vetasuṃ daśamāyaṃ daśoṇiṃ tūtujim indraḥ svabhiṣṭisumnaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, whose favor is well sought, drove on <s>Vetasu</s>, <s>Daśamāya</s>, <s>Daśoṇi</s>, and <s>Tūtuji</s>.

children.text: ā tugraṃ śaśvad ibhaṃ dyotanāya mātur na sīm upa sṛjā iyadhyai ||
children.translated_text: He also released <s>Tugra</s>, the ever-bright elephant, for <s>Dyotana</s>, as a mother releases her child to go.

children.text: sa īṃ spṛdho vanate apratīto bibhrad vajraṃ vṛtrahaṇaṃ gabhastau
children.translated_text: Unopposed, he wins the contests, bearing in his hand the <s>vajra</s> that slays <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: tiṣṭhaddharī adhy asteva garte vacoyujā vahata indram ṛṣvam ||
children.translated_text: Standing over the two bay steeds like a driver in the chariot-seat, they bring lofty <s>Indra</s>, yoked by speech.

children.text: sanema te 'vasā navya indra pra pūrava stavanta enā yajñaiḥ
children.translated_text: May we obtain your newest help, O <s>Indra</s>; the <s>Pūrus</s> have praised you with these sacrifices.

children.text: sapta yat puraḥ śarma śāradīr dard dhan dāsīḥ purukutsāya śikṣan ||
children.translated_text: When, teaching <s>Purukutsa</s>, you shattered the seven autumnal shelters, the slave-women's forts.

children.text: tvaṃ vṛdha indra pūrvyo bhūr varivasyann uśane kāvyāya
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, became the ancient increaser, making room for <s>Uśanā Kāvya</s>.

children.text: parā navavāstvam anudeyam mahe pitre dadātha svaṃ napātam ||
children.translated_text: For the great father you gave your own grandson, the one called <s>Navavāstva</s>, who was not to be given away.

children.text: tvaṃ dhunir indra dhunimatīr ṛṇor apaḥ sīrā na sravantīḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, set loose the roaring, rushing waters, flowing like channels.

children.text: pra yat samudram ati śūra parṣi pārayā turvaśaṃ yaduṃ svasti ||
children.translated_text: When, O hero, you ferry us across beyond the sea, carry <s>Turvaśa</s> and <s>Yadu</s> across in safety.

children.text: tava ha tyad indra viśvam ājau sasto dhunīcumurī yā ha siṣvap
children.translated_text: That whole deed of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, was praised in battle, when <s>Dhunī</s> and <s>Cumuri</s> were asleep.

children.text: dīdayad it tubhyaṃ somebhiḥ sunvan dabhītir idhmabhṛtiḥ pakthy arkaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: For you alone <s>Dabhīti</s>, pressing Soma and bearing fuel, kindled it with the songs of the <s>Pakthas</s>.

children.text: Chapter 462
imā u tvā purutamasya kāror havyaṃ vīra havyā havante
children.translated_text: These invocations of the very prolific singer call you, O hero, as an offering worthy of invocation.

children.text: dhiyo ratheṣṭhām ajaraṃ navīyo rayir vibhūtir īyate vacasyā ||
children.translated_text: A newer thought, unfailing and standing in the chariot, seeks wealth, power, and expression in speech.

children.text: tam u stuṣa indraṃ yo vidāno girvāhasaṃ gīrbhir yajñavṛddham
children.translated_text: I praise that <s>Indra</s>, the knowing one, the bearer of songs, increased by hymns and sacrifice.

children.text: yasya divam ati mahnā pṛthivyāḥ purumāyasya ririce mahitvam ||
children.translated_text: His greatness, rich in many powers, has surpassed heaven and the earth in magnitude.

children.text: sa it tamo 'vayunaṃ tatanvat sūryeṇa vayunavac cakāra
children.translated_text: He made the spreading, trackless darkness clear with the sun and with knowledge.

children.text: kadā te martā amṛtasya dhāmeyakṣanto na minanti svadhāvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When will mortals worship in the immortal's domain? O self-powerful ones, they do not diminish it.

children.text: yas tā cakāra sa kuha svid indraḥ kam ā janaṃ carati kāsu vikṣu
children.translated_text: Where indeed is <s>Indra</s>, who made those things? Among what people does he move, in what settlements?

children.text: kas te yajño manase śaṃ varāya ko arka indra katamaḥ sa hotā ||
children.translated_text: Which sacrifice of yours is pleasing to your mind as the best? Which song, O <s>Indra</s>, which one is that <s>hotṛ</s> priest?

children.text: idā hi te veviṣataḥ purājāḥ pratnāsa āsuḥ purukṛt sakhāyaḥ
children.translated_text: For now your foreborn friends, the ancient ones, have become eager for you, O worker of many deeds.

children.text: ye madhyamāsa uta nūtanāsa utāvamasya puruhūta bodhi ||
children.translated_text: Be aware of those in the middle, and the newest ones too, and of the lowest, O much-invoked one.

children.text: tam pṛcchanto 'varāsaḥ parāṇi pratnā ta indra śrutyānu yemuḥ
children.translated_text: Questioning after the later things, the earlier men followed your famous deeds, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: arcāmasi vīra brahmavāho yād eva vidma tāt tvā mahāntam ||
children.translated_text: We worship you, O hero, bearer of the sacred formulation, as great as we know you to be.

children.text: abhi tvā pājo rakṣaso vi tasthe mahi jajñānam abhi tat su tiṣṭha
children.translated_text: The force of the demon has spread against you as you are greatly born; stand firmly against it.

children.text: tava pratnena yujyena sakhyā vajreṇa dhṛṣṇo apa tā nudasva ||
children.translated_text: With your ancient, yoked friendship, O bold one, and with the <s>vajra</s>, drive them away.

children.text: sa tu śrudhīndra nūtanasya brahmaṇyato vīra kārudhāyaḥ
children.translated_text: So listen, O <s>Indra</s>, to the new singer, to the hymn-loving, hero-making poet.

children.text: tvaṃ hy āpiḥ pradivi pitṝṇāṃ śaśvad babhūtha suhava eṣṭau ||
children.translated_text: For you have always been a kinsman of the fathers from the beginning, easily invoked in seeking aid.

children.text: protaye varuṇam mitram indram marutaḥ kṛṣvāvase no adya
children.translated_text: For our help today, make <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Indra</s>, and the <s>Maruts</s> favorably disposed.

children.text: pra pūṣaṇaṃ viṣṇum agnim purandhiṃ savitāram oṣadhīḥ parvatāṃś ca ||
children.translated_text: Bring forward <s>Pūṣan</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>Agni</s>, <s>Purandhi</s>, <s>Savitṛ</s>, the plants, and the mountains.

children.text: ima u tvā puruśāka prayajyo jaritāro abhy arcanty arkaiḥ
children.translated_text: These singers, indeed, O many-powered one, worthy of the fore-offering, praise you with chants.

children.text: śrudhī havam ā huvato huvāno na tvāvāṁ anyo amṛta tvad asti ||
children.translated_text: Hear the call, as you are called by the one calling; there is no other like you, O immortal one, besides you.

children.text: nū ma ā vācam upa yāhi vidvān viśvebhiḥ sūno sahaso yajatraiḥ
children.translated_text: Now come near to my speech, knowing it, with all the worshipful ones, O son of strength.

children.text: ye agnijihvā ṛtasāpa āsur ye manuṃ cakrur uparaṃ dasāya ||
children.translated_text: They had <s>Agni</s> as their tongue and guarded <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), they who made <s>Manu</s> superior to the <s>Dāsa</s>.

children.text: sa no bodhi puraetā sugeṣūta durgeṣu pathikṛd vidānaḥ
children.translated_text: Be mindful of us, going before on easy paths and, on difficult ones, knowing as the maker of the path.

children.text: ye aśramāsa uravo vahiṣṭhās tebhir na indrābhi vakṣi vājam ||
children.translated_text: With those tireless, broad, most carrying powers, O <s>Indra</s>, bring the prize to us.

children.text: Chapter 463
ya eka iddhavyaś carṣaṇīnām indraṃ taṃ gīrbhir abhy arca ābhiḥ
children.translated_text: The one who alone is to be invoked among peoples, that <s>Indra</s> I praise with these songs.

children.text: yaḥ patyate vṛṣabho vṛṣṇyāvān satyaḥ satvā purumāyaḥ sahasvān ||
children.translated_text: He rules, a bull possessing virile force, true in strength, rich in wonders, mighty.

children.text: tam u naḥ pūrve pitaro navagvāḥ sapta viprāso abhi vājayantaḥ
children.translated_text: Him our ancient fathers, the <s>Navagvas</s>, the seven inspired seers, strengthened as they strove for the prize,

children.text: nakṣaddābhaṃ taturim parvateṣṭhām adroghavācam matibhiḥ śaviṣṭham ||
children.translated_text: the undeceivable overcomer, standing on the mountain, strongest through unfalse speech and through their thoughts.

children.text: tam īmaha indram asya rāyaḥ puruvīrasya nṛvataḥ purukṣoḥ
children.translated_text: We seek that <s>Indra</s> for this wealth, rich in heroes, manly, and rich in nourishment.

children.text: yo askṛdhoyur ajaraḥ svarvān tam ā bhara harivo mādayadhyai ||
children.translated_text: Bring here for exhilaration that one whose life is unobstructed, ageless, and bright with the sun, O bay-horsed one.

children.text: tan no vi voco yadi te purā cij jaritāra ānaśuḥ sumnam indra
children.translated_text: Tell us that, if even in former times the singers obtained your favor, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: kas te bhāgaḥ kiṃ vayo dudhra khidvaḥ puruhūta purūvaso 'suraghnaḥ ||
children.translated_text: What is your share, what refreshment, O formidable assailant, O much-invoked one rich in many goods, slayer of the <s>Asura</s>?

children.text: tam pṛcchantī vajrahastaṃ ratheṣṭhām indraṃ vepī vakvarī yasya nū gīḥ
children.translated_text: Questioning him, thunderbolt-handed and standing in the chariot, <s>Indra</s>, for whom now the trembling, winding song is raised,

children.text: tuvigrābhaṃ tuvikūrmiṃ rabhodāṃ gātum iṣe nakṣate tumram accha ||
children.translated_text: the strong-grasping, strong-working giver of gain; it reaches toward the mighty one for a path to refreshment.

children.text: ayā ha tyam māyayā vāvṛdhānam manojuvā svatavaḥ parvatena
children.translated_text: By this wondrous power, self-powerful and swift as thought, he made that swelling one grow against the mountain.

children.text: acyutā cid vīﾱitā svojo rujo vi dṛﾱhā dhṛṣatā virapśin ||
children.translated_text: Even the unshaken, tightly held, firm things he broke apart by his own force, boldly, O powerful one.

children.text: taṃ vo dhiyā navyasyā śaviṣṭham pratnam pratnavat paritaṃsayadhyai
children.translated_text: Praise that strongest one with new insight, the ancient one in ancient fashion, so as to honor him.

children.text: sa no vakṣad animānaḥ suvahmendro viśvāny ati durgahāṇi ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, not diminished and easy to invoke, carry us beyond all difficult passages.

children.text: ā janāya druhvaṇe pārthivāni divyāni dīpayo 'ntarikṣā
children.translated_text: For the hostile man make the earthly things, the heavenly things, and the midspaces blaze up.

children.text: tapā vṛṣan viśvataḥ śociṣā tān brahmadviṣe śocaya kṣām apaś ca ||
children.translated_text: Burn, O bull, those from every side with flame; make earth and waters burn against the hater of prayer.

children.text: bhuvo janasya divyasya rājā pārthivasya jagatas tveṣasaṃdṛk
children.translated_text: You became king of the heavenly people and of the earthly moving world, blazing to behold.

children.text: dhiṣva vajraṃ dakṣiṇa indra haste viśvā ajurya dayase vi māyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Set the thunderbolt in your right hand, O <s>Indra</s>; with unfailing power you cleave all magic arts apart.

children.text: ā saṃyatam indra ṇaḥ svastiṃ śatrutūryāya bṛhatīm amṛdhrām
children.translated_text: Bring together for us, O <s>Indra</s>, great, unharmed well-being for the overcoming of enemies,

children.text: yayā dāsāny āryāṇi vṛtrā karo vajrin sutukā nāhuṣāṇi ||
children.translated_text: by which, O thunderbolt-bearer, you overcome <s>Dāsa</s> and <s>Ārya</s> powers, the <s>Vṛtras</s>, and the <s>Nāhuṣas</s>, rich in good offspring.

children.text: sa no niyudbhiḥ puruhūta vedho viśvavārābhir ā gahi prayajyo
children.translated_text: With your teams, O much-invoked ordainer, come to us with all-desired aids, worthy of worship.

children.text: na yā adevo varate na deva ābhir yāhi tūyam ā madryadrik ||
children.translated_text: With those aids which neither godless man nor god can choose away from us, come quickly toward the exhilaration and the pressing-stones.

children.text: Chapter 464
suta it tvaṃ nimiśla indra some stome brahmaṇi śasyamāna ukthe
children.translated_text: When you, O <s>Indra</s>, are praised at the pressed <s>Soma</s>, in the hymn, the prayer, and the recited chant,

children.text: yad vā yuktābhyām maghavan haribhyām bibhrad vajram bāhvor indra yāsi ||
children.translated_text: or when, O generous one, with the two bay horses yoked, bearing the thunderbolt in your arms, you go, O <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: yad vā divi pārye suṣvim indra vṛtrahatye 'vasi śūrasātau
children.translated_text: or when in farthest heaven, rich in pressed <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, you aid in the battle with <s>Vṛtra</s> and in the winning of heroes,

children.text: yad vā dakṣasya bibhyuṣo abibhyad arandhayaḥ śardhata indra dasyūn ||
children.translated_text: or when, unafraid before fearful power, you subdue the boasting <s>Dasyus</s>, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: pātā sutam indro astu somam praṇenīr ugro jaritāram ūtī
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> be the drinker of the pressed <s>Soma</s>, fierce, leading the singer forward with aid.

children.text: kartā vīrāya suṣvaya u lokaṃ dātā vasu stuvate kīraye cit ||
children.translated_text: He makes a broad place for the good presser, the hero; he gives wealth even to the praising singer.

children.text: ganteyānti savanā haribhyām babhrir vajram papiḥ somaṃ dadir gāḥ
children.translated_text: Let him go to the libations with his bay horses, bearer of the thunderbolt, drinker of <s>Soma</s>, giver of cows.

children.text: kartā vīraṃ naryaṃ sarvavīraṃ śrotā havaṃ gṛṇata stomavāhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: He makes a manly hero, every kind of hero; he hears the call, carrying the praises as they are sung.

children.text: asmai vayaṃ yad vāvāna tad viviṣma indrāya yo naḥ pradivo apas kaḥ
children.translated_text: For him, whatever we have desired, that we seek to win for <s>Indra</s>, who from of old has made works for us.

children.text: sute some stumasi śaṃsad ukthendrāya brahma vardhanaṃ yathāsat ||
children.translated_text: At the pressed <s>Soma</s> we praise him, uttering the chant, so that the prayer may serve as increase for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: brahmāṇi hi cakṛṣe vardhanāni tāvat ta indra matibhir viviṣmaḥ
children.translated_text: For you have made prayers into strengthenings; so far, O <s>Indra</s>, we have sought you with our thoughts.

children.text: sute some sutapāḥ śantamāni rāṇḍyā kriyāsma vakṣaṇāni yajñaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: At the pressed <s>Soma</s>, O drinker of what is pressed, may we perform most peaceful, desirable refreshment-offerings with sacrifices.

children.text: sa no bodhi puroﾱāśaṃ rarāṇaḥ pibā tu somaṃ goṛjīkam indra
children.translated_text: Be mindful of us, accepting the <s>puroḍāśa</s> (sacrificial cake); drink this <s>Soma</s>, rich in milk, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: edam barhir yajamānasya sīdoruṃ kṛdhi tvāyata u lokam ||
children.translated_text: Sit on this sacrificial grass of the worshipper; make a broad place for the one who longs for you.

children.text: sa mandasvā hy anu joṣam ugra pra tvā yajñāsa ime aśnuvantu
children.translated_text: So rejoice according to your pleasure, O fierce one; let these sacrifices reach you.

children.text: preme havāsaḥ puruhūtam asme ā tveyaṃ dhīr avasa indra yamyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let these invocations come forward to the much-invoked one for us; may this thought of mine extend toward your aid, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: taṃ vaḥ sakhāyaḥ saṃ yathā suteṣu somebhir īm pṛṇatā bhojam indram
children.translated_text: That <s>Indra</s>, O friends, fill together at the pressings with <s>Soma</s>, the bounteous one.

children.text: kuvit tasmā asati no bharāya na suṣvim indro 'vase mṛdhāti ||
children.translated_text: Perhaps he will be there for our support; <s>Indra</s> does not fail a good presser in need of help.

children.text: eved indraḥ sute astāvi some bharadvājeṣu kṣayad in maghonaḥ
children.translated_text: Thus <s>Indra</s> has been praised at the pressed <s>Soma</s> among the <s>Bharadvājas</s>, dwelling amid the gifts of the generous.

children.text: asad yathā jaritra uta sūrir indro rāyo viśvavārasya dātā ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> be giver of wealth full of all goods to the singer and also to the patron.

children.text: Chapter 465
vṛṣā mada indre śloka ukthā sacā someṣu sutapā ṛjīṣī
children.translated_text: The bull-like exhilaration, the praise, and the recitations are joined with <s>Indra</s>; among the pressed <s>Somas</s> he is the drinker of what is pressed, rich in dregs.

children.text: arcatryo maghavā nṛbhya ukthair dyukṣo rājā girām akṣitotiḥ ||
children.translated_text: The generous one, to be praised by men with hymns, bright king of songs, has unfailing aid.

children.text: taturir vīro naryo vicetāḥ śrotā havaṃ gṛṇata urvyūtiḥ
children.translated_text: He is an overcoming hero, manly, wise, a hearer of the call, with wide help.

children.text: vasuḥ śaṃso narāṃ kārudhāyā vājī stuto vidathe dāti vājam ||
children.translated_text: Good and praiseworthy among men for the singer's sake, the prize-winner, when lauded in the assembly, gives the prize.

children.text: akṣo na cakryoḥ śūra bṛhan pra te mahnā ririce rodasyoḥ
children.translated_text: Like an axle between two wheels, O hero, your greatness has extended beyond heaven and earth.

children.text: vṛkṣasya nu te puruhūta vayā vy ūtayo ruruhur indra pūrvīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Now your many aids, O much-invoked <s>Indra</s>, have grown up like the branches of a tree.

children.text: śacīvatas te puruśāka śākā gavām iva srutayaḥ saṃcaraṇīḥ
children.translated_text: Your powers, O many-powered one, are moving courses like the streams of cows.

children.text: vatsānāṃ na tantayas ta indra dāmanvanto adāmānaḥ sudāman ||
children.translated_text: Like the cords of calves, yours, O <s>Indra</s>, are with bonds and yet unbound, well-bound.

children.text: anyad adya karvaram anyad u śvo 'sac ca san muhur ācakrir indraḥ
children.translated_text: One task is for today, another for tomorrow; again and again <s>Indra</s> makes what is not and what is.

children.text: mitro no atra varuṇaś ca pūṣāryo vaśasya paryetāsti ||
children.translated_text: Here may <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Pūṣan</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s> stand around us for mastery.

children.text: vi tvad āpo na parvatasya pṛṣṭhād ukthebhir indrānayanta yajñaiḥ
children.translated_text: From you, O <s>Indra</s>, as waters from the back of a mountain, they have led forth praises with hymns and sacrifices.

children.text: taṃ tvābhiḥ suṣṭutibhir vājayanta ājiṃ na jagmur girvāho aśvāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeking the prize with those excellent laudations, O lord of songs, the horses have gone to you as to a contest.

children.text: na yaṃ jaranti śarado na māsā na dyāva indram avakarśayanti
children.translated_text: No autumns wear him away, no months; the two worlds do not drag <s>Indra</s> down.

children.text: vṛddhasya cid vardhatām asya tanū stomebhir ukthaiś ca śasyamānā ||
children.translated_text: Even the body of this ancient one grows, as he is praised with chants and hymns.

children.text: na vīﾱave namate na sthirāya na śardhate dasyujūtāya stavān
children.translated_text: He does not bow to the yielding one, nor to the firm one, nor to the boasting enemy driven on by <s>Dasyus</s>, when he is praised.

children.text: ajrā indrasya girayaś cid ṛṣvā gambhīre cid bhavati gādham asmai ||
children.translated_text: Unaging are even the lofty mountains of <s>Indra</s>; even in the deep a ford is found for him.

children.text: gambhīreṇa na uruṇāmatrin preṣo yandhi sutapāvan vājān
children.translated_text: With deep and broad favor, O unbetraying drinker of the pressed <s>Soma</s>, send forth the prizes to us.

children.text: sthā ū ṣu ūrdhva ūtī ariṣaṇyann aktor vyuṣṭau paritakmyāyām ||
children.translated_text: Stand upright with aid, unharming, at the break of night, at the dawning that turns all around.

children.text: sacasva nāyam avase abhīka ito vā tam indra pāhi riṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Be joined to this man close at hand for help; from here or there, O <s>Indra</s>, protect him from injury.

children.text: amā cainam araṇye pāhi riṣo madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Protect him from injury at home and in the wilderness; may we rejoice for a hundred winters, rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 466
yā ta ūtir avamā yā paramā yā madhyamendra śuṣminn asti
children.translated_text: Whatever aid of yours is lowest, whatever is highest, whatever is middle, O mighty <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: tābhir ū ṣu vṛtrahatye 'vīr na ebhiś ca vājair mahān na ugra ||
children.translated_text: with those aids favor us in the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>; with these prizes too, O fierce one, be great for us.

children.text: ābhi spṛdho mithatīr ariṣaṇyann amitrasya vyathayā manyum indra
children.translated_text: With these aids, warding off battling rivals, shake the anger of the foe, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: ābhir viśvā abhiyujo viṣūcīr āryāya viśo 'va tārīr dāsīḥ ||
children.translated_text: With these aids carry all opposing assaults away in different directions, and carry the subject peoples across for the <s>Ārya</s>.

children.text: indra jāmaya uta ye 'jāmayo 'rvācīnāso vanuṣo yuyujre
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, kinsmen and those who are not kinsmen, the near-at-hand hostile men, have yoked themselves against us.

children.text: tvam eṣāṃ vithurā śavāṃsi jahi vṛṣṇyāni kṛṇuhī parācaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Strike down their scattered powers; turn their manly forces away.

children.text: śūro vā śūraṃ vanate śarīrais tanūrucā taruṣi yat kṛṇvaite
children.translated_text: A hero wins over a hero with his bodies when the two strive in blazing strength.

children.text: toke vā goṣu tanaye yad apsu vi krandasī urvarāsu bravaite ||
children.translated_text: When there is contention over child, cows, offspring, waters, or fertile fields, the two loudly declare their claim.

children.text: nahi tvā śūro na turo na dhṛṣṇur na tvā yodho manyamāno yuyodha
children.translated_text: No hero, no swift attacker, no bold man has fought you; no warrior, thinking himself strong, has fought you.

children.text: indra nakiṣ ṭvā praty asty eṣāṃ viśvā jātāny abhy asi tāni ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, none among them stands against you; all beings that are born, you surpass them.

children.text: sa patyata ubhayor nṛmṇam ayor yadī vedhasaḥ samithe havante
children.translated_text: He gains the manly strength of both sides when the wise ones call upon him in battle,

children.text: vṛtre vā maho nṛvati kṣaye vā vyacasvantā yadi vitantasaite ||
children.translated_text: whether in the great fight with <s>Vṛtra</s>, or in a strong settlement, when the two far-stretching forces extend themselves.

children.text: adha smā te carṣaṇayo yad ejān indra trātota bhavā varūtā
children.translated_text: Then, when the peoples tremble, O <s>Indra</s>, be our savior and also our protecting defense.

children.text: asmākāso ye nṛtamāso arya indra sūrayo dadhire puro naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those who are our most manly lords, O noble <s>Indra</s>, have set you before us.

children.text: anu te dāyi maha indriyāya satrā te viśvam anu vṛtrahatye
children.translated_text: To your great <s>Indra</s>-power all has been assigned; all follows you in the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: anu kṣatram anu saho yajatrendra devebhir anu te nṛṣahye ||
children.translated_text: Kingship follows you, strength follows you, O worshipful <s>Indra</s>; with the gods it follows you in your man-winning power.

children.text: evā na spṛdhaḥ sam ajā samatsv indra rārandhi mithatīr adevīḥ
children.translated_text: Thus in battles, O <s>Indra</s>, bring our rivals together under control, the godless ones who fight against us.

children.text: vidyāma vastor avasā gṛṇanto bharadvājā uta ta indra nūnam ||
children.translated_text: May we <s>Bharadvājas</s>, praising you, now obtain a dwelling through your help.

children.text: Chapter 467
śrudhī na indra hvayāmasi tvā maho vājasya sātau vāvṛṣāṇāḥ
children.translated_text: Hear us, O <s>Indra</s>; we call upon you, grown mighty, at the winning of the great prize.

children.text: saṃ yad viśo 'yanta śūrasātā ugraṃ no 'vaḥ pārye ahan dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the clans have gone together to the winning of heroes, grant us fierce aid on the difficult day.

children.text: tvāṃ vājī havate vājineyo maho vājasya gadhyasya sātau
children.translated_text: The racer calls you, O son of the prize, at the winning of the great, graspable prize.

children.text: tvāṃ vṛtreṣv indra satpatiṃ tarutraṃ tvāṃ caṣṭe muṣṭihā goṣu yudhyan ||
children.translated_text: In the battles with <s>Vṛtras</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, he looks to you as the true lord and overcomer; he looks to you, the fist-striker, when fighting for cows.

children.text: tvaṃ kaviṃ codayo 'rkasātau tvaṃ kutsāya śuṣṇaṃ dāśuṣe vark
children.translated_text: You urged on the inspired poet at the winning of song; you, for <s>Kutsa</s> the worshipper, dealt with <s>Śuṣṇa</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ śiro amarmaṇaḥ parāhann atithigvāya śaṃsyaṃ kariṣyan ||
children.translated_text: You struck away the head of the vulnerable one, intending to make a deed worthy of praise for <s>Atithigva</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ ratham pra bharo yodham ṛṣvam āvo yudhyantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ daśadyum
children.translated_text: You brought forward the chariot, the lofty warrior; you helped the fighting bull <s>Daśadyu</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ tugraṃ vetasave sacāhan tvaṃ tujiṃ gṛṇantam indra tūtoḥ ||
children.translated_text: You struck down <s>Tugra</s> along with <s>Vetasu</s>; you protected <s>Tuji</s>, who praised you, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ tad uktham indra barhaṇā kaḥ pra yacchatā sahasrā śūra darṣi
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, made that hymn great, when, granting thousands, you showed yourself, O hero.

children.text: ava girer dāsaṃ śambaraṃ han prāvo divodāsaṃ citrābhir ūtī ||
children.translated_text: You struck down <s>Śambara</s> the <s>Dāsa</s> from the mountain, and you aided <s>Divodāsa</s> with splendid helps.

children.text: tvaṃ śraddhābhir mandasānaḥ somair dabhītaye cumurim indra siṣvap
children.translated_text: Exhilarated by faithful <s>Soma</s> draughts, O <s>Indra</s>, you put <s>Cumuri</s> to sleep for <s>Dabhīti</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ rajim piṭhīnase daśasyan ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrā śacyā sacāhan ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Piṭhīnasa</s>, in generosity, you struck down <s>Raji</s>, sixty thousand in all, by your power.

children.text: ahaṃ cana tat sūribhir ānaśyāṃ tava jyāya indra sumnam ojaḥ
children.translated_text: May I too, with the patrons, attain that gracious favor of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, your greater might.

children.text: tvayā yat stavante sadhavīra vīrās trivarūthena nahuṣā śaviṣṭha ||
children.translated_text: For, through you, the heroes accompanied by heroes praise, O strongest one, protected on three sides among the <s>Nahuṣas</s>.

children.text: vayaṃ te asyām indra dyumnahūtau sakhāyaḥ syāma mahina preṣṭhāḥ
children.translated_text: May we, your friends, O <s>Indra</s>, be most dear to you in this call to glory through greatness.

children.text: prātardaniḥ kṣatraśrīr astu śreṣṭho ghane vṛtrāṇāṃ sanaye dhanānām ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Prātardani</s>, rich in royal power, be best in the smashing of <s>Vṛtras</s> and in the winning of wealth.

children.text: Chapter 468
kim asya made kim v asya pītāv indraḥ kim asya sakhye cakāra
children.translated_text: What has <s>Indra</s> done in this exhilaration of his, what at this drinking of his, what in this friendship of his?

children.text: raṇā vā ye niṣadi kiṃ te asya purā vividre kim u nūtanāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Or what battles are there in his sitting? What ancient deeds of his have they discerned, and what new ones?

children.text: sad asya made sad v asya pītāv indraḥ sad asya sakhye cakāra
children.translated_text: Indeed, in this exhilaration of his, indeed at this drinking of his, indeed in this friendship of his, <s>Indra</s> has acted.

children.text: raṇā vā ye niṣadi sat te asya purā vividre sad u nūtanāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And the battles in his sitting are real; ancient deeds of his they have discerned, and new ones as well.

children.text: nahi nu te mahimanaḥ samasya na maghavan maghavattvasya vidma
children.translated_text: Now we do not know any equal of your greatness, nor of your bounteousness, O bounteous one.

children.text: na rādhaso rādhaso nūtanasyendra nakir dadṛśa indriyaṃ te ||
children.translated_text: No one has seen the power of your newest bounty, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: etat tyat ta indriyam aceti yenāvadhīr varaśikhasya śeṣaḥ
children.translated_text: This power of yours was perceived, by which you struck down the remnant of <s>Varaśikha</s>.

children.text: vajrasya yat te nihatasya śuṣmāt svanāc cid indra paramo dadāra ||
children.translated_text: When, from the force of your hurled thunderbolt, O <s>Indra</s>, even its sound split the highest place.

children.text: vadhīd indro varaśikhasya śeṣo 'bhyāvartine cāyamānāya śikṣan
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> struck down the remnant of <s>Varaśikha</s>, giving instruction and aid to <s>Abhyāvartin Cāyamāna</s>.

children.text: vṛcīvato yaddhariyūpīyāyāṃ han pūrve ardhe bhiyasāparo dart ||
children.translated_text: When he struck the <s>Vṛcīvants</s> at <s>Hariyūpīyā</s>, in the eastern half the others scattered in fear.

children.text: triṃśacchataṃ varmiṇa indra sākaṃ yavyāvatyām puruhūta śravasyā
children.translated_text: Thirty hundred armored men, O <s>Indra</s>, together at <s>Yavyāvatī</s>, O much-invoked one, sought fame.

children.text: vṛcīvantaḥ śarave patyamānāḥ pātrā bhindānā nyarthāny āyan ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Vṛcīvants</s>, falling before the arrow and breaking their vessels, went down to destruction.

children.text: yasya gāvāv aruṣā sūyavasyū antar ū ṣu carato rerihāṇā
children.translated_text: The one whose two reddish cows, seeking good pasture, move about within, licking as they go,

children.text: sa sṛñjayāya turvaśam parādād vṛcīvato daivavātāya śikṣan ||
children.translated_text: he, instructing, handed <s>Turvaśa</s> over to <s>Sṛñjaya Daivavāta</s>, away from the <s>Vṛcīvants</s>.

children.text: dvayāṁ agne rathino viṃśatiṃ gā vadhūmato maghavā mahyaṃ samrāṭ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, the bounteous sovereign gives me two chariot-horses, twenty cows, and brides,

children.text: abhyāvartī cāyamāno dadāti dūṇāśeyaṃ dakṣiṇā pārthavānām ||
children.translated_text: and this gift of <s>Dūṇāśeya</s>, the sacrificial fee of the <s>Pārthavas</s>, is given by <s>Abhyāvartin Cāyamāna</s>.

children.text: Chapter 469
ā gāvo agmann uta bhadram akran sīdantu goṣṭhe raṇayantv asme
children.translated_text: The cows have come; they have also brought good fortune. Let them sit in the cowshed and gladden us.

children.text: prajāvatīḥ pururūpā iha syur indrāya pūrvīr uṣaso duhānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Rich in offspring and many-formed, may they be here, milking through many dawns for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: indro yajvane pṛṇate ca śikṣaty uped dadāti na svam muṣāyati
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> instructs the sacrificer who satisfies him; he gives to him and does not steal what is his own.

children.text: bhūyo bhūyo rayim id asya vardhayann abhinne khilye ni dadhāti devayum ||
children.translated_text: Again and again increasing that man's wealth, he sets the god-loving one in an unbroken cattle-run.

children.text: na tā naśanti na dabhāti taskaro nāsām āmitro vyathir ā dadharṣati
children.translated_text: They do not perish; no thief harms them; no enemy or assailant dares to trouble them.

children.text: devāṃś ca yābhir yajate dadāti ca jyog it tābhiḥ sacate gopatiḥ saha ||
children.translated_text: With those cows by which he sacrifices to the gods and gives gifts, the lord of cattle remains joined for a long time.

children.text: na tā arvā reṇukakāṭo aśnute na saṃskṛtatram upa yanti tā abhi
children.translated_text: No dust-raising horse overtakes them, nor do they go near the place of slaughter.

children.text: urugāyam abhayaṃ tasya tā anu gāvo martasya vi caranti yajvanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The cows of the worshipping mortal roam after his wide-ranging, fearless domain.

children.text: gāvo bhago gāva indro me acchān gāvaḥ somasya prathamasya bhakṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Cows are <s>Bhaga</s>; cows are <s>Indra</s> to me; cows are the first portion of the <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: imā yā gāvaḥ sa janāsa indra icchāmīddhṛdā manasā cid indram ||
children.translated_text: These cows, O people, are <s>Indra</s>; with heart and even with mind I desire <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yūyaṃ gāvo medayathā kṛśaṃ cid aśrīraṃ cit kṛṇuthā supratīkam
children.translated_text: You cows make even the lean one fat; you make even the unlovely one fair-faced.

children.text: bhadraṃ gṛhaṃ kṛṇutha bhadravāco bṛhad vo vaya ucyate sabhāsu ||
children.translated_text: You make the house auspicious, O you of auspicious voice; your great vigor is spoken of in the assemblies.

children.text: prajāvatīḥ sūyavasaṃ riśantīḥ śuddhā apaḥ suprapāṇe pibantīḥ
children.translated_text: Rich in offspring, grazing good pasture, and drinking pure waters at a good watering-place,

children.text: mā va stena īśata māghaśaṃsaḥ pari vo hetī rudrasya vṛjyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: let no thief or evil-speaking man rule over you; may <s>Rudra</s>'s missile be turned away from you.

children.text: upedam upaparcanam āsu goṣūpa pṛcyatām
children.translated_text: Let this joining be joined among these cows; let it be brought close to them.

children.text: upa ṛṣabhasya retasy upendra tava vīrye ||
children.translated_text: Let it be joined to the bull's seed, to your virile power, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 470
indraṃ vo naraḥ sakhyāya sepur maho yantaḥ sumataye cakānāḥ
children.translated_text: Men have sought <s>Indra</s> for friendship, going to the great one and desiring his favor.

children.text: maho hi dātā vajrahasto asti mahām u raṇvam avase yajadhvam ||
children.translated_text: For the great giver, the <s>vajra</s>-handed one, exists; worship the great, delightful one for help.

children.text: ā yasmin haste naryā mimikṣur ā rathe hiraṇyaye ratheṣṭhāḥ
children.translated_text: Into whose hand the men poured heroic powers, and onto the golden chariot the chariot-fighters came,

children.text: ā raśmayo gabhastyo sthūrayor ādhvann aśvāso vṛṣaṇo yujānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: there the reins and hand-straps stretched over the strong shafts, and the virile horses were yoked.

children.text: śriye te pādā duva ā mimikṣur dhṛṣṇur vajrī śavasā dakṣiṇāvān
children.translated_text: For your splendor and service your feet were made ready; bold, <s>vajra</s>-bearing, powerful, and rich in gifts,

children.text: vasāno atkaṃ surabhiṃ dṛśe kaṃ svar ṇa nṛtav iṣiro babhūtha ||
children.translated_text: wearing a fragrant garment pleasant to see, like the sun you became active and impetuous.

children.text: sa soma āmiślatamaḥ suto bhūd yasmin paktiḥ pacyate santi dhānāḥ
children.translated_text: That pressed <s>Soma</s> became the best-mixed, where the cooked offering is cooked and the grains are present.

children.text: indraṃ nara stuvanto brahmakārā ukthā śaṃsanto devavātatamāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Men praise <s>Indra</s>, makers of sacred formulation, reciters of hymns, most devoted to the gods.

children.text: na te antaḥ śavaso dhāyy asya vi tu bābadhe rodasī mahitvā
children.translated_text: There is no limit set to this might of yours; the two worlds cannot hem you in because of your greatness.

children.text: ā tā sūriḥ pṛṇati tūtujāno yūthevāpsu samījamāna ūtī ||
children.translated_text: The generous patron, pressing forward, fills them with aid, like a herd being driven together to the waters.

children.text: eved indraḥ suhava ṛṣvo astūtī anūtī hiriśipraḥ satvā
children.translated_text: Thus may <s>Indra</s>, lofty and easy to invoke, be here for help and not for abandonment, the tawny-jawed hero.

children.text: evā hi jāto asamātyojāḥ purū ca vṛtrā hanati ni dasyūn ||
children.translated_text: For thus, born with incomparable force, he strikes down many <s>Vṛtras</s> and lays low the <s>Dasyus</s>.

children.text: Chapter 471
bhūya id vāvṛdhe vīryāyaṃ eko ajuryo dayate vasūni
