children.translated_text: He grew still more for heroic power; alone and undecaying, he apportions treasures.

children.text: pra ririce diva indraḥ pṛthivyā ardham id asya prati rodasī ubhe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> has surpassed heaven and earth; both worlds together are only half of him.

children.text: adhā manye bṛhad asuryam asya yāni dādhāra nakir ā mināti
children.translated_text: Therefore I think his great lordly power is in the things he has upheld; no one diminishes them.

children.text: dive dive sūryo darśato bhūd vi sadmāny urviyā sukratur dhāt ||
children.translated_text: Day after day the visible sun has appeared; the wise one has widely established the dwellings.

children.text: adyā cin nū cit tad apo nadīnāṃ yad ābhyo arado gātum indra
children.translated_text: Even today that deed concerns the waters, the rivers, when you, <s>Indra</s>, dug out a path for them.

children.text: ni parvatā admasado na sedus tvayā dṛﾱhāni sukrato rajāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: The mountains settled down like eaters of food; by you, O wise one, the firm spaces were opened.

children.text: satyam it tan na tvāvāṁ anyo astīndra devo na martyo jyāyān
children.translated_text: This is true: there is no other like you, O <s>Indra</s>, no god and no mortal greater than you.

children.text: ahann ahim pariśayānam arṇo 'vāsṛjo apo acchā samudram ||
children.translated_text: You struck the serpent lying around the flood; you released the waters toward the ocean.

children.text: tvam apo vi duro viṣūcīr indra dṛﾱham arujaḥ parvatasya
children.translated_text: You opened the waters in every direction, O <s>Indra</s>; you broke the firm part of the mountain.

children.text: rājābhavo jagataś carṣaṇīnāṃ sākaṃ sūryaṃ janayan dyām uṣāsam ||
children.translated_text: You became king of the moving world and of peoples, bringing forth the sun, heaven, and dawn.

children.text: Chapter 472
abhūr eko rayipate rayīṇām ā hastayor adhithā indra kṛṣṭīḥ
children.translated_text: You alone became lord of riches among riches; in your hands, O <s>Indra</s>, you held the peoples.

children.text: vi toke apsu tanaye ca sūre 'vocanta carṣaṇayo vivācaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In offspring, in the waters, in descendants, and in the hero, the clans of many voices proclaimed you.

children.text: tvad bhiyendra pārthivāni viśvācyutā cic cyāvayante rajāṃsi
children.translated_text: Through fear of you, O <s>Indra</s>, all earthly realms, even the immovable ones, are shaken loose.

children.text: dyāvākṣāmā parvatāso vanāni viśvaṃ dṛﾱham bhayate ajmann ā te ||
children.translated_text: Heaven and earth, the mountains and the forests: everything firm fears your onset.

children.text: tvaṃ kutsenābhi śuṣṇam indrāśuṣaṃ yudhya kuyavaṃ gaviṣṭau
children.translated_text: With <s>Kutsa</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, you fought against <s>Śuṣṇa</s>, against the drought, and against <s>Kuyava</s> in the search for cows.

children.text: daśa prapitve adha sūryasya muṣāyaś cakram avive rapāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: At the pressing, beneath the sun, you stole the wheel; you made the hostile forces vanish.

children.text: tvaṃ śatāny ava śambarasya puro jaghanthāpratīni dasyoḥ
children.translated_text: You smashed down the hundreds of unassailable forts of <s>Śambara</s>, the <s>Dasyu</s>.

children.text: aśikṣo yatra śacyā śacīvo divodāsāya sunvate sutakre bharadvājāya gṛṇate vasūni ||
children.translated_text: There, by your power, O powerful one, you bestowed riches on <s>Divodāsa</s>, the Soma-presser, the skillful presser, and on <s>Bharadvāja</s>, who praised you.

children.text: sa satyasatvan mahate raṇāya ratham ā tiṣṭha tuvinṛmṇa bhīmam
children.translated_text: O true in strength, mount the fearsome chariot for the great battle, O one mighty in men.

children.text: yāhi prapathinn avasopa madrik pra ca śruta śrāvaya carṣaṇibhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Go forth on the road with aid toward me; and, famed one, make yourself heard among the peoples.

children.text: Chapter 473
apūrvyā purutamāny asmai mahe vīrāya tavase turāya
children.translated_text: For him, the great hero, most mighty and swift, I fashion unprecedented and most manifold words,

children.text: virapśine vajriṇe śantamāni vacāṃsy āsā sthavirāya takṣam ||
children.translated_text: for the far-reaching, <s>vajra</s>-bearing, most kindly ancient one, I have shaped them with my mouth.

children.text: sa mātarā sūryeṇā kavīnām avāsayad rujad adriṃ gṛṇānaḥ
children.translated_text: He clothed the two mothers of the poets with the sun; praised in song, he broke the rock.

children.text: svādhībhir ṛkvabhir vāvaśāna ud usriyāṇām asṛjan nidānam ||
children.translated_text: With self-ruling verses, longing for them, he released the hidden place of the bright cows.

children.text: sa vahnibhir ṛkvabhir goṣu śaśvan mitajñubhiḥ purukṛtvā jigāya
children.translated_text: With bearers and with verses, among the cows he always conquered, much-working, with measured bowings.

children.text: puraḥ purohā sakhibhiḥ sakhīyan dṛﾱhā ruroja kavibhiḥ kaviḥ san ||
children.translated_text: Breaking fort after fort, befriending his friends, he, a poet among poets, shattered the firm ones.

children.text: sa nīvyābhir jaritāram acchā maho vājebhir mahadbhiś ca śuṣmaiḥ
children.translated_text: With near protections, with great prizes and with great powers, go toward the singer,

children.text: puruvīrābhir vṛṣabha kṣitīnām ā girvaṇaḥ suvitāya pra yāhi ||
children.translated_text: with many heroes, O bull of the peoples, O lover of song; come forward for good fortune.

children.text: sa sargeṇa śavasā takto atyair apa indro dakṣiṇatas turāṣāṭ
children.translated_text: With his outpouring force, harnessed with coursers, <s>Indra</s>, the swift conqueror, drove the waters away from the right side.

children.text: itthā sṛjānā anapāvṛd arthaṃ dive dive viviṣur apramṛṣyam ||
children.translated_text: Thus, being released and not checked in their purpose, day after day they entered the unassailable realm.

children.text: Chapter 474
ya ojiṣṭha indra taṃ su no dā mado vṛṣan svabhiṣṭir dāsvān
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, give us that strongest exhilaration, O bull, self-helping and generous,

children.text: sauvaśvyaṃ yo vanavat svaśvo vṛtrā samatsu sāsahad amitrān ||
children.translated_text: which wins good horses and, itself well horsed, overcomes <s>Vṛtra</s> and enemies in battles.

children.text: tvāṃ hīndrāvase vivāco havante carṣaṇayaḥ śūrasātau
children.translated_text: For all-speaking peoples call upon you, O <s>Indra</s>, for aid in the winning of heroes.

children.text: tvaṃ viprebhir vi paṇīṃr aśāyas tvota it sanitā vājam arvā ||
children.translated_text: You made the <s>Paṇis</s> lie scattered by means of the inspired poets; protected by you, the winning horse gains the prize.

children.text: tvaṃ tāṁ indrobhayāṁ amitrān dāsā vṛtrāṇy āryā ca śūra
children.translated_text: You, O heroic <s>Indra</s>, slew both kinds of foes, the slave enemies and the Aryan <s>Vṛtras</s>.

children.text: vadhīr vaneva sudhitebhir atkair ā pṛtsu darṣi nṛṇāṃ nṛtama ||
children.translated_text: Like trees with well-sharpened axes you cut them down; in battles you appear as the manliest of men.

children.text: sa tvaṃ na indrākavābhir ūtī sakhā viśvāyur avitā vṛdhe bhūḥ
children.translated_text: So you, O <s>Indra</s>, be our friend with protecting aids, long-lived, a guardian for increase.

children.text: svarṣātā yaddhvayāmasi tvā yudhyanto nemadhitā pṛtsu śūra ||
children.translated_text: When we call on you in battles for the winning of light, while fighting, O hero, in contest for shares.

children.text: nūnaṃ na indrāparāya ca syā bhavā mṛﾱīka uta no abhiṣṭau
children.translated_text: Now, O <s>Indra</s>, be for us also hereafter; be gracious to us and be present for our help.

children.text: itthā gṛṇanto mahinasya śarman divi ṣyāma pārye goṣatamāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Praising thus, may we be under the shelter of your greatness, in heaven's farthest place, richest in cattle.

children.text: Chapter 475
saṃ ca tve jagmur gira indra pūrvīr vi ca tvad yanti vibhvo manīṣāḥ
children.translated_text: Many songs have come together to you, O <s>Indra</s>; many thoughts go forth from you, O far-reaching one.

children.text: purā nūnaṃ ca stutaya ṛṣīṇām paspṛdhra indre adhy ukthārkā ||
children.translated_text: Formerly and now the praises of the seers, the hymns and chants, have vied with one another in <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: puruhūto yaḥ purugūrta ṛbhvāṁ ekaḥ purupraśasto asti yajñaiḥ
children.translated_text: He is much-invoked, much-praised, mighty, one alone, widely celebrated through sacrifices.

children.text: ratho na mahe śavase yujāno 'smābhir indro anumādyo bhūt ||
children.translated_text: Like a chariot yoked for great strength, may <s>Indra</s> be gladdened together with us.

children.text: na yaṃ hiṃsanti dhītayo na vāṇīr indraṃ nakṣantīd abhi vardhayantīḥ
children.translated_text: Thoughts and voices do not injure him; they reach <s>Indra</s> and increase him.

children.text: yadi stotāraḥ śataṃ yat sahasraṃ gṛṇanti girvaṇasaṃ śaṃ tad asmai ||
children.translated_text: If the praisers, whether a hundred or a thousand, praise the lover of song, may that be a blessing for him.

children.text: asmā etad divy arceva māsā mimikṣa indre ny ayāmi somaḥ
children.translated_text: For him, as a heavenly chant in the months, the <s>Soma</s> has mingled itself; I pour it down into <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: janaṃ na dhanvann abhi saṃ yad āpaḥ satrā vāvṛdhur havanāni yajñaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: As waters gather upon a man in the desert, so invocations with sacrifices have mightily increased him.

children.text: asmā etan mahy āṅgūṣam asmā indrāya stotram matibhir avāci
children.translated_text: For him, for this great cry, for <s>Indra</s>, this praise has been uttered with thoughts.

children.text: asad yathā mahati vṛtratūrya indro viśvāyur avitā vṛdhaś ca ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, ever-living, be a helper and increaser in the great contest with <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 476
kadā bhuvan rathakṣayāṇi brahma kadā stotre sahasrapoṣyaṃ dāḥ
children.translated_text: When will the prayers be dwelling with chariots? When will you give a thousandfold nourishment to the hymn?

children.text: kadā stomaṃ vāsayo 'sya rāyā kadā dhiyaḥ karasi vājaratnāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When will you clothe this chant with wealth? When will you make our thoughts rich in prizes?

children.text: karhi svit tad indra yan nṛbhir nṝn vīrair vīrān nīﾱayāse jayājīn
children.translated_text: When will that be, O <s>Indra</s>, when with men you lead men, and with heroes heroes, to win the battles?

children.text: tridhātu gā adhi jayāsi goṣv indra dyumnaṃ svarvad dhehy asme ||
children.translated_text: Win the threefold cattle among the cows; O <s>Indra</s>, place splendor rich in light among us.

children.text: karhi svit tad indra yaj jaritre viśvapsu brahma kṛṇavaḥ śaviṣṭha
children.translated_text: When will that be, O <s>Indra</s>, strongest one, when you will make a prayer for the singer, rich in all goods?

children.text: kadā dhiyo na niyuto yuvāse kadā gomaghā havanāni gacchāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When will you yoke our thoughts like teams? When will you come to our invocations rich in cattle?

children.text: sa gomaghā jaritre aśvaścandrā vājaśravaso adhi dhehi pṛkṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Set for the singer cattle-rich, horse-bright, prize-renowned refreshments.

children.text: pīpihīṣaḥ sudughām indra dhenum bharadvājeṣu suruco rurucyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, make the well-milking cow swell with milk; among the <s>Bharadvājas</s> shine forth with fair radiance.

children.text: tam ā nūnaṃ vṛjanam anyathā cicchūro yacchakra vi duro gṛṇīṣe
children.translated_text: Now stir up that enclosure otherwise, O hero; whatever stronghold, O mighty one, is hard to praise open wide.

children.text: mā nir araṃ śukradughasya dhenor āṅgirasān brahmaṇā vipra jinva ||
children.translated_text: Do not let the brightly milking cow be withheld; O inspired one, quicken the <s>Āṅgirasas</s> with sacred formulation.

children.text: Chapter 477
satrā madāsas tava viśvajanyāḥ satrā rāyo 'dha ye pārthivāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Altogether your exhilarations are for all people; altogether also are the earthly riches.

children.text: satrā vājānām abhavo vibhaktā yad deveṣu dhārayathā asuryam ||
children.translated_text: Altogether you became the distributor of prizes, when you held lordly power among the gods.

children.text: anu pra yeje jana ojo asya satrā dadhire anu vīryāya
children.translated_text: The people have followed after this strength of his; altogether they have held fast to his heroic power.

children.text: syūmagṛbhe dudhaye 'rvate ca kratuṃ vṛñjanty api vṛtrahatye ||
children.translated_text: For the well-harnessed grasp, for the milch cow and for the running horse, they choose his will even in the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: taṃ sadhrīcīr ūtayo vṛṣṇyāni pauṃsyāni niyutaḥ saścur indram
children.translated_text: Concordant aids, virile powers, manly deeds, and teams of steeds have attended <s>Indra</s> the bull.

children.text: samudraṃ na sindhava ukthaśuṣmā uruvyacasaṃ gira ā viśanti ||
children.translated_text: Like rivers into the ocean, hymns full of force and songs enter the wide-ranging one.

children.text: sa rāyas khām upa sṛjā gṛṇānaḥ puruścandrasya tvam indra vasvaḥ
children.translated_text: So, being praised, release for us the opening of wealth; you, O <s>Indra</s>, are lord of much brilliant treasure.

children.text: patir babhūthāsamo janānām eko viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā ||
children.translated_text: You have become the unmatched master of peoples, the one king of the whole world.

children.text: sa tu śrudhi śrutyā yo duvoyur dyaur na bhūmābhi rāyo aryaḥ
children.translated_text: So hear the one who serves you with worship; like the broad heaven and earth, O noble one, you are rich in wealth.

children.text: aso yathā naḥ śavasā cakāno yuge yuge vayasā cekitānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: As one favoring us with power, mindful through age after age and through the course of life, be so for us.

children.text: Chapter 478
arvāg rathaṃ viśvavāraṃ ta ugrendra yuktāso harayo vahantu
children.translated_text: Let your yoked bay horses, O fierce <s>Indra</s>, bring your all-desired chariot hither.

children.text: kīriś ciddhi tvā havate svarvān ṛdhīmahi sadhamādas te adya ||
children.translated_text: For even the singer, possessing light, calls you; today may we prosper in your common feast.

children.text: pro droṇe harayaḥ karmāgman punānāsa ṛjyanto abhūvan
children.translated_text: The bay horses have come forth to the vessel for the rite; being purified, they have become straight-going.

children.text: indro no asya pūrvyaḥ papīyād dyukṣo madasya somyasya rājā ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, our ancient king, bright and heavenly, drink of this intoxicating <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: āsasrāṇāsaḥ śavasānam acchendraṃ sucakre rathyāso aśvāḥ
children.translated_text: The chariot-horses, streaming toward mighty <s>Indra</s>, with good wheels and with force,

children.text: abhi śrava ṛjyanto vaheyur nū cin nu vāyor amṛtaṃ vi dasyet ||
children.translated_text: may carry him toward fame as they speed along; even now may he distribute the immortal draught of <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: variṣṭho asya dakṣiṇām iyartīndro maghonāṃ tuvikūrmitamaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, strongest among the generous and most mighty in action, raises up his gift.

children.text: yayā vajrivaḥ pariyāsy aṃho maghā ca dhṛṣṇo dayase vi sūrīn ||
children.translated_text: With it, O wielder of the <s>vajra</s>, you go around distress; O bold one, with gifts you favor the patrons.

children.text: indro vājasya sthavirasya dātendro gīrbhir vardhatāṃ vṛddhamahāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is the giver of the firm prize; may <s>Indra</s>, great by increase, grow through songs.

children.text: indro vṛtraṃ haniṣṭho astu satvā tā sūriḥ pṛṇati tūtujānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> be the strongest slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, the powerful one; the patron, pressing forward, fills these things.

children.text: Chapter 479
apād ita ud u naś citratamo mahīm bharṣad dyumatīm indrahūtim
children.translated_text: From here let the most wondrous one rise up and bear the great, shining invocation of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: panyasīṃ dhītiṃ daivyasya yāmañ janasya rātiṃ vanate sudānuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The generous giver wins the praiseworthy thought, the divine course, and the gift of the people.

children.text: dūrāc cid ā vasato asya karṇā ghoṣād indrasya tanyati bruvāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Even from afar, from his dwelling, his ears thunder at the sound when <s>Indra</s> is being invoked.

children.text: eyam enaṃ devahūtir vavṛtyān madryag indram iyam ṛcyamānā ||
children.translated_text: May this divine invocation, being recited, turn him, <s>Indra</s>, hither toward me.

children.text: taṃ vo dhiyā paramayā purājām ajaram indram abhy anūṣy arkaiḥ
children.translated_text: Him, <s>Indra</s>, born of old and ageless, I praise for you with highest thought and with songs;

children.text: brahmā ca giro dadhire sam asmin mahāṃś ca stomo adhi vardhad indre ||
children.translated_text: the sacred formulations and chants have been set together in him, and a great hymn has grown in <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: vardhād yaṃ yajña uta soma indraṃ vardhād brahma gira ukthā ca manma
children.translated_text: May the sacrifice and the <s>Soma</s> strengthen <s>Indra</s>; may the <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation), the songs, the praises, and the thought strengthen him.

children.text: vardhāhainam uṣaso yāmann aktor vardhān māsāḥ śarado dyāva indram ||
children.translated_text: May the dawns, in the course of night, strengthen him; may the months, the autumns, and heaven strengthen <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: evā jajñānaṃ sahase asāmi vāvṛdhānaṃ rādhase ca śrutāya
children.translated_text: Thus, born for might, unequalled, growing for bounty and for renowned fame,

children.text: mahām ugram avase vipra nūnam ā vivāsema vṛtratūryeṣu ||
children.translated_text: may we now invite the great and fierce one for aid, O inspired singer, in battles against <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 480
mandrasya kaver divyasya vahner vipramanmano vacanasya madhvaḥ
children.translated_text: Of the delightful poet, the heavenly carrier, of inspired mind, and of the sweet utterance,

children.text: apā nas tasya sacanasya deveṣo yuvasva gṛṇate goagrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O gods, keep hostility away from us, away from that companionship; for the singer let the cows be foremost.

children.text: ayam uśānaḥ pary adrim usrā ṛtadhītibhir ṛtayug yujānaḥ
children.translated_text: This one, desiring, went around the rock to the bright cows; with thoughts set on <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), yoked with a team joined to <s>ṛta</s>,

children.text: rujad arugṇaṃ vi valasya sānum paṇīṃr vacobhir abhi yodhad indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> split the unbroken summit of <s>Vala</s> and battled the <s>Paṇis</s> with words.

children.text: ayaṃ dyotayad adyuto vy aktūn doṣā vastoḥ śarada indur indra
children.translated_text: This bright <s>Soma</s> drop, O <s>Indra</s>, made the unshining nights shine, the evenings, mornings, and autumn days;

children.text: imaṃ ketum adadhur nū cid ahnāṃ śucijanmana uṣasaś cakāra ||
children.translated_text: now they have set up this sign of the days; he made the dawns of bright birth.

children.text: ayaṃ rocayad aruco rucāno 'yaṃ vāsayad vy ṛtena pūrvīḥ
children.translated_text: This shining one made the lightless ones shine; this one clothed many former dawns with truth;

children.text: ayam īyata ṛtayugbhir aśvaiḥ svarvidā nābhinā carṣaṇiprāḥ ||
children.translated_text: this one goes with truth-yoked horses, finding the sun, filling the peoples from the navel.

children.text: nū gṛṇāno gṛṇate pratna rājann iṣaḥ pinva vasudeyāya pūrvīḥ
children.translated_text: Now, being praised by the singer, O ancient king, swell many refreshments for the giving of wealth;

children.text: apa oṣadhīr aviṣā vanāni gā arvato nṝn ṛcase rirīhi ||
children.translated_text: release waters, plants, forests, cows, horses, and men for praise.

children.text: Chapter 481
indra piba tubhyaṃ suto madāyāva sya harī vi mucā sakhāyā
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, drink; the pressed <s>Soma</s> is for you, for exhilaration. Unyoke your two bay friends here,

children.text: uta pra gāya gaṇa ā niṣadyāthā yajñāya gṛṇate vayo dhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: and sing forth, sitting among the troop; then grant vigor to the singer for the sacrifice.

children.text: asya piba yasya jajñāna indra madāya kratve apibo virapśin
children.translated_text: Drink of this, of which, when it was born, O <s>Indra</s>, you drank for exhilaration and resolve, O mighty one;

children.text: tam u te gāvo nara āpo adrir induṃ sam ahyan pītaye sam asmai ||
children.translated_text: for you the cows, men, waters, and pressing-stone together strengthened this <s>Soma</s> drop for drinking, for this one.

children.text: samiddhe agnau suta indra soma ā tvā vahantu harayo vahiṣṭhāḥ
children.translated_text: When the fire is kindled and the <s>Soma</s> is pressed, O <s>Indra</s>, may the bay horses, best at carrying, bring you.

children.text: tvāyatā manasā johavīmīndrā yāhi suvitāya mahe naḥ ||
children.translated_text: With a mind directed to you I call and call: O <s>Indra</s>, come for our great well-being.

children.text: ā yāhi śaśvad uśatā yayāthendra mahā manasā somapeyam
children.translated_text: Come always, as you have come with eager, great mind, O <s>Indra</s>, to the <s>Soma</s>-drinking.

children.text: upa brahmāṇi śṛṇava imā no 'thā te yajñas tanve vayo dhāt ||
children.translated_text: Hear these sacred formulations of ours; then may your sacrifice set vigor in your body.

children.text: yad indra divi pārye yad ṛdhag yad vā sve sadane yatra vāsi
children.translated_text: Whether you are in the farthest heaven, whether apart, or in your own seat, wherever you are,

children.text: ato no yajñam avase niyutvān sajoṣāḥ pāhi girvaṇo marudbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: from there, harnessed with teams, O lover of song, protect our sacrifice for aid, in accord with the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: Chapter 482
aheﾱamāna upa yāhi yajñaṃ tubhyam pavanta indavaḥ sutāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Come to the sacrifice without disdain; for you the pressed <s>Soma</s> drops purify themselves.

children.text: gāvo na vajrin svam oko acchendrā gahi prathamo yajñiyānām ||
children.translated_text: Like cows toward their own stall, O thunderbolt-bearer, come here, O <s>Indra</s>, first of those worthy of sacrifice.

children.text: yā te kākut sukṛtā yā variṣṭhā yayā śaśvat pibasi madhva ūrmim
children.translated_text: That crest of yours, well made, that highest one by which you constantly drink the wave of sweetness,

children.text: tayā pāhi pra te adhvaryur asthāt saṃ te vajro vartatām indra gavyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: with that protect us; the <s>adhvaryu</s> (ritual priest) has stood ready before you. May your thunderbolt, O <s>Indra</s>, turn cow-seeking.

children.text: eṣa drapso vṛṣabho viśvarūpa indrāya vṛṣṇe sam akāri somaḥ
children.translated_text: This drop, the bull of every form, the <s>Soma</s>, has been prepared for bull-like <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: etam piba hariva sthātar ugra yasyeśiṣe pradivi yas te annam ||
children.translated_text: Drink it, O bay-horsed, standing, fierce one, whose food it is and over which you have lordship from of old.

children.text: sutaḥ somo asutād indra vasyān ayaṃ śreyāñ cikituṣe raṇāya
children.translated_text: The pressed <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, is better than the unpressed; this one is better for the discerning contest.

children.text: etaṃ titirva upa yāhi yajñaṃ tena viśvās taviṣīr ā pṛṇasva ||
children.translated_text: Come to this sacrifice, O victorious one; with it fill up all your powers.

children.text: hvayāmasi tvendra yāhy arvāṅ araṃ te somas tanve bhavāti
children.translated_text: We call you; O <s>Indra</s>, come hither. The <s>Soma</s> will be enough for your body.

children.text: śatakrato mādayasvā suteṣu prāsmāṁ ava pṛtanāsu pra vikṣu ||
children.translated_text: O hundred-powered one, rejoice in the pressed draughts; protect us in battles, protect us among the peoples.

children.text: Chapter 483
praty asmai pipīṣate viśvāni viduṣe bhara
children.translated_text: For him who longs to drink, for the one who knows, bring all things,

children.text: araṅgamāya jagmaye 'paścāddaghvane nare ||
children.translated_text: for the man who goes straight to the goal, who has set out, who does not strike from behind.

children.text: em enam pratyetana somebhiḥ somapātamam
children.translated_text: Go toward him with the <s>Somas</s>, toward the greatest drinker of <s>Soma</s>,

children.text: amatrebhir ṛjīṣiṇam indraṃ sutebhir indubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: toward <s>Indra</s>, impetuous, with vessels and with pressed <s>Soma</s> drops.

children.text: yadī sutebhir indubhiḥ somebhiḥ pratibhūṣatha
children.translated_text: When you adorn him with pressed drops, with <s>Somas</s>,

children.text: vedā viśvasya medhiro dhṛṣat taṃ tam id eṣate ||
children.translated_text: the wise one knows the whole; boldly he seeks each and every prize.

children.text: asmā asmā id andhaso 'dhvaryo pra bharā sutam
children.translated_text: For this one, for this one, O <s>adhvaryu</s> (ritual priest), bring forward the pressed draught,

children.text: kuvit samasya jenyasya śardhato 'bhiśaster avasparat ||
children.translated_text: so that perhaps he may ward off the curse of the whole raging, conquering foe.

children.text: Chapter 484
yasya tyacchambaram made divodāsāya randhayaḥ
children.translated_text: In whose intoxication you subdued that <s>Śambara</s> for <s>Divodāsa</s>;

children.text: ayaṃ sa soma indra te sutaḥ piba ||
children.translated_text: this is that <s>Soma</s>, pressed for you, O <s>Indra</s>; drink.

children.text: yasya tīvrasutam madam madhyam antaṃ ca rakṣase
children.translated_text: Of whose sharply pressed exhilaration you guard the middle and the end;

children.text: ayaṃ sa soma indra te sutaḥ piba ||
children.translated_text: this is that <s>Soma</s>, pressed for you, O <s>Indra</s>; drink.

children.text: yasya gā antar aśmano made dṛﾱhā avāsṛjaḥ
children.translated_text: In whose intoxication you released the cows held firm inside the stone;

children.text: ayaṃ sa soma indra te sutaḥ piba ||
children.translated_text: this is that <s>Soma</s>, pressed for you, O <s>Indra</s>; drink.

children.text: yasya mandāno andhaso māghonaṃ dadhiṣe śavaḥ
children.translated_text: Of whose draught, when exhilarated, you place strength in the generous patron;

children.text: ayaṃ sa soma indra te sutaḥ piba ||
children.translated_text: this is that <s>Soma</s>, pressed for you, O <s>Indra</s>; drink.

children.text: Chapter 485
yo rayivo rayintamo yo dyumnair dyumnavattamaḥ
children.translated_text: He who is richest in wealth, who has the most riches, who through splendors is most splendid,

children.text: somaḥ sutaḥ sa indra te 'sti svadhāpate madaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that pressed <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, is your exhilaration, O lord of <s>svadhā</s> (self-power).

children.text: yaḥ śagmas tuviśagma te rāyo dāmā matīnām
children.translated_text: He who is strong, very strong for you, the giver of riches and of inspired thoughts,

children.text: somaḥ sutaḥ sa indra te 'sti svadhāpate madaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that pressed <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, is your exhilaration, O lord of <s>svadhā</s> (self-power).

children.text: yena vṛddho na śavasā turo na svābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: By whom you have grown mighty in strength, swift with your own aids,

children.text: somaḥ sutaḥ sa indra te 'sti svadhāpate madaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that pressed <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, is your exhilaration, O lord of <s>svadhā</s> (self-power).

children.text: tyam u vo aprahaṇaṃ gṛṇīṣe śavasas patim
children.translated_text: That unassailable one I sing for you, the lord of might,

children.text: indraṃ viśvāsāhaṃ naram maṃhiṣṭhaṃ viśvacarṣaṇim ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, the all-overcoming man, most bounteous, belonging to all peoples.

children.text: yaṃ vardhayantīd giraḥ patiṃ turasya rādhasaḥ
children.translated_text: Whom the songs increase, the lord of swift bounty,

children.text: tam in nv asya rodasī devī śuṣmaṃ saparyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: him indeed the two divine worlds now honor as this one's power.

children.text: tad va ukthasya barhaṇendrāyopastṛṇīṣaṇi
children.translated_text: That spreading of the praise-song for you I would strew for <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: vipo na yasyotayo vi yad rohanti sakṣitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: whose aids, like inspired singers, spread forth when they rise apart with power.

children.text: avidad dakṣam mitro navīyān papāno devebhyo vasyo acait
children.translated_text: The newer <s>Mitra</s>, drinking, found skill; he perceived what was better for the gods.

children.text: sasavān staulābhir dhautarībhir uruṣyā pāyur abhavat sakhibhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having gained, with the staulābha and dhautarī aids, he became a broad protector for his companions.

children.text: ṛtasya pathi vedhā apāyi śriye manāṃsi devāso akran
children.translated_text: On the path of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), the ordainer has been drunk; the gods have fashioned thoughts for splendor.

children.text: dadhāno nāma maho vacobhir vapur dṛśaye venyo vy āvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bearing a great name through utterances, he has opened his lovely form to be seen.

children.text: dyumattamaṃ dakṣaṃ dhehy asme sedhā janānām pūrvīr arātīḥ
children.translated_text: Place in us the most brilliant skill; drive away the many former hostilities of men.

children.text: varṣīyo vayaḥ kṛṇuhi śacībhir dhanasya sātāv asmāṁ aviḍḍhi ||
children.translated_text: Make our life-span longer by your powers; at the winning of wealth, protect us.

children.text: indra tubhyam in maghavann abhūma vayaṃ dātre harivo mā vi venaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, bountiful one, lord of bay horses, we have become yours, for you are the giver; do not be displeased with us.

children.text: nakir āpir dadṛśe martyatrā kim aṅga radhracodanaṃ tvāhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: No nearer friend is seen among mortals; why then do they call you an inciter of the poor?

children.text: mā jasvane vṛṣabha no rarīthā mā te revataḥ sakhye riṣāma
children.translated_text: Do not hand us over to one who would consume us, O bull; may we not suffer harm in friendship with you, the wealthy one.

children.text: pūrvīṣ ṭa indra niṣṣidho janeṣu jahy asuṣvīn pra vṛhāpṛṇataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Many are your checks among people, O <s>Indra</s>; strike down the non-pressers, the swollen and ungiving men.

children.text: ud abhrāṇīva stanayann iyartīndro rādhāṃsy aśvyāni gavyā
children.translated_text: Thundering like clouds, <s>Indra</s> sends up horse-rich and cow-rich gifts.

children.text: tvam asi pradivaḥ kārudhāyā mā tvādāmāna ā dabhan maghonaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are from of old the support of the singer; let not those who would seize from you deceive the generous patrons.

children.text: adhvaryo vīra pra mahe sutānām indrāya bhara sa hy asya rājā
children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryu</s> priest, heroic one, bring forward the great pressings for <s>Indra</s>, for he is king over this Soma.

children.text: yaḥ pūrvyābhir uta nūtanābhir gīrbhir vāvṛdhe gṛṇatām ṛṣīṇām ||
children.translated_text: He who has grown great through both ancient and new songs of the praising seers.

children.text: asya made puru varpāṃsi vidvān indro vṛtrāṇy apratī jaghāna
children.translated_text: Knowing many forms in this exhilaration, <s>Indra</s> has struck down the resisting <s>Vṛtras</s>.

children.text: tam u pra hoṣi madhumantam asmai somaṃ vīrāya śipriṇe pibadhyai ||
children.translated_text: So pour out for him, the hero with beautiful lips, that honeyed <s>Soma</s> for him to drink.

children.text: pātā sutam indro astu somaṃ hantā vṛtraṃ vajreṇa mandasānaḥ
children.translated_text: Let <s>Indra</s> be the drinker of the pressed <s>Soma</s>, rejoicing as the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s> with the <s>vajra</s>.

children.text: gantā yajñam parāvataś cid acchā vasur dhīnām avitā kārudhāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even from afar he comes to the sacrifice, a benefactor, protector of thoughts and support of the singer.

children.text: idaṃ tyat pātram indrapānam indrasya priyam amṛtam apāyi
children.translated_text: This vessel, this drink for <s>Indra</s>, dear to <s>Indra</s>, has been drunk as an immortal draught.

children.text: matsad yathā saumanasāya devaṃ vy asmad dveṣo yuyavad vy aṃhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May it exhilarate the god for gracious-mindedness; may it drive hatred and distress away from us.

children.text: enā mandāno jahi śūra śatrūñ jāmim ajāmim maghavann amitrān
children.translated_text: Rejoicing with this, O hero, strike down the enemies, O bountiful one, both kinsman and non-kinsman, the hostile men.

children.text: abhiṣeṇāṁ abhy ādediśānān parāca indra pra mṛṇā jahī ca ||
children.translated_text: Those who marshal armies and make attacks, O <s>Indra</s>, crush them backward and slay them.

children.text: āsu ṣmā ṇo maghavann indra pṛtsv asmabhyam mahi varivaḥ sugaṃ kaḥ
children.translated_text: In these battles, O bountiful <s>Indra</s>, make for us great, easy passage and broad room.

children.text: apāṃ tokasya tanayasya jeṣa indra sūrīn kṛṇuhi smā no ardham ||
children.translated_text: Win for us waters, offspring, and descendants; O <s>Indra</s>, make the patrons our portion.

children.text: ā tvā harayo vṛṣaṇo yujānā vṛṣarathāso vṛṣaraśmayo 'tyāḥ
children.translated_text: May the tawny, virile steeds, being yoked, the stallion-charioted, stallion-reined racers, come to you.

children.text: asmatrāñco vṛṣaṇo vajravāho vṛṣṇe madāya suyujo vahantu ||
children.translated_text: Facing toward us, strong bearers of the <s>vajra</s>, well-yoked, let them carry you for virile exhilaration.

children.text: ā te vṛṣan vṛṣaṇo droṇam asthur ghṛtapruṣo normayo madantaḥ
children.translated_text: To your wooden trough, O bull, the virile drops have come; sprinkled with ghee, the waves rejoice.

children.text: indra pra tubhyaṃ vṛṣabhiḥ sutānāṃ vṛṣṇe bharanti vṛṣabhāya somam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, for you, with virile pressings, they bring <s>Soma</s> to the virile bull.

children.text: vṛṣāsi divo vṛṣabhaḥ pṛthivyā vṛṣā sindhūnāṃ vṛṣabha stiyānām
children.translated_text: You are the bull of heaven, the bull of earth, the bull of rivers, the bull of standing waters.

children.text: vṛṣṇe ta indur vṛṣabha pīpāya svādū raso madhupeyo varāya ||
children.translated_text: For you, the bull, O bull, the <s>Soma</s> drop has swelled; the sweet juice is for the chosen one to drink as honey.

children.text: ayaṃ devaḥ sahasā jāyamāna indreṇa yujā paṇim astabhāyat
children.translated_text: This god, born with force and yoked with <s>Indra</s>, held back the <s>Paṇi</s>.

children.text: ayaṃ svasya pitur āyudhānīndur amuṣṇād aśivasya māyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s> drop stole the weapons of his own father and the spells of the inauspicious one.

children.text: ayam akṛṇod uṣasaḥ supatnīr ayaṃ sūrye adadhāj jyotir antaḥ
children.translated_text: This one made the dawns good consorts; this one placed light within the sun.

children.text: ayaṃ tridhātu divi rocaneṣu triteṣu vindad amṛtaṃ nigūﾱham ||
children.translated_text: This one, in the threefold bright realms of heaven, found the hidden immortal nectar in the three stations.

children.text: ayaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī vi ṣkabhāyad ayaṃ ratham ayunak saptaraśmim
children.translated_text: This one propped apart heaven and earth; this one yoked the seven-reined chariot.

children.text: ayaṃ goṣu śacyā pakvam antaḥ somo dādhāra daśayantram utsam ||
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s>, by his power, held within the cows the ripened spring, the ten-channeled fountain.

children.text: Chapter 486
ya ānayat parāvataḥ sunītī turvaśaṃ yadum
children.translated_text: He who with good guidance brought <s>Turvaśa</s> and <s>Yadu</s> from afar,

children.text: indraḥ sa no yuvā sakhā ||
children.translated_text: that <s>Indra</s> is our young friend.

children.text: avipre cid vayo dadhad anāśunā cid arvatā
children.translated_text: Even to the uninspired he gives vigor, even with an unflagging horse,

children.text: indro jetā hitaṃ dhanam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is the winner of the prize set out.

children.text: mahīr asya praṇītayaḥ pūrvīr uta praśastayaḥ
children.translated_text: Great are his leadings, and many also are his praises;

children.text: nāsya kṣīyanta ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: his helps do not fail.

children.text: sakhāyo brahmavāhase 'rcata pra ca gāyata
children.translated_text: Friends, sing to the bearer of sacred formulation; praise and chant aloud,

children.text: sa hi naḥ pramatir mahī ||
children.translated_text: for he is our great provident care.

children.text: tvam ekasya vṛtrahann avitā dvayor asi
children.translated_text: You, O slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, are the protector of one and of two,

children.text: utedṛśe yathā vayam ||
children.translated_text: and also of such people as we are.

children.text: nayasīd v ati dviṣaḥ kṛṇoṣy ukthaśaṃsinaḥ
children.translated_text: You lead us beyond hatreds; you make men who proclaim hymns,

children.text: nṛbhiḥ suvīra ucyase ||
children.translated_text: and with men you are called rich in heroes.

children.text: brahmāṇam brahmavāhasaṃ gīrbhiḥ sakhāyam ṛgmiyam
children.translated_text: With songs I call the sacred-formulation bearer, the friend worthy of Ṛgvedic praise,

children.text: gāṃ na dohase huve ||
children.translated_text: as one calls a cow for milking.

children.text: yasya viśvāni hastayor ūcur vasūni ni dvitā
children.translated_text: In whose two hands, men say, all treasures are set in double measure,

children.text: vīrasya pṛtanāṣahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the hero who overcomes armies.

children.text: vi dṛﾱhāni cid adrivo janānāṃ śacīpate
children.translated_text: Break apart even the firm things of men, O stone-wielder, lord of power;

children.text: vṛha māyā anānata ||
children.translated_text: tear away the unbending wiles.

children.text: tam u tvā satya somapā indra vājānām pate
children.translated_text: To you, true drinker of <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, lord of prizes,

children.text: ahūmahi śravasyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we have called, desiring fame.

children.text: tam u tvā yaḥ purāsitha yo vā nūnaṃ hite dhane
children.translated_text: You who were called upon of old, or who are now invoked when the prize is set,

children.text: havyaḥ sa śrudhī havam ||
children.translated_text: being worthy of oblation, hear this call.

children.text: dhībhir arvadbhir arvato vājāṁ indra śravāyyān
children.translated_text: With thoughts and with swift horses, O <s>Indra</s>, may we win the prizes worthy of fame;

children.text: tvayā jeṣma hitaṃ dhanam ||
children.translated_text: with you may we conquer the prize set out.

children.text: abhūr u vīra girvaṇo mahāṁ indra dhane hite
children.translated_text: You have become, O heroic lover of song, great <s>Indra</s>, when wealth is set forth,

children.text: bhare vitantasāyyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: one to be stretched forth in the struggle.

children.text: yā ta ūtir amitrahan makṣūjavastamāsati
children.translated_text: That aid of yours, O slayer of foes, which is swiftest to hasten,

children.text: tayā no hinuhī ratham ||
children.translated_text: with that impel our chariot onward.

children.text: sa rathena rathītamo 'smākenābhiyugvanā
children.translated_text: With that chariot, best of charioteers, yoked for assault with ours,

children.text: jeṣi jiṣṇo hitaṃ dhanam ||
children.translated_text: conquer the prize set out, O victorious one.

children.text: ya eka it tam u ṣṭuhi kṛṣṭīnāṃ vicarṣaṇiḥ
children.translated_text: Praise him alone, the one who watches over peoples,

children.text: patir jajñe vṛṣakratuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the lord born with bull-like will.

children.text: yo gṛṇatām id āsithāpir ūtī śivaḥ sakhā
children.translated_text: You who have been a gracious helper, aid, and friend of those who praise,

children.text: sa tvaṃ na indra mṛﾱaya ||
children.translated_text: you, O <s>Indra</s>, be merciful to us.

children.text: dhiṣva vajraṃ gabhastyo rakṣohatyāya vajrivaḥ
children.translated_text: Place the <s>vajra</s> in your hands, O wielder of the <s>vajra</s>, for the slaying of demons;

children.text: sāsahīṣṭhā abhi spṛdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: prove strongest against the contests.

children.text: pratnaṃ rayīṇāṃ yujaṃ sakhāyaṃ kīricodanam
children.translated_text: I call the ancient one, the yoke-fellow of riches, the friend who urges the singer,

children.text: brahmavāhastamaṃ huve ||
children.translated_text: the best bearer of sacred formulation.

children.text: sa hi viśvāni pārthivāṁ eko vasūni patyate
children.translated_text: For he alone rules over all earthly treasures,

children.text: girvaṇastamo adhriguḥ ||
children.translated_text: the most song-loving, the unassailable one.

children.text: sa no niyudbhir ā pṛṇa kāmaṃ vājebhir aśvibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Fill us with your teams, with desired prizes, with horses,

children.text: gomadbhir gopate dhṛṣat ||
children.translated_text: with cattle, O lord of cattle, boldly.

children.text: tad vo gāya sute sacā puruhūtāya satvane
children.translated_text: Sing that for him at the Soma pressing, together, for the much-invoked strong one;

children.text: śaṃ yad gave na śākine ||
children.translated_text: when there may be blessing, as for a cow, for the powerful one.

children.text: na ghā vasur ni yamate dānaṃ vājasya gomataḥ
children.translated_text: No wealthy man restrains the gift of cattle-rich prize,

children.text: yat sīm upa śravad giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: when he has heard the songs near him.

children.text: kuvitsasya pra hi vrajaṃ gomantaṃ dasyuhā gamat
children.translated_text: Perhaps he, the slayer of Dasyus, will come to this cattle-rich enclosure;

children.text: śacībhir apa no varat ||
children.translated_text: with his powers may he ward harm away from us.

children.text: imā u tvā śatakrato 'bhi pra ṇonuvur giraḥ
children.translated_text: These songs have now cried aloud toward you, O hundred-powered one,

children.text: indra vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, like mothers toward a calf.

children.text: dūṇāśaṃ sakhyaṃ tava gaur asi vīra gavyate
children.translated_text: Your friendship is hard to destroy. Be a cow for one who desires cattle, O hero;

children.text: aśvo aśvāyate bhava ||
children.translated_text: become a horse for one who longs for horses.

children.text: sa mandasvā hy andhaso rādhase tanvā mahe
children.translated_text: So rejoice in the Soma juice, for great bounty, with your own body;

children.text: na stotāraṃ nide karaḥ ||
children.translated_text: do not make the singer an object of reproach.

children.text: imā u tvā sute sute nakṣante girvaṇo giraḥ
children.translated_text: At every pressing these songs approach you, O lover of song,

children.text: vatsaṃ gāvo na dhenavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like milch cows their calf.

children.text: purūtamam purūṇāṃ stotṝṇāṃ vivāci
children.translated_text: May those who seek prizes impel with prizes

children.text: vājebhir vājayatām ||
children.translated_text: the most abundant among the abundant, amid the speech of singers.

children.text: asmākam indra bhūtu te stomo vāhiṣṭho antamaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, may our praise be for you the most effective and nearest;

children.text: asmān rāye mahe hinu ||
children.translated_text: impel us toward great wealth.

children.text: adhi bṛbuḥ paṇīnāṃ varṣiṣṭhe mūrdhann asthāt
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛbu</s> stood upon the highest head of the <s>Paṇis</s>,

children.text: uruḥ kakṣo na gāṅgyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: broad in flank, like a <s>Gāṅgya</s>.

children.text: yasya vāyor iva dravad bhadrā rātiḥ sahasriṇī
children.translated_text: His auspicious thousandfold gift runs like the wind;

children.text: sadyo dānāya maṃhate ||
children.translated_text: he exerts himself at once for giving.

children.text: tat su no viśve arya ā sadā gṛṇanti kāravaḥ
children.translated_text: All the Aryan singers continually celebrate that for us:

children.text: bṛbuṃ sahasradātamaṃ sūriṃ sahasrasātamam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛbu</s>, the greatest giver of thousands, the patron who wins thousands most fully.

children.text: Chapter 487
tvām iddhi havāmahe sātā vājasya kāravaḥ
children.translated_text: It is you indeed that we poets invoke for the winning of prize,

children.text: tvāṃ vṛtreṣv indra satpatiṃ naras tvāṃ kāṣṭhāsv arvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: you, O <s>Indra</s>, true lord in battles with <s>Vṛtras</s>; men invoke you at the finish-lines of the racing horse.

children.text: sa tvaṃ naś citra vajrahasta dhṛṣṇuyā maha stavāno adrivaḥ
children.translated_text: So you, O wondrous one, vajra-handed, bold in strength, O stone-hurler, greatly praised by us,

children.text: gām aśvaṃ rathyam indra saṃ kira satrā vājaṃ na jigyuṣe ||
children.translated_text: scatter together cow, horse, chariot-wealth, O <s>Indra</s>, and the prize for one who has not yet won.

children.text: yaḥ satrāhā vicarṣaṇir indraṃ taṃ hūmahe vayam
children.translated_text: We call upon that <s>Indra</s> who conquers altogether and moves among peoples;

children.text: sahasramuṣka tuvinṛmṇa satpate bhavā samatsu no vṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: O thousandfold in virility, rich in heroic might, true lord, be for our increase in battles.

children.text: bādhase janān vṛṣabheva manyunā ghṛṣau mīﾱha ṛcīṣama
children.translated_text: You overpower peoples like a bull with fury in the fray, O bounteous one praised in verses;

children.text: asmākam bodhy avitā mahādhane tanūṣv apsu sūrye ||
children.translated_text: be our protector in the great contest, for our bodies, in the waters, and in the sun.

children.text: indra jyeṣṭhaṃ na ā bharaṃ ojiṣṭham papuri śravaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, bring us the highest, strongest, overflowing fame,

children.text: yeneme citra vajrahasta rodasī obhe suśipra prāḥ ||
children.translated_text: by which, O wondrous vajra-handed one, fair-lipped, you filled both heaven and earth.

children.text: tvām ugram avase carṣaṇīsahaṃ rājan deveṣu hūmahe
children.translated_text: We call you, the fierce one, for aid, conqueror of peoples, king among the gods;

children.text: viśvā su no vithurā pibdanā vaso 'mitrān suṣahān kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: make all our scattered and pressing enemies easy to overcome, O good one.

children.text: yad indra nāhuṣīṣv āṃ ojo nṛmṇaṃ ca kṛṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: Whatever strength and manly power, O <s>Indra</s>, is among the <s>Nāhuṣa</s> peoples and among the tribes,

children.text: yad vā pañca kṣitīnāṃ dyumnam ā bhara satrā viśvāni pauṃsyā ||
children.translated_text: or whatever splendor belongs to the five peoples, bring all heroic powers together.

children.text: yad vā tṛkṣau maghavan druhyāv ā jane yat pūrau kac ca vṛṣṇyam
children.translated_text: Or whatever bull-strength is among the <s>Tṛkṣus</s>, O bounteous one, among the <s>Druhyus</s>, or also among the <s>Pūrus</s>,

children.text: asmabhyaṃ tad rirīhi saṃ nṛṣāhye 'mitrān pṛtsu turvaṇe ||
children.translated_text: bestow that upon us for man-slaying valor, to overcome enemies in battles.

children.text: indra tridhātu śaraṇaṃ trivarūthaṃ svastimat
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, grant a threefold refuge, triple protection, full of well-being,

children.text: chardir yaccha maghavadbhyaś ca mahyaṃ ca yāvayā didyum ebhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: a shelter for the generous and for me; drive away these missiles.

children.text: ye gavyatā manasā śatrum ādabhur abhipraghnanti dhṛṣṇuyā
children.translated_text: Those who, with minds set on cattle, have attacked the enemy and boldly strike against him,

children.text: adha smā no maghavann indra girvaṇas tanūpā antamo bhava ||
children.translated_text: then, O bounteous <s>Indra</s>, lover of song, be nearest to us as guardian of the body.

children.text: adha smā no vṛdhe bhavendra nāyam avā yudhi
children.translated_text: Then be for our increase, O <s>Indra</s>; do not abandon us in battle,

children.text: yad antarikṣe patayanti parṇino didyavas tigmamūrdhānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when feathered shafts fly in the midspace, sharp-headed missiles.

children.text: yatra śūrāsas tanvo vitanvate priyā śarma pitṝṇām
children.translated_text: Where heroes stretch out their bodies, seeking the dear shelter of the fathers,

children.text: adha smā yaccha tanve tane ca chardir acittaṃ yāvaya dveṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: then grant shelter to body and offspring; drive away senseless hatred.

children.text: yad indra sarge arvataś codayāse mahādhane
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indra</s>, you urge on the rush of the horse in the great contest,

children.text: asamane adhvani vṛjine pathi śyenāṁ iva śravasyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: on the uneven course, on the crooked path, like falcons seeking fame,

children.text: sindhūṃr iva pravaṇa āśuyā yato yadi klośam anu ṣvaṇi
children.translated_text: like rivers on a slope going with speed, when they follow the cry with a roar,

children.text: ā ye vayo na varvṛtaty āmiṣi gṛbhītā bāhvor gavi ||
children.translated_text: when, like birds, they circle toward the bait grasped in the arms, toward the cow.

children.text: Chapter 488
svāduṣ kilāyam madhumāṁ utāyaṃ tīvraḥ kilāyaṃ rasavāṁ utāyam
children.translated_text: Sweet indeed is this one, honeyed is this one; sharp indeed is this one, full of savor is this one.

children.text: uto nv asya papivāṃsam indraṃ na kaścana sahata āhaveṣu ||
children.translated_text: And no one withstands <s>Indra</s> in battles after he has drunk of it.

children.text: ayaṃ svādur iha madiṣṭha āsa yasyendro vṛtrahatye mamāda
children.translated_text: This sweet one here was most intoxicating, by which <s>Indra</s> exulted in the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>;

children.text: purūṇi yaś cyautnā śambarasya vi navatiṃ nava ca dehyo han ||
children.translated_text: he shattered many strongholds of <s>Śambara</s>, ninety and nine fortresses.

children.text: ayam me pīta ud iyarti vācam ayam manīṣām uśatīm ajīgaḥ
children.translated_text: This draught of mine raises up my speech; this has awakened my eager thought.

children.text: ayaṃ ṣaﾱ urvīr amimīta dhīro na yābhyo bhuvanaṃ kac canāre ||
children.translated_text: This wise one measured out the six broad spaces, apart from which there is no creature at all.

children.text: ayaṃ sa yo varimāṇam pṛthivyā varṣmāṇaṃ divo akṛṇod ayaṃ saḥ
children.translated_text: This one is he who made the breadth of earth and the height of heaven; this is he.

children.text: ayam pīyūṣaṃ tisṛṣu pravatsu somo dādhārorv antarikṣam ||
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s> held the sap in the three streams and the wide midspace.

children.text: ayaṃ vidac citradṛśīkam arṇaḥ śukrasadmanām uṣasām anīke
children.translated_text: This one found the brightly visible flood at the front of the dawns whose homes are bright.

children.text: ayam mahān mahatā skambhanenod dyām astabhnād vṛṣabho marutvān ||
children.translated_text: This great bull, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, propped up heaven with a great support.

children.text: dhṛṣat piba kalaśe somam indra vṛtrahā śūra samare vasūnām
children.translated_text: Drink boldly the <s>Soma</s> in the beaker, O <s>Indra</s>, slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, hero in the battle for goods.

children.text: mādhyandine savana ā vṛṣasva rayisthāno rayim asmāsu dhehi ||
children.translated_text: At the midday pressing become strong; dwelling in wealth, place wealth among us.

children.text: indra pra ṇaḥ puraeteva paśya pra no naya prataraṃ vasyo accha
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, look upon us like a leader going in front; lead us onward toward better good.

children.text: bhavā supāro atipārayo no bhavā sunītir uta vāmanītiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Be a good ferryman and carry us across; be good guidance and gracious guidance.

children.text: uruṃ no lokam anu neṣi vidvān svarvaj jyotir abhayaṃ svasti
children.translated_text: Knowing, lead us into a broad world, sun-filled light, fearlessness, and well-being.

children.text: ṛṣvā ta indra sthavirasya bāhū upa stheyāma śaraṇā bṛhantā ||
children.translated_text: May we stand under your lofty, ancient, great arms, O <s>Indra</s>, as shelters.

children.text: variṣṭhe na indra vandhure dhā vahiṣṭhayoḥ śatāvann aśvayor ā
children.translated_text: Set us, O <s>Indra</s>, in the best seat; bring us here on your two best, hundred-strong horses.

children.text: iṣam ā vakṣīṣāṃ varṣiṣṭhām mā nas tārīn maghavan rāyo aryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bring the most abundant nourishment; O bounteous one, do not let hostile wealth pass us by.

children.text: indra mṛﾱa mahyaṃ jīvātum iccha codaya dhiyam ayaso na dhārām
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, be gracious to me; desire life for me; impel my thought like an iron edge.

children.text: yat kiṃ cāhaṃ tvāyur idaṃ vadāmi taj juṣasva kṛdhi mā devavantam ||
children.translated_text: Whatever I, whose life depends on you, say here to you, accept that; make me possessed of the gods.

children.text: trātāram indram avitāram indraṃ have have suhavaṃ śūram indram
children.translated_text: I call on <s>Indra</s> as protector, <s>Indra</s> as helper, at every invocation the well-invoked heroic <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: hvayāmi śakram puruhūtam indraṃ svasti no maghavā dhātv indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: I call on powerful <s>Indra</s>, the much-invoked; may bounteous <s>Indra</s> establish well-being for us.

children.text: indraḥ sutrāmā svavāṁ avobhiḥ sumṛﾱīko bhavatu viśvavedāḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, good guardian, self-powerful, with his protections, gracious and all-knowing, be favorable.

children.text: bādhatāṃ dveṣo abhayaṃ kṛṇotu suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: Let him ward off hatred and make freedom from fear; may we be lords of good heroic strength.

children.text: tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma
children.translated_text: May we be in the favor of that worshipful one, in his auspicious goodwill.

children.text: sa sutrāmā svavāṁ indro asme ārāc cid dveṣaḥ sanutar yuyotu ||
children.translated_text: May that good guardian, self-powerful <s>Indra</s>, drive hatred far away from us, altogether remote.

children.text: ava tve indra pravato normir giro brahmāṇi niyuto dhavante
children.translated_text: Toward you, <s>Indra</s>, down the slopes like waves, the songs, the sacred formulations, and the teams rush on.

children.text: urū na rādhaḥ savanā purūṇy apo gā vajrin yuvase sam indūn ||
children.translated_text: You release broad bounty, many Soma-pressings, the waters and the cows, O wielder of the <s>vajra</s>, and the Soma drops together.

children.text: ka īṃ stavat kaḥ pṛṇāt ko yajāte yad ugram in maghavā viśvahāvet
children.translated_text: Who will praise him? Who will satisfy him? Who will sacrifice, when the bounteous one is formidable at every call?

children.text: pādāv iva praharann anyam anyaṃ kṛṇoti pūrvam aparaṃ śacībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Striking one foot against the other, as it were, by his powers he makes the earlier one into the later.

children.text: śṛṇve vīra ugram ugraṃ damāyann anyam anyam atinenīyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: The hero is heard, fierce, taming the fierce one, while one after another is being led beyond.

children.text: edhamānadviﾱ ubhayasya rājā coṣkūyate viśa indro manuṣyān ||
children.translated_text: As his hostility grows, king of both sides, <s>Indra</s> shakes the human clans.

children.text: parā pūrveṣāṃ sakhyā vṛṇakti vitarturāṇo aparebhir eti
children.translated_text: He casts away the friendships of the former ones; breaking through, he goes on with the later ones.

children.text: anānubhūtīr avadhūnvānaḥ pūrvīr indraḥ śaradas tartarīti ||
children.translated_text: Shaking off the former, unexperienced autumns, <s>Indra</s> passes beyond autumn after autumn.

children.text: rūpaṃ rūpam pratirūpo babhūva tad asya rūpam praticakṣaṇāya
children.translated_text: Form after form he has become the counterpart of each form; that is his form for being seen.

children.text: indro māyābhiḥ pururūpa īyate yuktā hy asya harayaḥ śatā daśa ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> moves in many forms through his powers of illusion, for his bay horses are yoked, a hundred and ten.

children.text: yujāno haritā rathe bhūri tvaṣṭeha rājati
children.translated_text: Yoking the bay mares to the chariot, the much-fashioned one shines here in abundance.

children.text: ko viśvāhā dviṣataḥ pakṣa āsata utāsīneṣu sūriṣu ||
children.translated_text: Who can sit all days on the side of his enemies, or among patrons who sit still?

children.text: agavyūti kṣetram āganma devā urvī satī bhūmir aṃhūraṇābhūt
children.translated_text: O gods, we have come to a field without cow-pasture; though broad, the earth has become narrow.

children.text: bṛhaspate pra cikitsā gaviṣṭāv itthā sate jaritra indra panthām ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, discern the way in the quest for cows; so, O <s>Indra</s>, let there be a path for the singer.

children.text: dive dive sadṛśīr anyam ardhaṃ kṛṣṇā asedhad apa sadmano jāḥ
children.translated_text: Day after day he drove the black brood, the other half, away from its dwelling-place.

children.text: ahan dāsā vṛṣabho vasnayantodavraje varcinaṃ śambaraṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: The bull slew the <s>Dāsas</s> who craved goods, <s>Varcin</s> and <s>Śambara</s>, in the waterless enclosure.

children.text: prastoka in nu rādhasas ta indra daśa kośayīr daśa vājino 'dāt
children.translated_text: Now <s>Prastoka</s>, from your bounty, O <s>Indra</s>, gave ten purses and ten racehorses.

children.text: divodāsād atithigvasya rādhaḥ śāmbaraṃ vasu praty agrabhīṣma ||
children.translated_text: We received as a gift the <s>Śāmbara</s> wealth, the bounty of <s>Divodāsa</s> <s>Atithigva</s>.

children.text: daśāśvān daśa kośān daśa vastrādhibhojanā
children.translated_text: Ten horses, ten purses, and ten garments with provisions,

children.text: daśo hiraṇyapiṇḍān divodāsād asāniṣam ||
children.translated_text: ten lumps of gold I obtained from <s>Divodāsa</s>.

children.text: daśa rathān praṣṭimataḥ śataṃ gā atharvabhyaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Aśvatha</s> gave ten chariots with side-horses and a hundred cows for the <s>Atharvans</s>,

children.text: aśvathaḥ pāyave 'dāt ||
children.translated_text: giving them to <s>Pāyu</s>.

children.text: mahi rādho viśvajanyaṃ dadhānān bharadvājān sārñjayo abhy ayaṣṭa ||
children.translated_text: Bearing great bounty for all peoples, the <s>Sārñjaya</s> honored the <s>Bharadvājas</s>.

children.text: vanaspate vīḍvaṅgo hi bhūyā asmatsakhā prataraṇaḥ suvīraḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Vanaspati</s>, be firm-limbed, our companion, carrying us across, rich in heroes.

children.text: gobhiḥ saṃnaddho asi vīﾱayasvāsthātā te jayatu jetvāni ||
children.translated_text: You are bound with cowhide; be strong. May the one mounted on you win the things to be won.

children.text: divas pṛthivyāḥ pary oja udbhṛtaṃ vanaspatibhyaḥ pary ābhṛtaṃ sahaḥ
children.translated_text: The force drawn up from heaven and earth, the strength brought from the forest trees,

children.text: apām ojmānam pari gobhir āvṛtam indrasya vajraṃ haviṣā rathaṃ yaja ||
children.translated_text: the might of the waters, enclosed with cowhides: with oblation worship the chariot, <s>Indra</s>'s <s>vajra</s>.

children.text: indrasya vajro marutām anīkam mitrasya garbho varuṇasya nābhiḥ
children.translated_text: It is <s>Indra</s>'s <s>vajra</s>, the front of the <s>Maruts</s>, the embryo of <s>Mitra</s>, the navel of <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: semāṃ no havyadātiṃ juṣāṇo deva ratha prati havyā gṛbhāya ||
children.translated_text: Accepting this gift of oblation from us, O divine chariot, take hold of the offerings.

children.text: upa śvāsaya pṛthivīm uta dyām purutrā te manutāṃ viṣṭhitaṃ jagat
children.translated_text: Breathe upon earth and also heaven; let the far-spread world hear you in many places.

children.text: sa dundubhe sajūr indreṇa devair dūrād davīyo apa sedha śatrūn ||
children.translated_text: O <s>dundubhi</s>, together with <s>Indra</s> and the gods, drive the enemies away farther than far.

children.text: ā krandaya balam ojo na ā dhā ni ṣṭanihi duritā bādhamānaḥ
children.translated_text: Make a cry; set strength and vigor in us; thunder, driving away misfortunes.

children.text: apa protha dundubhe ducchunā ita indrasya muṣṭir asi vīﾱayasva ||
children.translated_text: Drive ill-boding things away from here, O <s>dundubhi</s>; you are <s>Indra</s>'s fist, be strong.

children.text: āmūr aja pratyāvartayemāḥ ketumad dundubhir vāvadīti
children.translated_text: Drive those hostile forces back and turn them around; the bannered <s>dundubhi</s> resounds loudly.

children.text: sam aśvaparṇāś caranti no naro 'smākam indra rathino jayantu ||
children.translated_text: Our men move together, with horses as their wings; may our chariot-fighters, O <s>Indra</s>, be victorious.

children.text: Chapter 489
yajñā yajñā vo agnaye girā girā ca dakṣase
children.translated_text: Sacrifice after sacrifice, and with song after song, for <s>Agni</s> and for skill,

children.text: pra pra vayam amṛtaṃ jātavedasam priyam mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣam ||
children.translated_text: again and again we would proclaim immortal <s>Jātavedas</s>, dear like a friend.

children.text: ūrjo napātaṃ sa hināyam asmayur dāśema havyadātaye
children.translated_text: May we serve the son of strength, who is inclined toward us, for the receiving of oblations.

children.text: bhuvad vājeṣv avitā bhuvad vṛdha uta trātā tanūnām ||
children.translated_text: May he be a protector in contests, may he be an increaser, and also a guardian of our bodies.

children.text: vṛṣā hy agne ajaro mahān vibhāsy arciṣā
children.translated_text: For, O <s>Agni</s>, you are a bull, ageless and great; you shine with flame.

children.text: ajasreṇa śociṣā śośucacchuce sudītibhiḥ su dīdihi ||
children.translated_text: With unceasing blaze, O gleaming bright one, shine well with splendid lights.

children.text: maho devān yajasi yakṣy ānuṣak tava kratvota daṃsanā
children.translated_text: You sacrifice to the great gods; you will worship them in order, through your insight and your wondrous powers.

children.text: arvācaḥ sīṃ kṛṇuhy agne 'vase rāsva vājota vaṃsva ||
children.translated_text: Bring them near, O <s>Agni</s>, for help; grant the prize, and win it for us.

children.text: yam āpo adrayo vanā garbham ṛtasya piprati
children.translated_text: Him whom the waters, the stones, and the forests bear as the embryo of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order),

children.text: sahasā yo mathito jāyate nṛbhiḥ pṛthivyā adhi sānavi ||
children.translated_text: who, churned forth by men with force, is born upon the ridge of the earth,

children.text: ā yaḥ paprau bhānunā rodasī ubhe dhūmena dhāvate divi
children.translated_text: who has filled both worlds with his radiance and runs in heaven with smoke,

children.text: tiras tamo dadṛśa ūrmyāsv ā śyāvāsv aruṣo vṛṣā śyāvā aruṣo vṛṣā ||
children.translated_text: through the darkness he has been seen in the waves, tawny among the dark ones, a bull, dark and tawny, a bull.

children.text: bṛhadbhir agne arcibhiḥ śukreṇa deva śociṣā
children.translated_text: With great flames, O <s>Agni</s>, with bright divine blaze,

children.text: bharadvāje samidhāno yaviṣṭhya revan naḥ śukra dīdihi dyumat pāvaka dīdihi ||
children.translated_text: kindled among the <s>Bharadvājas</s>, O youngest one, shine for us richly, bright one; shine with brilliance, purifier.

children.text: viśvāsāṃ gṛhapatir viśām asi tvam agne mānuṣīṇām
children.translated_text: You are the household lord of all clans, O <s>Agni</s>, of human peoples.

children.text: śatam pūrbhir yaviṣṭha pāhy aṃhasaḥ sameddhāraṃ śataṃ himā stotṛbhyo ye ca dadati ||
children.translated_text: With a hundred strongholds, O youngest, protect from distress for a hundred winters the kindler and the praisers who give.

children.text: tvaṃ naś citra ūtyā vaso rādhāṃsi codaya
children.translated_text: With your wondrous help, O good one, impel riches for us.

children.text: asya rāyas tvam agne rathīr asi vidā gādhaṃ tuce tu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are the charioteer of this wealth; find a passage for our offspring.

children.text: parṣi tokaṃ tanayam partṛbhiṣ ṭvam adabdhair aprayutvabhiḥ
children.translated_text: Carry our child and descendant across with rescuers that are uninjured and never failing.

children.text: agne heﾱāṃsi daivyā yuyodhi no 'devāni hvarāṃsi ca ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, keep divine angers away from us, and godless deceits as well.

children.text: ā sakhāyaḥ sabardughāṃ dhenum ajadhvam upa navyasā vacaḥ
children.translated_text: Come, friends; with a newer utterance drive here the cow that milks abundant nourishment.

children.text: sṛjadhvam anapasphurām ||
children.translated_text: Release her, the one that does not kick back.

children.text: yā śardhāya mārutāya svabhānave śravo 'mṛtyu dhukṣata
children.translated_text: She has milked immortal fame for the self-radiant host of the <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: yā mṛﾱīke marutāṃ turāṇāṃ yā sumnair evayāvarī ||
children.translated_text: she who is gracious among the swift <s>Maruts</s>, she who moves readily with their favors.

children.text: bharadvājāyāva dhukṣata dvitā
children.translated_text: Milk her down doubly for <s>Bharadvāja</s>,

children.text: dhenuṃ ca viśvadohasam iṣaṃ ca viśvabhojasam ||
children.translated_text: both as a cow yielding all milk and as nourishment for all enjoyment.

children.text: taṃ va indraṃ na sukratuṃ varuṇam iva māyinam
children.translated_text: For you I turn to him as to <s>Indra</s> of good counsel, as to wonder-working <s>Varuṇa</s>,

children.text: aryamaṇaṃ na mandraṃ sṛprabhojasaṃ viṣṇuṃ na stuṣa ādiśe ||
children.translated_text: as to gladdening <s>Aryaman</s>, as to <s>Viṣṇu</s> of flowing bounty, for praise and command.

children.text: tveṣaṃ śardho na mārutaṃ tuviṣvaṇy anarvāṇam pūṣaṇaṃ saṃ yathā śatā
children.translated_text: To fierce <s>Pūṣan</s>, like the roaring host of the <s>Maruts</s>, loud-sounding and irresistible, may hundreds be gathered,

children.text: saṃ sahasrā kāriṣac carṣaṇibhya āṃ āvir gūﾱhā vasū karat suvedā no vasū karat ||
children.translated_text: and thousands for the peoples; may he reveal the hidden treasures, may the good knower make treasures for us.

children.text: ā mā pūṣann upa drava śaṃsiṣaṃ nu te apikarṇa āghṛṇe
children.translated_text: Run near to me, O <s>Pūṣan</s>; I will now proclaim you, O attentive, glowing one.

children.text: aghā aryo arātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the harmful and ungenerous enemies be driven away.

children.text: mā kākambīram ud vṛho vanaspatim aśastīr vi hi nīnaśaḥ
children.translated_text: Do not tear up the kākambīra tree, the lord of the forest; drive away the curses far from us.

children.text: mota sūro aha evā cana grīvā ādadhate veḥ ||
children.translated_text: And let not the bird, even on such a day, set its neck there.

children.text: dṛter iva te 'vṛkam astu sakhyam
children.translated_text: Like a leather skin, may your friendship be free from the wolf,

children.text: acchidrasya dadhanvataḥ supūrṇasya dadhanvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: the friendship of one unbroken, swelling, well filled and swelling full.

children.text: paro hi martyair asi samo devair uta śriyā
children.translated_text: For you are beyond mortals and equal to the gods in splendor.

children.text: abhi khyaḥ pūṣan pṛtanāsu nas tvam avā nūnaṃ yathā purā ||
children.translated_text: Look upon us, O <s>Pūṣan</s>, in the battles; protect us now as in former times.

children.text: vāmī vāmasya dhūtayaḥ praṇītir astu sūnṛtā
children.translated_text: Lovely are the impulses of the lovely one; may his guidance be truthful and gracious,

children.text: devasya vā maruto martyasya vejānasya prayajyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: whether of the god, O <s>Maruts</s>, or of the mortal who understands and offers worship.

children.text: sadyaś cid yasya carkṛtiḥ pari dyāṃ devo naiti sūryaḥ
children.translated_text: Even at once, by his working, the god <s>Sūrya</s> goes around the heaven.

children.text: tveṣaṃ śavo dadhire nāma yajñiyam maruto vṛtrahaṃ śavo jyeṣṭhaṃ vṛtrahaṃ śavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Maruts</s> have taken on his blazing might, the sacrificial name, the <s>Vṛtra</s>-slaying force, the foremost <s>Vṛtra</s>-slaying force.

children.text: sakṛddha dyaur ajāyata sakṛd bhūmir ajāyata
children.translated_text: Once heaven was born; once earth was born.

children.text: pṛśnyā dugdhaṃ sakṛt payas tad anyo nānu jāyate ||
children.translated_text: Once the milk of <s>Pṛśni</s> was milked; another such one is not born after it.

children.text: Chapter 490
stuṣe janaṃ suvrataṃ navyasībhir gīrbhir mitrāvaruṇā sumnayantā
children.translated_text: With newer songs I praise the well-vowed people, bringing favor from <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantu sukṣatrāso varuṇo mitro agniḥ ||
children.translated_text: May they come; may they listen here: the good rulers <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: viśo viśa īḍyam adhvareṣv adṛptakratum aratiṃ yuvatyoḥ
children.translated_text: For worship at sacrifices, I call <s>Agni</s>, praiseworthy among every people, of unproud resolve, the mediator of the two young maidens,

children.text: divaḥ śiśuṃ sahasaḥ sūnum agniṃ yajñasya ketum aruṣaṃ yajadhyai ||
children.translated_text: the child of heaven, son of strength, the ruddy banner of the <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice).

children.text: aruṣasya duhitarā virūpe stṛbhir anyā pipiśe sūro anyā
children.translated_text: The two daughters of the ruddy one are different in form: one adorns herself with stars, the other with the sun.

children.text: mithasturā vicarantī pāvake manma śrutaṃ nakṣata ṛcyamāne ||
children.translated_text: Moving apart from one another, the shining ones wander; as the verse is being praised, may my thought reach what is heard.

children.text: pra vāyum acchā bṛhatī manīṣā bṛhadrayiṃ viśvavāraṃ rathaprām
children.translated_text: Toward <s>Vāyu</s> goes the lofty insight, toward the one of great wealth, desired by all, who brings the chariot forward.

children.text: dyutadyāmā niyutaḥ patyamānaḥ kaviḥ kavim iyakṣasi prayajyo ||
children.translated_text: Bright in track, lord of the teams, a poet, worthy of worship, you seek to sacrifice to the poet.

children.text: sa me vapuś chadayad aśvinor yo ratho virukmān manasā yujānaḥ
children.translated_text: May that chariot of the <s>Aśvins</s>, splendid with gold, yoked by thought, cover me with its protection,

children.text: yena narā nāsatyeṣayadhyai vartir yāthas tanayāya tmane ca ||
children.translated_text: the course by which, O heroic <s>Nāsatyas</s>, you go for refreshment, for offspring, and for the self.

children.text: parjanyavātā vṛṣabhā pṛthivyāḥ purīṣāṇi jinvatam apyāni
children.translated_text: O <s>Parjanya</s> and <s>Vāta</s>, bulls of the earth, quicken the watery, fertilizing powers.

children.text: satyaśrutaḥ kavayo yasya gīrbhir jagata sthātar jagad ā kṛṇudhvam ||
children.translated_text: O true-hearing poets, by whose songs you sustain the moving and the standing world, make the world alive.

children.text: pāvīravī kanyā citrāyuḥ sarasvatī vīrapatnī dhiyaṃ dhāt
children.translated_text: <s>Sarasvatī</s>, the daughter of <s>Pāvīra</s>, bright-lived, a maiden and hero's wife, has set our inspired thought.

children.text: gnābhir acchidraṃ śaraṇaṃ sajoṣā durādharṣaṃ gṛṇate śarma yaṃsat ||
children.translated_text: Together with the divine women, may she grant the singer unbroken refuge and unassailable shelter.

children.text: pathas pathaḥ paripatiṃ vacasyā kāmena kṛto abhy ānaﾱ arkam
children.translated_text: With speech for the guardian of every path, fashioned by desire, I have approached the song.

children.text: sa no rāsacchurudhaś candrāgrā dhiyaṃ dhiyaṃ sīṣadhāti pra pūṣā ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Pūṣan</s> grant us wealth with easy roads and bright foremost gifts; may he further every inspired thought.

children.text: prathamabhājaṃ yaśasaṃ vayodhāṃ supāṇiṃ devaṃ sugabhastim ṛbhvam
children.translated_text: May the shining <s>Agni</s>, the <s>Hotṛ</s>, worship <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, first to receive a share, famous, life-giving, fair-handed, fair-armed, skillful,

children.text: hotā yakṣad yajatam pastyānām agnis tvaṣṭāraṃ suhavaṃ vibhāvā ||
children.translated_text: the adorable god, easy to invoke, among the households.

children.text: bhuvanasya pitaraṃ gīrbhir ābhī rudraṃ divā vardhayā rudram aktau
children.translated_text: With these songs let us strengthen <s>Rudra</s>, father of the world, by day; let us strengthen <s>Rudra</s> by night,

children.text: bṛhantam ṛṣvam ajaraṃ suṣumnam ṛdhagghuvema kavineṣitāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the great, lofty, ageless, well-disposed one; impelled by the seer, let us call him separately.

children.text: ā yuvānaḥ kavayo yajñiyāso maruto ganta gṛṇato varasyām
children.translated_text: Come here, young, inspired, worshipful <s>Maruts</s>, to the desirable praise of the singer.

children.text: acitraṃ ciddhi jinvathā vṛdhanta itthā nakṣanto naro aṅgirasvat ||
children.translated_text: For even what is not yet manifest you quicken as you grow; thus the men attain it, like the <s>Aṅgirases</s>.

children.text: pra vīrāya pra tavase turāyājā yūtheva paśurakṣir astam
children.translated_text: Forth to the heroic one, forth to the mighty, swift one; like a herd-guarding animal, he comes home to the stall.

children.text: sa pispṛśati tanvi śrutasya stṛbhir na nākaṃ vacanasya vipaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He touches the body of what is heard; by the stars, like the height of heaven, he reaches the inspired speech.

children.text: yo rajāṃsi vimame pārthivāni triś cid viṣṇur manave bādhitāya
children.translated_text: He who measured out the earthly realms, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, three times, for oppressed <s>Manu</s>,

children.text: tasya te śarmann upadadyamāne rāyā madema tanvā tanā ca ||
children.translated_text: under his shelter, as it is offered to you, may we rejoice in wealth, with body and with offspring.

children.text: tan no 'hir budhnyo adbhir arkais tat parvatas tat savitā cano dhāt
children.translated_text: May <s>Ahi Budhnya</s> with the waters and hymns, may <s>Parvata</s>, and may <s>Savitṛ</s> set that delight for us.

children.text: tad oṣadhībhir abhi rātiṣāco bhagaḥ purandhir jinvatu pra rāye ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Bhaga</s>, attended by gifts, together with the plants and <s>Purandhi</s>, quicken us toward wealth.

children.text: nu no rayiṃ rathyaṃ carṣaṇiprām puruvīram maha ṛtasya gopām
children.translated_text: Now may the giver grant us wealth fit for chariots, filling the peoples, rich in heroes, the great guardian of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order),

children.text: kṣayaṃ dātājaraṃ yena janān spṛdho adevīr abhi ca kramāma viśa ādevīr abhy aśnavāma ||
children.translated_text: an undecaying dwelling by which we may stride beyond hostile godless peoples and reach the godly peoples.

children.text: Chapter 491
huve vo devīm aditiṃ namobhir mṛﾱīkāya varuṇam mitram agnim
children.translated_text: With reverences I call the goddess <s>Aditi</s> for mercy, and <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: abhikṣadām aryamaṇaṃ suśevaṃ trātṝn devān savitāram bhagaṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: <s>Aryaman</s>, easy to approach, the protecting gods, <s>Savitṛ</s>, and <s>Bhaga</s>.

children.text: sujyotiṣaḥ sūrya dakṣapitṝn anāgāstve sumaho vīhi devān
children.translated_text: O bright <s>Sūrya</s>, in sinlessness go to the great gods whose fathers are <s>Dakṣa</s>,

children.text: dvijanmāno ya ṛtasāpaḥ satyāḥ svarvanto yajatā agnijihvāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the twice-born, protectors of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), true, rich in heavenly light, worthy of worship, and having <s>Agni</s> as their tongue.

children.text: uta dyāvāpṛthivī kṣatram uru bṛhad rodasī śaraṇaṃ suṣumne
children.translated_text: And may <s>Heaven-and-Earth</s>, the two great worlds, grant broad and wide dominion, a shelter rich in favor.

children.text: mahas karatho varivo yathā no 'sme kṣayāya dhiṣaṇe anehaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Make spacious room for us, O <s>Dhiṣaṇās</s>, so that there may be a faultless dwelling for us.

children.text: ā no rudrasya sūnavo namantām adyā hūtāso vasavo 'dhṛṣṭāḥ
children.translated_text: May the sons of <s>Rudra</s>, the <s>Vasus</s>, unassailable and invoked today, bend toward us.

children.text: yad īm arbhe mahati vā hitāso bādhe maruto ahvāma devān ||
children.translated_text: When, in small or in great distress, being placed there, we have called upon the gods, the <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: mimyakṣa yeṣu rodasī nu devī siṣakti pūṣā abhyardhayajvā
children.translated_text: among whom the two divine worlds are mingled, and <s>Pūṣan</s> attends, worshipping close by,

children.text: śrutvā havam maruto yaddha yātha bhūmā rejante adhvani pravikte ||
children.translated_text: when you hear the call and come, O <s>Maruts</s>, the earth trembles on the open road.

children.text: abhi tyaṃ vīraṃ girvaṇasam arcendram brahmaṇā jaritar navena
children.translated_text: Sing with a new sacred formulation, O singer, to that heroic <s>Indra</s>, lover of songs.

children.text: śravad iddhavam upa ca stavāno rāsad vājāṁ upa maho gṛṇānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Being praised and highly lauded, may he hear this call and bestow prizes and greatness.

children.text: omānam āpo mānuṣīr amṛktaṃ dhāta tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ
children.translated_text: O human waters, uninjured, establish refreshment and welfare for offspring and descendants.

children.text: yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā bhiṣajo mātṛtamā viśvasya sthātur jagato janitrīḥ ||
children.translated_text: For you are the healers, most motherly, the mothers of all that stands and moves.

children.text: ā no devaḥ savitā trāyamāṇo hiraṇyapāṇir yajato jagamyāt
children.translated_text: May the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, protecting us, golden-handed and worthy of sacrifice, come to us.

children.text: yo datravāṁ uṣaso na pratīkaṃ vyūrṇute dāśuṣe vāryāṇi ||
children.translated_text: Like the face of the dawns, he who is generous opens desirable goods for the giver.

children.text: uta tvaṃ sūno sahaso no adyā devāṁ asminn adhvare vavṛtyāḥ
children.translated_text: And you, O son of strength, today turn the gods toward us in this sacrifice.

children.text: syām ahaṃ te sadam id rātau tava syām agne 'vasā suvīraḥ ||
