children.translated_text: May I always be in your gift; may I, O <s>Agni</s>, be rich in heroes through your help.

children.text: uta tyā me havam ā jagmyātaṃ nāsatyā dhībhir yuvam aṅga viprā
children.translated_text: And may that call of mine come to you, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>; you two are inspired with thoughts, O sages.

children.text: atriṃ na mahas tamaso 'mumuktaṃ tūrvataṃ narā duritād abhīke ||
children.translated_text: As you freed <s>Atri</s> from great darkness, carry us, O men, beyond distress close at hand.

children.text: te no rāyo dyumato vājavato dātāro bhūta nṛvataḥ purukṣoḥ
children.translated_text: Be givers to us of bright wealth, prize-winning wealth, wealth with men and abundant cattle.

children.text: daśasyanto divyāḥ pārthivāso gojātā apyā mṛﾱatā ca devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Granting gifts, O heavenly and earthly gods, born of the cow and of the waters, be merciful.

children.text: te no rudraḥ sarasvatī sajoṣā mīﾱhuṣmanto viṣṇur mṛﾱantu vāyuḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Rudra</s>, <s>Sarasvatī</s> in harmony, the bounteous ones, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and <s>Vāyu</s> be merciful to us.

children.text: ṛbhukṣā vājo daivyo vidhātā parjanyāvātā pipyatām iṣaṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Ṛbhukṣan</s>, <s>Vāja</s>, the divine arranger, and the rain-bearing winds swell our refreshment.

children.text: uta sya devaḥ savitā bhago no 'pāṃ napād avatu dānu papriḥ
children.translated_text: And may the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, <s>Bhaga</s>, and <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s>, rich in giving, protect us.

children.text: tvaṣṭā devebhir janibhiḥ sajoṣā dyaur devebhiḥ pṛthivī samudraiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, together with the gods and their divine consorts, and Heaven with the gods, Earth, and the seas protect us.

children.text: uta no 'hir budhnyaḥ śṛṇotv aja ekapāt pṛthivī samudraḥ
children.translated_text: And may <s>Ahi Budhnya</s> hear us, and <s>Aja Ekapāt</s>, Earth, and the sea.

children.text: viśve devā ṛtāvṛdho huvānā stutā mantrāḥ kaviśastā avantu ||
children.translated_text: May all the gods, increasers of truth, when invoked, and the praised mantras lauded by seers, help us.

children.text: evā napāto mama tasya dhībhir bharadvājā abhy arcanty arkaiḥ
children.translated_text: Thus, O offspring, the <s>Bharadvājas</s> worship that one of mine with thoughts and songs.

children.text: gnā hutāso vasavo 'dhṛṣṭā viśve stutāso bhūtā yajatrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O divine women, invoked <s>Vasus</s>, unconquered ones, may all of you, praised and worthy of sacrifice, be present.

children.text: Chapter 492
ud u tyac cakṣur mahi mitrayor āṃ eti priyaṃ varuṇayor adabdham
children.translated_text: Up rises that great eye of <s>Mitra</s>, and goes forth, dear and undeceived, of <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: ṛtasya śuci darśatam anīkaṃ rukmo na diva uditā vy adyaut ||
children.translated_text: The pure, visible face of truth has shone out, like a golden ornament risen in heaven.

children.text: veda yas trīṇi vidathāny eṣāṃ devānāṃ janma sanutar ā ca vipraḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired poet knows the three sacred gatherings of these gods, and their birth from of old and from near at hand.

children.text: ṛju marteṣu vṛjinā ca paśyann abhi caṣṭe sūro arya evān ||
children.translated_text: Seeing what is straight and what is crooked among mortals, the sun looks upon them like a noble one.

children.text: stuṣa u vo maha ṛtasya gopān aditim mitraṃ varuṇaṃ sujātān
children.translated_text: I praise for you the great guardians of truth: <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, the well-born ones.

children.text: aryamaṇam bhagam adabdhadhītīn acchā voce sadhanyaḥ pāvakān ||
children.translated_text: I will speak toward <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Bhaga</s>, those of unbroken intent, the shared, purifying ones.

children.text: riśādasaḥ satpatīṃr adabdhān maho rājñaḥ suvasanasya dātṝn
children.translated_text: I seek with reverence the devourers of foes, true lords, undeceived, the great kings, givers of good dwelling.

children.text: yūnaḥ sukṣatrān kṣayato divo nṝn ādityān yāmy aditiṃ duvoyu ||
children.translated_text: I go to the youthful <s>Ādityas</s>, of good rule, men dwelling in heaven, and to <s>Aditi</s>.

children.text: dyauṣ pitaḥ pṛthivi mātar adhrug agne bhrātar vasavo mṛﾱatā naḥ
children.translated_text: Father Heaven, Mother Earth, harmless one, brother <s>Agni</s>, O <s>Vasus</s>, be merciful to us.

children.text: viśva ādityā adite sajoṣā asmabhyaṃ śarma bahulaṃ vi yanta ||
children.translated_text: All you <s>Ādityas</s>, together with <s>Aditi</s>, extend broad shelter for us.

children.text: mā no vṛkāya vṛkye samasmā aghāyate rīradhatā yajatrāḥ
children.translated_text: Do not hand us over to the wolf, to the she-wolf, or to the malicious evildoer, O worshipful ones.

children.text: yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā rathyo nas tanūnāṃ yūyaṃ dakṣasya vacaso babhūva ||
children.translated_text: For you are the charioteers of our bodies; you have become the power of skillful speech.

children.text: mā va eno anyakṛtam bhujema mā tat karma vasavo yac cayadhve
children.translated_text: May we not suffer sin committed by another; nor, O <s>Vasus</s>, that deed which you punish.

children.text: viśvasya hi kṣayatha viśvadevāḥ svayaṃ ripus tanvaṃ rīriṣīṣṭa ||
children.translated_text: For you, all-gods, rule over everything; let the enemy himself injure his own body.

children.text: nama id ugraṃ nama ā vivāse namo dādhāra pṛthivīm uta dyām
children.translated_text: With homage I attend the mighty one; homage upheld earth and heaven.

children.text: namo devebhyo nama īśa eṣāṃ kṛtaṃ cid eno namasā vivāse ||
children.translated_text: Homage to the gods; homage is their lord. Even committed sin I attend with homage.

children.text: ṛtasya vo rathyaḥ pūtadakṣān ṛtasya pastyasado adabdhān
children.translated_text: Your charioteers of truth, purified in discernment, dwelling in the homes of truth, undeceived,

children.text: tāṁ ā namobhir urucakṣaso nṝn viśvān va ā name maho yajatrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: all those far-seeing men, all you great worshipful ones, I bow to with acts of homage.

children.text: te hi śreṣṭhavarcasas ta u nas tiro viśvāni duritā nayanti
children.translated_text: For they have the best radiance; they lead us beyond all difficulties.

children.text: sukṣatrāso varuṇo mitro agnir ṛtadhītayo vakmarājasatyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Agni</s>, of good rule, whose thoughts are truth, are true kings of sacred utterance.

children.text: te na indraḥ pṛthivī kṣāma vardhan pūṣā bhago aditiḥ pañca janāḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, Earth, the ground, <s>Pūṣan</s>, <s>Bhaga</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, and the five peoples strengthen us.

children.text: suśarmāṇaḥ svavasaḥ sunīthā bhavantu naḥ sutrātrāsaḥ sugopāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May they be of good shelter, self-helping, good guides for us, good protectors and good guardians.

children.text: nū sadmānaṃ divyaṃ naṃśi devā bhāradvājaḥ sumatiṃ yāti hotā
children.translated_text: Now the <s>Bhāradvāja</s> hotar seeks the heavenly seat and the gods' good favor.

children.text: āsānebhir yajamāno miyedhair devānāṃ janma vasūyur vavanda ||
children.translated_text: With his sitting priests and generous ritual shares, the worshipper, desiring wealth, has honored the birth of the gods.

children.text: apa tyaṃ vṛjinaṃ ripuṃ stenam agne durādhyam
children.translated_text: Drive away that crooked enemy, the thief hard to master, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: daviṣṭham asya satpate kṛdhī sugam ||
children.translated_text: Make him very far away, O true lord, and make the path easy.

children.text: grāvāṇaḥ soma no hi kaṃ sakhitvanāya vāvaśuḥ
children.translated_text: The pressing stones and <s>Soma</s> have truly called out for our friendship.

children.text: jahī ny atriṇam paṇiṃ vṛko hi ṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Strike down here the devouring <s>Paṇi</s>; for he is a wolf.

children.text: yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā sudānava indrajyeṣṭhā abhidyavaḥ
children.translated_text: For you are good givers, with <s>Indra</s> as chief, shining against attack.

children.text: kartā no adhvann ā sugaṃ gopā amā ||
children.translated_text: Make the road easy for us on the journey, O protectors close at hand.

children.text: api panthām aganmahi svastigām anehasam
children.translated_text: We have reached the path that goes to well-being, free from harm.

children.text: yena viśvāḥ pari dviṣo vṛṇakti vindate vasu ||
children.translated_text: By it one wards off all hatreds on every side and finds wealth.

children.text: Chapter 493
na tad divā na pṛthivyānu manye na yajñena nota śamībhir ābhiḥ
children.translated_text: I do not approve that by heaven, nor by earth, nor by sacrifice, nor by these labors.

children.text: ubjantu taṃ subhvaḥ parvatāso ni hīyatām atiyājasya yaṣṭā ||
children.translated_text: Let the fair mountains press him down; let the sacrificer who sacrifices beyond measure be cast down.

children.text: ati vā yo maruto manyate no brahma vā yaḥ kriyamāṇaṃ ninitsāt
children.translated_text: Whoever, O <s>Maruts</s>, thinks himself beyond us, or whoever would revile the sacred formulation being made,

children.text: tapūṃṣi tasmai vṛjināni santu brahmadviṣam abhi taṃ śocatu dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: may scorching crookednesses be his; let heaven burn against that hater of sacred formulation.

children.text: kim aṅga tvā brahmaṇaḥ soma gopāṃ kim aṅga tvāhur abhiśastipāṃ naḥ
children.translated_text: Why indeed, O <s>Soma</s>, do they call you guardian of the sacred formulation? Why indeed do they call you our protector from curse?

children.text: kim aṅga naḥ paśyasi nidyamānān brahmadviṣe tapuṣiṃ hetim asya ||
children.translated_text: What then? Do you see us being reviled? Hurl his burning missile at the hater of sacred formulation.

children.text: avantu mām uṣaso jāyamānā avantu mā sindhavaḥ pinvamānāḥ
children.translated_text: May the Dawns, as they are born, protect me; may the swelling rivers protect me.

children.text: avantu mā parvatāso dhruvāso 'vantu mā pitaro devahūtau ||
children.translated_text: May the firm mountains protect me; may the Fathers protect me at the invocation of the gods.

children.text: viśvadānīṃ sumanasaḥ syāma paśyema nu sūryam uccarantam
children.translated_text: May we always be well-disposed; may we now see the sun rising.

children.text: tathā karad vasupatir vasūnāṃ devāṁ ohāno 'vasāgamiṣṭhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: So may the lord of treasures, bringing the gods and coming most readily with help, make it so.

children.text: indro nediṣṭham avasāgamiṣṭhaḥ sarasvatī sindhubhiḥ pinvamānā
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, nearest and coming most readily with help, and <s>Sarasvatī</s>, swelling with the rivers, protect us.

children.text: parjanyo na oṣadhībhir mayobhur agniḥ suśaṃsaḥ suhavaḥ piteva ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Parjanya</s>, gladdening us with the plants, and <s>Agni</s>, well-praised and easy to call like a father, protect us.

children.text: viśve devāsa ā gata śṛṇutā ma imaṃ havam
children.translated_text: All gods, come here; hear this call of mine.

children.text: edam barhir ni ṣīdata ||
children.translated_text: Sit down upon this sacred grass.

children.text: yo vo devā ghṛtasnunā havyena pratibhūṣati
children.translated_text: The one who adorns you, O gods, with ghee-flowing oblation,

children.text: taṃ viśva upa gacchatha ||
children.translated_text: to him, all of you, come near.

children.text: upa naḥ sūnavo giraḥ śṛṇvantv amṛtasya ye
children.translated_text: Let the sons of immortality hear our songs.

children.text: sumṛﾱīkā bhavantu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let them be very gracious to us.

children.text: viśve devā ṛtāvṛdha ṛtubhir havanaśrutaḥ
children.translated_text: May all the gods, increasers of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), hearers of invocation at the proper seasons,

children.text: juṣantāṃ yujyam payaḥ ||
children.translated_text: enjoy the yoked milk.

children.text: stotram indro marudgaṇas tvaṣṭṛmān mitro aryamā
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> with the troop of <s>Maruts</s>, with <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>,

children.text: imā havyā juṣanta naḥ ||
children.translated_text: enjoy these oblations of ours.

children.text: imaṃ no agne adhvaraṃ hotar vayunaśo yaja
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, <s>Hotar</s>, conduct this rite of ours according to insight.

children.text: cikitvān daivyaṃ janam ||
children.translated_text: Being wise, worship the divine people.

children.text: viśve devāḥ śṛṇutemaṃ havam me ye antarikṣe ya upa dyavi ṣṭha
children.translated_text: All gods, hear this call of mine, those who are in the midspace and those who stand near heaven,

children.text: ye agnijihvā uta vā yajatrā āsadyāsmin barhiṣi mādayadhvam ||
children.translated_text: those whose tongues are fire, or those who are worshipful; sit on this sacred grass and rejoice.

children.text: viśve devā mama śṛṇvantu yajñiyā ubhe rodasī apāṃ napāc ca manma
children.translated_text: May all the worshipful gods hear my thought, both Heaven and Earth and <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s>.

children.text: mā vo vacāṃsi paricakṣyāṇi vocaṃ sumneṣv id vo antamā madema ||
children.translated_text: May I not speak words that are to be blamed among you; in your favors may we, nearest to you, rejoice.

children.text: ye ke ca jmā mahino ahimāyā divo jajñire apāṃ sadhasthe
children.translated_text: Whoever are great ones on earth, of unfathomable power, born from heaven in the seat of the waters,

children.text: te asmabhyam iṣaye viśvam āyuḥ kṣapa usrā varivasyantu devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: may those gods bestow on us nourishment and a full lifetime; through nights and dawns may they make broad room for us.

children.text: agnīparjanyāv avataṃ dhiyam me 'smin have suhavā suṣṭutiṃ naḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Parjanya</s>, protect my thought, you easy to invoke in this call, and our good praise.

children.text: iﾱām anyo janayad garbham anyaḥ prajāvatīr iṣa ā dhattam asme ||
children.translated_text: One of you generates refreshment, the other the embryo; place in us nourishment rich in offspring.

children.text: stīrṇe barhiṣi samidhāne agnau sūktena mahā namasā vivāse
children.translated_text: On the strewn sacred grass, when the fire is kindled, I honor you with a hymn and great homage.

children.text: asmin no adya vidathe yajatrā viśve devā haviṣi mādayadhvam ||
children.translated_text: In this assembly today, O worshipful All-Gods, rejoice in our oblation.

children.text: Chapter 494
vayam u tvā pathas pate rathaṃ na vājasātaye
children.translated_text: And we have yoked you, O lord of paths, like a chariot for the winning of the prize,

children.text: dhiye pūṣann ayujmahi ||
children.translated_text: for inspired thought, O <s>Pūṣan</s>.

children.text: abhi no naryaṃ vasu vīram prayatadakṣiṇam
children.translated_text: Bring toward us manly wealth, a hero who gives prepared gifts,

children.text: vāmaṃ gṛhapatiṃ naya ||
children.translated_text: a lovely lord of the household.

children.text: aditsantaṃ cid āghṛṇe pūṣan dānāya codaya
children.translated_text: Even one unwilling to give, O glowing <s>Pūṣan</s>, impel to giving.

children.text: paṇeś cid vi mradā manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Soften even the mind of the <s>Paṇi</s>.

children.text: vi patho vājasātaye cinuhi vi mṛdho jahi
children.translated_text: Clear the roads for the winning of the prize; strike away hostilities.

children.text: sādhantām ugra no dhiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May our thoughts succeed, O fierce one.

children.text: pari tṛndhi paṇīnām ārayā hṛdayā kave
children.translated_text: Pierce all around the hearts of the <s>Paṇis</s> with your goad, O sage,

children.text: athem asmabhyaṃ randhaya ||
children.translated_text: and then make them subject to us.

children.text: vi pūṣann ārayā tuda paṇer iccha hṛdi priyam
children.translated_text: O <s>Pūṣan</s>, strike them apart with your goad; seek what is dear in the heart of the <s>Paṇi</s>,

children.text: athem asmabhyaṃ randhaya ||
children.translated_text: and then make him subject to us.

children.text: ā rikha kikirā kṛṇu paṇīnāṃ hṛdayā kave
children.translated_text: Scratch them; make the hearts of the <s>Paṇis</s> be scraped, O sage,

children.text: athem asmabhyaṃ randhaya ||
children.translated_text: and then make them subject to us.

children.text: yām pūṣan brahmacodanīm ārām bibharṣy āghṛṇe
children.translated_text: That goad for stirring sacred formulation which you bear, O glowing <s>Pūṣan</s>,

children.text: tayā samasya hṛdayam ā rikha kikirā kṛṇu ||
children.translated_text: with it scratch every heart; make it be scraped.

children.text: yā te aṣṭrā goopaśāghṛṇe paśusādhanī
children.translated_text: That driving whip of yours, O glowing one, cattle-controlling and livestock-winning,

children.text: tasyās te sumnam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: of that favor of yours we ask.

children.text: uta no goṣaṇiṃ dhiyam aśvasāṃ vājasām uta
children.translated_text: And make for us inspired thought that wins cattle, horses, and prizes,

children.text: nṛvat kṛṇuhi vītaye ||
children.translated_text: rich in men, for the feast.

children.text: Chapter 495
sam pūṣan viduṣā naya yo añjasānuśāsati
children.translated_text: Lead us together, O <s>Pūṣan</s>, with the knowing one, who instructs straightforwardly,

children.text: ya evedam iti bravat ||
children.translated_text: who says, 'It is just here.'

children.text: sam u pūṣṇā gamemahi yo gṛhāṁ abhiśāsati
children.translated_text: May we come together with <s>Pūṣan</s>, who rules over the houses

children.text: ima eveti ca bravat ||
children.translated_text: and says, 'These are the very ones.'

children.text: pūṣṇaś cakraṃ na riṣyati na kośo 'va padyate
children.translated_text: The wheel of <s>Pūṣan</s> is not damaged, his box does not fall down,

children.text: no asya vyathate paviḥ ||
children.translated_text: nor does its felly suffer harm.

children.text: yo asmai haviṣāvidhan na tam pūṣāpi mṛṣyate
children.translated_text: Whoever worships him with oblation, <s>Pūṣan</s> does not neglect him.

children.text: prathamo vindate vasu ||
children.translated_text: He is the first to find wealth.

children.text: pūṣā gā anv etu naḥ pūṣā rakṣatv arvataḥ
children.translated_text: Let <s>Pūṣan</s> follow after our cows; let <s>Pūṣan</s> guard our horses.

children.text: pūṣā vājaṃ sanotu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Pūṣan</s> win the prize for us.

children.text: pūṣann anu pra gā ihi yajamānasya sunvataḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Pūṣan</s>, go forth after the cows of the pressing sacrificer

children.text: asmākaṃ stuvatām uta ||
children.translated_text: and after those of us who praise.

children.text: mākir neśan mākīṃ riṣan mākīṃ saṃ śāri kevaṭe
children.translated_text: Let none be lost, let none be harmed, let none be broken in a pit.

children.text: athāriṣṭābhir ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: Then come here with them uninjured.

children.text: śṛṇvantam pūṣaṇaṃ vayam iryam anaṣṭavedasam
children.translated_text: We seek <s>Pūṣan</s>, one who hears, active, whose possessions are not lost,

children.text: īśānaṃ rāya īmahe ||
children.translated_text: lord of wealth.

children.text: pūṣan tava vrate vayaṃ na riṣyema kadācana
children.translated_text: O <s>Pūṣan</s>, within your ordinance may we never suffer harm.

children.text: stotāras ta iha smasi ||
children.translated_text: We are your singers here.

children.text: pari pūṣā parastāddhastaṃ dadhātu dakṣiṇam
children.translated_text: May <s>Pūṣan</s> place his right hand around us from afar

children.text: punar no naṣṭam ājatu ||
children.translated_text: and bring back what has been lost to us.

children.text: Chapter 496
ehi vāṃ vimuco napād āghṛṇe saṃ sacāvahai
children.translated_text: Come here, O child of release, O glowing one; let us join ourselves with you.

children.text: rathīr ṛtasya no bhava ||
children.translated_text: Be our charioteer of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: rathītamaṃ kapardinam īśānaṃ rādhaso mahaḥ
children.translated_text: We seek the best charioteer, the braided-haired one, lord of great bounty,

children.text: rāyaḥ sakhāyam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: the friend of wealth.

children.text: rāyo dhārāsy āghṛṇe vaso rāśir ajāśva
children.translated_text: O glowing one, stream of wealth, O good one, heap of riches, goat-horsed one,

children.text: dhīvato dhīvataḥ sakhā ||
children.translated_text: friend of each inspired man.

children.text: pūṣaṇaṃ nv ajāśvam upa stoṣāma vājinam
children.translated_text: Now let us praise <s>Pūṣan</s>, goat-horsed and vigorous,

children.text: svasur yo jāra ucyate ||
children.translated_text: who is called the lover of his sister.

children.text: mātur didhiṣum abravaṃ svasur jāraḥ śṛṇotu naḥ
children.translated_text: I have called him the suitor of his mother; let the lover of his sister hear us,

children.text: bhrātendrasya sakhā mama ||
children.translated_text: the brother of <s>Indra</s>, my friend.

children.text: ājāsaḥ pūṣaṇaṃ rathe niśṛmbhās te janaśriyam
children.translated_text: Let the goats, harnessed to the chariot, bearing <s>Pūṣan</s>,

children.text: devaṃ vahantu bibhrataḥ ||
children.translated_text: carry the god whose fame is among the people.

children.text: Chapter 497
ya enam ādideśati karambhād iti pūṣaṇam
children.translated_text: Whoever points out <s>Pūṣan</s> with the words, 'because of the karambha gruel,'

children.text: na tena deva ādiśe ||
children.translated_text: by him the god is not truly indicated.

children.text: uta ghā sa rathītamaḥ sakhyā satpatir yujā
children.translated_text: And indeed that best charioteer, through friendship, as a true lord with his yoked team,

children.text: indro vṛtrāṇi jighnate ||
children.translated_text: helps <s>Indra</s> strike down the <s>Vṛtras</s>.

children.text: utādaḥ paruṣe gavi sūraś cakraṃ hiraṇyayam
children.translated_text: And then, in the dappled cow, the sun, best of charioteers,

children.text: ny airayad rathītamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: sent down the golden wheel.

children.text: yad adya tvā puruṣṭuta bravāma dasra mantumaḥ
children.translated_text: What we speak to you today, O much-praised wonder-worker, rich in counsel,

children.text: tat su no manma sādhaya ||
children.translated_text: make that thought of ours succeed well.

children.text: imaṃ ca no gaveṣaṇaṃ sātaye sīṣadho gaṇam
children.translated_text: And set this cattle-searching band of ours on the path to gain.

children.text: ārāt pūṣann asi śrutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For from afar, O <s>Pūṣan</s>, you are heard.

children.text: ā te svastim īmaha āreaghām upāvasum
children.translated_text: We seek welfare from you, with evil far away and wealth close at hand.

children.text: adyā ca sarvatātaye śvaś ca sarvatātaye ||
children.translated_text: Both today for complete protection, and tomorrow for complete protection.

children.text: Chapter 498
indrā nu pūṣaṇā vayaṃ sakhyāya svastaye
children.translated_text: Now we would call <s>Indra</s> and <s>Pūṣan</s> for friendship and welfare,

children.text: huvema vājasātaye ||
children.translated_text: and for the winning of the prize.

children.text: somam anya upāsadat pātave camvoḥ sutam
children.translated_text: One approaches the pressed <s>soma</s> (sacred drink) in the two vessels to drink it;

children.text: karambham anya icchati ||
children.translated_text: another desires the barley gruel.

children.text: ajā anyasya vahnayo harī anyasya sambhṛtā
children.translated_text: Goats are the draft animals of one; the bay horses are harnessed for the other,

children.text: tābhyāṃ vṛtrāṇi jighnate ||
children.translated_text: and with those two they strike down the obstructions.

children.text: yad indro anayad rito mahīr apo vṛṣantamaḥ
children.translated_text: When <s>Indra</s>, the strongest bull, brought the mighty waters according to order,

children.text: tatra pūṣābhavat sacā ||
children.translated_text: then <s>Pūṣan</s> was there beside him.

children.text: tām pūṣṇaḥ sumatiṃ vayaṃ vṛkṣasya pra vayām iva
children.translated_text: We take hold of that favor of <s>Pūṣan</s>, as one takes hold of the branch of a tree,

children.text: indrasya cā rabhāmahe ||
children.translated_text: and also of <s>Indra</s>'s favor.

children.text: ut pūṣaṇaṃ yuvāmahe 'bhīśūṃr iva sārathiḥ
children.translated_text: We set <s>Pūṣan</s> in motion, like a charioteer his reins,

children.text: mahyā indraṃ svastaye ||
children.translated_text: and great <s>Indra</s> for welfare.

children.text: Chapter 499
śukraṃ te anyad yajataṃ te anyad viṣurūpe ahanī dyaur ivāsi
children.translated_text: One form of yours is bright; another of yours is worthy of sacrifice. The two days are of different forms; you are like heaven.

children.text: viśvā hi māyā avasi svadhāvo bhadrā te pūṣann iha rātir astu ||
children.translated_text: For you sustain all powers of wonder, self-powered one. Let your gracious gift be here, O <s>Pūṣan</s>.

children.text: ajāśvaḥ paśupā vājapastyo dhiyañjinvo bhuvane viśve arpitaḥ
children.translated_text: With goats for horses, guardian of cattle, lord of prize-winning stalls, quickening thought, set in every world,

children.text: aṣṭrām pūṣā śithirām udvarīvṛjat saṃcakṣāṇo bhuvanā deva īyate ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pūṣan</s> has shaken loose the slack goad; beholding the worlds, the god goes onward.

children.text: yās te pūṣan nāvo antaḥ samudre hiraṇyayīr antarikṣe caranti
children.translated_text: Those boats of yours, O <s>Pūṣan</s>, that are within the sea, golden, and move in midspace,

children.text: tābhir yāsi dūtyāṃ sūryasya kāmena kṛta śrava icchamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with them you go on the embassy of the Sun, made by desire, seeking renown.

children.text: pūṣā subandhur diva ā pṛthivyā iﾱas patir maghavā dasmavarcāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Pūṣan</s>, good kinsman of heaven and earth, lord of <s>Iḷā</s>, bountiful, wondrous in splendor,

children.text: yaṃ devāso adaduḥ sūryāyai kāmena kṛtaṃ tavasaṃ svañcam ||
children.translated_text: whom the gods gave to <s>Sūryā</s>, fashioned by desire, strong and moving well.

children.text: Chapter 500
pra nu vocā suteṣu vāṃ vīryā yāni cakrathuḥ
children.translated_text: Now, at the pressings, I will proclaim the heroic deeds of you two, which you performed.

children.text: hatāso vām pitaro devaśatrava indrāgnī jīvatho yuvam ||
children.translated_text: The fathers who were enemies of the gods were slain by you; O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, you two live on.

children.text: baﾱ itthā mahimā vām indrāgnī paniṣṭha ā
children.translated_text: Great indeed is your greatness, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, most worthy of praise.

children.text: samāno vāṃ janitā bhrātarā yuvaṃ yamāv ihehamātarā ||
children.translated_text: You two have the same begetter; you are brothers, twins, with a mother here and there.

children.text: okivāṃsā sute sacāṃ aśvā saptī ivādane
children.translated_text: Dwelling together at the pressing, like two swift horses at the feeding-place,

children.text: indrā nv agnī avaseha vajriṇā vayaṃ devā havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: now, O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Indra</s>, for help here we call you gods, mighty with the <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt).

children.text: ya indrāgnī suteṣu vāṃ stavat teṣv ṛtāvṛdhā
children.translated_text: Whoever praises you two, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, at the pressings, O increasers of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order),

children.text: joṣavākaṃ vadataḥ pajrahoṣiṇā na devā bhasathaś cana ||
children.translated_text: you speak a welcome word, O drinkers of the offering; you gods do not consume him.

children.text: indrāgnī ko asya vāṃ devau martaś ciketati
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, what mortal, O two gods, understands this of yours?

children.text: viṣūco aśvān yuyujāna īyata ekaḥ samāna ā rathe ||
children.translated_text: Yoking horses that face apart, one travels in a single common chariot.

children.text: indrāgnī apād iyam pūrvāgāt padvatībhyaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, this footless one came first before the footed ones;

children.text: hitvī śiro jihvayā vāvadac carat triṃśat padā ny akramīt ||
children.translated_text: leaving her head behind, she moves speaking with her tongue, and she has stepped thirty steps.

children.text: indrāgnī ā hi tanvate naro dhanvāni bāhvoḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, men stretch bows upon their arms;

children.text: mā no asmin mahādhane parā varktaṃ gaviṣṭiṣu ||
children.translated_text: do not cast us away in this great prize, in the contests for cows.

children.text: indrāgnī tapanti māghā aryo arātayaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, hostile attacks from the ungenerous foe burn us;

children.text: apa dveṣāṃsy ā kṛtaṃ yuyutaṃ sūryād adhi ||
children.translated_text: drive away hatreds, and ward them off from beneath the sun.

children.text: indrāgnī yuvor api vasu divyāni pārthivā
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, heavenly and earthly goods are in your power;

children.text: ā na iha pra yacchataṃ rayiṃ viśvāyupoṣasam ||
children.translated_text: bestow them on us here, wealth that nourishes all life.

children.text: indrāgnī ukthavāhasā stomebhir havanaśrutā
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, hymn-bearing ones, hearers of invocation through praises,

children.text: viśvābhir gīrbhir ā gatam asya somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: come with all songs to drink this <s>soma</s> (sacred drink).

children.text: Chapter 501
śnathad vṛtram uta sanoti vājam indrā yo agnī sahurī saparyāt
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, who worships together with <s>Agni</s> as a strong ally, shatters <s>Vṛtra</s> and wins the prize,

children.text: irajyantā vasavyasya bhūreḥ sahastamā sahasā vājayantā ||
children.translated_text: the two ruling over abundant wealth, most mighty, striving by force for the prize.

children.text: tā yodhiṣṭam abhi gā indra nūnam apaḥ svar uṣaso agna ūﾱhāḥ
children.translated_text: Fight now for the cows, O <s>Indra</s>; O <s>Agni</s>, for the waters, the sun, and the hidden dawns.

children.text: diśaḥ svar uṣasa indra citrā apo gā agne yuvase niyutvān ||
children.translated_text: For the quarters, the sun, and the bright dawns, O <s>Indra</s>; O <s>Agni</s>, rich in teams, you win waters and cows.

children.text: ā vṛtrahaṇā vṛtrahabhiḥ śuṣmair indra yātaṃ namobhir agne arvāk
children.translated_text: O slayers of <s>Vṛtra</s>, with <s>Vṛtra</s>-slaying powers, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, come hither with reverences,

children.text: yuvaṃ rādhobhir akavebhir indrāgne asme bhavatam uttamebhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: and with your best, unwasting favors, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, be present for us.

children.text: tā huve yayor idam papne viśvam purā kṛtam
children.translated_text: I call those two by whom this whole world, fashioned long ago, has been encompassed.

children.text: indrāgnī na mardhataḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> not neglect us.

children.text: ugrā vighaninā mṛdha indrāgnī havāmahe
children.translated_text: Fierce, smiting attackers in battles, we call <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>;

children.text: tā no mṛﾱāta īdṛśe ||
children.translated_text: may those two be gracious to us in such a circumstance.

children.text: hato vṛtrāṇy āryā hato dāsāni satpatī
children.translated_text: Slay the hostile powers of the Aryan, slay the <s>Dāsa</s> powers, O true lords;

children.text: hato viśvā apa dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: slay all hatreds away.

children.text: indrāgnī yuvām ime 'bhi stomā anūṣata
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, these praises have sung out toward you;

children.text: pibataṃ śambhuvā sutam ||
children.translated_text: drink the pressed <s>soma</s> (sacred drink), bringer of happiness.

children.text: yā vāṃ santi puruspṛho niyuto dāśuṣe narā
children.translated_text: Those teams of yours, O heroes, which are much desired and serve the worshipper,

children.text: indrāgnī tābhir ā gatam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, come with them.

children.text: tābhir ā gacchataṃ naropedaṃ savanaṃ sutam
children.translated_text: With them come, O heroes; this pressed libation is set near,

children.text: indrāgnī somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, for the drinking of <s>soma</s> (sacred drink).

children.text: tam īﾱiṣva yo arciṣā vanā viśvā pariṣvajat
children.translated_text: Praise him who with his flame embraces all the forests,

children.text: kṛṣṇā kṛṇoti jihvayā ||
children.translated_text: and makes them black with his tongue.

children.text: ya iddha āvivāsati sumnam indrasya martyaḥ
children.translated_text: The mortal who, when it is kindled, attends upon the favor of <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: dyumnāya sutarā apaḥ ||
children.translated_text: crosses the waters most easily toward glory.

children.text: tā no vājavatīr iṣa āśūn pipṛtam arvataḥ
children.translated_text: Fill for us swift horses with prize-rich nourishment,

children.text: indram agniṃ ca voﾱhave ||
children.translated_text: to carry <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> here.

children.text: ubhā vām indrāgnī āhuvadhyā ubhā rādhasaḥ saha mādayadhyai
children.translated_text: Both of you, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, are to be invoked; both, together, for rejoicing in bounty;

children.text: ubhā dātārāv iṣāṃ rayīṇām ubhā vājasya sātaye huve vām ||
children.translated_text: both givers of foods and riches, both I call for the winning of the prize.

children.text: ā no gavyebhir aśvyair vasavyair upa gacchatam
children.translated_text: Come to us with cattle-rich, horse-rich, wealth-bringing gifts;

children.text: sakhāyau devau sakhyāya śambhuvendrāgnī tā havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: the two friendly gods, for friendship, bringing happiness: those <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> we call.

children.text: indrāgnī śṛṇutaṃ havaṃ yajamānasya sunvataḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, hear the call of the sacrificer who presses <s>soma</s> (sacred drink);

children.text: vītaṃ havyāny ā gatam pibataṃ somyam madhu ||
children.translated_text: enjoy the oblations, come, and drink the <s>soma</s>-honey.

children.text: Chapter 502
iyam adadād rabhasam ṛṇacyutaṃ divodāsaṃ vadhryaśvāya dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: This one gave impetuous <s>Divodāsa</s>, shaking off debt, to <s>Vadhryaśva</s> the worshipper;

children.text: yā śaśvantam ācakhādāvasam paṇiṃ tā te dātrāṇi taviṣā sarasvati ||
children.translated_text: she who chewed up the long-standing, devouring <s>Paṇi</s>: those are your mighty gifts, O <s>Sarasvatī</s>.

children.text: iyaṃ śuṣmebhir bisakhā ivārujat sānu girīṇāṃ taviṣebhir ūrmibhiḥ
children.translated_text: With her powers she broke open the ridges of the mountains, like a digger of lotus-stalks, with her mighty waves;

children.text: pārāvataghnīm avase suvṛktibhiḥ sarasvatīm ā vivāsema dhītibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: for aid, with good praises and with thoughts, we would attend upon <s>Sarasvatī</s>, smasher of distant foes.

children.text: sarasvati devanido ni barhaya prajāṃ viśvasya bṛsayasya māyinaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Sarasvatī</s>, lay low the revilers of the gods, the offspring of every deceitful <s>Bṛsaya</s>;

children.text: uta kṣitibhyo 'vanīr avindo viṣam ebhyo asravo vājinīvati ||
children.translated_text: and for the settlements you found the waters; against these, O prize-winning one, you flowed forth poison.

children.text: pra ṇo devī sarasvatī vājebhir vājinīvatī
children.translated_text: May divine <s>Sarasvatī</s>, rich in prize-winning strength, come forth for us with prizes,

children.text: dhīnām avitry avatu ||
children.translated_text: may she, the protectress of thoughts, protect us.

children.text: yas tvā devi sarasvaty upabrūte dhane hite
children.translated_text: Whoever invokes you, O goddess <s>Sarasvatī</s>, when wealth is at stake,

children.text: indraṃ na vṛtratūrye ||
children.translated_text: as one invokes <s>Indra</s> in the battle for overcoming <s>Vṛtra</s>,

children.text: tvaṃ devi sarasvaty avā vājeṣu vājini
children.translated_text: you, O goddess <s>Sarasvatī</s>, prize-winning one, help us in the contests for prizes;

children.text: radā pūṣeva naḥ sanim ||
children.translated_text: like <s>Pūṣan</s>, grant us gain.

children.text: uta syā naḥ sarasvatī ghorā hiraṇyavartaniḥ
children.translated_text: And may that <s>Sarasvatī</s> of ours, fearsome, with golden track,

children.text: vṛtraghnī vaṣṭi suṣṭutim ||
children.translated_text: slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, desire our good praise.

children.text: yasyā ananto ahrutas tveṣaś cariṣṇur arṇavaḥ
children.translated_text: She whose endless, unbent, flashing, moving flood,

children.text: amaś carati roruvat ||
children.translated_text: with force goes roaring along,

children.text: sā no viśvā ati dviṣaḥ svasṝr anyā ṛtāvarī
children.translated_text: may she, true to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), carry us beyond all hatreds, beyond other hostile sisters,

children.text: atann aheva sūryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: as the sun stretches out the days.

children.text: uta naḥ priyā priyāsu saptasvasā sujuṣṭā
children.translated_text: And may <s>Sarasvatī</s>, dear among dear ones, seven-sistered and well-pleased,

children.text: sarasvatī stomyā bhūt ||
children.translated_text: be worthy of praise for us.

children.text: āpapruṣī pārthivāny uru rajo antarikṣam
children.translated_text: Filling the earthly regions and the wide midspace,

children.text: sarasvatī nidas pātu ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Sarasvatī</s> protect us from blame.

children.text: triṣadhasthā saptadhātuḥ pañca jātā vardhayantī
children.translated_text: Dwelling in three seats, sevenfold in substance, increasing the five peoples,

children.text: vāje vāje havyā bhūt ||
children.translated_text: may she be invoked in every contest for prize.

children.text: pra yā mahimnā mahināsu cekite dyumnebhir anyā apasām apastamā
children.translated_text: She who is known by her greatness among the great, most active among the active, with splendors,

children.text: ratha iva bṛhatī vibhvane kṛtopastutyā cikituṣā sarasvatī ||
children.translated_text: like a broad chariot made for expansion, <s>Sarasvatī</s> is to be praised by the discerning worshipper.

children.text: sarasvaty abhi no neṣi vasyo māpa spharīḥ payasā mā na ā dhak
children.translated_text: O <s>Sarasvatī</s>, lead us toward better wealth; do not overrun us with your milk, do not burn us,

children.text: juṣasva naḥ sakhyā veśyā ca mā tvat kṣetrāṇy araṇāni ganma ||
children.translated_text: accept our friendships and our dwelling; may we not go from you to alien fields.

children.text: Chapter 503
stuṣe narā divo asya prasantāśvinā huve jaramāṇo arkaiḥ
children.translated_text: I praise the two heroes, the far-extending sons of heaven; growing old with songs, I call the <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: yā sadya usrā vyuṣi jmo antān yuyūṣataḥ pary urū varāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: who at once, at dawn, drive the bright ruddy cows to the ends of earth, around the broad spaces.

children.text: tā yajñam ā śucibhiś cakramāṇā rathasya bhānuṃ rurucū rajobhiḥ
children.translated_text: Those two, carrying out the sacrifice with bright aids, made the radiance of the chariot shine through the realms,

children.text: purū varāṃsy amitā mimānāpo dhanvāny ati yātho ajrān ||
children.translated_text: measuring out many boundless spaces; you pass beyond waters, deserts, and the trackless ways.

children.text: tā ha tyad vartir yad aradhram ugretthā dhiya ūhathuḥ śaśvad aśvaiḥ
children.translated_text: Those two, when that course was unimpeded, O mighty ones, thus, with your thought, you have always conveyed it with horses,

children.text: manojavebhir iṣiraiḥ śayadhyai pari vyathir dāśuṣo martyasya ||
children.translated_text: with mind-swift, eager ones, for rest, around the distress of the mortal worshipper.

children.text: tā navyaso jaramāṇasya manmopa bhūṣato yuyujānasaptī
children.translated_text: Those two, to the new prayer of the praising man as he adorns it, yoking your paired steeds,

children.text: śubham pṛkṣam iṣam ūrjaṃ vahantā hotā yakṣat pratno adhrug yuvānā ||
children.translated_text: bringing lovely abundance, food, and vigor: may the ancient, undeceiving, youthful <s>hotṛ</s> worship them.

children.text: tā valgū dasrā puruśākatamā pratnā navyasā vacasā vivāse
children.translated_text: Those lovely, wondrous two, most helpful to many, ancient yet new, I approach with speech,

children.text: yā śaṃsate stuvate śambhaviṣṭhā babhūvatur gṛṇate citrarātī ||
children.translated_text: who have become most auspicious to the one who proclaims and praises, richly-giving to the singer.

children.text: tā bhujyuṃ vibhir adbhyaḥ samudrāt tugrasya sūnum ūhathū rajobhiḥ
children.translated_text: Those two carried <s>Bhujyu</s>, son of <s>Tugra</s>, with birds from the waters, from the sea, through the spaces,

children.text: areṇubhir yojanebhir bhujantā patatribhir arṇaso nir upasthāt ||
children.translated_text: rescuing him with dustless courses, with winged ones, from the lap of the flood.

children.text: vi jayuṣā rathyā yātam adriṃ śrutaṃ havaṃ vṛṣaṇā vadhrimatyāḥ
children.translated_text: With victorious chariotry come through the mountain; hear the call, O bulls, of <s>Vadhrimatī</s>,

children.text: daśasyantā śayave pipyathur gām iti cyavānā sumatim bhuraṇyū ||
children.translated_text: granting favor, you filled the cow for <s>Śayu</s>; thus, O swift helpers, you brought good will to <s>Cyavāna</s>.

children.text: yad rodasī pradivo asti bhūmā heﾱo devānām uta martyatrā
children.translated_text: Whatever wrath of the gods there is in heaven and earth, from of old, and among mortals,

children.text: tad ādityā vasavo rudriyāso rakṣoyuje tapur aghaṃ dadhāta ||
children.translated_text: that evil, O <s>Ādityas</s>, <s>Vasus</s>, and <s>Rudriyas</s>, set as scorching heat upon the demon-allied one.

children.text: ya īṃ rājānāv ṛtuthā vidadhad rajaso mitro varuṇaś ciketat
children.translated_text: He who, as <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, the two kings, has perceived the expanse in due season, distributing the realm of space,

children.text: gambhīrāya rakṣase hetim asya droghāya cid vacasa ānavāya ||
children.translated_text: let him aim this missile against the deep-protecting one, even against the deceitful, hostile speech.

children.text: antaraiś cakrais tanayāya vartir dyumatā yātaṃ nṛvatā rathena
children.translated_text: With wheels set between, travel the course for our offspring in your radiant, manly chariot,

children.text: sanutyena tyajasā martyasya vanuṣyatām api śīrṣā vavṛktam ||
children.translated_text: and with hidden brilliance cut off the heads of the mortal who would assail us.

children.text: ā paramābhir uta madhyamābhir niyudbhir yātam avamābhir arvāk
children.translated_text: Come hither with your highest, middle, and lowest teams, with your yoked steeds,

children.text: dṛﾱhasya cid gomato vi vrajasya duro vartaṃ gṛṇate citrarātī ||
children.translated_text: and for the singer, O richly-giving ones, open the doors of the firm cattle-filled enclosure.

children.text: Chapter 504
kva tyā valgū puruhūtādya dūto na stomo 'vidan namasvān
children.translated_text: Where is that lovely, much-invoked pair today? Like a reverent messenger, has the hymn found you,

children.text: ā yo arvāṅ nāsatyā vavarta preṣṭhā hy asatho asya manman ||
children.translated_text: the hymn that has turned hither, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>? For you are most dear to this thought.

children.text: aram me gantaṃ havanāyāsmai gṛṇānā yathā pibātho andhaḥ
children.translated_text: Come readily to this invocation of mine, O praised ones, as you drink the soma-draught,

children.text: pari ha tyad vartir yātho riṣo na yat paro nāntaras tuturyāt ||
children.translated_text: go around that course, so that no harm may break through, neither from afar nor from within.

children.text: akāri vām andhaso varīmann astāri barhiḥ suprāyaṇatamam
children.translated_text: For you the broad place of the soma-draught has been made; the most easy-going sacrificial grass has been spread,

children.text: uttānahasto yuvayur vavandā vāṃ nakṣanto adraya āñjan ||
children.translated_text: with upraised hands the one devoted to you has bowed; the pressing stones, approaching you, have been anointed.

children.text: ūrdhvo vām agnir adhvareṣv asthāt pra rātir eti jūrṇinī ghṛtācī
children.translated_text: Your <s>Agni</s> has stood upright in the rites; the streaming, ghee-faced gift goes forth,

children.text: pra hotā gūrtamanā urāṇo 'yukta yo nāsatyā havīman ||
children.translated_text: the eager, joyful <s>hotṛ</s> has gone forward; he has yoked the invitation for you, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>.

children.text: adhi śriye duhitā sūryasya rathaṃ tasthau purubhujā śatotim
children.translated_text: For beauty, the daughter of <s>Sūrya</s> mounted your chariot, O much-enjoying ones, with its hundred aids,

children.text: pra māyābhir māyinā bhūtam atra narā nṛtū janiman yajñiyānām ||
children.translated_text: by your wondrous powers become wonder-workers here, O heroes, dancers at the birth of the worshipful ones.

children.text: yuvaṃ śrībhir darśatābhir ābhiḥ śubhe puṣṭim ūhathuḥ sūryāyāḥ
children.translated_text: You two, with these visible beauties, brought splendor and nourishment for <s>Sūryā</s>,

children.text: pra vāṃ vayo vapuṣe 'nu paptan nakṣad vāṇī suṣṭutā dhiṣṇyā vām ||
children.translated_text: the birds flew forth after your form; the well-praised voice reached you two, O worthy ones.

children.text: ā vāṃ vayo 'śvāso vahiṣṭhā abhi prayo nāsatyā vahantu
children.translated_text: May the birds, the swiftest horses, bring you hither, carrying delight, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>,

children.text: pra vāṃ ratho manojavā asarjīṣaḥ pṛkṣa iṣidho anu pūrvīḥ ||
children.translated_text: your mind-swift chariot has been sent forth, eager for refreshment, following many former paths.

children.text: puru hi vām purubhujā deṣṇaṃ dhenuṃ na iṣam pinvatam asakrām
children.translated_text: For yours, O much-enjoying ones, is much giving; fill for us unfailing food like a milch cow,

children.text: stutaś ca vām mādhvī suṣṭutiś ca rasāś ca ye vām anu rātim agman ||
children.translated_text: and both the praise for you and the honeyed good praise, and the juices that have come according to your bounty.

children.text: uta ma ṛjre purayasya raghvī sumīﾱhe śatam peruke ca pakvā
children.translated_text: And for me, at <s>Ṛjra</s>, <s>Puraya</s>'s swift gift, at well-praised <s>Peruka</s>, were a hundred ripe ones,

children.text: śāṇḍo dāddhiraṇinaḥ smaddiṣṭīn daśa vaśāso abhiṣāca ṛṣvān ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Śāṇḍa</s>, son of <s>Dāddhiraṇi</s>, gave from us ten strong cattle, imposing and accompanying.

children.text: saṃ vāṃ śatā nāsatyā sahasrāśvānām purupanthā gire dāt
children.translated_text: May <s>Purupanthā</s> give to my song hundreds and thousands of horses for you, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>,

children.text: bharadvājāya vīra nū gire dād dhatā rakṣāṃsi purudaṃsasā syuḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he give to <s>Bharadvāja</s>, O heroes, now to my song; may the much-wondrous ones slay the demons.

children.text: ā vāṃ sumne variman sūribhiḥ ṣyām ||
children.translated_text: May we be in your favor, in spaciousness, together with patrons.

children.text: Chapter 505
ud u śriya uṣaso rocamānā asthur apāṃ normayo ruśantaḥ
children.translated_text: The radiant dawns have risen up in beauty; the shining waves of the waters have stood forth,

children.text: kṛṇoti viśvā supathā sugāny abhūd u vasvī dakṣiṇā maghonī ||
children.translated_text: generous <s>Dakṣiṇā</s>, rich in goods, has made all paths fair and easy to travel.

children.text: bhadrā dadṛkṣa urviyā vi bhāsy ut te śocir bhānavo dyām apaptan
children.translated_text: Auspiciously she has appeared; widely you shine forth; your flame, your beams, have flown up to heaven.

children.text: āvir vakṣaḥ kṛṇuṣe śumbhamānoṣo devi rocamānā mahobhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: You make your breast visible as you adorn yourself, O divine <s>Uṣas</s>, shining with great powers.

children.text: vahanti sīm aruṇāso ruśanto gāvaḥ subhagām urviyā prathānām
children.translated_text: The ruddy, bright cattle bear her, the fortunate one, as she spreads out broadly.

children.text: apejate śūro asteva śatrūn bādhate tamo ajiro na voﾱhā ||
children.translated_text: She drives away enemies like a hero shooting arrows; swift as a bearer, she drives away the darkness.

children.text: sugota te supathā parvateṣv avāte apas tarasi svabhāno
children.translated_text: By good tracks and good paths among the mountains, in windless places, you cross the waters, self-luminous one.

children.text: sā na ā vaha pṛthuyāmann ṛṣve rayiṃ divo duhitar iṣayadhyai ||
children.translated_text: Bring to us, O broad-ranging, lofty daughter of heaven, wealth from heaven for refreshment.

children.text: sā vaha yokṣabhir avātoṣo varaṃ vahasi joṣam anu
children.translated_text: Bring it with your yoked companions, O <s>Uṣas</s> of calm course; you carry the best thing according to delight.

children.text: tvaṃ divo duhitar yā ha devī pūrvahūtau maṃhanā darśatā bhūḥ ||
children.translated_text: You, daughter of heaven, the goddess, became great and visible at the first invocation.

children.text: ut te vayaś cid vasater apaptan naraś ca ye pitubhājo vyuṣṭau
children.translated_text: Even the birds have flown up from their dwelling, and the men who share in food at the daybreak.

children.text: amā sate vahasi bhūri vāmam uṣo devi dāśuṣe martyāya ||
children.translated_text: You bring much desirable treasure homeward, O divine <s>Uṣas</s>, for the generous mortal.

children.text: Chapter 506
eṣā syā no duhitā divojāḥ kṣitīr ucchantī mānuṣīr ajīgaḥ
children.translated_text: This daughter of heaven, born in the sky, has awakened the human peoples as she shines forth.

children.text: yā bhānunā ruśatā rāmyāsv ajñāyi tiras tamasaś cid aktūn ||
children.translated_text: She who, with her ruddy beam, was recognized in the lovely nights, even beyond the darkness.

children.text: vi tad yayur aruṇayugbhir aśvaiś citram bhānty uṣasaś candrarathāḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Uṣases</s>, with ruddy-yoked horses and bright chariots, have gone apart and shine splendidly.

children.text: agraṃ yajñasya bṛhato nayantīr vi tā bādhante tama ūrmyāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Leading the front of the great sacrifice, they drive away the darkness of the flood.

children.text: śravo vājam iṣam ūrjaṃ vahantīr ni dāśuṣa uṣaso martyāya
children.translated_text: Bringing fame, prize, refreshment, and strength, the <s>Uṣases</s> set them down for the generous mortal.

children.text: maghonīr vīravat patyamānā avo dhāta vidhate ratnam adya ||
children.translated_text: Rich in gifts and ruling with heroes, grant protection and treasure today to the worshipper.

children.text: idā hi vo vidhate ratnam astīdā vīrāya dāśuṣa uṣāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Now indeed there is treasure for your worshipper; now, O <s>Uṣases</s>, there is treasure for the heroic generous man.

children.text: idā viprāya jarate yad ukthā ni ṣma māvate vahathā purā cit ||
children.translated_text: Now, when he recites hymns, you bring it even of old for the inspired singer who praises me.

children.text: idā hi ta uṣo adrisāno gotrā gavām aṅgiraso gṛṇanti
children.translated_text: Now indeed, O <s>Uṣas</s>, stone-winning one, the <s>Aṅgirases</s> praise the cow-stalls of the cattle.

children.text: vy arkeṇa bibhidur brahmaṇā ca satyā nṛṇām abhavad devahūtiḥ ||
children.translated_text: With chant and with sacred formulation they split them open; the god-invocation of men became true.

children.text: ucchā divo duhitaḥ pratnavan no bharadvājavad vidhate maghoni
children.translated_text: Shine up for us, daughter of heaven, as of old, O rich one, for the worshipper like <s>Bharadvāja</s>.

children.text: suvīraṃ rayiṃ gṛṇate rirīhy urugāyam adhi dhehi śravo naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bestow on the singer wealth rich in heroes; place wide-ranging fame upon us.

children.text: Chapter 507
vapur nu tac cikituṣe cid astu samānaṃ nāma dhenu patyamānam
children.translated_text: Let that form be evident even to the discerning one: the same name belongs to the cow coming to her lord.

children.text: marteṣv anyad dohase pīpāya sakṛcchukraṃ duduhe pṛśnir ūdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Among mortals one thing has swollen for milking; once <s>Pṛśni</s> milked her bright udder.

children.text: ye agnayo na śośucann idhānā dvir yat trir maruto vāvṛdhanta
children.translated_text: The fires blazed like kindled ones, when the <s>Maruts</s> grew twofold and threefold.

children.text: areṇavo hiraṇyayāsa eṣāṃ sākaṃ nṛmṇaiḥ pauṃsyebhiś ca bhūvan ||
children.translated_text: Dustless and golden were they, together with powers and manly strengths.

children.text: rudrasya ye mīﾱhuṣaḥ santi putrā yāṃś co nu dādhṛvir bharadhyai
children.translated_text: Those who are the sons of bountiful <s>Rudra</s>, and whom he has sustained so that they may be borne onward,

children.text: vide hi mātā maho mahī ṣā set pṛśniḥ subhve garbham ādhāt ||
children.translated_text: their great mother knew them well; for good birth <s>Pṛśni</s> placed the embryo.

children.text: na ya īṣante januṣo 'yā nv antaḥ santo 'vadyāni punānāḥ
children.translated_text: They do not fail from their birth; being within, they purify away blameworthy things.

children.text: nir yad duhre śucayo 'nu joṣam anu śriyā tanvam ukṣamāṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the pure ones milk out according to delight, they anoint their bodies with beauty.

children.text: makṣū na yeṣu dohase cid ayā ā nāma dhṛṣṇu mārutaṃ dadhānāḥ
children.translated_text: Quickly among them, even for milking, this bold name of the <s>Maruts</s> is assumed.

children.text: na ye staunā ayāso mahnā nū cit sudānur ava yāsad ugrān ||
children.translated_text: They are not wearied supports; even now, by greatness, the generous one will not turn away the fierce ones.

children.text: ta id ugrāḥ śavasā dhṛṣṇuṣeṇā ubhe yujanta rodasī sumeke
children.translated_text: Those fierce ones, with strength and a bold army, yoke the two well-matched worlds.

children.text: adha smaiṣu rodasī svaśocir āmavatsu tasthau na rokaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then among them the two worlds stood, self-luminous, like light among the vigorous.

children.text: aneno vo maruto yāmo astv anaśvaś cid yam ajaty arathīḥ
children.translated_text: May your course, O <s>Maruts</s>, be faultless, the one which even the horseless and chariotless man drives.

children.text: anavaso anabhīśū rajastūr vi rodasī pathyā yāti sādhan ||
children.translated_text: Without wagons and without reins, traversing the midspace, it goes on the paths between the two worlds, accomplishing its aim.

children.text: nāsya vartā na tarutā nv asti maruto yam avatha vājasātau
children.translated_text: There is no one to turn back or overcome the man, O <s>Maruts</s>, whom you help in the winning of the prize.

children.text: toke vā goṣu tanaye yam apsu sa vrajaṃ dartā pārye adha dyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: In offspring, in cattle, in children, and in the waters, he splits open the enclosure beyond heaven.

children.text: pra citram arkaṃ gṛṇate turāya mārutāya svatavase bharadhvam
children.translated_text: Bring forth a bright song for the swift, self-strong <s>Marut</s> host as it is praised.

children.text: ye sahāṃsi sahasā sahante rejate agne pṛthivī makhebhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They overpower powers by their might; O <s>Agni</s>, the earth trembles at their rites.

children.text: tviṣīmanto adhvarasyeva didyut tṛṣucyavaso juhvo nāgneḥ
children.translated_text: Full of brilliance, like the lightning of the sacrifice, moving in showers, with tongues like those of <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: arcatrayo dhunayo na vīrā bhrājajjanmāno maruto adhṛṣṭāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the singing, roaring heroes, the bright-born <s>Maruts</s>, are unassailable.

children.text: taṃ vṛdhantam mārutam bhrājadṛṣṭiṃ rudrasya sūnuṃ havasā vivāse
children.translated_text: I seek with invocation that growing <s>Marut</s> host, bright in appearance, the son of <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: divaḥ śardhāya śucayo manīṣā girayo nāpa ugrā aspṛdhran ||
children.translated_text: The pure ones, the host of heaven, with inspired thought; the mountains did not contend with the fierce one.

children.text: Chapter 508
viśveṣāṃ vaḥ satāṃ jyeṣṭhatamā gīrbhir mitrāvaruṇā vāvṛdhadhyai
children.translated_text: With songs I would magnify you, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, greatest among all the true ones.

children.text: saṃ yā raśmeva yamatur yamiṣṭhā dvā janāṁ asamā bāhubhiḥ svaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: The two unequal peoples, most restraining, you have joined together like a rein, with your own arms.

children.text: iyam mad vām pra stṛṇīte manīṣopa priyā namasā barhir accha
children.translated_text: This inspired thought of mine spreads itself toward you, toward the dear sacred grass with reverence.

children.text: yantaṃ no mitrāvaruṇāv adhṛṣṭaṃ chardir yad vāṃ varūthyaṃ sudānū ||
children.translated_text: Come to us, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, with inviolable shelter, the protective cover that is yours, good givers.

children.text: ā yātam mitrāvaruṇā suśasty upa priyā namasā hūyamānā
children.translated_text: Come, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, well praised, invoked with dear reverence.

children.text: saṃ yāv apnaḥstho apaseva janāñ chrudhīyataś cid yatatho mahitvā ||
children.translated_text: Since you two stand together in work among the peoples as if for labor, even when heard you extend yourselves by greatness.

children.text: aśvā na yā vājinā pūtabandhū ṛtā yad garbham aditir bharadhyai
children.translated_text: Like two prize-winning horses with pure bonds, when <s>Aditi</s> bears the embryo of truth,

children.text: pra yā mahi mahāntā jāyamānā ghorā martāya ripave ni dīdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: those great and mighty ones, being born, terrible, set themselves against the mortal enemy.

children.text: viśve yad vām maṃhanā mandamānāḥ kṣatraṃ devāso adadhuḥ sajoṣāḥ
children.translated_text: When all the gods, rejoicing together, gave you sovereignty by their greatness,

children.text: pari yad bhūtho rodasī cid urvī santi spaśo adabdhāso amūrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: when you encompassed even the two broad worlds, your spies are undeceived and not foolish.

children.text: tā hi kṣatraṃ dhārayethe anu dyūn dṛṃhethe sānum upamād iva dyoḥ
children.translated_text: For you two uphold sovereignty through the days; you make firm the ridge like the highest point of heaven.

children.text: dṛﾱho nakṣatra uta viśvadevo bhūmim ātān dyāṃ dhāsināyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: The fixed star, and the all-divine power, held firm; by your support you stretched out earth and heaven.

children.text: tā vigraṃ dhaithe jaṭharam pṛṇadhyā ā yat sadma sabhṛtayaḥ pṛṇanti
children.translated_text: You two hold the wide belly to be filled, when the companions fill the seat together.

children.text: na mṛṣyante yuvatayo 'vātā vi yat payo viśvajinvā bharante ||
children.translated_text: The young women, windless, do not fail, when they bear the all-conquering milk.

children.text: tā jihvayā sadam edaṃ sumedhā ā yad vāṃ satyo aratir ṛte bhūt
children.translated_text: With his tongue the wise one is ever here, when your true envoy has come according to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: tad vām mahitvaṃ ghṛtānnāv astu yuvaṃ dāśuṣe vi cayiṣṭam aṃhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May that greatness of yours, rich in ghee, be ours; you two best remove distress from the worshipper.

children.text: pra yad vām mitrāvaruṇā spūrdhan priyā dhāma yuvadhitā minanti
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, men strive against your dear ordinances and violate the stations set by you,

children.text: na ye devāsa ohasā na martā ayajñasāco apyo na putrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: neither gods by their power, nor mortals who do not join the sacrifice, nor even kinsmen as sons can withstand you.

children.text: vi yad vācaṃ kīstāso bharante śaṃsanti kecin nivido manānāḥ
children.translated_text: When the singers carry forth speech, and some proclaim the <s>nivid</s> invocations, intent in their minds,

children.text: ād vām bravāma satyāny ukthā nakir devebhir yatatho mahitvā ||
children.translated_text: then we speak true hymns to you; none among the gods contends with your greatness.

children.text: avor itthā vāṃ chardiṣo abhiṣṭau yuvor mitrāvaruṇāv askṛdhoyu
children.translated_text: Truly, in seeking your shelter and help, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, may we not fail before you,

children.text: anu yad gāva sphurān ṛjipyaṃ dhṛṣṇuṃ yad raṇe vṛṣaṇaṃ yunajan ||
children.translated_text: when they yoked the strong bull in battle, following the leaping, straight-speeding one with the cows.

children.text: Chapter 509
śruṣṭī vāṃ yajña udyataḥ sajoṣā manuṣvad vṛktabarhiṣo yajadhyai
children.translated_text: Your sacrifice, raised with eager obedience and shared accord, is ready for worship, with the sacred grass spread as by <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: ā ya indrāvaruṇāv iṣe adya mahe sumnāya maha āvavartat ||
children.translated_text: He has turned today to you, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, for refreshment, for great favor, for greatness.

children.text: tā hi śreṣṭhā devatātā tujā śūrāṇāṃ śaviṣṭhā tā hi bhūtam
children.translated_text: For you two are the best among the divine powers, swift, the mightiest among heroes; so indeed you have become.

children.text: maghonām maṃhiṣṭhā tuviśuṣma ṛtena vṛtraturā sarvasenā ||
children.translated_text: Among generous lords you are most generous, very mighty, overcoming <s>Vṛtra</s> by <s>ṛta</s>, with every host.

children.text: tā gṛṇīhi namasyebhiḥ śūṣaiḥ sumnebhir indrāvaruṇā cakānā
children.translated_text: Praise those two with reverent songs and good favors, desiring them, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: vajreṇānyaḥ śavasā hanti vṛtraṃ siṣakty anyo vṛjaneṣu vipraḥ ||
children.translated_text: One strikes <s>Vṛtra</s> with the thunderbolt and power; the other, the inspired sage, attends in the contests.

children.text: gnāś ca yan naraś ca vāvṛdhanta viśve devāso narāṃ svagūrtāḥ
children.translated_text: When women and men have magnified you, and all the gods, well-praised men among men,

children.text: praibhya indrāvaruṇā mahitvā dyauś ca pṛthivi bhūtam urvī ||
children.translated_text: before them, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, by your greatness heaven and earth became broad and spacious.

children.text: sa it sudānuḥ svavāṁ ṛtāvendrā yo vāṃ varuṇa dāśati tman
children.translated_text: That one indeed is generous, self-strong, faithful to <s>ṛta</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, who of himself worships you and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: iṣā sa dviṣas tared dāsvān vaṃsad rayiṃ rayivataś ca janān ||
children.translated_text: With refreshment that giver crosses hatreds; he wins wealth and people rich in wealth.

children.text: yaṃ yuvaṃ dāśvadhvarāya devā rayiṃ dhattho vasumantam purukṣum
children.translated_text: The wealth which you two gods place for the sacrificer who performs the rite, rich in goods and abundant in cattle,

children.text: asme sa indrāvaruṇāv api ṣyāt pra yo bhanakti vanuṣām aśastīḥ ||
children.translated_text: may that wealth be ours, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, which breaks apart the evil spells of enemies.

children.text: uta naḥ sutrātro devagopāḥ sūribhya indrāvaruṇā rayiḥ ṣyāt
children.translated_text: And may wealth be ours from you, good rescuers and god-guarded ones, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, for the patrons,

children.text: yeṣāṃ śuṣmaḥ pṛtanāsu sāhvān pra sadyo dyumnā tirate taturiḥ ||
children.translated_text: whose force conquers in battles and whose victorious splendor at once carries off the prize.

children.text: nū na indrāvaruṇā gṛṇānā pṛṅktaṃ rayiṃ sauśravasāya devā
children.translated_text: Now, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, being praised, fill us with wealth for good renown, O gods.

children.text: itthā gṛṇanto mahinasya śardho 'po na nāvā duritā tarema ||
children.translated_text: Praising in this way the host of greatness, may we cross beyond hardships as over waters by a ship.

children.text: pra samrāje bṛhate manma nu priyam arca devāya varuṇāya saprathaḥ
children.translated_text: Sing forth now a dear thought, wide-spreading, to the great sovereign, to the god <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: ayaṃ ya urvī mahinā mahivrataḥ kratvā vibhāty ajaro na śociṣā ||
children.translated_text: This one, wide by his greatness, great in vow, shines by his will, ageless like a flame.

children.text: indrāvaruṇā sutapāv imaṃ sutaṃ somam pibatam madyaṃ dhṛtavratā
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, drinkers of the pressed Soma, drink this pressed, intoxicating Soma, firm in your vows.

children.text: yuvo ratho adhvaraṃ devavītaye prati svasaram upa yāti pītaye ||
children.translated_text: Your chariot comes to the rite for the gods' feast, turning toward the bright draught for drinking.

children.text: indrāvaruṇā madhumattamasya vṛṣṇaḥ somasya vṛṣaṇā vṛṣethām
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, strong ones, may you be strengthened by the sweetest, vigorous Soma.

children.text: idaṃ vām andhaḥ pariṣiktam asme āsadyāsmin barhiṣi mādayethām ||
children.translated_text: This draught of yours has been poured out here for us; sit down on this sacred grass and rejoice.

children.text: Chapter 510
saṃ vāṃ karmaṇā sam iṣā hinomīndrāviṣṇū apasas pāre asya
children.translated_text: By ritual action and refreshment I impel you together, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, to the far side of this work.

children.text: juṣethāṃ yajñaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattam ariṣṭair naḥ pathibhiḥ pārayantā ||
children.translated_text: Enjoy the sacrifice and bestow wealth, carrying us across by unharmed paths.

children.text: yā viśvāsāṃ janitārā matīnām indrāviṣṇū kalaśā somadhānā
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, begetters of all inspirations, the Soma-holding beakers are set for you.

children.text: pra vāṃ giraḥ śasyamānā avantu pra stomāso gīyamānāso arkaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the recited songs go forth to help you; may the hymns being sung go forth with verses.

children.text: indrāviṣṇū madapatī madānām ā somaṃ yātaṃ draviṇo dadhānā
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, lords of exhilarations, come to the Soma, bearing wealth.

children.text: saṃ vām añjantv aktubhir matīnāṃ saṃ stomāsaḥ śasyamānāsa ukthaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the thoughts anoint you together with their lights; may the hymns being recited anoint you together with praises.

children.text: ā vām aśvāso abhimātiṣāha indrāviṣṇū sadhamādo vahantu
children.translated_text: May horses that overcome hostile attack bring you, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, to the common exhilaration.

children.text: juṣethāṃ viśvā havanā matīnām upa brahmāṇi śṛṇutaṃ giro me ||
children.translated_text: Enjoy all the invocations of the inspired thoughts; listen close to the sacred formulations and to my songs.

children.text: indrāviṣṇū tat panayāyyaṃ vāṃ somasya mada uru cakramāthe
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, this deed of yours is praiseworthy: in the exhilaration of Soma you strode widely.

children.text: akṛṇutam antarikṣaṃ varīyo 'prathataṃ jīvase no rajāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: You made the midspace broader; you spread out the realms for us to live.

children.text: indrāviṣṇū haviṣā vāvṛdhānāgrādvānā namasā rātahavyā
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, increased by oblation, going foremost, receiving offerings with reverence,

children.text: ghṛtāsutī draviṇaṃ dhattam asme samudra sthaḥ kalaśaḥ somadhānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with ghee as your libation, bestow wealth on us; you stand as the ocean, the beaker, the Soma-holder.

children.text: indrāviṣṇū pibatam madhvo asya somasya dasrā jaṭharam pṛṇethām
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, drink of this sweet Soma, wondrous ones; fill your belly.

children.text: ā vām andhāṃsi madirāṇy agmann upa brahmāṇi śṛṇutaṃ havam me ||
children.translated_text: The exhilarating draughts have come to you; listen close to the sacred formulations, to my call.

children.text: ubhā jigyathur na parā jayethe na parā jigye kataraś canainoḥ
children.translated_text: Both of you have conquered; you are not conquered from afar, and neither one of you has been conquered.

children.text: indraś ca viṣṇo yad apaspṛdhethāṃ tredhā sahasraṃ vi tad airayethām ||
children.translated_text: When you, <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, contended, you set the thousand in motion in threefold form.

children.text: Chapter 511
ghṛtavatī bhuvanānām abhiśriyorvī pṛthvī madhudughe supeśasā
children.translated_text: Ghee-rich, adorned above the worlds, broad and wide, milkers of honey, beautifully formed,

children.text: dyāvāpṛthivī varuṇasya dharmaṇā viṣkabhite ajare bhūriretasā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, Heaven and Earth, are propped apart by the law of <s>Varuṇa</s>, undecaying and rich in seed.

children.text: asaścantī bhūridhāre payasvatī ghṛtaṃ duhāte sukṛte śucivrate
children.translated_text: Unfailing, of many streams, full of milk, pure in vow, they milk ghee for the doer of good.

children.text: rājantī asya bhuvanasya rodasī asme retaḥ siñcataṃ yan manurhitam ||
children.translated_text: The two world-halves, shining over this world, pour upon us the seed that was set by <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: yo vām ṛjave kramaṇāya rodasī marto dadāśa dhiṣaṇe sa sādhati
children.translated_text: The mortal who has given to you, O two world-halves, for straight going, O wise goddesses, succeeds.

children.text: pra prajābhir jāyate dharmaṇas pari yuvoḥ siktā viṣurūpāṇi savratā ||
children.translated_text: He is born forth with offspring under the order; your poured streams are manifold and share one vow.

children.text: ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī abhīvṛte ghṛtaśriyā ghṛtapṛcā ghṛtāvṛdhā
children.translated_text: Covered with ghee, O <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, ghee-bright, touched with ghee, increased by ghee,

children.text: urvī pṛthvī hotṛvūrye purohite te id viprā īﾱate sumnam iṣṭaye ||
children.translated_text: broad and wide, serving as hotar and purohita, you two are sought by inspired poets for favor and for the desired gain.

children.text: madhu no dyāvāpṛthivī mimikṣatām madhuścutā madhudughe madhuvrate
children.translated_text: May <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, Heaven and Earth, mix sweetness for us, dripping honey, milking honey, honey-vowed,

children.text: dadhāne yajñaṃ draviṇaṃ ca devatā mahi śravo vājam asme suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: bearing sacrifice, wealth, and divinity; may they set for us great fame, prize-winning strength, and heroic power.

children.text: ūrjaṃ no dyauś ca pṛthivī ca pinvatām pitā mātā viśvavidā sudaṃsasā
children.translated_text: May Heaven and Earth, father and mother, all-knowing and of good deeds, swell nourishment for us,

children.text: saṃrarāṇe rodasī viśvaśambhuvā saniṃ vājaṃ rayim asme sam invatām ||
children.translated_text: the two world-halves coming together, bringing welfare to all; may they bestow gain, strength, and wealth upon us.

children.text: Chapter 512
ud u ṣya devaḥ savitā hiraṇyayā bāhū ayaṃsta savanāya sukratuḥ
children.translated_text: That god <s>Savitṛ</s>, golden-armed and of good resolve, has stretched up his arms for the pressing,

children.text: ghṛtena pāṇī abhi pruṣṇute makho yuvā sudakṣo rajaso vidharmaṇi ||
children.translated_text: the bounteous one sprinkles his hands with ghee, young and skillful, at the ordinance of the midspace.

children.text: devasya vayaṃ savituḥ savīmani śreṣṭhe syāma vasunaś ca dāvane
children.translated_text: May we be under the impelling power of the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, in the best gift of wealth,

children.text: yo viśvasya dvipado yaś catuṣpado niveśane prasave cāsi bhūmanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: of you who are lord in the settling and the impulse of all that is two-footed and four-footed, in abundance.

children.text: adabdhebhiḥ savitaḥ pāyubhiṣ ṭvaṃ śivebhir adya pari pāhi no gayam
children.translated_text: With unharmed protectors, O <s>Savitṛ</s>, with auspicious ones, today guard our household all around.

children.text: hiraṇyajihvaḥ suvitāya navyase rakṣā mākir no aghaśaṃsa īśata ||
children.translated_text: Golden-tongued, guard us for newer well-being; let no evil-speaking man gain power over us.

children.text: ud u ṣya devaḥ savitā damūnā hiraṇyapāṇiḥ pratidoṣam asthāt
children.translated_text: That god <s>Savitṛ</s>, household-lord and golden-handed, has risen up at evening,

children.text: ayohanur yajato mandrajihva ā dāśuṣe suvati bhūri vāmam ||
children.translated_text: iron-jawed, worshipful, and sweet-tongued; for the giver he impels much that is lovely.

children.text: ud ū ayāṁ upavakteva bāhū hiraṇyayā savitā supratīkā
children.translated_text: Upward, like an announcer, fair-faced <s>Savitṛ</s> raised his golden arms,

children.text: divo rohāṃsy aruhat pṛthivyā arīramat patayat kaccid abhvam ||
children.translated_text: he mounted the heights of heaven and of earth; he set moving what flies, and checked what was inert.

children.text: vāmam adya savitar vāmam u śvo dive dive vāmam asmabhyaṃ sāvīḥ
children.translated_text: Today, O <s>Savitṛ</s>, may you grant what is lovely, and tomorrow what is lovely; day by day may you impel what is lovely for us.

children.text: vāmasya hi kṣayasya deva bhūrer ayā dhiyā vāmabhājaḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: For, O god, by this thought may we be sharers in the lovely abundance of a rich dwelling.

children.text: Chapter 513
indrāsomā mahi tad vām mahitvaṃ yuvam mahāni prathamāni cakrathuḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, great is that greatness of yours; you two performed the first great deeds.

children.text: yuvaṃ sūryaṃ vividathur yuvaṃ svar viśvā tamāṃsy ahataṃ nidaś ca ||
children.translated_text: You two discovered the sun, you two the light of heaven; you struck down all darknesses and revilings.

children.text: indrāsomā vāsayatha uṣāsam ut sūryaṃ nayatho jyotiṣā saha
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, you clothe the dawn; you lead up the sun together with light.

children.text: upa dyāṃ skambhathu skambhanenāprathatam pṛthivīm mātaraṃ vi ||
children.translated_text: You propped up heaven with a support; you spread out mother earth far and wide.

children.text: indrāsomāv ahim apaḥ pariṣṭhāṃ hatho vṛtram anu vāṃ dyaur amanyata
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, you slew <s>Ahi</s>, <s>Vṛtra</s>, who enclosed the waters; heaven assented to you.

children.text: prārṇāṃsy airayataṃ nadīnām ā samudrāṇi paprathuḥ purūṇi ||
children.translated_text: You set the floods of the rivers in motion; you filled the many seas.

children.text: indrāsomā pakvam āmāsv antar ni gavām id dadhathur vakṣaṇāsu
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, you placed the ripened thing inside the unripe cows, in the cows' bellies,

children.text: jagṛbhathur anapinaddham āsu ruśac citrāsu jagatīṣv antaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you grasped the unfastened thing within them, within the shining, variegated living creatures.

children.text: indrāsomā yuvam aṅga tarutram apatyasācaṃ śrutyaṃ rarāthe
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, you granted a saving power, joined with offspring and worthy of hearing.

children.text: yuvaṃ śuṣmaṃ naryaṃ carṣaṇibhyaḥ saṃ vivyathuḥ pṛtanāṣāham ugrā ||
children.translated_text: You, fierce ones, spread manly might among peoples, a power that conquers battles.

children.text: Chapter 514
yo adribhit prathamajā ṛtāvā bṛhaspatir āṅgiraso haviṣmān
children.translated_text: He who is the first-born, true to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), breaker of rocks, <s>Bṛhaspati</s> the <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, rich in oblation,

children.text: dvibarhajmā prāgharmasat pitā na ā rodasī vṛṣabho roravīti ||
children.translated_text: of double strength, seated at the hot draught, like a father, the bull roars to Heaven and Earth.

children.text: janāya cid ya īvata u lokam bṛhaspatir devahūtau cakāra
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, who even for the distressed man made a space at the gods' invocation,

children.text: ghnan vṛtrāṇi vi puro dardarīti jayañchatrūṃr amitrān pṛtsu sāhan ||
children.translated_text: slaying obstacles, he splits the strongholds apart, conquering hostile enemies, overcoming in battles.

children.text: bṛhaspatiḥ sam ajayad vasūni maho vrajān gomato deva eṣaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s> won the goods; this god won the great cattle-pens full of cows.

children.text: apaḥ siṣāsan svar apratīto bṛhaspatir hanty amitram arkaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeking the waters and the unopposed light of heaven, <s>Bṛhaspati</s> slays the enemy with songs.

children.text: Chapter 515
somārudrā dhārayethām asuryam pra vām iṣṭayo 'ram aśnuvantu
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s> and <s>Rudra</s>, uphold lordly power; may our offerings fully reach you.

children.text: dame dame sapta ratnā dadhānā śaṃ no bhūtaṃ dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||
children.translated_text: Setting seven treasures in every house, be auspicious for our two-footed and auspicious for our four-footed.

children.text: somārudrā vi vṛhataṃ viṣūcīm amīvā yā no gayam āviveśa
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s> and <s>Rudra</s>, drive apart the disease, going in all directions, that has entered our household.

children.text: āre bādhethāṃ nirṛtim parācair asme bhadrā sauśravasāni santu ||
children.translated_text: Drive perdition far away by distant paths; may gracious, well-famed blessings be ours.

children.text: somārudrā yuvam etāny asme viśvā tanūṣu bheṣajāni dhattam
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s> and <s>Rudra</s>, place in our bodies all these remedies,

children.text: ava syatam muñcataṃ yan no asti tanūṣu baddhaṃ kṛtam eno asmat ||
children.translated_text: loosen and release from us whatever committed sin is bound in our bodies.

children.text: tigmāyudhau tigmahetī suśevau somārudrāv iha su mṛﾱataṃ naḥ
children.translated_text: Sharp-weaponed, sharp-missiled, and kindly, O <s>Soma</s> and <s>Rudra</s>, be gracious to us here.

children.text: pra no muñcataṃ varuṇasya pāśād gopāyataṃ naḥ sumanasyamānā ||
children.translated_text: Release us from the noose of <s>Varuṇa</s>; guard us, being well-disposed toward us.

children.text: Chapter 516
jīmūtasyeva bhavati pratīkaṃ yad varmī yāti samadām upasthe
children.translated_text: Like the face of a rain-cloud is his appearance when the armored man advances into the lap of battles.

children.text: anāviddhayā tanvā jaya tvaṃ sa tvā varmaṇo mahimā pipartu ||
children.translated_text: With an unwounded body, win victory; may the greatness of armor protect you.

children.text: dhanvanā gā dhanvanājiṃ jayema dhanvanā tīvrāḥ samado jayema
children.translated_text: With the bow may we win cattle; with the bow may we win the contest; with the bow may we win fierce battles.

children.text: dhanuḥ śatror apakāmaṃ kṛṇoti dhanvanā sarvāḥ pradiśo jayema ||
