children.translated_text: The bow makes the enemy's desire ineffective; with the bow may we win all the quarters.

children.text: vakṣyantīved ā ganīganti karṇam priyaṃ sakhāyam pariṣasvajānā
children.translated_text: As if about to speak, she comes close to the ear, embracing her dear friend;

children.text: yoṣeva śiṅkte vitatādhi dhanvañ jyā iyaṃ samane pārayantī ||
children.translated_text: like a woman she twangs, stretched upon the bow, this bowstring carrying one across in the contest.

children.text: te ācarantī samaneva yoṣā māteva putram bibhṛtām upasthe
children.translated_text: Moving forward like two women to the contest, let these two, like a mother her son, hold him in their lap.

children.text: apa śatrūn vidhyatāṃ saṃvidāne ārtnī ime viṣphurantī amitrān ||
children.translated_text: In agreement, let these two bow-ends shoot the enemies away, quivering against the unfriends.

children.text: bahvīnām pitā bahur asya putraś ciścā kṛṇoti samanāvagatya
children.translated_text: Father of many, many are his sons; with a hiss he acts when he has come into the battle.

children.text: iṣudhiḥ saṅkāḥ pṛtanāś ca sarvāḥ pṛṣṭhe ninaddho jayati prasūtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The quiver, bound upon the back, when sent forward, conquers the clash and all battles.

children.text: rathe tiṣṭhan nayati vājinaḥ puro yatra yatra kāmayate suṣārathiḥ
children.translated_text: Standing on the chariot, the good charioteer drives the swift horses ahead wherever he wishes.

children.text: abhīśūnām mahimānam panāyata manaḥ paścād anu yacchanti raśmayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Praise the greatness of the reins; the reins follow behind the mind.

children.text: tīvrān ghoṣān kṛṇvate vṛṣapāṇayo 'śvā rathebhiḥ saha vājayantaḥ
children.translated_text: The horses, with strong hooves, make piercing sounds as they race together with the chariots.

children.text: avakrāmantaḥ prapadair amitrān kṣiṇanti śatrūṃr anapavyayantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Treading upon the unfriends with their forefeet, they destroy the enemies without turning away.

children.text: rathavāhanaṃ havir asya nāma yatrāyudhaṃ nihitam asya varma
children.translated_text: Chariot-borne is the name of his oblation, where his weapon and his armor are laid down.

children.text: tatrā ratham upa śagmaṃ sadema viśvāhā vayaṃ sumanasyamānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: There may we mount a helpful chariot, favorably minded on every day.

children.text: svāduṣaṃsadaḥ pitaro vayodhāḥ kṛcchreśritaḥ śaktīvanto gabhīrāḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Pitṛs</s>, sweet in their seat, givers of life, resorted to in distress, powerful and deep,

children.text: citrasenā iṣubalā amṛdhrāḥ satovīrā uravo vrātasāhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: with splendid armies, strong in arrows, unassailable, with true heroes, broad, and overcoming hosts.

children.text: brāhmaṇāsaḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ śive no dyāvāpṛthivī anehasā
children.translated_text: May the Brahman fathers, rich in soma, and Heaven and Earth be gracious to us, free from injury.

children.text: pūṣā naḥ pātu duritād ṛtāvṛdho rakṣā mākir no aghaśaṃsa īśata ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Pūṣan</s> protect us from misfortune, the increaser of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order); let no evil-speaking foe gain power over us.

children.text: suparṇaṃ vaste mṛgo asyā danto gobhiḥ saṃnaddhā patati prasūtā
children.translated_text: She wears fair wings; the deer is her tooth; bound with cowhide, when released she flies.

children.text: yatrā naraḥ saṃ ca vi ca dravanti tatrāsmabhyam iṣavaḥ śarma yaṃsan ||
children.translated_text: Where men rush together and scatter apart, there may the arrows extend shelter for us.

children.text: ṛjīte pari vṛṅdhi no 'śmā bhavatu nas tanūḥ
children.translated_text: Wrap us round in the straight course; let our body become like stone.

children.text: somo adhi bravītu no 'ditiḥ śarma yacchatu ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Soma</s> speak in our favor; let <s>Aditi</s> grant us shelter.

children.text: ā jaṅghanti sānv eṣāṃ jaghanāṁ upa jighnate
children.translated_text: She strikes at their backs; she beats upon their haunches.

children.text: aśvājani pracetaso 'śvān samatsu codaya ||
children.translated_text: O horse-born, discerning one, drive the horses forward in the battles.

children.text: ahir iva bhogaiḥ pary eti bāhuṃ jyāyā hetim paribādhamānaḥ
children.translated_text: Like a serpent with its coils she goes around the arm, warding off the missile with the bowstring.

children.text: hastaghno viśvā vayunāni vidvān pumān pumāṃsam pari pātu viśvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: The hand-guard, knowing all the stratagems, manly, protects man from every side.

children.text: ālāktā yā ruruśīrṣṇy atho yasyā ayo mukham
children.translated_text: She that is reddened, with ruddy head, and whose mouth is of iron,

children.text: idam parjanyaretasa iṣvai devyai bṛhan namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: to this divine arrow, born from <s>Parjanya</s>'s seed, great homage is paid.

children.text: avasṛṣṭā parā pata śaravye brahmasaṃśite
children.translated_text: Released, fly away, O arrow, sharpened by prayer.

children.text: gacchāmitrān pra padyasva māmīṣāṃ kaṃ canoc chiṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Go to the enemies; enter them; leave none of them remaining.

children.text: yatra bāṇāḥ saṃpatanti kumārā viśikhā iva
children.translated_text: Where the arrows fly together like boys with loosened locks,

children.text: tatrā no brahmaṇas patir aditiḥ śarma yacchatu viśvāhā śarma yacchatu ||
children.translated_text: there may <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> and <s>Aditi</s> grant us shelter; may they grant shelter at all times.

children.text: marmāṇi te varmaṇā chādayāmi somas tvā rājāmṛtenānu vastām
children.translated_text: I cover your vital parts with armor; may king <s>Soma</s> clothe you with immortality.

children.text: uror varīyo varuṇas te kṛṇotu jayantaṃ tvānu devā madantu ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Varuṇa</s> make broad space for you broader than the wide; may the gods rejoice in you as you conquer.

children.text: yo naḥ svo araṇo yaś ca niṣṭyo jighāṃsati
children.translated_text: Whoever of our own, or a stranger, or a neighbor wishes to slay us,

children.text: devās taṃ sarve dhūrvantu brahma varma mamāntaram ||
children.translated_text: may all the gods drive him away; prayer is my innermost armor.

children.text: Chapter 517
agniṃ naro dīdhitibhir araṇyor hastacyutī janayanta praśastam
children.translated_text: Men, with their kindlings, produced praised <s>Agni</s> from the two fire-sticks as they slipped from their hands,

children.text: dūredṛśaṃ gṛhapatim atharyum ||
children.translated_text: the far-seeing house-lord, the unfailing one.

children.text: tam agnim aste vasavo ny ṛṇvan supraticakṣam avase kutaś cit
children.translated_text: The <s>Vasus</s> placed that <s>Agni</s> here, with good vision, for help from every side,

children.text: dakṣāyyo yo dama āsa nityaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the skillful one who is always in the house.

children.text: preddho agne dīdihi puro no 'jasrayā sūrmyā yaviṣṭha
children.translated_text: Kindled before us, O <s>Agni</s>, shine with unfailing sunlight, youngest one.

children.text: tvāṃ śaśvanta upa yanti vājāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Perpetual prizes come near to you.

children.text: pra te agnayo 'gnibhyo varaṃ niḥ suvīrāsaḥ śośucanta dyumantaḥ
children.translated_text: Your fires, O <s>Agni</s>, brightly blazing, heroic and splendid, have brought forth the choicest share from the fires,

children.text: yatrā naraḥ samāsate sujātāḥ ||
children.translated_text: where well-born men sit together.

children.text: dā no agne dhiyā rayiṃ suvīraṃ svapatyaṃ sahasya praśastam
children.translated_text: Give us, O <s>Agni</s>, through inspired thought, wealth with good heroes and good offspring, praised son of strength,

children.text: na yaṃ yāvā tarati yātumāvān ||
children.translated_text: wealth which no sorcerous attacker can overcome.

children.text: upa yam eti yuvatiḥ sudakṣaṃ doṣā vastor haviṣmatī ghṛtācī
children.translated_text: To him the young woman comes, skillful, at evening and morning, bearing oblation and rich in ghee.

children.text: upa svainam aramatir vasūyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: To him comes his own <s>Aramati</s>, desiring wealth.

children.text: viśvā agne 'pa dahārātīr yebhis tapobhir adaho jarūtham
children.translated_text: Burn away all hostilities, O <s>Agni</s>, with the heats by which you burned up decay.

children.text: pra nisvaraṃ cātayasvāmīvām ||
children.translated_text: Drive far away the noisy sickness.

children.text: ā yas te agna idhate anīkaṃ vasiṣṭha śukra dīdivaḥ pāvaka
children.translated_text: When your face is kindled, O <s>Agni</s>, most excellent, bright, shining, purifying,

children.text: uto na ebhi stavathair iha syāḥ ||
children.translated_text: then be here for us also with these praises.

children.text: vi ye te agne bhejire anīkam martā naraḥ pitryāsaḥ purutrā
children.translated_text: The mortal men, our fathers, who in many places have shared in your face, O <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: uto na ebhiḥ sumanā iha syāḥ ||
children.translated_text: be here for us also with these, gracious in mind.

children.text: ime naro vṛtrahatyeṣu śūrā viśvā adevīr abhi santu māyāḥ
children.translated_text: May these heroic men, in the slayings of <s>Vṛtra</s>, overcome all ungodly deceits,

children.text: ye me dhiyam panayanta praśastām ||
children.translated_text: those who praise my excellent thought.

children.text: mā śūne agne ni ṣadāma nṛṇām māśeṣaso 'vīratā pari tvā
children.translated_text: Let us not sit, O <s>Agni</s>, in men's emptiness, nor in want of descendants, nor in lack of heroes around you,

children.text: prajāvatīṣu duryāsu durya ||
children.translated_text: but, O householder, in houses rich in offspring.

children.text: yam aśvī nityam upayāti yajñam prajāvantaṃ svapatyaṃ kṣayaṃ naḥ
children.translated_text: The sacrifice which the two <s>Aśvins</s> regularly approach, our dwelling rich in children and good offspring,

children.text: svajanmanā śeṣasā vāvṛdhānam ||
children.translated_text: growing through its own birth and through what remains.

children.text: pāhi no agne rakṣaso ajuṣṭāt pāhi dhūrter araruṣo aghāyoḥ
children.translated_text: Protect us, O <s>Agni</s>, from the hated demon; protect us from the deceiver, the hostile evildoer.

children.text: tvā yujā pṛtanāyūṃr abhi ṣyām ||
children.translated_text: With you as ally may we overcome those who seek battle.

children.text: sed agnir agnīṃr aty astv anyān yatra vājī tanayo vīﾱupāṇiḥ
children.translated_text: May that <s>Agni</s> surpass other fires, where the charger, the son with varied forms,

children.text: sahasrapāthā akṣarā sameti ||
children.translated_text: comes together with a thousand paths, imperishable.

children.text: sed agnir yo vanuṣyato nipāti sameddhāram aṃhasa uruṣyāt
children.translated_text: May that <s>Agni</s>, who guards against the assailant, protect the kindler from distress,

children.text: sujātāsaḥ pari caranti vīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: while well-born heroes attend him on every side.

children.text: ayaṃ so agnir āhutaḥ purutrā yam īśānaḥ sam id indhe haviṣmān
children.translated_text: This is that <s>Agni</s>, invoked in many places, whom the ruling oblation-bearer kindles completely,

children.text: pari yam ety adhvareṣu hotā ||
children.translated_text: around whom the <s>hotṛ</s> moves in the sacrifices.

children.text: tve agna āhavanāni bhūrīśānāsa ā juhuyāma nityā
children.translated_text: To you, O <s>Agni</s>, may we, ruling, always offer many oblations,

children.text: ubhā kṛṇvanto vahatū miyedhe ||
children.translated_text: making both bearers bring what is to be measured out.

children.text: imo agne vītatamāni havyājasro vakṣi devatātim accha
children.translated_text: Carry these most widely extended oblations, O <s>Agni</s>, unfailing, toward the divine assembly.

children.text: prati na īṃ surabhīṇi vyantu ||
children.translated_text: May their fragrant portions come back to us.

children.text: mā no agne 'vīrate parā dā durvāsase 'mataye mā no asyai
children.translated_text: Do not hand us over, O <s>Agni</s>, to lack of heroes, to bad dwelling, to folly, nor to this distress.

children.text: mā naḥ kṣudhe mā rakṣasa ṛtāvo mā no dame mā vana ā juhūrthāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Do not surrender us to hunger, to the demon, O keeper of order, neither at home nor in the forest.

children.text: nū me brahmāṇy agna uc chaśādhi tvaṃ deva maghavadbhyaḥ suṣūdaḥ
children.translated_text: Now, O <s>Agni</s>, make my prayers prosper; you, god, have been gracious to the bountiful.

children.text: rātau syāmobhayāsa ā te yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we be among both kinds in the gift; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: tvam agne suhavo raṇvasaṃdṛk sudītī sūno sahaso didīhi
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, easy to invoke and lovely to behold, shine brightly with good flame, son of strength.

children.text: mā tve sacā tanaye nitya ā dhaṅ mā vīro asman naryo vi dāsīt ||
children.translated_text: Do not, together with you, strike harm upon my son forever; let no manly hero be lacking among us.

children.text: mā no agne durbhṛtaye sacaiṣu deveddheṣv agniṣu pra vocaḥ
children.translated_text: Do not speak us over, O <s>Agni</s>, to ill-maintenance among these fires kindled by the gods.

children.text: mā te asmān durmatayo bhṛmāc cid devasya sūno sahaso naśanta ||
children.translated_text: May not your evil thoughts, not even a wandering one, destroy us, O divine son of strength.

children.text: sa marto agne svanīka revān amartye ya ājuhoti havyam
children.translated_text: The mortal, O <s>Agni</s>, who with his own bright face, wealthy, offers oblation to the immortal,

children.text: sa devatā vasuvaniṃ dadhāti yaṃ sūrir arthī pṛcchamāna eti ||
children.translated_text: he obtains divine treasure-winning power, whom a generous patron, seeking his aim, approaches.

children.text: maho no agne suvitasya vidvān rayiṃ sūribhya ā vahā bṛhantam
children.translated_text: Knowing great welfare for us, O <s>Agni</s>, bring vast wealth to the patrons,

children.text: yena vayaṃ sahasāvan mademāvikṣitāsa āyuṣā suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: by which, O strong one, we may rejoice, unwearied in life and rich in heroes.

children.text: nū me brahmāṇy agna uc chaśādhi tvaṃ deva maghavadbhyaḥ suṣūdaḥ
children.translated_text: Now, O <s>Agni</s>, make my prayers prosper; you, god, have been gracious to the bountiful.

children.text: rātau syāmobhayāsa ā te yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we be among both kinds in the gift; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 518
juṣasva naḥ samidham agne adya śocā bṛhad yajataṃ dhūmam ṛṇvan
children.translated_text: Accept our kindling, O <s>Agni</s>, today; shine out broadly, raising the worshipful smoke.

children.text: upa spṛśa divyaṃ sānu stūpaiḥ saṃ raśmibhis tatanaḥ sūryasya ||
children.translated_text: Touch the heavenly ridge with your crests; stretch yourself out together with the rays of the sun.

children.text: narāśaṃsasya mahimānam eṣām upa stoṣāma yajatasya yajñaiḥ
children.translated_text: We shall praise with sacrifices the greatness of venerable, worshipful <s>Narāśaṃsa</s> among these.

children.text: ye sukratavaḥ śucayo dhiyandhāḥ svadanti devā ubhayāni havyā ||
children.translated_text: The gods who have good insight, are pure, and hold thought make both kinds of oblations pleasant.

children.text: īﾱenyaṃ vo asuraṃ sudakṣam antar dūtaṃ rodasī satyavācam
children.translated_text: For you I praise the praiseworthy, lordly, skillful one, the true-speaking messenger between the two worlds.

children.text: manuṣvad agnim manunā samiddhaṃ sam adhvarāya sadam in mahema ||
children.translated_text: With <s>Manu</s>'s manner, with <s>Manu</s>'s fire kindled, may we honor <s>Agni</s> always for the rite.

children.text: saparyavo bharamāṇā abhijñu pra vṛñjate namasā barhir agnau
children.translated_text: The worshipful ones, bringing their burden and bending the knee, spread the sacrificial grass before <s>Agni</s> with reverence.

children.text: ājuhvānā ghṛtapṛṣṭham pṛṣadvad adhvaryavo haviṣā marjayadhvam ||
children.translated_text: Calling it near, ghee-backed and speckled, O <s>adhvaryus</s>, cleanse it with the oblation.

children.text: svādhyo vi duro devayanto 'śiśrayū rathayur devatātā
children.translated_text: The god-seeking ones have opened the well-set doors; desirous of the chariot, they have rested in the divine service.

children.text: pūrvī śiśuṃ na mātarā rihāṇe sam agruvo na samaneṣv añjan ||
children.translated_text: Like two mothers licking their child, the ancient ones anointed him together, like singers in the assemblies.

children.text: uta yoṣaṇe divye mahī na uṣāsānaktā sudugheva dhenuḥ
children.translated_text: And may the two divine women, great <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Naktā</s>, for us, like a well-milking cow,

children.text: barhiṣadā puruhūte maghonī ā yajñiye suvitāya śrayetām ||
children.translated_text: rich, much-invoked, sitting on the sacrificial grass, come to rest for auspicious help in the rite.

children.text: viprā yajñeṣu mānuṣeṣu kārū manye vāṃ jātavedasā yajadhyai
children.translated_text: O inspired priests in human sacrifices, O singers, I think you two <s>Jātavedases</s> should be worshipped.

children.text: ūrdhvaṃ no adhvaraṃ kṛtaṃ haveṣu tā deveṣu vanatho vāryāṇi ||
children.translated_text: Make our rite rise upward among the invocations; thus may you two win desirable things among the gods.

children.text: ā bhāratī bhāratībhiḥ sajoṣā iﾱā devair manuṣyebhir agniḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Bhāratī</s> come with the <s>Bhāratīs</s> in harmony, <s>Iḷā</s> with gods and human beings, and <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: sarasvatī sārasvatebhir arvāk tisro devīr barhir edaṃ sadantu ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Sarasvatī</s> with the <s>Sārasvatas</s> come hither; may the three goddesses sit on this sacrificial grass.

children.text: tan nas turīpam adha poṣayitnu deva tvaṣṭar vi rarāṇaḥ syasva
children.translated_text: Then, O god <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, become for us swift and nourishing, distributing abundance.

children.text: yato vīraḥ karmaṇyaḥ sudakṣo yuktagrāvā jāyate devakāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: From him is born the capable hero, skillful in work, with pressing stones yoked, desiring the gods.

children.text: vanaspate 'va sṛjopa devān agnir haviḥ śamitā sūdayāti
children.translated_text: O forest-lord, release the oblation toward the gods; <s>Agni</s>, the appeasing priest, will make the offering ready.

children.text: sed u hotā satyataro yajāti yathā devānāṃ janimāni veda ||
children.translated_text: He indeed, the truer <s>hotṛ</s>, worships, since he knows the births of the gods.

children.text: ā yāhy agne samidhāno arvāṅ indreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṃ turebhiḥ
children.translated_text: Come hither, O <s>Agni</s>, kindled, facing us, in one chariot with <s>Indra</s> and the swift gods.

children.text: barhir na āstām aditiḥ suputrā svāhā devā amṛtā mādayantām ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Aditi</s> with good sons sit upon our sacrificial grass; with svāhā may the immortal gods rejoice.

children.text: Chapter 519
agniṃ vo devam agnibhiḥ sajoṣā yajiṣṭhaṃ dūtam adhvare kṛṇudhvam
children.translated_text: Make <s>Agni</s>, the god, together with the fires, your most worshipful messenger in the rite.

children.text: yo martyeṣu nidhruvir ṛtāvā tapurmūrdhā ghṛtānnaḥ pāvakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He who among mortals is unfailing, order-true, hot-headed, ghee-fed, and purifying.

children.text: prothad aśvo na yavase 'viṣyan yadā mahaḥ saṃvaraṇād vy asthāt
children.translated_text: Like a horse rushing to fodder, he neighs when he has broken out from the great enclosure.

children.text: ād asya vāto anu vāti śocir adha sma te vrajanaṃ kṛṣṇam asti ||
children.translated_text: Then the wind follows after his flame; and your path is then blackened.

children.text: ud yasya te navajātasya vṛṣṇo 'gne caranty ajarā idhānāḥ
children.translated_text: When your ageless kindlings move upward, O newly born bull <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: acchā dyām aruṣo dhūma eti saṃ dūto agna īyase hi devān ||
children.translated_text: your ruddy smoke goes toward heaven; as messenger, O <s>Agni</s>, you go to the gods.

children.text: vi yasya te pṛthivyām pājo aśret tṛṣu yad annā samavṛkta jambhaiḥ
children.translated_text: When your power has spread out over the earth, when with your jaws you have gathered the dry foods,

children.text: seneva sṛṣṭā prasitiṣ ṭa eti yavaṃ na dasma juhvā vivekṣi ||
children.translated_text: your pursuit goes forth like a released army; wondrous one, you discern barley with your tongue.

children.text: tam id doṣā tam uṣasi yaviṣṭham agnim atyaṃ na marjayanta naraḥ
children.translated_text: Men polish that youngest <s>Agni</s> at night and at dawn, like a racehorse,

children.text: niśiśānā atithim asya yonau dīdāya śocir āhutasya vṛṣṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: sharpening the guest in his birthplace; the flame of the invoked bull has shone out.

children.text: susaṃdṛk te svanīka pratīkaṃ vi yad rukmo na rocasa upāke
children.translated_text: Fair to behold is your face, O fair-fronted one, when like gold it shines near at hand.

children.text: divo na te tanyatur eti śuṣmaś citro na sūraḥ prati cakṣi bhānum ||
children.translated_text: Your force comes like the thunder of heaven; like a bright sun you show your light to the eye.

children.text: yathā vaḥ svāhāgnaye dāśema parīﾱābhir ghṛtavadbhiś ca havyaiḥ
children.translated_text: As we would serve you with svāhā, O <s>Agni</s>, with encircling, ghee-rich oblations,

children.text: tebhir no agne amitair mahobhiḥ śatam pūrbhir āyasībhir ni pāhi ||
children.translated_text: with those boundless greatnesses protect us, O <s>Agni</s>, with a hundred iron fortresses.

children.text: yā vā te santi dāśuṣe adhṛṣṭā giro vā yābhir nṛvatīr uruṣyāḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever unassailable protections of yours there are for the worshipper, or songs with which you save manly hosts,

children.text: tābhir naḥ sūno sahaso ni pāhi smat sūrīñ jaritṝñ jātavedaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with those protect us, O son of strength, and protect our patrons and singers, O <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: nir yat pūteva svadhitiḥ śucir gāt svayā kṛpā tanvā rocamānaḥ
children.translated_text: When, like a clean axe from its sheath, he has gone forth, shining with his own form and body,

children.text: ā yo mātror uśenyo janiṣṭa devayajyāya sukratuḥ pāvakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he who, desirable, was born from the two mothers for divine worship, wise and purifying.

children.text: etā no agne saubhagā didīhy api kratuṃ sucetasaṃ vatema
children.translated_text: Kindle these good fortunes for us, O <s>Agni</s>; may we obtain wise understanding.

children.text: viśvā stotṛbhyo gṛṇate ca santu yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May all good things belong to the praisers and to the one who sings; do you always protect us with well-being.

children.text: Chapter 520
pra vaḥ śukrāya bhānave bharadhvaṃ havyam matiṃ cāgnaye supūtam
children.translated_text: Bring forward your purified oblation and your thought to <s>Agni</s>, the bright shining one.

children.text: yo daivyāni mānuṣā janūṃṣy antar viśvāni vidmanā jigāti ||
children.translated_text: He who with knowledge goes among all divine and human generations.

children.text: sa gṛtso agnis taruṇaś cid astu yato yaviṣṭho ajaniṣṭa mātuḥ
children.translated_text: May that clever <s>Agni</s> be young, since the youngest was born from his mother.

children.text: saṃ yo vanā yuvate śucidan bhūri cid annā sam id atti sadyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He who joins himself to the woods as he shines, and at once eats much food.

children.text: asya devasya saṃsady anīke yam martāsaḥ śyetaṃ jagṛbhre
children.translated_text: In the assembly, before the face of this god, mortals have taken hold of the bright one.

children.text: ni yo gṛbham pauruṣeyīm uvoca durokam agnir āyave śuśoca ||
children.translated_text: He who has proclaimed the human grip, <s>Agni</s> has shone for living man in the hard-to-reach house.

children.text: ayaṃ kavir akaviṣu pracetā marteṣv agnir amṛto ni dhāyi
children.translated_text: This seer, thoughtful among the unseeing, immortal <s>Agni</s>, has been set among mortals.

children.text: sa mā no atra juhuraḥ sahasvaḥ sadā tve sumanasaḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: May he not abandon us here, the powerful one; may we always be of good mind toward you.

children.text: ā yo yoniṃ devakṛtaṃ sasāda kratvā hy agnir amṛtāṁ atārīt
children.translated_text: He who has sat down in the god-made womb; by insight <s>Agni</s> has crossed to the immortals.

children.text: tam oṣadhīś ca vaninaś ca garbham bhūmiś ca viśvadhāyasam bibharti ||
children.translated_text: The plants, the forest trees, and the earth bear him as embryo, the all-sustaining one.

children.text: īśe hy agnir amṛtasya bhūrer īśe rāyaḥ suvīryasya dātoḥ
children.translated_text: For <s>Agni</s> has command over abundant immortality; he has command over wealth and the gift of good heroism.

children.text: mā tvā vayaṃ sahasāvann avīrā māpsavaḥ pari ṣadāma māduvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we not, O strong one, become without heroes around you; may we not, helpless and unfriendly, sit apart.

children.text: pariṣadyaṃ hy araṇasya rekṇo nityasya rāyaḥ patayaḥ syāma
children.translated_text: For may we be lords of accessible treasure and of lasting wealth.

children.text: na śeṣo agne anyajātam asty acetānasya mā patho vi dukṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There is no remnant of what is born from another, O <s>Agni</s>; do not lead the unthinking one astray from the path.

children.text: nahi grabhāyāraṇaḥ suśevo 'nyodaryo manasā mantavā u
children.translated_text: For he who is not grasping, not hostile, and kindly, though born from another womb, is to be considered with the mind.

children.text: adhā cid okaḥ punar it sa ety ā no vājy abhīṣāﾱ etu navyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Then indeed he returns again to his home; may the new prize-winning power come to us with help.

children.text: tvam agne vanuṣyato ni pāhi tvam u naḥ sahasāvann avadyāt
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, protect us from the hostile man; you, O mighty one, protect us from blame.

children.text: saṃ tvā dhvasmanvad abhy etu pāthaḥ saṃ rayi spṛhayāyyaḥ sahasrī ||
children.translated_text: May the smoky path come together to you; may desirable, thousandfold wealth come together.

children.text: etā no agne saubhagā didīhy api kratuṃ sucetasaṃ vatema
children.translated_text: Kindle these good fortunes for us, O <s>Agni</s>; may we attain inspired resolve with good understanding.

children.text: viśvā stotṛbhyo gṛṇate ca santu yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May all good things belong to the praisers and to the singer; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 521
prāgnaye tavase bharadhvaṃ giraṃ divo arataye pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: Bring forward a song to mighty <s>Agni</s>, the mediator of heaven and earth,

children.text: yo viśveṣām amṛtānām upasthe vaiśvānaro vāvṛdhe jāgṛvadbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: who, as <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, grew in the lap of all the immortals through the wakeful ones.

children.text: pṛṣṭo divi dhāyy agniḥ pṛthivyāṃ netā sindhūnāṃ vṛṣabha stiyānām
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> was set on the back of heaven and on earth, the leader of rivers, the bull of the standing waters.

children.text: sa mānuṣīr abhi viśo vi bhāti vaiśvānaro vāvṛdhāno vareṇa ||
children.translated_text: He shines forth over the human clans, <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, growing by his chosen excellence.

children.text: tvad bhiyā viśa āyann asiknīr asamanā jahatīr bhojanāni
children.translated_text: In fear of you the dark peoples went away, unlike in mind, abandoning their enjoyments.

children.text: vaiśvānara pūrave śośucānaḥ puro yad agne darayann adīdeḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, when, blazing for <s>Pūru</s>, you shone, O <s>Agni</s>, breaking open the strongholds.

children.text: tava tridhātu pṛthivī uta dyaur vaiśvānara vratam agne sacanta
children.translated_text: Your threefold realm, earth and heaven, O <s>Vaiśvānara</s> <s>Agni</s>, attend upon your ordinance.

children.text: tvam bhāsā rodasī ā tatanthājasreṇa śociṣā śośucānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With your radiance you have stretched out the two worlds, blazing with unfailing flame.

children.text: tvām agne harito vāvaśānā giraḥ sacante dhunayo ghṛtācīḥ
children.translated_text: The eager tawny ones and the songs attend you, O <s>Agni</s>, roaring and rich in ghee.

children.text: patiṃ kṛṣṭīnāṃ rathyaṃ rayīṇāṃ vaiśvānaram uṣasāṃ ketum ahnām ||
children.translated_text: They attend the lord of peoples, the chariot-lord of riches, <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, the beacon of dawns and days.

children.text: tve asuryaṃ vasavo ny ṛṇvan kratuṃ hi te mitramaho juṣanta
children.translated_text: In you the <s>Vasus</s> placed lordly power; for the powers of friendly greatness have delighted in your resolve.

children.text: tvaṃ dasyūṃr okaso agna āja uru jyotir janayann āryāya ||
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, drove the <s>Dasyus</s> from their dwelling, generating broad light for the <s>Ārya</s>.

children.text: sa jāyamānaḥ parame vyoman vāyur na pāthaḥ pari pāsi sadyaḥ
children.translated_text: Being born in the highest heaven, like <s>Vāyu</s> you at once guard the paths on every side.

children.text: tvam bhuvanā janayann abhi krann apatyāya jātavedo daśasyan ||
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, roaring as you generate the worlds, bestow favor for offspring.

children.text: tām agne asme iṣam erayasva vaiśvānara dyumatīṃ jātavedaḥ
children.translated_text: Send that nourishment to us, O <s>Agni</s>, O <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, bright one, O <s>Jātavedas</s>,

children.text: yayā rādhaḥ pinvasi viśvavāra pṛthu śravo dāśuṣe martyāya ||
children.translated_text: by which you swell bounty, O all-chosen one, and broad fame for the mortal worshipper.

children.text: taṃ no agne maghavadbhyaḥ purukṣuṃ rayiṃ ni vājaṃ śrutyaṃ yuvasva
children.translated_text: For our generous patrons, O <s>Agni</s>, harness wealth rich in many goods, a prize worthy of renown.

children.text: vaiśvānara mahi naḥ śarma yaccha rudrebhir agne vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, grant us great shelter, O <s>Agni</s>, together with the <s>Rudras</s> and the <s>Vasus</s>.

children.text: Chapter 522
pra samrājo asurasya praśastim puṃsaḥ kṛṣṭīnām anumādyasya
children.translated_text: I proclaim the praise of the sovereign, of the lordly one, of the man approved among peoples.

children.text: indrasyeva pra tavasas kṛtāni vande dāruṃ vandamāno vivakmi ||
children.translated_text: Like the mighty deeds of <s>Indra</s>, I speak of the works; venerating the wood, I utter my praise.

children.text: kaviṃ ketuṃ dhāsim bhānum adrer hinvanti śaṃ rājyaṃ rodasyoḥ
children.translated_text: They impel the sage, the sign, the support, the light of the rock, toward auspicious rule over the two worlds.

children.text: purandarasya gīrbhir ā vivāse 'gner vratāni pūrvyā mahāni ||
children.translated_text: With songs I seek the ancient, great ordinances of <s>Agni</s>, the fort-destroyer.

children.text: ny akratūn grathino mṛdhravācaḥ paṇīṃr aśraddhāṁ avṛdhāṁ ayajñān
children.translated_text: The thoughtless, entangling, contemptuous-speaking <s>Paṇis</s>, without faith, without growth, without sacrifice,

children.text: pra pra tān dasyūṃr agnir vivāya pūrvaś cakārāparāṁ ayajyūn ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> drove those <s>Dasyus</s> farther and farther away; he made the earlier ones into later, non-sacrificing men.

children.text: yo apācīne tamasi madantīḥ prācīś cakāra nṛtamaḥ śacībhiḥ
children.translated_text: He, the best of men, by his powers made eastward those who were rejoicing in the western darkness.

children.text: tam īśānaṃ vasvo agniṃ gṛṇīṣe 'nānataṃ damayantam pṛtanyūn ||
children.translated_text: I praise that <s>Agni</s>, lord of goods, unbending, subduing those who seek battle.

children.text: yo dehyo anamayad vadhasnair yo aryapatnīr uṣasaś cakāra
children.translated_text: He bent the embodied foes with deadly weapons; he made the dawns wives of the <s>Ārya</s>.

children.text: sa nirudhyā nahuṣo yahvo agnir viśaś cakre balihṛtaḥ sahobhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: That mighty <s>Agni</s>, having hemmed in the <s>Nahuṣas</s>, made the clans tribute-bearing by his powers.

children.text: yasya śarmann upa viśve janāsa evais tasthuḥ sumatim bhikṣamāṇāḥ
children.translated_text: In whose shelter all peoples have stood in just this way, begging for good favor,

children.text: vaiśvānaro varam ā rodasyor āgniḥ sasāda pitror upastham ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vaiśvānara</s> <s>Agni</s>, the best one of the two worlds, has sat down in the lap of his two parents.

children.text: ā devo dade budhnyā vasūni vaiśvānara uditā sūryasya
children.translated_text: The god <s>Vaiśvānara</s> has taken the treasures of the depths at the rising of the sun.

children.text: ā samudrād avarād ā parasmād āgnir dade diva ā pṛthivyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has taken them from the nearer ocean and from the farther, from heaven and from earth.

children.text: Chapter 523
pra vo devaṃ cit sahasānam agnim aśvaṃ na vājinaṃ hiṣe namobhiḥ
children.translated_text: With reverences I urge for you the god <s>Agni</s>, forceful, like a prize-winning horse.

children.text: bhavā no dūto adhvarasya vidvān tmanā deveṣu vivide mitadruḥ ||
children.translated_text: Be our messenger of the <s>adhvara</s> (sacrificial rite), knowing it; by himself, among the gods, he has found the measured course.

children.text: ā yāhy agne pathyā anu svā mandro devānāṃ sakhyaṃ juṣāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Come here, O <s>Agni</s>, along your own paths, joyful, enjoying the friendship of the gods.

children.text: ā sānu śuṣmair nadayan pṛthivyā jambhebhir viśvam uśadhag vanāni ||
children.translated_text: Come to the ridge, roaring over the earth with your powers, burning all the forests with your jaws.

children.text: prācīno yajñaḥ sudhitaṃ hi barhiḥ prīṇīte agnir īﾱito na hotā
children.translated_text: The sacrifice turns forward; the <s>barhis</s> (sacrificial grass) is well laid; <s>Agni</s> delights like an invoked <s>hotṛ</s> (priest).

children.text: ā mātarā viśvavāre huvāno yato yaviṣṭha jajñiṣe suśevaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Calling the two all-bestowing Mothers, from where, O youngest one, you were born, very gracious.

children.text: sadyo adhvare rathiraṃ jananta mānuṣāso vicetaso ya eṣām
children.translated_text: At once at the <s>adhvara</s>, discerning men beget the charioteer who belongs to them.

children.text: viśām adhāyi viśpatir duroṇe 'gnir mandro madhuvacā ṛtāvā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, joyful, honey-voiced, true to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), was set in the house as lord of the clans.

children.text: asādi vṛto vahnir ājaganvān agnir brahmā nṛṣadane vidhartā
children.translated_text: Chosen as carrier, having come here, <s>Agni</s> has sat down as priest and ordainer in the seat of men.

children.text: dyauś ca yam pṛthivī vāvṛdhāte ā yaṃ hotā yajati viśvavāram ||
children.translated_text: He whom heaven and earth have strengthened, whom the <s>hotṛ</s> worships as all-chosen.

children.text: ete dyumnebhir viśvam ātiranta mantraṃ ye vāraṃ naryā atakṣan
children.translated_text: Those who fashioned the manly boon and the chant have crossed the whole world with splendors.

children.text: pra ye viśas tiranta śroṣamāṇā ā ye me asya dīdhayann ṛtasya ||
children.translated_text: Those who have crossed beyond the clans as they listened, those who have made this <s>ṛta</s> shine for me.

children.text: nū tvām agna īmahe vasiṣṭhā īśānaṃ sūno sahaso vasūnām
children.translated_text: Now we, the <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s>, implore you, O <s>Agni</s>, lord of goods, son of strength.

children.text: iṣaṃ stotṛbhyo maghavadbhya ānaḍ yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bring nourishment to the praising, generous patrons; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 524
indhe rājā sam aryo namobhir yasya pratīkam āhutaṃ ghṛtena
children.translated_text: The king is kindled by reverences together with the noble ones, he whose face is offered with ghee.

children.text: naro havyebhir īﾱate sabādha āgnir agra uṣasām aśoci ||
children.translated_text: Men invoke <s>Agni</s> with oblations amid constraint; at the forefront of the dawns <s>Agni</s> has shone.

children.text: ayam u ṣya sumahāṁ avedi hotā mandro manuṣo yahvo agniḥ
children.translated_text: This very great one has been perceived, the <s>hotṛ</s>, joyful, mighty <s>Agni</s> of <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: vi bhā akaḥ sasṛjānaḥ pṛthivyāṃ kṛṣṇapavir oṣadhībhir vavakṣe ||
children.translated_text: Making brightness as he was released upon the earth, black-tracked, he has grown among the plants.

children.text: kayā no agne vi vasaḥ suvṛktiṃ kām u svadhām ṛṇavaḥ śasyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: By what fair praise, O <s>Agni</s>, will you shine for us? What native power will you grant when praised?

children.text: kadā bhavema patayaḥ sudatra rāyo vantāro duṣṭarasya sādhoḥ ||
children.translated_text: When shall we become lords, O good giver, winners of wealth and of the hard-to-cross prize?

children.text: pra prāyam agnir bharatasya śṛṇve vi yat sūryo na rocate bṛhad bhāḥ
children.translated_text: The advancing <s>Agni</s> of <s>Bharata</s> is heard afar, when, like the sun, he shines with great light.

children.text: abhi yaḥ pūrum pṛtanāsu tasthau dyutāno daivyo atithiḥ śuśoca ||
children.translated_text: He who stood by <s>Pūru</s> in battles, flashing forth, has shone as the divine guest.

children.text: asann it tve āhavanāni bhūri bhuvo viśvebhiḥ sumanā anīkaiḥ
children.translated_text: Many indeed are the summons made to you; be gracious with all your faces.

children.text: stutaś cid agne śṛṇviṣe gṛṇānaḥ svayaṃ vardhasva tanvaṃ sujāta ||
children.translated_text: Even when praised, O <s>Agni</s>, you listen as you are lauded; of yourself increase your body, well-born one.

children.text: idaṃ vacaḥ śatasāḥ saṃsahasram ud agnaye janiṣīṣṭa dvibarhāḥ
children.translated_text: May this speech, winning hundreds and thousands, rise up for <s>Agni</s>, with twofold exaltation.

children.text: śaṃ yat stotṛbhya āpaye bhavāti dyumad amīvacātanaṃ rakṣohā ||
children.translated_text: May what brings welfare to the praising <s>Āpaya</s> be radiant, driving off sickness and slaying demons.

children.text: nū tvām agna īmahe vasiṣṭhā īśānaṃ sūno sahaso vasūnām
children.translated_text: Now we <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s> seek you, O <s>Agni</s>, lord of goods, son of strength.

children.text: iṣaṃ stotṛbhyo maghavadbhya ānaḍ yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bring nourishment to the generous praisers; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 525
abodhi jāra uṣasām upasthāddhotā mandraḥ kavitamaḥ pāvakaḥ
children.translated_text: The lover of the <s>Uṣases</s> has awakened from their lap, the pleasant <s>hotṛ</s> (invoking priest), most inspired, purifying.

children.text: dadhāti ketum ubhayasya jantor havyā deveṣu draviṇaṃ sukṛtsu ||
children.translated_text: He sets the signal for both kinds of creature, the oblations among the gods and wealth among those who act well.

children.text: sa sukratur yo vi duraḥ paṇīnām punāno arkam purubhojasaṃ naḥ
children.translated_text: He of good resolve, who opened the doors of the <s>Paṇis</s>, purifying our song rich in many enjoyments,

children.text: hotā mandro viśāṃ damūnās tiras tamo dadṛśe rāmyāṇām ||
children.translated_text: the pleasant <s>hotṛ</s>, lord of the houses of the clans, was seen through the darknesses of the nights.

children.text: amūraḥ kavir aditir vivasvān susaṃsan mitro atithiḥ śivo naḥ
children.translated_text: Unbewildered, a seer, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Vivasvān</s>, well-praised <s>Mitra</s>, an auspicious guest for us,

children.text: citrabhānur uṣasām bhāty agre 'pāṃ garbhaḥ prasva ā viveśa ||
children.translated_text: of variegated radiance, he shines before the <s>Uṣases</s>; the embryo of the waters has entered the stream.

children.text: īﾱenyo vo manuṣo yugeṣu samanagā aśucaj jātavedāḥ
children.translated_text: In the ages of men <s>Jātavedas</s>, worthy of praise, going in common, has shone brightly.

children.text: susaṃdṛśā bhānunā yo vibhāti prati gāvaḥ samidhānam budhanta ||
children.translated_text: He who gleams with a fair-seen radiance: toward him the cows awaken as he is kindled.

children.text: agne yāhi dūtyam mā riṣaṇyo devāṁ acchā brahmakṛtā gaṇena
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, go on the embassy, unharmed, toward the gods with the troop that fashions sacred utterance.

children.text: sarasvatīm maruto aśvināpo yakṣi devān ratnadheyāya viśvān ||
children.translated_text: Worship <s>Sarasvatī</s>, the <s>Maruts</s>, the <s>Aśvins</s>, the Waters, and all the gods for the bestowal of treasure.

children.text: tvām agne samidhāno vasiṣṭho jarūthaṃ han yakṣi rāye purandhim
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, kindled by <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, ward off decay; worship <s>Purandhi</s> for wealth.

children.text: puruṇīthā jātavedo jarasva yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Jātavedas</s>, rich in many paths, sing out; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 526
uṣo na jāraḥ pṛthu pājo aśred davidyutad dīdyacchośucānaḥ
children.translated_text: Like the lover of <s>Uṣas</s>, broad in might, he has shone, flashing, blazing, and burning.

children.text: vṛṣā hariḥ śucir ā bhāti bhāsā dhiyo hinvāna uśatīr ajīgaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The bull, tawny and bright, shines with radiance; impelling the eager thoughts, he has awakened them.

children.text: svar ṇa vastor uṣasām aroci yajñaṃ tanvānā uśijo na manma
children.translated_text: Like heavenly light at the dwelling of the <s>Uṣases</s> he has shone, as the <s>Uśijs</s> extend the sacrifice with their hymn.

children.text: agnir janmāni deva ā vi vidvān dravad dūto devayāvā vaniṣṭhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, the god, knowing the births, has run forth as the best messenger eager for the gods.

children.text: acchā giro matayo devayantīr agniṃ yanti draviṇam bhikṣamāṇāḥ
children.translated_text: Toward <s>Agni</s> go the songs and thoughts that seek the gods, begging for treasure,

children.text: susaṃdṛśaṃ supratīkaṃ svañcaṃ havyavāham aratim mānuṣāṇām ||
children.translated_text: toward him who is fair to behold, fair-faced, well-directed, the oblation-bearer and minister of men.

children.text: indraṃ no agne vasubhiḥ sajoṣā rudraṃ rudrebhir ā vahā bṛhantam
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, bring <s>Indra</s> to us together with the <s>Vasus</s>, and great <s>Rudra</s> with the <s>Rudras</s>.

children.text: ādityebhir aditiṃ viśvajanyām bṛhaspatim ṛkvabhir viśvavāram ||
children.translated_text: Bring <s>Aditi</s>, mother of all, with the <s>Ādityas</s>, and <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, desired by all, with the ṛc-singers.

children.text: mandraṃ hotāram uśijo yaviṣṭham agniṃ viśa īﾱate adhvareṣu
children.translated_text: The clans seek <s>Agni</s>, the pleasant <s>hotṛ</s>, the youngest <s>Uśij</s>, in the rites.

children.text: sa hi kṣapāvāṁ abhavad rayīṇām atandro dūto yajathāya devān ||
children.translated_text: For he became watchful through the nights for riches, an unwearied messenger for worshipping the gods.

children.text: Chapter 527
mahāṁ asy adhvarasya praketo na ṛte tvad amṛtā mādayante
children.translated_text: Great is the foretoken of this rite; apart from you the immortals do not rejoice.

children.text: ā viśvebhiḥ sarathaṃ yāhi devair ny agne hotā prathamaḥ sadeha ||
children.translated_text: Come with all the gods in one chariot, O <s>Agni</s>; sit down here as the first <s>hotṛ</s>.

children.text: tvām īﾱate ajiraṃ dūtyāya haviṣmantaḥ sadam in mānuṣāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Oblation-bearing men always seek you, swift one, for the embassy.

children.text: yasya devair āsado barhir agne 'hāny asmai sudinā bhavanti ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, for the man whose sacred grass is seated with the gods, his days become good days.

children.text: triś cid aktoḥ pra cikitur vasūni tve antar dāśuṣe martyāya
children.translated_text: Even three times in the night they have perceived the goods placed within you for the mortal worshipper.

children.text: manuṣvad agna iha yakṣi devān bhavā no dūto abhiśastipāvā ||
children.translated_text: Like <s>Manu</s>, O <s>Agni</s>, worship the gods here; be our messenger, warding off curses.

children.text: agnir īśe bṛhato adhvarasyāgnir viśvasya haviṣaḥ kṛtasya
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> rules the great rite; <s>Agni</s> rules every oblation that has been prepared.

children.text: kratuṃ hy asya vasavo juṣantāthā devā dadhire havyavāham ||
children.translated_text: For the <s>Vasus</s>, gladly accepting his resolve, then made him the bearer of oblations.

children.text: āgne vaha haviradyāya devān indrajyeṣṭhāsa iha mādayantām
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, carry the oblation to the gods for today; may those led by <s>Indra</s> rejoice here.

children.text: imaṃ yajñaṃ divi deveṣu dhehi yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Set this sacrifice among the gods in heaven; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 528
aganma mahā namasā yaviṣṭhaṃ yo dīdāya samiddhaḥ sve duroṇe
children.translated_text: We have come with great homage to the youngest one, who blazed when kindled in his own dwelling,

children.text: citrabhānuṃ rodasī antar urvī svāhutaṃ viśvataḥ pratyañcam ||
children.translated_text: the variegated-radiant one between the two broad worlds, well-invoked and facing us from every side.

children.text: sa mahnā viśvā duritāni sāhvān agni ṣṭave dama ā jātavedāḥ
children.translated_text: By his greatness overcoming all hardships, <s>Agni</s> <s>Jātavedas</s> is praised in the house.

children.text: sa no rakṣiṣad duritād avadyād asmān gṛṇata uta no maghonaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May he protect us from hardship and from blame, us who sing and also our generous patrons.

children.text: tvaṃ varuṇa uta mitro agne tvāṃ vardhanti matibhir vasiṣṭhāḥ
children.translated_text: You are <s>Varuṇa</s> and also <s>Mitra</s>, O <s>Agni</s>; the <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s> increase you with their thoughts.

children.text: tve vasu suṣaṇanāni santu yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: In you may easily won riches abide; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 529
prāgnaye viśvaśuce dhiyandhe 'suraghne manma dhītim bharadhvam
children.translated_text: Bring forward a hymn and inspired thought for <s>Agni</s>, all-bright, thought-kindling, slayer of hostile powers.

children.text: bhare havir na barhiṣi prīṇāno vaiśvānarāya yataye matīnām ||
children.translated_text: As one pleasing him with oblation upon the sacred grass, bear your thoughts to <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, the striver after insight.

children.text: tvam agne śociṣā śośucāna ā rodasī apṛṇā jāyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, blazing with flame as you were born, filled the two worlds.

children.text: tvaṃ devāṁ abhiśaster amuñco vaiśvānara jātavedo mahitvā ||
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Vaiśvānara</s> <s>Jātavedas</s>, by your greatness released the gods from the curse.

children.text: jāto yad agne bhuvanā vy akhyaḥ paśūn na gopā iryaḥ parijmā
children.translated_text: When born, O <s>Agni</s>, you surveyed the worlds, like an active herdsman going around his cattle.

children.text: vaiśvānara brahmaṇe vinda gātuṃ yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, find a path for sacred utterance; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 530
samidhā jātavedase devāya devahūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: With kindling sticks for <s>Jātavedas</s>, the god, and with invocations to the gods,

children.text: havirbhiḥ śukraśociṣe namasvino vayaṃ dāśemāgnaye ||
children.translated_text: with oblations, reverent, may we serve <s>Agni</s> of bright flame.

children.text: vayaṃ te agne samidhā vidhema vayaṃ dāśema suṣṭutī yajatra
children.translated_text: We would worship you, O <s>Agni</s>, with kindling; we would serve you with good praise, worshipful one.

children.text: vayaṃ ghṛtenādhvarasya hotar vayaṃ deva haviṣā bhadraśoce ||
children.translated_text: We would serve you with ghee, O <s>hotṛ</s> of the rite; we would serve you with oblation, O god of auspicious light.

children.text: ā no devebhir upa devahūtim agne yāhi vaṣaṭkṛtiṃ juṣāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Come to our divine invocation with the gods, O <s>Agni</s>, taking pleasure in the vaṣaṭ-call.

children.text: tubhyaṃ devāya dāśataḥ syāma yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we be servants to you, the god; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 531
upasadyāya mīﾱhuṣa āsye juhutā haviḥ
children.translated_text: For the approachable, bounteous one, pour the oblation into his mouth,

children.text: yo no nediṣṭham āpyam ||
children.translated_text: the one who is nearest to us as an ally.

children.text: yaḥ pañca carṣaṇīr abhi niṣasāda dame dame
children.translated_text: He who has taken his seat over the five peoples in every house,

children.text: kavir gṛhapatir yuvā ||
children.translated_text: the seer, the young lord of the household,

children.text: sa no vedo amātyam agnī rakṣatu viśvataḥ
children.translated_text: may that <s>Agni</s>, knowing our household, protect us from every side.

children.text: utāsmān pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And may he also protect us from distress.

children.text: navaṃ nu stomam agnaye divaḥ śyenāya jījanam
children.translated_text: Now I have brought forth a new hymn for <s>Agni</s>, the eagle of heaven;

children.text: vasvaḥ kuvid vanāti naḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he perhaps win wealth for us.

children.text: spārhā yasya śriyo dṛśe rayir vīravato yathā
children.translated_text: Desirable for sight are the splendors of him who shines at the front of the sacrifice,

children.text: agre yajñasya śocataḥ ||
children.translated_text: like wealth rich in heroes.

children.text: semāṃ vetu vaṣaṭkṛtim agnir juṣata no giraḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s> hear this <s>vaṣaṭ</s> (sacrificial exclamation); may he enjoy our songs,

children.text: yajiṣṭho havyavāhanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the best sacrificer, the carrier of oblations.

children.text: ni tvā nakṣya viśpate dyumantaṃ deva dhīmahi
children.translated_text: We approach you, lord of the clans; we establish you, O god, as radiant,

children.text: suvīram agna āhuta ||
children.translated_text: rich in heroes, O <s>Agni</s>, when you are invoked.

children.text: kṣapa usraś ca dīdihi svagnayas tvayā vayam
children.translated_text: Shine through the nights and dawns. With good fires through you, may we

children.text: suvīras tvam asmayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: be rich in heroes; and may you, seeking us, be rich in heroes.

children.text: upa tvā sātaye naro viprāso yanti dhītibhiḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired men come toward you for gain with their thoughts;

children.text: upākṣarā sahasriṇī ||
children.translated_text: the thousandfold streams have drawn near.

children.text: agnī rakṣāṃsi sedhati śukraśocir amartyaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> drives away the demons, bright-flamed and immortal,

children.text: śuciḥ pāvaka īḍyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: pure, purifying, and worthy of praise.

children.text: sa no rādhāṃsy ā bhareśānaḥ sahaso yaho
children.translated_text: May he bring us gifts, the mighty lord of strength;

children.text: bhagaś ca dātu vāryam ||
children.translated_text: and may <s>Bhaga</s> give what is desirable.

children.text: tvam agne vīravad yaśo devaś ca savitā bhagaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, give fame rich in heroes; and the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, <s>Bhaga</s>,

children.text: ditiś ca dāti vāryam ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Diti</s> give what is desirable.

children.text: agne rakṣā ṇo aṃhasaḥ prati ṣma deva rīṣataḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, protect us from distress; against the injurer, O god,

children.text: tapiṣṭhair ajaro daha ||
children.translated_text: burn with your hottest flames, undecaying one.

children.text: adhā mahī na āyasy anādhṛṣṭo nṛpītaye
children.translated_text: Then be for us a great iron fortress, unassailable,

children.text: pūr bhavā śatabhujiḥ ||
children.translated_text: for the protection of men, a stronghold with a hundred defenses.

children.text: tvaṃ naḥ pāhy aṃhaso doṣāvastar aghāyataḥ
children.translated_text: You, undeceivable one, protect us from distress, from the evildoer,

children.text: divā naktam adābhya ||
children.translated_text: at evening and morning, by day and by night.

children.text: Chapter 532
enā vo agniṃ namasorjo napātam ā huve
children.translated_text: With this homage I call for you <s>Agni</s>, the son of strength,

children.text: priyaṃ cetiṣṭham aratiṃ svadhvaraṃ viśvasya dūtam amṛtam ||
children.translated_text: dear, most attentive, active in good rites, the immortal messenger of all.

children.text: sa yojate aruṣā viśvabhojasā sa dudravat svāhutaḥ
children.translated_text: He is yoked with ruddy, all-nourishing powers; well-invoked, he has rushed forth.

children.text: subrahmā yajñaḥ suśamī vasūnāṃ devaṃ rādho janānām ||
children.translated_text: The sacrifice, rich in prayer and well prepared, seeks the god, the bounty of the <s>Vasus</s> and of men.

children.text: ud asya śocir asthād ājuhvānasya mīﾱhuṣaḥ
children.translated_text: The flame of him, the bountiful one being invoked, has risen up;

children.text: ud dhūmāso aruṣāso divispṛśaḥ sam agnim indhate naraḥ ||
children.translated_text: the ruddy smokes, touching heaven, have risen; men kindle <s>Agni</s> together.

children.text: taṃ tvā dūtaṃ kṛṇmahe yaśastamaṃ devāṁ ā vītaye vaha
children.translated_text: We make you that messenger, most glorious: bring the gods here for the feast.

children.text: viśvā sūno sahaso martabhojanā rāsva tad yat tvemahe ||
children.translated_text: O son of strength, grant all enjoyments for mortals, that which we ask of you.

children.text: tvam agne gṛhapatis tvaṃ hotā no adhvare
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are the house-lord; you are our <s>hotṛ</s> (invoking priest) at the rite.

children.text: tvam potā viśvavāra pracetā yakṣi veṣi ca vāryam ||
children.translated_text: You are the <s>potṛ</s> (purifying priest), all-desired and mindful; sacrifice, and seek what is desirable.

children.text: kṛdhi ratnaṃ yajamānāya sukrato tvaṃ hi ratnadhā asi
children.translated_text: Make treasure for the sacrificer, O good-willed one, for you are the treasure-giver.

children.text: ā na ṛte śiśīhi viśvam ṛtvijaṃ suśaṃso yaś ca dakṣate ||
children.translated_text: Rouse for us the whole priesthood, the good-praising one and whoever is skillful.

children.text: tve agne svāhuta priyāsaḥ santu sūrayaḥ
children.translated_text: In you, O <s>Agni</s>, well-invoked, may the patrons be dear,

children.text: yantāro ye maghavāno janānām ūrvān dayanta gonām ||
children.translated_text: those generous leaders of men who apportion broad spaces for cattle.

children.text: yeṣām iﾱā ghṛtahastā duroṇa āṃ api prātā niṣīdati
children.translated_text: Those in whose house <s>Iḷā</s>, ghee-handed, sits even in the morning,

children.text: tāṃs trāyasva sahasya druho nido yacchā naḥ śarma dīrghaśrut ||
children.translated_text: protect them, O mighty one, from deceit and blame; grant us shelter, far-renowned one.

children.text: sa mandrayā ca jihvayā vahnir āsā viduṣṭaraḥ
children.translated_text: He, the carrier, with gladdening tongue and mouth, is the more knowing;

children.text: agne rayim maghavadbhyo na ā vaha havyadātiṃ ca sūdaya ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, bring wealth to our patrons and speed the gift of oblation.

children.text: ye rādhāṃsi dadaty aśvyā maghā kāmena śravaso mahaḥ
children.translated_text: Those who give gifts, horse-rich largesse, through desire for great fame,

children.text: tāṁ aṃhasaḥ pipṛhi partṛbhiṣ ṭvaṃ śatam pūrbhir yaviṣṭhya ||
children.translated_text: protect them from distress with rescuers, with a hundred fortresses, O youngest one.

children.text: devo vo draviṇodāḥ pūrṇāṃ vivaṣṭy āsicam
children.translated_text: The god <s>Draviṇodā</s> desires your full ladle;

children.text: ud vā siñcadhvam upa vā pṛṇadhvam ād id vo deva ohate ||
children.translated_text: either pour it out or fill it up; then indeed the god will favor you.

children.text: taṃ hotāram adhvarasya pracetasaṃ vahniṃ devā akṛṇvata
children.translated_text: The gods made him the mindful <s>hotṛ</s> of the rite, the carrier;

children.text: dadhāti ratnaṃ vidhate suvīryam agnir janāya dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> gives treasure and good heroic power to the worshipping man who makes offerings.

children.text: Chapter 533
agne bhava suṣamidhā samiddha uta barhir urviyā vi stṛṇītām ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, be kindled with good fuel; and let the ritual grass be spread broadly.

children.text: uta dvāra uśatīr vi śrayantām uta devāṁ uśata ā vaheha ||
children.translated_text: And let the eager doors open wide; and bring the eager gods here.

children.text: agne vīhi haviṣā yakṣi devān svadhvarā kṛṇuhi jātavedaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, go with the oblation; sacrifice to the gods; make the rites well ordered, O <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: svadhvarā karati jātavedā yakṣad devāṁ amṛtān piprayac ca ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jātavedas</s> makes the rites well ordered; may he sacrifice to the immortal gods and satisfy them.

children.text: vaṃsva viśvā vāryāṇi pracetaḥ satyā bhavantv āśiṣo no adya ||
children.translated_text: Win all desirable things, O mindful one; may our blessings become true today.

children.text: tvām u te dadhire havyavāhaṃ devāso agna ūrja ā napātam ||
children.translated_text: The gods have set you, O <s>Agni</s>, as the oblation-carrier, the son of strength.

children.text: te te devāya dāśataḥ syāma maho no ratnā vi dadha iyānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we be among those who worship you as god; coming, distribute great treasures to us.

children.text: Chapter 534
tve ha yat pitaraś cin na indra viśvā vāmā jaritāro asanvan
children.translated_text: In you indeed, O <s>Indra</s>, even our fathers, the singers, won all desirable things;

children.text: tve gāvaḥ sudughās tve hy aśvās tvaṃ vasu devayate vaniṣṭhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: in you are the good-milking cows, in you the horses; you win wealth most for the god-seeking man.

children.text: rājeva hi janibhiḥ kṣeṣy evāva dyubhir abhi viduṣ kaviḥ san
children.translated_text: For like a king with his peoples you rule; being a knowing sage, you encompass with your bright days.

children.text: piśā giro maghavan gobhir aśvais tvāyataḥ śiśīhi rāye asmān ||
children.translated_text: Adorn our songs, O bountiful one, with cows and horses; sharpen us, who seek you, for wealth.

children.text: imā u tvā paspṛdhānāso atra mandrā giro devayantīr upa sthuḥ
children.translated_text: These gladdening songs, striving here and seeking the god, have approached you.

children.text: arvācī te pathyā rāya etu syāma te sumatāv indra śarman ||
children.translated_text: Let your path to wealth come hither; may we be in your favor and shelter, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: dhenuṃ na tvā sūyavase dudukṣann upa brahmāṇi sasṛje vasiṣṭhaḥ
children.translated_text: Like a milch cow for good pasture, <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, wishing to milk you, has sent forth prayers toward you.

children.text: tvām in me gopatiṃ viśva āhā na indraḥ sumatiṃ gantv accha ||
children.translated_text: You alone I call lord of cattle on all days; may <s>Indra</s> come toward our favor.

children.text: arṇāṃsi cit paprathānā sudāsa indro gādhāny akṛṇot supārā
children.translated_text: For <s>Sudās</s>, <s>Indra</s> made even the spreading floods shallow and easy to cross;

children.text: śardhantaṃ śimyum ucathasya navyaḥ śāpaṃ sindhūnām akṛṇod aśastīḥ ||
children.translated_text: with the new song he made the boastful <s>Śimyu</s>, the curse of the rivers, without praise.

children.text: puroﾱā it turvaśo yakṣur āsīd rāye matsyāso niśitā apīva
children.translated_text: <s>Turvaśa</s> was then, as it were, an offering-cake for the rite; the <s>Matsyas</s>, sharpened for wealth, were like fish.

children.text: śruṣṭiṃ cakrur bhṛgavo druhyavaś ca sakhā sakhāyam atarad viṣūcoḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Bhṛgus</s> and the <s>Druhyus</s> made ready obedience; friend crossed over to friend from the two separated sides.

children.text: ā pakthāso bhalānaso bhanantālināso viṣāṇinaḥ śivāsaḥ
children.translated_text: He brought the <s>Pakthas</s>, <s>Bhalānas</s>, <s>Alinas</s>, <s>Viṣāṇins</s>, and <s>Śivas</s>,

children.text: ā yo 'nayat sadhamā āryasya gavyā tṛtsubhyo ajagan yudhā nṝn ||
children.translated_text: to the shared feast of the <s>Ārya</s>; the cattle-seeking men came to the <s>Tṛtsus</s> in battle.

children.text: durādhyo aditiṃ srevayanto 'cetaso vi jagṛbhre paruṣṇīm
children.translated_text: Hard to overcome, violating <s>Aditi</s>, mindless, they seized apart the <s>Paruṣṇī</s>.

children.text: mahnāvivyak pṛthivīm patyamānaḥ paśuṣ kavir aśayac cāyamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: By greatness the seer marked out the earth; falling, he lay among the cattle, stretching himself out.

children.text: īyur arthaṃ na nyartham paruṣṇīm āśuś caned abhipitvaṃ jagāma
children.translated_text: They went to the <s>Paruṣṇī</s> for gain, not for no gain; not even the swift one reached the refuge.

children.text: sudāsa indraḥ sutukāṁ amitrān arandhayan mānuṣe vadhrivācaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Sudās</s>, <s>Indra</s>, rich in good aid, subdued the foes, the men of hostile speech, with his strength.

children.text: īyur gāvo na yavasād agopā yathākṛtam abhi mitraṃ citāsaḥ
children.translated_text: They went like cattle from pasture without a herdsman, each to his appointed place, thinking even of <s>Mitra</s>.

children.text: pṛśnigāvaḥ pṛśninipreṣitāsaḥ śruṣṭiṃ cakrur niyuto rantayaś ca ||
children.translated_text: The dappled cattle, sent forth by the dappled udder, and the quick teams and those who gladden made ready obedience.

children.text: ekaṃ ca yo viṃśatiṃ ca śravasyā vaikarṇayor janān rājā ny astaḥ
children.translated_text: The king cast down one and twenty famous peoples of the two <s>Vaikarṇas</s>.

children.text: dasmo na sadman ni śiśāti barhiḥ śūraḥ sargam akṛṇod indra eṣām ||
children.translated_text: Like a wonder-worker in his seat, he lays out the sacred grass; heroic <s>Indra</s> opened their outflow.

children.text: adha śrutaṃ kavaṣaṃ vṛddham apsv anu druhyuṃ ni vṛṇag vajrabāhuḥ
children.translated_text: Then the thunder-armed one cast down the heard-of, aged <s>Kavaṣa</s> into the waters, and after him the <s>Druhyu</s>.

children.text: vṛṇānā atra sakhyāya sakhyaṃ tvāyanto ye amadann anu tvā ||
children.translated_text: Choosing here friendship for friendship, those who sought you rejoiced after you.

children.text: vi sadyo viśvā dṛṃhitāny eṣām indraḥ puraḥ sahasā sapta dardaḥ
children.translated_text: At once <s>Indra</s> violently split apart all their firm strongholds, seven forts.

children.text: vy ānavasya tṛtsave gayam bhāg jeṣma pūruṃ vidathe mṛdhravācam ||
children.translated_text: For the <s>Tṛtsu</s> he won the wealth of the <s>Ānava</s>; in the assembly may we conquer the hostile-speaking <s>Pūru</s>.

children.text: ni gavyavo 'navo druhyavaś ca ṣaṣṭiḥ śatā suṣupuḥ ṣaṭ sahasrā
children.translated_text: The cattle-seeking <s>Anus</s> and <s>Druhyus</s>, sixty hundreds and six thousand, sank down to sleep.

children.text: ṣaṣṭir vīrāso adhi ṣaḍ duvoyu viśved indrasya vīryā kṛtāni ||
children.translated_text: Sixty heroes too, over and above six, performed service: all these are deeds of <s>Indra</s>'s might.

children.text: indreṇaite tṛtsavo veviṣāṇā āpo na sṛṣṭā adhavanta nīcīḥ
children.translated_text: Smitten by <s>Indra</s>, these hostile <s>Tṛtsus</s> ran downward like released waters.

children.text: durmitrāsaḥ prakalavin mimānā jahur viśvāni bhojanā sudāse ||
children.translated_text: Ill-allied and measuring themselves against ruin, they abandoned all their possessions to <s>Sudās</s>.

children.text: ardhaṃ vīrasya śṛtapām anindram parā śardhantaṃ nunude abhi kṣām
children.translated_text: He drove away over the earth the half of the hero's force, the drinkers of cooked offerings, who were without <s>Indra</s> and defiant.

children.text: indro manyum manyumyo mimāya bheje patho vartanim patyamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, angered against the angry one, measured him out; as he fell, he took to the track of the path.

children.text: ādhreṇa cit tad v ekaṃ cakāra siṃhyaṃ cit petvenā jaghāna
children.translated_text: Even with a feeble instrument he made that one deed; even the lion-like one he struck down with a blow.

children.text: ava sraktīr veśyāvṛścad indraḥ prāyacchad viśvā bhojanā sudāse ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> cut off the pegs and stakes, and granted all possessions to <s>Sudās</s>.

children.text: śaśvanto hi śatravo rāradhuṣ ṭe bhedasya cicchardhato vinda randhim
children.translated_text: For your enemies have always been brought under control; find the weak point even of arrogant <s>Bheda</s>.

children.text: martāṁ ena stuvato yaḥ kṛṇoti tigmaṃ tasmin ni jahi vajram indra ||
children.translated_text: The mortal who makes this praise for you: on him, O <s>Indra</s>, bring down your sharp thunderbolt.

children.text: āvad indraṃ yamunā tṛtsavaś ca prātra bhedaṃ sarvatātā muṣāyat
children.translated_text: The <s>Yamunā</s> and the <s>Tṛtsus</s> called on <s>Indra</s>; there <s>Bheda</s> was stripped of everything on every side.

children.text: ajāsaś ca śigravo yakṣavaś ca baliṃ śīrṣāṇi jabhrur aśvyāni ||
children.translated_text: And the <s>Ajas</s>, the <s>Śigravas</s>, and the <s>Yakṣus</s> brought tribute: heads of horses.

children.text: na ta indra sumatayo na rāyaḥ saṃcakṣe pūrvā uṣaso na nūtnāḥ
children.translated_text: Neither your favor, O <s>Indra</s>, nor your riches are fully seen, whether former like the dawns or new.

children.text: devakaṃ cin mānyamānaṃ jaghanthāva tmanā bṛhataḥ śambaram bhet ||
children.translated_text: You struck down even <s>Devaka</s>, who thought himself honorable; by yourself you broke great <s>Śambara</s>.

children.text: pra ye gṛhād amamadus tvāyā parāśaraḥ śatayātur vasiṣṭhaḥ
children.translated_text: Those who went rejoicing from the house through you, <s>Parāśara</s>, <s>Śatayātu</s>, and <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>,

children.text: na te bhojasya sakhyam mṛṣantādhā sūribhyaḥ sudinā vy ucchān ||
children.translated_text: do not betray your friendship with the generous patron; then let good days dawn for the liberal men.

children.text: dve naptur devavataḥ śate gor dvā rathā vadhūmantā sudāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Two hundred cows from the grandson of <s>Devavat</s>, and two chariots with brides, <s>Sudās</s> gave.

children.text: arhann agne paijavanasya dānaṃ hoteva sadma pary emi rebhan ||
children.translated_text: Deserving the gift of <s>Paijavana</s>, O <s>Agni</s>, I go around the dwelling like a <s>hotṛ</s> (invoking priest), singing aloud.

children.text: catvāro mā paijavanasya dānāḥ smaddiṣṭayaḥ kṛśanino nireke
children.translated_text: Four gifts of <s>Paijavana</s> came to me: splendid, adorned, surpassing those allotted to us.

children.text: ṛjrāso mā pṛthiviṣṭhāḥ sudāsas tokaṃ tokāya śravase vahanti ||
children.translated_text: The straight-going, earth-standing gifts of <s>Sudās</s> carry offspring to offspring, and renown.

children.text: yasya śravo rodasī antar urvī śīrṣṇe śīrṣṇe vibabhājā vibhaktā
children.translated_text: His fame, apportioned and divided, extends between the two wide worlds, head by head.

children.text: sapted indraṃ na sravato gṛṇanti ni yudhyāmadhim aśiśād abhīke ||
children.translated_text: The seven streams praise <s>Indra</s> for him; in the clash he has sharpened himself for battle.

children.text: imaṃ naro marutaḥ saścatānu divodāsaṃ na pitaraṃ sudāsaḥ
children.translated_text: O men, O <s>Maruts</s>, attend this <s>Sudās</s>, as sons attend father <s>Divodāsa</s>.

children.text: aviṣṭanā paijavanasya ketaṃ dūṇāśaṃ kṣatram ajaraṃ duvoyu ||
children.translated_text: Protect the banner of <s>Paijavana</s>, his hard-to-destroy, undecaying dominion, full of service.

children.text: Chapter 535
yas tigmaśṛṅgo vṛṣabho na bhīma ekaḥ kṛṣṭīś cyāvayati pra viśvāḥ
children.translated_text: He who, sharp-horned and fearsome like a bull, alone drives all peoples into motion,

children.text: yaḥ śaśvato adāśuṣo gayasya prayantāsi suṣvitarāya vedaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you are the ancient guide of the non-giving man's wealth for one who presses well, O inspired one.

children.text: tvaṃ ha tyad indra kutsam āvaḥ śuśrūṣamāṇas tanvā samarye
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, indeed protected that <s>Kutsa</s>, listening eagerly with your own body in battle,

children.text: dāsaṃ yacchuṣṇaṃ kuyavaṃ ny asmā arandhaya ārjuneyāya śikṣan ||
children.translated_text: when for him you brought low the <s>Dāsa</s> <s>Śuṣṇa</s> and <s>Kuyava</s>, instructing the son of <s>Arjuna</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ dhṛṣṇo dhṛṣatā vītahavyam prāvo viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ sudāsam
children.translated_text: You, bold one, boldly protected <s>Vītahavya</s> and <s>Sudās</s> with all your aids.

children.text: pra paurukutsiṃ trasadasyum āvaḥ kṣetrasātā vṛtrahatyeṣu pūrum ||
children.translated_text: You helped <s>Paurukutsi</s> <s>Trasadasyu</s>, and the <s>Pūru</s> in winning fields and in the slayings of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ nṛbhir nṛmaṇo devavītau bhūrīṇi vṛtrā haryaśva haṃsi
children.translated_text: You, strong-minded among men in the divine summons, O bay-horsed one, strike down many <s>Vṛtras</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ ni dasyuṃ cumuriṃ dhuniṃ cāsvāpayo dabhītaye suhantu ||
children.translated_text: You put to sleep the <s>Dasyu</s> <s>Cumuri</s> and <s>Dhuni</s> for <s>Dabhīti</s>, so that they might be well slain.

children.text: tava cyautnāni vajrahasta tāni nava yat puro navatiṃ ca sadyaḥ
children.translated_text: Those are your shakings, O thunder-handed one: when at once you entered the ninety-nine forts,

children.text: niveśane śatatamāviveṣīr ahañca vṛtraṃ namucim utāhan ||
children.translated_text: and at the hundredth dwelling you struck down <s>Vṛtra</s>, and you also struck down <s>Namuci</s>.

children.text: sanā tā ta indra bhojanāni rātahavyāya dāśuṣe sudāse
children.translated_text: Ancient are those possessions of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, for <s>Sudās</s>, the sacrificing giver whose oblations are granted.

children.text: vṛṣṇe te harī vṛṣaṇā yunajmi vyantu brahmāṇi puruśāka vājam ||
children.translated_text: For you, the virile one, I yoke the two virile bay horses; let the prayers, O much-invoked one, go forth to the prize.

children.text: mā te asyāṃ sahasāvan pariṣṭāv aghāya bhūma harivaḥ parādai
children.translated_text: O mighty one, let us not, in this praise of yours, fall into evil or be handed over to harm, O bay-horsed one.

children.text: trāyasva no 'vṛkebhir varūthais tava priyāsaḥ sūriṣu syāma ||
children.translated_text: Protect us with shelters free from injury; may we be dear to you among the liberal patrons.

children.text: priyāsa it te maghavann abhiṣṭau naro madema śaraṇe sakhāyaḥ
children.translated_text: May we, men dear to you in your aid, O bountiful one, rejoice as friends in your shelter.

children.text: ni turvaśaṃ ni yādvaṃ śiśīhy atithigvāya śaṃsyaṃ kariṣyan ||
children.translated_text: Strike down <s>Turvaśa</s>, strike down <s>Yādva</s>, making a praiseworthy deed for <s>Atithigva</s>.

children.text: sadyaś cin nu te maghavann abhiṣṭau naraḥ śaṃsanty ukthaśāsa ukthā
children.translated_text: Even now at once in your aid, O bountiful one, the men who command hymns proclaim hymns.

children.text: ye te havebhir vi paṇīṃr adāśann asmān vṛṇīṣva yujyāya tasmai ||
children.translated_text: Those who by invocations have assigned the non-giving <s>Paṇis</s> to you: choose us for that partnership.

children.text: ete stomā narāṃ nṛtama tubhyam asmadryañco dadato maghāni
children.translated_text: These praises, O most manly of men, are directed from us to you, granting gifts.

children.text: teṣām indra vṛtrahatye śivo bhūḥ sakhā ca śūro 'vitā ca nṛṇām ||
children.translated_text: For them, O <s>Indra</s>, in the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>, be auspicious, a friend, a hero, and a protector of men.

children.text: nū indra śūra stavamāna ūtī brahmajūtas tanvā vāvṛdhasva
children.translated_text: Now, O heroic <s>Indra</s>, praised in your aid and urged by prayer, increase in your own body.

children.text: upa no vājān mimīhy upa stīn yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Measure out prizes for us, and measure out possessions; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 536
ugro jajñe vīryāya svadhāvāñcakrir apo naryo yat kariṣyan
children.translated_text: The fierce, self-powerful one was born for heroic strength, when the manly one, intending to act, set the waters in motion.

children.text: jagmir yuvā nṛṣadanam avobhis trātā na indra enaso mahaś cit ||
children.translated_text: The young one came to the seat of men with aids; may <s>Indra</s>, our protector, save us even from great sin.

children.text: hantā vṛtram indraḥ śūśuvānaḥ prāvīn nu vīro jaritāram ūtī
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, swelling with strength, the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, has now aided the heroic singer with his help.

children.text: kartā sudāse aha vā u lokaṃ dātā vasu muhur ā dāśuṣe bhūt ||
children.translated_text: He has made a place for <s>Sudās</s> here; indeed, let him become again and again the giver of wealth to the worshipper.

children.text: yudhmo anarvā khajakṛt samadvā śūraḥ satrāṣāḍ januṣem aṣāﾱhaḥ
children.translated_text: Warlike, unassailable, carving out booty, advancing into battle, a hero overcoming foes, unconquered from birth,

children.text: vy āsa indraḥ pṛtanāḥ svojā adhā viśvaṃ śatrūyantaṃ jaghāna ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> scattered the battles by his own power; then he struck down every hostile one.

children.text: ubhe cid indra rodasī mahitvā paprātha taviṣībhis tuviṣmaḥ
children.translated_text: Even both heaven and earth, O <s>Indra</s>, you filled out with greatness, very mighty with your powers.

children.text: ni vajram indro harivān mimikṣan sam andhasā madeṣu vā uvoca ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, rich in bay horses, dipping down the thunderbolt, spoke in the exhilarations of the soma-draught.

children.text: vṛṣā jajāna vṛṣaṇaṃ raṇāya tam u cin nārī naryaṃ sasūva
children.translated_text: The bull begot the bull for battle; even a woman bore that manly one.

children.text: pra yaḥ senānīr adha nṛbhyo astīnaḥ satvā gaveṣaṇaḥ sa dhṛṣṇuḥ ||
children.translated_text: He who afterward stands as army-leader before men, eager for cows, vigorous and bold.

children.text: nū cit sa bhreṣate jano na reṣan mano yo asya ghoram āvivāsāt
children.translated_text: Now that man does not stumble or perish, he whose mind seeks to win his dreadful power.

children.text: yajñair ya indre dadhate duvāṃsi kṣayat sa rāya ṛtapā ṛtejāḥ ||
children.translated_text: He who by sacrifices places acts of worship in <s>Indra</s> dwells with wealth, guardian of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), born of <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: yad indra pūrvo aparāya śikṣann ayaj jyāyān kanīyaso deṣṇam
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indra</s>, as the earlier one you instructed the later, the greater bestowed a gift upon the lesser.

children.text: amṛta it pary āsīta dūram ā citra citryam bharā rayiṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: The immortal sat far around; bring us brilliant, wondrous wealth.

children.text: yas ta indra priyo jano dadāśad asan nireke adrivaḥ sakhā te
children.translated_text: The dear man who has worshipped you, O <s>Indra</s>, let him be without poverty, O stone-wielder, your friend.

children.text: vayaṃ te asyāṃ sumatau caniṣṭhāḥ syāma varūthe aghnato nṛpītau ||
children.translated_text: May we be nearest to you in this favor, in the shelter of the unharming one, in manly protection.

children.text: eṣa stomo acikradad vṛṣā ta uta stāmur maghavann akrapiṣṭa
children.translated_text: This praise has cried out to you, the bull; and that firm support, O bounteous one, has called aloud.

children.text: rāyas kāmo jaritāraṃ ta āgan tvam aṅga śakra vasva ā śako naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Desiring wealth, your singer has come to you; you indeed, O mighty one, are able to help us to treasure.

children.text: sa na indra tvayatāyā iṣe dhās tmanā ca ye maghavāno junanti
children.translated_text: So, O <s>Indra</s>, place us in nourishment through your aid, together with the bounteous men who urge onward by their own selves.

children.text: vasvī ṣu te jaritre astu śaktir yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let your power be beneficent for the singer; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 537
asāvi devaṃ goṛjīkam andho ny asminn indro januṣem uvoca
children.translated_text: The soma-draught rich in cows has been pressed for the god; in this birth <s>Indra</s> has spoken.

children.text: bodhāmasi tvā haryaśva yajñair bodhā na stomam andhaso madeṣu ||
children.translated_text: We awaken you, O bay-horsed one, with sacrifices; awake to our praise in the exhilarations of the soma-draught.

children.text: pra yanti yajñaṃ vipayanti barhiḥ somamādo vidathe dudhravācaḥ
children.translated_text: They go forth to the sacrifice and spread the sacred grass; soma-intoxicated, hard-rushing in voice, they attend the assembly.

children.text: ny u bhriyante yaśaso gṛbhād ā dūraupabdo vṛṣaṇo nṛṣācaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The glorious, bull-like companions of men are brought here from the grasp, with a call heard from afar.

children.text: tvam indra sravitavā apas kaḥ pariṣṭhitā ahinā śūra pūrvīḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, made the waters flow, the many waters that had been enclosed by the serpent, O hero.

children.text: tvad vāvakre rathyo na dhenā rejante viśvā kṛtrimāṇi bhīṣā ||
children.translated_text: At your turning, like streams toward a chariot, all fashioned things tremble in fear.

children.text: bhīmo viveṣāyudhebhir eṣām apāṃsi viśvā naryāṇi vidvān
children.translated_text: Terrible, he entered among them with weapons, knowing all manly works.

children.text: indraḥ puro jarhṛṣāṇo vi dūdhod vi vajrahasto mahinā jaghāna ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, exulting, shook the forts apart; with thunderbolt in hand he struck them down by his greatness.

children.text: na yātava indra jūjuvur no na vandanā śaviṣṭha vedyābhiḥ
