children.translated_text: No sorcerers, O <s>Indra</s>, have harmed us, nor have incantations, O strongest one, with their known powers.

children.text: sa śardhad aryo viṣuṇasya jantor mā śiśnadevā api gur ṛtaṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: He shattered the fury of the alien creature; let not the phallus-worshippers overrun our <s>ṛta</s> (sacred order).

children.text: abhi kratvendra bhūr adha jman na te vivyaṅ mahimānaṃ rajāṃsi
children.translated_text: With insight, O <s>Indra</s>, you prevailed over the earth below; the realms have not surpassed your greatness.

children.text: svenā hi vṛtraṃ śavasā jaghantha na śatrur antaṃ vividad yudhā te ||
children.translated_text: For by your own might you struck down <s>Vṛtra</s>; no enemy found your limit in battle.

children.text: devāś cit te asuryāya pūrve 'nu kṣatrāya mamire sahāṃsi
children.translated_text: Even the former gods measured out powers for your lordship and sovereignty.

children.text: indro maghāni dayate viṣahyendraṃ vājasya johuvanta sātau ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, having overcome, apportions bounties; they call on <s>Indra</s> in the winning of the prize.

children.text: kīriś ciddhi tvām avase juhāveśānam indra saubhagasya bhūreḥ
children.translated_text: For even the poet has called on you for aid, O <s>Indra</s>, lord of abundant good fortune.

children.text: avo babhūtha śatamūte asme abhikṣattus tvāvato varūtā ||
children.translated_text: You have become help to us, with a hundred aids, a protector against an assailant as strong as you.

children.text: sakhāyas ta indra viśvaha syāma namovṛdhāso mahinā tarutra
children.translated_text: May we be your friends at all times, O <s>Indra</s>, increasing through homage, crossing beyond by greatness.

children.text: vanvantu smā te 'vasā samīke 'bhītim aryo vanuṣāṃ śavāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: May they, with your help in the contest, overcome the powers of the hostile assailants.

children.text: sa na indra tvayatāyā iṣe dhās tmanā ca ye maghavāno junanti
children.translated_text: So, O <s>Indra</s>, place us in nourishment through your aid, together with the bounteous men who urge onward by their own selves.

children.text: vasvī ṣu te jaritre astu śaktir yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let your power be beneficent for the singer; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 538
pibā somam indra mandatu tvā yaṃ te suṣāva haryaśvādriḥ
children.translated_text: Drink the soma, O <s>Indra</s>; may it gladden you, that which the pressing-stone, O bay-horsed one, has pressed for you.

children.text: sotur bāhubhyāṃ suyato nārvā ||
children.translated_text: It is well-guided by the presser's two arms, like a steed.

children.text: yas te mado yujyaś cārur asti yena vṛtrāṇi haryaśva haṃsi
children.translated_text: That lovely, well-yoked exhilaration of yours, by which, O bay-horsed one, you slay <s>Vṛtras</s>,

children.text: sa tvām indra prabhūvaso mamattu ||
children.translated_text: let that intoxicate you, O <s>Indra</s> of surpassing wealth.

children.text: bodhā su me maghavan vācam emāṃ yāṃ te vasiṣṭho arcati praśastim
children.translated_text: Attend well, O bounteous one, to this speech of mine, the praise which <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> chants to you.

children.text: imā brahma sadhamāde juṣasva ||
children.translated_text: Accept these sacred formulations at the common feast.

children.text: śrudhī havaṃ vipipānasyādrer bodhā viprasyārcato manīṣām
children.translated_text: Hear the call of the dripping pressing-stone; attend to the inspired thought of the singing poet.

children.text: kṛṣvā duvāṃsy antamā sacemā ||
children.translated_text: Make our acts of worship nearest to you; may we accompany you.

children.text: na te giro api mṛṣye turasya na suṣṭutim asuryasya vidvān
children.translated_text: I do not let your songs go in vain, O impetuous one, knowing the fine praise of the lordly one.

children.text: sadā te nāma svayaśo vivakmi ||
children.translated_text: I always proclaim your name, famous by itself.

children.text: bhūri hi te savanā mānuṣeṣu bhūri manīṣī havate tvām it
children.translated_text: For many are your soma-pressings among men; many a thoughtful poet calls upon you alone.

children.text: māre asman maghavañ jyok kaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Do not keep us far away for long, O bounteous one.

children.text: tubhyed imā savanā śūra viśvā tubhyam brahmāṇi vardhanā kṛṇomi
children.translated_text: For you, O hero, are all these soma-pressings; for you I make prayers that increase you.

children.text: tvaṃ nṛbhir havyo viśvadhāsi ||
children.translated_text: You are to be invoked by men in every way.

children.text: nū cin nu te manyamānasya dasmod aśnuvanti mahimānam ugra
children.translated_text: Even now, O wondrous fierce one, they do not attain the greatness of you who are revered.

children.text: na vīryam indra te na rādhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Nor do they attain your heroic power, O <s>Indra</s>, nor your gift.

children.text: ye ca pūrva ṛṣayo ye ca nūtnā indra brahmāṇi janayanta viprāḥ
children.translated_text: Both the former seers and the new inspired poets, O <s>Indra</s>, have generated prayers.

children.text: asme te santu sakhyā śivāni yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May your auspicious friendships be ours; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 539
ud u brahmāṇy airata śravasyendraṃ samarye mahayā vasiṣṭha
children.translated_text: Let the prayers rise up for fame; magnify <s>Indra</s> in the contest, O <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>.

children.text: ā yo viśvāni śavasā tatānopaśrotā ma īvato vacāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: He who by his might has stretched out all things: may he listen closely to my eager words.

children.text: ayāmi ghoṣa indra devajāmir irajyanta yacchurudho vivāci
children.translated_text: I come with a call, O <s>Indra</s>, one born of the gods, when the attentive ones move in inspired speech.

children.text: nahi svam āyuś cikite janeṣu tānīd aṃhāṃsy ati parṣy asmān ||
children.translated_text: For no one among men perceives his own lifespan; carry us beyond those distresses.

children.text: yuje rathaṃ gaveṣaṇaṃ haribhyām upa brahmāṇi jujuṣāṇam asthuḥ
children.translated_text: I yoke the cow-seeking chariot with the two bay horses; the prayers have come near, taking pleasure in it.

children.text: vi bādhiṣṭa sya rodasī mahitvendro vṛtrāṇy apratī jaghanvān ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, who by his greatness set heaven and earth apart, struck down the irresistible <s>Vṛtras</s>.

children.text: āpaś cit pipyu staryo na gāvo nakṣann ṛtaṃ jaritāras ta indra
children.translated_text: Even the waters have swelled, like cows in their stalls; the singers have reached your sacred order, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yāhi vāyur na niyuto no acchā tvaṃ hi dhībhir dayase vi vājān ||
children.translated_text: Come toward us like <s>Vāyu</s> with his teams, for through inspired thoughts you distribute the prizes.

children.text: te tvā madā indra mādayantu śuṣmiṇaṃ tuvirādhasaṃ jaritre
children.translated_text: May these exhilarations delight you, O <s>Indra</s>, powerful and very munificent toward the singer.

children.text: eko devatrā dayase hi martān asmiñchūra savane mādayasva ||
children.translated_text: Alone among the gods you allot things to mortals; at this soma-pressing, hero, take delight.

children.text: eved indraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vajrabāhuṃ vasiṣṭhāso abhy arcanty arkaiḥ
children.translated_text: Thus the <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s> praise <s>Indra</s>, the bull, whose arm bears the thunderbolt, with their songs.

children.text: sa na stuto vīravad dhātu gomad yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May he, when praised, bestow on us wealth with heroes and cattle; protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 540
yoniṣ ṭa indra sadane akāri tam ā nṛbhiḥ puruhūta pra yāhi
children.translated_text: Your seat, O <s>Indra</s>, has been made in the dwelling; come to it with the men, O much-invoked one.

children.text: aso yathā no 'vitā vṛdhe ca dado vasūni mamadaś ca somaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thus be our helper and our increaser; give us possessions, and rejoice in the soma-draughts.

children.text: gṛbhītaṃ te mana indra dvibarhāḥ sutaḥ somaḥ pariṣiktā madhūni
children.translated_text: Your mind has been seized, O <s>Indra</s>; the soma has been pressed, the honeyed drops have been poured around.

children.text: visṛṣṭadhenā bharate suvṛktir iyam indraṃ johuvatī manīṣā ||
children.translated_text: This well-spoken thought, its milch-cow released, bears itself onward, calling aloud to <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: ā no diva ā pṛthivyā ṛjīṣinn idam barhiḥ somapeyāya yāhi
children.translated_text: Come to us from heaven and from earth, O impetuous one; come to this sacred grass for soma-drinking.

children.text: vahantu tvā harayo madryañcam āṅgūṣam acchā tavasam madāya ||
children.translated_text: Let your bay horses carry you, turned toward the intoxicating draught, to the chant, to mighty exhilaration.

children.text: ā no viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ sajoṣā brahma juṣāṇo haryaśva yāhi
children.translated_text: Come to us in harmony with all your aids, O bay-horsed one, enjoying the sacred formulation.

children.text: varīvṛjat sthavirebhiḥ suśiprāsme dadhad vṛṣaṇaṃ śuṣmam indra ||
children.translated_text: Making wide room with firm supports, O fair-lipped <s>Indra</s>, place virile strength among us.

children.text: eṣa stomo maha ugrāya vāhe dhurīvātyo na vājayann adhāyi
children.translated_text: This praise has been set in harness for the great fierce one, like a draught-beast eager for the prize.

children.text: indra tvāyam arka īṭṭe vasūnāṃ divīva dyām adhi naḥ śromataṃ dhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, this song seeks you for possessions; set our renown high, as heaven is set above the sky.

children.text: evā na indra vāryasya pūrdhi pra te mahīṃ sumatiṃ vevidāma
children.translated_text: So fill us, O <s>Indra</s>, with desirable wealth; may we come to know your great favor.

children.text: iṣam pinva maghavadbhyaḥ suvīrāṃ yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Swell nourishment rich in heroes for the bountiful men; protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 541
ā te maha indroty ugra samanyavo yat samaranta senāḥ
children.translated_text: Your great aid, O fierce <s>Indra</s>, is near when the armies meet together in battle.

children.text: patāti didyun naryasya bāhvor mā te mano viṣvadryag vi cārīt ||
children.translated_text: The bolt of the manly one flies from your arms; let your mind not wander away in all directions.

children.text: ni durga indra śnathihy amitrāṁ abhi ye no martāso amanti
children.translated_text: Shatter the difficult strongholds, O <s>Indra</s>; attack the unfriendly mortals who menace us.

children.text: āre taṃ śaṃsaṃ kṛṇuhi ninitsor ā no bhara sambharaṇaṃ vasūnām ||
children.translated_text: Drive far away the accusation of the reviler; bring to us the gathered wealth of possessions.

children.text: śataṃ te śiprinn ūtayaḥ sudāse sahasraṃ śaṃsā uta rātir astu
children.translated_text: A hundred aids be yours for <s>Sudās</s>, O strong-jawed one; let there be a thousand praises and gifts.

children.text: jahi vadhar vanuṣo martyasyāsme dyumnam adhi ratnaṃ ca dhehi ||
children.translated_text: Slay the deadly hostile mortal; set splendor and treasure upon us.

children.text: tvāvato hīndra kratve asmi tvāvato 'vituḥ śūra rātau
children.translated_text: For in resolve I belong to one like you, O <s>Indra</s>; in receiving aid and gifts, O hero, I belong to one like you.

children.text: viśved ahāni taviṣīva ugraṃ okaḥ kṛṇuṣva harivo na mardhīḥ ||
children.translated_text: On all days make a powerful home for yourself, as with might, O bay-horsed one; do not neglect us.

children.text: kutsā ete haryaśvāya śūṣam indre saho devajūtam iyānāḥ
children.translated_text: These <s>Kutsas</s>, bringing refreshment to the bay-horsed one, have come to <s>Indra</s> with strength urged by the gods.

children.text: satrā kṛdhi suhanā śūra vṛtrā vayaṃ tarutrāḥ sanuyāma vājam ||
children.translated_text: Make the <s>Vṛtras</s> easy to slay at once, O hero; may we, overcoming, win the prize.

children.text: evā na indra vāryasya pūrdhi pra te mahīṃ sumatiṃ vevidāma
children.translated_text: So fill us, O <s>Indra</s>, with desirable wealth; may we come to know your great favor.

children.text: iṣam pinva maghavadbhyaḥ suvīrāṃ yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Swell nourishment rich in heroes for the bountiful men; protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 542
na soma indram asuto mamāda nābrahmāṇo maghavānaṃ sutāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Unpressed soma has never exhilarated <s>Indra</s>; nor have pressed soma-draughts without sacred formulations exhilarated the bountiful one.

children.text: tasmā ukthaṃ janaye yaj jujoṣan nṛvan navīyaḥ śṛṇavad yathā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: For him I generate a hymn which he may gladly accept; may the manly one hear us with something newer.

children.text: uktha ukthe soma indram mamāda nīthe nīthe maghavānaṃ sutāsaḥ
children.translated_text: With hymn after hymn the soma exhilarated <s>Indra</s>; with leading after leading the pressed draughts exhilarated the bountiful one.

children.text: yad īṃ sabādhaḥ pitaraṃ na putrāḥ samānadakṣā avase havante ||
children.translated_text: When, hard pressed, men of equal skill call on him for help like sons calling on their father.

children.text: cakāra tā kṛṇavan nūnam anyā yāni bruvanti vedhasaḥ suteṣu
children.translated_text: He has done those deeds, and now he will do others, the deeds that the wise speak of at the soma-pressings.

children.text: janīr iva patir ekaḥ samāno ni māmṛje pura indraḥ su sarvāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like a single husband shared among wives, <s>Indra</s> has wiped away all the strongholds.

children.text: evā tam āhur uta śṛṇva indra eko vibhaktā taraṇir maghānām
children.translated_text: So they call him; and hear this, O <s>Indra</s>: he alone is the distributor and swift deliverer of gifts.

children.text: mithastura ūtayo yasya pūrvīr asme bhadrāṇi saścata priyāṇi ||
children.translated_text: His many ancient aids press on together; may good and dear things attach themselves to us.

children.text: evā vasiṣṭha indram ūtaye nṝn kṛṣṭīnāṃ vṛṣabhaṃ sute gṛṇāti
children.translated_text: Thus <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> praises <s>Indra</s> at the pressing for aid, the bull of men and peoples.

children.text: sahasriṇa upa no māhi vājān yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bring thousandfold prizes close to us; protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 543
indraṃ naro nemadhitā havante yat pāryā yunajate dhiyas tāḥ
children.translated_text: Men call upon <s>Indra</s> at the decisive contest, when they yoke those thoughts to the goal beyond.

children.text: śūro nṛṣātā śavasaś cakāna ā gomati vraje bhajā tvaṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: The hero, delighting in man-winning through might: share out to us the cattle-rich enclosure.

children.text: ya indra śuṣmo maghavan te asti śikṣā sakhibhyaḥ puruhūta nṛbhyaḥ
children.translated_text: That strength of yours which exists, O bountiful <s>Indra</s>, bestow on your friends, on the much-invoked men.

children.text: tvaṃ hi dṛﾱhā maghavan vicetā apā vṛdhi parivṛtaṃ na rādhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For you, discerning bountiful one, open the firm things, like wealth that has been enclosed.

children.text: indro rājā jagataś carṣaṇīnām adhi kṣami viṣurūpaṃ yad asti
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is king of the moving world and of peoples, over whatever varied thing there is upon the earth.

children.text: tato dadāti dāśuṣe vasūni codad rādha upastutaś cid arvāk ||
children.translated_text: From there he gives possessions to the worshipper, and, even when praised, he urges bounty hither.

children.text: nū cin na indro maghavā sahūtī dāno vājaṃ ni yamate na ūtī
children.translated_text: Now may bountiful <s>Indra</s>, called together with us, as a giver bring the prize under control for us with aid.

children.text: anūnā yasya dakṣiṇā pīpāya vāmaṃ nṛbhyo abhivītā sakhibhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: His gift, not deficient, has swelled lovely wealth for men, protected on all sides by friends.

children.text: nū indra rāye varivas kṛdhī na ā te mano vavṛtyāma maghāya
children.translated_text: Now, O <s>Indra</s>, make broad space for wealth for us; let us turn your mind toward bounty.

children.text: gomad aśvāvad rathavad vyanto yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we go forth with cattle, with horses, and with chariots; protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 544
brahmā ṇa indropa yāhi vidvān arvāñcas te harayaḥ santu yuktāḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, knowing the sacred formulation, come near; let your bay horses be harnessed toward us.

children.text: viśve ciddhi tvā vihavanta martā asmākam icchṛṇuhi viśvaminva ||
children.translated_text: For all mortals call upon you from every side; hear what is ours, O all-impelling one.

children.text: havaṃ ta indra mahimā vy ānaḍ brahma yat pāsi śavasinn ṛṣīṇām
children.translated_text: The call has reached your greatness, O <s>Indra</s>, the sacred formulation of the seers which you protect, O mighty one.

children.text: ā yad vajraṃ dadhiṣe hasta ugra ghoraḥ san kratvā janiṣṭhā aṣāﾱhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When you take the thunderbolt in your hand, O fierce one, you are born terrible by will, unconquered.

children.text: tava praṇītīndra johuvānān saṃ yan nṝn na rodasī ninetha
children.translated_text: Under your guidance, O <s>Indra</s>, when you led together the calling men, you brought heaven and earth together as if they were people.

children.text: mahe kṣatrāya śavase hi jajñe 'tūtujiṃ cit tūtujir aśiśnat ||
children.translated_text: For he was born for great dominion and might; the impeller has stirred even what was unstirred.

children.text: ebhir na indrāhabhir daśasya durmitrāso hi kṣitayaḥ pavante
children.translated_text: With these days, O <s>Indra</s>, show favor to us, for hostile peoples are stirring.

children.text: prati yac caṣṭe anṛtam anenā ava dvitā varuṇo māyī naḥ sāt ||
children.translated_text: And when he observes falsehood, by this power let crafty <s>Varuṇa</s> ward off from us a second offense.

children.text: vocemed indram maghavānam enam maho rāyo rādhaso yad dadan naḥ
children.translated_text: Let us proclaim this bountiful <s>Indra</s>, when he grants us great wealth and largess.

children.text: yo arcato brahmakṛtim aviṣṭho yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: He is the closest helper of the worshipper who makes the sacred formulation; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 545
ayaṃ soma indra tubhyaṃ sunva ā tu pra yāhi harivas tadokāḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s> is being pressed for you, O <s>Indra</s>; come here, O bay-horsed one, to this your dwelling.

children.text: pibā tv asya suṣutasya cāror dado maghāni maghavann iyānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Drink of this well-pressed, lovely drink; as you come, O bountiful one, bestow gifts.

children.text: brahman vīra brahmakṛtiṃ juṣāṇo 'rvācīno haribhir yāhi tūyam
children.translated_text: O heroic lord of prayer, delighting in the fashioned prayer, come quickly hither with your bay horses.

children.text: asminn ū ṣu savane mādayasvopa brahmāṇi śṛṇava imā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: In this pressing, then, make yourself glad; hear these prayers of ours.

children.text: kā te asty araṅkṛtiḥ sūktaiḥ kadā nūnaṃ te maghavan dāśema
children.translated_text: What adornment for you is there through hymns? When now, O <s>Maghavan</s>, shall we serve you?

children.text: viśvā matīr ā tatane tvāyādhā ma indra śṛṇavo havemā ||
children.translated_text: All thoughts stretch toward you; therefore, O <s>Indra</s>, may you hear these invocations of mine.

children.text: uto ghā te puruṣyā id āsan yeṣām pūrveṣām aśṛṇor ṛṣīṇām
children.translated_text: Indeed many were those human ones of yours, the former seers whose words you heard.

children.text: adhāhaṃ tvā maghavañ johavīmi tvaṃ na indrāsi pramatiḥ piteva ||
children.translated_text: Therefore I call on you again and again, O <s>Maghavan</s>; you, O <s>Indra</s>, are our guiding thought, like a father.

children.text: vocemed indram maghavānam enam maho rāyo rādhaso yad dadan naḥ
children.translated_text: Let us proclaim this bountiful <s>Indra</s>, when he grants us great wealth and largess.

children.text: yo arcato brahmakṛtim aviṣṭho yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: He is the closest helper of the worshipper who makes the sacred formulation; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 546
ā no deva śavasā yāhi śuṣmin bhavā vṛdha indra rāyo asya
children.translated_text: Come to us, O god, with might, O powerful <s>Indra</s>; be the increaser of this wealth.

children.text: mahe nṛmṇāya nṛpate suvajra mahi kṣatrāya pauṃsyāya śūra ||
children.translated_text: For great manly strength, O king of men with the good thunderbolt, for great dominion and heroic power, O hero.

children.text: havanta u tvā havyaṃ vivāci tanūṣu śūrāḥ sūryasya sātau
children.translated_text: They call upon you, the one to be invoked, with many voices; heroes call in their own persons at the winning of the sun.

children.text: tvaṃ viśveṣu senyo janeṣu tvaṃ vṛtrāṇi randhayā suhantu ||
children.translated_text: You are to be summoned among all peoples; make the <s>Vṛtras</s> yield, O good slayer.

children.text: ahā yad indra sudinā vyucchān dadho yat ketum upamaṃ samatsu
children.translated_text: When bright good days dawned, O <s>Indra</s>, when you set up the highest banner in battles,

children.text: ny agniḥ sīdad asuro na hotā huvāno atra subhagāya devān ||
children.translated_text: then <s>Agni</s> sat down below like a mighty <s>hotṛ</s> (invoking priest), calling the gods here for good fortune.

children.text: vayaṃ te ta indra ye ca deva stavanta śūra dadato maghāni
children.translated_text: We, O divine <s>Indra</s>, and those who praise you, O hero who gives gifts,

children.text: yacchā sūribhya upamaṃ varūthaṃ svābhuvo jaraṇām aśnavanta ||
children.translated_text: grant the patrons the highest protection; may the self-possessed attain enduring songs of praise.

children.text: vocemed indram maghavānam enam maho rāyo rādhaso yad dadan naḥ
children.translated_text: Let us proclaim this bountiful <s>Indra</s>, when he grants us great wealth and largess.

children.text: yo arcato brahmakṛtim aviṣṭho yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: He is the closest helper of the worshipper who makes the sacred formulation; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 547
pra va indrāya mādanaṃ haryaśvāya gāyata
children.translated_text: Sing forth for <s>Indra</s> the exhilarating song, for the bay-horsed one,

children.text: sakhāyaḥ somapāvne ||
children.translated_text: friends, for the drinker of <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: śaṃsed ukthaṃ sudānava uta dyukṣaṃ yathā naraḥ
children.translated_text: Proclaim the hymn, O generous ones, and the shining praise, as men do;

children.text: cakṛmā satyarādhase ||
children.translated_text: we have made it for the one whose gifts are true.

children.text: tvaṃ na indra vājayus tvaṃ gavyuḥ śatakrato
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, seek prizes for us; you seek cattle, O hundred-powered one;

children.text: tvaṃ hiraṇyayur vaso ||
children.translated_text: you seek gold, O good one.

children.text: vayam indra tvāyavo 'bhi pra ṇonumo vṛṣan
children.translated_text: We, desiring you, bow ourselves toward you, O <s>Indra</s>, O bull;

children.text: viddhī tv asya no vaso ||
children.translated_text: take notice of this praise of ours, O good one.

children.text: mā no nide ca vaktave 'ryo randhīr arāvṇe
children.translated_text: Do not give us over to censure or reproach, nor subject us to the ungenerous enemy.

children.text: tve api kratur mama ||
children.translated_text: In you, indeed, my resolve is placed.

children.text: tvaṃ varmāsi saprathaḥ puroyodhaś ca vṛtrahan
children.translated_text: You are broad armor and the champion in front, O slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>;

children.text: tvayā prati bruve yujā ||
children.translated_text: with you as ally I answer back.

children.text: mahāṁ utāsi yasya te 'nu svadhāvarī sahaḥ
children.translated_text: Great also is that strength of yours, according to whose self-law

children.text: mamnāte indra rodasī ||
children.translated_text: the two worlds are measured out, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: taṃ tvā marutvatī pari bhuvad vāṇī sayāvarī
children.translated_text: May that moving voice, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, encompass you,

children.text: nakṣamāṇā saha dyubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: reaching you together with the lights of heaven.

children.text: ūrdhvāsas tvānv indavo bhuvan dasmam upa dyavi
children.translated_text: The drops have risen upward after you, the wondrous one, toward heaven;

children.text: saṃ te namanta kṛṣṭayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the peoples bow down together before you.

children.text: pra vo mahe mahivṛdhe bharadhvam pracetase pra sumatiṃ kṛṇudhvam
children.translated_text: Bring forward your offering for the great one, the increaser of greatness; for the discerning one, make favor.

children.text: viśaḥ pūrvīḥ pra carā carṣaṇiprāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Many clans go forth, filling the peoples.

children.text: uruvyacase mahine suvṛktim indrāya brahma janayanta viprāḥ
children.translated_text: For wide-extending, great <s>Indra</s>, the inspired poets generate a fair hymn, a prayer;

children.text: tasya vratāni na minanti dhīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the wise do not transgress his ordinances.

children.text: indraṃ vāṇīr anuttamanyum eva satrā rājānaṃ dadhire sahadhyai
children.translated_text: Voices have set up <s>Indra</s>, whose wrath is unsurpassed, as king forever, for shared strength;

children.text: haryaśvāya barhayā sam āpīn ||
children.translated_text: for the bay-horsed one, spread the sacred grass and fill it full.

children.text: Chapter 548
mo ṣu tvā vāghataś canāre asman ni rīraman
children.translated_text: Let not even the singers from afar hold you back away from us.

children.text: ārāttāc cit sadhamādaṃ na ā gahīha vā sann upa śrudhi ||
children.translated_text: Come from far away to our common exhilaration; whether here or there, hear us.

children.text: ime hi te brahmakṛtaḥ sute sacā madhau na makṣa āsate
children.translated_text: For these makers of prayer sit beside your pressing, like bees at honey;

children.text: indre kāmaṃ jaritāro vasūyavo rathe na pādam ā dadhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the singers, desiring wealth in <s>Indra</s>, have set down their longing as one sets a foot in a chariot.

children.text: rāyaskāmo vajrahastaṃ sudakṣiṇam putro na pitaraṃ huve ||
children.translated_text: Desiring wealth, I call upon the thunder-handed, very skillful one, like a son upon his father.

children.text: ima indrāya sunvire somāso dadhyāśiraḥ
children.translated_text: These <s>Somas</s>, mixed with curds, have been pressed for <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: tāṁ ā madāya vajrahasta pītaye haribhyāṃ yāhy oka ā ||
children.translated_text: come with your two bay horses to your dwelling for exhilaration and drinking, O thunder-handed one.

children.text: śravac chrutkarṇa īyate vasūnāṃ nū cin no mardhiṣad giraḥ
children.translated_text: The listening, keen-eared one goes toward the goods; even now let him not neglect our songs,

children.text: sadyaś cid yaḥ sahasrāṇi śatā dadan nakir ditsantam ā minat ||
children.translated_text: he who at once gives thousands and hundreds; no one injures the man who wishes to give.

children.text: sa vīro apratiṣkuta indreṇa śūśuve nṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: That hero, unopposed, has grown strong with <s>Indra</s> among men,

children.text: yas te gabhīrā savanāni vṛtrahan sunoty ā ca dhāvati ||
children.translated_text: who presses for you the deep pressings, O slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, and hastens toward you.

children.text: bhavā varūtham maghavan maghonāṃ yat samajāsi śardhataḥ
children.translated_text: Be a shelter, O <s>Maghavan</s>, for the bountiful, when you have joined the exultant host.

children.text: vi tvāhatasya vedanam bhajemahy ā dūṇāśo bharā gayam ||
children.translated_text: May we share in the knowledge of what you have struck down; bring life and household wealth to us who seek aid.

children.text: sunotā somapāvne somam indrāya vajriṇe
children.translated_text: Press the <s>Soma</s> for <s>Indra</s> the thunderer, the drinker of <s>Soma</s>;

children.text: pacatā paktīr avase kṛṇudhvam it pṛṇann it pṛṇate mayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: cook the cooked offerings for help; create delight both for the one who fills and for the one who is filled.

children.text: mā sredhata somino dakṣatā mahe kṛṇudhvaṃ rāya ātuje
children.translated_text: Do not go astray, O Soma-pressers; be skillful, and make wealth for the great one, for acquisition.

children.text: taraṇir ij jayati kṣeti puṣyati na devāsaḥ kavatnave ||
children.translated_text: The swift one alone wins, dwells, and prospers; the gods are not for the deceiver.

children.text: nakiḥ sudāso ratham pary āsa na rīramat
children.translated_text: No one has checked the chariot of <s>Sudās</s> on every side or made it halt,

children.text: indro yasyāvitā yasya maruto gamat sa gomati vraje ||
children.translated_text: whose helper was <s>Indra</s>, and to whose cattle-rich enclosure the <s>Maruts</s> came.

children.text: gamad vājaṃ vājayann indra martyo yasya tvam avitā bhuvaḥ
children.translated_text: The mortal for whom you become a helper, O <s>Indra</s>, goes to the prize, winning prizes;

children.text: asmākam bodhy avitā rathānām asmākaṃ śūra nṛṇām ||
children.translated_text: be the helper of our chariots, and the helper of our men, O hero.

children.text: ud in nv asya ricyate 'ṃśo dhanaṃ na jigyuṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Now his share rises up, like the wealth of one who has won,

children.text: ya indro harivān na dabhanti taṃ ripo dakṣaṃ dadhāti somini ||
children.translated_text: the one whom bay-horsed <s>Indra</s> protects; enemies do not deceive him, and he places skill in the Soma-presser.

children.text: mantram akharvaṃ sudhitaṃ supeśasaṃ dadhāta yajñiyeṣv ā
children.translated_text: Set among the worshipful ones the unbroken mantra, well placed and beautifully formed.

children.text: pūrvīś cana prasitayas taranti taṃ ya indre karmaṇā bhuvat ||
children.translated_text: Even many hostile assaults do not overcome the man who comes to belong to <s>Indra</s> through action.

children.text: kas tam indra tvāvasum ā martyo dadharṣati
children.translated_text: What mortal, O <s>Indra</s>, could dare to assail you, who are rich in help?

children.text: śraddhā it te maghavan pārye divi vājī vājaṃ siṣāsati ||
children.translated_text: Faith in you, O <s>Maghavan</s>, in the farthest heaven, seeks to win the prize, as a racer seeks the prize.

children.text: maghonaḥ sma vṛtrahatyeṣu codaya ye dadati priyā vasu
children.translated_text: Urge on the bounteous men in the slayings of <s>Vṛtra</s>, those who give dear wealth.

children.text: tava praṇītī haryaśva sūribhir viśvā tarema duritā ||
children.translated_text: Through your guidance, O <s>Haryaśva</s>, together with generous patrons, may we cross over all hardships.

children.text: taved indrāvamaṃ vasu tvam puṣyasi madhyamam
children.translated_text: Yours indeed, O <s>Indra</s>, is the lowest wealth; you make the middle wealth prosper.

children.text: satrā viśvasya paramasya rājasi nakiṣ ṭvā goṣu vṛṇvate ||
children.translated_text: Together you rule over all that is highest; no one chooses you merely for cattle.

children.text: tvaṃ viśvasya dhanadā asi śruto ya īm bhavanty ājayaḥ
children.translated_text: You are known as the giver of all wealth, when contests arise.

children.text: tavāyaṃ viśvaḥ puruhūta pārthivo 'vasyur nāma bhikṣate ||
children.translated_text: This whole earthly realm, O <s>Puruhūta</s>, seeking aid, begs for your name.

children.text: yad indra yāvatas tvam etāvad aham īśīya
children.translated_text: If, O <s>Indra</s>, I had lordship as far as you have it,

children.text: stotāram id didhiṣeya radāvaso na pāpatvāya rāsīya ||
children.translated_text: I would support only the singer, O giver of gifts; I would not bestow him for evil.

children.text: śikṣeyam in mahayate dive dive rāya ā kuhacidvide
children.translated_text: I would help the one who magnifies you, day by day, toward wealth, wherever it is to be found.

children.text: nahi tvad anyan maghavan na āpyaṃ vasyo asti pitā cana ||
children.translated_text: For apart from you, O <s>Maghavan</s>, there is no nearer and better kinsman for us, not even a father.

children.text: taraṇir it siṣāsati vājam purandhyā yujā
children.translated_text: The swift one seeks to win the prize, joined with abundant insight as ally.

children.text: ā va indram puruhūtaṃ name girā nemiṃ taṣṭeva sudrvam ||
children.translated_text: I bow to you with song, to <s>Indra</s> the much-invoked, as a carpenter bends a well-running wheel-rim.

children.text: na duṣṭutī martyo vindate vasu na sredhantaṃ rayir naśat
children.translated_text: A mortal does not gain wealth by bad praise; riches do not reach the negligent man.

children.text: suśaktir in maghavan tubhyam māvate deṣṇaṃ yat pārye divi ||
children.translated_text: Powerful indeed, O <s>Maghavan</s>, is the gift for one like me, the gift that is in the farthest heaven for you.

children.text: abhi tvā śūra nonumo 'dugdhā iva dhenavaḥ
children.translated_text: We bow down before you, O hero, like unmilked cows.

children.text: īśānam asya jagataḥ svardṛśam īśānam indra tasthuṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Before the lord of this moving world, the seer of sunlight, before the lord, O <s>Indra</s>, of what stands still.

children.text: na tvāvāṁ anyo divyo na pārthivo na jāto na janiṣyate
children.translated_text: There is no other like you, heavenly or earthly; none has been born, and none will be born.

children.text: aśvāyanto maghavann indra vājino gavyantas tvā havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: Desiring horses, O bounteous <s>Indra</s>, desiring prize-winning steeds and desiring cows, we call upon you.

children.text: abhī ṣatas tad ā bharendra jyāyaḥ kanīyasaḥ
children.translated_text: Bring that here against the attackers, O <s>Indra</s>, the greater thing against the smaller.

children.text: purūvasur hi maghavan sanād asi bhare bhare ca havyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For from of old, O <s>Maghavan</s>, rich in many goods, you are to be invoked in every contest.

children.text: parā ṇudasva maghavann amitrān suvedā no vasū kṛdhi
children.translated_text: Drive away our unfriends, O <s>Maghavan</s>; knowing well, make possessions for us.

children.text: asmākam bodhy avitā mahādhane bhavā vṛdhaḥ sakhīnām ||
children.translated_text: Be our protector in the great prize; be the increaser of your friends.

children.text: indra kratuṃ na ā bhara pitā putrebhyo yathā
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, bring us resolve, as a father brings it to his sons.

children.text: śikṣā ṇo asmin puruhūta yāmani jīvā jyotir aśīmahi ||
children.translated_text: Instruct us on this journey, O <s>Puruhūta</s>; while living, may we attain the light.

children.text: mā no ajñātā vṛjanā durādhyo māśivāso ava kramuḥ
children.translated_text: Let unknown hostile bands, ill-minded and inauspicious, not step down upon us.

children.text: tvayā vayam pravataḥ śaśvatīr apo 'ti śūra tarāmasi ||
children.translated_text: With you, O hero, may we cross beyond the perpetual rushing waters.

children.text: Chapter 549
śvityañco mā dakṣiṇataskapardā dhiyañjinvāso abhi hi pramanduḥ
children.translated_text: The white-robed ones, with right-side topknots, quickening thought, have greatly gladdened me.

children.text: uttiṣṭhan voce pari barhiṣo nṝn na me dūrād avitave vasiṣṭhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Standing up, I would call out around the sacred grass to the men: the <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s> are not far away to help me.

children.text: dūrād indram anayann ā sutena tiro vaiśantam ati pāntam ugram
children.translated_text: They brought <s>Indra</s> from afar with the pressed soma, past the settlement and beyond the fierce drinker.

children.text: pāśadyumnasya vāyatasya somāt sutād indro 'vṛṇītā vasiṣṭhān ||
children.translated_text: From the pressed soma of <s>Pāśadyumna</s>, son of <s>Vāyata</s>, <s>Indra</s> chose the <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s>.

children.text: even nu kaṃ sindhum ebhis tatāreven nu kam bhedam ebhir jaghāna
children.translated_text: Indeed now with these he crossed the <s>Sindhu</s>; indeed now with these he struck down <s>Bheda</s>.

children.text: even nu kaṃ dāśarājñe sudāsam prāvad indro brahmaṇā vo vasiṣṭhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Indeed now by your <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation), O <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s>, <s>Indra</s> helped <s>Sudās</s> in the Battle of Ten Kings.

children.text: juṣṭī naro brahmaṇā vaḥ pitṝṇām akṣam avyayaṃ na kilā riṣātha
children.translated_text: Favored, O men, by the <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation) of your fathers, surely you do not perish, like an unwasting axle.

children.text: yacchakvarīṣu bṛhatā raveṇendre śuṣmam adadhātā vasiṣṭhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When, in the <s>Śakvarī</s> verses, with a great roar, you <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s> placed might in <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: ud dyām ivet tṛṣṇajo nāthitāso 'dīdhayur dāśarājñe vṛtāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Hemmed in and longing for aid in the Battle of Ten Kings, they shone forth like the sky.

children.text: vasiṣṭhasya stuvata indro aśrod uruṃ tṛtsubhyo akṛṇod u lokam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> heard <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> as he praised; he made a broad space for the <s>Tṛtsus</s>.

children.text: daṇḍā ived goajanāsa āsan paricchinnā bharatā arbhakāsaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Bharatas</s> were like staffs for driving cattle, cut off and small.

children.text: abhavac ca puraetā vasiṣṭha ād it tṛtsūnāṃ viśo aprathanta ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> became their forerunner; only then did the clans of the <s>Tṛtsus</s> spread out.

children.text: trayaḥ kṛṇvanti bhuvaneṣu retas tisraḥ prajā āryā jyotiragrāḥ
children.translated_text: Three make seed in the worlds; three noble births have light before them.

children.text: trayo gharmāsa uṣasaṃ sacante sarvāṁ it tāṁ anu vidur vasiṣṭhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Three hot offerings accompany the dawn; the <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s> know all of these.

children.text: sūryasyeva vakṣatho jyotir eṣāṃ samudrasyeva mahimā gabhīraḥ
children.translated_text: Like the sun is the expanse of their light; like the ocean is their deep greatness.

children.text: vātasyeva prajavo nānyena stomo vasiṣṭhā anvetave vaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like the wind is your forward rush; no other can follow your hymn, O <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s>.

children.text: ta in niṇyaṃ hṛdayasya praketaiḥ sahasravalśam abhi saṃ caranti
children.translated_text: By the signs of the hidden heart they move around the thousand-branched one.

children.text: yamena tatam paridhiṃ vayanto 'psarasa upa sedur vasiṣṭhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Weaving the enclosure stretched out by <s>Yama</s>, the <s>Apsarases</s> sat down near, O <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s>.

children.text: vidyuto jyotiḥ pari saṃjihānam mitrāvaruṇā yad apaśyatāṃ tvā
children.translated_text: When <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> saw you as a light of lightning flashing all around,

children.text: tat te janmotaikaṃ vasiṣṭhāgastyo yat tvā viśa ājabhāra ||
children.translated_text: that was your one birth, O <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, and <s>Agastya</s>'s too, when the people brought you forth.

children.text: utāsi maitrāvaruṇo vasiṣṭhorvaśyā brahman manaso 'dhi jātaḥ
children.translated_text: And you are <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>, O <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, born from the mind of <s>Urvaśī</s>, O priest.

children.text: drapsaṃ skannam brahmaṇā daivyena viśve devāḥ puṣkare tvādadanta ||
children.translated_text: The fallen drop, through divine <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation), all the gods received as you in the lotus.

children.text: sa praketa ubhayasya pravidvān sahasradāna uta vā sadānaḥ
children.translated_text: He, perceptive and knowing both sides, was a giver of a thousand and also a giver of dwellings.

children.text: yamena tatam paridhiṃ vayiṣyann apsarasaḥ pari jajñe vasiṣṭhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: As he was to weave the boundary stretched out by <s>Yama</s>, <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> was born among the <s>Apsarases</s>.

children.text: satre ha jātāv iṣitā namobhiḥ kumbhe retaḥ siṣicatuḥ samānam
children.translated_text: At the sacrifice, the two born ones, impelled by reverence, poured their common seed into the jar.

children.text: tato ha māna ud iyāya madhyāt tato jātam ṛṣim āhur vasiṣṭham ||
children.translated_text: From that <s>Māna</s> rose up from the middle; from that they say the seer <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> was born.

children.text: ukthabhṛtaṃ sāmabhṛtam bibharti grāvāṇam bibhrat pra vadāty agre
children.translated_text: Bearing the recitation, bearing the chant, holding the pressing-stone, he speaks forth at the front.

children.text: upainam ādhvaṃ sumanasyamānā ā vo gacchāti pratṛdo vasiṣṭhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Approach him with good will; <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, the breaker-through, comes to you.

children.text: Chapter 550
pra śukraitu devī manīṣā asmat sutaṣṭo ratho na vājī ||
children.translated_text: Let the bright divine inspiration go forth from us, like a well-fashioned chariot, like a racer.

children.text: viduḥ pṛthivyā divo janitraṃ śṛṇvanty āpo adha kṣarantīḥ ||
children.translated_text: They know the birthplace of earth and heaven; the waters, streaming below, hear.

children.text: āpaś cid asmai pinvanta pṛthvīr vṛtreṣu śūrā maṃsanta ugrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even the broad waters swell for him; among the <s>Vṛtras</s>, the heroes thought him mighty and fierce.

children.text: ā dhūrṣv asmai dadhātāśvān indro na vajrī hiraṇyabāhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Set the horses on the shafts for him, as for <s>Indra</s>, the thunderbolt-bearer with golden arms.

children.text: abhi pra sthātāheva yajñaṃ yāteva patman tmanā hinota ||
children.translated_text: Stand forth toward the <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice), like one setting out, like a traveler on the path; by yourselves set it in motion.

children.text: tmanā samatsu hinota yajñaṃ dadhāta ketuṃ janāya vīram ||
children.translated_text: By yourselves set the <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice) in motion in contests; establish for the people a banner, a hero.

children.text: ud asya śuṣmād bhānur nārta bibharti bhāram pṛthivī na bhūma ||
children.translated_text: From his force the radiance rose up; he bears the burden as the earth bears the broad expanse.

children.text: hvayāmi devāṁ ayātur agne sādhann ṛtena dhiyaṃ dadhāmi ||
children.translated_text: I call the gods, O <s>Agni</s>, unharming; succeeding through <s>ṛta</s> (sacred order), I set down the inspired thought.

children.text: abhi vo devīṃ dhiyaṃ dadhidhvam pra vo devatrā vācaṃ kṛṇudhvam ||
children.translated_text: Take up, all of you, the divine inspired thought; fashion your speech toward the gods.

children.text: ā caṣṭa āsām pātho nadīnāṃ varuṇa ugraḥ sahasracakṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Mighty <s>Varuṇa</s>, thousand-eyed, observes the paths of these rivers.

children.text: rājā rāṣṭrānām peśo nadīnām anuttam asmai kṣatraṃ viśvāyu ||
children.translated_text: King of kingdoms, adornment of rivers: unsurpassed lordship, lasting through all life, belongs to him.

children.text: aviṣṭo asmān viśvāsu vikṣv adyuṃ kṛṇota śaṃsaṃ ninitsoḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having aided us among all peoples, today make powerless the accusation of the reviler.

children.text: vy etu didyud dviṣām aśevā yuyota viṣvag rapas tanūnām ||
children.translated_text: Let the hostile missile of enemies depart; drive bodily harm away in every direction.

children.text: avīn no agnir havyān namobhiḥ preṣṭho asmā adhāyi stomaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s> aid us with oblations and acts of homage; the dearest hymn has been set before him.

children.text: sajūr devebhir apāṃ napātaṃ sakhāyaṃ kṛdhvaṃ śivo no astu ||
children.translated_text: Together with the gods, make <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s> your friend; may he be auspicious for us.

children.text: abjām ukthair ahiṃ gṛṇīṣe budhne nadīnāṃ rajassu ṣīdan ||
children.translated_text: Born in the waters, I praise the serpent with hymns, seated in the depth of the rivers, in the spaces.

children.text: mā no 'hir budhnyo riṣe dhān mā yajño asya sridhad ṛtāyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Ahi Budhnya</s> not give us over to harm; let the <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice) of this worshipper of <s>ṛta</s> (sacred order) not fail.

children.text: uta na eṣu nṛṣu śravo dhuḥ pra rāye yantu śardhanto aryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And among these men let them place fame for us; let the eager noble ones go forth toward wealth.

children.text: tapanti śatruṃ svar ṇa bhūmā mahāsenāso amebhir eṣām ||
children.translated_text: Their great armies burn the enemy like the sun upon the earth, with their powers.

children.text: ā yan naḥ patnīr gamanty acchā tvaṣṭā supāṇir dadhātu vīrān ||
children.translated_text: When our wives come near to us, may fair-handed <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> grant heroes.

children.text: prati na stomaṃ tvaṣṭā juṣeta syād asme aramatir vasūyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> accept our hymn in return; may generous <s>Aramati</s>, desiring goods, be ours.

children.text: tā no rāsan rātiṣāco vasūny ā rodasī varuṇānī śṛṇotu
children.translated_text: May those gift-bringers bestow goods on us; may <s>Rodasī</s> and <s>Varuṇānī</s> hear us.

children.text: varūtrībhiḥ suśaraṇo no astu tvaṣṭā sudatro vi dadhātu rāyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With protections may he be a good refuge for us; may <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, the good giver, apportion riches.

children.text: tan no rāyaḥ parvatās tan na āpas tad rātiṣāca oṣadhīr uta dyauḥ
children.translated_text: May the mountains bring us that wealth, may the waters bring it, and may the gift-bringing herbs and heaven bring it.

children.text: vanaspatibhiḥ pṛthivī sajoṣā ubhe rodasī pari pāsato naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May earth, together with the forest trees, and both worlds in accord, guard us all around.

children.text: anu tad urvī rodasī jihātām anu dyukṣo varuṇa indrasakhā
children.translated_text: Let the two wide worlds assent to that; let bright <s>Varuṇa</s>, friend of <s>Indra</s>, assent.

children.text: anu viśve maruto ye sahāso rāyaḥ syāma dharuṇaṃ dhiyadhyai ||
children.translated_text: Let all the <s>Maruts</s>, who are mighty, assent; may we be a foundation of wealth for inspired thought.

children.text: tan na indro varuṇo mitro agnir āpa oṣadhīr vanino juṣanta
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Agni</s>, the waters, the herbs, and the forest-lords enjoy that for us.

children.text: śarman syāma marutām upasthe yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we be in shelter, in the lap of the <s>Maruts</s>; all of you, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 551
śaṃ na indrāgnī bhavatām avobhiḥ śaṃ na indrāvaruṇā rātahavyā
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra-Agni</s> be auspicious to us with aids; may <s>Indra-Varuṇa</s>, to whom oblations are offered, be auspicious to us.

children.text: śam indrāsomā suvitāya śaṃ yoḥ śaṃ na indrāpūṣaṇā vājasātau ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra-Soma</s> be auspicious for good guidance and welfare; may <s>Indra-Pūṣan</s> be auspicious to us in the winning of strength.

children.text: śaṃ no bhagaḥ śam u naḥ śaṃso astu śaṃ naḥ purandhiḥ śam u santu rāyaḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Bhaga</s> be auspicious to us, and may our praise be auspicious; may <s>Purandhi</s> be auspicious, and may riches be auspicious to us.

children.text: śaṃ naḥ satyasya suyamasya śaṃsaḥ śaṃ no aryamā purujāto astu ||
children.translated_text: May the proclamation of truth and good restraint be auspicious to us; may many-born <s>Aryaman</s> be auspicious to us.

children.text: śaṃ no dhātā śam u dhartā no astu śaṃ na urūcī bhavatu svadhābhiḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Dhātṛ</s> be auspicious to us, and may our sustainer be auspicious; may the wide one be auspicious to us with her own powers.

children.text: śaṃ rodasī bṛhatī śaṃ no adriḥ śaṃ no devānāṃ suhavāni santu ||
children.translated_text: May great <s>Rodasī</s> be auspicious, may the mountain be auspicious to us; may the gods' easily invoked powers be auspicious to us.

children.text: śaṃ no agnir jyotiranīko astu śaṃ no mitrāvaruṇāv aśvinā śam
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s>, whose face is light, be auspicious to us; may <s>Mitra-Varuṇa</s> and the <s>Aśvins</s> be auspicious to us.

children.text: śaṃ naḥ sukṛtāṃ sukṛtāni santu śaṃ na iṣiro abhi vātu vātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the good deeds of the good-doers be auspicious to us; may the impelling wind blow auspiciously upon us.

children.text: śaṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī pūrvahūtau śam antarikṣaṃ dṛśaye no astu
children.translated_text: May Heaven and Earth, first invoked, be auspicious to us; may the midspace be auspicious for our seeing.

children.text: śaṃ na oṣadhīr vanino bhavantu śaṃ no rajasas patir astu jiṣṇuḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the herbs and forest-lords be auspicious to us; may the victorious lord of the realm be auspicious to us.

children.text: śaṃ na indro vasubhir devo astu śam ādityebhir varuṇaḥ suśaṃsaḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> the god be auspicious with the <s>Vasus</s>; may well-praised <s>Varuṇa</s> be auspicious with the <s>Ādityas</s>.

children.text: śaṃ no rudro rudrebhir jalāṣaḥ śaṃ nas tvaṣṭā gnābhir iha śṛṇotu ||
children.translated_text: May healing <s>Rudra</s> be auspicious to us with the <s>Rudras</s>; may <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> hear us here with the divine women.

children.text: śaṃ naḥ somo bhavatu brahma śaṃ naḥ śaṃ no grāvāṇaḥ śam u santu yajñāḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Soma</s> be auspicious to us, may <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation) be auspicious to us; may the pressing-stones be auspicious to us, and may the <s>yajñas</s> (sacrifices) be auspicious.

children.text: śaṃ naḥ svarūṇām mitayo bhavantu śaṃ naḥ prasvaḥ śam v astu vediḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the measures of the sacrificial posts be auspicious to us; may the forward impulse be auspicious, and may the altar be auspicious to us.

children.text: śaṃ naḥ sūrya urucakṣā ud etu śaṃ naś catasraḥ pradiśo bhavantu
children.translated_text: May the wide-seeing <s>Sūrya</s> rise auspiciously for us; may the four directions be auspicious to us.

children.text: śaṃ naḥ parvatā dhruvayo bhavantu śaṃ naḥ sindhavaḥ śam u santv āpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the fixed mountains be auspicious to us; may the rivers be auspicious, and may the waters be auspicious.

children.text: śaṃ no aditir bhavatu vratebhiḥ śaṃ no bhavantu marutaḥ svarkāḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Aditi</s> be auspicious to us through her vows; may the song-rich <s>Maruts</s> be auspicious to us.

children.text: śaṃ no viṣṇuḥ śam u pūṣā no astu śaṃ no bhavitraṃ śam v astu vāyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Viṣṇu</s> be auspicious, and may <s>Pūṣan</s> be auspicious to us; may the purifier be auspicious to us, and may <s>Vāyu</s> be auspicious.

children.text: śaṃ no devaḥ savitā trāyamāṇaḥ śaṃ no bhavantūṣaso vibhātīḥ
children.translated_text: May the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, protecting us, be auspicious to us; may the shining Dawns be auspicious to us.

children.text: śaṃ naḥ parjanyo bhavatu prajābhyaḥ śaṃ naḥ kṣetrasya patir astu śambhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Parjanya</s> be auspicious to our offspring; may the kindly lord of the field be auspicious to us.

children.text: śaṃ no devā viśvadevā bhavantu śaṃ sarasvatī saha dhībhir astu
children.translated_text: May the gods, all the gods, be auspicious to us; may <s>Sarasvatī</s> be auspicious together with inspired thoughts.

children.text: śam abhiṣācaḥ śam u rātiṣācaḥ śaṃ no divyāḥ pārthivāḥ śaṃ no apyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the helpers in conquest be auspicious, and may the gift-bringers be auspicious; may the heavenly, earthly, and watery powers be auspicious to us.

children.text: śaṃ naḥ satyasya patayo bhavantu śaṃ no arvantaḥ śam u santu gāvaḥ
children.translated_text: May the lords of truth be auspicious to us; may the coursing horses be auspicious, and may the cows be auspicious.

children.text: śaṃ na ṛbhavaḥ sukṛtaḥ suhastāḥ śaṃ no bhavantu pitaro haveṣu ||
children.translated_text: May the <s>Ṛbhus</s>, skillful and good-handed, be auspicious to us; may the Fathers be auspicious to us at our invocations.

children.text: śaṃ no aja ekapād devo astu śaṃ no 'hir budhnyaḥ śaṃ samudraḥ
children.translated_text: May the god <s>Aja Ekapād</s> be auspicious to us; may <s>Ahi Budhnya</s> be auspicious to us, and may the ocean be auspicious.

children.text: śaṃ no apāṃ napāt perur astu śaṃ naḥ pṛśnir bhavatu devagopā ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s>, the swelling one, be auspicious to us; may <s>Pṛśni</s>, guardian of the gods, be auspicious to us.

children.text: ādityā rudrā vasavo juṣantedam brahma kriyamāṇaṃ navīyaḥ
children.translated_text: May the <s>Ādityas</s>, <s>Rudras</s>, and <s>Vasus</s> enjoy this newer <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation) as it is being made.

children.text: śṛṇvantu no divyāḥ pārthivāso gojātā uta ye yajñiyāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the heavenly and earthly ones hear us, those born of cows and also those worthy of sacrifice.

children.text: ye devānāṃ yajñiyā yajñiyānām manor yajatrā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ
children.translated_text: Those among the gods who are sacrificable among the sacrificable, worthy of worship, immortal, knowers of <s>ṛta</s> (sacred order), belonging to <s>Manu</s>,

children.text: te no rāsantām urugāyam adya yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: may they grant us wide-ranging favor today; all of you, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 552
pra brahmaitu sadanād ṛtasya vi raśmibhiḥ sasṛje sūryo gāḥ
children.translated_text: Let the prayer go forth from the seat of <s>ṛta</s> (sacred order); <s>Sūrya</s> has been released, spreading the cows with his rays.

children.text: vi sānunā pṛthivī sasra urvī pṛthu pratīkam adhy edhe agniḥ ||
children.translated_text: Along the ridge, over the broad earth, <s>Agni</s> has spread abroad; he has blazed up with a wide-facing front.

children.text: imāṃ vām mitrāvaruṇā suvṛktim iṣaṃ na kṛṇve asurā navīyaḥ
children.translated_text: For you two, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, mighty lords, I make this well-spoken newer nourishment as if a refreshment.

children.text: ino vām anyaḥ padavīr adabdho janaṃ ca mitro yatati bruvāṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: One of you, an uninjured guide on the path, and <s>Mitra</s>, speaking, sets the people in order.

children.text: ā vātasya dhrajato ranta ityā apīpayanta dhenavo na sūdāḥ
children.translated_text: The streams came toward the rushing wind; like good milch-cows they filled him full.

children.text: maho divaḥ sadane jāyamāno 'cikradad vṛṣabhaḥ sasminn ūdhan ||
children.translated_text: Being born in the seat of great heaven, the bull cried aloud in that udder.

children.text: girā ya etā yunajaddharī ta indra priyā surathā śūra dhāyū
children.translated_text: The one who with song has yoked those two bay steeds of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, beloved, well-charioted, heroic, eager ones,

children.text: pra yo manyuṃ ririkṣato mināty ā sukratum aryamaṇaṃ vavṛtyām ||
children.translated_text: he thwarts the wrath of the one wishing harm; I would turn hither <s>Aryaman</s>, rich in good resolve.

children.text: yajante asya sakhyaṃ vayaś ca namasvinaḥ sva ṛtasya dhāman
children.translated_text: The reverent ones sacrifice for his friendship and for life-span, in the own domain of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: vi pṛkṣo bābadhe nṛbhi stavāna idaṃ namo rudrāya preṣṭham ||
children.translated_text: Praised among men, he has warded off the contests; this reverence is most dear to <s>Rudra</s>.

children.text: ā yat sākaṃ yaśaso vāvaśānāḥ sarasvatī saptathī sindhumātā
children.translated_text: When, together, desiring glory, <s>Sarasvatī</s>, the seventh, mother of rivers, came near,

children.text: yāḥ suṣvayanta sudughāḥ sudhārā abhi svena payasā pīpyānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the good-milking, well-streaming ones, swelling with their own milk, poured forth richly.

children.text: uta tye no maruto mandasānā dhiyaṃ tokaṃ ca vājino 'vantu
children.translated_text: And may those rejoicing <s>Maruts</s>, winners of the prize, help our thought and our offspring.

children.text: mā naḥ pari khyad akṣarā caranty avīvṛdhan yujyaṃ te rayiṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let the imperishable one moving onward not look past us; they have increased for us your yoked wealth.

children.text: pra vo mahīm aramatiṃ kṛṇudhvam pra pūṣaṇaṃ vidathyaṃ na vīram
children.translated_text: Set forth for yourselves great <s>Aramati</s>; set forth <s>Pūṣan</s>, like a hero worthy of the rite,

children.text: bhagaṃ dhiyo 'vitāraṃ no asyāḥ sātau vājaṃ rātiṣācam purandhim ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Bhaga</s>, protector of our thoughts in this winning, together with prize-accompanying <s>Purandhi</s>.

children.text: acchāyaṃ vo marutaḥ śloka etv acchā viṣṇuṃ niṣiktapām avobhiḥ
children.translated_text: Let this chant go toward you, O <s>Maruts</s>; let it go toward <s>Viṣṇu</s>, who drinks the sprinkled offering, with aids.

children.text: uta prajāyai gṛṇate vayo dhur yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: And for progeny they set life-span for the singer; protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 553
ā vo vāhiṣṭho vahatu stavadhyai ratho vājā ṛbhukṣaṇo amṛktaḥ
children.translated_text: Let your swiftest chariot, O <s>Ṛbhukṣaṇas</s>, uninjured, carry you here for praising.

children.text: abhi tripṛṣṭhaiḥ savaneṣu somair made suśiprā mahabhiḥ pṛṇadhvam ||
children.translated_text: With the three-backed soma-draughts at the pressings, O fair-lipped ones, be filled in great exhilaration.

children.text: yūyaṃ ha ratnam maghavatsu dhattha svardṛśa ṛbhukṣaṇo amṛktam
children.translated_text: You place uninjured treasure among the bountiful, O <s>Ṛbhukṣaṇas</s>, seers of the sun.

children.text: saṃ yajñeṣu svadhāvantaḥ pibadhvaṃ vi no rādhāṃsi matibhir dayadhvam ||
children.translated_text: Self-powered ones, drink together in the sacrifices; with your thoughts divide out favors for us.

children.text: uvocitha hi maghavan deṣṇam maho arbhasya vasuno vibhāge
children.translated_text: For you have spoken, O <s>Maghavan</s>, of a gift at the distribution of great and small wealth.

children.text: ubhā te pūrṇā vasunā gabhastī na sūnṛtā ni yamate vasavyā ||
children.translated_text: Both your hands are full of wealth; generous speech, rich in goods, is not restrained.

children.text: tvam indra svayaśā ṛbhukṣā vājo na sādhur astam eṣy ṛkvā
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, self-renowned, O <s>Ṛbhukṣan</s>, like <s>Vāja</s> the effective one, go home, song-worthy.

children.text: vayaṃ nu te dāśvāṃsaḥ syāma brahma kṛṇvanto harivo vasiṣṭhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we now be your worshippers, making sacred formulations, O bay-horsed one, we <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s>.

children.text: sanitāsi pravato dāśuṣe cid yābhir viveṣo haryaśva dhībhiḥ
children.translated_text: You are the winner for the giver, even in the onward course, with those thoughts by which you have entered, O bay-horsed one.

children.text: vavanmā nu te yujyābhir ūtī kadā na indra rāya ā daśasyeḥ ||
children.translated_text: Favoring us with your allied aids, when, O <s>Indra</s>, will you bestow wealth upon us?

children.text: vāsayasīva vedhasas tvaṃ naḥ kadā na indra vacaso bubodhaḥ
children.translated_text: As if causing us to dwell, O ordainer, when, O <s>Indra</s>, will you listen to our words?

children.text: astaṃ tātyā dhiyā rayiṃ suvīram pṛkṣo no arvā ny uhīta vājī ||
children.translated_text: With that thought bring home heroic wealth; let prize-winning nourishment come down to us nearby.

children.text: abhi yaṃ devī nirṛtiś cid īśe nakṣanta indraṃ śaradaḥ supṛkṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Even divine <s>Nirṛti</s> has power over him; favorable autumns approach <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: upa tribandhur jaradaṣṭim ety asvaveśaṃ yaṃ kṛṇavanta martāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The three-banded one comes near the worn-down old man whom mortals make into a resting-place without horses.

children.text: ā no rādhāṃsi savita stavadhyā ā rāyo yantu parvatasya rātau
children.translated_text: Let favors come to us, O <s>Savitar</s>, for praising; let riches come at the gift of the mountain.

children.text: sadā no divyaḥ pāyuḥ siṣaktu yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the heavenly protector always attend us; protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 554
ud u ṣya devaḥ savitā yayāma hiraṇyayīm amatiṃ yām aśiśret
children.translated_text: That god <s>Savitar</s> has now raised up the golden thought on which he had leaned.

children.text: nūnam bhago havyo mānuṣebhir vi yo ratnā purūvasur dadhāti ||
children.translated_text: Now <s>Bhaga</s>, rich in many goods, is to be invoked by human beings, he who distributes treasures widely.

children.text: ud u tiṣṭha savitaḥ śrudhy asya hiraṇyapāṇe prabhṛtāv ṛtasya
children.translated_text: Rise up, O <s>Savitar</s>; hear this, golden-handed one, at the setting forth of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: vy urvīm pṛthvīm amatiṃ sṛjāna ā nṛbhyo martabhojanaṃ suvānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Releasing the broad, wide-ranging thought, you bring forth mortal food for men.

children.text: api ṣṭutaḥ savitā devo astu yam ā cid viśve vasavo gṛṇanti
children.translated_text: Let the god <s>Savitar</s> be praised here, whom all the <s>Vasus</s> praise.

children.text: sa na stomān namasyaś cano dhād viśvebhiḥ pātu pāyubhir ni sūrīn ||
children.translated_text: May he, worthy of reverence, grant delight to our hymns; may he guard the patrons with all his protections.

children.text: abhi yaṃ devy aditir gṛṇāti savaṃ devasya savitur juṣāṇā
children.translated_text: Divine <s>Aditi</s> praises him, gladly accepting the impulse of the god <s>Savitar</s>.

children.text: abhi samrājo varuṇo gṛṇanty abhi mitrāso aryamā sajoṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The sovereign <s>Varuṇa</s> praises him; the <s>Mitras</s> and <s>Aryaman</s> praise him together.

children.text: abhi ye mitho vanuṣaḥ sapante rātiṃ divo rātiṣācaḥ pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: Those who strive with one another for the gift of heaven, prize-accompanying ones of earth, praise him.

children.text: ahir budhnya uta naḥ śṛṇotu varūtry ekadhenubhir ni pātu ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Ahir Budhnya</s> hear us, and may <s>Varūtrī</s> protect us with her single milch-cows.

children.text: anu tan no jāspatir maṃsīṣṭa ratnaṃ devasya savitur iyānaḥ
children.translated_text: Let <s>Jāspati</s>, coming after that, think for us of the treasure of the god <s>Savitar</s>.

children.text: bhagam ugro 'vase johavīti bhagam anugro adha yāti ratnam ||
children.translated_text: The fierce one calls on <s>Bhaga</s> for aid; the gentle one then goes after <s>Bhaga</s>, the treasure.

children.text: śaṃ no bhavantu vājino haveṣu devatātā mitadravaḥ svarkāḥ
children.translated_text: May the prize-winning ones, measured in their course and bright with heaven, be auspicious to us at our invocations and at divine service.

children.text: jambhayanto 'hiṃ vṛkaṃ rakṣāṃsi sanemy asmad yuyavann amīvāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Subduing the serpent, the wolf, and the demons, may they drive sickness away from us so that we may win.

children.text: vāje vāje 'vata vājino no dhaneṣu viprā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ
children.translated_text: At every contest for the prize, help us, O prize-winning inspired immortals, knowers of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), among the riches.

children.text: asya madhvaḥ pibata mādayadhvaṃ tṛptā yāta pathibhir devayānaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Drink of this sweetness; rejoice. Sated, go by the paths traveled by the gods.

children.text: Chapter 555
ūrdhvo agniḥ sumatiṃ vasvo aśret pratīcī jūrṇir devatātim eti
children.translated_text: Upright <s>Agni</s> has taken hold of the good will of wealth; the forward-moving ancient one comes to the divine service.

children.text: bhejāte adrī rathyeva panthām ṛtaṃ hotā na iṣito yajāti ||
children.translated_text: The two pressing stones share the path like chariot-tracks; the inspired <s>Hotar</s> (invoking priest) sacrifices according to <s>ṛta</s> for us.

children.text: pra vāvṛje suprayā barhir eṣām ā viśpatīva bīriṭa iyāte
children.translated_text: Their well-going sacred grass has been spread forward; the two lords of the clans move as if to the adornment.

children.text: viśām aktor uṣasaḥ pūrvahūtau vāyuḥ pūṣā svastaye niyutvān ||
children.translated_text: At the first invocation of dawn from the tribes in the night, <s>Vāyu</s> and <s>Pūṣan</s>, rich in teams, come for well-being.

children.text: jmayā atra vasavo ranta devā urāv antarikṣe marjayanta śubhrāḥ
children.translated_text: Here on earth the shining <s>Vasus</s>, the gods, have rejoiced; in the broad midspace they have cleansed themselves.

children.text: arvāk patha urujrayaḥ kṛṇudhvaṃ śrotā dūtasya jagmuṣo no asya ||
children.translated_text: Make broad paths hitherward, you of wide stride; hear this messenger of ours who has come.

children.text: te hi yajñeṣu yajñiyāsa ūmāḥ sadhasthaṃ viśve abhi santi devāḥ
children.translated_text: For these worshipful gods, kindly in the sacrifices, all the gods are present at the common seat.

children.text: tāṁ adhvara uśato yakṣy agne śruṣṭī bhagaṃ nāsatyā purandhim ||
children.translated_text: Them, eager at the rite, worship swiftly, O <s>Agni</s>: <s>Bhaga</s>, the <s>Nāsatyas</s>, and <s>Purandhi</s>.

children.text: āgne giro diva ā pṛthivyā mitraṃ vaha varuṇam indram agnim
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, with our songs bring here from heaven and earth <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Indra</s>, and <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: āryamaṇam aditiṃ viṣṇum eṣāṃ sarasvatī maruto mādayantām ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, may <s>Sarasvatī</s> and the <s>Maruts</s>, gladden them.

children.text: rare havyam matibhir yajñiyānāṃ nakṣat kāmam martyānām asinvan
children.translated_text: May the oblation of the worshipful ones draw near through their thoughts; may it attain the desire of mortals, not failing.

children.text: dhātā rayim avidasyaṃ sadāsāṃ sakṣīmahi yujyebhir nu devaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Dhātṛ</s> grant inexhaustible wealth for all time; may we now attain it with the gods who are yoked with us.

children.text: nū rodasī abhiṣṭute vasiṣṭhair ṛtāvāno varuṇo mitro agniḥ
children.translated_text: Now let the two worlds, praised by the <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s>, and the order-keeping <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: yacchantu candrā upamaṃ no arkaṃ yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: bright ones, bestow upon us unsurpassed song; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 556
o śruṣṭir vidathyā sam etu prati stomaṃ dadhīmahi turāṇām
children.translated_text: May ready hearing come together in the assembly; we set our praise before the swift ones.

children.text: yad adya devaḥ savitā suvāti syāmāsya ratnino vibhāge ||
children.translated_text: When today the god <s>Savitṛ</s> impels, may we have a share in the portioning of his treasures.

children.text: mitras tan no varuṇo rodasī ca dyubhaktam indro aryamā dadātu
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and the two worlds give that to us; may <s>Indra</s> and <s>Aryaman</s> give the heaven-allotted share.

children.text: dideṣṭu devy aditī rekṇo vāyuś ca yan niyuvaite bhagaś ca ||
children.translated_text: May the goddess <s>Aditi</s> assign wealth; and may <s>Vāyu</s> and <s>Bhaga</s> assign what is joined to their teams.

children.text: sed ugro astu marutaḥ sa śuṣmī yam martyam pṛṣadaśvā avātha
children.translated_text: Let that mortal be mighty and strong, O <s>Maruts</s> with spotted horses, whom you protect.

children.text: utem agniḥ sarasvatī junanti na tasya rāyaḥ paryetāsti ||
children.translated_text: And <s>Agni</s> and <s>Sarasvatī</s> urge him on; there is no limit to his riches.

children.text: ayaṃ hi netā varuṇa ṛtasya mitro rājāno aryamāpo dhuḥ
children.translated_text: For <s>Varuṇa</s> is the guide of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order); <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, and the Waters are kings.

children.text: suhavā devy aditir anarvā te no aṃho ati parṣann ariṣṭān ||
children.translated_text: The easily invoked goddess <s>Aditi</s> is unhindered; may they carry us, uninjured, beyond distress.

children.text: asya devasya mīﾱhuṣo vayā viṣṇor eṣasya prabhṛthe havirbhiḥ
children.translated_text: With offerings, at the presentation for this bounteous god, for this vigorous <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: vide hi rudro rudriyam mahitvaṃ yāsiṣṭaṃ vartir aśvināv irāvat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Rudra</s> indeed knows his Rudrian greatness; may you two <s>Aśvins</s> take the path rich in refreshment.

children.text: mātra pūṣann āghṛṇa irasyo varūtrī yad rātiṣācaś ca rāsan
children.translated_text: O <s>Pūṣan</s>, glowing one, and O sheltering power, may the gift-accompanying powers grant nourishment.

children.text: mayobhuvo no arvanto ni pāntu vṛṣṭim parijmā vāto dadātu ||
children.translated_text: May our joy-bringing coursers protect us; may the wind that ranges around give rain.

children.text: nū rodasī abhiṣṭute vasiṣṭhair ṛtāvāno varuṇo mitro agniḥ
children.translated_text: Now let the two worlds, praised by the <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s>, and the order-keeping <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: yacchantu candrā upamaṃ no arkaṃ yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: bright ones, bestow upon us unsurpassed song; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 557
prātar agnim prātar indraṃ havāmahe prātar mitrāvaruṇā prātar aśvinā
children.translated_text: At morning we call <s>Agni</s>; at morning <s>Indra</s>; at morning <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; at morning the <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: prātar bhagam pūṣaṇam brahmaṇas patim prātaḥ somam uta rudraṃ huvema ||
children.translated_text: At morning let us invoke <s>Bhaga</s>, <s>Pūṣan</s>, <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, and at morning <s>Soma</s> and <s>Rudra</s> too.

children.text: prātarjitam bhagam ugraṃ huvema vayam putram aditer yo vidhartā
children.translated_text: At morning we call mighty <s>Bhaga</s>, conqueror at daybreak, son of <s>Aditi</s>, who is the supporter.

children.text: ādhraś cid yam manyamānas turaś cid rājā cid yam bhagam bhakṣīty āha ||
children.translated_text: Even the poor man, even the active man, even the king says of him, '<s>Bhaga</s> will let me partake.'

children.text: bhaga praṇetar bhaga satyarādho bhagemāṃ dhiyam ud avā dadan naḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Bhaga</s>, guide, O <s>Bhaga</s> whose gifts are true, raise up this thought for us, giving favor.

children.text: bhaga pra ṇo janaya gobhir aśvair bhaga pra nṛbhir nṛvantaḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Bhaga</s>, bring us forth with cattle and horses; O <s>Bhaga</s>, may we be rich in men and heroes.

children.text: utedānīm bhagavantaḥ syāmota prapitva uta madhye ahnām
children.translated_text: And now may we be possessed of <s>Bhaga</s> (good fortune), both at the first approach and in the midst of the days.

children.text: utoditā maghavan sūryasya vayaṃ devānāṃ sumatau syāma ||
children.translated_text: And at the rising of the bountiful <s>Sūrya</s>, may we be in the gracious favor of the gods.

children.text: bhaga eva bhagavāṁ astu devās tena vayam bhagavantaḥ syāma
children.translated_text: May <s>Bhaga</s> himself be fortunate, O gods; through him may we become fortunate.

children.text: taṃ tvā bhaga sarva ij johavīti sa no bhaga puraetā bhaveha ||
children.translated_text: All people here call upon you, O <s>Bhaga</s>; be our leader in front here, O <s>Bhaga</s>.

children.text: sam adhvarāyoṣaso namanta dadhikrāveva śucaye padāya
children.translated_text: Let the dawns bow together toward the sacrifice, as <s>Dadhikrāvan</s> bends toward the shining track.

children.text: arvācīnaṃ vasuvidam bhagaṃ no ratham ivāśvā vājina ā vahantu ||
children.translated_text: May strong horses, like a chariot, bring hither to us <s>Bhaga</s>, the finder of wealth.

children.text: aśvāvatīr gomatīr na uṣāso vīravatīḥ sadam ucchantu bhadrāḥ
children.translated_text: May the auspicious dawns rise for us always, rich in horses, rich in cattle, rich in heroes.

children.text: ghṛtaṃ duhānā viśvataḥ prapītā yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Milking ghee, filled everywhere with drink; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 558
pra brahmāṇo aṅgiraso nakṣanta pra krandanur nabhanyasya vetu
children.translated_text: May the priests, the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, advance; may the roaring voice of the cloud go forth.

children.text: pra dhenava udapruto navanta yujyātām adrī adhvarasya peśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the water-filled cows low forth; let the two pressing stones be yoked, the adornment of the rite.

children.text: sugas te agne sanavitto adhvā yukṣvā sute harito rohitaś ca
children.translated_text: Your path, O <s>Agni</s>, known from of old, is easy to travel; yoke the bay and ruddy horses to the pressed draught.

children.text: ye vā sadmann aruṣā vīravāho huve devānāṃ janimāni sattaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Or those reddish ones that are in your seat, bearers of heroes; seated, I call upon the births of the gods.

children.text: sam u vo yajñam mahayan namobhiḥ pra hotā mandro ririca upāke
children.translated_text: Together I magnify your sacrifice with reverences; the cheerful <s>Hotṛ</s> has shone forth nearby.

children.text: yajasva su purvaṇīka devān ā yajñiyām aramatiṃ vavṛtyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Sacrifice well, O many-faced one, to the gods; turn the worshipful devotion toward us.

children.text: yadā vīrasya revato duroṇe syonaśīr atithir āciketat
children.translated_text: When, in the house of a wealthy hero, the gracious guest has made himself known,

children.text: suprīto agniḥ sudhito dama ā sa viśe dāti vāryam iyatyai ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, well pleased and well kindled in the home, gives desirable wealth to the clan for its going forward.

children.text: imaṃ no agne adhvaraṃ juṣasva marutsv indre yaśasaṃ kṛdhī naḥ
children.translated_text: Accept this rite of ours, O <s>Agni</s>; among the <s>Maruts</s> and <s>Indra</s>, make us glorious.

children.text: ā naktā barhiḥ sadatām uṣāsośantā mitrāvaruṇā yajeha ||
children.translated_text: Let Night and the Dawns sit upon the sacred grass; desiring favor, I sacrifice here to <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: evāgniṃ sahasyaṃ vasiṣṭho rāyaskāmo viśvapsnyasya staut
children.translated_text: Thus <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, desiring wealth, praised powerful <s>Agni</s>, lord of all abundance.

children.text: iṣaṃ rayim paprathad vājam asme yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May he extend nourishment, wealth, and prize-winning strength for us; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 559
pra vo yajñeṣu devayanto arcan dyāvā namobhiḥ pṛthivī iṣadhyai
children.translated_text: Desiring the gods, the priests have worshipped you in sacrifices; with reverences they worshipped Heaven and Earth for refreshment.

children.text: yeṣām brahmāṇy asamāni viprā viṣvag viyanti vanino na śākhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Their matchless prayers, O inspired ones, go in every direction, like the branches of forest trees.

children.text: pra yajña etu hetvo na saptir ud yacchadhvaṃ samanaso ghṛtācīḥ
children.translated_text: Let the sacrifice go forth like a swift horse to its goal; raise yourselves with one mind, dripping with ghee.

children.text: stṛṇīta barhir adhvarāya sādhūrdhvā śocīṃṣi devayūny asthuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Spread the sacred grass well for the rite; the flames that seek the gods have stood upright.

children.text: ā putrāso na mātaraṃ vibhṛtrāḥ sānau devāso barhiṣaḥ sadantu
children.translated_text: Like sons around a nourishing mother, may the gods sit on the height of the sacred grass.

children.text: ā viśvācī vidathyām anaktv agne mā no devatātā mṛdhas kaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the all-facing one anoint us in the assembly; O <s>Agni</s>, let no assailant harm us in the divine rite.

children.text: te sīṣapanta joṣam ā yajatrā ṛtasya dhārāḥ sudughā duhānāḥ
children.translated_text: The worshipful ones sit eagerly at the sacrifice, milking the well-milking streams of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: jyeṣṭhaṃ vo adya maha ā vasūnām ā gantana samanaso yati ṣṭha ||
children.translated_text: Come here today, of one mind, greatest among the great treasures, and stand by the worshipper.

children.text: evā no agne vikṣv ā daśasya tvayā vayaṃ sahasāvann āskrāḥ
children.translated_text: Thus, O <s>Agni</s>, show favor to us among the clans; with you, O powerful one, may we be unharmed.

children.text: rāyā yujā sadhamādo ariṣṭā yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Joined with wealth, rejoicing together and uninjured; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 560
dadhikrāṃ vaḥ prathamam aśvinoṣasam agniṃ samiddham bhagam ūtaye huve
children.translated_text: For aid I call first for you <s>Dadhikrāvan</s>, the <s>Aśvins</s>, <s>Uṣas</s>, kindled <s>Agni</s>, and <s>Bhaga</s>.

children.text: indraṃ viṣṇum pūṣaṇam brahmaṇas patim ādityān dyāvāpṛthivī apaḥ svaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>Pūṣan</s>, <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, the <s>Ādityas</s>, Heaven and Earth, the Waters, and heaven itself.

children.text: dadhikrām u namasā bodhayanta udīrāṇā yajñam upaprayantaḥ
children.translated_text: Awakening <s>Dadhikrāvan</s> with reverence, rising up and approaching the <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice),

children.text: iﾱāṃ devīm barhiṣi sādayanto 'śvinā viprā suhavā huvema ||
children.translated_text: seating the goddess <s>Iḍā</s> upon the sacred grass, we inspired priests would call upon the readily invoked <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: dadhikrāvāṇam bubudhāno agnim upa bruva uṣasaṃ sūryaṃ gām
children.translated_text: Awakening <s>Dadhikrāvan</s>, I address <s>Agni</s>, the Dawn, <s>Sūrya</s>, the cow,

children.text: bradhnam māṃścator varuṇasya babhruṃ te viśvāsmad duritā yāvayantu ||
children.translated_text: the bright one, the tawny one of <s>Varuṇa</s>; may they drive all evils away from us.

children.text: dadhikrāvā prathamo vājy arvāgre rathānām bhavati prajānan
children.translated_text: <s>Dadhikrāvan</s>, the first prize-winning courser, becomes foremost among chariots, fully aware,

children.text: saṃvidāna uṣasā sūryeṇādityebhir vasubhir aṅgirobhiḥ ||
