children.translated_text: in accord with Dawn and <s>Sūrya</s>, with the <s>Ādityas</s>, the <s>Vasus</s>, and the <s>Aṅgirases</s>.

children.text: ā no dadhikrāḥ pathyām anaktv ṛtasya panthām anvetavā u
children.translated_text: May <s>Dadhikrāvan</s> anoint for us the passable way, the path of <s>ṛta</s> (sacred order), to be followed onward.

children.text: śṛṇotu no daivyaṃ śardho agniḥ śṛṇvantu viśve mahiṣā amūrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the divine host, <s>Agni</s>, hear us; may all the great, unwasting ones hear us.

children.text: Chapter 561
ā devo yātu savitā suratno 'ntarikṣaprā vahamāno aśvaiḥ
children.translated_text: Let the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, rich in good gifts, come here, borne by horses that reach through the midspace,

children.text: haste dadhāno naryā purūṇi niveśayañca prasuvañca bhūma ||
children.translated_text: holding many manly treasures in his hand, settling the earth and setting it in motion.

children.text: ud asya bāhū śithirā bṛhantā hiraṇyayā divo antāṁ anaṣṭām
children.translated_text: His loose, great, golden arms have stretched out to the ends of heaven.

children.text: nūnaṃ so asya mahimā paniṣṭa sūraś cid asmā anu dād apasyām ||
children.translated_text: Now may his greatness be praised; even <s>Sūra</s> has yielded his activity to him.

children.text: sa ghā no devaḥ savitā sahāvā sāviṣad vasupatir vasūni
children.translated_text: May that god <s>Savitṛ</s>, powerful and lord of goods, impel riches for us,

children.text: viśrayamāṇo amatim urūcīm martabhojanam adha rāsate naḥ ||
children.translated_text: spreading wide freedom from want; then he bestows on us nourishment fit for mortals.

children.text: imā giraḥ savitāraṃ sujihvam pūrṇagabhastim īﾱate supāṇim
children.translated_text: These songs praise <s>Savitṛ</s>, fair-tongued, full-handed, and beautiful-handed.

children.text: citraṃ vayo bṛhad asme dadhātu yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May he place brilliant, great vitality among us; all of you, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 562
imā rudrāya sthiradhanvane giraḥ kṣipreṣave devāya svadhāvne
children.translated_text: Bring these songs to <s>Rudra</s>, the firm-bowed god with swift arrows and self-power,

children.text: aṣāﾱhāya sahamānāya vedhase tigmāyudhāya bharatā śṛṇotu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: to the unconquered, overpowering maker, sharp-weaponed and fierce; may he hear us.

children.text: sa hi kṣayeṇa kṣamyasya janmanaḥ sāmrājyena divyasya cetati
children.translated_text: For through the dwelling of earthly birth and through the sovereignty of heavenly birth he is attentive.

children.text: avann avantīr upa no duraś carānamīvo rudra jāsu no bhava ||
children.translated_text: Protecting those who protect, come near us from difficult paths; O <s>Rudra</s>, be free of sickness among our people.

children.text: yā te didyud avasṛṣṭā divas pari kṣmayā carati pari sā vṛṇaktu naḥ
children.translated_text: May that missile of yours, released from heaven and ranging over the earth, pass around us and spare us.

children.text: sahasraṃ te svapivāta bheṣajā mā nas tokeṣu tanayeṣu rīriṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You have a thousand medicines, O well-aiding one; do not harm our children or descendants.

children.text: mā no vadhī rudra mā parā dā mā te bhūma prasitau hīﾱitasya
children.translated_text: Do not strike us, O <s>Rudra</s>; do not abandon us; let us not fall into the snare of one who has been angered.

children.text: ā no bhaja barhiṣi jīvaśaṃse yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Grant us a share here at the sacred grass, with praise that sustains life; all of you, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 563
āpo yaṃ vaḥ prathamaṃ devayanta indrapānam ūrmim akṛṇvateﾱaḥ
children.translated_text: O Waters, that first wave of yours, made divine and fit for <s>Indra</s>'s drinking,

children.text: taṃ vo vayaṃ śucim aripram adya ghṛtapruṣam madhumantaṃ vanema ||
children.translated_text: that pure, harmless, ghee-sprinkled, honeyed wave we would win for ourselves today.

children.text: tam ūrmim āpo madhumattamaṃ vo 'pāṃ napād avatv āśuhemā
children.translated_text: May <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s>, swift in help, protect that sweetest wave of yours, O Waters,

children.text: yasminn indro vasubhir mādayāte tam aśyāma devayanto vo adya ||
children.translated_text: in which <s>Indra</s> rejoices with the <s>Vasus</s>; seeking the gods, may we attain it today.

children.text: śatapavitrāḥ svadhayā madantīr devīr devānām api yanti pāthaḥ
children.translated_text: Purified through a hundred filters, rejoicing by their own power, the divine Waters follow the paths of the gods.

children.text: tā indrasya na minanti vratāni sindhubhyo havyaṃ ghṛtavaj juhota ||
children.translated_text: They do not transgress <s>Indra</s>'s ordinances; offer the ghee-rich oblation to the rivers.

children.text: yāḥ sūryo raśmibhir ātatāna yābhya indro aradad gātum ūrmim
children.translated_text: Those waters which <s>Sūrya</s> stretched out with his rays, for which <s>Indra</s> opened a course, a wave to move in,

children.text: te sindhavo varivo dhātanā no yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: may those rivers grant us wide space; all of you, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 564
ṛbhukṣaṇo vājā mādayadhvam asme naro maghavānaḥ sutasya
children.translated_text: O <s>Ṛbhukṣans</s>, O <s>Vājas</s>, rejoice for us, generous men, in the pressed Soma.

children.text: ā vo 'rvācaḥ kratavo na yātāṃ vibhvo rathaṃ naryaṃ vartayantu ||
children.translated_text: May your purposes come toward us from nearby; let <s>Vibhvan</s> set the manly chariot in motion.

children.text: ṛbhur ṛbhubhir abhi vaḥ syāma vibhvo vibhubhiḥ śavasā śavāṃsi
children.translated_text: May we be with <s>Ṛbhu</s> among the <s>Ṛbhus</s>, and with <s>Vibhvan</s> among the <s>Vibhus</s>, strength matched with strengths.

children.text: vājo asmāṁ avatu vājasātāv indreṇa yujā taruṣema vṛtram ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Vāja</s> protect us in the winning of prizes; yoked with <s>Indra</s>, may we overcome <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: te ciddhi pūrvīr abhi santi śāsā viśvāṁ arya uparatāti vanvan
children.translated_text: For even they stand over many commands, winning every thing for the noble one when obstruction has ceased.

children.text: indro vibhvāṁ ṛbhukṣā vājo aryaḥ śatror mithatyā kṛṇavan vi nṛmṇam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, <s>Vibhvan</s>, <s>Ṛbhukṣan</s>, and noble <s>Vāja</s> will shatter the enemy's manly power in contest.

children.text: nū devāso varivaḥ kartanā no bhūta no viśve 'vase sajoṣāḥ
children.translated_text: Now, O gods, make wide room for us; all of you, be united for our aid.

children.text: sam asme iṣaṃ vasavo dadīran yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the <s>Vasus</s> together grant us refreshment; all of you, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 565
samudrajyeṣṭhāḥ salilasya madhyāt punānā yanty aniviśamānāḥ
children.translated_text: Having the ocean as their eldest, purifying themselves from the midst of the waters, they go on without settling down.

children.text: indro yā vajrī vṛṣabho rarāda tā āpo devīr iha mām avantu ||
children.translated_text: Those whom <s>Indra</s>, the thunderbolt-bearing bull, opened up, may those divine Waters protect me here.

children.text: yā āpo divyā uta vā sravanti khanitrimā uta vā yāḥ svayañjāḥ
children.translated_text: Those Waters that are heavenly, and those that flow, those dug out, and those that arise by themselves,

children.text: samudrārthā yāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakās tā āpo devīr iha mām avantu ||
children.translated_text: those pure and cleansing ones whose goal is the ocean: may those divine Waters protect me here.

children.text: yāsāṃ rājā varuṇo yāti madhye satyānṛte avapaśyañ janānām
children.translated_text: Those among whom king <s>Varuṇa</s> moves, watching the truth and falsehood of human beings,

children.text: madhuścutaḥ śucayo yāḥ pāvakās tā āpo devīr iha mām avantu ||
children.translated_text: those honey-dripping, pure, cleansing Waters: may those divine Waters protect me here.

children.text: yāsu rājā varuṇo yāsu somo viśve devā yāsūrjam madanti
children.translated_text: Those in whom king <s>Varuṇa</s> is, in whom <s>Soma</s> is, in whom all the gods rejoice in nourishment,

children.text: vaiśvānaro yāsv agniḥ praviṣṭas tā āpo devīr iha mām avantu ||
children.translated_text: those into whom <s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s> has entered: may those divine Waters protect me here.

children.text: Chapter 566
ā mām mitrāvaruṇeha rakṣataṃ kulāyayad viśvayan mā na ā gan
children.translated_text: O <s>Mitra-Varuṇa</s>, protect me here; let the lair-making, all-pervading one not come upon us.

children.text: ajakāvaṃ durdṛśīkaṃ tiro dadhe mā mām padyena rapasā vidat tsaruḥ ||
children.translated_text: I set aside the ill-looking <s>Ajakāva</s>; may the harmful splinter not find me with foot-injury.

children.text: yad vijāman paruṣi vandanam bhuvad aṣṭhīvantau pari kulphau ca dehat
children.translated_text: If a binding or swelling should arise in the joint or limb, and should burn around the bones and ankles,

children.text: agniṣ ṭacchocann apa bādhatām ito mā mām padyena rapasā vidat tsaruḥ ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Agni</s>, blazing, drive it away from here; may the harmful splinter not find me with foot-injury.

children.text: yacchalmalau bhavati yan nadīṣu yad oṣadhībhyaḥ pari jāyate viṣam
children.translated_text: Whatever poison is in the śalmali trees, whatever is in the rivers, whatever is born from the plants,

children.text: viśve devā nir itas tat suvantu mā mām padyena rapasā vidat tsaruḥ ||
children.translated_text: may all the gods send that away from here; may the harmful splinter not find me with foot-injury.

children.text: yāḥ pravato nivata udvata udanvatīr anudakāś ca yāḥ
children.translated_text: Those waters that are on slopes, in lowlands, on heights, in watery places, and those without water,

children.text: tā asmabhyam payasā pinvamānāḥ śivā devīr aśipadā bhavantu sarvā nadyo aśimidā bhavantu ||
children.translated_text: may they, swelling with milk for us, be auspicious goddesses, free from foot-harm; may all rivers be free from injury.

children.text: Chapter 567
ādityānām avasā nūtanena sakṣīmahi śarmaṇā śantamena
children.translated_text: By the new aid of the <s>Ādityas</s> may we attain the most peaceful shelter.

children.text: anāgāstve adititve turāsa imaṃ yajñaṃ dadhatu śroṣamāṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: In guiltlessness, in the freedom of <s>Aditi</s>, may the swift ones, listening, uphold this <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice).

children.text: ādityāso aditir mādayantām mitro aryamā varuṇo rajiṣṭhāḥ
children.translated_text: May the <s>Ādityas</s> and <s>Aditi</s> gladden us, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s>, the most straight-guiding ones.

children.text: asmākaṃ santu bhuvanasya gopāḥ pibantu somam avase no adya ||
children.translated_text: May they be guardians of our world; may they drink the <s>Soma</s> for our aid today.

children.text: ādityā viśve marutaś ca viśve devāś ca viśva ṛbhavaś ca viśve
children.translated_text: All the <s>Ādityas</s>, and all the <s>Maruts</s>, all the gods, and all the <s>Ṛbhus</s>,

children.text: indro agnir aśvinā tuṣṭuvānā yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, <s>Agni</s>, and the <s>Aśvins</s>, being praised: all of you, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 568
ādityāso aditayaḥ syāma pūr devatrā vasavo martyatrā
children.translated_text: O <s>Ādityas</s>, may we be of <s>Aditi</s>; may we be a stronghold among the gods, and <s>Vasus</s> among mortals.

children.text: sanema mitrāvaruṇā sananto bhavema dyāvāpṛthivī bhavantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we win, O <s>Mitra-Varuṇa</s>, while still winning; may we become, O <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> (Heaven and Earth), under your favor.

children.text: mitras tan no varuṇo māmahanta śarma tokāya tanayāya gopāḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, guardians, enlarge that shelter for us, for child and for offspring.

children.text: mā vo bhujemānyajātam eno mā tat karma vasavo yac cayadhve ||
children.translated_text: May we not partake of sin born from another; may that deed not be ours, O <s>Vasus</s>, which you would punish.

children.text: turaṇyavo 'ṅgiraso nakṣanta ratnaṃ devasya savitur iyānāḥ
children.translated_text: The swift <s>Angirases</s>, going toward the treasure of the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, have approached it.

children.text: pitā ca tan no mahān yajatro viśve devāḥ samanaso juṣanta ||
children.translated_text: And may that great worshipful father, together with all the gods of one mind, accept it for us.

children.text: Chapter 569
pra dyāvā yajñaiḥ pṛthivī namobhiḥ sabādha īﾱe bṛhatī yajatre
children.translated_text: With sacrifices and acts of homage I call upon <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> (Heaven and Earth), the broad, worshipful pair, free from oppression.

children.text: te ciddhi pūrve kavayo gṛṇantaḥ puro mahī dadhire devaputre ||
children.translated_text: For the former inspired seers, praising them, placed the two great daughters of the gods in front.

children.text: pra pūrvaje pitarā navyasībhir gīrbhiḥ kṛṇudhvaṃ sadane ṛtasya
children.translated_text: For the primeval parents, make praise with newer songs in the seat of <s>ṛta</s> (sacred order).

children.text: ā no dyāvāpṛthivī daivyena janena yātam mahi vāṃ varūtham ||
children.translated_text: Come to us, O <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> (Heaven and Earth), with the divine host; great is your shelter.

children.text: uto hi vāṃ ratnadheyāni santi purūṇi dyāvāpṛthivī sudāse
children.translated_text: For indeed you have many deposits of treasure, O <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> (Heaven and Earth), for <s>Sudās</s>.

children.text: asme dhattaṃ yad asad askṛdhoyu yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Place in us whatever will be unharmed and inexhaustible; all of you, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 570
vāstoṣpate prati jānīhy asmān svāveśo anamīvo bhavā naḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāstoṣpati</s>, recognize us; be easy of entrance and free from sickness for us.

children.text: yat tvemahe prati tan no juṣasva śaṃ no bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||
children.translated_text: What we ask of you, accept that for us; be welfare for our two-footed and welfare for our four-footed.

children.text: vāstoṣpate prataraṇo na edhi gayasphāno gobhir aśvebhir indo
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāstoṣpati</s>, be our deliverer, increaser of household life with cows and horses, O bright one.

children.text: ajarāsas te sakhye syāma piteva putrān prati no juṣasva ||
children.translated_text: May we be ageless in your friendship; like a father with his sons, accept us.

children.text: vāstoṣpate śagmayā saṃsadā te sakṣīmahi raṇvayā gātumatyā
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāstoṣpati</s>, may we attain your auspicious assembly, delightful and rich in paths.

children.text: pāhi kṣema uta yoge varaṃ no yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Guard our security and also our acquisition; choose what is best for us. All of you, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 571
amīvahā vāstoṣpate viśvā rūpāṇy āviśan
children.translated_text: O disease-slayer <s>Vāstoṣpati</s>, entering all forms,

children.text: sakhā suśeva edhi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: be our well-disposed friend, easy to approach.

children.text: yad arjuna sārameya dataḥ piśaṅga yacchase
children.translated_text: When, O tawny <s>Arjuna Sārameya</s>, you bare your teeth,

children.text: vīva bhrājanta ṛṣṭaya upa srakveṣu bapsato ni ṣu svapa ||
children.translated_text: your spears gleam as you snap among the jaws; settle down and sleep.

children.text: stenaṃ rāya sārameya taskaraṃ vā punaḥsara
children.translated_text: Run after the thief, O <s>Sārameya</s>, or the robber; then turn back again.

children.text: stotṝn indrasya rāyasi kim asmān ducchunāyase ni ṣu svapa ||
children.translated_text: You run at the praisers of <s>Indra</s>; why do you bark at us, bad dog? Settle down and sleep.

children.text: tvaṃ sūkarasya dardṛhi tava dardartu sūkaraḥ
children.translated_text: Tear at the boar; let the boar tear at you.

children.text: stotṝn indrasya rāyasi kim asmān ducchunāyase ni ṣu svapa ||
children.translated_text: You run at the praisers of <s>Indra</s>; why do you bark at us, bad dog? Settle down and sleep.

children.text: sastu mātā sastu pitā sastu śvā sastu viśpatiḥ
children.translated_text: Let the mother sleep, let the father sleep, let the dog sleep, let the lord of the settlement sleep.

children.text: sasantu sarve jñātayaḥ sastv ayam abhito janaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let all the kinsmen sleep; let this whole people round about sleep.

children.text: ya āste yaś ca carati yaś ca paśyati no janaḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever sits, whoever walks, and whatever person sees us,

children.text: teṣāṃ saṃ hanmo akṣāṇi yathedaṃ harmyaṃ tathā ||
children.translated_text: we close their eyes together, as this mansion is still, so let them be.

children.text: sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabho yaḥ samudrād udācarat
children.translated_text: The thousand-horned bull that rose up from the ocean,

children.text: tenā sahasyenā vayaṃ ni janān svāpayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: with that mighty one we put the people to sleep.

children.text: proṣṭheśayā vahyeśayā nārīr yās talpaśīvarīḥ
children.translated_text: Those women who sleep on the porch, who sleep in the wagon, who lie on couches,

children.text: striyo yāḥ puṇyagandhās tāḥ sarvāḥ svāpayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: the women who have lovely fragrance: all of them we put to sleep.

children.text: Chapter 572
ka īṃ vyaktā naraḥ sanīﾱā rudrasya maryā adha svaśvāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Who indeed are they, manifest as men, sharing one nest, the young heroes of <s>Rudra</s>, and well-horsed?

children.text: nakir hy eṣāṃ janūṃṣi veda te aṅga vidre mitho janitram ||
children.translated_text: For no one knows their births; they themselves know one another's birthplace.

children.text: abhi svapūbhir mitho vapanta vātasvanasaḥ śyenā aspṛdhran ||
children.translated_text: With their own adornments they shake one another; sounding like winds, the eagles have contended.

children.text: etāni dhīro niṇyā ciketa pṛśnir yad ūdho mahī jabhāra ||
children.translated_text: The wise one has perceived these secret things, when <s>Pṛśni</s> bore her great udder.

children.text: sā viṭ suvīrā marudbhir astu sanāt sahantī puṣyantī nṛmṇam ||
children.translated_text: May that clan be rich in heroes with the <s>Maruts</s>, overcoming from of old and nourishing manly strength.

children.text: yāmaṃ yeṣṭhāḥ śubhā śobhiṣṭhāḥ śriyā sammiślā ojobhir ugrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the best go forth, bright, most splendid, mingled with beauty, fierce with powers,

children.text: ugraṃ va oja sthirā śavāṃsy adhā marudbhir gaṇas tuviṣmān ||
children.translated_text: fierce is your force and firm are your strengths; therefore the troop with the <s>Maruts</s> is mighty.

children.text: śubhro vaḥ śuṣmaḥ krudhmī manāṃsi dhunir munir iva śardhasya dhṛṣṇoḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bright is your impetuous power; wrathful are the minds of the bold host, shaking like an inspired <s>muni</s> (seer).

children.text: sanemy asmad yuyota didyum mā vo durmatir iha praṇaṅ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May I win; keep the missile away from us. Let not your ill-will come upon us here.

children.text: priyā vo nāma huve turāṇām ā yat tṛpan maruto vāvaśānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: I call the dear names of you swift ones, when, longing for delight, O <s>Maruts</s>, you seek satisfaction.

children.text: svāyudhāsa iṣmiṇaḥ suniṣkā uta svayaṃ tanvaḥ śumbhamānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: With your own weapons, impetuous, wearing fine necklaces, and adorning your own bodies,

children.text: śucī vo havyā marutaḥ śucīnāṃ śuciṃ hinomy adhvaraṃ śucibhyaḥ
children.translated_text: pure are your offerings, O pure <s>Maruts</s>; I send a pure rite to the pure ones.

children.text: ṛtena satyam ṛtasāpa āyañchucijanmānaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ ||
children.translated_text: By <s>ṛta</s> (sacred order) they attained truth, protectors of <s>ṛta</s>, pure-born, pure, and purifying.

children.text: aṃseṣv ā marutaḥ khādayo vo vakṣassu rukmā upaśiśriyāṇāḥ
children.translated_text: On your shoulders, O <s>Maruts</s>, are your ornaments; on your breasts golden plates have settled.

children.text: vi vidyuto na vṛṣṭibhī rucānā anu svadhām āyudhair yacchamānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Shining like lightnings with rains, following your own law, stretching yourselves out with weapons.

children.text: pra budhnyā va īrate mahāṃsi pra nāmāni prayajyavas tiradhvam
children.translated_text: Your great powers from the depth are set in motion; stretch forth your names, O worshipful ones.

children.text: sahasriyaṃ damyam bhāgam etaṃ gṛhamedhīyam maruto juṣadhvam ||
children.translated_text: Enjoy this thousandfold household share, this domestic portion, O <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: yadi stutasya maruto adhīthetthā viprasya vājino havīman
children.translated_text: If, O <s>Maruts</s>, you take thought in this way for the praised invocation of the inspired, vigorous poet,

children.text: makṣū rāyaḥ suvīryasya dāta nū cid yam anya ādabhad arāvā ||
children.translated_text: quickly give wealth and good heroism, even now, which another ungenerous man has withheld.

children.text: atyāso na ye marutaḥ svañco yakṣadṛśo na śubhayanta maryāḥ
children.translated_text: Like racehorses, O <s>Maruts</s>, self-turning; like wondrous young men, they adorn themselves.

children.text: te harmyeṣṭhāḥ śiśavo na śubhrā vatsāso na prakrīﾱinaḥ payodhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They are bright like children dwelling in the house, like calves playing at the milk-giving udder.

children.text: daśasyanto no maruto mṛﾱantu varivasyanto rodasī sumeke
children.translated_text: Giving gifts to us, O <s>Maruts</s>, let them be gracious, honoring <s>Rodasī</s> (Heaven and Earth), fair in form.

children.text: āre gohā nṛhā vadho vo astu sumnebhir asme vasavo namadhvam ||
children.translated_text: Far away be your blow that slays cattle and men; with gracious favors, O <s>Vasus</s>, bow down toward us.

children.text: ā vo hotā johavīti sattaḥ satrācīṃ rātim maruto gṛṇānaḥ
children.translated_text: The seated <s>Hotṛ</s> calls aloud to you, praising the <s>Maruts</s> for a gift that comes straight to the rite.

children.text: ya īvato vṛṣaṇo asti gopāḥ so advayāvī havate va ukthaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: He who is the guardian of the active, vigorous ones, free from double-dealing, calls you with hymns.

children.text: ime turam maruto rāmayantīme sahaḥ sahasa ā namanti
children.translated_text: These <s>Maruts</s> gladden the swift one; these powers bow down before strength.

children.text: ime śaṃsaṃ vanuṣyato ni pānti guru dveṣo araruṣe dadhanti ||
children.translated_text: These protect the praise from the hostile man; they set heavy hatred upon the ungenerous foe.

children.text: ime radhraṃ cin maruto junanti bhṛmiṃ cid yathā vasavo juṣanta
children.translated_text: These <s>Maruts</s> quicken even the poor man; the <s>Vasus</s> favor even the faltering one.

children.text: apa bādhadhvaṃ vṛṣaṇas tamāṃsi dhatta viśvaṃ tanayaṃ tokam asme ||
children.translated_text: Drive away the darknesses, O bulls; place every son and offspring among us.

children.text: mā vo dātrān maruto nir arāma mā paścād daghma rathyo vibhāge
children.translated_text: Let us not be excluded from your gifts, O <s>Maruts</s>; let us not be burned behind, when the chariot-share is divided.

children.text: ā na spārhe bhajatanā vasavye yad īṃ sujātaṃ vṛṣaṇo vo asti ||
children.translated_text: Share with us in desirable treasure, O <s>Vasus</s>, whatever well-born good of yours there is, O bulls.

children.text: saṃ yaddhananta manyubhir janāsaḥ śūrā yahvīṣv oṣadhīṣu vikṣu
children.translated_text: When men strike together in their rages, heroes among the mighty clans and living growths,

children.text: adha smā no maruto rudriyāsas trātāro bhūta pṛtanāsv aryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: then, O <s>Maruts</s>, sons of <s>Rudra</s>, be our rescuing protectors, allies in battles.

children.text: bhūri cakra marutaḥ pitryāṇy ukthāni yā vaḥ śasyante purā cit
children.translated_text: Many ancestral deeds have you done, O <s>Maruts</s>, and many hymns were sung to you even of old.

children.text: marudbhir ugraḥ pṛtanāsu sāﾱhā marudbhir it sanitā vājam arvā ||
children.translated_text: With the <s>Maruts</s> the fierce one conquers in battles; with the <s>Maruts</s> the horse wins the prize.

children.text: asme vīro marutaḥ śuṣmy astu janānāṃ yo asuro vidhartā
children.translated_text: Let there be among us, O <s>Maruts</s>, a vigorous hero, one who, as lord, upholds the peoples,

children.text: apo yena sukṣitaye taremādha svam oko abhi vaḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: by whom we may cross the waters to good dwelling; then may we come into our own home before you.

children.text: tan na indro varuṇo mitro agnir āpa oṣadhīr vanino juṣanta
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Agni</s>, the Waters, the herbs, and the forest trees enjoy that for us.

children.text: śarman syāma marutām upasthe yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we be in shelter, in the lap of the <s>Maruts</s>; you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 573
madhvo vo nāma mārutaṃ yajatrāḥ pra yajñeṣu śavasā madanti
children.translated_text: Sweet as honey is your Marut name, O worshipful ones; in sacrifices they rejoice through power,

children.text: ye rejayanti rodasī cid urvī pinvanty utsaṃ yad ayāsur ugrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: they who make even the two broad worlds tremble and swell the spring when the fierce ones have gone forth.

children.text: nicetāro hi maruto gṛṇantam praṇetāro yajamānasya manma
children.translated_text: For the <s>Maruts</s> are discerners of the singer and leaders of the sacrificer's thought.

children.text: asmākam adya vidatheṣu barhir ā vītaye sadata pipriyāṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Today in our rites sit upon the sacred grass for refreshment, taking pleasure in us.

children.text: naitāvad anye maruto yatheme bhrājante rukmair āyudhais tanūbhiḥ
children.translated_text: There are no others like these <s>Maruts</s>, when they shine with gold ornaments, weapons, and bodies.

children.text: ā rodasī viśvapiśaḥ piśānāḥ samānam añjy añjate śubhe kam ||
children.translated_text: Adorning Heaven and Earth with every form, they anoint themselves with the same adornment for beauty.

children.text: ṛdhak sā vo maruto didyud astu yad va āgaḥ puruṣatā karāma
children.translated_text: Let your lightning be turned away from us, O <s>Maruts</s>, if through human nature we commit an offense against you.

children.text: mā vas tasyām api bhūmā yajatrā asme vo astu sumatiś caniṣṭhā ||
children.translated_text: May we not fall under that, O worshipful ones; may your nearest goodwill be ours.

children.text: kṛte cid atra maruto raṇantānavadyāsaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ
children.translated_text: Even when tumult is made here, O <s>Maruts</s>, the faultless, bright, purifying ones roar.

children.text: pra ṇo 'vata sumatibhir yajatrāḥ pra vājebhis tirata puṣyase naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Help us with favorable thoughts, O worshipful ones; carry us across with prizes for our thriving.

children.text: uta stutāso maruto vyantu viśvebhir nāmabhir naro havīṃṣi
children.translated_text: And, when praised, may the <s>Maruts</s>, the men, come to the oblations with all their names.

children.text: dadāta no amṛtasya prajāyai jigṛta rāyaḥ sūnṛtā maghāni ||
children.translated_text: Give us riches, truthful speech, and generous gifts for undying progeny; bestir yourselves.

children.text: ā stutāso maruto viśva ūtī acchā sūrīn sarvatātā jigāta
children.translated_text: Praised, O <s>Maruts</s>, come with every aid toward the patrons on every side.

children.text: ye nas tmanā śatino vardhayanti yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: They by their own power increase us a hundredfold; you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 574
pra sākamukṣe arcatā gaṇāya yo daivyasya dhāmnas tuviṣmān
children.translated_text: Sing forth together to the bounteous troop, which is mighty with divine power.

children.text: uta kṣodanti rodasī mahitvā nakṣante nākaṃ nirṛter avaṃśāt ||
children.translated_text: And by their greatness they shake Heaven and Earth; they reach the vault of heaven from the depth of ruin.

children.text: janūś cid vo marutas tveṣyeṇa bhīmāsas tuvimanyavo 'yāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Even your births, O <s>Maruts</s>, are terrifying with flashing force; you are fearsome, greatly wrathful, tireless ones.

children.text: pra ye mahobhir ojasota santi viśvo vo yāman bhayate svardṛk ||
children.translated_text: Those who with greatness and power surpass all; every being that sees the sunlight fears your march.

children.text: bṛhad vayo maghavadbhyo dadhāta jujoṣann in marutaḥ suṣṭutiṃ naḥ
children.translated_text: Set great vitality for the generous patrons, O <s>Maruts</s>, accepting our good praise.

children.text: gato nādhvā vi tirāti jantum pra ṇa spārhābhir ūtibhis tireta ||
children.translated_text: As a travelled road carries a person beyond, carry us over with desirable aids.

children.text: yuṣmoto vipro marutaḥ śatasvī yuṣmoto arvā sahuriḥ sahasrī
children.translated_text: From you, O <s>Maruts</s>, comes the inspired sage rich in hundreds; from you comes the victorious horse rich in thousands.

children.text: yuṣmotaḥ samrāﾱ uta hanti vṛtram pra tad vo astu dhūtayo deṣṇam ||
children.translated_text: From you the sovereign too smites <s>Vṛtra</s>; let that gift be yours, O shakers.

children.text: tāṁ ā rudrasya mīﾱhuṣo vivāse kuvin naṃsante marutaḥ punar naḥ
children.translated_text: I seek those <s>Maruts</s> of bounteous <s>Rudra</s>; perhaps they will turn back toward us again.

children.text: yat sasvartā jihīﾱire yad āvir ava tad ena īmahe turāṇām ||
children.translated_text: Whatever hidden offense they have grown angry at, whatever open one, for that guilt we implore the swift ones.

children.text: pra sā vāci suṣṭutir maghonām idaṃ sūktam maruto juṣanta
children.translated_text: Let this well-praised speech of the liberal patrons go forth; accept this hymn, O <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: ārāc cid dveṣo vṛṣaṇo yuyota yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Drive hatred far away, O bulls; you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 575
yaṃ trāyadhva idam idaṃ devāso yaṃ ca nayatha
children.translated_text: The one whom you protect again and again, O gods, and the one whom you lead,

children.text: tasmā agne varuṇa mitrāryaman marutaḥ śarma yacchata ||
children.translated_text: to him, O <s>Agni</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, and <s>Maruts</s>, grant shelter.

children.text: yuṣmākaṃ devā avasāhani priya ījānas tarati dviṣaḥ
children.translated_text: With your aid, O gods, the dear worshipper overcomes hatreds.

children.text: pra sa kṣayaṃ tirate vi mahīr iṣo yo vo varāya dāśati ||
children.translated_text: He advances his dwelling and great nourishments, he who worships you for favor.

children.text: nahi vaś caramaṃ cana vasiṣṭhaḥ parimaṃsate
children.translated_text: For <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> does not neglect even the least of your aids.

children.text: asmākam adya marutaḥ sute sacā viśve pibata kāminaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Today, together with our pressed Soma, O <s>Maruts</s>, all of you, eager, drink.

children.text: nahi va ūtiḥ pṛtanāsu mardhati yasmā arādhvaṃ naraḥ
children.translated_text: For your aid does not fail in battles, O men, for the one to whom you show favor.

children.text: abhi va āvart sumatir navīyasī tūyaṃ yāta pipīṣavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May your newer goodwill turn hither toward us; come quickly, eager to drink.

children.text: o ṣu ghṛṣvirādhaso yātanāndhāṃsi pītaye
children.translated_text: O you rich in bold gifts, come to drink the Soma-draughts.

children.text: imā vo havyā maruto rare hi kam mo ṣv anyatra gantana ||
children.translated_text: For these oblations have been offered to you, O <s>Maruts</s>; do not go anywhere else.

children.text: ā ca no barhiḥ sadatāvitā ca na spārhāṇi dātave vasu
children.translated_text: Come and sit upon our sacred grass; come also to give us desirable wealth.

children.text: asredhanto marutaḥ somye madhau svāheha mādayādhvai ||
children.translated_text: Unfailing, O <s>Maruts</s>, rejoice here with svāhā in the soma mead.

children.text: sasvaś ciddhi tanvaḥ śumbhamānā ā haṃsāso nīlapṛṣṭhā apaptan
children.translated_text: For always, adorning their bodies, they have flown here like swans with dark-blue backs.

children.text: viśvaṃ śardho abhito mā ni ṣeda naro na raṇvāḥ savane madantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The whole troop has settled around me on every side, the men rejoicing at the pressing as if in a joyful contest.

children.text: yo no maruto abhi durhṛṇāyus tiraś cittāni vasavo jighāṃsati
children.translated_text: Whoever, O <s>Maruts</s>, with hostile intent toward us, with crooked thoughts, O <s>Vasus</s>, wishes to slay us,

children.text: druhaḥ pāśān prati sa mucīṣṭa tapiṣṭhena hanmanā hantanā tam ||
children.translated_text: let him be given over to the snares of treachery; strike him down with your hottest weapon.

children.text: sāṃtapanā idaṃ havir marutas taj jujuṣṭana
children.translated_text: O scorchers, O <s>Maruts</s>, accept this oblation.

children.text: yuṣmākotī riśādasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With your aid, O destroyers of foes.

children.text: gṛhamedhāsa ā gata maruto māpa bhūtana
children.translated_text: Come to the household rites, O <s>Maruts</s>; do not stay away.

children.text: yuṣmākotī sudānavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With your aid, O bountiful ones.

children.text: iheha vaḥ svatavasaḥ kavayaḥ sūryatvacaḥ
children.translated_text: Here, here, O self-powerful ones, inspired sages with the brightness of the sun,

children.text: yajñam maruta ā vṛṇe ||
children.translated_text: I choose you, O <s>Maruts</s>, for the sacrifice.

children.text: tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhim puṣṭivardhanam
children.translated_text: We worship <s>Tryambaka</s>, fragrant, increasing nourishment;

children.text: urvārukam iva bandhanān mṛtyor mukṣīya māmṛtāt ||
children.translated_text: like a cucumber from its bond, may I be released from death, not from immortality.

children.text: Chapter 576
yad adya sūrya bravo 'nāgā udyan mitrāya varuṇāya satyam
children.translated_text: Whatever truth, O <s>Sūrya</s>, you declare today as you rise to <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> about the guiltless,

children.text: vayaṃ devatrādite syāma tava priyāso aryaman gṛṇantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may we, O <s>Aditi</s>, be among the gods, dear to you, O <s>Aryaman</s>, as we praise.

children.text: eṣa sya mitrāvaruṇā nṛcakṣā ubhe ud eti sūryo abhi jman
children.translated_text: This <s>Sūrya</s>, the eye of men, rises over both realms, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, across the earth,

children.text: viśvasya sthātur jagataś ca gopā ṛju marteṣu vṛjinā ca paśyan ||
children.translated_text: guardian of all that stands and moves, seeing the straight and the crooked among mortals.

children.text: ayukta sapta haritaḥ sadhasthād yā īṃ vahanti sūryaṃ ghṛtācīḥ
children.translated_text: The seven bay mares have been yoked from their common seat, the ghee-bright ones that carry <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: dhāmāni mitrāvaruṇā yuvākuḥ saṃ yo yūtheva janimāni caṣṭe ||
children.translated_text: Belonging to you, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, he surveys the stations and the births together, like a herd.

children.text: ud vām pṛkṣāso madhumanto asthur ā sūryo aruhacchukram arṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Your honey-sweet nourishments have risen; <s>Sūrya</s> has mounted the bright flood,

children.text: yasmā ādityā adhvano radanti mitro aryamā varuṇaḥ sajoṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: for whom the <s>Ādityas</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s> together make the paths smooth.

children.text: ime cetāro anṛtasya bhūrer mitro aryamā varuṇo hi santi
children.translated_text: These are observers of abundant falsehood; indeed <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s> are so.

children.text: ima ṛtasya vāvṛdhur duroṇe śagmāsaḥ putrā aditer adabdhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: These gracious, un-deceived sons of <s>Aditi</s> have grown strong in the house of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: ime mitro varuṇo dūﾱabhāso 'cetasaṃ cic citayanti dakṣaiḥ
children.translated_text: These, <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, hard to deceive, awaken even the unthinking by their powers.

children.text: api kratuṃ sucetasaṃ vatantas tiraś cid aṃhaḥ supathā nayanti ||
children.translated_text: They further even the purpose of the wise and lead one across distress by a good path.

children.text: ime divo animiṣā pṛthivyāś cikitvāṃso acetasaṃ nayanti
children.translated_text: These unblinking ones of heaven and earth, knowing, guide the unknowing.

children.text: pravrāje cin nadyo gādham asti pāraṃ no asya viṣpitasya parṣan ||
children.translated_text: Even in the trackless waste there is a ford through the rivers; may they carry us beyond this scattered danger.

children.text: yad gopāvad aditiḥ śarma bhadram mitro yacchanti varuṇaḥ sudāse
children.translated_text: When <s>Aditi</s> gives good shelter with protection, and <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> give it to <s>Sudās</s>,

children.text: tasminn ā tokaṃ tanayaṃ dadhānā mā karma devaheﾱanaṃ turāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: placing child and offspring in that shelter, may we not commit offense against the gods, O swift ones.

children.text: ava vediṃ hotrābhir yajeta ripaḥ kāścid varuṇadhrutaḥ saḥ
children.translated_text: Let the foe fall away from the altar through the invocations, whatever enemy is seized by <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: pari dveṣobhir aryamā vṛṇaktūruṃ sudāse vṛṣaṇā u lokam ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Aryaman</s> ward him off with enmities; you two bulls, make a broad space for <s>Sudās</s>.

children.text: sasvaś ciddhi samṛtis tveṣy eṣām apīcyena sahasā sahante
children.translated_text: For in every conflict, in their fierce onset, they overpower by hidden might.

children.text: yuṣmad bhiyā vṛṣaṇo rejamānā dakṣasya cin mahinā mṛﾱatā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Trembling through fear of you, O bulls, may we be spared by the greatness even of your skill.

children.text: yo brahmaṇe sumatim āyajāte vājasya sātau paramasya rāyaḥ
children.translated_text: The one who invokes good favor for prayer, in the winning of strength and of highest wealth,

children.text: sīkṣanta manyum maghavāno arya uru kṣayāya cakrire sudhātu ||
children.translated_text: the bountiful ones restrain anger; for noble dwelling they have made a broad, well-founded home.

children.text: iyaṃ deva purohitir yuvabhyāṃ yajñeṣu mitrāvaruṇāv akāri
children.translated_text: This priestly service, O gods <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, has been performed for you both in the sacrifices.

children.text: viśvāni durgā pipṛtaṃ tiro no yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Carry us across all difficulties; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 577
ud vāṃ cakṣur varuṇa supratīkaṃ devayor eti sūryas tatanvān
children.translated_text: Your eye, O fair-faced <s>Varuṇa</s>, rises, <s>Sūrya</s>, spreading out for the two gods.

children.text: abhi yo viśvā bhuvanāni caṣṭe sa manyum martyeṣv ā ciketa ||
children.translated_text: He beholds all beings, and he discerns anger among mortals.

children.text: pra vāṃ sa mitrāvaruṇāv ṛtāvā vipro manmāni dīrghaśrud iyarti
children.translated_text: To you, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, the <s>ṛta</s>-bearing inspired singer of far hearing sends forth hymns.

children.text: yasya brahmāṇi sukratū avātha ā yat kratvā na śaradaḥ pṛṇaithe ||
children.translated_text: His prayers, O wise ones, you favor, when by your wisdom you fill his years like autumns.

children.text: proror mitrāvaruṇā pṛthivyāḥ pra diva ṛṣvād bṛhataḥ sudānū
children.translated_text: From the wide earth, O generous <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, from lofty, great heaven,

children.text: spaśo dadhāthe oṣadhīṣu vikṣv ṛdhag yato animiṣaṃ rakṣamāṇā ||
children.translated_text: you set spies among plants and peoples, going apart and keeping watch without blinking.

children.text: śaṃsā mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma śuṣmo rodasī badbadhe mahitvā
children.translated_text: Praise the domain of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; their force has bound heaven and earth by its greatness.

children.text: ayan māsā ayajvanām avīrāḥ pra yajñamanmā vṛjanaṃ tirāte ||
children.translated_text: These months of the non-sacrificers pass away without heroes; the one whose mind is on sacrifice crosses beyond the enclosure.

children.text: amūrā viśvā vṛṣaṇāv imā vāṃ na yāsu citraṃ dadṛśe na yakṣam
children.translated_text: Unbewildered, O mighty ones, all these things are yours; among them no wonder, no apparition, is seen.

children.text: druhaḥ sacante anṛtā janānāṃ na vāṃ niṇyāny acite abhūvan ||
children.translated_text: Deceits and falsehoods cling to the peoples; your hidden things have not become known to the thoughtless.

children.text: sam u vāṃ yajñam mahayaṃ namobhir huve vām mitrāvaruṇā sabādhaḥ
children.translated_text: Together with reverences I magnify your sacrifice; I call you, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, in distress.

children.text: pra vām manmāny ṛcase navāni kṛtāni brahma jujuṣann imāni ||
children.translated_text: I send forth new hymns to you for praise; may these composed prayers please you.

children.text: iyaṃ deva purohitir yuvabhyāṃ yajñeṣu mitrāvaruṇāv akāri
children.translated_text: This priestly service, O gods <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, has been performed for you both in the sacrifices.

children.text: viśvāni durgā pipṛtaṃ tiro no yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Carry us across all difficulties; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 578
ut sūryo bṛhad arcīṃṣy aśret puru viśvā janima mānuṣāṇām
children.translated_text: <s>Sūrya</s> has risen with great flames; many are all the births of human beings.

children.text: samo divā dadṛśe rocamānaḥ kratvā kṛtaḥ sukṛtaḥ kartṛbhir bhūt ||
children.translated_text: Shining, he is seen alike by day, fashioned by insight, well fashioned by his makers.

children.text: sa sūrya prati puro na ud gā ebhi stomebhir etaśebhir evaiḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Sūrya</s>, rise forth before us with these praises, with these shining courses,

children.text: pra no mitrāya varuṇāya voco 'nāgaso aryamṇe agnaye ca ||
children.translated_text: and speak for us, as guiltless, to <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, and <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: vi naḥ sahasraṃ śurudho radantv ṛtāvāno varuṇo mitro agniḥ
children.translated_text: May a thousand helps be apportioned to us by the keepers of <s>ṛta</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: yacchantu candrā upamaṃ no arkam ā naḥ kāmam pūpurantu stavānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the shining ones grant our highest song; being praised, may they fulfill our desire.

children.text: dyāvābhūmī adite trāsīthāṃ no ye vāṃ jajñuḥ sujanimāna ṛṣve
children.translated_text: Heaven and Earth, and <s>Aditi</s>, protect us, and those lofty, well-born ones who were born from you two.

children.text: mā heﾱe bhūma varuṇasya vāyor mā mitrasya priyatamasya nṛṇām ||
children.translated_text: May we not fall into the displeasure of <s>Varuṇa</s> or of <s>Vāyu</s>, nor of <s>Mitra</s>, dearest of men.

children.text: pra bāhavā sisṛtaṃ jīvase na ā no gavyūtim ukṣataṃ ghṛtena
children.translated_text: Stretch out your arms for us to live; sprinkle our pasture with ghee.

children.text: ā no jane śravayataṃ yuvānā śrutam me mitrāvaruṇā havemā ||
children.translated_text: Make us heard among the people, O young ones; hear these invocations of mine, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: nū mitro varuṇo aryamā nas tmane tokāya varivo dadhantu
children.translated_text: Now may <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s> grant us broad space for ourselves and for offspring.

children.text: sugā no viśvā supathāni santu yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May all good paths be easy for us; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 579
ud v eti subhago viśvacakṣāḥ sādhāraṇaḥ sūryo mānuṣāṇām
children.translated_text: The fortunate, all-seeing <s>Sūrya</s> rises, common to human beings,

children.text: cakṣur mitrasya varuṇasya devaś carmeva yaḥ samavivyak tamāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: the divine eye of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, who has rolled up the darkness like a hide.

children.text: ud v eti prasavītā janānām mahān ketur arṇavaḥ sūryasya
children.translated_text: He rises, the impeller of peoples, the great signal, the flood of <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: samānaṃ cakram paryāvivṛtsan yad etaśo vahati dhūrṣu yuktaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He seeks to turn the common wheel around, which <s>Etaśa</s>, yoked to the poles, carries.

children.text: vibhrājamāna uṣasām upasthād rebhair ud ety anumadyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: Shining from the lap of the dawns, he rises with songs of praise, approved by them.

children.text: eṣa me devaḥ savitā cacchanda yaḥ samānaṃ na pramināti dhāma ||
children.translated_text: This god <s>Savitṛ</s> has pleased me, he who does not diminish the common domain.

children.text: divo rukma urucakṣā ud eti dūrearthas taraṇir bhrājamānaḥ
children.translated_text: The golden ornament of heaven, far-seeing, rises; the shining courser reaches distant goals.

children.text: nūnaṃ janāḥ sūryeṇa prasūtā ayann arthāni kṛṇavann apāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: Now the peoples, impelled by <s>Sūrya</s>, go after their aims and perform their works.

children.text: yatrā cakrur amṛtā gātum asmai śyeno na dīyann anv eti pāthaḥ
children.translated_text: Where the immortals made a path for him, he follows the course like a flying eagle.

children.text: prati vāṃ sūra udite vidhema namobhir mitrāvaruṇota havyaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: When <s>Sūra</s> has risen, we would worship you two, O <s>Mitra-Varuṇa</s>, with reverences and oblations.

children.text: nū mitro varuṇo aryamā nas tmane tokāya varivo dadhantu
children.translated_text: Now may <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s> set wide room for us ourselves and for our offspring.

children.text: sugā no viśvā supathāni santu yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May all our ways be easy, with good paths; all of you, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 580
divi kṣayantā rajasaḥ pṛthivyām pra vāṃ ghṛtasya nirṇijo dadīran
children.translated_text: Dwelling in heaven, in the midspace, and upon earth, they have poured forth for you two the shining streams of ghee.

children.text: havyaṃ no mitro aryamā sujāto rājā sukṣatro varuṇo juṣanta ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s> of good birth, and king <s>Varuṇa</s> of fair sovereignty accept our oblation.

children.text: ā rājānā maha ṛtasya gopā sindhupatī kṣatriyā yātam arvāk
children.translated_text: Come here, O two kings, great guardians of <s>ṛta</s> (sacred order), lords of the rivers, sovereign rulers.

children.text: iﾱāṃ no mitrāvaruṇota vṛṣṭim ava diva invataṃ jīradānū ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Mitra-Varuṇa</s>, swift in giving, pour down for us refreshment and rain from heaven.

children.text: mitras tan no varuṇo devo aryaḥ pra sādhiṣṭhebhiḥ pathibhir nayantu
children.translated_text: May the god <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and noble <s>Aryaman</s> lead us by the straightest paths.

children.text: bravad yathā na ād ariḥ sudāsa iṣā madema saha devagopāḥ ||
children.translated_text: So that no enemy may harm us, as with <s>Sudās</s>, may we rejoice in nourishment, guarded by the gods.

children.text: yo vāṃ gartam manasā takṣad etam ūrdhvāṃ dhītiṃ kṛṇavad dhārayac ca
children.translated_text: He who fashioned this chariot for you two with his mind, and made and upheld the lofty thought,

children.text: ukṣethām mitrāvaruṇā ghṛtena tā rājānā sukṣitīs tarpayethām ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Mitra-Varuṇa</s>, moisten it with ghee; satisfy those two kings who grant good dwelling.

children.text: eṣa stomo varuṇa mitra tubhyaṃ somaḥ śukro na vāyave 'yāmi
children.translated_text: This hymn, O <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Mitra</s>, I send to you like bright Soma to <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: aviṣṭaṃ dhiyo jigṛtam purandhīr yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Help our thoughts; take hold of our inspired powers; all of you, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 581
prati vāṃ sūra udite sūktair mitraṃ huve varuṇam pūtadakṣam
children.translated_text: When <s>Sūra</s> has risen, I call with hymns upon <s>Mitra</s> and pure-skilled <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: yayor asuryam akṣitaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ viśvasya yāmann ācitā jigatnu ||
children.translated_text: The imperishable divine might of those two, foremost in the course of all, has been set moving and goes forth.

children.text: tā hi devānām asurā tāv aryā tā naḥ kṣitīḥ karatam ūrjayantīḥ
children.translated_text: For those two are the mighty lords among the gods, those two are noble; make our settlements rich in strength.

children.text: aśyāma mitrāvaruṇā vayaṃ vāṃ dyāvā ca yatra pīpayann ahā ca ||
children.translated_text: May we attain you two, O <s>Mitra-Varuṇa</s>, where heaven and the days have swollen you with abundance.

children.text: tā bhūripāśāv anṛtasya setū duratyetū ripave martyāya
children.translated_text: Those two, with many snares, are barriers against falsehood, hard for a mortal enemy to cross.

children.text: ṛtasya mitrāvaruṇā pathā vām apo na nāvā duritā tarema ||
children.translated_text: By your path of <s>ṛta</s>, O <s>Mitra-Varuṇa</s>, may we cross evils as one crosses waters by boat.

children.text: ā no mitrāvaruṇā havyajuṣṭiṃ ghṛtair gavyūtim ukṣatam iﾱābhiḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Mitra-Varuṇa</s>, sprinkle for us the enjoyment of the oblation, a cattle-pasture, with ghee and sacred refreshment.

children.text: prati vām atra varam ā janāya pṛṇītam udno divyasya cāroḥ ||
children.translated_text: Here, before the people, fill for you two the chosen gift from the lovely heavenly water.

children.text: eṣa stomo varuṇa mitra tubhyaṃ somaḥ śukro na vāyave 'yāmi
children.translated_text: This hymn, O <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Mitra</s>, I send to you like bright Soma to <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: aviṣṭaṃ dhiyo jigṛtam purandhīr yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Help our thoughts; take hold of our inspired powers; all of you, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 582
pra mitrayor varuṇayo stomo na etu śūṣyaḥ
children.translated_text: Let our hymn go forth to <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, worthy of praise,

children.text: namasvān tuvijātayoḥ ||
children.translated_text: reverent before the two of mighty birth.

children.text: yā dhārayanta devāḥ sudakṣā dakṣapitarā
children.translated_text: Those two the skillful gods upheld, fathers of skill,

children.text: asuryāya pramahasā ||
children.translated_text: for mighty lordship and great power.

children.text: tā na stipā tanūpā varuṇa jaritṝṇām
children.translated_text: Those two, protectors of the singers and guardians of their bodies, O <s>Varuṇa</s>,

children.text: mitra sādhayataṃ dhiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Mitra</s>, bring our thoughts to fulfillment.

children.text: yad adya sūra udite 'nāgā mitro aryamā
children.translated_text: When today, at the rising of <s>Sūra</s>, sinless <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Aryaman</s>,

children.text: suvāti savitā bhagaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Savitṛ</s> and <s>Bhaga</s> impel good fortune,

children.text: suprāvīr astu sa kṣayaḥ pra nu yāman sudānavaḥ
children.translated_text: may that dwelling be well protected; now advance our journey, O bountiful ones,

children.text: ye no aṃho 'tipiprati ||
children.translated_text: you who carry us beyond distress.

children.text: uta svarājo aditir adabdhasya vratasya ye
children.translated_text: And <s>Aditi</s>, self-ruling, and those of uninjured vow,

children.text: maho rājāna īśate ||
children.translated_text: the great kings, exercise dominion.

children.text: prati vāṃ sūra udite mitraṃ gṛṇīṣe varuṇam
children.translated_text: At the rising of <s>Sūra</s>, I praise you two, <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>,

children.text: aryamaṇaṃ riśādasam ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Aryaman</s>, who harms the hostile.

children.text: rāyā hiraṇyayā matir iyam avṛkāya śavase
children.translated_text: This thought, with golden wealth, is for strength free from attack;

children.text: iyaṃ viprā medhasātaye ||
children.translated_text: this inspired prayer is for the winning of insight.

children.text: te syāma deva varuṇa te mitra sūribhiḥ saha
children.translated_text: May we be yours, O god <s>Varuṇa</s>, yours, O <s>Mitra</s>, together with generous patrons;

children.text: iṣaṃ svaś ca dhīmahi ||
children.translated_text: may we obtain nourishment and well-being.

children.text: bahavaḥ sūracakṣaso 'gnijihvā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: Many are sun-eyed, fire-tongued, increasers of <s>ṛta</s>,

children.text: trīṇi ye yemur vidathāni dhītibhir viśvāni paribhūtibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: who by their thoughts have measured out the three sacred gatherings, and all things by their superior powers.

children.text: vi ye dadhuḥ śaradam māsam ād ahar yajñam aktuṃ cād ṛcam
children.translated_text: They who arranged autumn, month, and then day, sacrifice, night, and hymn,

children.text: anāpyaṃ varuṇo mitro aryamā kṣatraṃ rājāna āśata ||
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>, the kings, have attained unapproachable dominion.

children.text: tad vo adya manāmahe sūktaiḥ sūra udite
children.translated_text: Today, at the rising of <s>Sūra</s>, we honor that of yours with hymns,

children.text: yad ohate varuṇo mitro aryamā yūyam ṛtasya rathyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: what <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s> uphold; you are the charioteers of <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: ṛtāvāna ṛtajātā ṛtāvṛdho ghorāso anṛtadviṣaḥ
children.translated_text: True to <s>ṛta</s>, born of <s>ṛta</s>, increasing <s>ṛta</s>, terrible haters of falsehood,

children.text: teṣāṃ vaḥ sumne succhardiṣṭame naraḥ syāma ye ca sūrayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may we men, and the patrons too, be in their favor, in your most sheltering protection.

children.text: ud u tyad darśataṃ vapur diva eti pratihvare
children.translated_text: That beautiful form rises from heaven at the turnings of the way,

children.text: yad īm āśur vahati deva etaśo viśvasmai cakṣase aram ||
children.translated_text: when swift divine <s>Etaśa</s> bears him, sufficient for the sight of all.

children.text: śīrṣṇaḥ śīrṣṇo jagatas tasthuṣas patiṃ samayā viśvam ā rajaḥ
children.translated_text: Over the head of each head, the lord of what moves and what stands, across the whole region,

children.text: sapta svasāraḥ suvitāya sūryaṃ vahanti harito rathe ||
children.translated_text: the seven sisters, the bay mares, carry <s>Sūrya</s> on the chariot for good guidance.

children.text: tac cakṣur devahitaṃ śukram uccarat
children.translated_text: That eye, established by the gods, bright, has risen upward.

children.text: paśyema śaradaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ śatam ||
children.translated_text: May we see a hundred autumns; may we live a hundred autumns.

children.text: kāvyebhir adābhyā yātaṃ varuṇa dyumat
children.translated_text: Come with your inspired powers, unassailable, O bright <s>Varuṇa</s>,

children.text: mitraś ca somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Mitra</s> too, for the drinking of Soma.

children.text: divo dhāmabhir varuṇa mitraś cā yātam adruhā
children.translated_text: From the heavenly stations, O <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Mitra</s>, come, unbetraying,

children.text: pibataṃ somam ātujī ||
children.translated_text: and drink the Soma at once.

children.text: ā yātam mitrāvaruṇā juṣāṇāv āhutiṃ narā
children.translated_text: Come, O <s>Mitra-Varuṇa</s>, delighting in the offering, O heroes;

children.text: pātaṃ somam ṛtāvṛdhā ||
children.translated_text: drink the Soma, O increasers of <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: Chapter 583
prati vāṃ rathaṃ nṛpatī jaradhyai haviṣmatā manasā yajñiyena
children.translated_text: To praise your chariot, O lords of men, with an oblation-bearing mind fit for sacrifice,

children.text: yo vāṃ dūto na dhiṣṇyāv ajīgar acchā sūnur na pitarā vivakmi ||
children.translated_text: the one who, like your messenger, has awakened the sacred seats: like a son to his fathers, I speak to you.

children.text: aśocy agniḥ samidhāno asme upo adṛśran tamasaś cid antāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has shone as he is kindled among us; even the bounds of darkness have appeared nearby.

children.text: aceti ketur uṣasaḥ purastācchriye divo duhitur jāyamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The sign of dawn has been perceived in front, born for the glory of the daughter of heaven.

children.text: abhi vāṃ nūnam aśvinā suhotā stomaiḥ siṣakti nāsatyā vivakvān
children.translated_text: Now, O <s>Aśvins</s>, the good hotṛ, eloquent, attends upon you with hymns, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>.

children.text: pūrvībhir yātam pathyābhir arvāk svarvidā vasumatā rathena ||
children.translated_text: Come hither by the ancient paths, with your sun-finding, wealth-bearing chariot.

children.text: avor vāṃ nūnam aśvinā yuvākur huve yad vāṃ sute mādhvī vasūyuḥ
children.translated_text: For your help now, O <s>Aśvins</s>, I call as one devoted to you, when at the pressed soma the sweet draught is offered, desiring wealth from you.

children.text: ā vāṃ vahantu sthavirāso aśvāḥ pibātho asme suṣutā madhūni ||
children.translated_text: Let your firm horses bring you here; drink for us the well-pressed sweet soma-juices.

children.text: prācīm u devāśvinā dhiyam me 'mṛdhrāṃ sātaye kṛtaṃ vasūyum
children.translated_text: O divine <s>Aśvins</s>, make my forward prayer unharmed, for winning, and desirous of wealth.

children.text: viśvā aviṣṭaṃ vāja ā purandhīs tā naḥ śaktaṃ śacīpatī śacībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Protect every bounty in the prize-contest; lords of power, may you be able to help us with your powers.

children.text: aviṣṭaṃ dhīṣv aśvinā na āsu prajāvad reto ahrayaṃ no astu
children.translated_text: Protect us, O <s>Aśvins</s>, in these prayers; let our seed, rich in offspring, be unfailing.

children.text: ā vāṃ toke tanaye tūtujānāḥ suratnāso devavītiṃ gamema ||
children.translated_text: Hastening to you for child and descendant, rich in good treasures, may we reach the divine feast.

children.text: eṣa sya vām pūrvagatveva sakhye nidhir hito mādhvī rāto asme
children.translated_text: This treasure of yours, as if foremost in friendship, has been set down here, sweet and granted to us.

children.text: aheﾱatā manasā yātam arvāg aśnantā havyam mānuṣīṣu vikṣu ||
children.translated_text: Come hither with an unoffending mind, eating the oblation among human clans.

children.text: ekasmin yoge bhuraṇā samāne pari vāṃ sapta sravato ratho gāt
children.translated_text: At one common yoking, your chariot went around the seven streams, O active ones.

children.text: na vāyanti subhvo devayuktā ye vāṃ dhūrṣu taraṇayo vahanti ||
children.translated_text: The well-formed, god-yoked horses do not grow weary, those swift ones that carry you at the pole.

children.text: asaścatā maghavadbhyo hi bhūtaṃ ye rāyā maghadeyaṃ junanti
children.translated_text: Be without attachment to the munificent patrons, to those who urge on the wealth that is to be given as largesse.

children.text: pra ye bandhuṃ sūnṛtābhis tirante gavyā pṛñcanto aśvyā maghāni ||
children.translated_text: Those who further kinship with gracious words, mingling gifts of cattle and horses.

children.text: nū me havam ā śṛṇutaṃ yuvānā yāsiṣṭaṃ vartir aśvināv irāvat
children.translated_text: Now hear my call, O young ones; come by the refreshment-bringing path, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: dhattaṃ ratnāni jarataṃ ca sūrīn yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Set treasures in place, and quicken the patrons; all of you, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 584
ā śubhrā yātam aśvinā svaśvā giro dasrā jujuṣāṇā yuvākoḥ
children.translated_text: Come brightly, O <s>Aśvins</s>, with good horses; wondrous ones, taking pleasure in the songs of your devoted singer.

children.text: havyāni ca pratibhṛtā vītaṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: And enjoy the oblations that have been presented for us.

children.text: pra vām andhāṃsi madyāny asthur araṃ gantaṃ haviṣo vītaye me
children.translated_text: The intoxicating draughts have been set forth for you; come readily for the enjoyment of my oblation.

children.text: tiro aryo havanāni śrutaṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Hear our invocations from beyond the stranger's calls.

children.text: pra vāṃ ratho manojavā iyarti tiro rajāṃsy aśvinā śatotiḥ
children.translated_text: Your mind-swift chariot speeds forth, O <s>Aśvins</s>, a hundredfold helper across the spaces.

children.text: asmabhyaṃ sūryāvasū iyānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: It comes to us, rich in sun-bright wealth.

children.text: ayaṃ ha yad vāṃ devayā u adrir ūrdhvo vivakti somasud yuvabhyām
children.translated_text: When this god-seeking pressing stone, standing upright, announces the soma pressed for you two,

children.text: ā valgū vipro vavṛtīta havyaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: let the eloquent priest turn toward you with lovely oblations.

children.text: citraṃ ha yad vām bhojanaṃ nv asti ny atraye mahiṣvantaṃ yuyotam
children.translated_text: Wonderful indeed is the nourishment you possess, when for <s>Atri</s> you drove away the great affliction.

children.text: yo vām omānaṃ dadhate priyaḥ san ||
children.translated_text: He who, being dear, sets your protection over himself.

children.text: uta tyad vāṃ jurate aśvinā bhūc cyavānāya pratītyaṃ havirde
children.translated_text: And that deed of yours, O <s>Aśvins</s>, became famous, when you responded to <s>Cyavāna</s>, giver of oblations.

children.text: adhi yad varpa itaūti dhatthaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When you set beauty upon his body with your aid.

children.text: uta tyam bhujyum aśvinā sakhāyo madhye jahur durevāsaḥ samudre
children.translated_text: And <s>Bhujyu</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>, whom evil-minded companions abandoned in the middle of the ocean,

children.text: nir īm parṣad arāvā yo yuvākuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the one devoted to you carried him out across the shoreless flood.

children.text: vṛkāya cij jasamānāya śaktam uta śrutaṃ śayave hūyamānā
children.translated_text: You were able even for <s>Vṛka</s> as he cried out, and you heard <s>Śayu</s> when he called.

children.text: yāv aghnyām apinvatam apo na staryaṃ cicchakty aśvinā śacībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: You filled the inviolable cow like waters; even what was worn out you could restore, O <s>Aśvins</s>, with your powers.

children.text: eṣa sya kārur jarate sūktair agre budhāna uṣasāṃ sumanmā
children.translated_text: This poet, awakened before the dawns and well-minded, sings with hymns at the front.

children.text: iṣā taṃ vardhad aghnyā payobhir yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the cow increase him with nourishment and milk; all of you, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 585
ā vāṃ ratho rodasī badbadhāno hiraṇyayo vṛṣabhir yātv aśvaiḥ
children.translated_text: May your golden chariot, binding heaven and earth together, come with its vigorous horses.

children.text: ghṛtavartaniḥ pavibhī rucāna iṣāṃ voﾱhā nṛpatir vājinīvān ||
children.translated_text: With ghee-lined tracks and shining rims, bearer of refreshment, lord of men, rich in steeds.

children.text: sa paprathāno abhi pañca bhūmā trivandhuro manasā yātu yuktaḥ
children.translated_text: Spreading wide over the five lands, three-seated, let it come yoked by thought.

children.text: viśo yena gacchatho devayantīḥ kutrā cid yāmam aśvinā dadhānā ||
children.translated_text: By it you go to the worshiping peoples, setting your journey wherever you will, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: svaśvā yaśasā yātam arvāg dasrā nidhim madhumantam pibāthaḥ
children.translated_text: Come hither with good horses and renown, wondrous ones; drink the honeyed treasure.

children.text: vi vāṃ ratho vadhvā yādamāno 'ntān divo bādhate vartanibhyām ||
children.translated_text: Your chariot, moving with the bride, drives back the ends of heaven with its tracks.

children.text: yuvoḥ śriyam pari yoṣāvṛṇīta sūro duhitā paritakmyāyām
children.translated_text: The daughter of <s>Sūrya</s>, as a bride at the circuit, chose the splendor of you two.

children.text: yad devayantam avathaḥ śacībhiḥ pari ghraṃsam omanā vāṃ vayo gāt ||
children.translated_text: When you protected the god-loving one with your powers, your protecting bird went around the heat.

children.text: yo ha sya vāṃ rathirā vasta usrā ratho yujānaḥ pariyāti vartiḥ
children.translated_text: That chariot of yours, harnessed in the dawns, goes around the course as your charioteer.

children.text: tena naḥ śaṃ yor uṣaso vyuṣṭau ny aśvinā vahataṃ yajñe asmin ||
children.translated_text: With it, at the shining forth of dawn, carry us, O <s>Aśvins</s>, to peace and joy in this sacrifice.

children.text: narā gaureva vidyutaṃ tṛṣāṇāsmākam adya savanopa yātam
children.translated_text: O heroes, thirsting like a cow for the lightning-rain, come today to our soma-pressing.

children.text: purutrā hi vām matibhir havante mā vām anye ni yaman devayantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For many invoke you with their thoughts; let not other god-loving men restrain you.

children.text: yuvam bhujyum avaviddhaṃ samudra ud ūhathur arṇaso asridhānaiḥ
children.translated_text: You two lifted <s>Bhujyu</s>, cast away in the ocean, up out of the flood with unfailing aids.

children.text: patatribhir aśramair avyathibhir daṃsanābhir aśvinā pārayantā ||
children.translated_text: With winged, tireless, unharmed powers you carried him across, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: nū me havam ā śṛṇutaṃ yuvānā yāsiṣṭaṃ vartir aśvināv irāvat
children.translated_text: Now hear my call, O young ones; come by the refreshment-bringing path, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: dhattaṃ ratnāni jarataṃ ca sūrīn yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Set treasures in place, and quicken the patrons; all of you, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 586
ā viśvavārāśvinā gataṃ naḥ pra tat sthānam avāci vām pṛthivyām
children.translated_text: Come to us, O all-desirable <s>Aśvins</s>; that station of yours has been proclaimed upon the earth.

children.text: aśvo na vājī śunapṛṣṭho asthād ā yat sedathur dhruvase na yonim ||
children.translated_text: Like a swift horse with a fair back it has stood up, when you sat down as in a firm seat.

children.text: siṣakti sā vāṃ sumatiś caniṣṭhātāpi gharmo manuṣo duroṇe
children.translated_text: That favor of yours follows from nearest at hand; the hot offering burns in the dwelling of <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: yo vāṃ samudrān saritaḥ piparty etagvā cin na suyujā yujānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: It carries you across oceans and rivers, even when yoked with a difficult team.

children.text: yāni sthānāny aśvinā dadhāthe divo yahvīṣv oṣadhīṣu vikṣu
children.translated_text: The stations that you hold, O <s>Aśvins</s>, in heaven, in the mighty plants, and among the clans,

children.text: ni parvatasya mūrdhani sadanteṣaṃ janāya dāśuṣe vahantā ||
children.translated_text: they sit on the summit of the mountain, bringing nourishment to the worshiping people.

children.text: caniṣṭaṃ devā oṣadhīṣv apsu yad yogyā aśnavaithe ṛṣīṇām
children.translated_text: You take pleasure, gods, in plants and waters, when you attain the yoking prepared by the seers.

children.text: purūṇi ratnā dadhatau ny asme anu pūrvāṇi cakhyathur yugāni ||
children.translated_text: Bestowing many treasures here upon us, you have looked upon the former ages one after another.

children.text: śuśruvāṃsā cid aśvinā purūṇy abhi brahmāṇi cakṣāthe ṛṣīṇām
children.translated_text: Having heard many prayers, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you look toward the sacred formulations of the seers.

children.text: prati pra yātaṃ varam ā janāyāsme vām astu sumatiś caniṣṭhā ||
children.translated_text: Come forth in response with the chosen boon for the people; may your favor be most pleasing to us.

children.text: yo vāṃ yajño nāsatyā haviṣmān kṛtabrahmā samaryo bhavāti
children.translated_text: The sacrifice for you, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, provided with oblation, fashioned with sacred formulation, becomes a contest among men.

children.text: upa pra yātaṃ varam ā vasiṣṭham imā brahmāṇy ṛcyante yuvabhyām ||
children.translated_text: Come here, approach <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, the chosen one; these sacred utterances are being recited for you two.

children.text: iyam manīṣā iyam aśvinā gīr imāṃ suvṛktiṃ vṛṣaṇā juṣethām
children.translated_text: This is the thought, this, O <s>Aśvins</s>, the song; O virile ones, take pleasure in this well-spoken praise.

children.text: imā brahmāṇi yuvayūny agman yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: These sacred formulations belonging to you two have come; may you always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 587
apa svasur uṣaso nag jihīte riṇakti kṛṣṇīr aruṣāya panthām
children.translated_text: The Dawn withdraws from her sister; she lets the black paths yield to the ruddy one.

children.text: aśvāmaghā gomaghā vāṃ huvema divā naktaṃ śarum asmad yuyotam ||
children.translated_text: Rich in horses and rich in cows, we would call upon you; by day and by night keep the arrow away from us.

children.text: upāyātaṃ dāśuṣe martyāya rathena vāmam aśvinā vahantā
children.translated_text: Come near for the mortal worshipper, O <s>Aśvins</s>, with your chariot, bringing what is desirable.

children.text: yuyutam asmad anirām amīvāṃ divā naktam mādhvī trāsīthāṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Drive away from us want and sickness; by day and by night, sweet ones, protect us.

children.text: ā vāṃ ratham avamasyāṃ vyuṣṭau sumnāyavo vṛṣaṇo vartayantu
children.translated_text: At the earliest break of dawn may those seeking favor set your chariot in motion, O virile ones.

children.text: syūmagabhastim ṛtayugbhir aśvair āśvinā vasumantaṃ vahethām ||
children.translated_text: With horses yoked according to <s>ṛta</s> (sacred order), O <s>Aśvins</s>, bring the wealth-bearing chariot with its well-held reins.

children.text: yo vāṃ ratho nṛpatī asti voﾱhā trivandhuro vasumāṁ usrayāmā
children.translated_text: Your chariot, O lords of men, is a bearer, three-seated, rich in goods, coming at daybreak.

children.text: ā na enā nāsatyopa yātam abhi yad vāṃ viśvapsnyo jigāti ||
children.translated_text: Come to us with that, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, when the all-supporting power approaches you.

children.text: yuvaṃ cyavānaṃ jaraso 'mumuktaṃ ni pedava ūhathur āśum aśvam
children.translated_text: You two freed <s>Cyavāna</s> from old age; for <s>Pedu</s> you brought the swift horse.

children.text: nir aṃhasas tamasa spartam atriṃ ni jāhuṣaṃ śithire dhātam antaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You rescued <s>Atri</s> from distress and darkness; you placed <s>Jāhuṣa</s> within loosened bonds.

children.text: iyam manīṣā iyam aśvinā gīr imāṃ suvṛktiṃ vṛṣaṇā juṣethām
children.translated_text: This is the thought, this, O <s>Aśvins</s>, the song; O virile ones, take pleasure in this well-spoken praise.

children.text: imā brahmāṇi yuvayūny agman yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: These sacred formulations belonging to you two have come; may you always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 588
ā gomatā nāsatyā rathenāśvāvatā puruścandreṇa yātam
children.translated_text: Come, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, in a chariot rich in cows, rich in horses, and richly shining.

children.text: abhi vāṃ viśvā niyutaḥ sacante spārhayā śriyā tanvā śubhānā ||
children.translated_text: All the teams attend you, adorning their bodies with desirable splendor.

children.text: ā no devebhir upa yātam arvāk sajoṣasā nāsatyā rathena
children.translated_text: Come hither to us with the gods, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, in the chariot, in common accord.

children.text: yuvor hi naḥ sakhyā pitryāṇi samāno bandhur uta tasya vittam ||
children.translated_text: For your ancestral friendships belong to us; the bond is common, and know that.

children.text: ud u stomāso aśvinor abudhrañ jāmi brahmāṇy uṣasaś ca devīḥ
children.translated_text: The hymns to the <s>Aśvins</s> have awakened, together with kindred sacred utterances and the divine Dawns.

children.text: āvivāsan rodasī dhiṣṇyeme acchā vipro nāsatyā vivakti ||
children.translated_text: These holy seats worship Heaven and Earth; the inspired poet speaks toward you, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>.

children.text: vi ced ucchanty aśvinā uṣāsaḥ pra vām brahmāṇi kāravo bharante
children.translated_text: When the Dawns shine forth, O <s>Aśvins</s>, the singers bring praises forward for you.

children.text: ūrdhvam bhānuṃ savitā devo aśred bṛhad agnayaḥ samidhā jarante ||
children.translated_text: The god <s>Savitṛ</s> has raised his beam upward; the great fires are kindled with fuel.

children.text: ā paścātān nāsatyā purastād āśvinā yātam adharād udaktāt
children.translated_text: From the west, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, from the east, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come from below and from the north.

children.text: ā viśvataḥ pāñcajanyena rāyā yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Come from every side with wealth belonging to the five peoples; may you always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 589
atāriṣma tamasas pāram asya prati stomaṃ devayanto dadhānāḥ
children.translated_text: We have crossed to the far shore of this darkness, offering praise as men devoted to the gods.

children.text: purudaṃsā purutamā purājāmartyā havate aśvinā gīḥ ||
children.translated_text: The song calls you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, doers of many wonders, most bountiful, ancient-born, immortal.

children.text: ny u priyo manuṣaḥ sādi hotā nāsatyā yo yajate vandate ca
children.translated_text: The beloved Hotar of men has now sat down, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, the one who sacrifices and worships.

children.text: aśnītam madhvo aśvinā upāka ā vāṃ voce vidatheṣu prayasvān ||
children.translated_text: Drink the nearby sweetness, O <s>Aśvins</s>; in the assemblies I, rich in offerings, will speak to you.

children.text: ahema yajñam pathām urāṇā imāṃ suvṛktiṃ vṛṣaṇā juṣethām
children.translated_text: We have gone along the broad paths of sacrifice; O virile ones, take pleasure in this well-spoken praise.

children.text: śruṣṭīveva preṣito vām abodhi prati stomair jaramāṇo vasiṣṭhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: As if eagerly dispatched, <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, aging with hymns, has awakened to you.

children.text: upa tyā vahnī gamato viśaṃ no rakṣohaṇā sambhṛtā vīﾱupāṇī
children.translated_text: May those two carriers come near to our clan, demon-slayers, gathered together, firm-handed in many forms.

children.text: sam andhāṃsy agmata matsarāṇi mā no mardhiṣṭam ā gataṃ śivena ||
children.translated_text: The exhilarating draughts have come together; do not neglect us; come with auspicious help.

children.text: ā paścātān nāsatyā purastād āśvinā yātam adharād udaktāt
children.translated_text: From the west, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, from the east, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come from below and from the north.

children.text: ā viśvataḥ pāñcajanyena rāyā yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Come from every side with wealth belonging to the five peoples; may you always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 590
imā u vāṃ diviṣṭaya usrā havante aśvinā
children.translated_text: These bright heavenly invocations call you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, at daybreak.

children.text: ayaṃ vām ahve 'vase śacīvasū viśaṃ viśaṃ hi gacchathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I call you two for aid, O possessors of power and wealth, for you go to settlement after settlement.

children.text: yuvaṃ citraṃ dadathur bhojanaṃ narā codethāṃ sūnṛtāvate
children.translated_text: You two, O heroes, gave wondrous nourishment; you impel the one rich in truthful speech.

children.text: arvāg rathaṃ samanasā ni yacchatam pibataṃ somyam madhu ||
children.translated_text: Turn the chariot this way with one mind; drink the soma-sweet honey.

children.text: ā yātam upa bhūṣatam madhvaḥ pibatam aśvinā
children.translated_text: Come here, adorn yourselves nearby, and drink of the sweetness, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: dugdham payo vṛṣaṇā jenyāvasū mā no mardhiṣṭam ā gatam ||
children.translated_text: The milk has been milked, O virile ones rich in winning goods; do not neglect us; come.

children.text: aśvāso ye vām upa dāśuṣo gṛhaṃ yuvāṃ dīyanti bibhrataḥ
children.translated_text: The horses that bear you two fly to the house of the worshipper.

children.text: makṣūyubhir narā hayebhir aśvinā devā yātam asmayū ||
children.translated_text: With swift-moving steeds, O heroes, O divine <s>Aśvins</s>, come desiring us.

children.text: adhā ha yanto aśvinā pṛkṣaḥ sacanta sūrayaḥ
children.translated_text: Then, as they set out, O <s>Aśvins</s>, the patrons attach themselves to the nourishment.

children.text: tā yaṃsato maghavadbhyo dhruvaṃ yaśaś chardir asmabhyaṃ nāsatyā ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, extend firm fame and shelter to the liberal patrons and to us.

children.text: pra ye yayur avṛkāso rathā iva nṛpātāro janānām
children.translated_text: Those guileless protectors of men went forth like chariots.

children.text: uta svena śavasā śūśuvur nara uta kṣiyanti sukṣitim ||
children.translated_text: And by their own strength, O heroes, they have swelled with power, and they dwell in a good dwelling.

children.text: Chapter 591
vy uṣā āvo divijā ṛtenāviṣkṛṇvānā mahimānam āgāt
children.translated_text: Dawn, born of heaven, has opened out through <s>ṛta</s> (sacred order); revealing her greatness, she has come.

children.text: apa druhas tama āvar ajuṣṭam aṅgirastamā pathyā ajīgaḥ ||
children.translated_text: She has driven away treacherous, unwelcome darkness; most like the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, she has awakened the paths.

children.text: mahe no adya suvitāya bodhy uṣo mahe saubhagāya pra yandhi
children.translated_text: Awaken today for our great good passage, O <s>Uṣas</s>; send us forth to great good fortune.

children.text: citraṃ rayiṃ yaśasaṃ dhehy asme devi marteṣu mānuṣi śravasyum ||
children.translated_text: Place splendid, fame-bearing wealth in us, O goddess, among mortal human beings who seek renown.

children.text: ete tye bhānavo darśatāyāś citrā uṣaso amṛtāsa āguḥ
children.translated_text: These visible beams of the bright, immortal <s>Uṣas</s> have come.

children.text: janayanto daivyāni vratāny āpṛṇanto antarikṣā vy asthuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Generating the divine ordinances and filling the midspaces, they have spread out.
