children.text: eṣā syā yujānā parākāt pañca kṣitīḥ pari sadyo jigāti
children.translated_text: This one, yoked from afar, at once goes around the five peoples.

children.text: abhipaśyantī vayunā janānāṃ divo duhitā bhuvanasya patnī ||
children.translated_text: Looking upon the ways of men, the daughter of heaven is mistress of the world.

children.text: vājinīvatī sūryasya yoṣā citrāmaghā rāya īśe vasūnām
children.translated_text: Rich in prize-winning steeds, wife of the Sun, splendid in gifts, she rules over wealth and goods.

children.text: ṛṣiṣṭutā jarayantī maghony uṣā ucchati vahnibhir gṛṇānā ||
children.translated_text: Praised by seers and awakening the generous, <s>Uṣas</s> shines forth, lauded by the singers.

children.text: prati dyutānām aruṣāso aśvāś citrā adṛśrann uṣasaṃ vahantaḥ
children.translated_text: The ruddy horses have appeared facing the shining one, bearing <s>Uṣas</s>.

children.text: yāti śubhrā viśvapiśā rathena dadhāti ratnaṃ vidhate janāya ||
children.translated_text: The bright one goes in her all-adorned chariot; she gives treasure to the person who performs worship.

children.text: satyā satyebhir mahatī mahadbhir devī devebhir yajatā yajatraiḥ
children.translated_text: True with the true, great with the great, the goddess with the gods, worshipful with the worshipful.

children.text: rujad dṛﾱhāni dadad usriyāṇām prati gāva uṣasaṃ vāvaśanta ||
children.translated_text: Breaking open the firm enclosures and giving of the ruddy cows, the cows have lowed toward <s>Uṣas</s>.

children.text: nū no gomad vīravad dhehi ratnam uṣo aśvāvat purubhojo asme
children.translated_text: Now bestow on us, O <s>Uṣas</s>, wealth rich in cows and heroes, rich in horses, abounding in enjoyment.

children.text: mā no barhiḥ puruṣatā nide kar yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Do not make our sacred grass a reproach among men; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 592
ud u jyotir amṛtaṃ viśvajanyaṃ viśvānaraḥ savitā devo aśret
children.translated_text: The immortal light, belonging to all peoples, has risen; the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, common to all men, has stretched it forth.

children.text: kratvā devānām ajaniṣṭa cakṣur āvir akar bhuvanaṃ viśvam uṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: By the will of the gods their eye was born; <s>Uṣas</s> has made manifest the whole world of beings.

children.text: pra me panthā devayānā adṛśrann amardhanto vasubhir iṣkṛtāsaḥ
children.translated_text: The god-traveled paths have appeared to me, unharmed and adorned with treasures.

children.text: abhūd u ketur uṣasaḥ purastāt pratīcy āgād adhi harmyebhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The signal of <s>Uṣas</s> has come to be in front; facing us, she has gone up above the dwellings.

children.text: tānīd ahāni bahulāny āsan yā prācīnam uditā sūryasya
children.translated_text: Those many days were indeed those which rose before the rising of <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: yataḥ pari jāra ivācaranty uṣo dadṛkṣe na punar yatīva ||
children.translated_text: From there, moving about like a lover, O <s>Uṣas</s>, you are seen, not like one going back again.

children.text: ta id devānāṃ sadhamāda āsann ṛtāvānaḥ kavayaḥ pūrvyāsaḥ
children.translated_text: They indeed were at the gods' common feast, the <s>ṛta</s>-keeping seers of old.

children.text: gūﾱhaṃ jyotiḥ pitaro anv avindan satyamantrā ajanayann uṣāsam ||
children.translated_text: The Fathers found the hidden light; true in their mantras, they brought forth <s>Uṣas</s>.

children.text: samāna ūrve adhi saṃgatāsaḥ saṃ jānate na yatante mithas te
children.translated_text: Gathered together on the same broad space, they know together and do not strive against one another.

children.text: te devānāṃ na minanti vratāny amardhanto vasubhir yādamānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They do not violate the vows of the gods, unharmed as they move with the treasures.

children.text: prati tvā stomair īﾱate vasiṣṭhā uṣarbudhaḥ subhage tuṣṭuvāṃsaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s>, awakened by dawn, praise you with hymns, O fortunate <s>Uṣas</s>, singing lauds.

children.text: gavāṃ netrī vājapatnī na ucchoṣaḥ sujāte prathamā jarasva ||
children.translated_text: Leader of cows, mistress of the prize, shine forth for us; O well-born <s>Uṣas</s>, be praised first.

children.text: eṣā netrī rādhasaḥ sūnṛtānām uṣā ucchantī ribhyate vasiṣṭhaiḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>Uṣas</s>, leader of bounty and of gracious truth, shines forth and is invoked by the <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s>.

children.text: dīrghaśrutaṃ rayim asme dadhānā yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: She places in us wealth of far renown; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 593
upo ruruce yuvatir na yoṣā viśvaṃ jīvam prasuvantī carāyai
children.translated_text: She has shone near, like a young woman, a maiden, setting every living being in motion to move.

children.text: abhūd agniḥ samidhe mānuṣāṇām akar jyotir bādhamānā tamāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has appeared for the kindling of human beings; she has made light, driving away the darknesses.

children.text: viśvam pratīcī saprathā ud asthād ruśad vāso bibhratī śukram aśvait
children.translated_text: Facing all, wide-spreading, she has risen; bearing a bright garment, shining, she has gleamed brightly.

children.text: hiraṇyavarṇā sudṛśīkasaṃdṛg gavām mātā netry ahnām aroci ||
children.translated_text: Golden-colored, fair to behold with beautiful aspect, mother of cows and leader of days, she has shone.

children.text: devānāṃ cakṣuḥ subhagā vahantī śvetaṃ nayantī sudṛśīkam aśvam
children.translated_text: Bearing the eye of the gods, fortunate, leading the white, beautiful horse,

children.text: uṣā adarśi raśmibhir vyaktā citrāmaghā viśvam anu prabhūtā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Uṣas</s> has been seen, made distinct by her rays, rich in varied gifts and extending over all.

children.text: antivāmā dūre amitram ucchorvīṃ gavyūtim abhayaṃ kṛdhī naḥ
children.translated_text: Shine away what is near and the distant enemy; make for us a broad, fearless pasture.

children.text: yāvaya dveṣa ā bharā vasūni codaya rādho gṛṇate maghoni ||
children.translated_text: Drive away hatred; bring treasures; impel bounty for the singer, O generous one.

children.text: asme śreṣṭhebhir bhānubhir vi bhāhy uṣo devi pratirantī na āyuḥ
children.translated_text: Shine broadly upon us with your best beams, O goddess <s>Uṣas</s>, extending our life.

children.text: iṣaṃ ca no dadhatī viśvavāre gomad aśvāvad rathavac ca rādhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Set nourishment for us, O all-desired one, and bounty with cows, horses, and chariots.

children.text: yāṃ tvā divo duhitar vardhayanty uṣaḥ sujāte matibhir vasiṣṭhāḥ
children.translated_text: You whom the <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s>, O well-born <s>Uṣas</s>, daughter of heaven, strengthen with their thoughts,

children.text: sāsmāsu dhā rayim ṛṣvam bṛhantaṃ yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: place among us lofty, great wealth; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 594
prati ketavaḥ prathamā adṛśrann ūrdhvā asyā añjayo vi śrayante
children.translated_text: Her first beams have appeared; her adornments spread upward.

children.text: uṣo arvācā bṛhatā rathena jyotiṣmatā vāmam asmabhyaṃ vakṣi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, come hither with your great, shining chariot; carry lovely wealth to us.

children.text: prati ṣīm agnir jarate samiddhaḥ prati viprāso matibhir gṛṇantaḥ
children.translated_text: Kindled <s>Agni</s> sings to you; the inspired sages praise you with their thoughts.

children.text: uṣā yāti jyotiṣā bādhamānā viśvā tamāṃsi duritāpa devī ||
children.translated_text: <s>Uṣas</s>, the goddess, comes with light, driving away all darknesses and evils far off.

children.text: etā u tyāḥ praty adṛśran purastāj jyotir yacchantīr uṣaso vibhātīḥ
children.translated_text: Those shining <s>Uṣases</s> have appeared in front, giving light.

children.text: ajījanan sūryaṃ yajñam agnim apācīnaṃ tamo agād ajuṣṭam ||
children.translated_text: They brought forth <s>Sūrya</s>, sacrifice, and <s>Agni</s>; the unwelcome darkness has gone away westward.

children.text: aceti divo duhitā maghonī viśve paśyanty uṣasaṃ vibhātīm
children.translated_text: The generous daughter of heaven has become manifest; all behold shining <s>Uṣas</s>.

children.text: āsthād rathaṃ svadhayā yujyamānam ā yam aśvāsaḥ suyujo vahanti ||
children.translated_text: She has mounted the chariot yoked by its own power, which well-yoked horses draw.

children.text: prati tvādya sumanaso budhantāsmākāso maghavāno vayaṃ ca
children.translated_text: May the well-minded awaken to you today: our patrons of gifts, and we ourselves.

children.text: tilvilāyadhvam uṣaso vibhātīr yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bestir yourselves toward the shining <s>Uṣases</s>; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 595
vy uṣā āvaḥ pathyā janānām pañca kṣitīr mānuṣīr bodhayantī
children.translated_text: <s>Uṣas</s> has opened the pathways of men, awakening the five human peoples.

children.text: susaṃdṛgbhir ukṣabhir bhānum aśred vi sūryo rodasī cakṣasāvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With well-seen oxen she has extended her radiance; <s>Sūrya</s> has filled heaven and earth with sight.

children.text: vy añjate divo anteṣv aktūn viśo na yuktā uṣaso yatante
children.translated_text: At the ends of heaven the nights are adorned; the peoples, as if yoked, strive toward the <s>Uṣases</s>.

children.text: saṃ te gāvas tama ā vartayanti jyotir yacchanti saviteva bāhū ||
children.translated_text: Your cows turn back the darkness; they extend light like <s>Savitṛ</s> with his arms.

children.text: abhūd uṣā indratamā maghony ajījanat suvitāya śravāṃsi
children.translated_text: <s>Uṣas</s> has appeared, most powerful and generous; for good guidance she has brought forth glories.

children.text: vi divo devī duhitā dadhāty aṅgirastamā sukṛte vasūni ||
children.translated_text: The divine daughter of heaven sets treasures in the sky for the good worker, most like the <s>Aṅgirases</s>.

children.text: tāvad uṣo rādho asmabhyaṃ rāsva yāvat stotṛbhyo arado gṛṇānā
children.translated_text: Grant us, O <s>Uṣas</s>, as much bounty as, when praised, you have bestowed on singers,

children.text: yāṃ tvā jajñur vṛṣabhasyā raveṇa vi dṛﾱhasya duro adrer aurṇoḥ ||
children.translated_text: you whom they recognized by the bull's roaring, when you opened the doors of the firm mountain.

children.text: devaṃ devaṃ rādhase codayanty asmadryak sūnṛtā īrayantī
children.translated_text: Urging each god to generosity and setting gracious words in motion toward us,

children.text: vyucchantī naḥ sanaye dhiyo dhā yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: as you dawn, place thoughts in us for winning wealth; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 596
prati stomebhir uṣasaṃ vasiṣṭhā gīrbhir viprāsaḥ prathamā abudhran
children.translated_text: With hymns the <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s>, inspired singers, first awakened <s>Uṣas</s> with songs,

children.text: vivartayantīṃ rajasī samante āviṣkṛṇvatīm bhuvanāni viśvā ||
children.translated_text: as she rolls apart both realms all around and reveals all beings.

children.text: eṣā syā navyam āyur dadhānā gūḍhvī tamo jyotiṣoṣā abodhi
children.translated_text: This very <s>Uṣas</s> has awakened, giving new life and covering the hidden darkness with light.

children.text: agra eti yuvatir ahrayāṇā prācikitat sūryaṃ yajñam agnim ||
children.translated_text: The young woman goes in front, unashamed; she has made known <s>Sūrya</s>, sacrifice, and <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: aśvāvatīr gomatīr na uṣāso vīravatīḥ sadam ucchantu bhadrāḥ
children.translated_text: May kindly <s>Uṣases</s>, rich in horses, rich in cows, and rich in heroes, dawn for us always,

children.text: ghṛtaṃ duhānā viśvataḥ prapītā yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: milking ghee, fully refreshed on every side; and you all, protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 597
praty u adarśy āyaty ucchantī duhitā divaḥ
children.translated_text: Advancing and dawning, the daughter of heaven has appeared face to face.

children.text: apo mahi vyayati cakṣase tamo jyotiṣ kṛṇoti sūnarī ||
children.translated_text: The lovely one opens out the great darkness for sight; she makes light.

children.text: ud usriyāḥ sṛjate sūryaḥ sacāṁ udyan nakṣatram arcivat
children.translated_text: Rising together with them, <s>Sūrya</s> releases the ruddy cows; the star rises, bright with flame.

children.text: taved uṣo vyuṣi sūryasya ca sam bhaktena gamemahi ||
children.translated_text: At your shining forth, O <s>Uṣas</s>, and at that of <s>Sūrya</s>, may we come together with our allotted share.

children.text: prati tvā duhitar diva uṣo jīrā abhutsmahi
children.translated_text: Toward you, daughter of heaven, O <s>Uṣas</s>, we have awakened eagerly.

children.text: yā vahasi puru spārhaṃ vananvati ratnaṃ na dāśuṣe mayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You bring much-desired delight, like a treasure, to the worshipper.

children.text: ucchantī yā kṛṇoṣi maṃhanā mahi prakhyai devi svar dṛśe
children.translated_text: Shining forth, you by your greatness make great splendor visible, O goddess, the heavenly light to be seen.

children.text: tasyās te ratnabhāja īmahe vayaṃ syāma mātur na sūnavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: We seek to be sharers in that treasure of yours; may we be like sons of a mother.

children.text: tac citraṃ rādha ā bharoṣo yad dīrghaśruttamam
children.translated_text: Bring here that splendid gift, O <s>Uṣas</s>, the one most widely famed.

children.text: yat te divo duhitar martabhojanaṃ tad rāsva bhunajāmahai ||
children.translated_text: Whatever mortal enjoyment is yours, daughter of heaven, grant that; may we partake of it.

children.text: śravaḥ sūribhyo amṛtaṃ vasutvanaṃ vājāṁ asmabhyaṃ gomataḥ
children.translated_text: Bestow immortal fame and wealth upon the patrons, and prizes rich in cattle upon us.

children.text: codayitrī maghonaḥ sūnṛtāvaty uṣā ucchad apa sridhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, inciter of the generous, rich in true speech, shine forth and drive away hostilities.

children.text: Chapter 598
indrāvaruṇā yuvam adhvarāya no viśe janāya mahi śarma yacchatam
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, grant great shelter to our rite and to the whole people.

children.text: dīrghaprayajyum ati yo vanuṣyati vayaṃ jayema pṛtanāsu dūḍhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we conquer in battles the hard-pressed enemies, the one who seeks to injure the long sacrifice.

children.text: samrāﾱ anyaḥ svarāﾱ anya ucyate vām mahāntāv indrāvaruṇā mahāvasū
children.translated_text: One is called universal ruler, the other self-ruler; you two are mighty, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, possessors of great goods.

children.text: viśve devāsaḥ parame vyomani saṃ vām ojo vṛṣaṇā sam balaṃ dadhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: All the gods in the highest heaven have placed force and strength together in you two, O bulls.

children.text: anv apāṃ khāny atṛntam ojasā sūryam airayataṃ divi prabhum
children.translated_text: With power you opened the channels of the waters; you set <s>Sūrya</s>, the lord, in motion in heaven.

children.text: indrāvaruṇā made asya māyino 'pinvatam apitaḥ pinvataṃ dhiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, in the exhilaration of this wondrous draught, you swelled what was not swollen; you made the thoughts swell.

children.text: yuvām id yutsu pṛtanāsu vahnayo yuvāṃ kṣemasya prasave mitajñavaḥ
children.translated_text: You two indeed are leaders in fights and battles; you two, of measured wisdom, stand at the impulse of security.

children.text: īśānā vasva ubhayasya kārava indrāvaruṇā suhavā havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: Ruling over wealth of both kinds, easy to invoke, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, we singers call upon you.

children.text: indrāvaruṇā yad imāni cakrathur viśvā jātāni bhuvanasya majmanā
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, by the greatness of the world you fashioned all these beings that have been born.

children.text: kṣemeṇa mitro varuṇaṃ duvasyati marudbhir ugraḥ śubham anya īyate ||
children.translated_text: In peaceful order <s>Mitra</s> honors <s>Varuṇa</s>; the other, the fierce one, goes to splendor with the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: mahe śulkāya varuṇasya nu tviṣa ojo mimāte dhruvam asya yat svam
children.translated_text: Now the power of <s>Varuṇa</s>, for his great shining brightness, measures out what is firm and his own.

children.text: ajāmim anyaḥ śnathayantam ātirad dabhrebhir anyaḥ pra vṛṇoti bhūyasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: One has overcome the attacker who breaks what is kinless; the other surpasses the greater force with the few.

children.text: na tam aṃho na duritāni martyam indrāvaruṇā na tapaḥ kutaś cana
children.translated_text: No distress, no evil deeds, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, and no affliction from anywhere reaches that mortal

children.text: yasya devā gacchatho vītho adhvaraṃ na tam martasya naśate parihvṛtiḥ ||
children.translated_text: whose sacrifice you gods approach and favor; the contempt of a mortal does not destroy him.

children.text: arvāṅ narā daivyenāvasā gataṃ śṛṇutaṃ havaṃ yadi me jujoṣathaḥ
children.translated_text: Come hither, O heroes, with divine aid; hear my call, if you have taken pleasure in me.

children.text: yuvor hi sakhyam uta vā yad āpyam mārḍīkam indrāvaruṇā ni yacchatam ||
children.translated_text: For your friendship, and whatever kinship there is with you, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, grant mercy.

children.text: asmākam indrāvaruṇā bhare bhare puroyodhā bhavataṃ kṛṣṭyojasā
children.translated_text: For us, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, in every contest be front-fighters with the strength of the people.

children.text: yad vāṃ havanta ubhaye adha spṛdhi naras tokasya tanayasya sātiṣu ||
children.translated_text: For both parties call upon you in rivalry, O heroes, in the winning of offspring and descendants.

children.text: asme indro varuṇo mitro aryamā dyumnaṃ yacchantu mahi śarma saprathaḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s> grant us brilliance, great shelter, broad and expansive.

children.text: avadhraṃ jyotir aditer ṛtāvṛdho devasya ślokaṃ savitur manāmahe ||
children.translated_text: May we contemplate the unharmed light of <s>Aditi</s>, increaser of <s>ṛta</s>, and the praise of the god <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: Chapter 599
yuvāṃ narā paśyamānāsa āpyam prācā gavyantaḥ pṛthuparśavo yayuḥ
children.translated_text: Seeing your kinship, O heroes, the broad-flanked ones went forward, facing east and seeking cattle.

children.text: dāsā ca vṛtrā hatam āryāṇi ca sudāsam indrāvaruṇāvasāvatam ||
children.translated_text: You struck down the <s>Dāsas</s> and the <s>Vṛtras</s>, and the Aryan foes as well; O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, you aided <s>Sudās</s> with protection.

children.text: yatrā naraḥ samayante kṛtadhvajo yasminn ājā bhavati kiṃ cana priyam
children.translated_text: Where men assemble with banners raised, where in battle something dear is at stake,

children.text: yatrā bhayante bhuvanā svardṛśas tatrā na indrāvaruṇādhi vocatam ||
children.translated_text: where the worlds that behold the sunlight are afraid, there, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, speak on our behalf.

children.text: sam bhūmyā antā dhvasirā adṛkṣatendrāvaruṇā divi ghoṣa āruhat
children.translated_text: The ends of the earth were seen as shaken; the shout rose to heaven, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: asthur janānām upa mām arātayo 'rvāg avasā havanaśrutā gatam ||
children.translated_text: The hostile ones stood near the peoples, close to me; come hither with aid, you who hear the invocation.

children.text: indrāvaruṇā vadhanābhir aprati bhedaṃ vanvantā pra sudāsam āvatam
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, with irresistible weapons, conquering <s>Bheda</s>, you aided <s>Sudās</s>.

children.text: brahmāṇy eṣāṃ śṛṇutaṃ havīmani satyā tṛtsūnām abhavat purohitiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Hear their prayers at the offerings; true was the priestly service of the <s>Tṛtsus</s>.

children.text: indrāvaruṇāv abhy ā tapanti māghāny aryo vanuṣām arātayaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, the gifts of the noble one are beset by hostile enemies.

children.text: yuvaṃ hi vasva ubhayasya rājatho 'dha smā no 'vatam pārye divi ||
children.translated_text: For you two rule over wealth of both kinds; therefore protect us on the farther day.

children.text: yuvāṃ havanta ubhayāsa ājiṣv indraṃ ca vasvo varuṇaṃ ca sātaye
children.translated_text: Both sides call upon you in contests, upon <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> for the winning of wealth,

children.text: yatra rājabhir daśabhir nibādhitam pra sudāsam āvataṃ tṛtsubhiḥ saha ||
children.translated_text: where, hemmed in by ten kings, you aided <s>Sudās</s> together with the <s>Tṛtsus</s>.

children.text: daśa rājānaḥ samitā ayajyavaḥ sudāsam indrāvaruṇā na yuyudhuḥ
children.translated_text: The ten kings, joined together yet without sacrifice, did not overcome <s>Sudās</s>, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: satyā nṛṇām admasadām upastutir devā eṣām abhavan devahūtiṣu ||
children.translated_text: True was the praise of the men seated at the feast; the gods were with them at their invocations of the gods.

children.text: dāśarājñe pariyattāya viśvataḥ sudāsa indrāvaruṇāv aśikṣatam
children.translated_text: For <s>Sudās</s>, surrounded on every side in the battle of the ten kings, you two, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, gave aid.

children.text: śvityañco yatra namasā kapardino dhiyā dhīvanto asapanta tṛtsavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There the white-robed, top-knotted <s>Tṛtsus</s>, bowing with reverence and thinking with inspired thought, served you.

children.text: vṛtrāṇy anyaḥ samitheṣu jighnate vratāny anyo abhi rakṣate sadā
children.translated_text: One strikes down <s>Vṛtras</s> in battles; the other always guards the sacred ordinances.

children.text: havāmahe vāṃ vṛṣaṇā suvṛktibhir asme indrāvaruṇā śarma yacchatam ||
children.translated_text: We call upon you two bulls with well-fashioned hymns; grant us shelter, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: asme indro varuṇo mitro aryamā dyumnaṃ yacchantu mahi śarma saprathaḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s> grant us brilliance, great shelter, broad and expansive.

children.text: avadhraṃ jyotir aditer ṛtāvṛdho devasya ślokaṃ savitur manāmahe ||
children.translated_text: May we contemplate the unharmed light of <s>Aditi</s>, increaser of <s>ṛta</s>, and the praise of the god <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: Chapter 600
ā vāṃ rājānāv adhvare vavṛtyāṃ havyebhir indrāvaruṇā namobhiḥ
children.translated_text: I would turn you two kings toward the rite, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, with oblations and reverences.

children.text: pra vāṃ ghṛtācī bāhvor dadhānā pari tmanā viṣurūpā jigāti ||
children.translated_text: The ghee-flowing offering, placed upon your arms, goes around of itself in many forms.

children.text: yuvo rāṣṭram bṛhad invati dyaur yau setṛbhir arajjubhiḥ sinīthaḥ
children.translated_text: Heaven strengthens your broad realm, you two who have bound it with fastenings that are not ropes.

children.text: pari no heﾱo varuṇasya vṛjyā uruṃ na indraḥ kṛṇavad u lokam ||
children.translated_text: May the anger of <s>Varuṇa</s> turn away from us; may <s>Indra</s> make a broad space for us.

children.text: kṛtaṃ no yajñaṃ vidatheṣu cāruṃ kṛtam brahmāṇi sūriṣu praśastā
children.translated_text: Make our sacrifice lovely in the gatherings; make our sacred prayers praised among the patrons.

children.text: upo rayir devajūto na etu pra ṇa spārhābhir ūtibhis tiretam ||
children.translated_text: Let wealth, impelled by the gods, come near us; carry us forward with desirable aids.

children.text: asme indrāvaruṇā viśvavāraṃ rayiṃ dhattaṃ vasumantam purukṣum
children.translated_text: For us, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, set down wealth desirable to all, rich in goods and abundant in nourishment.

children.text: pra ya ādityo anṛtā mināty amitā śūro dayate vasūni ||
children.translated_text: For he, the <s>Āditya</s>, the boundless hero, destroys falsehoods and distributes treasures.

children.text: iyam indraṃ varuṇam aṣṭa me gīḥ prāvat toke tanaye tūtujānā
children.translated_text: This song of mine has reached <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, pressing forward for child and descendant.

children.text: suratnāso devavītiṃ gamema yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Rich in good treasures, may we go to the divine worship; may you always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 601
punīṣe vām arakṣasam manīṣāṃ somam indrāya varuṇāya juhvat
children.translated_text: I purify for you two a demon-free inspiration, offering soma to <s>Indra</s> and to <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: ghṛtapratīkām uṣasaṃ na devīṃ tā no yāmann uruṣyatām abhīke ||
children.translated_text: Like the goddess <s>Uṣas</s>, ghee-bright in face, may that inspiration guard us on the journey and nearby.

children.text: spardhante vā u devahūye atra yeṣu dhvajeṣu didyavaḥ patanti
children.translated_text: For here, in the invocation of the gods, they contend, upon whose standards the flashing missiles fall.

children.text: yuvaṃ tāṁ indrāvaruṇāv amitrān hatam parācaḥ śarvā viṣūcaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You two, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, strike down those enemies, turned away, with arrows in every direction.

children.text: āpaś ciddhi svayaśasaḥ sadassu devīr indraṃ varuṇaṃ devatā dhuḥ
children.translated_text: Even the self-renowned divine waters in their seats have named <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> as divinities.

children.text: kṛṣṭīr anyo dhārayati praviktā vṛtrāṇy anyo apratīni hanti ||
children.translated_text: One sustains the separate peoples; the other smites irresistible <s>Vṛtras</s> (obstructions).

children.text: sa sukratur ṛtacid astu hotā ya āditya śavasā vāṃ namasvān
children.translated_text: Let that well-purposed, <s>ṛta</s>-knowing Hotar be present, O <s>Āditya</s>, who is reverent before you two through his might.

children.text: āvavartad avase vāṃ haviṣmān asad it sa suvitāya prayasvān ||
children.translated_text: Bearing oblation, he has turned toward you two for aid; may he be strong for good fortune.

children.text: iyam indraṃ varuṇam aṣṭa me gīḥ prāvat toke tanaye tūtujānā
children.translated_text: This song of mine has reached <s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, pressing forward for child and descendant.

children.text: suratnāso devavītiṃ gamema yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Rich in good treasures, may we go to the divine worship; may you always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 602
dhīrā tv asya mahinā janūṃṣi vi yas tastambha rodasī cid urvī
children.translated_text: Wise through his greatness are his generations, he who propped apart even the two broad worlds.

children.text: pra nākam ṛṣvaṃ nunude bṛhantaṃ dvitā nakṣatram paprathac ca bhūma ||
children.translated_text: He thrust up the lofty, great vault of heaven, and spread out the starry realm and the earth in twofold form.

children.text: uta svayā tanvā saṃ vade tat kadā nv antar varuṇe bhuvāni
children.translated_text: And with my own self I speak this: when indeed shall I be within <s>Varuṇa</s>'s favor?

children.text: kim me havyam ahṛṇāno juṣeta kadā mṛﾱīkaṃ sumanā abhi khyam ||
children.translated_text: What offering of mine will he, unangered, accept? When shall I, with good mind, behold his mercy?

children.text: pṛcche tad eno varuṇa didṛkṣūpo emi cikituṣo vipṛccham
children.translated_text: I ask about that sin, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, wishing to see it; I approach the wise in order to question them.

children.text: samānam in me kavayaś cid āhur ayaṃ ha tubhyaṃ varuṇo hṛṇīte ||
children.translated_text: Even the poets tell me the same thing: 'This <s>Varuṇa</s> has become angry with you.'

children.text: kim āga āsa varuṇa jyeṣṭhaṃ yat stotāraṃ jighāṃsasi sakhāyam
children.translated_text: What was the chief offense, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, that you wish to slay the singer, your friend?

children.text: pra tan me voco dūﾱabha svadhāvo 'va tvānenā namasā tura iyām ||
children.translated_text: Tell me that, O hard-to-deceive one, O self-ruling one; sinless, I would quickly come to you with homage.

children.text: ava drugdhāni pitryā sṛjā no 'va yā vayaṃ cakṛmā tanūbhiḥ
children.translated_text: Release from us the inherited wrongs; release the wrongs that we ourselves have committed with our bodies.

children.text: ava rājan paśutṛpaṃ na tāyuṃ sṛjā vatsaṃ na dāmno vasiṣṭham ||
children.translated_text: Release, O king, <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> like a calf from the tether, like a cattle-stealing thief who has fed on the herd.

children.text: na sa svo dakṣo varuṇa dhrutiḥ sā surā manyur vibhīdako acittiḥ
children.translated_text: It was not my own intent, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, nor firmness of will; it was liquor, anger, dice, and thoughtlessness.

children.text: asti jyāyān kanīyasa upāre svapnaś caned anṛtasya prayotā ||
children.translated_text: There is a greater power near the lesser; even sleep is a provoker of untruth.

children.text: araṃ dāso na mīﾱhuṣe karāṇy ahaṃ devāya bhūrṇaye 'nāgāḥ
children.translated_text: Like a servant for a generous lord, guiltless, I will perform service for the impetuous god.

children.text: acetayad acito devo aryo gṛtsaṃ rāye kavitaro junāti ||
children.translated_text: The noble god has made the unknowing man aware; wiser than the poets, he urges the skillful one toward wealth.

children.text: ayaṃ su tubhyaṃ varuṇa svadhāvo hṛdi stoma upaśritaś cid astu
children.translated_text: May this hymn for you, O self-ruling <s>Varuṇa</s>, indeed be lodged close within your heart.

children.text: śaṃ naḥ kṣeme śam u yoge no astu yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May there be welfare for us in rest and welfare for us in movement; may you always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 603
radat patho varuṇaḥ sūryāya prārṇāṃsi samudriyā nadīnām
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s> has cleared paths for <s>Sūrya</s>; he has sent forth the oceanic floods of the rivers.

children.text: sargo na sṛṣṭo arvatīr ṛtāyañ cakāra mahīr avanīr ahabhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like a released surge sent onward, he made the rushing streams move according to <s>ṛta</s> (sacred order), and made broad lowlands for the days.

children.text: ātmā te vāto raja ā navīnot paśur na bhūrṇir yavase sasavān
children.translated_text: Your breath is the wind, which has stirred the realm, like a restless beast that has seized the pasture.

children.text: antar mahī bṛhatī rodasīme viśvā te dhāma varuṇa priyāṇi ||
children.translated_text: Within these two great, broad worlds are all your dear dwellings, O <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: pari spaśo varuṇasya smadiṣṭā ubhe paśyanti rodasī sumeke
children.translated_text: The spies of <s>Varuṇa</s>, sent around by him, behold both well-fashioned worlds.

children.text: ṛtāvānaḥ kavayo yajñadhīrāḥ pracetaso ya iṣayanta manma ||
children.translated_text: They are <s>ṛta</s>-holding seers, sacrifice-minded, discerning, who set inspired thought in motion.

children.text: uvāca me varuṇo medhirāya triḥ sapta nāmāghnyā bibharti
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s> said to me, the wise one: 'The inviolate cow bears thrice seven names.'

children.text: vidvān padasya guhyā na vocad yugāya vipra uparāya śikṣan ||
children.translated_text: The knowing inspired poet should speak the hidden things of the station, teaching for a later age.

children.text: tisro dyāvo nihitā antar asmin tisro bhūmīr uparāḥ ṣaḍvidhānāḥ
children.translated_text: Three heavens are placed within this, three earths above, arranged in sixfold form.

children.text: gṛtso rājā varuṇaś cakra etaṃ divi preṅkhaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ śubhe kam ||
children.translated_text: The skillful king <s>Varuṇa</s> made this golden swing in heaven for splendid beauty.

children.text: ava sindhuṃ varuṇo dyaur iva sthād drapso na śveto mṛgas tuviṣmān
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s> stood over the river like heaven itself, like a white drop, a mighty beast.

children.text: gambhīraśaṃso rajaso vimānaḥ supārakṣatraḥ sato asya rājā ||
children.translated_text: Deep in command, measuring the realm, he is king over this existent world, with excellent sovereign power.

children.text: yo mṛﾱayāti cakruṣe cid āgo vayaṃ syāma varuṇe anāgāḥ
children.translated_text: May he show mercy even to one who has committed offense; may we be without guilt before <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: anu vratāny aditer ṛdhanto yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we prosper while following the vows of <s>Aditi</s>; may you always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 604
pra śundhyuvaṃ varuṇāya preṣṭhām matiṃ vasiṣṭha mīﾱhuṣe bharasva
children.translated_text: Bring forward to <s>Varuṇa</s>, O <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, your dearest thought, your purified praise, to the bountiful one.

children.text: ya īm arvāñcaṃ karate yajatraṃ sahasrāmaghaṃ vṛṣaṇam bṛhantam ||
children.translated_text: He makes the worshipful, thousand-gifted, virile, great one turn hither.

children.text: adhā nv asya saṃdṛśaṃ jaganvān agner anīkaṃ varuṇasya maṃsi
children.translated_text: Now, having come into his sight, I contemplate the face of <s>Agni</s>, the face of <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: svar yad aśmann adhipā u andho 'bhi mā vapur dṛśaye ninīyāt ||
children.translated_text: As light in the stone, as a guardian in darkness, may he bring my form forth for sight.

children.text: ā yad ruhāva varuṇaś ca nāvam pra yat samudram īrayāva madhyam
children.translated_text: When <s>Varuṇa</s> and I mount the boat, when we drive it into the middle of the sea,

children.text: adhi yad apāṃ snubhiś carāva pra preṅkha īṅkhayāvahai śubhe kam ||
children.translated_text: when we move over the ridges of the waters, then may we swing upon the swing for splendid beauty.

children.text: vasiṣṭhaṃ ha varuṇo nāvy ādhād ṛṣiṃ cakāra svapā mahobhiḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s> indeed placed <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> in the boat; the skillful one, by his powers, made him a seer.

children.text: stotāraṃ vipraḥ sudinatve ahnāṃ yān nu dyāvas tatanan yād uṣāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The inspired poet made the singer one of fair days, while the heavens stretched out and so did the dawns.

children.text: kva tyāni nau sakhyā babhūvuḥ sacāvahe yad avṛkam purā cit
children.translated_text: Where have those friendships of ours gone, when once, unharmed, we were together?

children.text: bṛhantam mānaṃ varuṇa svadhāvaḥ sahasradvāraṃ jagamā gṛhaṃ te ||
children.translated_text: O self-ruling <s>Varuṇa</s>, I went to your great dwelling, your lofty, thousand-doored house.

children.text: ya āpir nityo varuṇa priyaḥ san tvām āgāṃsi kṛṇavat sakhā te
children.translated_text: Though a constant kinsman and dear to you, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, your friend has committed offenses against you.

children.text: mā ta enasvanto yakṣin bhujema yandhi ṣmā vipra stuvate varūtham ||
children.translated_text: May we, though guilty, not partake of another's due; grant protection, O inspired one, to the singer who praises you.

children.text: dhruvāsu tvāsu kṣitiṣu kṣiyanto vy asmat pāśaṃ varuṇo mumocat
children.translated_text: Dwelling in those firm abodes, <s>Varuṇa</s> has loosened the noose from us.

children.text: avo vanvānā aditer upasthād yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Winning help from the lap of <s>Aditi</s>, may you always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 605
mo ṣu varuṇa mṛnmayaṃ gṛhaṃ rājann ahaṃ gamam
children.translated_text: O <s>Varuṇa</s>, let me not go to the house made of clay, O king.

children.text: mṛﾱā sukṣatra mṛﾱaya ||
children.translated_text: Be gracious, O well-ruling one; be gracious.

children.text: yad emi prasphurann iva dṛtir na dhmāto adrivaḥ
children.translated_text: When I go trembling, like an inflated skin bag, O stone-possessing one,

children.text: mṛﾱā sukṣatra mṛﾱaya ||
children.translated_text: be gracious, O well-ruling one; be gracious.

children.text: kratvaḥ samaha dīnatā pratīpaṃ jagamā śuce
children.translated_text: Through weakness of will I have gone contrary to you, O bright one;

children.text: mṛﾱā sukṣatra mṛﾱaya ||
children.translated_text: be gracious, O well-ruling one; be gracious.

children.text: apām madhye tasthivāṃsaṃ tṛṣṇāvidaj jaritāram
children.translated_text: Thirst has found the singer standing in the midst of the waters;

children.text: mṛﾱā sukṣatra mṛﾱaya ||
children.translated_text: be gracious, O well-ruling one; be gracious.

children.text: yat kiṃ cedaṃ varuṇa daivye jane 'bhidroham manuṣyāś carāmasi
children.translated_text: Whatever treachery, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, we men commit among the divine folk,

children.text: acittī yat tava dharmā yuyopima mā nas tasmād enaso deva rīriṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: whatever through lack of thought we have loosened from your <s>dharma</s> (sacred ordinance), do not harm us for that sin, O god.

children.text: Chapter 606
pra vīrayā śucayo dadrire vām adhvaryubhir madhumantaḥ sutāsaḥ
children.translated_text: The bright, honey-rich pressed draughts have been set forth for you two with vigor by the <s>Adhvaryus</s>.

children.text: vaha vāyo niyuto yāhy acchā pibā sutasyāndhaso madāya ||
children.translated_text: Bring your teams, O <s>Vāyu</s>; come hither. Drink the pressed soma-juice for exhilaration.

children.text: īśānāya prahutiṃ yas ta ānaṭ chuciṃ somaṃ śucipās tubhyaṃ vāyo
children.translated_text: Whoever has brought an offering to you, the ruling one, the bright soma, O pure-drinking <s>Vāyu</s>,

children.text: kṛṇoṣi tam martyeṣu praśastaṃ jāto jāto jāyate vājy asya ||
children.translated_text: you make him praised among mortals; born again and again, he becomes a winner of the prize through it.

children.text: rāye nu yaṃ jajñatū rodasīme rāye devī dhiṣaṇā dhāti devam
children.translated_text: For wealth these two, heaven and earth, brought this god to birth; for wealth the divine <s>Dhiṣaṇā</s> establishes the god.

children.text: adha vāyuṃ niyutaḥ saścata svā uta śvetaṃ vasudhitiṃ nireke ||
children.translated_text: Then the teams follow <s>Vāyu</s> as their own, and he has revealed the white, treasure-bestowing power.

children.text: ucchann uṣasaḥ sudinā ariprā uru jyotir vividur dīdhyānāḥ
children.translated_text: The dawns have shone forth, bringing good days, unharmed; shining, they have found wide light.

children.text: gavyaṃ cid ūrvam uśijo vi vavrus teṣām anu pradivaḥ sasrur āpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Uśijs</s> have opened even the cow-rich enclosure; after them the waters streamed from heaven.

children.text: te satyena manasā dīdhyānāḥ svena yuktāsaḥ kratunā vahanti
children.translated_text: They, shining with a truthful mind, yoked by their own resolve, convey

children.text: indravāyū vīravāhaṃ rathaṃ vām īśānayor abhi pṛkṣaḥ sacante ||
children.translated_text: your hero-bearing chariot, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>; around the two rulers the nourishments attend.

children.text: īśānāso ye dadhate svar ṇo gobhir aśvebhir vasubhir hiraṇyaiḥ
children.translated_text: Those ruling ones who hold sunlight for us with cows, horses, goods, and gold,

children.text: indravāyū sūrayo viśvam āyur arvadbhir vīraiḥ pṛtanāsu sahyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: may the patrons, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>, through a whole lifetime overcome in battles with racers and heroes.

children.text: arvanto na śravaso bhikṣamāṇā indravāyū suṣṭutibhir vasiṣṭhāḥ
children.translated_text: Like racehorses seeking fame, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>, the <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s> call with good praises;

children.text: vājayantaḥ sv avase huvema yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: striving for the prize, we would call you for our own aid; may you always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 607
kuvid aṅga namasā ye vṛdhāsaḥ purā devā anavadyāsa āsan
children.translated_text: Might those who were strengthened by reverence, the ancient faultless gods,

children.text: te vāyave manave bādhitāyāvāsayann uṣasaṃ sūryeṇa ||
children.translated_text: have caused <s>Uṣas</s> to shine with <s>Sūrya</s> for <s>Vāyu</s>, for oppressed <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: uśantā dūtā na dabhāya gopā māsaś ca pāthaḥ śaradaś ca pūrvīḥ
children.translated_text: Desiring us, like messengers not to be deceived, as guardians through months, paths, and many autumns,

children.text: indravāyū suṣṭutir vām iyānā mārḍīkam īṭṭe suvitaṃ ca navyam ||
children.translated_text: this good praise, coming to you, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>, asks for mercy and new good guidance.

children.text: pīvoannāṁ rayivṛdhaḥ sumedhāḥ śvetaḥ siṣakti niyutām abhiśrīḥ
children.translated_text: The white one, rich in food, increaser of wealth, wise and splendid among the teams, attends.

children.text: te vāyave samanaso vi tasthur viśven naraḥ svapatyāni cakruḥ ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Vāyu</s> they stood apart with one mind; all the men made good offspring.

children.text: yāvat taras tanvo yāvad ojo yāvan naraś cakṣasā dīdhyānāḥ
children.translated_text: As far as the body's force extends, as far as vigor, as far as men shine with sight,

children.text: śuciṃ somaṃ śucipā pātam asme indravāyū sadatam barhir edam ||
children.translated_text: drink the bright soma for us, O pure-drinkers, <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>; sit upon this sacred grass.

children.text: niyuvānā niyuta spārhavīrā indravāyū sarathaṃ yātam arvāk
children.translated_text: Yoked with your teams, with desirable heroes among the teams, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>, come hither on the same chariot.

children.text: idaṃ hi vām prabhṛtam madhvo agram adha prīṇānā vi mumuktam asme ||
children.translated_text: For this first portion of sweetness has been brought for you; then, being pleased, release gifts for us.

children.text: yā vāṃ śataṃ niyuto yāḥ sahasram indravāyū viśvavārāḥ sacante
children.translated_text: Those hundred teams of yours, those thousand, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>, all-choice, attend you;

children.text: ābhir yātaṃ suvidatrābhir arvāk pātaṃ narā pratibhṛtasya madhvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with these, good bestowers, come hither; drink, O heroes, of the sweetness set before you.

children.text: arvanto na śravaso bhikṣamāṇā indravāyū suṣṭutibhir vasiṣṭhāḥ
children.translated_text: Like racehorses seeking fame, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>, the <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s> call with good praises;

children.text: vājayantaḥ sv avase huvema yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: striving for the prize, we would call you for our own aid; may you always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 608
ā vāyo bhūṣa śucipā upa naḥ sahasraṃ te niyuto viśvavāra
children.translated_text: Come adorn yourself near us, O pure-drinking <s>Vāyu</s>; your thousand teams are all-choice.

children.text: upo te andho madyam ayāmi yasya deva dadhiṣe pūrvapeyam ||
children.translated_text: I bring near to you the intoxicating soma-draught of which, O god, you claim the first drinking.

children.text: pra sotā jīro adhvareṣv asthāt somam indrāya vāyave pibadhyai
children.translated_text: The quick presser has stepped forth at the rites, to press soma for <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s> to drink,

children.text: pra yad vām madhvo agriyam bharanty adhvaryavo devayantaḥ śacībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: when the <s>Adhvaryus</s>, seeking the gods with their powers, bring the foremost sweetness for you two.

children.text: pra yābhir yāsi dāśvāṃsam acchā niyudbhir vāyav iṣṭaye duroṇe
children.translated_text: With those teams by which you go toward the worshipper, O <s>Vāyu</s>, for refreshment in his home,

children.text: ni no rayiṃ subhojasaṃ yuvasva ni vīraṃ gavyam aśvyaṃ ca rādhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: yoke for us wealth rich in food; yoke heroic, cattle-rich and horse-rich bounty.

children.text: ye vāyava indramādanāsa ādevāso nitośanāso aryaḥ
children.translated_text: Those, O <s>Vāyu</s>, who gladden <s>Indra</s>, godward, keenly urging the noble one,

children.text: ghnanto vṛtrāṇi sūribhiḥ ṣyāma sāsahvāṃso yudhā nṛbhir amitrān ||
children.translated_text: may we, with patrons, be smiters of obstacles, overpowering enemies in battle with men.

children.text: ā no niyudbhiḥ śatinībhir adhvaraṃ sahasriṇībhir upa yāhi yajñam
children.translated_text: Come to our rite, to the sacrifice, with hundredfold teams and with thousandfold teams.

children.text: vāyo asmin savane mādayasva yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāyu</s>, take delight in this pressing; may you always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 609
śuciṃ nu stomaṃ navajātam adyendrāgnī vṛtrahaṇā juṣethām
children.translated_text: Now today may you two enjoy the bright, newly born hymn, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, slayers of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: ubhā hi vāṃ suhavā johavīmi tā vājaṃ sadya uśate dheṣṭhā ||
children.translated_text: For I call upon you both, easy to invoke; bestow the prize at once on the one who desires it.

children.text: tā sānasī śavasānā hi bhūtaṃ sākaṃvṛdhā śavasā śūśuvāṃsā
children.translated_text: For you two are prize-winning and mighty, growing together, swollen with power.

children.text: kṣayantau rāyo yavasasya bhūreḥ pṛṅktaṃ vājasya sthavirasya ghṛṣveḥ ||
children.translated_text: Dwelling over abundant wealth of grain, mingle yourselves with the firm, eager prize.

children.text: upo ha yad vidathaṃ vājino gur dhībhir viprāḥ pramatim icchamānāḥ
children.translated_text: When the inspired poets, seeking insight with their thoughts, have gone near the assembly like racers,

children.text: arvanto na kāṣṭhāṃ nakṣamāṇā indrāgnī johuvato naras te ||
children.translated_text: like horses reaching the goal, those men call upon you, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: gīrbhir vipraḥ pramatim icchamāna īṭṭe rayiṃ yaśasam pūrvabhājam
children.translated_text: The inspired poet, seeking insight with songs, asks for wealth, fame-bearing and anciently shared.

children.text: indrāgnī vṛtrahaṇā suvajrā pra no navyebhis tirataṃ deṣṇaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, slayers of <s>Vṛtra</s>, bearing good thunderbolts, carry us beyond with new gifts.

children.text: saṃ yan mahī mithatī spardhamāne tanūrucā śūrasātā yataite
children.translated_text: When the two great ones, clashing and contending, go forth with shining bodies to the winning of heroes,

children.text: adevayuṃ vidathe devayubhiḥ satrā hataṃ somasutā janena ||
children.translated_text: strike down at once the godless man in the assembly with the soma-pressing, god-loving people.

children.text: imām u ṣu somasutim upa na endrāgnī saumanasāya yātam
children.translated_text: Come near to this soma-pressing of ours, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, for gracious-mindedness.

children.text: nū ciddhi parimamnāthe asmān ā vāṃ śaśvadbhir vavṛtīya vājaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: For even now you have encompassed us; I would turn you hither always with prizes.

children.text: so agna enā namasā samiddho 'cchā mitraṃ varuṇam indraṃ voceḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, kindled by this reverence, speak well here to <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yat sīm āgaś cakṛmā tat su mṛﾱa tad aryamāditiḥ śiśrathantu ||
children.translated_text: Whatever offense we have committed, be gracious about that; let <s>Aryaman</s> and <s>Aditi</s> loosen it.

children.text: etā agna āśuṣāṇāsa iṣṭīr yuvoḥ sacābhy aśyāma vājān
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, may we, eagerly desiring, together with you two attain these offerings and the prizes.

children.text: mendro no viṣṇur marutaḥ pari khyan yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let not <s>Indra</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, or the <s>Maruts</s> disregard us; may you always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 610
iyaṃ vām asya manmana indrāgnī pūrvyastutiḥ
children.translated_text: This ancient praise-thought of mine for you two, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: abhrād vṛṣṭir ivājani ||
children.translated_text: has been born like rain from a cloud.

children.text: śṛṇutaṃ jaritur havam indrāgnī vanataṃ giraḥ
children.translated_text: Hear the singer's call, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>; welcome the songs.

children.text: īśānā pipyataṃ dhiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: As lords, make the thoughts swell.

children.text: mā pāpatvāya no narendrāgnī mābhiśastaye
children.translated_text: Do not give us over to evil, O heroes, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, nor to curse.

children.text: mā no rīradhataṃ nide ||
children.translated_text: Do not let us fall into blame.

children.text: indre agnā namo bṛhat suvṛktim erayāmahe
children.translated_text: To <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> we send forth great homage and a well-spoken hymn,

children.text: dhiyā dhenā avasyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with thought and with a milch cow, seeking aid.

children.text: tā hi śaśvanta īﾱata itthā viprāsa ūtaye
children.translated_text: For the inspired poets have always invoked those two in just this way for help,

children.text: sabādho vājasātaye ||
children.translated_text: when pressed, for the winning of prize.

children.text: tā vāṃ gīrbhir vipanyavaḥ prayasvanto havāmahe
children.translated_text: We, discerning and bringing offerings, call you two with songs,

children.text: medhasātā saniṣyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: desiring to win inspired skill.

children.text: indrāgnī avasā gatam asmabhyaṃ carṣaṇīsahā
children.translated_text: Come with aid for us, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, conquerors of peoples.

children.text: mā no duḥśaṃsa īśata ||
children.translated_text: Let no ill-speaking man rule over us.

children.text: mā kasya no araruṣo dhūrtiḥ praṇaṅ martyasya
children.translated_text: Let no injury from any hostile mortal overtake us.

children.text: indrāgnī śarma yacchatam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, grant us shelter.

children.text: gomaddhiraṇyavad vasu yad vām aśvāvad īmahe
children.translated_text: The wealth rich in cows, rich in gold, and rich in horses that we ask of you two,

children.text: indrāgnī tad vanemahi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, may we win that.

children.text: yat soma ā sute nara indrāgnī ajohavuḥ
children.translated_text: When, at the pressed soma, O heroes, the worshippers called out to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: saptīvantā saparyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: honoring you two with teams of swift horses,

children.text: ukthebhir vṛtrahantamā yā mandānā cid ā girā
children.translated_text: then with recitations they attend upon you, greatest slayers of <s>Vṛtra</s>,

children.text: āṅgūṣair āvivāsataḥ ||
children.translated_text: even while you are exhilarated, with songs of praise and calls.

children.text: tāv id duḥśaṃsam martyaṃ durvidvāṃsaṃ rakṣasvinam
children.translated_text: Strike down that ill-speaking mortal, ignorant and possessed by demonic force;

children.text: ābhogaṃ hanmanā hatam udadhiṃ hanmanā hatam ||
children.translated_text: slay the devourer with your weapon, slay the swelling foe with your weapon.

children.text: Chapter 611
pra kṣodasā dhāyasā sasra eṣā sarasvatī dharuṇam āyasī pūḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>Sarasvatī</s> has flowed forth with mighty flood and nourishing force, a firm iron citadel as support.

children.text: prabābadhānā rathyeva yāti viśvā apo mahinā sindhur anyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Breaking forth, like one on a chariot road, the river goes in greatness beyond all other waters.

children.text: ekācetat sarasvatī nadīnāṃ śucir yatī giribhya ā samudrāt
children.translated_text: <s>Sarasvatī</s> alone, pure in her course among rivers, going from the mountains to the sea,

children.text: rāyaś cetantī bhuvanasya bhūrer ghṛtam payo duduhe nāhuṣāya ||
children.translated_text: aware of the wealth of the vast world, has milked out ghee and milk for <s>Nahuṣa</s>.

children.text: sa vāvṛdhe naryo yoṣaṇāsu vṛṣā śiśur vṛṣabho yajñiyāsu
children.translated_text: He has grown strong, a manly bull among women, a vigorous child, a bull among those worthy of sacrifice.

children.text: sa vājinam maghavadbhyo dadhāti vi sātaye tanvam māmṛjīta ||
children.translated_text: He grants a prize-winning steed to the liberal patrons; for winning goods he cleanses his body.

children.text: uta syā naḥ sarasvatī juṣāṇopa śravat subhagā yajñe asmin
children.translated_text: And may that fortunate <s>Sarasvatī</s>, accepting us, hear us in this sacrifice,

children.text: mitajñubhir namasyair iyānā rāyā yujā cid uttarā sakhibhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: coming with measured knees and reverent bows, even higher in wealth, yoked with friendship, than our companions.

children.text: imā juhvānā yuṣmad ā namobhiḥ prati stomaṃ sarasvati juṣasva
children.translated_text: As these offerings are poured with reverences from us, accept the praise-song, O <s>Sarasvatī</s>.

children.text: tava śarman priyatame dadhānā upa stheyāma śaraṇaṃ na vṛkṣam ||
children.translated_text: Dwelling in your dearest shelter, may we stand near you as at the refuge of a tree.

children.text: ayam u te sarasvati vasiṣṭho dvārāv ṛtasya subhage vy āvaḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, O <s>Sarasvatī</s>, has opened wide for you the doors of <s>ṛta</s> (sacred order), O fortunate one.

children.text: vardha śubhre stuvate rāsi vājān yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Grow strong, O bright one; grant prizes to the singer. May you always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 612
bṛhad u gāyiṣe vaco 'suryā nadīnām
children.translated_text: A great utterance has been sung of the divine power of the rivers.

children.text: sarasvatīm in mahayā suvṛktibhi stomair vasiṣṭha rodasī ||
children.translated_text: With good hymns and praises, O <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, magnify <s>Sarasvatī</s> and both Heaven and Earth.

children.text: ubhe yat te mahinā śubhre andhasī adhikṣiyanti pūravaḥ
children.translated_text: When, O bright one, both realms by your greatness the <s>Pūrus</s> occupy,

children.text: sā no bodhy avitrī marutsakhā coda rādho maghonām ||
children.translated_text: be mindful of us as a protectress; friend of the <s>Maruts</s>, impel the gift of the generous.

children.text: bhadram id bhadrā kṛṇavat sarasvaty akavārī cetati vājinīvatī
children.translated_text: Auspicious <s>Sarasvatī</s> will indeed make auspicious good, uninjuring, aware, and rich in prizes,

children.text: gṛṇānā jamadagnivat stuvānā ca vasiṣṭhavat ||
children.translated_text: being praised like <s>Jamadagni</s> and lauded like <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>.

children.text: janīyanto nv agravaḥ putrīyantaḥ sudānavaḥ
children.translated_text: Seeking children and desiring sons, O very generous ones,

children.text: sarasvantaṃ havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: we call upon <s>Sarasvant</s>.

children.text: ye te sarasva ūrmayo madhumanto ghṛtaścutaḥ
children.translated_text: Those waves of yours, O <s>Sarasvant</s>, honey-sweet and dripping with ghee,

children.text: tebhir no 'vitā bhava ||
children.translated_text: with them become our protector.

children.text: pīpivāṃsaṃ sarasvata stanaṃ yo viśvadarśataḥ
children.translated_text: May we partake of the swelling breast of <s>Sarasvant</s>, visible to all,

children.text: bhakṣīmahi prajām iṣam ||
children.translated_text: for progeny and nourishment.

children.text: Chapter 613
yajñe divo nṛṣadane pṛthivyā naro yatra devayavo madanti
children.translated_text: At the sacrifice, in the heavenly seat of men and on earth, where men devoted to the gods rejoice,

children.text: indrāya yatra savanāni sunve gaman madāya prathamaṃ vayaś ca ||
children.translated_text: where the pressings are pressed for <s>Indra</s>, let the first vigor and strength come for exhilaration.

children.text: ā daivyā vṛṇīmahe 'vāṃsi bṛhaspatir no maha ā sakhāyaḥ
children.translated_text: We choose the divine aids; may <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, our great friend, come to us.

children.text: yathā bhavema mīﾱhuṣe anāgā yo no dātā parāvataḥ piteva ||
children.translated_text: May we be free from guilt before the bountiful one, who is our giver from afar, like a father.

children.text: tam u jyeṣṭhaṃ namasā havirbhiḥ suśevam brahmaṇaspatiṃ gṛṇīṣe
children.translated_text: I praise with reverence and offerings that eldest, gracious <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>.

children.text: indraṃ śloko mahi daivyaḥ siṣaktu yo brahmaṇo devakṛtasya rājā ||
children.translated_text: May the great divine hymn attend <s>Indra</s>, who is king of the sacred formulation made by the gods.

children.text: sa ā no yoniṃ sadatu preṣṭho bṛhaspatir viśvavāro yo asti
children.translated_text: May <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, dearest and desirable to all, sit down here in our birthplace.

children.text: kāmo rāyaḥ suvīryasya taṃ dāt parṣan no ati saścato ariṣṭān ||
children.translated_text: Desire for wealth and heroic power shall give him; may he carry us across the harmful foes that cling to us.

children.text: tam ā no arkam amṛtāya juṣṭam ime dhāsur amṛtāsaḥ purājāḥ
children.translated_text: Let these immortals, ancient-born, establish for us that song, pleasing for immortality.

children.text: śucikrandaṃ yajatam pastyānām bṛhaspatim anarvāṇaṃ huvema ||
children.translated_text: Let us call on <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, bright-sounding, worthy of sacrifice, lord of dwellings, irresistible.

children.text: taṃ śagmāso aruṣāso aśvā bṛhaspatiṃ sahavāho vahanti
children.translated_text: The strong, ruddy horses, yoked together, carry that <s>Bṛhaspati</s>,

children.text: sahaś cid yasya nīlavat sadhasthaṃ nabho na rūpam aruṣaṃ vasānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: he whose common seat is even in strength, blue-hued, wearing a form like ruddy cloud.

children.text: sa hi śuciḥ śatapatraḥ sa śundhyur hiraṇyavāśīr iṣiraḥ svarṣāḥ
children.translated_text: For he is pure, hundred-winged, purifying, golden-haired, vigorous, winning the sun.

children.text: bṛhaspatiḥ sa svāveśa ṛṣvaḥ purū sakhibhya āsutiṃ kariṣṭhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, well-housed and lofty, will make abundant libation for his friends.

children.text: devī devasya rodasī janitrī bṛhaspatiṃ vāvṛdhatur mahitvā
children.translated_text: The two goddesses, Heaven and Earth, mothers of the god, have magnified <s>Bṛhaspati</s> with greatness.

children.text: dakṣāyyāya dakṣatā sakhāyaḥ karad brahmaṇe sutarā sugādhā ||
children.translated_text: With skill for the skillful one, O friends, he will make the path very easy and fordable for sacred formulation.

children.text: iyaṃ vām brahmaṇaspate suvṛktir brahmendrāya vajriṇe akāri
children.translated_text: This good hymn has been made for you two, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, and for <s>Indra</s> the wielder of the thunderbolt.

children.text: aviṣṭaṃ dhiyo jigṛtam purandhīr jajastam aryo vanuṣām arātīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Aid our thoughts, seize the insights, and drive away the hostilities of enemies and assailants.

children.text: bṛhaspate yuvam indraś ca vasvo divyasyeśāthe uta pārthivasya
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, you and <s>Indra</s> are lords of heavenly and also earthly wealth.

children.text: dhattaṃ rayiṃ stuvate kīraye cid yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bestow riches on the praising singer; may you always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 614
adhvaryavo 'ruṇaṃ dugdham aṃśuṃ juhotana vṛṣabhāya kṣitīnām
children.translated_text: O <s>Adhvaryus</s>, pour as an offering the ruddy, milked-out shoot for the bull of the peoples.

children.text: gaurād vedīyāṁ avapānam indro viśvāhed yāti sutasomam icchan ||
children.translated_text: From the bright pressing-place <s>Indra</s> comes to the trough every day, seeking the pressed <s>soma</s>.

children.text: yad dadhiṣe pradivi cārv annaṃ dive dive pītim id asya vakṣi
children.translated_text: When you set down the lovely food in the ancient place, day by day you bring him only the drink.

children.text: uta hṛdota manasā juṣāṇa uśann indra prasthitān pāhi somān ||
children.translated_text: And, taking pleasure with heart and with mind, O eager <s>Indra</s>, drink the <s>somas</s> set forth.

children.text: jajñānaḥ somaṃ sahase papātha pra te mātā mahimānam uvāca
children.translated_text: At your birth you drank the <s>soma</s> for strength; your mother proclaimed your greatness to you.

children.text: endra paprāthorv antarikṣaṃ yudhā devebhyo varivaś cakartha ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, you filled the wide midspace; by battle you made broad room for the gods.

children.text: yad yodhayā mahato manyamānān sākṣāma tān bāhubhiḥ śāśadānān
children.translated_text: When we should contend with those who think themselves great, those who rule by their arms,

children.text: yad vā nṛbhir vṛta indrābhiyudhyās taṃ tvayājiṃ sauśravasaṃ jayema ||
children.translated_text: or when, O <s>Indra</s>, you would fight surrounded by men, may we win that contest that brings good fame through you.

children.text: prendrasya vocam prathamā kṛtāni pra nūtanā maghavā yā cakāra
children.translated_text: I shall proclaim first the ancient deeds of <s>Indra</s>, and then the new ones which the bountiful one has done.

children.text: yaded adevīr asahiṣṭa māyā athābhavat kevalaḥ somo asya ||
children.translated_text: When he overpowered the ungodly deceits, then the <s>soma</s> became his alone.

children.text: tavedaṃ viśvam abhitaḥ paśavyaṃ yat paśyasi cakṣasā sūryasya
children.translated_text: All this pasturage around you is yours, whatever you see with the eye of the sun.

children.text: gavām asi gopatir eka indra bhakṣīmahi te prayatasya vasvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You alone, O <s>Indra</s>, are lord of the cows; may we enjoy your well-prepared wealth.

children.text: bṛhaspate yuvam indraś ca vasvo divyasyeśāthe uta pārthivasya
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s> and <s>Indra</s>, you two rule over heavenly wealth and also earthly wealth.

children.text: dhattaṃ rayiṃ stuvate kīraye cid yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Set wealth for the singer who praises, even for the poet; may you always protect us with well-being.

children.text: Chapter 615
paro mātrayā tanvā vṛdhāna na te mahitvam anv aśnuvanti
children.translated_text: Growing beyond measure in your body, they do not attain to your greatness.

children.text: ubhe te vidma rajasī pṛthivyā viṣṇo deva tvam paramasya vitse ||
children.translated_text: We know your two regions of the earth; O god <s>Viṣṇu</s>, you know the highest one.

children.text: na te viṣṇo jāyamāno na jāto deva mahimnaḥ param antam āpa
children.translated_text: No one being born, nor one already born, O <s>Viṣṇu</s>, god, has reached the farthest limit of your greatness.

children.text: ud astabhnā nākam ṛṣvam bṛhantaṃ dādhartha prācīṃ kakubham pṛthivyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: You propped up the lofty, great vault of heaven; you supported the eastern quarter of the earth.

children.text: irāvatī dhenumatī hi bhūtaṃ sūyavasinī manuṣe daśasyā
children.translated_text: For you two have become rich in refreshment, rich in milk-cows, rich in good pasture, showing favor to humankind.

children.text: vy astabhnā rodasī viṣṇav ete dādhartha pṛthivīm abhito mayūkhaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: You propped apart the two worlds, O <s>Viṣṇu</s>; you held the earth fast on every side with rays.

children.text: uruṃ yajñāya cakrathur u lokaṃ janayantā sūryam uṣāsam agnim
children.translated_text: You two made wide space for the sacrifice, broad room, bringing forth the sun, dawn, and fire.

children.text: dāsasya cid vṛṣaśiprasya māyā jaghnathur narā pṛtanājyeṣu ||
children.translated_text: You two heroes struck down even the deceits of the <s>Dāsa</s> <s>Vṛṣaśipra</s> in the contests of battle.

children.text: indrāviṣṇū dṛṃhitāḥ śambarasya nava puro navatiṃ ca śnathiṣṭam
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, you shattered the ninety-nine strongholds of <s>Śambara</s>, firmly built.

children.text: śataṃ varcinaḥ sahasraṃ ca sākaṃ hatho apraty asurasya vīrān ||
children.translated_text: You struck down a hundred and a thousand heroes of <s>Varcin</s> together, the warriors of the hostile <s>Asura</s>, with no one left to oppose you.

children.text: iyam manīṣā bṛhatī bṛhantorukramā tavasā vardhayantī
children.translated_text: This great inspired thought, making the two great, wide-striding ones grow by its might,

children.text: rare vāṃ stomaṃ vidatheṣu viṣṇo pinvatam iṣo vṛjaneṣv indra ||
children.translated_text: has granted you two a hymn in the assemblies; O <s>Viṣṇu</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, fill us with nourishments in the settlements.

children.text: vaṣaṭ te viṣṇav āsa ā kṛṇomi tan me juṣasva śipiviṣṭa havyam
children.translated_text: I utter the vaṣaṭ-call to you, O <s>Viṣṇu</s>; accept this oblation of mine, O <s>Śipiviṣṭa</s>.

children.text: vardhantu tvā suṣṭutayo giro me yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May my well-praised songs and words strengthen you; may you always protect us with well-being.

children.text: Chapter 616
nū marto dayate saniṣyan yo viṣṇava urugāyāya dāśat
children.translated_text: Now the mortal who seeks to gain favor shows generosity, the one who gives to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the far-sung one.

children.text: pra yaḥ satrācā manasā yajāta etāvantaṃ naryam āvivāsāt ||
children.translated_text: He who with a straight mind worships continuously has honored so great a manly power.

children.text: tvaṃ viṣṇo sumatiṃ viśvajanyām aprayutām evayāvo matiṃ dāḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Viṣṇu</s>, give a favorable thought belonging to all peoples, an unfailing intention, O impeller.

children.text: parco yathā naḥ suvitasya bhūrer aśvāvataḥ puruścandrasya rāyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: So that you may bring us near to much good fortune, to wealth with horses and many bright gifts.

children.text: trir devaḥ pṛthivīm eṣa etāṃ vi cakrame śatarcasam mahitvā
children.translated_text: This god strode three times across this earth in his greatness, with a hundred praises.

children.text: pra viṣṇur astu tavasas tavīyān tveṣaṃ hy asya sthavirasya nāma ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Viṣṇu</s> be mightier than the mighty, for the name of this ancient one is fierce.

children.text: vi cakrame pṛthivīm eṣa etāṃ kṣetrāya viṣṇur manuṣe daśasyan
children.translated_text: This <s>Viṣṇu</s> strode across this earth, showing favor to humankind for a dwelling-place.

children.text: dhruvāso asya kīrayo janāsa urukṣitiṃ sujanimā cakāra ||
children.translated_text: His singers are firmly established people; noble-born, he made a broad dwelling.

children.text: pra tat te adya śipiviṣṭa nāmāryaḥ śaṃsāmi vayunāni vidvān
children.translated_text: Today I, the noble one, proclaim that name of yours, O <s>Śipiviṣṭa</s>, knowing your workings.

children.text: taṃ tvā gṛṇāmi tavasam atavyān kṣayantam asya rajasaḥ parāke ||
children.translated_text: I praise you, mighty and stronger than the strong, dwelling at the far end of this realm.

children.text: kim it te viṣṇo paricakṣyam bhūt pra yad vavakṣe śipiviṣṭo asmi
children.translated_text: What blame could there be in this for you, O <s>Viṣṇu</s>, when you have declared, 'I am <s>Śipiviṣṭa</s>'?

children.text: mā varpo asmad apa gūha etad yad anyarūpaḥ samithe babhūtha ||
children.translated_text: Do not hide this form of yours from us, since you became of another shape in the battle.

children.text: vaṣaṭ te viṣṇav āsa ā kṛṇomi tan me juṣasva śipiviṣṭa havyam
children.translated_text: I utter the vaṣaṭ-call to you, O <s>Viṣṇu</s>; accept this oblation of mine, O <s>Śipiviṣṭa</s>.

children.text: vardhantu tvā suṣṭutayo giro me yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May my well-praised songs and words strengthen you; may you always protect us with well-being.

children.text: Chapter 617
tisro vācaḥ pra vada jyotiragrā yā etad duhre madhudogham ūdhaḥ
children.translated_text: Speak forth the three voices, foremost in light, which milk this udder that yields honey.

children.text: sa vatsaṃ kṛṇvan garbham oṣadhīnāṃ sadyo jāto vṛṣabho roravīti ||
children.translated_text: Making the calf, the embryo of the plants, the bull, born at once, bellows aloud.

children.text: yo vardhana oṣadhīnāṃ yo apāṃ yo viśvasya jagato deva īśe
children.translated_text: He who is the increaser of plants, of waters, and who as god rules over the whole moving world,

children.text: sa tridhātu śaraṇaṃ śarma yaṃsat trivartu jyotiḥ svabhiṣṭy asme ||
children.translated_text: may he grant us threefold refuge and shelter, the threefold light, for our own aid.

children.text: starīr u tvad bhavati sūta u tvad yathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ cakra eṣaḥ
children.translated_text: The barren one becomes fertile from you; what is produced comes from you; this one fashions his body according to will.

children.text: pituḥ payaḥ prati gṛbhṇāti mātā tena pitā vardhate tena putraḥ ||
children.translated_text: The mother receives the milk of the father; by it the father grows, and by it the son grows.

children.text: yasmin viśvāni bhuvanāni tasthus tisro dyāvas tredhā sasrur āpaḥ
children.translated_text: In whom all beings have stood, the three heavens, and the waters have streamed threefold,

children.text: trayaḥ kośāsa upasecanāso madhva ścotanty abhito virapśam ||
children.translated_text: the three vessels for pouring drip honey all around the overflowing one.

children.text: idaṃ vacaḥ parjanyāya svarāje hṛdo astv antaraṃ taj jujoṣat
children.translated_text: Let this speech be for <s>Parjanya</s>, the self-ruling one; let what is inside my heart be dear to him.

children.text: mayobhuvo vṛṣṭayaḥ santv asme supippalā oṣadhīr devagopāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the rains that bring delight be ours; may the plants, well-fruited and guarded by the gods, be ours.

children.text: sa retodhā vṛṣabhaḥ śaśvatīnāṃ tasminn ātmā jagatas tasthuṣaś ca
children.translated_text: He is the seed-bearing bull of the everlasting ones; in him is the self of what moves and what stands.

children.text: tan ma ṛtam pātu śataśāradāya yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May that truth protect me for a hundred autumns; may you always protect us with well-being.

children.text: Chapter 618
parjanyāya pra gāyata divas putrāya mīﾱhuṣe
children.translated_text: Sing forth to <s>Parjanya</s>, the son of heaven, the bountiful one.

children.text: sa no yavasam icchatu ||
children.translated_text: May he desire pasture for us.

children.text: yo garbham oṣadhīnāṃ gavāṃ kṛṇoty arvatām
children.translated_text: He who makes the embryo of plants, of cows, and of horses,

children.text: parjanyaḥ puruṣīṇām ||
children.translated_text: <s>Parjanya</s>, of women too,

children.text: tasmā id āsye havir juhotā madhumattamam
children.translated_text: to him indeed pour into the mouth the sweetest oblation.

children.text: iﾱāṃ naḥ saṃyataṃ karat ||
children.translated_text: May he make this joined together for us.

children.text: Chapter 619
saṃvatsaraṃ śaśayānā brāhmaṇā vratacāriṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Having lain quiet for a year, the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, observers of the vow,

children.text: vācam parjanyajinvitām pra maṇḍūkā avādiṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the frogs have spoken forth a voice quickened by <s>Parjanya</s>.

children.text: divyā āpo abhi yad enam āyan dṛtiṃ na śuṣkaṃ sarasī śayānam
children.translated_text: When the heavenly waters came upon this one, lying in the lake like a dry waterskin,

children.text: gavām aha na māyur vatsinīnām maṇḍūkānāṃ vagnur atrā sam eti ||
children.translated_text: then the cry of the frogs comes together like the lowing of cows with calves.

children.text: yad īm enāṁ uśato abhy avarṣīt tṛṣyāvataḥ prāvṛṣy āgatāyām
children.translated_text: When, as the rainy season arrived, the longed-for one rained upon them as they thirsted,

children.text: akhkhalīkṛtyā pitaraṃ na putro anyo anyam upa vadantam eti ||
children.translated_text: one comes to another who is speaking, croaking, like a son to his father.

children.text: anyo anyam anu gṛbhṇāty enor apām prasarge yad amandiṣātām
children.translated_text: One of the two takes hold of the other when they have rejoiced at the release of the waters.

children.text: maṇḍūko yad abhivṛṣṭaḥ kaniṣkan pṛśniḥ saṃpṛṅkte haritena vācam ||
children.translated_text: When the rained-upon frog croaks, the speckled one mingles his voice with the green one.

children.text: yad eṣām anyo anyasya vācaṃ śāktasyeva vadati śikṣamāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: When one of them repeats the voice of another, like a pupil learning from his teacher,

children.text: sarvaṃ tad eṣāṃ samṛdheva parva yat suvāco vadathanādhy apsu ||
children.translated_text: all that belongs to them is like abundance at a festival, when, eloquent, you speak upon the waters.

children.text: gomāyur eko ajamāyur ekaḥ pṛśnir eko harita eka eṣām
children.translated_text: One has the voice of a cow, one has the voice of a goat; one of them is speckled, one is green.

children.text: samānaṃ nāma bibhrato virūpāḥ purutrā vācam pipiśur vadantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bearing a common name though different in form, they ornament their voice in many ways as they speak.

children.text: brāhmaṇāso atirātre na some saro na pūrṇam abhito vadantaḥ
children.translated_text: Like <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> at the overnight <s>soma</s> rite, they speak all around the full lake.

children.text: saṃvatsarasya tad ahaḥ pari ṣṭha yan maṇḍūkāḥ prāvṛṣīṇam babhūva ||
children.translated_text: That day of the year has come upon them, when the frogs belong to the rainy season.

children.text: brāhmaṇāsaḥ somino vācam akrata brahma kṛṇvantaḥ parivatsarīṇam
children.translated_text: The <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> rich in <s>soma</s> have made their voice, performing the year-long sacred utterance.

children.text: adhvaryavo gharmiṇaḥ siṣvidānā āvir bhavanti guhyā na ke cit ||
children.translated_text: The heated <s>adhvaryu</s> priests, sweating, appear, like certain men who had been hidden.

children.text: devahitiṃ jugupur dvādaśasya ṛtuṃ naro na pra minanty ete
children.translated_text: They have guarded the divine ordinance of the twelfth month; these men do not transgress the season.

children.text: saṃvatsare prāvṛṣy āgatāyāṃ taptā gharmā aśnuvate visargam ||
children.translated_text: When the rainy season has come in the year, the heated <s>gharma</s> vessels obtain their release.

children.text: gomāyur adād ajamāyur adāt pṛśnir adāddharito no vasūni
children.translated_text: The cow-voiced one has given, the goat-voiced one has given; the speckled one and the green one have given us goods.

children.text: gavām maṇḍūkā dadataḥ śatāni sahasrasāve pra tiranta āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: O frogs, giving hundreds of cattle, extend our life in the winning of thousands.

children.text: Chapter 620
indrāsomā tapataṃ rakṣa ubjataṃ ny arpayataṃ vṛṣaṇā tamovṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, burn the <s>rakṣas</s>; thrust them down; O bulls, cast down those who grow in darkness.

children.text: parā śṛṇītam acito ny oṣataṃ hataṃ nudethāṃ ni śiśītam atriṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Tear apart the witless ones; burn them down; strike, drive away, and sharpen yourselves against the devourers.

children.text: indrāsomā sam aghaśaṃsam abhy aghaṃ tapur yayastu carur agnivāṁ iva
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, let burning heat go against the evil-speaking evil-doer, like a fire-filled cauldron.

children.text: brahmadviṣe kravyāde ghoracakṣase dveṣo dhattam anavāyaṃ kimīdine ||
children.translated_text: Against the hater of prayer, the flesh-eater, the terrible-eyed one, set inescapable hatred, against the <s>kimīdin</s>.

children.text: indrāsomā duṣkṛto vavre antar anārambhaṇe tamasi pra vidhyatam
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, pierce the evil-doers within the enclosure, in the supportless darkness.

children.text: yathā nātaḥ punar ekaś canodayat tad vām astu sahase manyumacchavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: So that not one of them may rise from there again, let that wrath-bearing deed of yours be for might.

children.text: indrāsomā vartayataṃ divo vadhaṃ sam pṛthivyā aghaśaṃsāya tarhaṇam
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, set in motion from heaven the weapon, and from earth the crushing missile against the evil-speaker.

children.text: ut takṣataṃ svaryam parvatebhyo yena rakṣo vāvṛdhānaṃ nijūrvathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And fashion the heavenly missile from the mountains, with which you bring down the growing <s>rakṣas</s>.

children.text: indrāsomā vartayataṃ divas pary agnitaptebhir yuvam aśmahanmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, from all around heaven set it in motion with fire-heated, stone-smiting missiles.

children.text: tapurvadhebhir ajarebhir atriṇo ni parśāne vidhyataṃ yantu nisvaram ||
children.translated_text: With burning, ageless weapons pierce the devourers in the ribs; let them go away voiceless.

children.text: indrāsomā pari vām bhūtu viśvata iyam matiḥ kakṣyāśveva vājinā
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, may this thought of mine surround you on every side, like a girth around racehorses.

children.text: yāṃ vāṃ hotrām parihinomi medhayemā brahmāṇi nṛpatīva jinvatam ||
children.translated_text: The priestly invocation that I gird about you with insight, may these sacred utterances gladden you like lords of men.

children.text: prati smarethāṃ tujayadbhir evair hataṃ druho rakṣaso bhaṅgurāvataḥ
children.translated_text: Remember, with impelling aids; strike the deceptions of the <s>rakṣases</s> that have destructive force.

children.text: indrāsomā duṣkṛte mā sugam bhūd yo naḥ kadā cid abhidāsati druhā ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, let there be no easy path for the evil-doer who ever attacks us with deceit.

children.text: yo mā pākena manasā carantam abhicaṣṭe anṛtebhir vacobhiḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever, while I go about with an innocent mind, assails me with untrue words,

children.text: āpa iva kāśinā saṃgṛbhītā asann astv āsata indra vaktā ||
children.translated_text: let him become as nothing, like waters grasped in a fist; O <s>Indra</s>, let the speaker be undone where he sits.

children.text: ye pākaśaṃsaṃ viharanta evair ye vā bhadraṃ dūṣayanti svadhābhiḥ
children.translated_text: Those who spread slander against the innocent with their attacks, or who by their own powers spoil what is good,

children.text: ahaye vā tān pradadātu soma ā vā dadhātu nirṛter upasthe ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Soma</s> hand them over to the serpent, or place them in the lap of <s>Nirṛti</s>.

children.text: yo no rasaṃ dipsati pitvo agne yo aśvānāṃ yo gavāṃ yas tanūnām
children.translated_text: Whoever seeks to steal our sap, O <s>Agni</s>, from food, from horses, from cows, or from our bodies,

children.text: ripu stena steyakṛd dabhram etu ni ṣa hīyatāṃ tanvā tanā ca ||
