children.translated_text: may that foe, thief, and worker of theft come to little; let him be deprived in body and offspring.

children.text: paraḥ so astu tanvā tanā ca tisraḥ pṛthivīr adho astu viśvāḥ
children.translated_text: Far away may he be, in body and offspring; may he be beneath all the three earths.

children.text: prati śuṣyatu yaśo asya devā yo no divā dipsati yaś ca naktam ||
children.translated_text: May his fame dry up, O gods, who seeks to steal from us by day and who by night.

children.text: suvijñānaṃ cikituṣe janāya sac cāsac ca vacasī paspṛdhāte
children.translated_text: For the discerning person it is easy to know: true and false words contend with each other.

children.text: tayor yat satyaṃ yatarad ṛjīyas tad it somo 'vati hanty āsat ||
children.translated_text: Of the two, whichever is true and straighter, that one <s>Soma</s> favors; he strikes down the false.

children.text: na vā u somo vṛjinaṃ hinoti na kṣatriyam mithuyā dhārayantam
children.translated_text: Indeed <s>Soma</s> does not aid crookedness, nor the ruler who falsely upholds it.

children.text: hanti rakṣo hanty āsad vadantam ubhāv indrasya prasitau śayāte ||
children.translated_text: He strikes the <s>rakṣas</s>; he strikes the speaker of falsehood; both lie in <s>Indra</s>'s snare.

children.text: yadi vāham anṛtadeva āsa moghaṃ vā devāṁ apyūhe agne
children.translated_text: If I have been one whose god is falsehood, or if I have vainly approached the gods, O <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: kim asmabhyaṃ jātavedo hṛṇīṣe droghavācas te nirṛthaṃ sacantām ||
children.translated_text: why are you angry with us, O <s>Jātavedas</s>? Let speakers of deceit fall into ruin before you.

children.text: adyā murīya yadi yātudhāno asmi yadi vāyus tatapa pūruṣasya
children.translated_text: May I die today if I am a <s>yātudhāna</s>, or if I have burned the life-breath of a man.

children.text: adhā sa vīrair daśabhir vi yūyā yo mā moghaṃ yātudhānety āha ||
children.translated_text: Then let that man be separated from ten heroes, who falsely calls me a <s>yātudhāna</s>.

children.text: yo māyātuṃ yātudhānety āha yo vā rakṣāḥ śucir asmīty āha
children.translated_text: Who calls me a sorcerer, a <s>yātudhāna</s>, or who, being a <s>rakṣas</s>, says, 'I am pure,'

children.text: indras taṃ hantu mahatā vadhena viśvasya jantor adhamas padīṣṭa ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Indra</s> strike him with a great weapon; may he sink to the lowest place of every creature.

children.text: pra yā jigāti khargaleva naktam apa druhā tanvaṃ gūhamānā
children.translated_text: She who goes forth by night like an owl, hiding her body through deceit,

children.text: vavrāṁ anantāṁ ava sā padīṣṭa grāvāṇo ghnantu rakṣasa upabdaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: may she fall into endless pits below; let the pressing-stones smash the <s>rakṣases</s> with their crashes.

children.text: vi tiṣṭhadhvam maruto vikṣv icchata gṛbhāyata rakṣasaḥ sam pinaṣṭana
children.translated_text: Spread out, O <s>Maruts</s>; search among the peoples; seize the <s>rakṣases</s> and crush them together.

children.text: vayo ye bhūtvī patayanti naktabhir ye vā ripo dadhire deve adhvare ||
children.translated_text: Those who, becoming birds, fly by night, or who as foes have taken their place in the divine sacrifice.

children.text: pra vartaya divo aśmānam indra somaśitam maghavan saṃ śiśādhi
children.translated_text: Set rolling from heaven, O <s>Indra</s>, the stone sharpened by <s>Soma</s>; O bounteous one, sharpen it well.

children.text: prāktād apāktād adharād udaktād abhi jahi rakṣasaḥ parvatena ||
children.translated_text: From the east, from the west, from below, from the north, strike the <s>rakṣases</s> with the mountain.

children.text: eta u tye patayanti śvayātava indraṃ dipsanti dipsavo 'dābhyam
children.translated_text: Here indeed those sorcerous ones with dog-like ways fly about; the deceivers seek to deceive inviolable <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: śiśīte śakraḥ piśunebhyo vadhaṃ nūnaṃ sṛjad aśaniṃ yātumadbhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The mighty one sharpens the weapon against the malicious informers; now he lets loose the thunderbolt against those possessed of sorcery.

children.text: indro yātūnām abhavat parāśaro havirmathīnām abhy āvivāsatām
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> became the destroyer of sorceries, drawing near against those who ravage the oblation.

children.text: abhīd u śakraḥ paraśur yathā vanam pātreva bhindan sata eti rakṣasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The mighty one comes against the <s>rakṣases</s>, cleaving them as an axe cleaves a forest, as one breaks vessels.

children.text: ulūkayātuṃ śuśulūkayātuṃ jahi śvayātum uta kokayātum
children.translated_text: Strike the owl-sorcerer and the screech-owl-sorcerer; strike the dog-sorcerer and also the cuckoo-sorcerer.

children.text: suparṇayātum uta gṛdhrayātuṃ dṛṣadeva pra mṛṇa rakṣa indra ||
children.translated_text: The eagle-sorcerer and the vulture-sorcerer too: crush the <s>rakṣas</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, as with a stone.

children.text: mā no rakṣo abhi naḍ yātumāvatām apocchatu mithunā yā kimīdinā
children.translated_text: Let no <s>rakṣas</s> possessed of sorcery assail us; let whatever paired <s>kimīdins</s> there are be driven away.

children.text: pṛthivī naḥ pārthivāt pātv aṃhaso 'ntarikṣaṃ divyāt pātv asmān ||
children.translated_text: May earth protect us from earthly distress; may the midspace protect us from heavenly distress.

children.text: indra jahi pumāṃsaṃ yātudhānam uta striyam māyayā śāśadānām
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, strike the male <s>yātudhāna</s>, and also the woman who practices deceit by magic.

children.text: vigrīvāso mūradevā ṛdantu mā te dṛśan sūryam uccarantam ||
children.translated_text: Let the neck-broken, foolish-godless ones howl; let them not see the sun rising.

children.text: prati cakṣva vi cakṣvendraś ca soma jāgṛtam
children.translated_text: Look toward them and look all around, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>; keep watch.

children.text: rakṣobhyo vadham asyatam aśaniṃ yātumadbhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Cast the weapon against the <s>rakṣases</s>, the thunderbolt against those possessed of sorcery.

children.text: Chapter 621
mā cid anyad vi śaṃsata sakhāyo mā riṣaṇyata
children.translated_text: Do not proclaim anything else, friends; do not come to harm.

children.text: indram it stotā vṛṣaṇaṃ sacā sute muhur ukthā ca śaṃsata ||
children.translated_text: Praise only <s>Indra</s>, the vigorous one, beside the pressed <s>soma</s>; again and again proclaim your hymns.

children.text: avakrakṣiṇaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ yathājuraṃ gāṃ na carṣaṇīsaham
children.translated_text: Praise the bending, mighty bull, powerful by nature, like a cow that overcomes the peoples,

children.text: vidveṣaṇaṃ saṃvananobhayaṅkaram maṃhiṣṭham ubhayāvinam ||
children.translated_text: the one who drives apart and wins together, fearsome to both sides, the greatest, possessing both powers.

children.text: yac ciddhi tvā janā ime nānā havanta ūtaye
children.translated_text: For even if these people invoke you in many different ways for aid,

children.text: asmākam brahmedam indra bhūtu te 'hā viśvā ca vardhanam ||
children.translated_text: may this prayer of ours, O <s>Indra</s>, become yours, for strengthening every day and in all ways.

children.text: vi tartūryante maghavan vipaścito 'ryo vipo janānām
children.translated_text: The wise poets strive through and through, O bounteous one, among the Arya peoples.

children.text: upa kramasva pururūpam ā bhara vājaṃ nediṣṭham ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: Step near; bring the nearest prize, manifold in form, for our aid.

children.text: mahe cana tvām adrivaḥ parā śulkāya deyām
children.translated_text: Not even for a great price, O possessor of the stone, would I give you away,

children.text: na sahasrāya nāyutāya vajrivo na śatāya śatāmagha ||
children.translated_text: not for a thousand, nor for ten thousand, O wielder of the thunderbolt, not for a hundred, O richly bounteous one.

children.text: vasyāṁ indrāsi me pitur uta bhrātur abhuñjataḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, you are better to me than my father, and than my brother who has not enjoyed wealth.

children.text: mātā ca me chadayathaḥ samā vaso vasutvanāya rādhase ||
children.translated_text: You and my mother shelter me alike, O good one, for wealth and a wealthy gift.

children.text: kveyatha kved asi purutrā ciddhi te manaḥ
children.translated_text: Where have you gone? Where are you? For your mind is in many places.

children.text: alarṣi yudhma khajakṛt purandara pra gāyatrā agāsiṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: You have gone forth, battle-eager, maker of spoils, breaker of strongholds; the <s>Gāyatrī</s> verses have gone out.

children.text: prāsmai gāyatram arcata vāvātur yaḥ purandaraḥ
children.translated_text: Sing forth the <s>Gāyatrī</s> song to him, the eagerly invoked breaker of strongholds,

children.text: yābhiḥ kāṇvasyopa barhir āsadaṃ yāsad vajrī bhinat puraḥ ||
children.translated_text: with which the thunderbolt-bearer sat down upon <s>Kāṇva</s>'s sacred grass, with which he shattered the strongholds.

children.text: ye te santi daśagvinaḥ śatino ye sahasriṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Those of yours that are yoked in tens, those in hundreds, those in thousands,

children.text: aśvāso ye te vṛṣaṇo raghudruvas tebhir nas tūyam ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: your swift-running, vigorous horses, with them come quickly to us.

children.text: ā tv adya sabardughāṃ huve gāyatravepasam
children.translated_text: Today I call to you the cow that yields for the whole company, trembling with <s>Gāyatrī</s> song:

children.text: indraṃ dhenuṃ sudughām anyām iṣam urudhārām araṅkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, the good-milking cow, another nourishment, broad-streaming and readily prepared.

children.text: yat tudat sūra etaśaṃ vaṅkū vātasya parṇinā
children.translated_text: When the hero struck <s>Etaśa</s>, or the crooked one, with the winged force of the wind,

children.text: vahat kutsam ārjuneyaṃ śatakratuḥ tsarad gandharvam astṛtam ||
children.translated_text: the hundred-powered one carried <s>Kutsa Ārjuneya</s>; he hurled down the undefeated <s>Gandharva</s>.

children.text: ya ṛte cid abhiśriṣaḥ purā jatrubhya ātṛdaḥ
children.translated_text: He who, even without support, long ago pierced through from the collarbones,

children.text: saṃdhātā saṃdhim maghavā purūvasur iṣkartā vihrutam punaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the bounteous, much-wealthy binder of the joint again sets right what is dislocated.

children.text: mā bhūma niṣṭyā ivendra tvad araṇā iva
children.translated_text: May we not be, O <s>Indra</s>, like men cast down away from you, like strangers,

children.text: vanāni na prajahitāny adrivo duroṣāso amanmahi ||
children.translated_text: like abandoned forests, O possessor of the stone; we have thought ourselves hard to dwell with.

children.text: amanmahīd anāśavo 'nugrāsaś ca vṛtrahan
children.translated_text: We have thought ourselves slow and ungracious, O <s>Vṛtrahan</s>,

children.text: sakṛt su te mahatā śūra rādhasā anu stomam mudīmahi ||
children.translated_text: yet once, O hero, through your great bounty may we rejoice in our hymn to you.

children.text: yadi stomam mama śravad asmākam indram indavaḥ
children.translated_text: If my hymn is heard, if our <s>soma</s> drops hear <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: tiraḥ pavitraṃ sasṛvāṃsa āśavo mandantu tugryāvṛdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: then, rushing through the filter, may they gladden the increaser of <s>Tugrya</s>.

children.text: ā tv adya sadhastutiṃ vāvātuḥ sakhyur ā gahi
children.translated_text: Come today to the shared praise, to the friendship of the eagerly invoked friend.

children.text: upastutir maghonām pra tvāvatv adhā te vaśmi suṣṭutim ||
children.translated_text: Let the praise of the bounteous ones help you forward; then I desire good praise for you.

children.text: sotā hi somam adribhir em enam apsu dhāvata
children.translated_text: For the presser has pressed <s>soma</s> with the stones; wash this one in the waters.

children.text: gavyā vastreva vāsayanta in naro nir dhukṣan vakṣaṇābhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The men clothe him as with a cow-yielding garment; they have milked him from the udders.

children.text: adha jmo adha vā divo bṛhato rocanād adhi
children.translated_text: Then, from the earth, or from the great heaven, from the bright realm,

children.text: ayā vardhasva tanvā girā mamā jātā sukrato pṛṇa ||
children.translated_text: grow by this body of mine, by my song, O good-minded one; fill what has been born.

children.text: indrāya su madintamaṃ somaṃ sotā vareṇyam
children.translated_text: Press for <s>Indra</s> the most exhilarating <s>soma</s>, the choice one.

children.text: śakra eṇam pīpayad viśvayā dhiyā hinvānaṃ na vājayum ||
children.translated_text: The mighty one, with all his thought, will swell this one as it is impelled, like one seeking the prize.

children.text: mā tvā somasya galdayā sadā yācann ahaṃ girā
children.translated_text: Let me not always beg you with a call because of the dripping flow of <s>soma</s>.

children.text: bhūrṇim mṛgaṃ na savaneṣu cukrudhaṃ ka īśānaṃ na yāciṣat ||
children.translated_text: Who would not beg the lord, roaring at the pressings like a restless beast?

children.text: madeneṣitam madam ugram ugreṇa śavasā
children.translated_text: Urged on by exhilaration, with fierce exhilaration and with fierce might,

children.text: viśveṣāṃ tarutāram madacyutam made hi ṣmā dadāti naḥ ||
children.translated_text: the one who overcomes all, whose intoxication does not fall away, in exhilaration indeed gives to us.

children.text: śevāre vāryā puru devo martāya dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: The god has many desirable, auspicious things for the mortal worshiper.

children.text: sa sunvate ca stuvate ca rāsate viśvagūrto ariṣṭutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He grants them to the presser and to the praiser, he who is praised by all and unpraised by foes.

children.text: endra yāhi matsva citreṇa deva rādhasā
children.translated_text: Come here, O <s>Indra</s>; rejoice, O god, in bright bounty.

children.text: saro na prāsy udaraṃ sapītibhir ā somebhir uru sphiram ||
children.translated_text: With your fellow-drinkers and these <s>somas</s>, fill your broad, firm belly as one fills a lake.

children.text: ā tvā sahasram ā śataṃ yuktā rathe hiraṇyaye
children.translated_text: Let a thousand, let a hundred, yoked to the golden chariot,

children.text: brahmayujo haraya indra keśino vahantu somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: the tawny, long-maned horses yoked by prayer, O <s>Indra</s>, bring you for drinking <s>soma</s>.

children.text: ā tvā rathe hiraṇyaye harī mayūraśepyā
children.translated_text: Let the two tawny steeds with peacock tails and pale backs

children.text: śitipṛṣṭhā vahatām madhvo andhaso vivakṣaṇasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: carry you in the golden chariot to drink the sweet, discerning <s>soma</s>-draught.

children.text: pibā tv asya girvaṇaḥ sutasya pūrvapā iva
children.translated_text: Drink of this, O lover of song, of the pressed <s>soma</s>, as one who drank before.

children.text: pariṣkṛtasya rasina iyam āsutiś cārur madāya patyate ||
children.translated_text: This purified, juicy pressing flows beautifully for exhilaration.

children.text: ya eko asti daṃsanā mahāṁ ugro abhi vrataiḥ
children.translated_text: He who alone is wondrous in deed, great and fierce in his ordinances,

children.text: gamat sa śiprī na sa yoṣad ā gamad dhavaṃ na pari varjati ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Śiprī</s> come; he does not desert us when he comes, nor does he turn away from our call.

children.text: tvam puraṃ cariṣṇvaṃ vadhaiḥ śuṣṇasya sam piṇak
children.translated_text: You crushed the moving fortress of <s>Śuṣṇa</s> with your weapons.

children.text: tvam bhā anu caro adha dvitā yad indra havyo bhuvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You followed after the light, O singer; then, a second time, O <s>Indra</s>, you became the one to be invoked.

children.text: mama tvā sūra udite mama madhyandine divaḥ
children.translated_text: At sunrise you are mine, O hero, and mine at the midday of heaven;

children.text: mama prapitve apiśarvare vasav ā stomāso avṛtsata ||
children.translated_text: at evening too, in the darkening time, O <s>Vasu</s>, the hymns have turned toward you.

children.text: stuhi stuhīd ete ghā te maṃhiṣṭhāso maghonām
children.translated_text: Praise him, praise him: these indeed are your greatest among the liberal patrons,

children.text: ninditāśvaḥ prapathī paramajyā maghasya medhyātithe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Ninditāśva</s>, <s>Prapathin</s>, <s>Paramajyā</s>, and, O <s>Medhyātithi</s>, the worthy one of bounty.

children.text: ā yad aśvān vananvataḥ śraddhayāhaṃ rathe ruham
children.translated_text: When, with trust, I mounted the chariot of those who win horses,

children.text: uta vāmasya vasunaś ciketati yo asti yādvaḥ paśuḥ ||
children.translated_text: then he recognizes the pleasing wealth, whatever cattle of the <s>Yādva</s> there is.

children.text: ya ṛjrā mahyam māmahe saha tvacā hiraṇyayā
children.translated_text: He who made straight-running steeds great for me, together with golden covering,

children.text: eṣa viśvāny abhy astu saubhagāsaṅgasya svanadrathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may this loud-rattling chariot of <s>Āsaṅga</s> stand above all fortunes.

children.text: adha plāyogir ati dāsad anyān āsaṅgo agne daśabhiḥ sahasraiḥ
children.translated_text: Then <s>Āsaṅga</s>, son of <s>Plāyoga</s>, O <s>Agni</s>, surpassed others with ten thousands;

children.text: adhokṣaṇo daśa mahyaṃ ruśanto naﾱā iva saraso nir atiṣṭhan ||
children.translated_text: ten ruddy oxen for me stood forth from the lake, like reeds.

children.text: anv asya sthūraṃ dadṛśe purastād anastha ūrur avarambamāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: His bulky form was seen in front; the boneless thigh was hanging down.

children.text: śaśvatī nāry abhicakṣyāha subhadram arya bhojanam bibharṣi ||
children.translated_text: The woman, looking upon it continually, said, 'O noble one, you bear auspicious food.'

children.text: Chapter 622
idaṃ vaso sutam andhaḥ pibā supūrṇam udaram
children.translated_text: O <s>Vasu</s>, drink this pressed draught; fill your belly full.

children.text: anābhayin rarimā te ||
children.translated_text: We have bestowed it upon you without fear.

children.text: nṛbhir dhūtaḥ suto aśnair avyo vāraiḥ paripūtaḥ
children.translated_text: Pressed by men, pressed with stones, purified through the woolen filters,

children.text: aśvo na nikto nadīṣu ||
children.translated_text: like a horse washed in the rivers.

children.text: taṃ te yavaṃ yathā gobhiḥ svādum akarma śrīṇantaḥ
children.translated_text: We have made that barley sweet for you, as with cows, mixing it,

children.text: indra tvāsmin sadhamāde ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, for you in this common feast.

children.text: indra it somapā eka indraḥ sutapā viśvāyuḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> alone is the <s>soma</s>-drinker; <s>Indra</s>, drinker of the pressed juice, is all-living,

children.text: antar devān martyāṃś ca ||
children.translated_text: among both gods and mortals.

children.text: na yaṃ śukro na durāśīr na tṛprā uruvyacasam
children.translated_text: Neither the bright one, nor the ill-invoked one, nor the gluttons touch him,

children.text: apaspṛṇvate suhārdam ||
children.translated_text: the broad-ranging, kindly-hearted one.

children.text: gobhir yad īm anye asman mṛgaṃ na vrā mṛgayante
children.translated_text: When others among us hunt him like a wild beast with cows,

children.text: abhitsaranti dhenubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: they run after him with milch cows.

children.text: traya indrasya somāḥ sutāsaḥ santu devasya
children.translated_text: Let three pressed <s>somas</s> belong to <s>Indra</s>, the god,

children.text: sve kṣaye sutapāvnaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the drinker of the pressed juice, in his own dwelling.

children.text: trayaḥ kośāsa ścotanti tisraś camvaḥ supūrṇāḥ
children.translated_text: Three vats pour forth; three bowls are filled completely,

children.text: samāne adhi bhārman ||
children.translated_text: upon the same support.

children.text: śucir asi puruniṣṭhāḥ kṣīrair madhyata āśīrtaḥ
children.translated_text: You are bright, much-desired, mixed in the middle with milk,

children.text: dadhnā mandiṣṭhaḥ śūrasya ||
children.translated_text: most gladdening with curds for the hero.

children.text: ime ta indra somās tīvrā asme sutāsaḥ
children.translated_text: These sharp <s>somas</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, have been pressed for us;

children.text: śukrā āśiraṃ yācante ||
children.translated_text: bright, they seek the admixture.

children.text: tāṃ āśiram puroﾱāśam indremaṃ somaṃ śrīṇīhi
children.translated_text: Mix that admixture, the sacrificial cake, and this <s>soma</s>, O <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: revantaṃ hi tvā śṛṇomi ||
children.translated_text: for I hear that you are wealthy.

children.text: hṛtsu pītāso yudhyante durmadāso na surāyām
children.translated_text: Drunk in the heart, the maddening draughts contend, like men made wild by liquor;

children.text: ūdhar na nagnā jarante ||
children.translated_text: they grow old naked, as it were, at the udder.

children.text: revāṁ id revata stotā syāt tvāvato maghonaḥ
children.translated_text: The praiser of the wealthy one should indeed become wealthy, of a patron such as you;

children.text: pred u harivaḥ śrutasya ||
children.translated_text: go forth, O bay-horsed one, toward fame.

children.text: ukthaṃ cana śasyamānam agor arir ā ciketa
children.translated_text: The niggardly foe has not even noticed the recited hymn,

children.text: na gāyatraṃ gīyamānam ||
children.translated_text: nor the <s>gāyatra</s> being sung.

children.text: mā na indra pīyatnave mā śardhate parā dāḥ
children.translated_text: Do not hand us over, O <s>Indra</s>, to one who would drink us up; do not give us over to the insolent.

children.text: śikṣā śacīvaḥ śacībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Teach us, O powerful one, with your powers.

children.text: vayam u tvā tadidarthā indra tvāyantaḥ sakhāyaḥ
children.translated_text: For that purpose we, O <s>Indra</s>, are your friends who seek you,

children.text: kaṇvā ukthebhir jarante ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Kaṇvas</s>, praising with hymns.

children.text: na ghem anyad ā papana vajrinn apaso naviṣṭau
children.translated_text: We have certainly reached after nothing else, O wielder of the thunderbolt, in the newest activity;

children.text: taved u stomaṃ ciketa ||
children.translated_text: it is your hymn alone that he has recognized.

children.text: icchanti devāḥ sunvantaṃ na svapnāya spṛhayanti
children.translated_text: The gods desire the man who presses <s>soma</s>; they do not long for sleep.

children.text: yanti pramādam atandrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Unwearied, they go against heedlessness.

children.text: o ṣu pra yāhi vājebhir mā hṛṇīthā abhy asmān
children.translated_text: Come here at once with your prizes; do not be angry with us,

children.text: mahāṁ iva yuvajāniḥ ||
children.translated_text: like a great man with a young wife.

children.text: mo ṣv adya durhaṇāvān sāyaṃ karad āre asmat
children.translated_text: Let not the hard-striking one today, at evening, put us far away,

children.text: aśrīra iva jāmātā ||
children.translated_text: like an unlovely son-in-law.

children.text: vidmā hy asya vīrasya bhūridāvarīṃ sumatim
children.translated_text: For we know the generous favor of this hero,

children.text: triṣu jātasya manāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: the intentions of him who was born in the three realms.

children.text: ā tū ṣiñca kaṇvamantaṃ na ghā vidma śavasānāt
children.translated_text: Now pour upon the <s>Kaṇva</s> company; indeed we know no one

children.text: yaśastaraṃ śatamūteḥ ||
children.translated_text: more renowned than <s>Śatamūti</s> for might.

children.text: jyeṣṭhena sotar indrāya somaṃ vīrāya śakrāya
children.translated_text: With the eldest presser, bring <s>soma</s> for <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: bharā piban naryāya ||
children.translated_text: for the hero, for the strong one, drinking for manly strength.

children.text: yo vediṣṭho avyathiṣv aśvāvantaṃ jaritṛbhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Who, the nearest in danger, gives to the singers

children.text: vājaṃ stotṛbhyo gomantam ||
children.translated_text: a prize rich in horses and rich in cattle for the praisers.

children.text: panyaṃ panyam it sotāra ā dhāvata madyāya
children.translated_text: O pressers, run up again and again to the praiseworthy one, for intoxication,

children.text: somaṃ vīrāya śūrāya ||
children.translated_text: with <s>soma</s> for the heroic, valiant one.

children.text: pātā vṛtrahā sutam ā ghā gaman nāre asmat
children.translated_text: May the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s> drink the pressed juice; may <s>Śatamūti</s> come near,

children.text: ni yamate śatamūtiḥ ||
children.translated_text: and not restrain himself far from us.

children.text: eha harī brahmayujā śagmā vakṣataḥ sakhāyam
children.translated_text: Here let the two bay horses, yoked by prayer and kindly, bring the friend,

children.text: gīrbhiḥ śrutaṃ girvaṇasam ||
children.translated_text: the famed lover of song, with our songs.

children.text: svādavaḥ somā ā yāhi śrītāḥ somā ā yāhi
children.translated_text: Come to the sweet <s>somas</s>; come to the prepared <s>somas</s>,

children.text: śiprinn ṛṣīvaḥ śacīvo nāyam acchā sadhamādam ||
children.translated_text: O fair-lipped one, rich in seers, powerful one, toward this common feast.

children.text: stutaś ca yās tvā vardhanti mahe rādhase nṛmṇāya
children.translated_text: And those praises that increase you for great bounty and manly power,

children.text: indra kāriṇaṃ vṛdhantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, increasing the performer,

children.text: giraś ca yās te girvāha ukthā ca tubhyaṃ tāni
children.translated_text: and the songs that are yours, O song-loving one, and the hymns for you,

children.text: satrā dadhire śavāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: all together have sustained your powers.

children.text: eved eṣa tuvikūrmir vājāṁ eko vajrahastaḥ
children.translated_text: Thus this one, mighty in action, alone wins the prizes, thunderbolt in hand,

children.text: sanād amṛkto dayate ||
children.translated_text: unharmed from of old, and he distributes them.

children.text: hantā vṛtraṃ dakṣiṇenendraḥ purū puruhūtaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, much-invoked, slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s> with his right hand, great one,

children.text: mahān mahībhiḥ śacībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: is mighty through his great powers.

children.text: yasmin viśvāś carṣaṇaya uta cyautnā jrayāṃsi ca
children.translated_text: In whom are all peoples, and also impelling powers and old strengths,

children.text: anu ghen mandī maghonaḥ ||
children.translated_text: they follow the gladness of the bountiful one.

children.text: eṣa etāni cakārendro viśvā yo 'ti śṛṇve
children.translated_text: This <s>Indra</s> has done all these things, he who is heard beyond all,

children.text: vājadāvā maghonām ||
children.translated_text: the prize-giver among the liberal patrons.

children.text: prabhartā rathaṃ gavyantam apākāc cid yam avati
children.translated_text: He brings forward the chariot that desires cattle; from afar he protects the one whom he favors.

children.text: ino vasu sa hi voﾱhā ||
children.translated_text: He is the lord of wealth, for he is the bearer.

children.text: sanitā vipro arvadbhir hantā vṛtraṃ nṛbhiḥ śūraḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired winner, with steeds, the hero, slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s> with men,

children.text: satyo 'vitā vidhantam ||
children.translated_text: is the true protector of the worshipper.

children.text: yajadhvainam priyamedhā indraṃ satrācā manasā
children.translated_text: O <s>Priyamedhas</s>, worship this <s>Indra</s> with one accord of mind,

children.text: yo bhūt somaiḥ satyamadvā ||
children.translated_text: who became truly exhilarated by the <s>somas</s>.

children.text: gāthaśravasaṃ satpatiṃ śravaskāmam purutmānam
children.translated_text: O <s>Kaṇvas</s>, sing of the famed one, the good lord, desiring fame, rich in many aids,

children.text: kaṇvāso gāta vājinam ||
children.translated_text: the prize-winning one.

children.text: ya ṛte cid gās padebhyo dāt sakhā nṛbhyaḥ śacīvān
children.translated_text: He who, apart even from the cattle-stalls, gave cattle to men as a powerful friend,

children.text: ye asmin kāmam aśriyan ||
children.translated_text: to those who placed their desire in him.

children.text: itthā dhīvantam adrivaḥ kāṇvam medhyātithim
children.translated_text: In this way, O stone-wielder, going toward thoughtful <s>Medhyātithi</s> of the <s>Kaṇvas</s>,

children.text: meṣo bhūto 'bhi yann ayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he became a ram facing the metal.

children.text: śikṣā vibhindo asmai catvāry ayutā dadat
children.translated_text: <s>Vibhindu</s>, giving this as a gift to him, bestowed four ten-thousands,

children.text: aṣṭā paraḥ sahasrā ||
children.translated_text: and, beyond that, eight thousand.

children.text: uta su tye payovṛdhā mākī raṇasya naptyā
children.translated_text: And we magnify those two milk-increasing granddaughters of <s>Raṇa</s>

children.text: janitvanāya māmahe ||
children.translated_text: for the sake of generation.

children.text: Chapter 623
pibā sutasya rasino matsvā na indra gomataḥ
children.translated_text: Drink of the pressed, savory <s>soma</s>; rejoice for us, O <s>Indra</s>, in that which is rich in cows.

children.text: āpir no bodhi sadhamādyo vṛdhe 'smāṁ avantu te dhiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Be our ally, our companion at the feast; may your inspired thoughts help us for increase.

children.text: bhūyāma te sumatau vājino vayam mā na star abhimātaye
children.translated_text: May we, rich in prizes, be in your favor; do not hand us over to hostile intent.

children.text: asmāñ citrābhir avatād abhiṣṭibhir ā naḥ sumneṣu yāmaya ||
children.translated_text: May he protect us with bright aids; lead us into your good graces.

children.text: imā u tvā purūvaso giro vardhantu yā mama
children.translated_text: Let these songs of mine, O much-wealthy one, strengthen you,

children.text: pāvakavarṇāḥ śucayo vipaścito 'bhi stomair anūṣata ||
children.translated_text: pure in color, bright, and discerning; with hymns they have sung toward you.

children.text: ayaṃ sahasram ṛṣibhiḥ sahaskṛtaḥ samudra iva paprathe
children.translated_text: This one, made strong by the seers with a thousandfold force, has spread out like the ocean.

children.text: satyaḥ so asya mahimā gṛṇe śavo yajñeṣu viprarājye ||
children.translated_text: True is this greatness of his; I praise his power at sacrifices, in the rule of inspired priests.

children.text: indram id devatātaya indram prayaty adhvare
children.translated_text: For divine aid we call on <s>Indra</s>, and on <s>Indra</s> in the rite set forth.

children.text: indraṃ samīke vanino havāmaha indraṃ dhanasya sātaye ||
children.translated_text: In the conflict, as men seeking gain, we call on <s>Indra</s> for the winning of wealth.

children.text: indro mahnā rodasī paprathacchava indraḥ sūryam arocayat
children.translated_text: By his greatness <s>Indra</s> spread out heaven and earth; <s>Indra</s> made the sun shine.

children.text: indre ha viśvā bhuvanāni yemira indre suvānāsa indavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In <s>Indra</s> all beings were held; in <s>Indra</s> are the pressed <s>soma</s> drops.

children.text: abhi tvā pūrvapītaya indra stomebhir āyavaḥ
children.translated_text: For your first drinking, O <s>Indra</s>, the <s>Āyus</s> have come toward you with hymns.

children.text: samīcīnāsa ṛbhavaḥ sam asvaran rudrā gṛṇanta pūrvyam ||
children.translated_text: Gathered in concord, the <s>Ṛbhus</s> sounded together; the <s>Rudras</s> praise the ancient one.

children.text: asyed indro vāvṛdhe vṛṣṇyaṃ śavo made sutasya viṣṇavi
children.translated_text: Through this exhilaration of the pressed <s>soma</s>, <s>Indra</s>'s virile power has grown in the sphere of <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

children.text: adyā tam asya mahimānam āyavo 'nu ṣṭuvanti pūrvathā ||
children.translated_text: Today the <s>Āyus</s> praise that greatness of his, as in former times.

children.text: tat tvā yāmi suvīryaṃ tad brahma pūrvacittaye
children.translated_text: For that heroic power I come to you, for that sacred formulation, for the first insight,

children.text: yenā yatibhyo bhṛgave dhane hite yena praskaṇvam āvitha ||
children.translated_text: by which, when wealth was set in place, you helped the <s>Yatis</s>, <s>Bhṛgu</s>, and <s>Praskaṇva</s>.

children.text: yenā samudram asṛjo mahīr apas tad indra vṛṣṇi te śavaḥ
children.translated_text: By which you released the ocean and the great waters: that, O <s>Indra</s>, is your bull-like power.

children.text: sadyaḥ so asya mahimā na saṃnaśe yaṃ kṣoṇīr anucakrade ||
children.translated_text: At once this greatness of his is not to be lost, which the lands have followed after.

children.text: śagdhī na indra yat tvā rayiṃ yāmi suvīryam
children.translated_text: Help us, O <s>Indra</s>, when I seek wealth from you, wealth with good heroic strength.

children.text: śagdhi vājāya prathamaṃ siṣāsate śagdhi stomāya pūrvya ||
children.translated_text: Help the one who first seeks to win the prize; help the ancient hymn.

children.text: śagdhī no asya yaddha pauram āvitha dhiya indra siṣāsataḥ
children.translated_text: Help us in this, since you protected the <s>Paura</s> who sought inspired thoughts, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: śagdhi yathā ruśamaṃ śyāvakaṃ kṛpam indra prāvaḥ svarṇaram ||
children.translated_text: Help as you formerly aided <s>Ruśama</s>, <s>Śyāvaka</s>, <s>Kṛpa</s>, and <s>Svarṇara</s>, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: kan navyo atasīnāṃ turo gṛṇīta martyaḥ
children.translated_text: What new mortal among those near at hand can praise the mighty one?

children.text: nahī nv asya mahimānam indriyaṃ svar gṛṇanta ānaśuḥ ||
children.translated_text: For even now those who praise have not reached his powerful greatness, his heavenly light.

children.text: kad u stuvanta ṛtayanta devata ṛṣiḥ ko vipra ohate
children.translated_text: When will a seer, keeping truth for the deity, what inspired poet, be eager?

children.text: kadā havam maghavann indra sunvataḥ kad u stuvata ā gamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When, O bountiful <s>Indra</s>, will you come to the call of the soma-presser, when to the one who praises?

children.text: ud u tye madhumattamā gira stomāsa īrate
children.translated_text: Up now these sweetest songs, these hymns, are set in motion,

children.text: satrājito dhanasā akṣitotayo vājayanto rathā iva ||
children.translated_text: ever victorious, winning wealth, with unfailing aids, seeking the prize like chariots.

children.text: kaṇvā iva bhṛgavaḥ sūryā iva viśvam iddhītam ānaśuḥ
children.translated_text: Like the <s>Kaṇvas</s>, like the <s>Bhṛgus</s>, like suns, they have reached all kindled brightness.

children.text: indraṃ stomebhir mahayanta āyavaḥ priyamedhāso asvaran ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Āyus</s>, the <s>Priyamedhas</s>, magnifying <s>Indra</s> with hymns, have sounded forth.

children.text: yukṣvā hi vṛtrahantama harī indra parāvataḥ
children.translated_text: Yoke your two bay horses from afar, O <s>Indra</s>, greatest slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: arvācīno maghavan somapītaya ugra ṛṣvebhir ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: Turned hither, O bountiful fierce one, come for the drinking of <s>soma</s> with the lofty ones.

children.text: ime hi te kāravo vāvaśur dhiyā viprāso medhasātaye
children.translated_text: For these singers of yours, the inspired poets, have cried out with thought for the winning of insight.

children.text: sa tvaṃ no maghavann indra girvaṇo veno na śṛṇudhī havam ||
children.translated_text: So you, O bountiful <s>Indra</s>, lover of song, listen to our call like one who longs.

children.text: nir indra bṛhatībhyo vṛtraṃ dhanubhyo asphuraḥ
children.translated_text: Out, O <s>Indra</s>, from the great bows you shook <s>Vṛtra</s> loose.

children.text: nir arbudasya mṛgayasya māyino niḥ parvatasya gā ājaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Out from <s>Arbuda</s>, the cunning beast, out from the mountain, you drove the cows.

children.text: nir agnayo rurucur nir u sūryo niḥ soma indriyo rasaḥ
children.translated_text: The fires shone forth, and the sun came forth; the <s>soma</s>, the powerful sap, came forth.

children.text: nir antarikṣād adhamo mahām ahiṃ kṛṣe tad indra pauṃsyam ||
children.translated_text: From the midspace you struck down the great serpent; you made that your manly deed, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yam me dur indro marutaḥ pākasthāmā kaurayāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: That man, <s>Pākasthāman</s> <s>Kaurayāṇa</s>, whom <s>Indra</s> and the <s>Maruts</s> gave to me from afar,

children.text: viśveṣāṃ tmanā śobhiṣṭham upeva divi dhāvamānam ||
children.translated_text: was most splendid in his own person among all, like one running up in heaven.

children.text: rohitam me pākasthāmā sudhuraṃ kakṣyaprām
children.translated_text: <s>Pākasthāman</s> gave me a red one, well-yoked and filling the girth,

children.text: adād rāyo vibodhanam ||
children.translated_text: an awakening of wealth.

children.text: yasmā anye daśa prati dhuraṃ vahanti vahnayaḥ
children.translated_text: For him ten other bearers carry the yoke in front,

children.text: astaṃ vayo na tugryam ||
children.translated_text: like birds carrying <s>Tugrya</s> home.

children.text: ātmā pitus tanūr vāsa ojodā abhyañjanam
children.translated_text: The self of the father, the body as garment, the strength-giving ointment:

children.text: turīyam id rohitasya pākasthāmānam bhojaṃ dātāram abravam ||
children.translated_text: I called the fourth red one, <s>Pākasthāman</s>, the generous giver.

children.text: Chapter 624
yad indra prāg apāg udaṅ nyag vā hūyase nṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indra</s>, you are called by men eastward, westward, northward, or downward,

children.text: simā purū nṛṣūto asy ānave 'si praśardha turvaśe ||
children.translated_text: you are abundant among many men, summoned for <s>Anu</s>; you are strong for <s>Turvaśa</s>.

children.text: yad vā rume ruśame śyāvake kṛpa indra mādayase sacā
children.translated_text: Or when, O <s>Indra</s>, you rejoice together in <s>Ruma</s>, <s>Ruśama</s>, <s>Śyāvaka</s>, and <s>Kṛpa</s>,

children.text: kaṇvāsas tvā brahmabhi stomavāhasa indrā yacchanty ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Kaṇvas</s>, bearers of sacred formulations, extend hymns to you, O <s>Indra</s>; come hither.

children.text: yathā gauro apā kṛtaṃ tṛṣyann ety averiṇam
children.translated_text: As a wild ox, released from the waters, goes thirsty to a waterless place,

children.text: āpitve naḥ prapitve tūyam ā gahi kaṇveṣu su sacā piba ||
children.translated_text: so come swiftly to us for drinking and for the first drinking; drink well together among the <s>Kaṇvas</s>.

children.text: mandantu tvā maghavann indrendavo rādhodeyāya sunvate
children.translated_text: May the <s>soma</s> drops exhilarate you, O bountiful <s>Indra</s>, for the patron who gives gifts.

children.text: āmuṣyā somam apibaś camū sutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ tad dadhiṣe sahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You drank that one's <s>soma</s>, pressed in the cup; you hold that highest strength.

children.text: pra cakre sahasā saho babhañja manyum ojasā
children.translated_text: He set power in motion by force; he broke wrath with might.

children.text: viśve ta indra pṛtanāyavo yaho ni vṛkṣā iva yemire ||
children.translated_text: All who seek battle, O <s>Indra</s>, bowed down before you like trees.

children.text: sahasreṇeva sacate yavīyudhā yas ta ānaﾱ upastutim
children.translated_text: With a thousand he attends the young fighter who has reached your praise,

children.text: putram prāvargaṃ kṛṇute suvīrye dāśnoti namauktibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: and he makes a son preeminent in heroic strength; he gives with words of homage.

children.text: mā bhema mā śramiṣmograsya sakhye tava
children.translated_text: Let us not be afraid; let us not grow weary in friendship with you, the fierce one.

children.text: mahat te vṛṣṇo abhicakṣyaṃ kṛtam paśyema turvaśaṃ yadum ||
children.translated_text: Great, O bull, is your deed to be beheld; may we see <s>Turvaśa</s> and <s>Yadu</s>.

children.text: savyām anu sphigyaṃ vāvase vṛṣā na dāno asya roṣati
children.translated_text: Along the left hip you clothe yourself; like a bull, he does not begrudge his gift.

children.text: madhvā saṃpṛktāḥ sāragheṇa dhenavas tūyam ehi dravā piba ||
children.translated_text: The milk-cows, mixed with honey and bee-sweetness, come swiftly; come quickly, run, and drink.

children.text: aśvī rathī surūpa id gomāṁ id indra te sakhā
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, your friend indeed has horses, chariots, fair form, and cows.

children.text: śvātrabhājā vayasā sacate sadā candro yāti sabhām upa ||
children.translated_text: Sharing in refreshment, with vigor, he accompanies you always; bright, he goes toward the assembly.

children.text: ṛśyo na tṛṣyann avapānam ā gahi pibā somaṃ vaśāṁ anu
children.translated_text: Come like a thirsty antelope to the watering-place; drink the <s>soma</s> according to your will.

children.text: nimeghamāno maghavan dive diva ojiṣṭhaṃ dadhiṣe sahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bellowing, O <s>Maghavan</s>, day after day you assume the strongest might.

children.text: adhvaryo drāvayā tvaṃ somam indraḥ pipāsati
children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryu</s>, make the <s>soma</s> run; <s>Indra</s> is thirsty.

children.text: upa nūnaṃ yuyuje vṛṣaṇā harī ā ca jagāma vṛtrahā ||
children.translated_text: Now the bull has yoked his two bay steeds, and the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s> has come.

children.text: svayaṃ cit sa manyate dāśurir jano yatrā somasya tṛmpasi
children.translated_text: Even the liberal worshipper thinks himself favored there where you are satisfied with the <s>soma</s>.

children.text: idaṃ te annaṃ yujyaṃ samukṣitaṃ tasyehi pra dravā piba ||
children.translated_text: This food of yours, fit for you and well-sprinkled, is here; come to it, run forward, and drink.

children.text: ratheṣṭhāyādhvaryavaḥ somam indrāya sotana
children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryu</s> priests, press the <s>soma</s> for <s>Indra</s>, who stands in the chariot.

children.text: adhi bradhnasyādrayo vi cakṣate sunvanto dāśvadhvaram ||
children.translated_text: The pressing-stones look out over the tawny one, as they press for the generous sacrificer.

children.text: upa bradhnaṃ vāvātā vṛṣaṇā harī indram apasu vakṣataḥ
children.translated_text: Let the two strong bay steeds, eager for the tawny one, bring <s>Indra</s> among the waters.

children.text: arvāñcaṃ tvā saptayo 'dhvaraśriyo vahantu savaned upa ||
children.translated_text: Let the steeds, ornaments of the rite, bring you hither to the pressing.

children.text: pra pūṣaṇaṃ vṛṇīmahe yujyāya purūvasum
children.translated_text: We choose <s>Pūṣan</s>, rich in many goods, to be our yoked companion.

children.text: sa śakra śikṣa puruhūta no dhiyā tuje rāye vimocana ||
children.translated_text: O powerful, much-invoked one, instruct us with insight toward forceful, releasing wealth.

children.text: saṃ naḥ śiśīhi bhurijor iva kṣuraṃ rāsva rāyo vimocana
children.translated_text: Sharpen us as one sharpens a razor in the hands; grant us releasing wealth.

children.text: tve tan naḥ suvedam usriyaṃ vasu yaṃ tvaṃ hinoṣi martyam ||
children.translated_text: In you that bright treasure is well known to us, O good one, when you impel a mortal.

children.text: vemi tvā pūṣann ṛñjase vemi stotava āghṛṇe
children.translated_text: I long for you, O <s>Pūṣan</s>, for adornment; I long to praise you, O glowing one.

children.text: na tasya vemy araṇaṃ hi tad vaso stuṣe pajrāya sāmne ||
children.translated_text: I do not long for its withholding; for that, O good one, I praise the strong one with song.

children.text: parā gāvo yavasaṃ kaccid āghṛṇe nityaṃ rekṇo amartya
children.translated_text: Have the cows gone away to pasture, O glowing immortal? Wealth is yours continually.

children.text: asmākam pūṣann avitā śivo bhava maṃhiṣṭho vājasātaye ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Pūṣan</s>, be our kindly protector, most bountiful for the winning of prizes.

children.text: sthūraṃ rādhaḥ śatāśvaṃ kuruṅgasya diviṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: We have thought upon the broad bounty, rich in a hundred horses, in the heavenly portions of <s>Kuruṅga</s>,

children.text: rājñas tveṣasya subhagasya rātiṣu turvaśeṣv amanmahi ||
children.translated_text: in the gifts of the brilliant and fortunate king, among the <s>Turvaśas</s>.

children.text: dhībhiḥ sātāni kāṇvasya vājinaḥ priyamedhair abhidyubhiḥ
children.translated_text: With inspired thoughts, the radiant <s>Priyamedhas</s> sought the gains of the vigorous <s>Kāṇva</s>.

children.text: ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrānu nirmajām aje nir yūthāni gavām ṛṣiḥ ||
children.translated_text: The seer drove out sixty thousand, and then herds of cows from the enclosure.

children.text: vṛkṣāś cin me abhipitve arāraṇuḥ
children.translated_text: Even the trees cried out to me at the approach.

children.text: gām bhajanta mehanāśvam bhajanta mehanā ||
children.translated_text: They apportioned cows to me; the <s>Mehanas</s> apportioned horses to me.

children.text: Chapter 625
dūrād iheva yat saty aruṇapsur aśiśvitat
children.translated_text: When, from afar as though from here, the ruddy one of true form flashed forth,

children.text: vi bhānuṃ viśvadhātanat ||
children.translated_text: you spread abroad the light that sustains all.

children.text: nṛvad dasrā manoyujā rathena pṛthupājasā
children.translated_text: O wondrous ones, with a manly, mind-yoked chariot of broad force,

children.text: sacethe aśvinoṣasam ||
children.translated_text: you accompany the Dawn, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: yuvābhyāṃ vājinīvasū prati stomā adṛkṣata
children.translated_text: Toward you two, O possessors of prize-winning wealth, the songs of praise have appeared,

children.text: vācaṃ dūto yathohiṣe ||
children.translated_text: like a messenger sent forth with speech.

children.text: purupriyā ṇa ūtaye purumandrā purūvasū
children.translated_text: Much-loved, greatly gladdening, rich in many goods, for our help

children.text: stuṣe kaṇvāso aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Kaṇvas</s> praise the <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: maṃhiṣṭhā vājasātameṣayantā śubhas patī
children.translated_text: Most bountiful, best at winning the prize, sending nourishment, lords of brilliance,

children.text: gantārā dāśuṣo gṛham ||
children.translated_text: you are goers to the house of the worshipper.

children.text: tā sudevāya dāśuṣe sumedhām avitāriṇīm
children.translated_text: For the pious worshipper, pour out good understanding and protection,

children.text: ghṛtair gavyūtim ukṣatam ||
children.translated_text: and sprinkle the cow-pasture with ghee.

children.text: ā na stomam upa dravat tūyaṃ śyenebhir āśubhiḥ
children.translated_text: Run here quickly to our praise with swift falcons;

children.text: yātam aśvebhir aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: come with horses, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: yebhis tisraḥ parāvato divo viśvāni rocanā
children.translated_text: With them you circle the three far distances, all the bright realms of heaven,

children.text: trīṃr aktūn paridīyathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and the three nights.

children.text: uta no gomatīr iṣa uta sātīr aharvidā
children.translated_text: And for us, discoverers of the day, cow-rich refreshments and winnings;

children.text: vi pathaḥ sātaye sitam ||
children.translated_text: open the paths wide for the winning.

children.text: ā no gomantam aśvinā suvīraṃ surathaṃ rayim
children.translated_text: Bring us, O <s>Aśvins</s>, wealth rich in cattle, rich in heroes, and well-charioted,

children.text: voﾱham aśvāvatīr iṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: bringing horse-rich refreshments.

children.text: vāvṛdhānā śubhas patī dasrā hiraṇyavartanī
children.translated_text: Growing strong, lords of brilliance, wondrous ones with golden tracks,

children.text: pibataṃ somyam madhu ||
children.translated_text: drink the <s>soma</s> sweetness.

children.text: asmabhyaṃ vājinīvasū maghavadbhyaś ca saprathaḥ
children.translated_text: For us, O possessors of prize-winning wealth, and for the generous, widely extended,

children.text: chardir yantam adābhyam ||
children.translated_text: stretch out an inviolable shelter.

children.text: ni ṣu brahma janānāṃ yāviṣṭaṃ tūyam ā gatam
children.translated_text: Settle among the prayers of the people; come most swiftly and quickly.

children.text: mo ṣv anyāṁ upāratam ||
children.translated_text: Do not stop away with another.

children.text: asya pibatam aśvinā yuvam madasya cāruṇaḥ
children.translated_text: You two, O <s>Aśvins</s>, drink of this lovely exhilaration,

children.text: madhvo rātasya dhiṣṇyā ||
children.translated_text: of the sweet drink that has been given, O skillful ones.

children.text: asme ā vahataṃ rayiṃ śatavantaṃ sahasriṇam
children.translated_text: Bring wealth to us, counted by hundreds and by thousands,

children.text: purukṣuṃ viśvadhāyasam ||
children.translated_text: abundant in nourishment and sustaining all.

children.text: purutrā ciddhi vāṃ narā vihvayante manīṣiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: For in many places, O men, the wise call loudly to you;

children.text: vāghadbhir aśvinā gatam ||
children.translated_text: come with the singers, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: janāso vṛktabarhiṣo haviṣmanto araṅkṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: The people, with the sacred grass spread, bearing oblations and prepared,

children.text: yuvāṃ havante aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: call upon you, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: asmākam adya vām ayaṃ stomo vāhiṣṭho antamaḥ
children.translated_text: May this praise of ours today be the swiftest and nearest

children.text: yuvābhyām bhūtv aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: for you two, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: yo ha vām madhuno dṛtir āhito rathacarṣaṇe
children.translated_text: The skin of honey that has been set for you, O chariot-guiding ones:

children.text: tataḥ pibatam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: drink from that, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: tena no vājinīvasū paśve tokāya śaṃ gave
children.translated_text: With it, O possessors of prize-winning wealth, for livestock, offspring, well-being, and cattle,

children.text: vahatam pīvarīr iṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: bring us rich nourishments.

children.text: uta no divyā iṣa uta sindhūṃr aharvidā
children.translated_text: And heavenly refreshments for us, and the rivers, O discoverers of the day:

children.text: apa dvāreva varṣathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: pour them out as if opening doors.

children.text: kadā vāṃ taugryo vidhat samudre jahito narā
children.translated_text: When did <s>Tugra</s>'s son, abandoned in the sea, call upon you, O men,

children.text: yad vāṃ ratho vibhiṣ patāt ||
children.translated_text: when your chariot flew with birds?

children.text: yuvaṃ kaṇvāya nāsatyā ṛpiriptāya harmye
children.translated_text: You two, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, for <s>Kaṇva</s>, though afflicted in his house,

children.text: śaśvad ūtīr daśasyathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: have always bestowed your aids.

children.text: tābhir ā yātam ūtibhir navyasībhiḥ suśastibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Come with those aids, newer and well-praised,

children.text: yad vāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū huve ||
children.translated_text: when I call you, O possessors of virile wealth.

children.text: yathā cit kaṇvam āvatam priyamedham upastutam
children.translated_text: As you aided <s>Kaṇva</s>, the praised <s>Priyamedha</s>,

children.text: atriṃ śiñjāram aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Atri Śiñjāra</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: yathota kṛtvye dhane 'ṃśuṃ goṣv agastyam
children.translated_text: and as in the wealth to be won you aided <s>Aṃśu</s> and <s>Agastya</s> among the cows,

children.text: yathā vājeṣu sobharim ||
children.translated_text: as also <s>Sobhari</s> in the contests,

children.text: etāvad vāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū ato vā bhūyo aśvinā
children.translated_text: so much favor from you, O possessors of virile wealth, or still more, O <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: gṛṇantaḥ sumnam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: we singers ask for your good will.

children.text: rathaṃ hiraṇyavandhuraṃ hiraṇyābhīśum aśvinā
children.translated_text: The chariot with golden seat and golden reins, O <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: ā hi sthātho divispṛśam ||
children.translated_text: indeed you mount, touching heaven.

children.text: hiraṇyayī vāṃ rabhir īṣā akṣo hiraṇyayaḥ
children.translated_text: Golden is your rim, golden the pole, golden the axle;

children.text: ubhā cakrā hiraṇyayā ||
children.translated_text: both wheels are golden.

children.text: tena no vājinīvasū parāvataś cid ā gatam
children.translated_text: With that, O possessors of prize-winning wealth, come to us even from afar,

children.text: upemāṃ suṣṭutim mama ||
children.translated_text: to this good praise of mine.

children.text: ā vahethe parākāt pūrvīr aśnantāv aśvinā
children.translated_text: You bring from afar, O <s>Aśvins</s>, enjoying many things,

children.text: iṣo dāsīr amartyā ||
children.translated_text: immortal refreshments and attendant aids.

children.text: ā no dyumnair ā śravobhir ā rāyā yātam aśvinā
children.translated_text: Come to us with splendors, with fame, and with wealth, O <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: puruścandrā nāsatyā ||
children.translated_text: O much-bright <s>Nāsatyas</s>.

children.text: eha vām pruṣitapsavo vayo vahantu parṇinaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the winged birds with dewy forms bear you here,

children.text: acchā svadhvaraṃ janam ||
children.translated_text: toward the people of good ritual.

children.text: rathaṃ vām anugāyasaṃ ya iṣā vartate saha
children.translated_text: Your chariot, worthy of following song, which turns together with nourishment,

children.text: na cakram abhi bādhate ||
children.translated_text: no wheel obstructs it.

children.text: hiraṇyayena rathena dravatpāṇibhir aśvaiḥ
children.translated_text: With a golden chariot and with horses of rushing feet...

children.text: dhījavanā nāsatyā ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, swift in inspired thought.

children.text: yuvam mṛgaṃ jāgṛvāṃsaṃ svadatho vā vṛṣaṇvasū
children.translated_text: You two, watchful ones, relish the wild offering, O bulls rich in treasure,

children.text: tā naḥ pṛṅktam iṣā rayim ||
children.translated_text: fill for us wealth together with nourishment.

children.text: tā me aśvinā sanīnāṃ vidyātaṃ navānām
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, know these new gains of mine,

children.text: yathā cic caidyaḥ kaśuḥ śatam uṣṭrānāṃ dadat sahasrā daśa gonām ||
children.translated_text: just as <s>Kaśu</s> the <s>Caidya</s>, giving a hundred camels and ten thousand cattle.

children.text: yo me hiraṇyasaṃdṛśo daśa rājño amaṃhata
children.translated_text: He, golden in appearance, granted me ten from the king;

children.text: adhaspadā ic caidyasya kṛṣṭayaś carmamnā abhito janāḥ ||
children.translated_text: beneath the feet of the <s>Caidya</s> are the peoples, and men stand all around as with a hide.

children.text: mākir enā pathā gād yeneme yanti cedayaḥ
children.translated_text: Let no one go by this path by which these <s>Cedis</s> go;

children.text: anyo net sūrir ohate bhūridāvattaro janaḥ ||
children.translated_text: no other patron among men boasts as one more bountiful.

children.text: Chapter 626
mahāṁ indro ya ojasā parjanyo vṛṣṭimāṁ iva
children.translated_text: Great is <s>Indra</s>, who by his might is like rain-bearing <s>Parjanya</s>;

children.text: stomair vatsasya vāvṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: he has grown through the praises of <s>Vatsa</s>.

children.text: prajām ṛtasya piprataḥ pra yad bharanta vahnayaḥ
children.translated_text: As they carry forth the offspring of truth,

children.text: viprā ṛtasya vāhasā ||
children.translated_text: the inspired priests are borne by the conveyance of truth.

children.text: kaṇvā indraṃ yad akrata stomair yajñasya sādhanam
children.translated_text: When the <s>Kaṇvas</s> made <s>Indra</s>, through hymns, the accomplisher of the sacrifice,

children.text: jāmi bruvata āyudham ||
children.translated_text: they proclaimed their kinsman as a weapon.

children.text: sam asya manyave viśo viśvā namanta kṛṣṭayaḥ
children.translated_text: All peoples, all communities, bow down before his wrath,

children.text: samudrāyeva sindhavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like rivers before the ocean.

children.text: ojas tad asya titviṣa ubhe yat samavartayat
children.translated_text: That force of his flashed forth, when he set both worlds turning together;

children.text: indraś carmeva rodasī ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> spread heaven and earth like a hide.

children.text: vi cid vṛtrasya dodhato vajreṇa śataparvaṇā
children.translated_text: With the hundred-jointed thunderbolt he split apart <s>Vṛtra</s> as he shook,

children.text: śiro bibheda vṛṣṇinā ||
children.translated_text: he split his head with the bull-like weapon.

children.text: imā abhi pra ṇonumo vipām agreṣu dhītayaḥ
children.translated_text: Toward these we bow down; at the forefront of inspired songs are the thoughts,

children.text: agneḥ śocir na didyutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: which have flashed like the flame of <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: guhā satīr upa tmanā pra yacchocanta dhītayaḥ
children.translated_text: The thoughts, though hidden, shone forth by themselves,

children.text: kaṇvā ṛtasya dhārayā ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Kaṇvas</s>, with the stream of truth.

children.text: pra tam indra naśīmahi rayiṃ gomantam aśvinam
children.translated_text: May we obtain from <s>Indra</s> that wealth rich in cattle and horses,

children.text: pra brahma pūrvacittaye ||
children.translated_text: and the sacred utterance for first awareness.

children.text: aham iddhi pituṣ pari medhām ṛtasya jagrabha
children.translated_text: For I have taken hold of the wisdom of truth from my father;

children.text: ahaṃ sūrya ivājani ||
children.translated_text: I have been born like the sun.

children.text: aham pratnena manmanā giraḥ śumbhāmi kaṇvavat
children.translated_text: With ancient thought I adorn the songs like a <s>Kaṇva</s>,

children.text: yenendraḥ śuṣmam id dadhe ||
children.translated_text: by which <s>Indra</s> has set his strength in place.

children.text: ye tvām indra na tuṣṭuvur ṛṣayo ye ca tuṣṭuvuḥ
children.translated_text: Those seers who did not praise you, O <s>Indra</s>, and those who did praise you,

children.text: mamed vardhasva suṣṭutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: praised well by me, grow greater for me.

children.text: yad asya manyur adhvanīd vi vṛtram parvaśo rujan
children.translated_text: When his wrath thundered, breaking <s>Vṛtra</s> joint by joint,

children.text: apaḥ samudram airayat ||
children.translated_text: he drove the waters to the ocean.

children.text: ni śuṣṇa indra dharṇasiṃ vajraṃ jaghantha dasyavi
children.translated_text: Down, O <s>Indra</s>, you struck <s>Śuṣṇa</s>, the firm one, with the thunderbolt in the fight against the <s>Dasyu</s>;

children.text: vṛṣā hy ugra śṛṇviṣe ||
children.translated_text: for you are heard of as a fierce bull, O mighty one.

children.text: na dyāva indram ojasā nāntarikṣāṇi vajriṇam
children.translated_text: Neither the heavens with their might, nor the midspaces, could contain the thunderbolt-bearing <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: na vivyacanta bhūmayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: nor could the earths encompass him.

children.text: yas ta indra mahīr apa stabhūyamāna āśayat
children.translated_text: He who lay there holding back your great waters, O <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: ni tam padyāsu śiśnathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you crushed him down in the tracks beneath your feet.

children.text: ya ime rodasī mahī samīcī samajagrabhīt
children.translated_text: He who seized these two great worlds together, facing one another,

children.text: tamobhir indra taṃ guhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: him, O <s>Indra</s>, you hid in darknesses.

children.text: ya indra yatayas tvā bhṛgavo ye ca tuṣṭuvuḥ
children.translated_text: Those <s>Yatis</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, and the <s>Bhṛgus</s>, who praised you,

children.text: mamed ugra śrudhī havam ||
children.translated_text: hear my call also, O mighty one.

children.text: imās ta indra pṛśnayo ghṛtaṃ duhata āśiram
children.translated_text: These speckled cows of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, milk ghee and the invigorating mixture,

children.text: enām ṛtasya pipyuṣīḥ ||
children.translated_text: these ones swollen with truth.

children.text: yā indra prasvas tvāsā garbham acakriran
children.translated_text: Those vigorous mothers, O <s>Indra</s>, made you an embryo,

children.text: pari dharmeva sūryam ||
children.translated_text: enclosing the sun as if with <s>dharma</s> (sacred order).

children.text: tvām icchavasas pate kaṇvā ukthena vāvṛdhuḥ
children.translated_text: You indeed, O lord of strength, the <s>Kaṇvas</s> have increased with a hymn;

children.text: tvāṃ sutāsa indavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you the pressed soma-drops have increased.

children.text: taved indra praṇītiṣūta praśastir adrivaḥ
children.translated_text: Yours indeed, O <s>Indra</s>, are the guidances and the praise, O stone-wielder;

children.text: yajño vitantasāyyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: yours is the sacrifice that is to be spread out.

children.text: ā na indra mahīm iṣam puraṃ na darṣi gomatīm
children.translated_text: Bring us, O <s>Indra</s>, great nourishment, a cow-rich stronghold as if breaking it open,

children.text: uta prajāṃ suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: and offspring, and excellent heroic power.

children.text: uta tyad āśvaśvyaṃ yad indra nāhuṣīṣv ā
children.translated_text: And that horse-rich wealth, O <s>Indra</s>, which among the <s>Nāhuṣas</s>

children.text: agre vikṣu pradīdayat ||
children.translated_text: shone forth at the front among the settlements.

children.text: abhi vrajaṃ na tatniṣe sūra upākacakṣasam
children.translated_text: You stretch yourself toward the cattle-pen, like the sun toward what is near to sight,

children.text: yad indra mṛﾱayāsi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: when, O <s>Indra</s>, you are gracious to us.

children.text: yad aṅga taviṣīyasa indra prarājasi kṣitīḥ
children.translated_text: When indeed, O most mighty <s>Indra</s>, you rule over the peoples,

children.text: mahāṁ apāra ojasā ||
children.translated_text: great and boundless in power.

children.text: taṃ tvā haviṣmatīr viśa upa bruvata ūtaye
children.translated_text: The offering-bearing clans call upon that you for help,

children.text: urujrayasam indubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: the wide-ranging one, with soma-drops.

children.text: upahvare girīṇāṃ saṃgathe ca nadīnām
children.translated_text: In the hollow of the mountains and at the meeting of the rivers,

children.text: dhiyā vipro ajāyata ||
children.translated_text: the inspired poet was born through thought.

children.text: ataḥ samudram udvataś cikitvāṁ ava paśyati
children.translated_text: From there the discerning one looks down from the height to the ocean,

children.text: yato vipāna ejati ||
children.translated_text: from where the flowing stream stirs.

children.text: ād it pratnasya retaso jyotiṣ paśyanti vāsaram
children.translated_text: Then they see the light, the bright day, of the ancient seed,

children.text: paro yad idhyate divā ||
children.translated_text: when it is kindled beyond by heaven.

children.text: kaṇvāsa indra te matiṃ viśve vardhanti pauṃsyam
children.translated_text: The <s>Kaṇvas</s>, all of them, increase your thought, O <s>Indra</s>, and your manly force,

children.text: uto śaviṣṭha vṛṣṇyam ||
children.translated_text: and also, O mightiest one, your bull-like strength.

children.text: imām ma indra suṣṭutiṃ juṣasva pra su mām ava
children.translated_text: Accept this good praise of mine, O <s>Indra</s>; protect me well,

children.text: uta pra vardhayā matim ||
children.translated_text: and further increase my inspired thought.

children.text: uta brahmaṇyā vayaṃ tubhyam pravṛddha vajrivaḥ
children.translated_text: And we, devoted to sacred utterance, for you, O grown-great thunderbolt-bearer,

children.text: viprā atakṣma jīvase ||
children.translated_text: we inspired priests have fashioned songs for life.

children.text: abhi kaṇvā anūṣatāpo na pravatā yatīḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Kaṇvas</s> have sung toward him, like waters going down a slope;

children.text: indraṃ vananvatī matiḥ ||
children.translated_text: the inspired thought seeks to win <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: indram ukthāni vāvṛdhuḥ samudram iva sindhavaḥ
children.translated_text: The recitations have increased <s>Indra</s>, as rivers increase the ocean,

children.text: anuttamanyum ajaram ||
children.translated_text: the ageless one whose anger cannot be surpassed.

children.text: ā no yāhi parāvato haribhyāṃ haryatābhyām
children.translated_text: Come to us from afar with your two bay, desirable horses;

children.text: imam indra sutam piba ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, drink this pressed soma.

children.text: tvām id vṛtrahantama janāso vṛktabarhiṣaḥ
children.translated_text: You, greatest slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, the people with strewn sacred grass

children.text: havante vājasātaye ||
children.translated_text: call upon for the winning of prizes.

children.text: anu tvā rodasī ubhe cakraṃ na varty etaśam
children.translated_text: Both heaven and earth follow you, like a wheel the swift horse;

children.text: anu suvānāsa indavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the pressed soma-drops follow you.

children.text: mandasvā su svarṇara utendra śaryaṇāvati
children.translated_text: Rejoice well, O golden-rayed one, and, O <s>Indra</s>, at <s>Śaryaṇāvat</s>;

children.text: matsvā vivasvato matī ||
children.translated_text: be exhilarated by the inspired thought of <s>Vivasvat</s>.

children.text: vāvṛdhāna upa dyavi vṛṣā vajry aroravīt
children.translated_text: Growing in heaven, the bull with the thunderbolt roared,

children.text: vṛtrahā somapātamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, best drinker of soma.

children.text: ṛṣir hi pūrvajā asy eka īśāna ojasā
children.translated_text: For he is the seer, firstborn, the one sovereign by might;

children.text: indra coṣkūyase vasu ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, you are stirred toward wealth.

children.text: asmākaṃ tvā sutāṁ upa vītapṛṣṭhā abhi prayaḥ
children.translated_text: Toward our pressed soma, toward the drink, let the broad-backed steeds

children.text: śataṃ vahantu harayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: bring you by the hundred.

children.text: imāṃ su pūrvyāṃ dhiyam madhor ghṛtasya pipyuṣīm
children.translated_text: This ancient inspired thought, swollen with honey and ghee,

children.text: kaṇvā ukthena vāvṛdhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Kaṇvas</s> have increased with a hymn.

children.text: indram id vimahīnām medhe vṛṇīta martyaḥ
children.translated_text: A mortal chooses <s>Indra</s> in the sacrificial gathering, among the great ones,

children.text: indraṃ saniṣyur ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, the one who seeks to win, for aid.

children.text: arvāñcaṃ tvā puruṣṭuta priyamedhastutā harī
children.translated_text: Let the two bay horses praised by <s>Priyamedha</s> bring you hither, O much-praised one,

children.text: somapeyāya vakṣataḥ ||
children.translated_text: for the drinking of soma.

children.text: śatam ahaṃ tirindire sahasram parśāv ā dade
children.translated_text: I received a hundred from <s>Tirindira</s>, a thousand from <s>Parśu</s>,

children.text: rādhāṃsi yādvānām ||
children.translated_text: the gifts of the <s>Yādvas</s>.

children.text: trīṇi śatāny arvatāṃ sahasrā daśa gonām
children.translated_text: Three hundred horses and ten thousand cattle

children.text: daduṣ pajrāya sāmne ||
children.translated_text: they gave to <s>Pajra</s> for the <s>Sāman</s>.

children.text: ud ānaṭ kakuho divam uṣṭrāñcaturyujo dadat
children.translated_text: He reached upward to the summit of heaven, giving camels yoked four at a time,

children.text: śravasā yādvaṃ janam ||
children.translated_text: with fame to the <s>Yādva</s> people.

children.text: Chapter 627
pra yad vas triṣṭubham iṣam maruto vipro akṣarat
children.translated_text: When the inspired poet poured forth for you a triṣṭubh nourishment, O <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: vi parvateṣu rājatha ||
children.translated_text: you rule widely among the mountains.

children.text: yad aṅga taviṣīyavo yāmaṃ śubhrā acidhvam
children.translated_text: When, O vigorous ones, O bright ones, you prepared your course,

children.text: ni parvatā ahāsata ||
children.translated_text: the mountains sank down.

children.text: ud īrayanta vāyubhir vāśrāsaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ
children.translated_text: The roaring sons of <s>Pṛśni</s> set things in motion with the winds;

children.text: dhukṣanta pipyuṣīm iṣam ||
children.translated_text: they milked swelling nourishment.

children.text: vapanti maruto miham pra vepayanti parvatān
children.translated_text: The <s>Maruts</s> scatter rain; they make the mountains tremble,

children.text: yad yāmaṃ yānti vāyubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: when they go on their course with the winds.

children.text: ni yad yāmāya vo girir ni sindhavo vidharmaṇe
children.translated_text: When the mountain and the rivers bowed down to your course,

children.text: mahe śuṣmāya yemire ||
children.translated_text: they were restrained for your great vehemence.

children.text: yuṣmāṁ u naktam ūtaye yuṣmān divā havāmahe
children.translated_text: We call you by night for aid; we call you by day;

children.text: yuṣmān prayaty adhvare ||
children.translated_text: we call you at the sacrifice when it is set in motion.

children.text: ud u tye aruṇapsavaś citrā yāmebhir īrate
children.translated_text: Those red-hued, bright ones are set in motion with their courses,

children.text: vāśrā adhi ṣṇunā divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the roaring ones from the back of heaven.

children.text: sṛjanti raśmim ojasā panthāṃ sūryāya yātave
children.translated_text: By their strength they send forth the ray, a path for the sun to travel;

children.text: te bhānubhir vi tasthire ||
children.translated_text: they have spread out with their beams.

children.text: imām me maruto giram imaṃ stomam ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Maruts</s>, O possessors of skill, accept this song of mine, this hymn;

children.text: imam me vanatā havam ||
children.translated_text: accept this invocation of mine.

children.text: trīṇi sarāṃsi pṛśnayo duduhre vajriṇe madhu
children.translated_text: The speckled cows milked three lakes of honey for the thunderbolt-bearer,

children.text: utsaṃ kavandham udriṇam ||
children.translated_text: a spring, a great vessel, a stone-opened source.

children.text: maruto yaddha vo divaḥ sumnāyanto havāmahe
children.translated_text: O <s>Maruts</s>, when, wishing for favor, we call you from heaven,

children.text: ā tū na upa gantana ||
children.translated_text: then come here to us.

children.text: yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā sudānavo rudrā ṛbhukṣaṇo dame
children.translated_text: For you are generous givers, <s>Rudras</s>, possessors of skill in the house,

children.text: uta pracetaso made ||
children.translated_text: and also discerning in exhilaration.

children.text: ā no rayim madacyutam purukṣuṃ viśvadhāyasam
children.translated_text: Set in motion for us from heaven wealth that does not fail in delight, rich in cattle and sustaining all,

children.text: iyartā maruto divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: adhīva yad girīṇāṃ yāmaṃ śubhrā acidhvam
children.translated_text: When, as if over the mountains, O bright ones, you prepared your course,

children.text: suvānair mandadhva indubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: be gladdened by the pressed <s>soma</s> drops.

children.text: etāvataś cid eṣāṃ sumnam bhikṣeta martyaḥ
children.translated_text: Even so much favor of these gods may a mortal seek

children.text: adābhyasya manmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: with thoughts directed to the unconquerable one.

children.text: ye drapsā iva rodasī dhamanty anu vṛṣṭibhiḥ
children.translated_text: They who, like drops, make the two worlds resound with rains,

children.text: utsaṃ duhanto akṣitam ||
children.translated_text: milk the inexhaustible spring.

children.text: ud u svānebhir īrata ud rathair ud u vāyubhiḥ
children.translated_text: They are stirred up with their sounds, up with their chariots, up with their winds,

children.text: ut stomaiḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: and up with hymns, the sons of <s>Pṛśni</s>.

children.text: yenāva turvaśaṃ yaduṃ yena kaṇvaṃ dhanaspṛtam
children.translated_text: By that with which you aided <s>Turvaśa</s> and <s>Yadu</s>, by that with which you aided <s>Kaṇva</s>, seeker of wealth,

children.text: rāye su tasya dhīmahi ||
children.translated_text: for wealth we would take thought of that help.

children.text: imā u vaḥ sudānavo ghṛtaṃ na pipyuṣīr iṣaḥ
children.translated_text: These nourishing refreshments, O generous ones, like ghee,

children.text: vardhān kāṇvasya manmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: have increased through the thoughts of the <s>Kaṇva</s>.

children.text: kva nūnaṃ sudānavo madathā vṛktabarhiṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Where now, O generous ones, do you rejoice, you for whom the sacred grass is strewn?

children.text: brahmā ko vaḥ saparyati ||
children.translated_text: What sacred formulation serves you?

children.text: nahi ṣma yaddha vaḥ purā stomebhir vṛktabarhiṣaḥ
children.translated_text: For surely, when formerly those with strewn sacred grass praised you with hymns,

children.text: śardhāṁ ṛtasya jinvatha ||
children.translated_text: you quickened the host of truth.

children.text: sam u tye mahatīr apaḥ saṃ kṣoṇī sam u sūryam
children.translated_text: Together they set the great waters, together the earth, together the sun;

children.text: saṃ vajram parvaśo dadhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: together they set the thunderbolt joint by joint.

children.text: vi vṛtram parvaśo yayur vi parvatāṁ arājinaḥ
children.translated_text: Joint by joint they went against <s>Vṛtra</s>; the trackless mountains spread apart,

children.text: cakrāṇā vṛṣṇi pauṃsyam ||
children.translated_text: as they made the bull's manly deed.

children.text: anu tritasya yudhyataḥ śuṣmam āvann uta kratum
children.translated_text: They followed the force and resolve of <s>Trita</s> as he fought;

children.text: anv indraṃ vṛtratūrye ||
children.translated_text: they followed <s>Indra</s> in the overcoming of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: vidyuddhastā abhidyavaḥ śiprāḥ śīrṣan hiraṇyayīḥ
children.translated_text: With lightning in their hands, heavenward, with golden helmets upon their heads,

children.text: śubhrā vy añjata śriye ||
children.translated_text: the bright ones adorned themselves for beauty.

children.text: uśanā yat parāvata ukṣṇo randhram ayātana
children.translated_text: When from afar <s>Uśanā</s> reached the opening of the bull,

children.text: dyaur na cakradad bhiyā ||
children.translated_text: heaven roared as if in fear.

children.text: ā no makhasya dāvane 'śvair hiraṇyapāṇibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Come to us, O gods, for the giving of bounty, with horses and golden hands;

children.text: devāsa upa gantana ||
children.translated_text: come near.

children.text: yad eṣām pṛṣatī rathe praṣṭir vahati rohitaḥ
children.translated_text: When the red leader bears their dappled mares on the chariot,

children.text: yānti śubhrā riṇann apaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the bright ones go, releasing the waters.

children.text: suṣome śaryaṇāvaty ārjīke pastyāvati
children.translated_text: At <s>Suṣoma</s>, at <s>Śaryaṇāvat</s>, at <s>Ārjīka</s>, in the settled place,

children.text: yayur nicakrayā naraḥ ||
children.translated_text: the men went with rolling wheels.

children.text: kadā gacchātha maruta itthā vipraṃ havamānam
children.translated_text: When will you come, O <s>Maruts</s>, to the inspired poet who calls in this way,

children.text: mārḍīkebhir nādhamānam ||
children.translated_text: to the needy one with mercies?

children.text: kaddha nūnaṃ kadhapriyo yad indram ajahātana
children.translated_text: When now, lovers of what time, since you have left <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: ko vaḥ sakhitva ohate ||
children.translated_text: who seeks your friendship?

children.text: saho ṣu ṇo vajrahastaiḥ kaṇvāso agnim marudbhiḥ
children.translated_text: With strength for us, with thunderbolt-handed ones, the <s>Kaṇvas</s> praise <s>Agni</s> together with the <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: stuṣe hiraṇyavāśībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: with golden axes.

children.text: o ṣu vṛṣṇaḥ prayajyūn ā navyase suvitāya
children.translated_text: Now may I turn the eager ones of the bull

children.text: vavṛtyāṃ citravājān ||
children.translated_text: toward newer good guidance, rich in splendid prizes.

children.text: girayaś cin ni jihate parśānāso manyamānāḥ
children.translated_text: Even the mountains bow down, thinking themselves split;

children.text: parvatāś cin ni yemire ||
children.translated_text: even the mountains are held down.

children.text: ākṣṇayāvāno vahanty antarikṣeṇa patataḥ
children.translated_text: The crosswise-moving ones bear, flying through the midspace,

children.text: dhātāra stuvate vayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: strength for the praiser, as sustainers.

children.text: agnir hi jāni pūrvyaś chando na sūro arciṣā
children.translated_text: For <s>Agni</s> has been born ancient, like a sun with his flame as with a hymn;

children.text: te bhānubhir vi tasthire ||
children.translated_text: they have spread out with their beams.

children.text: Chapter 628
ā no viśvābhir ūtibhir aśvinā gacchataṃ yuvam
children.translated_text: Come to us, both of you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, with all your aids;

children.text: dasrā hiraṇyavartanī pibataṃ somyam madhu ||
children.translated_text: O wondrous ones with golden tracks, drink the <s>soma</s> honey.

children.text: ā nūnaṃ yātam aśvinā rathena sūryatvacā
children.translated_text: Come now, O <s>Aśvins</s>, with your chariot whose covering is sunlight,

children.text: bhujī hiraṇyapeśasā kavī gambhīracetasā ||
children.translated_text: with nourishing, golden-adorned, inspired, deep-minded power.

children.text: ā yātaṃ nahuṣas pary āntarikṣāt suvṛktibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Come from the line of <s>Nahuṣ</s>, from around the midspace, with fair hymns;

children.text: pibātho aśvinā madhu kaṇvānāṃ savane sutam ||
children.translated_text: drink, O <s>Aśvins</s>, the honey pressed at the <s>Kaṇvas</s>' pressing.

children.text: ā no yātaṃ divas pary āntarikṣād adhapriyā
children.translated_text: Come to us from heaven, from around the midspace, you who are dear below;

children.text: putraḥ kaṇvasya vām iha suṣāva somyam madhu ||
children.translated_text: the son of <s>Kaṇva</s> has pressed for you here the <s>soma</s> honey.

children.text: ā no yātam upaśruty aśvinā somapītaye
children.translated_text: Come to us when you hear, O <s>Aśvins</s>, for the drinking of <s>soma</s>;

children.text: svāhā stomasya vardhanā pra kavī dhītibhir narā ||
