children.translated_text: with svāhā, O increasers of the hymn, O inspired men, by our thoughts.

children.text: yacciddhi vām pura ṛṣayo juhūre 'vase narā
children.translated_text: Since the seers of old called you, O men, for help,

children.text: ā yātam aśvinā gatam upemāṃ suṣṭutim mama ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Aśvins</s>; come to this well-spoken praise of mine.

children.text: divaś cid rocanād adhy ā no gantaṃ svarvidā
children.translated_text: Come to us even from the bright realm of heaven, finders of light,

children.text: dhībhir vatsapracetasā stomebhir havanaśrutā ||
children.translated_text: with insights, O you of mindful strength, with hymns, hearers of the call.

children.text: kim anye pary āsate 'smat stomebhir aśvinā
children.translated_text: Why do others sit around away from our hymns, O <s>Aśvins</s>?

children.text: putraḥ kaṇvasya vām ṛṣir gīrbhir vatso avīvṛdhat ||
children.translated_text: The seer, son of <s>Kaṇva</s>, <s>Vatsa</s>, has strengthened you with songs.

children.text: ā vāṃ vipra ihāvase 'hvat stomebhir aśvinā
children.translated_text: The inspired poet here has called you for help with hymns, O <s>Aśvins</s>;

children.text: ariprā vṛtrahantamā tā no bhūtam mayobhuvā ||
children.translated_text: unharmed, most slayers of <s>Vṛtra</s>, be bringers of happiness to us.

children.text: ā yad vāṃ yoṣaṇā ratham atiṣṭhad vājinīvasū
children.translated_text: When the woman mounted your chariot, O possessors of steeds and wealth,

children.text: viśvāny aśvinā yuvam pra dhītāny agacchatam ||
children.translated_text: you two, O <s>Aśvins</s>, went forth to all inspired thoughts.

children.text: ataḥ sahasranirṇijā rathenā yātam aśvinā
children.translated_text: From here, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come with the chariot that has a thousand ornaments;

children.text: vatso vām madhumad vaco 'śaṃsīt kāvyaḥ kaviḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vatsa</s>, the poetic seer, has proclaimed to you honey-sweet speech.

children.text: purumandrā purūvasū manotarā rayīṇām
children.translated_text: Rich in delight, rich in goods, most thoughtful about treasures,

children.text: stomam me aśvināv imam abhi vahnī anūṣātām ||
children.translated_text: may the two bearers, the <s>Aśvins</s>, attend this hymn of mine.

children.text: ā no viśvāny aśvinā dhattaṃ rādhāṃsy ahrayā
children.translated_text: Bring to us all favors, O <s>Aśvins</s>, without turning aside;

children.text: kṛtaṃ na ṛtviyāvato mā no rīradhataṃ nide ||
children.translated_text: make them as for one who observes the seasons; do not hand us over to blame.

children.text: yan nāsatyā parāvati yad vā stho adhy ambare
children.translated_text: Whether, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, you are in the far distance, or whether you stand above in the atmosphere,

children.text: ataḥ sahasranirṇijā rathenā yātam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: from there come by your thousand-adorned chariot, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: yo vāṃ nāsatyāv ṛṣir gīrbhir vatso avīvṛdhat
children.translated_text: The seer <s>Vatsa</s>, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, has strengthened you two with songs;

children.text: tasmai sahasranirṇijam iṣaṃ dhattaṃ ghṛtaścutam ||
children.translated_text: for him set down thousand-adorned refreshment, dripping with ghee.

children.text: prāsmā ūrjaṃ ghṛtaścutam aśvinā yacchataṃ yuvam
children.translated_text: Grant him vigor, dripping with ghee, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you two,

children.text: yo vāṃ sumnāya tuṣṭavad vasūyād dānunas patī ||
children.translated_text: the man who, desiring goods, has praised you for favor, O lords of giving.

children.text: ā no gantaṃ riśādasemaṃ stomam purubhujā
children.translated_text: Come to us, O devourers of foes, to this hymn, O you of manifold enjoyment;

children.text: kṛtaṃ naḥ suśriyo naremā dātam abhiṣṭaye ||
children.translated_text: make splendid glory for us, O men, and give it for our desire.

children.text: ā vāṃ viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ priyamedhā ahūṣata
children.translated_text: With all your aids the <s>Priyamedhas</s> have called you,

children.text: rājantāv adhvarāṇām aśvinā yāmahūtiṣu ||
children.translated_text: you who rule over the rites, O <s>Aśvins</s>, at the invocations of the journey.

children.text: ā no gantam mayobhuvāśvinā śambhuvā yuvam
children.translated_text: Come to us, bringing happiness, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you two bringing welfare,

children.text: yo vāṃ vipanyū dhītibhir gīrbhir vatso avīvṛdhat ||
children.translated_text: for <s>Vatsa</s>, skillful in praise, has strengthened you with thoughts and songs.

children.text: yābhiḥ kaṇvam medhātithiṃ yābhir vaśaṃ daśavrajam
children.translated_text: With those aids by which you helped <s>Kaṇva</s> and <s>Medhātithi</s>, by which you helped <s>Vaśa</s> and <s>Daśavraja</s>,

children.text: yābhir gośaryam āvataṃ tābhir no 'vataṃ narā ||
children.translated_text: by which you helped <s>Gośarya</s>, with those help us, O men.

children.text: yābhir narā trasadasyum āvataṃ kṛtvye dhane
children.translated_text: With those by which you helped <s>Trasadasyu</s>, O men, in wealth to be won by action,

children.text: tābhiḥ ṣv asmāṁ aśvinā prāvataṃ vājasātaye ||
children.translated_text: with those, O <s>Aśvins</s>, protect us here for the winning of the prize.

children.text: pra vāṃ stomāḥ suvṛktayo giro vardhantv aśvinā
children.translated_text: Let your well-turned hymns and songs increase you, O <s>Aśvins</s>;

children.text: purutrā vṛtrahantamā tā no bhūtam puruspṛhā ||
children.translated_text: most Vṛtra-slaying in many places, be much-desired by us.

children.text: trīṇi padāny aśvinor āviḥ sānti guhā paraḥ
children.translated_text: The three steps of the <s>Aśvins</s> are manifest; the hidden one is farther away,

children.text: kavī ṛtasya patmabhir arvāg jīvebhyas pari ||
children.translated_text: the two poets, by the paths of truth, turning hither toward living beings.

children.text: Chapter 629
ā nūnam aśvinā yuvaṃ vatsasya gantam avase
children.translated_text: Now, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come to the aid of <s>Vatsa</s>;

children.text: prāsmai yacchatam avṛkam pṛthu chardir yuyutaṃ yā arātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: grant him broad, harmless shelter, and keep away the hostile powers.

children.text: yad antarikṣe yad divi yat pañca mānuṣāṁ anu
children.translated_text: Whatever manly power is in the midspace, whatever in heaven, whatever among the five human peoples,

children.text: nṛmṇaṃ tad dhattam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: place that here, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: ye vāṃ daṃsāṃsy aśvinā viprāsaḥ parimāmṛśuḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired poets have pondered your wondrous deeds, O <s>Aśvins</s>;

children.text: evet kāṇvasya bodhatam ||
children.translated_text: so now take notice of the <s>Kaṇva</s>.

children.text: ayaṃ vāṃ gharmo aśvinā stomena pari ṣicyate
children.translated_text: This hot oblation is poured around for you with a hymn, O <s>Aśvins</s>;

children.text: ayaṃ somo madhumān vājinīvasū yena vṛtraṃ ciketathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: this honeyed <s>soma</s> is yours, O lords of prize-winning wealth, by which you perceived <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: yad apsu yad vanaspatau yad oṣadhīṣu purudaṃsasā kṛtam
children.translated_text: Whatever deed you have done in the waters, in the tree, or in the herbs, O you of many wonders,

children.text: tena māviṣṭam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: with that come near to me, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: yan nāsatyā bhuraṇyatho yad vā deva bhiṣajyathaḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, you bring forth, or whatever, O gods, you heal,

children.text: ayaṃ vāṃ vatso matibhir na vindhate haviṣmantaṃ hi gacchathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: this <s>Vatsa</s> does not fail to find you with his thoughts, for you come to the offerer of oblations.

children.text: ā nūnam aśvinor ṛṣi stomaṃ ciketa vāmayā
children.translated_text: Now the seer has discerned the gracious hymn of the <s>Aśvins</s>;

children.text: ā somam madhumattamaṃ gharmaṃ siñcād atharvaṇi ||
children.translated_text: let him pour the sweetest <s>soma</s>, the hot oblation, in the manner of <s>Atharvan</s>.

children.text: ā nūnaṃ raghuvartaniṃ rathaṃ tiṣṭhātho aśvinā
children.translated_text: Now mount the swift-turning chariot, O <s>Aśvins</s>;

children.text: ā vāṃ stomā ime mama nabho na cucyavīrata ||
children.translated_text: these hymns of mine have shaken you as the cloud shakes loose.

children.text: yad adya vāṃ nāsatyokthair ācucyuvīmahi
children.translated_text: If today, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, we have stirred you with recitations,

children.text: yad vā vāṇībhir aśvinevet kāṇvasya bodhatam ||
children.translated_text: or with voices, O <s>Aśvins</s>, then take notice of the <s>Kaṇva</s>.

children.text: yad vāṃ kakṣīvāṁ uta yad vyaśva ṛṣir yad vāṃ dīrghatamā juhāva
children.translated_text: If <s>Kakṣīvān</s> called you, or the seer <s>Vyaśva</s>, or if <s>Dīrghatamas</s> called you,

children.text: pṛthī yad vāṃ vainyaḥ sādaneṣv eved ato aśvinā cetayethām ||
children.translated_text: or if <s>Pṛthī Vainya</s> called you in his dwellings, then from here be mindful, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: yātaṃ chardiṣpā uta naḥ paraspā bhūtaṃ jagatpā uta nas tanūpā
children.translated_text: Come as guardians of shelter and as guardians from beyond; be guardians of the world and guardians of our bodies;

children.text: vartis tokāya tanayāya yātam ||
children.translated_text: come on your course for child and offspring.

children.text: yad indreṇa sarathaṃ yātho aśvinā yad vā vāyunā bhavathaḥ samokasā
children.translated_text: Whether you go in one chariot with <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>, or whether you share one home with <s>Vāyu</s>,

children.text: yad ādityebhir ṛbhubhiḥ sajoṣasā yad vā viṣṇor vikramaṇeṣu tiṣṭhathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: or whether you stand together with the <s>Ādityas</s> and <s>Ṛbhus</s>, or in the strides of <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: yad adyāśvināv ahaṃ huveya vājasātaye
children.translated_text: if today I should call you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, for the winning of the prize,

children.text: yat pṛtsu turvaṇe sahas tacchreṣṭham aśvinor avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that aid of the <s>Aśvins</s> is best when there is force in battles for overcoming.

children.text: ā nūnaṃ yātam aśvinemā havyāni vāṃ hitā
children.translated_text: Now come, O <s>Aśvins</s>; these oblations have been set out for you.

children.text: ime somāso adhi turvaśe yadāv ime kaṇveṣu vām atha ||
children.translated_text: These <s>somas</s> are placed among <s>Turvaśa</s> and <s>Yadu</s>; and now these are yours among the <s>Kaṇvas</s>.

children.text: yan nāsatyā parāke arvāke asti bheṣajam
children.translated_text: Whatever remedy, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, exists far away or near at hand,

children.text: tena nūnaṃ vimadāya pracetasā chardir vatsāya yacchatam ||
children.translated_text: with that, now, O wise ones, grant shelter to <s>Vimada</s>, to <s>Vatsa</s>.

children.text: abhutsy u pra devyā sākaṃ vācāham aśvinoḥ
children.translated_text: I have awakened together with divine speech, proclaiming the <s>Aśvins</s>;

children.text: vy āvar devy ā matiṃ vi rātim martyebhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the divine thought has opened, and the gift has opened for mortals.

children.text: pra bodhayoṣo aśvinā pra devi sūnṛte mahi
children.translated_text: Awaken, O <s>Uṣas</s>, the <s>Aśvins</s>; awaken, great goddess of gracious speech;

children.text: pra yajñahotar ānuṣak pra madāya śravo bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: awaken the sacrificer and the hotar in order, awaken great fame for exhilaration.

children.text: yad uṣo yāsi bhānunā saṃ sūryeṇa rocase
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Uṣas</s>, you go with your light and shine together with the <s>Sun</s>,

children.text: ā hāyam aśvino ratho vartir yāti nṛpāyyam ||
children.translated_text: then this chariot of the <s>Aśvins</s> comes here on a course worthy of men.

children.text: yad āpītāso aṃśavo gāvo na duhra ūdhabhiḥ
children.translated_text: When the pressed drops are milked like cows with their udders,

children.text: yad vā vāṇīr anūṣata pra devayanto aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: or when the voices have sounded, calling the <s>Aśvins</s> for the gods,

children.text: pra dyumnāya pra śavase pra nṛṣāhyāya śarmaṇe
children.translated_text: forth for brilliance, forth for might, forth for man-conquering shelter,

children.text: pra dakṣāya pracetasā ||
children.translated_text: forth for skill, O wise ones.

children.text: yan nūnaṃ dhībhir aśvinā pitur yonā niṣīdathaḥ
children.translated_text: If now, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you sit down with insights in the father's womb,

children.text: yad vā sumnebhir ukthyā ||
children.translated_text: or with favors, O praiseworthy ones,

children.text: Chapter 630
yat stho dīrghaprasadmani yad vādo rocane divaḥ
children.translated_text: whether you are in the long dwelling, or in the shining realm of heaven,

children.text: yad vā samudre adhy ākṛte gṛhe 'ta ā yātam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: or in the formed house upon the sea, come from there, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: yad vā yajñam manave saṃmimikṣathur evet kāṇvasya bodhatam
children.translated_text: Or if you two have mingled the sacrifice for <s>Manu</s>, then take notice of the <s>Kaṇva</s>.

children.text: bṛhaspatiṃ viśvān devāṁ ahaṃ huva indrāviṣṇū aśvināv āśuheṣasā ||
children.translated_text: I call <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, all the gods, <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and the swift-speeding <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: tyā nv aśvinā huve sudaṃsasā gṛbhe kṛtā
children.translated_text: Those two <s>Aśvins</s> I now call, wonder-working, fashioned for grasping,

children.text: yayor asti pra ṇaḥ sakhyaṃ deveṣv adhy āpyam ||
children.translated_text: with whom there is for us friendship and kinship among the gods.

children.text: yayor adhi pra yajñā asūre santi sūrayaḥ
children.translated_text: Over the sacrifices of those two, the inspired patrons preside in power;

children.text: tā yajñasyādhvarasya pracetasā svadhābhir yā pibataḥ somyam madhu ||
children.translated_text: those two wise ones drink the <s>soma</s> honey of the sacrifice and rite according to their own powers.

children.text: yad adyāśvināv apāg yat prāk stho vājinīvasū
children.translated_text: If today, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you are in the west, or if you are in the east, O lords of prize-winning wealth,

children.text: yad druhyavy anavi turvaśe yadau huve vām atha mā gatam ||
children.translated_text: or if, when I call you, you are among <s>Druhyu</s>, <s>Anu</s>, <s>Turvaśa</s>, and <s>Yadu</s>, then come to me.

children.text: yad antarikṣe patathaḥ purubhujā yad veme rodasī anu
children.translated_text: When you fly in the midspace, O much-enjoying ones, when you pass along these two worlds,

children.text: yad vā svadhābhir adhitiṣṭhatho ratham ata ā yātam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: or when by your own powers you mount the chariot, from there come here, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: Chapter 631
tvam agne vratapā asi deva ā martyeṣv ā
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are the guardian of vows, a god among mortals;

children.text: tvaṃ yajñeṣv īḍyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you are worthy of praise at sacrifices.

children.text: tvam asi praśasyo vidatheṣu sahantya
children.translated_text: You are to be proclaimed in the assemblies, O overpowering one;

children.text: agne rathīr adhvarāṇām ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, you are the charioteer of the rites.

children.text: sa tvam asmad apa dviṣo yuyodhi jātavedaḥ
children.translated_text: So drive hostile men away from us, O <s>Jātavedas</s>;

children.text: adevīr agne arātīḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, drive away the godless acts of withholding.

children.text: anti cit santam aha yajñam martasya ripoḥ
children.translated_text: Even though the sacrifice of a mortal enemy is close at hand,

children.text: nopa veṣi jātavedaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you do not attend it, O <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: martā amartyasya te bhūri nāma manāmahe
children.translated_text: We mortals, inspired poets, call to mind the many names of you, the immortal one,

children.text: viprāso jātavedasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: vipraṃ viprāso 'vase devam martāsa ūtaye
children.translated_text: We inspired mortals call the inspired god for help and protection,

children.text: agniṃ gīrbhir havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, with our songs.

children.text: ā te vatso mano yamat paramāc cit sadhasthāt
children.translated_text: May the calf-like mind turn toward you from even the highest seat,

children.text: agne tvāṅkāmayā girā ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, with a song full of longing for you.

children.text: purutrā hi sadṛṅṅ asi viśo viśvā anu prabhuḥ
children.translated_text: For you are visibly present in many places, lord over all the clans;

children.text: samatsu tvā havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: we call upon you in battles.

children.text: samatsv agnim avase vājayanto havāmahe
children.translated_text: In battles, striving for prizes, we call on <s>Agni</s> for help,

children.text: vājeṣu citrarādhasam ||
children.translated_text: the richly rewarding one in contests.

children.text: pratno hi kam īḍyo adhvareṣu sanāc ca hotā navyaś ca satsi
children.translated_text: For from of old you are surely worthy of praise at the rites; from ancient time and still now you sit as <s>hotṛ</s> (invoking priest).

children.text: svāṃ cāgne tanvam piprayasvāsmabhyaṃ ca saubhagam ā yajasva ||
children.translated_text: Refresh your own body, O <s>Agni</s>, and win good fortune for us through sacrifice.

children.text: Chapter 632
ya indra somapātamo madaḥ śaviṣṭha cetati
children.translated_text: That exhilaration, O <s>Indra</s>, most soma-drinking and most mighty, which makes you alert,

children.text: yenā haṃsi ny atriṇaṃ tam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: by which you slay the devourer, that we seek.

children.text: yenā daśagvam adhriguṃ vepayantaṃ svarṇaram
children.translated_text: That by which you aided <s>Daśagva</s>, <s>Adhrigu</s>, and trembling <s>Svarṇara</s>,

children.text: yenā samudram āvithā tam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: that by which you protected the ocean, that we seek.

children.text: yena sindhum mahīr apo rathāṁ iva pracodayaḥ
children.translated_text: That by which you drove the <s>Sindhu</s> and the great waters onward like chariots,

children.text: panthām ṛtasya yātave tam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: so that the path of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) might be traveled, that we seek.

children.text: imaṃ stomam abhiṣṭaye ghṛtaṃ na pūtam adrivaḥ
children.translated_text: For aid, O stone-armed one, accept this praise like purified ghee,

children.text: yenā nu sadya ojasā vavakṣitha ||
children.translated_text: by which now, at once, you have grown in strength.

children.text: imaṃ juṣasva girvaṇaḥ samudra iva pinvate
children.translated_text: Accept this, O lover of song; it swells like the ocean;

children.text: indra viśvābhir ūtibhir vavakṣitha ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, with all your aids you have grown.

children.text: yo no devaḥ parāvataḥ sakhitvanāya māmahe
children.translated_text: The god whom we call from afar for friendship,

children.text: divo na vṛṣṭim prathayan vavakṣitha ||
children.translated_text: you have made expand like rain from heaven.

children.text: vavakṣur asya ketavo uta vajro gabhastyoḥ
children.translated_text: His signs have carried him, and the thunderbolt in his hands,

children.text: yat sūryo na rodasī avardhayat ||
children.translated_text: when, like the sun, he made the two worlds grow.

children.text: yadi pravṛddha satpate sahasram mahiṣāṁ aghaḥ
children.translated_text: If, O grown-great lord of the good, there is an offense of a thousand buffaloes,

children.text: ād it ta indriyam mahi pra vāvṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: then your great <s>indriya</s> (lordly power) has indeed grown forth.

children.text: indraḥ sūryasya raśmibhir ny arśasānam oṣati
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> burns up the roaring one with the rays of the sun;

children.text: agnir vaneva sāsahiḥ pra vāvṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, overpowering like a forest fire, has grown forth.

children.text: iyaṃ ta ṛtviyāvatī dhītir eti navīyasī
children.translated_text: This inspired thought of yours, fitted to the rite, comes ever newer,

children.text: saparyantī purupriyā mimīta it ||
children.translated_text: serving you, beloved by many; it has measured itself out.

children.text: garbho yajñasya devayuḥ kratum punīta ānuṣak
children.translated_text: The germ of the sacrifice, longing for the gods, purifies the resolve continually;

children.text: stomair indrasya vāvṛdhe mimīta it ||
children.translated_text: with praises it has increased <s>Indra</s>; it has measured itself out.

children.text: sanir mitrasya papratha indraḥ somasya pītaye
children.translated_text: The winning power of <s>Mitra</s> has spread wide: <s>Indra</s> is for the drinking of <s>soma</s> (pressed offering);

children.text: prācī vāśīva sunvate mimīta it ||
children.translated_text: like a forward-pointing axe for the presser, it has measured itself out.

children.text: yaṃ viprā ukthavāhaso 'bhipramandur āyavaḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired poets, bearers of the recitation, the clans, have gladdened him,

children.text: ghṛtaṃ na pipya āsany ṛtasya yat ||
children.translated_text: as ghee fills the mouth, when it belongs to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: uta svarāje aditi stomam indrāya jījanat
children.translated_text: And <s>Aditi</s>, for sovereign rule, has brought forth a hymn for <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: purupraśastam ūtaya ṛtasya yat ||
children.translated_text: much praised, for aids, when it belongs to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: abhi vahnaya ūtaye 'nūṣata praśastaye
children.translated_text: The bearers have sung out for aid and for praise;

children.text: na deva vivratā harī ṛtasya yat ||
children.translated_text: O god, the two bay horses do not violate the ordinances, when it belongs to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: yat somam indra viṣṇavi yad vā gha trita āptye
children.translated_text: Whether, O <s>Indra</s>, you rejoice in <s>soma</s> with <s>Viṣṇu</s>, or with <s>Trita Āptya</s>,

children.text: yad vā marutsu mandase sam indubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: or whether you rejoice among the <s>Maruts</s>, together with the drops,

children.text: yad vā śakra parāvati samudre adhi mandase
children.translated_text: or whether, O <s>Śakra</s>, you rejoice far away, upon the sea,

children.text: asmākam it sute raṇā sam indubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: then rejoice in our pressed offering itself, together with the drops.

children.text: yad vāsi sunvato vṛdho yajamānasya satpate
children.translated_text: Or if you are the increaser of the presser, of the sacrificer, O lord of the good,

children.text: ukthe vā yasya raṇyasi sam indubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: or if you delight in his recitation, do so together with the drops.

children.text: devaṃ devaṃ vo 'vasa indramindraṃ gṛṇīṣaṇi
children.translated_text: For your help I will praise god after god, <s>Indra</s> after <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: adhā yajñāya turvaṇe vy ānaśuḥ ||
children.translated_text: then they have spread out for the sacrifice that overcomes.

children.text: yajñebhir yajñavāhasaṃ somebhiḥ somapātamam
children.translated_text: With sacrifices they strengthened <s>Indra</s>, bearer of sacrifice; with <s>somas</s>, the greatest drinker of <s>soma</s>;

children.text: hotrābhir indraṃ vāvṛdhur vy ānaśuḥ ||
children.translated_text: with priestly offices they made <s>Indra</s> grow and spread out.

children.text: mahīr asya praṇītayaḥ pūrvīr uta praśastayaḥ
children.translated_text: Great are his guidances, and many too are his praises;

children.text: viśvā vasūni dāśuṣe vy ānaśuḥ ||
children.translated_text: all treasures have spread out for the worshipper who gives.

children.text: indraṃ vṛtrāya hantave devāso dadhire puraḥ
children.translated_text: The gods set <s>Indra</s> before them to slay <s>Vṛtra</s>;

children.text: indraṃ vāṇīr anūṣatā sam ojase ||
children.translated_text: the voices sang after <s>Indra</s> for united strength.

children.text: mahāntam mahinā vayaṃ stomebhir havanaśrutam
children.translated_text: With praises and chants we bow before the great one, great in might, who hears the summons,

children.text: arkair abhi pra ṇonumaḥ sam ojase ||
children.translated_text: for united strength.

children.text: na yaṃ vivikto rodasī nāntarikṣāṇi vajriṇam
children.translated_text: Neither the divided two worlds nor the midspaces can contain the thunderbolt-bearer;

children.text: amād id asya titviṣe sam ojasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: from his very home he has shone with united power.

children.text: yad indra pṛtanājye devās tvā dadhire puraḥ
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indra</s>, in the contest of battle the gods set you before them,

children.text: ād it te haryatā harī vavakṣatuḥ ||
children.translated_text: then your desirable bay horses carried you onward.

children.text: yadā vṛtraṃ nadīvṛtaṃ śavasā vajrinn avadhīḥ
children.translated_text: When with force, O thunderbolt-bearer, you struck down <s>Vṛtra</s>, who enclosed the rivers,

children.text: ād it te haryatā harī vavakṣatuḥ ||
children.translated_text: then your desirable bay horses carried you onward.

children.text: yadā te viṣṇur ojasā trīṇi padā vicakrame
children.translated_text: When <s>Viṣṇu</s>, through your power, strode out his three steps,

children.text: ād it te haryatā harī vavakṣatuḥ ||
children.translated_text: then your desirable bay horses carried you onward.

children.text: yadā te haryatā harī vāvṛdhāte dive dive
children.translated_text: When your desirable bay horses grew day by day,

children.text: ād it te viśvā bhuvanāni yemire ||
children.translated_text: then all beings were brought under your control.

children.text: yadā te mārutīr viśas tubhyam indra niyemire
children.translated_text: When the <s>Marut</s> clans submitted themselves to you, O <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: ād it te viśvā bhuvanāni yemire ||
children.translated_text: then all beings were brought under your control.

children.text: yadā sūryam amuṃ divi śukraṃ jyotir adhārayaḥ
children.translated_text: When you held up that sun in heaven, the bright light,

children.text: ād it te viśvā bhuvanāni yemire ||
children.translated_text: then all beings were brought under your control.

children.text: imāṃ ta indra suṣṭutiṃ vipra iyarti dhītibhiḥ
children.translated_text: This good praise of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, the inspired poet sends forth with his thoughts,

children.text: jāmim padeva pipratīm prādhvare ||
children.translated_text: filling the kindred place as with a foot, at the fore-rite.

children.text: yad asya dhāmani priye samīcīnāso asvaran
children.translated_text: When, in his dear dwelling, the concordant ones have sounded out,

children.text: nābhā yajñasya dohanā prādhvare ||
children.translated_text: at the navel of the sacrifice, the milkings are at the fore-rite.

children.text: suvīryaṃ svaśvyaṃ sugavyam indra daddhi naḥ
children.translated_text: Grant us good heroic power, good horses, and good cattle, O <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: hoteva pūrvacittaye prādhvare ||
children.translated_text: like a <s>hotṛ</s> (invoking priest) for first insight at the fore-rite.

children.text: Chapter 633
indraḥ suteṣu someṣu kratum punīta ukthyam
children.translated_text: Among the pressed <s>somas</s>, <s>Indra</s> purifies the praiseworthy resolve;

children.text: vide vṛdhasya dakṣaso mahān hi ṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he is known for growing skill, for he is great.

children.text: sa prathame vyomani devānāṃ sadane vṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: He, the increaser, in the first heaven, in the seat of the gods.

children.text: supāraḥ suśravastamaḥ sam apsujit ||
children.translated_text: a good one to bring across, most renowned, winning together in the waters.

children.text: tam ahve vājasātaya indram bharāya śuṣmiṇam
children.translated_text: I call upon that vigorous <s>Indra</s> for the winning of prizes, for the contest;

children.text: bhavā naḥ sumne antamaḥ sakhā vṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: be our nearest friend for favor and increase.

children.text: iyaṃ ta indra girvaṇo rātiḥ kṣarati sunvataḥ
children.translated_text: This gift of the soma-presser, O <s>Indra</s>, lover of song, flows for you;

children.text: mandāno asya barhiṣo vi rājasi ||
children.translated_text: being gladdened by it, you shine out upon this sacred grass.

children.text: nūnaṃ tad indra daddhi no yat tvā sunvanta īmahe
children.translated_text: Now grant us that, O <s>Indra</s>, which we, pressing soma, ask of you;

children.text: rayiṃ naś citram ā bharā svarvidam ||
children.translated_text: bring us bright wealth that finds the sun.

children.text: stotā yat te vicarṣaṇir atipraśardhayad giraḥ
children.translated_text: When the singer, all-observing, has raised his songs very boldly for you,

children.text: vayā ivānu rohate juṣanta yat ||
children.translated_text: he climbs after them like branches, when they are pleasing.

children.text: pratnavaj janayā giraḥ śṛṇudhī jaritur havam
children.translated_text: Bring forth songs as of old; listen to the call of the singer;

children.text: made made vavakṣithā sukṛtvane ||
children.translated_text: at every exhilaration you have grown for the one who acts well.

children.text: krīﾱanty asya sūnṛtā āpo na pravatā yatīḥ
children.translated_text: His gracious words play like waters going down a slope,

children.text: ayā dhiyā ya ucyate patir divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: by this inspired thought through which he is called lord of heaven.

children.text: uto patir ya ucyate kṛṣṭīnām eka id vaśī
children.translated_text: And he is called lord of the peoples, the one sole ruler;

children.text: namovṛdhair avasyubhiḥ sute raṇa ||
children.translated_text: rejoice at the pressing with those who seek help and increase you with homage.

children.text: stuhi śrutaṃ vipaścitaṃ harī yasya prasakṣiṇā
children.translated_text: Praise the famed and discerning one whose two bay horses stand beside him,

children.text: gantārā dāśuṣo gṛhaṃ namasvinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the bringers to the house of the reverent giver.

children.text: tūtujāno mahemate 'śvebhiḥ pruṣitapsubhiḥ
children.translated_text: Urged on, O greatly wise one, with horses whose drops are sprinkled,

children.text: ā yāhi yajñam āśubhiḥ śam iddhi te ||
children.translated_text: come to the sacrifice with the swift ones; may it be auspicious for you.

children.text: indra śaviṣṭha satpate rayiṃ gṛṇatsu dhāraya
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, mightiest, lord of the good, uphold wealth among those who praise;

children.text: śravaḥ sūribhyo amṛtaṃ vasutvanam ||
children.translated_text: uphold immortal fame and prosperity for the patrons.

children.text: have tvā sūra udite have madhyandine divaḥ
children.translated_text: I call you when the sun has risen; I call you at midday;

children.text: juṣāṇa indra saptibhir na ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: taking pleasure, O <s>Indra</s>, come to us with your coursers.

children.text: ā tū gahi pra tu drava matsvā sutasya gomataḥ
children.translated_text: Come here now, run forth; be exhilarated by the pressed soma rich in cattle;

children.text: tantuṃ tanuṣva pūrvyaṃ yathā vide ||
children.translated_text: stretch out the ancient thread, as is known.

children.text: yacchakrāsi parāvati yad arvāvati vṛtrahan
children.translated_text: Whether you are far away, O powerful slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, or whether nearby,

children.text: yad vā samudre andhaso 'vited asi ||
children.translated_text: or whether you are in the ocean as protector of the draught,

children.text: indraṃ vardhantu no gira indraṃ sutāsa indavaḥ
children.translated_text: let our songs strengthen <s>Indra</s>; let the pressed soma-drops strengthen <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: indre haviṣmatīr viśo arāṇiṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the offering-bearing clans have served <s>Indra</s> in the contests.

children.text: tam id viprā avasyavaḥ pravatvatībhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired priests, seeking help, strengthened that very <s>Indra</s>

children.text: indraṃ kṣoṇīr avardhayan vayā iva ||
children.translated_text: with rushing aids; the two worlds strengthened him like branches.

children.text: trikadrukeṣu cetanaṃ devāso yajñam atnata
children.translated_text: At the three <s>Trikadrukas</s> the gods stretched out the conscious sacrifice;

children.text: tam id vardhantu no giraḥ sadāvṛdham ||
children.translated_text: let our songs strengthen that ever-growing one.

children.text: stotā yat te anuvrata ukthāny ṛtuthā dadhe
children.translated_text: When the singer, following your ordinance, has set the recitations in due season,

children.text: śuciḥ pāvaka ucyate so adbhutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he is called bright, purifying, and wondrous.

children.text: tad id rudrasya cetati yahvam pratneṣu dhāmasu
children.translated_text: This very thing marks the mighty force of <s>Rudra</s> in the ancient abodes,

children.text: mano yatrā vi tad dadhur vicetasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: where the wise ones fixed their mind apart.

children.text: yadi me sakhyam āvara imasya pāhy andhasaḥ
children.translated_text: If you choose my friendship, protect this draught,

children.text: yena viśvā ati dviṣo atārima ||
children.translated_text: by which we may cross beyond all hatreds.

children.text: kadā ta indra girvaṇa stotā bhavāti śantamaḥ
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indra</s>, lover of song, will the singer become most blessed for you?

children.text: kadā no gavye aśvye vasau dadhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When will you place us in cattle-rich and horse-rich wealth?

children.text: uta te suṣṭutā harī vṛṣaṇā vahato ratham
children.translated_text: And your well-praised two bay horses, the virile pair, carry the chariot,

children.text: ajuryasya madintamaṃ yam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: the ageless, most exhilarating one that we seek.

children.text: tam īmahe puruṣṭutaṃ yahvam pratnābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: We seek that much-praised mighty one with ancient aids;

children.text: ni barhiṣi priye sadad adha dvitā ||
children.translated_text: let him sit down upon the dear sacred grass, and then in twofold form.

children.text: vardhasvā su puruṣṭuta ṛṣiṣṭutābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Grow greatly, O much-praised one, with the aids praised by seers;

children.text: dhukṣasva pipyuṣīm iṣam avā ca naḥ ||
children.translated_text: milk out for us swelling nourishment, and help us.

children.text: indra tvam avited asītthā stuvato adrivaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, you have indeed been protector of the praising man, O stone-wielding one;

children.text: ṛtād iyarmi te dhiyam manoyujam ||
children.translated_text: from truth I send forth to you a thought yoked with the mind.

children.text: iha tyā sadhamādyā yujānaḥ somapītaye
children.translated_text: Here yoke those companions for the common feast, for the drinking of soma;

children.text: harī indra pratadvasū abhi svara ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, call aloud to the two bay steeds rich in forward strength.

children.text: abhi svarantu ye tava rudrāsaḥ sakṣata śriyam
children.translated_text: Let those <s>Rudras</s> of yours, who attain splendor, call aloud;

children.text: uto marutvatīr viśo abhi prayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and let the clans accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s> call aloud toward the offering.

children.text: imā asya pratūrtayaḥ padaṃ juṣanta yad divi
children.translated_text: These forward rushes of his, when they take pleasure in the place in heaven,

children.text: nābhā yajñasya saṃ dadhur yathā vide ||
children.translated_text: set together the navel of the sacrifice, as is known.

children.text: ayaṃ dīrghāya cakṣase prāci prayaty adhvare
children.translated_text: This one, for long sight, going eastward in the rite,

children.text: mimīte yajñam ānuṣag vicakṣya ||
children.translated_text: measures out the sacrifice in order, looking carefully.

children.text: vṛṣāyam indra te ratha uto te vṛṣaṇā harī
children.translated_text: Bull-like for you, O <s>Indra</s>, is your chariot, and bull-like are your two bay steeds;

children.text: vṛṣā tvaṃ śatakrato vṛṣā havaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you are a bull, O hundred-powered one, and bull-like is the call.

children.text: vṛṣā grāvā vṛṣā mado vṛṣā somo ayaṃ sutaḥ
children.translated_text: Bull-like is the pressing-stone, bull-like the exhilaration, bull-like this pressed soma;

children.text: vṛṣā yajño yam invasi vṛṣā havaḥ ||
children.translated_text: bull-like is the sacrifice that you impel, and bull-like is the call.

children.text: vṛṣā tvā vṛṣaṇaṃ huve vajriñcitrābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: I call you, the bull-like bull, O thunderbolt-bearer, with manifold aids;

children.text: vāvantha hi pratiṣṭutiṃ vṛṣā havaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for you have desired the answering praise; bull-like is the call.

children.text: Chapter 634
yad indrāhaṃ yathā tvam īśīya vasva eka it
children.translated_text: If, O <s>Indra</s>, I alone were lord of wealth as you are,

children.text: stotā me goṣakhā syāt ||
children.translated_text: my singer would be a companion rich in cattle.

children.text: śikṣeyam asmai ditseyaṃ śacīpate manīṣiṇe
children.translated_text: I would instruct him and give to him, O lord of power, the thoughtful man,

children.text: yad ahaṃ gopatiḥ syām ||
children.translated_text: if I were lord of cattle.

children.text: dhenuṣ ṭa indra sūnṛtā yajamānāya sunvate
children.translated_text: Your gracious word, O <s>Indra</s>, is a milch cow for the sacrificing soma-presser;

children.text: gām aśvam pipyuṣī duhe ||
children.translated_text: swelling, it milks out cow and horse.

children.text: na te vartāsti rādhasa indra devo na martyaḥ
children.translated_text: There is no withholder of your bounty, O <s>Indra</s>, neither god nor mortal,

children.text: yad ditsasi stuto magham ||
children.translated_text: when, being praised, you wish to give largesse.

children.text: yajña indram avardhayad yad bhūmiṃ vy avartayat
children.translated_text: The sacrifice strengthened <s>Indra</s> when he turned the earth apart,

children.text: cakrāṇa opaśaṃ divi ||
children.translated_text: making a girdle in heaven.

children.text: vāvṛdhānasya te vayaṃ viśvā dhanāni jigyuṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Of you who are growing, who have won all treasures,

children.text: ūtim indrā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: we choose your aid, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: vy antarikṣam atiran made somasya rocanā
children.translated_text: In the exhilaration of soma he surpassed the midspace and the lights,

children.text: indro yad abhinad valam ||
children.translated_text: when <s>Indra</s> split open <s>Vala</s>.

children.text: ud gā ājad aṅgirobhya āviṣkṛṇvan guhā satīḥ
children.translated_text: He drove up the cows for the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, revealing them though they were hidden;

children.text: arvāñcaṃ nunude valam ||
children.translated_text: he pushed <s>Vala</s> this way, toward us.

children.text: indreṇa rocanā divo dṛﾱhāni dṛṃhitāni ca
children.translated_text: By <s>Indra</s> the lights of heaven, the firm and strengthened ones,

children.text: sthirāṇi na parāṇude ||
children.translated_text: stand fast; he did not drive them away.

children.text: apām ūrmir madann iva stoma indrājirāyate
children.translated_text: Like a wave of the waters, as if exhilarated, the hymn speeds toward <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: vi te madā arājiṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: your exhilarations have shone out widely.

children.text: tvaṃ hi stomavardhana indrāsy ukthavardhanaḥ
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Indra</s>, are the increaser through hymns, the increaser through recitations;

children.text: stotṝṇām uta bhadrakṛt ||
children.translated_text: and you are the maker of good for the singers.

children.text: indram it keśinā harī somapeyāya vakṣataḥ
children.translated_text: The two long-maned bay horses shall carry <s>Indra</s> for the drinking of soma,

children.text: upa yajñaṃ surādhasam ||
children.translated_text: to the sacrifice rich in good gifts.

children.text: apām phenena namuceḥ śira indrod avartayaḥ
children.translated_text: With the foam of the waters, O <s>Indra</s>, you rolled away the head of <s>Namuci</s>,

children.text: viśvā yad ajaya spṛdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when you conquered all contests.

children.text: māyābhir utsisṛpsata indra dyām ārurukṣataḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, you shook down the <s>Dasyus</s> who, by their wiles, were trying to creep upward

children.text: ava dasyūṃr adhūnuthāḥ ||
children.translated_text: and to climb up to heaven.

children.text: asunvām indra saṃsadaṃ viṣūcīṃ vy anāśayaḥ
children.translated_text: O soma-drinker <s>Indra</s>, becoming superior, you destroyed

children.text: somapā uttaro bhavan ||
children.translated_text: the assembly of non-pressers, scattered in every direction.

children.text: Chapter 635
tam v abhi pra gāyata puruhūtam puruṣṭutam
children.translated_text: Sing forth loudly to him, the much-invoked, the much-praised one.

children.text: indraṃ gīrbhis taviṣam ā vivāsata ||
children.translated_text: Invite mighty <s>Indra</s> here with songs.

children.text: yasya dvibarhaso bṛhat saho dādhāra rodasī
children.translated_text: His twofold, lofty, great strength upheld heaven and earth,

children.text: girīṃr ajrāṁ apaḥ svar vṛṣatvanā ||
children.translated_text: the mountains, the undecaying waters, and the sun, by his bull-power.

children.text: sa rājasi puruṣṭutaṃ eko vṛtrāṇi jighnase
children.translated_text: You rule alone, O much-praised one; you strike down the <s>Vṛtras</s>,

children.text: indra jaitrā śravasyā ca yantave ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, so that victories and renown may come.

children.text: taṃ te madaṃ gṛṇīmasi vṛṣaṇam pṛtsu sāsahim
children.translated_text: We sing of that exhilaration of yours, bull-like and overpowering in battles,

children.text: u lokakṛtnum adrivo hariśriyam ||
children.translated_text: O wielder of the stone, maker of wide space, splendid with bay steeds.

children.text: yena jyotīṃṣy āyave manave ca viveditha
children.translated_text: By it, rejoicing, you discovered the lights for <s>Āyu</s> and for <s>Manu</s>;

children.text: mandāno asya barhiṣo vi rājasi ||
children.translated_text: from this <s>barhis</s> (sacrificial grass) you shine forth.

children.text: tad adyā cit ta ukthino 'nu ṣṭuvanti pūrvathā
children.translated_text: Even today the hymn-makers praise that of yours, as in former times:

children.text: vṛṣapatnīr apo jayā dive dive ||
children.translated_text: win the waters, the wives of the bull, day after day.

children.text: tava tyad indriyam bṛhat tava śuṣmam uta kratum
children.translated_text: That great <s>Indra</s>-power is yours, and yours are force and resolve;

children.text: vajraṃ śiśāti dhiṣaṇā vareṇyam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Dhiṣaṇā</s> sharpens the excellent thunderbolt.

children.text: tava dyaur indra pauṃsyam pṛthivī vardhati śravaḥ
children.translated_text: Heaven, O <s>Indra</s>, magnifies your manly power; earth magnifies your fame.

children.text: tvām āpaḥ parvatāsaś ca hinvire ||
children.translated_text: The waters and the mountains have urged you on.

children.text: tvāṃ viṣṇur bṛhan kṣayo mitro gṛṇāti varuṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Great <s>Viṣṇu</s> praises you, and <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> praise you;

children.text: tvāṃ śardho madaty anu mārutam ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Marut</s> host rejoices after you.

children.text: tvaṃ vṛṣā janānām maṃhiṣṭha indra jajñiṣe
children.translated_text: You were born the bull of peoples, the greatest, O <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: satrā viśvā svapatyāni dadhiṣe ||
children.translated_text: altogether you hold all good offspring.

children.text: satrā tvam puruṣṭutaṃ eko vṛtrāṇi tośase
children.translated_text: Altogether you alone, O much-praised one, delight in the <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayings;

children.text: nānya indrāt karaṇam bhūya invati ||
children.translated_text: no other power becomes greater than <s>Indra</s> in action.

children.text: yad indra manmaśas tvā nānā havanta ūtaye
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indra</s>, our inspired singers call you in many ways for aid,

children.text: asmākebhir nṛbhir atrā svar jaya ||
children.translated_text: win the bright world here with our men.

children.text: araṃ kṣayāya no mahe viśvā rūpāṇy āviśan
children.translated_text: Be ready for our great dwelling, entering all forms;

children.text: indraṃ jaitrāya harṣayā śacīpatim ||
children.translated_text: gladden <s>Indra</s>, lord of power, for victory.

children.text: Chapter 636
pra samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnām indraṃ stotā navyaṃ gīrbhiḥ
children.translated_text: Let the singer proclaim <s>Indra</s>, sovereign of peoples, with new songs,

children.text: naraṃ nṛṣāham maṃhiṣṭham ||
children.translated_text: the man, conqueror of men, the greatest.

children.text: yasminn ukthāni raṇyanti viśvāni ca śravasyā
children.translated_text: In him all hymns and all quests for glory take delight,

children.text: apām avo na samudre ||
children.translated_text: like the protection of waters in the ocean.

children.text: taṃ suṣṭutyā vivāse jyeṣṭharājam bhare kṛtnum
children.translated_text: I approach him with good praise, the eldest king, the skillful bearer,

children.text: maho vājinaṃ sanibhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the great prize-winning one, for gains.

children.text: yasyānūnā gabhīrā madā uravas tarutrāḥ
children.translated_text: His exhilarations are undiminished, deep, broad, and crossing beyond;

children.text: harṣumantaḥ śūrasātau ||
children.translated_text: they are full of gladness in the winning of heroes.

children.text: tam id dhaneṣu hiteṣv adhivākāya havante
children.translated_text: To him they call for advocacy when wealth is set as the stake;

children.text: yeṣām indras te jayanti ||
children.translated_text: those whose <s>Indra</s> he is, they win.

children.text: tam ic cyautnair āryanti taṃ kṛtebhiś carṣaṇayaḥ
children.translated_text: People approach him with mighty deeds, and him with completed works;

children.text: eṣa indro varivaskṛt ||
children.translated_text: this <s>Indra</s> is the maker of wide room.

children.text: indro brahmendra ṛṣir indraḥ purū puruhūtaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is the sacred formulation; <s>Indra</s> is the seer; <s>Indra</s>, much-invoked, is manifold;

children.text: mahān mahībhiḥ śacībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: he is great through his great powers.

children.text: sa stomyaḥ sa havyaḥ satyaḥ satvā tuvikūrmiḥ
children.translated_text: He is worthy of praise; he is worthy of invocation, true, strong, and of mighty action;

children.text: ekaś cit sann abhibhūtiḥ ||
children.translated_text: though one alone, he is overpowering.

children.text: tam arkebhis taṃ sāmabhis taṃ gāyatraiś carṣaṇayaḥ
children.translated_text: With songs, with chants, and with <s>Gāyatra</s> verses, the peoples,

children.text: indraṃ vardhanti kṣitayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the dwellers on earth, strengthen <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: praṇetāraṃ vasyo acchā kartāraṃ jyotiḥ samatsu
children.translated_text: They turn toward the leader for better wealth, the maker of light in battles,

children.text: sāsahvāṃsaṃ yudhāmitrān ||
children.translated_text: the one who overcomes hostile men in fight.

children.text: sa naḥ papriḥ pārayāti svasti nāvā puruhūtaḥ
children.translated_text: May he, the much-invoked <s>Indra</s>, carrying us across in safety as in a boat,

children.text: indro viśvā ati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: bring us beyond all hatreds.

children.text: sa tvaṃ na indra vājebhir daśasyā ca gātuyā ca
children.translated_text: So you, O <s>Indra</s>, favor us with prizes, with bounty and with a path;

children.text: acchā ca naḥ sumnaṃ neṣi ||
children.translated_text: and lead our good favor toward us.

children.text: Chapter 637
ā yāhi suṣumā hi ta indra somam pibā imam
children.translated_text: Come here, for your exhilaration is strong; O <s>Indra</s>, drink this <s>soma</s>.

children.text: edam barhiḥ sado mama ||
children.translated_text: Here is the <s>barhis</s>; sit in my seat.

children.text: ā tvā brahmayujā harī vahatām indra keśinā
children.translated_text: Let the two bay steeds yoked by prayer, O <s>Indra</s>, the long-maned ones, carry you here;

children.text: upa brahmāṇi naḥ śṛṇu ||
children.translated_text: listen to our sacred formulations.

children.text: brahmāṇas tvā vayaṃ yujā somapām indra sominaḥ
children.translated_text: We, the soma-bearing priests, with a yoke of prayer, call you, O <s>Indra</s>, drinker of <s>soma</s>,

children.text: sutāvanto havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: we who have pressed the <s>soma</s>.

children.text: ā no yāhi sutāvato 'smākaṃ suṣṭutīr upa
children.translated_text: Come to us, who have pressed the <s>soma</s>, toward our well-made praises;

children.text: pibā su śiprinn andhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: drink well of the draught, O fair-lipped one.

children.text: ā te siñcāmi kukṣyor anu gātrā vi dhāvatu
children.translated_text: I pour it into your two bellies; let it run along through your limbs.

children.text: gṛbhāya jihvayā madhu ||
children.translated_text: Grasp the honey with your tongue.

children.text: svāduṣ ṭe astu saṃsude madhumān tanve tava
children.translated_text: May it be sweet for you in the pressing, honeyed for your body;

children.text: somaḥ śam astu te hṛde ||
children.translated_text: may the <s>soma</s> be comfort for your heart.

children.text: ayam u tvā vicarṣaṇe janīr ivābhi saṃvṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: May this <s>soma</s>, O far-seeing <s>Indra</s>, fully enclosed like women,

children.text: pra soma indra sarpatu ||
children.translated_text: creep forward toward you.

children.text: tuvigrīvo vapodaraḥ subāhur andhaso made
children.translated_text: Thick-necked, broad-bellied, strong-armed in the exhilaration of the draught,

children.text: indro vṛtrāṇi jighnate ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> strikes down the <s>Vṛtras</s>.

children.text: indra prehi puras tvaṃ viśvasyeśāna ojasā
children.translated_text: Go forward, O <s>Indra</s>, in front, ruling all by your might;

children.text: vṛtrāṇi vṛtrahañ jahi ||
children.translated_text: O slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, strike down the <s>Vṛtras</s>.

children.text: dīrghas te astv aṅkuśo yenā vasu prayacchasi
children.translated_text: Long be your goad, with which you bestow wealth

children.text: yajamānāya sunvate ||
children.translated_text: on the sacrificing patron who presses <s>soma</s>.

children.text: ayaṃ ta indra somo nipūto adhi barhiṣi
children.translated_text: This <s>soma</s> of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, has been purified upon the <s>barhis</s>;

children.text: ehīm asya dravā piba ||
children.translated_text: come here, run to this, and drink.

children.text: śācigo śācipūjanāyaṃ raṇāya te sutaḥ
children.translated_text: This pressed draught is for you, O possessor of power, for the worship of power and for battle;

children.text: ākhaṇḍala pra hūyase ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Ākhaṇḍala</s>, you are called forth.

children.text: yas te śṛṅgavṛṣo napāt praṇapāt kuṇḍapāyyaḥ
children.translated_text: He who is horned like a bull, descendant and fore-descendant, drinker from the vessel,

children.text: ny asmin dadhra ā manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: has set his mind down upon this.

children.text: vāstoṣpate dhruvā sthūṇāṃsatraṃ somyānām
children.translated_text: O <s>Vāstoṣpati</s>, fixed among pillars, among the soma-loving hosts,

children.text: drapso bhettā purāṃ śaśvatīnām indro munīnāṃ sakhā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, the drop, breaker of everlasting strongholds, is the friend of sages.

children.text: pṛdākusānur yajato gaveṣaṇa ekaḥ sann abhi bhūyasaḥ
children.translated_text: He whose ridge is the speckled serpent, worshipful, seeking cattle, though one, overcomes the many;

children.text: bhūrṇim aśvaṃ nayat tujā puro gṛbhendraṃ somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: lead the swift horse by force; grasp <s>Indra</s> for the drinking of <s>soma</s>.

children.text: Chapter 638
idaṃ ha nūnam eṣāṃ sumnam bhikṣeta martyaḥ
children.translated_text: Now indeed a mortal should seek this kindly favor of theirs,

children.text: ādityānām apūrvyaṃ savīmani ||
children.translated_text: the matchless favor of the <s>Ādityas</s> in the impulsion of <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: anarvāṇo hy eṣām panthā ādityānām
children.translated_text: For the path of these <s>Ādityas</s> is unobstructed;

children.text: adabdhāḥ santi pāyavaḥ sugevṛdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: their guardians are undeceived, easy for the prospering one to approach.

children.text: tat su naḥ savitā bhago varuṇo mitro aryamā
children.translated_text: May <s>Savitṛ</s>, <s>Bhaga</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>,

children.text: śarma yacchantu sapratho yad īmahe ||
children.translated_text: grant us broad shelter, the shelter that we seek.

children.text: devebhir devy adite 'riṣṭabharmann ā gahi
children.translated_text: O divine <s>Aditi</s>, bearer of uninjuredness, come here with the gods,

children.text: smat sūribhiḥ purupriye suśarmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: together with bounteous patrons and with good shelters, O much-beloved one.

children.text: te hi putrāso aditer vidur dveṣāṃsi yotave
children.translated_text: For those sons of <s>Aditi</s> know how to ward off hostilities;

children.text: aṃhoś cid urucakrayo 'nehasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: wide-moving and sinless, they ward off even distress.

children.text: aditir no divā paśum aditir naktam advayāḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Aditi</s>, undivided, protect our cattle by day; may <s>Aditi</s> protect them by night;

children.text: aditiḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ sadāvṛdhā ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Aditi</s>, ever-increasing, protect us from distress.

children.text: uta syā no divā matir aditir ūtyā gamat
children.translated_text: And may that thought of ours, with <s>Aditi</s>'s aid, come by day;

children.text: sā śantāti mayas karad apa sridhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may she bring peace and refreshment, and drive away deceit.

children.text: uta tyā daivyā bhiṣajā śaṃ naḥ karato aśvinā
children.translated_text: And may those two divine healers, the <s>Aśvins</s>, make well-being for us;

children.text: yuyuyātām ito rapo apa sridhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may they keep harm away from here, and drive away deceit.

children.text: śam agnir agnibhiḥ karac chaṃ nas tapatu sūryaḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s> bring well-being with the fires; may <s>Sūrya</s> warm us for well-being.

children.text: śaṃ vāto vātv arapā apa sridhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the wind blow auspiciously, free from harm; drive away the assaults.

children.text: apāmīvām apa sridham apa sedhata durmatim
children.translated_text: Drive away disease, drive away stumbling, drive away evil intention.

children.text: ādityāso yuyotanā no aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Ādityas</s>, keep us away from distress.

children.text: yuyotā śarum asmad āṃ ādityāsa utāmatim
children.translated_text: Ward the arrow away from us, O <s>Ādityas</s>, and also hostile thought.

children.text: ṛdhag dveṣaḥ kṛṇuta viśvavedasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Set hatred apart from us, O all-knowing ones.

children.text: tat su naḥ śarma yacchatādityā yan mumocati
children.translated_text: Grant us that shelter, O <s>Ādityas</s>, which releases

children.text: enasvantaṃ cid enasaḥ sudānavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: even a guilty man from guilt, O generous ones.

children.text: yo naḥ kaścid ririkṣati rakṣastvena martyaḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever, any mortal, wishes to injure us with demonic malice,

children.text: svaiḥ ṣa evai ririṣīṣṭa yur janaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let that man be harmed by his own devices and his own acts.

children.text: sam it tam agham aśnavad duḥśaṃsam martyaṃ ripum
children.translated_text: May that evil overtake the evil-speaking mortal enemy,

children.text: yo asmatrā durhaṇāvāṁ upa dvayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the deceitful one who comes against us with hard-to-strike hostility.

children.text: pākatrā sthana devā hṛtsu jānītha martyam
children.translated_text: Stand on the side of discernment, O gods; in your hearts you know the mortal,

children.text: upa dvayuṃ cādvayuṃ ca vasavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: both the deceitful and the undeceitful, O <s>Vasus</s>.

children.text: ā śarma parvatānām otāpāṃ vṛṇīmahe
children.translated_text: We choose for ourselves the shelter of the mountains and also of the waters.

children.text: dyāvākṣāmāre asmad rapas kṛtam ||
children.translated_text: O heaven and earth, keep injury away from us.

children.text: te no bhadreṇa śarmaṇā yuṣmākaṃ nāvā vasavaḥ
children.translated_text: With your auspicious shelter, with your boat, O <s>Vasus</s>,

children.text: ati viśvāni duritā pipartana ||
children.translated_text: carry us across all difficulties.

children.text: tuce tanāya tat su no drāghīya āyur jīvase
children.translated_text: For child and offspring, make that life of ours longer

children.text: ādityāsaḥ sumahasaḥ kṛṇotana ||
children.translated_text: for living, O <s>Ādityas</s> of great majesty.

children.text: yajño hīﾱo vo antara ādityā asti mṛﾱata
children.translated_text: If there is offense within our sacrifice to you, O <s>Ādityas</s>, be gracious.

children.text: yuṣme id vo api ṣmasi sajātye ||
children.translated_text: For we indeed are with you, within your kinship.

children.text: bṛhad varūtham marutāṃ devaṃ trātāram aśvinā
children.translated_text: For well-being we seek the broad protection of the <s>Maruts</s>, the divine savior, and the <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: mitram īmahe varuṇaṃ svastaye ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: aneho mitrāryaman nṛvad varuṇa śaṃsyam
children.translated_text: Unharming, O <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s>, worthy of praise among men,

children.text: trivarūtham maruto yanta naś chardiḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Maruts</s>, extend to us a threefold protective shield.

children.text: ye ciddhi mṛtyubandhava ādityā manavaḥ smasi
children.translated_text: Though we men are bound to death, O <s>Ādityas</s>,

children.text: pra sū na āyur jīvase tiretana ||
children.translated_text: now prolong our life for living.

children.text: Chapter 639
taṃ gūrdhayā svarṇaraṃ devāso devam aratiṃ dadhanvire
children.translated_text: With praise the gods set that god, the golden-rayed messenger, in place,

children.text: devatrā havyam ohire ||
children.translated_text: and carried the oblation to the gods.

children.text: vibhūtarātiṃ vipra citraśociṣam agnim īﾱiṣva yanturam
children.translated_text: Praise <s>Agni</s>, rich in gifts, inspired, bright-flaming, and guiding,

children.text: asya medhasya somyasya sobhare prem adhvarāya pūrvyam ||
children.translated_text: the ancient one, O <s>Sobhari</s>, foremost for this honeyed <s>soma</s> rite and for the sacrifice.

children.text: yajiṣṭhaṃ tvā vavṛmahe devaṃ devatrā hotāram amartyam
children.translated_text: We have chosen you as the most fit for sacrifice, a god among the gods, the immortal <s>hotṛ</s> (officiating priest),

children.text: asya yajñasya sukratum ||
children.translated_text: of good resolve for this sacrifice.

children.text: ūrjo napātaṃ subhagaṃ sudīditim agniṃ śreṣṭhaśociṣam
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, son of strength, fortunate, brightly shining, best in flame,

children.text: sa no mitrasya varuṇasya so apām ā sumnaṃ yakṣate divi ||
children.translated_text: may he win for us in heaven the favor of <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and the waters.

children.text: yaḥ samidhā ya āhutī yo vedena dadāśa marto agnaye
children.translated_text: The mortal who has made offering to <s>Agni</s> with fuel, with oblations, and with sacred knowledge,

children.text: yo namasā svadhvaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: who, rightly sacrificing, has done so with reverence,

children.text: tasyed arvanto raṃhayanta āśavas tasya dyumnitamaṃ yaśaḥ
children.translated_text: his swift horses speed onward, and his fame is most brilliant.

children.text: na tam aṃho devakṛtaṃ kutaścana na martyakṛtaṃ naśat ||
children.translated_text: No distress made by gods, nor any made by mortals, reaches him from anywhere.

children.text: svagnayo vo agnibhiḥ syāma sūno sahasa ūrjām pate
children.translated_text: With good fires may we be yours through fires, O son of strength, lord of vigor.

children.text: suvīras tvam asmayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are rich in heroes and mindful of us.

children.text: praśaṃsamāno atithir na mitriyo 'gnī ratho na vedyaḥ
children.translated_text: Being praised, <s>Agni</s>, like a friendly guest and like a chariot worthy to be known,

children.text: tve kṣemāso api santi sādhavas tvaṃ rājā rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: in you are secure and successful dwellings; you are king of riches.

children.text: so addhā dāśvadhvaro 'gne martaḥ subhaga sa praśaṃsyaḥ
children.translated_text: That mortal whose rite truly serves you, O <s>Agni</s>, O fortunate one, is praiseworthy.

children.text: sa dhībhir astu sanitā ||
children.translated_text: May he be a winner through inspired thoughts.

children.text: yasya tvam ūrdhvo adhvarāya tiṣṭhasi kṣayadvīraḥ sa sādhate
children.translated_text: The one for whose sacrifice you stand upright, making heroes dwell, succeeds.

children.text: so arvadbhiḥ sanitā sa vipanyubhiḥ sa śūraiḥ sanitā kṛtam ||
children.translated_text: He is a winner with horses, a winner with inspired singers, and a winner of the prize with heroes.

children.text: yasyāgnir vapur gṛhe stomaṃ cano dadhīta viśvavāryaḥ
children.translated_text: In whose house <s>Agni</s>, desirable to all, places beauty, hymn, and delight,

children.text: havyā vā veviṣad viṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: or eagerly enjoys the oblations of the clans,

children.text: viprasya vā stuvataḥ sahaso yaho makṣūtamasya rātiṣu
children.translated_text: for the inspired poet or for the praising one, O mighty son of strength, in the swiftest gifts,

children.text: avodevam uparimartyaṃ kṛdhi vaso vividuṣo vacaḥ ||
children.translated_text: make the knowing man's speech god-protected and superior to mortals, O <s>Vasu</s>.

children.text: yo agniṃ havyadātibhir namobhir vā sudakṣam āvivāsati
children.translated_text: The one who attends upon skillful <s>Agni</s> with oblation-gifts or with reverences,

children.text: girā vājiraśociṣam ||
children.translated_text: with song, upon him of racer-like flame,

children.text: samidhā yo niśitī dāśad aditiṃ dhāmabhir asya martyaḥ
children.translated_text: the mortal who offers with fuel and rite to <s>Aditi</s> at his sacred stations,

children.text: viśvet sa dhībhiḥ subhago janāṁ ati dyumnair udna iva tāriṣat ||
children.translated_text: that blessed man shall cross beyond all people by inspired thoughts and splendors, as across water.

children.text: tad agne dyumnam ā bhara yat sāsahat sadane kaṃcid atriṇam
children.translated_text: Bring that splendor here, O <s>Agni</s>, by which you overcome in the dwelling any devourer

children.text: manyuṃ janasya dūḍhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and the hard-to-bend wrath of the people.

children.text: yena caṣṭe varuṇo mitro aryamā yena nāsatyā bhagaḥ
children.translated_text: By which <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, the <s>Nāsatyas</s>, and <s>Bhaga</s> take notice,

children.text: vayaṃ tat te śavasā gātuvittamā indra tvotā vidhemahi ||
children.translated_text: with that strength of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, best finder of paths, aided by you, may we worship.

children.text: te ghed agne svādhyo ye tvā vipra nidadhire nṛcakṣasam
children.translated_text: Those indeed, O <s>Agni</s>, are well-minded who, O inspired one, have set you in place as seer of men,

children.text: viprāso deva sukratum ||
children.translated_text: inspired men who know good resolve, O god.

children.text: ta id vediṃ subhaga ta āhutiṃ te sotuṃ cakrire divi
children.translated_text: They have prepared the altar, O fortunate one; they have prepared the offering; they have made the pressing in heaven.

children.text: ta id vājebhir jigyur mahad dhanaṃ ye tve kāmaṃ nyerire ||
children.translated_text: They have won great wealth with prizes, those who fixed their desire on you.

children.text: bhadro no agnir āhuto bhadrā rātiḥ subhaga bhadro adhvaraḥ
children.translated_text: Auspicious is our kindled <s>Agni</s>; auspicious the gift, O fortunate one; auspicious the rite;

children.text: bhadrā uta praśastayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: auspicious also are the praises.

children.text: bhadram manaḥ kṛṇuṣva vṛtratūrye yenā samatsu sāsahaḥ
children.translated_text: Make our mind auspicious in the conquest of <s>Vṛtra</s>, by which you will overcome in battles.

children.text: ava sthirā tanuhi bhūri śardhatāṃ vanemā te abhiṣṭibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Loosen the firm strength of many who rage; may we win through your aids.

children.text: īﾱe girā manurhitaṃ yaṃ devā dūtam aratiṃ nyerire
children.translated_text: With song I praise the one placed by <s>Manu</s>, whom the gods appointed as messenger and envoy,

children.text: yajiṣṭhaṃ havyavāhanam ||
children.translated_text: the best sacrificer, the carrier of oblations.

children.text: tigmajambhāya taruṇāya rājate prayo gāyasy agnaye
children.translated_text: For sharp-jawed, young, shining <s>Agni</s> you sing a welcome song,

children.text: yaḥ piṃśate sūnṛtābhiḥ suvīryam agnir ghṛtebhir āhutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for <s>Agni</s>, kindled with ghee, who adorns heroic power with true speeches.

children.text: yadī ghṛtebhir āhuto vāśīm agnir bharata uc cāva ca
children.translated_text: When <s>Agni</s>, kindled with ghee, bears his axe upward and downward,

children.text: asura iva nirṇijam ||
children.translated_text: like an <s>Asura</s>, he bears his adornment.

children.text: yo havyāny airayatā manurhito deva āsā sugandhinā
children.translated_text: The god placed by <s>Manu</s>, who sends forth the oblations with fragrant mouth,

children.text: vivāsate vāryāṇi svadhvaro hotā devo amartyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the rightly sacrificing divine immortal <s>hotṛ</s> seeks desirable goods.

children.text: yad agne martyas tvaṃ syām aham mitramaho amartyaḥ
children.translated_text: If, O <s>Agni</s>, I, a mortal, were you, the immortal one of friendly greatness,

children.text: sahasaḥ sūnav āhuta ||
children.translated_text: O kindled son of strength,

children.text: na tvā rāsīyābhiśastaye vaso na pāpatvāya santya
children.translated_text: I would not give you over to reviling, O <s>Vasu</s>, nor to sinfulness, O true one.

children.text: na me stotāmatīvā na durhitaḥ syād agne na pāpayā ||
children.translated_text: My praiser would not be in extreme danger nor in misfortune, O <s>Agni</s>, nor through evil.

children.text: pitur na putraḥ subhṛto duroṇa ā devāṃ etu pra ṇo haviḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like a well-supported son in his father's house, let our oblation go forth to the gods.

children.text: tavāham agna ūtibhir nediṣṭhābhiḥ saceya joṣam ā vaso
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, may I, with your nearest aids, gladly keep company with you, O good one,

children.text: sadā devasya martyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: a mortal, always with the god.

children.text: tava kratvā saneyaṃ tava rātibhir agne tava praśastibhiḥ
children.translated_text: By your purpose may I win; by your gifts, O <s>Agni</s>, by your praises may I win.

children.text: tvām id āhuḥ pramatiṃ vaso mamāgne harṣasva dātave ||
children.translated_text: You indeed they call wise guidance, O good one; my <s>Agni</s>, be eager to give.

children.text: pra so agne tavotibhiḥ suvīrābhis tirate vājabharmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: That man, O <s>Agni</s>, crosses forward by your aids, rich in heroes and bearing the prize,

children.text: yasya tvaṃ sakhyam āvaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: the one whose friendship you have chosen.

children.text: tava drapso nīlavān vāśa ṛtviya indhānaḥ siṣṇav ā dade
children.translated_text: Your dark-hued, bellowing drop, timely and kindled, takes hold of the horns,

children.text: tvam mahīnām uṣasām asi priyaḥ kṣapo vastuṣu rājasi ||
children.translated_text: you are dear to the great dawns, and you rule over the nights in the dwellings.

children.text: tam āganma sobharayaḥ sahasramuṣkaṃ svabhiṣṭim avase
children.translated_text: We <s>Sobharis</s> have come to him for help, the thousand-powered one with excellent aid,

children.text: samrājaṃ trāsadasyavam ||
children.translated_text: the sovereign <s>Trasadasyu</s>.

children.text: yasya te agne anye agnaya upakṣito vayā iva
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, your other fires, settled near you, are like branches,

children.text: vipo na dyumnā ni yuve janānāṃ tava kṣatrāṇi vardhayan ||
children.translated_text: and, like inspired singers, they yoke the splendors of the peoples, increasing your powers of rule.

children.text: yam ādityāso adruhaḥ pāraṃ nayatha martyam
children.translated_text: O guileless <s>Ādityas</s>, the mortal whom you carry to the far shore,

children.text: maghonāṃ viśveṣāṃ sudānavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O generous ones, belongs among all the liberal patrons.

children.text: yūyaṃ rājānaḥ kaṃcic carṣaṇīsahaḥ kṣayantam mānuṣāṁ anu
children.translated_text: You kings make some man, conqueror of peoples, dwell among humankind;

children.text: vayaṃ te vo varuṇa mitrāryaman syāmed ṛtasya rathyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may we be your charioteers of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), O <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>.

children.text: adān me paurukutsyaḥ pañcāśataṃ trasadasyur vadhūnām
children.translated_text: <s>Trasadasyu</s>, son of <s>Purukutsa</s>, gave me fifty women,

children.text: maṃhiṣṭho aryaḥ satpatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: the most generous noble, the true lord.

children.text: uta me prayiyor vayiyoḥ suvāstvā adhi tugvani
children.translated_text: And for me, upon the good dwelling at <s>Tugvan</s>, among the speeding and surpassing ones,

children.text: tisṝṇāṃ saptatīnāṃ śyāvaḥ praṇetā bhuvad vasur diyānām patiḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śyāva</s> became leader of three seventies, rich, lord of the bestowed gifts.

children.text: Chapter 640
ā gantā mā riṣaṇyata prasthāvāno māpa sthātā samanyavaḥ
children.translated_text: Come here; do not let yourselves be harmed. Set out; do not stand away, being of one mind,

children.text: sthirā cin namayiṣṇavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you who can bend even firm things.

children.text: vīﾱupavibhir maruta ṛbhukṣaṇa ā rudrāsaḥ sudītibhiḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Maruts</s>, strong as <s>Ṛbhukṣans</s>, O <s>Rudras</s>, with shining beams,

children.text: iṣā no adyā gatā puruspṛho yajñam ā sobharīyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: come today with refreshment to our much-desired sacrifice, O sons of <s>Sobhari</s>.

children.text: vidmā hi rudriyāṇāṃ śuṣmam ugram marutāṃ śimīvatām
children.translated_text: For we know the fierce might of the <s>Rudrian</s> ones, of the skillful <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: viṣṇor eṣasya mīﾱhuṣām ||
children.translated_text: and of swift, bountiful <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

children.text: vi dvīpāni pāpatan tiṣṭhad ducchunobhe yujanta rodasī
children.translated_text: The lands fly apart; the two worlds, heaven and earth, are yoked in trembling as the dreadful one stands,

children.text: pra dhanvāny airata śubhrakhādayo yad ejatha svabhānavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and the bright-ornamented ones stir up the deserts when you, self-radiant, shake yourselves.

children.text: acyutā cid vo ajmann ā nānadati parvatāso vanaspatiḥ
children.translated_text: Even the unmoving mountains roar at your advance, and the forest tree cries aloud;

children.text: bhūmir yāmeṣu rejate ||
children.translated_text: the earth trembles during your journeys.

children.text: amāya vo maruto yātave dyaur jihīta uttarā bṛhat
children.translated_text: At your going, O <s>Maruts</s>, the far, lofty heaven recoils,

children.text: yatrā naro dediśate tanūṣv ā tvakṣāṃsi bāhvojasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: where the heroes array adornments upon their bodies, strong with the power of their arms.

children.text: svadhām anu śriyaṃ naro mahi tveṣā amavanto vṛṣapsavaḥ
children.translated_text: Following your own law, the heroes bear beauty: great, blazing, powerful, rich in virile sap,

children.text: vahante ahrutapsavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: bearing unfailing strength.

children.text: gobhir vāṇo ajyate sobharīṇāṃ rathe kośe hiraṇyaye
children.translated_text: The song of the <s>Sobharis</s> is anointed with cattle in the golden chest of the chariot;

children.text: gobandhavaḥ sujātāsa iṣe bhuje mahānto na sparase nu ||
children.translated_text: kinsmen of cattle, well-born for refreshment and enjoyment, they are great and not to be touched now.

children.text: prati vo vṛṣadañjayo vṛṣṇe śardhāya mārutāya bharadhvam
children.translated_text: Bring your oblations to the rain-adorned, bull-like <s>Marut</s> host,

children.text: havyā vṛṣaprayāvṇe ||
children.translated_text: to the one that drives on the rain.

children.text: vṛṣaṇaśvena maruto vṛṣapsunā rathena vṛṣanābhinā
children.translated_text: O <s>Maruts</s>, with a chariot drawn by stallions, rich in virile sap, and having a strong nave,

children.text: ā śyenāso na pakṣiṇo vṛthā naro havyā no vītaye gata ||
children.translated_text: come for the enjoyment of our oblations like winged hawks, O heroes, freely.

children.text: samānam añjy eṣāṃ vi bhrājante rukmāso adhi bāhuṣu
children.translated_text: Their common adornment shines apart; golden plates gleam upon their arms,

children.text: davidyutaty ṛṣṭayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and their spears flash like lightning.

children.text: ta ugrāso vṛṣaṇa ugrabāhavo nakiṣ ṭanūṣu yetire
children.translated_text: Those fierce, bull-like ones with fierce arms: no one has reached beyond them in their bodies;

children.text: sthirā dhanvāny āyudhā ratheṣu vo 'nīkeṣv adhi śriyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: firm are your bows and weapons on the chariots, and splendors rest upon your faces.

children.text: yeṣām arṇo na sapratho nāma tveṣaṃ śaśvatām ekam id bhuje
children.translated_text: Their brilliant name, broad-spread like a flood, is the one possession of the everlasting ones,

children.text: vayo na pitryaṃ sahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like strength inherited from the fathers.

children.text: tān vandasva marutas tāṁ upa stuhi teṣāṃ hi dhunīnām
children.translated_text: Praise those <s>Maruts</s>; celebrate those storming ones,

children.text: arāṇāṃ na caramas tad eṣāṃ dānā mahnā tad eṣām ||
children.translated_text: for theirs is that greatness, like unbroken spokes; theirs are those gifts in majesty.

children.text: subhagaḥ sa va ūtiṣv āsa pūrvāsu maruto vyuṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: Blessed is the man who is within your aids at the former dawns, O <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: yo vā nūnam utāsati ||
children.translated_text: and who is also yours now.

children.text: yasya vā yūyam prati vājino nara ā havyā vītaye gatha
children.translated_text: Or, O vigorous heroes, the man to whose oblations you come for enjoyment,

children.text: abhi ṣa dyumnair uta vājasātibhiḥ sumnā vo dhūtayo naśat ||
children.translated_text: may your favor reach him with splendors and with prize-winning powers, O shakers.

children.text: yathā rudrasya sūnavo divo vaśanty asurasya vedhasaḥ
children.translated_text: As the sons of <s>Rudra</s>, of heaven, of the wise <s>Asura</s>, have their will,

children.text: yuvānas tathed asat ||
children.translated_text: so let it indeed be for the young ones.

children.text: ye cārhanti marutaḥ sudānavaḥ sman mīﾱhuṣaś caranti ye
children.translated_text: Those <s>Maruts</s> who are worthy, generous, and rain-giving, who move together with us,

children.text: ataś cid ā na upa vasyasā hṛdā yuvāna ā vavṛdhvam ||
children.translated_text: from there, as youths, come to us with a more gracious heart and grow strong.

children.text: yūna ū ṣu naviṣṭhayā vṛṣṇaḥ pāvakāṁ abhi sobhare girā
children.translated_text: With the newest song, O <s>Sobhari</s>, sing to the young, shining band of the bull,

children.text: gāya gā iva carkṛṣat ||
children.translated_text: as one calls the cows while driving them onward.

children.text: sāhā ye santi muṣṭiheva havyo viśvāsu pṛtsu hotṛṣu
children.translated_text: Those strong ones who are to be invoked, like clenched fists, in all battles and among the priests,

children.text: vṛṣṇaś candrān na suśravastamān girā vandasva maruto aha ||
children.translated_text: praise by song today the <s>Maruts</s>, most renowned, shining like bright moons of the bull.

children.text: gāvaś cid ghā samanyavaḥ sajātyena marutaḥ sabandhavaḥ
children.translated_text: Even cows of one mind, of the same birth, O <s>Maruts</s>, bound by kinship,

children.text: rihate kakubho mithaḥ ||
children.translated_text: lick one another on the flanks.

children.text: martaś cid vo nṛtavo rukmavakṣasa upa bhrātṛtvam āyati
children.translated_text: Even a mortal, O dancing ones with golden breasts, comes near to your brotherhood;

children.text: adhi no gāta marutaḥ sadā hi va āpitvam asti nidhruvi ||
children.translated_text: come over to us, O <s>Maruts</s>, for your kinship is always firm.

children.text: maruto mārutasya na ā bheṣajasya vahatā sudānavaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Maruts</s>, bring us the healing remedy of the <s>Marut</s>, O generous ones;

children.text: yūyaṃ sakhāyaḥ saptayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you are friends, swift coursers.

children.text: yābhiḥ sindhum avatha yābhis tūrvatha yābhir daśasyathā krivim
children.translated_text: By the aids with which you help <s>Sindhu</s>, with which you carry across, with which you favor <s>Krivi</s>,

children.text: mayo no bhūtotibhir mayobhuvaḥ śivābhir asacadviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: be happiness for us through happiness-making, auspicious aids, free from hatred.

children.text: yat sindhau yad asiknyāṃ yat samudreṣu marutaḥ subarhiṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever remedy is in the <s>Sindhu</s>, whatever is in the <s>Asiknī</s>, whatever is in the seas, O <s>Maruts</s> rich in sacred grass,

children.text: yat parvateṣu bheṣajam ||
children.translated_text: whatever remedy is in the mountains,

children.text: viśvam paśyanto bibhṛthā tanūṣv ā tenā no adhi vocata
children.translated_text: seeing all, you bear it in your bodies; with that, speak on our behalf.

children.text: kṣamā rapo maruta āturasya na iṣkartā vihrutam punaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Maruts</s>, remove the affliction of the sick man from his body; make whole again what has been dislocated.

children.text: Chapter 641
vayam u tvām apūrvya sthūraṃ na kaccid bharanto 'vasyavaḥ
children.translated_text: We, seeking aid, call upon you, the unprecedented one, holding you as something firm,

children.text: vāje citraṃ havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: the wondrous one in the contest for the prize.
