children.text: upa tvā karmann ūtaye sa no yuvograś cakrāma yo dhṛṣat
children.translated_text: We come near to you in action for help; may he, young and formidable, who is bold, make us able,

children.text: tvām iddhy avitāraṃ vavṛmahe sakhāya indra sānasim ||
children.translated_text: for we have chosen you as helper, O <s>Indra</s>, a winning friend.

children.text: ā yāhīma indavo 'śvapate gopata urvarāpate
children.translated_text: Come here to us, O soma-drops, O lord of horses, lord of cattle, lord of fields;

children.text: somaṃ somapate piba ||
children.translated_text: drink the soma, O lord of soma.

children.text: vayaṃ hi tvā bandhumantam abandhavo viprāsa indra yemima
children.translated_text: For we, though without kin, have sought you as a kinsman, O inspired ones, O <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: yā te dhāmāni vṛṣabha tebhir ā gahi viśvebhiḥ somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: with those abodes of yours, O bull, come here with all of them for the drinking of soma.

children.text: sīdantas te vayo yathā gośrīte madhau madire vivakṣaṇe
children.translated_text: As birds settle on the honeyed, intoxicating, delightful drink mixed with milk,

children.text: abhi tvām indra nonumaḥ ||
children.translated_text: so we call aloud to you, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: acchā ca tvainā namasā vadāmasi kim muhuś cid vi dīdhayaḥ
children.translated_text: And we address this one, you, with reverence: why do you ponder again and again?

children.text: santi kāmāso harivo dadiṣ ṭvaṃ smo vayaṃ santi no dhiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There are desires, O bay-horsed one; give them. We are here; our thoughts are here.

children.text: nūtnā id indra te vayam ūtī abhūma nahi nū te adrivaḥ
children.translated_text: Now indeed, O <s>Indra</s>, we have come to be in your aid; for now, O stone-wielding one,

children.text: vidmā purā parīṇasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we know of no former abundance.

children.text: vidmā sakhitvam uta śūra bhojyam ā te tā vajrinn īmahe
children.translated_text: We know friendship and also enjoyment, O hero; from you, O thunderbolt-bearer, we seek those things.

children.text: uto samasminn ā śiśīhi no vaso vāje suśipra gomati ||
children.translated_text: And in this same contest sharpen us, O good one, toward the prize rich in cattle, O fair-lipped one.

children.text: yo na idam idaṃ purā pra vasya ānināya tam u va stuṣe
children.translated_text: He who formerly brought this and that good thing to us, him I praise,

children.text: sakhāya indram ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, as friend, for aid.

children.text: haryaśvaṃ satpatiṃ carṣaṇīsahaṃ sa hi ṣmā yo amandata
children.translated_text: The bay-horsed one, true lord, conqueror of peoples; for he indeed is the one who became exhilarated.

children.text: ā tu naḥ sa vayati gavyam aśvyaṃ stotṛbhyo maghavā śatam ||
children.translated_text: May that bounteous one bring to us cattle-wealth and horse-wealth, a hundred gifts for the praisers.

children.text: tvayā ha svid yujā vayam prati śvasantaṃ vṛṣabha bruvīmahi
children.translated_text: With you as an ally, O bull, we would speak against the snorting enemy,

children.text: saṃsthe janasya gomataḥ ||
children.translated_text: in the assembly of the cattle-rich people.

children.text: jayema kāre puruhūta kāriṇo 'bhi tiṣṭhema dūḍhyaḥ
children.translated_text: May we, the doers, win the contest, O much-invoked one; may we stand over the hard places.

children.text: nṛbhir vṛtraṃ hanyāma śūśuyāma cāver indra pra ṇo dhiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With men may we slay <s>Vṛtra</s>; may we grow strong; further our thoughts, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: abhrātṛvyo anā tvam anāpir indra januṣā sanād asi
children.translated_text: You have no hostile brother, no elder brother, no kinsman, O <s>Indra</s>; by birth from of old you are alone.

children.text: yudhed āpitvam icchase ||
children.translated_text: In battle you seek kinship.

children.text: nakī revantaṃ sakhyāya vindase pīyanti te surāśvaḥ
children.translated_text: You find no wealthy man for friendship; your splendid horses drink.

children.text: yadā kṛṇoṣi nadanuṃ sam ūhasy ād it piteva hūyase ||
children.translated_text: When you make a man without a river, you carry him together; then you are called on like a father.

children.text: mā te amājuro yathā mūrāsa indra sakhye tvāvataḥ
children.translated_text: Let us not, like feeble men grown old at home, O <s>Indra</s>, sit down

children.text: ni ṣadāma sacā sute ||
children.translated_text: in friendship with one such as you, beside the pressed soma.

children.text: mā te godatra nir arāma rādhasa indra mā te gṛhāmahi
children.translated_text: Let us not be kept away from your cattle-giving bounty, O <s>Indra</s>; let us not be excluded from you.

children.text: dṛﾱhā cid aryaḥ pra mṛśābhy ā bhara na te dāmāna ādabhe ||
children.translated_text: Bring forth firm things, even those of the noble one, to be touched; I do not damage your bonds.

children.text: indro vā ghed iyan maghaṃ sarasvatī vā subhagā dadir vasu
children.translated_text: Surely <s>Indra</s> has given this bounty, or fortunate <s>Sarasvatī</s> has given the good,

children.text: tvaṃ vā citra dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: or you, O <s>Citra</s>, to the worshipper.

children.text: citra id rājā rājakā id anyake yake sarasvatīm anu
children.translated_text: <s>Citra</s> alone is king; the others are petty kings, those who follow <s>Sarasvatī</s>.

children.text: parjanya iva tatanaddhi vṛṣṭyā sahasram ayutā dadat ||
children.translated_text: Like <s>Parjanya</s>, stretch out with rain, giving a thousand and ten thousand.

children.text: Chapter 642
o tyam ahva ā ratham adyā daṃsiṣṭham ūtaye
children.translated_text: I have called that chariot here today, the most wondrous, for aid,

children.text: yam aśvinā suhavā rudravartanī ā sūryāyai tasthathuḥ ||
children.translated_text: on which the well-invoked <s>Aśvins</s>, whose path is ruddy, mounted for <s>Sūryā</s>.

children.text: pūrvāyuṣaṃ suhavam puruspṛham bhujyuṃ vājeṣu pūrvyam
children.translated_text: Ancient in lifetime, easily invoked, much desired, <s>Bhujyu</s>, foremost in contests,

children.text: sacanāvantaṃ sumatibhiḥ sobhare vidveṣasam anehasam ||
children.translated_text: attended by favoring thoughts, O <s>Sobhari</s>, free from hatred, unharmed.

children.text: iha tyā purubhūtamā devā namobhir aśvinā
children.translated_text: Here, with reverences, we would bring those most manifold gods, the <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: arvācīnā sv avase karāmahe gantārā dāśuṣo gṛham ||
children.translated_text: turned hither for our help, as those who go to the house of the worshipper.

children.text: yuvo rathasya pari cakram īyata īrmānyad vām iṣaṇyati
children.translated_text: The wheel of your chariot goes round; one part of it urges you onward.

children.text: asmāṃ acchā sumatir vāṃ śubhas patī ā dhenur iva dhāvatu ||
children.translated_text: May your gracious thought run toward us, O lords of beauty, like a milk-cow.

children.text: ratho yo vāṃ trivandhuro hiraṇyābhīśur aśvinā
children.translated_text: The chariot of yours which is three-seated, with golden reins, O <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: pari dyāvāpṛthivī bhūṣati śrutas tena nāsatyā gatam ||
children.translated_text: adorns heaven and earth all around; come with it, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, famed ones.

children.text: daśasyantā manave pūrvyaṃ divi yavaṃ vṛkeṇa karṣathaḥ
children.translated_text: Showing favor to <s>Manu</s>, you plough the ancient barley in heaven with the wolf.

children.text: tā vām adya sumatibhiḥ śubhas patī aśvinā pra stuvīmahi ||
children.translated_text: Today with favorable thoughts we praise you two, O lords of beauty, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: upa no vājinīvasū yātam ṛtasya pathibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Come near to us, O possessors of prize-winning wealth, by the paths of truth,

children.text: yebhis tṛkṣiṃ vṛṣaṇā trāsadasyavam mahe kṣatrāya jinvathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: by which, O mighty bulls, you quickened <s>Tṛkṣi</s> <s>Trasadasyu</s> for great sovereignty.

children.text: ayaṃ vām adribhiḥ sutaḥ somo narā vṛṣaṇvasū
children.translated_text: This soma has been pressed for you with the stones, O men, O mighty possessors of wealth.

children.text: ā yātaṃ somapītaye pibataṃ dāśuṣo gṛhe ||
children.translated_text: Come for the drinking of soma; drink in the house of the worshipper.

children.text: ā hi ruhatam aśvinā rathe kośe hiraṇyaye vṛṣaṇvasū
children.translated_text: Mount up, O <s>Aśvins</s>, onto the chariot, into the golden vessel, O mighty possessors of wealth;

children.text: yuñjāthām pīvarīr iṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: yoke the swelling nourishments.

children.text: yābhiḥ paktham avatho yābhir adhriguṃ yābhir babhruṃ vijoṣasam
children.translated_text: With the aids by which you helped <s>Paktha</s>, by which you helped <s>Adhrigu</s>, by which you helped <s>Babhru</s> who was gladly received,

children.text: tābhir no makṣū tūyam aśvinā gatam bhiṣajyataṃ yad āturam ||
children.translated_text: with those come quickly and swiftly to us, O <s>Aśvins</s>; heal whatever is sick.

children.text: yad adhrigāvo adhrigū idā cid ahno aśvinā havāmahe
children.translated_text: When even by day, O <s>Aśvins</s>, we singers call on you, unfailing ones,

children.text: vayaṃ gīrbhir vipanyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we do so with songs, praising you.

children.text: tābhir ā yātaṃ vṛṣaṇopa me havaṃ viśvapsuṃ viśvavāryam
children.translated_text: With those aids come here, O mighty ones, to my invocation, rich in every form, worthy of every choice.

children.text: iṣā maṃhiṣṭhā purubhūtamā narā yābhiḥ kriviṃ vāvṛdhus tābhir ā gatam ||
children.translated_text: With richest refreshment, O most manifold men, with those by which they strengthened <s>Krivi</s>, come here.

children.text: tāv idā cid ahānāṃ tāv aśvinā vandamāna upa bruve
children.translated_text: Those two even now, on days, those two <s>Aśvins</s>, I, worshipping, address nearby;

children.text: tā u namobhir īmahe ||
children.translated_text: those two indeed we seek with reverences.

children.text: tāv id doṣā tā uṣasi śubhas patī tā yāman rudravartanī
children.translated_text: Those two at evening, those two at dawn, lords of beauty, those two in their course, whose path is ruddy,

children.text: mā no martāya ripave vājinīvasū paro rudrāv ati khyatam ||
children.translated_text: do not overlook us from afar for a mortal enemy, O possessors of prize-winning wealth, O ruddy ones.

children.text: ā sugmyāya sugmyam prātā rathenāśvinā vā sakṣaṇī
children.translated_text: For easy approach, I call the easily approached ones in the morning with their chariot, or the accompanying <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: huve piteva sobharī ||
children.translated_text: as a father, I, <s>Sobhari</s>, call them.

children.text: manojavasā vṛṣaṇā madacyutā makṣuṃgamābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Swift as thought, mighty, letting exhilaration flow, with aids that come quickly,

children.text: ārāttāc cid bhūtam asme avase pūrvībhiḥ purubhojasā ||
children.translated_text: be present for us for help even from far away, with many aids, O richly bounteous ones.

children.text: ā no aśvāvad aśvinā vartir yāsiṣṭam madhupātamā narā
children.translated_text: May your course come to us with horses, O <s>Aśvins</s>, O men who drink honey most richly,

children.text: gomad dasrā hiraṇyavat ||
children.translated_text: with cattle, O wondrous ones, and with gold.

children.text: suprāvargaṃ suvīryaṃ suṣṭhu vāryam anādhṛṣṭaṃ rakṣasvinā
children.translated_text: Splendidly preeminent, rich in heroes, very desirable, irresistible, guarded against harm;

children.text: asminn ā vām āyāne vājinīvasū viśvā vāmāni dhīmahi ||
children.translated_text: at this coming of yours, O possessors of prize-winning wealth, we set all lovely things before you.

children.text: Chapter 643
īﾱiṣvā hi pratīvyaṃ yajasva jātavedasam
children.translated_text: Implore the god who is to be met in response; worship <s>Jātavedas</s>,

children.text: cariṣṇudhūmam agṛbhītaśociṣam ||
children.translated_text: whose smoke moves, whose flame cannot be seized.

children.text: dāmānaṃ viśvacarṣaṇe 'gniṃ viśvamano girā
children.translated_text: With song I praise <s>Agni</s>, the binder, belonging to all peoples, of universal mind,

children.text: uta stuṣe viṣpardhaso rathānām ||
children.translated_text: and also the rival chariots of the contests.

children.text: yeṣām ābādha ṛgmiya iṣaḥ pṛkṣaś ca nigrabhe
children.translated_text: For those whose poetic assault and refreshments and nourishments are held fast,

children.text: upavidā vahnir vindate vasu ||
children.translated_text: the carrier, finding them close at hand, wins wealth.

children.text: ud asya śocir asthād dīdiyuṣo vy ajaram
children.translated_text: Up has stood the flame of this shining, undecaying one.

children.text: tapurjambhasya sudyuto gaṇaśriyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: of fiery jaws, shining brightly, splendid with his company.

children.text: ud u tiṣṭha svadhvara stavāno devyā kṛpā
children.translated_text: Rise up, O performer of the good rite, being praised, with divine favor,

children.text: abhikhyā bhāsā bṛhatā śuśukvaniḥ ||
children.translated_text: flashing forth with broad radiance, shining brightly.

children.text: agne yāhi suśastibhir havyā juhvāna ānuṣak
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, come with fair praises, offering the oblations in regular order,

children.text: yathā dūto babhūtha havyavāhanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: since you have become the messenger, the bearer of offerings.

children.text: agniṃ vaḥ pūrvyaṃ huve hotāraṃ carṣaṇīnām
children.translated_text: For you I call <s>Agni</s>, the ancient one, the <s>hotṛ</s> (invoking priest) of the peoples;

children.text: tam ayā vācā gṛṇe tam u va stuṣe ||
children.translated_text: with this speech I sing to him, and him indeed I praise.

children.text: yajñebhir adbhutakratuṃ yaṃ kṛpā sūdayanta it
children.translated_text: By sacrifices they sharpen him of wondrous resolve,

children.text: mitraṃ na jane sudhitam ṛtāvani ||
children.translated_text: well established among men like <s>Mitra</s>, guardian of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: ṛtāvānam ṛtāyavo yajñasya sādhanaṃ girā
children.translated_text: Those who seek <s>ṛta</s> have gladly approached with song him who keeps <s>ṛta</s>, the accomplisher of the sacrifice,

children.text: upo enaṃ jujuṣur namasas pade ||
children.translated_text: at the place of reverence.

children.text: acchā no aṅgirastamaṃ yajñāso yantu saṃyataḥ
children.translated_text: Let our sacrifices, well arranged, go toward the most <s>Aṅgiras</s>-like one,

children.text: hotā yo asti vikṣv ā yaśastamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>hotṛ</s> who is most renowned among the clans.

children.text: agne tava tye ajarendhānāso bṛhad bhāḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, those kindled, ageless fires of yours have a great blaze,

children.text: aśvā iva vṛṣaṇas taviṣīyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like vigorous stallions eager for might.

children.text: sa tvaṃ na ūrjām pate rayiṃ rāsva suvīryam
children.translated_text: So you, O lord of strength, grant us wealth and good heroic power;

children.text: prāva nas toke tanaye samatsv ā ||
children.translated_text: protect us in offspring and descendants, and in battles.

children.text: yad vā u viśpatiḥ śitaḥ suprīto manuṣo viśi
children.translated_text: And when the keen lord of the settlement, well pleased, is among the human clan,

children.text: viśved agniḥ prati rakṣāṃsi sedhati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> drives away all demonic powers.

children.text: śruṣṭy agne navasya me stomasya vīra viśpate
children.translated_text: Listen, O <s>Agni</s>, O hero, lord of the people, to this new hymn of mine;

children.text: ni māyinas tapuṣā rakṣaso daha ||
children.translated_text: with your heat burn down the deceptive demons.

children.text: na tasya māyayā cana ripur īśīta martyaḥ
children.translated_text: No mortal enemy can have power over him through any magic,

children.text: yo agnaye dadāśa havyadātibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: the one who has worshipped <s>Agni</s> with gifts of oblation.

children.text: vyaśvas tvā vasuvidam ukṣaṇyur aprīṇād ṛṣiḥ
children.translated_text: The seer <s>Vyaśva</s>, seeking cattle, satisfied you, the finder of goods;

children.text: maho rāye tam u tvā sam idhīmahi ||
children.translated_text: for great wealth we now kindle you.

children.text: uśanā kāvyas tvā ni hotāram asādayat
children.translated_text: <s>Uśanā Kāvya</s> set you down as <s>hotṛ</s>,

children.text: āyajiṃ tvā manave jātavedasam ||
children.translated_text: as worshipping priest, as <s>Jātavedas</s>, for <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: viśve hi tvā sajoṣaso devāso dūtam akrata
children.translated_text: For all the gods, acting together, made you their messenger;

children.text: śruṣṭī deva prathamo yajñiyo bhuvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: swift to hear, O god, you became the first worthy of sacrifice.

children.text: imaṃ ghā vīro amṛtaṃ dūtaṃ kṛṇvīta martyaḥ
children.translated_text: A mortal hero should make this immortal messenger

children.text: pāvakaṃ kṛṣṇavartaniṃ vihāyasam ||
children.translated_text: purifying, black-tracked, and traversing the air.

children.text: taṃ huvema yatasrucaḥ subhāsaṃ śukraśociṣam
children.translated_text: Let us call him with outstretched ladles, fair-shining, bright-flamed,

children.text: viśām agnim ajaram pratnam īḍyam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> of the clans, ageless, ancient, worthy of praise.

children.text: yo asmai havyadātibhir āhutim marto 'vidhat
children.translated_text: The mortal who has duly made an offering to him with gifts of oblation

children.text: bhūri poṣaṃ sa dhatte vīravad yaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: holds abundant nourishment and fame rich in heroes.

children.text: prathamaṃ jātavedasam agniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyam
children.translated_text: Toward <s>Agni</s>, <s>Jātavedas</s>, the first and ancient one in sacrifices,

children.text: prati srug eti namasā haviṣmatī ||
children.translated_text: the offering-ladle goes with reverence, bearing oblation.

children.text: ābhir vidhemāgnaye jyeṣṭhābhir vyaśvavat
children.translated_text: With these best,

children.text: maṃhiṣṭhābhir matibhiḥ śukraśociṣe ||
children.translated_text: most bounteous thoughts, as <s>Vyaśva</s> did, let us serve <s>Agni</s> of bright flame.

children.text: nūnam arca vihāyase stomebhi sthūrayūpavat
children.translated_text: Now sing with hymns to the one who traverses the air, as <s>Sthūrayūpa</s> did,

children.text: ṛṣe vaiyaśva damyāyāgnaye ||
children.translated_text: O seer descended from <s>Vyaśva</s>, to <s>Agni</s> of the house.

children.text: atithim mānuṣāṇāṃ sūnuṃ vanaspatīnām
children.translated_text: The inspired priests praise ancient <s>Agni</s> for aid,

children.text: viprā agnim avase pratnam īﾱate ||
children.translated_text: the guest of human beings, the son of the forest-lords.

children.text: maho viśvāṃ abhi ṣato 'bhi havyāni mānuṣā
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, against all great assailants and toward the human oblations,

children.text: agne ni ṣatsi namasādhi barhiṣi ||
children.translated_text: sit down with reverence upon the sacred grass.

children.text: vaṃsvā no vāryā puru vaṃsva rāyaḥ puruspṛhaḥ
children.translated_text: Win for us many desirable goods; win riches much longed for,

children.text: suvīryasya prajāvato yaśasvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: rich in heroic power, rich in offspring, and glorious.

children.text: tvaṃ varo suṣāmṇe 'gne janāya codaya
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, as the chosen one, impel the gracious man;

children.text: sadā vaso rātiṃ yaviṣṭha śaśvate ||
children.translated_text: O good one, O youngest, always impel lasting liberality.

children.text: tvaṃ hi supratūr asi tvaṃ no gomatīr iṣaḥ
children.translated_text: For you are the very strong helper; O <s>Agni</s>, open wide for us

children.text: maho rāyaḥ sātim agne apā vṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: cattle-rich refreshments and the attainment of great wealth.

children.text: agne tvaṃ yaśā asy ā mitrāvaruṇā vaha
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, you are glorious; bring <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>,

children.text: ṛtāvānā samrājā pūtadakṣasā ||
children.translated_text: the two kings who keep <s>ṛta</s> and whose skill is purified.

children.text: Chapter 644
sakhāya ā śiṣāmahi brahmendrāya vajriṇe
children.translated_text: Friends, let us offer sacred formulation to <s>Indra</s>, the thunderbolt-bearer;

children.text: stuṣa ū ṣu vo nṛtamāya dhṛṣṇave ||
children.translated_text: praise him now for you, the most manly and bold.

children.text: śavasā hy asi śruto vṛtrahatyena vṛtrahā
children.translated_text: For you are famed through might; as Vṛtra-slayer you slew <s>Vṛtra</s>;

children.text: maghair maghono ati śūra dāśasi ||
children.translated_text: with gifts, O hero, you surpass the bountiful.

children.text: sa na stavāna ā bhara rayiṃ citraśravastamam
children.translated_text: So, being praised, bring us wealth of most brilliant fame,

children.text: nireke cid yo harivo vasur dadiḥ ||
children.translated_text: which, O bay-horsed one, you give as treasure even in scarcity.

children.text: ā nirekam uta priyam indra darṣi janānām
children.translated_text: Bring near even what is scarce and what is dear among men, O <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: dhṛṣatā dhṛṣṇo stavamāna ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: being praised, O bold and daring one, bring it with boldness.

children.text: na te savyaṃ na dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ varanta āmuraḥ
children.translated_text: The foolish do not check your left hand nor your right hand,

children.text: na paribādho harivo gaviṣṭiṣu ||
children.translated_text: nor do restraints hold you back, O bay-horsed one, in contests for cattle.

children.text: ā tvā gobhir iva vrajaṃ gīrbhir ṛṇomy adrivaḥ
children.translated_text: Like a cattle-pen with cows, O stone-wielding one, I open you with songs;

children.text: ā smā kāmaṃ jaritur ā manaḥ pṛṇa ||
children.translated_text: fill the singer's desire and mind for us.

children.text: viśvāni viśvamanaso dhiyā no vṛtrahantama
children.translated_text: O most Vṛtra-slaying one, guide all our wide-minded thoughts;

children.text: ugra praṇetar adhi ṣū vaso gahi ||
children.translated_text: O mighty leader, O good one, come here over them.

children.text: vayaṃ te asya vṛtrahan vidyāma śūra navyasaḥ
children.translated_text: O Vṛtra-slayer, may we know this newer

children.text: vaso spārhasya puruhūta rādhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: desirable bounty of yours, O hero, O good one, O much-invoked.

children.text: indra yathā hy asti te 'parītaṃ nṛto śavaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, since your manly force is indeed irresistible,

children.text: amṛktā rātiḥ puruhūta dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: your gift to the worshipper, O much-invoked, is unharmed.

children.text: ā vṛṣasva mahāmaha mahe nṛtama rādhase
children.translated_text: Swell forth, O greatly great one, O most manly, for great bounty;

children.text: dṛﾱhaś cid dṛhya maghavan maghattaye ||
children.translated_text: make even the firm thing firm, O bountiful one, for munificence.

children.text: nū anyatrā cid adrivas tvan no jagmur āśasaḥ
children.translated_text: Now, O stone-wielding one, even elsewhere hopes have gone to you from us;

children.text: maghavañchagdhi tava tan na ūtibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: O bountiful one, make that possible for us by your aids.

children.text: nahy aṅga nṛto tvad anyaṃ vindāmi rādhase
children.translated_text: Indeed, O manly one, I find no other than you for bounty,

children.text: rāye dyumnāya śavase ca girvaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for wealth, splendor, and might, O lover of song.

children.text: endum indrāya siñcata pibāti somyam madhu
children.translated_text: Pour the drop for <s>Indra</s>; he drinks the soma-sweet honey,

children.text: pra rādhasā codayāte mahitvanā ||
children.translated_text: and through largesse and greatness he impels us onward.

children.text: upo harīṇām patiṃ dakṣam pṛñcantam abravam
children.translated_text: I have spoken to the lord of the bay steeds, the skillful one who fills them;

children.text: nūnaṃ śrudhi stuvato aśvyasya ||
children.translated_text: now hear the praising son of <s>Aśva</s>.

children.text: nahy aṅga purā cana jajñe vīrataras tvat
children.translated_text: Indeed, never before was one born more heroic than you,

children.text: nakī rāyā naivathā na bhandanā ||
children.translated_text: neither in riches, nor in such strength, nor in bestowal.

children.text: ed u madhvo madintaraṃ siñca vādhvaryo andhasaḥ
children.translated_text: Pour out, O <s>Adhvaryu</s>, the more exhilarating sweetness of the draught;

children.text: evā hi vīra stavate sadāvṛdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for thus, O hero, the ever-growing one is praised.

children.text: indra sthātar harīṇāṃ nakiṣ ṭe pūrvyastutim
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, holder of the bay steeds, no ancient praise of yours

children.text: ud ānaṃśa śavasā na bhandanā ||
children.translated_text: has reached so high through might, nor any bestowal.

children.text: taṃ vo vājānām patim ahūmahi śravasyavaḥ
children.translated_text: We, desiring fame, have called him, the lord of prizes,

children.text: aprāyubhir yajñebhir vāvṛdhenyam ||
children.translated_text: who is to be strengthened by unaging sacrifices.

children.text: eto nv indraṃ stavāma sakhāya stomyaṃ naram
children.translated_text: Come now, friends, let us praise <s>Indra</s>, the praiseworthy man,

children.text: kṛṣṭīr yo viśvā abhy asty eka it ||
children.translated_text: who alone stands over all peoples.

children.text: agorudhāya gaviṣe dyukṣāya dasmyaṃ vacaḥ
children.translated_text: A wondrous word for the giver of shelter, the seeker of cattle, the bright one.

children.text: ghṛtāt svādīyo madhunaś ca vocata ||
children.translated_text: Speak what is sweeter than ghee and than honey.

children.text: yasyāmitāni vīryā na rādhaḥ paryetave
children.translated_text: His heroic powers are immeasurable; like bounty they cannot be traversed,

children.text: jyotir na viśvam abhy asti dakṣiṇā ||
children.translated_text: and his sacrificial gift encompasses everything like light.

children.text: stuhīndraṃ vyaśvavad anūrmiṃ vājinaṃ yamam
children.translated_text: Praise <s>Indra</s>, as <s>Vyaśva</s> did, the unassailable prize-winner, the restrainer,

children.text: aryo gayam maṃhamānaṃ vi dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: the noble one who makes the household great for the worshipper.

children.text: evā nūnam upa stuhi vaiyaśva daśamaṃ navam
children.translated_text: So now, O <s>Vaiyaśva</s>, praise the tenth, the ninth,

children.text: suvidvāṃsaṃ carkṛtyaṃ caraṇīnām ||
children.translated_text: the very wise one, active among the moving ones.

children.text: vetthā hi nirṛtīnāṃ vajrahasta parivṛjam
children.translated_text: For you know, O thunderbolt-handed one, the way around calamities,

children.text: ahar ahaḥ śundhyuḥ paripadām iva ||
children.translated_text: clearing them day by day, like the snares about one's feet.

children.text: tad indrāva ā bhara yenā daṃsiṣṭha kṛtvane
children.translated_text: Bring that to us, O <s>Indra</s>, with which you are strongest for action;

children.text: dvitā kutsāya śiśnatho ni codaya ||
children.translated_text: twice you helped <s>Kutsa</s>; urge us on also.

children.text: tam u tvā nūnam īmahe navyaṃ daṃsiṣṭha sanyase
children.translated_text: Now we implore you as that newest, strongest one for winning,

children.text: sa tvaṃ no viśvā abhimātīḥ sakṣaṇiḥ ||
children.translated_text: so you, as conqueror, may master all hostile designs for us.

children.text: ya ṛkṣād aṃhaso mucad yo vāryāt saptasindhuṣu
children.translated_text: You who released us from the bear, from distress, or from the desirable wealth among the Seven Rivers,

children.text: vadhar dāsasya tuvinṛmṇa nīnamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: bring down the weapon of the Dāsa, O very mighty one.

children.text: yathā varo suṣāmṇe sanibhya āvaho rayim
children.translated_text: As you brought wealth for <s>Suṣāman</s>, for his companions, as the chosen one,

children.text: vyaśvebhyaḥ subhage vājinīvati ||
children.translated_text: bring it for the <s>Vyaśvas</s>, O fortunate prize-winning lady.

children.text: ā nāryasya dakṣiṇā vyaśvāṁ etu sominaḥ
children.translated_text: May the gift of the manly sacrificer, of the soma-presser, come to the <s>Vyaśvas</s>,

children.text: sthūraṃ ca rādhaḥ śatavat sahasravat ||
children.translated_text: broad bounty, with hundreds and with thousands.

children.text: yat tvā pṛcchād ījānaḥ kuhayā kuhayākṛte
children.translated_text: When the sacrificer has asked you, 'Where is he, where has he gone?',

children.text: eṣo apaśrito valo gomatīm ava tiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: this <s>Vala</s>, hidden away, stands over the cattle-rich place.

children.text: Chapter 645
tā vāṃ viśvasya gopā devā deveṣu yajñiyā
children.translated_text: You two are guardians of all, gods worshipful among the gods,

children.text: ṛtāvānā yajase pūtadakṣasā ||
children.translated_text: truthful ones, with purified skill, for the sacrifice.

children.text: mitrā tanā na rathyā varuṇo yaś ca sukratuḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s> like a kinsman, not a chariot warrior, and <s>Varuṇa</s>, who is of good resolve,

children.text: sanāt sujātā tanayā dhṛtavratā ||
children.translated_text: are well-born from of old, sons holding fast their vows.

children.text: tā mātā viśvavedasāsuryāya pramahasā
children.translated_text: Their mother, all-knowing <s>Aditi</s>, for lordly power,

children.text: mahī jajānāditir ṛtāvarī ||
children.translated_text: the great keeper of truth, bore them for great majesty.

children.text: mahāntā mitrāvaruṇā samrājā devāv asurā
children.translated_text: Great <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, sovereigns, divine <s>Asuras</s>,

children.text: ṛtāvānāv ṛtam ā ghoṣato bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: truthful ones, proclaim the lofty truth.

children.text: napātā śavaso mahaḥ sūnū dakṣasya sukratū
children.translated_text: Grandsons of great might, sons of <s>Dakṣa</s>, of good resolve,

children.text: sṛpradānū iṣo vāstv adhi kṣitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: of flowing gifts, you dwell over nourishment and dwelling-place.

children.text: saṃ yā dānūni yemathur divyāḥ pārthivīr iṣaḥ
children.translated_text: When you two have controlled the heavenly and earthly gifts and nourishments,

children.text: nabhasvatīr ā vāṃ carantu vṛṣṭayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: then let cloud-borne rains come to you.

children.text: adhi yā bṛhato divo 'bhi yūtheva paśyataḥ
children.translated_text: From the height of great heaven you look, as over a herd,

children.text: ṛtāvānā samrājā namase hitā ||
children.translated_text: truthful sovereigns, established for reverence.

children.text: ṛtāvānā ni ṣedatuḥ sāmrājyāya sukratū
children.translated_text: The truthful ones, of good resolve, have sat down for sovereignty;

children.text: dhṛtavratā kṣatriyā kṣatram āśatuḥ ||
children.translated_text: holding fast their vows, the rulers have reached dominion.

children.text: akṣṇaś cid gātuvittarānulbaṇena cakṣasā
children.translated_text: With an unobstructed eye they are path-finders even beyond sight,

children.text: ni cin miṣantā nicirā ni cikyatuḥ ||
children.translated_text: and though they close their eyes, the unfailing ones perceive and discern.

children.text: uta no devy aditir uruṣyatāṃ nāsatyā
children.translated_text: And may the goddess <s>Aditi</s> protect us; may the <s>Nāsatyas</s> protect us,

children.text: uruṣyantu maruto vṛddhaśavasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and may the <s>Maruts</s> of increased might protect us.

children.text: te no nāvam uruṣyata divā naktaṃ sudānavaḥ
children.translated_text: Protect our ship, O generous ones, by day and by night;

children.text: ariṣyanto ni pāyubhiḥ sacemahi ||
children.translated_text: unharmed, may we be joined with your protections.

children.text: aghnate viṣṇave vayam ariṣyantaḥ sudānave
children.translated_text: We, unharmed, call to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the unharmed, generous one:

children.text: śrudhi svayāvan sindho pūrvacittaye ||
children.translated_text: Hear us, self-moving <s>Sindhu</s>, for forethought.

children.text: tad vāryaṃ vṛṇīmahe variṣṭhaṃ gopayatyam
children.translated_text: We choose that desirable thing, the best, worthy of guardianship,

children.text: mitro yat pānti varuṇo yad aryamā ||
children.translated_text: which <s>Mitra</s> protects, which <s>Varuṇa</s>, which <s>Aryaman</s> protects.

children.text: uta naḥ sindhur apāṃ tan marutas tad aśvinā
children.translated_text: And may <s>Sindhu</s> of the waters grant it to us; may the <s>Maruts</s>, may the <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: indro viṣṇur mīḍhvāṃsaḥ sajoṣasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, gracious ones, grant it together.

children.text: te hi ṣmā vanuṣo naro 'bhimātiṃ kayasya cit
children.translated_text: For these men, swift ones, strike back the hostility of any attacker,

children.text: tigmaṃ na kṣodaḥ pratighnanti bhūrṇayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like a sharp flood, O vigorous ones.

children.text: ayam eka itthā purūru caṣṭe vi viśpatiḥ
children.translated_text: This one alone sees far and wide in this way, the lord of the clans;

children.text: tasya vratāny anu vaś carāmasi ||
children.translated_text: we follow after his ordinances.

children.text: anu pūrvāṇy okyā sāmrājyasya saścima
children.translated_text: We have attached ourselves to the ancient dwellings of sovereignty,

children.text: mitrasya vratā varuṇasya dīrghaśrut ||
children.translated_text: to the long-heard vows of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: pari yo raśminā divo 'ntān mame pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: He who with his ray measured out the ends of heaven and earth,

children.text: ubhe ā paprau rodasī mahitvā ||
children.translated_text: filled both heaven and earth with his greatness.

children.text: ud u ṣya śaraṇe divo jyotir ayaṃsta sūryaḥ
children.translated_text: Up from the shelter of heaven this <s>Sūrya</s> has extended his light,

children.text: agnir na śukraḥ samidhāna āhutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like bright <s>Agni</s> kindled and invoked with fuel.

children.text: vaco dīrghaprasadmanīśe vājasya gomataḥ
children.translated_text: He rules speech of far-reaching seat, and prize-rich cattle;

children.text: īśe hi pitvo 'viṣasya dāvane ||
children.translated_text: for he rules over the giving of food and the harmless draught.

children.text: tat sūryaṃ rodasī ubhe doṣā vastor upa bruve
children.translated_text: I address that <s>Sūrya</s>, and both heaven and earth, at evening and morning:

children.text: bhojeṣv asmāṁ abhy uc carā sadā ||
children.translated_text: rise always over us among the enjoyments.

children.text: ṛjram ukṣaṇyāyane rajataṃ harayāṇe
children.translated_text: May we obtain the straight, silvery chariot of the bull's course and of the bay one's course,

children.text: rathaṃ yuktam asanāma suṣāmaṇi ||
children.translated_text: the chariot yoked for <s>Suṣāman</s>.

children.text: tā me aśvyānāṃ harīṇāṃ nitośanā
children.translated_text: Those two bay horses, the urged ones among the horse-teams, are mine,

children.text: uto nu kṛtvyānāṃ nṛvāhasā ||
children.translated_text: and now also among those to be employed, carrying men.

children.text: smadabhīśū kaśāvantā viprā naviṣṭhayā matī
children.translated_text: With reins near at hand, with whips, inspired singers with the newest thought,

children.text: maho vājināv arvantā sacāsanam ||
children.translated_text: have sat beside the two great prize-winning coursers.

children.text: Chapter 646
yuvor u ṣū rathaṃ huve sadhastutyāya sūriṣu
children.translated_text: I call your chariot, then, for shared praise among the patrons,

children.text: atūrtadakṣā vṛṣaṇā vṛṣaṇvasū ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, bulls of unthwarted skill, rich in bull-like strength.

children.text: yuvaṃ varo suṣāmṇe mahe tane nāsatyā
children.translated_text: You two, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, went with your aids for chosen <s>Suṣāman</s> and for the great offspring,

children.text: avobhir yātho vṛṣaṇā vṛṣaṇvasū ||
children.translated_text: O bulls, rich in bull-like strength.

children.text: tā vām adya havāmahe havyebhir vājinīvasū
children.translated_text: Today we call you two with oblations, O possessors of prize-winning wealth,

children.text: pūrvīr iṣa iṣayantāv ati kṣapaḥ ||
children.translated_text: as you set many nourishments in motion through the nights.

children.text: ā vāṃ vāhiṣṭho aśvinā ratho yātu śruto narā
children.translated_text: Let your swiftest chariot come to us, O <s>Aśvins</s>, O famed men;

children.text: upa stomān turasya darśathaḥ śriye ||
children.translated_text: you appear near the songs of <s>Tura</s> for beauty.

children.text: juhurāṇā cid aśvinā manyethāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū
children.translated_text: Even if you were turning away, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you should think of us, O possessors of bull-like wealth;

children.text: yuvaṃ hi rudrā parṣatho ati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for you two, fierce ones, carry us across beyond hatreds.

children.text: dasrā hi viśvam ānuṣaṅ makṣūbhiḥ paridīyathaḥ
children.translated_text: For, O wondrous ones, you move about the whole human world with swift protections,

children.text: dhiyañjinvā madhuvarṇā śubhas patī ||
children.translated_text: inspiring thought, honey-hued, lords of splendor.

children.text: upa no yātam aśvinā rāyā viśvapuṣā saha
children.translated_text: Come near to us, O <s>Aśvins</s>, together with wealth that nourishes all,

children.text: maghavānā suvīrāv anapacyutā ||
children.translated_text: O bounteous ones, rich in heroes and unfailing.

children.text: ā me asya pratīvyam indranāsatyā gatam
children.translated_text: Come to this response of mine, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Nāsatyas</s>,

children.text: devā devebhir adya sacanastamā ||
children.translated_text: O gods, today most closely accompanied by the gods.

children.text: vayaṃ hi vāṃ havāmaha ukṣaṇyanto vyaśvavat
children.translated_text: For we call you, longing for bulls, as <s>Vyaśva</s> did;

children.text: sumatibhir upa viprāv ihā gatam ||
children.translated_text: come here, inspired ones, with favorable thoughts.

children.text: aśvinā sv ṛṣe stuhi kuvit te śravato havam
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, praise well for the seer; perhaps they will hear your call,

children.text: nedīyasaḥ kūﾱayātaḥ paṇīṃr uta ||
children.translated_text: those coming from nearer by, and also the Paṇis.

children.text: vaiyaśvasya śrutaṃ naroto me asya vedathaḥ
children.translated_text: Hear the call of <s>Vaiyaśva</s>, O men, and know this of mine,

children.text: sajoṣasā varuṇo mitro aryamā ||
children.translated_text: together with <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>.

children.text: yuvādattasya dhiṣṇyā yuvānītasya sūribhiḥ
children.translated_text: By the inspired patrons to whom you have given and whom you have led,

children.text: ahar ahar vṛṣaṇa mahyaṃ śikṣatam ||
children.translated_text: teach me day by day, O bulls.

children.text: yo vāṃ yajñebhir āvṛto 'dhivastrā vadhūr iva
children.translated_text: Whoever, surrounded by sacrifices to you two, like a bride in her bridal garments,

children.text: saparyantā śubhe cakrāte aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: worships you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, has made the bright wheels ready.

children.text: yo vām uruvyacastamaṃ ciketati nṛpāyyam
children.translated_text: He who takes thought of your widest-seeing, man-protecting

children.text: vartir aśvinā pari yātam asmayū ||
children.translated_text: course, O <s>Aśvins</s>, go around him, desiring us.

children.text: asmabhyaṃ su vṛṣaṇvasū yātaṃ vartir nṛpāyyam
children.translated_text: For us, O strong possessors of wealth, come with your man-protecting course;

children.text: viṣudruheva yajñam ūhathur girā ||
children.translated_text: as if against one who deceives, carry the sacrifice by our song.

children.text: vāhiṣṭho vāṃ havānāṃ stomo dūto huvan narā
children.translated_text: Let the most conveying hymn among invocations, becoming a messenger, call you, O men,

children.text: yuvābhyām bhūtv aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: for you two, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: yad ado divo arṇava iṣo vā madatho gṛhe
children.translated_text: Whether you rejoice yonder in the ocean of heaven, or at the house of refreshment,

children.text: śrutam in me amartyā ||
children.translated_text: hear this of mine, O immortal ones.

children.text: uta syā śvetayāvarī vāhiṣṭhā vāṃ nadīnām
children.translated_text: And that whitely-flowing <s>Sindhu</s>, best carrier among rivers,

children.text: sindhur hiraṇyavartaniḥ ||
children.translated_text: has a golden track.

children.text: smad etayā sukīrtyāśvinā śvetayā dhiyā
children.translated_text: With this good praise, O <s>Aśvins</s>, with this bright thought,

children.text: vahethe śubhrayāvānā ||
children.translated_text: you two drive, having shining courses.

children.text: yukṣvā hi tvaṃ rathāsahā yuvasva poṣyā vaso
children.translated_text: Yoke, indeed, you who withstand chariots; harness the nourishments, O good one;

children.text: ān no vāyo madhu pibāsmākaṃ savanā gahi ||
children.translated_text: come to us, O <s>Vāyu</s>; drink the honey; come to our soma-pressing.

children.text: tava vāyav ṛtaspate tvaṣṭur jāmātar adbhuta
children.translated_text: Of you, O <s>Vāyu</s>, lord of truth, wondrous son-in-law of <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>,

children.text: avāṃsy ā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: we choose the aids.

children.text: tvaṣṭur jāmātaraṃ vayam īśānaṃ rāya īmahe
children.translated_text: We seek <s>Vāyu</s>, <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>'s son-in-law, lord of wealth,

children.text: sutāvanto vāyuṃ dyumnā janāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we people with soma pressed, for splendors.

children.text: vāyo yāhi śivā divo vahasvā su svaśvyam
children.translated_text: Come, O <s>Vāyu</s>, from kindly heaven; bring good horse-power;

children.text: vahasva mahaḥ pṛthupakṣasā rathe ||
children.translated_text: bring greatness in your broad-winged chariot.

children.text: tvāṃ hi supsarastamaṃ nṛṣadaneṣu hūmahe
children.translated_text: For we call you, most beautifully streaming, in the seats of men,

children.text: grāvāṇaṃ nāśvapṛṣṭham maṃhanā ||
children.translated_text: like a pressing-stone on a horse's back, with greatness.

children.text: sa tvaṃ no deva manasā vāyo mandāno agriyaḥ
children.translated_text: So you, O god <s>Vāyu</s>, delighted in mind, foremost one,

children.text: kṛdhi vājāṁ apo dhiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: make for us prizes, waters, and inspired thoughts.

children.text: Chapter 647
agnir ukthe purohito grāvāṇo barhir adhvare
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is the household priest in the recitation; the pressing-stones and the ritual grass are at the rite;

children.text: ṛcā yāmi maruto brahmaṇaspatiṃ devāṁ avo vareṇyam ||
children.translated_text: with a verse I go to the <s>Maruts</s> and <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, choosing the gods for aid.

children.text: ā paśuṃ gāsi pṛthivīṃ vanaspatīn uṣāsā naktam oṣadhīḥ
children.translated_text: Sing to the animal, the earth, the forest-lords, dawn and night, and the plants;

children.text: viśve ca no vasavo viśvavedaso dhīnām bhūta prāvitāraḥ ||
children.translated_text: and may all the <s>Vasus</s>, the all-knowing ones, be protectors of our thoughts.

children.text: pra sū na etv adhvaro 'gnā deveṣu pūrvyaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the ancient rite now go forward among the gods in <s>Agni</s>;

children.text: ādityeṣu pra varuṇe dhṛtavrate marutsu viśvabhānuṣu ||
children.translated_text: among the <s>Ādityas</s>, toward <s>Varuṇa</s> of fixed vow, and among the all-shining <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: viśve hi ṣmā manave viśvavedaso bhuvan vṛdhe riśādasaḥ
children.translated_text: For all the all-knowing gods, free from injury, have been for <s>Manu</s>'s increase;

children.text: ariṣṭebhiḥ pāyubhir viśvavedaso yantā no 'vṛkaṃ chardiḥ ||
children.translated_text: with uninjured protections, O all-knowing ones, guide toward us a shelter free from harm.

children.text: ā no adya samanaso gantā viśve sajoṣasaḥ
children.translated_text: Today, of one mind, come to us, all of you united in joy;

children.text: ṛcā girā maruto devy adite sadane pastye mahi ||
children.translated_text: with verse and song, O <s>Maruts</s>, and divine <s>Aditi</s>, to the great seat in the dwelling.

children.text: abhi priyā maruto yā vo aśvyā havyā mitra prayāthana
children.translated_text: Approach the beloved oblations that are yours, O <s>Maruts</s>, with your horse-teams; O <s>Mitra</s>, go forth.

children.text: ā barhir indro varuṇas turā nara ādityāsaḥ sadantu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Indra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, the strong men, and the <s>Ādityas</s> sit on our ritual grass.

children.text: vayaṃ vo vṛktabarhiṣo hitaprayasa ānuṣak
children.translated_text: We, with ritual grass strewn and offerings set in place, continually,

children.text: sutasomāso varuṇa havāmahe manuṣvad iddhāgnayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with soma pressed, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, call you, with fires kindled like <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: ā pra yāta maruto viṣṇo aśvinā pūṣan mākīnayā dhiyā
children.translated_text: Come forth, O <s>Maruts</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>Aśvins</s>, and <s>Pūṣan</s>, with uninjuring thought;

children.text: indra ā yātu prathamaḥ saniṣyubhir vṛṣā yo vṛtrahā gṛṇe ||
children.translated_text: let <s>Indra</s> come first with the prize-winning ones, the bull, the <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer whom I praise.

children.text: vi no devāso adruho 'cchidraṃ śarma yacchata
children.translated_text: O gods without deceit, grant us unbroken shelter,

children.text: na yad dūrād vasavo nū cid antito varūtham ādadharṣati ||
children.translated_text: which neither from far away nor even from near, O <s>Vasus</s>, any defense can assail.

children.text: asti hi vaḥ sajātyaṃ riśādaso devāso asty āpyam
children.translated_text: For there is kinship with you, O injury-repelling gods; there is closeness.

children.text: pra ṇaḥ pūrvasmai suvitāya vocata makṣū sumnāya navyase ||
children.translated_text: Speak for us toward former good guidance and quickly toward new favor.

children.text: idā hi va upastutim idā vāmasya bhaktaye
children.translated_text: Now indeed for you there is praise; now there is worship for a share of what is lovely.

children.text: upa vo viśvavedaso namasyur āṃ asṛkṣy anyām iva ||
children.translated_text: Reverent, I have sent it forth to you all-knowing ones, like another offering.

children.text: ud u ṣya vaḥ savitā supraṇītayo 'sthād ūrdhvo vareṇyaḥ
children.translated_text: Up has arisen that <s>Savitṛ</s> of yours, of good guidance, standing upright, worthy of choice;

children.text: ni dvipādaś catuṣpādo arthino 'viśran patayiṣṇavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the two-footed and four-footed needy ones, the flying ones, have come to rest.

children.text: devaṃ devaṃ vo 'vase devaṃ devam abhiṣṭaye
children.translated_text: Each god of yours we would call for aid, each god for fulfillment of desire,

children.text: devaṃ devaṃ huvema vājasātaye gṛṇanto devyā dhiyā ||
children.translated_text: each god for winning the prize, praising with divine thought.

children.text: devāso hi ṣmā manave samanyavo viśve sākaṃ sarātayaḥ
children.translated_text: For the gods, all of one mind and sharing gifts together, are for <s>Manu</s>;

children.text: te no adya te aparaṃ tuce tu no bhavantu varivovidaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may they be today, and afterward, finders of broad space for us and for our offspring.

children.text: pra vaḥ śaṃsāmy adruhaḥ saṃstha upastutīnām
children.translated_text: I proclaim for you, undeceitful ones, the gathering of praises;

children.text: na taṃ dhūrtir varuṇa mitra martyaṃ yo vo dhāmabhyo 'vidhat ||
children.translated_text: no deception harms that mortal, O <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Mitra</s>, who has served your ordinances.

children.text: pra sa kṣayaṃ tirate vi mahīr iṣo yo vo varāya dāśati
children.translated_text: He crosses into dwelling and great nourishments, he who gives offering for your chosen favor;

children.text: pra prajābhir jāyate dharmaṇas pary ariṣṭaḥ sarva edhate ||
children.translated_text: he is born with offspring; around <s>dharma</s> (lawful order), unharmed, he prospers entirely.

children.text: ṛte sa vindate yudhaḥ sugebhir yāty adhvanaḥ
children.translated_text: Without battle he gains; by easy paths he travels the roads,

children.text: aryamā mitro varuṇaḥ sarātayo yaṃ trāyante sajoṣasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the one whom <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and the gift-sharing ones protect in harmony.

children.text: ajre cid asmai kṛṇuthā nyañcanaṃ durge cid ā susaraṇam
children.translated_text: Even on the open plain you make a descent for him, and even in difficulty an easy passage;

children.text: eṣā cid asmād aśaniḥ paro nu sāsredhantī vi naśyatu ||
children.translated_text: may even this thunderbolt pass far away from him and, not reaching him, disappear.

children.text: yad adya sūrya udyati priyakṣatrā ṛtaṃ dadha
children.translated_text: When today the sun rises, O you whose rule is dear, uphold truth;

children.text: yan nimruci prabudhi viśvavedaso yad vā madhyandine divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when it sets, at awakening, O all-knowing ones, or at midday in heaven;

children.text: yad vābhipitve asurā ṛtaṃ yate chardir yema vi dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: or when at evening, O <s>Asuras</s>, you go according to truth, may we obtain shelter for the giver;

children.text: vayaṃ tad vo vasavo viśvavedasa upa stheyāma madhya ā ||
children.translated_text: we would stand in the midst of that of yours, O <s>Vasus</s>, all-knowing ones.

children.text: yad adya sūra udite yan madhyandina ātuci
children.translated_text: Whatever lovely thing you set down today at sunrise or at midday,

children.text: vāmaṃ dhattha manave viśvavedaso juhvānāya pracetase ||
children.translated_text: for <s>Manu</s>, O all-knowing ones, for the wise offerer who pours the oblation,

children.text: vayaṃ tad vaḥ samrāja ā vṛṇīmahe putro na bahupāyyam
children.translated_text: that we choose from you, O sovereigns, like a son choosing much protection;

children.text: aśyāma tad ādityā juhvato havir yena vasyo 'naśāmahai ||
children.translated_text: may we attain that, O <s>Ādityas</s>, from the one offering the oblation, by which we may gain better welfare.

children.text: Chapter 648
ye triṃśati trayas paro devāso barhir āsadan
children.translated_text: Those thirty gods and three beyond who sat upon the ritual grass

children.text: vidann aha dvitāsanan ||
children.translated_text: indeed found the two seats.

children.text: varuṇo mitro aryamā smadrātiṣāco agnayaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, and the fires who accompany bounty,

children.text: patnīvanto vaṣaṭkṛtāḥ ||
children.translated_text: with their wives, called by the vaṣaṭ-call,

children.text: te no gopā apācyās ta udak ta itthā nyak
children.translated_text: they are our protectors downward, they upward, they thus below,

children.text: purastāt sarvayā viśā ||
children.translated_text: in front, with every clan.

children.text: yathā vaśanti devās tathed asat tad eṣāṃ nakir ā minat
children.translated_text: As the gods wish, so indeed let it be; no one diminishes this of theirs,

children.text: arāvā cana martyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: not even an ungenerous mortal.

children.text: saptānāṃ sapta ṛṣṭayaḥ sapta dyumnāny eṣām
children.translated_text: Of the seven, there are seven spears; seven splendors are theirs.

children.text: sapto adhi śriyo dhire ||
children.translated_text: The seven have set their splendors upon him.

children.text: Chapter 649
babhrur eko viṣuṇaḥ sūnaro yuvāñjy aṅkte hiraṇyayam ||
children.translated_text: One brown one, distinct, fair to behold, young, anoints himself with gold.

children.text: yonim eka ā sasāda dyotano 'ntar deveṣu medhiraḥ ||
children.translated_text: One shining one has sat down in the womb, wise among the gods.

children.text: vāśīm eko bibharti hasta āyasīm antar deveṣu nidhruviḥ ||
children.translated_text: One bears an iron axe in his hand, steadfast among the gods.

children.text: vajram eko bibharti hasta āhitaṃ tena vṛtrāṇi jighnate ||
children.translated_text: One bears the thunderbolt placed in his hand; with it he strikes down the <s>Vṛtras</s>.

children.text: tigmam eko bibharti hasta āyudhaṃ śucir ugro jalāṣabheṣajaḥ ||
children.translated_text: One bears a sharp weapon in his hand, pure, fierce, having the waters as remedies.

children.text: patha ekaḥ pīpāya taskaro yathāṃ eṣa veda nidhīnām ||
children.translated_text: One has filled the path like a thief; this one knows the hidden treasures.

children.text: trīṇy eka urugāyo vi cakrame yatra devāso madanti ||
children.translated_text: One, the wide-going one, has stepped out three steps, where the gods rejoice.

children.text: vibhir dvā carata ekayā saha pra pravāseva vasataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Two move with birds, together with one; they dwell as if in a distant lodging.

children.text: sado dvā cakrāte upamā divi samrājā sarpirāsutī ||
children.translated_text: Two have made their seat in the highest heaven, sovereigns, rich in streams of ghee.

children.text: arcanta eke mahi sāma manvata tena sūryam arocayan ||
children.translated_text: Some, singing, devised the great <s>sāman</s> (chant); by it they made the sun shine.

children.text: Chapter 650
nahi vo asty arbhako devāso na kumārakaḥ
children.translated_text: For among you there is no little one, O gods, and no child;

children.text: viśve satomahānta it ||
children.translated_text: all of you are truly great.

children.text: iti stutāso asathā riśādaso ye stha trayaś ca triṃśac ca
children.translated_text: Thus praised, you are destroyers of foes, you who are three and thirty;

children.text: manor devā yajñiyāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the gods of <s>Manu</s>, worthy of sacrifice.

children.text: te nas trādhvaṃ te 'vata ta u no adhi vocata
children.translated_text: Protect us, help us, and speak on our behalf.

children.text: mā naḥ pathaḥ pitryān mānavād adhi dūraṃ naiṣṭa parāvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Do not carry us far away from the ancestral path of mankind, into remoteness.

children.text: ye devāsa iha sthana viśve vaiśvānarā uta
children.translated_text: You gods who are here, all of you, and the <s>Vaiśvānaras</s> too,

children.text: asmabhyaṃ śarma sapratho gave 'śvāya yacchata ||
children.translated_text: grant us broad shelter, for cow and for horse.

children.text: Chapter 651
yo yajāti yajāta it sunavac ca pacāti ca
children.translated_text: The one who sacrifices again and again, who presses soma and cooks the offering,

children.text: brahmed indrasya cākanat ||
children.translated_text: his prayer truly pleases <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: puroﾱāśaṃ yo asmai somaṃ rarata āśiram
children.translated_text: The one who gives to him the sacrificial cake, the soma, and the admixture,

children.text: pād it taṃ śakro aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Śakra</s> indeed protects that man from distress.

children.text: tasya dyumāṁ asad ratho devajūtaḥ sa śūśuvat
children.translated_text: His chariot shall be brilliant, impelled by the gods; he shall thrive,

children.text: viśvā vanvann amitriyā ||
children.translated_text: conquering all hostile powers.

children.text: asya prajāvatī gṛhe 'saścantī dive dive
children.translated_text: In his house, rich in offspring and unfailing day by day,

children.text: iﾱā dhenumatī duhe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Iḷā</s>, rich in milch-cows, yields milk.

children.text: yā dampatī samanasā sunuta ā ca dhāvataḥ
children.translated_text: The husband and wife who, of one mind, press soma and hasten here,

children.text: devāso nityayāśirā ||
children.translated_text: the gods come to them, ever with refreshment.

children.text: prati prāśavyāṃ itaḥ samyañcā barhir āśāte
children.translated_text: From here the two sit together upon the fitting sacred grass, facing the offering.

children.text: na tā vājeṣu vāyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those two are not left behind in the contests for prize.

children.text: na devānām api hnutaḥ sumatiṃ na jugukṣataḥ
children.translated_text: They do not conceal themselves from the gods, nor do they reject their good favor;

children.text: śravo bṛhad vivāsataḥ ||
children.translated_text: they seek to win great renown.

children.text: putriṇā tā kumāriṇā viśvam āyur vy aśnutaḥ
children.translated_text: With sons and with daughters those two enjoy their whole span of life,

children.text: ubhā hiraṇyapeśasā ||
children.translated_text: both adorned with golden beauty.

children.text: vītihotrā kṛtadvasū daśasyantāmṛtāya kam
children.translated_text: Let the immortal ones, whose oblations are enjoyed and whose goods are prepared, show favor;

children.text: sam ūdho romaśaṃ hato deveṣu kṛṇuto duvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: pour forth the shaggy udder; make service among the gods.

children.text: ā śarma parvatānāṃ vṛṇīmahe nadīnām
children.translated_text: We choose the shelter of the mountains, of the rivers,

children.text: ā viṣṇoḥ sacābhuvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, who comes in companionship.

children.text: aitu pūṣā rayir bhagaḥ svasti sarvadhātamaḥ
children.translated_text: Let <s>Pūṣan</s>, wealth, and <s>Bhaga</s> come, with well-being most rich in all support;

children.text: urur adhvā svastaye ||
children.translated_text: let the broad road be for well-being.

children.text: aramatir anarvaṇo viśvo devasya manasā
children.translated_text: Let <s>Aramati</s>, unhindered, come by the mind of the universal god,

children.text: ādityānām aneha it ||
children.translated_text: and likewise the blameless favor of the <s>Ādityas</s>.

children.text: yathā no mitro aryamā varuṇaḥ santi gopāḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s> be our protectors;

children.text: sugā ṛtasya panthāḥ ||
children.translated_text: easy are the paths of truth.

children.text: agniṃ vaḥ pūrvyaṃ girā devam īﾱe vasūnām
children.translated_text: With song I praise for you <s>Agni</s>, the ancient god of the <s>Vasus</s>,

children.text: saparyantaḥ purupriyam mitraṃ na kṣetrasādhasam ||
children.translated_text: as you attend on the much-loved one, like <s>Mitra</s> who wins the fields.

children.text: makṣū devavato rathaḥ śūro vā pṛtsu kāsucit
children.translated_text: Quickly may the god-attended chariot, or the hero in whatever battles,

children.text: devānāṃ ya in mano yajamāna iyakṣaty abhīd ayajvano bhuvat ||
children.translated_text: belong to the worshipper who seeks to sacrifice into the gods' own mind; he shall overcome the non-sacrificer.

children.text: na yajamāna riṣyasi na sunvāna na devayo
children.translated_text: You do not come to harm, O worshipper, O soma-presser, O one devoted to the gods,

children.text: devānāṃ ya in mano yajamāna iyakṣaty abhīd ayajvano bhuvat ||
children.translated_text: the worshipper who seeks to sacrifice into the gods' own mind; he shall overcome the non-sacrificer.

children.text: nakiṣ ṭaṃ karmaṇā naśan na pra yoṣan na yoṣati
children.translated_text: No one will destroy him by action, nor will any hostile woman charm him away;

children.text: devānāṃ ya in mano yajamāna iyakṣaty abhīd ayajvano bhuvat ||
children.translated_text: the worshipper who seeks to sacrifice into the gods' own mind; he shall overcome the non-sacrificer.

children.text: asad atra suvīryam uta tyad āśvaśvyam
children.translated_text: Here there shall be good heroic strength, and also that wealth in horses;

children.text: devānāṃ ya in mano yajamāna iyakṣaty abhīd ayajvano bhuvat ||
children.translated_text: the worshipper who seeks to sacrifice into the gods' own mind; he shall overcome the non-sacrificer.

children.text: Chapter 652
pra kṛtāny ṛjīṣiṇaḥ kaṇvā indrasya gāthayā
children.translated_text: O <s>Kaṇvas</s>, with the song of <s>Indra</s> speak forth the deeds

children.text: made somasya vocata ||
children.translated_text: of the straight-rushing one in the exhilaration of soma.

children.text: yaḥ sṛbindam anarśanim pipruṃ dāsam ahīśuvam
children.translated_text: He who struck down <s>Sṛbinda</s>, <s>Anarśani</s>, and <s>Pipru</s>, the <s>Dāsa</s> without serpent-venom,

children.text: vadhīd ugro riṇann apaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the fierce one, releasing the waters.

children.text: ny arbudasya viṣṭapaṃ varṣmāṇam bṛhatas tira
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, over the height of <s>Arbuda</s>, over the stature of the great one,

children.text: kṛṣe tad indra pauṃsyam ||
children.translated_text: you displayed that manly power.

children.text: prati śrutāya vo dhṛṣat tūrṇāśaṃ na girer adhi
children.translated_text: For you, for the famed one, boldly, like a swift horse from the mountain,

children.text: huve suśipram ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: I call the fair-lipped one for aid.

children.text: sa gor aśvasya vi vrajam mandānaḥ somyebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Exhilarated by the soma-offerings, O hero, you burst open

children.text: puraṃ na śūra darṣasi ||
children.translated_text: the enclosure of cow and horse, like a fortress.

children.text: yadi me rāraṇaḥ suta ukthe vā dadhase canaḥ
children.translated_text: If you delight in my pressed soma, or place favor in the hymn,

children.text: ārād upa svadhā gahi ||
children.translated_text: come from near, according to your own nature.

children.text: vayaṃ ghā te api ṣmasi stotāra indra girvaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Indeed we are your own singers, O <s>Indra</s>, lover of song;

children.text: tvaṃ no jinva somapāḥ ||
children.translated_text: you, O soma-drinker, quicken us.

children.text: uta naḥ pitum ā bhara saṃrarāṇo avikṣitam
children.translated_text: And bring us food, granting it together, undecaying;

children.text: maghavan bhūri te vasu ||
children.translated_text: O bountiful one, your wealth is abundant.

children.text: uta no gomatas kṛdhi hiraṇyavato aśvinaḥ
children.translated_text: And make us possessed of cattle, possessed of gold, possessed of horses;

children.text: iﾱābhiḥ saṃ rabhemahi ||
children.translated_text: may we join ourselves with the refreshment of <s>Iḷā</s>.

children.text: bṛbadukthaṃ havāmahe sṛprakarasnam ūtaye
children.translated_text: We call the greatly praised one, strong-armed, for aid,

children.text: sādhu kṛṇvantam avase ||
children.translated_text: who acts well for our help.

children.text: yaḥ saṃsthe cicchatakratur ād īṃ kṛṇoti vṛtrahā
children.translated_text: He who, even in the gathering, the hundred-powered <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer, at once accomplishes it

children.text: jaritṛbhyaḥ purūvasuḥ ||
children.translated_text: for the singers, rich in many goods.

children.text: sa naḥ śakraś cid ā śakad dānavāṃ antarābharaḥ
children.translated_text: May that <s>Śakra</s> be able for us too, bringing gifts among us,

children.text: indro viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> with all his aids.

children.text: yo rāyo 'vanir mahān supāraḥ sunvataḥ sakhā
children.translated_text: He who is the great support of wealth, easy to cross to, the friend of the soma-presser,

children.text: tam indram abhi gāyata ||
children.translated_text: sing toward that <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: āyantāram mahi sthiram pṛtanāsu śravojitam
children.translated_text: Toward the approaching one, great and firm, winner of glory in battles,

children.text: bhūrer īśānam ojasā ||
children.translated_text: lord of much might.

children.text: nakir asya śacīnāṃ niyantā sūnṛtānām
children.translated_text: There is no controller of his powers, nor of his gracious gifts;

children.text: nakir vaktā na dād iti ||
children.translated_text: there is no one who says, 'Do not give.'

children.text: na nūnam brahmaṇām ṛṇam prāśūnām asti sunvatām
children.translated_text: Now there is no debt of hymns for the pressing worshippers,

children.text: na somo apratā pape ||
children.translated_text: nor has soma been drunk without return.

children.text: panya id upa gāyata panya ukthāni śaṃsata
children.translated_text: Sing only to the praiseworthy one; proclaim praiseworthy hymns;

children.text: brahmā kṛṇota panya it ||
children.translated_text: make the prayer praiseworthy indeed.

children.text: panya ā dardiracchatā sahasrā vājy avṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: May the praiseworthy one burst open thousands of prize-winning riches, unobstructed,

children.text: indro yo yajvano vṛdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, who increases the sacrificer.

children.text: vi ṣū cara svadhā anu kṛṣṭīnām anv āhuvaḥ
children.translated_text: Move widely according to your own nature, following the calls of the peoples.

children.text: indra piba sutānām ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, drink of the pressed soma offerings.

children.text: piba svadhainavānām uta yas tugrye sacā
children.translated_text: Drink of those rich in their own power, and also of that which is joined with <s>Tugrya</s>.

children.text: utāyam indra yas tava ||
children.translated_text: And drink this one, O <s>Indra</s>, which is yours.

children.text: atīhi manyuṣāviṇaṃ suṣuvāṃsam upāraṇe
children.translated_text: Come past the wrathful assailant to the presser at the offering-place.

children.text: imaṃ rātaṃ sutam piba ||
children.translated_text: Drink this bestowed, pressed soma.

children.text: ihi tisraḥ parāvata ihi pañca janāṃ ati
children.translated_text: Come from the three far distances; come beyond the five peoples.

children.text: dhenā indrāvacākaśat ||
children.translated_text: The inspired songs have shone forth for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: sūryo raśmiṃ yathā sṛjā tvā yacchantu me giraḥ
children.translated_text: As the sun sends out its ray, so let my songs reach you,

children.text: nimnam āpo na sadhryak ||
children.translated_text: like waters running together to a low place.

children.text: adhvaryav ā tu hi ṣiñca somaṃ vīrāya śipriṇe
children.translated_text: O <s>Adhvaryu</s>, come here; pour the soma for the hero, the fair-lipped one.

children.text: bharā sutasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: Bring it for the drinking of what has been pressed.

children.text: ya udnaḥ phaligam bhinan nyak sindhūṃr avāsṛjat
children.translated_text: He who split open the water's covering and let the rivers flow downward,

children.text: yo goṣu pakvaṃ dhārayat ||
children.translated_text: who set the ripened nourishment among the cows.

children.text: ahan vṛtram ṛcīṣama aurṇavābham ahīśuvam
children.translated_text: He struck down <s>Vṛtra</s>, <s>Ṛcīṣama</s>, <s>Aurṇavābha</s>, and <s>Ahīśuva</s>,

children.text: himenāvidhyad arbudam ||
children.translated_text: and with cold he pierced <s>Arbuda</s>.

children.text: pra va ugrāya niṣṭure 'ṣāﾱhāya prasakṣiṇe
children.translated_text: Sing forth the god-given prayer to the fierce one, the harsh one, the unconquerable and overpowering one.

children.text: devattam brahma gāyata ||
children.translated_text: Sing the god-given sacred formulation.

children.text: yo viśvāny abhi vratā somasya made andhasaḥ
children.translated_text: He who, in the exhilaration of the strong soma, perceives all ordinances,

children.text: indro deveṣu cetati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is conscious among the gods.

children.text: iha tyā sadhamādyā harī hiraṇyakeśyā
children.translated_text: Here are those two bay steeds for the shared feast, golden-maned,

children.text: voﾱhām abhi prayo hitam ||
children.translated_text: set ready to carry you toward the delight.

children.text: arvāñcaṃ tvā puruṣṭuta priyamedhastutā harī
children.translated_text: Let the two bay steeds, turned hither and praised by <s>Priyamedha</s>, bring you, the much-invoked one,

children.text: somapeyāya vakṣataḥ ||
children.translated_text: for the drinking of soma.

children.text: Chapter 653
vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvanta āpo na vṛktabarhiṣaḥ
children.translated_text: We, having pressed soma, sit around you like waters, with the sacrificial grass spread,

children.text: pavitrasya prasravaṇeṣu vṛtrahan pari stotāra āsate ||
children.translated_text: at the outpourings of the filter, O <s>Vṛtrahan</s>, as singers.

children.text: svaranti tvā sute naro vaso nireka ukthinaḥ
children.translated_text: The hymn-singing men resound to you at the pressing, O good one, at the overflow.

children.text: kadā sutaṃ tṛṣāṇa oka ā gama indra svabdīva vaṃsagaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When, thirsty for the pressed soma, will you come home, O <s>Indra</s>, like one who goes well to the stalks?

children.text: kaṇvebhir dhṛṣṇav ā dhṛṣad vājaṃ darṣi sahasriṇam
children.translated_text: With the <s>Kaṇvas</s>, bold one, boldly reveal a thousandfold prize.

children.text: piśaṅgarūpam maghavan vicarṣaṇe makṣū gomantam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Maghavan</s>, tawny in form and attentive to men, we quickly seek wealth rich in cattle.

children.text: pāhi gāyāndhaso mada indrāya medhyātithe
children.translated_text: Drink the songs and the exhilarating soma, O <s>Indra</s>, for <s>Medhyātithi</s>.

children.text: yaḥ sammiślo haryor yaḥ sute sacā vajrī ratho hiraṇyayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The wielder of the thunderbolt, whose golden chariot is joined with the two bay steeds, is present at the pressing.

children.text: yaḥ suṣavyaḥ sudakṣiṇa ino yaḥ sukratur gṛṇe
children.translated_text: He who is easy to invoke, liberal, a lord, whose good insight I praise,

children.text: ya ākaraḥ sahasrā yaḥ śatāmagha indro yaḥ pūrbhid āritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: who is the source of thousands, bountiful with hundreds: that <s>Indra</s>, the fort-breaker, has been called.

children.text: yo dhṛṣito yo 'vṛto yo asti śmaśruṣu śritaḥ
children.translated_text: He who is bold, who is unobstructed, who has taken his place among bearded men,

children.text: vibhūtadyumnaś cyavanaḥ puruṣṭutaḥ kratvā gaur iva śākinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: of manifest splendor, shaking things loose, much-praised, strong in will like a bull.

children.text: ka īṃ veda sute sacā pibantaṃ kad vayo dadhe
children.translated_text: Who knows him when he drinks beside the pressed soma? When does he grant vigor?

children.text: ayaṃ yaḥ puro vibhinatty ojasā mandānaḥ śipry andhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: This is he who smashes fortresses with might, exhilarated by the strong soma, O fair-lipped one.

children.text: dānā mṛgo na vāraṇaḥ purutrā carathaṃ dadhe
children.translated_text: Like a wild elephant in his gifts, he has set his course in many places.

children.text: nakiṣ ṭvā ni yamad ā sute gamo mahāṃś carasy ojasā ||
children.translated_text: No one restrains you when you come to the pressing; great, you move by your might.

children.text: ya ugraḥ sann aniṣṭṛta sthiro raṇāya saṃskṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: You are fierce, unconquered, firm, and readied for battle.

children.text: yadi stotur maghavā śṛṇavaddhavaṃ nendro yoṣaty ā gamat ||
children.translated_text: If <s>Maghavan</s> hears the singer's call, <s>Indra</s> does not fail; he comes.

children.text: satyam itthā vṛṣed asi vṛṣajūtir no 'vṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: Truly, just so, you are a bull, with bull-like impulse, not shut away from us.

children.text: vṛṣā hy ugra śṛṇviṣe parāvati vṛṣo arvāvati śrutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For as a bull, O fierce one, you are heard from afar; as a bull you are heard from nearby.

children.text: vṛṣaṇas te abhīśavo vṛṣā kaśā hiraṇyayī
children.translated_text: Bull-like are your reins; bull-like is the golden whip.

children.text: vṛṣā ratho maghavan vṛṣaṇā harī vṛṣā tvaṃ śatakrato ||
children.translated_text: Bull-like is the chariot, O <s>Maghavan</s>; bull-like are the two bay steeds; bull-like are you, O <s>Śatakratu</s>.

children.text: vṛṣā sotā sunotu te vṛṣann ṛjīpinn ā bhara
children.translated_text: Let the bull-like presser press for you; O bull, O <s>Ṛjīpin</s>, bring it here.

children.text: vṛṣā dadhanve vṛṣaṇaṃ nadīṣv ā tubhyaṃ sthātar harīṇām ||
children.translated_text: The bull was stretched for the bull among the streams; for you it is stationed, holder of the bay steeds.

children.text: endra yāhi pītaye madhu śaviṣṭha somyam
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, come for drinking the honeyed soma, O strongest one.

children.text: nāyam acchā maghavā śṛṇavad giro brahmokthā ca sukratuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Maghavan</s>, of good insight, hear these songs and sacred hymns directed here.

children.text: vahantu tvā ratheṣṭhām ā harayo rathayujaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the bay steeds, standing in the chariot and yoked to the chariot, carry you,

children.text: tiraś cid aryaṃ savanāni vṛtrahann anyeṣāṃ yā śatakrato ||
children.translated_text: even past the pressings of others, O <s>Vṛtrahan</s>, O <s>Śatakratu</s>.

children.text: asmākam adyāntamaṃ stomaṃ dhiṣva mahāmaha
children.translated_text: Set in your mind today our inmost hymn, O greatly bounteous one.

children.text: asmākaṃ te savanā santu śantamā madāya dyukṣa somapāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let our soma-pressings be most auspicious for your exhilaration, O radiant soma-drinker.

children.text: nahi ṣas tava no mama śāstre anyasya raṇyati
children.translated_text: For neither yours nor mine delights in the instruction of another,

children.text: yo asmān vīra ānayat ||
children.translated_text: the hero who brought us here.

children.text: indraś cid ghā tad abravīt striyā aśāsyam manaḥ
children.translated_text: Even <s>Indra</s> said this: a woman's mind is not to be governed,

children.text: uto aha kratuṃ raghum ||
children.translated_text: and indeed her resolve is quick and light.

children.text: saptī cid ghā madacyutā mithunā vahato ratham
children.translated_text: Even the two spirited mares, letting exhilaration flow, draw the chariot as a pair;

children.text: eved dhūr vṛṣṇa uttarā ||
children.translated_text: so indeed the upper yoke belongs to the bull.

children.text: adhaḥ paśyasva mopari saṃtarām pādakau hara
children.translated_text: Look downward, not upward; draw your two feet together more closely.

children.text: mā te kaśaplakau dṛśan strī hi brahmā babhūvitha ||
children.translated_text: Let not your two ankles be seen, for you, a woman, have become a reciter of sacred speech.

children.text: Chapter 654
endra yāhi haribhir upa kaṇvasya suṣṭutim
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, come with the bay steeds to the fair praise of <s>Kaṇva</s>.

children.text: divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
children.translated_text: From the rule of that heaven, go to heaven, O heavenly good one.

children.text: ā tvā grāvā vadann iha somī ghoṣeṇa yacchatu
children.translated_text: Let the pressing-stone, speaking here, direct you with the soma-voice.

children.text: divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
children.translated_text: From the rule of that heaven, go to heaven, O heavenly good one.

children.text: atrā vi nemir eṣām urāṃ na dhūnute vṛkaḥ
children.translated_text: Here the rim of their wheel shakes, as a wolf shakes a sheep.

children.text: divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
children.translated_text: From the rule of that heaven, go to heaven, O heavenly good one.

children.text: ā tvā kaṇvā ihāvase havante vājasātaye
children.translated_text: The <s>Kaṇvas</s> call you here for aid, for the winning of the prize.

children.text: divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
children.translated_text: From the rule of that heaven, go to heaven, O heavenly good one.

children.text: dadhāmi te sutānāṃ vṛṣṇe na pūrvapāyyam
children.translated_text: For you, the bull, I set down the first drinking of the pressed soma.

children.text: divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
children.translated_text: From the rule of that heaven, go to heaven, O heavenly good one.

children.text: smatpurandhir na ā gahi viśvatodhīr na ūtaye
children.translated_text: Come to us, mindful of us, with thought turned every way, for help.

children.text: divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
children.translated_text: From the rule of that heaven, go to heaven, O heavenly good one.

children.text: ā no yāhi mahemate sahasrote śatāmagha
children.translated_text: Come to us, great-minded one, with thousandfold aid, bountiful with hundreds.

children.text: divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
children.translated_text: From the rule of that heaven, go to heaven, O heavenly good one.

children.text: ā tvā hotā manurhito devatrā vakṣad īḍyaḥ
children.translated_text: The adorable <s>Hotṛ</s>, set in place by <s>Manu</s>, shall convey you among the gods.

children.text: divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
children.translated_text: From the rule of that heaven, go to heaven, O heavenly good one.

children.text: ā tvā madacyutā harī śyenam pakṣeva vakṣataḥ
children.translated_text: Let the two bay steeds, letting exhilaration flow, carry you like wings carrying a falcon.

children.text: divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
children.translated_text: From the rule of that heaven, go to heaven, O heavenly good one.

children.text: ā yāhy arya ā pari svāhā somasya pītaye
children.translated_text: Come here, O noble one, all around, with svāhā, for the drinking of soma.

children.text: divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
children.translated_text: From the rule of that heaven, go to heaven, O heavenly good one.

children.text: ā no yāhy upaśruty uktheṣu raṇayā iha
children.translated_text: Come to us, hearing us nearby; take delight here in the hymns.

children.text: divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
children.translated_text: From the rule of that heaven, go to heaven, O heavenly good one.

children.text: sarūpair ā su no gahi sambhṛtaiḥ sambhṛtāśvaḥ
children.translated_text: Come well to us with those of like form, with gathered ones, you whose horses are gathered.

children.text: divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
children.translated_text: From the heaven of that ruler go to heaven, O <s>Divāvasu</s>.

children.text: ā yāhi parvatebhyaḥ samudrasyādhi viṣṭapaḥ
children.translated_text: Come here from the mountains, from the surface of the ocean.

children.text: divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
children.translated_text: From the heaven of that ruler go to heaven, O <s>Divāvasu</s>.

children.text: ā no gavyāny aśvyā sahasrā śūra dardṛhi
children.translated_text: Bring open for us thousands rich in cows and horses, O hero.

children.text: divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
children.translated_text: From the heaven of that ruler go to heaven, O <s>Divāvasu</s>.

children.text: ā naḥ sahasraśo bharāyutāni śatāni ca
children.translated_text: Bring to us thousands upon thousands, and tens of thousands and hundreds.

children.text: divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
children.translated_text: From the heaven of that ruler go to heaven, O <s>Divāvasu</s>.

children.text: ā yad indraś ca dadvahe sahasraṃ vasurociṣaḥ
children.translated_text: When we receive together with <s>Indra</s> a thousandfold treasure, shining with goods,

children.text: ojiṣṭham aśvyam paśum ||
children.translated_text: the mightiest horse-rich herd.

children.text: ya ṛjrā vātaraṃhaso 'ruṣāso raghuṣyadaḥ
children.translated_text: Those straight-rushing, wind-swift, ruddy ones, granting quick movement,
