children.text: bhrājante sūryā iva ||
children.translated_text: shine like suns.

children.text: pārāvatasya rātiṣu dravaccakreṣv āśuṣu
children.translated_text: In the gifts of <s>Pārāvata</s>, on swift running wheels,

children.text: tiṣṭhaṃ vanasya madhya ā ||
children.translated_text: stand here in the middle of the wood.

children.text: Chapter 655
agninendreṇa varuṇena viṣṇunādityai rudrair vasubhiḥ sacābhuvā
children.translated_text: Together with <s>Agni</s>, <s>Indra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the <s>Ādityas</s>, the <s>Rudras</s>, and the <s>Vasus</s>, as companions,

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: in shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, drink the soma, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: viśvābhir dhībhir bhuvanena vājinā divā pṛthivyādribhiḥ sacābhuvā
children.translated_text: With all inspired thoughts, with the living world and prize-winning power, with heaven, earth, and the mountains as companions,

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: in shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, drink the soma, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: viśvair devais tribhir ekādaśair ihādbhir marudbhir bhṛgubhiḥ sacābhuvā
children.translated_text: Together here with all the gods, with the three times eleven, with the waters, the <s>Maruts</s>, and the <s>Bhṛgus</s> as companions,

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: in shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, drink the soma, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: juṣethāṃ yajñam bodhataṃ havasya me viśveha devau savanāva gacchatam
children.translated_text: Accept the sacrifice; awaken to my invocation; come, O all-present gods, to the soma-pressings.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ceṣaṃ no voﾱham aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, bring us refreshment, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: stomaṃ juṣethāṃ yuvaśeva kanyanāṃ viśveha devau savanāva gacchatam
children.translated_text: Accept the hymn as young men accept maidens; come, O all-present gods, to the soma-pressings.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ceṣaṃ no voﾱham aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, bring us refreshment, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: giro juṣethām adhvaraṃ juṣethāṃ viśveha devau savanāva gacchatam
children.translated_text: Accept the songs; accept the rite; come, O all-present gods, to the soma-pressings.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ceṣaṃ no voﾱham aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, bring us refreshment, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: hāridraveva patatho vaned upa somaṃ sutam mahiṣevāva gacchathaḥ
children.translated_text: Like two yellow birds you fly toward the wood; like two buffaloes you come to the pressed soma.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca trir vartir yātam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, come by the threefold course, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: haṃsāv iva patatho adhvagāv iva somaṃ sutam mahiṣevāva gacchathaḥ
children.translated_text: Like two geese, like two wayfarers, you fly; like two buffaloes you come to the pressed soma.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca trir vartir yātam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, come by the threefold course, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: śyenāv iva patatho havyadātaye somaṃ sutam mahiṣevāva gacchathaḥ
children.translated_text: Like two falcons you fly for the giving of oblation; like two buffaloes you come to the pressed soma.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca trir vartir yātam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, come by the threefold course, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: pibataṃ ca tṛpṇutaṃ cā ca gacchatam prajāṃ ca dhattaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattam
children.translated_text: Drink, be satisfied, and come here; bestow progeny, and bestow wealth.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa corjaṃ no dhattam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, bestow nourishment on us, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: jayataṃ ca pra stutaṃ ca pra cāvatam prajāṃ ca dhattaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattam
children.translated_text: Win victory, further the praise, and protect us; bestow progeny, and bestow wealth.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa corjaṃ no dhattam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, bestow nourishment on us, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: hataṃ ca śatrūn yatataṃ ca mitriṇaḥ prajāṃ ca dhattaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattam
children.translated_text: Strike down enemies and attend to friends; bestow progeny, and bestow wealth.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa corjaṃ no dhattam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, bestow nourishment on us, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: mitrāvaruṇavantā uta dharmavantā marutvantā jaritur gacchatho havam
children.translated_text: Having <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, having dharma, having the <s>Maruts</s>, you come to the singer's call.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cādityair yātam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, come with the <s>Ādityas</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: aṅgirasvantā uta viṣṇuvantā marutvantā jaritur gacchatho havam
children.translated_text: Having the <s>Aṅgirases</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, having the <s>Maruts</s>, you come to the singer's call.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cādityair yātam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, come with the <s>Ādityas</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: ṛbhumantā vṛṣaṇā vājavantā marutvantā jaritur gacchatho havam
children.translated_text: Having the <s>Ṛbhus</s>, O bulls, rich in prizes and accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, you come to the singer's call.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cādityair yātam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, come with the <s>Ādityas</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: brahma jinvatam uta jinvataṃ dhiyo hataṃ rakṣāṃsi sedhatam amīvāḥ
children.translated_text: Quicken the sacred formulation, and quicken the thoughts; strike down the demons, drive away diseases.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ sunvato aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, drink the soma of the soma-presser, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: kṣatraṃ jinvatam uta jinvataṃ nṝn hataṃ rakṣāṃsi sedhatam amīvāḥ
children.translated_text: Quicken sovereign power, and quicken men; strike down the demons, drive away diseases.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ sunvato aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, drink the soma of the soma-presser, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: dhenūr jinvatam uta jinvataṃ viśo hataṃ rakṣāṃsi sedhatam amīvāḥ
children.translated_text: Quicken the milch cows, and quicken the clans; strike down the demons, drive away diseases.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ sunvato aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, drink the soma of the soma-presser, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: atrer iva śṛṇutam pūrvyastutiṃ śyāvāśvasya sunvato madacyutā
children.translated_text: Hear the ancient praise, as you heard <s>Atri</s>'s, of <s>Śyāvāśva</s> who presses soma, O you whose exhilaration does not fail.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cāśvinā tiroahnyam ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>, through the day.

children.text: sargāṁ iva sṛjataṃ suṣṭutīr upa śyāvāśvasya sunvato madacyutā
children.translated_text: Like streams let loose, send forth the well-praised songs toward <s>Śyāvāśva</s> who presses soma, O you whose exhilaration does not fail.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cāśvinā tiroahnyam ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>, through the day.

children.text: raśmīṃr iva yacchatam adhvarāṁ upa śyāvāśvasya sunvato madacyutā
children.translated_text: Like reins, guide them toward the rites for <s>Śyāvāśva</s> who presses soma, O you whose exhilaration does not fail.

children.text: sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cāśvinā tiroahnyam ||
children.translated_text: In shared delight with <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Sūrya</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>, through the day.

children.text: arvāg rathaṃ ni yacchatam pibataṃ somyam madhu
children.translated_text: Turn your chariot hither; drink the soma-honey.

children.text: ā yātam aśvinā gatam avasyur vām ahaṃ huve dhattaṃ ratnāni dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: Come, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come; I, desiring aid, call you; bestow treasures on the worshipper.

children.text: namovāke prasthite adhvare narā vivakṣaṇasya pītaye
children.translated_text: When the reverent speech has gone forth in the rite, O men, for the drinking by the eloquent one,

children.text: ā yātam aśvinā gatam avasyur vām ahaṃ huve dhattaṃ ratnāni dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come; I, desiring aid, call you; bestow treasures on the worshipper.

children.text: svāhākṛtasya tṛmpataṃ sutasya devāv andhasaḥ
children.translated_text: Be satisfied with the svāhā-offered, pressed drink, O two gods.

children.text: ā yātam aśvinā gatam avasyur vām ahaṃ huve dhattaṃ ratnāni dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: Come, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come; I, desiring aid, call you; bestow treasures on the worshipper.

children.text: Chapter 656
avitāsi sunvato vṛktabarhiṣaḥ pibā somam madāya kaṃ śatakrato
children.translated_text: You are the protector of the soma-presser with the strewn barhis; drink soma for exhilaration, O <s>Śatakratu</s>.

children.text: yaṃ te bhāgam adhārayan viśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ sam apsujin marutvāṁ indra satpate ||
children.translated_text: The portion which they assigned to you, as you overcome all battles, wide in speed, winner in the waters, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, lord of the good.

children.text: prāva stotāram maghavann ava tvām pibā somam madāya kaṃ śatakrato
children.translated_text: Protect the singer, O <s>Maghavan</s>; protect yourself; drink soma for exhilaration, O <s>Śatakratu</s>.

children.text: yaṃ te bhāgam adhārayan viśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ sam apsujin marutvāṁ indra satpate ||
children.translated_text: That portion of yours which all have assigned: overcoming battles, far-ranging in speed, victorious together in the waters, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, lord of the true.

children.text: ūrjā devāṁ avasy ojasā tvām pibā somam madāya kaṃ śatakrato
children.translated_text: With nourishment, with aid, with strength for the gods, drink the <s>soma</s> for exhilaration, O <s>Śatakratu</s>.

children.text: yaṃ te bhāgam adhārayan viśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ sam apsujin marutvāṁ indra satpate ||
children.translated_text: That portion of yours which all have assigned: overcoming battles, far-ranging in speed, victorious together in the waters, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, lord of the true.

children.text: janitā divo janitā pṛthivyāḥ pibā somam madāya kaṃ śatakrato
children.translated_text: Begetter of heaven, begetter of earth, drink the <s>soma</s> for exhilaration, O <s>Śatakratu</s>.

children.text: yaṃ te bhāgam adhārayan viśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ sam apsujin marutvāṁ indra satpate ||
children.translated_text: That portion of yours which all have assigned: overcoming battles, far-ranging in speed, victorious together in the waters, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, lord of the true.

children.text: janitāśvānāṃ janitā gavām asi pibā somam madāya kaṃ śatakrato
children.translated_text: You are the begetter of horses and the begetter of cows; drink the <s>soma</s> for exhilaration, O <s>Śatakratu</s>.

children.text: yaṃ te bhāgam adhārayan viśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ sam apsujin marutvāṁ indra satpate ||
children.translated_text: That portion of yours which all have assigned: overcoming battles, far-ranging in speed, victorious together in the waters, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, lord of the true.

children.text: atrīṇāṃ stomam adrivo mahas kṛdhi pibā somam madāya kaṃ śatakrato
children.translated_text: O stone-wielder, make great the hymn of the <s>Atris</s>; drink the <s>soma</s> for exhilaration, O <s>Śatakratu</s>.

children.text: yaṃ te bhāgam adhārayan viśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ sam apsujin marutvāṁ indra satpate ||
children.translated_text: That portion of yours which all have assigned: overcoming battles, far-ranging in speed, victorious together in the waters, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, lord of the true.

children.text: śyāvāśvasya sunvatas tathā śṛṇu yathāśṛṇor atreḥ karmāṇi kṛṇvataḥ
children.translated_text: Hear <s>Śyāvāśva</s>, who presses soma, just as you heard <s>Atri</s> when he performed the rites.

children.text: pra trasadasyum āvitha tvam eka in nṛṣāhya indra brahmāṇi vardhayan ||
children.translated_text: You aided <s>Trasadasyu</s>; you alone are conquering among men, O <s>Indra</s>, increasing the sacred formulations.

children.text: Chapter 657
predam brahma vṛtratūryeṣv āvitha pra sunvataḥ śacīpata indra viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: You have furthered this sacred formulation in the battles with <s>Vṛtra</s>; further the soma-presser, O <s>Indra Śacīpati</s>, with all aids.

children.text: mādhyandinasya savanasya vṛtrahann anedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: At the midday pressing, O <s>Vṛtrahan</s>, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the <s>soma</s>.

children.text: sehāna ugra pṛtanā abhi druhaḥ śacīpata indra viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Overcoming battles and hostile attacks, O fierce one, O <s>Indra Śacīpati</s>, with all aids,

children.text: mādhyandinasya savanasya vṛtrahann anedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: at the midday pressing, O <s>Vṛtrahan</s>, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the <s>soma</s>.

children.text: ekarāﾱ asya bhuvanasya rājasi śacīpata indra viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: As sole king you rule this world, O <s>Indra Śacīpati</s>, with all aids,

children.text: mādhyandinasya savanasya vṛtrahann anedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: at the midday pressing, O <s>Vṛtrahan</s>, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the <s>soma</s>.

children.text: sasthāvānā yavayasi tvam eka icchacīpata indra viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: You alone drive away those who have taken their stand, O <s>Śacīpati</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, with all aids,

children.text: mādhyandinasya savanasya vṛtrahann anedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: at the midday pressing, O <s>Vṛtrahan</s>, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the <s>soma</s>.

children.text: kṣemasya ca prayujaś ca tvam īśiṣe śacīpata indra viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: You have command over security and active endeavor, O <s>Śacīpati</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, with all aids,

children.text: mādhyandinasya savanasya vṛtrahann anedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: at the midday pressing, O <s>Vṛtrahan</s>, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the <s>soma</s>.

children.text: kṣatrāya tvam avasi na tvam āvitha śacīpata indra viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: You aid us for lordly power; you have protected us, O <s>Śacīpati</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, with all aids,

children.text: mādhyandinasya savanasya vṛtrahann anedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: at the midday pressing, O <s>Vṛtrahan</s>, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the <s>soma</s>.

children.text: śyāvāśvasya rebhatas tathā śṛṇu yathāśṛṇor atreḥ karmāṇi kṛṇvataḥ
children.translated_text: Hear <s>Śyāvāśva</s> as he chants, just as you heard <s>Atri</s> when he performed the rites.

children.text: pra trasadasyum āvitha tvam eka in nṛṣāhya indra kṣatrāṇi vardhayan ||
children.translated_text: You aided <s>Trasadasyu</s>; you alone are conquering among men, O <s>Indra</s>, increasing royal powers.

children.text: Chapter 658
yajñasya hi stha ṛtvijā sasnī vājeṣu karmasu
children.translated_text: For you two are the ritual priests of the sacrifice, winners in contests and ritual works;

children.text: indrāgnī tasya bodhatam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indrāgnī</s>, take notice of it.

children.text: tośāsā rathayāvānā vṛtrahaṇāparājitā
children.translated_text: Delighting, riding in the chariot, slayers of <s>Vṛtra</s>, unconquered,

children.text: indrāgnī tasya bodhatam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indrāgnī</s>, take notice of it.

children.text: idaṃ vām madiram madhv adhukṣann adribhir naraḥ
children.translated_text: Men have milked this exhilarating honey-sweet drink for you with the pressing stones;

children.text: indrāgnī tasya bodhatam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indrāgnī</s>, take notice of it.

children.text: juṣethāṃ yajñam iṣṭaye sutaṃ somaṃ sadhastutī
children.translated_text: Enjoy the sacrifice for refreshment, the pressed <s>soma</s>, both praised together;

children.text: indrāgnī ā gataṃ narā ||
children.translated_text: come here, O heroic <s>Indrāgnī</s>.

children.text: imā juṣethāṃ savanā yebhir havyāny ūhathuḥ
children.translated_text: Enjoy these pressings by which you carry the oblations;

children.text: indrāgnī ā gataṃ narā ||
children.translated_text: come here, O heroic <s>Indrāgnī</s>.

children.text: imāṃ gāyatravartaniṃ juṣethāṃ suṣṭutim mama
children.translated_text: Enjoy this my well-made praise moving in the <s>Gāyatra</s> measure;

children.text: indrāgnī ā gataṃ narā ||
children.translated_text: come here, O heroic <s>Indrāgnī</s>.

children.text: prātaryāvabhir ā gataṃ devebhir jenyāvasū
children.translated_text: Come with the gods who travel in the morning, you two whose goods are victorious,

children.text: indrāgnī somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indrāgnī</s>, for the drinking of <s>soma</s>.

children.text: śyāvāśvasya sunvato 'trīṇāṃ śṛṇutaṃ havam
children.translated_text: Hear the call of <s>Śyāvāśva</s>, the soma-presser, of the <s>Atris</s>,

children.text: indrāgnī somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indrāgnī</s>, for the drinking of <s>soma</s>.

children.text: evā vām ahva ūtaye yathāhuvanta medhirāḥ
children.translated_text: Thus have I called you for aid, as the wise ones called you,

children.text: indrāgnī somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indrāgnī</s>, for the drinking of <s>soma</s>.

children.text: āhaṃ sarasvatīvator indrāgnyor avo vṛṇe
children.translated_text: I choose the aid of <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, who are attended by <s>Sarasvatī</s>,

children.text: yābhyāṃ gāyatram ṛcyate ||
children.translated_text: by whom the <s>Gāyatra</s> chant is recited.

children.text: Chapter 659
agnim astoṣy ṛgmiyam agnim īﾱā yajadhyai
children.translated_text: I shall praise <s>Agni</s>, worthy of a ṛc; I call upon <s>Agni</s> for worship.

children.text: agnir devāṁ anaktu na ubhe hi vidathe kavir antaś carati dūtyaṃ nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s> favor the gods for us, for the seer moves as messenger in both assemblies; let the others be crushed in the contest.

children.text: ny agne navyasā vacas tanūṣu śaṃsam eṣām
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, with a newer utterance set down the praise among their persons.

children.text: ny arātī rarāvṇāṃ viśvā aryo arātīr ito yucchantv āmuro nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: Drive down the hostilities of the roaring ones; let all the enemy's hatreds turn away from here; let the hostile ones be crushed in the contest.

children.text: agne manmāni tubhyaṃ kaṃ ghṛtaṃ na juhva āsani
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, may the thoughts for you be like ghee in the ladle, in the mouth.

children.text: sa deveṣu pra cikiddhi tvaṃ hy asi pūrvyaḥ śivo dūto vivasvato nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: Make that known among the gods, for you are the ancient, auspicious messenger of <s>Vivasvat</s>; let the others be crushed in the contest.

children.text: tat tad agnir vayo dadhe yathā yathā kṛpaṇyati
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> bestows vitality again and again, according as he shows favor.

children.text: ūrjāhutir vasūnāṃ śaṃ ca yoś ca mayo dadhe viśvasyai devahūtyai nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: As an oblation of nourishment, he has set wealth, peace, welfare, and delight for the calling of all the gods; let the others be crushed in the contest.

children.text: sa ciketa sahīyasāgniś citreṇa karmaṇā
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has perceived with a stronger and brilliant work.

children.text: sa hotā śaśvatīnāṃ dakṣiṇābhir abhīvṛta inoti ca pratīvyaṃ nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: He, the <s>Hotṛ</s> of perpetual rites, surrounded by gifts, advances and meets what comes against him; let the others be crushed in the contest.

children.text: agnir jātā devānām agnir veda martānām apīcyam
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is born among the gods; <s>Agni</s> knows the hidden thing of mortals.

children.text: agniḥ sa draviṇodā agnir dvārā vy ūrṇute svāhuto navīyasā nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is the giver of treasure; <s>Agni</s> opens the doors, well-invoked by the newer call; let the others be crushed in the contest.

children.text: agnir deveṣu saṃvasuḥ sa vikṣu yajñiyāsv ā
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> dwells as wealth among the gods and among the sacrificial clans.

children.text: sa mudā kāvyā puru viśvam bhūmeva puṣyati devo deveṣu yajñiyo nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: With joy he fosters many poetic inspirations, the whole world as the earth does; a god, sacrificial among the gods, let the others be crushed in the contest.

children.text: yo agniḥ saptamānuṣaḥ śrito viśveṣu sindhuṣu
children.translated_text: The <s>Agni</s> who belongs to the seven human tribes, established among all the rivers,

children.text: tam āganma tripastyam mandhātur dasyuhantamam agniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyaṃ nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: to him we have come, the three-seated one, <s>Mandhātṛ</s>'s best slayer of <s>Dasyus</s>, <s>Agni</s>, ancient in the sacrifices; let the others be crushed in the contest.

children.text: agnis trīṇi tridhātūny ā kṣeti vidathā kaviḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, the seer, dwells in the three threefold realms at the sacred assemblies.

children.text: sa trīṃr ekādaśāṁ iha yakṣac ca piprayac ca no vipro dūtaḥ pariṣkṛto nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: As the inspired messenger, well adorned, may he worship and gladden the three times eleven here for us; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: tvaṃ no agna āyuṣu tvaṃ deveṣu pūrvya vasva eka irajyasi
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, rule over our lifetimes; you, ancient among the gods, alone govern wealth.

children.text: tvām āpaḥ parisrutaḥ pari yanti svasetavo nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: The flowing waters, with their own good paths, go around you; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: Chapter 660
indrāgnī yuvaṃ su naḥ sahantā dāsatho rayim
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra-Agni</s>, you two, as overpowering allies, gladly give us wealth.

children.text: yena dṛﾱhā samatsv ā vīﾱu cit sāhiṣīmahy agnir vaneva vāta in nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: With it may we overcome firm foes in battles, even the strong; <s>Agni</s> is like the wind among forests; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: nahi vāṃ vavrayāmahe 'thendram id yajāmahe śaviṣṭhaṃ nṛṇāṃ naram
children.translated_text: For we do not turn away from you two; rather we sacrifice to <s>Indra</s>, the mightiest man among men.

children.text: sa naḥ kadācid arvatā gamad ā vājasātaye gamad ā medhasātaye nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: May he come to us at some time with horses for the winning of prize; may he come for the winning of inspired wisdom; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: tā hi madhyam bharāṇām indrāgnī adhikṣitaḥ
children.translated_text: For these two, <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, are set over the middle of the offerings.

children.text: tā u kavitvanā kavī pṛcchyamānā sakhīyate saṃ dhītam aśnutaṃ narā nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: Those two sages, through poetic skill, being asked for friendship, partake of the composed thought, O men; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: abhy arca nabhākavad indrāgnī yajasā girā
children.translated_text: Praise <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, as <s>Nabhāka</s> did, with worshipful song.

children.text: yayor viśvam idaṃ jagad iyaṃ dyauḥ pṛthivī mahy upasthe bibhṛto vasu nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: In the lap of those two this whole moving world, this heaven and broad earth, bear wealth; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: pra brahmāṇi nabhākavad indrāgnibhyām irajyata
children.translated_text: Set the sacred utterances in motion, as <s>Nabhāka</s> did, for <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: yā saptabudhnam arṇavaṃ jihmabāram aporṇuta indra īśāna ojasā nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: By his might, <s>Indra</s>, the ruling one, uncovered the seven-bottomed ocean with its crooked barrier; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: api vṛśca purāṇavad vratater iva guṣpitam ojo dāsasya dambhaya
children.translated_text: Cut away, as of old, what is tangled like the thicket of a creeper; crush the strength of the <s>Dāsa</s>.

children.text: vayaṃ tad asya saṃbhṛtaṃ vasv indreṇa vi bhajemahi nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: May we divide among ourselves that gathered wealth of his with <s>Indra</s>; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: yad indrāgnī janā ime vihvayante tanā girā
children.translated_text: When these people, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, challenge us with bodily force and speech,

children.text: asmākebhir nṛbhir vayaṃ sāsahyāma pṛtanyato vanuyāma vanuṣyato nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: then with our own men may we overpower the attackers and conquer those who would conquer; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: yā nu śvetāv avo diva uccarāta upa dyubhiḥ
children.translated_text: Those two white ones now have risen from heaven, coming forth with heavenly lights.

children.text: indrāgnyor anu vratam uhānā yanti sindhavo yān sīm bandhād amuñcatāṃ nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: Following the ordinance of <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, the rivers go bearing it, those whom the two released from bondage; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: pūrvīṣ ṭa indropamātayaḥ pūrvīr uta praśastayaḥ sūno hinvasya harivaḥ
children.translated_text: Many are your aids like <s>Indra</s>'s, many too your praises, O son of the impeller, bearer of bay steeds.

children.text: vasvo vīrasyāpṛco yā nu sādhanta no dhiyo nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: Now may the thoughts that win the wealth of the heroic one, not withheld, accomplish their aim for us; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: taṃ śiśītā suvṛktibhis tveṣaṃ satvānam ṛgmiyam
children.translated_text: Sharpen him with well-turned hymns, the blazing, vigorous one, worthy of the ṛc.

children.text: uto nu cid ya ojasā śuṣṇasyāṇḍāni bhedati jeṣat svarvatīr apo nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: And now indeed he who by might breaks the eggs of <s>Śuṣṇa</s> shall win the sun-filled waters; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: taṃ śiśītā svadhvaraṃ satyaṃ satvānam ṛtviyam
children.translated_text: Sharpen him, the true and vigorous one, having good sacrifice and fitting the season.

children.text: uto nu cid ya ohata āṇḍā śuṣṇasya bhedaty ajaiḥ svarvatīr apo nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: And now indeed he who strikes breaks the eggs of <s>Śuṣṇa</s> with unconquered force and has won the sun-filled waters; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: evendrāgnibhyām pitṛvan navīyo mandhātṛvad aṅgirasvad avāci
children.translated_text: Thus a newer utterance has been spoken for <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, as by the fathers, as by <s>Mandhātṛ</s>, as by <s>Aṅgiras</s>.

children.text: tridhātunā śarmaṇā pātam asmān vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: With threefold shelter protect us; may we become lords of riches.

children.text: Chapter 661
asmā ū ṣu prabhūtaye varuṇāya marudbhyo 'rcā viduṣṭarebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Now sing, for our abundance, to <s>Varuṇa</s> and to the <s>Maruts</s>, the wiser ones.

children.text: yo dhītā mānuṣāṇām paśvo gā iva rakṣati nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: He guards the thoughts of human beings as a herdsman guards cattle, cows; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: tam ū ṣu samanā girā pitṝṇāṃ ca manmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: Praise him now with one-minded song and with the hymns of the fathers,

children.text: nābhākasya praśastibhir yaḥ sindhūnām upodaye saptasvasā sa madhyamo nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: with the praises of <s>Nābhāka</s>; he who, at the rising of the rivers, is the middle one among the seven sisters; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: sa kṣapaḥ pari ṣasvaje ny usro māyayā dadhe sa viśvam pari darśataḥ
children.translated_text: He has embraced the nights; by his art he has set down the dawns; he is visible around the whole world.

children.text: tasya venīr anu vratam uṣas tisro avardhayan nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: Following his ordinance, the three dawns increased the braided streams; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: yaḥ kakubho nidhārayaḥ pṛthivyām adhi darśataḥ
children.translated_text: He who fixed the quarters upon the earth is visible.

children.text: sa mātā pūrvyam padaṃ tad varuṇasya saptyaṃ sa hi gopā iveryo nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: He measured out that ancient station, that course of <s>Varuṇa</s>; for he is a herdsman to be chosen; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: yo dhartā bhuvanānāṃ ya usrāṇām apīcyā veda nāmāni guhyā
children.translated_text: He who is the supporter of beings, who knows the hidden secret names of the bright cows,

children.text: sa kaviḥ kāvyā puru rūpaṃ dyaur iva puṣyati nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: that poet, by poetic powers, nourishes many forms like heaven; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: yasmin viśvāni kāvyā cakre nābhir iva śritā
children.translated_text: In him all poetic powers have been set, like spokes in a nave.

children.text: tritaṃ jūtī saparyata vraje gāvo na saṃyuje yuje aśvāṁ ayukṣata nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: Serve <s>Trita</s> with impelling aid; as cows in the pen come to the yoke, they yoked the horses to the harness; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: ya āsv atka āśaye viśvā jātāny eṣām
children.translated_text: He who lies in these waters, in whom all their births are contained,

children.text: pari dhāmāni marmṛśad varuṇasya puro gaye viśve devā anu vrataṃ nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: has touched all the abodes around; in the song before <s>Varuṇa</s>, all the gods follow the ordinance; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: sa samudro apīcyas turo dyām iva rohati ni yad āsu yajur dadhe
children.translated_text: He, the hidden ocean, swift, rises like heaven when he has set the sacrificial formula among these waters.

children.text: sa māyā arcinā padāstṛṇān nākam āruhan nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: He, by his art, with flaming foot, spreading upward, climbed the vault of heaven; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: yasya śvetā vicakṣaṇā tisro bhūmīr adhikṣitaḥ
children.translated_text: His white, discerning powers have taken possession of the three earths.

children.text: trir uttarāṇi papratur varuṇasya dhruvaṃ sadaḥ sa saptānām irajyati nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: They filled the three upper realms, the fixed seat of <s>Varuṇa</s>; he rules over the seven; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: yaḥ śvetāṁ adhinirṇijaś cakre kṛṣṇāṁ anu vratā
children.translated_text: He who made the white one with shining garment according to the ordinances made the black one too.

children.text: sa dhāma pūrvyam mame ya skambhena vi rodasī ajo na dyām adhārayan nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: He measured out that ancient dwelling, he who with a prop held apart the two worlds, like the unborn one holding up heaven; let the others be broken in the contest.

children.text: Chapter 662
astabhnād dyām asuro viśvavedā amimīta varimāṇam pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: The all-knowing <s>Asura</s> propped up heaven and measured out the breadth of the earth.

children.text: āsīdad viśvā bhuvanāni samrāḍ viśvet tāni varuṇasya vratāni ||
children.translated_text: The sovereign sat amid all beings; all these are the ordinances of <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: evā vandasva varuṇam bṛhantaṃ namasyā dhīram amṛtasya gopām
children.translated_text: Thus praise great <s>Varuṇa</s>; worship the wise guardian of immortality.

children.text: sa naḥ śarma trivarūthaṃ vi yaṃsat pātaṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī upasthe ||
children.translated_text: May he extend to us shelter with threefold protection; protect us, O <s>Heaven-and-Earth</s>, in your lap.

children.text: imāṃ dhiyaṃ śikṣamāṇasya deva kratuṃ dakṣaṃ varuṇa saṃ śiśādhi
children.translated_text: O god <s>Varuṇa</s>, strengthen this thought, the will and discernment of the one who is being instructed.

children.text: yayāti viśvā duritā tarema sutarmāṇam adhi nāvaṃ ruhema ||
children.translated_text: Through it may we pass beyond all hardships; may we mount the ship that carries safely across.

children.text: ā vāṃ grāvāṇo aśvinā dhībhir viprā acucyavuḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, the inspired pressing-stones, stirred by sacred thoughts, have moved toward you.

children.text: nāsatyā somapītaye nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, for the drinking of soma, let all the others give way together.

children.text: yathā vām atrir aśvinā gīrbhir vipro ajohavīt
children.translated_text: Just as the inspired sage <s>Atri</s> called upon you with songs, O <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: nāsatyā somapītaye nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, for the drinking of soma, let all the others give way together.

children.text: evā vām ahva ūtaye yathāhuvanta medhirāḥ
children.translated_text: So I have called you for aid, as the wise ones called you.

children.text: nāsatyā somapītaye nabhantām anyake same ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, for the drinking of soma, let all the others give way together.

children.text: Chapter 663
ime viprasya vedhaso 'gner astṛtayajvanaḥ
children.translated_text: These songs and praises of the inspired, skillful poet, the sacrificer whose rites are not overthrown,

children.text: gira stomāsa īrate ||
children.translated_text: are set in motion for <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: asmai te pratiharyate jātavedo vicarṣaṇe
children.translated_text: For you, who are to be welcomed, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, O watcher of men,

children.text: agne janāmi suṣṭutim ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, I generate a fair praise.

children.text: ārokā iva ghed aha tigmā agne tava tviṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Like bright spaces indeed are your sharp gleams, O <s>Agni</s>;

children.text: dadbhir vanāni bapsati ||
children.translated_text: with his teeth he devours the forests.

children.text: harayo dhūmaketavo vātajūtā upa dyavi
children.translated_text: The tawny, smoke-bannered fires, driven by the wind, up toward heaven

children.text: yatante vṛthag agnayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: strive separately.

children.text: ete tye vṛthag agnaya iddhāsaḥ sam adṛkṣata
children.translated_text: Those separate fires, once kindled, have been seen together,

children.text: uṣasām iva ketavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like the banners of the dawns.

children.text: kṛṣṇā rajāṃsi patsutaḥ prayāṇe jātavedasaḥ
children.translated_text: Dark are the realms beneath the feet of <s>Jātavedas</s> on his march,

children.text: agnir yad rodhati kṣami ||
children.translated_text: when <s>Agni</s> grows upon the ground.

children.text: dhāsiṃ kṛṇvāna oṣadhīr bapsad agnir na vāyati
children.translated_text: Making the plants his food, <s>Agni</s> devours them and does not tire,

children.text: punar yan taruṇīr api ||
children.translated_text: even when they grow young again.

children.text: jihvābhir aha nannamad arciṣā jañjaṇābhavan
children.translated_text: With his tongues he has bent them down; with flame he has made them crackle.

children.text: agnir vaneṣu rocate ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> shines in the forests.

children.text: apsv agne sadhiṣ ṭava sauṣadhīr anu rudhyase
children.translated_text: In the waters, O <s>Agni</s>, is your seat; along the plants you are enclosed.

children.text: garbhe sañ jāyase punaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In the womb you are born again.

children.text: ud agne tava tad ghṛtād arcī rocata āhutam
children.translated_text: That flame of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, rises up from the ghee, the oblation blazing forth,

children.text: niṃsānaṃ juhvo mukhe ||
children.translated_text: settling in the mouth of the offering-ladle.

children.text: ukṣānnāya vaśānnāya somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase
children.translated_text: For the bull-fed one, the cow-fed one, the soma-backed, skillful one,

children.text: stomair vidhemāgnaye ||
children.translated_text: let us serve <s>Agni</s> with praises.

children.text: uta tvā namasā vayaṃ hotar vareṇyakrato
children.translated_text: And with reverence, O <s>Hotṛ</s> of excellent resolve,

children.text: agne samidbhir īmahe ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, we seek you with fuel-sticks.

children.text: uta tvā bhṛguvacchuce manuṣvad agna āhuta
children.translated_text: And you, O <s>Agni</s>, bright one, invoked like <s>Bhṛgu</s>, kindled like <s>Manu</s>,

children.text: aṅgirasvaddhavāmahe ||
children.translated_text: we call like <s>Aṅgiras</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ hy agne agninā vipro vipreṇa san satā
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Agni</s>, as a sage with sagehood, as one truly existing,

children.text: sakhā sakhyā samidhyase ||
children.translated_text: are kindled by fire, as a friend by friendship.

children.text: sa tvaṃ viprāya dāśuṣe rayiṃ dehi sahasriṇam
children.translated_text: So give to the generous inspired man wealth in thousands,

children.text: agne vīravatīm iṣam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, and nourishment rich in heroes.

children.text: agne bhrātaḥ sahaskṛta rohidaśva śucivrata
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, brother, made mighty, red-horsed, pure in vow,

children.text: imaṃ stomaṃ juṣasva me ||
children.translated_text: take pleasure in this praise of mine.

children.text: uta tvāgne mama stuto vāśrāya pratiharyate
children.translated_text: And you, O <s>Agni</s>, praised by me, are welcomed for the lowing one;

children.text: goṣṭhaṃ gāva ivāśata ||
children.translated_text: the cows have come like cows to the stall.

children.text: tubhyaṃ tā aṅgirastama viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthak
children.translated_text: To you, best of the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, all fair settlements, each apart,

children.text: agne kāmāya yemire ||
children.translated_text: have come for desire, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: agniṃ dhībhir manīṣiṇo medhirāso vipaścitaḥ
children.translated_text: The thoughtful, wise, discerning inspired men

children.text: admasadyāya hinvire ||
children.translated_text: have urged <s>Agni</s> on to sit at the meal.

children.text: taṃ tvām ajmeṣu vājinaṃ tanvānā agne adhvaram
children.translated_text: Extending the rite in contests, O <s>Agni</s>, they praise you,

children.text: vahniṃ hotāram īﾱate ||
children.translated_text: the steed, the carrier, the <s>Hotṛ</s>.

children.text: purutrā hi sadṛṅṅ asi viśo viśvā anu prabhuḥ
children.translated_text: For in many places you are alike, lord over all peoples everywhere;

children.text: samatsu tvā havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: in battles we call upon you.

children.text: tam īﾱiṣva ya āhuto 'gnir vibhrājate ghṛtaiḥ
children.translated_text: Praise him who, when invoked, <s>Agni</s>, shines with ghee-offerings;

children.text: imaṃ naḥ śṛṇavaddhavam ||
children.translated_text: may he hear this call of ours.

children.text: taṃ tvā vayaṃ havāmahe śṛṇvantaṃ jātavedasam
children.translated_text: We call upon you, <s>Jātavedas</s>, who listens,

children.text: agne ghnantam apa dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, who strikes away the haters.

children.text: viśāṃ rājānam adbhutam adhyakṣaṃ dharmaṇām imam
children.translated_text: This wondrous king of the peoples, overseer of ordinances,

children.text: agnim īﾱe sa u śravat ||
children.translated_text: I praise as <s>Agni</s>; may he hear.

children.text: agniṃ viśvāyuvepasam maryaṃ na vājinaṃ hitam
children.translated_text: We speed <s>Agni</s>, all-life-stirring, set in place like a vigorous young man,

children.text: saptiṃ na vājayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: like a racing steed.

children.text: ghnan mṛdhrāṇy apa dviṣo dahan rakṣāṃsi viśvahā
children.translated_text: Striking down the contemptuous and the haters, burning the demons every day,

children.text: agne tigmena dīdihi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, shine with your sharp flame.

children.text: yaṃ tvā janāsa indhate manuṣvad aṅgirastama
children.translated_text: You whom people kindle in the manner of <s>Manu</s>, best of the <s>Aṅgirases</s>,

children.text: agne sa bodhi me vacaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, take heed of my word.

children.text: yad agne divijā asy apsujā vā sahaskṛta
children.translated_text: Since you are heaven-born, O <s>Agni</s>, or water-born, O mighty-made one,

children.text: taṃ tvā gīrbhir havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: we call upon you with songs.

children.text: tubhyaṃ ghet te janā ime viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthak
children.translated_text: To you indeed, to you, these peoples, all fair settlements each apart,

children.text: dhāsiṃ hinvanty attave ||
children.translated_text: drive food for you to eat.

children.text: te ghed agne svādhyo 'hā viśvā nṛcakṣasaḥ
children.translated_text: Then, O <s>Agni</s>, may we be those of good thought, day by day, all seeing men,

children.text: tarantaḥ syāma durgahā ||
children.translated_text: crossing beyond difficulties.

children.text: agnim mandram purupriyaṃ śīram pāvakaśociṣam
children.translated_text: With joyful hearts we seek <s>Agni</s>, delightful, much-loved, swift,

children.text: hṛdbhir mandrebhir īmahe ||
children.translated_text: with purifying flame.

children.text: sa tvam agne vibhāvasuḥ sṛjan sūryo na raśmibhiḥ
children.translated_text: So you, O <s>Agni</s>, O radiant wealth, releasing like the sun with its rays,

children.text: śardhan tamāṃsi jighnase ||
children.translated_text: break the darkness and strike it down.

children.text: tat te sahasva īmahe dātraṃ yan nopadasyati
children.translated_text: That gift of yours we seek, O mighty one, the gift that does not fail:

children.text: tvad agne vāryaṃ vasu ||
children.translated_text: from you, O <s>Agni</s>, desirable treasure.

children.text: Chapter 664
samidhāgniṃ duvasyata ghṛtair bodhayatātithim
children.translated_text: Honor <s>Agni</s> with kindling; awaken the guest with ghee.

children.text: āsmin havyā juhotana ||
children.translated_text: Pour the oblations into him.

children.text: agne stomaṃ juṣasva me vardhasvānena manmanā
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, take pleasure in my praise; grow strong through this thought.

children.text: prati sūktāni harya naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Welcome our hymns in return.

children.text: agniṃ dūtam puro dadhe havyavāham upa bruve
children.translated_text: I place <s>Agni</s> before me as messenger; I call near the carrier of oblations.

children.text: devāṁ ā sādayād iha ||
children.translated_text: May he seat the gods here.

children.text: ut te bṛhanto arcayaḥ samidhānasya dīdivaḥ
children.translated_text: Your great flames, as you are kindled and shining bright,

children.text: agne śukrāsa īrate ||
children.translated_text: rise up, O <s>Agni</s>, brilliant.

children.text: upa tvā juhvo mama ghṛtācīr yantu haryata
children.translated_text: Let my ghee-bearing ladles come near to you, delightful one;

children.text: agne havyā juṣasva naḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, take pleasure in our oblations.

children.text: mandraṃ hotāram ṛtvijaṃ citrabhānuṃ vibhāvasum
children.translated_text: I praise <s>Agni</s>, the delightful <s>Hotṛ</s>, the priest in due season, bright-shining, radiant with wealth;

children.text: agnim īﾱe sa u śravat ||
children.translated_text: may he hear.

children.text: pratnaṃ hotāram īḍyaṃ juṣṭam agniṃ kavikratum
children.translated_text: I praise ancient <s>Agni</s>, the laudable <s>Hotṛ</s>, the welcome one, wise in will,

children.text: adhvarāṇām abhiśriyam ||
children.translated_text: the ornament of the rites.

children.text: juṣāṇo aṅgirastamemā havyāny ānuṣak
children.translated_text: Taking pleasure, best of the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, in these oblations without interruption,

children.text: agne yajñaṃ naya ṛtuthā ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, lead the sacrifice according to the proper seasons.

children.text: samidhāna u santya śukraśoca ihā vaha
children.translated_text: Being kindled, O truthful one, bright-flamed, bring here

children.text: cikitvān daivyaṃ janam ||
children.translated_text: the knowing divine people.

children.text: vipraṃ hotāram adruhaṃ dhūmaketuṃ vibhāvasum
children.translated_text: We seek the inspired <s>Hotṛ</s>, free from deceit, smoke-bannered, radiant with wealth,

children.text: yajñānāṃ ketum īmahe ||
children.translated_text: the beacon of sacrifices.

children.text: agne ni pāhi nas tvam prati ṣma deva rīṣataḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, protect us; O god, guard us from the injurer.

children.text: bhinddhi dveṣaḥ sahaskṛta ||
children.translated_text: Break apart hatred, O mighty-made one.

children.text: agniḥ pratnena manmanā śumbhānas tanvaṃ svām
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, adorning his own body with ancient thought,

children.text: kavir vipreṇa vāvṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: the poet, has grown through the inspired poet.

children.text: ūrjo napātam ā huve 'gnim pāvakaśociṣam
children.translated_text: I call the child of strength, <s>Agni</s> of purifying flame,

children.text: asmin yajñe svadhvare ||
children.translated_text: in this sacrifice with good rite.

children.text: sa no mitramahas tvam agne śukreṇa śociṣā
children.translated_text: So, O <s>Agni</s>, you of friendly might, with your bright flame,

children.text: devair ā satsi barhiṣi ||
children.translated_text: sit down with the gods upon the sacred grass.

children.text: yo agniṃ tanvo dame devam martaḥ saparyati
children.translated_text: The mortal who serves <s>Agni</s>, the god, in the house of his own body

children.text: tasmā id dīdayad vasu ||
children.translated_text: For him indeed wealth shone forth.

children.text: agnir mūrdhā divaḥ kakut patiḥ pṛthivyā ayam
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is the head of heaven, the summit, this lord of the earth;

children.text: apāṃ retāṃsi jinvati ||
children.translated_text: he quickens the seeds of the waters.

children.text: ud agne śucayas tava śukrā bhrājanta īrate
children.translated_text: Upward, O <s>Agni</s>, your pure, bright flames rise and shine;

children.text: tava jyotīṃṣy arcayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: your lights, your rays, blaze forth.

children.text: īśiṣe vāryasya hi dātrasyāgne svarpatiḥ
children.translated_text: For you have power over what is desirable, over the gift, O <s>Agni</s>, lord of the bright heaven;

children.text: stotā syāṃ tava śarmaṇi ||
children.translated_text: may I, the singer, be within your shelter.

children.text: tvām agne manīṣiṇas tvāṃ hinvanti cittibhiḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, the wise men impel; you they impel with their insights;

children.text: tvāṃ vardhantu no giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: may our songs strengthen you.

children.text: adabdhasya svadhāvato dūtasya rebhataḥ sadā
children.translated_text: We choose the friendship of <s>Agni</s>, the unbetraying one, self-powered, the ever-roaring messenger;

children.text: agneḥ sakhyaṃ vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: we choose <s>Agni</s>'s friendship.

children.text: agniḥ śucivratatamaḥ śucir vipraḥ śuciḥ kaviḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, most pure in vow, pure, an inspired priest, pure, a seer,

children.text: śucī rocata āhutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: shines pure when he has been invoked.

children.text: uta tvā dhītayo mama giro vardhantu viśvahā
children.translated_text: And may my thoughts and songs strengthen you every day;

children.text: agne sakhyasya bodhi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, be mindful of our friendship.

children.text: yad agne syām ahaṃ tvaṃ tvaṃ vā ghā syā aham
children.translated_text: If, O <s>Agni</s>, I were you, or if you indeed were I,

children.text: syuṣ ṭe satyā ihāśiṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: your blessings would be fulfilled here.

children.text: vasur vasupatir hi kam asy agne vibhāvasuḥ
children.translated_text: For, O <s>Agni</s>, you are truly wealth, lord of wealth, shining with riches;

children.text: syāma te sumatāv api ||
children.translated_text: may we be within your favor.

children.text: agne dhṛtavratāya te samudrāyeva sindhavaḥ
children.translated_text: To you, O <s>Agni</s>, keeper of firm vows, as rivers to the sea,

children.text: giro vāśrāsa īrate ||
children.translated_text: the lowing songs go forth.

children.text: yuvānaṃ viśpatiṃ kaviṃ viśvādam puruvepasam
children.translated_text: I adorn with my thoughts <s>Agni</s>, the young lord of the clans, the seer, all-consuming, much-sounding;

children.text: agniṃ śumbhāmi manmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: I adorn <s>Agni</s> with my songs.

children.text: yajñānāṃ rathye vayaṃ tigmajambhāya vīﾱave
children.translated_text: For <s>Agni</s>, the charioteer of sacrifices, sharp-jawed and strong,

children.text: stomair iṣemāgnaye ||
children.translated_text: may we seek favor with praises.

children.text: ayam agne tve api jaritā bhūtu santya
children.translated_text: May this singer here, O <s>Agni</s>, become dear to you;

children.text: tasmai pāvaka mṛﾱaya ||
children.translated_text: to him, O purifier, be gracious.

children.text: dhīro hy asy admasad vipro na jāgṛviḥ sadā
children.translated_text: For he is wise, an inspired one seated at the meal, ever watchful;

children.text: agne dīdayasi dyavi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, you shine in heaven.

children.text: purāgne duritebhyaḥ purā mṛdhrebhyaḥ kave
children.translated_text: Before evils come, O <s>Agni</s>, before hostile attacks, O seer,

children.text: pra ṇa āyur vaso tira ||
children.translated_text: carry our life onward, O wealthy one.

children.text: Chapter 665
ā ghā ye agnim indhate stṛṇanti barhir ānuṣak
children.translated_text: Indeed, those who kindle <s>Agni</s> and spread the sacred grass continually,

children.text: yeṣām indro yuvā sakhā ||
children.translated_text: they have young <s>Indra</s> as their friend.

children.text: bṛhann id idhma eṣām bhūri śastam pṛthuḥ svaruḥ
children.translated_text: Great indeed is their kindling-wood, abundant their praise, broad their sacrificial stake,

children.text: yeṣām indro yuvā sakhā ||
children.translated_text: they who have young <s>Indra</s> as their friend.

children.text: ayuddha id yudhā vṛtaṃ śūra ājati satvabhiḥ
children.translated_text: Without battle the hero wins what is enclosed by battle, pressing on with his strong men,

children.text: yeṣām indro yuvā sakhā ||
children.translated_text: they who have young <s>Indra</s> as their friend.

children.text: ā bundaṃ vṛtrahā dade jātaḥ pṛcchad vi mātaram
children.translated_text: At birth the <s>Vṛtrahan</s> took up the weapon and questioned his mother apart:

children.text: ka ugrāḥ ke ha śṛṇvire ||
children.translated_text: "Who are the fierce ones? Who here are renowned?"

children.text: prati tvā śavasī vadad girāv apso na yodhiṣat
children.translated_text: The mountain answered you in might; the active one did not fight like waters,

children.text: yas te śatrutvam ācake ||
children.translated_text: he who declared himself your enemy.

children.text: uta tvam maghavañchṛṇu yas te vaṣṭi vavakṣi tat
children.translated_text: And you, O <s>Maghavan</s>, hear: whatever one wishes from you, make that grow;

children.text: yad vīﾱayāsi vīﾱu tat ||
children.translated_text: whatever you make firm, that indeed is firm.

children.text: yad ājiṃ yāty ājikṛd indraḥ svaśvayur upa
children.translated_text: When <s>Indra</s>, maker of contests and desirous of good horses, goes to the contest,

children.text: rathītamo rathīnām ||
children.translated_text: he is the best chariot-warrior among chariot-warriors.

children.text: vi ṣu viśvā abhiyujo vajrin viṣvag yathā vṛha
children.translated_text: Scatter all attackers apart on every side, O wielder of the thunderbolt, just as one tears them away;

children.text: bhavā naḥ suśravastamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: be for us most famed for good renown.

children.text: asmākaṃ su ratham pura indraḥ kṛṇotu sātaye
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> set our chariot in front for the winning of the prize,

children.text: na yaṃ dhūrvanti dhūrtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the one that deceivers do not shake.

children.text: vṛjyāma te pari dviṣo 'raṃ te śakra dāvane
children.translated_text: May we turn hostile men away from you; enough is yours, O <s>Śakra</s>, for giving;

children.text: gamemed indra gomataḥ ||
children.translated_text: may we come, O <s>Indra</s>, to wealth rich in cattle.

children.text: śanaiś cid yanto adrivo 'śvāvantaḥ śatagvinaḥ
children.translated_text: Even when going slowly, O stone-wielder, with horses and a hundred cows,

children.text: vivakṣaṇā anehasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: they are discerning and unharmed.

children.text: ūrdhvā hi te dive dive sahasrā sūnṛtā śatā
children.translated_text: For day by day your thousands and hundreds of fair gifts rise high;

children.text: jaritṛbhyo vimaṃhate ||
children.translated_text: they are bestowed broadly upon the singers.

children.text: vidmā hi tvā dhanañjayam indra dṛﾱhā cid ārujam
children.translated_text: For we know you as a winner of wealth, O <s>Indra</s>, breaking even what is firm,

children.text: ādāriṇaṃ yathā gayam ||
children.translated_text: a splitter-open, as of a closed stall.

children.text: kakuhaṃ cit tvā kave mandantu dhṛṣṇav indavaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the soma-drops exhilarate even you, the lofty one, O seer, O bold one,

children.text: ā tvā paṇiṃ yad īmahe ||
children.translated_text: when we seek you against the <s>Paṇi</s>.

children.text: yas te revāṃ adāśuriḥ pramamarṣa maghattaye
children.translated_text: The wealthy non-giver who has offended you in regard to bounty,

children.text: tasya no veda ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: bring us his possessions.

children.text: ima u tvā vi cakṣate sakhāya indra sominaḥ
children.translated_text: These soma-pressing friends look toward you, O <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: puṣṭāvanto yathā paśum ||
children.translated_text: as men rich in nourishment look toward a beast.

children.text: uta tvābadhiraṃ vayaṃ śrutkarṇaṃ santam ūtaye
children.translated_text: And we call you, not deaf but having hearing ears, for aid,

children.text: dūrād iha havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: from far away to here.

children.text: yacchuśrūyā imaṃ havaṃ durmarṣaṃ cakriyā uta
children.translated_text: If you would hear this call, hard to withstand, and would make it effective,

children.text: bhaver āpir no antamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: then become our nearest ally.

children.text: yacciddhi te api vyathir jaganvāṃso amanmahi
children.translated_text: Even if distress has come upon those who have gone to you, we have thought of you;

children.text: godā id indra bodhi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, be mindful of us as giver of cattle.

children.text: ā tvā rambhaṃ na jivrayo rarabhmā śavasas pate
children.translated_text: We grasp you like a staff, O unaging one, O lord of might;

children.text: uśmasi tvā sadhastha ā ||
children.translated_text: we desire you here at the assembly-place.

children.text: stotram indrāya gāyata purunṛmṇāya satvane
children.translated_text: Sing a praise-song to <s>Indra</s>, rich in men and full of strength,

children.text: nakir yaṃ vṛṇvate yudhi ||
children.translated_text: whom no one chooses as an opponent in battle.

children.text: abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute sutaṃ sṛjāmi pītaye
children.translated_text: At the pressing, O bull, I pour out the pressed soma for you to drink;

children.text: tṛmpā vy aśnuhī madam ||
children.translated_text: be satisfied; fully enjoy the exhilaration.

children.text: mā tvā mūrā aviṣyavo mopahasvāna ā dabhan
children.translated_text: Let not fools, hostile men, or mockers harm you;

children.text: mākīm brahmadviṣo vanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: do not favor the haters of sacred utterance.

children.text: iha tvā goparīṇasā mahe mandantu rādhase
children.translated_text: Here may those rich in cattle exhilarate you for great bounty;

children.text: saro gauro yathā piba ||
children.translated_text: drink like a gaur in a lake.

children.text: yā vṛtrahā parāvati sanā navā ca cucyuve
children.translated_text: Those ancient and new deeds of the <s>Vṛtrahan</s>, which have been set in motion from afar,

children.text: tā saṃsatsu pra vocata ||
children.translated_text: proclaim them in the assemblies.

children.text: apibat kadruvaḥ sutam indraḥ sahasrabāhve
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> drank the pressed soma of <s>Kadru</s> for the thousand-armed one;

children.text: atrādediṣṭa pauṃsyam ||
children.translated_text: there he displayed his manly power.

children.text: satyaṃ tat turvaśe yadau vidāno ahnavāyyam
children.translated_text: That true deed, known among <s>Turvaśa</s> and <s>Yadu</s>, not to be evaded,

children.text: vy ānaṭ turvaṇe śami ||
children.translated_text: he spread forth for <s>Turvaṇa</s> at <s>Śami</s>.

children.text: taraṇiṃ vo janānāṃ tradaṃ vājasya gomataḥ
children.translated_text: For you I have praised the swift one of peoples, the rescuer of cattle-rich prize,

children.text: samānam u pra śaṃsiṣam ||
children.translated_text: the one common to all.

children.text: ṛbhukṣaṇaṃ na vartava uktheṣu tugryāvṛdham
children.translated_text: Like <s>Ṛbhukṣan</s> in the hymns, the increaser of <s>Tugrya</s>,

children.text: indraṃ some sacā sute ||
children.translated_text: I praise <s>Indra</s> together with the pressed soma.

children.text: yaḥ kṛntad id vi yonyaṃ triśokāya girim pṛthum
children.translated_text: He cut apart from its womb the broad mountain for <s>Triśoka</s>,

children.text: gobhyo gātuṃ niretave ||
children.translated_text: to release a path for the cows.

children.text: yad dadhiṣe manasyasi mandānaḥ pred iyakṣasi
children.translated_text: What you hold in mind, when exhilarated, and intend to bring forward,

children.text: mā tat kar indra mṛﾱaya ||
children.translated_text: do not do that, O <s>Indra</s>; be gracious.

children.text: dabhraṃ ciddhi tvāvataḥ kṛtaṃ śṛṇve adhi kṣami
children.translated_text: For even a small deed done by one like you is heard over the earth;

children.text: jigātv indra te manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may your mind come to us, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: taved u tāḥ sukīrtayo 'sann uta praśastayaḥ
children.translated_text: Yours indeed are these good praises, and yours also the commendations,

children.text: yad indra mṛﾱayāsi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: when, O <s>Indra</s>, you are gracious to us.

children.text: mā na ekasminn āgasi mā dvayor uta triṣu
children.translated_text: Do not strike us for one offense, nor for two, nor even for three;

children.text: vadhīr mā śūra bhūriṣu ||
children.translated_text: do not strike us, O hero, for many offenses.

children.text: bibhayā hi tvāvata ugrād abhiprabhaṅgiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: For I fear one like you, fierce and shattering in attack,

children.text: dasmād aham ṛtīṣahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: wondrous, overpowering the assailant.

children.text: mā sakhyuḥ śūnam ā vide mā putrasya prabhūvaso
children.translated_text: May I not encounter the emptiness of a friend, nor that of a son, O very wealthy one;

children.text: āvṛtvad bhūtu te manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may your mind turn back toward us.

children.text: ko nu maryā amithitaḥ sakhā sakhāyam abravīt
children.translated_text: What man now, unopposed, has said to a friend, friend to friend...

children.text: jahā ko asmad īṣate ||
children.translated_text: Strike down whoever seeks to assail us.

children.text: evāre vṛṣabhā sute 'sinvan bhūry āvayaḥ
children.translated_text: Thus, O bulls, at the pressing you have sent forth much abundance,

children.text: śvaghnīva nivatā caran ||
children.translated_text: moving through the low ground like one who strikes down dogs.

children.text: ā ta etā vacoyujā harī gṛbhṇe sumadrathā
children.translated_text: I take hold of those two bay steeds of yours, yoked by speech and drawing a good chariot,

children.text: yad īm brahmabhya id dadaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when you gave this to the sacred utterances.

children.text: bhinddhi viśvā apa dviṣaḥ paribādho jahī mṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: Break apart all hostile waters; slay the oppressors, the battles.

children.text: vasu spārhaṃ tad ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: Bring here that desirable wealth.

children.text: yad vīﾱāv indra yat sthire yat parśāne parābhṛtam
children.translated_text: Whatever wealth, O <s>Indra</s>, is in the stronghold, whatever is fixed, whatever has been carried off to the rocky place,

children.text: vasu spārhaṃ tad ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: bring here that desirable wealth.

children.text: yasya te viśvamānuṣo bhūrer dattasya vedati
children.translated_text: That wealth of yours, given in abundance, of which every human being knows,

children.text: vasu spārhaṃ tad ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: bring here that desirable wealth.

children.text: Chapter 666
tvāvataḥ purūvaso vayam indra praṇetaḥ
children.translated_text: With one such as you, O much-wealthy <s>Indra</s>, as leader,

children.text: smasi sthātar harīṇām ||
children.translated_text: we are keepers of the bay steeds.

children.text: tvāṃ hi satyam adrivo vidma dātāram iṣām
children.translated_text: For we know you truly, O stone-bearing one, as giver of refreshments;

children.text: vidma dātāraṃ rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: we know you as giver of riches.

children.text: ā yasya te mahimānaṃ śatamūte śatakrato
children.translated_text: Your greatness, O hundred-aided, hundred-powered one,

children.text: gīrbhir gṛṇanti kāravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the singers praise with songs.

children.text: sunītho ghā sa martyo yam maruto yam aryamā
children.translated_text: That mortal whom the <s>Maruts</s>, whom <s>Aryaman</s>,

children.text: mitraḥ pānty adruhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and guileless <s>Mitra</s> protect is well led.

children.text: dadhāno gomad aśvavat suvīryam ādityajūta edhate
children.translated_text: Bearing wealth in cattle and horses, rich in heroic strength, impelled by the <s>Ādityas</s>, he prospers,

children.text: sadā rāyā puruspṛhā ||
children.translated_text: always with wealth much desired.

children.text: tam indraṃ dānam īmahe śavasānam abhīrvam
children.translated_text: We seek that <s>Indra</s> for giving, the mighty and fearless one;

children.text: īśānaṃ rāya īmahe ||
children.translated_text: we seek the lord of wealth.

children.text: tasmin hi santy ūtayo viśvā abhīravaḥ sacā
children.translated_text: For in him are all aids together, fearless and present;

children.text: tam ā vahantu saptayaḥ purūvasum madāya harayaḥ sutam ||
children.translated_text: may the coursers, the bay steeds, bring him, rich in many goods, to rejoice in the pressed <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: yas te mado vareṇyo ya indra vṛtrahantamaḥ
children.translated_text: That exhilaration of yours which is most excellent, O <s>Indra</s>, which is best at slaying <s>Vṛtra</s>,

children.text: ya ādadiḥ svar nṛbhir yaḥ pṛtanāsu duṣṭaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: by which you won the sun with men, which is hard to cross in battles,

children.text: yo duṣṭaro viśvavāra śravāyyo vājeṣv asti tarutā
children.translated_text: which, O all-desired one, is hard to overcome, famous, and victorious in contests,

children.text: sa naḥ śaviṣṭha savanā vaso gahi gamema gomati vraje ||
children.translated_text: with that, O strongest wealth-holder, come to our pressings; may we go to a cattle-rich enclosure.

children.text: gavyo ṣu ṇo yathā purāśvayota rathayā
children.translated_text: For cattle, as of old, and also for horses and chariots,

children.text: varivasya mahāmaha ||
children.translated_text: make wide room for us, O greatly mighty one.

children.text: nahi te śūra rādhaso 'ntaṃ vindāmi satrā
children.translated_text: For I do not find an end to your bounty, O hero, not at all.

children.text: daśasyā no maghavan nū cid adrivo dhiyo vājebhir āvitha ||
children.translated_text: Show favor to us now, O bounteous stone-bearing one; with prizes you have helped our thoughts.

children.text: ya ṛṣvaḥ śrāvayatsakhā viśvet sa veda janimā puruṣṭutaḥ
children.translated_text: He who is lofty, whose friendship is renowned, he, much-praised, knows all births.

children.text: taṃ viśve mānuṣā yugendraṃ havante taviṣaṃ yatasrucaḥ ||
children.translated_text: All human generations, with ladles held out, call upon that mighty <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: sa no vājeṣv avitā purūvasuḥ purasthātā maghavā vṛtrahā bhuvat ||
children.translated_text: May he, rich in many goods, the bounteous slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, be our protector in the contests and stand before us.

children.text: abhi vo vīram andhaso madeṣu gāya girā mahā vicetasam
children.translated_text: Sing out to your hero in the exhilarations of the <s>Soma</s>, with a song, to the great wise one,

children.text: indraṃ nāma śrutyaṃ śākinaṃ vaco yathā ||
children.translated_text: to <s>Indra</s>, famous by name, powerful in speech.

children.text: dadī rekṇas tanve dadir vasu dadir vājeṣu puruhūta vājinam
children.translated_text: You gave treasure for the body, you gave wealth, you gave the winner of prizes in the contests, O much-invoked one;

children.text: nūnam atha ||
children.translated_text: now, therefore.

children.text: viśveṣām irajyantaṃ vasūnāṃ sāsahvāṃsaṃ cid asya varpasaḥ
children.translated_text: Now, therefore, he rules over all goods, overcoming even by his own form

children.text: kṛpayato nūnam aty atha ||
children.translated_text: as he takes pity.

children.text: mahaḥ su vo aram iṣe stavāmahe mīﾱhuṣe araṅgamāya jagmaye
children.translated_text: We praise you greatly for help and refreshment, O generous one who reaches the right goal,

children.text: yajñebhir gīrbhir viśvamanuṣām marutām iyakṣasi gāye tvā namasā girā ||
children.translated_text: with sacrifices and songs; you seek the <s>Maruts</s> of all mankind, and I sing to you with reverent song.

children.text: ye pātayante ajmabhir girīṇāṃ snubhir eṣām
children.translated_text: They who make things fly along the courses, along the ridges of the mountains,

children.text: yajñam mahiṣvaṇīnāṃ sumnaṃ tuviṣvaṇīnām prādhvare ||
children.translated_text: bring to the rite the favor of the greatly roaring, the favor of the mightily roaring ones.

children.text: prabhaṅgaṃ durmatīnām indra śaviṣṭhā bhara
children.translated_text: Bring, O strongest <s>Indra</s>, the breaking of evil thoughts,

children.text: rayim asmabhyaṃ yujyaṃ codayanmate jyeṣṭhaṃ codayanmate ||
children.translated_text: and wealth suited to us, O stirrer of inspiration, the highest wealth, O stirrer of inspiration.

children.text: sanitaḥ susanitar ugra citra cetiṣṭha sūnṛta
children.translated_text: O winner, good winner, fierce, brilliant, most attentive to true speech,

children.text: prāsahā samrāṭ sahuriṃ sahantam bhujyuṃ vājeṣu pūrvyam ||
children.translated_text: victorious, sovereign, overpowering, strong, ancient helper in the contests.

children.text: ā sa etu ya īvad āṃ adevaḥ pūrtam ādade
children.translated_text: Let him come here, the godless one who has taken away what was filled up as if it were his own,

children.text: yathā cid vaśo aśvyaḥ pṛthuśravasi kānīte 'syā vyuṣy ādade ||
children.translated_text: just as the lord of horses took it at the daybreak of <s>Pṛthuśravas Kānīta</s>.

children.text: ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrāśvyasyāyutāsanam uṣṭrānāṃ viṃśatiṃ śatā
children.translated_text: Sixty thousand horses as a seat, twenty hundreds of camels,

children.text: daśa śyāvīnāṃ śatā daśa tryaruṣīṇāṃ daśa gavāṃ sahasrā ||
children.translated_text: ten hundreds of dark mares, ten hundreds of three-red ones, and ten thousand cattle.

children.text: daśa śyāvā ṛdhadrayo vītavārāsa āśavaḥ
children.translated_text: Ten dark, well-running, open-passing, swift horses

children.text: mathrā nemiṃ ni vāvṛtuḥ ||
children.translated_text: turned the wheel around the axle.

children.text: dānāsaḥ pṛthuśravasaḥ kānītasya surādhasaḥ
children.translated_text: The gifts of <s>Pṛthuśravas Kānīta</s>, rich in bounty,

children.text: rathaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ dadan maṃhiṣṭhaḥ sūrir abhūd varṣiṣṭham akṛta śravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: gave a golden chariot; the most generous patron became greatest and made his fame highest.

children.text: ā no vāyo mahe tane yāhi makhāya pājase
children.translated_text: Come to us, O <s>Vāyu</s>, for great offspring, for the rite and for strength.

children.text: vayaṃ hi te cakṛmā bhūri dāvane sadyaś cin mahi dāvane ||
children.translated_text: For we have made much for you to give; at once we have made a great thing for giving.

children.text: yo aśvebhir vahate vasta usrās triḥ sapta saptatīnām
children.translated_text: He who is carried by horses at dawn, three times seven among the seventies,

children.text: ebhiḥ somebhiḥ somasudbhiḥ somapā dānāya śukrapūtapāḥ ||
children.translated_text: with these <s>Somas</s>, pressed by the Soma-pressers, is a Soma-drinker, purified by the bright draught for giving.

children.text: yo ma imaṃ cid u tmanāmandac citraṃ dāvane
children.translated_text: He who, even by himself, delighted me with this brilliant gift,

children.text: araṭve akṣe nahuṣe sukṛtvani sukṛttarāya sukratuḥ ||
children.translated_text: for <s>Nahuṣa</s> of good deeds, in the chariotless axle, the wise one gave to the better doer.

children.text: ucathye vapuṣi yaḥ svarāﾱ uta vāyo ghṛtasnāḥ
children.translated_text: He who, in the beautiful form of <s>Ucathya</s>, is self-ruling, and you too, O <s>Vāyu</s>, bathed in ghee,

children.text: aśveṣitaṃ rajeṣitaṃ śuneṣitam prājma tad idaṃ nu tat ||
children.translated_text: the horse-impelled, dust-impelled, dog-impelled course: now this is that.

children.text: adha priyam iṣirāya ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrāsanam
children.translated_text: Then for dear <s>Iṣira</s> he gave a seat of sixty thousand,

children.text: aśvānām in na vṛṣṇām ||
children.translated_text: indeed of stallion horses.

children.text: gāvo na yūtham upa yanti vadhraya upa mā yanti vadhrayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like cattle to the herd the castrated animals come near; the castrated animals come near to me.

children.text: adha yac cārathe gaṇe śatam uṣṭrāṃ acikradat
children.translated_text: And when in the chariot-company he made a hundred camels cry out,

children.text: adha śvitneṣu viṃśatiṃ śatā ||
children.translated_text: then among the white ones he gave twenty hundreds.

children.text: śataṃ dāse balbūthe vipras tarukṣa ā dade
children.translated_text: The sage <s>Tarukṣa</s> received a hundred from the servant <s>Balbūtha</s>.

children.text: te te vāyav ime janā madantīndragopā madanti devagopāḥ ||
children.translated_text: These people of yours, O <s>Vāyu</s>, rejoice; protected by <s>Indra</s> they rejoice, protected by the gods they rejoice.

children.text: adha syā yoṣaṇā mahī pratīcī vaśam aśvyam
children.translated_text: Then that great woman, coming toward the horse-team,

children.text: adhirukmā vi nīyate ||
children.translated_text: is led away adorned with gold.

children.text: Chapter 667
mahi vo mahatām avo varuṇa mitra dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: Great is your help for the great giver, O <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Mitra</s>.

children.text: yam ādityā abhi druho rakṣathā nem aghaṃ naśad anehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whom you <s>Ādityas</s> protect from treachery, no evil reaches him; faultless are your aids, good are your aids.

children.text: vidā devā aghānām ādityāso apākṛtim
children.translated_text: Know, O gods, O <s>Ādityas</s>, the removal of sins.

children.text: pakṣā vayo yathopari vy asme śarma yacchatānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like birds' wings overhead, spread shelter over us; faultless are your aids, good are your aids.

children.text: vy asme adhi śarma tat pakṣā vayo na yantana
children.translated_text: Spread that shelter over us; come like birds with wings.

children.text: viśvāni viśvavedaso varūthyā manāmahe 'nehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: We ask for all protective shelters from you who know all things; yours are unharmed aids, yours are good aids.

children.text: yasmā arāsata kṣayaṃ jīvātuṃ ca pracetasaḥ
children.translated_text: For the one to whom, O wise ones, you have granted a dwelling and a living life,

children.text: manor viśvasya ghed ima ādityā rāya īśate 'nehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: these <s>Ādityas</s> indeed rule over the wealth of every man; yours are unharmed aids, yours are good aids.

children.text: pari ṇo vṛṇajann aghā durgāṇi rathyo yathā
children.translated_text: Turn evils and hard passages away from us all around, as a charioteer does,

children.text: syāmed indrasya śarmaṇy ādityānām utāvasy anehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: so that we may be in <s>Indra</s>'s shelter and also in the help of the <s>Ādityas</s>; yours are unharmed aids, yours are good aids.

children.text: parihvṛted anā jano yuṣmādattasya vāyati
children.translated_text: The man who is turned aside from want enjoys what has been given by you.

children.text: devā adabhram āśa vo yam ādityā ahetanānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O gods, O <s>Ādityas</s>, may that unfailing hope of yours be ours; yours are unharmed aids, yours are good aids.

children.text: na taṃ tigmaṃ cana tyajo na drāsad abhi taṃ guru
children.translated_text: No sharp missile at all, nor any heavy assault, strikes that man,

children.text: yasmā u śarma sapratha ādityāso arādhvam anehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for whom you <s>Ādityas</s> have granted shelter broad and spacious; yours are unharmed aids, yours are good aids.

children.text: yuṣme devā api ṣmasi yudhyanta iva varmasu
children.translated_text: In you, O gods, we are enclosed, like men fighting in armor.

children.text: yūyam maho na enaso yūyam arbhād uruṣyatānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Protect us from great sin, and protect us from small sin; yours are unharmed aids, yours are good aids.

children.text: aditir na uruṣyatv aditiḥ śarma yacchatu
children.translated_text: May <s>Aditi</s> protect us; may <s>Aditi</s> grant us shelter,

children.text: mātā mitrasya revato 'ryamṇo varuṇasya cānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the mother of splendid <s>Mitra</s>, of <s>Aryaman</s>, and of <s>Varuṇa</s>; yours are unharmed aids, yours are good aids.

children.text: yad devāḥ śarma śaraṇaṃ yad bhadraṃ yad anāturam
children.translated_text: Whatever shelter, refuge, blessing, and freedom from sickness there is among the gods,

children.text: tridhātu yad varūthyaṃ tad asmāsu vi yantanānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that threefold protective defense, extend it over us; yours are unharmed aids, yours are good aids.

children.text: ādityā ava hi khyatādhi kūlād iva spaśaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Ādityas</s>, look down here, like watchers from the bank above.

children.text: sutīrtham arvato yathānu no neṣathā sugam anehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Lead us along an easy road, as horses are led to a good ford; yours are unharmed aids, yours are good aids.

children.text: neha bhadraṃ rakṣasvine nāvayai nopayā uta
children.translated_text: Let there be no good here for the demonic one, nor for hostile withdrawal, nor for hostile approach,

children.text: gave ca bhadraṃ dhenave vīrāya ca śravasyate 'nehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: but good for the cow, for the milch cow, and for the hero seeking renown; yours are unharmed aids, yours are good aids.

children.text: yad āvir yad apīcyaṃ devāso asti duṣkṛtam
children.translated_text: Whatever evil deed there is, O gods, whether open or hidden,

children.text: trite tad viśvam āptya āre asmad dadhātanānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: place all of that far away from us, upon <s>Trita Āptya</s>; yours are unharmed aids, yours are good aids.

children.text: yac ca goṣu duṣṣvapnyaṃ yac cāsme duhitar divaḥ
children.translated_text: And whatever bad dream is among the cows, and whatever is among us, O daughter of heaven,

children.text: tritāya tad vibhāvary āptyāya parā vahānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: carry that away, O radiant one, to <s>Trita Āptya</s>; yours are unharmed aids, yours are good aids.

children.text: niṣkaṃ vā ghā kṛṇavate srajaṃ vā duhitar divaḥ
children.translated_text: Whether one makes a golden ornament or a garland, O daughter of heaven,

children.text: trite duṣṣvapnyaṃ sarvam āptye pari dadmasy anehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we hand every bad dream over to <s>Trita Āptya</s>; yours are unharmed aids, yours are good aids.

children.text: tadannāya tadapase tam bhāgam upaseduṣe
children.translated_text: To the one for whom that is food, for whom that is work, who has sat down beside that share,

children.text: tritāya ca dvitāya coṣo duṣṣvapnyaṃ vahānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and to <s>Trita</s> and <s>Dvita</s>, O <s>Uṣas</s>, carry the bad dream; yours are unharmed aids, yours are good aids.
