children.text: yathā kalāṃ yathā śaphaṃ yatha ṛṇaṃ saṃnayāmasi
children.translated_text: As we bring together a portion, as a hoof, as a debt,

children.text: evā duṣṣvapnyaṃ sarvam āptye saṃ nayāmasy anehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: so we bring together every bad dream for <s>Āptya</s>; yours are unharmed aids, yours are good aids.

children.text: ajaiṣmādyāsanāma cābhūmānāgaso vayam
children.translated_text: Today we have conquered, and we have won; we have become free from guilt.

children.text: uṣo yasmād duṣṣvapnyād abhaiṣmāpa tad ucchatv anehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, from whatever bad dream we were afraid, may it dawn away from us; yours are unharmed aids, yours are good aids.

children.text: Chapter 668
svādor abhakṣi vayasaḥ sumedhāḥ svādhyo varivovittarasya
children.translated_text: Wise in mind, I have partaken of the sweet refreshment, of the good draught that wins wider space,

children.text: viśve yaṃ devā uta martyāso madhu bruvanto abhi saṃcaranti ||
children.translated_text: the one toward which all the gods and mortals move, calling it honey.

children.text: antaś ca prāgā aditir bhavāsy avayātā haraso daivyasya
children.translated_text: You have gone within; you will become <s>Aditi</s>, warding off divine wrath.

children.text: indav indrasya sakhyaṃ juṣāṇaḥ śrauṣṭīva dhuram anu rāya ṛdhyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, enjoying the friendship of <s>Indra</s>, prosper after wealth like a well-trained horse following the yoke.

children.text: apāma somam amṛtā abhūmāganma jyotir avidāma devān
children.translated_text: We have drunk <s>Soma</s>; we have become immortal; we have gone to the light; we have found the gods.

children.text: kiṃ nūnam asmān kṛṇavad arātiḥ kim u dhūrtir amṛta martyasya ||
children.translated_text: What can hostility do to us now? What can the malice of a mortal do, O immortal one?

children.text: śaṃ no bhava hṛda ā pīta indo piteva soma sūnave suśevaḥ
children.translated_text: Be auspicious to our heart when drunk, O <s>Indu</s>; like a father to a son, O <s>Soma</s>, be kindly disposed.

children.text: sakheva sakhya uruśaṃsa dhīraḥ pra ṇa āyur jīvase soma tārīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like a wise friend to a friend, O widely praised one, carry our lifetime forward for living, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: ime mā pītā yaśasa uruṣyavo rathaṃ na gāvaḥ sam anāha parvasu
children.translated_text: These drunk, glorious, protecting drops have bound me at the joints, like cows a chariot.

children.text: te mā rakṣantu visrasaś caritrād uta mā srāmād yavayantv indavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May those <s>Indus</s> protect me from loose wandering, and may they keep me away from weariness.

children.text: agniṃ na mā mathitaṃ saṃ didīpaḥ pra cakṣaya kṛṇuhi vasyaso naḥ
children.translated_text: Make me blaze like kindled <s>Agni</s>; make us shine forth for something better.

children.text: athā hi te mada ā soma manye revāṁ iva pra carā puṣṭim accha ||
children.translated_text: For in your exhilaration, O <s>Soma</s>, I think that I move like a wealthy man toward nourishment.

children.text: iṣireṇa te manasā sutasya bhakṣīmahi pitryasyeva rāyaḥ
children.translated_text: With eager mind may we partake of you, the pressed one, as of ancestral wealth.

children.text: soma rājan pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tārīr ahānīva sūryo vāsarāṇi ||
children.translated_text: O king <s>Soma</s>, carry our lifetimes forward, as the sun carries forward the days.

children.text: soma rājan mṛﾱayā naḥ svasti tava smasi vratyās tasya viddhi
children.translated_text: O king <s>Soma</s>, be gracious to us for well-being; we belong to your ordinance, know that.

children.text: alarti dakṣa uta manyur indo mā no aryo anukāmam parā dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let skill and wrath be set in motion, O <s>Indu</s>; do not hand us over to the enemy according to his desire.

children.text: tvaṃ hi nas tanvaḥ soma gopā gātre gātre niṣasatthā nṛcakṣāḥ
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Soma</s>, are guardian of our bodies; you have settled in every limb, seeing men.

children.text: yat te vayam pramināma vratāni sa no mṛﾱa suṣakhā deva vasyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: If we transgress your ordinances, be gracious to us, O god, as a very good friend for our welfare.

children.text: ṛdūdareṇa sakhyā saceya yo mā na riṣyeddharyaśva pītaḥ
children.translated_text: May I be joined in friendship with the true-bellied one, who, when drunk, will not harm me, O <s>Haryaśva</s>.

children.text: ayaṃ yaḥ somo ny adhāyy asme tasmā indram pratiram emy āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s> that has been placed here in us: for it I go to <s>Indra</s>, extending my life.

children.text: apa tyā asthur anirā amīvā nir atrasan tamiṣīcīr abhaiṣuḥ
children.translated_text: Those lifeless diseases have gone away; the dark powers have fled in fear.

children.text: ā somo asmāṁ aruhad vihāyā aganma yatra pratiranta āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> has mounted up within us, spreading wide; we have gone where they extend life.

children.text: yo na induḥ pitaro hṛtsu pīto 'martyo martyāṁ āviveśa
children.translated_text: The <s>Indu</s> who, drunk in our hearts, O fathers, immortal, has entered mortals,

children.text: tasmai somāya haviṣā vidhema mṛﾱīke asya sumatau syāma ||
children.translated_text: to that <s>Soma</s> let us pay worship with oblation; may we be in his mercy and good favor.

children.text: tvaṃ soma pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidāno 'nu dyāvāpṛthivī ā tatantha
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Soma</s>, in accord with the Fathers, have stretched yourself along heaven and earth.

children.text: tasmai ta indo haviṣā vidhema vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: To you, O <s>Indu</s>, let us offer with oblation; may we be lords of riches.

children.text: trātāro devā adhi vocatā no mā no nidrā īśata mota jalpiḥ
children.translated_text: O protecting gods, speak on our behalf; let not sleep have power over us, nor idle speech.

children.text: vayaṃ somasya viśvaha priyāsaḥ suvīrāso vidatham ā vadema ||
children.translated_text: May we, always dear to <s>Soma</s>, rich in good heroes, speak forth at the assembly.

children.text: tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvato vayodhās tvaṃ svarvid ā viśā nṛcakṣāḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Soma</s>, are our giver of vigor from every side; you are the finder of light, seen by men among the peoples.

children.text: tvaṃ na inda ūtibhiḥ sajoṣāḥ pāhi paścātād uta vā purastāt ||
children.translated_text: You, O drop, together with your aids, protect us from behind and also from before.

children.text: Chapter 669
abhi pra vaḥ surādhasam indram arca yathā vide
children.translated_text: Sing forth to richly generous <s>Indra</s>, so that he may be known.

children.text: yo jaritṛbhyo maghavā purūvasuḥ sahasreṇeva śikṣati ||
children.translated_text: He, the bounteous one rich in many goods, bestows on the singers as if with a thousand gifts.

children.text: śatānīkeva pra jigāti dhṛṣṇuyā hanti vṛtrāṇi dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: Like one with a hundred troops he advances boldly; he slays the <s>Vṛtras</s> for the worshipper.

children.text: girer iva pra rasā asya pinvire datrāṇi purubhojasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like streams from a mountain, the gifts of that giver of many enjoyments swell forth.

children.text: ā tvā sutāsa indavo madā ya indra girvaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: To you the pressed drops have come for exhilaration, O <s>Indra</s>, lover of song.

children.text: āpo na vajrinn anv okyaṃ saraḥ pṛṇanti śūra rādhase ||
children.translated_text: Like waters, O wielder of the <s>vajra</s>, they fill the familiar lake for bounty, O hero.

children.text: anehasam prataraṇaṃ vivakṣaṇam madhvaḥ svādiṣṭham īm piba
children.translated_text: Drink this faultless draught, carrying across, discerning, the sweetest of honey.

children.text: ā yathā mandasānaḥ kirāsi naḥ pra kṣudreva tmanā dhṛṣat ||
children.translated_text: So that, being exhilarated, you may scatter for us boldly, by your own power, as though it were a small thing.

children.text: ā na stomam upa dravaddhiyāno aśvo na sotṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: May our praise run toward you, intent with thought, like a horse with the soma-pressers.

children.text: yaṃ te svadhāvan svadayanti dhenava indra kaṇveṣu rātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: That which your milch-cows, your gifts among the <s>Kaṇvas</s>, make sweet for you, O self-powered <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: ugraṃ na vīraṃ namasopa sedima vibhūtim akṣitāvasum
children.translated_text: With reverence we have approached the fierce one, like a hero, the lordly power with unfailing wealth.

children.text: udrīva vajrinn avato na siñcate kṣarantīndra dhītayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O wielder of the <s>vajra</s>, the inspired thoughts flow to <s>Indra</s> as waters are poured from a reservoir.

children.text: yaddha nūnaṃ yad vā yajñe yad vā pṛthivyām adhi
children.translated_text: Whatever is now, whatever is at the sacrifice, or whatever is upon the earth,

children.text: ato no yajñam āśubhir mahemata ugra ugrebhir ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: from there come to our sacrifice with swift aids, O fierce one, mighty with the mighty ones.

children.text: ajirāso harayo ye ta āśavo vātā iva prasakṣiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Those nimble bay steeds of yours, which are swift and press onward like winds,

children.text: yebhir apatyam manuṣaḥ parīyase yebhir viśvaṃ svar dṛśe ||
children.translated_text: with them you range around the offspring of <s>Manu</s>; with them you behold the whole light.

children.text: etāvatas ta īmaha indra sumnasya gomataḥ
children.translated_text: So much favor of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, rich in cattle, we ask for.

children.text: yathā prāvo maghavan medhyātithiṃ yathā nīpātithiṃ dhane ||
children.translated_text: As you aided <s>Medhyātithi</s>, O bounteous one, and as you aided <s>Nīpātithi</s> in the contest for wealth.

children.text: yathā kaṇve maghavan trasadasyavi yathā pakthe daśavraje
children.translated_text: As for <s>Kaṇva</s>, O bounteous one, for <s>Trasadasyu</s>, and as for <s>Paktha</s> at <s>Daśavraja</s>,

children.text: yathā gośarye asanor ṛjiśvanīndra gomaddhiraṇyavat ||
children.translated_text: as at <s>Gośarya</s> you favored <s>Asana</s> and <s>Ṛjiśvan</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, with cattle and gold.

children.text: Chapter 670
pra su śrutaṃ surādhasam arcā śakram abhiṣṭaye
children.translated_text: Sing forth the renowned, richly generous <s>Śakra</s> for aid.

children.text: yaḥ sunvate stuvate kāmyaṃ vasu sahasreṇeva maṃhate ||
children.translated_text: He who, for the soma-presser and the praiser, magnifies desirable wealth as if by a thousand gifts.

children.text: śatānīkā hetayo asya duṣṭarā indrasya samiṣo mahīḥ
children.translated_text: The weapons of <s>Indra</s> are like hundred-fronted hosts, hard to cross; his powers in combat are great.

children.text: girir na bhujmā maghavatsu pinvate yad īṃ sutā amandiṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like a mountain's slope he swells among the bounteous, when the pressed juices have exhilarated him.

children.text: yad īṃ sutāsa indavo 'bhi priyam amandiṣuḥ
children.translated_text: When the pressed soma-drops have exhilarated him toward what is dear,

children.text: āpo na dhāyi savanam ma ā vaso dughā ivopa dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: let the pressing be set down for me, O good one, like waters, like milk-giving cows for the worshipper.

children.text: anehasaṃ vo havamānam ūtaye madhvaḥ kṣaranti dhītayaḥ
children.translated_text: For you who are being called for aid, the inspired thoughts flow with honey.

children.text: ā tvā vaso havamānāsa indava upa stotreṣu dadhire ||
children.translated_text: Calling you, O good one, the soma-drops have placed themselves among the praises.

children.text: ā naḥ some svadhvara iyāno atyo na tośate
children.translated_text: Toward us at the good rite he comes with <s>Soma</s> and is delighted like a racing steed.

children.text: yaṃ te svadāvan svadanti gūrtayaḥ paure chandayase havam ||
children.translated_text: The call which your praises make sweet for you, O sweet-tasting one, you favor for the <s>Paura</s>.

children.text: pra vīram ugraṃ viviciṃ dhanaspṛtaṃ vibhūtiṃ rādhaso mahaḥ
children.translated_text: Sing forth the hero, fierce, discerning, striving for wealth, the lordly power of great bounty.

children.text: udrīva vajrinn avato vasutvanā sadā pīpetha dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: O wielder of the <s>vajra</s>, with wealth you have always filled the worshipper, as a reservoir fills the low places.

children.text: yaddha nūnam parāvati yad vā pṛthivyāṃ divi
children.translated_text: Whatever is now in the distance, or whatever is on earth or in heaven,

children.text: yujāna indra haribhir mahemata ṛṣva ṛṣvebhir ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: yoking your bay steeds, O <s>Indra</s>, come to our great rite, lofty with the lofty ones.

children.text: rathirāso harayo ye te asridha ojo vātasya piprati
children.translated_text: Those bay steeds of yours are chariot-drawing and unerring; they drink in the vigor of the wind.

children.text: yebhir ni dasyum manuṣo nighoṣayo yebhiḥ svaḥ parīyase ||
children.translated_text: With them you made the <s>Dasyu</s> resound downward for the man of <s>Manu</s>; with them you pass around the light.

children.text: etāvatas te vaso vidyāma śūra navyasaḥ
children.translated_text: So much of you, O good one, O hero, may we know as ever newer.

children.text: yathā prāva etaśaṃ kṛtvye dhane yathā vaśaṃ daśavraje ||
children.translated_text: As you aided <s>Etaśa</s> in the effective contest for wealth, and as you aided <s>Vaśa</s> at <s>Daśavraja</s>.

children.text: yathā kaṇve maghavan medhe adhvare dīrghanīthe damūnasi
children.translated_text: As for <s>Kaṇva</s>, O bounteous one, at <s>Medha</s>'s sacrifice, at <s>Dīrghanītha</s>, in the house of <s>Damūnas</s>,

children.text: yathā gośarye asiṣāso adrivo mayi gotraṃ hariśriyam ||
children.translated_text: as at <s>Gośarya</s> you favored <s>Asiṣa</s>, O stone-splitter, may the cattle-pen bright with bay splendor be mine.

children.text: Chapter 671
yathā manau sāṃvaraṇau somam indrāpibaḥ sutam
children.translated_text: As in the time of <s>Manu Vivasvat</s>, O <s>Śakra</s>, you drank the pressed <s>Soma</s>,

children.text: nīpātithau maghavan medhyātithau puṣṭigau śruṣṭigau sacā ||
children.translated_text: together with <s>Nīpātithi</s>, O bounteous one, with <s>Medhyātithi</s>, with <s>Puṣṭigu</s> and <s>Śruṣṭigu</s>.

children.text: pārṣadvāṇaḥ praskaṇvaṃ sam asādayacchayānaṃ jivrim uddhitam
children.translated_text: <s>Pārṣadvāṇa</s> seated <s>Praskaṇva</s> together, as he lay aged and was raised up.

children.text: sahasrāṇy asiṣāsad gavām ṛṣis tvoto dasyave vṛkaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The seer, protected by you, assigned thousands of cows; he was a wolf against the <s>Dasyu</s>.

children.text: ya ukthebhir na vindhate cikid ya ṛṣicodanaḥ
children.translated_text: He who does not find him by hymns should perceive him, the one impelled by seers.

children.text: indraṃ tam acchā vada navyasyā maty ariṣyantaṃ na bhojase ||
children.translated_text: Speak to that <s>Indra</s> with a newer thought, unfailing, for enjoyment.

children.text: yasmā arkaṃ saptaśīrṣāṇam ānṛcus tridhātum uttame pade
children.translated_text: For him they sang the seven-headed chant, threefold, in the highest station.

children.text: sa tv imā viśvā bhuvanāni cikradad ād ij janiṣṭa pauṃsyam ||
children.translated_text: He made all these beings resound; then manly power was born.

children.text: yo no dātā vasūnām indraṃ taṃ hūmahe vayam
children.translated_text: We call upon that <s>Indra</s>, the giver of goods to us.

children.text: vidmā hy asya sumatiṃ navīyasīṃ gamema gomati vraje ||
children.translated_text: For we know his newer favor; may we go into the cattle-rich enclosure.

children.text: yasmai tvaṃ vaso dānāya śikṣasi sa rāyas poṣam aśnute
children.translated_text: The one whom you instruct for giving, O good one, obtains the increase of wealth.

children.text: taṃ tvā vayam maghavann indra girvaṇaḥ sutāvanto havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: We, with Soma pressed, call upon you, O bounteous <s>Indra</s>, lover of song.

children.text: kadācana starīr asi nendra saścasi dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: Never are you a withholder; O <s>Indra</s>, you do not fail the worshipper.

children.text: upopen nu maghavan bhūya in nu te dānaṃ devasya pṛcyate ||
children.translated_text: Come near now, O bounteous one; now your gift, the god's gift, is sought.

children.text: pra yo nanakṣe abhy ojasā kriviṃ vadhaiḥ śuṣṇaṃ nighoṣayan
children.translated_text: He who with strength struck against <s>Krivi</s>, making <s>Śuṣṇa</s> resound beneath his blows,

children.text: yaded astambhīt prathayann amūṃ divam ād ij janiṣṭa pārthivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when he propped up and spread out that heaven, then earthly power was born.

children.text: yasyāyaṃ viśva āryo dāsaḥ śevadhipā ariḥ
children.translated_text: Of him this whole <s>Ārya</s> and <s>Dāsa</s>, friend and treasure-keeper, is subject.

children.text: tiraś cid arye ruśame parīravi tubhyet so ajyate rayiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even beyond the <s>Ārya</s>, among the <s>Ruśamas</s>, he has roared around; that wealth is urged toward you.

children.text: turaṇyavo madhumantaṃ ghṛtaścutaṃ viprāso arkam ānṛcuḥ
children.translated_text: The swift inspired poets sang the honeyed, ghee-dripping chant.

children.text: asme rayiḥ paprathe vṛṣṇyaṃ śavo 'sme suvānāsa indavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For us wealth has spread out, virile might; for us the pressed soma-drops have flowed.

children.text: Chapter 672
yathā manau vivasvati somaṃ śakrāpibaḥ sutam
children.translated_text: As in the time of <s>Manu Vivasvat</s>, O <s>Śakra</s>, you drank the pressed <s>Soma</s>,

children.text: yathā trite chanda indra jujoṣasy āyau mādayase sacā ||
children.translated_text: as you delighted in <s>Trita</s>'s song, O <s>Indra</s>, and rejoice together with <s>Āyu</s>,

children.text: pṛṣadhre medhye mātariśvanīndra suvāne amandathāḥ
children.translated_text: at <s>Pṛṣadhra</s>'s, <s>Medhya</s>'s, and <s>Mātariśvan</s>'s pressing, O <s>Indra</s>, you were exhilarated.

children.text: yathā somaṃ daśaśipre daśoṇye syūmaraśmāv ṛjūnasi ||
children.translated_text: As at the Soma, O ten-lipped, ten-fingered one, you make the straight reins run true.

children.text: ya ukthā kevalā dadhe yaḥ somaṃ dhṛṣitāpibat
children.translated_text: He who took up the hymns alone, who boldly drank the Soma,

children.text: yasmai viṣṇus trīṇi padā vicakrama upa mitrasya dharmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: for whom <s>Viṣṇu</s> strode out the three steps according to the ordinances of <s>Mitra</s>.

children.text: yasya tvam indra stomeṣu cākano vāje vājiñchatakrato
children.translated_text: You whom, O <s>Indra</s>, you of hundred powers, winner of the prize, delight in our praises,

children.text: taṃ tvā vayaṃ sudughām iva goduho juhūmasi śravasyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we, desiring fame, call upon you as milkers call upon a good milch cow.

children.text: yo no dātā sa naḥ pitā mahāṁ ugra īśānakṛt
children.translated_text: He who is our giver, he is our father, the great and fierce one who makes lordship.

children.text: ayāmann ugro maghavā purūvasur gor aśvasya pra dātu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: At the advance, may the fierce <s>Maghavan</s>, rich in many goods, give us cattle and horses.

children.text: yasmai tvaṃ vaso dānāya maṃhase sa rāyas poṣam invati
children.translated_text: The man for whom you, O good one, become generous in giving, he obtains the increase of wealth.

children.text: vasūyavo vasupatiṃ śatakratuṃ stomair indraṃ havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: Desiring goods, we call with praises upon <s>Indra</s>, lord of goods, the god of a hundred powers.

children.text: kadācana pra yucchasy ubhe ni pāsi janmanī
children.translated_text: Never at any time do you loosen your care; you guard both births.

children.text: turīyāditya havanaṃ ta indriyam ā tasthāv amṛtaṃ divi ||
children.translated_text: O fourth <s>Āditya</s>, your summons, your immortal Indra-power, has taken its stand in heaven.

children.text: yasmai tvam maghavann indra girvaṇaḥ śikṣo śikṣasi dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: The one whom you, O bountiful <s>Indra</s>, lover of song, instruct and strengthen as a worshipper,

children.text: asmākaṃ gira uta suṣṭutiṃ vaso kaṇvavacchṛṇudhī havam ||
children.translated_text: hear our songs and our good praise, O good one; hear our call as you heard <s>Kaṇva</s>.

children.text: astāvi manma pūrvyam brahmendrāya vocata
children.translated_text: The ancient thought has been praised; speak the sacred formulation to <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: pūrvīr ṛtasya bṛhatīr anūṣata stotur medhā asṛkṣata ||
children.translated_text: The old and lofty powers of truth have sounded forth; the singer's insights have been released.

children.text: sam indro rāyo bṛhatīr adhūnuta saṃ kṣoṇī sam u sūryam
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> shook together the great riches, the two worlds, and the sun.

children.text: saṃ śukrāsaḥ śucayaḥ saṃ gavāśiraḥ somā indram amandiṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The bright, pure Soma-draughts, mixed with milk, have exhilarated <s>Indra</s> together.

children.text: Chapter 673
upamaṃ tvā maghonāṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ ca vṛṣabhāṇām
children.translated_text: We seek you as the highest of the generous, the eldest of the bulls,

children.text: pūrbhittamam maghavann indra govidam īśānaṃ rāya īmahe ||
children.translated_text: the greatest breaker of strongholds, O bountiful <s>Indra</s>, finder of cattle, lord of wealth.

children.text: ya āyuṃ kutsam atithigvam ardayo vāvṛdhāno dive dive
children.translated_text: You who furthered <s>Āyu</s>, <s>Kutsa</s>, and <s>Atithigva</s>, growing greater day by day,

children.text: taṃ tvā vayaṃ haryaśvaṃ śatakratuṃ vājayanto havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: we call upon you, the bay-horsed one of a hundred powers, as we strive for the prize.

children.text: ā no viśveṣāṃ rasam madhvaḥ siñcantv adrayaḥ
children.translated_text: May the pressing stones pour out for us all the essence of sweetness,

children.text: ye parāvati sunvire janeṣv ā ye arvāvatīndavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the Soma-drops that were pressed among distant peoples and those that are near at hand.

children.text: viśvā dveṣāṃsi jahi cāva cā kṛdhi viśve sanvantv ā vasu
children.translated_text: Strike down all hatreds and thrust them away; let all men win wealth.

children.text: śīṣṭeṣu cit te madirāso aṃśavo yatrā somasya tṛmpasi ||
children.translated_text: Even among those who remain, your intoxicating portions are there where you are satisfied with Soma.

children.text: indra nedīya ed ihi mitamedhābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, come nearer with measured wisdom and with aids,

children.text: ā śantama śantamābhir abhiṣṭibhir ā svāpe svāpibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: with the most peaceful protections, with the most helpful supports, with friendly helpers.

children.text: ājituraṃ satpatiṃ viśvacarṣaṇiṃ kṛdhi prajāsv ābhagam
children.translated_text: Make the swift conqueror, the good lord, lord of all peoples, fortunate among the offspring.

children.text: pra sū tirā śacībhir ye ta ukthinaḥ kratum punata ānuṣak ||
children.translated_text: Drive forward with your powers those hymn-singers of yours who purify their resolve in due order.

children.text: yas te sādhiṣṭho 'vase te syāma bhareṣu te
children.translated_text: May we be yours, those most effective for your aid, yours in the contests.

children.text: vayaṃ hotrābhir uta devahūtibhiḥ sasavāṃso manāmahe ||
children.translated_text: Having won through priestly offices and invocations of the gods, we think upon you.

children.text: ahaṃ hi te harivo brahma vājayur ājiṃ yāmi sadotibhiḥ
children.translated_text: For I, O bay-horsed one, eager for the prize, go to the contest for you with constant aids.

children.text: tvām id eva tam ame sam aśvayur gavyur agre matīnām ||
children.translated_text: You alone are that one at the forefront of my thoughts, desired for horses and desired for cattle.

children.text: Chapter 674
etat ta indra vīryaṃ gīrbhir gṛṇanti kāravaḥ
children.translated_text: This heroic power of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, the singers proclaim with songs.

children.text: te stobhanta ūrjam āvan ghṛtaścutam paurāso nakṣan dhītibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Praising, they reached nourishing strength that drips with ghee; the ancient ones attained it through their thoughts.

children.text: nakṣanta indram avase sukṛtyayā yeṣāṃ suteṣu mandase
children.translated_text: They approach <s>Indra</s> for aid through good action, in whose pressed Soma you rejoice.

children.text: yathā saṃvarte amado yathā kṛśa evāsme indra matsva ||
children.translated_text: As you were gladdened with <s>Saṃvarta</s>, as with <s>Kṛśa</s>, so, O <s>Indra</s>, be exhilarated with us.

children.text: ā no viśve sajoṣaso devāso gantanopa naḥ
children.translated_text: May all the gods, of one accord, come here to us.

children.text: vasavo rudrā avase na ā gamañchṛṇvantu maruto havam ||
children.translated_text: May the <s>Vasus</s> and <s>Rudras</s> come to us for aid; let the <s>Maruts</s> hear our call.

children.text: pūṣā viṣṇur havanam me sarasvaty avantu sapta sindhavaḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Pūṣan</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and <s>Sarasvatī</s> protect my invocation; may the seven rivers protect it.

children.text: āpo vātaḥ parvatāso vanaspatiḥ śṛṇotu pṛthivī havam ||
children.translated_text: May the waters, wind, mountains, and forest lord hear; may earth hear the call.

children.text: yad indra rādho asti te māghonam maghavattama
children.translated_text: Whatever generous bounty is yours, O <s>Indra</s>, most bountiful one,

children.text: tena no bodhi sadhamādyo vṛdhe bhago dānāya vṛtrahan ||
children.translated_text: with that, O <s>Bhaga</s>, be mindful of us for shared exhilaration and increase, for giving, O slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: ājipate nṛpate tvam iddhi no vāja ā vakṣi sukrato
children.translated_text: Lord of contests, lord of men, you indeed bring the prize to us, O wise-willed one.

children.text: vītī hotrābhir uta devavītibhiḥ sasavāṃso vi śṛṇvire ||
children.translated_text: Through enjoyments, priestly offerings, and invitations to the gods, the victorious ones have become widely heard.

children.text: santi hy arya āśiṣa indra āyur janānām
children.translated_text: For Aryan blessings exist, O <s>Indra</s>, as the life of peoples.

children.text: asmān nakṣasva maghavann upāvase dhukṣasva pipyuṣīm iṣam ||
children.translated_text: Come near to us for aid, O <s>Maghavan</s>; milk out swelling refreshment for us.

children.text: vayaṃ ta indra stomebhir vidhema tvam asmākaṃ śatakrato
children.translated_text: We would worship you, O <s>Indra</s>, with praises; you, O god of a hundred powers, are ours.

children.text: mahi sthūraṃ śaśayaṃ rādho ahrayam praskaṇvāya ni tośaya ||
children.translated_text: Bring and bestow upon <s>Praskaṇva</s> great, solid, enduring, unfailing bounty.

children.text: Chapter 675
bhūrīd indrasya vīryaṃ vy akhyam abhy āyati
children.translated_text: I have seen the abundant heroic power of <s>Indra</s> as it comes forth.

children.text: rādhas te dasyave vṛka ||
children.translated_text: Your bounty, O <s>Dasyave Vṛka</s>.

children.text: śataṃ śvetāsa ukṣaṇo divi tāro na rocante
children.translated_text: A hundred white bulls shine like stars in heaven.

children.text: mahnā divaṃ na tastabhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: By their greatness they have propped up heaven itself.

children.text: śataṃ veṇūñchataṃ śunaḥ śataṃ carmāṇi mlātāni
children.translated_text: A hundred reeds, a hundred hounds, a hundred wetted hides,

children.text: śatam me balbajastukā aruṣīṇāṃ catuḥśatam ||
children.translated_text: a hundred tufts of balbaja grass for me, and four hundred reddish mares.

children.text: sudevā stha kāṇvāyanā vayo vayo vicarantaḥ
children.translated_text: You are well-gifted, O descendants of <s>Kaṇva</s>, moving from age to age.

children.text: aśvāso na caṅkramata ||
children.translated_text: Stride about like horses.

children.text: ād it sāptasya carkirann ānūnasya mahi śravaḥ
children.translated_text: Then they proclaimed the great fame of <s>Sāpta</s>, of <s>Ānūna</s>.

children.text: śyāvīr atidhvasan pathaś cakṣuṣā cana saṃnaśe ||
children.translated_text: The dark mares sped beyond the roads, not to be overtaken even by the eye.

children.text: Chapter 676
prati te dasyave vṛka rādho adarśy ahrayam
children.translated_text: Your unfailing bounty has appeared before you, O <s>Dasyave Vṛka</s>.

children.text: dyaur na prathinā śavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Your might is broad like heaven.

children.text: daśa mahyam pautakrataḥ sahasrā dasyave vṛkaḥ
children.translated_text: Ten thousand, O descendant of <s>Pūtakratu</s>, were for me; <s>Vṛka</s> was for <s>Dasyave</s>.

children.text: nityād rāyo amaṃhata ||
children.translated_text: He magnified me out of unfailing wealth.

children.text: śatam me gardabhānāṃ śatam ūrṇāvatīnām
children.translated_text: A hundred donkeys for me, a hundred wool-bearing sheep,

children.text: śataṃ dāsāṁ ati srajaḥ ||
children.translated_text: a hundred slave-women with garlands beyond measure.

children.text: tatro api prāṇīyata pūtakratāyai vyaktā
children.translated_text: There too it was led forward clearly for <s>Pūtakratā</s>,

children.text: aśvānām in na yūthyām ||
children.translated_text: like a herd of horses.

children.text: acety agniś cikitur havyavāṭ sa sumadrathaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, the thoughtful knower, carrier of oblations, with the good chariot, has perceived.

children.text: agniḥ śukreṇa śociṣā bṛhat sūro arocata divi sūryo arocata ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> shone with bright flame, great as the sun; the sun shone in heaven.

children.text: Chapter 677
yuvaṃ devā kratunā pūrvyeṇa yuktā rathena taviṣaṃ yajatrā
children.translated_text: You two gods, worshipful ones, yoked by ancient resolve with your strong chariot,

children.text: āgacchataṃ nāsatyā śacībhir idaṃ tṛtīyaṃ savanam pibāthaḥ ||
children.translated_text: come, O <s>Nāsatyā</s>, with your powers; drink this third Soma-pressing.

children.text: yuvāṃ devās traya ekādaśāsaḥ satyāḥ satyasya dadṛśe purastāt
children.translated_text: You two, O gods, and the three times eleven truthful gods were seen before the truth of the truthful one.

children.text: asmākaṃ yajñaṃ savanaṃ juṣāṇā pātaṃ somam aśvinā dīdyagnī ||
children.translated_text: Enjoying our sacrifice and our Soma-pressing, drink the <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>, radiant with <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: panāyyaṃ tad aśvinā kṛtaṃ vāṃ vṛṣabho divo rajasaḥ pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: That praiseworthy deed has been done by you, O <s>Aśvins</s>: the bull of heaven, of midspace, and of earth.

children.text: sahasraṃ śaṃsā uta ye gaviṣṭau sarvāṁ it tāṁ upa yātā pibadhyai ||
children.translated_text: The thousand praises too, and those that are in the quest for cows: come near to all of them, in order to drink.

children.text: ayaṃ vām bhāgo nihito yajatremā giro nāsatyopa yātam
children.translated_text: This share of yours has been set down, O worshipful <s>Nāsatyas</s>; come near to these songs.

children.text: pibataṃ somam madhumantam asme pra dāśvāṃsam avataṃ śacībhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Drink the honeyed <s>Soma</s> among us; with your powers protect the worshipper who gives.

children.text: Chapter 678
yam ṛtvijo bahudhā kalpayantaḥ sacetaso yajñam imaṃ vahanti
children.translated_text: The priests, arranging it in many ways and of one mind, carry this sacrifice forward.

children.text: yo anūcāno brāhmaṇo yukta āsīt kā svit tatra yajamānasya saṃvit ||
children.translated_text: The learned <s>brāhmaṇa</s> (ritual priest), yoked to his office, was seated; what understanding of the sacrificer was there?

children.text: eka evāgnir bahudhā samiddha ekaḥ sūryo viśvam anu prabhūtaḥ
children.translated_text: One alone is <s>Agni</s>, kindled in many ways; one is the sun, spread through the whole world.

children.text: ekaivoṣāḥ sarvam idaṃ vi bhāty ekaṃ vā idaṃ vi babhūva sarvam ||
children.translated_text: One alone is <s>Uṣas</s>, shining out over all this; this one thing indeed has become all things in many forms.

children.text: jyotiṣmantaṃ ketumantaṃ tricakraṃ sukhaṃ rathaṃ suṣadam bhūrivāram
children.translated_text: I call for you that shining, sign-bearing, three-wheeled chariot, easy to ride, well-seated, and richly guarded.

children.text: citrāmaghā yasya yoge 'dhijajñe taṃ vāṃ huve ati riktam pibadhyai ||
children.translated_text: At its yoking <s>Citrāmaghā</s> was born; I summon that chariot of yours, surpassingly full, for the drinking.

children.text: Chapter 679
imāni vām bhāgadheyāni sisrata indrāvaruṇā pra mahe suteṣu vām
children.translated_text: Let these allotted shares of yours flow forth, O <s>Indra-Varuṇa</s>, for your greatness at the Soma-pressings.

children.text: yajñe yajñe ha savanā bhuraṇyatho yat sunvate yajamānāya śikṣathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: At every sacrifice you two hasten to the pressings, when you instruct the sacrificer who presses Soma.

children.text: niṣṣidhvarīr oṣadhīr āpa āstām indrāvaruṇā mahimānam āśata
children.translated_text: The obstructing plants and the waters settled down; O <s>Indra-Varuṇa</s>, they attained greatness.

children.text: yā sisratū rajasaḥ pāre adhvano yayoḥ śatrur nakir ādeva ohate ||
children.translated_text: They flowed beyond the course of the midspace; by them no enemy, not even a godless one, assails you.

children.text: satyaṃ tad indrāvaruṇā kṛśasya vām madhva ūrmiṃ duhate sapta vāṇīḥ
children.translated_text: True is that wave of honey of yours, O <s>Indra-Varuṇa</s>, for the lean one; the seven voices milk it out.

children.text: tābhir dāśvāṃsam avataṃ śubhas patī yo vām adabdho abhipāti cittibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: With them protect the giver, O lords of beauty, the one who, undeceived, guards you with his thoughts.

children.text: ghṛtapruṣaḥ saumyā jīradānavaḥ sapta svasāraḥ sadana ṛtasya
children.translated_text: The seven sisters, sprinkling ghee, Soma-bearing, giving refreshment, are at the seat of truth.

children.text: yā ha vām indrāvaruṇā ghṛtaścutas tābhir dhattaṃ yajamānāya śikṣatam ||
children.translated_text: Those ghee-dropping ones are yours, O <s>Indra-Varuṇa</s>; with them bestow and instruct the sacrificer.

children.text: avocāma mahate saubhagāya satyaṃ tveṣābhyām mahimānam indriyam
children.translated_text: We have spoken for great good fortune, for the true, brilliant, mighty majesty of the two.

children.text: asmān sv indrāvaruṇā ghṛtaścutas tribhiḥ sāptebhir avataṃ śubhas patī ||
children.translated_text: With the ghee-dropping ones, with the three sevens, protect us well, O <s>Indra-Varuṇa</s>, lords of beauty.

children.text: indrāvaruṇā yad ṛṣibhyo manīṣāṃ vāco matiṃ śrutam adattam agre
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra-Varuṇa</s>, when in the beginning you gave insight, speech, thought, and inspired hearing to the seers,

children.text: yāni sthānāny asṛjanta dhīrā yajñaṃ tanvānās tapasābhy apaśyam ||
children.translated_text: I beheld the stations that the wise created, as they stretched out the sacrifice by their austerity.

children.text: indrāvaruṇā saumanasam adṛptaṃ rāyas poṣaṃ yajamāneṣu dhattam
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra-Varuṇa</s>, place unbroken good-mindedness and the growth and increase of wealth among the sacrificers.

children.text: prajām puṣṭim bhūtim asmāsu dhattaṃ dīrghāyutvāya pra tirataṃ na āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Place offspring, nourishment, and prosperity among us; for long life extend our lifetime forward.

children.text: Chapter 680
agna ā yāhy agnibhir hotāraṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, come here with the fires; we choose you as <s>hotar</s> (invoking priest).

children.text: ā tvām anaktu prayatā haviṣmatī yajiṣṭham barhir āsade ||
children.translated_text: Let the prepared, oblation-bearing offering anoint you, the most fit for sacrifice, to sit upon the sacred grass.

children.text: acchā hi tvā sahasaḥ sūno aṅgiraḥ srucaś caranty adhvare
children.translated_text: For toward you, O son of strength, O <s>Aṅgiras</s>, the ladles move in the rite.

children.text: ūrjo napātaṃ ghṛtakeśam īmahe 'gniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyam ||
children.translated_text: We seek <s>Agni</s>, child of strength, butter-haired, the ancient one in sacrifices.

children.text: agne kavir vedhā asi hotā pāvaka yakṣyaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, you are the inspired poet and ordainer, the purifying <s>hotar</s>, worthy of worship.

children.text: mandro yajiṣṭho adhvareṣv īḍyo viprebhiḥ śukra manmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Joy-giving, most fit for sacrifice, praiseworthy in the rites, O bright one, with the inspired hymns of the poets.

children.text: adrogham ā vahośato yaviṣṭhya devāṁ ajasra vītaye
children.translated_text: Bring the eager gods here without deceit, O youngest one, unfailingly, for the feast.

children.text: abhi prayāṃsi sudhitā vaso gahi mandasva dhītibhir hitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Come toward the well-set offerings, O <s>Vasu</s>; delight, established by the songs.

children.text: tvam it saprathā asy agne trātar ṛtas kaviḥ
children.translated_text: You indeed are the widely extended one, O <s>Agni</s>, protector, poet of truth.

children.text: tvāṃ viprāsaḥ samidhāna dīdiva ā vivāsanti vedhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The inspired priests, kindling you as you blaze, serve you with reverence.

children.text: śocā śociṣṭha dīdihi viśe mayo rāsva stotre mahāṁ asi
children.translated_text: Flame up, most flaming one; shine forth. Give joy to the clan; you are great for the singer.

children.text: devānāṃ śarman mama santu sūrayaḥ śatrūṣāhaḥ svagnayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May my patrons be under the shelter of the gods, enemy-subduing and rich in good fires.

children.text: yathā cid vṛddham atasam agne saṃjūrvasi kṣami
children.translated_text: As you burn up even an overgrown thicket on the earth, O <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: evā daha mitramaho yo asmadhrug durmanmā kaś ca venati ||
children.translated_text: so burn the one who is hostile to us, O mighty ally, whatever evil-minded man plots against us.

children.text: mā no martāya ripave rakṣasvine māghaśaṃsāya rīradhaḥ
children.translated_text: Do not hand us over to a mortal enemy, to a demon-guarded foe, or to an evil-speaking man.

children.text: asredhadbhis taraṇibhir yaviṣṭhya śivebhiḥ pāhi pāyubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: With unfailing, rescuing, auspicious protections, O youngest one, guard us with guardians.

children.text: pāhi no agna ekayā pāhy uta dvitīyayā
children.translated_text: Protect us, O <s>Agni</s>, with one protection; protect us also with a second.

children.text: pāhi gīrbhis tisṛbhir ūrjām pate pāhi catasṛbhir vaso ||
children.translated_text: Protect us with three songs, O lord of nourishment; protect us with four, O <s>Vasu</s>.

children.text: pāhi viśvasmād rakṣaso arāvṇaḥ pra sma vājeṣu no 'va
children.translated_text: Protect us from every hostile demon and from the ungenerous one; stand before us in the contests.

children.text: tvām iddhi nediṣṭhaṃ devatātaya āpiṃ nakṣāmahe vṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: For growth we seek you as the nearest ally in the worship of the gods.

children.text: ā no agne vayovṛdhaṃ rayim pāvaka śaṃsyam
children.translated_text: Bring us, O purifying <s>Agni</s>, wealth that increases vital strength and is worthy of praise.

children.text: rāsvā ca na upamāte puruspṛhaṃ sunītī svayaśastaram ||
children.translated_text: Grant us, through good guidance, unsurpassed wealth, much desired and bringing greater renown of its own.

children.text: yena vaṃsāma pṛtanāsu śardhatas taranto arya ādiśaḥ
children.translated_text: By which we may win in battles against the raging hosts, crossing beyond hostile commands,

children.text: sa tvaṃ no vardha prayasā śacīvaso jinvā dhiyo vasuvidaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with that, O possessor of power, increase us by your bounty; quicken the thoughts that find wealth.

children.text: śiśāno vṛṣabho yathāgniḥ śṛṅge davidhvat
children.translated_text: Sharpening himself like a bull, <s>Agni</s> shakes his horns.

children.text: tigmā asya hanavo na pratidhṛṣe sujambhaḥ sahaso yahuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Sharp are his jaws, not to be withstood; well-toothed is the young son of strength.

children.text: nahi te agne vṛṣabha pratidhṛṣe jambhāso yad vitiṣṭhase
children.translated_text: For your jaws, O bull <s>Agni</s>, are not to be withstood when you take your stand.

children.text: sa tvaṃ no hotaḥ suhutaṃ haviṣ kṛdhi vaṃsvā no vāryā puru ||
children.translated_text: So, O <s>hotar</s>, make our oblation well offered; win for us many desirable goods.

children.text: śeṣe vaneṣu mātroḥ saṃ tvā martāsa indhate
children.translated_text: You lie in the forests, in the lap of the two mothers; mortals kindle you.

children.text: atandro havyā vahasi haviṣkṛta ād id deveṣu rājasi ||
children.translated_text: Unwearied, you carry the offerings, O maker of oblation; then indeed you rule among the gods.

children.text: sapta hotāras tam id īﾱate tvāgne sutyajam ahrayam
children.translated_text: The seven <s>hotars</s> praise that very <s>Agni</s>, you who are easy to sacrifice to and unashamed.

children.text: bhinatsy adriṃ tapasā vi śociṣā prāgne tiṣṭha janāṁ ati ||
children.translated_text: You split the rock with heat and with flame; go forth, O <s>Agni</s>, and stand beyond the peoples.

children.text: agnim agniṃ vo adhriguṃ huvema vṛktabarhiṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Let us, with sacred grass spread, call <s>Agni</s> after <s>Agni</s>, the undeceiving one.

children.text: agniṃ hitaprayasaḥ śaśvatīṣv ā hotāraṃ carṣaṇīnām ||
children.translated_text: Let us call <s>Agni</s>, whose offerings are well set, the <s>hotar</s> of the peoples in the everlasting rites.

children.text: ketena śarman sacate suṣāmaṇy agne tubhyaṃ cikitvanā
children.translated_text: By his sign he joins himself to shelter and good protection; O <s>Agni</s>, with understanding, for you,

children.text: iṣaṇyayā naḥ pururūpam ā bhara vājaṃ nediṣṭham ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: through impelling aid, bring us manifold prize, the nearest one for help.

children.text: agne jaritar viśpatis tepāno deva rakṣasaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, lord of the clans for the singer, blazing god against the demons,

children.text: aproṣivān gṛhapatir mahāṁ asi divas pāyur duroṇayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: you are great, an unfailing householder, guardian of heaven, dwelling in the home.

children.text: mā no rakṣa ā veśīd āghṛṇīvaso mā yātur yātumāvatām
children.translated_text: Let no demon enter us, O possessor of glowing wealth; let no sorcerer of the sorcerers come near.

children.text: parogavyūty anirām apa kṣudham agne sedha rakṣasvinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Beyond the cattle-pasture, into barrenness, drive away hunger, O <s>Agni</s>, and the demonic ones.

children.text: Chapter 681
ubhayaṃ śṛṇavac ca na indro arvāg idaṃ vacaḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> hear both this word of ours, coming hither,

children.text: satrācyā maghavā somapītaye dhiyā śaviṣṭha ā gamat ||
children.translated_text: and may <s>Maghavan</s>, most powerful, come with united thought to drink the <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: taṃ hi svarājaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tam ojase dhiṣaṇe niṣṭatakṣatuḥ
children.translated_text: For that self-ruling bull, that one, the two inspirations fashioned for might;

children.text: utopamānām prathamo ni ṣīdasi somakāmaṃ hi te manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and among the highest you sit first, for your mind longs for <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: ā vṛṣasva purūvaso sutasyendrāndhasaḥ
children.translated_text: Pour yourself out, O much-wealthy <s>Indra</s>, upon the pressed Soma-draught,

children.text: vidmā hi tvā harivaḥ pṛtsu sāsahim adhṛṣṭaṃ cid dadhṛṣvaṇim ||
children.translated_text: for we know you, O bay-horsed one, as a conqueror in battles, one who overcomes even the unassailable.

children.text: aprāmisatya maghavan tathed asad indra kratvā yathā vaśaḥ
children.translated_text: O unfailing and true <s>Maghavan</s>, so let it be, O <s>Indra</s>, by will, as you have power.

children.text: sanema vājaṃ tava śiprinn avasā makṣū cid yanto adrivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we win prize by your help, O fair-lipped one, even when going swiftly, O wielder of the stone.

children.text: śagdhy ū ṣu śacīpata indra viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Show your might now, O lord of power, <s>Indra</s>, with all your aids.

children.text: bhagaṃ na hi tvā yaśasaṃ vasuvidam anu śūra carāmasi ||
children.translated_text: For like a share of fortune, O hero, we follow you, famed and finder of wealth.

children.text: pauro aśvasya purukṛd gavām asy utso deva hiraṇyayaḥ
children.translated_text: He is foremost for the horse, maker of abundance; of cattle he is the golden spring, O god.

children.text: nakir hi dānam parimardhiṣat tve yad yad yāmi tad ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: For no one can check the gift in you; whatever I ask, bring that here.

children.text: tvaṃ hy ehi cerave vidā bhagaṃ vasuttaye
children.translated_text: Come here, then, for motion and insight; know the share for the winning of goods.

children.text: ud vāvṛṣasva maghavan gaviṣṭaya ud indrāśvamiṣṭaye ||
children.translated_text: Swell up, O <s>Maghavan</s>, for the quest of cattle; rise up, O <s>Indra</s>, for the quest of horses.

children.text: tvam purū sahasrāṇi śatāni ca yūthā dānāya maṃhase
children.translated_text: You, many thousands and hundreds, magnify herds for giving.

children.text: ā purandaraṃ cakṛma vipravacasa indraṃ gāyanto 'vase ||
children.translated_text: Singing, with inspired speech, we have made <s>Indra</s>, breaker of strongholds, for aid.

children.text: avipro vā yad avidhad vipro vendra te vacaḥ
children.translated_text: Whether an uninspired man or an inspired man has uttered your word, O <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: sa pra mamandat tvāyā śatakrato prācāmanyo ahaṃsana ||
children.translated_text: may it gladden you mightily, O <s>Śatakratu</s>, and may hostile intent not prevail.

children.text: ugrabāhur mrakṣakṛtvā purandaro yadi me śṛṇavaddhavam
children.translated_text: If the strong-armed, demon-destroying, stronghold-breaking one will hear my call,

children.text: vasūyavo vasupatiṃ śatakratuṃ stomair indraṃ havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: then we, seeking wealth, call with praises on <s>Indra</s>, lord of wealth, <s>Śatakratu</s>.

children.text: na pāpāso manāmahe nārāyāso na jaﾱhavaḥ
children.translated_text: We do not think ourselves sinful, nor ungenerous, nor contemptible,

children.text: yad in nv indraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ sacā sute sakhāyaṃ kṛṇavāmahai ||
children.translated_text: when here at the Soma-pressing we make the bull <s>Indra</s> our companion and friend.

children.text: ugraṃ yuyujma pṛtanāsu sāsahim ṛṇakātim adābhyam
children.translated_text: We have yoked the fierce one in battles, the conqueror, debt-destroyer, not to be deceived,

children.text: vedā bhṛmaṃ cit sanitā rathītamo vājinaṃ yam id ū naśat ||
children.translated_text: the winning charioteer, who knows even the hidden burden, the prize-horse whom one seeks.

children.text: yata indra bhayāmahe tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi
children.translated_text: From whatever direction, O <s>Indra</s>, we are afraid, from there make us fearless.

children.text: maghavañchagdhi tava tan na ūtibhir vi dviṣo vi mṛdho jahi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Maghavan</s>, with your aids make that possible for us; strike apart hatreds, strike apart hostilities.

children.text: tvaṃ hi rādhaspate rādhaso mahaḥ kṣayasyāsi vidhataḥ
children.translated_text: For you, O lord of bounty, are master of the great bounty of the dwelling.

children.text: taṃ tvā vayam maghavann indra girvaṇaḥ sutāvanto havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: So we, with Soma pressed, call upon you, O <s>Maghavan</s>, <s>Indra</s>, lover of song.

children.text: indra spaﾱ uta vṛtrahā paraspā no vareṇyaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, protector nearby and slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, is our choice-worthy protector from afar.

children.text: sa no rakṣiṣac caramaṃ sa madhyamaṃ sa paścāt pātu naḥ puraḥ ||
children.translated_text: May he protect us at the last, may he in the middle, may he guard us from behind and before.

children.text: tvaṃ naḥ paścād adharād uttarāt pura indra ni pāhi viśvataḥ
children.translated_text: From behind, from below, from above, and from before, O <s>Indra</s>, guard us on every side.

children.text: āre asmat kṛṇuhi daivyam bhayam āre hetīr adevīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Set divine fear far from us; set far away the ungodly missiles.

children.text: adyādyā śvaḥ śva indra trāsva pare ca naḥ
children.translated_text: Day after day and tomorrow after tomorrow, O <s>Indra</s>, rescue us and those beyond us.

children.text: viśvā ca no jaritṝn satpate ahā divā naktaṃ ca rakṣiṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And through all days, O true lord, protect us singers by day and by night.

children.text: prabhaṅgī śūro maghavā tuvīmaghaḥ sammiślo vīryāya kam
children.translated_text: The shattering hero, <s>Maghavan</s>, rich in might, joined for some deed of valor,

children.text: ubhā te bāhū vṛṣaṇā śatakrato ni yā vajram mimikṣatuḥ ||
children.translated_text: both your bullish arms, O <s>Śatakratu</s>, have taken hold of the thunderbolt.

children.text: Chapter 682
pro asmā upastutim bharatā yaj jujoṣati
children.translated_text: Bring forward to him praise when he accepts it.

children.text: ukthair indrasya māhinaṃ vayo vardhanti somino bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The Soma-pressers increase the greatness and vigor of <s>Indra</s> with hymns; good are <s>Indra</s>'s gifts.

children.text: ayujo asamo nṛbhir ekaḥ kṛṣṭīr ayāsyaḥ
children.translated_text: Unyoked, unequaled by men, alone, irresistible among peoples,

children.text: pūrvīr ati pra vāvṛdhe viśvā jātāny ojasā bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he has grown far beyond many things, beyond all beings by his might; good are <s>Indra</s>'s gifts.

children.text: ahitena cid arvatā jīradānuḥ siṣāsati
children.translated_text: Even with an unharnessed steed, the giver of life seeks to win,

children.text: pravācyam indra tat tava vīryāṇi kariṣyato bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and that of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, the heroic deeds of one about to act, must be proclaimed; good are <s>Indra</s>'s gifts.

children.text: ā yāhi kṛṇavāma ta indra brahmāṇi vardhanā
children.translated_text: Come here; we will make for you, O <s>Indra</s>, sacred formulations that strengthen you,

children.text: yebhiḥ śaviṣṭha cākano bhadram iha śravasyate bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with which, O most powerful one, you have been pleased, while auspicious fame is sought here; good are <s>Indra</s>'s gifts.

children.text: dhṛṣataś cid dhṛṣan manaḥ kṛṇoṣīndra yat tvam
children.translated_text: Even the daring man's daring mind you make, O <s>Indra</s>, when you,

children.text: tīvraiḥ somaiḥ saparyato namobhiḥ pratibhūṣato bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with strong Somas, are worshipped with reverences and adorned in return; good are <s>Indra</s>'s gifts.

children.text: ava caṣṭa ṛcīṣamo 'vatāṁ iva mānuṣaḥ
children.translated_text: The seer of hymns looks down like a man from a descent,

children.text: juṣṭvī dakṣasya sominaḥ sakhāyaṃ kṛṇute yujam bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and, enjoying the skill of the Soma-presser, he makes him a friend and ally; good are <s>Indra</s>'s gifts.

children.text: viśve ta indra vīryaṃ devā anu kratuṃ daduḥ
children.translated_text: All the gods, O <s>Indra</s>, have given strength and wisdom after your power.

children.text: bhuvo viśvasya gopatiḥ puruṣṭuta bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You became the guardian-lord of all, O much-praised one; good are <s>Indra</s>'s gifts.

children.text: gṛṇe tad indra te śava upamaṃ devatātaye
children.translated_text: I sing that strength of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, supreme for godhead,

children.text: yaddhaṃsi vṛtram ojasā śacīpate bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when you slay <s>Vṛtra</s> with might, O lord of power; good are <s>Indra</s>'s gifts.

children.text: samaneva vapuṣyataḥ kṛṇavan mānuṣā yugā
children.translated_text: As if in common, making human generations shine in form,

children.text: vide tad indraś cetanam adha śruto bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that conscious power of <s>Indra</s> became known; then it was heard; good are <s>Indra</s>'s gifts.

children.text: uj jātam indra te śava ut tvām ut tava kratum
children.translated_text: Raised up is your strength, O <s>Indra</s>; raised are you and your wisdom.

children.text: bhūrigo bhūri vāvṛdhur maghavan tava śarmaṇi bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Many cattle, much abundance have grown under your shelter, O <s>Maghavan</s>; good are <s>Indra</s>'s gifts.

children.text: ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca vṛtrahan saṃ yujyāva sanibhya ā
children.translated_text: I and you, O <s>Vṛtrahan</s>, let us yoke ourselves together for gains.

children.text: arātīvā cid adrivo 'nu nau śūra maṃsate bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even hostile powers, O wielder of the stone, O hero, will pay attention to us two; good are <s>Indra</s>'s gifts.

children.text: satyam id vā u taṃ vayam indraṃ stavāma nānṛtam
children.translated_text: Truly, indeed, we praise that <s>Indra</s>, not falsely.

children.text: mahāṁ asunvato vadho bhūri jyotīṃṣi sunvato bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Great is his blow against the non-presser, and many are the lights for the Soma-presser; good are <s>Indra</s>'s gifts.

children.text: Chapter 683
sa pūrvyo mahānāṃ venaḥ kratubhir ānaje
children.translated_text: He, the ancient great singer, has adorned himself with insights,

children.text: yasya dvārā manuṣ pitā deveṣu dhiya ānaje ||
children.translated_text: through whose doors father <s>Manu</s> adorned his thoughts among the gods.

children.text: divo mānaṃ not sadan somapṛṣṭhāso adrayaḥ
children.translated_text: The pressing stones, bearing <s>Soma</s> on their backs, have measured out the measure of heaven, as it were, in their seats.

children.text: ukthā brahma ca śaṃsyā ||
children.translated_text: The ukthas and the sacred formulations are to be proclaimed in praise.

children.text: sa vidvāṁ aṅgirobhya indro gā avṛṇod apa
children.translated_text: That wise <s>Indra</s> opened up the cows for the <s>Aṅgirases</s>.

children.text: stuṣe tad asya pauṃsyam ||
children.translated_text: I praise that manly power of his.

children.text: sa pratnathā kavivṛdha indro vākasya vakṣaṇiḥ
children.translated_text: As of old, <s>Indra</s>, increaser of poets, bearer of speech,

children.text: śivo arkasya homany asmatrā gantv avase ||
children.translated_text: auspicious at the invocation of the song, let him come to us for aid.

children.text: ād ū nu te anu kratuṃ svāhā varasya yajyavaḥ
children.translated_text: Now, following your resolve, with svāhā, the worshippers of the chosen one

children.text: śvātram arkā anūṣatendra gotrasya dāvane ||
children.translated_text: have sung swift songs after you, O <s>Indra</s>, for the giving of the cattle-pen.

children.text: indre viśvāni vīryā kṛtāni kartvāni ca
children.translated_text: In <s>Indra</s> are all heroic deeds, those already done and those still to be done,

children.text: yam arkā adhvaraṃ viduḥ ||
children.translated_text: whom the songs know at the sacrifice.

children.text: yat pāñcajanyayā viśendre ghoṣā asṛkṣata
children.translated_text: When the cries went forth among all the five peoples toward <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: astṛṇād barhaṇā vipo 'ryo mānasya sa kṣayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he spread the sacred grass with might; that is the dwelling of the noble-minded seer.

children.text: iyam u te anuṣṭutiś cakṛṣe tāni pauṃsyā
children.translated_text: This praise has been made for you; you have performed those manly deeds.

children.text: prāvaś cakrasya vartanim ||
children.translated_text: You protected the track of the wheel.

children.text: asya vṛṣṇo vyodana uru kramiṣṭa jīvase
children.translated_text: For life may the wide portion of this bull extend far.

children.text: yavaṃ na paśva ā dade ||
children.translated_text: He has taken barley, as one takes it for cattle.

children.text: tad dadhānā avasyavo yuṣmābhir dakṣapitaraḥ
children.translated_text: Bearing that, desirous of aid, with you whose fathers are skill,

children.text: syāma marutvato vṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: may we be there for the increase of the one accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: baﾱ ṛtviyāya dhāmna ṛkvabhiḥ śūra nonumaḥ
children.translated_text: With the corrupt opening preserved in the text, for the timely sacred seat, with verses, O hero, we praise you.

children.text: jeṣāmendra tvayā yujā ||
children.translated_text: May we conquer, O <s>Indra</s>, joined with you.

children.text: asme rudrā mehanā parvatāso vṛtrahatye bharahūtau sajoṣāḥ
children.translated_text: For us may the <s>Rudras</s>, the rain-pourers, and the mountains, united at the call for help in the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>,

children.text: yaḥ śaṃsate stuvate dhāyi pajra indrajyeṣṭhā asmāṁ avantu devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: may the gods, with <s>Indra</s> foremost, protect us, the <s>Pajra</s> who recites and praises.

children.text: Chapter 684
ut tvā mandantu stomāḥ kṛṇuṣva rādho adrivaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the chants gladden you; make bounty for us, O stone-armed one.

children.text: ava brahmadviṣo jahi ||
children.translated_text: Strike down the haters of sacred formulation.

children.text: padā paṇīṃr arādhaso ni bādhasva mahāṁ asi
children.translated_text: With your foot press down the ungenerous <s>Paṇis</s>; you are great.

children.text: nahi tvā kaścana prati ||
children.translated_text: For no one at all can stand against you.

children.text: tvam īśiṣe sutānām indra tvam asutānām
children.translated_text: You are lord of the pressed soma-draughts, O <s>Indra</s>, and you are lord of the unpressed ones.

children.text: tvaṃ rājā janānām ||
children.translated_text: You are king of peoples.

children.text: ehi prehi kṣayo divy āghoṣañcarṣaṇīnām
children.translated_text: Come here, come forth to the heavenly dwelling, roaring among the peoples.

children.text: obhe pṛṇāsi rodasī ||
children.translated_text: You fill both heaven and earth.

children.text: tyaṃ cit parvataṃ giriṃ śatavantaṃ sahasriṇam
children.translated_text: That mountain, that hill, possessing hundreds and thousands,

children.text: vi stotṛbhyo rurojitha ||
children.translated_text: you broke open for the singers.

children.text: vayam u tvā divā sute vayaṃ naktaṃ havāmahe
children.translated_text: We call you by day when the soma is pressed; we call you by night.

children.text: asmākaṃ kāmam ā pṛṇa ||
children.translated_text: Fulfill our desire.

children.text: kva sya vṛṣabho yuvā tuvigrīvo anānataḥ
children.translated_text: Where is that young bull, thick-necked and unbending?

children.text: brahmā kas taṃ saparyati ||
children.translated_text: What priest tends him with sacred formulation?

children.text: kasya svit savanaṃ vṛṣā jujuṣvāṁ ava gacchati
children.translated_text: To whose pressing does the bull come down after gladly accepting it?

children.text: indraṃ ka u svid ā cake ||
children.translated_text: Who indeed has looked toward <s>Indra</s>?

children.text: kaṃ te dānā asakṣata vṛtrahan kaṃ suvīryā
children.translated_text: Whom have your gifts reached, O <s>Vṛtrahan</s>; whom have your heroic powers reached?

children.text: ukthe ka u svid antamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Who indeed is nearest to you in the hymn?

children.text: ayaṃ te mānuṣe jane somaḥ pūruṣu sūyate
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s> for you is pressed among human folk, among the <s>Pūrus</s>.

children.text: tasyehi pra dravā piba ||
children.translated_text: Come to it; run forward and drink.

children.text: ayaṃ te śaryaṇāvati suṣomāyām adhi priyaḥ
children.translated_text: This dear draught for you is at <s>Śaryaṇāvat</s>, at <s>Suṣomā</s>,

children.text: ārjīkīye madintamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and at the <s>Ārjīkīya</s>, most exhilarating.

children.text: tam adya rādhase mahe cārum madāya ghṛṣvaye
children.translated_text: For great bounty today, for lovely exhilaration and keen delight,

children.text: ehīm indra dravā piba ||
children.translated_text: come here, O <s>Indra</s>; run and drink.

children.text: Chapter 685
yad indra prāg apāg udaṅ nyag vā hūyase nṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: Whether, O <s>Indra</s>, you are called by men from the east, the west, the north, or below,

children.text: ā yāhi tūyam āśubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: come quickly with the swift ones.

children.text: yad vā prasravaṇe divo mādayāse svarṇare
children.translated_text: Or if you are exhilarated at the outflow of heaven, in the sun-bright realm,

children.text: yad vā samudre andhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: or if you are exhilarated in the ocean of the draught,

children.text: ā tvā gīrbhir mahām uruṃ huve gām iva bhojase
children.translated_text: I call you with songs, great and broad, like a cow for enjoyment,

children.text: indra somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, for the drinking of <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: ā ta indra mahimānaṃ harayo deva te mahaḥ
children.translated_text: May your bay steeds, O <s>Indra</s>, O god, bearing your greatness and your majesty,

children.text: rathe vahantu bibhrataḥ ||
children.translated_text: carry it on the chariot.

children.text: indra gṛṇīṣa u stuṣe mahāṁ ugra īśānakṛt
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, I sing to you and praise you, great, fierce, maker of lordship.

children.text: ehi naḥ sutam piba ||
children.translated_text: Come; drink our pressed soma.

children.text: sutāvantas tvā vayam prayasvanto havāmahe
children.translated_text: With soma pressed and offerings prepared, we call you.

children.text: idaṃ no barhir āsade ||
children.translated_text: This sacred grass is here for our sitting.

children.text: yac ciddhi śaśvatām asīndra sādhāraṇas tvam
children.translated_text: For even if you are common to all generations, O <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: taṃ tvā vayaṃ havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: you are the one whom we call.

children.text: idaṃ te somyam madhv adhukṣann adribhir naraḥ
children.translated_text: Men have milked this soma-honey for you with the stones.

children.text: juṣāṇa indra tat piba ||
children.translated_text: Accepting it, O <s>Indra</s>, drink that.

children.text: viśvāṁ aryo vipaścito 'ti khyas tūyam ā gahi
children.translated_text: Look beyond all discerning <s>Āryas</s>; come quickly.

children.text: asme dhehi śravo bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: Place great renown in us.

children.text: dātā me pṛṣatīnāṃ rājā hiraṇyavīnām
children.translated_text: The giver to me of dappled mares, the king of those with golden reins,

children.text: mā devā maghavā riṣat ||
children.translated_text: may the bounteous god not suffer harm.

children.text: sahasre pṛṣatīnām adhi ścandram bṛhat pṛthu
children.translated_text: Over a thousand dappled mares

children.text: śukraṃ hiraṇyam ā dade ||
children.translated_text: I have taken shining gold, bright, great, and broad.

children.text: napāto durgahasya me sahasreṇa surādhasaḥ
children.translated_text: The descendants of <s>Durgaha</s>, with a thousand gifts, very generous,

children.text: śravo deveṣv akrata ||
children.translated_text: have made my renown among the gods.

children.text: Chapter 686
tarobhir vo vidadvasum indraṃ sabādha ūtaye
children.translated_text: With songs, call <s>Indra</s>, finder of wealth, for aid amid distress.

children.text: bṛhad gāyantaḥ sutasome adhvare huve bharaṃ na kāriṇam ||
children.translated_text: Singing loudly at the soma-pressed sacrifice, I call him like a doer of work who bears the load.

children.text: na yaṃ dudhrā varante na sthirā muro made suśipram andhasaḥ
children.translated_text: Neither the weak nor firm walls restrain him when he is exhilarated by the soma, the fair-lipped one,

children.text: ya ādṛtyā śaśamānāya sunvate dātā jaritra ukthyam ||
children.translated_text: who, paying heed to the praising soma-presser, is a giver worthy of hymn for the singer.

children.text: yaḥ śakro mṛkṣo aśvyo yo vā kījo hiraṇyayaḥ
children.translated_text: He who is mighty, vigorous with horses, or who is golden in treasure,

children.text: sa ūrvasya rejayaty apāvṛtim indro gavyasya vṛtrahā ||
children.translated_text: that <s>Indra</s>, slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, shakes loose the opening of the cow-rich enclosure.

children.text: nikhātaṃ cid yaḥ purusaṃbhṛtaṃ vasūd id vapati dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: Even buried wealth, gathered by many, he scatters for the giver.

children.text: vajrī suśipro haryaśva it karad indraḥ kratvā yathā vaśat ||
children.translated_text: The vajra-bearing, fair-lipped, bay-horsed <s>Indra</s> will act by insight as he wills.

children.text: yad vāvantha puruṣṭuta purā cicchūra nṛṇām
children.translated_text: Whatever you have favored, much-praised one, even before, O hero, among men,

children.text: vayaṃ tat ta indra sam bharāmasi yajñam ukthaṃ turaṃ vacaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that we bring together for you, O <s>Indra</s>: sacrifice, hymn, and swift utterance.

children.text: sacā someṣu puruhūta vajrivo madāya dyukṣa somapāḥ
children.translated_text: Be present among the soma-pressings, much-invoked vajra-bearer, shining soma-drinker, for exhilaration.

children.text: tvam iddhi brahmakṛte kāmyaṃ vasu deṣṭhaḥ sunvate bhuvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For you indeed have been the best giver of desirable wealth to the maker of sacred verse and to the soma-presser.

children.text: vayam enam idā hyo 'pīpemeha vajriṇam
children.translated_text: We have now, here, filled this vajra-bearer even from yesterday's rite.

children.text: tasmā u adya samanā sutam bharā nūnam bhūṣata śrute ||
children.translated_text: Therefore today bring the pressed soma to him together; now adorn him for what is heard.

children.text: vṛkaś cid asya vāraṇa urāmathir ā vayuneṣu bhūṣati
children.translated_text: Even a fierce defender of his, ranging wide, adorns himself among the guiding powers.

children.text: semaṃ na stomaṃ jujuṣāṇa ā gahīndra pra citrayā dhiyā ||
children.translated_text: Enjoying this chant of ours, come here, O <s>Indra</s>, with brilliant thought.

children.text: kad ū nv asyākṛtam indrasyāsti pauṃsyam
children.translated_text: When indeed has any manly deed of <s>Indra</s> been left undone?

children.text: keno nu kaṃ śromatena na śuśruve januṣaḥ pari vṛtrahā ||
children.translated_text: By what famed deed has the <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer not been heard of from his birth?

children.text: kad ū mahīr adhṛṣṭā asya taviṣīḥ kad u vṛtraghno astṛtam
children.translated_text: When have his great, unassailable powers failed? When has the <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer's strength not spread out?

children.text: indro viśvān bekanāṭāṁ ahardṛśa uta kratvā paṇīṃr abhi ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> brought all the <s>Bekanāṭas</s> to the sight of day, and by his will overcame the <s>Paṇis</s>.

children.text: vayaṃ ghā te apūrvyendra brahmāṇi vṛtrahan
children.translated_text: We indeed offer sacred formulations to you, O unprecedented <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Vṛtrahan</s>.

children.text: purūtamāsaḥ puruhūta vajrivo bhṛtiṃ na pra bharāmasi ||
children.translated_text: O most bountiful, much-invoked thunderbolt-bearer, we bring forward abundant sustenance as if a tribute.

children.text: pūrvīś ciddhi tve tuvikūrminn āśaso havanta indrotayaḥ
children.translated_text: For even many hopes and aids call upon you, O mighty-working <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: tiraś cid aryaḥ savanā vaso gahi śaviṣṭha śrudhi me havam ||
children.translated_text: come across even to the Soma-pressing, O good one; strongest, hear my call.

children.text: vayaṃ ghā te tve id v indra viprā api ṣmasi
children.translated_text: We indeed, O <s>Indra</s>, inspired poets, are attached to you alone.

children.text: nahi tvad anyaḥ puruhūta kaścana maghavann asti marḍitā ||
children.translated_text: For apart from you, O much-invoked <s>Maghavan</s>, there is no one at all who shows mercy.

children.text: tvaṃ no asyā amater uta kṣudho 'bhiśaster ava spṛdhi
children.translated_text: Protect us from this want, and also from hunger and from the curse.

children.text: tvaṃ na ūtī tava citrayā dhiyā śikṣā śaciṣṭha gātuvit ||
children.translated_text: With your aid and your bright insight, guide us, most powerful finder of the path.

children.text: soma id vaḥ suto astu kalayo mā bibhītana
children.translated_text: Let the <s>Soma</s> be pressed for you, O singers; do not be afraid.

children.text: aped eṣa dhvasmāyati svayaṃ ghaiṣo apāyati ||
children.translated_text: This one goes away to ruin; indeed he departs by himself.

children.text: Chapter 687
tyān nu kṣatriyāṁ ava ādityān yāciṣāmahe
children.translated_text: Now let us seek protection from those sovereign <s>Ādityas</s>,

children.text: sumṛﾱīkāṁ abhiṣṭaye ||
children.translated_text: for gracious favor, for the desired help.

children.text: mitro no aty aṃhatiṃ varuṇaḥ parṣad aryamā
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s> carry us beyond distress, and <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Aryaman</s>,

children.text: ādityāso yathā viduḥ ||
children.translated_text: as the <s>Ādityas</s> know how.

children.text: teṣāṃ hi citram ukthyaṃ varūtham asti dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: For theirs is a wondrous, praiseworthy shelter for the worshipper,

children.text: ādityānām araṅkṛte ||
children.translated_text: for the one who honors the <s>Ādityas</s>.

children.text: mahi vo mahatām avo varuṇa mitrāryaman
children.translated_text: Great is your aid, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>, aid of the great ones;

children.text: avāṃsy ā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: we choose your protections.

children.text: jīvān no abhi dhetanādityāsaḥ purā hathāt
children.translated_text: Set us down alive, O <s>Ādityas</s>, before the blow strikes;

children.text: kaddha stha havanaśrutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: where indeed are you, hearers of the invocation?

children.text: yad vaḥ śrāntāya sunvate varūtham asti yac chardiḥ
children.translated_text: That shelter of yours for the weary Soma-presser, that protection,

children.text: tenā no adhi vocata ||
children.translated_text: with that, speak on our behalf.

children.text: asti devā aṃhor urv asti ratnam anāgasaḥ
children.translated_text: There is, O gods, a broad escape from distress; there is treasure for the guiltless.

children.text: ādityā adbhutainasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Ādityas</s>, wondrous removers of sin.

children.text: mā naḥ setuḥ siṣed ayam mahe vṛṇaktu nas pari
children.translated_text: Let not this bond fasten upon us; let it turn away from us for greatness.

children.text: indra iddhi śruto vaśī ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s> is renowned and masterful.

children.text: mā no mṛcā ripūṇāṃ vṛjinānām aviṣyavaḥ
children.translated_text: Do not crush us among enemies and crooked men who wish to harm us,

children.text: devā abhi pra mṛkṣata ||
children.translated_text: O gods, do not strike us down.

children.text: uta tvām adite mahy ahaṃ devy upa bruve
children.translated_text: And you, O great goddess <s>Aditi</s>, I call upon

children.text: sumṛﾱīkām abhiṣṭaye ||
children.translated_text: for gracious favor, for the desired help.

children.text: parṣi dīne gabhīra āṃ ugraputre jighāṃsataḥ
children.translated_text: Carry us, though poor, through the deep place, away from the fierce son who seeks to kill.

children.text: mākis tokasya no riṣat ||
children.translated_text: Let no harm come to our offspring.

children.text: aneho na uruvraja urūci vi prasartave
children.translated_text: Make for us, unharmed, a broad enclosure, wide for going forth,

children.text: kṛdhi tokāya jīvase ||
children.translated_text: for our offspring, that they may live.

children.text: ye mūrdhānaḥ kṣitīnām adabdhāsaḥ svayaśasaḥ
children.translated_text: Those who are chiefs of peoples, undeceived and famed by themselves,

children.text: vratā rakṣante adruhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: guileless, guard the sacred ordinances.

children.text: te na āsno vṛkāṇām ādityāso mumocata
children.translated_text: Those <s>Ādityas</s>, O <s>Aditi</s>, release us from the mouths of wolves,

children.text: stenam baddham ivādite ||
children.translated_text: like a thief bound in fetters.

children.text: apo ṣu ṇa iyaṃ śarur ādityā apa durmatiḥ
children.translated_text: Let this arrow go away from us, O <s>Ādityas</s>; let evil thought go away.

children.text: asmad etv ajaghnuṣī ||
children.translated_text: Let it depart from us without striking.

children.text: śaśvaddhi vaḥ sudānava ādityā ūtibhir vayam
children.translated_text: For always, O generous <s>Ādityas</s>, through your aids we

children.text: purā nūnam bubhujmahe ||
children.translated_text: have enjoyed protection, before and now.

children.text: śaśvantaṃ hi pracetasaḥ pratiyantaṃ cid enasaḥ
children.translated_text: For, O thoughtful gods, even one continually approaching guilt

children.text: devāḥ kṛṇutha jīvase ||
children.translated_text: you set free for life.

children.text: tat su no navyaṃ sanyasa ādityā yan mumocati
children.translated_text: May that new release be ours, O <s>Ādityas</s>, by which one frees,

children.text: bandhād baddham ivādite ||
children.translated_text: as <s>Aditi</s> frees one bound from a bond.

children.text: nāsmākam asti tat tara ādityāso atiṣkade
children.translated_text: There is no such obstacle for us there, O <s>Ādityas</s>, to be overstepped.

children.text: yūyam asmabhyam mṛﾱata ||
children.translated_text: Show mercy to us.

children.text: mā no hetir vivasvata ādityāḥ kṛtrimā śaruḥ
children.translated_text: Let not the missile of <s>Vivasvat</s>, O <s>Ādityas</s>, nor the fashioned arrow,

children.text: purā nu jaraso vadhīt ||
children.translated_text: strike us down before old age.

children.text: vi ṣu dveṣo vy aṃhatim ādityāso vi saṃhitam
children.translated_text: Scatter hatred, scatter distress, O <s>Ādityas</s>; scatter what is bound together.

children.text: viṣvag vi vṛhatā rapaḥ ||
children.translated_text: On every side tear harm apart.

children.text: Chapter 688
ā tvā rathaṃ yathotaye sumnāya vartayāmasi
children.translated_text: I turn your chariot toward aid and toward favor,

children.text: tuvikūrmim ṛtīṣaham indra śaviṣṭha satpate ||
children.translated_text: O mighty-working, truth-winning <s>Indra</s>, strongest lord of the good.

children.text: tuviśuṣma tuvikrato śacīvo viśvayā mate
children.translated_text: O mighty in force, mighty in will, powerful one, with every thought

children.text: ā paprātha mahitvanā ||
children.translated_text: you have filled the spaces with your greatness.

children.text: yasya te mahinā mahaḥ pari jmāyantam īyatuḥ
children.translated_text: At whose greatness your two great hands, moving around the earth,

children.text: hastā vajraṃ hiraṇyayam ||
children.translated_text: have taken up the golden thunderbolt.

children.text: viśvānarasya vas patim anānatasya śavasaḥ
children.translated_text: As lord of the wealth of all men, of unbending might,

children.text: evaiś ca carṣaṇīnām ūtī huve rathānām ||
children.translated_text: with these aids I call you for men and for chariots.

children.text: abhiṣṭaye sadāvṛdhaṃ svarmīﾱheṣu yaṃ naraḥ
children.translated_text: For desired help, the ever-growing one, whom men in the Soma-rich places

children.text: nānā havanta ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: call in many ways for aid.

children.text: paromātram ṛcīṣamam indram ugraṃ surādhasam
children.translated_text: I call <s>Indra</s>, beyond measure, rich in hymns, fierce, rich in good gifts,

children.text: īśānaṃ cid vasūnām ||
children.translated_text: even the lord of treasures.

children.text: taṃ tam id rādhase maha indraṃ codāmi pītaye
children.translated_text: That very <s>Indra</s> I urge toward great bounty and toward drinking,

children.text: yaḥ pūrvyām anuṣṭutim īśe kṛṣṭīnāṃ nṛtuḥ ||
children.translated_text: who rules the ancient praise, the leader of the peoples.

children.text: na yasya te śavasāna sakhyam ānaṃśa martyaḥ
children.translated_text: No mortal has attained your friendship, O powerful one.

children.text: nakiḥ śavāṃsi te naśat ||
children.translated_text: No one has reached your powers.

children.text: tvotāsas tvā yujāpsu sūrye mahad dhanam
children.translated_text: Protected by you, yoked with you, may we win great wealth in the waters and in the sun,

children.text: jayema pṛtsu vajrivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: in battles, O thunderbolt-bearer.

children.text: taṃ tvā yajñebhir īmahe taṃ gīrbhir girvaṇastama
children.translated_text: We seek that very you with sacrifices, that very you with songs, O most song-loving one,

children.text: indra yathā cid āvitha vājeṣu purumāyyam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, just as you aided <s>Purumāyya</s> in the contests.

children.text: yasya te svādu sakhyaṃ svādvī praṇītir adrivaḥ
children.translated_text: Your friendship is sweet, your guidance sweet, O stone-wielder.

children.text: yajño vitantasāyyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The sacrifice is worthy of being stretched out.

children.text: uru ṇas tanve tana uru kṣayāya nas kṛdhi
children.translated_text: Make broad space for our body, broad space for our dwelling.

children.text: uru ṇo yandhi jīvase ||
children.translated_text: Grant us broad room for living.

children.text: uruṃ nṛbhya uruṃ gava uruṃ rathāya panthām
children.translated_text: A broad path for men, broad for cattle, broad for the chariot,

children.text: devavītim manāmahe ||
children.translated_text: we think upon as the way to the gods.

children.text: upa mā ṣaḍ dvā dvā naraḥ somasya harṣyā
children.translated_text: Near me stand six men, two by two, exhilarated by <s>Soma</s>,

children.text: tiṣṭhanti svādurātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: givers of sweet gifts.

children.text: ṛjrāv indrota ā dade harī ṛkṣasya sūnavi
children.translated_text: With <s>Indra</s>'s aid I received the two bay horses, the two straight-going ones, for the son of <s>Ṛkṣa</s>,

children.text: āśvamedhasya rohitā ||
children.translated_text: the two red ones of <s>Āśvamedha</s>.

children.text: surathāṁ ātithigve svabhīśūṃr ārkṣe
children.translated_text: Good-charioted horses for <s>Ātithigva</s>, finely reined, from the descendant of <s>Ṛkṣa</s>,

children.text: āśvamedhe supeśasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for <s>Āśvamedha</s>, beautifully adorned.

children.text: ṣaﾱ aśvāṁ ātithigva indrote vadhūmataḥ
children.translated_text: Six horses, O <s>Ātithigva</s>, with <s>Indra</s>'s aid, accompanied by mares,

children.text: sacā pūtakratau sanam ||
children.translated_text: I won together from <s>Pūtakratu</s>.

children.text: aiṣu cetad vṛṣaṇvaty antar ṛjreṣv aruṣī
