children.translated_text: Among these reddish mares, this one, full of bull-like vigor,

children.text: svabhīśuḥ kaśāvatī ||
children.translated_text: has good reins and a whip.

children.text: na yuṣme vājabandhavo ninitsuś cana martyaḥ
children.translated_text: Among you, O kinsmen bound to the prize, no mortal, not even one wishing to blame,

children.text: avadyam adhi dīdharat ||
children.translated_text: has laid reproach upon you.

children.text: Chapter 689
pra pra vas triṣṭubham iṣam mandadvīrāyendave
children.translated_text: Forward and forward he wins nourishing power in triṣṭubh measure for the Soma that gladdens heroes;

children.text: dhiyā vo medhasātaye purandhyā vivāsati ||
children.translated_text: with thought and inspiration, for your winning of wisdom.

children.text: nadaṃ va odatīnāṃ nadaṃ yoyuvatīnām
children.translated_text: A stream among the waters, a stream among young women,

children.text: patiṃ vo aghnyānāṃ dhenūnām iṣudhyasi ||
children.translated_text: you seek the lord of your cows, of the milk-cows that must not be slain.

children.text: tā asya sūdadohasaḥ somaṃ śrīṇanti pṛśnayaḥ
children.translated_text: Those speckled cows, yielding good milk, mix the <s>Soma</s> for him.

children.text: janman devānāṃ viśas triṣv ā rocane divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: At the birth of the gods, the peoples shine in the three bright realms of heaven.

children.text: abhi pra gopatiṃ girendram arca yathā vide
children.translated_text: With song praise <s>Indra</s>, the lord of cattle, as you know how,

children.text: sūnuṃ satyasya satpatim ||
children.translated_text: the son of truth, the true lord.

children.text: ā harayaḥ sasṛjrire 'ruṣīr adhi barhiṣi
children.translated_text: The tawny ones have streamed forth, reddish, upon the sacred grass.

children.text: yatrābhi saṃnavāmahe ||
children.translated_text: where we join ourselves together.

children.text: indrāya gāva āśiraṃ duduhre vajriṇe madhu
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s>, for the vajra-bearing one, the cows have milked the honeyed mixture,

children.text: yat sīm upahvare vidat ||
children.translated_text: when he found it in the secret place.

children.text: ud yad bradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ gṛham indraś ca ganvahi
children.translated_text: When we two, <s>Indra</s> and I, go up to the summit, to the house of the ruddy one,

children.text: madhvaḥ pītvā sacevahi triḥ sapta sakhyuḥ pade ||
children.translated_text: having drunk of the honey, let us remain together at the thrice-sevenfold station of the friend.

children.text: arcata prārcata priyamedhāso arcata
children.translated_text: Sing, sing forth, O <s>Priyamedhas</s>; sing.

children.text: arcantu putrakā uta puraṃ na dhṛṣṇv arcata ||
children.translated_text: Let even the sons sing; like a bold stronghold, sing.

children.text: ava svarāti gargaro godhā pari saniṣvaṇat
children.translated_text: The gargara instrument sounds down; the godhā sounds all around.

children.text: piṅgā pari caniṣkadad indrāya brahmodyatam ||
children.translated_text: The piṅgā rings all around; let the sacred formulation be raised for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: ā yat patanty enyaḥ sudughā anapasphuraḥ
children.translated_text: When the dark, easy-milking, unshaken ones fly here,

children.text: apasphuraṃ gṛbhāyata somam indrāya pātave ||
children.translated_text: grasp the unshaken Soma for <s>Indra</s> to drink.

children.text: apād indro apād agnir viśve devā amatsata
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> has drunk, <s>Agni</s> has drunk; all the gods have rejoiced.

children.text: varuṇa id iha kṣayat tam āpo abhy anūṣata vatsaṃ saṃśiśvarīr iva ||
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s> indeed dwells here; the waters have called to him like cows lowing after a calf.

children.text: sudevo asi varuṇa yasya te sapta sindhavaḥ
children.translated_text: You are a good god, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, for your seven rivers

children.text: anukṣaranti kākudaṃ sūrmyaṃ suṣirām iva ||
children.translated_text: flow along your height, like pipes into a well-bored channel.

children.text: yo vyatīṃr aphāṇayat suyuktāṁ upa dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: He who made the wide-spread waters swell out for the well-yoked worshipper,

children.text: takvo netā tad id vapur upamā yo amucyata ||
children.translated_text: the swift leader: that indeed was his form, the likeness by which he was released.

children.text: atīd u śakra ohata indro viśvā ati dviṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Thereupon, O mighty one, <s>Indra</s> drove off, beyond all hatreds;

children.text: bhinat kanīna odanam pacyamānam paro girā ||
children.translated_text: by his cry he split open, for the girl, the cooked grain that was being prepared.

children.text: arbhako na kumārako 'dhi tiṣṭhan navaṃ ratham
children.translated_text: Like a little child, like a boy, standing upon the new chariot,

children.text: sa pakṣan mahiṣam mṛgam pitre mātre vibhukratum ||
children.translated_text: he seized the great buffalo, the wild beast, rich in skill, for father and mother.

children.text: ā tū suśipra dampate rathaṃ tiṣṭhā hiraṇyayam
children.translated_text: Come now, O fair-lipped lord of the house; mount the golden chariot.

children.text: adha dyukṣaṃ sacevahi sahasrapādam aruṣaṃ svastigām anehasam ||
children.translated_text: Then let us accompany the bright, thousand-footed, ruddy one, going well and unharmed.

children.text: taṃ ghem itthā namasvina upa svarājam āsate
children.translated_text: The reverent ones sit beside him in just that way, the self-ruling one.

children.text: arthaṃ cid asya sudhitaṃ yad etava āvartayanti dāvane ||
children.translated_text: Even the well-set purpose of this man they turn around for giving, when they come.

children.text: anu pratnasyaukasaḥ priyamedhāsa eṣām
children.translated_text: Following the ancient dwelling, the <s>Priyamedhas</s> among them

children.text: pūrvām anu prayatiṃ vṛktabarhiṣo hitaprayasa āśata ||
children.translated_text: have reached the former offering, with strewn sacrificial grass and well-directed zeal.

children.text: Chapter 690
yo rājā carṣaṇīnāṃ yātā rathebhir adhriguḥ
children.translated_text: The king of peoples, who goes with chariots, irresistible,

children.text: viśvāsāṃ tarutā pṛtanānāṃ jyeṣṭho yo vṛtrahā gṛṇe ||
children.translated_text: the crosser of all battles, the foremost, the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>: him I praise.

children.text: indraṃ taṃ śumbha puruhanmann avase yasya dvitā vidhartari
children.translated_text: Adorn that <s>Indra</s>, O much-invoked one, for aid, in whose double support

children.text: hastāya vajraḥ prati dhāyi darśato maho dive na sūryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the visible vajra has been placed in his hand, like the sun in great heaven.

children.text: nakiṣ ṭaṃ karmaṇā naśad yaś cakāra sadāvṛdham
children.translated_text: No one will destroy by deed the one who made <s>Indra</s> ever-growing,

children.text: indraṃ na yajñair viśvagūrtam ṛbhvasam adhṛṣṭaṃ dhṛṣṇvojasam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, celebrated everywhere by sacrifices, skillful, undaunted, and of bold power.

children.text: aṣāﾱham ugram pṛtanāsu sāsahiṃ yasmin mahīr urujrayaḥ
children.translated_text: The overpowering, fierce one, conquering in battles, in whom the great, wide-ranging powers rest,

children.text: saṃ dhenavo jāyamāne anonavur dyāvaḥ kṣāmo anonavuḥ ||
children.translated_text: at his birth the milk-cows lowed together; the heavens and the earths lowed together.

children.text: yad dyāva indra te śataṃ śatam bhūmīr uta syuḥ
children.translated_text: If, O <s>Indra</s>, a hundred heavens should be yours, and a hundred earths as well,

children.text: na tvā vajrin sahasraṃ sūryā anu na jātam aṣṭa rodasī ||
children.translated_text: not even a thousand suns, O vajra-bearer, nor the two worlds that have been born, would equal you.

children.text: ā paprātha mahinā vṛṣṇyā vṛṣan viśvā śaviṣṭha śavasā
children.translated_text: You have spread out by your greatness and bull-like force, O bull, strongest one, with your might.

children.text: asmāṁ ava maghavan gomati vraje vajriñ citrābhir ūtibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Protect us, O <s>Maghavan</s>, in a cattle-rich enclosure, O vajra-bearer, with splendid aids.

children.text: na sīm adeva āpad iṣaṃ dīrghāyo martyaḥ
children.translated_text: No godless mortal, though long-lived, has reached that nourishment.

children.text: etagvā cid ya etaśā yuyojate harī indro yuyojate ||
children.translated_text: Even the one who harnesses with the swift horse: <s>Indra</s> harnesses his two bay steeds.

children.text: taṃ vo maho mahāyyam indraṃ dānāya sakṣaṇim
children.translated_text: That great <s>Indra</s>, worthy of greatness, I proclaim to you, able to win gifts,

children.text: yo gādheṣu ya āraṇeṣu havyo vājeṣv asti havyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he who is to be invoked in shallows, who is to be invoked in wildernesses, who is to be invoked in contests.

children.text: ud ū ṣu ṇo vaso mahe mṛśasva śūra rādhase
children.translated_text: Rise up for us, O good one, O hero; touch us for great bounty.

children.text: ud ū ṣu mahyai maghavan maghattaya ud indra śravase mahe ||
children.translated_text: Rise up for great generosity, O <s>Maghavan</s>; rise, O <s>Indra</s>, for great fame.

children.text: tvaṃ na indra ṛtayus tvānido ni tṛmpasi
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, are our one who seeks the truth; you cast down those who revile you.

children.text: madhye vasiṣva tuvinṛmṇorvor ni dāsaṃ śiśnatho hathaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Dwell in the midst of the two wide spaces, rich in manly strength; strike down the servant with your slaying blows.

children.text: anyavratam amānuṣam ayajvānam adevayum
children.translated_text: The one of other vows, inhuman, not sacrificing, not honoring the gods:

children.text: ava svaḥ sakhā dudhuvīta parvataḥ sughnāya dasyum parvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: let the mountain, as a friend, shake him down from heaven; the mountain, easy to strike with, shake down the Dasyu.

children.text: tvaṃ na indrāsāṃ haste śaviṣṭha dāvane
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, most powerful, are in our hands for giving,

children.text: dhānānāṃ na saṃ gṛbhāyāsmayur dviḥ saṃ gṛbhāyāsmayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: as men gather grains; may they gather them for us twice, may they gather them for us.

children.text: sakhāyaḥ kratum icchata kathā rādhāma śarasya
children.translated_text: Friends, seek inspired resolve: how shall we attain the bounty of the arrow?

children.text: upastutim bhojaḥ sūrir yo ahrayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The generous patron, the munificent giver, who is unashamed, deserves praise.

children.text: bhūribhiḥ samaha ṛṣibhir barhiṣmadbhi staviṣyase
children.translated_text: With many seers together, with those possessing sacrificial grass, you will be praised,

children.text: yad ittham ekam ekam icchara vatsān parādadaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when, seeking each single one in this way, you gave the calves away to others.

children.text: karṇagṛhyā maghavā śauradevyo vatsaṃ nas tribhya ānayat
children.translated_text: <s>Maghavan Śauradevya</s>, taking it by the ear, brought us the calf for the three,

children.text: ajāṃ sūrir na dhātave ||
children.translated_text: like a generous patron bringing a goat to be bestowed.

children.text: Chapter 691
tvaṃ no agne mahobhiḥ pāhi viśvasyā arāteḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, protect us with your greatnesses from every hostility,

children.text: uta dviṣo martyasya ||
children.translated_text: and also from the hatred of mortal man.

children.text: nahi manyuḥ pauruṣeya īśe hi vaḥ priyajāta
children.translated_text: For human anger has no power, since you are dear-born among you;

children.text: tvam id asi kṣapāvān ||
children.translated_text: you alone are the lord of nights.

children.text: sa no viśvebhir devebhir ūrjo napād bhadraśoce
children.translated_text: With all the gods, O offspring of strength, O bright-flamed one,

children.text: rayiṃ dehi viśvavāram ||
children.translated_text: give us wealth desirable to all.

children.text: na tam agne arātayo martaṃ yuvanta rāyaḥ
children.translated_text: Hostilities do not deprive that mortal of wealth, O <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: yaṃ trāyase dāśvāṃsam ||
children.translated_text: whom you protect when he gives offerings.

children.text: yaṃ tvaṃ vipra medhasātāv agne hinoṣi dhanāya
children.translated_text: The man whom you, O inspired <s>Agni</s>, urge on in the contest for a share, for wealth,

children.text: sa tavotī goṣu gantā ||
children.translated_text: he, through your aid, will reach the cattle.

children.text: tvaṃ rayim puruvīram agne dāśuṣe martāya
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, bring wealth rich in heroes to the mortal worshipper;

children.text: pra ṇo naya vasyo accha ||
children.translated_text: lead us onward toward what is better.

children.text: uruṣyā ṇo mā parā dā aghāyate jātavedaḥ
children.translated_text: Protect us; do not hand us over to the evil-doer, O <s>Jātavedas</s>,

children.text: durādhye martāya ||
children.translated_text: to the mortal of evil intent.

children.text: agne mākiṣ ṭe devasya rātim adevo yuyota
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, let no godless man cut off the gift of you, the god;

children.text: tvam īśiṣe vasūnām ||
children.translated_text: you have command of goods.

children.text: sa no vasva upa māsy ūrjo napān māhinasya
children.translated_text: Come near to us with wealth, O offspring of strength, with greatness,

children.text: sakhe vaso jaritṛbhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O friend, O good one, for the singers.

children.text: acchā naḥ śīraśociṣaṃ giro yantu darśatam
children.translated_text: Let our songs go toward the bright-flamed, visible one;

children.text: acchā yajñāso namasā purūvasum purupraśastam ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: let our sacrifices go with reverence toward the very wealthy, much-praised one, for aid.

children.text: agniṃ sūnuṃ sahaso jātavedasaṃ dānāya vāryāṇām
children.translated_text: To <s>Agni</s>, son of strength, <s>Jātavedas</s>, for the gift of desirable goods,

children.text: dvitā yo bhūd amṛto martyeṣv ā hotā mandratamo viśi ||
children.translated_text: who became twofold, immortal among mortals, the most gladdening hotar in the clan.

children.text: agniṃ vo devayajyayāgnim prayaty adhvare
children.translated_text: To <s>Agni</s> with worship of the gods, to <s>Agni</s> at the beginning of the sacrifice.

children.text: agniṃ dhīṣu prathamam agnim arvaty agniṃ kṣaitrāya sādhase ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> first in our thoughts, <s>Agni</s> in the swift steed, <s>Agni</s> for success in the fields.

children.text: agnir iṣāṃ sakhye dadātu na īśe yo vāryāṇām
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s> grant us friendship in nourishment; he is lord of desirable goods.

children.text: agniṃ toke tanaye śaśvad īmahe vasuṃ santaṃ tanūpām ||
children.translated_text: We continually implore <s>Agni</s> for offspring and descendants, as wealth, present and protecting the body.

children.text: agnim īﾱiṣvāvase gāthābhiḥ śīraśociṣam
children.translated_text: Praise <s>Agni</s> for aid with songs, him whose flame is keen.

children.text: agniṃ rāye purumīﾱha śrutaṃ naro 'gniṃ sudītaye chardiḥ ||
children.translated_text: O men, praise <s>Agni</s> for wealth, the much-invoked, renowned one; praise <s>Agni</s> as shelter for good shining.

children.text: agniṃ dveṣo yotavai no gṛṇīmasy agniṃ śaṃ yoś ca dātave
children.translated_text: We praise <s>Agni</s> to ward off hatred from us, and <s>Agni</s> to grant peace and well-being.

children.text: viśvāsu vikṣv aviteva havyo bhuvad vastur ṛṣūṇām ||
children.translated_text: In all settlements may he, invoked like a protector, become the dwelling-place of the inspired ones.

children.text: Chapter 692
haviṣ kṛṇudhvam ā gamad adhvaryur vanate punaḥ
children.translated_text: Make the oblation ready; the <s>adhvaryu</s> will come, and he wins it again,

children.text: vidvāṁ asya praśāsanam ||
children.translated_text: knowing this one's ordinance.

children.text: ni tigmam abhy aṃśuṃ sīdaddhotā manāv adhi
children.translated_text: The <s>hotṛ</s> sat down among men upon the sharp stalk,

children.text: juṣāṇo asya sakhyam ||
children.translated_text: delighting in his friendship.

children.text: antar icchanti taṃ jane rudram paro manīṣayā
children.translated_text: Among the people they seek that <s>Rudra</s> within; from afar, through inspired thought,

children.text: gṛbhṇanti jihvayā sasam ||
children.translated_text: they grasp the sleeping one with the tongue.

children.text: jāmy atītape dhanur vayodhā aruhad vanam
children.translated_text: The kinswoman grew hot; the strength-giving bow mounted the wood,

children.text: dṛṣadaṃ jihvayāvadhīt ||
children.translated_text: and with its tongue struck the stone.

children.text: caran vatso ruśann iha nidātāraṃ na vindate
children.translated_text: The bright calf, moving here, does not find the binder;

children.text: veti stotava ambyam ||
children.translated_text: he goes to the praiser, to the motherly place.

children.text: uto nv asya yan mahad aśvāvad yojanam bṛhat
children.translated_text: And now, when his great, broad course with horses is seen,

children.text: dāmā rathasya dadṛśe ||
children.translated_text: the reins of the chariot appear.

children.text: duhanti saptaikām upa dvā pañca sṛjataḥ
children.translated_text: Seven milk the one; beside the two, five send forth

children.text: tīrthe sindhor adhi svare ||
children.translated_text: at the ford of the river, upon the sounding height.

children.text: ā daśabhir vivasvata indraḥ kośam acucyavīt
children.translated_text: With ten, <s>Indra</s>, son of <s>Vivasvat</s>, shook down the vessel

children.text: khedayā trivṛtā divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: from heaven with the threefold strap.

children.text: pari tridhātur adhvaraṃ jūrṇir eti navīyasī
children.translated_text: The threefold one, newly ancient, goes around the sacrifice,

children.text: madhvā hotāro añjate ||
children.translated_text: and the <s>hotṛ</s>s anoint themselves with honey.

children.text: siñcanti namasāvatam uccācakram parijmānam
children.translated_text: With reverence they pour into the well the high-wheeled one that ranges around,

children.text: nīcīnabāram akṣitam ||
children.translated_text: with its downward bar, inexhaustible.

children.text: abhyāram id adrayo niṣiktam puṣkare madhu
children.translated_text: The pressing stones have come near the poured honey in the lotus

children.text: avatasya visarjane ||
children.translated_text: at the outlet of the well.

children.text: gāva upāvatāvatam mahī yajñasya rapsudā
children.translated_text: The cows have approached the well, the great giver of sap for the sacrifice,

children.text: ubhā karṇā hiraṇyayā ||
children.translated_text: with both ears golden.

children.text: ā sute siñcata śriyaṃ rodasyor abhiśriyam
children.translated_text: At the Soma-pressing pour out splendor, the adornment of heaven and earth;

children.text: rasā dadhīta vṛṣabham ||
children.translated_text: let him take the bull with the juices.

children.text: te jānata svam okyaṃ saṃ vatsāso na mātṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: They know their own home; like calves with their mothers,

children.text: mitho nasanta jāmibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: they meet one another with their kin.

children.text: upa srakveṣu bapsataḥ kṛṇvate dharuṇaṃ divi
children.translated_text: Feeding at the corners, they make a support in heaven;

children.text: indre agnā namaḥ svaḥ ||
children.translated_text: in <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> there is homage and the sacred cry.

children.text: adhukṣat pipyuṣīm iṣam ūrjaṃ saptapadīm ariḥ
children.translated_text: The foe milked the swelling nourishment, strength with seven steps,

children.text: sūryasya sapta raśmibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: by the seven rays of the sun.

children.text: somasya mitrāvaruṇoditā sūra ā dade
children.translated_text: The sun, set in motion by <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, took hold of the Soma;

children.text: tad āturasya bheṣajam ||
children.translated_text: that is the medicine for the distressed one.

children.text: uto nv asya yat padaṃ haryatasya nidhānyam
children.translated_text: And now, when this hidden step of the tawny one

children.text: pari dyāṃ jihvayātanat ||
children.translated_text: stretched its tongue around heaven.

children.text: Chapter 693
ud īrāthām ṛtāyate yuñjāthām aśvinā ratham
children.translated_text: Rise up for the one who seeks <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order); yoke the chariot, O <s>Aśvins</s>;

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let your aid be near.

children.text: nimiṣaś cij javīyasā rathenā yātam aśvinā
children.translated_text: With a chariot swifter even than a blink, come, O <s>Aśvins</s>;

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let your aid be near.

children.text: upa stṛṇītam atraye himena gharmam aśvinā
children.translated_text: Spread coolness over the heat for <s>Atri</s> with snow, O <s>Aśvins</s>;

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let your aid be near.

children.text: kuha sthaḥ kuha jagmathuḥ kuha śyeneva petathuḥ
children.translated_text: Where are you? Where have you gone? Where have you flown like eagles?

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let your aid be near.

children.text: yad adya karhi karhicicchuśrūyātam imaṃ havam
children.translated_text: If today, whenever it may be, you should hear this call,

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let your aid be near.

children.text: aśvinā yāmahūtamā nediṣṭhaṃ yāmy āpyam
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, most invoked at the journey, I call upon your nearest kinship;

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let your aid be near.

children.text: avantam atraye gṛhaṃ kṛṇutaṃ yuvam aśvinā
children.translated_text: Make a protecting house for <s>Atri</s>, you two, O <s>Aśvins</s>;

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let your aid be near.

children.text: varethe agnim ātapo vadate valgv atraye
children.translated_text: You warded off the fire's heat; it speaks sweetly for <s>Atri</s>;

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let your aid be near.

children.text: pra saptavadhrir āśasā dhārām agner aśāyata
children.translated_text: <s>Saptavadhrī</s>, through hope, made the stream of fire lie down;

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let your aid be near.

children.text: ihā gataṃ vṛṣaṇvasū śṛṇutam ma imaṃ havam
children.translated_text: Come here, rich in manly goods; hear this call of mine;

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let your aid be near.

children.text: kim idaṃ vām purāṇavaj jarator iva śasyate
children.translated_text: What is this of yours that is praised like something ancient, as if belonging to old men?

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let your aid be near.

children.text: samānaṃ vāṃ sajātyaṃ samāno bandhur aśvinā
children.translated_text: Common is your birth, common your kinship, O <s>Aśvins</s>;

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let your aid be near.

children.text: yo vāṃ rajāṃsy aśvinā ratho viyāti rodasī
children.translated_text: Your chariot, O <s>Aśvins</s>, travels through the realms and the two worlds;

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let your aid be near.

children.text: ā no gavyebhir aśvyaiḥ sahasrair upa gacchatam
children.translated_text: Come to us with cow-winning and horse-winning thousands;

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let your aid be near.

children.text: mā no gavyebhir aśvyaiḥ sahasrebhir ati khyatam
children.translated_text: Do not pass us by with cow-winning and horse-winning thousands;

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let your aid be near.

children.text: aruṇapsur uṣā abhūd akar jyotir ṛtāvarī
children.translated_text: The red-hued <s>Uṣas</s> has appeared, true to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), making light;

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let your aid be near.

children.text: aśvinā su vicākaśad vṛkṣam paraśumāṁ iva
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, it shone forth clearly, like a man with an axe beside a tree;

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let your aid be near.

children.text: puraṃ na dhṛṣṇav ā ruja kṛṣṇayā bādhito viśā
children.translated_text: Break open the stronghold, O bold ones, as if it were beset by a dark clan;

children.text: anti ṣad bhūtu vām avaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let your aid be near.

children.text: Chapter 694
viśo viśo vo atithiṃ vājayantaḥ purupriyam
children.translated_text: Clan by clan, O people, seeking strength, I praise your guest, beloved by many,

children.text: agniṃ vo duryaṃ vaca stuṣe śūṣasya manmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, your household one, with speech and with thoughts of power.

children.text: yaṃ janāso haviṣmanto mitraṃ na sarpirāsutim
children.translated_text: The oblation-bearing people praise him like a friend who pours ghee,

children.text: praśaṃsanti praśastibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: with praises upon praises.

children.text: panyāṃsaṃ jātavedasaṃ yo devatāty udyatā
children.translated_text: The admirable <s>Jātavedas</s>, who, raised up for divine worship,

children.text: havyāny airayad divi ||
children.translated_text: sent the oblations to heaven.

children.text: āganma vṛtrahantamaṃ jyeṣṭham agnim ānavam
children.translated_text: We have come to <s>Agni</s>, greatest slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, the eldest, descended from <s>Manu</s>,

children.text: yasya śrutarvā bṛhann ārkṣo anīka edhate ||
children.translated_text: in whose presence <s>Śrutarvan</s>, the great son of <s>Ṛkṣa</s>, prospers.

children.text: amṛtaṃ jātavedasaṃ tiras tamāṃsi darśatam
children.translated_text: To immortal <s>Jātavedas</s>, visible across the darkness,

children.text: ghṛtāhavanam īḍyam ||
children.translated_text: worthy of praise and invoked with ghee.

children.text: sabādho yaṃ janā ime 'gniṃ havyebhir īﾱate
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, whom these pressed people praise with oblations,

children.text: juhvānāso yatasrucaḥ ||
children.translated_text: offering with outstretched ladles.

children.text: iyaṃ te navyasī matir agne adhāyy asmad ā
children.translated_text: This newest thought for you, O <s>Agni</s>, has been placed here by us,

children.text: mandra sujāta sukrato 'mūra dasmātithe ||
children.translated_text: O gladdening, well-born, wise, unbewildered, wondrous guest.

children.text: sā te agne śantamā caniṣṭhā bhavatu priyā
children.translated_text: May that song be for you, O <s>Agni</s>, most peaceful, youngest, and dear;

children.text: tayā vardhasva suṣṭutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: by it, well praised, grow strong.

children.text: sā dyumnair dyumninī bṛhad upopa śravasi śravaḥ
children.translated_text: May she, rich in brilliance through brilliances, great, place fame beside fame,

children.text: dadhīta vṛtratūrye ||
children.translated_text: in the overcoming of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: aśvam id gāṃ rathaprāṃ tveṣam indraṃ na satpatim
children.translated_text: the horse, the cow, the chariot-winning, blazing one, like <s>Indra</s>, the true lord

children.text: yasya śravāṃsi tūrvatha panyaṃ panyaṃ ca kṛṣṭayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: His praises the clans speed onward, praiseworthy again and again.

children.text: yaṃ tvā gopavano girā caniṣṭhad agne aṅgiraḥ
children.translated_text: You whom <s>Gopavana</s>, with his song, has most delighted, O <s>Agni</s> <s>Aṅgiras</s>,

children.text: sa pāvaka śrudhī havam ||
children.translated_text: that one, O purifier, hear the call.

children.text: yaṃ tvā janāsa īﾱate sabādho vājasātaye
children.translated_text: You whom men implore under pressure for the winning of prizes,

children.text: sa bodhi vṛtratūrye ||
children.translated_text: be awake in the conquest over obstruction.

children.text: ahaṃ huvāna ārkṣe śrutarvaṇi madacyuti
children.translated_text: I, calling at <s>Ārkṣa</s>, at <s>Śrutarvan</s>'s place, where exhilaration does not fail,

children.text: śardhāṃsīva stukāvinām mṛkṣā śīrṣā caturṇām ||
children.translated_text: would wipe away the heads of four, like the hosts of the tufted ones.

children.text: māṃ catvāra āśavaḥ śaviṣṭhasya dravitnavaḥ
children.translated_text: Let four swift coursers, most impetuous and hastening for the mightiest one,

children.text: surathāso abhi prayo vakṣan vayo na tugryam ||
children.translated_text: well-charioted, carry me toward delight, like birds carrying <s>Tugrya</s>.

children.text: satyam it tvā mahenadi paruṣṇy ava dediśam
children.translated_text: Truly, O great river <s>Paruṣṇī</s>, I have pointed you out clearly;

children.text: nem āpo aśvadātaraḥ śaviṣṭhād asti martyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: among the waters that give horses, no mortal exists stronger than the mightiest one.

children.text: Chapter 695
yukṣvā hi devahūtamāṁ aśvāṁ agne rathīr iva
children.translated_text: Yoke, for you are most invoked by the gods; yoke the horses, O <s>Agni</s>, like a charioteer.

children.text: ni hotā pūrvyaḥ sadaḥ ||
children.translated_text: As the ancient Hotṛ, sit down in your seat.

children.text: uta no deva devāṁ acchā voco viduṣṭaraḥ
children.translated_text: And, O god, as the wiser one, speak for us toward the gods;

children.text: śrad viśvā vāryā kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: make all desirable things worthy of trust for us.

children.text: tvaṃ ha yad yaviṣṭhya sahasaḥ sūnav āhuta
children.translated_text: For when you, O youngest one, O son of strength, are invoked,

children.text: ṛtāvā yajñiyo bhuvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you become the truth-bearing, sacrifice-worthy one.

children.text: ayam agniḥ sahasriṇo vājasya śatinas patiḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>Agni</s> is lord of a thousandfold and hundredfold prize,

children.text: mūrdhā kavī rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: the head of inspired poets and of riches.

children.text: taṃ nemim ṛbhavo yathā namasva sahūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: As the <s>Ṛbhus</s> bow to a wheel-rim, so bow to him with joint invocations,

children.text: nedīyo yajñam aṅgiraḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Aṅgiras</s>, bring the sacrifice nearer.

children.text: tasmai nūnam abhidyave vācā virūpa nityayā
children.translated_text: For that bull, now, O <s>Virūpa</s>, on the shining day, with constant speech,

children.text: vṛṣṇe codasva suṣṭutim ||
children.translated_text: impel a good praise-song.

children.text: kam u ṣvid asya senayāgner apākacakṣasaḥ
children.translated_text: Whom indeed, with the army of this far-seeing <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: paṇiṃ goṣu starāmahe ||
children.translated_text: shall we overthrow, a <s>Paṇi</s> among the cattle?

children.text: mā no devānāṃ viśaḥ prasnātīr ivosrāḥ
children.translated_text: Let not the clans of the gods pass us by like milch cows that have strayed away;

children.text: kṛśaṃ na hāsur aghnyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: let the inviolable cows not abandon a lean man.

children.text: mā naḥ samasya dūḍhyaḥ paridveṣaso aṃhatiḥ
children.translated_text: Let not the evil thought of one hostile to all, nor hatred from enemies, nor distress,

children.text: ūrmir na nāvam ā vadhīt ||
children.translated_text: strike us like a wave striking a ship.

children.text: namas te agna ojase gṛṇanti deva kṛṣṭayaḥ
children.translated_text: Reverence to your vigor, O <s>Agni</s>; the clans praise you, O god.

children.text: amair amitram ardaya ||
children.translated_text: With your powers crush the unfriendly foe.

children.text: kuvit su no gaviṣṭaye 'gne saṃveṣiṣo rayim
children.translated_text: May you perhaps, O <s>Agni</s>, secure wealth for us in the quest for cattle;

children.text: urukṛd uru ṇas kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: making wide space, make wide room for us.

children.text: mā no asmin mahādhane parā varg bhārabhṛd yathā
children.translated_text: Let us not, in this great contest for wealth, be turned aside like a bearer of burdens;

children.text: saṃvargaṃ saṃ rayiṃ jaya ||
children.translated_text: win gathered abundance, win gathered wealth.

children.text: anyam asmad bhiyā iyam agne siṣaktu ducchunā
children.translated_text: Let this evil one, driven by fear, cling to another than us, O <s>Agni</s>;

children.text: vardhā no amavacchavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: increase our force and strength.

children.text: yasyājuṣan namasvinaḥ śamīm adurmakhasya vā
children.translated_text: Whose rite the reverent have accepted, whether that of a kindly or ill-minded man,

children.text: taṃ ghed agnir vṛdhāvati ||
children.translated_text: him indeed <s>Agni</s> brings to growth.

children.text: parasyā adhi saṃvato 'varāṁ abhy ā tara
children.translated_text: From the farther settlement cross over to the nearer one;

children.text: yatrāham asmi tāṁ ava ||
children.translated_text: where I am, protect that place.

children.text: vidmā hi te purā vayam agne pitur yathāvasaḥ
children.translated_text: For we know your aid of old, O <s>Agni</s>, as we know a father's;

children.text: adhā te sumnam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: therefore we seek your favor.

children.text: Chapter 696
imaṃ nu māyinaṃ huva indram īśānam ojasā
children.translated_text: I call now upon this wondrous <s>Indra</s>, ruling by his might,

children.text: marutvantaṃ na vṛñjase ||
children.translated_text: accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>; do not withhold yourself.

children.text: ayam indro marutsakhā vi vṛtrasyābhinacchiraḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>Indra</s>, friend of the <s>Maruts</s>, split apart <s>Vṛtra</s>'s head

children.text: vajreṇa śataparvaṇā ||
children.translated_text: with the thunderbolt of a hundred joints.

children.text: vāvṛdhāno marutsakhendro vi vṛtram airayat
children.translated_text: Growing strong with the <s>Maruts</s> as friends, <s>Indra</s> drove <s>Vṛtra</s> away,

children.text: sṛjan samudriyā apaḥ ||
children.translated_text: releasing the waters that belong to the sea.

children.text: ayaṃ ha yena vā idaṃ svar marutvatā jitam
children.translated_text: This is he by whom, with the <s>Maruts</s>, this heavenly light was won,

children.text: indreṇa somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: by <s>Indra</s>, for the drinking of Soma.

children.text: marutvantam ṛjīṣiṇam ojasvantaṃ virapśinam
children.translated_text: We call with songs upon <s>Indra</s>, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, strong in vigor, mighty, and overpowering,

children.text: indraṃ gīrbhir havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: the impetuous one.

children.text: indram pratnena manmanā marutvantaṃ havāmahe
children.translated_text: With an ancient thought we call upon <s>Indra</s>, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: asya somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: for the drinking of this Soma.

children.text: marutvāṁ indra mīḍhvaḥ pibā somaṃ śatakrato
children.translated_text: O bountiful <s>Indra</s> with the <s>Maruts</s>, drink the Soma, O hundred-powered one,

children.text: asmin yajñe puruṣṭuta ||
children.translated_text: in this sacrifice, O much-praised one.

children.text: tubhyed indra marutvate sutāḥ somāso adrivaḥ
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Indra</s> with the <s>Maruts</s>, the pressed Somas, O stone-wielder,

children.text: hṛdā hūyanta ukthinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: are invoked from the heart, rich in hymns.

children.text: pibed indra marutsakhā sutaṃ somaṃ diviṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: Let <s>Indra</s>, friend of the <s>Maruts</s>, drink the pressed Soma in the heavenly contests,

children.text: vajraṃ śiśāna ojasā ||
children.translated_text: sharpening the thunderbolt with his might.

children.text: uttiṣṭhann ojasā saha pītvī śipre avepayaḥ
children.translated_text: Rising up with force after drinking, you made your lips tremble,

children.text: somam indra camū sutam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, over the Soma pressed in the cup.

children.text: anu tvā rodasī ubhe krakṣamāṇam akṛpetām
children.translated_text: Both heaven and earth had compassion on you as you ranged fiercely,

children.text: indra yad dasyuhābhavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, when you became the slayer of the Dasyus.

children.text: vācam aṣṭāpadīm ahaṃ navasraktim ṛtaspṛśam
children.translated_text: I have measured out speech of eight feet, nine-cornered, touching the truth,

children.text: indrāt pari tanvam mame ||
children.translated_text: from <s>Indra</s> around my own body.

children.text: Chapter 697
jajñāno nu śatakratur vi pṛcchad iti mātaram
children.translated_text: Newborn, the hundred-powered one then asked his mother,

children.text: ka ugrāḥ ke ha śṛṇvire ||
children.translated_text: 'Who are the fierce ones? Who indeed have been heard?'

children.text: ād īṃ śavasy abravīd aurṇavābham ahīśuvam
children.translated_text: Then she spoke to him of <s>Aurṇavābha</s>, mighty in force, and of <s>Ahīśuva</s>:

children.text: te putra santu niṣṭuraḥ ||
children.translated_text: 'Let those, my son, be the hard ones.'

children.text: sam it tān vṛtrahākhidat khe arāṁ iva khedayā
children.translated_text: The slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s> smashed them together, as one smashes spokes in a nave with a breaker;

children.text: pravṛddho dasyuhābhavat ||
children.translated_text: grown great, he became the slayer of the Dasyus.

children.text: ekayā pratidhāpibat sākaṃ sarāṃsi triṃśatam
children.translated_text: With one draught <s>Indra</s> drank thirty lakes together,

children.text: indraḥ somasya kāṇukā ||
children.translated_text: the little Soma-pressings.

children.text: abhi gandharvam atṛṇad abudhneṣu rajassv ā
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> pierced the <s>Gandharva</s> in the bottomless regions,

children.text: indro brahmabhya id vṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: for the increase of the sacred formulations.

children.text: nir āvidhyad giribhya ā dhārayat pakvam odanam
children.translated_text: He shot forth from the mountains and held fast the cooked food,

children.text: indro bundaṃ svātatam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, the well-stretched bottom.

children.text: śatabradhna iṣus tava sahasraparṇa eka it
children.translated_text: Your arrow, O <s>Indra</s>, is hundred-fastened, thousand-feathered, single,

children.text: yam indra cakṛṣe yujam ||
children.translated_text: which you have made your ally.

children.text: tena stotṛbhya ā bhara nṛbhyo nāribhyo attave
children.translated_text: With that bring food for the singers, for the men and women to eat,

children.text: sadyo jāta ṛbhuṣṭhira ||
children.translated_text: O newly born, firm among the <s>Ṛbhus</s>.

children.text: etā cyautnāni te kṛtā varṣiṣṭhāni parīṇasā
children.translated_text: These shaking deeds of yours have been done, the tallest through your abundance;

children.text: hṛdā vīḍv adhārayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you held them firm in your heart.

children.text: viśvet tā viṣṇur ābharad urukramas tveṣitaḥ
children.translated_text: All these things <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the wide-striding one, brought, impelled by you:

children.text: śatam mahiṣān kṣīrapākam odanaṃ varāham indra emuṣam ||
children.translated_text: a hundred buffaloes, milk-cooked porridge, and the boar <s>Emuṣa</s>, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: tuvikṣaṃ te sukṛtaṃ sūmayaṃ dhanuḥ sādhur bundo hiraṇyayaḥ
children.translated_text: Strong in impulse is your well-made, kindly bow; good is the golden bottom;

children.text: ubhā te bāhū raṇyā susaṃskṛta ṛdūpe cid ṛdūvṛdhā ||
children.translated_text: both your arms, beautiful and well-fashioned, even in the proper form grow properly.

children.text: Chapter 698
puroﾱāśaṃ no andhasa indra sahasram ā bhara
children.translated_text: Bring us a sacrificial cake of nourishment, O <s>Indra</s>, a thousandfold,

children.text: śatā ca śūra gonām ||
children.translated_text: and a hundred cows, O hero.

children.text: ā no bhara vyañjanaṃ gām aśvam abhyañjanam
children.translated_text: Bring us adornment, a cow, a horse, and anointing oil,

children.text: sacā manā hiraṇyayā ||
children.translated_text: together with a golden ornament.

children.text: uta naḥ karṇaśobhanā purūṇi dhṛṣṇav ā bhara
children.translated_text: And bring us many ear-ornaments, O bold one;

children.text: tvaṃ hi śṛṇviṣe vaso ||
children.translated_text: for you are heard, O good one.

children.text: nakīṃ vṛdhīka indra te na suṣā na sudā uta
children.translated_text: No grower is yours, O <s>Indra</s>, neither <s>Suṣā</s> nor <s>Sudā</s>,

children.text: nānyas tvacchūra vāghataḥ ||
children.translated_text: nor any other singer than you, O hero.

children.text: nakīm indro nikartave na śakraḥ pariśaktave
children.translated_text: No one can cut down <s>Indra</s>; the mighty one cannot be overcome.

children.text: viśvaṃ śṛṇoti paśyati ||
children.translated_text: He hears and sees everything.

children.text: sa manyum martyānām adabdho ni cikīṣate
children.translated_text: Unharmed, he intends to perceive the anger of mortals.

children.text: purā nidaś cikīṣate ||
children.translated_text: From of old, indeed, they seek to recognize him.

children.text: kratva it pūrṇam udaraṃ turasyāsti vidhataḥ
children.translated_text: Through inspired resolve there is a full belly for the worshipper, for the swift one,

children.text: vṛtraghnaḥ somapāvnaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for the Vṛtra-slayer, the Soma-drinker.

children.text: tve vasūni saṃgatā viśvā ca soma saubhagā
children.translated_text: In you, O <s>Soma</s>, all goods and all good fortunes are gathered,

children.text: sudātv aparihvṛtā ||
children.translated_text: easy to give, not to be led astray.

children.text: tvām id yavayur mama kāmo gavyur hiraṇyayuḥ
children.translated_text: You indeed my desire, seeking barley, seeking cattle, seeking gold,

children.text: tvām aśvayur eṣate ||
children.translated_text: and the seeker of horses turns to you.

children.text: taved indrāham āśasā haste dātraṃ canā dade
children.translated_text: In hope of you, O <s>Indra</s>, I take the gift in my hand,

children.text: dinasya vā maghavan saṃbhṛtasya vā pūrdhi yavasya kāśinā ||
children.translated_text: or, O <s>Maghavan</s>, fill me with the shining fodder, whether for the day or gathered up.

children.text: Chapter 699
ayaṃ kṛtnur agṛbhīto viśvajid udbhid it somaḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s>, the maker, ungrasped, all-conquering, the breaker-open,

children.text: ṛṣir vipraḥ kāvyena ||
children.translated_text: is a seer, an inspired sage through poetic wisdom.

children.text: abhy ūrṇoti yan nagnam bhiṣakti viśvaṃ yat turam
children.translated_text: He covers what is naked; he heals whatever is injured.

children.text: prem andhaḥ khyan niḥ śroṇo bhūt ||
children.translated_text: The blind man saw; the lame man came forth.

children.text: tvaṃ soma tanūkṛdbhyo dveṣobhyo 'nyakṛtebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Soma</s>, against hatreds done to the body and done by others,

children.text: uru yantāsi varūtham ||
children.translated_text: are a wide-reaching shelter.

children.text: tvaṃ cittī tava dakṣair diva ā pṛthivyā ṛjīṣin
children.translated_text: You, O strong <s>Soma</s>, with your insights and skills, from heaven and earth,

children.text: yāvīr aghasya cid dveṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: drive away even the hatred of sin and hostility.

children.text: arthino yanti ced arthaṃ gacchān id daduṣo rātim
children.translated_text: If seekers go to their goal, let them go to the gift of the giver;

children.text: vavṛjyus tṛṣyataḥ kāmam ||
children.translated_text: they have turned aside the desire of the thirsty man.

children.text: vidad yat pūrvyaṃ naṣṭam ud īm ṛtāyum īrayat
children.translated_text: Finding what was ancient and lost, he sends up the life that follows truth;

children.text: prem āyus tārīd atīrṇam ||
children.translated_text: he carries life across what had not been crossed.

children.text: suśevo no mṛﾱayākur adṛptakratur avātaḥ
children.translated_text: Be kindly disposed to us, making mercy, with undeceived resolve and without harm;

children.text: bhavā naḥ soma śaṃ hṛde ||
children.translated_text: be peace for our heart, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: mā naḥ soma saṃ vīvijo mā vi bībhiṣathā rājan
children.translated_text: Do not make us tremble, O <s>Soma</s>; do not terrify us, O king;

children.text: mā no hārdi tviṣā vadhīḥ ||
children.translated_text: do not strike our heart with your fiery force.

children.text: ava yat sve sadhasthe devānāṃ durmatīr īkṣe
children.translated_text: When in your own seat you look upon the evil thoughts of the gods,

children.text: rājann apa dviṣaḥ sedha mīḍhvo apa sridhaḥ sedha ||
children.translated_text: O king, drive away the haters; O bountiful one, drive away the deceits.

children.text: Chapter 700
nahy anyam baﾱākaram marḍitāraṃ śatakrato
children.translated_text: For we have no other strong helper, no other one to show mercy, O hundred-powered one;

children.text: tvaṃ na indra mṛﾱaya ||
children.translated_text: you, O <s>Indra</s>, be gracious to us.

children.text: yo naḥ śaśvat purāvithāmṛdhro vājasātaye
children.translated_text: You who always protected us of old for the winning of strength,

children.text: sa tvaṃ na indra mṛﾱaya ||
children.translated_text: that same you, O <s>Indra</s>, be gracious to us.

children.text: kim aṅga radhracodanaḥ sunvānasyāvited asi
children.translated_text: Why then, rouser of the needy, are you protector of the Soma-presser?

children.text: kuvit sv indra ṇaḥ śakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Might you, O <s>Indra</s>, be able to help us?

children.text: indra pra ṇo ratham ava paścāc cit santam adrivaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, favor our chariot, even if it is behind, O stone-armed one;

children.text: purastād enam me kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: set it in front for me.

children.text: hanto nu kim āsase prathamaṃ no rathaṃ kṛdhi
children.translated_text: Come now, why do you sit still? Make our chariot first,

children.text: upamaṃ vājayu śravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: nearest, O seeker of prize and fame.

children.text: avā no vājayuṃ rathaṃ sukaraṃ te kim it pari
children.translated_text: Favor our prize-winning chariot, easy for you; why pass around it?

children.text: asmān su jigyuṣas kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: Make us good victors.

children.text: indra dṛhyasva pūr asi bhadrā ta eti niṣkṛtam
children.translated_text: Stand firm, O <s>Indra</s>; you are a stronghold, and a good release comes to you.

children.text: iyaṃ dhīr ṛtviyāvatī ||
children.translated_text: This inspired thought is rich in the proper ritual season.

children.text: mā sīm avadya ā bhāg urvī kāṣṭhā hitaṃ dhanam
children.translated_text: Let no blame come upon us; the treasure set in the wide regions

children.text: apāvṛktā aratnayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: must not be turned away by empty-handed men.

children.text: turīyaṃ nāma yajñiyaṃ yadā karas tad uśmasi
children.translated_text: When you make the fourth sacrificial name, that is what we desire;

children.text: ād it patir na ohase ||
children.translated_text: then, like a lord, you will be called upon by us.

children.text: avīvṛdhad vo amṛtā amandīd ekadyūr devā uta yāś ca devīḥ
children.translated_text: It has increased you, O immortals; it has gladdened the one-day gods and also the goddesses.

children.text: tasmā u rādhaḥ kṛṇuta praśastam prātar makṣū dhiyāvasur jagamyāt ||
children.translated_text: For him make splendid, praised bounty; may the one whose wealth is inspired thought come quickly in the morning.

children.text: Chapter 701
ā tū na indra kṣumantaṃ citraṃ grābhaṃ saṃ gṛbhāya
children.translated_text: Come now, O <s>Indra</s>, grasp for us the firm, bright prize,

children.text: mahāhastī dakṣiṇena ||
children.translated_text: with your great right hand.

children.text: vidmā hi tvā tuvikūrmiṃ tuvideṣṇaṃ tuvīmagham
children.translated_text: For we know you as very mighty, very skillful, very bounteous,

children.text: tuvimātram avobhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: of great measure in your aids.

children.text: nahi tvā śūra devā na martāso ditsantam
children.translated_text: For neither gods nor mortals hinder you, O hero, when you wish to give,

children.text: bhīmaṃ na gāṃ vārayante ||
children.translated_text: as they would ward off a fearsome cow.

children.text: eto nv indraṃ stavāmeśānaṃ vasvaḥ svarājam
children.translated_text: Now let us praise <s>Indra</s>, lord of wealth, self-ruling;

children.text: na rādhasā mardhiṣan naḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he not deprive us of bounty.

children.text: pra stoṣad upa gāsiṣac chravat sāma gīyamānam
children.translated_text: He will praise forth and sing nearby; he will hear the <s>sāman</s> being sung.

children.text: abhi rādhasā jugurat ||
children.translated_text: They have called aloud toward bounty.

children.text: ā no bhara dakṣiṇenābhi savyena pra mṛśa
children.translated_text: Bring to us with your right hand; touch us with your left;

children.text: indra mā no vasor nir bhāk ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, do not shut us out from wealth.

children.text: upa kramasvā bhara dhṛṣatā dhṛṣṇo janānām
children.translated_text: Step near; bring boldly, O bold one, the wealth of men,

children.text: adāśūṣṭarasya vedaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the wealth of the man who is more ungenerous than the non-giver.

children.text: indra ya u nu te asti vājo viprebhiḥ sanitvaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, whatever prize of yours is to be won by inspired singers,

children.text: asmābhiḥ su taṃ sanuhi ||
children.translated_text: win that well together with us.

children.text: sadyojuvas te vājā asmabhyaṃ viśvaścandrāḥ
children.translated_text: Your prizes, rushing at once to us, all-bright,

children.text: vaśaiś ca makṣū jarante ||
children.translated_text: are quickly praised together with the willing ones.

children.text: Chapter 702
ā pra drava parāvato 'rvāvataś ca vṛtrahan
children.translated_text: Run here from the far and from the near, O <s>Vṛtrahan</s>,

children.text: madhvaḥ prati prabharmaṇi ||
children.translated_text: to the presentation of the honey-sweet drink.

children.text: tīvrāḥ somāsa ā gahi sutāso mādayiṣṇavaḥ
children.translated_text: The strong Somas have been pressed, gladdening; come here;

children.text: pibā dadhṛg yathociṣe ||
children.translated_text: drink boldly, as you choose.

children.text: iṣā mandasvād u te 'raṃ varāya manyave
children.translated_text: Be exhilarated by refreshment; then there will be enough for favor and for wrath;

children.text: bhuvat ta indra śaṃ hṛde ||
children.translated_text: it will be peace for your heart, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: ā tv aśatrav ā gahi ny ukthāni ca hūyase
children.translated_text: Come here, enemyless one; the hymns are being recited for you,

children.text: upame rocane divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: in the highest shining realm of heaven.

children.text: tubhyāyam adribhiḥ suto gobhiḥ śrīto madāya kam
children.translated_text: For you this Soma has been pressed with stones, mixed with milk, for exhilaration;

children.text: pra soma indra hūyate ||
children.translated_text: the Soma is called forth to <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: indra śrudhi su me havam asme sutasya gomataḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, hear my good call; among us, of the pressed Soma rich in cows,

children.text: vi pītiṃ tṛptim aśnuhi ||
children.translated_text: enjoy the drinking and satisfaction.

children.text: ya indra camaseṣv ā somaś camūṣu te sutaḥ
children.translated_text: The Soma which, O <s>Indra</s>, has been pressed for you in cups and bowls:

children.text: pibed asya tvam īśiṣe ||
children.translated_text: drink of it; you have mastery over it.

children.text: yo apsu candramā iva somaś camūṣu dadṛśe
children.translated_text: The Soma which, like the moon in the waters, is seen in the bowls:

children.text: pibed asya tvam īśiṣe ||
children.translated_text: drink of it; you have mastery over it.

children.text: yaṃ te śyenaḥ padābharat tiro rajāṃsy aspṛtam
children.translated_text: The one which the eagle brought for you with his foot across the untraversed spaces:

children.text: pibed asya tvam īśiṣe ||
children.translated_text: drink of it; you have mastery over it.

children.text: Chapter 703
devānām id avo mahat tad ā vṛṇīmahe vayam
children.translated_text: We choose that great aid of the gods,

children.text: vṛṣṇām asmabhyam ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: of the mighty ones, for our help.

children.text: te naḥ santu yujaḥ sadā varuṇo mitro aryamā
children.translated_text: May they always be our yokemates: <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>,

children.text: vṛdhāsaś ca pracetasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and the growing, far-seeing ones.

children.text: ati no viṣpitā puru naubhir apo na parṣatha
children.translated_text: Carry us beyond many perils, as across waters with boats;

children.text: yūyam ṛtasya rathyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you are charioteers of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: vāmaṃ no astv aryaman vāmaṃ varuṇa śaṃsyam
children.translated_text: Let favor be ours, O <s>Aryaman</s>; favor, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, worthy of praise;

children.text: vāmaṃ hy āvṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: for we choose favor.

children.text: vāmasya hi pracetasa īśānāso riśādasaḥ
children.translated_text: For, O far-seeing <s>Ādityas</s>, lords of favor, destroyers of enemies,

children.text: nem ādityā aghasya yat ||
children.translated_text: let no portion of sin be ours.

children.text: vayam id vaḥ sudānavaḥ kṣiyanto yānto adhvann ā
children.translated_text: We indeed, O generous ones, dwelling here and going on the road,

children.text: devā vṛdhāya hūmahe ||
children.translated_text: call you gods for increase.

children.text: adhi na indraiṣāṃ viṣṇo sajātyānām
children.translated_text: Over us and these kinsmen be <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: itā maruto aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: likewise the <s>Maruts</s> and the <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: pra bhrātṛtvaṃ sudānavo 'dha dvitā samānyā
children.translated_text: O generous ones, we bear brotherhood, and then twofold common kinship,

children.text: mātur garbhe bharāmahe ||
children.translated_text: in the mother's womb.

children.text: yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā sudānava indrajyeṣṭhā abhidyavaḥ
children.translated_text: For you, O generous ones, are accompanied by <s>Indra</s> as eldest, shining toward us.

children.text: adhā cid va uta bruve ||
children.translated_text: And now, indeed, I speak forth as well.

children.text: Chapter 704
preṣṭhaṃ vo atithiṃ stuṣe mitram iva priyam
children.translated_text: I praise for you the dearest guest, beloved like <s>Mitra</s>,

children.text: agniṃ rathaṃ na vedyam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, like a chariot to be sought at the rite.

children.text: kavim iva pracetasaṃ yaṃ devāso adha dvitā
children.translated_text: Like a poet, fully conscious, whom the gods then, in a second form,

children.text: ni martyeṣv ādadhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: placed down among mortals.

children.text: tvaṃ yaviṣṭha dāśuṣo nṝṁḥ pāhi śṛṇudhī giraḥ
children.translated_text: You, youngest one, protect the worshipper's men; hear the songs,

children.text: rakṣā tokam uta tmanā ||
children.translated_text: and by yourself guard our offspring and ourselves.

children.text: kayā te agne aṅgira ūrjo napād upastutim
children.translated_text: With what praise of you, O <s>Agni Aṅgiras</s>, offspring of strength,

children.text: varāya deva manyave ||
children.translated_text: shall we approach the excellent divine ardor?

children.text: dāśema kasya manasā yajñasya sahaso yaho
children.translated_text: With whose mind shall we serve the sacrifice, O mighty son of strength?

children.text: kad u voca idaṃ namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When will one speak this homage?

children.text: adhā tvaṃ hi nas karo viśvā asmabhyaṃ sukṣitīḥ
children.translated_text: Then you indeed shall make for us all good dwellings,

children.text: vājadraviṇaso giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: and songs rich in prize-winning wealth.

children.text: kasya nūnam parīṇaso dhiyo jinvasi dampate
children.translated_text: Whose present abundance, O lord of the house, do you quicken in inspired thoughts,

children.text: goṣātā yasya te giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: whose songs win cattle for you?

children.text: tam marjayanta sukratum puroyāvānam ājiṣu
children.translated_text: They adorn that one of good resolve, the forerunner in contests,

children.text: sveṣu kṣayeṣu vājinam ||
children.translated_text: the vigorous one in his own dwellings.

children.text: kṣeti kṣemebhiḥ sādhubhir nakir yaṃ ghnanti hanti yaḥ
children.translated_text: He dwells with secure and excellent settlements; no one strikes him down, while he strikes down foes;

children.text: agne suvīra edhate ||
children.translated_text: through <s>Agni</s> he prospers, rich in heroes.

children.text: Chapter 705
ā me havaṃ nāsatyāśvinā gacchataṃ yuvam
children.translated_text: Come, both of you, to my call, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: to drink the sweet soma.

children.text: imam me stomam aśvinemam me śṛṇutaṃ havam
children.translated_text: Hear this praise of mine, O <s>Aśvins</s>, this call of mine,

children.text: madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: to drink the sweet soma.

children.text: ayaṃ vāṃ kṛṣṇo aśvinā havate vājinīvasū
children.translated_text: This <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> calls you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, possessors of prize-winning wealth,

children.text: madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: to drink the sweet soma.

children.text: śṛṇutaṃ jaritur havaṃ kṛṣṇasya stuvato narā
children.translated_text: Hear the call of the singer, of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> as he praises you, O heroes,

children.text: madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: to drink the sweet soma.

children.text: chardir yantam adābhyaṃ viprāya stuvate narā
children.translated_text: Grant inviolable shelter to the inspired singer who praises you, O heroes,

children.text: madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: to drink the sweet soma.

children.text: gacchataṃ dāśuṣo gṛham itthā stuvato aśvinā
children.translated_text: Go to the house of the worshipper who praises you thus, O <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: to drink the sweet soma.

children.text: yuñjāthāṃ rāsabhaṃ rathe vīḍvaṅge vṛṣaṇvasū
children.translated_text: Harness the ass to the chariot, O strong-limbed possessors of virile wealth,

children.text: madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: to drink the sweet soma.

children.text: trivandhureṇa trivṛtā rathenā yātam aśvinā
children.translated_text: Come, O <s>Aśvins</s>, with your three-seated, threefold chariot,

children.text: madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: to drink the sweet soma.

children.text: nū me giro nāsatyāśvinā prāvataṃ yuvam
children.translated_text: Now protect my songs, both of you, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: to drink the sweet soma.

children.text: Chapter 706
ubhā hi dasrā bhiṣajā mayobhuvobhā dakṣasya vacaso babhūvathuḥ
children.translated_text: For both of you, O wondrous ones, are physicians and bringers of joy; both of you have become masters of skillful speech.

children.text: tā vāṃ viśvako havate tanūkṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Viśvaka</s> calls you for his own body; do not part from us, and do not release us from friendship.

children.text: kathā nūnaṃ vāṃ vimanā upa stavad yuvaṃ dhiyaṃ dadathur vasyaiṣṭaye
children.translated_text: How now should the troubled one praise you? You two gave inspired thought for the winning of good things.

children.text: tā vāṃ viśvako havate tanūkṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Viśvaka</s> calls you for his own body; do not part from us, and do not release us from friendship.

children.text: yuvaṃ hi ṣmā purubhujemam edhatuṃ viṣṇāpve dadathur vasyaiṣṭaye
children.translated_text: For you two indeed gave this <s>Edhatu</s>, rich in many enjoyments, to <s>Viṣṇāpū</s> for the winning of good things.

children.text: tā vāṃ viśvako havate tanūkṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Viśvaka</s> calls you for his own body; do not part from us, and do not release us from friendship.

children.text: uta tyaṃ vīraṃ dhanasām ṛjīṣiṇaṃ dūre cit santam avase havāmahe
children.translated_text: And that heroic, eager winner of wealth, though he is far away, we call for help,

children.text: yasya svādiṣṭhā sumatiḥ pitur yathā mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||
children.translated_text: whose sweetest favor is like a father's; do not part from us, and do not release us from friendship.

children.text: ṛtena devaḥ savitā śamāyata ṛtasya śṛṅgam urviyā vi paprathe
children.translated_text: By <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic truth) the god <s>Savitṛ</s> has brought peace; the horn of <s>ṛta</s> has spread out widely.

children.text: ṛtaṃ sāsāha mahi cit pṛtanyato mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Ṛta</s> has overpowered even the great assailant; do not part from us, and do not release us from friendship.

children.text: Chapter 707
dyumnī vāṃ stomo aśvinā krivir na seka ā gatam
children.translated_text: Your brilliant hymn, O <s>Aśvins</s>, is like an outpoured skin-bag; come here,

children.text: madhvaḥ sutasya sa divi priyo narā pātaṃ gaurāv iveriṇe ||
children.translated_text: O heroes, and drink the sweet pressed soma, dear in heaven, like two gauras in the waste.

children.text: pibataṃ gharmam madhumantam aśvinā barhiḥ sīdataṃ narā
children.translated_text: Drink the honeyed <s>gharma</s> (hot libation), O <s>Aśvins</s>; sit on the sacrificial grass, O heroes.

children.text: tā mandasānā manuṣo duroṇa ā ni pātaṃ vedasā vayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Exhilarated, at the doors of <s>Manu</s>, drink down vitality with insight.

children.text: ā vāṃ viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ priyamedhā ahūṣata
children.translated_text: The <s>Priyamedhas</s> have called you with all aids,

children.text: tā vartir yātam upa vṛktabarhiṣo juṣṭaṃ yajñaṃ diviṣṭiṣu ||
children.translated_text: so come by the path to the one whose sacrificial grass is cut, to the sacrifice made pleasing among the heavenly invocations.

children.text: pibataṃ somam madhumantam aśvinā barhiḥ sīdataṃ sumat
children.translated_text: Drink the honeyed soma, O <s>Aśvins</s>; sit well upon the sacrificial grass.

children.text: tā vāvṛdhānā upa suṣṭutiṃ divo gantaṃ gaurāv iveriṇam ||
children.translated_text: Growing strong, come from heaven to the good praise, like two gauras to the waste.

children.text: ā nūnaṃ yātam aśvināśvebhiḥ pruṣitapsubhiḥ
children.translated_text: Come now, O <s>Aśvins</s>, with horses dappled with drops,

children.text: dasrā hiraṇyavartanī śubhas patī pātaṃ somam ṛtāvṛdhā ||
children.translated_text: O wondrous ones with golden tracks, lords of beauty, drink the soma, increasers of <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: vayaṃ hi vāṃ havāmahe vipanyavo viprāso vājasātaye
children.translated_text: For we inspired poets call you for the winning of the prize,

children.text: tā valgū dasrā purudaṃsasā dhiyāśvinā śruṣṭy ā gatam ||
children.translated_text: so, O lovely wondrous ones of many marvels, O <s>Aśvins</s>, come quickly with inspired thought.

children.text: Chapter 708
taṃ vo dasmam ṛtīṣahaṃ vasor mandānam andhasaḥ
children.translated_text: That wondrous one for you, overpowering enemies, delighting in the draught of wealth,

children.text: abhi vatsaṃ na svasareṣu dhenava indraṃ gīrbhir navāmahe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, we praise anew with songs, as cows go to the calf in their stalls.

children.text: dyukṣaṃ sudānuṃ taviṣībhir āvṛtaṃ giriṃ na purubhojasam
children.translated_text: Bright, most generous, wrapped in powers, like a mountain rich in many enjoyments,

children.text: kṣumantaṃ vājaṃ śatinaṃ sahasriṇam makṣū gomantam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: we seek at once a prize rich in dwellings, hundredfold, thousandfold, and rich in cattle.

children.text: na tvā bṛhanto adrayo varanta indra vīﾱavaḥ
children.translated_text: Great stones do not restrain you, O <s>Indra</s>, nor the corruptly written 'vīﾱavaḥ',

children.text: yad ditsasi stuvate māvate vasu nakiṣ ṭad ā mināti te ||
children.translated_text: when you wish to give wealth to a singer like me; no one diminishes that gift of yours.

children.text: yoddhāsi kratvā śavasota daṃsanā viśvā jātābhi majmanā
children.translated_text: You are a fighter by resolve, by might, and by wondrous power, beyond all beings in greatness.

children.text: ā tvāyam arka ūtaye vavartati yaṃ gotamā ajījanan ||
children.translated_text: This song, which the <s>Gotamas</s> have generated, has turned toward you for aid.

children.text: pra hi ririkṣa ojasā divo antebhyas pari
children.translated_text: For by your strength you have reached beyond the ends of heaven,

children.text: na tvā vivyāca raja indra pārthivam anu svadhāṃ vavakṣitha ||
children.translated_text: and the earthly realm has not encompassed you, O <s>Indra</s>; you have grown according to your own law.

children.text: nakiḥ pariṣṭir maghavan maghasya te yad dāśuṣe daśasyasi
children.translated_text: There is no boundary around your bounty, O <s>Maghavan</s>, when you bestow upon the worshipper.

children.text: asmākam bodhy ucathasya coditā maṃhiṣṭho vājasātaye ||
children.translated_text: Be the inciter of our praise, the most bountiful one for the winning of the prize.

children.text: Chapter 709
bṛhad indrāya gāyata maruto vṛtrahantamam
children.translated_text: Sing a great song to <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Maruts</s>, to the greatest slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>,

children.text: yena jyotir ajanayann ṛtāvṛdho devaṃ devāya jāgṛvi ||
children.translated_text: by whom the gods, increasers of <s>ṛta</s>, generated light, the wakeful god for the god.

children.text: apādhamad abhiśastīr aśastihāthendro dyumny ābhavat
children.translated_text: He drove away curses, the curse-slayer; then <s>Indra</s> became glorious.

children.text: devās ta indra sakhyāya yemire bṛhadbhāno marudgaṇa ||
children.translated_text: The gods joined themselves to you, O <s>Indra</s>, for friendship, O broad-rayed one, O host of <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: pra va indrāya bṛhate maruto brahmārcata
children.translated_text: Sing forth sacred formulation to great <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: vṛtraṃ hanati vṛtrahā śatakratur vajreṇa śataparvaṇā ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer, of hundred powers, strikes <s>Vṛtra</s> with the hundred-jointed <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt).

children.text: abhi pra bhara dhṛṣatā dhṛṣanmanaḥ śravaś cit te asad bṛhat
children.translated_text: Bring it forth boldly, O bold-minded one; even your fame shall be great.

children.text: arṣantv āpo javasā vi mātaro hano vṛtraṃ jayā svaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let the mother waters stream forth with speed; slay <s>Vṛtra</s>, win the heavenly light.

children.text: yaj jāyathā apūrvya maghavan vṛtrahatyāya
children.translated_text: When you were born, O unprecedented bountiful one, for the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>,

children.text: tat pṛthivīm aprathayas tad astabhnā uta dyām ||
children.translated_text: then you spread out the earth; then you also propped up heaven.

children.text: tat te yajño ajāyata tad arka uta haskṛtiḥ
children.translated_text: Then your sacrifice was born, and then the hymn and the cry of praise;

children.text: tad viśvam abhibhūr asi yaj jātaṃ yac ca jantvam ||
children.translated_text: then you are the overpowerer of all that has been born and all living creatures.

children.text: āmāsu pakvam airaya ā sūryaṃ rohayo divi
children.translated_text: You set the ripe among the unripe in motion; you made the sun ascend in heaven.

children.text: gharmaṃ na sāman tapatā suvṛktibhir juṣṭaṃ girvaṇase bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: Like a hot draught, O chant, made bright by glowing good praises, it is great and pleasing to the lover of songs.

children.text: Chapter 710
ā no viśvāsu havya indraḥ samatsu bhūṣatu
children.translated_text: In all contests let <s>Indra</s> make himself ready for our oblations.

children.text: upa brahmāṇi savanāni vṛtrahā paramajyā ṛcīṣamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, strongest in the lofty bowstring, attend the sacred formulations and the Soma-pressings, O praiseworthy one.

children.text: tvaṃ dātā prathamo rādhasām asy asi satya īśānakṛt
children.translated_text: You are the first giver of riches; you are true, the maker of lordship.

children.text: tuvidyumnasya yujyā vṛṇīmahe putrasya śavaso mahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: We choose the alliance of the much-shining son of mighty strength.

children.text: brahmā ta indra girvaṇaḥ kriyante anatidbhutā
children.translated_text: Sacred formulations, O <s>Indra</s>, lover of songs, are being made for you, unsurpassed in wonder.

children.text: imā juṣasva haryaśva yojanendra yā te amanmahi ||
children.translated_text: Accept these, O bay-horsed <s>Indra</s>; yoke your horses, O <s>Indra</s>, for what we have thought out for you.

children.text: tvaṃ hi satyo maghavann anānato vṛtrā bhūri nyṛñjase
children.translated_text: For you are true, O bountiful one, not bending down; you strike down many <s>Vṛtras</s>.

children.text: sa tvaṃ śaviṣṭha vajrahasta dāśuṣe 'rvāñcaṃ rayim ā kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: So you, O mightiest one with the thunderbolt in hand, bring wealth hither for the worshipper.

children.text: tvam indra yaśā asy ṛjīṣī śavasas pate
children.translated_text: You, <s>Indra</s>, are famed, strong in exhilaration, lord of might.

children.text: tvaṃ vṛtrāṇi haṃsy apratīny eka id anuttā carṣaṇīdhṛtā ||
children.translated_text: You alone, sustaining peoples, slay irresistible <s>Vṛtras</s>, unsurpassed.

children.text: tam u tvā nūnam asura pracetasaṃ rādho bhāgam ivemahe
children.translated_text: Now we seek you, lordly and wise, as one seeks a portion of wealth.

children.text: mahīva kṛttiḥ śaraṇā ta indra pra te sumnā no aśnavan ||
children.translated_text: Like a great sheltering hide, O <s>Indra</s>, may your favors reach forth to us.

children.text: Chapter 711
kanyā vār avāyatī somam api srutāvidat
children.translated_text: The maiden, going down to the water, found Soma that had flowed down.

children.text: astam bharanty abravīd indrāya sunavai tvā śakrāya sunavai tvā ||
children.translated_text: Carrying it home, she said, 'For <s>Indra</s> I will press you; for <s>Śakra</s> I will press you.'

children.text: asau ya eṣi vīrako gṛhaṃ gṛhaṃ vicākaśad
children.translated_text: That little hero there, whom you see going from house to house,

children.text: imaṃ jambhasutam piba dhānāvantaṃ karambhiṇam apūpavantam ukthinam ||
children.translated_text: drink this pressed Soma with sprouts, with gruel, with cakes, rich in hymns.

children.text: ā cana tvā cikitsāmo 'dhi cana tvā nemasi
children.translated_text: We do not fully know you, nor do we bow to you enough.

children.text: śanair iva śanakair ivendrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: Slowly, as if little by little, O Soma-drop, flow around for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: kuvicchakat kuvit karat kuvin no vasyasas karat
children.translated_text: Will he act? Will he do it? Will he make us better off?

children.text: kuvit patidviṣo yatīr indreṇa saṃgamāmahai ||
children.translated_text: Will we, women hated by our husbands, come together with <s>Indra</s>?

children.text: imāni trīṇi viṣṭapā tānīndra vi rohaya
children.translated_text: These three realms: cause them, O <s>Indra</s>, to grow forth.

children.text: śiras tatasyorvarām ād idam ma upodare ||
children.translated_text: The head of my father, his field, and this part below my belly:

children.text: asau ca yā na urvarād imāṃ tanvam mama
children.translated_text: and that field of ours, and this body of mine,

children.text: atho tatasya yacchiraḥ sarvā tā romaśā kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: and also that head of my father: make all these covered with hair.

children.text: khe rathasya khe 'nasaḥ khe yugasya śatakrato
children.translated_text: In the hole of the chariot, in the hole of the wagon, in the hole of the yoke, O hundred-powered one,

children.text: apālām indra triṣ pūtvy akṛṇoḥ sūryatvacam ||
children.translated_text: having purified <s>Apālā</s> three times, O <s>Indra</s>, you made her sun-skinned.

children.text: Chapter 712
pāntam ā vo andhasa indram abhi pra gāyata
children.translated_text: Come to the Soma-drink; sing forth to <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: viśvāsāhaṃ śatakratum maṃhiṣṭhaṃ carṣaṇīnām ||
children.translated_text: the all-conquering, hundred-powered one, the greatest of peoples.

children.text: puruhūtam puruṣṭutaṃ gāthānyaṃ sanaśrutam
children.translated_text: Much-invoked, much-praised, to be sung in songs, famed from of old:

children.text: indra iti bravītana ||
children.translated_text: say, '<s>Indra</s>.'

children.text: indra in no mahānāṃ dātā vājānāṃ nṛtuḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is indeed the great giver of prizes to us, the lord of vigorous men;

children.text: mahāṁ abhijñv ā yamat ||
children.translated_text: the great one has taken hold with command.

children.text: apād u śipry andhasaḥ sudakṣasya prahoṣiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: From the drink, O beautiful-lipped one, from the Soma of the skillful, impetuous presser,

children.text: indor indro yavāśiraḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> drank the Soma mixed with barley.

children.text: tam v abhi prārcatendraṃ somasya pītaye
children.translated_text: Praise that <s>Indra</s> for the drinking of Soma;

children.text: tad iddhy asya vardhanam ||
children.translated_text: for that indeed is his strengthening.

children.text: asya pītvā madānāṃ devo devasyaujasā
children.translated_text: After drinking of these exhilarations, the god, by the might of the god,

children.text: viśvābhi bhuvanā bhuvat ||
children.translated_text: became lord over all beings.

children.text: tyam u vaḥ satrāsāhaṃ viśvāsu gīrṣv āyatam
children.translated_text: That overpowering one of yours, extended through all songs,

children.text: ā cyāvayasy ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: you make come down for aid.

children.text: yudhmaṃ santam anarvāṇaṃ somapām anapacyutam
children.translated_text: The fighting one, unassailable, Soma-drinking, unfailing:

children.text: naram avāryakratum ||
children.translated_text: the man whose resolve cannot be warded off.

children.text: śikṣā ṇa indra rāya ā puru vidvāṁ ṛcīṣama
children.translated_text: Instruct us, O <s>Indra</s>, toward wealth, O much-knowing and praiseworthy one.

children.text: avā naḥ pārye dhane ||
children.translated_text: Help us in the prize to be won.

children.text: ataś cid indra ṇa upā yāhi śatavājayā
children.translated_text: From there too, O <s>Indra</s>, come to us with hundredfold prize-winning power,

children.text: iṣā sahasravājayā ||
children.translated_text: with nourishment that wins a thousand prizes.

children.text: ayāma dhīvato dhiyo 'rvadbhiḥ śakra godare
children.translated_text: May we guide the thoughts of the thoughtful with swift horses, O <s>Śakra</s>, rich in cattle.

children.text: jayema pṛtsu vajrivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we conquer in battles, O wielder of the thunderbolt.

children.text: vayam u tvā śatakrato gāvo na yavaseṣv ā
children.translated_text: We stir you to joy, O hundred-powered one, as cows go to the barley-fields,

children.text: uktheṣu raṇayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: in our hymns.

children.text: viśvā hi martyatvanānukāmā śatakrato
children.translated_text: For all the longings of mortal men, O hundred-powered one,

children.text: aganma vajrinn āśasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we have approached as hopes, O thunderbolt-wielder.

children.text: tve su putra śavaso 'vṛtran kāmakātayaḥ
children.translated_text: In you, O son of strength, are the wish-granting powers that remove obstruction;

children.text: na tvām indrāti ricyate ||
children.translated_text: no one surpasses you, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: sa no vṛṣan saniṣṭhayā saṃ ghorayā dravitnvā
children.translated_text: So, O bull, with the most winning, fierce, swiftly-moving

children.text: dhiyāviḍḍhi purandhyā ||
children.translated_text: inspired thought, find us with abundant insight.

children.text: yas te nūnaṃ śatakratav indra dyumnitamo madaḥ
children.translated_text: That exhilaration of yours, O hundred-powered <s>Indra</s>, which is now most splendid:

children.text: tena nūnam made madeḥ ||
children.translated_text: with that, now, delight in each exhilaration.

children.text: yas te citraśravastamo ya indra vṛtrahantamaḥ
children.translated_text: That which is most famous for wondrous renown, which, O <s>Indra</s>, most slays <s>Vṛtra</s>,

children.text: ya ojodātamo madaḥ ||
children.translated_text: which gives the greatest strength as exhilaration:

children.text: vidmā hi yas te adrivas tvādattaḥ satya somapāḥ
children.translated_text: for we know the Soma, O stone-wielder, which is given by you, O true Soma-drinker,

children.text: viśvāsu dasma kṛṣṭiṣu ||
children.translated_text: among all peoples, O wondrous one.

children.text: indrāya madvane sutam pari ṣṭobhantu no giraḥ
children.translated_text: Let our songs resound around the pressed Soma for <s>Indra</s>, for exhilaration.

children.text: arkam arcantu kāravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let the singers sing the hymn.

children.text: yasmin viśvā adhi śriyo raṇanti sapta saṃsadaḥ
children.translated_text: In whom all glories and the seven assemblies rejoice:

children.text: indraṃ sute havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: we call <s>Indra</s> at the pressing.

children.text: trikadrukeṣu cetanaṃ devāso yajñam atnata
children.translated_text: At the three Soma-pressings the gods, attentive, stretched out the sacrifice;

children.text: tam id vardhantu no giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: let our songs strengthen him.

children.text: ā tvā viśantv indavaḥ samudram iva sindhavaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the Soma-drops enter you, O <s>Indra</s>, as rivers enter the ocean.

children.text: na tvām indrāti ricyate ||
children.translated_text: No one surpasses you, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: vivyaktha mahinā vṛṣan bhakṣaṃ somasya jāgṛve
children.translated_text: You have opened out in greatness, O bull, for the wakeful enjoyment of Soma,

children.text: ya indra jaṭhareṣu te ||
children.translated_text: which is in your bellies, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: araṃ ta indra kukṣaye somo bhavatu vṛtrahan
children.translated_text: Let the Soma be enough for your belly, O <s>Indra</s>, slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: araṃ dhāmabhya indavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let the Soma-drops be enough for your seats.

children.text: aram aśvāya gāyati śrutakakṣo araṃ gave
children.translated_text: <s>Śrutakakṣa</s> sings what is enough for the horse and enough for the cow,

children.text: aram indrasya dhāmne ||
children.translated_text: enough for <s>Indra</s>'s abode.
