children.text: araṃ hi ṣma suteṣu ṇaḥ someṣv indra bhūṣasi
children.translated_text: For, O <s>Indra</s>, you adorn yourself among our pressed Somas,

children.text: araṃ te śakra dāvane ||
children.translated_text: enough for you, O <s>Śakra</s>, to give.

children.text: parākāttāc cid adrivas tvāṃ nakṣanta no giraḥ
children.translated_text: Even from afar, O stone-wielder, our songs reach you.

children.text: araṃ gamāma te vayam ||
children.translated_text: May we come to what is enough for you.

children.text: evā hy asi vīrayur evā śūra uta sthiraḥ
children.translated_text: For so you are eager for heroes; so, O hero, you are firm as well.

children.text: evā te rādhyam manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: So your mind is to be won over.

children.text: evā rātis tuvīmagha viśvebhir dhāyi dhātṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: So, O greatly bountiful one, your gift has been established by all the ordainers.

children.text: adhā cid indra me sacā ||
children.translated_text: Then indeed, O <s>Indra</s>, be with me.

children.text: mo ṣu brahmeva tandrayur bhuvo vājānām pate
children.translated_text: Do not, like a weary reciter of sacred speech, become sluggish, O lord of prizes;

children.text: matsvā sutasya gomataḥ ||
children.translated_text: rejoice in the pressed Soma rich in cows.

children.text: mā na indrābhy ādiśaḥ sūro aktuṣv ā yaman
children.translated_text: Do not, O <s>Indra</s>, hand us over to hostile directions, as the sun goes into the nights;

children.text: tvā yujā vanema tat ||
children.translated_text: with you yoked as ally, may we win that.

children.text: tvayed indra yujā vayam prati bruvīmahi spṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: With you, O <s>Indra</s>, as ally, we answer the rivals;

children.text: tvam asmākaṃ tava smasi ||
children.translated_text: you are ours, and we are yours.

children.text: tvām iddhi tvāyavo 'nunonuvataś carān
children.translated_text: For it is you that the singers who desire you follow again and again as they move,

children.text: sakhāya indra kāravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: your friends, O <s>Indra</s>, the poets.

children.text: Chapter 713
ud ghed abhi śrutāmaghaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ naryāpasam
children.translated_text: You rise up toward the famed giver, the bull who performs heroic deeds;

children.text: astāram eṣi sūrya ||
children.translated_text: you go as the arouser, O <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: nava yo navatim puro bibheda bāhvojasā
children.translated_text: He who split ninety-nine fortresses by the strength of his arms

children.text: ahiṃ ca vṛtrahāvadhīt ||
children.translated_text: and, as slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, slew the serpent.

children.text: sa na indraḥ śivaḥ sakhāśvāvad gomad yavamat
children.translated_text: May that <s>Indra</s>, a kindly friend to us, rich in horses, cows, and barley,

children.text: urudhāreva dohate ||
children.translated_text: milk out for us like a stream with broad flow.

children.text: yad adya kac ca vṛtrahann udagā abhi sūrya
children.translated_text: Whatever thing today, O slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, the sun has risen upon,

children.text: sarvaṃ tad indra te vaśe ||
children.translated_text: all that, O <s>Indra</s>, is under your power.

children.text: yad vā pravṛddha satpate na marā iti manyase
children.translated_text: Or if, O grown one, lord of the good, you think, 'I do not die,'

children.text: uto tat satyam it tava ||
children.translated_text: then that indeed is your truth.

children.text: ye somāsaḥ parāvati ye arvāvati sunvire
children.translated_text: The Somas that have been pressed far away and those that have been pressed nearby,

children.text: sarvāṃs tāṁ indra gacchasi ||
children.translated_text: to all those, O <s>Indra</s>, you go.

children.text: tam indraṃ vājayāmasi mahe vṛtrāya hantave
children.translated_text: We strengthen that <s>Indra</s> for the prize, for slaying the great <s>Vṛtra</s>;

children.text: sa vṛṣā vṛṣabho bhuvat ||
children.translated_text: let him, the strong bull, become a bull.

children.text: indraḥ sa dāmane kṛta ojiṣṭhaḥ sa made hitaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is made for mastery; he is strongest, set in exhilaration,

children.text: dyumnī ślokī sa somyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: bright, famed, and fit for Soma.

children.text: girā vajro na saṃbhṛtaḥ sabalo anapacyutaḥ
children.translated_text: Like a thunderbolt gathered by song, powerful and not falling away,

children.text: vavakṣa ṛṣvo astṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he has grown lofty and unpierced.

children.text: durge cin naḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi gṛṇāna indra girvaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Even in difficulty make an easy path for us, O praised <s>Indra</s>, lover of song;

children.text: tvaṃ ca maghavan vaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and you, O bountiful one, are master.

children.text: yasya te nū cid ādiśaṃ na minanti svarājyam
children.translated_text: Your command, even now, they do not diminish, nor your self-rule,

children.text: na devo nādhrigur janaḥ ||
children.translated_text: neither god nor lowly mortal.

children.text: adhā te apratiṣkutaṃ devī śuṣmaṃ saparyataḥ
children.translated_text: Then the two divine worlds serve your irresistible might,

children.text: ubhe suśipra rodasī ||
children.translated_text: O fair-lipped one, both heaven and earth.

children.text: tvam etad adhārayaḥ kṛṣṇāsu rohiṇīṣu ca
children.translated_text: You held this fast among the black, the red,

children.text: paruṣṇīṣu ruśat payaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and the tawny ones: the shining milk.

children.text: vi yad aher adha tviṣo viśve devāso akramuḥ
children.translated_text: When, after the serpent's splendor was broken apart, all the gods strode forth,

children.text: vidan mṛgasya tāṁ amaḥ ||
children.translated_text: they found that force of the wild beast.

children.text: ād u me nivaro bhuvad vṛtrahādiṣṭa pauṃsyam
children.translated_text: Then the highest manly power came to me, O slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>,

children.text: ajātaśatrur astṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: unassailed and with no enemy born.

children.text: śrutaṃ vo vṛtrahantamam pra śardhaṃ carṣaṇīnām
children.translated_text: Hear, you all, the mightiest slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>; proclaim the host of the peoples

children.text: ā śuṣe rādhase mahe ||
children.translated_text: to the great one, for splendid bounty to the eager worshiper.

children.text: ayā dhiyā ca gavyayā puruṇāman puruṣṭuta
children.translated_text: With this thought seeking cows, O much-named, much-praised one,

children.text: yat some soma ābhavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when at the Soma you became exhilarated by Soma.

children.text: bodhinmanā id astu no vṛtrahā bhūryāsutiḥ
children.translated_text: Let the much-invoked slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s> be of awakened mind toward us;

children.text: śṛṇotu śakra āśiṣam ||
children.translated_text: let mighty <s>Śakra</s> hear our blessing.

children.text: kayā tvaṃ na ūtyābhi pra mandase vṛṣan
children.translated_text: With what aid of yours do you come to rejoice in us, O bull?

children.text: kayā stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: With what aid will you bring wealth to the singers?

children.text: kasya vṛṣā sute sacā niyutvān vṛṣabho raṇat
children.translated_text: At whose pressing, as a bull, yoked with teams, will the bull roar,

children.text: vṛtrahā somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, for the drinking of Soma?

children.text: abhī ṣu ṇas tvaṃ rayim mandasānaḥ sahasriṇam
children.translated_text: Come toward us with thousandfold wealth while you rejoice;

children.text: prayantā bodhi dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: be the giver to the worshiper.

children.text: patnīvantaḥ sutā ima uśanto yanti vītaye
children.translated_text: These pressed draughts, accompanied by the wives and eager, go to the feast;

children.text: apāṃ jagmir nicumpuṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: they have gone to the waters, sipping deeply.

children.text: iṣṭā hotrā asṛkṣatendraṃ vṛdhāso adhvare
children.translated_text: The chosen invocations have been sent forth, increasing <s>Indra</s> at the sacrifice,

children.text: acchāvabhṛtham ojasā ||
children.translated_text: with force toward the final bath.

children.text: iha tyā sadhamādyā harī hiraṇyakeśyā
children.translated_text: Here those two bay steeds, fit for shared exhilaration, golden-maned,

children.text: voﾱhām abhi prayo hitam ||
children.translated_text: have been set toward the offered refreshment, to carry him.

children.text: tubhyaṃ somāḥ sutā ime stīrṇam barhir vibhāvaso
children.translated_text: For you these Somas are pressed; the ritual grass is strewn, O shining one;

children.text: stotṛbhya indram ā vaha ||
children.translated_text: bring <s>Indra</s> to the singers.

children.text: ā te dakṣaṃ vi rocanā dadhad ratnā vi dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: Bring your skill here through the bright spaces, bestowing treasures for the worshiper;

children.text: stotṛbhya indram arcata ||
children.translated_text: praise <s>Indra</s> for the singers.

children.text: ā te dadhāmīndriyam ukthā viśvā śatakrato
children.translated_text: I place strength in you, O <s>Indra</s>, and all hymns, O hundred-powered one;

children.text: stotṛbhya indra mṛﾱaya ||
children.translated_text: be gracious to the singers, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: bhadraṃ bhadraṃ na ā bhareṣam ūrjaṃ śatakrato
children.translated_text: Bring us blessing after blessing, refreshment and strength, O hundred-powered one,

children.text: yad indra mṛﾱayāsi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: when you, O <s>Indra</s>, are gracious to us.

children.text: sa no viśvāny ā bhara suvitāni śatakrato
children.translated_text: Bring us all prosperities, O hundred-powered one,

children.text: yad indra mṛﾱayāsi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: when you, O <s>Indra</s>, are gracious to us.

children.text: tvām id vṛtrahantama sutāvanto havāmahe
children.translated_text: It is you, mightiest slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, whom we, possessing pressed Soma, call,

children.text: yad indra mṛﾱayāsi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: when you, O <s>Indra</s>, are gracious to us.

children.text: upa no haribhiḥ sutaṃ yāhi madānām pate
children.translated_text: Come to our pressed Soma with your bay horses, O lord of exhilarations;

children.text: upa no haribhiḥ sutam ||
children.translated_text: come to our pressed Soma with your bay horses.

children.text: dvitā yo vṛtrahantamo vida indraḥ śatakratuḥ
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s>, the hundred-powered one, is known in two ways as the mightiest slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>;

children.text: upa no haribhiḥ sutam ||
children.translated_text: come to our pressed Soma with your bay horses.

children.text: tvaṃ hi vṛtrahann eṣām pātā somānām asi
children.translated_text: For you, O slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, are the guardian of these Somas;

children.text: upa no haribhiḥ sutam ||
children.translated_text: come to our pressed Soma with your bay horses.

children.text: indra iṣe dadātu na ṛbhukṣaṇam ṛbhuṃ rayim
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> give us nourishment, skillful wealth rich in sustenance;

children.text: vājī dadātu vājinam ||
children.translated_text: may the prize-winner give prize-winning wealth.

children.text: Chapter 714
gaur dhayati marutāṃ śravasyur mātā maghonām
children.translated_text: The cow, seeking fame, suckles the <s>Maruts</s>, the mother of the bountiful ones,

children.text: yuktā vahnī rathānām ||
children.translated_text: with the draught animals of the chariots yoked.

children.text: yasyā devā upasthe vratā viśve dhārayante
children.translated_text: In whose lap all the gods uphold their vows,

children.text: sūryāmāsā dṛśe kam ||
children.translated_text: the Sun and Moon, for lovely sight.

children.text: tat su no viśve arya ā sadā gṛṇanti kāravaḥ
children.translated_text: May all those noble <s>Maruts</s>, whom the singers ever praise,

children.text: marutaḥ somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: come for the drinking of Soma.

children.text: asti somo ayaṃ sutaḥ pibanty asya marutaḥ
children.translated_text: This Soma has been pressed; the <s>Maruts</s> drink of it,

children.text: uta svarājo aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: and also the self-ruling <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: pibanti mitro aryamā tanā pūtasya varuṇaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s> drink the purified one with their bodies,

children.text: triṣadhasthasya jāvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: the swift one dwelling in three seats.

children.text: uto nv asya joṣam āṃ indraḥ sutasya gomataḥ
children.translated_text: And now <s>Indra</s> too will enjoy the pleasure of this pressed Soma rich in cows,

children.text: prātar hoteva matsati ||
children.translated_text: like the hotar in the morning.

children.text: kad atviṣanta sūrayas tira āpa iva sridhaḥ
children.translated_text: When will the inspired ones, pure in skill, flash forth across the streams

children.text: arṣanti pūtadakṣasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and flow like waters?

children.text: kad vo adya mahānāṃ devānām avo vṛṇe
children.translated_text: When today shall I choose the protection of you great gods,

children.text: tmanā ca dasmavarcasām ||
children.translated_text: and, by myself, that of the wondrously shining ones?

children.text: ā ye viśvā pārthivāni paprathan rocanā divaḥ
children.translated_text: You who have spread out all earthly spaces and the lights of heaven,

children.text: marutaḥ somapītaye ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Maruts</s>, come for the drinking of Soma.

children.text: tyān nu pūtadakṣaso divo vo maruto huve
children.translated_text: Those pure in skill from heaven, you <s>Maruts</s>, I now call

children.text: asya somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: for the drinking of this Soma.

children.text: tyān nu ye vi rodasī tastabhur maruto huve
children.translated_text: Those <s>Maruts</s> who have propped apart the two worlds, I now call

children.text: asya somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: for the drinking of this Soma.

children.text: tyaṃ nu mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ giriṣṭhāṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ huve
children.translated_text: That host of the <s>Maruts</s>, mountain-standing and vigorous, I now call

children.text: asya somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: for the drinking of this Soma.

children.text: Chapter 715
ā tvā giro rathīr ivāsthuḥ suteṣu girvaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Your songs have come to you like charioteers at the pressings, O lover of song;

children.text: abhi tvā sam anūṣatendra vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: they have sung all around you, O <s>Indra</s>, like mothers around a calf.

children.text: ā tvā śukrā acucyavuḥ sutāsa indra girvaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: The bright pressed Soma draughts have flowed down to you, O <s>Indra</s>, lover of song;

children.text: pibā tv asyāndhasa indra viśvāsu te hitam ||
children.translated_text: drink this draught, O <s>Indra</s>; it is set for you in all ways.

children.text: pibā somam madāya kam indra śyenābhṛtaṃ sutam
children.translated_text: Drink the pressed <s>soma</s>, brought by the eagle, for exhilaration, O <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: tvaṃ hi śaśvatīnām patī rājā viśām asi ||
children.translated_text: for you are lord and king of the clans through all generations.

children.text: śrudhī havaṃ tiraścyā indra yas tvā saparyati
children.translated_text: Hear the call, O <s>Indra</s>, even from across, of the one who worships you.

children.text: suvīryasya gomato rāyas pūrdhi mahāṁ asi ||
children.translated_text: Fill him with wealth rich in heroic sons and cattle; you are great.

children.text: indra yas te navīyasīṃ giram mandrām ajījanat
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, the man who has generated for you a newer, delightful song,

children.text: cikitvinmanasaṃ dhiyam pratnām ṛtasya pipyuṣīm ||
children.translated_text: a thought with discerning mind, ancient and swollen with <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic truth),

children.text: tam u ṣṭavāma yaṃ gira indram ukthāni vāvṛdhuḥ
children.translated_text: him let us praise: <s>Indra</s>, whom songs and recitations have strengthened.

children.text: purūṇy asya pauṃsyā siṣāsanto vanāmahe ||
children.translated_text: Seeking his many manly powers, we would win him for ourselves.

children.text: eto nv indraṃ stavāma śuddhaṃ śuddhena sāmnā
children.translated_text: Come now: let us praise pure <s>Indra</s> with a pure chant,

children.text: śuddhair ukthair vāvṛdhvāṃsaṃ śuddha āśīrvān mamattu ||
children.translated_text: him who has grown through pure recitations; pure and rich in blessings, may he rejoice.

children.text: indra śuddho na ā gahi śuddhaḥ śuddhābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Come to us pure, O <s>Indra</s>, pure with pure aids.

children.text: śuddho rayiṃ ni dhāraya śuddho mamaddhi somyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Pure, set wealth in place for us; pure, delight in the soma.

children.text: indra śuddho hi no rayiṃ śuddho ratnāni dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: For pure <s>Indra</s> gives us wealth; pure, he gives treasures to the worshipper.

children.text: śuddho vṛtrāṇi jighnase śuddho vājaṃ siṣāsasi ||
children.translated_text: Pure, you strike down the <s>Vṛtras</s>; pure, you seek to win the prize.

children.text: Chapter 716
asmā uṣāsa ātiranta yāmam indrāya naktam ūrmyāḥ suvācaḥ
children.translated_text: For him the dawns and the eloquent nights rich in waves have crossed their course for <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: asmā āpo mātaraḥ sapta tasthur nṛbhyas tarāya sindhavaḥ supārāḥ ||
children.translated_text: for him the seven mothering waters have stood ready, rivers easy for men to cross.

children.text: atividdhā vithureṇā cid astrā triḥ sapta sānu saṃhitā girīṇām
children.translated_text: Even weapons pierced by the scattered one, thrice seven ridges joined among the mountains,

children.text: na tad devo na martyas tuturyād yāni pravṛddho vṛṣabhaś cakāra ||
children.translated_text: neither god nor mortal could pass beyond the deeds which the swollen bull performed.

children.text: indrasya vajra āyaso nimiśla indrasya bāhvor bhūyiṣṭham ojaḥ
children.translated_text: The iron <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt) of <s>Indra</s> is hurled; in <s>Indra</s>'s two arms is the greatest strength.

children.text: śīrṣann indrasya kratavo nireka āsann eṣanta śrutyā upāke ||
children.translated_text: On <s>Indra</s>'s head his powers of will stood out; near his mouth they hastened for renowned aid.

children.text: manye tvā yajñiyaṃ yajñiyānām manye tvā cyavanam acyutānām
children.translated_text: I deem you the most worthy of sacrifice among those worthy of sacrifice; I deem you the mover of the unmoved.

children.text: manye tvā satvanām indra ketum manye tvā vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnām ||
children.translated_text: I deem you the sign of the strong, O <s>Indra</s>; I deem you the bull of peoples.

children.text: ā yad vajram bāhvor indra dhatse madacyutam ahaye hantavā u
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indra</s>, you take the exhilaration-loosing <s>vajra</s> in your two arms to slay the serpent,

children.text: pra parvatā anavanta pra gāvaḥ pra brahmāṇo abhinakṣanta indram ||
children.translated_text: the mountains go forward, the cows go forward, and the sacred formulations press on toward <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: tam u ṣṭavāma ya imā jajāna viśvā jātāny avarāṇy asmāt
children.translated_text: Let us praise him who generated these things, all beings lower than himself.

children.text: indreṇa mitraṃ didhiṣema gīrbhir upo namobhir vṛṣabhaṃ viśema ||
children.translated_text: With songs let us seek friendship through <s>Indra</s>; with reverences let us enter near the bull.

children.text: vṛtrasya tvā śvasathād īṣamāṇā viśve devā ajahur ye sakhāyaḥ
children.translated_text: Fearing the breath of <s>Vṛtra</s>, all the gods who were your friends abandoned you.

children.text: marudbhir indra sakhyaṃ te astv athemā viśvāḥ pṛtanā jayāsi ||
children.translated_text: Let your friendship be with the <s>Maruts</s>, O <s>Indra</s>; then you shall conquer all these battles.

children.text: triḥ ṣaṣṭis tvā maruto vāvṛdhānā usrā iva rāśayo yajñiyāsaḥ
children.translated_text: The thrice-sixty <s>Maruts</s>, strengthening you like radiant heaps, worthy of sacrifice,

children.text: upa tvemaḥ kṛdhi no bhāgadheyaṃ śuṣmaṃ ta enā haviṣā vidhema ||
children.translated_text: have come near you. Make us your allotted share; with this oblation let us serve your might.

children.text: tigmam āyudham marutām anīkaṃ kas ta indra prati vajraṃ dadharṣa
children.translated_text: The sharp weapon, the battle-front of the <s>Maruts</s>: who, O <s>Indra</s>, has dared withstand your <s>vajra</s>?

children.text: anāyudhāso asurā adevāś cakreṇa tāṁ apa vapa ṛjīṣin ||
children.translated_text: The weaponless <s>Asuras</s>, the godless ones: with your wheel, O possessor of the dregs, cast them away.

children.text: maha ugrāya tavase suvṛktim preraya śivatamāya paśvaḥ
children.translated_text: Send forth a well-spoken hymn for the great, fierce, mighty, and most auspicious lord of cattle.

children.text: girvāhase gira indrāya pūrvīr dhehi tanve kuvid aṅga vedat ||
children.translated_text: Set many songs before <s>Indra</s>, bearer of hymns; perhaps, indeed, he will attend to your person.

children.text: ukthavāhase vibhve manīṣāṃ druṇā na pāram īrayā nadīnām
children.translated_text: For the hymn-bearer, the far-reaching one, send forth inspired thought, as with a wooden vessel across the far shore of rivers.

children.text: ni spṛśa dhiyā tanvi śrutasya juṣṭatarasya kuvid aṅga vedat ||
children.translated_text: With thought touch the body of the renowned, more welcome one; perhaps, indeed, he will attend.

children.text: tad viviḍḍhi yat ta indro jujoṣat stuhi suṣṭutiṃ namasā vivāsa
children.translated_text: Discover what <s>Indra</s> will enjoy from you; praise him with good praise, attend on him with reverence.

children.text: upa bhūṣa jaritar mā ruvaṇyaḥ śrāvayā vācaṃ kuvid aṅga vedat ||
children.translated_text: Adorn him nearby, O singer; do not howl. Make your voice heard; perhaps, indeed, he will attend.

children.text: ava drapso aṃśumatīm atiṣṭhad iyānaḥ kṛṣṇo daśabhiḥ sahasraiḥ
children.translated_text: The drop settled upon the <s>Aṃśumatī</s>; moving black, with ten thousand,

children.text: āvat tam indraḥ śacyā dhamantam apa snehitīr nṛmaṇā adhatta ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> aided him as he blew with power; with manly spirit he drove away the clinging foes.

children.text: drapsam apaśyaṃ viṣuṇe carantam upahvare nadyo aṃśumatyāḥ
children.translated_text: I saw the drop moving apart in the hidden place of the rivers of <s>Aṃśumatī</s>,

children.text: nabho na kṛṣṇam avatasthivāṃsam iṣyāmi vo vṛṣaṇo yudhyatājau ||
children.translated_text: standing like a black cloud. I urge you, O bulls: fight in the contest.

children.text: adha drapso aṃśumatyā upasthe 'dhārayat tanvaṃ titviṣāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Then the drop, in the lap of <s>Aṃśumatī</s>, held his body, blazing.

children.text: viśo adevīr abhy ācarantīr bṛhaspatinā yujendraḥ sasāhe ||
children.translated_text: Together with <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, <s>Indra</s> overcame the godless peoples who were advancing against him.

children.text: tvaṃ ha tyat saptabhyo jāyamāno 'śatrubhyo abhavaḥ śatrur indra
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, at birth became an enemy to those seven, to those who had no enemies.

children.text: gūﾱhe dyāvāpṛthivī anv avindo vibhumadbhyo bhuvanebhyo raṇaṃ dhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: You found heaven and earth hidden away; for the spacious worlds you set battle in motion.

children.text: tvaṃ ha tyad apratimānam ojo vajreṇa vajrin dhṛṣito jaghantha
children.translated_text: You, O bearer of the <s>vajra</s>, boldly struck down that incomparable power with the <s>vajra</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ śuṣṇasyāvātiro vadhatrais tvaṃ gā indra śacyed avindaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You turned aside the destructive weapons of <s>Śuṣṇa</s>; you, O <s>Indra</s>, by your power found the cows.

children.text: tvaṃ ha tyad vṛṣabha carṣaṇīnāṃ ghano vṛtrāṇāṃ taviṣo babhūtha
children.translated_text: You, bull of peoples, became the mighty crusher of the <s>Vṛtras</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ sindhūṃr asṛjas tastabhānān tvam apo ajayo dāsapatnīḥ ||
children.translated_text: You released the rivers that were held back; you conquered the waters possessed by the Dāsa.

children.text: sa sukratū raṇitā yaḥ suteṣv anuttamanyur yo aheva revān
children.translated_text: He of good insight, roaring at the pressings, whose anger is unsurpassed, rich like a serpent,

children.text: ya eka in nary apāṃsi kartā sa vṛtrahā pratīd anyam āhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: who alone is the doer of manly deeds: him they call, in answer to any other, the <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer.

children.text: sa vṛtrahendraś carṣaṇīdhṛt taṃ suṣṭutyā havyaṃ huvema
children.translated_text: Let us call that <s>Indra</s>, the <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer, upholder of peoples, as one to be invoked with good praise.

children.text: sa prāvitā maghavā no 'dhivaktā sa vājasya śravasyasya dātā ||
children.translated_text: May that bountiful one be our forward helper and advocate; may he be the giver of prize-winning fame.

children.text: sa vṛtrahendra ṛbhukṣāḥ sadyo jajñāno havyo babhūva
children.translated_text: That <s>Indra</s>, the <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer, rich in skill, became invokable as soon as he was born.

children.text: kṛṇvann apāṃsi naryā purūṇi somo na pīto havyaḥ sakhibhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Doing many manly deeds, like drunk <s>soma</s>, he was to be invoked by his friends.

children.text: Chapter 717
yā indra bhuja ābharaḥ svarvāṁ asurebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: The portion that you, O <s>Indra</s>, have taken in your arms, rich in sunlight, from the <s>Asuras</s>,

children.text: stotāram in maghavann asya vardhaya ye ca tve vṛktabarhiṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: increase this praiser, O <s>Maghavan</s>, and those who have spread the sacrificial grass for you.

children.text: yam indra dadhiṣe tvam aśvaṃ gām bhāgam avyayam
children.translated_text: The horse, the cow, and the imperishable share that you assign, O <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: yajamāne sunvati dakṣiṇāvati tasmin taṃ dhehi mā paṇau ||
children.translated_text: place that in the sacrificing patron who presses soma and gives the fee; do not place it in the <s>Paṇi</s>.

children.text: ya indra sasty avrato 'nuṣvāpam adevayuḥ
children.translated_text: He who sleeps, O <s>Indra</s>, vowless, sinking into sleep, without devotion to the gods,

children.text: svaiḥ ṣa evair mumurat poṣyaṃ rayiṃ sanutar dhehi taṃ tataḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he waste away by his own impulses; set nourishing wealth far away from him.

children.text: yacchakrāsi parāvati yad arvāvati vṛtrahan
children.translated_text: Whatever powerful act you perform far away, whatever nearby, O slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>,

children.text: atas tvā gīrbhir dyugad indra keśibhiḥ sutāvāṁ ā vivāsati ||
children.translated_text: from there the Soma-presser calls you with songs, O <s>Indra</s>, with bright praises.

children.text: yad vāsi rocane divaḥ samudrasyādhi viṣṭapi
children.translated_text: Or whether you are in the luminous realm of heaven, upon the summit of the ocean,

children.text: yat pārthive sadane vṛtrahantama yad antarikṣa ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: or in an earthly dwelling, most mighty slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, or in the midspace, come here.

children.text: sa naḥ someṣu somapāḥ suteṣu śavasas pate
children.translated_text: For us, among the Somas, O Soma-drinker, among the pressed offerings, O lord of might,

children.text: mādayasva rādhasā sūnṛtāvatendra rāyā parīṇasā ||
children.translated_text: be exhilarated by favor rich in good speech, O <s>Indra</s>, and by wealth spread all around.

children.text: mā na indra parā vṛṇag bhavā naḥ sadhamādyaḥ
children.translated_text: Do not turn away from us, O <s>Indra</s>; be our companion at the common feast.

children.text: tvaṃ na ūtī tvam in na āpyam mā na indra parā vṛṇak ||
children.translated_text: You are our aid, you indeed are our kin; do not turn away from us, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: asme indra sacā sute ni ṣadā pītaye madhu
children.translated_text: With us, O <s>Indra</s>, sit down beside the pressed Soma, to drink the sweetness.

children.text: kṛdhī jaritre maghavann avo mahad asme indra sacā sute ||
children.translated_text: Make great protection for the singer, O bountiful one; with us, O <s>Indra</s>, beside the pressed Soma.

children.text: na tvā devāsa āśata na martyāso adrivaḥ
children.translated_text: The gods have not reached you, nor mortal men, O stone-wielder.

children.text: viśvā jātāni śavasābhibhūr asi na tvā devāsa āśata ||
children.translated_text: By your might you overpower all born beings; the gods have not reached you.

children.text: viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhūtaraṃ naraṃ sajūs tatakṣur indraṃ jajanuś ca rājase
children.translated_text: All battles, joined together, fashioned and generated <s>Indra</s>, the man most overpowering, for kingship.

children.text: kratvā variṣṭhaṃ vara āmurim utogram ojiṣṭhaṃ tavasaṃ tarasvinam ||
children.translated_text: They made him greatest in resolve, chosen, assailing, fierce, strongest, mighty, and impetuous.

children.text: sam īṃ rebhāso asvarann indraṃ somasya pītaye
children.translated_text: Together the praisers have sounded for <s>Indra</s>, for the drinking of Soma.

children.text: svarpatiṃ yad īṃ vṛdhe dhṛtavrato hy ojasā sam ūtibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: When they strengthen the lord of light, firm in vow, he is mighty with vigor and with aids.

children.text: nemiṃ namanti cakṣasā meṣaṃ viprā abhisvarā
children.translated_text: The inspired poets bow with their sight to him like to a felly, to the ram, singing around him.

children.text: sudītayo vo adruho 'pi karṇe tarasvinaḥ sam ṛkvabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Your well-kindled, unharming, swift praises are at his ear, together with the verses.

children.text: tam indraṃ johavīmi maghavānam ugraṃ satrā dadhānam apratiṣkutaṃ śavāṃsi
children.translated_text: I call upon that <s>Indra</s>, bountiful and fierce, truly bearing irresistible powers.

children.text: maṃhiṣṭho gīrbhir ā ca yajñiyo vavartad rāye no viśvā supathā kṛṇotu vajrī ||
children.translated_text: Most generous, worshipful with songs, may the thunderbolt-wielder turn toward our wealth and make all paths easy for us.

children.text: tvam pura indra cikid enā vy ojasā śaviṣṭha śakra nāśayadhyai
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, have perceived the strongholds; by this force, most mighty <s>Śakra</s>, you are able to destroy them.

children.text: tvad viśvāni bhuvanāni vajrin dyāvā rejete pṛthivī ca bhīṣā ||
children.translated_text: At you, O thunderbolt-wielder, all beings, heaven and earth, tremble in fear.

children.text: tan ma ṛtam indra śūra citra pātv apo na vajrin duritāti parṣi bhūri
children.translated_text: May that truth protect me, O <s>Indra</s>, wondrous hero; like waters, O thunderbolt-wielder, carry me across many hardships.

children.text: kadā na indra rāya ā daśasyer viśvapsnyasya spṛhayāyyasya rājan ||
children.translated_text: When, O king <s>Indra</s>, will you grant us wealth, desirable and possessing all treasures?

children.text: Chapter 718
indrāya sāma gāyata viprāya bṛhate bṛhat
children.translated_text: Sing the Sāman to <s>Indra</s>, the great chant to the great inspired one,

children.text: dharmakṛte vipaścite panasyave ||
children.translated_text: to the maker of <s>dharma</s> (order), the discerning one, the one to be praised.

children.text: tvam indrābhibhūr asi tvaṃ sūryam arocayaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, are the overcomer; you made the sun shine.

children.text: viśvakarmā viśvadevo mahāṁ asi ||
children.translated_text: All-making, god of all, you are great.

children.text: vibhrājañ jyotiṣā svar agaccho rocanaṃ divaḥ
children.translated_text: Shining with light, you reached the bright heavenly world.

children.text: devās ta indra sakhyāya yemire ||
children.translated_text: The gods held themselves ready for your friendship, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: endra no gadhi priyaḥ satrājid agohyaḥ
children.translated_text: Come to us, O <s>Indra</s>, dear, truly victorious, not to be hidden,

children.text: girir na viśvatas pṛthuḥ patir divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: broad on every side like a mountain, lord of heaven.

children.text: abhi hi satya somapā ubhe babhūtha rodasī
children.translated_text: For truly, O truthful Soma-drinker, you have become both worlds.

children.text: indrāsi sunvato vṛdhaḥ patir divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You are <s>Indra</s>, the increaser of the Soma-presser, lord of heaven.

children.text: tvaṃ hi śaśvatīnām indra dartā purām asi
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Indra</s>, have always been the splitter of strongholds,

children.text: hantā dasyor manor vṛdhaḥ patir divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the slayer of the <s>Dasyu</s>, the increaser of <s>Manu</s>, lord of heaven.

children.text: adhā hīndra girvaṇa upa tvā kāmān mahaḥ sasṛjmahe
children.translated_text: Therefore, O song-loving <s>Indra</s>, we have released great desires toward you,

children.text: udeva yanta udabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: like waters rising upward.

children.text: vār ṇa tvā yavyābhir vardhanti śūra brahmāṇi
children.translated_text: The hymns, O hero, increase you with youthful streams, as waters do,

children.text: vāvṛdhvāṃsaṃ cid adrivo dive dive ||
children.translated_text: you who have grown great, O stone-wielder, day by day for heaven.

children.text: yuñjanti harī iṣirasya gāthayorau ratha uruyuge
children.translated_text: They yoke the two bay horses of the impetuous one to the wide-yoked chariot of the chants,

children.text: indravāhā vacoyujā ||
children.translated_text: bearers of <s>Indra</s>, yoked by speech.

children.text: tvaṃ na indrā bharaṃ ojo nṛmṇaṃ śatakrato vicarṣaṇe
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, bring us strength and manly power, O hundred-powered, all-observing one,

children.text: ā vīram pṛtanāṣaham ||
children.translated_text: and a hero who conquers battles.

children.text: tvaṃ hi naḥ pitā vaso tvam mātā śatakrato babhūvitha
children.translated_text: For you, O good one, have become our father; you, O hundred-powered one, our mother.

children.text: adhā te sumnam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: Therefore we seek your favor.

children.text: tvāṃ śuṣmin puruhūta vājayantam upa bruve śatakrato
children.translated_text: I address you, powerful, much-invoked, striving for the prize, O hundred-powered one.

children.text: sa no rāsva suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: Grant us excellent heroic strength.

children.text: Chapter 719
tvām idā hyo naro 'pīpyan vajrin bhūrṇayaḥ
children.translated_text: You indeed now, O thunderbolt-wielder, men have swollen with praise, the active ones.

children.text: sa indra stomavāhasām iha śrudhy upa svasaram ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, bearer of hymns, listen here; come to your own dwelling.

children.text: matsvā suśipra harivas tad īmahe tve ā bhūṣanti vedhasaḥ
children.translated_text: Be exhilarated, fair-lipped, bay-horsed one; this we ask, and the inspired ones adorn themselves in you.

children.text: tava śravāṃsy upamāny ukthyā suteṣv indra girvaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Your renowned deeds, worthy of comparison and praise, are among the pressed Somas, O song-loving <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: śrāyanta iva sūryaṃ viśved indrasya bhakṣata
children.translated_text: As all lean upon the sun, so all partake of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: vasūni jāte janamāna ojasā prati bhāgaṃ na dīdhima ||
children.translated_text: Born and being born with strength, may we shine toward the portions like wealth.

children.text: anarśarātiṃ vasudām upa stuhi bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ
children.translated_text: Praise the one whose gifts do not fail, the giver of wealth; auspicious are <s>Indra</s>'s gifts.

children.text: so asya kāmaṃ vidhato na roṣati mano dānāya codayan ||
children.translated_text: He is not angry with the one who fulfils his desire, urging his mind toward giving.

children.text: tvam indra pratūrtiṣv abhi viśvā asi spṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, in onrushes overcome all rivalries.

children.text: aśastihā janitā viśvatūr asi tvaṃ tūrya taruṣyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Slayer of ill speech, progenitor, conqueror of all, you overcome those who would overcome.

children.text: anu te śuṣmaṃ turayantam īyatuḥ kṣoṇī śiśuṃ na mātarā
children.translated_text: The two earths have followed your force rushing onward, like two mothers a child.

children.text: viśvās te spṛdhaḥ śnathayanta manyave vṛtraṃ yad indra tūrvasi ||
children.translated_text: All your rivals are shattered by your wrath when, O <s>Indra</s>, you overpower <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: ita ūtī vo ajaram prahetāram aprahitam
children.translated_text: From here, for aid, we call the ageless sender, not sent by another,

children.text: āśuṃ jetāraṃ hetāraṃ rathītamam atūrtaṃ tugryāvṛdham ||
children.translated_text: swift, victorious, the striker, best charioteer, unconquered, helper of <s>Tugrya</s>,

children.text: iṣkartāram aniṣkṛtaṃ sahaskṛtaṃ śatamūtiṃ śatakratum
children.translated_text: the accomplisher of the unaccomplished, made strong by force, of a hundred aids and a hundred powers;

children.text: samānam indram avase havāmahe vasavānaṃ vasūjuvam ||
children.translated_text: we call the same <s>Indra</s> for help, possessing wealth and impelling riches.

children.text: Chapter 720
ayaṃ ta emi tanvā purastād viśve devā abhi mā yanti paścāt
children.translated_text: I come to you with my body before you; all the gods go behind me.

children.text: yadā mahyaṃ dīdharo bhāgam indrād in mayā kṛṇavo vīryāṇi ||
children.translated_text: When you allot a share to me from <s>Indra</s>, you will perform heroic deeds with me.

children.text: dadhāmi te madhuno bhakṣam agre hitas te bhāgaḥ suto astu somaḥ
children.translated_text: I place before you the first portion of sweetness; let the pressed Soma be your assigned share.

children.text: asaś ca tvaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ sakhā me 'dhā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanāva bhūri ||
children.translated_text: And you shall be at my right hand, my friend; then we two shall strike down many <s>Vṛtras</s>.

children.text: pra su stomam bharata vājayanta indrāya satyaṃ yadi satyam asti
children.translated_text: Bring forth the excellent hymn, seeking the prize, for <s>Indra</s>, the true one, if truth there is.

children.text: nendro astīti nema u tva āha ka īṃ dadarśa kam abhi ṣṭavāma ||
children.translated_text: <s>Nema</s> says of you, 'There is no <s>Indra</s>'; who has seen him? Whom shall we praise?

children.text: ayam asmi jaritaḥ paśya meha viśvā jātāny abhy asmi mahnā
children.translated_text: Here I am, O singer; look at me here. By greatness I surpass all born beings.

children.text: ṛtasya mā pradiśo vardhayanty ādardiro bhuvanā dardarīmi ||
children.translated_text: The directions of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) make me grow; I have split open the worlds, I rend them apart.

children.text: ā yan mā venā aruhann ṛtasyaṃ ekam āsīnaṃ haryatasya pṛṣṭhe
children.translated_text: When the eager ones mounted up to <s>ṛta</s>, to the one seated on the back of the tawny one,

children.text: manaś cin me hṛda ā praty avocad acikradañ chiśumantaḥ sakhāyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: even my mind spoke back from my heart; the friends, bearing children, cried out.

children.text: viśvet tā te savaneṣu pravācyā yā cakartha maghavann indra sunvate
children.translated_text: All those deeds of yours are to be proclaimed at the pressings, the deeds you have done, O bountiful <s>Indra</s>, for the Soma-presser.

children.text: pārāvataṃ yat purusaṃbhṛtaṃ vasv apāvṛṇoḥ śarabhāya ṛṣibandhave ||
children.translated_text: You opened the distant wealth, gathered by many, for <s>Śarabha</s>, the kinsman of seers.

children.text: pra nūnaṃ dhāvatā pṛthaṅ neha yo vo avāvarīt
children.translated_text: Run forth now, separately; here there is no one who has held you back.

children.text: ni ṣīṃ vṛtrasya marmaṇi vajram indro apīpatat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> drove the thunderbolt down upon the vital spot of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: manojavā ayamāna āyasīm atarat puram
children.translated_text: Moving with the speed of thought, he crossed the iron fort.

children.text: divaṃ suparṇo gatvāya somaṃ vajriṇa ābharat ||
children.translated_text: The well-winged one went to heaven and brought Soma for the thunderbolt-wielder.

children.text: samudre antaḥ śayata udnā vajro abhīvṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: The thunderbolt lies within the ocean, covered over by water.

children.text: bharanty asmai saṃyataḥ puraḥprasravaṇā balim ||
children.translated_text: The streams, held together and flowing forward, bring tribute to him.

children.text: yad vāg vadanty avicetanāni rāṣṭrī devānāṃ niṣasāda mandrā
children.translated_text: When speech, queen of the gods, speaking among uncomprehending beings, sat down as the delightful one,

children.text: catasra ūrjaṃ duduhe payāṃsi kva svid asyāḥ paramaṃ jagāma ||
children.translated_text: she milked four nourishments, the streams of milk; where indeed has her highest form gone?

children.text: devīṃ vācam ajanayanta devās tāṃ viśvarūpāḥ paśavo vadanti
children.translated_text: The gods brought forth the goddess <s>Vāc</s>; animals of every form speak her.

children.text: sā no mandreṣam ūrjaṃ duhānā dhenur vāg asmān upa suṣṭutaitu ||
children.translated_text: May that milch-cow Speech, milking delightful nourishment for us, come near us with excellent praise.

children.text: sakhe viṣṇo vitaraṃ vi kramasva dyaur dehi lokaṃ vajrāya viṣkabhe
children.translated_text: Friend <s>Viṣṇu</s>, stride more widely; grant heaven as a space for the thunderbolt to be braced.

children.text: hanāva vṛtraṃ riṇacāva sindhūn indrasya yantu prasave visṛṣṭāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let us slay <s>Vṛtra</s> and release the rivers; let them go, sent forth at <s>Indra</s>'s impulse.

children.text: Chapter 721
ṛdhag itthā sa martyaḥ śaśame devatātaye
children.translated_text: That mortal has exerted himself in just this distinct way for service to the gods,

children.text: yo nūnam mitrāvaruṇāv abhiṣṭaya ācakre havyadātaye ||
children.translated_text: who now has arranged oblation-giving for help from <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: varṣiṣṭhakṣatrā urucakṣasā narā rājānā dīrghaśruttamā
children.translated_text: The two kings, men of greatest dominion, far-seeing and most widely famed,

children.text: tā bāhutā na daṃsanā ratharyataḥ sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: those two, not to be harmed in strength, eager for the chariot, are together with the rays of the sun.

children.text: pra yo vām mitrāvaruṇājiro dūto adravat
children.translated_text: The swift messenger who ran forth to you, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>,

children.text: ayaḥśīrṣā maderaghuḥ ||
children.translated_text: was iron-headed and rapid in exhilaration.

children.text: na yaḥ saṃpṛcche na punar havītave na saṃvādāya ramate
children.translated_text: He who does not delight in consultation, nor again in being invoked, nor in converse,

children.text: tasmān no adya samṛter uruṣyatam bāhubhyāṃ na uruṣyatam ||
children.translated_text: from him protect us today in the conflict; protect us with your arms.

children.text: pra mitrāya prāryamṇe sacathyam ṛtāvaso
children.translated_text: For <s>Mitra</s>, for <s>Aryaman</s>, O possessors of <s>ṛta</s>, sing the companionable hymn,

children.text: varūthyaṃ varuṇe chandyaṃ vaca stotraṃ rājasu gāyata ||
children.translated_text: the protective, pleasing word for <s>Varuṇa</s>, the praise-song among kings.

children.text: te hinvire aruṇaṃ jenyaṃ vasv ekam putraṃ tisṝṇām
children.translated_text: They impelled the reddish, victorious one, the single son of the three mothers, toward wealth.

children.text: te dhāmāny amṛtā martyānām adabdhā abhi cakṣate ||
children.translated_text: Those unbetrayed immortals look upon the abodes of mortals.

children.text: ā me vacāṃsy udyatā dyumattamāni kartvā
children.translated_text: My words, raised up and most luminous, are to be set to work.

children.text: ubhā yātaṃ nāsatyā sajoṣasā prati havyāni vītaye ||
children.translated_text: Come, both of you <s>Nāsatyas</s>, in one accord, to enjoy the oblations.

children.text: rātiṃ yad vām arakṣasaṃ havāmahe yuvābhyāṃ vājinīvasū
children.translated_text: When we call upon your unharmed gift, O two possessors of prize-winning wealth,

children.text: prācīṃ hotrām pratirantāv itaṃ narā gṛṇānā jamadagninā ||
children.translated_text: come hither, O men, extending the eastward priestly service, praised by <s>Jamadagni</s>.

children.text: ā no yajñaṃ divispṛśaṃ vāyo yāhi sumanmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: Come to our sacrifice that touches heaven, O <s>Vāyu</s>, with favorable thoughts.

children.text: antaḥ pavitra upari śrīṇāno 'yaṃ śukro ayāmi te ||
children.translated_text: This bright one, being mixed within the filter above, I send to you.

children.text: vety adhvaryuḥ pathibhī rajiṣṭhaiḥ prati havyāni vītaye
children.translated_text: The <s>adhvaryu</s> (ritual officiant) goes by the straightest paths to partake of the oblations.

children.text: adhā niyutva ubhayasya naḥ piba śuciṃ somaṃ gavāśiram ||
children.translated_text: Then, with your teams, drink for us the pure Soma mixed with milk.

children.text: baṇ mahāṁ asi sūrya baﾱ āditya mahāṁ asi
children.translated_text: Indeed you are great, O <s>Sūrya</s>; indeed, O <s>Āditya</s>, you are great.

children.text: mahas te sato mahimā panasyate 'ddhā deva mahāṁ asi ||
children.translated_text: The greatness of you, being great, is praised; truly, O god, you are great.

children.text: baṭ sūrya śravasā mahāṁ asi satrā deva mahāṁ asi
children.translated_text: Indeed, O <s>Sūrya</s>, you are great through fame; altogether, O god, you are great.

children.text: mahnā devānām asuryaḥ purohito vibhu jyotir adābhyam ||
children.translated_text: By greatness, the divine power of the gods, their priest, is a far-shining, unassailable light.

children.text: iyaṃ yā nīcy arkiṇī rūpā rohiṇyā kṛtā
children.translated_text: This low-lying singer, fashioned with the forms of the red one,

children.text: citreva praty adarśy āyaty antar daśasu bāhuṣu ||
children.translated_text: like a bright sight, was seen approaching within the ten arms.

children.text: prajā ha tisro atyāyam īyur ny anyā arkam abhito viviśre
children.translated_text: Three offspring went beyond the courser; another entered all around the chant.

children.text: bṛhaddha tasthau bhuvaneṣv antaḥ pavamāno harita ā viveśa ||
children.translated_text: The great one stood within the worlds; the purifying green one entered in.

children.text: mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ svasādityānām amṛtasya nābhiḥ
children.translated_text: Mother of the <s>Rudras</s>, daughter of the <s>Vasus</s>, sister of the <s>Ādityas</s>, navel of immortality,

children.text: pra nu vocaṃ cikituṣe janāya mā gām anāgām aditiṃ vadhiṣṭa ||
children.translated_text: I now speak to the discerning person: do not kill the guiltless cow, <s>Aditi</s>.

children.text: vacovidaṃ vācam udīrayantīṃ viśvābhir dhībhir upatiṣṭhamānām
children.translated_text: Uttering speech that knows speech, approached with all inspired thoughts,

children.text: devīṃ devebhyaḥ pary eyuṣīṃ gām ā māvṛkta martyo dabhracetāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the cow, the goddess who has gone around to the gods, let no mortal of scant understanding harm her.

children.text: Chapter 722
tvam agne bṛhad vayo dadhāsi deva dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, bestow broad vital power, O god, upon the worshipper.

children.text: kavir gṛhapatir yuvā ||
children.translated_text: You are the poet, the youthful lord of the house.

children.text: sa na īﾱānayā saha devāṁ agne duvasyuvā
children.translated_text: With this praise and together with the gods, O <s>Agni</s>, lover of worship,

children.text: cikid vibhānav ā vaha ||
children.translated_text: knowing one, bring them here, O radiant one.

children.text: tvayā ha svid yujā vayaṃ codiṣṭhena yaviṣṭhya
children.translated_text: With you as our yoked ally, most impelling, O youngest one,

children.text: abhi ṣmo vājasātaye ||
children.translated_text: we press onward toward the winning of prizes.

children.text: aurvabhṛguvac chucim apnavānavad ā huve
children.translated_text: I call, as <s>Aurva</s> and <s>Bhṛgu</s> did, as <s>Apnavāna</s> did, the pure

children.text: agniṃ samudravāsasam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, dwelling in the ocean.

children.text: huve vātasvanaṃ kavim parjanyakrandyaṃ sahaḥ
children.translated_text: I call <s>Agni</s>, sounding like wind, the poet, a force roaring like <s>Parjanya</s>,

children.text: agniṃ samudravāsasam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, dwelling in the ocean.

children.text: ā savaṃ savitur yathā bhagasyeva bhujiṃ huve
children.translated_text: As at the pressing of <s>Savitṛ</s>, as for the enjoyment of <s>Bhaga</s>, I call

children.text: agniṃ samudravāsasam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, dwelling in the ocean.

children.text: agniṃ vo vṛdhantam adhvarāṇām purūtamam
children.translated_text: For you I approach <s>Agni</s>, growing through the rites and most abundant,

children.text: acchā naptre sahasvate ||
children.translated_text: the mighty grandson, rich in strength.

children.text: ayaṃ yathā na ābhuvat tvaṣṭā rūpeva takṣyā
children.translated_text: As this <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> was for us, like one shaping forms,

children.text: asya kratvā yaśasvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: so is the will of this glorious one.

children.text: ayaṃ viśvā abhi śriyo 'gnir deveṣu patyate
children.translated_text: This <s>Agni</s> rules over all splendors among the gods.

children.text: ā vājair upa no gamat ||
children.translated_text: May he come near us with prizes.

children.text: viśveṣām iha stuhi hotṝṇāṃ yaśastamam
children.translated_text: Praise here the most famous of all hotṛ-priests,

children.text: agniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, the ancient one in sacrifices.

children.text: śīram pāvakaśociṣaṃ jyeṣṭho yo dameṣv ā
children.translated_text: The active one with purifying flame, the eldest, who in homes

children.text: dīdāya dīrghaśruttamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: has shone, most widely famed.

children.text: tam arvantaṃ na sānasiṃ gṛṇīhi vipra śuṣmiṇam
children.translated_text: Sing of him, like a coursing horse to be won, O inspired one, powerful,

children.text: mitraṃ na yātayajjanam ||
children.translated_text: like <s>Mitra</s>, guiding the people.

children.text: upa tvā jāmayo giro dediśatīr haviṣkṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: The kindred songs, preparing oblation, direct themselves toward you.

children.text: vāyor anīke asthiran ||
children.translated_text: They have taken their stand in the face of <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: yasya tridhātv avṛtam barhis tasthāv asaṃdinam
children.translated_text: He whose threefold-covered sacrificial grass stood unbroken,

children.text: āpaś cin ni dadhā padam ||
children.translated_text: even the waters have set down their foot.

children.text: padaṃ devasya mīﾱhuṣo 'nādhṛṣṭābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: The station of the bounteous god, with inviolable aids,

children.text: bhadrā sūrya ivopadṛk ||
children.translated_text: is auspicious to behold, like the sun.

children.text: agne ghṛtasya dhītibhis tepāno deva śociṣā
children.translated_text: O god <s>Agni</s>, blazing with the thoughts of ghee, with your flame,

children.text: ā devān vakṣi yakṣi ca ||
children.translated_text: bring the gods here, and worship them.

children.text: taṃ tvājananta mātaraḥ kaviṃ devāso aṅgiraḥ
children.translated_text: The mothers generated you, the poet; the gods made you, O <s>Aṅgiras</s>,

children.text: havyavāham amartyam ||
children.translated_text: the immortal bearer of oblations.

children.text: pracetasaṃ tvā kave 'gne dūtaṃ vareṇyam
children.translated_text: You, O seer, O <s>Agni</s>, the discerning one, the chosen messenger,

children.text: havyavāhaṃ ni ṣedire ||
children.translated_text: they seated as bearer of oblations.

children.text: nahi me asty aghnyā na svadhitir vananvati
children.translated_text: For I have no uninjured cow, nor an axe that wins wood;

children.text: athaitādṛg bharāmi te ||
children.translated_text: therefore I bring you what is of this sort.

children.text: yad agne kāni kāni cid ā te dārūṇi dadhmasi
children.translated_text: Whatever pieces of wood, O <s>Agni</s>, we lay down for you,

children.text: tā juṣasva yaviṣṭhya ||
children.translated_text: accept them, O youngest one.

children.text: yad atty upajihvikā yad vamro atisarpati
children.translated_text: What the little tongue eats, what the ant creeps over,

children.text: sarvaṃ tad astu te ghṛtam ||
children.translated_text: let all that be ghee for you.

children.text: agnim indhāno manasā dhiyaṃ saceta martyaḥ
children.translated_text: The mortal who kindles <s>Agni</s> with his mind should join inspired thought;

children.text: agnim īdhe vivasvabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: I praise <s>Agni</s> with shining powers.

children.text: Chapter 723
adarśi gātuvittamo yasmin vratāny ādadhuḥ
children.translated_text: He has appeared, best finder of the path, in whom they placed the sacred ordinances;

children.text: upo ṣu jātam āryasya vardhanam agniṃ nakṣanta no giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: let our songs now approach newborn <s>Agni</s>, the increaser of the noble one.

children.text: pra daivodāso agnir devāṁ acchā na majmanā
children.translated_text: The <s>Agni</s> of <s>Divodāsa</s>, with greatness, advanced toward the gods;

children.text: anu mātaram pṛthivīṃ vi vāvṛte tasthau nākasya sānavi ||
children.translated_text: following mother earth he spread himself out; he stood on the summit of heaven.

children.text: yasmād rejanta kṛṣṭayaś carkṛtyāni kṛṇvataḥ
children.translated_text: From him the peoples tremble as he performs his deeds;

children.text: sahasrasām medhasātāv iva tmanāgniṃ dhībhiḥ saparyata ||
children.translated_text: as at an offering that wins a thousand, serve <s>Agni</s> with inspired thoughts.

children.text: pra yaṃ rāye ninīṣasi marto yas te vaso dāśat
children.translated_text: The mortal whom you lead onward to wealth, O good one, who serves you,

children.text: sa vīraṃ dhatte agna ukthaśaṃsinaṃ tmanā sahasrapoṣiṇam ||
children.translated_text: he, O <s>Agni</s>, obtains a heroic son praised in hymns, nourishing a thousand by himself.

children.text: sa dṛﾱhe cid abhi tṛṇatti vājam arvatā sa dhatte akṣiti śravaḥ
children.translated_text: He breaks through even what is firm; by the steed he wins prize and imperishable fame.

children.text: tve devatrā sadā purūvaso viśvā vāmāni dhīmahi ||
children.translated_text: In you, ever among the gods, O rich in many goods, we hold all lovely things in thought.

children.text: yo viśvā dayate vasu hotā mandro janānām
children.translated_text: He who distributes every good, the joyful <s>hotar</s> (sacrificial priest) of men:

children.text: madhor na pātrā prathamāny asmai pra stomā yanty agnaye ||
children.translated_text: to him, to <s>Agni</s>, the first hymns go forth like vessels of honey.

children.text: aśvaṃ na gīrbhī rathyaṃ sudānavo marmṛjyante devayavaḥ
children.translated_text: Like a chariot-horse, the generous god-seekers groom him with songs;

children.text: ubhe toke tanaye dasma viśpate parṣi rādho maghonām ||
children.translated_text: in both child and descendant, O wondrous lord of the people, carry across the bounty of the generous.

children.text: pra maṃhiṣṭhāya gāyata ṛtāvne bṛhate śukraśociṣe
children.translated_text: Sing forth to the most bountiful, to the great keeper of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), to the one of bright flame,

children.text: upastutāso agnaye ||
children.translated_text: to <s>Agni</s>, you who have offered praise.

children.text: ā vaṃsate maghavā vīravad yaśaḥ samiddho dyumny āhutaḥ
children.translated_text: May the bounteous one, kindled, radiant, invoked, win fame with heroes;

children.text: kuvin no asya sumatir navīyasy acchā vājebhir āgamat ||
children.translated_text: may his newer good will come toward us with prizes.

children.text: preṣṭham u priyāṇāṃ stuhy āsāvātithim
children.translated_text: Praise him as the dearest of dear guests in the house,

children.text: agniṃ rathānāṃ yamam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, the restrainer and guide of chariots.

children.text: uditā yo niditā veditā vasv ā yajñiyo vavartati
children.translated_text: He who, as the offered and accepted knower of wealth, turns toward the sacrifice,

children.text: duṣṭarā yasya pravaṇe normayo dhiyā vājaṃ siṣāsataḥ ||
children.translated_text: whose streams on the slope are hard to cross for the one who, by thought, seeks the prize.

children.text: mā no hṛṇītām atithir vasur agniḥ purupraśasta eṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Let not <s>Agni</s>, the guest, the good one, this one of many praises, be angry with us,

children.text: yaḥ suhotā svadhvaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: he who is the good <s>hotar</s> and performs the rite well.

children.text: mo te riṣan ye acchoktibhir vaso 'gne kebhiścid evaiḥ
children.translated_text: Let those who, with well-directed praises, O good <s>Agni</s>, approach you by any aids not come to harm;

children.text: kīriś ciddhi tvām īṭṭe dūtyāya rātahavyaḥ svadhvaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: for even a singer praises you for messenger-service, one to whom offerings are given, performer of the rite well.

children.text: āgne yāhi marutsakhā rudrebhiḥ somapītaye
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, come with the <s>Maruts</s> as your companions, with the <s>Rudras</s>, to drink the Soma;

children.text: sobharyā upa suṣṭutim mādayasva svarṇare ||
children.translated_text: rejoice in <s>Sobhari</s>'s fair praise, O you who shines with light.

children.text: Chapter 724
svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayā pavasva soma dhārayā
children.translated_text: With your sweetest, most intoxicating stream, purify yourself, O <s>Soma</s>,

children.text: indrāya pātave sutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: pressed for <s>Indra</s> to drink.

children.text: rakṣohā viśvacarṣaṇir abhi yonim ayohatam
children.translated_text: Slayer of demons, all-seeing among people, toward the iron-fastened womb,

children.text: druṇā sadhastham āsadat ||
children.translated_text: he has sat down in the wooden communal vessel.

children.text: varivodhātamo bhava maṃhiṣṭho vṛtrahantamaḥ
children.translated_text: Be the best giver of wide room, the most bountiful, the greatest slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>;

children.text: parṣi rādho maghonām ||
children.translated_text: carry across the bounty of the generous.

children.text: abhy arṣa mahānāṃ devānāṃ vītim andhasā
children.translated_text: Flow onward with the draught toward the feast of the great gods,

children.text: abhi vājam uta śravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: toward prize and also toward fame.

children.text: tvām acchā carāmasi tad id arthaṃ dive dive
children.translated_text: We go toward you for just that purpose, day by day;

children.text: indo tve na āśasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O drop, our hopes are in you.

children.text: punāti te parisrutaṃ somaṃ sūryasya duhitā
children.translated_text: The daughter of the sun purifies your flowing <s>Soma</s>,

children.text: vāreṇa śaśvatā tanā ||
children.translated_text: with the eternal strainer, with the thread.

children.text: tam īm aṇvīḥ samarya ā gṛbhṇanti yoṣaṇo daśa
children.translated_text: Him, then, the ten subtle maidens together grasp in the contest,

children.text: svasāraḥ pārye divi ||
children.translated_text: the sisters, in the farther heaven.

children.text: tam īṃ hinvanty agruvo dhamanti bākuraṃ dṛtim
children.translated_text: Him the eager ones urge on; they blow upon the skin bag, the bākura,

children.text: tridhātu vāraṇam madhu ||
children.translated_text: the threefold strainer, the honey.

children.text: abhīmam aghnyā uta śrīṇanti dhenavaḥ śiśum
children.translated_text: The harmless cows too, the milch-cows, mix this child,

children.text: somam indrāya pātave ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, for <s>Indra</s> to drink.

children.text: asyed indro madeṣv ā viśvā vṛtrāṇi jighnate
children.translated_text: In his exhilarations <s>Indra</s> smites all obstacles;

children.text: śūro maghā ca maṃhate ||
children.translated_text: the hero also magnifies the gifts.

children.text: Chapter 725
pavasva devavīr ati pavitraṃ soma raṃhyā
children.translated_text: Purify yourself for divine heroes through the filter, O <s>Soma</s>, swiftly;

children.text: indram indo vṛṣā viśa ||
children.translated_text: O drop, as a bull, enter <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: ā vacyasva mahi psaro vṛṣendo dyumnavattamaḥ
children.translated_text: Pour yourself out as a great wave, O bull-like drop, most full of splendor;

children.text: ā yoniṃ dharṇasiḥ sadaḥ ||
children.translated_text: take your seat in the womb, the sustaining seat.

children.text: adhukṣata priyam madhu dhārā sutasya vedhasaḥ
children.translated_text: The streams of the pressed, wise one have milked the dear honey;

children.text: apo vasiṣṭa sukratuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the skillful one, O <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, has clothed himself in the waters.

children.text: mahāntaṃ tvā mahīr anv āpo arṣanti sindhavaḥ
children.translated_text: The great waters, the rivers, flow after you, the great one,

children.text: yad gobhir vāsayiṣyase ||
children.translated_text: when you will be clothed with the cows.

children.text: samudro apsu māmṛje viṣṭambho dharuṇo divaḥ
children.translated_text: The ocean has cleansed himself in the waters, the support and foundation of heaven;

children.text: somaḥ pavitre asmayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, longing for us, is in the filter.

children.text: acikradad vṛṣā harir mahān mitro na darśataḥ
children.translated_text: The tawny bull has cried out, great, visible like <s>Mitra</s>;

children.text: saṃ sūryeṇa rocate ||
children.translated_text: he shines together with the sun.

children.text: giras ta inda ojasā marmṛjyante apasyuvaḥ
children.translated_text: Your songs, O drop, are rubbed bright with power by those eager to work,

children.text: yābhir madāya śumbhase ||
children.translated_text: with which you adorn yourself for exhilaration.

children.text: taṃ tvā madāya ghṛṣvaya u lokakṛtnum īmahe
children.translated_text: We seek you for exhilaration, impetuous one, maker of the world,

children.text: tava praśastayo mahīḥ ||
children.translated_text: your praises are great.

children.text: asmabhyam indav indrayur madhvaḥ pavasva dhārayā
children.translated_text: For us, O drop, desiring <s>Indra</s>, purify yourself with a stream of honey,

children.text: parjanyo vṛṣṭimāṁ iva ||
children.translated_text: like <s>Parjanya</s> rich in rain.

children.text: goṣā indo nṛṣā asy aśvasā vājasā uta
children.translated_text: You are cow-winning, O drop, man-winning, horse-winning, and prize-winning,

children.text: ātmā yajñasya pūrvyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the ancient soul of the sacrifice.

children.text: Chapter 726
eṣa devo amartyaḥ parṇavīr iva dīyati
children.translated_text: This immortal god flies like one with wings,

children.text: abhi droṇāny āsadam ||
children.translated_text: toward the wooden vats, to sit down.

children.text: eṣa devo vipā kṛto 'ti hvarāṃsi dhāvati
children.translated_text: This god, made by inspired skill, runs past the crooked places,

children.text: pavamāno adābhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: purifying himself, not to be deceived.

children.text: eṣa devo vipanyubhiḥ pavamāna ṛtāyubhiḥ
children.translated_text: This god, purifying himself with inspired, truth-seeking men,

children.text: harir vājāya mṛjyate ||
children.translated_text: the tawny one, is cleansed for the prize.

children.text: eṣa viśvāni vāryā śūro yann iva satvabhiḥ
children.translated_text: This purifying hero seeks all desirable things,

children.text: pavamānaḥ siṣāsati ||
children.translated_text: as if going with his strong companions.

children.text: eṣa devo ratharyati pavamāno daśasyati
children.translated_text: This god, purifying himself, longs for the chariot and shows favor;

children.text: āviṣkṛṇoti vagvanum ||
children.translated_text: he makes manifest the one who speaks aloud.

children.text: eṣa viprair abhiṣṭuto 'po devo vi gāhate
children.translated_text: This god, praised by inspired priests, plunges through the waters,

children.text: dadhad ratnāni dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: bestowing treasures on the worshipper.

children.text: eṣa divaṃ vi dhāvati tiro rajāṃsi dhārayā
children.translated_text: This one rushes across heaven, through the realms, with his stream,

children.text: pavamānaḥ kanikradat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pavamāna</s>, roaring aloud.

children.text: eṣa divaṃ vy āsarat tiro rajāṃsy aspṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: This one has spread through heaven, through the realms, untouched,

children.text: pavamānaḥ svadhvaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pavamāna</s>, with good sacrificial work.

children.text: eṣa pratnena janmanā devo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ
children.translated_text: This god, pressed for the gods by his ancient birth,

children.text: hariḥ pavitre arṣati ||
children.translated_text: the tawny one, flows through the filter.

children.text: eṣa u sya puruvrato jajñāno janayann iṣaḥ
children.translated_text: This one indeed, of many vows, born and generating refreshment,

children.text: dhārayā pavate sutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: pressed, purifies himself with his stream.

children.text: Chapter 727
sanā ca soma jeṣi ca pavamāna mahi śravaḥ
children.translated_text: From of old, O <s>Soma</s>, you conquer; win also, O <s>Pavamāna</s>, great renown;

children.text: athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: then make us more prosperous.

children.text: sanā jyotiḥ sanā svar viśvā ca soma saubhagā
children.translated_text: Win ancient light, win the ancient sun-world, and all good fortune, O <s>Soma</s>;

children.text: athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: then make us more prosperous.

children.text: sanā dakṣam uta kratum apa soma mṛdho jahi
children.translated_text: Win skill and resolve; drive hostilities away, O <s>Soma</s>;

children.text: athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: then make us more prosperous.

children.text: pavītāraḥ punītana somam indrāya pātave
children.translated_text: O purifiers, purify <s>Soma</s> for <s>Indra</s> to drink;

children.text: athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: then make us more prosperous.

children.text: tvaṃ sūrye na ā bhaja tava kratvā tavotibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Allot us a share in the sun through your resolve and through your aids;

children.text: athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: then make us more prosperous.

children.text: tava kratvā tavotibhir jyok paśyema sūryam
children.translated_text: Through your resolve, through your aids, may we behold the sun for a long time;

children.text: athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: then make us more prosperous.

children.text: abhy arṣa svāyudha soma dvibarhasaṃ rayim
children.translated_text: Flow toward us, well-armed <s>Soma</s>, with wealth of double greatness;

children.text: athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: then make us more prosperous.

children.text: abhy arṣānapacyuto rayiṃ samatsu sāsahiḥ
children.translated_text: Flow toward unfailing wealth, a conqueror in battles;

children.text: athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: then make us more prosperous.

children.text: tvāṃ yajñair avīvṛdhan pavamāna vidharmaṇi
children.translated_text: They have strengthened you with sacrifices, O <s>Pavamāna</s>, at the sacred station;

children.text: athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: then make us more prosperous.

children.text: rayiṃ naś citram aśvinam indo viśvāyum ā bhara
children.translated_text: Bring us, O drop, bright wealth with horses, wealth giving life to all;

children.text: athā no vasyasas kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: then make us more prosperous.

children.text: Chapter 728
samiddho viśvatas patiḥ pavamāno vi rājati
children.translated_text: Kindled, the lord on every side, <s>Pavamāna</s> shines forth,

children.text: prīṇan vṛṣā kanikradat ||
children.translated_text: gladdening, a bull, roaring aloud.

children.text: tanūnapāt pavamānaḥ śṛṅge śiśāno arṣati
children.translated_text: <s>Tanūnapāt</s>, as <s>Pavamāna</s>, flows on, whetting himself on the horn,

children.text: antarikṣeṇa rārajat ||
children.translated_text: shining through the midspace.

children.text: īﾱenyaḥ pavamāno rayir vi rājati dyumān
children.translated_text: Praiseworthy <s>Pavamāna</s>, wealth itself, shines forth, radiant,

children.text: madhor dhārābhir ojasā ||
children.translated_text: with the streams of sweetness, with might.

children.text: barhiḥ prācīnam ojasā pavamāna stṛṇan hariḥ
children.translated_text: Strewing the eastward sacrificial grass with might, O <s>Pavamāna</s>, the tawny one,

children.text: deveṣu deva īyate ||
children.translated_text: as a god he goes among the gods.

children.text: ud ātair jihate bṛhad dvāro devīr hiraṇyayīḥ
children.translated_text: The great divine golden doors swing open upward,

children.text: pavamānena suṣṭutāḥ ||
children.translated_text: well praised by <s>Pavamāna</s>.

children.text: suśilpe bṛhatī mahī pavamāno vṛṣaṇyati
children.translated_text: The finely fashioned, lofty, great pair <s>Night</s> and <s>Dawn</s>, while <s>Pavamāna</s> shows bull-like vigor,

children.text: naktoṣāsā na darśate ||
children.translated_text: become visible, as if before him.

children.text: ubhā devā nṛcakṣasā hotārā daivyā huve
children.translated_text: I call the two gods, watchers of men, the divine Hotars;

children.text: pavamāna indro vṛṣā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pavamāna</s> is <s>Indra</s>, the bull.

children.text: bhāratī pavamānasya sarasvatīﾱā mahī
children.translated_text: May <s>Bhāratī</s>, <s>Sarasvatī</s>, and <s>Iḷā</s>, great ones of <s>Pavamāna</s>,

children.text: imaṃ no yajñam ā gaman tisro devīḥ supeśasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the three beautiful goddesses, come to this sacrifice of ours.

children.text: tvaṣṭāram agrajāṃ gopām puroyāvānam ā huve
children.translated_text: I call <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, first-born guardian, the one who goes before;

children.text: indur indro vṛṣā hariḥ pavamānaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: the drop is <s>Indra</s>, bull, tawny, <s>Pavamāna</s>, <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: vanaspatim pavamāna madhvā sam aṅgdhi dhārayā
children.translated_text: O <s>Pavamāna</s>, anoint the forest-lord with honey by your stream,

children.text: sahasravalśaṃ haritam bhrājamānaṃ hiraṇyayam ||
children.translated_text: the thousand-branched, green, shining, golden one.

children.text: viśve devāḥ svāhākṛtim pavamānasyā gata
children.translated_text: All gods, come to <s>Pavamāna</s>'s svāhā-call,

children.text: vāyur bṛhaspatiḥ sūryo 'gnir indraḥ sajoṣasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vāyu</s>, <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, <s>Sūrya</s>, <s>Agni</s>, and <s>Indra</s>, in one accord.

children.text: Chapter 729
mandrayā soma dhārayā vṛṣā pavasva devayuḥ
children.translated_text: With an exhilarating stream, O <s>Soma</s>, flow, a bull, longing for the gods,

children.text: avyo vāreṣv asmayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: desiring us upon the sheep's-wool filters.

children.text: abhi tyam madyam madam indav indra iti kṣara
children.translated_text: Flow forth, O drop, toward that intoxicating exhilaration, saying '<s>Indra</s>',

children.text: abhi vājino arvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: toward the prize-winning steeds.

children.text: abhi tyam pūrvyam madaṃ suvāno arṣa pavitra ā
children.translated_text: Flow, being pressed, toward that ancient exhilaration, onto the filter,

children.text: abhi vājam uta śravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: toward the prize and toward fame.

children.text: anu drapsāsa indava āpo na pravatāsaran
children.translated_text: The drops, like waters, have run down along the slope,

children.text: punānā indram āśata ||
children.translated_text: purifying themselves, they have reached <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yam atyam iva vājinam mṛjanti yoṣaṇo daśa
children.translated_text: Him, like a prize-winning racehorse, the ten maidens cleanse,

children.text: vane krīﾱantam atyavim ||
children.translated_text: playing in the wood, passing through the sheep's wool.

children.text: taṃ gobhir vṛṣaṇaṃ rasam madāya devavītaye
children.translated_text: Set free that bull, the juice, with the cows, for exhilaration and the gods' feast,

children.text: sutam bharāya saṃ sṛja ||
children.translated_text: the pressed one, for sustaining power.

children.text: devo devāya dhārayendrāya pavate sutaḥ
children.translated_text: The god, for the god, pressed, flows to <s>Indra</s> with his stream,

children.text: payo yad asya pīpayat ||
children.translated_text: when he swells his milk.

children.text: ātmā yajñasya raṃhyā suṣvāṇaḥ pavate sutaḥ
children.translated_text: The soul of sacrifice, well pressed and swift, flows purified;

children.text: pratnaṃ ni pāti kāvyam ||
children.translated_text: he guards the ancient poetic wisdom.

children.text: evā punāna indrayur madam madiṣṭha vītaye
children.translated_text: Thus purifying yourself, desiring <s>Indra</s>, most exhilarating for the feast,

children.text: guhā cid dadhiṣe giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: even in secret you hold the songs.

children.text: Chapter 730
asṛgram indavaḥ pathā dharmann ṛtasya suśriyaḥ
children.translated_text: The drops have been let loose on the path, in the ordinance of truth, beautiful,

children.text: vidānā asya yojanam ||
children.translated_text: knowing his harnessing.

children.text: pra dhārā madhvo agriyo mahīr apo vi gāhate
children.translated_text: The foremost stream of sweetness plunges through the great waters,

children.text: havir haviṣṣu vandyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: an oblation, worthy of praise among oblations.

children.text: pra yujo vāco agriyo vṛṣāva cakradad vane
children.translated_text: The foremost bull has cried out the yoked voices in the wood,

children.text: sadmābhi satyo adhvaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: the true sacrifice, with its seats.

children.text: pari yat kāvyā kavir nṛmṇā vasāno arṣati
children.translated_text: When the sage flows around the poetic works, clothing himself in heroic powers,

children.text: svar vājī siṣāsati ||
children.translated_text: the prize-winning horse seeks the sun-world.

children.text: pavamāno abhi spṛdho viśo rājeva sīdati
children.translated_text: <s>Pavamāna</s> sits among rival peoples like a king,

children.text: yad īm ṛṇvanti vedhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when the inspired craftsmen set him in motion.

children.text: avyo vāre pari priyo harir vaneṣu sīdati
children.translated_text: Around the sheep's wool the beloved tawny one sits in the woods,

children.text: rebho vanuṣyate matī ||
children.translated_text: the roaring one seeks the inspired thought.

children.text: sa vāyum indram aśvinā sākam madena gacchati
children.translated_text: With exhilaration he goes together to <s>Vāyu</s>, <s>Indra</s>, and the <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: raṇā yo asya dharmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: he who is joyful by his ordinances.

children.text: ā mitrāvaruṇā bhagam madhvaḥ pavanta ūrmayaḥ
children.translated_text: The waves of sweetness flow to <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Bhaga</s>,

children.text: vidānā asya śakmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: knowing by his powers.

children.text: asmabhyaṃ rodasī rayim madhvo vājasya sātaye
children.translated_text: For us, O Heaven and Earth, wealth for the winning of the sweet prize,

children.text: śravo vasūni saṃ jitam ||
children.translated_text: fame and treasures gathered together.

children.text: Chapter 731
ete somā abhi priyam indrasya kāmam akṣaran
children.translated_text: These <s>Somas</s> have flowed toward dear <s>Indra</s>'s desire,

children.text: vardhanto asya vīryam ||
children.translated_text: increasing his heroic power.

children.text: punānāsaś camūṣado gacchanto vāyum aśvinā
children.translated_text: Purifying themselves, sitting in the vats, going to <s>Vāyu</s> and the <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: te no dhāntu suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: may they set heroic strength in us.

children.text: indrasya soma rādhase punāno hārdi codaya
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s>'s bounty, O <s>Soma</s>, purifying yourself, stir him in the heart,

children.text: ṛtasya yonim āsadam ||
children.translated_text: to sit at the womb of truth.

children.text: mṛjanti tvā daśa kṣipo hinvanti sapta dhītayaḥ
children.translated_text: The ten fingers cleanse you; the seven insights urge you on;

children.text: anu viprā amādiṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the inspired poets have rejoiced in the exhilarations.

children.text: devebhyas tvā madāya kaṃ sṛjānam ati meṣyaḥ
children.translated_text: For the gods' exhilaration, as you are released over the sheep's wool,

children.text: saṃ gobhir vāsayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: we clothe you together with the cows.

children.text: punānaḥ kalaśeṣv ā vastrāṇy aruṣo hariḥ
children.translated_text: Purifying himself in the beakers, the ruddy tawny one puts on garments,

children.text: pari gavyāny avyata ||
children.translated_text: and has clothed himself all around in the cow-products.

children.text: maghona ā pavasva no jahi viśvā apa dviṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Flow to us for bounty; drive all hatreds away,

children.text: indo sakhāyam ā viśa ||
children.translated_text: O drop, enter your friend.

children.text: vṛṣṭiṃ divaḥ pari srava dyumnam pṛthivyā adhi
children.translated_text: Flow forth with rain from heaven, with splendor from earth;

children.text: saho naḥ soma pṛtsu dhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: place strength in us, O <s>Soma</s>, in battles.

children.text: nṛcakṣasaṃ tvā vayam indrapītaṃ svarvidam
children.translated_text: May we partake of you, watcher of men, drunk by <s>Indra</s>, finder of the sunlight,

children.text: bhakṣīmahi prajām iṣam ||
children.translated_text: for offspring and nourishment.

children.text: Chapter 732
pari priyā divaḥ kavir vayāṃsi naptyor hitaḥ
children.translated_text: Around the beloved stations of heaven the sage, set among the courses of the two daughters,

children.text: suvāno yāti kavikratuḥ ||
children.translated_text: goes onward as he is pressed, with a poet's purpose.

children.text: pra pra kṣayāya panyase janāya juṣṭo adruhe
children.translated_text: Forward, forward you are praised for dwelling, pleasing to the guileless people;

children.text: vīty arṣa caniṣṭhayā ||
children.translated_text: flow on for the feast with your most welcome aid.

children.text: sa sūnur mātarā śucir jāto jāte arocayat
children.translated_text: That pure son, born, at his birth made his two mothers shine,

children.text: mahān mahī ṛtāvṛdhā ||
children.translated_text: the great ones, mighty and increasing through <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: sa sapta dhītibhir hito nadyo ajinvad adruhaḥ
children.translated_text: Set in motion by seven inspired thoughts, he urged on the guileless rivers,

children.text: yā ekam akṣi vāvṛdhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: those which have made the single eye grow.
