children.text: tā abhi santam astṛtam mahe yuvānam ā dadhuḥ
children.translated_text: They have brought near to the great one the young, present, unobstructed one,

children.text: indum indra tava vrate ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Indu</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, according to your ordinance.

children.text: abhi vahnir amartyaḥ sapta paśyati vāvahiḥ
children.translated_text: The immortal carrier sees the seven; he who bears onward, <s>Krivi</s>,

children.text: krivir devīr atarpayat ||
children.translated_text: has satisfied the divine ones.

children.text: avā kalpeṣu naḥ pumas tamāṃsi soma yodhyā
children.translated_text: Protect us in the appointed places, O <s>Soma</s>; fight away the darknesses,

children.text: tāni punāna jaṅghanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and, as you purify yourself, beat those darknesses down.

children.text: nū navyase navīyase sūktāya sādhayā pathaḥ
children.translated_text: Now, for the newer, newest hymn, make the paths succeed;

children.text: pratnavad rocayā rucaḥ ||
children.translated_text: as of old, make the lights shine with radiance.

children.text: pavamāna mahi śravo gām aśvaṃ rāsi vīravat
children.translated_text: O purifying one, bestow great fame, a cow, a horse, wealth rich in heroes;

children.text: sanā medhāṃ sanā svaḥ ||
children.translated_text: win ancient insight, win the heavenly light.

children.text: Chapter 733
pra svānāso rathā ivārvanto na śravasyavaḥ
children.translated_text: The sounding <s>Somas</s>, like chariots, like steeds eager for renown,

children.text: somāso rāye akramuḥ ||
children.translated_text: have advanced toward wealth.

children.text: hinvānāso rathā iva dadhanvire gabhastyoḥ
children.translated_text: Driven on like chariots, they have stretched themselves into the hands,

children.text: bharāsaḥ kāriṇām iva ||
children.translated_text: like the burdens of those who perform the rite.

children.text: rājāno na praśastibhiḥ somāso gobhir añjate
children.translated_text: Like kings with praises, the <s>Somas</s> adorn themselves with cows,

children.text: yajño na sapta dhātṛbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: like a sacrifice with its seven establishers.

children.text: pari suvānāsa indavo madāya barhaṇā girā
children.translated_text: The flowing drops, pressed out, stream around with a swelling song for exhilaration,

children.text: sutā arṣanti dhārayā ||
children.translated_text: in a flowing current.

children.text: āpānāso vivasvato jananta uṣaso bhagam
children.translated_text: Drinking from <s>Vivasvat</s>, bringing forth the share of the dawns,

children.text: sūrā aṇvaṃ vi tanvate ||
children.translated_text: the strong ones stretch out the fine thread.

children.text: apa dvārā matīnām pratnā ṛṇvanti kāravaḥ
children.translated_text: The singers open the ancient doors of inspired thoughts,

children.text: vṛṣṇo harasa āyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the active men of the bull's heat.

children.text: samīcīnāsa āsate hotāraḥ saptajāmayaḥ
children.translated_text: Sitting together are the <s>hotṛ</s> priests, seven kinsmen,

children.text: padam ekasya piprataḥ ||
children.translated_text: protecting the station of the single one.

children.text: nābhā nābhiṃ na ā dade cakṣuś cit sūrye sacā
children.translated_text: Navel to navel he has taken his place for us; even the eye is joined with the sun,

children.text: kaver apatyam ā duhe ||
children.translated_text: and he milks the offspring of the sage.

children.text: abhi priyā divas padam adhvaryubhir guhā hitam
children.translated_text: The sun, with his eye, sees the beloved station of heaven,

children.text: sūraḥ paśyati cakṣasā ||
children.translated_text: hidden in secret by the <s>adhvaryu</s> priests.

children.text: Chapter 734
upāsmai gāyatā naraḥ pavamānāyendave
children.translated_text: Sing near to this purifying <s>Indu</s>, O men;

children.text: abhi devāṁ iyakṣate ||
children.translated_text: he seeks to worship the gods.

children.text: abhi te madhunā payo 'tharvāṇo aśiśrayuḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Atharvans</s> have mingled your milk with sweetness,

children.text: devaṃ devāya devayu ||
children.translated_text: loving the god for the god.

children.text: sa naḥ pavasva śaṃ gave śaṃ janāya śam arvate
children.translated_text: Flow for us as blessing for the cow, blessing for the people, blessing for the steed,

children.text: śaṃ rājann oṣadhībhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and blessing, O king, for the plants.

children.text: babhrave nu svatavase 'ruṇāya divispṛśe
children.translated_text: Now sing a chant to tawny <s>Soma</s>, self-strong,

children.text: somāya gātham arcata ||
children.translated_text: ruddy and touching heaven.

children.text: hastacyutebhir adribhiḥ sutaṃ somam punītana
children.translated_text: Purify the pressed <s>Soma</s> with stones released by the hand;

children.text: madhāv ā dhāvatā madhu ||
children.translated_text: run into the honey as honeyed drink.

children.text: namased upa sīdata dadhned abhi śrīṇītana
children.translated_text: Sit near with reverence; mix him with curds;

children.text: indum indre dadhātana ||
children.translated_text: place the <s>Indu</s> in <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: amitrahā vicarṣaṇiḥ pavasva soma śaṃ gave
children.translated_text: Slayer of enemies, discerning among peoples, flow, O <s>Soma</s>, as blessing for the cow,

children.text: devebhyo anukāmakṛt ||
children.translated_text: fulfilling desire for the gods.

children.text: indrāya soma pātave madāya pari ṣicyase
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s> to drink, O <s>Soma</s>, for exhilaration, you are poured all around,

children.text: manaścin manasas patiḥ ||
children.translated_text: lord of mind, even of thought itself.

children.text: pavamāna suvīryaṃ rayiṃ soma rirīhi naḥ
children.translated_text: O purifying <s>Soma</s>, bestow heroic wealth upon us;

children.text: indav indreṇa no yujā ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, do so with <s>Indra</s> as our ally.

children.text: Chapter 735
somā asṛgram indavaḥ sutā ṛtasya sādane
children.translated_text: The <s>Soma</s> drops have streamed forth, pressed in the seat of <s>ṛta</s>,

children.text: indrāya madhumattamāḥ ||
children.translated_text: most sweet for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: abhi viprā anūṣata gāvo vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired singers have chanted toward <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: indraṃ somasya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: like mother cows toward a calf, for the drinking of <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: madacyut kṣeti sādane sindhor ūrmā vipaścit
children.translated_text: The wise <s>Soma</s>, shedding exhilaration, dwells in the seat, on the wave of the river,

children.text: somo gaurī adhi śritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: resting upon the bright one.

children.text: divo nābhā vicakṣaṇo 'vyo vāre mahīyate
children.translated_text: At the navel of heaven, on the sheep's wool filter, he is magnified,

children.text: somo yaḥ sukratuḥ kaviḥ ||
children.translated_text: that <s>Soma</s> of good purpose, the far-seeing sage.

children.text: yaḥ somaḥ kalaśeṣv āṃ antaḥ pavitra āhitaḥ
children.translated_text: That <s>Soma</s> which has been placed within the filter and in the bowls,

children.text: tam induḥ pari ṣasvaje ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Indu</s> has embraced all around.

children.text: pra vācam indur iṣyati samudrasyādhi viṣṭapi
children.translated_text: The <s>Indu</s> sends forth speech from the expanse of the ocean,

children.text: jinvan kośam madhuścutam ||
children.translated_text: quickening the honey-dripping vat.

children.text: nityastotro vanaspatir dhīnām antaḥ sabardughaḥ
children.translated_text: The ever-praised lord of the wood, milk-giving within the inspired thoughts,

children.text: hinvāno mānuṣā yugā ||
children.translated_text: is set in motion through the ages of men.

children.text: abhi priyā divas padā somo hinvāno arṣati
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, being impelled, flows toward the beloved stations of heaven,

children.text: viprasya dhārayā kaviḥ ||
children.translated_text: the sage, through the stream of the inspired priest.

children.text: ā pavamāna dhāraya rayiṃ sahasravarcasam
children.translated_text: Come, O purifying one, with your stream, bringing wealth of a thousand splendors,

children.text: asme indo svābhuvam ||
children.translated_text: to us, O <s>Indu</s>, self-born.

children.text: Chapter 736
somaḥ punāno arṣati sahasradhāro atyaviḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, purifying himself, flows with a thousand streams across the sheep's wool,

children.text: vāyor indrasya niṣkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: to the appointed place of <s>Vāyu</s> and <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: pavamānam avasyavo vipram abhi pra gāyata
children.translated_text: You who seek aid, sing forth to the purifying inspired one,

children.text: suṣvāṇaṃ devavītaye ||
children.translated_text: well pressed for the feast of the gods.

children.text: pavante vājasātaye somāḥ sahasrapājasaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Somas</s>, with thousandfold force, flow for the winning of prize,

children.text: gṛṇānā devavītaye ||
children.translated_text: being praised for the feast of the gods.

children.text: uta no vājasātaye pavasva bṛhatīr iṣaḥ
children.translated_text: And for us, for the winning of prize, flow forth broad nourishments,

children.text: dyumad indo suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, and shining heroic power.

children.text: te naḥ sahasriṇaṃ rayim pavantām ā suvīryam
children.translated_text: May those pressed divine drops flow here to us,

children.text: suvānā devāsa indavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: bringing thousandfold wealth and heroic power.

children.text: atyā hiyānā na hetṛbhir asṛgraṃ vājasātaye
children.translated_text: Sent forth like racing horses by their drivers, the swift ones have streamed for the winning of prize,

children.text: vi vāram avyam āśavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: through the sheep's wool filter.

children.text: vāśrā arṣantīndavo 'bhi vatsaṃ na dhenavaḥ
children.translated_text: The bellowing drops flow like milch cows toward a calf;

children.text: dadhanvire gabhastyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: they have stretched themselves into the hands.

children.text: juṣṭa indrāya matsaraḥ pavamāna kanikradat
children.translated_text: O purifying one, pleasing to <s>Indra</s>, exhilarating and roaring,

children.text: viśvā apa dviṣo jahi ||
children.translated_text: strike away all hatreds.

children.text: apaghnanto arāvṇaḥ pavamānāḥ svardṛśaḥ
children.translated_text: Driving away the ungenerous, O purifying ones, seers of the heavenly light,

children.text: yonāv ṛtasya sīdata ||
children.translated_text: sit in the womb of <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: Chapter 737
pari prāsiṣyadat kaviḥ sindhor ūrmāv adhi śritaḥ
children.translated_text: The sage has flowed around, resting upon the wave of the river,

children.text: kāram bibhrat puruspṛham ||
children.translated_text: bearing a song much desired by many.

children.text: girā yadī sabandhavaḥ pañca vrātā apasyavaḥ
children.translated_text: When, with song, the five kindred bands, eager for work,

children.text: pariṣkṛṇvanti dharṇasim ||
children.translated_text: adorn the supporter,

children.text: ād asya śuṣmiṇo rase viśve devā amatsata
children.translated_text: then in the juice of this mighty one all the gods rejoiced,

children.text: yadī gobhir vasāyate ||
children.translated_text: when he is clothed with cows' milk.

children.text: niriṇāno vi dhāvati jahaccharyāṇi tānvā
children.translated_text: Rushing out, he runs apart, leaving the tawny forms with his body;

children.text: atrā saṃ jighnate yujā ||
children.translated_text: here they join him with his companion.

children.text: naptībhir yo vivasvataḥ śubhro na māmṛje yuvā
children.translated_text: He who, by the daughters of <s>Vivasvat</s>, like a bright youth, has been wiped clean,

children.text: gāḥ kṛṇvāno na nirṇijam ||
children.translated_text: making the cows his adornment,

children.text: ati śritī tiraścatā gavyā jigāty aṇvyā
children.translated_text: passes beyond the resting places, crosswise, along the cow-rich and fine path;

children.text: vagnum iyarti yaṃ vide ||
children.translated_text: he raises the voice for the one who knows.

children.text: abhi kṣipaḥ sam agmata marjayantīr iṣas patim
children.translated_text: The fingers have come together, cleansing the lord of nourishment;

children.text: pṛṣṭhā gṛbhṇata vājinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: they grasp the backs of the vigorous one.

children.text: pari divyāni marmṛśad viśvāni soma pārthivā
children.translated_text: Touching all heavenly things and all earthly things,

children.text: vasūni yāhy asmayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, come to us with the riches, desiring us.

children.text: Chapter 738
eṣa dhiyā yāty aṇvyā śūro rathebhir āśubhiḥ
children.translated_text: This hero goes by subtle insight, with swift chariots,

children.text: gacchann indrasya niṣkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: as he goes to <s>Indra</s>'s own prepared place.

children.text: eṣa purū dhiyāyate bṛhate devatātaye
children.translated_text: This one is contemplated in many ways by thought, for the great divine assembly,

children.text: yatrāmṛtāsa āsate ||
children.translated_text: where the immortals sit.

children.text: eṣa hito vi nīyate 'ntaḥ śubhrāvatā pathā
children.translated_text: This one, set in place, is led apart within by the bright path,

children.text: yadī tuñjanti bhūrṇayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when the swift ones urge him on.

children.text: eṣa śṛṅgāṇi dodhuvacchiśīte yūthyo vṛṣā
children.translated_text: This one shakes his horns and sharpens himself, the bull of the herd,

children.text: nṛmṇā dadhāna ojasā ||
children.translated_text: holding manly powers by his might.

children.text: eṣa rukmibhir īyate vājī śubhrebhir aṃśubhiḥ
children.translated_text: This racer goes with golden ornaments, with bright streaming rays,

children.text: patiḥ sindhūnām bhavan ||
children.translated_text: becoming lord of the rivers.

children.text: eṣa vasūni pibdanā paruṣā yayivāṁ ati
children.translated_text: This tawny one, drinking in the goods and having passed beyond,

children.text: ava śādeṣu gacchati ||
children.translated_text: goes down into the settled places.

children.text: etam mṛjanti marjyam upa droṇeṣv āyavaḥ
children.translated_text: The active men cleanse this one, who is to be cleansed, in the vats,

children.text: pracakrāṇam mahīr iṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: as he sets great nourishments in motion.

children.text: etam u tyaṃ daśa kṣipo mṛjanti sapta dhītayaḥ
children.translated_text: This very one the ten fingers cleanse, and the seven inspired thoughts,

children.text: svāyudham madintamam ||
children.translated_text: with his own weapon, the most intoxicating one.

children.text: Chapter 739
pra te sotāra oṇyo rasam madāya ghṛṣvaye
children.translated_text: For you the pressers send forth the swelling juice for exhilarating intoxication;

children.text: sargo na takty etaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like a released steed, the swift stream runs on.

children.text: kratvā dakṣasya rathyam apo vasānam andhasā
children.translated_text: By will, clothed in the waters and in the draught, as the chariot of skill,

children.text: goṣām aṇveṣu saścima ||
children.translated_text: we attend him among the woolen filters, seeking cows.

children.text: anaptam apsu duṣṭaraṃ somam pavitra ā sṛja
children.translated_text: Set the unattached, hard-to-cross <s>Soma</s> in the waters upon the filter;

children.text: punīhīndrāya pātave ||
children.translated_text: purify him for <s>Indra</s> to drink.

children.text: pra punānasya cetasā somaḥ pavitre arṣati
children.translated_text: With the thought of the one being purified, <s>Soma</s> flows in the filter;

children.text: kratvā sadhastham āsadat ||
children.translated_text: by will he has taken his seat at the assembly.

children.text: pra tvā namobhir indava indra somā asṛkṣata
children.translated_text: Toward you, O drops, the <s>Somas</s> have been released with reverences for <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: mahe bharāya kāriṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the workers, for the great prize.

children.text: punāno rūpe avyaye viśvā arṣann abhi śriyaḥ
children.translated_text: Being purified in an imperishable form, flowing toward all splendors,

children.text: śūro na goṣu tiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: he stands like a hero among the cows.

children.text: divo na sānu pipyuṣī dhārā sutasya vedhasaḥ
children.translated_text: Like a ridge of heaven, the swelling stream of the pressed inspired one

children.text: vṛthā pavitre arṣati ||
children.translated_text: flows freely in the filter.

children.text: tvaṃ soma vipaścitaṃ tanā punāna āyuṣu
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Soma</s>, being purified among living beings for the discerning man,

children.text: avyo vāraṃ vi dhāvasi ||
children.translated_text: run through the sheep's-wool strainer.

children.text: Chapter 740
pra nimneneva sindhavo ghnanto vṛtrāṇi bhūrṇayaḥ
children.translated_text: Like rivers down a slope, striking down obstacles, the swift ones,

children.text: somā asṛgram āśavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the rapid <s>Somas</s>, have been released.

children.text: abhi suvānāsa indavo vṛṣṭayaḥ pṛthivīm iva
children.translated_text: The pressed drops, like rains toward the earth,

children.text: indraṃ somāso akṣaran ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Somas</s> have flowed toward <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: atyūrmir matsaro madaḥ somaḥ pavitre arṣati
children.translated_text: A great wave, exhilarating and intoxicating, <s>Soma</s> flows in the filter,

children.text: vighnan rakṣāṃsi devayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: smashing the demons, desiring the gods.

children.text: ā kalaśeṣu dhāvati pavitre pari ṣicyate
children.translated_text: He runs into the jars; he is poured around through the filter;

children.text: ukthair yajñeṣu vardhate ||
children.translated_text: he is strengthened by hymns in the sacrifices.

children.text: ati trī soma rocanā rohan na bhrājase divam
children.translated_text: Beyond the three luminous realms, O <s>Soma</s>, ascending, you shine up to heaven;

children.text: iṣṇan sūryaṃ na codayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: pressing onward, you impel like the sun.

children.text: abhi viprā anūṣata mūrdhan yajñasya kāravaḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired poets, the makers, have sung toward the head of the sacrifice,

children.text: dadhānāś cakṣasi priyam ||
children.translated_text: placing what is dear in their sight.

children.text: tam u tvā vājinaṃ naro dhībhir viprā avasyavaḥ
children.translated_text: Then you, the prize-winning one, the inspired men seeking help

children.text: mṛjanti devatātaye ||
children.translated_text: cleanse with their thoughts for the divine assembly.

children.text: madhor dhārām anu kṣara tīvraḥ sadhastham āsadaḥ
children.translated_text: Flow along as a stream of sweetness; keen, take your seat at the assembly,

children.text: cārur ṛtāya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: beautiful for <s>ṛta</s> and for drinking.

children.text: Chapter 741
pari suvāno giriṣṭhāḥ pavitre somo akṣāḥ
children.translated_text: Flowing around from the mountain heights, <s>Soma</s>, you have streamed through the filter;

children.text: madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
children.translated_text: in exhilarations you are complete in every way.

children.text: tvaṃ vipras tvaṃ kavir madhu pra jātam andhasaḥ
children.translated_text: You are the inspired priest; you are the poet; you are the sweetness born from the draught;

children.text: madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
children.translated_text: in exhilarations you are complete in every way.

children.text: tava viśve sajoṣaso devāsaḥ pītim āśata
children.translated_text: All the gods, joined in common accord, sought your drinking;

children.text: madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
children.translated_text: in exhilarations you are complete in every way.

children.text: ā yo viśvāni vāryā vasūni hastayor dadhe
children.translated_text: He who has taken all desirable riches and goods in his hands,

children.text: madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
children.translated_text: in exhilarations you are complete in every way.

children.text: ya ime rodasī mahī sam mātareva dohate
children.translated_text: He who milks these two great worlds, heaven and earth, as if they were mothers,

children.text: madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
children.translated_text: in exhilarations you are complete in every way.

children.text: pari yo rodasī ubhe sadyo vājebhir arṣati
children.translated_text: He who flows around both worlds at once with prizes,

children.text: madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
children.translated_text: in exhilarations you are complete in every way.

children.text: sa śuṣmī kalaśeṣv ā punāno acikradat
children.translated_text: That powerful one, being purified, has cried aloud in the jars;

children.text: madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
children.translated_text: in exhilarations you are complete in every way.

children.text: Chapter 742
yat soma citram ukthyaṃ divyam pārthivaṃ vasu
children.translated_text: Whatever splendid, praiseworthy wealth there is, O <s>Soma</s>, heavenly and earthly,

children.text: tan naḥ punāna ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: bring that to us as you are purified.

children.text: yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ svarpatī indraś ca soma gopatī
children.translated_text: For you two are lords of the sun-world, <s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>, lords of cows;

children.text: īśānā pipyataṃ dhiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: ruling, make our thoughts swell.

children.text: vṛṣā punāna āyuṣu stanayann adhi barhiṣi
children.translated_text: The bull, being purified among living beings, thundering upon the sacred grass,

children.text: hariḥ san yonim āsadat ||
children.translated_text: being tawny, has sat in his womb.

children.text: avāvaśanta dhītayo vṛṣabhasyādhi retasi
children.translated_text: The inspired thoughts have bellowed over the bull's seed,

children.text: sūnor vatsasya mātaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: like mothers over the son, the calf.

children.text: kuvid vṛṣaṇyantībhyaḥ punāno garbham ādadhat
children.translated_text: Will he, being purified, place an embryo among the females eager for the bull,

children.text: yāḥ śukraṃ duhate payaḥ ||
children.translated_text: who milk the bright milk?

children.text: upa śikṣāpatasthuṣo bhiyasam ā dhehi śatruṣu
children.translated_text: Come near; set fear among the enemies who stand against us,

children.text: pavamāna vidā rayim ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Pavamāna</s>, and find wealth.

children.text: ni śatroḥ soma vṛṣṇyaṃ ni śuṣmaṃ ni vayas tira
children.translated_text: Lay low, O <s>Soma</s>, the enemy's virility; lay low his force and his vigor,

children.text: dūre vā sato anti vā ||
children.translated_text: whether he is far away or near.

children.text: Chapter 743
pra kavir devavītaye 'vyo vārebhir arṣati
children.translated_text: The seer flows for the feast of the gods through the sheep's-wool strainers,

children.text: sāhvān viśvā abhi spṛdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: overcoming all contests.

children.text: sa hi ṣmā jaritṛbhya ā vājaṃ gomantam invati
children.translated_text: For he, <s>Pavamāna</s>, indeed brings to the singers

children.text: pavamānaḥ sahasriṇam ||
children.translated_text: a prize rich in cattle, rich in thousands.

children.text: pari viśvāni cetasā mṛśase pavase matī
children.translated_text: With your mind you touch all things; you purify yourself with thought;

children.text: sa naḥ soma śravo vidaḥ ||
children.translated_text: so find fame for us, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: abhy arṣa bṛhad yaśo maghavadbhyo dhruvaṃ rayim
children.translated_text: Flow toward great glory and firm wealth for the generous;

children.text: iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: bring nourishment to the praisers.

children.text: tvaṃ rājeva suvrato giraḥ somā viveśitha
children.translated_text: Like a king of good vows, O <s>Soma</s>, you have entered the songs,

children.text: punāno vahne adbhuta ||
children.translated_text: being purified, O wondrous carrier.

children.text: sa vahnir apsu duṣṭaro mṛjyamāno gabhastyoḥ
children.translated_text: That carrier, hard to cross in the waters, being cleansed by the hands,

children.text: somaś camūṣu sīdati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> sits in the bowls.

children.text: krīﾱur makho na maṃhayuḥ pavitraṃ soma gacchasi
children.translated_text: Like a playful, munificent patron, you go to the filter, O <s>Soma</s>,

children.text: dadhat stotre suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: placing heroic strength in the praise.

children.text: Chapter 744
ete dhāvantīndavaḥ somā indrāya ghṛṣvayaḥ
children.translated_text: These drops run, <s>Somas</s> for <s>Indra</s>, exhilarating,

children.text: matsarāsaḥ svarvidaḥ ||
children.translated_text: intoxicating, finders of the sun-world.

children.text: pravṛṇvanto abhiyujaḥ suṣvaye varivovidaḥ
children.translated_text: Opening wide room against attackers, well pressed and finding broad space,

children.text: svayaṃ stotre vayaskṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: they themselves make vigor for the praise.

children.text: vṛthā krīﾱanta indavaḥ sadhastham abhy ekam it
children.translated_text: Playing freely, the drops have flowed toward one common seat,

children.text: sindhor ūrmā vy akṣaran ||
children.translated_text: like waves of the river.

children.text: ete viśvāni vāryā pavamānāsa āśata
children.translated_text: These purifying ones have obtained all desirable things,

children.text: hitā na saptayo rathe ||
children.translated_text: like well-yoked steeds set in a chariot.

children.text: āsmin piśaṅgam indavo dadhātā venam ādiśe
children.translated_text: Set this tawny one among us, O drops, as the longed-for one, for guidance,

children.text: yo asmabhyam arāvā ||
children.translated_text: the one who does not withhold from us.

children.text: ṛbhur na rathyaṃ navaṃ dadhātā ketam ādiśe
children.translated_text: Like an <s>Ṛbhu</s>, set a new chariot in place; set the beacon in place for guidance,

children.text: śukrāḥ pavadhvam arṇasā ||
children.translated_text: O bright ones, purify yourselves with the flood.

children.text: eta u tye avīvaśan kāṣṭhāṃ vājino akrata
children.translated_text: These indeed have hastened forth; the racers have reached the goal,

children.text: sataḥ prāsāviṣur matim ||
children.translated_text: and have impelled the thought of the true.

children.text: Chapter 745
ete somāsa āśavo rathā iva pra vājinaḥ
children.translated_text: These swift <s>Somas</s>, like chariots, like prize-winning steeds,

children.text: sargāḥ sṛṣṭā aheṣata ||
children.translated_text: have neighed when let loose in their outpourings.

children.text: ete vātā ivoravaḥ parjanyasyeva vṛṣṭayaḥ
children.translated_text: These are broad like winds, like the rains of <s>Parjanya</s>,

children.text: agner iva bhramā vṛthā ||
children.translated_text: like the whirling flames of <s>Agni</s>, freely moving.

children.text: ete pūtā vipaścitaḥ somāso dadhyāśiraḥ
children.translated_text: These purified, inspired <s>Somas</s>, mixed with curds,

children.text: vipā vy ānaśur dhiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: have spread the thoughts through the inspired chant.

children.text: ete mṛṣṭā amartyāḥ sasṛvāṃso na śaśramuḥ
children.translated_text: These cleansed immortal ones, having streamed forth, have not grown weary,

children.text: iyakṣantaḥ patho rajaḥ ||
children.translated_text: seeking to worship along the path of the airy realm.

children.text: ete pṛṣṭhāni rodasor viprayanto vy ānaśuḥ
children.translated_text: These, stirring the backs of heaven and earth, have spread out,

children.text: utedam uttamaṃ rajaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and also this highest region.

children.text: tantuṃ tanvānam uttamam anu pravata āśata
children.translated_text: Following the one who stretches out the highest thread, they have settled along the slopes,

children.text: utedam uttamāyyam ||
children.translated_text: and also upon this highest place.

children.text: tvaṃ soma paṇibhya ā vasu gavyāni dhārayaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Soma</s>, have drawn wealth and cow-rich treasures from the <s>Paṇis</s>,

children.text: tataṃ tantum acikradaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and have made the stretched thread resound.

children.text: Chapter 746
somā asṛgram āśavo madhor madasya dhārayā
children.translated_text: The swift <s>Somas</s> have been sent forth with a stream of honeyed exhilaration,

children.text: abhi viśvāni kāvyā ||
children.translated_text: toward all inspired works.

children.text: anu pratnāsa āyavaḥ padaṃ navīyo akramuḥ
children.translated_text: The ancient vital powers, following, have stepped upon a newer track;

children.text: ruce jananta sūryam ||
children.translated_text: they generated the sun for radiance.

children.text: ā pavamāna no bharāryo adāśuṣo gayam
children.translated_text: O purifying one, bring us the household wealth of the noble giver, away from the ungenerous,

children.text: kṛdhi prajāvatīr iṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and make our nourishments rich in offspring.

children.text: abhi somāsa āyavaḥ pavante madyam madam
children.translated_text: The <s>Somas</s>, the vital drops, flow toward the intoxicating exhilaration,

children.text: abhi kośam madhuścutam ||
children.translated_text: toward the honey-dripping vat.

children.text: somo arṣati dharṇasir dadhāna indriyaṃ rasam
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, the supporter, rushes on, bearing the powerful sap,

children.text: suvīro abhiśastipāḥ ||
children.translated_text: rich in heroes, warding off hostile speech.

children.text: indrāya soma pavase devebhyaḥ sadhamādyaḥ
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s> you are purified, O <s>Soma</s>, fit for shared feasting with the gods;

children.text: indo vājaṃ siṣāsasi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, you seek to win the prize.

children.text: asya pītvā madānām indro vṛtrāṇy aprati
children.translated_text: Having drunk of these exhilarations, <s>Indra</s>, unopposed,

children.text: jaghāna jaghanac ca nu ||
children.translated_text: has slain the <s>Vṛtras</s>, and now too he will slay them.

children.text: Chapter 747
pra somāso adhanviṣuḥ pavamānāsa indavaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Somas</s>, the purifying drops, have rushed forth;

children.text: śrīṇānā apsu mṛñjata ||
children.translated_text: being mixed in the waters, they cleanse themselves.

children.text: abhi gāvo adhanviṣur āpo na pravatā yatīḥ
children.translated_text: The cows have rushed toward him, like waters going down a slope;

children.text: punānā indram āśata ||
children.translated_text: being purified, they have reached <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: pra pavamāna dhanvasi somendrāya pātave
children.translated_text: O purifying one, you race forth, O <s>Soma</s>, for <s>Indra</s> to drink,

children.text: nṛbhir yato vi nīyase ||
children.translated_text: when you are led onward by men.

children.text: tvaṃ soma nṛmādanaḥ pavasva carṣaṇīsahe
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Soma</s>, delighting men, purify yourself for mastery over peoples,

children.text: sasnir yo anumādyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: a winner who is to be praised.

children.text: indo yad adribhiḥ sutaḥ pavitram paridhāvasi
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, when pressed by the stones you run around the filter,

children.text: aram indrasya dhāmne ||
children.translated_text: ready for <s>Indra</s>'s abode.

children.text: pavasva vṛtrahantamokthebhir anumādyaḥ
children.translated_text: Purify yourself, most slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>, praised with hymns,

children.text: śuciḥ pāvako adbhutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: bright, purifying, and wondrous.

children.text: śuciḥ pāvaka ucyate somaḥ sutasya madhvaḥ
children.translated_text: Bright and purifying is the <s>Soma</s> called, of the pressed sweetness,

children.text: devāvīr aghaśaṃsahā ||
children.translated_text: winning the gods, slaying evil speech.

children.text: Chapter 748
pavasva dakṣasādhano devebhyaḥ pītaye hare
children.translated_text: Purify yourself, accomplisher of skill, for the gods to drink, O tawny one,

children.text: marudbhyo vāyave madaḥ ||
children.translated_text: as exhilaration for the <s>Maruts</s> and for <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: pavamāna dhiyā hito 'bhi yoniṃ kanikradat
children.translated_text: O purifying one, set in place by inspired thought, roaring toward the womb,

children.text: dharmaṇā vāyum ā viśa ||
children.translated_text: enter <s>Vāyu</s> according to <s>dharma</s> (sacred order).

children.text: saṃ devaiḥ śobhate vṛṣā kavir yonāv adhi priyaḥ
children.translated_text: Together with the gods the bull shines, the sage beloved in the womb,

children.text: vṛtrahā devavītamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, best winner of the gods.

children.text: viśvā rūpāṇy āviśan punāno yāti haryataḥ
children.translated_text: Entering all forms, being purified, the desirable one goes

children.text: yatrāmṛtāsa āsate ||
children.translated_text: to where the immortals sit.

children.text: aruṣo janayan giraḥ somaḥ pavata āyuṣak
children.translated_text: The ruddy <s>Soma</s>, generating songs, purifies himself for length of life,

children.text: indraṃ gacchan kavikratuḥ ||
children.translated_text: going to <s>Indra</s>, sage in will.

children.text: ā pavasva madintama pavitraṃ dhārayā kave
children.translated_text: Flow here, most exhilarating one, through the filter with your stream, O sage,

children.text: arkasya yonim āsadam ||
children.translated_text: to sit in the womb of the chant.

children.text: Chapter 749
tam amṛkṣanta vājinam upasthe aditer adhi
children.translated_text: The inspired priests have wiped that prize-winning steed on the lap of <s>Aditi</s>,

children.text: viprāso aṇvyā dhiyā ||
children.translated_text: with subtle inspired thought.

children.text: taṃ gāvo abhy anūṣata sahasradhāram akṣitam
children.translated_text: The cows have bellowed toward that inexhaustible thousand-streamed

children.text: induṃ dhartāram ā divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indu</s>, the holder of heaven.

children.text: taṃ vedhām medhayāhyan pavamānam adhi dyavi
children.translated_text: They have strengthened that wise one with wisdom, the purifying one upon heaven,

children.text: dharṇasim bhūridhāyasam ||
children.translated_text: the supporter, rich in gifts.

children.text: tam ahyan bhurijor dhiyā saṃvasānaṃ vivasvataḥ
children.translated_text: With abundant inspired thought they have strengthened him, dwelling together with the daughters of <s>Vivasvat</s>,

children.text: patiṃ vāco adābhyam ||
children.translated_text: the unassailable lord of speech.

children.text: taṃ sānāv adhi jāmayo hariṃ hinvanty adribhiḥ
children.translated_text: On the height the sisters impel that tawny one with the stones,

children.text: haryatam bhūricakṣasam ||
children.translated_text: the desirable one of many eyes.

children.text: taṃ tvā hinvanti vedhasaḥ pavamāna girāvṛdham
children.translated_text: The wise ones impel you, O purifying one, increaser of song,

children.text: indav indrāya matsaram ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, exhilarating for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 750
eṣa kavir abhiṣṭutaḥ pavitre adhi tośate
children.translated_text: This praised sage delights upon the filter,

children.text: punāno ghnann apa sridhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: being purified, striking away deceits.

children.text: eṣa indrāya vāyave svarjit pari ṣicyate
children.translated_text: This one is poured around for <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>, winning the sunlight,

children.text: pavitre dakṣasādhanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: on the filter, accomplisher of skill.

children.text: eṣa nṛbhir vi nīyate divo mūrdhā vṛṣā sutaḥ
children.translated_text: This pressed bull, the head of heaven, is led onward by men,

children.text: somo vaneṣu viśvavit ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, all-knowing among the wooden vessels.

children.text: eṣa gavyur acikradat pavamāno hiraṇyayuḥ
children.translated_text: This cow-seeking purifying one has cried out, desirous of gold,

children.text: induḥ satrājid astṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Indu</s>, conqueror in assembly, unobstructed.

children.text: eṣa sūryeṇa hāsate pavamāno adhi dyavi
children.translated_text: This purifying one shines with the sun upon heaven,

children.text: pavitre matsaro madaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the exhilarating draught on the filter.

children.text: eṣa śuṣmy asiṣyadad antarikṣe vṛṣā hariḥ
children.translated_text: This mighty tawny bull has flowed powerfully in the midspace,

children.text: punāna indur indram ā ||
children.translated_text: the purifying <s>Indu</s>, toward <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 751
eṣa vājī hito nṛbhir viśvavin manasas patiḥ
children.translated_text: This prize-winning steed, set in place by men, all-winning, lord of the mind,

children.text: avyo vāraṃ vi dhāvati ||
children.translated_text: runs through the sheep's-wool filter.

children.text: eṣa pavitre akṣarat somo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s>, pressed for the gods, has flowed upon the filter,

children.text: viśvā dhāmāny āviśan ||
children.translated_text: entering all the abodes.

children.text: eṣa devaḥ śubhāyate 'dhi yonāv amartyaḥ
children.translated_text: This god shines in beauty upon the womb, immortal,

children.text: vṛtrahā devavītamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, best winner of the gods.

children.text: eṣa vṛṣā kanikradad daśabhir jāmibhir yataḥ
children.translated_text: This bull, roaring, guided by the ten sisters,

children.text: abhi droṇāni dhāvati ||
children.translated_text: runs toward the wooden vats.

children.text: eṣa sūryam arocayat pavamāno vicarṣaṇiḥ
children.translated_text: This purifying one, active among men, has made the sun shine,

children.text: viśvā dhāmāni viśvavit ||
children.translated_text: all-knowing, through all the abodes.

children.text: eṣa śuṣmy adābhyaḥ somaḥ punāno arṣati
children.translated_text: This mighty, unassailable <s>Soma</s>, being purified, rushes on,

children.text: devāvīr aghaśaṃsahā ||
children.translated_text: winning the gods, slaying evil speech.

children.text: Chapter 752
prāsya dhārā akṣaran vṛṣṇaḥ sutasyaujasā
children.translated_text: The streams of this pressed bull have flowed forth with strength,

children.text: devāṁ anu prabhūṣataḥ ||
children.translated_text: adorning themselves after the gods.

children.text: saptim mṛjanti vedhaso gṛṇantaḥ kāravo girā
children.translated_text: The wise singers cleanse the racehorse, praising with song,

children.text: jyotir jajñānam ukthyam ||
children.translated_text: the newborn light worthy of hymns.

children.text: suṣahā soma tāni te punānāya prabhūvaso
children.translated_text: Those things of yours, O <s>Soma</s>, are easy to overcome for the purifying one, O powerful lord of goods;

children.text: vardhā samudram ukthyam ||
children.translated_text: increase the hymn-worthy ocean.

children.text: viśvā vasūni saṃjayan pavasva soma dhārayā
children.translated_text: Winning all goods together, purify yourself, O <s>Soma</s>, with your stream;

children.text: inu dveṣāṃsi sadhryak ||
children.translated_text: drive away hatreds all at once.

children.text: rakṣā su no araruṣaḥ svanāt samasya kasya cit
children.translated_text: Protect us from the hostile man, from the noise of everyone whatsoever,

children.text: nido yatra mumucmahe ||
children.translated_text: where we would free ourselves from reproach.

children.text: endo pārthivaṃ rayiṃ divyam pavasva dhārayā
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, purify yourself with your stream toward earthly and heavenly wealth;

children.text: dyumantaṃ śuṣmam ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: bring brilliant force and might.

children.text: Chapter 753
pra dhārā asya śuṣmiṇo vṛthā pavitre akṣaran
children.translated_text: The streams of this mighty one have flowed freely upon the filter;

children.text: punāno vācam iṣyati ||
children.translated_text: being purified, he sends forth speech.

children.text: indur hiyānaḥ sotṛbhir mṛjyamānaḥ kanikradat
children.translated_text: The <s>Indu</s>, impelled by the pressers, being cleansed, roaring,

children.text: iyarti vagnum indriyam ||
children.translated_text: sets in motion a powerful utterance.

children.text: ā naḥ śuṣmaṃ nṛṣāhyaṃ vīravantam puruspṛham
children.translated_text: Bring to us man-conquering strength, rich in heroes and much desired.

children.text: pavasva soma dhārayā ||
children.translated_text: Flow, O <s>Soma</s>, with your stream.

children.text: pra somo ati dhārayā pavamāno asiṣyadat
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, purifying himself, has poured himself onward with the stream,

children.text: abhi droṇāny āsadam ||
children.translated_text: settling toward the wooden vats.

children.text: apsu tvā madhumattamaṃ hariṃ hinvanty adribhiḥ
children.translated_text: In the waters they urge you, the tawny, most honeyed one, with the pressing stones,

children.text: indav indrāya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, for <s>Indra</s> to drink.

children.text: sunotā madhumattamaṃ somam indrāya vajriṇe
children.translated_text: Press the most honeyed <s>Soma</s> for <s>Indra</s>, the thunderbolt-bearer,

children.text: cāruṃ śardhāya matsaram ||
children.translated_text: lovely, exhilarating for the troop.

children.text: Chapter 754
pra somāsaḥ svādhyaḥ pavamānāso akramuḥ
children.translated_text: The well-inspired <s>Somas</s>, purifying themselves, have stepped forth,

children.text: rayiṃ kṛṇvanti cetanam ||
children.translated_text: making wealth alive and perceptive.

children.text: divas pṛthivyā adhi bhavendo dyumnavardhanaḥ
children.translated_text: From heaven and earth, become, O <s>Indu</s>, an increaser of splendor;

children.text: bhavā vājānām patiḥ ||
children.translated_text: become lord of the prizes.

children.text: tubhyaṃ vātā abhipriyas tubhyam arṣanti sindhavaḥ
children.translated_text: For you the winds are dear; for you the rivers flow,

children.text: soma vardhanti te mahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, and they magnify your greatness.

children.text: ā pyāyasva sam etu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam
children.translated_text: Swell up; let your virile power come together from every side, O <s>Soma</s>;

children.text: bhavā vājasya saṃgathe ||
children.translated_text: be present at the gathering of prize.

children.text: tubhyaṃ gāvo ghṛtam payo babhro duduhre akṣitam
children.translated_text: For you, O brown one, the cows have milked imperishable ghee and milk,

children.text: varṣiṣṭhe adhi sānavi ||
children.translated_text: upon the highest ridge.

children.text: svāyudhasya te sato bhuvanasya pate vayam
children.translated_text: Since you are well-armed, O lord of the world, we

children.text: indo sakhitvam uśmasi ||
children.translated_text: desire your friendship, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: Chapter 755
pra somāso madacyutaḥ śravase no maghonaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Somas</s>, shedding exhilaration, for the fame of us liberal ones,

children.text: sutā vidathe akramuḥ ||
children.translated_text: pressed, have advanced in the ritual assembly.

children.text: ād īṃ tritasya yoṣaṇo hariṃ hinvanty adribhiḥ
children.translated_text: Then the women of <s>Trita</s> urge the tawny one with pressing stones,

children.text: indum indrāya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Indu</s>, for <s>Indra</s> to drink.

children.text: ād īṃ haṃso yathā gaṇaṃ viśvasyāvīvaśan matim
children.translated_text: Then, like a swan toward its flock, he has won the thought of all,

children.text: atyo na gobhir ajyate ||
children.translated_text: and, like a courser, he is adorned with cows' milk.

children.text: ubhe somāvacākaśan mṛgo na takto arṣasi
children.translated_text: Both worlds have shone upon you, O <s>Soma</s>; you flow like a readied beast,

children.text: sīdann ṛtasya yonim ā ||
children.translated_text: sitting down into the womb of <s>rta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: abhi gāvo anūṣata yoṣā jāram iva priyam
children.translated_text: The cows have lowed toward him, like women toward a beloved lover;

children.text: agann ājiṃ yathā hitam ||
children.translated_text: he has gone to the contest as to an appointed place.

children.text: asme dhehi dyumad yaśo maghavadbhyaś ca mahyaṃ ca
children.translated_text: Set among us shining glory, for the liberal patrons and for me,

children.text: sanim medhām uta śravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: gain, wisdom, and fame as well.

children.text: Chapter 756
pra somāso vipaścito 'pāṃ na yanty ūrmayaḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired <s>Somas</s> go forth like waves of the waters,

children.text: vanāni mahiṣā iva ||
children.translated_text: like buffaloes through the woods.

children.text: abhi droṇāni babhravaḥ śukrā ṛtasya dhārayā
children.translated_text: The brown, bright ones have flowed toward the vats with the stream of <s>rta</s> (cosmic order),

children.text: vājaṃ gomantam akṣaran ||
children.translated_text: streaming forth cow-rich prize.

children.text: sutā indrāya vāyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Pressed for <s>Indra</s>, for <s>Vayu</s>, for <s>Varuna</s>, and for the <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: somā arṣanti viṣṇave ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Somas</s> flow for <s>Visnu</s>.

children.text: tisro vāca ud īrate gāvo mimanti dhenavaḥ
children.translated_text: Three voices rise up; the cows, the milch cows, low;

children.text: harir eti kanikradat ||
children.translated_text: the tawny one goes, bellowing.

children.text: abhi brahmīr anūṣata yahvīr ṛtasya mātaraḥ
children.translated_text: The sacred utterances have sounded toward him, the mighty mothers of <s>rta</s> (cosmic order);

children.text: marmṛjyante divaḥ śiśum ||
children.translated_text: they cleanse the child of heaven.

children.text: rāyaḥ samudrāṃś caturo 'smabhyaṃ soma viśvataḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, from every side bring us four oceans of wealth,

children.text: ā pavasva sahasriṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and flow here, thousandfold.

children.text: Chapter 757
pra suvāno dhārayā tanendur hinvāno arṣati
children.translated_text: The self-pressed <s>Indu</s>, set in motion, flows forth with the stream,

children.text: rujad dṛﾱhā vy ojasā ||
children.translated_text: breaking firm strongholds apart by his force.

children.text: suta indrāya vāyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Pressed for <s>Indra</s>, for <s>Vayu</s>, for <s>Varuna</s>, and for the <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: somo arṣati viṣṇave ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> flows for <s>Visnu</s>.

children.text: vṛṣāṇaṃ vṛṣabhir yataṃ sunvanti somam adribhiḥ
children.translated_text: They press <s>Soma</s>, the bull, driven by bulls, with the pressing stones;

children.text: duhanti śakmanā payaḥ ||
children.translated_text: they milk out the milk with power.

children.text: bhuvat tritasya marjyo bhuvad indrāya matsaraḥ
children.translated_text: He becomes the one to be cleansed for <s>Trita</s>; he becomes the exhilarant for <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: saṃ rūpair ajyate hariḥ ||
children.translated_text: the tawny one is adorned with forms.

children.text: abhīm ṛtasya viṣṭapaṃ duhate pṛśnimātaraḥ
children.translated_text: Toward him, on the height of <s>rta</s> (cosmic order), the mothers of the speckled one milk

children.text: cāru priyatamaṃ haviḥ ||
children.translated_text: the lovely, most beloved oblation.

children.text: sam enam ahrutā imā giro arṣanti sasrutaḥ
children.translated_text: These unbent songs flow together toward him, streaming,

children.text: dhenūr vāśro avīvaśat ||
children.translated_text: as the bellowing one calls out to the milch cows.

children.text: Chapter 758
ā naḥ pavasva dhārayā pavamāna rayim pṛthum
children.translated_text: Flow here to us with your stream, O purifying one, bringing broad wealth,

children.text: yayā jyotir vidāsi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: by which you find light for us.

children.text: indo samudramīṅkhaya pavasva viśvamejaya
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, stir the ocean; flow, shaking all things,

children.text: rāyo dhartā na ojasā ||
children.translated_text: as our supporter of wealth by your force.

children.text: tvayā vīreṇa vīravo 'bhi ṣyāma pṛtanyataḥ
children.translated_text: With you as hero, may we heroic men overcome the hostile attackers;

children.text: kṣarā ṇo abhi vāryam ||
children.translated_text: stream desirable wealth toward us.

children.text: pra vājam indur iṣyati siṣāsan vājasā ṛṣiḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indu</s>, the seer eager to win, sends forth the prize with strength,

children.text: vratā vidāna āyudhā ||
children.translated_text: knowing the ordinances and the weapons.

children.text: taṃ gīrbhir vācamīṅkhayam punānaṃ vāsayāmasi
children.translated_text: With songs we clothe that purifying <s>Soma</s>, who stirs speech,

children.text: somaṃ janasya gopatim ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, guardian of the people.

children.text: viśvo yasya vrate jano dādhāra dharmaṇas pateḥ
children.translated_text: In whose ordinance every people has taken its stand, the lord of <s>dharma</s> (sustaining law),

children.text: punānasya prabhūvasoḥ ||
children.translated_text: the purifying one of abundant wealth.

children.text: Chapter 759
asarji rathyo yathā pavitre camvoḥ sutaḥ
children.translated_text: Pressed, he has been released on the filter like a chariot-horse, between the two bowls;

children.text: kārṣman vājī ny akramīt ||
children.translated_text: the prize-winning steed has stepped down upon the course.

children.text: sa vahniḥ soma jāgṛviḥ pavasva devavīr ati
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, that wakeful carrier, rich in divine heroes, flow onward,

children.text: abhi kośam madhuścutam ||
children.translated_text: toward the honey-dripping vessel.

children.text: sa no jyotīṃṣi pūrvya pavamāna vi rocaya
children.translated_text: Ancient purifying one, make the lights shine forth for us;

children.text: kratve dakṣāya no hinu ||
children.translated_text: impel us toward insight and skill.

children.text: śumbhamāna ṛtāyubhir mṛjyamāno gabhastyoḥ
children.translated_text: Adorned by those who live according to <s>rta</s> (cosmic order), cleansed in the hands,

children.text: pavate vāre avyaye ||
children.translated_text: he purifies himself on the unfailing fleece.

children.text: sa viśvā dāśuṣe vasu somo divyāni pārthivā
children.translated_text: May that <s>Soma</s> purify all goods for the worshipper, heavenly and earthly,

children.text: pavatām āntarikṣyā ||
children.translated_text: and those of the midspace.

children.text: ā divas pṛṣṭham aśvayur gavyayuḥ soma rohasi
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, desiring horses and cows, you mount to the back of heaven,

children.text: vīrayuḥ śavasas pate ||
children.translated_text: desiring heroes, O lord of might.

children.text: Chapter 760
sa sutaḥ pītaye vṛṣā somaḥ pavitre arṣati
children.translated_text: Pressed for drinking, that bull <s>Soma</s> flows on the filter,

children.text: vighnan rakṣāṃsi devayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: smiting the demons, seeking the gods.

children.text: sa pavitre vicakṣaṇo harir arṣati dharṇasiḥ
children.translated_text: That farsighted tawny one, the supporter, flows on the filter,

children.text: abhi yoniṃ kanikradat ||
children.translated_text: bellowing toward the womb.

children.text: sa vājī rocanā divaḥ pavamāno vi dhāvati
children.translated_text: That prize-winning steed, purifying himself, runs through the lights of heaven,

children.text: rakṣohā vāram avyayam ||
children.translated_text: demon-slayer, to the unfailing fleece.

children.text: sa tritasyādhi sānavi pavamāno arocayat
children.translated_text: He, purifying himself on <s>Trita</s>'s height, has made shine

children.text: jāmibhiḥ sūryaṃ saha ||
children.translated_text: the sun together with the sisters.

children.text: sa vṛtrahā vṛṣā suto varivovid adābhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Pressed, that bull, the <s>Vrtra</s>-slayer, finder of wide space, unassailable,

children.text: somo vājam ivāsarat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> has flowed like a prize.

children.text: sa devaḥ kavineṣito 'bhi droṇāni dhāvati
children.translated_text: That god, impelled by the seer, runs toward the vats,

children.text: indur indrāya maṃhanā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indu</s>, bringing greatness for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 761
eṣa u sya vṛṣā ratho 'vyo vārebhir arṣati
children.translated_text: This bull, like a chariot, flows through the fleeces of sheep's wool,

children.text: gacchan vājaṃ sahasriṇam ||
children.translated_text: going to thousandfold prize.

children.text: etaṃ tritasya yoṣaṇo hariṃ hinvanty adribhiḥ
children.translated_text: This tawny one the women of <s>Trita</s> urge with pressing stones,

children.text: indum indrāya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Indu</s>, for <s>Indra</s> to drink.

children.text: etaṃ tyaṃ harito daśa marmṛjyante apasyuvaḥ
children.translated_text: This one, those ten working maidens, the tawny fingers, cleanse,

children.text: yābhir madāya śumbhate ||
children.translated_text: with whom he is adorned for exhilaration.

children.text: eṣa sya mānuṣīṣv ā śyeno na vikṣu sīdati
children.translated_text: This one settles among human clans like a falcon,

children.text: gacchañ jāro na yoṣitam ||
children.translated_text: going like a lover to a woman.

children.text: eṣa sya madyo raso 'va caṣṭe divaḥ śiśuḥ
children.translated_text: This exhilarating juice, the child of heaven, looks down,

children.text: ya indur vāram āviśat ||
children.translated_text: that <s>Indu</s> who has entered the fleece.

children.text: eṣa sya pītaye suto harir arṣati dharṇasiḥ
children.translated_text: This tawny supporter, pressed for drinking, flows,

children.text: krandan yonim abhi priyam ||
children.translated_text: crying aloud toward the beloved womb.

children.text: Chapter 762
āśur arṣa bṛhanmate pari priyeṇa dhāmnā
children.translated_text: Swift one, flow, O greatly minded one, around the beloved dwelling,

children.text: yatra devā iti bravan ||
children.translated_text: where the gods spoke, saying, 'Thus.'

children.text: pariṣkṛṇvann aniṣkṛtaṃ janāya yātayann iṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Refining the unrefined and setting nourishment in motion for the people,

children.text: vṛṣṭiṃ divaḥ pari srava ||
children.translated_text: flow all around as the rain of heaven.

children.text: suta eti pavitra ā tviṣiṃ dadhāna ojasā
children.translated_text: The pressed one goes to the filter, bearing brightness by his power,

children.text: vicakṣāṇo virocayan ||
children.translated_text: seeing widely and making things shine.

children.text: ayaṃ sa yo divas pari raghuyāmā pavitra ā
children.translated_text: This is he who, swift-moving from heaven, toward the filter,

children.text: sindhor ūrmā vy akṣarat ||
children.translated_text: has flowed out like a wave of the river.

children.text: āvivāsan parāvato atho arvāvataḥ sutaḥ
children.translated_text: The pressed one, seeking both what is far away and what is near,

children.text: indrāya sicyate madhu ||
children.translated_text: is poured out as honey for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: samīcīnā anūṣata hariṃ hinvanty adribhiḥ
children.translated_text: In one accord they have sung; they urge on the tawny one with the pressing stones.

children.text: yonāv ṛtasya sīdata ||
children.translated_text: Sit down in the womb of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: Chapter 763
punāno akramīd abhi viśvā mṛdho vicarṣaṇiḥ
children.translated_text: Being purified, active among peoples, he has advanced against all hostilities;

children.text: śumbhanti vipraṃ dhītibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: they adorn the inspired one with their thoughts.

children.text: ā yonim aruṇo ruhad gamad indraṃ vṛṣā sutaḥ
children.translated_text: The ruddy bull has climbed to his womb; the pressed one has gone to <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: dhruve sadasi sīdati ||
children.translated_text: and sits in the fixed seat.

children.text: nū no rayim mahām indo 'smabhyaṃ soma viśvataḥ
children.translated_text: Now, O drop, O <s>Soma</s>, flow to us from every side with great wealth,

children.text: ā pavasva sahasriṇam ||
children.translated_text: with wealth in thousands.

children.text: viśvā soma pavamāna dyumnānīndav ā bhara
children.translated_text: O purifying <s>Soma</s>, O drop, bring all splendors;

children.text: vidāḥ sahasriṇīr iṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: find nourishments in thousands.

children.text: sa naḥ punāna ā bhara rayiṃ stotre suvīryam
children.translated_text: Being purified, bring us wealth with good heroic strength for the singer;

children.text: jaritur vardhayā giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: increase the chants of the chanter.

children.text: punāna indav ā bhara soma dvibarhasaṃ rayim
children.translated_text: Being purified, O drop, O <s>Soma</s>, bring broad wealth twice over,

children.text: vṛṣann indo na ukthyam ||
children.translated_text: O bull, O drop, praiseworthy for us.

children.text: Chapter 764
pra ye gāvo na bhūrṇayas tveṣā ayāso akramuḥ
children.translated_text: Those who, like rushing cows, fierce and unwearied, have advanced,

children.text: ghnantaḥ kṛṣṇām apa tvacam ||
children.translated_text: strike away the black skin.

children.text: suvitasya manāmahe 'ti setuṃ durāvyam
children.translated_text: We seek the good course beyond the bridge that is hard to cross,

children.text: sāhvāṃso dasyum avratam ||
children.translated_text: overcoming the lawless <s>Dasyu</s>.

children.text: śṛṇve vṛṣṭer iva svanaḥ pavamānasya śuṣmiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: The roar of powerful <s>Pavamāna</s> is heard like that of rain;

children.text: caranti vidyuto divi ||
children.translated_text: lightnings move in heaven.

children.text: ā pavasva mahīm iṣaṃ gomad indo hiraṇyavat
children.translated_text: Flow here with great nourishment, rich in cattle, O drop, rich in gold,

children.text: aśvāvad vājavat sutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: pressed, rich in horses and rich in prize.

children.text: sa pavasva vicarṣaṇa ā mahī rodasī pṛṇa
children.translated_text: Flow, O active one among peoples; fill the two great worlds,

children.text: uṣāḥ sūryo na raśmibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: as the dawns and the sun fill them with rays.

children.text: pari ṇaḥ śarmayantyā dhārayā soma viśvataḥ
children.translated_text: Around us, O <s>Soma</s>, with a sheltering stream from every side,

children.text: sarā raseva viṣṭapam ||
children.translated_text: spread like a lake with its sap over the expanse.

children.text: Chapter 765
janayan rocanā divo janayann apsu sūryam
children.translated_text: Generating the lights of heaven, generating the sun in the waters,

children.text: vasāno gā apo hariḥ ||
children.translated_text: the tawny one clothes himself in cows and waters.

children.text: eṣa pratnena manmanā devo devebhyas pari
children.translated_text: This pressed god, with the ancient inspired thought, for the gods,

children.text: dhārayā pavate sutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: purifies himself all around with the stream.

children.text: vāvṛdhānāya tūrvaye pavante vājasātaye
children.translated_text: For the growing <s>Tūrva</s>, for the winning of prize,

children.text: somāḥ sahasrapājasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Somas</s>, possessing strength by the thousand, are purified.

children.text: duhānaḥ pratnam it payaḥ pavitre pari ṣicyate
children.translated_text: Milking the ancient milk, he is poured all around in the filter;

children.text: krandan devāṁ ajījanat ||
children.translated_text: crying aloud, he has begotten the gods.

children.text: abhi viśvāni vāryābhi devāṁ ṛtāvṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: Toward all desirable goods, toward the gods who increase <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order),

children.text: somaḥ punāno arṣati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, being purified, rushes on.

children.text: goman naḥ soma vīravad aśvāvad vājavat sutaḥ
children.translated_text: O pressed <s>Soma</s>, rich in cattle for us, rich in heroes, rich in horses and prize,

children.text: pavasva bṛhatīr iṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: flow with great nourishments.

children.text: Chapter 766
yo atya iva mṛjyate gobhir madāya haryataḥ
children.translated_text: He who is cleansed with milk like a racehorse, the desirable one for exhilaration,

children.text: taṃ gīrbhir vāsayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: we clothe with songs.

children.text: taṃ no viśvā avasyuvo giraḥ śumbhanti pūrvathā
children.translated_text: All our songs, seeking aid, adorn him as in former times,

children.text: indum indrāya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: the drop, for <s>Indra</s> to drink.

children.text: punāno yāti haryataḥ somo gīrbhiḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: Being purified, the desirable <s>Soma</s> goes, adorned with songs,

children.text: viprasya medhyātitheḥ ||
children.translated_text: belonging to the inspired <s>Medhyātithi</s>.

children.text: pavamāna vidā rayim asmabhyaṃ soma suśriyam
children.translated_text: O <s>Pavamāna</s>, find wealth for us, O <s>Soma</s>, fair in splendor;

children.text: indo sahasravarcasam ||
children.translated_text: O drop, find wealth with a thousand bright powers.

children.text: indur atyo na vājasṛt kanikranti pavitra ā
children.translated_text: The drop, like a racehorse winning the prize, cries out toward the filter,

children.text: yad akṣār ati devayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: when, devoted to the gods, he has flowed beyond.

children.text: pavasva vājasātaye viprasya gṛṇato vṛdhe
children.translated_text: Flow for the winning of prize, for the growth of the inspired singer;

children.text: soma rāsva suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, grant excellent heroic strength.

children.text: Chapter 767
pra ṇa indo mahe tana ūrmiṃ na bibhrad arṣasi
children.translated_text: Forward for our great extension, O drop, you rush, bearing a wave,

children.text: abhi devāṁ ayāsyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: toward the gods, O tireless one.

children.text: matī juṣṭo dhiyā hitaḥ somo hinve parāvati
children.translated_text: Favored by thought, set in insight, <s>Soma</s> is impelled from afar,

children.text: viprasya dhārayā kaviḥ ||
children.translated_text: the seer, by the stream of the inspired one.

children.text: ayaṃ deveṣu jāgṛviḥ suta eti pavitra ā
children.translated_text: This watchful one among the gods, pressed, goes to the filter;

children.text: somo yāti vicarṣaṇiḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, active among peoples, goes on.

children.text: sa naḥ pavasva vājayuś cakrāṇaś cārum adhvaram
children.translated_text: So flow for us, desirous of prize, making the sacrifice lovely;

children.text: barhiṣmāṁ ā vivāsati ||
children.translated_text: he who has the sacred grass eagerly approaches.

children.text: sa no bhagāya vāyave vipravīraḥ sadāvṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: For our share, for <s>Vāyu</s>, may the inspired hero, ever-growing,

children.text: somo deveṣv ā yamat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, extend himself among the gods.

children.text: sa no adya vasuttaye kratuvid gātuvittamaḥ
children.translated_text: For our gaining of goods today, knowing resolve and best at finding the path,

children.text: vājaṃ jeṣi śravo bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: win prize and lofty fame.

children.text: Chapter 768
sa pavasva madāya kaṃ nṛcakṣā devavītaye
children.translated_text: Flow for exhilaration, watchful over men, for the feast of the gods,

children.text: indav indrāya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: O drop, for <s>Indra</s> to drink.

children.text: sa no arṣābhi dūtyaṃ tvam indrāya tośase
children.translated_text: Rush for us with your embassy; you, to please <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: devān sakhibhya ā varam ||
children.translated_text: bring the gods here as the best friends.

children.text: uta tvām aruṇaṃ vayaṃ gobhir añjmo madāya kam
children.translated_text: And we anoint you, the ruddy one, with milk for exhilaration;

children.text: vi no rāye duro vṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: open the doors for us to wealth.

children.text: aty ū pavitram akramīd vājī dhuraṃ na yāmani
children.translated_text: The racer has stepped over the filter, like a draught animal to the pole on the journey;

children.text: indur deveṣu patyate ||
children.translated_text: the drop rules among the gods.

children.text: sam ī sakhāyo asvaran vane krīﾱantam atyavim
children.translated_text: Together his friends sounded; they sang after the drop playing in the wooden vessel, through the wool,

children.text: induṃ nāvā anūṣata ||
children.translated_text: as men sing around a boat.

children.text: tayā pavasva dhārayā yayā pīto vicakṣase
children.translated_text: With that stream flow, the stream by which, when drunk, you look out clearly;

children.text: indo stotre suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: O drop, bring excellent heroic strength to the singer.

children.text: Chapter 769
asṛgran devavītaye 'tyāsaḥ kṛtvyā iva
children.translated_text: The racers have been released for the feast of the gods, like workers fit for action,

children.text: kṣarantaḥ parvatāvṛdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: flowing, grown on the mountain.

children.text: pariṣkṛtāsa indavo yoṣeva pitryāvatī
children.translated_text: The drops, fully adorned like a woman in her father's house,

children.text: vāyuṃ somā asṛkṣata ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Somas</s>, have been released toward <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: ete somāsa indavaḥ prayasvantaś camū sutāḥ
children.translated_text: These <s>Somas</s>, these drops, rich in refreshment and pressed in the vats,

children.text: indraṃ vardhanti karmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: strengthen <s>Indra</s> by their rites.

children.text: ā dhāvatā suhastyaḥ śukrā gṛbhṇīta manthinā
children.translated_text: Run here, good-handed ones; grasp the bright ones with the stirring-stick;

children.text: gobhiḥ śrīṇīta matsaram ||
children.translated_text: mix the exhilarating draught with milk.

children.text: sa pavasva dhanañjaya prayantā rādhaso mahaḥ
children.translated_text: So flow, winner of wealth, sender of great bounty,

children.text: asmabhyaṃ soma gātuvit ||
children.translated_text: for us, O <s>Soma</s>, finder of the path.

children.text: etam mṛjanti marjyam pavamānaṃ daśa kṣipaḥ
children.translated_text: The ten fingers cleanse this one to be cleansed, the purifying one,

children.text: indrāya matsaram madam ||
children.translated_text: the exhilarating, intoxicating draught for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 770
ayā somaḥ sukṛtyayā mahaś cid abhy avardhata
children.translated_text: By this good work <s>Soma</s> has grown greater still;

children.text: mandāna ud vṛṣāyate ||
children.translated_text: rejoicing, he rises like a bull.

children.text: kṛtānīd asya kartvā cetante dasyutarhaṇā
children.translated_text: His deeds, once done, are recognized as deeds that strike down the <s>Dasyu</s>;

children.text: ṛṇā ca dhṛṣṇuś cayate ||
children.translated_text: boldly he gathers up what is owed.

children.text: āt soma indriyo raso vajraḥ sahasrasā bhuvat
children.translated_text: Then <s>Soma</s>, the invigorating sap, became the thunderbolt that wins thousands,

children.text: ukthaṃ yad asya jāyate ||
children.translated_text: when his hymn is born.

children.text: svayaṃ kavir vidhartari viprāya ratnam icchati
children.translated_text: The self-wise poet seeks a jewel for the inspired one in the ordainer,

children.text: yadī marmṛjyate dhiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when thoughts cleanse him thoroughly.

children.text: siṣāsatū rayīṇāṃ vājeṣv arvatām iva
children.translated_text: You are eager to win riches, as horses are eager in contests for prize,

children.text: bhareṣu jigyuṣām asi ||
children.translated_text: as victors are in battles.

children.text: Chapter 771
taṃ tvā nṛmṇāni bibhrataṃ sadhastheṣu maho divaḥ
children.translated_text: We seek you, bearing manly powers in the seats of great heaven,

children.text: cāruṃ sukṛtyayemahe ||
children.translated_text: lovely through good action.

children.text: saṃvṛktadhṛṣṇum ukthyam mahāmahivratam madam
children.translated_text: the exhilarating drink, well-mixed in boldness, worthy of praise, of very great ordinance,

children.text: śatam puro rurukṣaṇim ||
children.translated_text: seeking to break down a hundred forts.

children.text: atas tvā rayim abhi rājānaṃ sukrato divaḥ
children.translated_text: From there the fair-winged, unshaken one bore you from heaven toward wealth,

children.text: suparṇo avyathir bharat ||
children.translated_text: the king, O wise one.

children.text: viśvasmā it svar dṛśe sādhāraṇaṃ rajasturam
children.translated_text: For all to see the sun-world, the common expanse that crosses the midspace,

children.text: gopām ṛtasya vir bharat ||
children.translated_text: he bore the heroic guardian of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: adhā hinvāna indriyaṃ jyāyo mahitvam ānaśe
children.translated_text: Then, impelling his power, he attained a greatness greater still,

children.text: abhiṣṭikṛd vicarṣaṇiḥ ||
children.translated_text: a maker of aid, active among the peoples.

children.text: Chapter 772
pavasva vṛṣṭim ā su no 'pām ūrmiṃ divas pari
children.translated_text: Flow for us rain, the wave of the waters from heaven,

children.text: ayakṣmā bṛhatīr iṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and great nourishments free from disease.

children.text: tayā pavasva dhārayā yayā gāva ihāgaman
children.translated_text: Flow with that stream by which the cows have come here,

children.text: janyāsa upa no gṛham ||
children.translated_text: as kindred ones, to our house.

children.text: ghṛtam pavasva dhārayā yajñeṣu devavītamaḥ
children.translated_text: Flow ghee with the stream, most god-inviting at the sacrifices;

children.text: asmabhyaṃ vṛṣṭim ā pava ||
children.translated_text: flow rain for us.

children.text: sa na ūrje vy avyayam pavitraṃ dhāva dhārayā
children.translated_text: For nourishment run through the imperishable filter with your stream;

children.text: devāsaḥ śṛṇavan hi kam ||
children.translated_text: for the gods will surely hear.

children.text: pavamāno asiṣyadad rakṣāṃsy apajaṅghanat
children.translated_text: <s>Pavamāna</s> has darted forth, beating away the demons,

children.text: pratnavad rocayan rucaḥ ||
children.translated_text: making the lights shine as of old.

children.text: Chapter 773
ut te śuṣmāsa īrate sindhor ūrmer iva svanaḥ
children.translated_text: Your powers rise up like the roar of a wave of the river;

children.text: vāṇasya codayā pavim ||
children.translated_text: impel the edge of the song.

children.text: prasave ta ud īrate tisro vāco makhasyuvaḥ
children.translated_text: At your impulse three voices rise up, eager for the rite,

children.text: yad avya eṣi sānavi ||
children.translated_text: when you go upon the ridge of the wool.

children.text: avyo vāre pari priyaṃ hariṃ hinvanty adribhiḥ
children.translated_text: At the sheep-wool strainer they drive the dear tawny one with stones,

children.text: pavamānam madhuścutam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Pavamāna</s>, dripping sweetness.

children.text: ā pavasva madintama pavitraṃ dhārayā kave
children.translated_text: Flow here, most exhilarating one, through the filter with your stream, O seer,

children.text: arkasya yonim āsadam ||
children.translated_text: to sit in the womb of the chant.

children.text: sa pavasva madintama gobhir añjāno aktubhiḥ
children.translated_text: So flow, most exhilarating one, anointed with milks and bright drops,

children.text: indav indrāya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: O drops, for <s>Indra</s> to drink.

children.text: Chapter 774
adhvaryo adribhiḥ sutaṃ somam pavitra ā sṛja
children.translated_text: O Adhvaryu, release the pressed <s>Soma</s> with the stones into the filter;

children.text: punīhīndrāya pātave ||
children.translated_text: purify him for <s>Indra</s> to drink.

children.text: divaḥ pīyūṣam uttamaṃ somam indrāya vajriṇe
children.translated_text: Press the highest sweetness of heaven, <s>Soma</s>, for <s>Indra</s> the wielder of the thunderbolt,

children.text: sunotā madhumattamam ||
children.translated_text: the richest in honey.

children.text: tava tya indo andhaso devā madhor vy aśnate
children.translated_text: Of your draught, O drop, of the honey, the gods partake,

children.text: pavamānasya marutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Maruts</s>, of <s>Pavamāna</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ hi soma vardhayan suto madāya bhūrṇaye
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Soma</s>, when pressed, make the praiser grow,

children.text: vṛṣan stotāram ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: for exhilaration, for the eager one, O bull, for aid.

children.text: abhy arṣa vicakṣaṇa pavitraṃ dhārayā sutaḥ
children.translated_text: Flow forth, O discerning one, pressed through the filter,

children.text: abhi vājam uta śravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: toward the prize and toward fame.

children.text: Chapter 775
pari dyukṣaḥ sanadrayir bharad vājaṃ no andhasā
children.translated_text: Shining, with ancient wealth, he brings us prize with the draught;

children.text: suvāno arṣa pavitra ā ||
children.translated_text: being pressed, flow into the filter.

children.text: tava pratnebhir adhvabhir avyo vāre pari priyaḥ
children.translated_text: Through your ancient paths, dear one, toward the sheep-wool strainer,

children.text: sahasradhāro yāt tanā ||
children.translated_text: the thousand-streamed one goes forth to the body.

children.text: carur na yas tam īṅkhayendo na dānam īṅkhaya
children.translated_text: Make him tremble like a bowl, O drop; make the gift tremble,

children.text: vadhair vadhasnav īṅkhaya ||
children.translated_text: make the murderous one tremble with blows.

children.text: ni śuṣmam indav eṣām puruhūta janānām
children.translated_text: Put down, O much-invoked drop, the force of these men,

children.text: yo asmāṁ ādideśati ||
children.translated_text: whoever sets himself against us.

children.text: śataṃ na inda ūtibhiḥ sahasraṃ vā śucīnām
children.translated_text: With a hundred aids, O drop, or with a thousand bright ones,

children.text: pavasva maṃhayadrayiḥ ||
children.translated_text: flow, rich in bounty-giving wealth.

children.text: Chapter 776
ut te śuṣmāso asthū rakṣo bhindanto adrivaḥ
children.translated_text: Let your powers stand up, O possessor of stones, splitting the demon;

children.text: nudasva yāḥ parispṛdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: drive away those who contend around us.

children.text: ayā nijaghnir ojasā rathasaṃge dhane hite
children.translated_text: With this crushing power, in the chariot-fight when wealth is set forth,

children.text: stavā abibhyuṣā hṛdā ||
children.translated_text: let me praise with a fearless heart.

children.text: asya vratāni nādhṛṣe pavamānasya dūḍhyā
children.translated_text: The ordinances of this <s>Pavamāna</s> are not to be assailed, hard to deceive;

children.text: ruja yas tvā pṛtanyati ||
children.translated_text: break the one who fights against you.

children.text: taṃ hinvanti madacyutaṃ hariṃ nadīṣu vājinam
children.translated_text: They impel that tawny one, spilling exhilaration, the steed in the rivers,

children.text: indum indrāya matsaram ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Indu</s>, eager for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 777
asya pratnām anu dyutaṃ śukraṃ duduhre ahrayaḥ
children.translated_text: Following his ancient radiance, the unfailing ones have milked out

children.text: payaḥ sahasrasām ṛṣim ||
children.translated_text: the bright milk, the thousand-winning seer.

children.text: ayaṃ sūrya ivopadṛg ayaṃ sarāṃsi dhāvati
children.translated_text: This one, looking down like <s>Sūrya</s>, runs through the pools,

children.text: sapta pravata ā divam ||
children.translated_text: along the seven slopes up to heaven.

children.text: ayaṃ viśvāni tiṣṭhati punāno bhuvanopari
children.translated_text: This one, purifying himself, stands above all beings,

children.text: somo devo na sūryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> the god, like <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: pari ṇo devavītaye vājāṁ arṣasi gomataḥ
children.translated_text: For the feast of the gods you flow around us with cattle-rich prizes,

children.text: punāna indav indrayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: purifying yourself, O drop, eager for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 778
yavaṃ yavaṃ no andhasā puṣṭaṃ puṣṭaṃ pari srava
children.translated_text: With your draught flow around every grain for us, every well-fed thing,

children.text: soma viśvā ca saubhagā ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, and all good fortunes.

children.text: indo yathā tava stavo yathā te jātam andhasaḥ
children.translated_text: O drop, as your praise is, as your draught has been born,

children.text: ni barhiṣi priye sadaḥ ||
children.translated_text: sit down on the beloved sacred grass.

children.text: uta no govid aśvavit pavasva somāndhasā
children.translated_text: And, finding cows and finding horses for us, O <s>Soma</s>, flow with the draught,

children.text: makṣūtamebhir ahabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: with the swiftest days.

children.text: yo jināti na jīyate hanti śatrum abhītya
children.translated_text: He who conquers and is not conquered, who strikes the enemy when attacked,

children.text: sa pavasva sahasrajit ||
children.translated_text: let that thousand-conquering one flow.

children.text: Chapter 779
pari soma ṛtam bṛhad āśuḥ pavitre arṣati
children.translated_text: Around the great <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), O <s>Soma</s>, the swift one flows in the filter,

children.text: vighnan rakṣāṃsi devayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: smiting the demons, seeking the gods.

children.text: yat somo vājam arṣati śataṃ dhārā apasyuvaḥ
children.translated_text: When <s>Soma</s> flows toward the prize, a hundred streams eager for work

children.text: indrasya sakhyam āviśan ||
children.translated_text: enter the friendship of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: abhi tvā yoṣaṇo daśa jāraṃ na kanyānūṣata
children.translated_text: The ten maidens sing to you like girls to a lover;

children.text: mṛjyase soma sātaye ||
children.translated_text: you are cleansed, O <s>Soma</s>, for gain.

children.text: tvam indrāya viṣṇave svādur indo pari srava
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, O sweet drop, flow around;

children.text: nṝn stotṝn pāhy aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: protect the praising men from distress.

children.text: Chapter 780
pra te dhārā asaścato divo na yanti vṛṣṭayaḥ
children.translated_text: Your unceasing streams go forth like rains from heaven,

children.text: acchā vājaṃ sahasriṇam ||
children.translated_text: toward the prize rich in thousands.

children.text: abhi priyāṇi kāvyā viśvā cakṣāṇo arṣati
children.translated_text: Seeing all beloved poetic utterances, he flows,

children.text: haris tuñjāna āyudhā ||
children.translated_text: the tawny one sharpening his weapons.

children.text: sa marmṛjāna āyubhir ibho rājeva suvrataḥ
children.translated_text: He, being rubbed clean by the life-powers, like an elephant, like a king of good vows,

children.text: śyeno na vaṃsu ṣīdati ||
children.translated_text: settles like a falcon among the good things.

children.text: sa no viśvā divo vasūto pṛthivyā adhi
children.translated_text: Bring us all goods from heaven and from earth,
