children.text: punāna indav ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: O purifying drop.

children.text: Chapter 781
tarat sa mandī dhāvati dhārā sutasyāndhasaḥ
children.translated_text: The exhilarating stream of the pressed draught runs swiftly;

children.text: tarat sa mandī dhāvati ||
children.translated_text: that exhilarating one runs swiftly.

children.text: usrā veda vasūnām martasya devy avasaḥ
children.translated_text: The bright divine one knows the goods and aid of the mortal;

children.text: tarat sa mandī dhāvati ||
children.translated_text: that exhilarating one runs swiftly.

children.text: dhvasrayoḥ puruṣantyor ā sahasrāṇi dadmahe
children.translated_text: To the two who are dark and dwell among men we give thousands;

children.text: tarat sa mandī dhāvati ||
children.translated_text: that exhilarating one runs swiftly.

children.text: ā yayos triṃśataṃ tanā sahasrāṇi ca dadmahe
children.translated_text: To those two we give thirty descendants and thousands besides;

children.text: tarat sa mandī dhāvati ||
children.translated_text: that exhilarating one runs swiftly.

children.text: Chapter 782
pavasva gojid aśvajid viśvajit soma raṇyajit
children.translated_text: Flow as cow-winner, horse-winner, all-winner, O <s>Soma</s>, winner of delight in battle;

children.text: prajāvad ratnam ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: bring a treasure rich in offspring.

children.text: pavasvādbhyo adābhyaḥ pavasvauṣadhībhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Flow for the waters, invincible; flow for the plants;

children.text: pavasva dhiṣaṇābhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: flow for the inspirations.

children.text: tvaṃ soma pavamāno viśvāni duritā tara
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Soma Pavamāna</s>, cross beyond all evils;

children.text: kaviḥ sīda ni barhiṣi ||
children.translated_text: as a seer, sit down on the sacred grass.

children.text: pavamāna svar vido jāyamāno 'bhavo mahān
children.translated_text: O <s>Pavamāna</s>, finder of the sun-world, being born you became great,

children.text: indo viśvāṁ abhīd asi ||
children.translated_text: O drop, you have reached all things.

children.text: Chapter 783
pra gāyatreṇa gāyata pavamānaṃ vicarṣaṇim
children.translated_text: Sing forth with the Gāyatra chant to <s>Pavamāna</s>, who ranges among the peoples.

children.text: induṃ sahasracakṣasam ||
children.translated_text: the thousand-eyed <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: taṃ tvā sahasracakṣasam atho sahasrabharṇasam
children.translated_text: That thousand-eyed one, you, and also the thousand-sustaining one,

children.text: ati vāram apāviṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: they have purified beyond the covering.

children.text: ati vārān pavamāno asiṣyadat kalaśāṁ abhi dhāvati
children.translated_text: Flowing purified, he has streamed beyond the coverings; he runs toward the bowls,

children.text: indrasya hārdy āviśan ||
children.translated_text: entering the heart of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: indrasya soma rādhase śam pavasva vicarṣaṇe
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, for <s>Indra</s>'s bounty flow with blessing, O all-observing one;

children.text: prajāvad reta ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: bring seed rich in offspring.

children.text: Chapter 784
ayā vītī pari srava yas ta indo madeṣv ā
children.translated_text: With this course flow around, O <s>Indu</s>, you who, in the exhilarations,

children.text: avāhan navatīr nava ||
children.translated_text: brought down the ninety-nine.

children.text: puraḥ sadya itthādhiye divodāsāya śambaram
children.translated_text: Immediately, for such insight, you brought the forts and <s>Śambara</s>

children.text: adha tyaṃ turvaśaṃ yadum ||
children.translated_text: for <s>Divodāsa</s>, and then that <s>Turvaśa</s> and <s>Yadu</s>.

children.text: pari ṇo aśvam aśvavid gomad indo hiraṇyavat
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, knower of horses, flow around for us with horses, with cattle, and with gold;

children.text: kṣarā sahasriṇīr iṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: stream forth thousandfold nourishments.

children.text: pavamānasya te vayam pavitram abhyundataḥ
children.translated_text: We choose the friendship of you, the purifying one,

children.text: sakhitvam ā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: as you wet the filter.

children.text: ye te pavitram ūrmayo 'bhikṣaranti dhārayā
children.translated_text: Those waves of yours that pour over the filter with their stream,

children.text: tebhir naḥ soma mṛﾱaya ||
children.translated_text: with them, O <s>Soma</s>, be gracious to us.

children.text: sa naḥ punāna ā bhara rayiṃ vīravatīm iṣam
children.translated_text: Being purified, bring us wealth, nourishment rich in heroes,

children.text: īśānaḥ soma viśvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, ruling on every side.

children.text: etam u tyaṃ daśa kṣipo mṛjanti sindhumātaram
children.translated_text: The ten fingers cleanse this one, that river-mothered one;

children.text: sam ādityebhir akhyata ||
children.translated_text: he has appeared together with the <s>Ādityas</s>.

children.text: sam indreṇota vāyunā suta eti pavitra ā
children.translated_text: Pressed out, he goes to the filter together with <s>Indra</s> and with <s>Vāyu</s>,

children.text: saṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: together with the rays of <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: sa no bhagāya vāyave pūṣṇe pavasva madhumān
children.translated_text: Flow for us, honey-sweet, for <s>Bhaga</s>, for <s>Vāyu</s>, for <s>Pūṣan</s>,

children.text: cārur mitre varuṇe ca ||
children.translated_text: lovely for <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: uccā te jātam andhaso divi ṣad bhūmy ā dade
children.translated_text: High in heaven is your birth from the Soma-plant; on earth I take hold of

children.text: ugraṃ śarma mahi śravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: fierce shelter and great fame.

children.text: enā viśvāny arya ā dyumnāni mānuṣāṇām
children.translated_text: With this, O noble one, all the splendors of human beings

children.text: siṣāsanto vanāmahe ||
children.translated_text: we seek to win.

children.text: sa na indrāya yajyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s>, worthy of sacrifice, for <s>Varuṇa</s>, and for the <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: varivovit pari srava ||
children.translated_text: flow around as a finder of wide space.

children.text: upo ṣu jātam apturaṃ gobhir bhaṅgam pariṣkṛtam
children.translated_text: The gods have set in motion the newborn, swift-working, cow-adorned, polished

children.text: induṃ devā ayāsiṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: tam id vardhantu no giro vatsaṃ saṃśiśvarīr iva
children.translated_text: Let our songs strengthen him, like mother cows lowing over a calf,

children.text: ya indrasya hṛdaṃsaniḥ ||
children.translated_text: him who wins <s>Indra</s>'s heart.

children.text: arṣā ṇaḥ soma śaṃ gave dhukṣasva pipyuṣīm iṣam
children.translated_text: Flow for us, O <s>Soma</s>, with blessing for the cow; milk out swelling nourishment;

children.text: vardhā samudram ukthyam ||
children.translated_text: increase the hymn-worthy ocean.

children.text: pavamāno ajījanad divaś citraṃ na tanyatum
children.translated_text: The purifying one has generated, like the wondrous thunder from heaven,

children.text: jyotir vaiśvānaram bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: the great universal light.

children.text: pavamānasya te raso mado rājann aducchunaḥ
children.translated_text: Your juice, O king, the exhilaration of the purifying one, free from harm,

children.text: vi vāram avyam arṣati ||
children.translated_text: flows through the sheep's-wool covering.

children.text: pavamāna rasas tava dakṣo vi rājati dyumān
children.translated_text: O purifying one, your juice, your skill, shines forth brilliantly;

children.text: jyotir viśvaṃ svar dṛśe ||
children.translated_text: the light, the whole heaven, is for seeing.

children.text: yas te mado vareṇyas tenā pavasvāndhasā
children.translated_text: With that desirable exhilaration of yours, purify yourself with the Soma-plant,

children.text: devāvīr aghaśaṃsahā ||
children.translated_text: favoring the gods and slaying evil speech.

children.text: jaghnir vṛtram amitriyaṃ sasnir vājaṃ dive dive
children.translated_text: You are the smiter of hostile <s>Vṛtra</s>, the winner of prize day by day;

children.text: goṣā u aśvasā asi ||
children.translated_text: you are winning cows and winning horses.

children.text: sammiślo aruṣo bhava sūpasthābhir na dhenubhiḥ
children.translated_text: Become mixed together, ruddy one, with fair seats like milch cows;

children.text: sīdañchyeno na yonim ā ||
children.translated_text: sit down like an eagle in its nest.

children.text: sa pavasva ya āvithendraṃ vṛtrāya hantave
children.translated_text: Flow purified, you who aided <s>Indra</s> for the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>,

children.text: vavrivāṃsam mahīr apaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when he encompassed the great waters.

children.text: suvīrāso vayaṃ dhanā jayema soma mīḍhvaḥ
children.translated_text: Rich in good heroes, may we win wealth, O bountiful <s>Soma</s>;

children.text: punāno vardha no giraḥ ||
children.translated_text: being purified, strengthen our songs.

children.text: tvotāsas tavāvasā syāma vanvanta āmuraḥ
children.translated_text: Aided by you and by your help, may we be conquering the defiant;

children.text: soma vrateṣu jāgṛhi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, keep watch over the sacred ordinances.

children.text: apaghnan pavate mṛdho 'pa somo arāvṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Soma flows, striking away enemies, striking away the ungenerous,

children.text: gacchann indrasya niṣkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: going to <s>Indra</s>'s prepared place.

children.text: maho no rāya ā bhara pavamāna jahī mṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: Bring us great wealth, O purifying one; strike down enemies;

children.text: rāsvendo vīravad yaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: grant, O <s>Indu</s>, glory rich in heroes.

children.text: na tvā śataṃ cana hruto rādho ditsantam ā minan
children.translated_text: Not even a hundred deceivers can diminish you as you wish to give bounty,

children.text: yat punāno makhasyase ||
children.translated_text: when, being purified, you make yourself powerful.

children.text: pavasvendo vṛṣā sutaḥ kṛdhī no yaśaso jane
children.translated_text: Flow purified, O <s>Indu</s>, a pressed bull; make us renowned among the people;

children.text: viśvā apa dviṣo jahi ||
children.translated_text: drive away all hatreds.

children.text: asya te sakhye vayaṃ tavendo dyumna uttame
children.translated_text: In this friendship of yours, O <s>Indu</s>, in your highest splendor,

children.text: sāsahyāma pṛtanyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: may we overcome those who fight against us.

children.text: yā te bhīmāny āyudhā tigmāni santi dhūrvaṇe
children.translated_text: Those fearsome weapons of yours, the sharp ones, are for harming the hostile;

children.text: rakṣā samasya no nidaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with them protect us from every reviler.

children.text: Chapter 785
ete asṛgram indavas tiraḥ pavitram āśavaḥ
children.translated_text: These swift drops have been released through the filter,

children.text: viśvāny abhi saubhagā ||
children.translated_text: toward all good fortunes.

children.text: vighnanto duritā puru sugā tokāya vājinaḥ
children.translated_text: Breaking many evils, the vigorous ones make easy paths

children.text: tanā kṛṇvanto arvate ||
children.translated_text: for offspring and for the courser.

children.text: kṛṇvanto varivo gave 'bhy arṣanti suṣṭutim
children.translated_text: Making wide space for the cow, they flow toward good praise,

children.text: iﾱām asmabhyaṃ saṃyatam ||
children.translated_text: bringing refreshment, controlled for us.

children.text: asāvy aṃśur madāyāpsu dakṣo giriṣṭhāḥ
children.translated_text: The shoot has been pressed for exhilaration in the waters, skillful, mountain-dwelling;

children.text: śyeno na yonim āsadat ||
children.translated_text: like an eagle it has sat down in its nest.

children.text: śubhram andho devavātam apsu dhūto nṛbhiḥ sutaḥ
children.translated_text: The bright Soma-draught, sent by the gods, shaken in the waters and pressed by men,

children.text: svadanti gāvaḥ payobhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: the cows sweeten with their milk.

children.text: ād īm aśvaṃ na hetāro 'śūśubhann amṛtāya
children.translated_text: Then, like handlers adorning a horse, they have adorned for immortality

children.text: madhvo rasaṃ sadhamāde ||
children.translated_text: the honeyed juice at the common feast.

children.text: yās te dhārā madhuścuto 'sṛgram inda ūtaye
children.translated_text: Those streams of yours, honey-dropping, have been released, O <s>Indu</s>, for aid;

children.text: tābhiḥ pavitram āsadaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with them you have taken your seat upon the filter.

children.text: so arṣendrāya pītaye tiro romāṇy avyayā
children.translated_text: Flow, then, for <s>Indra</s> to drink, through the woolly hairs of the sheep,

children.text: sīdan yonā vaneṣv ā ||
children.translated_text: sitting in the womb, among the wooden vats.

children.text: tvam indo pari srava svādiṣṭho aṅgirobhyaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indu</s>, flow around, sweetest for the <s>Aṅgirases</s>,

children.text: varivovid ghṛtam payaḥ ||
children.translated_text: finder of wide space, ghee and milk.

children.text: ayaṃ vicarṣaṇir hitaḥ pavamānaḥ sa cetati
children.translated_text: This purifying one, active among men, set in place, is conscious,

children.text: hinvāna āpyam bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: being impelled toward the great watery realm.

children.text: eṣa vṛṣā vṛṣavrataḥ pavamāno aśastihā
children.translated_text: This bull, whose ordinance is bullish, the purifying slayer of ill praise,

children.text: karad vasūni dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: will make goods for the worshipper.

children.text: ā pavasva sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ gomantam aśvinam
children.translated_text: Flow here, bringing thousandfold wealth, rich in cattle and horses,

children.text: puruścandram puruspṛham ||
children.translated_text: much-brilliant and much-desired.

children.text: eṣa sya pari ṣicyate marmṛjyamāna āyubhiḥ
children.translated_text: This one is poured around, being cleansed by vital powers,

children.text: urugāyaḥ kavikratuḥ ||
children.translated_text: far-praised and sage-minded.

children.text: sahasrotiḥ śatāmagho vimāno rajasaḥ kaviḥ
children.translated_text: The exhilaration with thousandfold help and hundredfold bounty, the sage measuring out the midspace,

children.text: indrāya pavate madaḥ ||
children.translated_text: flows purified for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: girā jāta iha stuta indur indrāya dhīyate
children.translated_text: Born here through song and praised, <s>Indu</s> is placed for <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: vir yonā vasatāv iva ||
children.translated_text: spreading in the womb as in a dwelling.

children.text: pavamānaḥ suto nṛbhiḥ somo vājam ivāsarat
children.translated_text: The purifying <s>Soma</s>, pressed by men, has flowed like a prize

children.text: camūṣu śakmanāsadam ||
children.translated_text: into the bowls, taking his seat with power.

children.text: taṃ tripṛṣṭhe trivandhure rathe yuñjanti yātave
children.translated_text: They yoke him on the three-backed, three-seated chariot for the journey,

children.text: ṛṣīṇāṃ sapta dhītibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: with the seven inspired thoughts of the seers.

children.text: taṃ sotāro dhanaspṛtam āśuṃ vājāya yātave
children.translated_text: The pressers impel that wealth-seeking, swift, tawny, prize-winning one

children.text: hariṃ hinota vājinam ||
children.translated_text: to go for the prize.

children.text: āviśan kalaśaṃ suto viśvā arṣann abhi śriyaḥ
children.translated_text: Pressed out, entering the bowl, he flows toward all splendors;

children.text: śūro na goṣu tiṣṭhati ||
children.translated_text: he stands like a hero among the cows.

children.text: ā ta indo madāya kam payo duhanty āyavaḥ
children.translated_text: Here, for exhilaration, O <s>Indu</s>, the men milk out the milk,

children.text: devā devebhyo madhu ||
children.translated_text: the god's honey for the gods.

children.text: ā naḥ somam pavitra ā sṛjatā madhumattamam
children.translated_text: Pour forth for us through the filter the sweetest <s>Soma</s>,

children.text: devebhyo devaśruttamam ||
children.translated_text: the god most heard among the gods.

children.text: ete somā asṛkṣata gṛṇānāḥ śravase mahe
children.translated_text: These <s>Somas</s> have been let flow, being praised, for great fame,

children.text: madintamasya dhārayā ||
children.translated_text: with the stream of the most intoxicating one.

children.text: abhi gavyāni vītaye nṛmṇā punāno arṣasi
children.translated_text: You flow, being purified, toward the cow-rich prizes for enjoyment, toward manly powers;

children.text: sanadvājaḥ pari srava ||
children.translated_text: flow around, bringing strength from of old.

children.text: uta no gomatīr iṣo viśvā arṣa pariṣṭubhaḥ
children.translated_text: And flow forth for us with all cow-rich foods, sounding loudly,

children.text: gṛṇāno jamadagninā ||
children.translated_text: being praised by <s>Jamadagni</s>.

children.text: pavasva vāco agriyaḥ soma citrābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Purify yourself, foremost of voices, O <s>Soma</s>, with manifold helps,

children.text: abhi viśvāni kāvyā ||
children.translated_text: toward all poetic inspirations.

children.text: tvaṃ samudriyā apo 'griyo vāca īrayan
children.translated_text: You, foremost, set in motion the waters of the sea and the voices;

children.text: pavasva viśvamejaya ||
children.translated_text: purify yourself, shaker of all.

children.text: tubhyemā bhuvanā kave mahimne soma tasthire
children.translated_text: For you, O poet <s>Soma</s>, these beings have stood firm, for your greatness;

children.text: tubhyam arṣanti sindhavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for you the rivers flow.

children.text: pra te divo na vṛṣṭayo dhārā yanty asaścataḥ
children.translated_text: Like rains from heaven, your streams go unceasingly

children.text: abhi śukrām upastiram ||
children.translated_text: toward the bright woolen seat.

children.text: indrāyendum punītanograṃ dakṣāya sādhanam
children.translated_text: Purify the <s>Indu</s> for <s>Indra</s>, fierce, a means for skill,

children.text: īśānaṃ vītirādhasam ||
children.translated_text: a lord, bestower of enjoyment and bounty.

children.text: pavamāna ṛtaḥ kaviḥ somaḥ pavitram āsadat
children.translated_text: The purifying <s>Soma</s>, true and wise, has sat down upon the filter,

children.text: dadhat stotre suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: placing good heroic strength in the singer.

children.text: Chapter 786
ā pavasva sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ soma suvīryam
children.translated_text: Purify yourself toward thousandfold wealth, O <s>Soma</s>, with good heroic strength;

children.text: asme śravāṃsi dhāraya ||
children.translated_text: hold glories for us.

children.text: iṣam ūrjaṃ ca pinvasa indrāya matsarintamaḥ
children.translated_text: Swell nourishment and vigor; most exhilarating for <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: camūṣv ā ni ṣīdasi ||
children.translated_text: you sit down in the wooden vats.

children.text: suta indrāya viṣṇave somaḥ kalaśe akṣarat
children.translated_text: Pressed for <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>Soma</s> has flowed into the bowl;

children.text: madhumāṁ astu vāyave ||
children.translated_text: may he be honey-sweet for <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: ete asṛgram āśavo 'ti hvarāṃsi babhravaḥ
children.translated_text: These swift tawny <s>Somas</s> have been let loose past the crooked places,

children.text: somā ṛtasya dhārayā ||
children.translated_text: with the stream of truth.

children.text: indraṃ vardhanto apturaḥ kṛṇvanto viśvam āryam
children.translated_text: Increasing <s>Indra</s>, active in the waters, making the whole world noble,

children.text: apaghnanto arāvṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: driving away the hostile ones.

children.text: sutā anu svam ā rajo 'bhy arṣanti babhravaḥ
children.translated_text: Pressed, following their own realm, the tawny drops flow onward,

children.text: indraṃ gacchanta indavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Indus</s> going to <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: ayā pavasva dhārayā yayā sūryam arocayaḥ
children.translated_text: Purify yourself with that stream by which you made the sun shine,

children.text: hinvāno mānuṣīr apaḥ ||
children.translated_text: impelling the human waters.

children.text: ayukta sūra etaśam pavamāno manāv adhi
children.translated_text: The purifying one has yoked the sun's tawny steed, upon man,

children.text: antarikṣeṇa yātave ||
children.translated_text: to travel through the midspace.

children.text: uta tyā harito daśa sūro ayukta yātave
children.translated_text: And the sun has yoked those ten tawny mares for the journey,

children.text: indur indra iti bruvan ||
children.translated_text: while <s>Indu</s> cries, "For <s>Indra</s>!"

children.text: parīto vāyave sutaṃ gira indrāya matsaram
children.translated_text: Around this pressed draught for <s>Vāyu</s>, this exhilaration for <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: avyo vāreṣu siñcata ||
children.translated_text: pour the songs upon the sheep-wool filters.

children.text: pavamāna vidā rayim asmabhyaṃ soma duṣṭaram
children.translated_text: O purifying <s>Soma</s>, find for us wealth hard to assail,

children.text: yo dūṇāśo vanuṣyatā ||
children.translated_text: which may overcome the injurious attacker.

children.text: abhy arṣa sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ gomantam aśvinam
children.translated_text: Flow forth toward thousandfold wealth rich in cattle and horses,

children.text: abhi vājam uta śravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: toward prize and also fame.

children.text: somo devo na sūryo 'dribhiḥ pavate sutaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, like the god <s>Sūrya</s>, pressed with stones, is purified,

children.text: dadhānaḥ kalaśe rasam ||
children.translated_text: holding his juice in the bowl.

children.text: ete dhāmāny āryā śukrā ṛtasya dhārayā
children.translated_text: These bright noble abodes, with the stream of truth,

children.text: vājaṃ gomantam akṣaran ||
children.translated_text: have flowed toward a cow-rich prize.

children.text: sutā indrāya vajriṇe somāso dadhyāśiraḥ
children.translated_text: Pressed for <s>Indra</s> the wielder of the bolt, the <s>Somas</s>, mixed with curds,

children.text: pavitram aty akṣaran ||
children.translated_text: have flowed across the filter.

children.text: pra soma madhumattamo rāye arṣa pavitra ā
children.translated_text: Flow forth, O sweetest <s>Soma</s>, through the filter for wealth,

children.text: mado yo devavītamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the exhilaration that most seeks the gods.

children.text: tam ī mṛjanty āyavo hariṃ nadīṣu vājinam
children.translated_text: The men cleanse that tawny one, the racing <s>Indu</s>, in the streams,

children.text: indum indrāya matsaram ||
children.translated_text: the exhilaration for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: ā pavasva hiraṇyavad aśvāvat soma vīravat
children.translated_text: Purify yourself for us with gold, with horses, O <s>Soma</s>, and with heroes;

children.text: vājaṃ gomantam ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: bring the prize rich in cattle.

children.text: pari vāje na vājayum avyo vāreṣu siñcata
children.translated_text: Pour around, upon the sheep-wool filters, the one eager for the prize, like a prize-winning steed,

children.text: indrāya madhumattamam ||
children.translated_text: the sweetest one for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: kavim mṛjanti marjyaṃ dhībhir viprā avasyavaḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired sages, desiring help, cleanse the cleansable poet with their thoughts;

children.text: vṛṣā kanikrad arṣati ||
children.translated_text: the bull, bellowing, flows.

children.text: vṛṣaṇaṃ dhībhir apturaṃ somam ṛtasya dhārayā
children.translated_text: The inspired sages have sounded together around <s>Soma</s>, the bull, active in the waters,

children.text: matī viprāḥ sam asvaran ||
children.translated_text: with their thoughts and with the stream of truth.

children.text: pavasva devāyuṣag indraṃ gacchatu te madaḥ
children.translated_text: Purify yourself, joined with the gods; let your exhilaration go to <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: vāyum ā roha dharmaṇā ||
children.translated_text: mount <s>Vāyu</s> according to <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: pavamāna ni tośase rayiṃ soma śravāyyam
children.translated_text: O purifying <s>Soma</s>, for satisfaction, settle upon hymn-worthy wealth;

children.text: priyaḥ samudram ā viśa ||
children.translated_text: beloved, enter the ocean.

children.text: apaghnan pavase mṛdhaḥ kratuvit soma matsaraḥ
children.translated_text: Driving away foes, you are purified, O <s>Soma</s>, knower of intention, exhilarating;

children.text: nudasvādevayuṃ janam ||
children.translated_text: thrust away the godless people.

children.text: pavamānā asṛkṣata somāḥ śukrāsa indavaḥ
children.translated_text: The purifying <s>Somas</s>, the bright drops, have been let flow

children.text: abhi viśvāni kāvyā ||
children.translated_text: toward all poetic inspirations.

children.text: pavamānāsa āśavaḥ śubhrā asṛgram indavaḥ
children.translated_text: The purifying swift drops, shining, have been let flow,

children.text: ghnanto viśvā apa dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: striking away all hatreds.

children.text: pavamānā divas pary antarikṣād asṛkṣata
children.translated_text: The purifying ones have been let flow from heaven, through the midspace,

children.text: pṛthivyā adhi sānavi ||
children.translated_text: upon the summit of earth.

children.text: punānaḥ soma dhārayendo viśvā apa sridhaḥ
children.translated_text: Being purified with your stream, O <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indu</s>, drive away all treacheries;

children.text: jahi rakṣāṃsi sukrato ||
children.translated_text: slay the demons, O wise worker.

children.text: apaghnan soma rakṣaso 'bhy arṣa kanikradat
children.translated_text: Driving away the demons, O <s>Soma</s>, flow forth roaring,

children.text: dyumantaṃ śuṣmam uttamam ||
children.translated_text: with brilliant, highest force.

children.text: asme vasūni dhāraya soma divyāni pārthivā
children.translated_text: Hold for us goods, O <s>Soma</s>, heavenly and earthly,

children.text: indo viśvāni vāryā ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, all desirable things.

children.text: Chapter 787
vṛṣā soma dyumāṁ asi vṛṣā deva vṛṣavrataḥ
children.translated_text: You are a bull, O <s>Soma</s>, brilliant; a bull, O god, with a bull's vow;

children.text: vṛṣā dharmāṇi dadhiṣe ||
children.translated_text: as a bull you uphold the laws.

children.text: vṛṣṇas te vṛṣṇyaṃ śavo vṛṣā vanaṃ vṛṣā madaḥ
children.translated_text: Yours, a bull's, is bull-like might; the bull is the woodland, the bull the exhilaration;

children.text: satyaṃ vṛṣan vṛṣed asi ||
children.translated_text: truly, O bull, you are bulling.

children.text: aśvo na cakrado vṛṣā saṃ gā indo sam arvataḥ
children.translated_text: Like a neighing horse, O bull <s>Indu</s>, join the cows and the coursers;

children.text: vi no rāye duro vṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: open the doors for us to wealth.

children.text: asṛkṣata pra vājino gavyā somāso aśvayā
children.translated_text: The prize-winning, cow-seeking <s>Somas</s> have flowed forth, seeking horses,

children.text: śukrāso vīrayāśavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: bright, seeking heroes, swift.

children.text: śumbhamānā ṛtāyubhir mṛjyamānā gabhastyoḥ
children.translated_text: Being adorned by those devoted to truth, being cleansed by the hands,

children.text: pavante vāre avyaye ||
children.translated_text: they are purified on the imperishable woolen filter.

children.text: te viśvā dāśuṣe vasu somā divyāni pārthivā
children.translated_text: May those <s>Somas</s> be purified for the worshipper, bringing all goods, heavenly, earthly,

children.text: pavantām āntarikṣyā ||
children.translated_text: and those of the midspace.

children.text: pavamānasya viśvavit pra te sargā asṛkṣata
children.translated_text: O all-knowing one, the streams of the purifying one have flowed forth for you,

children.text: sūryasyeva na raśmayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like the rays of the sun.

children.text: ketuṃ kṛṇvan divas pari viśvā rūpābhy arṣasi
children.translated_text: Making a sign from heaven, you flow toward all forms;

children.text: samudraḥ soma pinvase ||
children.translated_text: as an ocean, O <s>Soma</s>, you swell.

children.text: hinvāno vācam iṣyasi pavamāna vidharmaṇi
children.translated_text: Being impelled, you seek the voice, O purifying one, in the ordinance;

children.text: akrān devo na sūryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you have strode forth like the god <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: induḥ paviṣṭa cetanaḥ priyaḥ kavīnām matī
children.translated_text: The conscious <s>Indu</s>, having entered the filter, dear to the poets' thought,

children.text: sṛjad aśvaṃ rathīr iva ||
children.translated_text: sends forth the horse like a charioteer.

children.text: ūrmir yas te pavitra ā devāvīḥ paryakṣarat
children.translated_text: That wave of yours, which has flowed around the filter, rich in divine aid,

children.text: sīdann ṛtasya yonim ā ||
children.translated_text: sits down toward the womb of truth.

children.text: sa no arṣa pavitra ā mado yo devavītamaḥ
children.translated_text: Flow for us through the filter, the exhilaration that most seeks the gods,

children.text: indav indrāya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, for <s>Indra</s> to drink.

children.text: iṣe pavasva dhārayā mṛjyamāno manīṣibhiḥ
children.translated_text: Purify yourself with your stream for nourishment, being cleansed by the inspired ones;

children.text: indo rucābhi gā ihi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, go toward the cows with light.

children.text: punāno varivas kṛdhy ūrjaṃ janāya girvaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Being purified, make broad space and strength for the people, O lover of song;

children.text: hare sṛjāna āśiram ||
children.translated_text: O tawny one, being poured forth, release the milk-mixture.

children.text: punāno devavītaya indrasya yāhi niṣkṛtam
children.translated_text: Being purified for the coming of the gods, go to the appointed place of <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: dyutāno vājibhir yataḥ ||
children.translated_text: shining, since you are accompanied by prize-winning powers.

children.text: pra hinvānāsa indavo 'cchā samudram āśavaḥ
children.translated_text: Driven forward, the swift drops toward the ocean

children.text: dhiyā jūtā asṛkṣata ||
children.translated_text: have been released, urged on by thought.

children.text: marmṛjānāsa āyavo vṛthā samudram indavaḥ
children.translated_text: The active drops, cleansing themselves, freely

children.text: agmann ṛtasya yonim ā ||
children.translated_text: have gone to the ocean, to the womb of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: pari ṇo yāhy asmayur viśvā vasūny ojasā
children.translated_text: Go around us, desiring us, with strength and all good things;

children.text: pāhi naḥ śarma vīravat ||
children.translated_text: protect our shelter, rich in heroes.

children.text: mimāti vahnir etaśaḥ padaṃ yujāna ṛkvabhiḥ
children.translated_text: The bright carrier measures out the track, yoking himself with verses,

children.text: pra yat samudra āhitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when he has been set forth in the ocean.

children.text: ā yad yoniṃ hiraṇyayam āśur ṛtasya sīdati
children.translated_text: When the swift one sits down in the golden womb of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order),

children.text: jahāty apracetasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he leaves the unthinking behind.

children.text: abhi venā anūṣateyakṣanti pracetasaḥ
children.translated_text: The discerning ones sing around him with longing; they seek to worship;

children.text: majjanty avicetasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the undiscerning sink down.

children.text: indrāyendo marutvate pavasva madhumattamaḥ
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s>, accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, O drop, flow, most sweet with honey,

children.text: ṛtasya yonim āsadam ||
children.translated_text: to sit in the womb of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: taṃ tvā viprā vacovidaḥ pariṣkṛṇvanti vedhasaḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired sages, knowing speech, the ordainers, adorn you;

children.text: saṃ tvā mṛjanty āyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the active ones cleanse you together.

children.text: rasaṃ te mitro aryamā pibanti varuṇaḥ kave
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s>, O seer, drink your sap,

children.text: pavamānasya marutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and the <s>Maruts</s> drink that of the flowing one.

children.text: tvaṃ soma vipaścitam punāno vācam iṣyasi
children.translated_text: You, <s>Soma</s>, being purified, set inspired speech in motion,

children.text: indo sahasrabharṇasam ||
children.translated_text: O drop, bringing a thousandfold support.

children.text: uto sahasrabharṇasaṃ vācaṃ soma makhasyuvam
children.translated_text: And, O <s>Soma</s>, bring speech that bears a thousandfold support and longs for worship,

children.text: punāna indav ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: O drop, as you are purified.

children.text: punāna indav eṣām puruhūta janānām
children.translated_text: Being purified, O drop, much-invoked one, beloved of these peoples,

children.text: priyaḥ samudram ā viśa ||
children.translated_text: enter the ocean.

children.text: davidyutatyā rucā pariṣṭobhantyā kṛpā
children.translated_text: With flashing brilliance, with beauty that resounds around,

children.text: somāḥ śukrā gavāśiraḥ ||
children.translated_text: the bright <s>Somas</s>, mixed with milk, shine.

children.text: hinvāno hetṛbhir yata ā vājaṃ vājy akramīt
children.translated_text: Impelled by the pressers, held in course, the prize-winning one has stepped to the prize,

children.text: sīdanto vanuṣo yathā ||
children.translated_text: settling down as conquerors do.

children.text: ṛdhak soma svastaye saṃjagmāno divaḥ kaviḥ
children.translated_text: Separately, O <s>Soma</s>, for well-being, coming together from heaven, O seer,

children.text: pavasva sūryo dṛśe ||
children.translated_text: flow like the sun, to be seen.

children.text: Chapter 788
hinvanti sūram usrayaḥ svasāro jāmayas patim
children.translated_text: The shining cows, the sisters and kinswomen, impel the sun-bright one, their lord,

children.text: mahām indum mahīyuvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the great drop, desiring greatness.

children.text: pavamāna rucā rucā devo devebhyas pari
children.translated_text: O flowing one, with brightness upon brightness, O god, go around for the gods,

children.text: viśvā vasūny ā viśa ||
children.translated_text: and enter all good things.

children.text: ā pavamāna suṣṭutiṃ vṛṣṭiṃ devebhyo duvaḥ
children.translated_text: Bring good praise, O flowing one, rain, and service for the gods;

children.text: iṣe pavasva saṃyatam ||
children.translated_text: flow, restrained, for refreshment.

children.text: vṛṣā hy asi bhānunā dyumantaṃ tvā havāmahe
children.translated_text: For you are a bull by your radiance; we call on you, shining,

children.text: pavamāna svādhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O flowing one, rich in good thought.

children.text: ā pavasva suvīryam mandamānaḥ svāyudha
children.translated_text: Flow here with excellent heroic power, rejoicing, O well-armed one;

children.text: iho ṣv indav ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: come hither, O drop.

children.text: yad adbhiḥ pariṣicyase mṛjyamāno gabhastyoḥ
children.translated_text: When you are sprinkled around with the waters, cleansed by the hands,

children.text: druṇā sadhastham aśnuṣe ||
children.translated_text: you reach the seat in the wooden vessel.

children.text: pra somāya vyaśvavat pavamānāya gāyata
children.translated_text: Sing to <s>Soma</s>, as to <s>Vyaśva</s>, to the flowing one,

children.text: mahe sahasracakṣase ||
children.translated_text: to the great thousand-eyed one.

children.text: yasya varṇam madhuścutaṃ hariṃ hinvanty adribhiḥ
children.translated_text: His honey-dripping tawny color they impel with the stones,

children.text: indum indrāya pītaye ||
children.translated_text: the drop, for <s>Indra</s> to drink.

children.text: tasya te vājino vayaṃ viśvā dhanāni jigyuṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Of you, the prize-winning one who would win all riches,

children.text: sakhitvam ā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: we choose the friendship.

children.text: vṛṣā pavasva dhārayā marutvate ca matsaraḥ
children.translated_text: Flow as a bull in the stream, exhilarating for <s>Marutvat</s>,

children.text: viśvā dadhāna ojasā ||
children.translated_text: placing all things with strength.

children.text: taṃ tvā dhartāram oṇyoḥ pavamāna svardṛśam
children.translated_text: You, O flowing one, supporter of the two worlds, seeing the sunlight,

children.text: hinve vājeṣu vājinam ||
children.translated_text: I impel in the contests, the prize-winning one.

children.text: ayā citto vipānayā hariḥ pavasva dhārayā
children.translated_text: With this inspired insight, O tawny one, flow in a stream;

children.text: yujaṃ vājeṣu codaya ||
children.translated_text: urge on your yoke-fellow in the contests.

children.text: ā na indo mahīm iṣam pavasva viśvadarśataḥ
children.translated_text: Flow to us, O drop, great refreshment, visible to all,

children.text: asmabhyaṃ soma gātuvit ||
children.translated_text: for us, O <s>Soma</s>, finder of the path.

children.text: ā kalaśā anūṣatendo dhārābhir ojasā
children.translated_text: The beakers have called to you, O drop, with streams and strength;

children.text: endrasya pītaye viśa ||
children.translated_text: enter for <s>Indra</s>'s drinking.

children.text: yasya te madyaṃ rasaṃ tīvraṃ duhanty adribhiḥ
children.translated_text: Your intoxicating, sharp sap they milk with the stones;

children.text: sa pavasvābhimātihā ||
children.translated_text: flow, you who slay attackers.

children.text: rājā medhābhir īyate pavamāno manāv adhi
children.translated_text: The king, the flowing one, is set in motion by inspired thoughts on behalf of <s>Manu</s>,

children.text: antarikṣeṇa yātave ||
children.translated_text: to travel through the midspace.

children.text: ā na indo śatagvinaṃ gavām poṣaṃ svaśvyam
children.translated_text: Bring to us, O drop, hundred-cowed nurture of cows and wealth in good horses,

children.text: vahā bhagattim ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: and fortune as help.

children.text: ā naḥ soma saho juvo rūpaṃ na varcase bhara
children.translated_text: Bring to us, O <s>Soma</s>, strength swiftly, and form for brilliance,

children.text: suṣvāṇo devavītaye ||
children.translated_text: well-pressed, for the coming of the gods.

children.text: arṣā soma dyumattamo 'bhi droṇāni roruvat
children.translated_text: Rush, O <s>Soma</s>, most radiant, bellowing toward the troughs,

children.text: sīdañchyeno na yonim ā ||
children.translated_text: settling like a falcon into its womb.

children.text: apsā indrāya vāyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ
children.translated_text: With the waters <s>Soma</s> flows for <s>Indra</s>, for <s>Vāyu</s>, for <s>Varuṇa</s>, and for the <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: somo arṣati viṣṇave ||
children.translated_text: and for <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

children.text: iṣaṃ tokāya no dadhad asmabhyaṃ soma viśvataḥ
children.translated_text: Giving refreshment for our offspring, O <s>Soma</s>, from every side,

children.text: ā pavasva sahasriṇam ||
children.translated_text: flow to us with a thousandfold gift.

children.text: ye somāsaḥ parāvati ye arvāvati sunvire
children.translated_text: The <s>Somas</s> that were pressed in the distance, those nearby,

children.text: ye vādaḥ śaryaṇāvati ||
children.translated_text: and those here in <s>Śaryaṇāvat</s>,

children.text: ya ārjīkeṣu kṛtvasu ye madhye pastyānām
children.translated_text: those made among the <s>Ārjīkas</s>, those in the midst of dwellings,

children.text: ye vā janeṣu pañcasu ||
children.translated_text: and those among the five peoples,

children.text: te no vṛṣṭiṃ divas pari pavantām ā suvīryam
children.translated_text: may those gods, the pressed drops, flow from heaven for us with rain,

children.text: suvānā devāsa indavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with excellent heroic strength.

children.text: pavate haryato harir gṛṇāno jamadagninā
children.translated_text: The desirable tawny one flows, sung by <s>Jamadagni</s>,

children.text: hinvāno gor adhi tvaci ||
children.translated_text: impelled upon the cow's hide.

children.text: pra śukrāso vayojuvo hinvānāso na saptayaḥ
children.translated_text: The bright ones, life-quickening, driven like racehorses,

children.text: śrīṇānā apsu mṛñjata ||
children.translated_text: mixing in the waters, cleanse themselves.

children.text: taṃ tvā suteṣv ābhuvo hinvire devatātaye
children.translated_text: In the pressings the worshipful ones have impelled you for divine service;

children.text: sa pavasvānayā rucā ||
children.translated_text: flow with this radiance.

children.text: ā te dakṣam mayobhuvaṃ vahnim adyā vṛṇīmahe
children.translated_text: Today we choose your skill, joy-bringing, the carrier,

children.text: pāntam ā puruspṛham ||
children.translated_text: the protector, much-desired.

children.text: ā mandram ā vareṇyam ā vipram ā manīṣiṇam
children.translated_text: We choose the delightful one, the worthy one, the inspired sage, the thinker,

children.text: pāntam ā puruspṛham ||
children.translated_text: the protector, much-desired.

children.text: ā rayim ā sucetunam ā sukrato tanūṣv ā
children.translated_text: We choose wealth, the well-minded one; O good-willed one, come into our bodies,

children.text: pāntam ā puruspṛham ||
children.translated_text: the protector, much-desired.

children.text: Chapter 789
pavasva viśvacarṣaṇe 'bhi viśvāni kāvyā
children.translated_text: Flow, O you who are for all peoples, over all poetic inspirations,

children.text: sakhā sakhibhya īḍyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: a friend, praiseworthy for friends.

children.text: tābhyāṃ viśvasya rājasi ye pavamāna dhāmanī
children.translated_text: By those two realms you rule the whole world, O flowing <s>Soma</s>,

children.text: pratīcī soma tasthatuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the two stations that stand facing you.

children.text: pari dhāmāni yāni te tvaṃ somāsi viśvataḥ
children.translated_text: Around your stations, wherever they are, you are <s>Soma</s> on every side,

children.text: pavamāna ṛtubhiḥ kave ||
children.translated_text: O flowing seer, according to the seasons.

children.text: pavasva janayann iṣo 'bhi viśvāni vāryā
children.translated_text: Flow, generating refreshments, over all desirable things,

children.text: sakhā sakhibhya ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: a friend for the help of friends.

children.text: tava śukrāso arcayo divas pṛṣṭhe vi tanvate
children.translated_text: Your bright rays stretch out over the back of heaven;

children.text: pavitraṃ soma dhāmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: your filter, O <s>Soma</s>, with its stations.

children.text: taveme sapta sindhavaḥ praśiṣaṃ soma sisrate
children.translated_text: These seven rivers run forth at your command, O <s>Soma</s>;

children.text: tubhyaṃ dhāvanti dhenavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the milch-cows run for you.

children.text: pra soma yāhi dhārayā suta indrāya matsaraḥ
children.translated_text: Go forth, O <s>Soma</s>, with the stream, pressed and exhilarating for <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: dadhāno akṣiti śravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: bearing imperishable fame.

children.text: sam u tvā dhībhir asvaran hinvatīḥ sapta jāmayaḥ
children.translated_text: Together the seven sister-streams have sounded for you with their inspired thoughts as they urge you on,

children.text: vipram ājā vivasvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: the inspired sage born of <s>Vivasvat</s>.

children.text: mṛjanti tvā sam agruvo 'vye jīrāv adhi ṣvaṇi
children.translated_text: The attentive maidens cleanse you together upon the woolen filter, on the swift-sounding fleece,

children.text: rebho yad ajyase vane ||
children.translated_text: when, O singer, you are anointed in the wooden vessel.

children.text: pavamānasya te kave vājin sargā asṛkṣata
children.translated_text: For you, O inspired poet, O prize-winning one, the outpourings of the flowing <s>Soma</s> have been released,

children.text: arvanto na śravasyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like horses eager for fame.

children.text: acchā kośam madhuścutam asṛgraṃ vāre avyaye
children.translated_text: Toward the honey-dripping vat, into the imperishable woolen strainer, they have been released;

children.text: avāvaśanta dhītayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the inspired thoughts have cried aloud.

children.text: acchā samudram indavo 'staṃ gāvo na dhenavaḥ
children.translated_text: The drops have gone toward the ocean, toward their home, like milch-cows,

children.text: agmann ṛtasya yonim ā ||
children.translated_text: toward the womb of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: pra ṇa indo mahe raṇa āpo arṣanti sindhavaḥ
children.translated_text: For us, O drop, toward the great contest the waters flow forth, the rivers,

children.text: yad gobhir vāsayiṣyase ||
children.translated_text: when you will be clothed with the cows.

children.text: asya te sakhye vayam iyakṣantas tvotayaḥ
children.translated_text: In this friendship of yours, wishing to worship and aided by you,

children.text: indo sakhitvam uśmasi ||
children.translated_text: O drop, we desire your friendship.

children.text: ā pavasva gaviṣṭaye mahe soma nṛcakṣase
children.translated_text: Flow here for the winning of cows, O <s>Soma</s>, for the great man-seeing one;

children.text: endrasya jaṭhare viśa ||
children.translated_text: enter into the belly of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: mahāṁ asi soma jyeṣṭha ugrāṇām inda ojiṣṭhaḥ
children.translated_text: You are great, O <s>Soma</s>, greatest among the mighty; O drop, strongest,

children.text: yudhvā sañchaśvaj jigetha ||
children.translated_text: fighting, you have conquered always.

children.text: ya ugrebhyaś cid ojīyāñchūrebhyaś cicchūrataraḥ
children.translated_text: You are stronger even than the strong, more heroic even than heroes,

children.text: bhūridābhyaś cin maṃhīyān ||
children.translated_text: more generous even than the lavish givers.

children.text: tvaṃ soma sūra eṣas tokasya sātā tanūnām
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Soma</s>, are a hero in the winning of offspring and of our bodies;

children.text: vṛṇīmahe sakhyāya vṛṇīmahe yujyāya ||
children.translated_text: we choose you for friendship; we choose you for alliance.

children.text: agna āyūṃṣi pavasa ā suvorjam iṣaṃ ca naḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, purify our lifespans; bring here refreshment and nourishment for us,

children.text: āre bādhasva ducchunām ||
children.translated_text: and drive evil fortune far away.

children.text: agnir ṛṣiḥ pavamānaḥ pāñcajanyaḥ purohitaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, the seer, the flowing one, born among the five peoples, the household priest,

children.text: tam īmahe mahāgayam ||
children.translated_text: him we seek, the greatly invoked one.

children.text: agne pavasva svapā asme varcaḥ suvīryam
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, flow pure, working well, placing in us brilliance and heroic strength,

children.text: dadhad rayim mayi poṣam ||
children.translated_text: wealth in me, and prosperity.

children.text: pavamāno ati sridho 'bhy arṣati suṣṭutim
children.translated_text: The flowing one passes beyond assailants; he streams forth toward good praise,

children.text: sūro na viśvadarśataḥ ||
children.translated_text: like the sun visible to all.

children.text: sa marmṛjāna āyubhiḥ prayasvān prayase hitaḥ
children.translated_text: He, being cleansed by the vital powers, rich in refreshment and set for refreshment,

children.text: indur atyo vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the drop, the discerning steed, goes forth.

children.text: pavamāna ṛtam bṛhacchukraṃ jyotir ajījanat
children.translated_text: The flowing one has generated lofty <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), the bright light,

children.text: kṛṣṇā tamāṃsi jaṅghanat ||
children.translated_text: striking down the black darknesses.

children.text: pavamānasya jaṅghnato hareś candrā asṛkṣata
children.translated_text: From the tawny one, from the flowing one as he smote, bright streams were released,

children.text: jīrā ajiraśociṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: swift, with swiftly gleaming flame.

children.text: pavamāno rathītamaḥ śubhrebhiḥ śubhraśastamaḥ
children.translated_text: The flowing one, best of charioteers, most praised with bright praises,

children.text: hariścandro marudgaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: tawny and golden-bright, is accompanied by the troop of <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: pavamāno vy aśnavad raśmibhir vājasātamaḥ
children.translated_text: The flowing one will spread out with his rays, most able to win the prize,

children.text: dadhat stotre suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: placing heroic strength in the singer.

children.text: pra suvāna indur akṣāḥ pavitram aty avyayam
children.translated_text: The pressed drop has run forth across the imperishable filter;

children.text: punāna indur indram ā ||
children.translated_text: being purified, the drop has gone to <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: eṣa somo adhi tvaci gavāṃ krīﾱaty adribhiḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s>, upon the hide of the cows, plays with the pressing stones,

children.text: indram madāya johuvat ||
children.translated_text: calling <s>Indra</s> for exhilaration.

children.text: yasya te dyumnavat payaḥ pavamānābhṛtaṃ divaḥ
children.translated_text: With that splendor-bearing milk of yours, O flowing one, brought from heaven,

children.text: tena no mṛﾱa jīvase ||
children.translated_text: with that show us mercy, that we may live.

children.text: Chapter 790
tvaṃ somāsi dhārayur mandra ojiṣṭho adhvare
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Soma</s>, are the supporter, gladdening and strongest in the sacrifice;

children.text: pavasva maṃhayadrayiḥ ||
children.translated_text: flow on, increasing wealth.

children.text: tvaṃ suto nṛmādano dadhanvān matsarintamaḥ
children.translated_text: You, when pressed, delight men; possessing the gift, most intoxicating,

children.text: indrāya sūrir andhasā ||
children.translated_text: you are the inspired giver for <s>Indra</s> with the Soma draught.

children.text: tvaṃ suṣvāṇo adribhir abhy arṣa kanikradat
children.translated_text: You, well-pressed by the stones, stream forth, roaring,

children.text: dyumantaṃ śuṣmam uttamam ||
children.translated_text: with radiant, highest force.

children.text: indur hinvāno arṣati tiro vārāṇy avyayā
children.translated_text: The drop, being impelled, flows through the imperishable woolen filters;

children.text: harir vājam acikradat ||
children.translated_text: the tawny one has roared for the prize.

children.text: indo vy avyam arṣasi vi śravāṃsi vi saubhagā
children.translated_text: O drop, you flow through the wool; spread forth fame, spread forth good fortune,

children.text: vi vājān soma gomataḥ ||
children.translated_text: spread forth prizes rich in cows, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: ā na indo śatagvinaṃ rayiṃ gomantam aśvinam
children.translated_text: Bring to us, O drop, wealth with a hundred cows, rich in cattle and horses,

children.text: bharā soma sahasriṇam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, wealth in thousands.

children.text: pavamānāsa indavas tiraḥ pavitram āśavaḥ
children.translated_text: The flowing drops, swift ones, have passed through the filter;

children.text: indraṃ yāmebhir āśata ||
children.translated_text: with their courses they have reached <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: kakuhaḥ somyo rasa indur indrāya pūrvyaḥ
children.translated_text: The high Soma sap, the ancient drop for <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: āyuḥ pavata āyave ||
children.translated_text: flows as life for the living man.

children.text: hinvanti sūram usrayaḥ pavamānam madhuścutam
children.translated_text: The dawn-cows impel the sun-like flowing one, dripping honey;

children.text: abhi girā sam asvaran ||
children.translated_text: they have sounded together around him with song.

children.text: avitā no ajāśvaḥ pūṣā yāmani yāmani
children.translated_text: May <s>Pūṣan</s> of the goat-horses be our helper on every journey;

children.text: ā bhakṣat kanyāsu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he take his share among our maidens.

children.text: ayaṃ somaḥ kapardine ghṛtaṃ na pavate madhu
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s> flows for the braided-haired one, like ghee, as honey;

children.text: ā bhakṣat kanyāsu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he take his share among our maidens.

children.text: ayaṃ ta āghṛṇe suto ghṛtaṃ na pavate śuci
children.translated_text: This pressed draught is for you, O glowing one; it flows pure like ghee;

children.text: ā bhakṣat kanyāsu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he take his share among our maidens.

children.text: vāco jantuḥ kavīnām pavasva soma dhārayā
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, creature of speech for the poets, flow in a stream;

children.text: deveṣu ratnadhā asi ||
children.translated_text: among the gods you are the holder of treasures.

children.text: ā kalaśeṣu dhāvati śyeno varma vi gāhate
children.translated_text: He runs into the bowls; like a falcon he plunges through the covering,

children.text: abhi droṇā kanikradat ||
children.translated_text: roaring toward the wooden vats.

children.text: pari pra soma te raso 'sarji kalaśe sutaḥ
children.translated_text: Your sap, O <s>Soma</s>, pressed and released, has gone around into the bowl;

children.text: śyeno na takto arṣati ||
children.translated_text: it flows like a swiftly fashioned falcon.

children.text: pavasva soma mandayann indrāya madhumattamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Flow, O <s>Soma</s>, gladdening, sweetest for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: asṛgran devavītaye vājayanto rathā iva ||
children.translated_text: They have been released for the gods' banquet, striving for the prize like chariots.

children.text: te sutāso madintamāḥ śukrā vāyum asṛkṣata ||
children.translated_text: Those pressed ones, most intoxicating and bright, have been released for <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: grāvṇā tunno abhiṣṭutaḥ pavitraṃ soma gacchasi
children.translated_text: Struck by the pressing stone and praised, O <s>Soma</s>, you go to the filter,

children.text: dadhat stotre suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: placing heroic strength in the singer.

children.text: eṣa tunno abhiṣṭutaḥ pavitram ati gāhate
children.translated_text: This one, struck and praised, plunges through the filter,

children.text: rakṣohā vāram avyayam ||
children.translated_text: slayer of demons, through the imperishable wool.

children.text: yad anti yac ca dūrake bhayaṃ vindati mām iha
children.translated_text: Whatever fear finds me here, whether near or far away,

children.text: pavamāna vi taj jahi ||
children.translated_text: O flowing one, drive that away.

children.text: pavamānaḥ so adya naḥ pavitreṇa vicarṣaṇiḥ
children.translated_text: May that flowing one today, through the filter, purify us, O you who regard all peoples;

children.text: yaḥ potā sa punātu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: he who is the purifier, may he purify us.

children.text: yat te pavitram arciṣy agne vitatam antar ā
children.translated_text: Whatever filter of yours is stretched out amid the flame, O <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: brahma tena punīhi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: with that sacred formulation purify us.

children.text: yat te pavitram arcivad agne tena punīhi naḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever flaming filter of yours there is, O <s>Agni</s>, with that purify us;

children.text: brahmasavaiḥ punīhi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: with the Soma-pressing rites of sacred speech, purify us.

children.text: ubhābhyāṃ deva savitaḥ pavitreṇa savena ca
children.translated_text: With both, O god <s>Savitar</s>, with the filter and with the impulse,

children.text: mām punīhi viśvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: purify me on every side.

children.text: tribhiṣ ṭvaṃ deva savitar varṣiṣṭhaiḥ soma dhāmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: With the three highest abodes of yours, O god <s>Savitar</s>, with <s>Soma</s>,

children.text: agne dakṣaiḥ punīhi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: and with the powers of <s>Agni</s>, purify us.

children.text: punantu māṃ devajanāḥ punantu vasavo dhiyā
children.translated_text: May the divine peoples purify me; may the <s>Vasus</s> purify me with inspired thought;

children.text: viśve devāḥ punīta mā jātavedaḥ punīhi mā ||
children.translated_text: may all the gods purify me; O <s>Jātavedas</s>, purify me.

children.text: pra pyāyasva pra syandasva soma viśvebhir aṃśubhiḥ
children.translated_text: Swell forth, stream forth, O <s>Soma</s>, with all your shoots,

children.text: devebhya uttamaṃ haviḥ ||
children.translated_text: the highest oblation for the gods.

children.text: upa priyam panipnataṃ yuvānam āhutīvṛdham
children.translated_text: We have approached the dear one, the young one who increases through offerings,

children.text: aganma bibhrato namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: bearing reverence.

children.text: alāyyasya paraśur nanāśa tam ā pavasva deva soma
children.translated_text: The axe of <s>Alāyya</s> has vanished; flow toward him, O god <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: ākhuṃ cid eva deva soma ||
children.translated_text: even a mouse indeed, O god <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: yaḥ pāvamānīr adhyety ṛṣibhiḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ rasam
children.translated_text: Whoever recites the <s>Pāvamānī</s> verses, the sap gathered by the seers,

children.text: sarvaṃ sa pūtam aśnāti svaditam mātariśvanā ||
children.translated_text: he eats all that is purified, made sweet by <s>Mātariśvan</s>.

children.text: pāvamānīr yo adhyety ṛṣibhiḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ rasam
children.translated_text: Whoever recites the <s>Pāvamānī</s> verses, the sap gathered by the seers,

children.text: tasmai sarasvatī duhe kṣīraṃ sarpir madhūdakam ||
children.translated_text: for him <s>Sarasvatī</s> milks milk, ghee, honey, and water.

children.text: Chapter 791
pra devam acchā madhumanta indavo 'siṣyadanta gāva ā na dhenavaḥ
children.translated_text: The honeyed drops have streamed forth toward the god, like cows, like milch cows coming near.

children.text: barhiṣado vacanāvanta ūdhabhiḥ parisrutam usriyā nirṇijaṃ dhire ||
children.translated_text: Sitting on the sacred grass, full of voice, with udders, the ruddy cows have placed the filtered, cleansed one.

children.text: sa roruvad abhi pūrvā acikradad upāruhaḥ śrathayan svādate hariḥ
children.translated_text: Roaring, that tawny one has cried out over those before him; mounting upward and loosening himself, he tastes sweet.

children.text: tiraḥ pavitram pariyann uru jrayo ni śaryāṇi dadhate deva ā varam ||
children.translated_text: Passing through the filter and going around with broad speed, the god sets down his stalks upon the chosen place.

children.text: vi yo mame yamyā saṃyatī madaḥ sākaṃvṛdhā payasā pinvad akṣitā
children.translated_text: The exhilaration, growing together with milk and inexhaustible, measured out the two paired and yoked ones.

children.text: mahī apāre rajasī vivevidad abhivrajann akṣitam pāja ā dade ||
children.translated_text: It discerned the two great boundless realms; advancing, it took to itself undecaying force.

children.text: sa mātarā vicaran vājayann apaḥ pra medhiraḥ svadhayā pinvate padam
children.translated_text: Moving between the two mothers, winning the prize and the waters, the wise one swells his station by his own law.

children.text: aṃśur yavena pipiśe yato nṛbhiḥ saṃ jāmibhir nasate rakṣate śiraḥ ||
children.translated_text: The stalk is adorned with barley; from there, by men and with his kin, he joins himself and protects his head.

children.text: saṃ dakṣeṇa manasā jāyate kavir ṛtasya garbho nihito yamā paraḥ
children.translated_text: With skill and mind the poet is born; the embryo of truth is set down, farther than the twin pair.

children.text: yūnā ha santā prathamaṃ vi jajñatur guhā hitaṃ janima nemam udyatam ||
children.translated_text: Though young, they first gave birth to him, this birth hidden in the secret place and now rising up.

children.text: mandrasya rūpaṃ vividur manīṣiṇaḥ śyeno yad andho abharat parāvataḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired thinkers discovered the pleasing form, when the eagle brought the Soma-draught from afar.

children.text: tam marjayanta suvṛdhaṃ nadīṣv āṃ uśantam aṃśum pariyantam ṛgmiyam ||
children.translated_text: They cleanse that well-growing one in the rivers, the eager stalk moving around, worthy of song.

children.text: tvām mṛjanti daśa yoṣaṇaḥ sutaṃ soma ṛṣibhir matibhir dhītibhir hitam
children.translated_text: Ten maidens cleanse you, pressed, O <s>Soma</s>, set in place by the seers with thoughts and insights,

children.text: avyo vārebhir uta devahūtibhir nṛbhir yato vājam ā darṣi sātaye ||
children.translated_text: with sheep-wool filters and with invocations to the gods, by men, from which you are seen for the winning of the prize.

children.text: pariprayantaṃ vayyaṃ suṣaṃsadaṃ somam manīṣā abhy anūṣata stubhaḥ
children.translated_text: The hymns have sung around with praise the flowing, vigorous, well-praised <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: yo dhārayā madhumāṁ ūrmiṇā diva iyarti vācaṃ rayiṣāﾱ amartyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He is the immortal one who, with his stream and honeyed wave from heaven, sets speech in motion with wealth.

children.text: ayaṃ diva iyarti viśvam ā rajaḥ somaḥ punānaḥ kalaśeṣu sīdati
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s>, being purified, sets all the expanse of heaven in motion; he sits down in the jars.

children.text: adbhir gobhir mṛjyate adribhiḥ sutaḥ punāna indur varivo vidat priyam ||
children.translated_text: Pressed and purifying, <s>Indu</s> is cleansed with waters, cows, and stones; he finds the dear wide space.

children.text: evā naḥ soma pariṣicyamāno vayo dadhac citratamam pavasva
children.translated_text: Thus, O <s>Soma</s>, as you are poured around for us, granting vitality, flow forth most wondrously.

children.text: adveṣe dyāvāpṛthivī huvema devā dhatta rayim asme suvīram ||
children.translated_text: May we call upon heaven and earth without hatred; O gods, place among us wealth rich in heroes.

children.text: Chapter 792
iṣur na dhanvan prati dhīyate matir vatso na mātur upa sarjy ūdhani
children.translated_text: The inspired thought is set forth like an arrow on the bow; like a calf it is released to its mother's udder.

children.text: urudhāreva duhe agra āyaty asya vrateṣv api soma iṣyate ||
children.translated_text: Like a broad-streaming cow it milks at the first approach; <s>Soma</s> is impelled within his ordinances.

children.text: upo matiḥ pṛcyate sicyate madhu mandrājanī codate antar āsani
children.translated_text: The thought draws near and is mixed; honey is poured; the gladdening birth impels it within the mouth.

children.text: pavamānaḥ saṃtaniḥ praghnatām iva madhumān drapsaḥ pari vāram arṣati ||
children.translated_text: The purifying one, extending himself like one smiting enemies, the honeyed drop, flows around the filter.

children.text: avye vadhūyuḥ pavate pari tvaci śrathnīte naptīr aditer ṛtaṃ yate
children.translated_text: Seeking a bride, he is purified around the sheep's skin; he loosens the daughters of <s>Aditi</s> as he goes to truth.

children.text: harir akrān yajataḥ saṃyato mado nṛmṇā śiśāno mahiṣo na śobhate ||
children.translated_text: The tawny, worshipful, restrained exhilaration has advanced; sharpening manly powers, he shines like a buffalo.

children.text: ukṣā mimāti prati yanti dhenavo devasya devīr upa yanti niṣkṛtam
children.translated_text: The bull bellows; the milk-cows go to meet him; the divine goddesses go to the god's prepared place.

children.text: aty akramīd arjunaṃ vāram avyayam atkaṃ na niktam pari somo avyata ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> has crossed over the white, imperishable filter; he has wrapped himself around like a washed garment.

children.text: amṛktena ruśatā vāsasā harir amartyo nirṇijānaḥ pari vyata
children.translated_text: With an unstained, shining garment, the tawny immortal, cleansing himself, has wrapped himself around.

children.text: divas pṛṣṭham barhaṇā nirṇije kṛtopastaraṇaṃ camvor nabhasmayam ||
children.translated_text: For his cleansing on the back of heaven, through greatness, he has made a cloud-like spread in the two vats.

children.text: sūryasyeva raśmayo drāvayitnavo matsarāsaḥ prasupaḥ sākam īrate
children.translated_text: Like the rays of the sun, the exhilarating, well-pressed, swift-running drops move forward together.

children.text: tantuṃ tatam pari sargāsa āśavo nendrād ṛte pavate dhāma kiṃcana ||
children.translated_text: The swift outflows run around the stretched thread; apart from <s>Indra</s>, no station at all is purified.

children.text: sindhor iva pravaṇe nimna āśavo vṛṣacyutā madāso gātum āśata
children.translated_text: Like swift currents on a river's slope, in the low place, the bull-poured exhilarations have reached the path.

children.text: śaṃ no niveśe dvipade catuṣpade 'sme vājāḥ soma tiṣṭhantu kṛṣṭayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May there be well-being for us in dwelling, for two-footed and four-footed; may prizes and peoples remain with us, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: ā naḥ pavasva vasumaddhiraṇyavad aśvāvad gomad yavamat suvīryam
children.translated_text: Flow to us with goods, with gold, with horses, with cows, with barley, and with heroic strength.

children.text: yūyaṃ hi soma pitaro mama sthana divo mūrdhānaḥ prasthitā vayaskṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Somas</s>, are my fathers, set forth as the heads of heaven, makers of vitality.

children.text: ete somāḥ pavamānāsa indraṃ rathā iva pra yayuḥ sātim accha
children.translated_text: These purifying <s>Somas</s> have gone forth toward <s>Indra</s>, like chariots toward the prize.

children.text: sutāḥ pavitram ati yanty avyaṃ hitvī vavriṃ harito vṛṣṭim accha ||
children.translated_text: Pressed, they pass over the sheep-wool filter, the tawny ones, having left the covering, toward the rain.

children.text: indav indrāya bṛhate pavasva sumṛﾱīko anavadyo riśādāḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, flow for great <s>Indra</s>, very gracious, faultless, slayer of enemies.

children.text: bharā candrāṇi gṛṇate vasūni devair dyāvāpṛthivī prāvataṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bring shining goods to the singer; with the gods, O heaven and earth, protect us.

children.text: Chapter 793
trir asmai sapta dhenavo duduhre satyām āśiram pūrvye vyomani
children.translated_text: Three times seven cows milked for him the true mixture in the ancient heaven.

children.text: catvāry anyā bhuvanāni nirṇije cārūṇi cakre yad ṛtair avardhata ||
children.translated_text: He made four other beautiful worlds for cleansing, when he grew by the truths.

children.text: sa bhikṣamāṇo amṛtasya cāruṇa ubhe dyāvā kāvyenā vi śaśrathe
children.translated_text: Begging for the lovely immortal draught, he has opened apart both heaven and earth by poetic power.

children.text: tejiṣṭhā apo maṃhanā pari vyata yadī devasya śravasā sado viduḥ ||
children.translated_text: The brightest waters have wrapped themselves around him with might, when they found the seat by the god's glory.

children.text: te asya santu ketavo 'mṛtyavo 'dābhyāso januṣī ubhe anu
children.translated_text: Let these be his deathless, unassailable beacons, following both births.

children.text: yebhir nṛmṇā ca devyā ca punata ād id rājānam mananā agṛbhṇata ||
children.translated_text: With them they purify both human powers and divine ones; then the thoughts grasped the king.

children.text: sa mṛjyamāno daśabhiḥ sukarmabhiḥ pra madhyamāsu mātṛṣu prame sacā
children.translated_text: Being cleansed by ten good workers, he goes forth among the middle mothers, in company with forward impulse.

children.text: vratāni pāno amṛtasya cāruṇa ubhe nṛcakṣā anu paśyate viśau ||
children.translated_text: Drinking the ordinances of the lovely immortal, the one seen by men looks upon both peoples.

children.text: sa marmṛjāna indriyāya dhāyasa obhe antā rodasī harṣate hitaḥ
children.translated_text: Polishing himself, he is set for lordly power and nourishment; placed at both ends of heaven and earth, he rejoices.

children.text: vṛṣā śuṣmeṇa bādhate vi durmatīr ādediśānaḥ śaryaheva śurudhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The bull, with force, drives away evil thoughts, pointing them off like an archer with arrows.

children.text: sa mātarā na dadṛśāna usriyo nānadad eti marutām iva svanaḥ
children.translated_text: Like a ruddy one not seeing his mothers, he goes bellowing with a sound like that of the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: jānann ṛtam prathamaṃ yat svarṇaram praśastaye kam avṛṇīta sukratuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Knowing first the <s>ṛta</s> (truth-order), what golden one did the wise-minded one choose for praise?

children.text: ruvati bhīmo vṛṣabhas taviṣyayā śṛṅge śiśāno hariṇī vicakṣaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: The fearsome bull roars with might, sharpening his two tawny horns, keen-sighted.

children.text: ā yoniṃ somaḥ sukṛtaṃ ni ṣīdati gavyayī tvag bhavati nirṇig avyayī ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> sits down in the well-made womb; the cow-winning skin becomes his imperishable covering.

children.text: śuciḥ punānas tanvam arepasam avye harir ny adhāviṣṭa sānavi
children.translated_text: Pure, cleansing his spotless body, the tawny one has been set down upon the height in the wool.

children.text: juṣṭo mitrāya varuṇāya vāyave tridhātu madhu kriyate sukarmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Acceptable to <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Vāyu</s>, the threefold honey is made by skillful rites.

children.text: pavasva soma devavītaye vṛṣendrasya hārdi somadhānam ā viśa
children.translated_text: Purify yourself, O <s>Soma</s>, for divine aid, O bull; enter the soma-vessel in <s>Indra</s>'s heart.

children.text: purā no bādhād duritāti pāraya kṣetraviddhi diśa āhā vipṛcchate ||
children.translated_text: Before obstruction comes upon us, carry us beyond distress; know the fields, point out the directions to the one who asks.

children.text: hito na saptir abhi vājam arṣendrasyendo jaṭharam ā pavasva
children.translated_text: Set in place like a swift steed, run toward the prize; O <s>Indu</s>, purify yourself into <s>Indra</s>'s belly.

children.text: nāvā na sindhum ati parṣi vidvāñchūro na yudhyann ava no nida spaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like a boat, carry us across the river, knowing the way; like a hero fighting, ward off the revilers from us.

children.text: Chapter 794
ā dakṣiṇā sṛjyate śuṣmy āsadaṃ veti druho rakṣasaḥ pāti jāgṛviḥ
children.translated_text: The strong one is released toward the right-hand gift and the seat; watchful, he goes against deceit and guards from demons.

children.text: harir opaśaṃ kṛṇute nabhas paya upastire camvor brahma nirṇije ||
children.translated_text: The tawny one makes for himself a covering; the heavenly milk is spread beneath in the two bowls as a prayer for his cleansing.

children.text: pra kṛṣṭiheva śūṣa eti roruvad asuryaṃ varṇaṃ ni riṇīte asya tam
children.translated_text: Like an eager singer he goes forth roaring; he strips away from himself that dark, asuric color.

children.text: jahāti vavrim pitur eti niṣkṛtam upaprutaṃ kṛṇute nirṇijaṃ tanā ||
children.translated_text: He abandons the covering, goes to the cleansing-place of the father, and by his own body makes himself a washed, purified one.

children.text: adribhiḥ sutaḥ pavate gabhastyor vṛṣāyate nabhasā vepate matī
children.translated_text: Pressed by the stones, he purifies himself in the hands; he acts like a bull, quivers through the cloud, and inspires thought.

children.text: sa modate nasate sādhate girā nenikte apsu yajate parīmaṇi ||
children.translated_text: He rejoices, wins, and accomplishes through song; he washes himself in the waters and is worshipped round about.

children.text: pari dyukṣaṃ sahasaḥ parvatāvṛdham madhvaḥ siñcanti harmyasya sakṣaṇim
children.translated_text: They pour the sweet draught around the bright one, strengthened by force and by the mountain, the companion of the high hall.

children.text: ā yasmin gāvaḥ suhutāda ūdhani mūrdhañchrīṇanty agriyaṃ varīmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: In him, at the udder of the well-invoked cow, the cows mix the foremost one with the choicest streams.

children.text: sam ī rathaṃ na bhurijor aheṣata daśa svasāro aditer upastha ā
children.translated_text: Together the ten sisters in <s>Aditi</s>'s lap have made him neigh like a chariot drawn by its two bays.

children.text: jigād upa jrayati gor apīcyam padaṃ yad asya matuthā ajījanan ||
children.translated_text: He has gone near and hastens to the hidden track of the cow, the place that they generated for him in due measure.

children.text: śyeno na yoniṃ sadanaṃ dhiyā kṛtaṃ hiraṇyayam āsadaṃ deva eṣati
children.translated_text: Like an eagle, the god seeks the womb, the seat fashioned by inspired thought, golden, the sitting-place.

children.text: e riṇanti barhiṣi priyaṃ girāśvo na devāṁ apy eti yajñiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They send the beloved one upon the ritual grass with song; like a horse worthy of sacrifice, he goes toward the gods.

children.text: parā vyakto aruṣo divaḥ kavir vṛṣā tripṛṣṭho anaviṣṭa gā abhi
children.translated_text: Clearly manifested, ruddy, from heaven, the seer and bull with three backs has entered among the cows.

children.text: sahasraṇītir yatiḥ parāyatī rebho na pūrvīr uṣaso vi rājati ||
children.translated_text: With a thousand guidances, advancing onward, the resonant one shines out like many former dawns.

children.text: tveṣaṃ rūpaṃ kṛṇute varṇo asya sa yatrāśayat samṛtā sedhati sridhaḥ
children.translated_text: He makes a brilliant form, his own color, where, having lain down together, he drives away assailants.

children.text: apsā yāti svadhayā daivyaṃ janaṃ saṃ suṣṭutī nasate saṃ goagrayā ||
children.translated_text: With sap and by his own power he goes to the divine people; with good praises he wins, and with cow-leading bounty.

children.text: ukṣeva yūthā pariyann arāvīd adhi tviṣīr adhita sūryasya
children.translated_text: Like a bull moving around herds, he has roared, placing himself upon the radiances of the sun.

children.text: divyaḥ suparṇo 'va cakṣata kṣāṃ somaḥ pari kratunā paśyate jāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The heavenly fair-winged one has looked down upon the earth; <s>Soma</s> sees the peoples all around with insight.

children.text: Chapter 795
harim mṛjanty aruṣo na yujyate saṃ dhenubhiḥ kalaśe somo ajyate
children.translated_text: They cleanse the tawny one; the ruddy one is yoked; <s>Soma</s> is anointed together with the milk-cows in the jar.

children.text: ud vācam īrayati hinvate matī puruṣṭutasya kati cit paripriyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He raises the voice and impels inspired thought, being in many ways dear to the much-praised one.

children.text: sākaṃ vadanti bahavo manīṣiṇa indrasya somaṃ jaṭhare yad āduhuḥ
children.translated_text: Many inspired sages speak together when they have milked <s>Soma</s> into <s>Indra</s>'s belly.

children.text: yadī mṛjanti sugabhastayo naraḥ sanīﾱābhir daśabhiḥ kāmyam madhu ||
children.translated_text: When the men with skillful hands cleanse the desirable honey with ten eager sisters,

children.text: aramamāṇo aty eti gā abhi sūryasya priyaṃ duhitus tiro ravam
children.translated_text: unwearied he goes beyond, toward the cows, beyond the roar, toward the beloved daughter of <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: anv asmai joṣam abharad vinaṅgṛsaḥ saṃ dvayībhiḥ svasṛbhiḥ kṣeti jāmibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Vinaṅgṛsa brought favor for him; with the two kinds of sisterly kinswomen he dwells among his kin.

children.text: nṛdhūto adriṣuto barhiṣi priyaḥ patir gavām pradiva indur ṛtviyaḥ
children.translated_text: Shaken by men, pressed by stones, beloved on the ritual grass, lord of cows, primeval <s>Indu</s>, fit for the season,

children.text: purandhivān manuṣo yajñasādhanaḥ śucir dhiyā pavate soma indra te ||
children.translated_text: rich in abundance, accomplisher of the human sacrifice, pure through inspired thought, <s>Soma</s> purifies himself for you, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: nṛbāhubhyāṃ codito dhārayā suto 'nuṣvadham pavate soma indra te
children.translated_text: Impelled by men's arms, pressed in a stream, <s>Soma</s> purifies himself according to his own ordinance for you, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: āprāḥ kratūn sam ajair adhvare matīr ver na druṣac camvor āsadaddhariḥ ||
children.translated_text: The tawny one has filled the intentions and gathered inspired thoughts in the rite, and has sat in the two bowls like a bird on wood.

children.text: aṃśuṃ duhanti stanayantam akṣitaṃ kaviṃ kavayo 'paso manīṣiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: The poets, active and inspired, milk the imperishable, thundering shoot, the seer.

children.text: sam ī gāvo matayo yanti saṃyata ṛtasya yonā sadane punarbhuvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The cows and the thoughts go together, restrained, to the womb of <s>ṛta</s>, the seat of renewed birth.

children.text: nābhā pṛthivyā dharuṇo maho divo 'pām ūrmau sindhuṣv antar ukṣitaḥ
children.translated_text: At the navel of earth, the support of great heaven, sprinkled in the wave of the waters and among the rivers,

children.text: indrasya vajro vṛṣabho vibhūvasuḥ somo hṛde pavate cāru matsaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, <s>Indra</s>'s thunderbolt, the bull rich in radiant wealth, purifies himself for the heart, lovely and exhilarating.

children.text: sa tū pavasva pari pārthivaṃ raja stotre śikṣann ādhūnvate ca sukrato
children.translated_text: So now purify yourself around the earthly realm, O wise-minded one, instructing the singer and the one who is shaken forth.

children.text: mā no nir bhāg vasunaḥ sādanaspṛśo rayim piśaṅgam bahulaṃ vasīmahi ||
children.translated_text: Do not drive us away from wealth, from those who reach the seat; may we win tawny, abundant riches.

children.text: ā tū na indo śatadātv aśvyaṃ sahasradātu paśumaddhiraṇyavat
children.translated_text: Come now to us, O <s>Indu</s>, with gifts in hundreds, with horses, with gifts in thousands, with cattle and gold.

children.text: upa māsva bṛhatī revatīr iṣo 'dhi stotrasya pavamāna no gahi ||
children.translated_text: Approach the great, splendid nourishments of the offering; O purifying one, come here in accord with the praise-song.

children.text: Chapter 796
srakve drapsasya dhamataḥ sam asvarann ṛtasya yonā sam aranta nābhayaḥ
children.translated_text: The fastenings sounded together for the drop as it was blown; at the womb of <s>ṛta</s> the naves came together.

children.text: trīn sa mūrdhno asuraś cakra ārabhe satyasya nāvaḥ sukṛtam apīparan ||
children.translated_text: The mighty one made three supports from the head; the ships of truth carried the well-made work across.

children.text: samyak samyañco mahiṣā aheṣata sindhor ūrmāv adhi venā avīvipan
children.translated_text: The buffaloes, moving in the same direction, neighed together upon the wave of the river, while the longing ones trembled.

children.text: madhor dhārābhir janayanto arkam it priyām indrasya tanvam avīvṛdhan ||
