children.translated_text: Generating the chant with streams of sweetness, they strengthened the dear body of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: pavitravantaḥ pari vācam āsate pitaiṣām pratno abhi rakṣati vratam
children.translated_text: Possessing filters, they sit around the voice; their ancient father watches over the vow.

children.text: mahaḥ samudraṃ varuṇas tiro dadhe dhīrā icchekur dharuṇeṣv ārabham ||
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s> has set the great ocean apart; the wise have sought a support among the foundations.

children.text: sahasradhāre 'va te sam asvaran divo nāke madhujihvā asaścataḥ
children.translated_text: They sounded together for you as if in a thousand streams, honey-tongued, unceasing, at the summit of heaven.

children.text: asya spaśo na ni miṣanti bhūrṇayaḥ pade pade pāśinaḥ santi setavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: His spies, swift and alert, do not blink; at every step there are noose-bearing barriers.

children.text: pitur mātur adhy ā ye samasvarann ṛcā śocantaḥ saṃdahanto avratān
children.translated_text: Those who have sounded together over father and mother, blazing with the hymn and burning up the vowless,

children.text: indradviṣṭām apa dhamanti māyayā tvacam asiknīm bhūmano divas pari ||
children.translated_text: by their art blow away, from the expanse of earth and heaven, the black skin hated by <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: pratnān mānād adhy ā ye samasvarañchlokayantrāso rabhasasya mantavaḥ
children.translated_text: Those who have sounded together from the ancient measure, makers of praise-songs, thoughts of impetuous force,

children.text: apānakṣāso badhirā ahāsata ṛtasya panthāṃ na taranti duṣkṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the breathless and deaf have laughed; the evildoers do not cross the path of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: sahasradhāre vitate pavitra ā vācam punanti kavayo manīṣiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: In the thousand-streamed outspread filter the inspired sages, the thoughtful ones, purify speech.

children.text: rudrāsa eṣām iṣirāso adruha spaśaḥ svañcaḥ sudṛśo nṛcakṣasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Their <s>Rudras</s> are impelling, unharming, watchers, well-directed, clear-sighted, seeing men.

children.text: ṛtasya gopā na dabhāya sukratus trī ṣa pavitrā hṛdy antar ā dadhe
children.translated_text: As guardian of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), not to be deceived, wise in purpose, he has set three filters within the heart.

children.text: vidvān sa viśvā bhuvanābhi paśyaty avājuṣṭān vidhyati karte avratān ||
children.translated_text: Knowing, he beholds all beings; he pierces the unpleasing, vowless ones into the pit.

children.text: ṛtasya tantur vitataḥ pavitra ā jihvāyā agre varuṇasya māyayā
children.translated_text: The thread of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) is stretched in the filter, by the art of <s>Varuṇa</s>, at the tip of the tongue.

children.text: dhīrāś cit tat saminakṣanta āśatātrā kartam ava padāty aprabhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even the wise have reached it together with eagerness; there the powerless man falls down into the pit.

children.text: Chapter 797
śiśur na jāto 'va cakradad vane svar yad vājy aruṣaḥ siṣāsati
children.translated_text: Like a newborn child he cries out in the wood, when the ruddy prize-winner seeks to win the light.

children.text: divo retasā sacate payovṛdhā tam īmahe sumatī śarma saprathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With the seed of heaven he joins himself to the milk-increasing one; we ask from him good favor and broad shelter.

children.text: divo ya skambho dharuṇaḥ svātata āpūrṇo aṃśuḥ paryeti viśvataḥ
children.translated_text: He who is the prop of heaven, its support, stretched by his own law, the full stalk, goes around on every side.

children.text: seme mahī rodasī yakṣad āvṛtā samīcīne dādhāra sam iṣaḥ kaviḥ ||
children.translated_text: This poet, wrapped in both mighty worlds, has honored and held together the two matching worlds and the nourishments.

children.text: mahi psaraḥ sukṛtaṃ somyam madhūrvī gavyūtir aditer ṛtaṃ yate
children.translated_text: Great is the flowing, well-made Soma-sweetness, the wide cow-pasture, <s>Aditi</s>'s <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), for the one who goes by the rite.

children.text: īśe yo vṛṣṭer ita usriyo vṛṣāpāṃ netā ya itaūtir ṛgmiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He has power over the rain from here: the bull, the bright one; he is the leader of the waters, he whose aid is hymn-worthy.

children.text: ātmanvan nabho duhyate ghṛtam paya ṛtasya nābhir amṛtaṃ vi jāyate
children.translated_text: From the living cloud ghee and milk are milked; the navel of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), the immortal, is born forth.

children.text: samīcīnāḥ sudānavaḥ prīṇanti taṃ naro hitam ava mehanti peravaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The generous men, moving together, gladden him when he has been set in place; the swelling streams pour down upon him.

children.text: arāvīd aṃśuḥ sacamāna ūrmiṇā devāvyam manuṣe pinvati tvacam
children.translated_text: The stalk has roared, joining itself with the wave; for man it swells the godward skin.

children.text: dadhāti garbham aditer upastha ā yena tokaṃ ca tanayaṃ ca dhāmahe ||
children.translated_text: It places the embryo in the lap of <s>Aditi</s>, through which we establish child and offspring.

children.text: sahasradhāre 'va tā asaścatas tṛtīye santu rajasi prajāvatīḥ
children.translated_text: Like those thousand-streamed ones, unceasing, let them be rich in offspring in the third realm.

children.text: catasro nābho nihitā avo divo havir bharanty amṛtaṃ ghṛtaścutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Four naves are set as aids of heaven; they bear the oblation, immortal and dripping with ghee.

children.text: śvetaṃ rūpaṃ kṛṇute yat siṣāsati somo mīḍhvāṁ asuro veda bhūmanaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, the bounteous mighty lord, makes a white form when he seeks to win; he knows the earth's expanse.

children.text: dhiyā śamī sacate sem abhi pravad divas kavandham ava darṣad udriṇam ||
children.translated_text: With inspired thought he joins in the rite and proclaims; he has revealed from heaven the raised vessel, the opened one.

children.text: adha śvetaṃ kalaśaṃ gobhir aktaṃ kārṣmann ā vājy akramīt sasavān
children.translated_text: Then the prize-winner, victorious, stepped onto the white cup anointed with cows' milk, on the course.

children.text: ā hinvire manasā devayantaḥ kakṣīvate śatahimāya gonām ||
children.translated_text: Those who desire the gods have impelled him with the mind, for <s>Kakṣīvat</s>, the hundred-wintered one, and for cows.

children.text: adbhiḥ soma papṛcānasya te raso 'vyo vāraṃ vi pavamāna dhāvati
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, as your juice is mixed with the waters, O purifying one, it runs through the sheep-wool filter.

children.text: sa mṛjyamānaḥ kavibhir madintama svadasvendrāya pavamāna pītaye ||
children.translated_text: Being cleansed by the inspired poets, most intoxicating, O purifying one, make yourself sweet for <s>Indra</s> to drink.

children.text: Chapter 798
abhi priyāṇi pavate canohito nāmāni yahvo adhi yeṣu vardhate
children.translated_text: Set in motion by delight, he purifies himself toward the dear names in which the mighty one grows.

children.text: ā sūryasya bṛhato bṛhann adhi rathaṃ viṣvañcam aruhad vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Far-seeing, he has mounted the all-turning chariot high upon the broad height of the great <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: ṛtasya jihvā pavate madhu priyaṃ vaktā patir dhiyo asyā adābhyaḥ
children.translated_text: The tongue of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) purifies itself, the dear honey; he is the speaker, the lord of this inspired thought, not to be deceived.

children.text: dadhāti putraḥ pitror apīcyaṃ nāma tṛtīyam adhi rocane divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The son places the hidden name of both parents, a third name, upon the luminous realm of heaven.

children.text: ava dyutānaḥ kalaśāṁ acikradan nṛbhir yemānaḥ kośa ā hiraṇyaye
children.translated_text: Flashing downward, he has cried out to the cups; guided by men, he is in the golden vessel.

children.text: abhīm ṛtasya dohanā anūṣatādhi tripṛṣṭha uṣaso vi rājati ||
children.translated_text: The milkings of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) have sung toward him; upon the three-backed place he shines forth over the dawns.

children.text: adribhiḥ suto matibhiś canohitaḥ prarocayan rodasī mātarā śuciḥ
children.translated_text: Pressed by the stones, set in motion by thoughts, the bright one has made the two mother-worlds, heaven and earth, shine out.

children.text: romāṇy avyā samayā vi dhāvati madhor dhārā pinvamānā dive dive ||
children.translated_text: The swelling streams of sweetness run through the hairs of the sheep each day toward heaven.

children.text: pari soma pra dhanvā svastaye nṛbhiḥ punāno abhi vāsayāśiram
children.translated_text: Run forth around us, O <s>Soma</s>, over the course for well-being; being purified by men, clothe yourself with the mixture.

children.text: ye te madā āhanaso vihāyasas tebhir indraṃ codaya dātave magham ||
children.translated_text: With those exhilarating draughts of yours, strong and far-ranging, urge <s>Indra</s> to give the bounty.

children.text: Chapter 799
dhartā divaḥ pavate kṛtvyo raso dakṣo devānām anumādyo nṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: The holder of heaven is purified, the effective juice, the skill of the gods, to be gladdened by men.

children.text: hariḥ sṛjāno atyo na satvabhir vṛthā pājāṃsi kṛṇute nadīṣv ā ||
children.translated_text: The tawny one, being released like a racehorse by strong companions, freely makes his powers in the rivers.

children.text: śūro na dhatta āyudhā gabhastyoḥ svaḥ siṣāsan rathiro gaviṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: Like a hero he places weapons in his hands, seeking the sun, a chariot-fighter in the contests for cows.

children.text: indrasya śuṣmam īrayann apasyubhir indur hinvāno ajyate manīṣibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Driving on <s>Indra</s>'s might with those who desire action, <s>Indu</s>, being impelled, is anointed by the inspired ones.

children.text: indrasya soma pavamāna ūrmiṇā taviṣyamāṇo jaṭhareṣv ā viśa
children.translated_text: O purifying <s>Soma</s>, growing mighty by your wave, enter into the bellies of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: pra ṇaḥ pinva vidyud abhreva rodasī dhiyā na vājāṁ upa māsi śaśvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Swell for us, like lightning in the cloud, the two worlds; with inspired thought draw near to the everlasting prizes.

children.text: viśvasya rājā pavate svardṛśa ṛtasya dhītim ṛṣiṣāﾱ avīvaśat
children.translated_text: The king of all is purified for the sight of heaven; he has set in motion the thought of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) through the damaged seerly utterance.

children.text: yaḥ sūryasyāsireṇa mṛjyate pitā matīnām asamaṣṭakāvyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He who is cleansed by the ray of <s>Sūrya</s> is the father of thoughts, unmatched in poetic wisdom.

children.text: vṛṣeva yūthā pari kośam arṣasy apām upasthe vṛṣabhaḥ kanikradat
children.translated_text: Like a bull around the herds, you run around the vessel; the bull bellows in the lap of the waters.

children.text: sa indrāya pavase matsarintamo yathā jeṣāma samithe tvotayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You purify yourself for <s>Indra</s>, most exhilarating, so that with your aids we may win in the contest.

children.text: Chapter 800
eṣa pra kośe madhumāṁ acikradad indrasya vajro vapuṣo vapuṣṭaraḥ
children.translated_text: This honeyed one has cried out in the vessel, <s>Indra</s>'s thunderbolt, fairer than fair in form.

children.text: abhīm ṛtasya sudughā ghṛtaścuto vāśrā arṣanti payaseva dhenavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Toward him the good-milking, ghee-dripping streams of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) run, lowing like cows for milk.

children.text: sa pūrvyaḥ pavate yaṃ divas pari śyeno mathāyad iṣitas tiro rajaḥ
children.translated_text: He, the ancient one, is purified, whom the eagle, sent from heaven, carried across the realm for delight.

children.text: sa madhva ā yuvate vevijāna it kṛśānor astur manasāha bibhyuṣā ||
children.translated_text: He comes to the sweetness, trembling, while <s>Kṛśānu</s>'s archer, hostile in mind, is afraid.

children.text: te naḥ pūrvāsa uparāsa indavo mahe vājāya dhanvantu gomate
children.translated_text: May those former and later drops run for us toward the great prize rich in cows.

children.text: īkṣeṇyāso ahyo na cāravo brahma brahma ye jujuṣur havir haviḥ ||
children.translated_text: Visible, lovely like serpents, they have welcomed each sacred formulation and each oblation.

children.text: ayaṃ no vidvān vanavad vanuṣyata induḥ satrācā manasā puruṣṭutaḥ
children.translated_text: May this knowing <s>Indu</s>, much-praised, win for us what is to be won against the hostile man, with a mind acting all at once.

children.text: inasya yaḥ sadane garbham ādadhe gavām urubjam abhy arṣati vrajam ||
children.translated_text: He who set the embryo in this one's seat streams toward the broad cattle-pen of the cows.

children.text: cakrir divaḥ pavate kṛtvyo raso mahāṁ adabdho varuṇo hurug yate
children.translated_text: The skillful sap of heaven flows; mighty, undeceived <s>Varuṇa</s> hastens on his way.

children.text: asāvi mitro vṛjaneṣu yajñiyo 'tyo na yūthe vṛṣayuḥ kanikradat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s>, worthy of sacrifice among the enclosures, has been pressed out, bellowing like a stallion in the herd, eager as a bull.

children.text: Chapter 801
pra rājā vācaṃ janayann asiṣyadad apo vasāno abhi gā iyakṣati
children.translated_text: The king, bringing forth speech, has streamed onward; clothed in the waters, he seeks the cows.

children.text: gṛbhṇāti ripram avir asya tānvā śuddho devānām upa yāti niṣkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: The fleece takes up his stain with its own body; purified, he goes to the gods' prepared place.

children.text: indrāya soma pari ṣicyase nṛbhir nṛcakṣā ūrmiḥ kavir ajyase vane
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Soma</s>, you are poured around by men; all-seeing wave, inspired seer, you are urged in the wood.

children.text: pūrvīr hi te srutayaḥ santi yātave sahasram aśvā harayaś camūṣadaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For many are your channels for going; a thousand tawny horses sit in the bowls.

children.text: samudriyā apsaraso manīṣiṇam āsīnā antar abhi somam akṣaran
children.translated_text: The oceanic <s>Apsarases</s>, sitting within, have streamed around the thoughtful <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: tā īṃ hinvanti harmyasya sakṣaṇiṃ yācante sumnam pavamānam akṣitam ||
children.translated_text: They urge him, the companion of the mansion; they seek imperishable favor from flowing <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: gojin naḥ somo rathajiddhiraṇyajit svarjid abjit pavate sahasrajit
children.translated_text: May <s>Soma</s>, winner of cows, chariots, gold, heaven, waters, and a thousand prizes, flow for us,

children.text: yaṃ devāsaś cakrire pītaye madaṃ svādiṣṭhaṃ drapsam aruṇam mayobhuvam ||
children.translated_text: the exhilaration which the gods made for drinking, the sweetest reddish drop, bringing happiness.

children.text: etāni soma pavamāno asmayuḥ satyāni kṛṇvan draviṇāny arṣasi
children.translated_text: Flowing <s>Soma</s>, desirous of us, making these true riches, you stream onward.

children.text: jahi śatrum antike dūrake ca ya urvīṃ gavyūtim abhayaṃ ca nas kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: Slay the enemy nearby and far away, and make for us broad cattle-pasture and fearlessness.

children.text: Chapter 802
acodaso no dhanvantv indavaḥ pra suvānāso bṛhaddiveṣu harayaḥ
children.translated_text: Unbidden, let the drops win wealth for us, the tawny ones being pressed for the lofty heavens;

children.text: vi ca naśan na iṣo arātayo 'ryo naśanta saniṣanta no dhiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: let hostile want and enemies vanish from us; let our noble thoughts win and gain.

children.text: pra ṇo dhanvantv indavo madacyuto dhanā vā yebhir arvato junīmasi
children.translated_text: Let the drops, dripping exhilaration, run forth for us, with which we may win wealth and racehorses;

children.text: tiro martasya kasyacit parihvṛtiṃ vayaṃ dhanāni viśvadhā bharemahi ||
children.translated_text: passing beyond the deceit of any mortal, may we carry riches in every direction.

children.text: uta svasyā arātyā arir hi ṣa utānyasyā arātyā vṛko hi ṣaḥ
children.translated_text: And against his own hostility, for he is an enemy, and against another's hostility, for he is a wolf,

children.text: dhanvan na tṛṣṇā sam arīta tāṁ abhi soma jahi pavamāna durādhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like thirst in a desert, run together against them; O flowing <s>Soma</s>, strike down the hard-minded ones.

children.text: divi te nābhā paramo ya ādade pṛthivyās te ruruhuḥ sānavi kṣipaḥ
children.translated_text: Your highest navel, which was set in heaven; on earth your streams have mounted the summit.

children.text: adrayas tvā bapsati gor adhi tvacy apsu tvā hastair duduhur manīṣiṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The stones devour you upon the cow's hide; in the waters the inspired men have milked you with their hands.

children.text: evā ta indo subhvaṃ supeśasaṃ rasaṃ tuñjanti prathamā abhiśriyaḥ
children.translated_text: Thus, O drop, the first adorning powers quicken your beautiful, well-fashioned sap;

children.text: nidaṃ nidam pavamāna ni tāriṣa āvis te śuṣmo bhavatu priyo madaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O flowing one, carry us safely through each hostile place; let your dear power, your exhilaration, become manifest.

children.text: Chapter 803
somasya dhārā pavate nṛcakṣasa ṛtena devān havate divas pari
children.translated_text: The stream of <s>Soma</s>, visible to men, flows; by ṛta he calls the gods from heaven.

children.text: bṛhaspate ravathenā vi didyute samudrāso na savanāni vivyacuḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, with roaring it has flashed forth; the pressings have spread out like seas.

children.text: yaṃ tvā vājinn aghnyā abhy anūṣatāyohataṃ yonim ā rohasi dyumān
children.translated_text: When the inviolate cows have lowed to you, O prize-winner, you mount the uninjured womb, shining.

children.text: maghonām āyuḥ pratiran mahi śrava indrāya soma pavase vṛṣā madaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Prolonging the life of the patrons and great fame, for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Soma</s>, you flow as a bull, an intoxicating draught.

children.text: endrasya kukṣā pavate madintama ūrjaṃ vasānaḥ śravase sumaṅgalaḥ
children.translated_text: Into <s>Indra</s>'s belly flows the most intoxicating one, clothed in strength, auspicious for fame;

children.text: pratyaṅ sa viśvā bhuvanābhi paprathe krīﾱan harir atyaḥ syandate vṛṣā ||
children.translated_text: facing us, he has spread over all beings; playing, the tawny racehorse, the bull, streams onward.

children.text: taṃ tvā devebhyo madhumattamaṃ naraḥ sahasradhāraṃ duhate daśa kṣipaḥ
children.translated_text: The ten fingers, men, milk you for the gods, sweetest and thousand-streamed;

children.text: nṛbhiḥ soma pracyuto grāvabhiḥ suto viśvān devāṁ ā pavasvā sahasrajit ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, set in motion by men and pressed by stones, flow here to all the gods, thousand-conquering.

children.text: taṃ tvā hastino madhumantam adribhir duhanty apsu vṛṣabhaṃ daśa kṣipaḥ
children.translated_text: The ten fingers milk you in the waters with the stones, sweet, honeyed, a bull;

children.text: indraṃ soma mādayan daivyaṃ janaṃ sindhor ivormiḥ pavamāno arṣasi ||
children.translated_text: O flowing <s>Soma</s>, gladdening <s>Indra</s> and the divine people, you stream like a wave of the river.

children.text: Chapter 804
pra somasya pavamānasyormaya indrasya yanti jaṭharaṃ supeśasaḥ
children.translated_text: The beautiful waves of flowing <s>Soma</s> go to <s>Indra</s>'s belly,

children.text: dadhnā yad īm unnītā yaśasā gavāṃ dānāya śūram udamandiṣuḥ sutāḥ ||
children.translated_text: when, raised up with curds and with the cows' glory, the pressed juices exhilarated the hero for giving.

children.text: acchā hi somaḥ kalaśāṁ asiṣyadad atyo na voﾱhā raghuvartanir vṛṣā
children.translated_text: For <s>Soma</s> has streamed toward the bowls, like a swift-turning bull, like a horse that bears the load;

children.text: athā devānām ubhayasya janmano vidvāṁ aśnoty amuta itaś ca yat ||
children.translated_text: then, knowing both births of the gods, he attains what is yonder and what is here.

children.text: ā naḥ soma pavamānaḥ kirā vasv indo bhava maghavā rādhaso mahaḥ
children.translated_text: Scatter wealth to us, O flowing <s>Soma</s>; O drop, be a bounteous giver of great bounty.

children.text: śikṣā vayodho vasave su cetunā mā no gayam āre asmat parā sicaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With good insight, train the life-giving one for wealth; do not pour our household far away from us.

children.text: ā naḥ pūṣā pavamānaḥ surātayo mitro gacchantu varuṇaḥ sajoṣasaḥ
children.translated_text: May flowing <s>Pūṣan</s> with good gifts, <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> in harmony, come to us;

children.text: bṛhaspatir maruto vāyur aśvinā tvaṣṭā savitā suyamā sarasvatī ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, the <s>Maruts</s>, <s>Vāyu</s>, the <s>Aśvins</s>, <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, <s>Savitṛ</s>, and well-guided <s>Sarasvatī</s>.

children.text: ubhe dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaminve aryamā devo aditir vidhātā
children.translated_text: Both <s>Heaven-and-Earth</s>, movers of all, the god <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, the Ordainer,

children.text: bhago nṛśaṃsa urv antarikṣaṃ viśve devāḥ pavamānaṃ juṣanta ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bhaga</s>, <s>Nṛśaṃsa</s>, the broad midspace, and all the gods, let them delight in the flowing one.

children.text: Chapter 805
asāvi somo aruṣo vṛṣā harī rājeva dasmo abhi gā acikradat
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> has been pressed, ruddy, a bull, tawny; wondrous like a king, he has bellowed toward the cows.

children.text: punāno vāram pary ety avyayaṃ śyeno na yoniṃ ghṛtavantam āsadam ||
children.translated_text: Purifying himself, he goes around the imperishable woolen filter, like a falcon settling in its ghee-rich womb.

children.text: kavir vedhasyā pary eṣi māhinam atyo na mṛṣṭo abhi vājam arṣasi
children.translated_text: O seer, you move around with the greatness of the inspired one; like a groomed racehorse you stream toward the prize.

children.text: apasedhan duritā soma mṛﾱaya ghṛtaṃ vasānaḥ pari yāsi nirṇijam ||
children.translated_text: Driving away evils, O <s>Soma</s>, show mercy; clothed in ghee, you go around the cleansing adornment.

children.text: parjanyaḥ pitā mahiṣasya parṇino nābhā pṛthivyā giriṣu kṣayaṃ dadhe
children.translated_text: <s>Parjanya</s>, father of the winged mighty one, set his dwelling in the navel of earth, in the mountains;

children.text: svasāra āpo abhi gā utāsaran saṃ grāvabhir nasate vīte adhvare ||
children.translated_text: the sister waters, and the cows as well, flowed toward him; with the pressing stones he is fashioned in the solemn rite.

children.text: jāyeva patyāv adhi śeva maṃhase pajrāyā garbha śṛṇuhi bravīmi te
children.translated_text: Like a wife toward her husband for gracious bounty, O embryo of <s>Pajrā</s>, hear what I say to you;

children.text: antar vāṇīṣu pra carā su jīvase 'nindyo vṛjane soma jāgṛhi ||
children.translated_text: move among the voices for good living; O <s>Soma</s>, wake in the enclosure, blameless.

children.text: yathā pūrvebhyaḥ śatasā amṛdhraḥ sahasrasāḥ paryayā vājam indo
children.translated_text: As for the former ones, hundred-winning, unconquered, thousand-winning, you went around the prize, O drop;

children.text: evā pavasva suvitāya navyase tava vratam anv āpaḥ sacante ||
children.translated_text: so flow for newer well-being; the waters attend upon your vow.

children.text: Chapter 806
pavitraṃ te vitatam brahmaṇaspate prabhur gātrāṇi pary eṣi viśvataḥ
children.translated_text: Your filter is stretched out, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>; as master, you move around all limbs on every side.

children.text: ataptatanūr na tad āmo aśnute śṛtāsa id vahantas tat sam āśata ||
children.translated_text: The unheated body does not attain that, nor the raw one; only the cooked, bearing it, have come together to it.

children.text: tapoṣ pavitraṃ vitataṃ divas pade śocanto asya tantavo vy asthiran
children.translated_text: The filter of heat is stretched out in the station of heaven; its glowing threads have spread apart.

children.text: avanty asya pavītāram āśavo divas pṛṣṭham adhi tiṣṭhanti cetasā ||
children.translated_text: The swift ones guard his purifier; with awareness they stand upon the back of heaven.

children.text: arūrucad uṣasaḥ pṛśnir agriya ukṣā bibharti bhuvanāni vājayuḥ
children.translated_text: The dappled one has shone forth at the forefront of the dawns; the bull, seeking the prize, bears the worlds.

children.text: māyāvino mamire asya māyayā nṛcakṣasaḥ pitaro garbham ā dadhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The wonder-working fathers, seeing men, measured out his magic by their magic and placed the embryo.

children.text: gandharva itthā padam asya rakṣati pāti devānāṃ janimāny adbhutaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Gandharva</s> truly guards his track; wondrous, he protects the births of the gods.

children.text: gṛbhṇāti ripuṃ nidhayā nidhāpatiḥ sukṛttamā madhuno bhakṣam āśata ||
children.translated_text: The lord of the hidden place grasps the foe with a deposit; the best worker has reached the draught of honey.

children.text: havir haviṣmo mahi sadma daivyaṃ nabho vasānaḥ pari yāsy adhvaram
children.translated_text: O oblation-rich oblation, clothing yourself in cloud, you go around the great divine seat, around the sacrifice.

children.text: rājā pavitraratho vājam āruhaḥ sahasrabhṛṣṭir jayasi śravo bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: As king, with the filter as your chariot, you have mounted the prize; with a thousand points you win great fame.

children.text: Chapter 807
pavasva devamādano vicarṣaṇir apsā indrāya varuṇāya vāyave
children.translated_text: Flow, gladdener of the gods, active among peoples, in the waters for <s>Indra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: kṛdhī no adya varivaḥ svastimad urukṣitau gṛṇīhi daivyaṃ janam ||
children.translated_text: Make for us today a wide path with well-being; in the broad dwelling praise the divine people.

children.text: ā yas tasthau bhuvanāny amartyo viśvāni somaḥ pari tāny arṣati
children.translated_text: Immortal <s>Soma</s>, who has taken his stand over the worlds, flows around all of them.

children.text: kṛṇvan saṃcṛtaṃ vicṛtam abhiṣṭaya induḥ siṣakty uṣasaṃ na sūryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Making what is joined and what is spread out for the wished-for goods, <s>Indu</s> clings to the dawn like the sun.

children.text: ā yo gobhiḥ sṛjyata oṣadhīṣv ā devānāṃ sumna iṣayann upāvasuḥ
children.translated_text: He who is released with cows among the plants, seeking the gracious favor of the gods, has come near to good possession.

children.text: ā vidyutā pavate dhārayā suta indraṃ somo mādayan daivyaṃ janam ||
children.translated_text: Pressed, he purifies himself with the lightning-like stream; <s>Soma</s>, gladdening <s>Indra</s>, gladdens the divine people.

children.text: eṣa sya somaḥ pavate sahasrajiddhinvāno vācam iṣirām uṣarbudham
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s> purifies himself, winning a thousand, impelling inspired speech that awakens the dawns.

children.text: induḥ samudram ud iyarti vāyubhir endrasya hārdi kalaśeṣu sīdati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indu</s> raises up the ocean with the winds and sits in the cups in <s>Indra</s>'s heart.

children.text: abhi tyaṃ gāvaḥ payasā payovṛdhaṃ somaṃ śrīṇanti matibhiḥ svarvidam
children.translated_text: The cows with milk mix that milk-increasing <s>Soma</s>, finder of the sun, with their inspired thoughts.

children.text: dhanañjayaḥ pavate kṛtvyo raso vipraḥ kaviḥ kāvyenā svarcanāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The effective juice, winning wealth, purifies itself; the inspired poet shines by poetic wisdom.

children.text: Chapter 808
indrāya soma suṣutaḥ pari sravāpāmīvā bhavatu rakṣasā saha
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s>, O well-pressed <s>Soma</s>, flow around; let disease be driven away together with the <s>rakṣas</s>.

children.text: mā te rasasya matsata dvayāvino draviṇasvanta iha santv indavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let not the double-dealers intoxicate themselves with your juice; let the drops rich in wealth be here.

children.text: asmān samarye pavamāna codaya dakṣo devānām asi hi priyo madaḥ
children.translated_text: In the battle, O purifying one, impel us; for you are the gods' skill, their dear exhilaration.

children.text: jahi śatrūṃr abhy ā bhandanāyataḥ pibendra somam ava no mṛdho jahi ||
children.translated_text: Strike down the enemies as they bind us; drink the <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indra</s>; strike away our foes.

children.text: adabdha indo pavase madintama ātmendrasya bhavasi dhāsir uttamaḥ
children.translated_text: Unharmed, O <s>Indu</s>, you purify yourself, most intoxicating; you become <s>Indra</s>'s very self, the highest support.

children.text: abhi svaranti bahavo manīṣiṇo rājānam asya bhuvanasya niṃsate ||
children.translated_text: Many inspired men call out toward him; they praise him as king of this world.

children.text: sahasraṇīthaḥ śatadhāro adbhuta indrāyenduḥ pavate kāmyam madhu
children.translated_text: Thousand-leading, hundred-streamed, wondrous, <s>Indu</s> purifies for <s>Indra</s> the desirable honey.

children.text: jayan kṣetram abhy arṣā jayann apa uruṃ no gātuṃ kṛṇu soma mīḍhvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Winning the field, flow forth and win the waters; make a broad path for us, O bounteous <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: kanikradat kalaśe gobhir ajyase vy avyayaṃ samayā vāram arṣasi
children.translated_text: Roaring in the vessel, you are anointed with cows' milk; through the imperishable filter you flow across the wool.

children.text: marmṛjyamāno atyo na sānasir indrasya soma jaṭhare sam akṣaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Being cleansed, like an unwearied racehorse, O <s>Soma</s>, you have flowed together into <s>Indra</s>'s belly.

children.text: svāduḥ pavasva divyāya janmane svādur indrāya suhavītunāmne
children.translated_text: Flow sweetly for the heavenly birth, sweetly for <s>Indra</s>, whose name is easy to invoke.

children.text: svādur mitrāya varuṇāya vāyave bṛhaspataye madhumāṁ adābhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Sweetly for <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Vāyu</s>, and <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, honeyed and not to be deceived.

children.text: atyam mṛjanti kalaśe daśa kṣipaḥ pra viprāṇām matayo vāca īrate
children.translated_text: The ten fingers cleanse the steed in the vessel; the inspired men's thoughts send forth words.

children.text: pavamānā abhy arṣanti suṣṭutim endraṃ viśanti madirāsa indavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The purifying, exhilarating drops flow toward the fair praise and enter <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: pavamāno abhy arṣā suvīryam urvīṃ gavyūtim mahi śarma saprathaḥ
children.translated_text: O purifying one, flow toward heroic strength, a broad pasture rich in cows, and great shelter spread wide.

children.text: mākir no asya pariṣūtir īśatendo jayema tvayā dhanaṃ dhanam ||
children.translated_text: Let no besieger of his rule over us, O <s>Indu</s>; with you may we win wealth after wealth.

children.text: adhi dyām asthād vṛṣabho vicakṣaṇo 'rūrucad vi divo rocanā kaviḥ
children.translated_text: The discerning bull has stood upon heaven; the poet has shone out through the luminous spaces of heaven.

children.text: rājā pavitram aty eti roruvad divaḥ pīyūṣaṃ duhate nṛcakṣasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The king goes beyond the filter, roaring; the watchers of men milk the nectar of heaven.

children.text: divo nāke madhujihvā asaścato venā duhanty ukṣaṇaṃ giriṣṭhām
children.translated_text: At heaven's summit the honey-tongued, unwearied songs milk the bull who stands on the mountain.

children.text: apsu drapsaṃ vāvṛdhānaṃ samudra ā sindhor ūrmā madhumantam pavitra ā ||
children.translated_text: In the waters and in the ocean, the drop swelling to greatness, the honeyed wave of the river, is in the filter.

children.text: nāke suparṇam upapaptivāṃsaṃ giro venānām akṛpanta pūrvīḥ
children.translated_text: The many songs of the longing ones have cried out to the eagle that has flown up to heaven's summit.

children.text: śiśuṃ rihanti matayaḥ panipnataṃ hiraṇyayaṃ śakunaṃ kṣāmaṇi sthām ||
children.translated_text: The thoughts lick the child as he trembles, the golden bird set upon the earth.

children.text: ūrdhvo gandharvo adhi nāke asthād viśvā rūpā praticakṣāṇo asya
children.translated_text: The <s>Gandharva</s> has stood upright on heaven's summit, beholding all his forms.

children.text: bhānuḥ śukreṇa śociṣā vy adyaut prārūrucad rodasī mātarā śuciḥ ||
children.translated_text: The bright one has shone with pure flame; the pure one has lit up the two mother-worlds, heaven and earth.

children.text: Chapter 809
pra ta āśavaḥ pavamāna dhījavo madā arṣanti raghujā iva tmanā
children.translated_text: Your swift, thought-driven exhilarations, O purifying one, run forth by themselves like those born for speed.

children.text: divyāḥ suparṇā madhumanta indavo madintamāsaḥ pari kośam āsate ||
children.translated_text: The heavenly eagles, honeyed drops, most intoxicating, settle around the vat.

children.text: pra te madāso madirāsa āśavo 'sṛkṣata rathyāso yathā pṛthak
children.translated_text: Your intoxicating, swift draughts have been released separately, like chariots on their roads.

children.text: dhenur na vatsam payasābhi vajriṇam indram indavo madhumanta ūrmayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The honeyed drops, the waves, flow with milk toward <s>Indra</s> the thunderbolt-bearer, as a cow toward her calf.

children.text: atyo na hiyāno abhi vājam arṣa svarvit kośaṃ divo adrimātaram
children.translated_text: Like a horse being urged on, flow toward the prize, finder of the sun, to the vessel of heaven, whose mother is the stone.

children.text: vṛṣā pavitre adhi sāno avyaye somaḥ punāna indriyāya dhāyase ||
children.translated_text: The bull, <s>Soma</s>, being purified on the imperishable ridge in the filter, is set down for strength.

children.text: pra ta āśvinīḥ pavamāna dhījuvo divyā asṛgran payasā dharīmaṇi
children.translated_text: Your swift, thought-driven streams, O purifying one, have been released, heavenly, with milk upon the support.

children.text: prāntar ṛṣaya sthāvirīr asṛkṣata ye tvā mṛjanty ṛṣiṣāṇa vedhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The ancient seers have sent him forth within, those inspired sages and makers who cleanse you.

children.text: viśvā dhāmāni viśvacakṣa ṛbhvasaḥ prabhos te sataḥ pari yanti ketavaḥ
children.translated_text: All stations, O all-seeing capable one, the rays go around you, as you are mighty.

children.text: vyānaśiḥ pavase soma dharmabhiḥ patir viśvasya bhuvanasya rājasi ||
children.translated_text: You pervade widely; you purify yourself, O <s>Soma</s>, according to the ordinances; as lord of the whole world you reign.

children.text: ubhayataḥ pavamānasya raśmayo dhruvasya sataḥ pari yanti ketavaḥ
children.translated_text: On both sides the rays of the purifying one, steadfast as he is, go around as signs.

children.text: yadī pavitre adhi mṛjyate hariḥ sattā ni yonā kalaśeṣu sīdati ||
children.translated_text: When the tawny one is cleansed upon the filter, the true one sits down in the wombs, in the bowls.

children.text: yajñasya ketuḥ pavate svadhvaraḥ somo devānām upa yāti niṣkṛtam
children.translated_text: The signal of the sacrifice, performing the rite well, <s>Soma</s> purifies himself; he goes to the prepared place of the gods.

children.text: sahasradhāraḥ pari kośam arṣati vṛṣā pavitram aty eti roruvat ||
children.translated_text: Thousand-streamed, the bull flows around the vessel; roaring, he passes beyond the filter.

children.text: rājā samudraṃ nadyo vi gāhate 'pām ūrmiṃ sacate sindhuṣu śritaḥ
children.translated_text: The king plunges into the sea, the rivers; lodged among the streams, he joins the wave of the waters.

children.text: adhy asthāt sānu pavamāno avyayaṃ nābhā pṛthivyā dharuṇo maho divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The purifying one has mounted the unfailing summit, the navel of earth, the support of great heaven.

children.text: divo na sānu stanayann acikradad dyauś ca yasya pṛthivī ca dharmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: Like the ridge of heaven, thundering, he has cried aloud, he by whose ordinances heaven and earth stand firm.

children.text: indrasya sakhyam pavate vivevidat somaḥ punānaḥ kalaśeṣu sīdati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, being purified, discovers friendship with <s>Indra</s>; he sits down in the bowls.

children.text: jyotir yajñasya pavate madhu priyam pitā devānāṃ janitā vibhūvasuḥ
children.translated_text: The light of the sacrifice purifies itself, the dear sweetness, father of the gods, begetter, rich in wide wealth.

children.text: dadhāti ratnaṃ svadhayor apīcyam madintamo matsara indriyo rasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He places the hidden treasure belonging to the two powers of self-rule, the most exhilarating intoxicant, the <s>Indra</s>-strengthening sap.

children.text: abhikrandan kalaśaṃ vājy arṣati patir divaḥ śatadhāro vicakṣaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Crying out, the prize-winning one flows to the bowl, lord of heaven, hundred-streamed, far-seeing.

children.text: harir mitrasya sadaneṣu sīdati marmṛjāno 'vibhiḥ sindhubhir vṛṣā ||
children.translated_text: The tawny bull sits in the seats of <s>Mitra</s>, being cleansed by the sheep-wool and by the rivers.

children.text: agre sindhūnām pavamāno arṣaty agre vāco agriyo goṣu gacchati
children.translated_text: At the head of the rivers the purifying one flows; foremost of speech, the foremost one goes among the cows.

children.text: agre vājasya bhajate mahādhanaṃ svāyudhaḥ sotṛbhiḥ pūyate vṛṣā ||
children.translated_text: At the head of the prize he claims great wealth; armed with his own weapon, the bull is purified by the pressers.

children.text: ayam matavāñchakuno yathā hito 'vye sasāra pavamāna ūrmiṇā
children.translated_text: This thoughtful bird, as if set in place, the purifying one, has streamed over the sheep-wool with his wave.

children.text: tava kratvā rodasī antarā kave śucir dhiyā pavate soma indra te ||
children.translated_text: By your insight, O poet, between heaven and earth, pure with thought, <s>Soma</s> purifies himself for you, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: drāpiṃ vasāno yajato divispṛśam antarikṣaprā bhuvaneṣv arpitaḥ
children.translated_text: Clothing himself in a cloak, worthy of worship, touching heaven, filling the midspace, set among beings,

children.text: svar jajñāno nabhasābhy akramīt pratnam asya pitaram ā vivāsati ||
children.translated_text: being born to the light, he stepped across with the cloud; he seeks to win his ancient father.

children.text: so asya viśe mahi śarma yacchati yo asya dhāma prathamaṃ vyānaśe
children.translated_text: He grants great shelter to this clan of his, he who has spread through his first abode.

children.text: padaṃ yad asya parame vyomany ato viśvā abhi saṃ yāti saṃyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: When his station is in the highest heaven, from there, well-restrained, he gathers all things together.

children.text: pro ayāsīd indur indrasya niṣkṛtaṃ sakhā sakhyur na pra mināti saṃgiram
children.translated_text: The drop has gone forth to <s>Indra</s>'s prepared place; like a friend, he does not break his friend's agreement.

children.text: marya iva yuvatibhiḥ sam arṣati somaḥ kalaśe śatayāmnā pathā ||
children.translated_text: Like a young man with maidens, <s>Soma</s> flows together into the bowl by a hundredfold path.

children.text: pra vo dhiyo mandrayuvo vipanyuvaḥ panasyuvaḥ saṃvasaneṣv akramuḥ
children.translated_text: Your thoughts, seeking delight, praising, and desiring praise, have advanced into the common dwellings.

children.text: somam manīṣā abhy anūṣata stubho 'bhi dhenavaḥ payasem aśiśrayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The praises and hymns have sung to <s>Soma</s> with insight; the milch-cows have leaned upon him with their milk.

children.text: ā naḥ soma saṃyatam pipyuṣīm iṣam indo pavasva pavamāno asridham
children.translated_text: For us, O <s>Soma</s>, pour forth the gathered, swelling refreshment; O <s>Indu</s>, purifying one, flow without failing.

children.text: yā no dohate trir ahann asaścuṣī kṣumad vājavan madhumat suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: It milks for us three times a day, unfailing, rich in food, prize-bearing, honey-sweet, and full of good heroic power.

children.text: vṛṣā matīnām pavate vicakṣaṇaḥ somo ahnaḥ pratarītoṣaso divaḥ
children.translated_text: The bull of thoughts, far-seeing <s>Soma</s>, is purified, carried forward from day, dawns, and heaven.

children.text: krāṇā sindhūnāṃ kalaśāṁ avīvaśad indrasya hārdy āviśan manīṣibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Active among the rivers, he has made the bowls long for him, entering <s>Indra</s>'s heart through inspired thoughts.

children.text: manīṣibhiḥ pavate pūrvyaḥ kavir nṛbhir yataḥ pari kośāṁ acikradat
children.translated_text: The ancient poet is purified by the inspired men; driven by men, he has cried out around the vessels.

children.text: tritasya nāma janayan madhu kṣarad indrasya vāyoḥ sakhyāya kartave ||
children.translated_text: Generating the name of <s>Trita</s>, he has poured sweetness, in order to make friendship with <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: ayam punāna uṣaso vi rocayad ayaṃ sindhubhyo abhavad u lokakṛt
children.translated_text: This one, being purified, made the dawns shine; this one became a maker of space for the rivers.

children.text: ayaṃ triḥ sapta duduhāna āśiraṃ somo hṛde pavate cāru matsaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s>, thrice sevenfold, milking the mixture, purifies himself for the heart, lovely and intoxicating.

children.text: pavasva soma divyeṣu dhāmasu sṛjāna indo kalaśe pavitra ā
children.translated_text: Purify yourself, O <s>Soma</s>, in the heavenly abodes, being released, O <s>Indu</s>, into the bowl upon the filter.

children.text: sīdann indrasya jaṭhare kanikradan nṛbhir yataḥ sūryam ārohayo divi ||
children.translated_text: Sitting in <s>Indra</s>'s belly and roaring, driven by men, you made the sun ascend in heaven.

children.text: adribhiḥ sutaḥ pavase pavitra āṃ indav indrasya jaṭhareṣv āviśan
children.translated_text: Pressed by the stones, you purify yourself upon the filter, O <s>Indu</s>, entering the bellies of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ nṛcakṣā abhavo vicakṣaṇa soma gotram aṅgirobhyo 'vṛṇor apa ||
children.translated_text: You became man-watching and far-seeing, O <s>Soma</s>; you opened the cow-pen for the <s>Aṅgirases</s>.

children.text: tvāṃ soma pavamānaṃ svādhyo 'nu viprāso amadann avasyavaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O purifying <s>Soma</s>, the well-minded inspired poets followed; seeking aid, they rejoiced in you.

children.text: tvāṃ suparṇa ābharad divas parīndo viśvābhir matibhiḥ pariṣkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: The eagle brought you from heaven, O <s>Indu</s>, adorned with all inspired thoughts.

children.text: avye punānam pari vāra ūrmiṇā hariṃ navante abhi sapta dhenavaḥ
children.translated_text: As the tawny one is purified in the sheep-wool, around the enclosure with his wave, the seven cows low toward him.

children.text: apām upasthe adhy āyavaḥ kavim ṛtasya yonā mahiṣā aheṣata ||
children.translated_text: In the lap of the waters, in the womb of <s>ṛta</s>, the mighty ones have bellowed to the poet, the buffalo.

children.text: induḥ punāno ati gāhate mṛdho viśvāni kṛṇvan supathāni yajyave
children.translated_text: The drop, being purified, passes beyond the attacks, making all paths good for the sacrificer.

children.text: gāḥ kṛṇvāno nirṇijaṃ haryataḥ kavir atyo na krīﾱan pari vāram arṣati ||
children.translated_text: The desired poet, making the cows his adornment, runs around the filter like a racehorse at play.

children.text: asaścataḥ śatadhārā abhiśriyo hariṃ navante 'va tā udanyuvaḥ
children.translated_text: The hundred-streamed, beautiful ones, unmingled, call to the tawny one like those thirsting for water.

children.text: kṣipo mṛjanti pari gobhir āvṛtaṃ tṛtīye pṛṣṭhe adhi rocane divaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The fingers cleanse him, covered about with cows' milk, upon the third back, in the shining realm of heaven.

children.text: tavemāḥ prajā divyasya retasas tvaṃ viśvasya bhuvanasya rājasi
children.translated_text: These creatures are yours, of heavenly seed; you rule over the whole world.

children.text: athedaṃ viśvam pavamāna te vaśe tvam indo prathamo dhāmadhā asi ||
children.translated_text: And this whole universe, O purifying one, is in your power; you, O <s>Indu</s>, are the first establisher of the abodes.

children.text: tvaṃ samudro asi viśvavit kave tavemāḥ pañca pradiśo vidharmaṇi
children.translated_text: You are the ocean, knowing all, O poet; these five regions are yours in their ordinances.

children.text: tvaṃ dyāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ cāti jabhriṣe tava jyotīṃṣi pavamāna sūryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You have encompassed heaven and earth; your lights, O purifying one, are <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: tvam pavitre rajaso vidharmaṇi devebhyaḥ soma pavamāna pūyase
children.translated_text: You are purified in the filter, in the ordinance of the midspace, O purifying <s>Soma</s>, for the gods.

children.text: tvām uśijaḥ prathamā agṛbhṇata tubhyemā viśvā bhuvanāni yemire ||
children.translated_text: The eager priests were the first to seize you; for you all these beings have held themselves in order.

children.text: pra rebha ety ati vāram avyayaṃ vṛṣā vaneṣv ava cakradaddhariḥ
children.translated_text: The roaring one goes forth beyond the sheep-wool filter; the tawny bull has roared down in the woods.

children.text: saṃ dhītayo vāvaśānā anūṣata śiśuṃ rihanti matayaḥ panipnatam ||
children.translated_text: The yearning thoughts have sung together; the inspired thoughts lick the child, who is to be praised.

children.text: sa sūryasya raśmibhiḥ pari vyata tantuṃ tanvānas trivṛtaṃ yathā vide
children.translated_text: With the rays of <s>Sūrya</s> he has stretched the thread around him, weaving the threefold one, as one who knows.

children.text: nayann ṛtasya praśiṣo navīyasīḥ patir janīnām upa yāti niṣkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: Leading the newer commands of <s>ṛta</s>, the lord of peoples goes to the prepared place.

children.text: rājā sindhūnām pavate patir diva ṛtasya yāti pathibhiḥ kanikradat
children.translated_text: The king of the rivers, the lord of heaven, is purified; he goes by the paths of <s>ṛta</s>, roaring.

children.text: sahasradhāraḥ pari ṣicyate hariḥ punāno vācaṃ janayann upāvasuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The thousand-streamed tawny one is poured all around; purifying himself, rich in goods, he generates speech.

children.text: pavamāna mahy arṇo vi dhāvasi sūro na citro avyayāni pavyayā
children.translated_text: O purifying one, you rush as a great flood, like the radiant sun, through the unfailing filters.

children.text: gabhastipūto nṛbhir adribhiḥ suto mahe vājāya dhanyāya dhanvasi ||
children.translated_text: Cleansed by hands and pressed by men with stones, you run for the great prize and for blessed wealth.

children.text: iṣam ūrjam pavamānābhy arṣasi śyeno na vaṃsu kalaśeṣu sīdasi
children.translated_text: As purifying one you flow toward refreshment and strength; like a hawk to its nest, you sit in the jars.

children.text: indrāya madvā madyo madaḥ suto divo viṣṭambha upamo vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Pressed for <s>Indra</s>, the sweet intoxicating draught is exhilaration itself, discerning, like the very prop of heaven.

children.text: sapta svasāro abhi mātaraḥ śiśuṃ navaṃ jajñānaṃ jenyaṃ vipaścitam
children.translated_text: The seven sisters, the mothers, come around the child newly born, victorious and inspired.

children.text: apāṃ gandharvaṃ divyaṃ nṛcakṣasaṃ somaṃ viśvasya bhuvanasya rājase ||
children.translated_text: They attend <s>Soma</s>, the heavenly <s>Gandharva</s> of the waters, seeing men, for the kingship of the whole world.

children.text: īśāna imā bhuvanāni vīyase yujāna indo haritaḥ suparṇyaḥ
children.translated_text: As lord you are mighty over these worlds, O <s>Indu</s>, yoking the tawny, fair-winged mares.

children.text: tās te kṣarantu madhumad ghṛtam payas tava vrate soma tiṣṭhantu kṛṣṭayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let them stream for you honeyed ghee and milk; let the peoples stand within your ordinance, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ nṛcakṣā asi soma viśvataḥ pavamāna vṛṣabha tā vi dhāvasi
children.translated_text: You are the watcher of men from every side, O <s>Soma</s>; O purifying bull, you run in all directions.

children.text: sa naḥ pavasva vasumaddhiraṇyavad vayaṃ syāma bhuvaneṣu jīvase ||
children.translated_text: So purify yourself for us with wealth and with gold; may we be among living beings for the sake of life.

children.text: govit pavasva vasuviddhiraṇyavid retodhā indo bhuvaneṣv arpitaḥ
children.translated_text: Find cows, find wealth, find gold as you purify yourself; O <s>Indu</s>, seed-holder, you are set among the worlds.

children.text: tvaṃ suvīro asi soma viśvavit taṃ tvā viprā upa girema āsate ||
children.translated_text: You are rich in heroes, O <s>Soma</s>, finder of all; to you the inspired poets sit near with song.

children.text: un madhva ūrmir vananā atiṣṭhipad apo vasāno mahiṣo vi gāhate
children.translated_text: The wave of honey has risen over the woods; clothed in the waters, the buffalo plunges deep.

children.text: rājā pavitraratho vājam āruhat sahasrabhṛṣṭir jayati śravo bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: The king whose chariot is the filter has mounted the prize; thousand-pointed, he wins broad fame.

children.text: sa bhandanā ud iyarti prajāvatīr viśvāyur viśvāḥ subharā ahardivi
children.translated_text: He raises up bounteous powers rich in offspring, life-giving to all and bearing all good things day by day.

children.text: brahma prajāvad rayim aśvapastyam pīta indav indram asmabhyaṃ yācatāt ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, when drunk, ask <s>Indra</s> for us for sacred utterance, wealth rich in offspring, and mastery of horses.

children.text: so agre ahnāṃ harir haryato madaḥ pra cetasā cetayate anu dyubhiḥ
children.translated_text: At the beginning of the days, the tawny, desirable exhilaration awakens with insight through the days.

children.text: dvā janā yātayann antar īyate narā ca śaṃsaṃ daivyaṃ ca dhartari ||
children.translated_text: Setting the two peoples in motion, he passes between them, holding both human praise and the divine one.

children.text: añjate vy añjate sam añjate kratuṃ rihanti madhunābhy añjate
children.translated_text: They anoint him, anoint him apart, anoint him together; they lick his power and anoint him with honey.

children.text: sindhor ucchvāse patayantam ukṣaṇaṃ hiraṇyapāvāḥ paśum āsu gṛbhṇate ||
children.translated_text: The golden purifiers grasp the bull, the beast, flying at the swelling of the river, among the waters.

children.text: vipaścite pavamānāya gāyata mahī na dhārāty andho arṣati
children.translated_text: Sing to the discerning purifying one; like a great stream the Soma-juice flows forth.

children.text: ahir na jūrṇām ati sarpati tvacam atyo na krīﾱann asarad vṛṣā hariḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like a serpent he creeps beyond its worn-out skin; like a courser at play, the tawny bull has flowed.

children.text: agrego rājāpyas taviṣyate vimāno ahnām bhuvaneṣv arpitaḥ
children.translated_text: The foremost watery king grows mighty, measuring the days, set in place among the worlds.

children.text: harir ghṛtasnuḥ sudṛśīko arṇavo jyotīrathaḥ pavate rāya okyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The tawny one, dripping ghee and beautiful to see, a flood with light as his chariot, purifies himself, dwelling in wealth.

children.text: asarji skambho diva udyato madaḥ pari tridhātur bhuvanāny arṣati
children.translated_text: The prop of heaven, the uplifted exhilaration, has been released; threefold, he flows around the worlds.

children.text: aṃśuṃ rihanti matayaḥ panipnataṃ girā yadi nirṇijam ṛgmiṇo yayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thoughts lick the trembling stalk when the singers have gone with song to its bright adornment.

children.text: pra te dhārā aty aṇvāni meṣyaḥ punānasya saṃyato yanti raṃhayaḥ
children.translated_text: Your streams, the swift sheep-wool cleansers of the one being purified, go over the fine fibers, sped onward.

children.text: yad gobhir indo camvoḥ samajyasa ā suvānaḥ soma kalaśeṣu sīdasi ||
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indu</s>, you are anointed with cows' milk in the two vats, being pressed, O <s>Soma</s>, you sit in the jars.

children.text: pavasva soma kratuvin na ukthyo 'vyo vāre pari dhāva madhu priyam
children.translated_text: Purify yourself, O <s>Soma</s>, knowing power, worthy of hymns; run around through the sheep-wool filter, the beloved honey.

children.text: jahi viśvān rakṣasa indo atriṇo bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Slay all the demon-devourers, O <s>Indu</s>; may we speak loudly in the assembly, rich in heroes.

children.text: Chapter 810
pra tu drava pari kośaṃ ni ṣīda nṛbhiḥ punāno abhi vājam arṣa
children.translated_text: Rush forward; settle down around the vat; being purified by men, flow toward the prize.

children.text: aśvaṃ na tvā vājinam marjayanto 'cchā barhī raśanābhir nayanti ||
children.translated_text: They groom you like a racing horse and lead you toward the <s>barhis</s> (sacrificial grass) with reins.

children.text: svāyudhaḥ pavate deva indur aśastihā vṛjanaṃ rakṣamāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: The divine <s>Indu</s> purifies himself with his own weapon, smiting malediction and guarding the enclosure.

children.text: pitā devānāṃ janitā sudakṣo viṣṭambho divo dharuṇaḥ pṛthivyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Father of the gods, begetter, very skillful, he is the support of heaven and the foundation of earth.

children.text: ṛṣir vipraḥ puraetā janānām ṛbhur dhīra uśanā kāvyena
children.translated_text: The seer, the inspired poet, the forerunner of peoples, an <s>Ṛbhu</s>, wise <s>Uśanā</s> through poetic wisdom,

children.text: sa cid viveda nihitaṃ yad āsām apīcyaṃ guhyaṃ nāma gonām ||
children.translated_text: he indeed discovered what was placed within them: the hidden, secret name of the cows.

children.text: eṣa sya te madhumāṁ indra somo vṛṣā vṛṣṇe pari pavitre akṣāḥ
children.translated_text: This honeyed <s>Soma</s> of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, the bull for the bull, has flowed around through the filter.

children.text: sahasrasāḥ śatasā bhūridāvā śaśvattamam barhir ā vājy asthāt ||
children.translated_text: Winning thousands, winning hundreds, giving much, he has taken his place on the most constant <s>barhis</s> as a prize-winner.

children.text: ete somā abhi gavyā sahasrā mahe vājāyāmṛtāya śravāṃsi
children.translated_text: These <s>Somas</s>, rich in cows and thousands, are for the great prize, for immortal fame.

children.text: pavitrebhiḥ pavamānā asṛgrañchravasyavo na pṛtanājo atyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They have been released through the filters, purifying themselves, seeking fame like coursers winning battles.

children.text: pari hi ṣmā puruhūto janānāṃ viśvāsarad bhojanā pūyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: For the much-invoked one, being purified, goes around among the peoples' nourishment in every season.

children.text: athā bhara śyenabhṛta prayāṃsi rayiṃ tuñjāno abhi vājam arṣa ||
children.translated_text: Then bring the eagle-borne delights; pressing out wealth, flow toward the prize.

children.text: eṣa suvānaḥ pari somaḥ pavitre sargo na sṛṣṭo adadhāvad arvā
children.translated_text: This pressed <s>Soma</s> has run through the filter, like a released stream sent forward.

children.text: tigme śiśāno mahiṣo na śṛṅge gā gavyann abhi śūro na satvā ||
children.translated_text: Sharpening his sharp horns like a buffalo, seeking cows, he advances against the cows like a hero, like a fighter.

children.text: eṣā yayau paramād antar adreḥ kūcit satīr ūrve gā viveda
children.translated_text: This stream went from the highest place within the rock; though hidden, she found the cows in the wide space.

children.text: divo na vidyut stanayanty abhraiḥ somasya te pavata indra dhārā ||
children.translated_text: Like lightning from heaven, thundering with clouds, your streams of <s>Soma</s> purify themselves for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: uta sma rāśim pari yāsi gonām indreṇa soma saratham punānaḥ
children.translated_text: And, O <s>Soma</s>, being purified, you go around the heap of cows, sharing one chariot with <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: pūrvīr iṣo bṛhatīr jīradāno śikṣā śacīvas tava tā upaṣṭut ||
children.translated_text: Giving many broad and quickening refreshments, grant those powers of yours, O powerful one, praised by us.

children.text: Chapter 811
ayaṃ soma indra tubhyaṃ sunve tubhyam pavate tvam asya pāhi
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s> is pressed for you, O <s>Indra</s>; for you he purifies himself; drink of him.

children.text: tvaṃ ha yaṃ cakṛṣe tvaṃ vavṛṣa indum madāya yujyāya somam ||
children.translated_text: You indeed made him; you have increased the <s>Indu</s>, the <s>Soma</s>, for exhilaration and allied help.

children.text: sa īṃ ratho na bhūriṣāﾱ ayoji mahaḥ purūṇi sātaye vasūni
children.translated_text: He, like a chariot, was yoked for the gaining of many great treasures.

children.text: ād īṃ viśvā nahuṣyāṇi jātā svarṣātā vana ūrdhvā navanta ||
children.translated_text: Then all the human births, winning the sun, bent upward in the wood.

children.text: vāyur na yo niyutvāṁ iṣṭayāmā nāsatyeva hava ā śambhaviṣṭhaḥ
children.translated_text: Like <s>Vāyu</s> with his teams, going to the offering, like the <s>Nāsatyas</s> at the call, most beneficent,

children.text: viśvavāro draviṇodā iva tman pūṣeva dhījavano 'si soma ||
children.translated_text: chosen by all, like <s>Draviṇodas</s> himself, like <s>Pūṣan</s> who speeds thought, you are, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: indro na yo mahā karmāṇi cakrir hantā vṛtrāṇām asi soma pūrbhit
children.translated_text: Like <s>Indra</s>, who has performed great deeds, you are the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>s, O <s>Soma</s>, breaker of strongholds.

children.text: paidvo na hi tvam ahināmnāṃ hantā viśvasyāsi soma dasyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like <s>Paidva</s>, for you, O <s>Soma</s>, are the slayer of those called serpents and of every <s>Dasyu</s>.

children.text: agnir na yo vana ā sṛjyamāno vṛthā pājāṃsi kṛṇute nadīṣu
children.translated_text: Like fire when it is let loose in the woods, he freely makes his powers in the rivers.

children.text: jano na yudhvā mahata upabdir iyarti somaḥ pavamāna ūrmim ||
children.translated_text: Like a fighting man, a mighty assailant, purifying <s>Soma</s> drives the wave onward.

children.text: ete somā ati vārāṇy avyā divyā na kośāso abhravarṣāḥ
children.translated_text: These <s>Somas</s> pass beyond the woolen filters, like heavenly vessels raining from the clouds.

children.text: vṛthā samudraṃ sindhavo na nīcīḥ sutāso abhi kalaśāṁ asṛgran ||
children.translated_text: The pressed juices have streamed toward the bowl, as rivers run freely downward to the ocean.

children.text: śuṣmī śardho na mārutam pavasvānabhiśastā divyā yathā viṭ
children.translated_text: Powerful, like the host of the <s>Maruts</s>, purify yourself, unreproached, like a heavenly clan.

children.text: āpo na makṣū sumatir bhavā naḥ sahasrāpsāḥ pṛtanāṣāṇ na yajñaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like the waters, quickly become good favor for us, thousand-watered, and battle-winning like a <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice).

children.text: rājño nu te varuṇasya vratāni bṛhad gabhīraṃ tava soma dhāma
children.translated_text: Now yours are the ordinances of King <s>Varuṇa</s>; broad and deep is your dwelling, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: śuciṣ ṭvam asi priyo na mitro dakṣāyyo aryamevāsi soma ||
children.translated_text: You are bright, dear like <s>Mitra</s>, fit for skill; you are as <s>Aryaman</s>, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: Chapter 812
pro sya vahniḥ pathyābhir asyān divo na vṛṣṭiḥ pavamāno akṣāḥ
children.translated_text: Forth this carrier has flowed along his paths; like rain from heaven, the purifying one has streamed.

children.text: sahasradhāro asadan ny asme mātur upasthe vana ā ca somaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thousand-streamed, <s>Soma</s> has settled here among us, in the mother's lap and in the wood.

children.text: rājā sindhūnām avasiṣṭa vāsa ṛtasya nāvam āruhad rajiṣṭhām
children.translated_text: The king of rivers has clothed himself in radiance; he has mounted the straightest ship of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: apsu drapso vāvṛdhe śyenajūto duha īm pitā duha īm pitur jām ||
children.translated_text: The drop in the waters has grown, impelled by the eagle; the father milks him, and he milks the father's daughter.

children.text: siṃhaṃ nasanta madhvo ayāsaṃ harim aruṣaṃ divo asya patim
children.translated_text: They seek the lion, the tireless one of sweetness, the tawny, ruddy lord of heaven.

children.text: śūro yutsu prathamaḥ pṛcchate gā asya cakṣasā pari pāty ukṣā ||
children.translated_text: The hero, first in battles, asks after the cows; by his sight the bull guards this world around.

children.text: madhupṛṣṭhaṃ ghoram ayāsam aśvaṃ rathe yuñjanty urucakra ṛṣvam
children.translated_text: They yoke to the chariot the honey-backed, terrible, tireless horse, wide-wheeled and lofty.

children.text: svasāra īṃ jāmayo marjayanti sanābhayo vājinam ūrjayanti ||
children.translated_text: The sisters, the kinswomen, cleanse him; those of one womb strengthen the prize-winning steed.

children.text: catasra īṃ ghṛtaduhaḥ sacante samāne antar dharuṇe niṣattāḥ
children.translated_text: Four ghee-milking ones accompany him, seated within the same support.

children.text: tā īm arṣanti namasā punānās tā īṃ viśvataḥ pari ṣanti pūrvīḥ ||
children.translated_text: They flow around him with reverence as they purify him; those many ancient ones surround him on every side.

children.text: viṣṭambho divo dharuṇaḥ pṛthivyā viśvā uta kṣitayo haste asya
children.translated_text: He is the prop of heaven and the support of earth; all peoples too are in his hand.

children.text: asat ta utso gṛṇate niyutvān madhvo aṃśuḥ pavata indriyāya ||
children.translated_text: Let your well, rich with teams, be there for the singer; the honeyed stalk purifies itself for strength.

children.text: vanvann avāto abhi devavītim indrāya soma vṛtrahā pavasva
children.translated_text: Winning aid, flowing toward the divine feast, purify yourself for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Soma</s>, slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: śagdhi mahaḥ puruścandrasya rāyaḥ suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: Grant us a share of great, richly shining wealth; may we be lords of heroic power.

children.text: Chapter 813
pra hinvāno janitā rodasyo ratho na vājaṃ saniṣyann ayāsīt
children.translated_text: Set in motion, the begetter of the two worlds has gone like a chariot seeking to win the prize.

children.text: indraṃ gacchann āyudhā saṃśiśāno viśvā vasu hastayor ādadhānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Going to <s>Indra</s>, sharpening his weapons, he places all riches in his hands.

children.text: abhi tripṛṣṭhaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vayodhām āṅgūṣāṇām avāvaśanta vāṇīḥ
children.translated_text: The voices of the pressers have called aloud to the three-backed, virile giver of vigor.

children.text: vanā vasāno varuṇo na sindhūn vi ratnadhā dayate vāryāṇi ||
children.translated_text: Clothing himself in the woods, like <s>Varuṇa</s> among the rivers, he distributes desirable treasures.

children.text: śūragrāmaḥ sarvavīraḥ sahāvāñ jetā pavasva sanitā dhanāni
children.translated_text: With a troop of heroes, all-heroic and strong, victorious, purify yourself as a winner of riches.

children.text: tigmāyudhaḥ kṣipradhanvā samatsv aṣāﾱhaḥ sāhvān pṛtanāsu śatrūn ||
children.translated_text: Sharp-weaponed and swift-bowed in battles, unconquered, he overcomes enemies in combats.

children.text: urugavyūtir abhayāni kṛṇvan samīcīne ā pavasvā purandhī
children.translated_text: Making broad cow-pastures and places free from fear, flow toward us in one direction with abundance.

children.text: apaḥ siṣāsann uṣasaḥ svar gāḥ saṃ cikrado maho asmabhyaṃ vājān ||
children.translated_text: Seeking waters, dawns, sunlight, and cows, roar together for great prizes for us.

children.text: matsi soma varuṇam matsi mitram matsīndram indo pavamāna viṣṇum
children.translated_text: Gladden <s>Varuṇa</s>, O <s>Soma</s>; gladden <s>Mitra</s>; gladden <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>, purifying one, and <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

children.text: matsi śardho mārutam matsi devān matsi mahām indram indo madāya ||
children.translated_text: Gladden the host of the <s>Maruts</s>; gladden the gods; gladden great <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>, for exhilaration.

children.text: evā rājeva kratumāṁ amena viśvā ghanighnad duritā pavasva
children.translated_text: Thus, like a king possessed of insight and force, purify yourself, crushing all hardships.

children.text: indo sūktāya vacase vayo dhā yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, bestow vigor for the well-spoken hymn and utterance. May you all protect us always with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 814
asarji vakvā rathye yathājau dhiyā manotā prathamo manīṣī
children.translated_text: The eloquent one has been released, like a chariot-horse on the racecourse; by inspired thought he is the first sage.

children.text: daśa svasāro adhi sāno avye 'janti vahniṃ sadanāny accha ||
children.translated_text: Ten sisters, upon the height of the wool, drive the carrier toward his seats.

children.text: vītī janasya divyasya kavyair adhi suvāno nahuṣyebhir induḥ
children.translated_text: For the feast of the heavenly people, with poems, the pressed <s>Indu</s> moves on with human praises.

children.text: pra yo nṛbhir amṛto martyebhir marmṛjāno 'vibhir gobhir adbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: He, immortal among mortals, is cleansed by men with wool, with cows' milk, and with waters.

children.text: vṛṣā vṛṣṇe roruvad aṃśur asmai pavamāno ruśad īrte payo goḥ
children.translated_text: The bulling stalk, bellowing for the bull, as it purifies itself sends forth for him the shining milk of the cow.

children.text: sahasram ṛkvā pathibhir vacovid adhvasmabhiḥ sūro aṇvaṃ vi yāti ||
children.translated_text: Rich in praise, thousandfold, knowing speech, the sun-like one travels the narrow course by prepared paths.

children.text: rujā dṛﾱhā cid rakṣasaḥ sadāṃsi punāna inda ūrṇuhi vi vājān
children.translated_text: Break even the firm seats of the <s>Rakṣas</s>; while purifying yourself, O <s>Indu</s>, uncover the prizes.

children.text: vṛścopariṣṭāt tujatā vadhena ye anti dūrād upanāyam eṣām ||
children.translated_text: Cut them down from above with the striking weapon, those who are near and those far away; bring them within reach.

children.text: sa pratnavan navyase viśvavāra sūktāya pathaḥ kṛṇuhi prācaḥ
children.translated_text: In the ancient manner, O all-desired one, make forward paths for the new hymn.

children.text: ye duḥṣahāso vanuṣā bṛhantas tāṃs te aśyāma purukṛt purukṣo ||
children.translated_text: Those hostile, mighty ones who are hard to withstand: may we overcome them through you, much-working, rich in abundance.

children.text: evā punāno apaḥ svar gā asmabhyaṃ tokā tanayāni bhūri
children.translated_text: Thus, being purified, bring us waters, sunlight, cows, and many children and descendants.

children.text: śaṃ naḥ kṣetram uru jyotīṃṣi soma jyoṅ naḥ sūryaṃ dṛśaye rirīhi ||
children.translated_text: Bring well-being to our field and broad lights, O <s>Soma</s>; for long life, make us see the sun.

children.text: Chapter 815
pari suvāno harir aṃśuḥ pavitre ratho na sarji sanaye hiyānaḥ
children.translated_text: The tawny stalk, being pressed, has been set in the filter like a chariot, sped onward for winning.

children.text: āpacchlokam indriyam pūyamānaḥ prati devāṁ ajuṣata prayobhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Being purified, gaining praise and strength, he has welcomed the gods with refreshments.

children.text: acchā nṛcakṣā asarat pavitre nāma dadhānaḥ kavir asya yonau
children.translated_text: The man-seeing poet has flowed to the filter, taking a name in his own womb.

children.text: sīdan hoteva sadane camūṣūpem agmann ṛṣayaḥ sapta viprāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Sitting like a <s>Hotṛ</s> priest at the seat in the tubs, the seven inspired seers have come near him.

children.text: pra sumedhā gātuvid viśvadevaḥ somaḥ punānaḥ sada eti nityam
children.translated_text: Wise <s>Soma</s>, finder of the path and belonging to all the gods, being purified, always goes to the seat forever.

children.text: bhuvad viśveṣu kāvyeṣu rantānu janān yatate pañca dhīraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Among all poetic works may he become a delighter; the wise one strives toward the five peoples.

children.text: tava tye soma pavamāna niṇye viśve devās traya ekādaśāsaḥ
children.translated_text: In your secret place, O purifying <s>Soma</s>, are all the gods, the thrice eleven.

children.text: daśa svadhābhir adhi sāno avye mṛjanti tvā nadyaḥ sapta yahvīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Ten with their own powers cleanse you upon the height of the wool, and the seven mighty rivers cleanse you.

children.text: tan nu satyam pavamānasyāstu yatra viśve kāravaḥ saṃnasanta
children.translated_text: Let that truth of the purifying one now come to pass, where all the singers have gathered together.

children.text: jyotir yad ahne akṛṇod u lokam prāvan manuṃ dasyave kar abhīkam ||
children.translated_text: When he made light and space for the day, he protected <s>Manu</s> and made a confronting power against the <s>Dasyu</s>.

children.text: pari sadmeva paśumānti hotā rājā na satyaḥ samitīr iyānaḥ
children.translated_text: Like a household rich in cattle, the <s>Hotṛ</s> priest goes around; like a true king he goes to the assemblies.

children.text: somaḥ punānaḥ kalaśāṁ ayāsīt sīdan mṛgo na mahiṣo vaneṣu ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, purifying himself, has gone to the jars, sitting like a wild beast, a buffalo, in the forests.

children.text: Chapter 816
sākamukṣo marjayanta svasāro daśa dhīrasya dhītayo dhanutrīḥ
children.translated_text: The sisters, pouring together, the ten wise thoughts of the inspired one, cleanse him as bowstrings cleanse the bow.

children.text: hariḥ pary adravaj jāḥ sūryasya droṇaṃ nanakṣe atyo na vājī ||
children.translated_text: The tawny one has run around the offspring of the sun; like a swift racehorse he has reached the wooden vat.

children.text: sam mātṛbhir na śiśur vāvaśāno vṛṣā dadhanve puruvāro adbhiḥ
children.translated_text: Like a child crying out with his mothers, the bull, rich in many gifts, has stretched himself out with the waters.

children.text: maryo na yoṣām abhi niṣkṛtaṃ yan saṃ gacchate kalaśa usriyābhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like a young man going to an adorned woman, he comes together in the jar with the ruddy cows.

children.text: uta pra pipya ūdhar aghnyāyā indur dhārābhiḥ sacate sumedhāḥ
children.translated_text: And the <s>Indu</s> swells the udder of the inviolate cow; wise-minded, he accompanies the streams.

children.text: mūrdhānaṃ gāvaḥ payasā camūṣv abhi śrīṇanti vasubhir na niktaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: The cows, with milk, adorn his head in the tubs, as if with bright treasures.

children.text: sa no devebhiḥ pavamāna radendo rayim aśvinaṃ vāvaśānaḥ
children.translated_text: O purifying one, O radiant <s>Indu</s>, desire wealth for us together with the gods and the <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: rathirāyatām uśatī purandhir asmadryag ā dāvane vasūnām ||
children.translated_text: May the eager, much-invoking wisdom come toward us, driving the chariot, for the giving of riches.

children.text: nū no rayim upa māsva nṛvantam punāno vātāpyaṃ viśvaścandram
children.translated_text: Now draw near to us wealth rich in men, all-delighting, born of the wind, as you purify yourself.

children.text: pra vanditur indo tāry āyuḥ prātar makṣū dhiyāvasur jagamyāt ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, may life pass safely for the singer; may the wealth of inspired thought come quickly in the morning.

children.text: Chapter 817
adhi yad asmin vājinīva śubha spardhante dhiyaḥ sūrye na viśaḥ
children.translated_text: When inspired thoughts contend in this splendid one, as peoples contend under the sun, like mares seeking the prize,

children.text: apo vṛṇānaḥ pavate kavīyan vrajaṃ na paśuvardhanāya manma ||
children.translated_text: he purifies himself, choosing the waters, acting as a poet; the hymn is like a pen for the increasing of cattle.

children.text: dvitā vyūrṇvann amṛtasya dhāma svarvide bhuvanāni prathanta
children.translated_text: Uncovering in two ways the seat of immortality, they extend the worlds for the finder of the light.

children.text: dhiyaḥ pinvānāḥ svasare na gāva ṛtāyantīr abhi vāvaśra indum ||
children.translated_text: Inspired thoughts swell around the <s>Indu</s>, like cows in their own stall, moving according to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: pari yat kaviḥ kāvyā bharate śūro na ratho bhuvanāni viśvā
children.translated_text: When the poet carries around poetic works, like a hero his chariot, he encompasses all the worlds.

children.text: deveṣu yaśo martāya bhūṣan dakṣāya rāyaḥ purubhūṣu navyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Among the gods he gains fame; for the mortal, for skill, he adorns new riches abounding in many goods.

children.text: śriye jātaḥ śriya ā nir iyāya śriyaṃ vayo jaritṛbhyo dadhāti
children.translated_text: Born for splendor, he has gone forth to splendor; he bestows splendor and vital power on the singers.

children.text: śriyaṃ vasānā amṛtatvam āyan bhavanti satyā samithā mitadrau ||
children.translated_text: Clothed in splendor, they have come to immortality; true are their meetings, measured in the droplet.

children.text: iṣam ūrjam abhy arṣāśvaṃ gām uru jyotiḥ kṛṇuhi matsi devān
children.translated_text: Flow onward to refreshment and strength; make horse, cow, and broad light for us; gladden the gods.

children.text: viśvāni hi suṣahā tāni tubhyam pavamāna bādhase soma śatrūn ||
children.translated_text: For all these things are easy for you to bear; O purifying <s>Soma</s>, you drive away enemies.

children.text: Chapter 818
kanikranti harir ā sṛjyamānaḥ sīdan vanasya jaṭhare punānaḥ
children.translated_text: Roaring, the tawny one is released; purifying himself, he sits in the belly of the wood.

children.text: nṛbhir yataḥ kṛṇute nirṇijaṃ gā ato matīr janayata svadhābhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Guided by men, he makes his bright adornment; from him the cows generate thoughts by their own powers.

children.text: hariḥ sṛjānaḥ pathyām ṛtasyeyarti vācam ariteva nāvam
children.translated_text: The tawny one, released, sends forth speech along the path of <s>ṛta</s>, like one who rows a boat.

children.text: devo devānāṃ guhyāni nāmāviṣkṛṇoti barhiṣi pravāce ||
children.translated_text: The god reveals the secret names of the gods, to be proclaimed upon the <s>barhis</s> (sacrificial grass).

children.text: apām ived ūrmayas tarturāṇāḥ pra manīṣā īrate somam accha
children.translated_text: Like waves of the waters hastening onward, the thoughts set out toward <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: namasyantīr upa ca yanti saṃ cā ca viśanty uśatīr uśantam ||
children.translated_text: Revering him, they approach and go together; desiring, they enter the one who is desired.

children.text: tam marmṛjānam mahiṣaṃ na sānāv aṃśuṃ duhanty ukṣaṇaṃ giriṣṭhām
children.translated_text: They milk the cleansed stalk, like a buffalo on a ridge, the sprinkling bull standing on the mountain.

children.text: taṃ vāvaśānam matayaḥ sacante trito bibharti varuṇaṃ samudre ||
children.translated_text: Inspired thoughts accompany him as he cries aloud; <s>Trita</s> bears <s>Varuṇa</s> in the ocean.

children.text: iṣyan vācam upavakteva hotuḥ punāna indo vi ṣyā manīṣām
children.translated_text: Seeking speech like an assistant beside the priest, O purifying <s>Indu</s>, expand our inspired thought.

children.text: indraś ca yat kṣayathaḥ saubhagāya suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: When you and <s>Indra</s> rule for good fortune, may we be lords of excellent heroic power.

children.text: Chapter 819
pra senānīḥ śūro agre rathānāṃ gavyann eti harṣate asya senā
children.translated_text: The heroic general goes forth at the front of the chariots, seeking cows; his army rejoices.

children.text: bhadrān kṛṇvann indrahavān sakhibhya ā somo vastrā rabhasāni datte ||
children.translated_text: Making good things for his friends, invoked with <s>Indra</s>, <s>Soma</s> vigorously puts on his garments.

children.text: sam asya hariṃ harayo mṛjanty aśvahayair aniśitaṃ namobhiḥ
children.translated_text: The tawny streams cleanse his tawny one with horse-guiding reverences, keen and unwearied.

children.text: ā tiṣṭhati ratham indrasya sakhā vidvāṁ enā sumatiṃ yāty accha ||
children.translated_text: The friend of <s>Indra</s> mounts the chariot; knowing, he goes with this good favor.

children.text: sa no deva devatāte pavasva mahe soma psarasa indrapānaḥ
children.translated_text: O god, purify yourself for us in the divine rite, O <s>Soma</s>, great, flowing, drink for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: kṛṇvann apo varṣayan dyām utemām uror ā no varivasyā punānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Making the waters, raining down heaven and this earth, as you purify yourself, open wide space for us from the broad expanse.

children.text: ajītaye 'hataye pavasva svastaye sarvatātaye bṛhate
children.translated_text: Purify yourself for unconqueredness, for unharmedness, for welfare, for full breadth and greatness.

children.text: tad uśanti viśva ime sakhāyas tad ahaṃ vaśmi pavamāna soma ||
children.translated_text: All these friends desire that; that, O purifying <s>Soma</s>, I myself desire.

children.text: somaḥ pavate janitā matīnāṃ janitā divo janitā pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> purifies himself, begetter of inspired thoughts, begetter of heaven, begetter of earth,

children.text: janitāgner janitā sūryasya janitendrasya janitota viṣṇoḥ ||
children.translated_text: begetter of <s>Agni</s>, begetter of the sun, begetter of <s>Indra</s>, and begetter also of <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

children.text: brahmā devānām padavīḥ kavīnām ṛṣir viprāṇām mahiṣo mṛgāṇām
children.translated_text: He is the priest of the gods, the path of poets, the seer of inspired sages, the buffalo among beasts,

children.text: śyeno gṛdhrāṇāṃ svadhitir vanānāṃ somaḥ pavitram aty eti rebhan ||
children.translated_text: the eagle among vultures, the axe among forests; <s>Soma</s> passes through the filter, bellowing.

children.text: prāvīvipad vāca ūrmiṃ na sindhur giraḥ somaḥ pavamāno manīṣāḥ
children.translated_text: Purifying <s>Soma</s> has set the surge of speech in motion like a river, the songs and inspired thoughts.

children.text: antaḥ paśyan vṛjanemāvarāṇy ā tiṣṭhati vṛṣabho goṣu jānan ||
children.translated_text: Seeing within the enclosed hidden places, the bull takes his stand among the cows, knowing.

children.text: sa matsaraḥ pṛtsu vanvann avātaḥ sahasraretā abhi vājam arṣa
