children.translated_text: That exhilarant one, conquering in battles, unimpeded, thousand-seeded, flow toward the prize.

children.text: indrāyendo pavamāno manīṣy aṃśor ūrmim īraya gā iṣaṇyan ||
children.translated_text: O purifying <s>Indu</s>, for <s>Indra</s>, with inspired thought, set the wave of the stalk in motion, seeking cows.

children.text: pari priyaḥ kalaśe devavāta indrāya somo raṇyo madāya
children.translated_text: Dear <s>Soma</s>, god-impelled, goes around in the jar for <s>Indra</s>, delightful for exhilaration.

children.text: sahasradhāraḥ śatavāja indur vājī na saptiḥ samanā jigāti ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Indu</s>, thousand-streamed and hundred-prized, goes to the gathering like a racing steed, a courser.

children.text: sa pūrvyo vasuvij jāyamāno mṛjāno apsu duduhāno adrau
children.translated_text: He, ancient and treasure-winning, being born, being cleansed in the waters, being milked on the pressing stone,

children.text: abhiśastipā bhuvanasya rājā vidad gātum brahmaṇe pūyamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: guardian against curses, king of the world, being purified, has found a path for sacred utterance.

children.text: tvayā hi naḥ pitaraḥ soma pūrve karmāṇi cakruḥ pavamāna dhīrāḥ
children.translated_text: For by you, O purifying <s>Soma</s>, our wise fathers of old performed their deeds.

children.text: vanvann avātaḥ paridhīṃr aporṇu vīrebhir aśvair maghavā bhavā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Conquering, unimpeded, open the enclosing barriers; be a bounteous lord for us with heroes and horses.

children.text: yathāpavathā manave vayodhā amitrahā varivoviddhaviṣmān
children.translated_text: As you purified yourself for <s>Manu</s>, giver of life, slayer of foes, finder of wide space, and hard to deceive,

children.text: evā pavasva draviṇaṃ dadhāna indre saṃ tiṣṭha janayāyudhāni ||
children.translated_text: so purify yourself, bearing wealth; stand together with <s>Indra</s> and generate weapons.

children.text: pavasva soma madhumāṁ ṛtāvāpo vasāno adhi sāno avye
children.translated_text: Purify yourself, O <s>Soma</s>, honey-sweet and true to <s>ṛta</s>, clothed in the waters on the summit of the sheep's wool.

children.text: ava droṇāni ghṛtavānti sīda madintamo matsara indrapānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Sit down in the ghee-filled vats below, most intoxicating exhilarant, drink for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: vṛṣṭiṃ divaḥ śatadhāraḥ pavasva sahasrasā vājayur devavītau
children.translated_text: With a hundred streams, purify the rain of heaven; winning thousands, seeking the prize, at the divine feast.

children.text: saṃ sindhubhiḥ kalaśe vāvaśānaḥ sam usriyābhiḥ pratiran na āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Together with the rivers, bellowing in the vat, together with the ruddy cows, he prolongs our life.

children.text: eṣa sya somo matibhiḥ punāno 'tyo na vājī taratīd arātīḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s>, purified by thoughts, like a racing steed rich in prize, crosses beyond hostilities.

children.text: payo na dugdham aditer iṣiram urv iva gātuḥ suyamo na voﾱhā ||
children.translated_text: Like milk that has been milked, the impelling milk of <s>Aditi</s>, like a broad course, like a well-reined bearer.

children.text: svāyudhaḥ sotṛbhiḥ pūyamāno 'bhy arṣa guhyaṃ cāru nāma
children.translated_text: With your own weapon, being purified by the pressers, flow toward the lovely hidden name.

children.text: abhi vājaṃ saptir iva śravasyābhi vāyum abhi gā deva soma ||
children.translated_text: Approach the prize like a racehorse seeking fame; approach <s>Vāyu</s>, approach the cows, O divine <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: śiśuṃ jajñānaṃ haryatam mṛjanti śumbhanti vahnim maruto gaṇena
children.translated_text: They cleanse the newborn child, the desirable one; the <s>Maruts</s> as a troop adorn the bearer.

children.text: kavir gīrbhiḥ kāvyenā kaviḥ san somaḥ pavitram aty eti rebhan ||
children.translated_text: The poet <s>Soma</s>, a poet through poetic power, passes over the filter with songs, roaring.

children.text: ṛṣimanā ya ṛṣikṛt svarṣāḥ sahasraṇīthaḥ padavīḥ kavīnām
children.translated_text: Seer-minded, maker of seers, winner of the sun, thousand-guided, he is the pathfinder of poets.

children.text: tṛtīyaṃ dhāma mahiṣaḥ siṣāsan somo virājam anu rājati ṣṭup ||
children.translated_text: Seeking to win the third realm, the buffalo, <s>Soma</s>, shines forth after the viraj and the strophic praise.

children.text: camūṣacchyenaḥ śakuno vibhṛtvā govindur drapsa āyudhāni bibhrat
children.translated_text: The eagle of the bowls, the bird, having borne it, the cow-finding drop bears his weapons.

children.text: apām ūrmiṃ sacamānaḥ samudraṃ turīyaṃ dhāma mahiṣo vivakti ||
children.translated_text: Following the wave of the waters and the ocean, the buffalo proclaims the fourth realm.

children.text: maryo na śubhras tanvam mṛjāno 'tyo na sṛtvā sanaye dhanānām
children.translated_text: Like a bright young man cleansing his body, like a courser rushing for the winning of treasures,

children.text: vṛṣeva yūthā pari kośam arṣan kanikradac camvor ā viveśa ||
children.translated_text: like a bull toward the herds, he flows around the vessel; roaring, he has entered the two vats.

children.text: pavasvendo pavamāno mahobhiḥ kanikradat pari vārāṇy arṣa
children.translated_text: Flow, O <s>Indu</s>, as <s>Pavamāna</s>, with your powers; roaring, flow around the woolen filters.

children.text: krīﾱañ camvor ā viśa pūyamāna indraṃ te raso madiro mamattu ||
children.translated_text: Playing, enter the two vats as you are purified; may your exhilarating juice gladden <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: prāsya dhārā bṛhatīr asṛgrann akto gobhiḥ kalaśāṁ ā viveśa
children.translated_text: His great streams have been released; adorned with milk, he has entered the jars in the night.

children.text: sāma kṛṇvan sāmanyo vipaścit krandann ety abhi sakhyur na jāmim ||
children.translated_text: Making a chant, fit for chant, discerning, he goes crying toward it like one going to a friend's kinswoman.

children.text: apaghnann eṣi pavamāna śatrūn priyāṃ na jāro abhigīta induḥ
children.translated_text: Striking away enemies, you go, O <s>Pavamāna</s>; O praised <s>Indu</s>, like a lover toward his dear one.

children.text: sīdan vaneṣu śakuno na patvā somaḥ punānaḥ kalaśeṣu sattā ||
children.translated_text: Settling in the woods like a bird after flight, <s>Soma</s>, being purified, is seated in the jars.

children.text: ā te rucaḥ pavamānasya soma yoṣeva yanti sudughāḥ sudhārāḥ
children.translated_text: Your lights, O purifying <s>Soma</s>, go like women, rich in milk and streaming well.

children.text: harir ānītaḥ puruvāro apsv acikradat kalaśe devayūnām ||
children.translated_text: The tawny one, brought here, much-desired, has cried aloud in the waters, in the jar of those who seek the gods.

children.text: Chapter 820
asya preṣā hemanā pūyamāno devo devebhiḥ sam apṛkta rasam
children.translated_text: At his impulse, being purified with golden brightness, the god has mingled his juice with the gods.

children.text: sutaḥ pavitram pary eti rebhan miteva sadma paśumānti hotā ||
children.translated_text: Pressed, he goes around the filter, roaring; like <s>Mitra</s>, the hotar goes to the cattle-filled seat.

children.text: bhadrā vastrā samanyā vasāno mahān kavir nivacanāni śaṃsan
children.translated_text: Wearing splendid garments together, the great poet proclaims the declarations.

children.text: ā vacyasva camvoḥ pūyamāno vicakṣaṇo jāgṛvir devavītau ||
children.translated_text: Be uttered forth in the two vats as you are purified, discerning and wakeful at the feast of the gods.

children.text: sam u priyo mṛjyate sāno avye yaśastaro yaśasāṃ kṣaito asme
children.translated_text: The dear one is cleansed upon the woolen ridge, more glorious; may he dwell among glories for us.

children.text: abhi svara dhanvā pūyamāno yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Sound forth as you are purified across the dry land; may you all protect us always with well-being.

children.text: pra gāyatābhy arcāma devān somaṃ hinota mahate dhanāya
children.translated_text: Sing out; let us praise the gods. Urge <s>Soma</s> on for great wealth.

children.text: svāduḥ pavāte ati vāram avyam ā sīdāti kalaśaṃ devayur naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Sweetly he purifies himself across the woolen filter; seeking the gods for us, he sits down in the jar.

children.text: indur devānām upa sakhyam āyan sahasradhāraḥ pavate madāya
children.translated_text: <s>Indu</s>, coming to the friendship of the gods, thousand-streamed, purifies himself for exhilaration.

children.text: nṛbhi stavāno anu dhāma pūrvam agann indram mahate saubhagāya ||
children.translated_text: Praised by men, following the former station, he has gone to <s>Indra</s> for great good fortune.

children.text: stotre rāye harir arṣā punāna indram mado gacchatu te bharāya
children.translated_text: For praise and for wealth, O tawny one, flow as you are purified; let your exhilaration go to <s>Indra</s> for support.

children.text: devair yāhi sarathaṃ rādho acchā yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Go with the gods on the same chariot toward bounty; may you all protect us always with well-being.

children.text: pra kāvyam uśaneva bruvāṇo devo devānāṃ janimā vivakti
children.translated_text: Speaking poetic wisdom like <s>Uśanā</s>, the god declares the births of the gods.

children.text: mahivrataḥ śucibandhuḥ pāvakaḥ padā varāho abhy eti rebhan ||
children.translated_text: Great in ordinance, pure in kinship, purifying, the boar goes forward with his step, roaring.

children.text: pra haṃsāsas tṛpalam manyum acchāmād astaṃ vṛṣagaṇā ayāsuḥ
children.translated_text: The swans have gone toward the stirring draught and impulse; the bull-herds have set out from the house.

children.text: āṅgūṣyam pavamānaṃ sakhāyo durmarṣaṃ sākam pra vadanti vāṇam ||
children.translated_text: Together, the companions proclaim the ringing, purifying, irresistible voice.

children.text: sa raṃhata urugāyasya jūtiṃ vṛthā krīﾱantam mimate na gāvaḥ
children.translated_text: He speeds along the impulse of the widely sung one; the cows do not measure him as he plays freely.

children.text: parīṇasaṃ kṛṇute tigmaśṛṅgo divā harir dadṛśe naktam ṛjraḥ ||
children.translated_text: The sharp-horned one makes abundance all around; tawny by day and bright by night, he is seen.

children.text: indur vājī pavate gonyoghā indre somaḥ saha invan madāya
children.translated_text: <s>Indu</s>, the prize-winning steed, purifies himself in cattle-streams; <s>Soma</s>, together with strength in <s>Indra</s>, presses on for exhilaration.

children.text: hanti rakṣo bādhate pary arātīr varivaḥ kṛṇvan vṛjanasya rājā ||
children.translated_text: He slays the demon, drives away hostilities on every side, and makes wide room, the king of the settlement.

children.text: adha dhārayā madhvā pṛcānas tiro roma pavate adridugdhaḥ
children.translated_text: Then, mixed with honey in his stream, pressed by stones, he purifies himself through the fleece.

children.text: indur indrasya sakhyaṃ juṣāṇo devo devasya matsaro madāya ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indu</s>, enjoying <s>Indra</s>'s friendship, the god's exhilarating god, flows for exhilaration.

children.text: abhi priyāṇi pavate punāno devo devān svena rasena pṛñcan
children.translated_text: He purifies himself toward beloved things, being cleansed, the god filling the gods with his own juice.

children.text: indur dharmāṇy ṛtuthā vasāno daśa kṣipo avyata sāno avye ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indu</s>, wearing the ordinances in due season, the ten fingers have adorned him on the woolen ridge.

children.text: vṛṣā śoṇo abhikanikradad gā nadayann eti pṛthivīm uta dyām
children.translated_text: The red bull, bellowing loudly toward the cows, goes on, making earth and heaven resound.

children.text: indrasyeva vagnur ā śṛṇva ājau pracetayann arṣati vācam emām ||
children.translated_text: Like <s>Indra</s>'s roar heard in battle, he flows, awakening this speech.

children.text: rasāyyaḥ payasā pinvamāna īrayann eṣi madhumantam aṃśum
children.translated_text: Rich in sap, swelling with milk, you go, sending forth the honeyed stalk.

children.text: pavamānaḥ saṃtanim eṣi kṛṇvann indrāya soma pariṣicyamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: As <s>Pavamāna</s>, you go creating continuance, O <s>Soma</s>, being poured around for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: evā pavasva madiro madāyodagrābhasya namayan vadhasnaiḥ
children.translated_text: Thus purify yourself, exhilarating one, for exhilaration, bending down the high-grasper with deadly weapons.

children.text: pari varṇam bharamāṇo ruśantaṃ gavyur no arṣa pari soma siktaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bearing the bright color around, seeking cows, flow for us, O <s>Soma</s>, poured all around.

children.text: juṣṭvī na indo supathā sugāny urau pavasva varivāṃsi kṛṇvan
children.translated_text: Like a favorable guide, O <s>Indu</s>, by good paths and easy ways, purify yourself in the wide space, making broad room.

children.text: ghaneva viṣvag duritāni vighnann adhi ṣṇunā dhanva sāno avye ||
children.translated_text: Like a heavy club, smashing evils in every direction, run over the ridge of the woolen filter.

children.text: vṛṣṭiṃ no arṣa divyāṃ jigatnum iﾱāvatīṃ śaṅgayīṃ jīradānum
children.translated_text: Flow for us heavenly rain that hastens here, rich in refreshment, auspicious, and swiftly giving life.

children.text: stukeva vītā dhanvā vicinvan bandhūṃr imāṁ avarāṁ indo vāyūn ||
children.translated_text: Like a stretched tuft, searching with the bow, O <s>Indu</s>, seek out these lower bonds and the <s>Vāyus</s>.

children.text: granthiṃ na vi ṣya grathitam punāna ṛjuṃ ca gātuṃ vṛjinaṃ ca soma
children.translated_text: Like a knot, loosen what is tied as you are purified; make both the straight path and the crooked one, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: atyo na krado harir ā sṛjāno maryo deva dhanva pastyāvān ||
children.translated_text: Like a neighing courser released, the tawny one, like a young man, O god, runs toward the homes.

children.text: juṣṭo madāya devatāta indo pari ṣṇunā dhanva sāno avye
children.translated_text: Loved for exhilaration in the rite of the gods, O <s>Indu</s>, run over the ridge of the woolen filter with the pressing-stone.

children.text: sahasradhāraḥ surabhir adabdhaḥ pari srava vājasātau nṛṣahye ||
children.translated_text: Thousand-streamed, fragrant, undeceived, flow around in the winning of the prize, in the conquering of men.

children.text: araśmāno ye 'rathā ayuktā atyāso na sasṛjānāsa ājau
children.translated_text: Those without reins, without chariots, unyoked, like coursers released in the contest,

children.text: ete śukrāso dhanvanti somā devāsas tāṁ upa yātā pibadhyai ||
children.translated_text: these bright <s>Somas</s> run. O gods, come near to drink that.

children.text: evā na indo abhi devavītim pari srava nabho arṇaś camūṣu
children.translated_text: Thus, O <s>Indu</s>, flow around for us toward the gods' feast, like a heavenly wave in the bowls.

children.text: somo asmabhyaṃ kāmyam bṛhantaṃ rayiṃ dadātu vīravantam ugram ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Soma</s> grant us the desirable, lofty wealth, rich in heroes and powerful.

children.text: takṣad yadī manaso venato vāg jyeṣṭhasya vā dharmaṇi kṣor anīke
children.translated_text: When the speech of the yearning mind fashioned him, at the ordinance of the eldest, at the face of the earth,

children.text: ād īm āyan varam ā vāvaśānā juṣṭam patiṃ kalaśe gāva indum ||
children.translated_text: then the cows, desiring him, came to him as a chosen, beloved lord, the <s>Indu</s> in the vessel.

children.text: pra dānudo divyo dānupinva ṛtam ṛtāya pavate sumedhāḥ
children.translated_text: The heavenly giver, swelling with gifts, wise-minded, purifies himself with truth for truth.

children.text: dharmā bhuvad vṛjanyasya rājā pra raśmibhir daśabhir bhāri bhūma ||
children.translated_text: He became the ordinance and king of the strong one; with his ten reins he has borne the earth forth.

children.text: pavitrebhiḥ pavamāno nṛcakṣā rājā devānām uta martyānām
children.translated_text: Being purified through the filters, seeing men, king of gods and also of mortals,

children.text: dvitā bhuvad rayipatī rayīṇām ṛtam bharat subhṛtaṃ cārv induḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Indu</s> became doubly lord of wealth, of riches; he bears well-supported, beautiful <s>ṛta</s> (truthful order).

children.text: arvāṁ iva śravase sātim acchendrasya vāyor abhi vītim arṣa
children.translated_text: Like a courser toward fame and gain, flow forward to the drinking of <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>.

children.text: sa naḥ sahasrā bṛhatīr iṣo dā bhavā soma draviṇovit punānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Give us thousands of lofty refreshments; become, O <s>Soma</s>, a finder of treasure as you are purified.

children.text: devāvyo naḥ pariṣicyamānāḥ kṣayaṃ suvīraṃ dhanvantu somāḥ
children.translated_text: Let the <s>Somas</s>, being poured around for the gods, hasten to a dwelling rich in heroes for us,

children.text: āyajyavaḥ sumatiṃ viśvavārā hotāro na diviyajo mandratamāḥ ||
children.translated_text: sacrificial, toward all-desired good favor, like most gladdening Hotṛ priests who sacrifice in heaven.

children.text: evā deva devatāte pavasva mahe soma psarase devapānaḥ
children.translated_text: Thus, O god, purify yourself in the divine rite, O <s>Soma</s>, for the great swelling, drunk by the gods.

children.text: mahaś ciddhi ṣmasi hitāḥ samarye kṛdhi suṣṭhāne rodasī punānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For even in battle we are set upon greatness; as you are purified, set the two worlds in a good station.

children.text: aśvo no krado vṛṣabhir yujānaḥ siṃho na bhīmo manaso javīyān
children.translated_text: Like a neighing horse yoking himself with the bulls, like a lion, terrible and swifter than thought,

children.text: arvācīnaiḥ pathibhir ye rajiṣṭhā ā pavasva saumanasaṃ na indo ||
children.translated_text: by the forward paths that are straightest, flow toward us, O <s>Indu</s>, with kind intent.

children.text: śataṃ dhārā devajātā asṛgran sahasram enāḥ kavayo mṛjanti
children.translated_text: A hundred streams, born of the gods, have been released; the poets cleanse these thousandfold.

children.text: indo sanitraṃ diva ā pavasva puraetāsi mahato dhanasya ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, flow here from heaven as a bestower; you are the forerunner of great wealth.

children.text: divo na sargā asasṛgram ahnāṃ rājā na mitram pra mināti dhīraḥ
children.translated_text: Like the outpourings of heaven, they have been released through the days; like king <s>Mitra</s>, the wise one does not transgress.

children.text: pitur na putraḥ kratubhir yatāna ā pavasva viśe asyā ajītim ||
children.translated_text: Like a son of his father, striving with powers of will, flow here for this people, for unconquered strength.

children.text: pra te dhārā madhumatīr asṛgran vārān yat pūto atyeṣy avyān
children.translated_text: Your honeyed streams have been released, when, purified, you pass over the sheep-wool filters.

children.text: pavamāna pavase dhāma gonāṃ jajñānaḥ sūryam apinvo arkaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: O purifying one, you purify yourself in the place of the cows; being born, you have swollen the sun with songs.

children.text: kanikradad anu panthām ṛtasya śukro vi bhāsy amṛtasya dhāma
children.translated_text: Roaring, following the path of <s>ṛta</s> (truthful order), bright one, you shine out toward the immortal abode.

children.text: sa indrāya pavase matsaravān hinvāno vācam matibhiḥ kavīnām ||
children.translated_text: You purify yourself for <s>Indra</s>, full of exhilaration, impelled by the inspired poets' thoughts into speech.

children.text: divyaḥ suparṇo 'va cakṣi soma pinvan dhārāḥ karmaṇā devavītau
children.translated_text: O heavenly eagle, look down, O <s>Soma</s>, swelling your streams by your work at the divine feast.

children.text: endo viśa kalaśaṃ somadhānaṃ krandann ihi sūryasyopa raśmim ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, enter the vessel, the Soma-holder; crying aloud, come here toward the ray of the sun.

children.text: tisro vāca īrayati pra vahnir ṛtasya dhītim brahmaṇo manīṣām
children.translated_text: The carrier sends forth the three voices, the thought of <s>ṛta</s> (truthful order), the inspired mind of sacred formulation.

children.text: gāvo yanti gopatim pṛcchamānāḥ somaṃ yanti matayo vāvaśānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The cows go asking for their cowherd; the thoughts, desiring him, go to <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: somaṃ gāvo dhenavo vāvaśānāḥ somaṃ viprā matibhiḥ pṛcchamānāḥ
children.translated_text: The cows, the milch-cows, desiring him, go to <s>Soma</s>; the inspired priests, asking with thoughts, go to <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: somaḥ sutaḥ pūyate ajyamānaḥ some arkās triṣṭubhaḥ saṃ navante ||
children.translated_text: The pressed <s>Soma</s> is purified as he is driven on; in <s>Soma</s> the songs in triṣṭubh meter join together.

children.text: evā naḥ soma pariṣicyamāna ā pavasva pūyamānaḥ svasti
children.translated_text: Thus, O <s>Soma</s>, being poured around for us, flow here, purified, for well-being.

children.text: indram ā viśa bṛhatā raveṇa vardhayā vācaṃ janayā purandhim ||
children.translated_text: Enter <s>Indra</s> with a great roar; strengthen speech and generate abundant inspiration.

children.text: ā jāgṛvir vipra ṛtā matīnāṃ somaḥ punāno asadac camūṣu
children.translated_text: The wakeful inspired <s>Soma</s>, being purified, has sat down among the bowls, with the truthful thoughts.

children.text: sapanti yam mithunāso nikāmā adhvaryavo rathirāsaḥ suhastāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The paired ones, longing for him, seek him; the Adhvaryu priests, chariot-like and skillful-handed, seek him.

children.text: sa punāna upa sūre na dhātobhe aprā rodasī vi ṣa āvaḥ
children.translated_text: He, being purified, like a supporter under the sun, has filled both heaven and earth.

children.text: priyā cid yasya priyasāsa ūtī sa tū dhanaṃ kāriṇe na pra yaṃsat ||
children.translated_text: He whose aids are dear even to his dear ones will indeed send wealth to the singer as to a worker.

children.text: sa vardhitā vardhanaḥ pūyamānaḥ somo mīḍhvāṁ abhi no jyotiṣāvīt
children.translated_text: He who increases and is an increaser, being purified, bounteous <s>Soma</s>, has aided us with light,

children.text: yenā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ padajñāḥ svarvido abhi gā adrim uṣṇan ||
children.translated_text: by which our former fathers, knowing the track and finding the sun, opened the cows from the rock.

children.text: akrān samudraḥ prathame vidharmañ janayan prajā bhuvanasya rājā
children.translated_text: The ocean has advanced in the first ordinance, generating creatures, king of the world.

children.text: vṛṣā pavitre adhi sāno avye bṛhat somo vāvṛdhe suvāna induḥ ||
children.translated_text: The bull on the woolen summit over the filter, the great <s>Soma</s>, the flowing <s>Indu</s>, has grown mighty.

children.text: mahat tat somo mahiṣaś cakārāpāṃ yad garbho 'vṛṇīta devān
children.translated_text: Great is what <s>Soma</s>, the buffalo, did, when the embryo of the waters chose the gods.

children.text: adadhād indre pavamāna ojo 'janayat sūrye jyotir induḥ ||
children.translated_text: Being purified, <s>Indu</s> placed strength in <s>Indra</s>; he generated light in the sun.

children.text: matsi vāyum iṣṭaye rādhase ca matsi mitrāvaruṇā pūyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: Exhilarate <s>Vāyu</s> for refreshment and bounty; being purified, exhilarate <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: matsi śardho mārutam matsi devān matsi dyāvāpṛthivī deva soma ||
children.translated_text: Exhilarate the Marut host; exhilarate the gods; exhilarate heaven and earth, O divine <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: ṛjuḥ pavasva vṛjinasya hantāpāmīvām bādhamāno mṛdhaś ca
children.translated_text: Flow straight, slayer of crookedness, driving away disease and battles.

children.text: abhiśrīṇan payaḥ payasābhi gonām indrasya tvaṃ tava vayaṃ sakhāyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Mixing milk with the milk of the cows, you are <s>Indra</s>'s; we are your companions.

children.text: madhvaḥ sūdam pavasva vasva utsaṃ vīraṃ ca na ā pavasvā bhagaṃ ca
children.translated_text: Purify yourself as a sweet draught, as a spring of wealth; flow here to us as a hero and as good fortune.

children.text: svadasvendrāya pavamāna indo rayiṃ ca na ā pavasvā samudrāt ||
children.translated_text: Make yourself tasteful for <s>Indra</s>, O purifying <s>Indu</s>; flow here to us with wealth from the ocean.

children.text: somaḥ suto dhārayātyo na hitvā sindhur na nimnam abhi vājy akṣāḥ
children.translated_text: The pressed <s>Soma</s>, like a courser let loose by the stream, like a river toward the lowland, has run to the prize.

children.text: ā yoniṃ vanyam asadat punānaḥ sam indur gobhir asarat sam adbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Being purified, he has sat down in his wild birthplace; the <s>Indu</s> has flowed together with the cows, together with the waters.

children.text: eṣa sya te pavata indra somaś camūṣu dhīra uśate tavasvān
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s> of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, purifies himself in the bowls, wise, mighty, for the eager one.

children.text: svarcakṣā rathiraḥ satyaśuṣmaḥ kāmo na yo devayatām asarji ||
children.translated_text: Sun-eyed, chariot-borne, true in force, he has been released like desire among those who seek the gods.

children.text: eṣa pratnena vayasā punānas tiro varpāṃsi duhitur dadhānaḥ
children.translated_text: This one, being purified with ancient vigor, placing forms across the daughter,

children.text: vasānaḥ śarma trivarūtham apsu hoteva yāti samaneṣu rebhan ||
children.translated_text: clothing himself in protection of triple defense in the waters, goes like a Hotṛ priest, roaring, to the gatherings.

children.text: nū nas tvaṃ rathiro deva soma pari srava camvoḥ pūyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: Now you, chariot-borne divine <s>Soma</s>, flow around for us, being purified in the two bowls.

children.text: apsu svādiṣṭho madhumāṁ ṛtāvā devo na yaḥ savitā satyamanmā ||
children.translated_text: In the waters, most sweet, full of honey, true to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), like the god <s>Savitā</s>, he is one whose thoughts are true.

children.text: abhi vāyuṃ vīty arṣā gṛṇāno 'bhi mitrāvaruṇā pūyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: Flow toward <s>Vāyu</s> after the drink, being praised; flow, being purified, toward <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: abhī naraṃ dhījavanaṃ ratheṣṭhām abhīndraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vajrabāhum ||
children.translated_text: Flow toward the man swift in thought, standing in the chariot, and toward bull-like <s>Indra</s> with the thunderbolt in his arm.

children.text: abhi vastrā suvasanāny arṣābhi dhenūḥ sudughāḥ pūyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: Flow toward garments and fair raiment, and toward the good-milking cows, as you are purified.

children.text: abhi candrā bhartave no hiraṇyābhy aśvān rathino deva soma ||
children.translated_text: Flow toward bright golden things for our sustenance, and toward horses with chariots, O god <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: abhī no arṣa divyā vasūny abhi viśvā pārthivā pūyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: Flow to us, as you are purified, toward heavenly goods and toward all earthly goods.

children.text: abhi yena draviṇam aśnavāmābhy ārṣeyaṃ jamadagnivan naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Flow toward that by which we may obtain treasure; flow toward inspired seerhood for us, as for <s>Jamadagni</s>.

children.text: ayā pavā pavasvainā vasūni māṃścatva indo sarasi pra dhanva
children.translated_text: With this stream purify yourself; by this stream purify these goods. O <s>Indu</s>, leap forward in the lake.

children.text: bradhnaś cid atra vāto na jūtaḥ purumedhaś cit takave naraṃ dāt ||
children.translated_text: Even the ruddy one here, urged like the wind, even the very wise one, will give a man to the active worshipper.

children.text: uta na enā pavayā pavasvādhi śrute śravāyyasya tīrthe
children.translated_text: And with this stream purify yourself for us, at the crossing of the renowned and celebrated one.

children.text: ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrā naiguto vasūni vṛkṣaṃ na pakvaṃ dhūnavad raṇāya ||
children.translated_text: Like a ripe tree shaken for battle, let him shake loose sixty thousand Niguta riches.

children.text: mahīme asya vṛṣanāma śūṣe māṃścatve vā pṛśane vā vadhatre
children.translated_text: Great is the force of this bull, whether in the flesh-cutting, the speckled one, or the weapon.

children.text: asvāpayan nigutaḥ snehayac cāpāmitrāṁ apācito acetaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He made the Nigutas sleep; he made them cling, and he drove off the enemies, the dishonored and senseless ones.

children.text: saṃ trī pavitrā vitatāny eṣy anv ekaṃ dhāvasi pūyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: You go through the three stretched-out filters; being purified, you run along the one.

children.text: asi bhago asi dātrasya dātāsi maghavā maghavadbhya indo ||
children.translated_text: You are <s>Bhaga</s>; you are the giver of gifts; you are the bountiful one for the bountiful, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: eṣa viśvavit pavate manīṣī somo viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā
children.translated_text: This all-knowing, inspired <s>Soma</s> purifies himself, king of the whole world.

children.text: drapsāṁ īrayan vidatheṣv indur vi vāram avyaṃ samayāti yāti ||
children.translated_text: Setting the drops in motion at the ritual gatherings, <s>Indu</s> goes and passes through the woolen filter.

children.text: induṃ rihanti mahiṣā adabdhāḥ pade rebhanti kavayo na gṛdhrāḥ
children.translated_text: The uninjured buffaloes lick <s>Indu</s>; the poets sound at his place like eager birds.

children.text: hinvanti dhīrā daśabhiḥ kṣipābhiḥ sam añjate rūpam apāṃ rasena ||
children.translated_text: The wise urge him on with ten fingers; they adorn his form with the sap of the waters.

children.text: tvayā vayam pavamānena soma bhare kṛtaṃ vi cinuyāma śaśvat
children.translated_text: Through you, O purifying <s>Soma</s>, may we continually win what has been made ready in the contest.

children.text: tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Sindhu</s>, the earth, and heaven not harm that for us.

children.text: Chapter 821
abhi no vājasātamaṃ rayim arṣa puruspṛham
children.translated_text: Flow toward us with wealth most able to win the prize, much desired by many.

children.text: indo sahasrabharṇasaṃ tuvidyumnaṃ vibhvāsaham ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, bring wealth that bears thousands, full of manifold brilliance, overcoming every foe.

children.text: pari ṣya suvāno avyayaṃ rathe na varmāvyata
children.translated_text: He, being pressed, has clothed himself round about in the imperishable filter, like armor on a chariot.

children.text: indur abhi druṇā hito hiyāno dhārābhir akṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indu</s>, placed in the wooden vats, urged forward, has flowed with his streams.

children.text: pari ṣya suvāno akṣā indur avye madacyutaḥ
children.translated_text: He, the pressed <s>Indu</s>, has flowed around in the woolen filter, dripping exhilaration.

children.text: dhārā ya ūrdhvo adhvare bhrājā naiti gavyayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: He whose stream is raised high in the <s>adhvara</s> (sacrificial rite) shines as he goes, seeking cattle.

children.text: sa hi tvaṃ deva śaśvate vasu martāya dāśuṣe
children.translated_text: For you, O god <s>Indu</s>, make wealth manifest for the mortal giver, enduring and abundant by the thousand.

children.text: indo sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ śatātmānaṃ vivāsasi ||
children.translated_text: You reveal riches by the thousand, with a hundred powers, to the worshipper, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: vayaṃ te asya vṛtrahan vaso vasvaḥ puruspṛhaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Vṛtrahan</s>, O good one, may we be nearest to this much-desired wealth of yours.

children.text: ni nediṣṭhatamā iṣaḥ syāma sumnasyādhrigo ||
children.translated_text: May we be closest to the foods and favors of your good will, O unassailable one.

children.text: dvir yam pañca svayaśasaṃ svasāro adrisaṃhatam
children.translated_text: The two sets of five glorious sisters bathe him, pressed by the stones,

children.text: priyam indrasya kāmyam prasnāpayanty ūrmiṇam ||
children.translated_text: the dear and desirable one of <s>Indra</s>, wave-rich and longed for.

children.text: pari tyaṃ haryataṃ harim babhrum punanti vāreṇa
children.translated_text: They cleanse that beloved tawny one, the brown <s>Hari</s>, with the woolen filter.

children.text: yo devān viśvāṁ it pari madena saha gacchati ||
children.translated_text: He goes together with all the gods, along with exhilaration.

children.text: asya vo hy avasā pānto dakṣasādhanam
children.translated_text: Indeed, under his help, while he protects you, he is the accomplisher of skill.

children.text: yaḥ sūriṣu śravo bṛhad dadhe svar ṇa haryataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Beloved like the sun, he has placed great fame among the patrons.

children.text: sa vāṃ yajñeṣu mānavī indur janiṣṭa rodasī
children.translated_text: That <s>Indu</s> was born for you two in the sacrifices, O human-like heaven and earth.

children.text: devo devī giriṣṭhā asredhan taṃ tuviṣvaṇi ||
children.translated_text: The god, standing on the mountain among the divine ones, is unwearied, loud-sounding, and mighty.

children.text: indrāya soma pātave vṛtraghne pari ṣicyase
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, you are poured round for <s>Indra</s> to drink, for the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>,

children.text: nare ca dakṣiṇāvate devāya sadanāsade ||
children.translated_text: and for the man rich in <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial gifts), for the god who sits in his proper seat.

children.text: te pratnāso vyuṣṭiṣu somāḥ pavitre akṣaran
children.translated_text: Those ancient <s>Somas</s> have flowed in the filters at the dawns,

children.text: apaprothantaḥ sanutar huraścitaḥ prātas tāṁ apracetasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: driving far away, secretly, the crooked and hostile ones, and in the morning those without insight.

children.text: taṃ sakhāyaḥ purorucaṃ yūyaṃ vayaṃ ca sūrayaḥ
children.translated_text: May we, your friends, both you and we, the patrons, obtain that one who shines in front,

children.text: aśyāma vājagandhyaṃ sanema vājapastyam ||
children.translated_text: and may we win prize-winning wealth and gain the household of the prize.

children.text: Chapter 822
ā haryatāya dhṛṣṇave dhanus tanvanti pauṃsyam
children.translated_text: For the eager, bold one they stretch out manly strength like a bow.

children.text: śukrāṃ vayanty asurāya nirṇijaṃ vipām agre mahīyuvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The mighty ones weave a bright adornment for the lordly one at the head of the inspired streams.

children.text: adha kṣapā pariṣkṛto vājāṁ abhi pra gāhate
children.translated_text: Then, adorned through the night, he plunges forward toward the prizes.

children.text: yadī vivasvato dhiyo hariṃ hinvanti yātave ||
children.translated_text: When the thoughts of <s>Vivasvat</s> impel the tawny one to go.

children.text: tam asya marjayāmasi mado ya indrapātamaḥ
children.translated_text: We cleanse this exhilarating one of his, the one most fit for <s>Indra</s> to drink.

children.text: yaṃ gāva āsabhir dadhuḥ purā nūnaṃ ca sūrayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The cows placed him with their mouths, both formerly and now, as did the patrons.

children.text: taṃ gāthayā purāṇyā punānam abhy anūṣata
children.translated_text: They have sung to him, being purified, with an ancient song.

children.text: uto kṛpanta dhītayo devānāṃ nāma bibhratīḥ ||
children.translated_text: And the inspired thoughts shape themselves, bearing the names of the gods.

children.text: tam ukṣamāṇam avyaye vāre punanti dharṇasim
children.translated_text: They cleanse that pouring, supporting one in the imperishable woolen filter.

children.text: dūtaṃ na pūrvacittaya ā śāsate manīṣiṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The inspired sages long for him like a messenger for their ancient insight.

children.text: sa punāno madintamaḥ somaś camūṣu sīdati
children.translated_text: That <s>Soma</s>, being purified and most exhilarating, sits in the vats.

children.text: paśau na reta ādadhat patir vacasyate dhiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like seed in cattle, the lord places thought and is celebrated by speech.

children.text: sa mṛjyate sukarmabhir devo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ
children.translated_text: The god, pressed for the gods, is cleansed by good workers.

children.text: vide yad āsu saṃdadir mahīr apo vi gāhate ||
children.translated_text: When he has joined himself among them, he enters the great waters.

children.text: suta indo pavitra ā nṛbhir yato vi nīyase
children.translated_text: Pressed, O <s>Indu</s>, in the filter, when you are led apart by men,

children.text: indrāya matsarintamaś camūṣv ā ni ṣīdasi ||
children.translated_text: you, most intoxicating for <s>Indra</s>, sit down in the vats.

children.text: Chapter 823
abhī navante adruhaḥ priyam indrasya kāmyam
children.translated_text: The harmless ones call toward the dear and desirable one of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: vatsaṃ na pūrva āyuni jātaṃ rihanti mātaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like mothers licking a calf newly born in the first span of life.

children.text: punāna indav ā bhara soma dvibarhasaṃ rayim
children.translated_text: Being purified, O drops, bring wealth of double greatness, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ vasūni puṣyasi viśvāni dāśuṣo gṛhe ||
children.translated_text: You make all goods flourish in the house of the worshipper.

children.text: tvaṃ dhiyam manoyujaṃ sṛjā vṛṣṭiṃ na tanyatuḥ
children.translated_text: Release inspired thought yoked with the mind, like thunder releasing rain.

children.text: tvaṃ vasūni pārthivā divyā ca soma puṣyasi ||
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Soma</s>, make earthly and heavenly goods flourish.

children.text: pari te jigyuṣo yathā dhārā sutasya dhāvati
children.translated_text: As after your victory, the stream of the pressed one runs,

children.text: raṃhamāṇā vy avyayaṃ vāraṃ vājīva sānasiḥ ||
children.translated_text: hastening through the imperishable woolen filter like a prize-winning steed.

children.text: kratve dakṣāya naḥ kave pavasva soma dhārayā
children.translated_text: For will and skill, O poet, purify yourself for us, O <s>Soma</s>, with your stream.

children.text: indrāya pātave suto mitrāya varuṇāya ca ||
children.translated_text: Pressed for <s>Indra</s> to drink, and for <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> also.

children.text: pavasva vājasātamaḥ pavitre dhārayā sutaḥ
children.translated_text: Purify yourself, most prize-winning one, pressed with your stream in the filter.

children.text: indrāya soma viṣṇave devebhyo madhumattamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s>, for <s>Soma</s>, for <s>Viṣṇu</s>, for the gods, most honey-sweet.

children.text: tvāṃ rihanti mātaro harim pavitre adruhaḥ
children.translated_text: The mothers lick you, the tawny one, harmless, in the filter,

children.text: vatsaṃ jātaṃ na dhenavaḥ pavamāna vidharmaṇi ||
children.translated_text: like milch cows a newborn calf, O purifying one, in the place of ordinance.

children.text: pavamāna mahi śravaś citrebhir yāsi raśmibhiḥ
children.translated_text: O purifying one, you go to great fame with bright rays;

children.text: śardhan tamāṃsi jighnase viśvāni dāśuṣo gṛhe ||
children.translated_text: you smite all darknesses in the house of the worshipper.

children.text: tvaṃ dyāṃ ca mahivrata pṛthivīṃ cāti jabhriṣe
children.translated_text: You, of great vow, have upheld heaven and earth;

children.text: prati drāpim amuñcathāḥ pavamāna mahitvanā ||
children.translated_text: you have put on the mantle, O purifying one, by your greatness.

children.text: Chapter 824
purojitī vo andhasaḥ sutāya mādayitnave
children.translated_text: With forward victory, O friends, for the pressed juice that brings exhilaration,

children.text: apa śvānaṃ śnathiṣṭana sakhāyo dīrghajihvyam ||
children.translated_text: crush away the long-tongued dog.

children.text: yo dhārayā pāvakayā pariprasyandate sutaḥ
children.translated_text: He who, pressed, streams all around with a purifying current,

children.text: indur aśvo na kṛtvyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: is the <s>Indu</s>, like a horse fit for the task.

children.text: taṃ duroṣam abhī naraḥ somaṃ viśvācyā dhiyā
children.translated_text: That hard-to-harm <s>Soma</s> men speed on with all-reaching thought,

children.text: yajñaṃ hinvanty adribhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: impelling the sacrifice with the pressing stones.

children.text: sutāso madhumattamāḥ somā indrāya mandinaḥ
children.translated_text: The pressed <s>Somas</s>, most honey-sweet, gladdening for <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: pavitravanto akṣaran devān gacchantu vo madāḥ ||
children.translated_text: have flowed with their filters; let your exhilarations go to the gods.

children.text: indur indrāya pavata iti devāso abruvan
children.translated_text: The <s>Indu</s> purifies himself for <s>Indra</s>, so the gods said;

children.text: vācaspatir makhasyate viśvasyeśāna ojasā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vācaspati</s> seeks the rite, ruling the whole world by his might.

children.text: sahasradhāraḥ pavate samudro vācamīṅkhayaḥ
children.translated_text: Thousand-streamed, the ocean purifies himself, setting speech in motion;

children.text: somaḥ patī rayīṇāṃ sakhendrasya dive dive ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, lord of riches, is <s>Indra</s>'s friend day by day.

children.text: ayam pūṣā rayir bhagaḥ somaḥ punāno arṣati
children.translated_text: This <s>Soma</s>, being purified, flows as <s>Pūṣan</s>, as wealth, as <s>Bhaga</s>;

children.text: patir viśvasya bhūmano vy akhyad rodasī ubhe ||
children.translated_text: lord of all abundance, he has looked out over both worlds.

children.text: sam u priyā anūṣata gāvo madāya ghṛṣvayaḥ
children.translated_text: The dear cows have lowed together for exhilaration, eager;

children.text: somāsaḥ kṛṇvate pathaḥ pavamānāsa indavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Somas</s>, the purifying <s>Indus</s>, make their paths.

children.text: ya ojiṣṭhas tam ā bhara pavamāna śravāyyam
children.translated_text: Bring that strongest, fame-winning wealth, O purifying one,

children.text: yaḥ pañca carṣaṇīr abhi rayiṃ yena vanāmahai ||
children.translated_text: that wealth by which we may win among the five peoples.

children.text: somāḥ pavanta indavo 'smabhyaṃ gātuvittamāḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Somas</s>, the <s>Indus</s>, flow for us as best finders of the path,

children.text: mitrāḥ suvānā arepasaḥ svādhyaḥ svarvidaḥ ||
children.translated_text: friends being pressed, spotless, wise, and finders of light.

children.text: suṣvāṇāso vy adribhiś citānā gor adhi tvaci
children.translated_text: Well-pressed by the stones, made bright on the cow-hide,

children.text: iṣam asmabhyam abhitaḥ sam asvaran vasuvidaḥ ||
children.translated_text: they have sounded all around for nourishment for us, finders of treasure.

children.text: ete pūtā vipaścitaḥ somāso dadhyāśiraḥ
children.translated_text: These purified, discerning <s>Somas</s>, mixed with curds,

children.text: sūryāso na darśatāso jigatnavo dhruvā ghṛte ||
children.translated_text: are visible like suns, eager to go, fixed in ghee.

children.text: pra sunvānasyāndhaso marto na vṛta tad vacaḥ
children.translated_text: Let that speech go forth for the man who presses the Soma-juice, like a chosen mortal;

children.text: apa śvānam arādhasaṃ hatā makhaṃ na bhṛgavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: strike away the giftless dog, as the <s>Bhṛgus</s> struck <s>Makha</s>.

children.text: ā jāmir atke avyata bhuje na putra oṇyoḥ
children.translated_text: The kinsman has been wrapped in the robe, like a son in the two arms;

children.text: saraj jāro na yoṣaṇāṃ varo na yonim āsadam ||
children.translated_text: he has run like a lover to women, like a bridegroom to the seat.

children.text: sa vīro dakṣasādhano vi yas tastambha rodasī
children.translated_text: That hero, accomplishing skill, who propped the two worlds apart,

children.text: hariḥ pavitre avyata vedhā na yonim āsadam ||
children.translated_text: the tawny one is wrapped in the filter, like a wise artisan sitting in his seat.

children.text: avyo vārebhiḥ pavate somo gavye adhi tvaci
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> is purified with woolen coverings upon the cow's hide;

children.text: kanikradad vṛṣā harir indrasyābhy eti niṣkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: roaring, the bull, the tawny one, goes toward <s>Indra</s>'s prepared place.

children.text: Chapter 825
krāṇā śiśur mahīnāṃ hinvann ṛtasya dīdhitim
children.translated_text: The child of the great ones, acting, impelling the light of <s>ṛta</s> (truthful order),

children.text: viśvā pari priyā bhuvad adha dvitā ||
children.translated_text: has encompassed all dear things; then he is twofold.

children.text: upa tritasya pāṣyor abhakta yad guhā padam
children.translated_text: When he apportioned the hidden place near <s>Trita</s>'s side,

children.text: yajñasya sapta dhāmabhir adha priyam ||
children.translated_text: then the dear place of the sacrifice with its seven stations.

children.text: trīṇi tritasya dhārayā pṛṣṭheṣv erayā rayim
children.translated_text: By <s>Trita</s>'s stream set wealth in motion upon the three backs;

children.text: mimīte asya yojanā vi sukratuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the wise-willed one measures out its courses.

children.text: jajñānaṃ sapta mātaro vedhām aśāsata śriye
children.translated_text: The seven mothers instructed him, the wise one born, for splendor;

children.text: ayaṃ dhruvo rayīṇāṃ ciketa yat ||
children.translated_text: this fixed one has perceived the riches.

children.text: asya vrate sajoṣaso viśve devāso adruhaḥ
children.translated_text: Under his ordinance, in one accord, all the gods are harmless;

children.text: spārhā bhavanti rantayo juṣanta yat ||
children.translated_text: desirable delights arise when they take pleasure in him.

children.text: yam ī garbham ṛtāvṛdho dṛśe cārum ajījanan
children.translated_text: The increasers of <s>ṛta</s> (truthful order) generated him as an embryo, lovely to behold,

children.text: kavim maṃhiṣṭham adhvare puruspṛham ||
children.translated_text: the poet, greatest and much-desired, at the sacrifice.

children.text: samīcīne abhi tmanā yahvī ṛtasya mātarā
children.translated_text: United in themselves, the two mighty mothers of <s>ṛta</s> (truthful order),

children.text: tanvānā yajñam ānuṣag yad añjate ||
children.translated_text: extend the sacrifice in order when they anoint him.

children.text: kratvā śukrebhir akṣabhir ṛṇor apa vrajaṃ divaḥ
children.translated_text: By will and by bright eyes you opened the enclosure of heaven,

children.text: hinvann ṛtasya dīdhitim prādhvare ||
children.translated_text: impelling the light of <s>ṛta</s> (truthful order) forward at the rite.

children.text: Chapter 826
pra punānāya vedhase somāya vaca udyatam
children.translated_text: For the purifying, wise <s>Soma</s>, let speech be raised;

children.text: bhṛtiṃ na bharā matibhir jujoṣate ||
children.translated_text: they favor the offering with thoughts, as one bears a tribute.

children.text: pari vārāṇy avyayā gobhir añjāno arṣati
children.translated_text: Around the woolen filters he flows, anointed with cows' milk;

children.text: trī ṣadhasthā punānaḥ kṛṇute hariḥ ||
children.translated_text: being purified, the tawny one makes the three seats.

children.text: pari kośam madhuścutam avyaye vāre arṣati
children.translated_text: Around the honey-dripping vat he flows in the woolen filter;

children.text: abhi vāṇīr ṛṣīṇāṃ sapta nūṣata ||
children.translated_text: the seven voices of the seers have sounded to him.

children.text: pariṇetā matīnāṃ viśvadevo adābhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Leader of thoughts, all-divine, not to be deceived,

children.text: somaḥ punānaś camvor viśaddhariḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, being purified, the tawny one enters the two bowls.

children.text: pari daivīr anu svadhā indreṇa yāhi saratham
children.translated_text: Following the divine powers, go together with <s>Indra</s> on the same chariot;

children.text: punāno vāghad vāghadbhir amartyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: being purified, O immortal singer, with the singers.

children.text: pari saptir na vājayur devo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ
children.translated_text: Like a racing horse eager for the prize, the god pressed for the gods,

children.text: vyānaśiḥ pavamāno vi dhāvati ||
children.translated_text: widely extending, purifying, runs forth.

children.text: Chapter 827
sakhāya ā ni ṣīdata punānāya pra gāyata
children.translated_text: Friends, sit down; sing forth to the purifying one;

children.text: śiśuṃ na yajñaiḥ pari bhūṣata śriye ||
children.translated_text: adorn him for beauty with sacrifices, as a child.

children.text: sam ī vatsaṃ na mātṛbhiḥ sṛjatā gayasādhanam
children.translated_text: Set him together like a calf with its mothers, the accomplisher of prosperity,

children.text: devāvyam madam abhi dviśavasam ||
children.translated_text: the god-seeking exhilaration, doubly powerful.

children.text: punātā dakṣasādhanaṃ yathā śardhāya vītaye
children.translated_text: Purify the accomplisher of skill, so that he may be for the host's refreshment,

children.text: yathā mitrāya varuṇāya śantamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: so that he may be most auspicious for <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: asmabhyaṃ tvā vasuvidam abhi vāṇīr anūṣata
children.translated_text: For us the voices have sung to you, finder of treasure;

children.text: gobhiṣ ṭe varṇam abhi vāsayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: with cows' milk we clothe your color.

children.text: sa no madānām pata indo devapsarā asi
children.translated_text: So, O <s>Indu</s>, you are lord of our exhilarations, of divine flow;

children.text: sakheva sakhye gātuvittamo bhava ||
children.translated_text: be the best finder of the path in friendship, like a friend.

children.text: sanemi kṛdhy asmad ā rakṣasaṃ kaṃcid atriṇam
children.translated_text: Keep every devouring demon far from us;

children.text: apādevaṃ dvayum aṃho yuyodhi naḥ ||
children.translated_text: ward off from us distress, the godless and double-dealing one.

children.text: Chapter 828
taṃ vaḥ sakhāyo madāya punānam abhi gāyata
children.translated_text: That one, O friends, sing around as he is purified for exhilaration,

children.text: śiśuṃ na yajñaiḥ svadayanta gūrtibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: as they sweeten a child with sacrifices and praises.

children.text: saṃ vatsa iva mātṛbhir indur hinvāno ajyate
children.translated_text: Like a calf with its mothers, the <s>Indu</s> is set in motion and anointed,

children.text: devāvīr mado matibhiḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the god-aiding exhilaration, adorned with thoughts.

children.text: ayaṃ dakṣāya sādhano 'yaṃ śardhāya vītaye
children.translated_text: This one is effective for skill; this one is for the host's refreshment;

children.text: ayaṃ devebhyo madhumattamaḥ sutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: this pressed one is most honey-sweet for the gods.

children.text: goman na indo aśvavat sutaḥ sudakṣa dhanva
children.translated_text: Rich in cows, rich in horses, O pressed <s>Indu</s>, very skillful, run forth.

children.text: śuciṃ te varṇam adhi goṣu dīdharam ||
children.translated_text: I have set your bright color upon the cows.

children.text: sa no harīṇām pata indo devapsarastamaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indu</s>, lord of the tawny ones, most divine in appearance for us,

children.text: sakheva sakhye naryo ruce bhava ||
children.translated_text: be like a friend in friendship, manly, for radiance.

children.text: sanemi tvam asmad āṃ adevaṃ kaṃcid atriṇam
children.translated_text: Remove from us every godless devourer,

children.text: sāhvāṁ indo pari bādho apa dvayum ||
children.translated_text: and, O conquering <s>Indu</s>, drive away the double-dealer.

children.text: Chapter 829
indram accha sutā ime vṛṣaṇaṃ yantu harayaḥ
children.translated_text: Let these pressed tawny drops go toward <s>Indra</s>, the bull;

children.text: śruṣṭī jātāsa indavaḥ svarvidaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Indus</s>, born swiftly, are finders of light.

children.text: ayam bharāya sānasir indrāya pavate sutaḥ
children.translated_text: This pressed one, winning spoil, is purified for <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: somo jaitrasya cetati yathā vide ||
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> is mindful of victorious gain, as he knows how.

children.text: asyed indro madeṣv ā grābhaṃ gṛbhṇīta sānasim
children.translated_text: In this one's exhilarations <s>Indra</s> took hold of the winning grasp,

children.text: vajraṃ ca vṛṣaṇam bharat sam apsujit ||
children.translated_text: and he bore the bull-like <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt), conquering amid the waters.

children.text: pra dhanvā soma jāgṛvir indrāyendo pari srava
children.translated_text: Flow forth across the course, O wakeful <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indu</s>, around for <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: dyumantaṃ śuṣmam ā bharā svarvidam ||
children.translated_text: bring shining, light-finding force.

children.text: indrāya vṛṣaṇam madam pavasva viśvadarśataḥ
children.translated_text: Purify yourself for <s>Indra</s> as a bull-like exhilaration, all-beholding,

children.text: sahasrayāmā pathikṛd vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: thousand-pathed, a maker of paths, discerning.

children.text: asmabhyaṃ gātuvittamo devebhyo madhumattamaḥ
children.translated_text: For us, best finder of ways, sweetest for the gods,

children.text: sahasraṃ yāhi pathibhiḥ kanikradat ||
children.translated_text: go by a thousand paths, roaring aloud.

children.text: pavasva devavītaya indo dhārābhir ojasā
children.translated_text: Purify yourself for the divine feast, O <s>Indu</s>, with streams and strength;

children.text: ā kalaśam madhumān soma naḥ sadaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O honeyed <s>Soma</s>, sit down for us in the beaker.

children.text: tava drapsā udapruta indram madāya vāvṛdhuḥ
children.translated_text: Your drops, overflowing, have strengthened <s>Indra</s> for exhilaration;

children.text: tvāṃ devāso amṛtāya kam papuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the immortal gods drank you for immortality.

children.text: ā naḥ sutāsa indavaḥ punānā dhāvatā rayim
children.translated_text: Come to us, pressed <s>Indus</s>; being purified, run toward wealth,

children.text: vṛṣṭidyāvo rītyāpaḥ svarvidaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with rain from heaven, waters in their flow, finders of light.

children.text: somaḥ punāna ūrmiṇāvyo vāraṃ vi dhāvati
children.translated_text: Purifying <s>Soma</s>, wavy with streams, runs through the woolen filter;

children.text: agre vācaḥ pavamānaḥ kanikradat ||
children.translated_text: at the head of speech, <s>Pavamāna</s> roars aloud.

children.text: dhībhir hinvanti vājinaṃ vane krīﾱantam atyavim
children.translated_text: With inspired thoughts they urge on the prize-winning steed, playing beyond the sheep-wool filter;

children.text: abhi tripṛṣṭham matayaḥ sam asvaran ||
children.translated_text: the thoughts have sounded together toward the three-backed one.

children.text: asarji kalaśāṁ abhi mīﾱhe saptir na vājayuḥ
children.translated_text: He has been sent forth toward the bowls, like an eager racing steed in the contest;

children.text: punāno vācaṃ janayann asiṣyadat ||
children.translated_text: being purified and generating speech, he has hissed onward.

children.text: pavate haryato harir ati hvarāṃsi raṃhyā
children.translated_text: The desirable tawny one, <s>Hari</s>, is purified, speeding beyond the crooked places;

children.text: abhyarṣan stotṛbhyo vīravad yaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: flowing toward them, he brings hero-filled fame to the praisers.

children.text: ayā pavasva devayur madhor dhārā asṛkṣata
children.translated_text: Flow this way, desiring the gods; the streams of sweetness have been released.

children.text: rebhan pavitram pary eṣi viśvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Roaring, you pass around the filter on every side.

children.text: Chapter 830
parīto ṣiñcatā sutaṃ somo ya uttamaṃ haviḥ
children.translated_text: Pour around the pressed <s>Soma</s>, who is the highest oblation,

children.text: dadhanvāṁ yo naryo apsv antar ā suṣāva somam adribhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: the manly one who, within the waters, pressed out <s>Soma</s> with the stones.

children.text: nūnam punāno 'vibhiḥ pari sravādabdhaḥ surabhintaraḥ
children.translated_text: Now, being purified through the sheep-wool filters, flow around, unassailable and more fragrant.

children.text: sute cit tvāpsu madāmo andhasā śrīṇanto gobhir uttaram ||
children.translated_text: Even when you are pressed, we exhilarate in you among the waters with the draught, mixing you further with milk.

children.text: pari suvānaś cakṣase devamādanaḥ kratur indur vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Being poured around for vision, gladdening the gods, the discerning <s>Indu</s> is sacred resolve.

children.text: punānaḥ soma dhārayāpo vasāno arṣasi
children.translated_text: Being purified, O <s>Soma</s>, clothed in waters, you flow with your stream;

children.text: ā ratnadhā yonim ṛtasya sīdasy utso deva hiraṇyayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: sit in the treasure-holding womb of <s>ṛta</s> (truthful order), a golden divine spring.

children.text: duhāna ūdhar divyam madhu priyam pratnaṃ sadhastham āsadat
children.translated_text: Milking the heavenly udder, the dear ancient honey, he has sat in the common seat.

children.text: āpṛcchyaṃ dharuṇaṃ vājy arṣati nṛbhir dhūto vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The discerning prize-winner, shaken by men, flows toward the foundation to be sought.

children.text: punānaḥ soma jāgṛvir avyo vāre pari priyaḥ
children.translated_text: Being purified, O wakeful <s>Soma</s>, dear as you pass around the sheep-wool filter,

children.text: tvaṃ vipro abhavo 'ṅgirastamo madhvā yajñam mimikṣa naḥ ||
children.translated_text: you became the inspired sage, most <s>Aṅgiras</s>-like; mix our sacrifice with sweetness.

children.text: somo mīḍhvān pavate gātuvittama ṛṣir vipro vicakṣaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Bounteous <s>Soma</s> is purified, best finder of ways, a seer, an inspired and discerning one;

children.text: tvaṃ kavir abhavo devavītama ā sūryaṃ rohayo divi ||
children.translated_text: you became the poet, most apt for the divine feast; you made the sun mount up in heaven.

children.text: soma u ṣuvāṇaḥ sotṛbhir adhi ṣṇubhir avīnām
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, well pressed by the pressers upon the ridges of the sheep-wool,

children.text: aśvayeva haritā yāti dhārayā mandrayā yāti dhārayā ||
children.translated_text: goes like a horse with the tawny stream; he goes with the gladdening stream.

children.text: anūpe gomān gobhir akṣāḥ somo dugdhābhir akṣāḥ
children.translated_text: In the watery place, rich in cows, <s>Soma</s> has streamed with the cows and with the milked draughts;

children.text: samudraṃ na saṃvaraṇāny agman mandī madāya tośate ||
children.translated_text: the coverings have gone together like streams to the ocean; the exhilarant one is pleased for rapture.

children.text: ā soma suvāno adribhis tiro vārāṇy avyayā
children.translated_text: Come, O <s>Soma</s>, pressed by the stones, through the imperishable filters;

children.text: jano na puri camvor viśaddhariḥ sado vaneṣu dadhiṣe ||
children.translated_text: the tawny one enters between the two bowls like a man into a city; you are set in the wooden vessels.

children.text: sa māmṛje tiro aṇvāni meṣyo mīﾱhe saptir na vājayuḥ
children.translated_text: He has cleansed himself through the fine sheep-wool, like an eager racing steed in the contest;

children.text: anumādyaḥ pavamāno manīṣibhiḥ somo viprebhir ṛkvabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: worthy of approval, <s>Pavamāna Soma</s>, with thoughtful priests and ṛc-singing sages.

children.text: pra soma devavītaye sindhur na pipye arṇasā
children.translated_text: Flow forth, O <s>Soma</s>, for the divine feast; swell like a river with your flood.

children.text: aṃśoḥ payasā madiro na jāgṛvir acchā kośam madhuścutam ||
children.translated_text: By the juice of the stalk, exhilarating and wakeful, flow toward the honey-dripping vessel.

children.text: ā haryato arjune atke avyata priyaḥ sūnur na marjyaḥ
children.translated_text: The desirable one has clothed himself in a bright garment, dear like a son to be cleansed;

children.text: tam īṃ hinvanty apaso yathā rathaṃ nadīṣv ā gabhastyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: the workers impel him like a chariot, into the rivers, in the two hands.

children.text: abhi somāsa āyavaḥ pavante madyam madam
children.translated_text: The active <s>Somas</s> are purified toward intoxicating exhilaration;

children.text: samudrasyādhi viṣṭapi manīṣiṇo matsarāsaḥ svarvidaḥ ||
children.translated_text: on the surface of the ocean, the thoughtful, rapturous ones are finders of light.

children.text: tarat samudram pavamāna ūrmiṇā rājā deva ṛtam bṛhat
children.translated_text: <s>Pavamāna</s>, the king, crosses the ocean with a wave: the divine king, the lofty <s>ṛta</s> (truthful order).

children.text: arṣan mitrasya varuṇasya dharmaṇā pra hinvāna ṛtam bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: Flowing by the ordinance of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, he is driven forth as the lofty <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: nṛbhir yemāno haryato vicakṣaṇo rājā devaḥ samudriyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Guided by men, desirable, discerning, the divine king is ocean-born.

children.text: indrāya pavate madaḥ somo marutvate sutaḥ
children.translated_text: The pressed <s>Soma</s>, exhilaration for <s>Indra</s> with the <s>Maruts</s>, is purified;

children.text: sahasradhāro aty avyam arṣati tam ī mṛjanty āyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: thousand-streamed, he flows over the sheep-wool, and the active ones cleanse him.

children.text: punānaś camū janayan matiṃ kaviḥ somo deveṣu raṇyati
children.translated_text: Being purified in the bowls and generating inspired thought, the poet <s>Soma</s> delights among the gods.

children.text: apo vasānaḥ pari gobhir uttaraḥ sīdan vaneṣv avyata ||
children.translated_text: Clothed in waters, higher through the cows, he sits in the wooden vessels, wrapped in the wool.

children.text: tavāhaṃ soma rāraṇa sakhya indo dive dive
children.translated_text: I have enjoyed your friendship, O <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indu</s>, day by day,

children.text: purūṇi babhro ni caranti mām ava paridhīṃr ati tāṁ ihi ||
children.translated_text: O tawny one; many encircling bounds move around me. Protect me; go beyond them.

children.text: utāhaṃ naktam uta soma te divā sakhyāya babhra ūdhani
children.translated_text: Both by night and by day, O tawny <s>Soma</s>, I seek friendship with you at the udder.

children.text: ghṛṇā tapantam ati sūryam paraḥ śakunā iva paptima ||
children.translated_text: We have flown beyond the burning sun, beyond the heat, like birds.

children.text: mṛjyamānaḥ suhastya samudre vācam invasi
children.translated_text: Being cleansed by skillful hands, you stir speech in the sea.

children.text: rayim piśaṅgam bahulam puruspṛham pavamānābhy arṣasi ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Pavamāna</s>, you flow toward tawny, abundant, much-desired wealth.

children.text: mṛjāno vāre pavamāno avyaye vṛṣāva cakrado vane
children.translated_text: Cleansing yourself in the imperishable filter, O purifying bull, you have roared in the wooden vessel.

children.text: devānāṃ soma pavamāna niṣkṛtaṃ gobhir añjāno arṣasi ||
children.translated_text: O purifying <s>Soma</s>, adorned with milk, you flow to the prepared place of the gods.

children.text: pavasva vājasātaye 'bhi viśvāni kāvyā
children.translated_text: Flow for the winning of prize, toward all inspired works.

children.text: tvaṃ samudram prathamo vi dhārayo devebhyaḥ soma matsaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: You first held apart the ocean for the gods, O exhilarating <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: sa tū pavasva pari pārthivaṃ rajo divyā ca soma dharmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: So purify yourself through the earthly realm, and through the heavenly ordinances, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: tvāṃ viprāso matibhir vicakṣaṇa śubhraṃ hinvanti dhītibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: The inspired seers, discerning one, drive you on, bright, with their thoughts and insights.

children.text: pavamānā asṛkṣata pavitram ati dhārayā
children.translated_text: The purifying ones have been released through the filter, over it with their stream.

children.text: marutvanto matsarā indriyā hayā medhām abhi prayāṃsi ca ||
children.translated_text: Accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, exhilarating and powerful like steeds, they go toward wisdom and delights.

children.text: apo vasānaḥ pari kośam arṣatīndur hiyānaḥ sotṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: Clothed in the waters, the drop flows around the vessel, impelled by the pressers.

children.text: janayañ jyotir mandanā avīvaśad gāḥ kṛṇvāno na nirṇijam ||
children.translated_text: Generating light, gladdening, he has made the cows shine out, as one making an adornment.

children.text: Chapter 831
pavasva madhumattama indrāya soma kratuvittamo madaḥ
children.translated_text: Purify yourself, sweetest of all, for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Soma</s>, an exhilaration best knowing resolve.

children.text: mahi dyukṣatamo madaḥ ||
children.translated_text: A great exhilaration, most radiant in heaven.

children.text: yasya te pītvā vṛṣabho vṛṣāyate 'sya pītā svarvidaḥ
children.translated_text: Having drunk you, the bull becomes bull-like; having drunk this, the finders of the light are strong.

children.text: sa supraketo abhy akramīd iṣo 'cchā vājaṃ naitaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He of good insight has advanced toward the nourishments, like <s>Naitaśa</s> toward the prize.

children.text: tvaṃ hy aṅga daivyā pavamāna janimāni dyumattamaḥ
children.translated_text: For you indeed, O divine <s>Pavamāna</s>, most radiant one, proclaimed your births

children.text: amṛtatvāya ghoṣayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for immortality.

children.text: yenā navagvo dadhyaṅṅ aporṇute yena viprāsa āpire
children.translated_text: By him <s>Navagva</s> and <s>Dadhyañc</s> opened what was shut; by him the inspired seers attained

children.text: devānāṃ sumne amṛtasya cāruṇo yena śravāṃsy ānaśuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the favor of the gods and of the beautiful immortal one, and by him they reached glories.

children.text: eṣa sya dhārayā suto 'vyo vārebhiḥ pavate madintamaḥ
children.translated_text: This one, pressed with a stream, purifies himself through the woolen hairs, most intoxicating.

children.text: krīﾱann ūrmir apām iva ||
children.translated_text: He plays like a wave of the waters.

children.text: ya usriyā apyā antar aśmano nir gā akṛntad ojasā
children.translated_text: He who, with force, cut the cows out from within the stone, the bright ones hidden there,

children.text: abhi vrajaṃ tatniṣe gavyam aśvyaṃ varmīva dhṛṣṇav ā ruja ||
children.translated_text: has stretched toward the cattle-pen rich in cows and horses; like an armored bold one, break it open.

children.text: ā sotā pari ṣiñcatāśvaṃ na stomam apturaṃ rajasturam
children.translated_text: O pressers, pour around the swift song, like a horse, conquering the waters and crossing the midspace,

children.text: vanakrakṣam udaprutam ||
children.translated_text: guarding the woods and rushing up from the waters.

children.text: sahasradhāraṃ vṛṣabham payovṛdham priyaṃ devāya janmane
children.translated_text: The thousand-streamed bull, increasing the milk, dear to the divine birth,

children.text: ṛtena ya ṛtajāto vivāvṛdhe rājā deva ṛtam bṛhat ||
children.translated_text: who, born of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), grew through <s>ṛta</s>; the god, the king, is the great <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: abhi dyumnam bṛhad yaśa iṣas pate didīhi deva devayuḥ
children.translated_text: Shine forth great splendor and broad fame, O lord of nourishment, O god loving the gods.

children.text: vi kośam madhyamaṃ yuva ||
children.translated_text: Open wide the middle vessel.

children.text: ā vacyasva sudakṣa camvoḥ suto viśāṃ vahnir na viśpatiḥ
children.translated_text: Be proclaimed, well-skilled one, pressed in the two bowls, like the carrier of the clans, the lord of the clans.

children.text: vṛṣṭiṃ divaḥ pavasva rītim apāṃ jinvā gaviṣṭaye dhiyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Purify the rain of heaven and the current of the waters; quicken our thoughts for the winning of cattle.

children.text: etam u tyam madacyutaṃ sahasradhāraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ divo duhuḥ
children.translated_text: This very exhilaration-dripping, thousand-streamed bull of heaven they have milked,

children.text: viśvā vasūni bibhratam ||
children.translated_text: bearing all good things.

children.text: vṛṣā vi jajñe janayann amartyaḥ pratapañ jyotiṣā tamaḥ
children.translated_text: The bull was born, immortal, generating, burning away darkness with his light.

children.text: sa suṣṭutaḥ kavibhir nirṇijaṃ dadhe tridhātv asya daṃsasā ||
children.translated_text: Well praised by poets, he has put on his adornment through his threefold power.

children.text: sa sunve yo vasūnāṃ yo rāyām ānetā ya iﾱānām
children.translated_text: He is pressed who is the bringer of goods, who is the bringer of riches, who is the bringer of invocations,

children.text: somo yaḥ sukṣitīnām ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Soma</s> who belongs to good settlements.

children.text: yasya na indraḥ pibād yasya maruto yasya vāryamaṇā bhagaḥ
children.translated_text: Of whom may <s>Indra</s> drink, of whom the <s>Maruts</s>, of whom <s>Aryaman</s> and <s>Bhaga</s>,

children.text: ā yena mitrāvaruṇā karāmaha endram avase mahe ||
children.translated_text: and by whom may we bring <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, and mighty <s>Indra</s>, for help.

children.text: indrāya soma pātave nṛbhir yataḥ svāyudho madintamaḥ
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s> to drink, O <s>Soma</s>, sped by men, armed with your own weapons, most intoxicating,

children.text: pavasva madhumattamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: purify yourself, sweetest of all.

children.text: indrasya hārdi somadhānam ā viśa samudram iva sindhavaḥ
children.translated_text: Enter <s>Indra</s>'s heart, the Soma-vessel, like rivers entering the ocean,

children.text: juṣṭo mitrāya varuṇāya vāyave divo viṣṭambha uttamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: welcome to <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Vāyu</s>, highest support of heaven.

children.text: Chapter 832
pari pra dhanvendrāya soma svādur mitrāya pūṣṇe bhagāya ||
children.translated_text: Flow around and forth for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Soma</s>, sweet for <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Pūṣan</s>, and <s>Bhaga</s>.

children.text: indras te soma sutasya peyāḥ kratve dakṣāya viśve ca devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> drink of your pressed juice, O <s>Soma</s>, for resolve and skill, and may all the gods drink.

children.text: evāmṛtāya mahe kṣayāya sa śukro arṣa divyaḥ pīyūṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Thus, for immortality and for a great dwelling, flow on, bright heavenly nectar.

children.text: pavasva soma mahān samudraḥ pitā devānāṃ viśvābhi dhāma ||
children.translated_text: Purify yourself, O <s>Soma</s>, a great ocean, father of the gods, through all your stations.

children.text: śukraḥ pavasva devebhyaḥ soma dive pṛthivyai śaṃ ca prajāyai ||
children.translated_text: Bright one, purify yourself for the gods, O <s>Soma</s>, for heaven and earth, and for welfare and offspring.

children.text: divo dhartāsi śukraḥ pīyūṣaḥ satye vidharman vājī pavasva ||
children.translated_text: You are the support of heaven, bright nectar; in the true ordinance, prize-winning one, purify yourself.

children.text: pavasva soma dyumnī sudhāro mahām avīnām anu pūrvyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Purify yourself, O <s>Soma</s>, glorious and well-streamed, following the ancient way among the great sheep's wool.

children.text: nṛbhir yemāno jajñānaḥ pūtaḥ kṣarad viśvāni mandraḥ svarvit ||
children.translated_text: Led by men, born and purified, the delightful finder of the light has flowed over all things.

children.text: induḥ punānaḥ prajām urāṇaḥ karad viśvāni draviṇāni naḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indu</s>, purifying himself and favoring offspring, will make all riches for us.

children.text: pavasva soma kratve dakṣāyāśvo na nikto vājī dhanāya ||
children.translated_text: Purify yourself for resolve and skill, O <s>Soma</s>, like a washed horse, a prize-winner for wealth.

children.text: taṃ te sotāro rasam madāya punanti somam mahe dyumnāya ||
children.translated_text: The pressers purify that juice of yours for exhilaration, <s>Soma</s>, for great splendor.

children.text: śiśuṃ jajñānaṃ harim mṛjanti pavitre somaṃ devebhya indum ||
children.translated_text: They cleanse the child, newborn and tawny, <s>Soma</s> the <s>Indu</s>, in the filter for the gods.

children.text: induḥ paviṣṭa cārur madāyāpām upasthe kavir bhagāya ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indu</s>, entered into the filter, beautiful for exhilaration, a poet in the lap of the waters, is for <s>Bhaga</s>.

children.text: bibharti cārv indrasya nāma yena viśvāni vṛtrā jaghāna ||
children.translated_text: He bears the beautiful name of <s>Indra</s>, by which he struck down all the <s>Vṛtras</s>.

children.text: pibanty asya viśve devāso gobhiḥ śrītasya nṛbhiḥ sutasya ||
children.translated_text: All the gods drink of him, mixed with milk and pressed by men.

children.text: pra suvāno akṣāḥ sahasradhāras tiraḥ pavitraṃ vi vāram avyam ||
children.translated_text: Flowing forth, you have run with a thousand streams through the filter, through the woolen fleece.

children.text: sa vājy akṣāḥ sahasraretā adbhir mṛjāno gobhiḥ śrīṇānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: That prize-winning one has run, thousand-seeded, cleansed with waters and mixed with milk.

children.text: pra soma yāhīndrasya kukṣā nṛbhir yemāno adribhiḥ sutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Go forth, O <s>Soma</s>, to <s>Indra</s>'s belly, led by men and pressed by the stones.

children.text: asarji vājī tiraḥ pavitram indrāya somaḥ sahasradhāraḥ ||
children.translated_text: The prize-winning <s>Soma</s>, thousand-streamed, has been sent through the filter for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: añjanty enam madhvo rasenendrāya vṛṣṇa indum madāya ||
children.translated_text: They anoint this <s>Indu</s> with the sweet juice for bull-like <s>Indra</s>, for exhilaration.

children.text: devebhyas tvā vṛthā pājase 'po vasānaṃ harim mṛjanti ||
children.translated_text: For the gods they freely cleanse you, tawny one clothed in waters, for strength.

children.text: indur indrāya tośate ni tośate śrīṇann ugro riṇann apaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indu</s> pleases <s>Indra</s>; he settles down, mixing himself, fierce and releasing the waters.

children.text: Chapter 833
pary ū ṣu pra dhanva vājasātaye pari vṛtrāṇi sakṣaṇiḥ
children.translated_text: Now run around and forth for the winning of prizes, overcoming the obstructions.

children.text: dviṣas taradhyā ṛṇayā na īyase ||
children.translated_text: You go to cross beyond our haters and to release us from debt.

children.text: anu hi tvā sutaṃ soma madāmasi mahe samaryarājye
children.translated_text: For we rejoice in you when you are pressed, O <s>Soma</s>, for the great lordly contest.

children.text: vājāṁ abhi pavamāna pra gāhase ||
children.translated_text: You plunge toward the prizes, O <s>Pavamāna</s>.

children.text: ajījano hi pavamāna sūryaṃ vidhāre śakmanā payaḥ
children.translated_text: For you have generated the sun, O <s>Pavamāna</s>; with power you have upheld the milk,

children.text: gojīrayā raṃhamāṇaḥ purandhyā ||
children.translated_text: hastening with cow-impelling, abundant wisdom.

children.text: ajījano amṛta martyeṣv āṃ ṛtasya dharmann amṛtasya cāruṇaḥ
children.translated_text: You have generated the immortal among mortals, under the law of <s>ṛta</s>, of the beautiful immortal one,

children.text: sadāsaro vājam acchā saniṣyadat ||
children.translated_text: the ever-flowing one; he will sit down toward the prize to be won.

children.text: abhyabhi hi śravasā tatardithotsaṃ na kaṃcij janapānam akṣitam
children.translated_text: For with fame you have pierced through on every side, like an unfailing spring from which anyone may drink,

children.text: śaryābhir na bharamāṇo gabhastyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: like one carrying arrows in his hands.

children.text: ād īṃ kecit paśyamānāsa āpyaṃ vasuruco divyā abhy anūṣata
children.translated_text: Then some, seeing him as a kinsman, the heavenly ones radiant with goods, shouted after him,

children.text: vāraṃ na devaḥ savitā vy ūrṇute ||
children.translated_text: as the god <s>Savitṛ</s> spreads out the enclosing cover.

children.text: tve soma prathamā vṛktabarhiṣo mahe vājāya śravase dhiyaṃ dadhuḥ
children.translated_text: In you, O <s>Soma</s>, the first ones with the sacred grass cut down set their inspired thought for great prize and fame.

children.text: sa tvaṃ no vīra vīryāya codaya ||
children.translated_text: So you, O hero, impel us toward heroic power.

children.text: divaḥ pīyūṣam pūrvyaṃ yad ukthyam maho gāhād diva ā nir adhukṣata
children.translated_text: When the ancient, hymn-worthy milk of heaven was milked down from the greatness and depth of heaven,

children.text: indram abhi jāyamānaṃ sam asvaran ||
children.translated_text: they sounded together around <s>Indra</s> as he was being born.

children.text: adha yad ime pavamāna rodasī imā ca viśvā bhuvanābhi majmanā
children.translated_text: And when, O purifying one, by your greatness you encompass these two worlds and all these beings,

children.text: yūthe na niṣṭhā vṛṣabho vi tiṣṭhase ||
children.translated_text: you stand apart like a bull at the resting place of the herd.

children.text: somaḥ punāno avyaye vāre śiśur na krīﾱan pavamāno akṣāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, being purified in the imperishable filter, runs playing like a child,

children.text: sahasradhāraḥ śatavāja induḥ ||
children.translated_text: a thousand-streamed, hundred-prized drop.

children.text: eṣa punāno madhumāṁ ṛtāvendrāyenduḥ pavate svādur ūrmiḥ
children.translated_text: This purified <s>Indu</s>, sweet, true, and honeyed, flows for <s>Indra</s> as a pleasant wave,

children.text: vājasanir varivovid vayodhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: winner of prize, finder of broad space, giver of vigor.

children.text: sa pavasva sahamānaḥ pṛtanyūn sedhan rakṣāṃsy apa durgahāṇi
children.translated_text: Purify yourself, overpowering those who fight, driving the <s>rakṣases</s> away and removing hardships,

children.text: svāyudhaḥ sāsahvān soma śatrūn ||
children.translated_text: armed with your own weapon, O <s>Soma</s>, conquering the enemies.

children.text: Chapter 834
ayā rucā hariṇyā punāno viśvā dveṣāṃsi tarati svayugvabhiḥ sūro na svayugvabhiḥ
children.translated_text: With this tawny radiance, being purified, he crosses beyond all hatreds with his own yoked powers, like the sun with his own yoked powers.

children.text: dhārā sutasya rocate punāno aruṣo hariḥ
children.translated_text: The stream of the pressed one shines; being purified, the ruddy tawny one gleams,

children.text: viśvā yad rūpā pariyāty ṛkvabhiḥ saptāsyebhir ṛkvabhiḥ ||
