children.translated_text: when he goes around all forms with hymns, with the seven-mouthed hymns.

children.text: tvaṃ tyat paṇīnāṃ vido vasu sam mātṛbhir marjayasi sva ā dama ṛtasya dhītibhir dame
children.translated_text: You have found that treasure of the <s>Paṇis</s>; with the mothers you cleanse yourself in your own house, in the house, with thoughts of truth.

children.text: parāvato na sāma tad yatrā raṇanti dhītayaḥ
children.translated_text: That chant is like one from afar, where the inspired thoughts cry out,

children.text: tridhātubhir aruṣībhir vayo dadhe rocamāno vayo dadhe ||
children.translated_text: and with the threefold tawny powers, shining, he has bestowed vitality; he has bestowed vitality.

children.text: pūrvām anu pradiśaṃ yāti cekitat saṃ raśmibhir yatate darśato ratho daivyo darśato rathaḥ
children.translated_text: Knowing well, he goes along the eastern direction; the divine, visible chariot, the visible chariot, strives together with its rays.

children.text: agmann ukthāni pauṃsyendraṃ jaitrāya harṣayan
children.translated_text: The hymns have come, gladdening <s>Indra</s> for victorious manly power,

children.text: vajraś ca yad bhavatho anapacyutā samatsv anapacyutā ||
children.translated_text: when you two, the thunderbolt and he, are unfailing in battles, unfailing.

children.text: Chapter 835
nānānaṃ vā u no dhiyo vi vratāni janānām
children.translated_text: Different indeed are our thoughts; different are the observances of people.

children.text: takṣā riṣṭaṃ rutam bhiṣag brahmā sunvantam icchatīndrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: The carpenter seeks what is broken, the physician what is diseased, the priest the sacrificer who presses Soma. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: jaratībhir oṣadhībhiḥ parṇebhiḥ śakunānām
children.translated_text: With old herbs and with the feathers of birds,

children.text: kārmāro aśmabhir dyubhir hiraṇyavantam icchatīndrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: the smith seeks one possessed of gold with stones and bright days. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: kārur ahaṃ tato bhiṣag upalaprakṣiṇī nanā
children.translated_text: I am a poet; my father, then, is a physician; my mother is a grinder on the stone.

children.text: nānādhiyo vasūyavo 'nu gā iva tasthimendrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: With different thoughts, desiring wealth, we have stood about like cows. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: aśvo voﾱhā sukhaṃ rathaṃ hasanām upamantriṇaḥ
children.translated_text: The horse seeks an easy chariot to draw, the laughing men seek an adviser,

children.text: śepo romaṇvantau bhedau vār in maṇḍūka icchatīndrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: the male organ seeks the hairy cleft, and the frog seeks water. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: Chapter 836
śaryaṇāvati somam indraḥ pibatu vṛtrahā
children.translated_text: At <s>Śaryaṇāvat</s> may <s>Indra</s>, the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, drink the <s>Soma</s>,

children.text: balaṃ dadhāna ātmani kariṣyan vīryam mahad indrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: placing strength in himself, about to perform a great heroic deed. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: ā pavasva diśām pata ārjīkāt soma mīḍhvaḥ
children.translated_text: Flow here, O lord of the directions, O generous <s>Soma</s> from <s>Ārjīka</s>,

children.text: ṛtavākena satyena śraddhayā tapasā suta indrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: pressed with truthful utterance, with truth, with faith, and with heat. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: parjanyavṛddham mahiṣaṃ taṃ sūryasya duhitābharat
children.translated_text: The daughter of the sun brought that mighty one, grown by <s>Parjanya</s>;

children.text: taṃ gandharvāḥ praty agṛbhṇan taṃ some rasam ādadhur indrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Gandharvas</s> received him, and they placed the sap in <s>Soma</s>. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: ṛtaṃ vadann ṛtadyumna satyaṃ vadan satyakarman
children.translated_text: Speaking truth, O truth-bright one; speaking the real, O worker of truth;

children.text: śraddhāṃ vadan soma rājan dhātrā soma pariṣkṛta indrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: speaking faith, O king <s>Soma</s>, adorned by the ordainer, O <s>Soma</s>. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: satyamugrasya bṛhataḥ saṃ sravanti saṃsravāḥ
children.translated_text: The streams flow together from the true, fierce, and great one;

children.text: saṃ yanti rasino rasāḥ punāno brahmaṇā hara indrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: the juicy juices go together. Being purified, bring them with sacred formulation. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: yatra brahmā pavamāna chandasyāṃ vācaṃ vadan
children.translated_text: Where the priest, O purifying one, speaks speech in meter,

children.text: grāvṇā some mahīyate somenānandaṃ janayann indrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: and is exalted by the pressing stone at <s>Soma</s>, generating delight with <s>Soma</s>: flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: yatra jyotir ajasraṃ yasmiṃl loke svar hitam
children.translated_text: Where there is unfailing light, in which world the heavenly radiance is set,

children.text: tasmin māṃ dhehi pavamānāmṛte loke akṣita indrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: in that immortal, undecaying world, O purifying one, place me. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: yatra rājā vaivasvato yatrāvarodhanaṃ divaḥ
children.translated_text: Where king <s>Vaivasvata</s> is, where the enclosure of heaven is,

children.text: yatrāmūr yahvatīr āpas tatra mām amṛtaṃ kṛdhīndrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: where those great waters are, there make me immortal. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: yatrānukāmaṃ caraṇaṃ trināke tridive divaḥ
children.translated_text: Where movement follows one's desire, in the three-peaked, third heaven of heaven,

children.text: lokā yatra jyotiṣmantas tatra mām amṛtaṃ kṛdhīndrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: where the worlds are full of light, there make me immortal. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: yatra kāmā nikāmāś ca yatra bradhnasya viṣṭapam
children.translated_text: Where there are wishes and full wishes, where the summit of the bright one is,

children.text: svadhā ca yatra tṛptiś ca tatra mām amṛtaṃ kṛdhīndrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: where refreshment and satisfaction are, there make me immortal. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: yatrānandāś ca modāś ca mudaḥ pramuda āsate
children.translated_text: Where joys and delights, gladness and exultations abide,

children.text: kāmasya yatrāptāḥ kāmās tatra mām amṛtaṃ kṛdhīndrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: where the desired desires of desire are fulfilled, there make me immortal. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: Chapter 837
ya indoḥ pavamānasyānu dhāmāny akramīt
children.translated_text: He who has stepped after the stations of purifying <s>Indu</s>,

children.text: tam āhuḥ suprajā iti yas te somāvidhan mana indrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: him they call rich in offspring, whose mind, O <s>Soma</s>, has won you. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: ṛṣe mantrakṛtāṃ stomaiḥ kaśyapodvardhayan giraḥ
children.translated_text: O seer, with the praises of the makers of mantras, <s>Kaśyapa</s> has raised up the songs.

children.text: somaṃ namasya rājānaṃ yo jajñe vīrudhām patir indrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: Revere king <s>Soma</s>, who was born as lord of plants. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: sapta diśo nānāsūryāḥ sapta hotāra ṛtvijaḥ
children.translated_text: There are seven directions with different suns, seven <s>hotṛ</s> priests, ritual officiants;

children.text: devā ādityā ye sapta tebhiḥ somābhi rakṣa na indrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: with those seven gods, the <s>Ādityas</s>, O <s>Soma</s>, protect us. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: yat te rājañchṛtaṃ havis tena somābhi rakṣa naḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever cooked oblation is yours, O king, with that, O <s>Soma</s>, protect us.

children.text: arātīvā mā nas tārīn mo ca naḥ kiṃ canāmamad indrāyendo pari srava ||
children.translated_text: Let hostility not pass beyond us, and let no intoxication of any kind harm us. Flow around for <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Indu</s>.

children.text: Chapter 838
agre bṛhann uṣasām ūrdhvo asthān nir jaganvān tamaso jyotiṣāgāt
children.translated_text: At the front, the great one has stood upright before the dawns; going forth from darkness, he has come with light.

children.text: agnir bhānunā ruśatā svaṅga ā jāto viśvā sadmāny aprāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, with ruddy radiance and beautiful form, once born, has filled all the dwellings.

children.text: sa jāto garbho asi rodasyor agne cārur vi bhṛta oṣadhīṣu
children.translated_text: Born as the embryo of the two worlds, O <s>Agni</s>, lovely, you are spread among the plants.

children.text: citraḥ śiśuḥ pari tamāṃsy aktūn pra mātṛbhyo adhi kanikradad gāḥ ||
children.translated_text: A wondrous child, through the darknesses and the nights you bellow forth from your mothers.

children.text: viṣṇur itthā paramam asya vidvāñ jāto bṛhann abhi pāti tṛtīyam
children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s>, knowing this highest station of his, being born great, guards the third realm.

children.text: āsā yad asya payo akrata svaṃ sacetaso abhy arcanty atra ||
children.translated_text: When his own milk was made in his mouth, the mindful ones worship him here.

children.text: ata u tvā pitubhṛto janitrīr annāvṛdham prati caranty annaiḥ
children.translated_text: Then the mothers who bear nourishment and increase food come toward you with foods.

children.text: tā īm praty eṣi punar anyarūpā asi tvaṃ vikṣu mānuṣīṣu hotā ||
children.translated_text: You go back to them again in another form; among human settlements you are the <s>hotṛ</s> (sacrificial priest).

children.text: hotāraṃ citraratham adhvarasya yajñasya yajñasya ketuṃ ruśantam
children.translated_text: As <s>hotṛ</s> of the <s>adhvara</s> (sacrificial rite), with a bright chariot, the gleaming sign of each sacrifice,

children.text: pratyardhiṃ devasya devasya mahnā śriyā tv agnim atithiṃ janānām ||
children.translated_text: as the match of each god in greatness, with splendor, I honor <s>Agni</s>, the guest of peoples.

children.text: sa tu vastrāṇy adha peśanāni vasāno agnir nābhā pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: Then <s>Agni</s>, wearing garments and embroidered adornments at the navel of the earth,

children.text: aruṣo jātaḥ pada iḍāyāḥ purohito rājan yakṣīha devān ||
children.translated_text: born ruddy at the place of <s>Iḍā</s>, O household-priest and king, worship the gods here.

children.text: ā hi dyāvāpṛthivī agna ubhe sadā putro na mātarā tatantha
children.translated_text: For, O <s>Agni</s>, like a son you have always stretched out both <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, your two mothers.

children.text: pra yāhy acchośato yaviṣṭhāthā vaha sahasyeha devān ||
children.translated_text: Go forth to the eager one, youngest god; then bring the gods here, O mighty one.

children.text: Chapter 839
piprīhi devāṁ uśato yaviṣṭha vidvāṁ ṛtūṁr ṛtupate yajeha
children.translated_text: Satisfy the gods who are eager, youngest god; knowing the seasons, O lord of seasons, sacrifice here.

children.text: ye daivyā ṛtvijas tebhir agne tvaṃ hotṝṇām asy āyajiṣṭhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With those divine officiants, O <s>Agni</s>, you are the best sacrificer among the <s>hotṛs</s>.

children.text: veṣi hotram uta potraṃ janānām mandhātāsi draviṇodā ṛtāvā
children.translated_text: You perform the office of <s>hotṛ</s> and also of <s>potṛ</s> for people; you are thoughtful, wealth-giving, and true to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: svāhā vayaṃ kṛṇavāmā havīṃṣi devo devān yajatv agnir arhan ||
children.translated_text: With svāhā, let us prepare the oblations; let the god <s>Agni</s>, worthy of worship, sacrifice to the gods.

children.text: ā devānām api panthām aganma yacchaknavāma tad anu pravoḍhum
children.translated_text: We have come upon the path of the gods; what we are able, let us carry forward according to that.

children.text: agnir vidvān sa yajāt sed u hotā so adhvarān sa ṛtūn kalpayāti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, knowing, shall sacrifice; he indeed is <s>hotṛ</s>, he arranges the rites and the seasons.

children.text: yad vo vayam pra mināma vratāni viduṣāṃ devā aviduṣṭarāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever vows of yours we violate, O gods, we who are more ignorant than the knowing ones,

children.text: agniṣ ṭad viśvam ā pṛṇāti vidvān yebhir devāṁ ṛtubhiḥ kalpayāti ||
children.translated_text: knowing <s>Agni</s> makes all that complete, through the seasons by which he arranges the gods.

children.text: yat pākatrā manasā dīnadakṣā na yajñasya manvate martyāsaḥ
children.translated_text: When mortals, with childish mind and feeble skill, do not understand the sacrifice,

children.text: agniṣ ṭaddhotā kratuvid vijānan yajiṣṭho devāṁ ṛtuśo yajāti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, the <s>hotṛ</s>, knowing and understanding the rite, sacrifices to the gods season by season as the best worshipper.

children.text: viśveṣāṃ hy adhvarāṇām anīkaṃ citraṃ ketuṃ janitā tvā jajāna
children.translated_text: For the creator begot you as the face of all <s>adhvaras</s>, the wondrous beacon,

children.text: sa ā yajasva nṛvatīr anu kṣā spārhā iṣaḥ kṣumatīr viśvajanyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: so sacrifice for us along the manly lands, for desirable, food-rich, people-sustaining nourishment.

children.text: yaṃ tvā dyāvāpṛthivī yaṃ tvāpas tvaṣṭā yaṃ tvā sujanimā jajāna
children.translated_text: You whom <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> bore, whom the waters bore, whom <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, giver of good birth, bore,

children.text: panthām anu pravidvān pitṛyāṇaṃ dyumad agne samidhāno vi bhāhi ||
children.translated_text: knowing the path, the ancestral path, shine widely, O <s>Agni</s>, kindled with bright light.

children.text: Chapter 840
ino rājann aratiḥ samiddho raudro dakṣāya suṣumāṁ adarśi
children.translated_text: Kindled, O king, the powerful messenger, fierce in nature, has appeared for skill and favor.

children.text: cikid vi bhāti bhāsā bṛhatāsiknīm eti ruśatīm apājan ||
children.translated_text: He perceives and shines with great light; he comes to the dark one, driving away the gleaming one.

children.text: kṛṣṇāṃ yad enīm abhi varpasā bhūj janayan yoṣām bṛhataḥ pitur jām
children.translated_text: When with his form he covered the black spotted one, generating the young woman, daughter of the great father,

children.text: ūrdhvam bhānuṃ sūryasya stabhāyan divo vasubhir aratir vi bhāti ||
children.translated_text: upholding the upward beam of the sun, the messenger shines from heaven with the <s>Vasus</s>.

children.text: bhadro bhadrayā sacamāna āgāt svasāraṃ jāro abhy eti paścāt
children.translated_text: The gracious one has come together with the gracious one; the lover follows after his sister.

children.text: supraketair dyubhir agnir vitiṣṭhan ruśadbhir varṇair abhi rāmam asthāt ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, standing forth with well-marked days and ruddy colors, has reached the lovely one with shining hues.

children.text: asya yāmāso bṛhato na vagnūn indhānā agneḥ sakhyuḥ śivasya
children.translated_text: His courses are like the cries of the great one, the friendly, auspicious <s>Agni</s> when kindled.

children.text: īḍyasya vṛṣṇo bṛhataḥ svāso bhāmāso yāmann aktavaś cikitre ||
children.translated_text: The flames of the praiseworthy, mighty, great one are seen clearly as they move through the nights.

children.text: svanā na yasya bhāmāsaḥ pavante rocamānasya bṛhataḥ sudivaḥ
children.translated_text: His blazing powers, like sounds, purify themselves, of the shining, great, fair-dayed one.

children.text: jyeṣṭhebhir yas tejiṣṭhaiḥ krīḍumadbhir varṣiṣṭhebhir bhānubhir nakṣati dyām ||
children.translated_text: With his eldest, sharpest, playful, tallest rays he reaches the sky.

children.text: asya śuṣmāso dadṛśānapaver jehamānasya svanayan niyudbhiḥ
children.translated_text: His powers, seen as he advances with his teams, make a sound without ceasing.

children.text: pratnebhir yo ruśadbhir devatamo vi rebhadbhir aratir bhāti vibhvā ||
children.translated_text: He who, most divine, with ancient ruddy and roaring powers, shines as a far-reaching messenger.

children.text: sa ā vakṣi mahi na ā ca satsi divaspṛthivyor aratir yuvatyoḥ
children.translated_text: Bring that great one here to us and sit down, messenger of heaven and earth, the two young women.

children.text: agniḥ sutukaḥ sutukebhir aśvai rabhasvadbhī rabhasvāṁ eha gamyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, well-born, with well-born, impetuous horses, come here, impetuous one.

children.text: Chapter 841
pra te yakṣi pra ta iyarmi manma bhuvo yathā vandyo no haveṣu
children.translated_text: I offer worship to you, I raise my thought to you, so that you may be worthy of praise in our invocations.

children.text: dhanvann iva prapā asi tvam agna iyakṣave pūrave pratna rājan ||
children.translated_text: Like a watering place in the desert, you are there for the ancient <s>Pūru</s> who wishes to sacrifice, O <s>Agni</s>, king.

children.text: yaṃ tvā janāso abhi saṃcaranti gāva uṣṇam iva vrajaṃ yaviṣṭha
children.translated_text: You whom people approach from all sides, like cows approaching a warm pen, youngest god,

children.text: dūto devānām asi martyānām antar mahāṃś carasi rocanena ||
children.translated_text: you are the messenger of gods and mortals; great, you move within the luminous realm.

children.text: śiśuṃ na tvā jenyaṃ vardhayantī mātā bibharti sacanasyamānā
children.translated_text: Like a mother nurturing a noble child, she bears you as you seek companionship.

children.text: dhanor adhi pravatā yāsi haryañ jigīṣase paśur ivāvasṛṣṭaḥ ||
children.translated_text: From the slope of the bow you go forth eagerly; you strive to win like a beast set loose.

children.text: mūrā amūra na vayaṃ cikitvo mahitvam agne tvam aṅga vitse
children.translated_text: O undeceived one, we are foolish and do not understand; you, O <s>Agni</s>, truly know your greatness.

children.text: śaye vavriś carati jihvayādan rerihyate yuvatiṃ viśpatiḥ san ||
children.translated_text: The lord of the clan, though lying wrapped up, moves with his tongue eating, licking the young woman.

children.text: kūcij jāyate sanayāsu navyo vane tasthau palito dhūmaketuḥ
children.translated_text: Somewhere, new, he is born in ancient places; in the forest the gray, smoke-bannered one has stood.

children.text: asnātāpo vṛṣabho na pra veti sacetaso yam praṇayanta martāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Burning yet not bathed, like a bull he presses forward, whom mindful mortals lead on.

children.text: tanūtyajeva taskarā vanargū raśanābhir daśabhir abhy adhītām
children.translated_text: Like thieves abandoning the body, going through the forest, they have studied him with ten reins.

children.text: iyaṃ te agne navyasī manīṣā yukṣvā rathaṃ na śucayadbhir aṅgaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: This is your newest inspired song, O <s>Agni</s>; yoke the chariot with your bright limbs.

children.text: brahma ca te jātavedo namaś ceyaṃ ca gīḥ sadam id vardhanī bhūt
children.translated_text: May this sacred formulation and homage to you, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, and this song always become strengthening.

children.text: rakṣā ṇo agne tanayāni tokā rakṣota nas tanvo aprayucchan ||
children.translated_text: Protect our offspring and children, O <s>Agni</s>; protect our own bodies without neglect.

children.text: Chapter 842
ekaḥ samudro dharuṇo rayīṇām asmaddhṛdo bhūrijanmā vi caṣṭe
children.translated_text: The one ocean, support of riches, born in many places, looks out from our hearts.

children.text: siṣakty ūdhar niṇyor upastha utsasya madhye nihitam padaṃ veḥ ||
children.translated_text: It clings to the udder in the hidden lap; in the middle of the spring lies the track of the bird.

children.text: samānaṃ nīḍaṃ vṛṣaṇo vasānāḥ saṃ jagmire mahiṣā arvatībhiḥ
children.translated_text: Clothed in a common nest, the bulls, the mighty ones, came together with the mares.

children.text: ṛtasya padaṃ kavayo ni pānti guhā nāmāni dadhire parāṇi ||
children.translated_text: The inspired poets guard the station of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order); in secret they have set down the distant names.

children.text: ṛtāyinī māyinī saṃ dadhāte mitvā śiśuṃ jajñatur vardhayantī
children.translated_text: The truth-moving and wonder-working pair come together; having measured out the child, the two bore him and made him grow.

children.text: viśvasya nābhiṃ carato dhruvasya kaveś cit tantum manasā viyantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: As they mentally weave even the poet's thread, they extend the navel of all that moves and stands firm.

children.text: ṛtasya hi vartanayaḥ sujātam iṣo vājāya pradivaḥ sacante
children.translated_text: For the well-born courses of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) attend the refreshments from of old, for strength and prize-winning vigor.

children.text: adhīvāsaṃ rodasī vāvasāne ghṛtair annair vāvṛdhāte madhūnām ||
children.translated_text: Heaven and earth, putting on their covering, have grown with ghee, foods, and sweetnesses.

children.text: sapta svasṝr aruṣīr vāvaśāno vidvān madhva uj jabhārā dṛśe kam
children.translated_text: Longing for the seven ruddy sisters, the knowing one drew up the sweetness for sight and delight.

children.text: antar yeme antarikṣe purājā icchan vavrim avidat pūṣaṇasya ||
children.translated_text: Born aforetime, he held them between in midspace; seeking, he found the enclosure of <s>Pūṣan</s>.

children.text: sapta maryādāḥ kavayas tatakṣus tāsām ekām id abhy aṃhuro gāt
children.translated_text: The poets fashioned seven boundaries; the distressed man has gone up to one of them.

children.text: āyor ha skambha upamasya nīḍe pathāṃ visarge dharuṇeṣu tasthau ||
children.translated_text: As the prop of life, in the highest nest, he stood at the release of the paths, among the foundations.

children.text: asac ca sac ca parame vyoman dakṣasya janmann aditer upasthe
children.translated_text: Non-being and being are in the highest heaven, at the birth of <s>Dakṣa</s>, in the lap of <s>Aditi</s>.

children.text: agnir ha naḥ prathamajā ṛtasya pūrva āyuni vṛṣabhaś ca dhenuḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> was our first-born of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), in the former age, both bull and cow.

children.text: Chapter 843
ayaṃ sa yasya śarmann avobhir agner edhate jaritābhiṣṭau
children.translated_text: This is he in whose shelter, with protections, the singer grows strong through the help of <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: jyeṣṭhebhir yo bhānubhir ṛṣūṇām paryeti parivīto vibhāvā ||
children.translated_text: He who with the eldest beams of the seers goes around, surrounded, shining widely.

children.text: yo bhānubhir vibhāvā vibhāty agnir devebhir ṛtāvājasraḥ
children.translated_text: He who shines with beams, the wide-shining <s>Agni</s>, true to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), together with the gods, unfailing.

children.text: ā yo vivāya sakhyā sakhibhyo 'parihvṛto atyo na saptiḥ ||
children.translated_text: He who has spread friendship for his friends, unassailable like a racing steed.

children.text: īśe yo viśvasyā devavīter īśe viśvāyur uṣaso vyuṣṭau
children.translated_text: He rules over the whole divine feast; all life is in his power at the dawning of the dawns.

children.text: ā yasmin manā havīṃṣy agnāv ariṣṭaratha skabhnāti śūṣaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: In <s>Agni</s>, O <s>Ariṣṭaratha</s>, the devoted one braces the oblations with his powers.

children.text: śūṣebhir vṛdho juṣāṇo arkair devāṁ acchā raghupatvā jigāti
children.translated_text: Growing through his powers and taking pleasure in songs, he goes with swift lordship toward the gods.

children.text: mandro hotā sa juhvā yajiṣṭhaḥ sammiślo agnir ā jigharti devān ||
children.translated_text: The pleasing <s>hotṛ</s> (sacrificial priest), best sacrificer, <s>Agni</s>, mixed with the offering-ladle, brings the gods here.

children.text: tam usrām indraṃ na rejamānam agniṃ gīrbhir namobhir ā kṛṇudhvam
children.translated_text: Make that ruddy <s>Agni</s>, trembling like <s>Indra</s>, ready with songs and acts of homage.

children.text: ā yaṃ viprāso matibhir gṛṇanti jātavedasaṃ juhvaṃ sahānām ||
children.translated_text: Him the inspired poets praise with their thoughts, <s>Jātavedas</s>, the tongue among the strong.

children.text: saṃ yasmin viśvā vasūni jagmur vāje nāśvāḥ saptīvanta evaiḥ
children.translated_text: In him all good things have come together, as horses with racing teams come for the prize.

children.text: asme ūtīr indravātatamā arvācīnā agna ā kṛṇuṣva ||
children.translated_text: For us, O <s>Agni</s>, make your aids, most impelled by <s>Indra</s> and the wind, turn hitherward.

children.text: adhā hy agne mahnā niṣadyā sadyo jajñāno havyo babhūtha
children.translated_text: For then, O <s>Agni</s>, sitting down in greatness, born at once, you became fit to be invoked.

children.text: taṃ te devāso anu ketam āyann adhāvardhanta prathamāsa ūmāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The gods followed that sign of yours; then the first powers made it grow.

children.text: Chapter 844
svasti no divo agne pṛthivyā viśvāyur dhehi yajathāya deva
children.translated_text: From heaven and from earth, O <s>Agni</s>, set well-being for us; O god, grant full life for worship.

children.text: sacemahi tava dasma praketair uruṣyā ṇa urubhir deva śaṃsaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we be joined with your manifestations, O wondrous one; with broad divine praises protect us on every side.

children.text: imā agne matayas tubhyaṃ jātā gobhir aśvair abhi gṛṇanti rādhaḥ
children.translated_text: These thoughts, O <s>Agni</s>, born for you, proclaim wealth with cows and horses.

children.text: yadā te marto anu bhogam ānaḍ vaso dadhāno matibhiḥ sujāta ||
children.translated_text: When a mortal has reached the enjoyment belonging to you, O good one, holding it through his thoughts, O well-born one.

children.text: agnim manye pitaram agnim āpim agnim bhrātaraṃ sadam it sakhāyam
children.translated_text: I regard <s>Agni</s> as father, <s>Agni</s> as kinsman, <s>Agni</s> as brother and always as friend.

children.text: agner anīkam bṛhataḥ saparyaṃ divi śukraṃ yajataṃ sūryasya ||
children.translated_text: I attend upon the face of great <s>Agni</s>, bright in heaven, worshipful, belonging to the sun.

children.text: sidhrā agne dhiyo asme sanutrīr yaṃ trāyase dama ā nityahotā
children.translated_text: Successful, protective thoughts are ours, O <s>Agni</s>, when as the constant <s>hotṛ</s> (sacrificial priest) you guard him in the house.

children.text: ṛtāvā sa rohidaśvaḥ purukṣur dyubhir asmā ahabhir vāmam astu ||
children.translated_text: True to <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), with ruddy horses and rich in goods, may what is desirable be his through days and bright days.

children.text: dyubhir hitam mitram iva prayogam pratnam ṛtvijam adhvarasya jāram
children.translated_text: Set in the bright days like an ally for service, the ancient priest, lover of the <s>adhvara</s> (sacrificial rite),

children.text: bāhubhyām agnim āyavo 'jananta vikṣu hotāraṃ ny asādayanta ||
children.translated_text: the descendants of <s>Āyu</s> generated <s>Agni</s> with their two arms and seated him among the clans as <s>hotṛ</s> (sacrificial priest).

children.text: svayaṃ yajasva divi deva devān kiṃ te pākaḥ kṛṇavad apracetāḥ
children.translated_text: Yourself sacrifice to the gods in heaven, O god; what can the childish, unthinking man do for you?

children.text: yathāyaja ṛtubhir deva devān evā yajasva tanvaṃ sujāta ||
children.translated_text: As one who sacrifices according to the seasons, O god, sacrifice to the gods; in this way, well-born one, sacrifice to your own body.

children.text: bhavā no agne 'vitota gopā bhavā vayaskṛd uta no vayodhāḥ
children.translated_text: Be our helper, O <s>Agni</s>, and our guardian; be maker of vigor for us and giver of vigor.

children.text: rāsvā ca naḥ sumaho havyadātiṃ trāsvota nas tanvo aprayucchan ||
children.translated_text: Grant us a very great gift of oblation, and protect our bodies without neglect.

children.text: Chapter 845
pra ketunā bṛhatā yāty agnir ā rodasī vṛṣabho roravīti
children.translated_text: With his great banner <s>Agni</s> goes forth; as a bull he roars to heaven and earth.

children.text: divaś cid antāṁ upamāṁ ud ānaḍ apām upasthe mahiṣo vavardha ||
children.translated_text: He has reached even the farthest boundary of heaven; the mighty bull has grown in the lap of the waters.

children.text: mumoda garbho vṛṣabhaḥ kakudmān asremā vatsaḥ śimīvāṁ arāvīt
children.translated_text: The bull embryo, humped and strong, rejoiced; the unwearied calf, powerful, bellowed.

children.text: sa devatāty udyatāni kṛṇvan sveṣu kṣayeṣu prathamo jigāti ||
children.translated_text: Making ready the things raised up for the deity, he goes first in his own dwellings.

children.text: ā yo mūrdhānam pitror arabdha ny adhvare dadhire sūro arṇaḥ
children.translated_text: He who has grasped the head of his two parents, the bright flood, they placed down at the <s>adhvara</s> (sacrificial rite).

children.text: asya patmann aruṣīr aśvabudhnā ṛtasya yonau tanvo juṣanta ||
children.translated_text: At his track the ruddy mares, whose base is the horse, rejoice in their bodies in the womb of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: uṣa uṣo hi vaso agram eṣi tvaṃ yamayor abhavo vibhāvā
children.translated_text: Dawn after dawn, O good one, you go foremost; you became the shining one for the twin pair.

children.text: ṛtāya sapta dadhiṣe padāni janayan mitraṃ tanve svāyai ||
children.translated_text: For <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) you hold the seven stations, generating <s>Mitra</s> for your own body.

children.text: bhuvaś cakṣur maha ṛtasya gopā bhuvo varuṇo yad ṛtāya veṣi
children.translated_text: You became the eye of great <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), its guardian; you became <s>Varuṇa</s> when you entered for <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: bhuvo apāṃ napāj jātavedo bhuvo dūto yasya havyaṃ jujoṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You became <s>Apām Napāt</s>, O <s>Jātavedas</s>; you became the messenger whose oblation you accepted.

children.text: bhuvo yajñasya rajasaś ca netā yatrā niyudbhiḥ sacase śivābhiḥ
children.translated_text: You became leader of the sacrifice and of the luminous realm, where you accompany the auspicious teams.

children.text: divi mūrdhānaṃ dadhiṣe svarṣāṃ jihvām agne cakṛṣe havyavāham ||
children.translated_text: In heaven you set your head, winning the sunlight; O <s>Agni</s>, you made your tongue the bearer of oblations.

children.text: asya tritaḥ kratunā vavre antar icchan dhītim pitur evaiḥ parasya
children.translated_text: With his will, <s>Trita</s> chose him within, seeking the inspired thought by the impulses of the further father.

children.text: sacasyamānaḥ pitror upasthe jāmi bruvāṇa āyudhāni veti ||
children.translated_text: Attending on the lap of the two parents, speaking as a kinsman, he sets the weapons in motion.

children.text: sa pitryāṇy āyudhāni vidvān indreṣita āptyo abhy ayudhyat
children.translated_text: Knowing the paternal weapons, <s>Trita Āptya</s>, impelled by <s>Indra</s>, fought against him.

children.text: triśīrṣāṇaṃ saptaraśmiṃ jaghanvān tvāṣṭrasya cin niḥ sasṛje trito gāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having struck down the three-headed, seven-rayed one, <s>Trita</s> released even the cows of <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>.

children.text: bhūrīd indra ud inakṣantam ojo 'vābhinat satpatir manyamānam
children.translated_text: Mighty <s>Indra</s>, lord of the good, split open the one swelling with force, who thought himself powerful.

children.text: tvāṣṭrasya cid viśvarūpasya gonām ā cakrāṇas trīṇi śīrṣā parā vark ||
children.translated_text: Turning against even <s>Viśvarūpa</s>, son of <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, he cut off the three heads from the cows.

children.text: Chapter 846
āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvas tā na ūrje dadhātana
children.translated_text: Waters, for you are bringers of bliss; place us in strength.

children.text: mahe raṇāya cakṣase ||
children.translated_text: Grant us great delight and clear vision.

children.text: yo vaḥ śivatamo rasas tasya bhājayateha naḥ
children.translated_text: Of your most auspicious sap, let us partake here,

children.text: uśatīr iva mātaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: like loving mothers.

children.text: tasmā araṃ gamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha
children.translated_text: To that refreshment of yours may we come readily, the one for whose dwelling you quicken us.

children.text: āpo janayathā ca naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Waters, generate us anew as well.

children.text: śaṃ no devīr abhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye
children.translated_text: May the divine waters be auspicious for us, for aid; may they be fit for drinking.

children.text: śaṃ yor abhi sravantu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May they stream upon us for welfare and health.

children.text: īśānā vāryāṇāṃ kṣayantīś carṣaṇīnām
children.translated_text: Mistresses of desirable goods, ruling over the peoples,

children.text: apo yācāmi bheṣajam ||
children.translated_text: I ask the waters for healing medicine.

children.text: apsu me somo abravīd antar viśvāni bheṣajā
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> has told me: within the waters are all medicines,

children.text: agniṃ ca viśvaśambhuvam ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Agni</s>, beneficent to all.

children.text: āpaḥ pṛṇīta bheṣajaṃ varūthaṃ tanve mama
children.translated_text: Waters, fill up the medicine, a sheltering protection for my body,

children.text: jyok ca sūryaṃ dṛśe ||
children.translated_text: so that I may long behold the sun.

children.text: idam āpaḥ pra vahata yat kiṃ ca duritam mayi
children.translated_text: Waters, carry away from me whatever evil there is in me,

children.text: yad vāham abhidudroha yad vā śepa utānṛtam ||
children.translated_text: whether I have acted treacherously, or whether I have sworn or spoken falsely.

children.text: āpo adyānv acāriṣaṃ rasena sam agasmahi
children.translated_text: Today, O waters, I have gone after you; we have come together with your sap.

children.text: payasvān agna ā gahi tam mā saṃ sṛja varcasā ||
children.translated_text: Rich in milk, O <s>Agni</s>, come; unite me with brilliance.

children.text: Chapter 847
o cit sakhāyaṃ sakhyā vavṛtyāṃ tiraḥ purū cid arṇavaṃ jaganvān
children.translated_text: If only, through friendship, I might turn the friend back, though he has gone across many floods.

children.text: pitur napātam ā dadhīta vedhā adhi kṣami prataraṃ dīdhyānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the wise ordainer set the father's descendant upon the earth, shining far and wide.

children.text: na te sakhā sakhyaṃ vaṣṭy etat salakṣmā yad viṣurūpā bhavāti
children.translated_text: Your friend does not desire this friendship of yours, when one of the same mark becomes of a different form.

children.text: mahas putrāso asurasya vīrā divo dhartāra urviyā pari khyan ||
children.translated_text: The heroic sons of the great <s>Asura</s>, sustainers of heaven, look widely around.

children.text: uśanti ghā te amṛtāsa etad ekasya cit tyajasam martyasya
children.translated_text: The immortals surely desire this from you: offspring even from the one mortal.

children.text: ni te mano manasi dhāyy asme janyuḥ patis tanvam ā viviśyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let your mind be set within my mind; as begetter and husband, enter my body.

children.text: na yat purā cakṛmā kaddha nūnam ṛtā vadanto anṛtaṃ rapema
children.translated_text: What we did not do before, how could we do now, speaking truth yet uttering untruth?

children.text: gandharvo apsv apyā ca yoṣā sā no nābhiḥ paramaṃ jāmi tan nau ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Gandharva</s> in the waters, and the watery woman: that is our highest bond, that kinship of ours.

children.text: garbhe nu nau janitā dampatī kar devas tvaṣṭā savitā viśvarūpaḥ
children.translated_text: In the womb our begetter made us a pair, husband and wife: the god <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, <s>Savitṛ</s>, of every form.

children.text: nakir asya pra minanti vratāni veda nāv asya pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: No one violates his ordinances; earth and heaven know this concerning us.

children.text: ko asya veda prathamasyāhnaḥ ka īṃ dadarśa ka iha pra vocat
children.translated_text: Who knows of that first day? Who has seen it? Who here can proclaim it?

children.text: bṛhan mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma kad u brava āhano vīcyā nṝn ||
children.translated_text: Great is the domain of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; what will you say, O striker, among men who are to be examined?

children.text: yamasya mā yamyaṃ kāma āgan samāne yonau sahaśeyyāya
children.translated_text: Desire for <s>Yama</s> has come upon me, <s>Yamī</s>, to lie together in the same place of origin.

children.text: jāyeva patye tanvaṃ riricyāṃ vi cid vṛheva rathyeva cakrā ||
children.translated_text: Like a wife to her husband I would yield my body; yet let us draw apart like the two wheels of a chariot.

children.text: na tiṣṭhanti na ni miṣanty ete devānāṃ spaśa iha ye caranti
children.translated_text: They do not stand still, nor do they close their eyes, these spies of the gods who move here.

children.text: anyena mad āhano yāhi tūyaṃ tena vi vṛha rathyeva cakrā ||
children.translated_text: Go quickly with someone other than me, O eager one; separate from me like the wheels of a chariot.

children.text: rātrībhir asmā ahabhir daśasyet sūryasya cakṣur muhur un mimīyāt
children.translated_text: With nights and days may he serve this one; may the eye of the sun open again and again.

children.text: divā pṛthivyā mithunā sabandhū yamīr yamasya bibhṛyād ajāmi ||
children.translated_text: May heaven and earth, a paired and kindred couple, make <s>Yamī</s> bear what is not sisterhood with <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: ā ghā tā gacchān uttarā yugāni yatra jāmayaḥ kṛṇavann ajāmi
children.translated_text: Indeed later ages will come, when kinsfolk will make what is not kinship.

children.text: upa barbṛhi vṛṣabhāya bāhum anyam icchasva subhage patim mat ||
children.translated_text: Stretch your arm toward a bull; seek another husband than me, fortunate one.

children.text: kim bhrātāsad yad anātham bhavāti kim u svasā yan nirṛtir nigacchāt
children.translated_text: What kind of brother is he when she is left without protector? What kind of sister, when destruction reaches her?

children.text: kāmamūtā bahv etad rapāmi tanvā me tanvaṃ sam pipṛgdhi ||
children.translated_text: Driven by desire, I speak much of this; with your body join my body.

children.text: na vā u te tanvā tanvaṃ sam papṛcyām pāpam āhur yaḥ svasāraṃ nigacchāt
children.translated_text: I will not join my body with your body; they call him evil who approaches his sister.

children.text: anyena mat pramudaḥ kalpayasva na te bhrātā subhage vaṣṭy etat ||
children.translated_text: Arrange your pleasures with someone other than me; your brother, fortunate one, does not desire this.

children.text: bato batāsi yama naiva te mano hṛdayaṃ cāvidāma
children.translated_text: Alas, indeed you are weak, O <s>Yama</s>; we have not found your mind or your heart.

children.text: anyā kila tvāṃ kakṣyeva yuktam pari ṣvajāte libujeva vṛkṣam ||
children.translated_text: Surely another embraces you like one fastened with a girth, like a creeper embracing a tree.

children.text: anyam ū ṣu tvaṃ yamy anya u tvām pari ṣvajāte libujeva vṛkṣam
children.translated_text: Then you, <s>Yamī</s>, embrace another, and another embraces you, like a creeper embracing a tree.

children.text: tasya vā tvam mana icchā sa vā tavādhā kṛṇuṣva saṃvidaṃ subhadrām ||
children.translated_text: Set your mind on him, or let him set his on you; then make a fair agreement.

children.text: Chapter 848
vṛṣā vṛṣṇe duduhe dohasā divaḥ payāṃsi yahvo aditer adābhyaḥ
children.translated_text: The bull, the mighty one, has milked the milks of heaven by his milking, the vigorous, undeceived son of <s>Aditi</s>.

children.text: viśvaṃ sa veda varuṇo yathā dhiyā sa yajñiyo yajatu yajñiyāṁ ṛtūn ||
children.translated_text: He, <s>Varuṇa</s>, knows everything by insight; may the worshipful one worship the worshipful seasons.

children.text: rapad gandharvīr apyā ca yoṣaṇā nadasya nāde pari pātu me manaḥ
children.translated_text: May the watery <s>Gandharvī</s> and the woman of the waters speak; in the river's sounding may she guard my mind.

children.text: iṣṭasya madhye aditir ni dhātu no bhrātā no jyeṣṭhaḥ prathamo vi vocati ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Aditi</s> place us in the midst of what has been offered; our eldest brother, the first, speaks forth for us.

children.text: so cin nu bhadrā kṣumatī yaśasvaty uṣā uvāsa manave svarvatī
children.translated_text: Now that blessed <s>Uṣas</s>, rich in possessions, glorious and sunlit, has dawned for <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: yad īm uśantam uśatām anu kratum agniṃ hotāraṃ vidathāya jījanan ||
children.translated_text: For the eager ones, according to their eager will, generated <s>Agni</s>, the <s>hotṛ</s>, for the ritual gathering.

children.text: adha tyaṃ drapsaṃ vibhvaṃ vicakṣaṇaṃ vir ābharad iṣitaḥ śyeno adhvare
children.translated_text: Then the impelled falcon brought forth that mighty, far-seeing drop at the <s>adhvara</s> (sacrificial rite).

children.text: yadī viśo vṛṇate dasmam āryā agniṃ hotāram adha dhīr ajāyata ||
children.translated_text: When the Ārya peoples choose wondrous <s>Agni</s> as <s>hotṛ</s>, then inspired thought is born.

children.text: sadāsi raṇvo yavaseva puṣyate hotrābhir agne manuṣaḥ svadhvaraḥ
children.translated_text: You are always delightful; like one nourished with fodder, O <s>Agni</s>, the man with good ritual prospers through the priestly offices.

children.text: viprasya vā yacchaśamāna ukthyaṃ vājaṃ sasavāṁ upayāsi bhūribhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Or, praised by the inspired poet as worthy of hymns, winning prize-strength, you come near with many riches.

children.text: ud īraya pitarā jāra ā bhagam iyakṣati haryato hṛtta iṣyati
children.translated_text: Raise up the two parents, O lover, toward fortune; the tawny one wishes to sacrifice and is impelled from the heart.

children.text: vivakti vahniḥ svapasyate makhas taviṣyate asuro vepate matī ||
children.translated_text: The bearer speaks forth; the rite is skillfully performed, the sacrifice grows strong, and the mighty one trembles with inspired thought.

children.text: yas te agne sumatim marto akṣat sahasaḥ sūno ati sa pra śṛṇve
children.translated_text: The mortal who obtains your good favor, O <s>Agni</s>, son of strength, is heard far and wide.

children.text: iṣaṃ dadhāno vahamāno aśvair ā sa dyumāṁ amavān bhūṣati dyūn ||
children.translated_text: Bearing refreshment and carried by horses, bright and powerful, he adorns his days.

children.text: yad agna eṣā samitir bhavāti devī deveṣu yajatā yajatra
children.translated_text: When this assembly of yours takes place, O <s>Agni</s>, divine among the gods, worshipful and worthy of worship,

children.text: ratnā ca yad vibhajāsi svadhāvo bhāgaṃ no atra vasumantaṃ vītāt ||
children.translated_text: and when you distribute treasures, O self-powerful one, may you allot to us here a share rich in goods.

children.text: śrudhī no agne sadane sadhasthe yukṣvā ratham amṛtasya dravitnum
children.translated_text: Hear us, O <s>Agni</s>, in the dwelling, in the common seat; yoke the swift chariot of immortality.

children.text: ā no vaha rodasī devaputre mākir devānām apa bhūr iha syāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bring to us <s>Rodasī</s>, the two divine children; do not be absent from the gods here.

children.text: Chapter 849
dyāvā ha kṣāmā prathame ṛtenābhiśrāve bhavataḥ satyavācā
children.translated_text: Heaven and earth, at the first, through <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), become true-speaking at the proclamation.

children.text: devo yan martān yajathāya kṛṇvan sīdaddhotā pratyaṅ svam asuṃ yan ||
children.translated_text: When the god, making mortals ready for worship, sat down as <s>hotṛ</s> (invoking priest), turning toward his own vital breath.

children.text: devo devān paribhūr ṛtena vahā no havyam prathamaś cikitvān
children.translated_text: The god, encompassing the gods through <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), first knowing one, carry our oblation.

children.text: dhūmaketuḥ samidhā bhāṛjīko mandro hotā nityo vācā yajīyān ||
children.translated_text: Smoke-bannered, bright through the kindling, the delightful, constant <s>hotṛ</s> (invoking priest), most fit for sacrifice with speech.

children.text: svāvṛg devasyāmṛtaṃ yadī gor ato jātāso dhārayanta urvī
children.translated_text: When the immortal part of the god, self-moving, is of the cow, from that the born ones uphold the two wide worlds.

children.text: viśve devā anu tat te yajur gur duhe yad enī divyaṃ ghṛtaṃ vāḥ ||
children.translated_text: All the gods follow that sacrificial formula of yours, when the dark one milks out the heavenly stream of ghee.

children.text: arcāmi vāṃ vardhāyāpo ghṛtasnū dyāvābhūmī śṛṇutaṃ rodasī me
children.translated_text: I praise you two for increase, O waters streaming with ghee; O heaven and earth, O two worlds, hear me.

children.text: ahā yad dyāvo 'sunītim ayan madhvā no atra pitarā śiśītām ||
children.translated_text: When the days, O heavens, went to life-giving order, then here may the two parents sharpen us with sweetness.

children.text: kiṃ svin no rājā jagṛhe kad asyāti vrataṃ cakṛmā ko vi veda
children.translated_text: What, then, has the king seized from us? When did we overstep his ordinance? Who knows it distinctly?

children.text: mitraś ciddhi ṣmā juhurāṇo devāñchloko na yātām api vājo asti ||
children.translated_text: For even <s>Mitra</s>, turning aside, would abandon the gods; like a song, they have not come, though strength is here.

children.text: durmantv atrāmṛtasya nāma salakṣmā yad viṣurūpā bhavāti
children.translated_text: Hard to think on here is the name of the immortal, when one becomes of like mark and yet of different forms.

children.text: yamasya yo manavate sumantv agne tam ṛṣva pāhy aprayucchan ||
children.translated_text: Whoever thinks well on <s>Yama</s>, O <s>Agni</s>, protect him, lofty one, without negligence.

children.text: yasmin devā vidathe mādayante vivasvataḥ sadane dhārayante
children.translated_text: In whom the gods rejoice at the gathering, in the seat of <s>Vivasvant</s> they uphold it.

children.text: sūrye jyotir adadhur māsy aktūn pari dyotaniṃ carato ajasrā ||
children.translated_text: They placed light in the sun, and nights in the moon; the two unfailing wander around the shining one.

children.text: yasmin devā manmani saṃcaranty apīcye na vayam asya vidma
children.translated_text: In whom the gods move together in thought, in the hidden place, we do not know this of him.

children.text: mitro no atrāditir anāgān savitā devo varuṇāya vocat ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, and the god <s>Savitṛ</s> speak us guiltless here to <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: śrudhī no agne sadane sadhasthe yukṣvā ratham amṛtasya dravitnum
children.translated_text: Hear us, O <s>Agni</s>, in the seat, in the common dwelling; yoke the swift chariot of immortality.

children.text: ā no vaha rodasī devaputre mākir devānām apa bhūr iha syāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bring to us the two worlds, daughters of the gods; do not be absent here from the gods.

children.text: Chapter 850
yuje vām brahma pūrvyaṃ namobhir vi śloka etu pathyeva sūreḥ
children.translated_text: With reverences I yoke for you two the ancient sacred formulation; let the song go forth like the path of a patron.

children.text: śṛṇvantu viśve amṛtasya putrā ā ye dhāmāni divyāni tasthuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let all the sons of immortality hear, those who have taken their stand in the heavenly abodes.

children.text: yame iva yatamāne yad aitam pra vām bharan mānuṣā devayantaḥ
children.translated_text: When, like two <s>Yamas</s> striving, you came here, god-seeking men brought you forward.

children.text: ā sīdataṃ svam u lokaṃ vidāne svāsasthe bhavatam indave naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Sit down in your own dwelling, knowing your place; be in your own seat for our <s>Indu</s> (Soma).

children.text: pañca padāni rupo anv arohaṃ catuṣpadīm anv emi vratena
children.translated_text: Having climbed after the forms, the five steps, I follow the four-footed one according to the vow.

children.text: akṣareṇa prati mima etām ṛtasya nābhāv adhi sam punāmi ||
children.translated_text: With the imperishable syllable I measure this out; at the navel of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) I cleanse it completely.

children.text: devebhyaḥ kam avṛṇīta mṛtyum prajāyai kam amṛtaṃ nāvṛṇīta
children.translated_text: For the gods, who chose death? For offspring, who did not choose immortality?

children.text: bṛhaspatiṃ yajñam akṛṇvata ṛṣim priyāṃ yamas tanvam prārirecīt ||
children.translated_text: They made <s>Bṛhaspati</s> the sacrifice, the seer; <s>Yama</s> poured forth his own beloved body.

children.text: sapta kṣaranti śiśave marutvate pitre putrāso apy avīvatann ṛtam
children.translated_text: Seven streams flow for the child accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>; the sons have strengthened <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) for the father.

children.text: ubhe id asyobhayasya rājata ubhe yatete ubhayasya puṣyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Both rule over both sides of him; both strive for, both nourish, what belongs to both.

children.text: Chapter 851
pareyivāṃsam pravato mahīr anu bahubhyaḥ panthām anupaspaśānam
children.translated_text: Honor with oblation <s>Yama</s>, the king, son of <s>Vivasvant</s>, gathering men together, who went away along the great descents and found the path for many.

children.text: vaivasvataṃ saṃgamanaṃ janānāṃ yamaṃ rājānaṃ haviṣā duvasya ||
children.translated_text: Honor with oblation <s>Yama</s>, the king, son of <s>Vivasvant</s>, the gatherer of people, who went away along the great descents, looking out the path for many.

children.text: yamo no gātum prathamo viveda naiṣā gavyūtir apabhartavā u
children.translated_text: <s>Yama</s> first found out the way for us; this pasture is not to be taken away.

children.text: yatrā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ pareyur enā jajñānāḥ pathyā anu svāḥ ||
children.translated_text: There our former fathers went forth, each born one following his own paths.

children.text: mātalī kavyair yamo aṅgirobhir bṛhaspatir ṛkvabhir vāvṛdhānaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mātalī</s> grows strong with the <s>Kavyas</s>, <s>Yama</s> with the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, and <s>Bṛhaspati</s> with the singers of ṛks.

children.text: yāṃś ca devā vāvṛdhur ye ca devān svāhānye svadhayānye madanti ||
children.translated_text: Those whom the gods have strengthened and those who strengthened the gods rejoice, some with <s>svāhā</s>, others with <s>svadhā</s>.

children.text: imaṃ yama prastaram ā hi sīdāṅgirobhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ
children.translated_text: Come, O <s>Yama</s>, sit down upon this sacrificial grass, in accord with the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, the Fathers.

children.text: ā tvā mantrāḥ kaviśastā vahantv enā rājan haviṣā mādayasva ||
children.translated_text: Let the mantras praised by poets bring you here; O king, rejoice in this oblation.

children.text: aṅgirobhir ā gahi yajñiyebhir yama vairūpair iha mādayasva
children.translated_text: Come here with the worshipful <s>Aṅgirases</s>, O <s>Yama</s>; rejoice here with the <s>Vairūpas</s>.

children.text: vivasvantaṃ huve yaḥ pitā te 'smin yajñe barhiṣy ā niṣadya ||
children.translated_text: I call <s>Vivasvant</s>, who is your father, as he sits down on the sacred grass in this sacrifice.

children.text: aṅgiraso naḥ pitaro navagvā atharvāṇo bhṛgavaḥ somyāsaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Aṅgirases</s>, our Fathers, the <s>Navagvas</s>, the <s>Atharvans</s>, the <s>Bhṛgus</s>, rich in Soma,

children.text: teṣāṃ vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyānām api bhadre saumanase syāma ||
children.translated_text: may we be in the good will, in the blessed favor, of those worshipful ones.

children.text: prehi prehi pathibhiḥ pūrvyebhir yatrā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ pareyuḥ
children.translated_text: Go forth, go forth by the ancient paths, where our former fathers went forth.

children.text: ubhā rājānā svadhayā madantā yamam paśyāsi varuṇaṃ ca devam ||
children.translated_text: You shall behold the two kings, <s>Yama</s> and the god <s>Varuṇa</s>, rejoicing in <s>svadhā</s>.

children.text: saṃ gacchasva pitṛbhiḥ saṃ yameneṣṭāpūrtena parame vyoman
children.translated_text: Join with the Fathers, join with <s>Yama</s>, with your sacrifice and pious works in the highest heaven.

children.text: hitvāyāvadyam punar astam ehi saṃ gacchasva tanvā suvarcāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having cast off what is blameworthy, go back again to your home; join with a body full of radiance.

children.text: apeta vīta vi ca sarpatāto 'smā etam pitaro lokam akran
children.translated_text: Depart, go away, creep off from here; the Fathers have made this place for him.

children.text: ahobhir adbhir aktubhir vyaktaṃ yamo dadāty avasānam asmai ||
children.translated_text: Marked out by days, waters, and nights, <s>Yama</s> gives him a resting place with protection.

children.text: ati drava sārameyau śvānau caturakṣau śabalau sādhunā pathā
children.translated_text: Run past the two dogs of <s>Saramā</s>, four-eyed and spotted, by the good path.

children.text: athā pitṝn suvidatrāṁ upehi yamena ye sadhamādam madanti ||
children.translated_text: Then approach the gracious Fathers, who rejoice in shared feast with <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: yau te śvānau yama rakṣitārau caturakṣau pathirakṣī nṛcakṣasau
children.translated_text: Those two dogs of yours, O <s>Yama</s>, guardians, four-eyed path-keepers, watchers of men,

children.text: tābhyām enam pari dehi rājan svasti cāsmā anamīvaṃ ca dhehi ||
children.translated_text: to them entrust this man, O king, and grant him well-being and freedom from sickness.

children.text: urūṇasāv asutṛpā udumbalau yamasya dūtau carato janāṁ anu
children.translated_text: Broad-nosed, life-snatching, tawny-brown, the two messengers of <s>Yama</s> move among people.

children.text: tāv asmabhyaṃ dṛśaye sūryāya punar dātām asum adyeha bhadram ||
children.translated_text: May those two give back to us today auspicious life here, that we may see the sun.

children.text: yamāya somaṃ sunuta yamāya juhutā haviḥ
children.translated_text: Press Soma for <s>Yama</s>; pour the oblation for <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: yamaṃ ha yajño gacchaty agnidūto araṃkṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The sacrifice, adorned and with <s>Agni</s> as messenger, goes to <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: yamāya ghṛtavaddhavir juhota pra ca tiṣṭhata
children.translated_text: Offer to <s>Yama</s> the ghee-rich oblation, and step forward.

children.text: sa no deveṣv ā yamad dīrgham āyuḥ pra jīvase ||
children.translated_text: May he lead us among the gods to long life, that we may live.

children.text: yamāya madhumattamaṃ rājñe havyaṃ juhotana
children.translated_text: Offer the sweetest oblation to <s>Yama</s>, the king.

children.text: idaṃ nama ṛṣibhyaḥ pūrvajebhyaḥ pūrvebhyaḥ pathikṛdbhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: This reverence is for the seers born of old, for the earlier path-makers.

children.text: trikadrukebhiḥ patati ṣaḍ urvīr ekam id bṛhat
children.translated_text: With the three <s>kadruka</s> Soma-pressings it flies; six wide realms, and one alone is great.

children.text: triṣṭub gāyatrī chandāṃsi sarvā tā yama āhitā ||
children.translated_text: The <s>triṣṭubh</s> and <s>gāyatrī</s> metres, all the metres, are placed in <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: Chapter 852
ud īratām avara ut parāsa un madhyamāḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the lower ones rise up, let the higher ones rise up, and let the middle <s>Pitṛs</s> (Fathers), delighting in Soma, rise up.

children.text: asuṃ ya īyur avṛkā ṛtajñās te no 'vantu pitaro haveṣu ||
children.translated_text: Those who have gone to life, harmless and knowing <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), may those <s>Pitṛs</s> protect us in our invocations.

children.text: idam pitṛbhyo namo astv adya ye pūrvāso ya uparāsa īyuḥ
children.translated_text: Let this homage be to the <s>Pitṛs</s> today, to those earlier ones and those later ones who have gone.

children.text: ye pārthive rajasy ā niṣattā ye vā nūnaṃ suvṛjanāsu vikṣu ||
children.translated_text: Those who are seated in the earthly realm, or who now dwell among well-settled peoples.

children.text: āham pitṝn suvidatrāṁ avitsi napātaṃ ca vikramaṇaṃ ca viṣṇoḥ
children.translated_text: I have found the <s>Pitṛs</s>, easy to invoke, and the offspring, and the wide stride of <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

children.text: barhiṣado ye svadhayā sutasya bhajanta pitvas ta ihāgamiṣṭhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those seated on the <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass), who through <s>svadhā</s> share in the pressed drink and food, may they most readily come here.

children.text: barhiṣadaḥ pitara ūty arvāg imā vo havyā cakṛmā juṣadhvam
children.translated_text: O <s>Pitṛs</s> seated on the <s>barhis</s>, come hither with aid; we have prepared these oblations for you; enjoy them.

children.text: ta ā gatāvasā śantamenāthā naḥ śaṃ yor arapo dadhāta ||
children.translated_text: Having come with most auspicious help, then place welfare, vigor, and freedom from harm upon us.

children.text: upahūtāḥ pitaraḥ somyāso barhiṣyeṣu nidhiṣu priyeṣu
children.translated_text: The Soma-loving <s>Pitṛs</s> have been invoked upon the dear deposits on the <s>barhis</s>.

children.text: ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantv adhi bruvantu te 'vantv asmān ||
children.translated_text: Let them come, let them listen here, let them speak in our favor, and let them protect us.

children.text: ācyā jānu dakṣiṇato niṣadyemaṃ yajñam abhi gṛṇīta viśve
children.translated_text: Sitting down on bended knee to the south, all of you, praise this sacrifice.

children.text: mā hiṃsiṣṭa pitaraḥ kena cin no yad va āgaḥ puruṣatā karāma ||
children.translated_text: Do not injure us for any reason, O <s>Pitṛs</s>, for whatever offense we may commit against you through human weakness.

children.text: āsīnāso aruṇīnām upasthe rayiṃ dhatta dāśuṣe martyāya
children.translated_text: Sitting in the lap of the ruddy ones, bestow wealth upon the mortal worshiper.

children.text: putrebhyaḥ pitaras tasya vasvaḥ pra yacchata ta ihorjaṃ dadhāta ||
children.translated_text: For his sons, O <s>Pitṛs</s>, grant possessions; here bestow strength upon them.

children.text: ye naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ somyāso 'nūhire somapīthaṃ vasiṣṭhāḥ
children.translated_text: Those former Soma-loving <s>Pitṛs</s> of ours, the <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s>, who followed after the Soma-drinking,

children.text: tebhir yamaḥ saṃ rarāṇo havīṃṣy uśann uśadbhiḥ pratikāmam attu ||
children.translated_text: with them may <s>Yama</s>, delighting in the offerings, eager with the eager ones, eat according to his desire.

children.text: ye tātṛṣur devatrā jehamānā hotrāvida stomataṣṭāso arkaiḥ
children.translated_text: Those who thirsted among the gods, hastening here, knowing the <s>hotra</s> (priestly offering), fashioned by praises and songs,

children.text: āgne yāhi suvidatrebhir arvāṅ satyaiḥ kavyaiḥ pitṛbhir gharmasadbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, come hither with the easy-to-invoke, true, inspired <s>Pitṛs</s> who sit at the hot offering.

children.text: ye satyāso havirado haviṣpā indreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṃ dadhānāḥ
children.translated_text: Those true ones, eaters of oblation and drinkers of oblation, sharing one chariot with <s>Indra</s> and the gods,

children.text: āgne yāhi sahasraṃ devavandaiḥ paraiḥ pūrvaiḥ pitṛbhir gharmasadbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, come with a thousand divine praisers, with the later and earlier <s>Pitṛs</s> who sit at the hot offering.

children.text: agniṣvāttāḥ pitara eha gacchata sadaḥ sadaḥ sadata supraṇītayaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agniṣvātta</s> <s>Pitṛs</s>, come here; sit down in each seat, well guided.

children.text: attā havīṃṣi prayatāni barhiṣy athā rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ dadhātana ||
children.translated_text: Eat the prepared oblations on the <s>barhis</s>; then bestow wealth rich in every hero.

children.text: tvam agna īḍito jātavedo 'vāḍḍhavyāni surabhīṇi kṛtvī
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s> <s>Jātavedas</s>, when praised, have carried the fragrant oblations after making them ready.

children.text: prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣann addhi tvaṃ deva prayatā havīṃṣi ||
children.translated_text: You gave them to the <s>Pitṛs</s>; by <s>svadhā</s> they ate them. Eat the prepared oblations yourself, O god.

children.text: ye ceha pitaro ye ca neha yāṃś ca vidma yāṁ u ca na pravidma
children.translated_text: Those <s>Pitṛs</s> who are here and those who are not here, those whom we know and those whom we do not fully know,

children.text: tvaṃ vettha yati te jātavedaḥ svadhābhir yajñaṃ sukṛtaṃ juṣasva ||
children.translated_text: you know how many they are, O <s>Jātavedas</s>; with the <s>svadhās</s>, enjoy the well-made sacrifice.

children.text: ye agnidagdhā ye anagnidagdhā madhye divaḥ svadhayā mādayante
children.translated_text: Those burned by fire and those not burned by fire, who rejoice with <s>svadhā</s> in the midst of heaven,

children.text: tebhiḥ svarāḍ asunītim etāṃ yathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ kalpayasva ||
children.translated_text: with them, O self-ruler, according to your will, prepare for yourself this path of life and a body.

children.text: Chapter 853
mainam agne vi daho mābhi śoco māsya tvacaṃ cikṣipo mā śarīram
children.translated_text: Do not burn him up, O <s>Agni</s>; do not scorch him; do not shrivel his skin or his body.

children.text: yadā śṛtaṃ kṛṇavo jātavedo 'them enam pra hiṇutāt pitṛbhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When you have made him cooked through, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, then send him onward to the <s>Pitṛs</s>.

children.text: śṛtaṃ yadā karasi jātavedo 'them enam pari dattāt pitṛbhyaḥ
children.translated_text: When you have made him cooked through, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, then hand him over to the <s>Pitṛs</s>.

children.text: yadā gacchāty asunītim etām athā devānāṃ vaśanīr bhavāti ||
children.translated_text: When he goes on this path of life, then he will become subject to the will of the gods.

children.text: sūryaṃ cakṣur gacchatu vātam ātmā dyāṃ ca gaccha pṛthivīṃ ca dharmaṇā
children.translated_text: Let the eye go to the Sun, the breath to the Wind; go to heaven and to earth according to <s>dharma</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: apo vā gaccha yadi tatra te hitam oṣadhīṣu prati tiṣṭhā śarīraiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Or go to the waters, if that is good for you; take your place in the plants with your bodily parts.

children.text: ajo bhāgas tapasā taṃ tapasva taṃ te śocis tapatu taṃ te arciḥ
children.translated_text: The goat is your share; burn that with your heat; let your flame burn it, let your blaze burn it.

children.text: yās te śivās tanvo jātavedas tābhir vahainaṃ sukṛtām u lokam ||
children.translated_text: With those auspicious bodies of yours, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, carry this one to the world of the righteous.

children.text: ava sṛja punar agne pitṛbhyo yas ta āhutaś carati svadhābhiḥ
children.translated_text: Release again to the <s>Pitṛs</s>, O <s>Agni</s>, the one who, offered to you, moves with <s>svadhās</s>.

children.text: āyur vasāna upa vetu śeṣaḥ saṃ gacchatāṃ tanvā jātavedaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Clothed in life, let what remains approach; let it unite with a body, O <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: yat te kṛṣṇaḥ śakuna ātutoda pipīlaḥ sarpa uta vā śvāpadaḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever the black bird has pecked at you, or an ant, a serpent, or a wild beast,

children.text: agniṣ ṭad viśvād agadaṃ kṛṇotu somaś ca yo brāhmaṇāṁ āviveśa ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Agni</s> make all that free from harm, and <s>Soma</s>, who has entered the Brahmins.

children.text: agner varma pari gobhir vyayasva sam prorṇuṣva pīvasā medasā ca
children.translated_text: Wrap yourself with the armor of <s>Agni</s>, with cowhide; cover yourself completely with fat and marrow.

children.text: net tvā dhṛṣṇur harasā jarhṛṣāṇo dadhṛg vidhakṣyan paryaṅkhayāte ||
children.translated_text: So that the bold one, exulting with heat, may not encircle you, eager to burn you through.

children.text: imam agne camasam mā vi jihvaraḥ priyo devānām uta somyānām
children.translated_text: Do not overturn this ladle, O <s>Agni</s>, dear to the gods and also to the Soma-loving ones.

children.text: eṣa yaś camaso devapānas tasmin devā amṛtā mādayante ||
children.translated_text: This is the ladle for the gods' drinking; in it the immortal gods rejoice.

children.text: kravyādam agnim pra hiṇomi dūraṃ yamarājño gacchatu ripravāhaḥ
children.translated_text: I send the flesh-eating <s>Agni</s> far away; let the impurity-bearer go to the realm of King <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: ihaivāyam itaro jātavedā devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan ||
children.translated_text: Let this other <s>Jātavedas</s> here, knowing, carry the oblation to the gods.

children.text: yo agniḥ kravyāt praviveśa vo gṛham imam paśyann itaraṃ jātavedasam
children.translated_text: The flesh-eating <s>Agni</s> who has entered your house, seeing this other <s>Jātavedas</s>,

children.text: taṃ harāmi pitṛyajñāya devaṃ sa gharmam invāt parame sadhasthe ||
children.translated_text: I carry that god away for the sacrifice to the <s>Pitṛs</s>; may he invigorate the hot offering in the highest assembly-place.

children.text: yo agniḥ kravyavāhanaḥ pitṝn yakṣad ṛtāvṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Agni</s> who carries raw flesh shall worship the <s>Pitṛs</s>, the increasers of <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: pred u havyāni vocati devebhyaś ca pitṛbhya ā ||
children.translated_text: Let him proclaim the oblations onward, both to the gods and to the <s>Pitṛs</s>.

children.text: uśantas tvā ni dhīmahy uśantaḥ sam idhīmahi
children.translated_text: Desiring you, we set you down; desiring you, we kindle you.

children.text: uśann uśata ā vaha pitṝn haviṣe attave ||
children.translated_text: Desiring, bring the desiring <s>Pitṛs</s> here to eat the oblation.

children.text: yaṃ tvam agne samadahas tam u nir vāpayā punaḥ
children.translated_text: Whom you have burned together, O <s>Agni</s>, extinguish him again.

children.text: kiyāmbv atra rohatu pākadūrvā vyalkaśā ||
children.translated_text: Let the kiyāmbu plant grow here, and tender <s>dūrvā</s> grass, and the <s>vyalkaśā</s> plant.

children.text: śītike śītikāvati hlādike hlādikāvati
children.translated_text: O cooling one, rich in cooling, O refreshing one, rich in refreshment,

children.text: maṇḍūkyā su saṃ gama imaṃ sv agniṃ harṣaya ||
children.translated_text: come well together with the frog; gladden this <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: Chapter 854
tvaṣṭā duhitre vahatuṃ kṛṇotītīdaṃ viśvam bhuvanaṃ sam eti
children.translated_text: <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> makes a wedding for his daughter; at this the whole world of beings comes together.

children.text: yamasya mātā paryuhyamānā maho jāyā vivasvato nanāśa ||
children.translated_text: As <s>Yama</s>'s mother was being led away, the great wife of <s>Vivasvat</s> disappeared.

children.text: apāgūhann amṛtām martyebhyaḥ kṛtvī savarṇām adadur vivasvate
children.translated_text: They hid the immortal woman from mortals; having made one of like form, they gave her to <s>Vivasvat</s>.

children.text: utāśvināv abharad yat tad āsīd ajahād u dvā mithunā saraṇyūḥ ||
children.translated_text: And the <s>Aśvins</s> brought what was there; <s>Saraṇyū</s> abandoned the two paired ones.

children.text: pūṣā tvetaś cyāvayatu pra vidvān anaṣṭapaśur bhuvanasya gopāḥ
children.translated_text: Let <s>Pūṣan</s>, knowing, move you onward from here, the guardian of the world whose cattle are not lost.

children.text: sa tvaitebhyaḥ pari dadat pitṛbhyo 'gnir devebhyaḥ suvidatriyebhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Agni</s> hand you over all around to these <s>Pitṛs</s> (Fathers), and to the gods who make good distribution.

children.text: āyur viśvāyuḥ pari pāsati tvā pūṣā tvā pātu prapathe purastāt
children.translated_text: Let <s>Pūṣan</s> protect you with life, with full life; let <s>Pūṣan</s> guard you in front on the forward path.

children.text: yatrāsate sukṛto yatra te yayus tatra tvā devaḥ savitā dadhātu ||
children.translated_text: Where the doers of good sit, where they have gone, there let the god <s>Savitṛ</s> place you.

children.text: pūṣemā āśā anu veda sarvāḥ so asmāṁ abhayatamena neṣat
children.translated_text: <s>Pūṣan</s> knows all these directions; may he lead us by the most fearless way.

children.text: svastidā āghṛṇiḥ sarvavīro 'prayucchan pura etu prajānan ||
children.translated_text: Bestowing welfare, glowing, rich in all heroes, never neglecting, let him go before, knowing.

children.text: prapathe pathām ajaniṣṭa pūṣā prapathe divaḥ prapathe pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Pūṣan</s> was born on the foremost path of paths, on the foremost path of heaven, on the foremost path of earth.

children.text: ubhe abhi priyatame sadhasthe ā ca parā ca carati prajānan ||
children.translated_text: Knowing, he travels both to and fro between the two dearest seats.

children.text: sarasvatīṃ devayanto havante sarasvatīm adhvare tāyamāne
children.translated_text: Those worshipping the gods call upon <s>Sarasvatī</s>; they call upon <s>Sarasvatī</s> when the <s>adhvara</s> (sacrificial rite) is being extended.

children.text: sarasvatīṃ sukṛto ahvayanta sarasvatī dāśuṣe vāryaṃ dāt ||
children.translated_text: The doers of good have invoked <s>Sarasvatī</s>; may <s>Sarasvatī</s> give desirable treasure to the worshipper.

children.text: sarasvati yā sarathaṃ yayātha svadhābhir devi pitṛbhir madantī
children.translated_text: O <s>Sarasvatī</s>, goddess, you who rode on the same chariot, rejoicing with the <s>Pitṛs</s> through the <s>svadhās</s> (ancestral offerings),

children.text: āsadyāsmin barhiṣi mādayasvānamīvā iṣa ā dhehy asme ||
children.translated_text: sit down on this sacred grass and rejoice; place unharmed nourishment here among us.

children.text: sarasvatīṃ yām pitaro havante dakṣiṇā yajñam abhinakṣamāṇāḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Pitṛs</s> invoke that <s>Sarasvatī</s>, as the gift turns toward the sacrifice.

children.text: sahasrārgham iḍo atra bhāgaṃ rāyas poṣaṃ yajamāneṣu dhehi ||
children.translated_text: Set here the thousand-valued share of <s>Iḍā</s>, wealth, and nourishment among the sacrificers.

children.text: āpo asmān mātaraḥ śundhayantu ghṛtena no ghṛtapvaḥ punantu
children.translated_text: May the waters, our mothers, cleanse us; may those that purify with ghee purify us with ghee.

children.text: viśvaṃ hi ripram pravahanti devīr ud id ābhyaḥ śucir ā pūta emi ||
children.translated_text: For the divine waters carry away every stain; from them, cleansed and pure, I rise up.

children.text: drapsaś caskanda prathamāṁ anu dyūn imaṃ ca yonim anu yaś ca pūrvaḥ
children.translated_text: The drop has fallen after the first days, after this womb and the one that was before.

children.text: samānaṃ yonim anu saṃcarantaṃ drapsaṃ juhomy anu sapta hotrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: I offer the drop that moves along the same womb, following the seven <s>hotṛs</s> (officiants).

children.text: yas te drapsa skandati yas te aṃśur bāhucyuto dhiṣaṇāyā upasthāt
children.translated_text: Whatever drop of yours falls, whatever portion of yours falls from the arms, from the lap of <s>Dhiṣaṇā</s>,

children.text: adhvaryor vā pari vā yaḥ pavitrāt taṃ te juhomi manasā vaṣaṭkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: or from the <s>adhvaryu</s>, or whatever falls from the strainer, that I offer to you, made into <s>vaṣaṭ</s> by the mind.

children.text: yas te drapsa skanno yas te aṃśur avaś ca yaḥ paraḥ srucā
children.translated_text: Whatever drop of yours has fallen, whatever portion of yours, and whatever is lower or farther away from the ladle,

children.text: ayaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ saṃ taṃ siñcatu rādhase ||
children.translated_text: may this god <s>Bṛhaspati</s> pour that together for you, for success.

children.text: payasvatīr oṣadhayaḥ payasvan māmakaṃ vacaḥ
children.translated_text: The plants are full of milk; my speech is full of milk.

children.text: apām payasvad it payas tena mā saha śundhata ||
children.translated_text: The milk of the waters is indeed full of milk; with that, cleanse me thoroughly.

children.text: Chapter 855
param mṛtyo anu parehi panthāṃ yas te sva itaro devayānāt
children.translated_text: Go away, O <s>Mṛtyu</s> (Death), by the further path, your own path that is other than the gods' path.

children.text: cakṣuṣmate śṛṇvate te bravīmi mā naḥ prajāṃ rīriṣo mota vīrān ||
children.translated_text: I speak to you who have eyes and hear: do not injure our offspring, nor our heroes.

children.text: mṛtyoḥ padaṃ yopayanto yad aita drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ
children.translated_text: When, erasing the track of <s>Mṛtyu</s>, you have come here, establishing a longer and more extended lifetime,

children.text: āpyāyamānāḥ prajayā dhanena śuddhāḥ pūtā bhavata yajñiyāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: then, increasing with offspring and wealth, purified and cleansed, become worthy of sacrifice.

children.text: ime jīvā vi mṛtair āvavṛtrann abhūd bhadrā devahūtir no adya
children.translated_text: These living ones have turned away from the dead; today our calling on the gods has become auspicious.

children.text: prāñco agāma nṛtaye hasāya drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: We have gone forward to dancing and laughter, establishing a longer and more extended lifetime.

children.text: imaṃ jīvebhyaḥ paridhiṃ dadhāmi maiṣāṃ nu gād aparo artham etam
children.translated_text: I set this boundary for the living; let none of them now go to that further goal.

children.text: śataṃ jīvantu śaradaḥ purūcīr antar mṛtyuṃ dadhatām parvatena ||
children.translated_text: Let them live a hundred abundant autumns; let them put Death away with a mountain between.

children.text: yathāhāny anupūrvam bhavanti yatha ṛtava ṛtubhir yanti sādhu
children.translated_text: As days arise one after another, as seasons go rightly with seasons,

children.text: yathā na pūrvam aparo jahāty evā dhātar āyūṃṣi kalpayaiṣām ||
children.translated_text: as the later one does not abandon the earlier, so, O <s>Dhātṛ</s>, arrange their lifetimes.

children.text: ā rohatāyur jarasaṃ vṛṇānā anupūrvaṃ yatamānā yati ṣṭha
children.translated_text: Mount upward to life, choosing old age; striving one after another, stand firm.

children.text: iha tvaṣṭā sujanimā sajoṣā dīrgham āyuḥ karati jīvase vaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Here may <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, giver of good birth, in harmony, make long life for you to live.

children.text: imā nārīr avidhavāḥ supatnīr āñjanena sarpiṣā saṃ viśantu
children.translated_text: Let these women, not widowed, with good husbands, enter together with ointment and ghee.

children.text: anaśravo 'namīvāḥ suratnā ā rohantu janayo yonim agre ||
children.translated_text: Without tears, free from disease, adorned with fine jewels, let the wives first mount the womb.

children.text: ud īrṣva nāry abhi jīvalokaṃ gatāsum etam upa śeṣa ehi
children.translated_text: Rise up, woman, toward the world of the living; come away from this lifeless man beside whom you lie.

children.text: hastagrābhasya didhiṣos tavedam patyur janitvam abhi sam babhūtha ||
children.translated_text: You have entered upon the wifehood of this husband, the suitor who took your hand.

children.text: dhanur hastād ādadāno mṛtasyāsme kṣatrāya varcase balāya
children.translated_text: Taking the bow from the hand of the dead man, for our sovereignty, splendor, and strength,

children.text: atraiva tvam iha vayaṃ suvīrā viśvā spṛdho abhimātīr jayema ||
children.translated_text: here itself may you and we, rich in heroes, conquer all rivals and hostile powers.

children.text: upa sarpa mātaram bhūmim etām uruvyacasam pṛthivīṃ suśevām
children.translated_text: Creep close to this mother, the earth, the broad, wide-stretching, kindly <s>Pṛthivī</s>.

children.text: ūrṇamradā yuvatir dakṣiṇāvata eṣā tvā pātu nirṛter upasthāt ||
children.translated_text: Soft as wool, a young woman with gifts, may she protect you from the lap of <s>Nirṛti</s> (destruction).

children.text: ucchvañcasva pṛthivi mā ni bādhathāḥ sūpāyanāsmai bhava sūpavañcanā
children.translated_text: Rise up, O <s>Pṛthivī</s>; do not press him down. Be easy for him to approach, easy to enter.

children.text: mātā putraṃ yathā sicābhy enam bhūma ūrṇuhi ||
children.translated_text: As a mother covers her son with the hem of her garment, so, O earth, cover him.

children.text: ucchvañcamānā pṛthivī su tiṣṭhatu sahasram mita upa hi śrayantām
children.translated_text: Let the rising earth stand firm; let a thousand supports rest upon it.

children.text: te gṛhāso ghṛtaścuto bhavantu viśvāhāsmai śaraṇāḥ santv atra ||
children.translated_text: Let these houses drip with ghee; let them be shelters for him here on all days.

children.text: ut te stabhnāmi pṛthivīṃ tvat parīmaṃ logaṃ nidadhan mo ahaṃ riṣam
children.translated_text: I prop up the earth for you; may I not be harmed while laying down this clod here.

children.text: etāṃ sthūṇām pitaro dhārayantu te 'trā yamaḥ sādanā te minotu ||
children.translated_text: Let the <s>Pitṛs</s> hold up this pillar; there may <s>Yama</s> build your dwelling places.

children.text: pratīcīne mām ahanīṣvāḥ parṇam ivā dadhuḥ
children.translated_text: They placed me in the days turned westward, like a feather.

children.text: pratīcīṃ jagrabhā vācam aśvaṃ raśanayā yathā ||
children.translated_text: I have grasped speech turned westward, as one grasps a horse with a rein.

children.text: Chapter 856
ni vartadhvam mānu gātāsmān siṣakta revatīḥ
children.translated_text: Turn back; do not go after him. Follow us, O prosperous ones.

children.text: agnīṣomā punarvasū asme dhārayataṃ rayim ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agnīṣomā</s>, bringers of renewed dwelling, hold wealth for us.

children.text: punar enā ni vartaya punar enā ny ā kuru
children.translated_text: Turn these back again; make these return again.

children.text: indra eṇā ni yacchatv agnir enā upājatu ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Indra</s> restrain these; let <s>Agni</s> drive these near.

children.text: punar etā ni vartantām asmin puṣyantu gopatau
children.translated_text: Let these turn back again; let them thrive under this cowherd.

children.text: ihaivāgne ni dhārayeha tiṣṭhatu yā rayiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Right here, O <s>Agni</s>, I hold the wealth; let the wealth that is here remain here.

children.text: yan niyānaṃ nyayanaṃ saṃjñānaṃ yat parāyaṇam
children.translated_text: Whatever is leading away, going down, recognizing, whatever is going forth,

children.text: āvartanaṃ nivartanaṃ yo gopā api taṃ huve ||
children.translated_text: turning back and returning, whatever guardian there is, I call upon him also.

children.text: ya udānaḍ vyayanaṃ ya udānaṭ parāyaṇam
