children.translated_text: Whoever has led away the going forth, whoever has led away the departure,

children.text: āvartanaṃ nivartanam api gopā ni vartatām ||
children.translated_text: the turning back and the returning: let even the herdsman turn them back.

children.text: ā nivarta ni vartaya punar na indra gā dehi
children.translated_text: Turn back, turn them back; give us the cows again, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: jīvābhir bhunajāmahai ||
children.translated_text: May we enjoy them while they are living.

children.text: pari vo viśvato dadha ūrjā ghṛtena payasā
children.translated_text: I set you all around on every side with nourishment, with ghee, with milk.

children.text: ye devāḥ ke ca yajñiyās te rayyā saṃ sṛjantu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whatever gods are worthy of sacrifice, let them join us with wealth.

children.text: ā nivartana vartaya ni nivartana vartaya
children.translated_text: Turn back, O return; turn back, O turning back.

children.text: bhūmyāś catasraḥ pradiśas tābhya enā ni vartaya ||
children.translated_text: From the four quarters of the earth, from those quarters turn these back.

children.text: Chapter 857
bhadraṃ no api vātaya manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Waft an auspicious mind toward us.

children.text: agnim īḍe bhujāṃ yaviṣṭhaṃ śāsā mitraṃ durdharītum
children.translated_text: I praise <s>Agni</s>, the youngest enjoyer, the ruler, like <s>Mitra</s>, hard to overcome,

children.text: yasya dharman svar enīḥ saparyanti mātur ūdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: in whose ordinance the bright ones serve the udder of their mother.

children.text: yam āsā kṛpanīḍam bhāsāketuṃ vardhayanti
children.translated_text: Him the lights increase, making him their nest, a beacon of brightness;

children.text: bhrājate śreṇidan ||
children.translated_text: he shines brilliantly in ranks.

children.text: aryo viśāṃ gātur eti pra yad ānaḍ divo antān
children.translated_text: The noble one goes as the path of the clans, when he has reached the ends of heaven,

children.text: kavir abhraṃ dīdyānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the poet flashing like a cloud.

children.text: juṣaddhavyā mānuṣasyordhvas tasthāv ṛbhvā yajñe
children.translated_text: Accepting the oblations of man, he has stood upright, skillful at the sacrifice,

children.text: minvan sadma pura eti ||
children.translated_text: measuring out the dwelling, he goes before.

children.text: sa hi kṣemo havir yajñaḥ śruṣṭīd asya gātur eti
children.translated_text: For he is safety, oblation, and sacrifice; by eager service his path is reached,

children.text: agniṃ devā vāśīmantam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, whom the gods desire.

children.text: yajñāsāhaṃ duva iṣe 'gnim pūrvasya śevasya
children.translated_text: They call <s>Agni</s>, conqueror in sacrifice, for worship and refreshment,

children.text: adreḥ sūnum āyum āhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the son of the former auspicious stone, <s>Āyu</s>.

children.text: naro ye ke cāsmad ā viśvet te vāma ā syuḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever men there are from us, may all these be lovely to you,

children.text: agniṃ haviṣā vardhantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: as they strengthen <s>Agni</s> with oblation.

children.text: kṛṣṇaḥ śveto 'ruṣo yāmo asya bradhna ṛjra uta śoṇo yaśasvān
children.translated_text: Black, white, ruddy is his course; tawny, straight, and red, glorious;

children.text: hiraṇyarūpaṃ janitā jajāna ||
children.translated_text: the begetter has begotten him of golden form.

children.text: evā te agne vimado manīṣām ūrjo napād amṛtebhiḥ sajoṣāḥ
children.translated_text: Thus for you, O <s>Agni</s>, <s>Vimada</s> has brought insight; child of strength, in accord with the immortals,

children.text: gira ā vakṣat sumatīr iyāna iṣam ūrjaṃ sukṣitiṃ viśvam ābhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: approaching with songs and good thoughts, you have shone over food, vigor, good dwelling, and all things.

children.text: Chapter 858
āgniṃ na svavṛktibhir hotāraṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe
children.translated_text: With well-turned praises we choose you, O <s>Agni</s>, as the <s>Hotar</s> (sacrificial priest),

children.text: yajñāya stīrṇabarhiṣe vi vo made śīram pāvakaśociṣaṃ vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: for the sacrifice with strewn sacred grass; in your exhilaration you seek to proclaim the swift one of purifying flame.

children.text: tvām u te svābhuvaḥ śumbhanty aśvarādhasaḥ
children.translated_text: Your own kinsmen, rich in horses, adorn you,

children.text: veti tvām upasecanī vi vo mada ṛjītir agna āhutir vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: the ladle goes to you; in your exhilaration, O <s>Agni</s>, the straight-faring offering seeks to proclaim you.

children.text: tve dharmāṇa āsate juhūbhiḥ siñcatīr iva
children.translated_text: In you the ordinances are seated, as if pouring with ladles;

children.text: kṛṣṇā rūpāṇy arjunā vi vo made viśvā adhi śriyo dhiṣe vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: dark forms and bright ones, in your exhilaration, all beauties you set upon yourself, as you seek to proclaim.

children.text: yam agne manyase rayiṃ sahasāvann amartya
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, mighty and immortal, whatever wealth you deem fit,

children.text: tam ā no vājasātaye vi vo made yajñeṣu citram ā bharā vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: bring that to us for the winning of prize; in the sacrifices bring the wondrous gift, as you seek to proclaim.

children.text: agnir jāto atharvaṇā vidad viśvāni kāvyā
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, born by <s>Atharvan</s>, found all acts of inspired wisdom;

children.text: bhuvad dūto vivasvato vi vo made priyo yamasya kāmyo vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: he became the messenger of <s>Vivasvat</s>, dear to <s>Yama</s> and desirable, as he seeks to proclaim.

children.text: tvāṃ yajñeṣv īḍate 'gne prayaty adhvare
children.translated_text: They praise you in sacrifices, O <s>Agni</s>, at the prepared rite;

children.text: tvaṃ vasūni kāmyā vi vo made viśvā dadhāsi dāśuṣe vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: you bestow desired treasures, in your exhilaration, all of them upon the worshiper, as you seek to proclaim.

children.text: tvāṃ yajñeṣv ṛtvijaṃ cārum agne ni ṣedire
children.translated_text: They have seated you in sacrifices as the lovely officiating priest, O <s>Agni</s>;

children.text: ghṛtapratīkam manuṣo vi vo made śukraṃ cetiṣṭham akṣabhir vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: with ghee as your face for men, in your exhilaration, you shine most brightly with your eyes, as you seek to proclaim.

children.text: agne śukreṇa śociṣoru prathayase bṛhat
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, with bright flame you spread yourself wide and vast;

children.text: abhikrandan vṛṣāyase vi vo made garbhaṃ dadhāsi jāmiṣu vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: bellowing, you act like a bull; in your exhilaration you place the embryo among kindred women, as you seek to proclaim.

children.text: Chapter 859
kuha śruta indraḥ kasminn adya jane mitro na śrūyate
children.translated_text: Where is the famed <s>Indra</s>? Among what people today is he not heard, like <s>Mitra</s>?

children.text: ṛṣīṇāṃ vā yaḥ kṣaye guhā vā carkṛṣe girā ||
children.translated_text: Or in the dwelling of the seers, or hidden, you keep stirring with song.

children.text: iha śruta indro asme adya stave vajry ṛcīṣamaḥ
children.translated_text: Here the famed <s>Indra</s> is praised by us today, the thunderbolt-bearing one, richest in hymns,

children.text: mitro na yo janeṣv ā yaśaś cakre asāmy ā ||
children.translated_text: who, like <s>Mitra</s>, has made unmatched renown among peoples.

children.text: maho yas patiḥ śavaso asāmy ā maho nṛmṇasya tūtujiḥ
children.translated_text: He is lord of great might, unmatched, impeller of great manly strength,

children.text: bhartā vajrasya dhṛṣṇoḥ pitā putram iva priyam ||
children.translated_text: bearer of the bold thunderbolt, like a father his dear son.

children.text: yujāno aśvā vātasya dhunī devo devasya vajrivaḥ
children.translated_text: Yoking the horses of the wind, O god, O thunderbolt-bearing one of the god,

children.text: syantā pathā virukmatā sṛjāna stoṣy adhvanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: letting them stream along the gleaming path, I will praise the roads of your journey.

children.text: tvaṃ tyā cid vātasyāśvāgā ṛjrā tmanā vahadhyai
children.translated_text: You indeed have those straight-running horses of the wind to carry you by themselves,

children.text: yayor devo na martyo yantā nakir vidāyyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: of whom, whether god or mortal, no driver can be found.

children.text: adha gmantośanā pṛcchate vāṃ kadarthā na ā gṛham
children.translated_text: Then <s>Uśanā</s>, having come, asks you two, 'For what purpose have you come to our house?

children.text: ā jagmathuḥ parākād divaś ca gmaś ca martyam ||
children.translated_text: Have you come from afar, from heaven and from earth, to a mortal?'

children.text: ā na indra pṛkṣase 'smākam brahmodyatam
children.translated_text: Come to us, O <s>Indra</s>, for abundance; our sacred formulation is raised up.

children.text: tat tvā yācāmahe 'vaḥ śuṣṇaṃ yaddhann amānuṣam ||
children.translated_text: This aid we ask of you, when you struck down inhuman <s>Śuṣṇa</s>.

children.text: akarmā dasyur abhi no amantur anyavrato amānuṣaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Dasyu</s>, inactive, mindless, of alien rite and inhuman, has come against us;

children.text: tvaṃ tasyāmitrahan vadhar dāsasya dambhaya ||
children.translated_text: O slayer of foes, crush the weapon of that hostile slave.

children.text: tvaṃ na indra śūra śūrair uta tvotāso barhaṇā
children.translated_text: You, O heroic <s>Indra</s>, with heroes, and we protected by you in greatness,

children.text: purutrā te vi pūrtayo navanta kṣoṇayo yathā ||
children.translated_text: your many fulfillments flow forth in many places, as lands do.

children.text: tvaṃ tān vṛtrahatye codayo nṝn kārpāṇe śūra vajrivaḥ
children.translated_text: You urged those men on in the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>, O hero, O thunderbolt-bearer, in the act of compassion,

children.text: guhā yadī kavīnāṃ viśāṃ na kṣatraśavasām ||
children.translated_text: when it was hidden among the poets, among peoples of royal might.

children.text: makṣū tā ta indra dānāpnasa ākṣāṇe śūra vajrivaḥ
children.translated_text: Quickly then, O <s>Indra</s>, with your gifts and gains, O hero, O thunderbolt-bearer, in the contest,

children.text: yaddha śuṣṇasya dambhayo jātaṃ viśvaṃ sayāvabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: when you crushed all that was born of <s>Śuṣṇa</s> together with his companions.

children.text: mākudhryag indra śūra vasvīr asme bhūvann abhiṣṭayaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the good aids, O heroic <s>Indra</s>, not turn away from us;

children.text: vayaṃ vayaṃ ta āsāṃ sumne syāma vajrivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may we, yes we, be in the favor of these aids of yours, O thunderbolt-bearer.

children.text: asme tā ta indra santu satyāhiṃsantīr upaspṛśaḥ
children.translated_text: Let those true, unharming approaches of yours be ours, O <s>Indra</s>;

children.text: vidyāma yāsām bhujo dhenūnāṃ na vajrivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may we know their enjoyments, like those of milch cows, O thunderbolt-bearer.

children.text: ahastā yad apadī vardhata kṣāḥ śacībhir vedyānām
children.translated_text: When the handless and footless one grew by the powers of the worshipers,

children.text: śuṣṇam pari pradakṣiṇid viśvāyave ni śiśnathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you shattered <s>Śuṣṇa</s> round about on the right side, for all life.

children.text: pibā pibed indra śūra somam mā riṣaṇyo vasavāna vasuḥ san
children.translated_text: Drink, let him drink the Soma, O heroic <s>Indra</s>; do not be harmed, being wealthy and good.

children.text: uta trāyasva gṛṇato maghono mahaś ca rāyo revatas kṛdhī naḥ ||
children.translated_text: And protect the generous singer; make us possessors of great and splendid wealth.

children.text: Chapter 860
yajāmaha indraṃ vajradakṣiṇaṃ harīṇāṃ rathyaṃ vivratānām
children.translated_text: We sacrifice to <s>Indra</s>, whose right hand bears the thunderbolt, charioteer of the bay steeds that do not turn aside;

children.text: pra śmaśru dodhuvad ūrdhvathā bhūd vi senābhir dayamāno vi rādhasā ||
children.translated_text: shaking his beard upward, he has risen, dividing the hosts with power and with bounty.

children.text: harī nv asya yā vane vide vasv indro maghair maghavā vṛtrahā bhuvat
children.translated_text: Indeed his two bay steeds, when found in the forest, brought wealth; <s>Indra</s>, bountiful with gifts, the generous one, became the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: ṛbhur vāja ṛbhukṣāḥ patyate śavo 'va kṣṇaumi dāsasya nāma cit ||
children.translated_text: <s>Ṛbhu</s>, <s>Vāja</s>, and <s>Ṛbhukṣan</s> have mastery over strength; I lower even the name of the <s>Dāsa</s>.

children.text: yadā vajraṃ hiraṇyam id athā rathaṃ harī yam asya vahato vi sūribhiḥ
children.translated_text: When the thunderbolt was golden, and then the chariot and his two bay horses carried him, made manifest by the patrons,

children.text: ā tiṣṭhati maghavā sanaśruta indro vājasya dīrghaśravasas patiḥ ||
children.translated_text: the far-famed generous <s>Indra</s> mounts it, lord of the prize with long renown.

children.text: so cin nu vṛṣṭir yūthyā svā sacāṁ indraḥ śmaśrūṇi haritābhi pruṣṇute
children.translated_text: Even now that <s>Indra</s>, the showerer, with his own troop, sprinkles his beard with tawny drops.

children.text: ava veti sukṣayaṃ sute madhūd id dhūnoti vāto yathā vanam ||
children.translated_text: He comes down to the well-settled pressed Soma; from the honeyed drink he shakes himself as the wind shakes a forest.

children.text: yo vācā vivāco mṛdhravācaḥ purū sahasrāśivā jaghāna
children.translated_text: He who by speech struck down many disputers, the hostile-voiced and contemptuous speakers,

children.text: tat tad id asya pauṃsyaṃ gṛṇīmasi piteva yas taviṣīṃ vāvṛdhe śavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that very manly power of his we praise, whose force and strength have grown like a father's.

children.text: stomaṃ ta indra vimadā ajījanann apūrvyam purutamaṃ sudānave
children.translated_text: The <s>Vimadas</s> generated for you, O <s>Indra</s>, an unprecedented, most abundant hymn for the liberal giver.

children.text: vidmā hy asya bhojanam inasya yad ā paśuṃ na gopāḥ karāmahe ||
children.translated_text: For we know the enjoyment of this mighty one, when, like herdsmen, we take possession of the cattle.

children.text: mākir na enā sakhyā vi yauṣus tava cendra vimadasya ca ṛṣeḥ
children.translated_text: Let no one sever these friendships of ours, yours, O <s>Indra</s>, and those of the seer <s>Vimada</s>.

children.text: vidmā hi te pramatiṃ deva jāmivad asme te santu sakhyā śivāni ||
children.translated_text: For we know your purpose, O god, like that of a kinsman; let your friendships be auspicious for us.

children.text: Chapter 861
indra somam imam piba madhumantaṃ camū sutam
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, drink this honeyed Soma, pressed in the beaker.

children.text: asme rayiṃ ni dhāraya vi vo made sahasriṇam purūvaso vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: Set among us thousandfold wealth, O much-wealthy one; in your exhilaration you seek to make it grow.

children.text: tvāṃ yajñebhir ukthair upa havyebhir īmahe
children.translated_text: With sacrifices, hymns, and invocations we approach you.

children.text: śacīpate śacīnāṃ vi vo made śreṣṭhaṃ no dhehi vāryaṃ vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: O lord of powers, in your exhilaration place for us the best desirable treasure, as you seek to make it grow.

children.text: yas patir vāryāṇām asi radhrasya coditā
children.translated_text: You are lord of desirable goods and the impeller of the weak.

children.text: indra stotṝṇām avitā vi vo made dviṣo naḥ pāhy aṃhaso vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, protector of singers, in your exhilaration guard us from hatreds and distress, as you seek to make it grow.

children.text: yuvaṃ śakrā māyāvinā samīcī nir amanthatam
children.translated_text: You two mighty, artful ones churned her forth together.

children.text: vimadena yad īḍitā nāsatyā niramanthatam ||
children.translated_text: When praised by <s>Vimada</s>, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, you churned her forth.

children.text: viśve devā akṛpanta samīcyor niṣpatantyoḥ
children.translated_text: All the gods took pity on the two who were falling together.

children.text: nāsatyāv abruvan devāḥ punar ā vahatād iti ||
children.translated_text: The gods said to the <s>Nāsatyas</s>, 'Bring them back again.'

children.text: madhuman me parāyaṇam madhumat punar āyanam
children.translated_text: May my going away be honey-sweet, and my returning honey-sweet.

children.text: tā no devā devatayā yuvam madhumatas kṛtam ||
children.translated_text: By your divinity, O gods, you two make those paths honey-sweet for us.

children.text: Chapter 862
bhadraṃ no api vātaya mano dakṣam uta kratum
children.translated_text: Blow toward us an auspicious mind, skill, and will.

children.text: adhā te sakhye andhaso vi vo made raṇan gāvo na yavase vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: Then, in friendship with you, O Soma-draught, in your exhilaration the cows bellow like cows at pasture, as you seek to make it grow.

children.text: hṛdispṛśas ta āsate viśveṣu soma dhāmasu
children.translated_text: Those that touch the heart sit in all your abodes, O <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: adhā kāmā ime mama vi vo made vi tiṣṭhante vasūyavo vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: Then these desires of mine, seeking wealth, spread out in your exhilaration, as you seek to make it grow.

children.text: uta vratāni soma te prāham mināmi pākyā
children.translated_text: And your observances, O <s>Soma</s>, I shall not violate before they are ripe.

children.text: adhā piteva sūnave vi vo made mṛḍā no abhi cid vadhād vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: Then, like a father for a son, in your exhilaration be gracious to us even against attack, as you seek to make it grow.

children.text: sam u pra yanti dhītayaḥ sargāso 'vatāṁ iva
children.translated_text: The inspired thoughts go forth together, like streams down the slopes.

children.text: kratuṃ naḥ soma jīvase vi vo made dhārayā camasāṁ iva vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: Hold firm our resolve for living, O <s>Soma</s>, in your exhilaration, like cups in a row, as you seek to make it grow.

children.text: tava tye soma śaktibhir nikāmāso vy ṛṇvire
children.translated_text: Those desires of yours, O <s>Soma</s>, have opened wide through your powers.

children.text: gṛtsasya dhīrās tavaso vi vo made vrajaṃ gomantam aśvinaṃ vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: The wise thoughts of the vigorous sage, in your exhilaration, open the cow-rich and horse-rich enclosure, as you seek to make it grow.

children.text: paśuṃ naḥ soma rakṣasi purutrā viṣṭhitaṃ jagat
children.translated_text: Like a herdsman you protect our cattle, O <s>Soma</s>, and the world spread out in many places.

children.text: samākṛṇoṣi jīvase vi vo made viśvā saṃpaśyan bhuvanā vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: You make it whole for life; in your exhilaration, seeing all beings, you seek to make it grow.

children.text: tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvato gopā adābhyo bhava
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, be our undeceivable guardian on every side.

children.text: sedha rājann apa sridho vi vo made mā no duḥśaṃsa īśatā vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: Drive away the assailants, O king; in your exhilaration let no evil-speaker rule over us, as you seek to make it grow.

children.text: tvaṃ naḥ soma sukratur vayodheyāya jāgṛhi
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, of good will, stay awake for us for the bestowal of vigor.

children.text: kṣetravittaro manuṣo vi vo made druho naḥ pāhy aṃhaso vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: Better than men at finding the field, in your exhilaration protect us from deceit and distress, as you seek to make it grow.

children.text: tvaṃ no vṛtrahantamendrasyendo śivaḥ sakhā
children.translated_text: O drop of Soma, be for us a gracious friend of <s>Indra</s>, the greatest slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: yat sīṃ havante samithe vi vo made yudhyamānās tokasātau vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: When they call upon him in battle, in your exhilaration, fighting for the winning of offspring, you seek to make it grow.

children.text: ayaṃ gha sa turo mada indrasya vardhata priyaḥ
children.translated_text: This strong exhilaration of <s>Indra</s>, dear to him, has indeed increased.

children.text: ayaṃ kakṣīvato maho vi vo made matiṃ viprasya vardhayad vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: This has increased the thought of great <s>Kakṣīvant</s>, the inspired poet, in your exhilaration, as you seek to make it grow.

children.text: ayaṃ viprāya dāśuṣe vājāṁ iyarti gomataḥ
children.translated_text: This one drives cow-rich prizes for the inspired giver.

children.text: ayaṃ saptabhya ā varaṃ vi vo made prāndhaṃ śroṇaṃ ca tāriṣad vivakṣase ||
children.translated_text: This one, best for the seven, in your exhilaration, carried the blind and the lame across, as you seek to make it grow.

children.text: Chapter 863
pra hy acchā manīṣā spārhā yanti niyutaḥ
children.translated_text: For desirable thoughts go forward toward you, like teams of horses.

children.text: pra dasrā niyudrathaḥ pūṣā aviṣṭu māhinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Pūṣan</s>, with his powers, aid the wondrous two whose chariot is yoked with teams.

children.text: yasya tyan mahitvaṃ vātāpyam ayaṃ janaḥ
children.translated_text: This people has recognized that greatness of yours, swift as the wind.

children.text: vipra ā vaṃsad dhītibhiś ciketa suṣṭutīnām ||
children.translated_text: The inspired poet has called upon it with thoughts and has understood it among the well-praised songs.

children.text: sa veda suṣṭutīnām indur na pūṣā vṛṣā
children.translated_text: He knows the well-praised songs; like the Soma-drop, <s>Pūṣan</s> is a bull.

children.text: abhi psuraḥ pruṣāyati vrajaṃ na ā pruṣāyati ||
children.translated_text: He sprinkles over the waters; he sprinkles upon our cattle-pen.

children.text: maṃsīmahi tvā vayam asmākaṃ deva pūṣan
children.translated_text: May we think upon you, O our god <s>Pūṣan</s>,

children.text: matīnāṃ ca sādhanaṃ viprāṇāṃ cādhavam ||
children.translated_text: as accomplisher of thoughts and support of inspired poets.

children.text: pratyardhir yajñānām aśvahayo rathānām
children.translated_text: He is the furtherer of sacrifices, the horse-driver of chariots;

children.text: ṛṣiḥ sa yo manurhito viprasya yāvayatsakhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he is the seer set by <s>Manu</s>, the helpful friend of the inspired poet.

children.text: ādhīṣamāṇāyāḥ patiḥ śucāyāś ca śucasya ca
children.translated_text: He is lord of the one being contemplated, of the bright woman, and of the bright man.

children.text: vāsovāyo 'vīnām ā vāsāṃsi marmṛjat ||
children.translated_text: The garment-weaver of sheep has rubbed the garments clean.

children.text: ino vājānām patir inaḥ puṣṭīnāṃ sakhā
children.translated_text: He is master of prizes and friend of prosperities.

children.text: pra śmaśru haryato dūdhod vi vṛthā yo adābhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The tawny-bearded, unassailable one shakes out his beard far and wide.

children.text: ā te rathasya pūṣann ajā dhuraṃ vavṛtyuḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Pūṣan</s>, the goats have turned themselves to the pole of your chariot.

children.text: viśvasyārthinaḥ sakhā sanojā anapacyutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Friend of every seeker, born together with us, unfailing.

children.text: asmākam ūrjā ratham pūṣā aviṣṭu māhinaḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Pūṣan</s>, with his greatness, aid our chariot with strength.

children.text: bhuvad vājānāṃ vṛdha imaṃ naḥ śṛṇavaddhavam ||
children.translated_text: May he become the increaser of prizes and hear this invocation of ours.

children.text: Chapter 864
asat su me jaritaḥ sābhivego yat sunvate yajamānāya śikṣam
children.translated_text: It will be good for me, O singer, with a rush of force, when I instruct the pressing sacrificer.

children.text: anāśīrdām aham asmi prahantā satyadhvṛtaṃ vṛjināyantam ābhum ||
children.translated_text: I am the smiter who gives no blessing, striking down the truth-breaking, crooked, hostile one.

children.text: yadīd ahaṃ yudhaye saṃnayāny adevayūn tanvā śūśujānān
children.translated_text: When I shall lead together to battle the godless ones, who make themselves blaze with their own bodies.

children.text: amā te tumraṃ vṛṣabham pacāni tīvraṃ sutam pañcadaśaṃ ni ṣiñcam ||
children.translated_text: At home for you I cook the swelling bull; I pour down the strong pressed drink, the fifteenfold one.

children.text: nāhaṃ taṃ veda ya iti bravīty adevayūn samaraṇe jaghanvān
children.translated_text: I do not know the one who says this, after striking down the godless men in the battle.

children.text: yadāvākhyat samaraṇam ṛghāvad ād iddha me vṛṣabhā pra bruvanti ||
children.translated_text: When he declared the battle to be rich in booty, then my bulls indeed proclaim it to me.

children.text: yad ajñāteṣu vṛjaneṣv āsaṃ viśve sato maghavāno ma āsan
children.translated_text: When I was among unknown enclosures, all the liberal lords who exist were there for me.

children.text: jināmi vet kṣema ā santam ābhum pra taṃ kṣiṇām parvate pādagṛhya ||
children.translated_text: I conquer, I know; I come to the secure one who is present. I crush him, seizing his foot upon the mountain.

children.text: na vā u māṃ vṛjane vārayante na parvatāso yad aham manasye
children.translated_text: Neither do enclosures hold me back, nor the mountains, when I set my mind upon something.

children.text: mama svanāt kṛdhukarṇo bhayāta eved anu dyūn kiraṇaḥ sam ejāt ||
children.translated_text: At my roar let the sharp-eared one be afraid; so, day after day, the ray has trembled.

children.text: darśan nv atra śṛtapāṃ anindrān bāhukṣadaḥ śarave patyamānān
children.translated_text: Now they will see here the Soma-drinkers, the non-Indras, arm-devourers falling before the arrow.

children.text: ghṛṣuṃ vā ye niniduḥ sakhāyam adhy ū nv eṣu pavayo vavṛtyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those who reviled their impetuous friend: now indeed the spear-points have turned upon them.

children.text: abhūr v aukṣīr vy u āyur ānaḍ darṣan nu pūrvo aparo nu darṣat
children.translated_text: You have become; you have grown; you have reached the span of life. Now let the former see, and now let the later see.

children.text: dve pavaste pari taṃ na bhūto yo asya pāre rajaso viveṣa ||
children.translated_text: The two purified streams flow around him as if he were not a being, the one who has entered beyond this expanse.

children.text: gāvo yavam prayutā aryo akṣan tā apaśyaṃ sahagopāś carantīḥ
children.translated_text: The cows, sent forth, ate the noble one's barley; I saw them roaming together with their herdsman.

children.text: havā id aryo abhitaḥ sam āyan kiyad āsu svapatiś chandayāte ||
children.translated_text: The noble one's calls came together all around; how much does their own lord delight himself among them?

children.text: saṃ yad vayaṃ yavasādo janānām ahaṃ yavāda urvajre antaḥ
children.translated_text: When we are together, barley-eaters among men, I am a barley-eater within the wide enclosure.

children.text: atrā yukto 'vasātāram icchād atho ayuktaṃ yunajad vavanvān ||
children.translated_text: There the yoked one sought the loosener, and then, winning, he yoked the unyoked one.

children.text: atred u me maṃsase satyam uktaṃ dvipāc ca yac catuṣpāt saṃsṛjāni
children.translated_text: Here indeed you think that what I have said is true: I bring together what is two-footed and what is four-footed.

children.text: strībhir yo atra vṛṣaṇam pṛtanyād ayuddho asya vi bhajāni vedaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whoever here would contend with the bull through women, though no battle is fought, I know how to divide up his possessions.

children.text: yasyānakṣā duhitā jātv āsa kas tāṃ vidvāṁ abhi manyāte andhām
children.translated_text: Whose daughter, born eyeless, was there? Who, knowing her to be blind, would desire her?

children.text: kataro menim prati tam mucāte ya īṃ vahāte ya īṃ vā vareyāt ||
children.translated_text: Which one lets loose the missile against him: the one who carries her away, or the one who would choose her?

children.text: kiyatī yoṣā maryato vadhūyoḥ pariprītā panyasā vāryeṇa
children.translated_text: How great is the woman, desired as bride by mortal bridegrooms, surrounded with affection and with desirable treasure?

children.text: bhadrā vadhūr bhavati yat supeśāḥ svayaṃ sā mitraṃ vanute jane cit ||
children.translated_text: The bride becomes blessed when she is well adorned; she herself chooses a friend even among the people.

children.text: patto jagāra pratyañcam atti śīrṣṇā śiraḥ prati dadhau varūtham
children.translated_text: The fallen one kept watch; he eats what faces him. He set head against head as a defense.

children.text: āsīna ūrdhvām upasi kṣiṇāti nyaṅṅ uttānām anv eti bhūmim ||
children.translated_text: Sitting, he wastes the upright woman in his lap; bent downward, he goes after the one lying on her back upon the earth.

children.text: bṛhann acchāyo apalāśo arvā tasthau mātā viṣito atti garbhaḥ
children.translated_text: Great, shadowless, leafless, the courser stood; the mother, loosened, eats the embryo.

children.text: anyasyā vatsaṃ rihatī mimāya kayā bhuvā ni dadhe dhenur ūdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Licking another's calf, she lowed. Upon what ground did the cow set down her udder?

children.text: sapta vīrāso adharād ud āyann aṣṭottarāttāt sam ajagmiran te
children.translated_text: Seven heroes rose up from below; eight came together from above.

children.text: nava paścātāt sthivimanta āyan daśa prāk sānu vi tiranty aśnaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Nine, firm-standing, came from behind; ten stretch across the ridge of the stone in front.

children.text: daśānām ekaṃ kapilaṃ samānaṃ taṃ hinvanti kratave pāryāya
children.translated_text: The one tawny one, common to the ten, they impel for insight and for the circuit.

children.text: garbham mātā sudhitaṃ vakṣaṇāsv avenantaṃ tuṣayantī bibharti ||
children.translated_text: The mother bears the embryo, well placed in her flanks, gladdening the one who is crying out and making him content.

children.text: pīvānam meṣam apacanta vīrā nyuptā akṣā anu dīva āsan
children.translated_text: The heroes cooked the fat ram; the dice, cast down, lay after the gaming.

children.text: dvā dhanum bṛhatīm apsv antaḥ pavitravantā carataḥ punantā ||
children.translated_text: Two bows, great and equipped with strainers, move within the waters, purifying as they go.

children.text: vi krośanāso viṣvañca āyan pacāti nemo nahi pakṣad ardhaḥ
children.translated_text: Crying out in different directions, they went apart; the half cooks, for the other half does not cook.

children.text: ayam me devaḥ savitā tad āha drvanna id vanavat sarpirannaḥ ||
children.translated_text: This god <s>Savitṛ</s> has told me that: the wood-eater will indeed conquer, the ghee-eater will not.

children.text: apaśyaṃ grāmaṃ vahamānam ārād acakrayā svadhayā vartamānam
children.translated_text: From afar I saw the host being carried along, wheel-less, moving by its own power.

children.text: siṣakty aryaḥ pra yugā janānāṃ sadyaḥ śiśnā pramināno navīyān ||
children.translated_text: The noble one attaches himself to the yokes of men, at once diminishing the newer phalluses.

children.text: etau me gāvau pramarasya yuktau mo ṣu pra sedhīr muhur in mamandhi
children.translated_text: These two cows of mine are yoked for the destroyer. Do not drive them away; exhilarate me again and again.

children.text: āpaś cid asya vi naśanty arthaṃ sūraś ca marka uparo babhūvān ||
children.translated_text: Even the waters lose their purpose; the sun, a shining one, has become later and lower.

children.text: ayaṃ yo vajraḥ purudhā vivṛtto 'vaḥ sūryasya bṛhataḥ purīṣāt
children.translated_text: This thunderbolt here, unfolded in many ways, is below the great sun's excrement.

children.text: śrava id enā paro anyad asti tad avyathī jarimāṇas taranti ||
children.translated_text: Fame is indeed by this; something else is beyond. The unshaken ones cross beyond old age.

children.text: vṛkṣe vṛkṣe niyatā mīmayad gaus tato vayaḥ pra patān pūruṣādaḥ
children.translated_text: At every tree the cow, fastened, bellows; from there the man-eating birds fly forth.

children.text: athedaṃ viśvam bhuvanam bhayāta indrāya sunvad ṛṣaye ca śikṣat ||
children.translated_text: Then let this whole world of beings be afraid; let it attend upon <s>Indra</s> who presses Soma, and upon the seer.

children.text: devānām māne prathamā atiṣṭhan kṛntatrād eṣām uparā ud āyan
children.translated_text: They stood first in the measure of the gods; from the cutter the later ones of them rose up.

children.text: trayas tapanti pṛthivīm anūpā dvā bṛbūkaṃ vahataḥ purīṣam ||
children.translated_text: Three heat the moist earth; two carry the dung-filled lump.

children.text: sā te jīvātur uta tasya viddhi mā smaitādṛg apa gūhaḥ samarye
children.translated_text: She is your living power; know also that of him. Do not hide away such a one in the contest.

children.text: āviḥ svaḥ kṛṇute gūhate busaṃ sa pādur asya nirṇijo na mucyate ||
children.translated_text: He makes the bright world manifest; he hides the chaff. His foot is not released from its covering.

children.text: Chapter 865
viśvo hy anyo arir ājagāma mamed aha śvaśuro nā jagāma
children.translated_text: Every other enemy has come here, but today my father-in-law has not come.

children.text: jakṣīyād dhānā uta somam papīyāt svāśitaḥ punar astaṃ jagāyāt ||
children.translated_text: Let him eat parched grain and drink Soma; well fed, let him go back home again.

children.text: sa roruvad vṛṣabhas tigmaśṛṅgo varṣman tasthau varimann ā pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: That roaring bull with sharp horn has taken his stand on the height, in the breadth of the earth.

children.text: viśveṣv enaṃ vṛjaneṣu pāmi yo me kukṣī sutasomaḥ pṛṇāti ||
children.translated_text: I protect him in all enclosures, the one who fills my belly with pressed Soma.

children.text: adriṇā te mandina indra tūyān sunvanti somān pibasi tvam eṣām
children.translated_text: With the pressing-stone, O exhilarating <s>Indra</s>, they quickly press Soma for you; you drink of theirs.

children.text: pacanti te vṛṣabhāṁ atsi teṣām pṛkṣeṇa yan maghavan hūyamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They cook bulls for you; you eat of theirs, when, O <s>Maghavan</s>, you are invoked with a share of food.

children.text: idaṃ su me jaritar ā cikiddhi pratīpaṃ śāpaṃ nadyo vahanti
children.translated_text: Understand this well from me, O singer: the rivers carry a curse upstream.

children.text: lopāśaḥ siṃham pratyañcam atsāḥ kroṣṭā varāhaṃ nir atakta kakṣāt ||
children.translated_text: The fox has eaten the lion facing it; the jackal has driven the boar out from the thicket.

children.text: kathā ta etad aham ā ciketaṃ gṛtsasya pākas tavaso manīṣām
children.translated_text: How shall I understand this of yours: the wise skill of the clever, mighty one?

children.text: tvaṃ no vidvāṁ ṛtuthā vi voco yam ardhaṃ te maghavan kṣemyā dhūḥ ||
children.translated_text: You, knowing, tell it to us in due season, O <s>Maghavan</s>: what half of you the secure ones have set in motion.

children.text: evā hi māṃ tavasaṃ vardhayanti divaś cin me bṛhata uttarā dhūḥ
children.translated_text: For thus they strengthen me, the mighty one; even beyond the great heaven are my poles.

children.text: purū sahasrā ni śiśāmi sākam aśatruṃ hi mā janitā jajāna ||
children.translated_text: I sharpen many thousands together, for my begetter made me without an enemy.

children.text: evā hi māṃ tavasaṃ jajñur ugraṃ karman karman vṛṣaṇam indra devāḥ
children.translated_text: For thus, in deed after deed, the gods have known me, <s>Indra</s>, as mighty, fierce, and virile.

children.text: vadhīṃ vṛtraṃ vajreṇa mandasāno 'pa vrajam mahinā dāśuṣe vam ||
children.translated_text: Exhilarated, I slew <s>Vṛtra</s> with the thunderbolt; by my greatness I opened the cattle-pen for the worshipper.

children.text: devāsa āyan paraśūṃr abibhran vanā vṛścanto abhi viḍbhir āyan
children.translated_text: The gods came bearing axes; cutting down the forests, they came on with the clans.

children.text: ni sudrvaṃ dadhato vakṣaṇāsu yatrā kṛpīṭam anu tad dahanti ||
children.translated_text: Setting the well-felled wood in the clefts, there they burn what has been cut down.

children.text: śaśaḥ kṣuram pratyañcaṃ jagārādriṃ logena vy abhedam ārāt
children.translated_text: The hare swallowed the backward-turned razor; from afar I split the rock with the blow.

children.text: bṛhantaṃ cid ṛhate randhayāni vayad vatso vṛṣabhaṃ śūśuvānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even the great one I will bring into subjection, like a calf growing strong that bites the bull.

children.text: suparṇa itthā nakham ā siṣāyāvaruddhaḥ paripadaṃ na siṃhaḥ
children.translated_text: The fair-winged one has set its claw down in this way, shut in like a lion at the encircling path.

children.text: niruddhaś cin mahiṣas tarṣyāvān godhā tasmā ayathaṃ karṣad etat ||
children.translated_text: Even a confined buffalo, thirsting, was there; the monitor-lizard dragged this away from him wrongly.

children.text: tebhyo godhā ayathaṃ karṣad etad ye brahmaṇaḥ pratipīyanty annaiḥ
children.translated_text: The monitor-lizard wrongly dragged this away from those who drink in response to the sacred utterance with foods.

children.text: sima ukṣṇo 'vasṛṣṭāṁ adanti svayam balāni tanvaḥ śṛṇānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They eat the released milk of the bull, themselves loosening the strengths of their bodies.

children.text: ete śamībhiḥ suśamī abhūvan ye hinvire tanvaḥ soma ukthaiḥ
children.translated_text: These became well-equipped with the <s>śamī</s> sticks, those who impelled their bodies with <s>Soma</s> and hymns.

children.text: nṛvad vadann upa no māhi vājān divi śravo dadhiṣe nāma vīraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Speaking like a man, bring great prizes near to us; in heaven, O hero, you have set glory and name.

children.text: Chapter 866
vane na vā yo ny adhāyi cākañ chucir vāṃ stomo bhuraṇāv ajīgaḥ
children.translated_text: Like one laid in the wood, whoever it was, seeking; your bright hymn, O active pair, has awakened.

children.text: yasyed indraḥ purudineṣu hotā nṛṇāṃ naryo nṛtamaḥ kṣapāvān ||
children.translated_text: For him <s>Indra</s> is the <s>hotṛ</s> on many days, manly among men, best of men, possessing the nights.

children.text: pra te asyā uṣasaḥ prāparasyā nṛtau syāma nṛtamasya nṛṇām
children.translated_text: At this dawn and at the later one, may we be in the manly work of the most manly of men.

children.text: anu triśokaḥ śatam āvahan nṝn kutsena ratho yo asat sasavān ||
children.translated_text: <s>Triśoka</s> brought a hundred men along; the chariot with <s>Kutsa</s> was the one that became victorious.

children.text: kas te mada indra rantyo bhūd duro giro abhy ugro vi dhāva
children.translated_text: What exhilaration of yours, O <s>Indra</s>, became delightful? Fierce one, run widely toward the hard invocations.

children.text: kad vāho arvāg upa mā manīṣā ā tvā śakyām upamaṃ rādho annaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: When will your team come hither to my thought? May I be able to bring you the highest bounty with foods.

children.text: kad u dyumnam indra tvāvato nṝn kayā dhiyā karase kan na āgan
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indra</s>, will you make splendor for men like yourself? By what insight? When has he come to us?

children.text: mitro na satya urugāya bhṛtyā anne samasya yad asan manīṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like <s>Mitra</s>, true and widely praised in support, when all the thoughts were together at the food.

children.text: preraya sūro arthaṃ na pāraṃ ye asya kāmaṃ janidhā iva gman
children.translated_text: Drive the bright one toward the goal, as toward the further shore, those who came to his desire like wives to a birthplace.

children.text: giraś ca ye te tuvijāta pūrvīr nara indra pratiśikṣanty annaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: And those many songs of yours, O power-born <s>Indra</s>, which men answer with foods.

children.text: mātre nu te sumite indra pūrvī dyaur majmanā pṛthivī kāvyena
children.translated_text: For your ancient, well-measured mother, O <s>Indra</s>, <s>Dyaus</s> by greatness and <s>Pṛthivī</s> by inspired wisdom are present.

children.text: varāya te ghṛtavantaḥ sutāsaḥ svādman bhavantu pītaye madhūni ||
children.translated_text: May the butter-rich pressings, the sweet honeyed draughts, be for your chosen drinking in sweetness.

children.text: ā madhvo asmā asicann amatram indrāya pūrṇaṃ sa hi satyarādhāḥ
children.translated_text: They poured out for him a full vessel of mead, for <s>Indra</s>, for he is true in bounty.

children.text: sa vāvṛdhe varimann ā pṛthivyā abhi kratvā naryaḥ pauṃsyaiś ca ||
children.translated_text: He grew to the breadth of the earth, by his will and by his manly powers.

children.text: vy ānaḍ indraḥ pṛtanāḥ svojā āsmai yatante sakhyāya pūrvīḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, by his own force, overcame the battles; many strive for his friendship.

children.text: ā smā rathaṃ na pṛtanāsu tiṣṭha yam bhadrayā sumatyā codayāse ||
children.translated_text: Stand by us in battles as upon a chariot, you whom we urge on with favorable good will.

children.text: Chapter 867
pra devatrā brahmaṇe gātur etv apo acchā manaso na prayukti
children.translated_text: Let the prayer go by a path toward the gods, toward the waters like a sending forth of the mind.

children.text: mahīm mitrasya varuṇasya dhāsim pṛthujrayase rīradhā suvṛktim ||
children.translated_text: For broad flowing, set in motion the great seat of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, the well-spoken hymn.

children.text: adhvaryavo haviṣmanto hi bhūtācchāpa itośatīr uśantaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryus</s>, be bearers of oblation; go from here toward the eager waters, eager yourselves.

children.text: ava yāś caṣṭe aruṇaḥ suparṇas tam āsyadhvam ūrmim adyā suhastāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The ruddy fair-winged one looks down upon them; today, with good hands, pour out that wave.

children.text: adhvaryavo 'pa itā samudram apāṃ napātaṃ haviṣā yajadhvam
children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryus</s>, go forth to the waters, to the ocean; worship <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s> with oblation.

children.text: sa vo dadad ūrmim adyā supūtaṃ tasmai somam madhumantaṃ sunota ||
children.translated_text: May he give you today a well-purified wave; for him press the honeyed <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: yo anidhmo dīdayad apsv antar yaṃ viprāsa īḍate adhvareṣu
children.translated_text: He who shines without fuel within the waters, whom the inspired ones praise in the rituals,

children.text: apāṃ napān madhumatīr apo dā yābhir indro vāvṛdhe vīryāya ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s>, give the honeyed waters by which <s>Indra</s> grew for heroic power.

children.text: yābhiḥ somo modate harṣate ca kalyāṇībhir yuvatibhir na maryaḥ
children.translated_text: With them <s>Soma</s> rejoices and is exhilarated, like a young man with auspicious young women.

children.text: tā adhvaryo apo acchā parehi yad āsiñcā oṣadhībhiḥ punītāt ||
children.translated_text: Go toward those waters, O <s>adhvaryu</s>, when you pour; let him purify with the plants.

children.text: eved yūne yuvatayo namanta yad īm uśann uśatīr ety accha
children.translated_text: Thus young women bow to the young man when he, desiring, comes toward the desirous ones.

children.text: saṃ jānate manasā saṃ cikitre 'dhvaryavo dhiṣaṇāpaś ca devīḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>adhvaryus</s>, <s>Dhiṣaṇā</s>, and the divine waters know together in mind and have understood together.

children.text: yo vo vṛtābhyo akṛṇod u lokaṃ yo vo mahyā abhiśaster amuñcat
children.translated_text: He who made a free space for you who were enclosed, who released you from the great curse,

children.text: tasmā indrāya madhumantam ūrmiṃ devamādanam pra hiṇotanāpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: to that <s>Indra</s> send forth the honeyed wave, the god-delighting one, O waters.

children.text: prāsmai hinota madhumantam ūrmiṃ garbho yo vaḥ sindhavo madhva utsaḥ
children.translated_text: Send forth to him the honeyed wave, he who is your embryo, O rivers, the spring of honey.

children.text: ghṛtapṛṣṭham īḍyam adhvareṣv āpo revatīḥ śṛṇutā havam me ||
children.translated_text: Ghee-backed and worthy of praise in the rites, O rich waters, hear my call.

children.text: taṃ sindhavo matsaram indrapānam ūrmim pra heta ya ubhe iyarti
children.translated_text: O rivers, drive forth that exhilarating wave for <s>Indra</s> to drink, the one that sets both in motion,

children.text: madacyutam auśānaṃ nabhojām pari tritantuṃ vicarantam utsam ||
children.translated_text: dropping intoxication, belonging to <s>Uśanas</s>, born in the cloud, moving around the three-threaded spring.

children.text: āvarvṛtatīr adha nu dvidhārā goṣuyudho na niyavaṃ carantīḥ
children.translated_text: Rolling onward now, two-streamed, moving like fighters for cattle around the low channel,

children.text: ṛṣe janitrīr bhuvanasya patnīr apo vandasva savṛdhaḥ sayonīḥ ||
children.translated_text: O seer, praise the waters, the mothers of the world, its wives, growing together and sharing one womb.

children.text: hinotā no adhvaraṃ devayajyā hinota brahma sanaye dhanānām
children.translated_text: Set our sacrifice in motion for worship of the gods; set the prayer in motion for the winning of riches.

children.text: ṛtasya yoge vi ṣyadhvam ūdhaḥ śruṣṭīvarīr bhūtanāsmabhyam āpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: At the yoking of truth, loosen your udder; become ready to hear for us, O waters.

children.text: āpo revatīḥ kṣayathā hi vasvaḥ kratuṃ ca bhadram bibhṛthāmṛtaṃ ca
children.translated_text: O rich waters, for you dwell among goods; you bear good resolve and immortality.

children.text: rāyaś ca stha svapatyasya patnīḥ sarasvatī tad gṛṇate vayo dhāt ||
children.translated_text: You are mistresses of wealth and good offspring; may <s>Sarasvatī</s> grant vitality to the singer.

children.text: prati yad āpo adṛśram āyatīr ghṛtam payāṃsi bibhratīr madhūni
children.translated_text: When I saw the waters coming, bearing ghee, milks, and honeys,

children.text: adhvaryubhir manasā saṃvidānā indrāya somaṃ suṣutam bharantīḥ ||
children.translated_text: in accord in mind with the <s>adhvaryus</s>, carrying the well-pressed <s>Soma</s> for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: emā agman revatīr jīvadhanyā adhvaryavaḥ sādayatā sakhāyaḥ
children.translated_text: These rich, life-giving waters have come; O <s>adhvaryus</s>, companions, seat them.

children.text: ni barhiṣi dhattana somyāso 'pāṃ naptrā saṃvidānāsa enāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Place them down on the sacred grass, fit for <s>Soma</s>, in accord here with <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s>.

children.text: āgmann āpa uśatīr barhir edaṃ ny adhvare asadan devayantīḥ
children.translated_text: The eager waters have come; seeking the gods, they have sat down here on this sacred grass in the rite.

children.text: adhvaryavaḥ sunutendrāya somam abhūd u vaḥ suśakā devayajyā ||
children.translated_text: O <s>adhvaryu</s> priests, press the <s>soma</s> for <s>Indra</s>; your divine sacrifice has become easy to accomplish.

children.text: Chapter 868
ā no devānām upa vetu śaṃso viśvebhis turair avase yajatraḥ
children.translated_text: May the praise of the gods come near to us, with all the swift ones, O worshipful one, for aid.

children.text: tebhir vayaṃ suṣakhāyo bhavema taranto viśvā duritā syāma ||
children.translated_text: With them may we become good friends; may we cross beyond all hardships.

children.text: pari cin marto draviṇam mamanyād ṛtasya pathā namasā vivāset
children.translated_text: Let the mortal honor wealth on every side; let him worship by the path of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) with reverence.

children.text: uta svena kratunā saṃ vadeta śreyāṃsaṃ dakṣam manasā jagṛbhyāt ||
children.translated_text: And let him speak in accord with his own insight; let him grasp with his mind the better skill.

children.text: adhāyi dhītir asasṛgram aṃśās tīrthe na dasmam upa yanty ūmāḥ
children.translated_text: The inspired thought has been set down; the portions have streamed forth. Like waves, they go near to the wondrous one at the ford.

children.text: abhy ānaśma suvitasya śūṣaṃ navedaso amṛtānām abhūma ||
children.translated_text: We have attained the strength of good guidance; we have become, as it were, knowers among the immortals.

children.text: nityaś cākanyāt svapatir damūnā yasmā u devaḥ savitā jajāna
children.translated_text: The good lord of the house, master of the dwelling, always looks kindly, for whom the god <s>Savitṛ</s> has brought birth.

children.text: bhago vā gobhir aryamem anajyāt so asmai cāruś chadayad uta syāt ||
children.translated_text: Or may <s>Bhaga</s> anoint him with cattle, together with <s>Aryaman</s>; may what is lovely cover him also.

children.text: iyaṃ sā bhūyā uṣasām iva kṣā yaddha kṣumantaḥ śavasā samāyan
children.translated_text: May this one become wide as the expanse of dawns, when men rich in substance have come together through power.

children.text: asya stutiṃ jaritur bhikṣamāṇā ā naḥ śagmāsa upa yantu vājāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeking the singer's hymn, may strengthening prizes, bringing happiness, come near to us.

children.text: asyed eṣā sumatiḥ paprathānābhavat pūrvyā bhūmanā gauḥ
children.translated_text: This favor of his, spreading wide, became ancient and vast, like a cow in abundance.

children.text: asya sanīḍā asurasya yonau samāna ā bharaṇe bibhramāṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those sharing one nest, in the womb of the mighty one, bearing themselves in a common support, are his.

children.text: kiṃ svid vanaṃ ka u sa vṛkṣa āsa yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ
children.translated_text: What was the forest, what indeed was the tree, from which they fashioned heaven and earth?

children.text: saṃtasthāne ajare itaūtī ahāni pūrvīr uṣaso jaranta ||
children.translated_text: In their fixed place, undecaying, with help from here and there, the former days and dawns grow old.

children.text: naitāvad enā paro anyad asty ukṣā sa dyāvāpṛthivī bibharti
children.translated_text: There is not merely this much, nor anything beyond it; that bull upholds heaven and earth.

children.text: tvacam pavitraṃ kṛṇuta svadhāvān yad īṃ sūryaṃ na harito vahanti ||
children.translated_text: The self-powered one makes the skin a purifier, when the bays carry him like the sun.

children.text: stego na kṣām aty eti pṛthvīm mihaṃ na vāto vi ha vāti bhūma
children.translated_text: Like a cover he passes over the broad earth; like mist the wind blows apart over the ground.

children.text: mitro yatra varuṇo ajyamāno 'gnir vane na vy asṛṣṭa śokam ||
children.translated_text: There, where <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> are kindled, <s>Agni</s> has sent forth his flame in the wood.

children.text: starīr yat sūta sadyo ajyamānā vyathir avyathīḥ kṛṇuta svagopā
children.translated_text: When the sterile one, just born, gives birth, the trembler makes the unshaken ones guarded by good herdsmen.

children.text: putro yat pūrvaḥ pitror janiṣṭa śamyāṃ gaur jagāra yaddha pṛcchān ||
children.translated_text: When the first son was born of his two parents, the cow swallowed the cord, as if being questioned.

children.text: uta kaṇvaṃ nṛṣadaḥ putram āhur uta śyāvo dhanam ādatta vājī
children.translated_text: They call <s>Kaṇva</s> the son of the man-sitting one; and the dark swift one has taken the wealth.

children.text: pra kṛṣṇāya ruśad apinvatodhar ṛtam atra nakir asmā apīpet ||
children.translated_text: For the dark one the bright udder swelled; here no one withheld the <s>ṛta</s> from him.

children.text: Chapter 869
pra su gmantā dhiyasānasya sakṣaṇi varebhir varāṁ abhi ṣu prasīdataḥ
children.translated_text: Come forward well to the companionship of the one who thinks, with chosen boons; sit down toward the chosen ones.

children.text: asmākam indra ubhayaṃ jujoṣati yat somyasyāndhaso bubodhati ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is pleased with both of ours, when he becomes aware of the <s>soma</s> draught.

children.text: vīndra yāsi divyāni rocanā vi pārthivāni rajasā puruṣṭuta
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, much praised, you go through the heavenly lights and through the earthly realms with your might.

children.text: ye tvā vahanti muhur adhvarāṁ upa te su vanvantu vagvanāṁ arādhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those who carry you again and again to the rites, may they win wealth for the singers, though they are without gifts.

children.text: tad in me chantsad vapuṣo vapuṣṭaram putro yaj jānam pitror adhīyati
children.translated_text: Let that be sung for me, more beautiful than beauty, what a son born of his parents learns.

children.text: jāyā patiṃ vahati vagnunā sumat puṃsa id bhadro vahatuḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The wife bears her husband with a good-sounding cry; for the man, the well-adorned conveyance is auspicious.

children.text: tad it sadhastham abhi cāru dīdhaya gāvo yacchāsan vahatuṃ na dhenavaḥ
children.translated_text: Shine beautifully upon that common seat, when the cows, like milch-cows, desire the conveyance.

children.text: mātā yan mantur yūthasya pūrvyābhi vāṇasya saptadhātur ij janaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the mother, the first of the thinking herd, is approached by the sevenfold people of speech.

children.text: pra vo 'cchā ririce devayuṣ padam eko rudrebhir yāti turvaṇiḥ
children.translated_text: Toward you the god-loving path has stretched forth; the one conqueror goes with the <s>Rudras</s>.

children.text: jarā vā yeṣv amṛteṣu dāvane pari va ūmebhyaḥ siñcatā madhu ||
children.translated_text: For the giving that is among those immortals, sprinkle honey around for your streams.

children.text: nidhīyamānam apagūḍham apsu pra me devānāṃ vratapā uvāca
children.translated_text: The guardian of the gods' vows told me of the treasure placed down and hidden in the waters.

children.text: indro vidvāṁ anu hi tvā cacakṣa tenāham agne anuśiṣṭa āgām ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, knowing, has indeed seen you; by that instruction, O <s>Agni</s>, I have come.

children.text: akṣetravit kṣetravidaṃ hy aprāṭ sa praiti kṣetravidānuśiṣṭaḥ
children.translated_text: The one who does not know the field has asked the knower of the field; he goes forward, instructed by the knower of the field.

children.text: etad vai bhadram anuśāsanasyota srutiṃ vindaty añjasīnām ||
children.translated_text: This, indeed, is the good of instruction, and he finds the straight course.

children.text: adyed u prāṇīd amamann imāhāpīvṛto adhayan mātur ūdhaḥ
children.translated_text: Today he has breathed forth; these days have thought of him. Those enclosed have sucked the mother's udder.

children.text: em enam āpa jarimā yuvānam aheḍan vasuḥ sumanā babhūva ||
children.translated_text: Now the waters have come upon him, young though he had reached old age; the good one became gracious and well-minded.

children.text: etāni bhadrā kalaśa kriyāma kuruśravaṇa dadato maghāni
children.translated_text: Let us perform these auspicious deeds for the beaker; O <s>Kuruśravaṇa</s>, the gifts are those of a giver.

children.text: dāna id vo maghavānaḥ so astv ayaṃ ca somo hṛdi yam bibharmi ||
children.translated_text: May he indeed be the generous one among you generous men; and this is the <s>soma</s> that I bear in my heart.

children.text: Chapter 870
pra mā yuyujre prayujo janānāṃ vahāmi sma pūṣaṇam antareṇa
children.translated_text: The harnessing teams of men have yoked me; I carried <s>Pūṣan</s> in between.

children.text: viśve devāso adha mām arakṣan duḥśāsur āgād iti ghoṣa āsīt ||
children.translated_text: Then all the gods protected me; the cry arose, 'A bad commander has come.'

children.text: sam mā tapanty abhitaḥ sapatnīr iva parśavaḥ
children.translated_text: The rival wives on every side burn me like ribs.

children.text: ni bādhate amatir nagnatā jasur ver na vevīyate matiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Want and nakedness press down; craving does not tremble, like a bird.

children.text: mūṣo na śiśnā vy adanti mādhya stotāraṃ te śatakrato
children.translated_text: Like mice they gnaw at the gambler's member, O hundred-powered one.

children.text: sakṛt su no maghavann indra mṛḍayādhā piteva no bhava ||
children.translated_text: Once now, O generous <s>Indra</s>, be gracious to us; then be like a father to us.

children.text: kuruśravaṇam āvṛṇi rājānaṃ trāsadasyavam
children.translated_text: I choose <s>Kuruśravaṇa</s>, the king descended from <s>Trasadasyu</s>,

children.text: maṃhiṣṭhaṃ vāghatām ṛṣiḥ ||
children.translated_text: the most generous of the singers, the seer.

children.text: yasya mā harito rathe tisro vahanti sādhuyā
children.translated_text: In whose chariot three bay mares carry me rightly,

children.text: stavai sahasradakṣiṇe ||
children.translated_text: I will praise him, rich with a thousand gifts.

children.text: yasya prasvādaso gira upamaśravasaḥ pituḥ
children.translated_text: Whose sweet songs, those of the father of <s>Upamaśravas</s>,

children.text: kṣetraṃ na raṇvam ūcuṣe ||
children.translated_text: spoke a delightful field for the speaker.

children.text: adhi putropamaśravo napān mitrātither ihi
children.translated_text: Come here, O son <s>Upamaśravas</s>, grandson of <s>Mitrātithi</s>.

children.text: pituṣ ṭe asmi vanditā ||
children.translated_text: I am the praiser of your father.

children.text: yad īśīyāmṛtānām uta vā martyānām
children.translated_text: If I were master of the immortals, or even of mortals,

children.text: jīved in maghavā mama ||
children.translated_text: then my generous patron would live.

children.text: na devānām ati vrataṃ śatātmā cana jīvati
children.translated_text: Not even one with a hundred selves lives beyond the ordinance of the gods.

children.text: tathā yujā vi vāvṛte ||
children.translated_text: Thus he has turned away from his companion.

children.text: Chapter 871
prāvepā mā bṛhato mādayanti pravātejā iriṇe varvṛtānāḥ
children.translated_text: The quivering ones from the great tree delight me, rolling on the windy place, on the barren ground.

children.text: somasyeva maujavatasya bhakṣo vibhīdako jāgṛvir mahyam acchān ||
children.translated_text: Like a draught of <s>soma</s> from <s>Maujavata</s>, the wakeful nut of <s>Vibhīdaka</s> has been pleasing to me.

children.text: na mā mimetha na jihīḍa eṣā śivā sakhibhya uta mahyam āsīt
children.translated_text: She did not scold me nor was she angry; she was kind to my companions and to me.

children.text: akṣasyāham ekaparasya hetor anuvratām apa jāyām arodham ||
children.translated_text: For the sake of the single throw of the die, I drove away my devoted wife.

children.text: dveṣṭi śvaśrūr apa jāyā ruṇaddhi na nāthito vindate marḍitāram
children.translated_text: His mother-in-law hates him; his wife drives him away; when he begs, he finds no one to pity him.

children.text: aśvasyeva jarato vasnyasya nāhaṃ vindāmi kitavasya bhogam ||
children.translated_text: Like an old horse put up for sale, I find no enjoyment in the gambler.

children.text: anye jāyām pari mṛśanty asya yasyāgṛdhad vedane vājy akṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Others caress the wife of the man whose possessions the winning die has coveted.

children.text: pitā mātā bhrātara enam āhur na jānīmo nayatā baddham etam ||
children.translated_text: Father, mother, and brothers say of him, 'We do not know him; take this man away bound.'

children.text: yad ā dīdhye na daviṣāṇy ebhiḥ parāyadbhyo 'va hīye sakhibhyaḥ
children.translated_text: When I resolve, 'I will not play with these,' I am left behind by my friends as they go away.

children.text: nyuptāś ca babhravo vācam akrataṁ emīd eṣāṃ niṣkṛtaṃ jāriṇīva ||
children.translated_text: But when the tawny dice, thrown down, have raised their voice, I go straight to their appointed place, like a lover to a woman.

children.text: sabhām eti kitavaḥ pṛcchamāno jeṣyāmīti tanvā śūśujānaḥ
children.translated_text: The gambler goes to the assembly, asking, 'Shall I win?' burning with his body.

children.text: akṣāso asya vi tiranti kāmam pratidīvne dadhata ā kṛtāni ||
children.translated_text: The dice stretch out his desire and place the winnings before the opposing player.

children.text: akṣāsa id aṅkuśino nitodino nikṛtvānas tapanās tāpayiṣṇavaḥ
children.translated_text: The dice indeed are hooks and goads, deceivers, tormentors, burners, and inflamers.

children.text: kumāradeṣṇā jayataḥ punarhaṇo madhvā saṃpṛktāḥ kitavasya barhaṇā ||
children.translated_text: Giving like children, striking back again at the winner, smeared with honey, they destroy the gambler.

children.text: tripañcāśaḥ krīḍati vrāta eṣāṃ deva iva savitā satyadharmā
children.translated_text: Their troop of fifty-three plays like the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, whose law is true.

children.text: ugrasya cin manyave nā namante rājā cid ebhyo nama it kṛṇoti ||
children.translated_text: They do not bow even to the wrath of the fierce one; even a king makes obeisance to them.

children.text: nīcā vartanta upari sphuranty ahastāso hastavantaṃ sahante
children.translated_text: They roll downward and leap upward; handless, they overpower the man with hands.

children.text: divyā aṅgārā iriṇe nyuptāḥ śītāḥ santo hṛdayaṃ nir dahanti ||
children.translated_text: Heavenly coals thrown down upon the gaming-board, though cold, they burn the heart completely.

children.text: jāyā tapyate kitavasya hīnā mātā putrasya carataḥ kva svit
children.translated_text: The gambler's wife is tormented, abandoned; the mother wonders where her wandering son may be.

children.text: ṛṇāvā bibhyad dhanam icchamāno 'nyeṣām astam upa naktam eti ||
children.translated_text: Fearing debt and seeking money, he goes by night to the house of others.

children.text: striyaṃ dṛṣṭvāya kitavaṃ tatāpānyeṣāṃ jāyāṃ sukṛtaṃ ca yonim
children.translated_text: Seeing another man's wife, and another man's well-ordered home, the gambler is tormented.

children.text: pūrvāhṇe aśvān yuyuje hi babhrūn so agner ante vṛṣalaḥ papāda ||
children.translated_text: In the morning he yoked the tawny horses; by the end of the fire-sacrifice the wretch had sunk down.

children.text: yo vaḥ senānīr mahato gaṇasya rājā vrātasya prathamo babhūva
children.translated_text: To him who became your army-leader, king of the great troop, first of the band,

children.text: tasmai kṛṇomi na dhanā ruṇadhmi daśāham prācīs tad ṛtaṃ vadāmi ||
children.translated_text: to him I stretch out my ten fingers in front; I do not withhold wealth; this truth I speak.

children.text: akṣair mā dīvyaḥ kṛṣim it kṛṣasva vitte ramasva bahu manyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: Do not play with dice; cultivate the field; enjoy your wealth, thinking it abundant.

children.text: tatra gāvaḥ kitava tatra jāyā tan me vi caṣṭe savitāyam aryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There are the cows, O gambler; there is your wife. This noble <s>Savitṛ</s> declares that to me.

children.text: mitraṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ khalu mṛḍatā no mā no ghoreṇa caratābhi dhṛṣṇu
children.translated_text: Make friendship with us; surely be gracious to us. Do not assail us with terrible boldness.

children.text: ni vo nu manyur viśatām arātir anyo babhrūṇām prasitau nv astu ||
children.translated_text: Let your wrath and hostility now settle down; let another be in the snare of the tawny dice.

children.text: Chapter 872
abudhram u tya indravanto agnayo jyotir bharanta uṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: Those fires, accompanied by <s>Indra</s>, have awakened, bearing light at the breakings of dawn.

children.text: mahī dyāvāpṛthivī cetatām apo 'dyā devānām ava ā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: May the great Heaven and Earth and the waters take heed; today we choose the help of the gods.

children.text: divaspṛthivyor ava ā vṛṇīmahe mātṝn sindhūn parvatāñcharyaṇāvataḥ
children.translated_text: We choose help from Heaven and Earth, from the mothers, the rivers, the mountains, and <s>Śaryaṇāvat</s>.

children.text: anāgāstvaṃ sūryam uṣāsam īmahe bhadraṃ somaḥ suvāno adyā kṛṇotu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: We seek guiltlessness, the Sun, and <s>Uṣas</s>; may <s>Soma</s>, being pressed, make good fortune for us today.

children.text: dyāvā no adya pṛthivī anāgaso mahī trāyetāṃ suvitāya mātarā
children.translated_text: May Heaven and Earth today, the great sinless mothers, protect us for good guidance.

children.text: uṣā ucchanty apa bādhatām aghaṃ svasty agniṃ sam idhānam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Uṣas</s>, shining forth, drive away evil; for well-being we seek <s>Agni</s> as he is kindled.

children.text: iyaṃ na usrā prathamā sudevyaṃ revat sanibhyo revatī vy ucchatu
children.translated_text: May this first ruddy dawn, rich in good divinity, shine forth richly for those who share in wealth.

children.text: āre manyuṃ durvidatrasya dhīmahi svasty agniṃ sam idhānam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: Let us put far away the anger of the ill-giving one; for well-being we seek <s>Agni</s> as he is kindled.

children.text: pra yāḥ sisrate sūryasya raśmibhir jyotir bharantīr uṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: The Dawns that stream forth with the rays of the Sun, bearing light at the breakings of dawn,

children.text: bhadrā no adya śravase vy ucchata svasty agniṃ sam idhānam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: may they shine forth auspiciously for our fame today; for well-being we seek <s>Agni</s> as he is kindled.

children.text: anamīvā uṣasa ā carantu na ud agnayo jihatāṃ jyotiṣā bṛhat
children.translated_text: Let the Dawns come to us free from sickness; let the fires rise up with great light.

children.text: ā yukṣātām aśvinā tūtujiṃ rathaṃ svasty agniṃ sam idhānam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: Let the two <s>Aśvins</s> yoke their swift chariot; for well-being we seek <s>Agni</s> as he is kindled.

children.text: śreṣṭhaṃ no adya savitar vareṇyam bhāgam ā suva sa hi ratnadhā asi
children.translated_text: O <s>Savitṛ</s>, send us today the best, most desirable share, for you are the bestower of treasures.

children.text: rāyo janitrīṃ dhiṣaṇām upa bruve svasty agniṃ sam idhānam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: I call upon <s>Dhiṣaṇā</s>, the mother of riches; for well-being we seek <s>Agni</s> as he is kindled.

children.text: pipartu mā tad ṛtasya pravācanaṃ devānāṃ yan manuṣyā amanmahi
children.translated_text: May that proclamation of <s>ṛta</s> carry me through, that which we mortals have thought concerning the gods.

children.text: viśvā id usrā spaḍ ud eti sūryaḥ svasty agniṃ sam idhānam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: Over all the ruddy Dawns the Sun rises forth; for well-being we seek <s>Agni</s> as he is kindled.

children.text: adveṣo adya barhiṣa starīmaṇi grāvṇāṃ yoge manmanaḥ sādha īmahe
children.translated_text: Free from hatred today, at the spreading of the sacred grass and the joining of the pressing-stones, we seek the fulfilment of thought.

children.text: ādityānāṃ śarmaṇi sthā bhuraṇyasi svasty agniṃ sam idhānam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: You stand in the shelter of the <s>Ādityas</s>, prospering; for well-being we seek <s>Agni</s> as he is kindled.

children.text: ā no barhiḥ sadhamāde bṛhad divi devāṁ īḍe sādayā sapta hotṝn
children.translated_text: Bring our sacred grass to the common feast in the high heaven; I praise the gods: seat the seven priests.

children.text: indram mitraṃ varuṇaṃ sātaye bhagaṃ svasty agniṃ sam idhānam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: I call <s>Indra</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Bhaga</s> for attainment; for well-being we seek <s>Agni</s> as he is kindled.

children.text: ta ādityā ā gatā sarvatātaye vṛdhe no yajñam avatā sajoṣasaḥ
children.translated_text: Come here, O <s>Ādityas</s>, for complete protection; for our growth, protect the sacrifice in harmony.

children.text: bṛhaspatim pūṣaṇam aśvinā bhagaṃ svasty agniṃ sam idhānam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: I call <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, <s>Pūṣan</s>, the two <s>Aśvins</s>, and <s>Bhaga</s>; for well-being we seek <s>Agni</s> as he is kindled.

children.text: tan no devā yacchata supravācanaṃ chardir ādityāḥ subharaṃ nṛpāyyam
children.translated_text: Grant us that good utterance, O gods, O <s>Ādityas</s>, a shelter easy to bear and protective of men,

children.text: paśve tokāya tanayāya jīvase svasty agniṃ sam idhānam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: for cattle, for children, for descendants, and for life; for well-being we seek <s>Agni</s> as he is kindled.

children.text: viśve adya maruto viśva ūtī viśve bhavantv agnayaḥ sam iddhāḥ
children.translated_text: May all the <s>Maruts</s> today, with every aid, and all the kindled fires be present.

children.text: viśve no devā avasā gamantu viśvam astu draviṇaṃ vājo asme ||
children.translated_text: May all the gods come to us with help; may every wealth and prize be ours.

children.text: yaṃ devāso 'vatha vājasātau yaṃ trāyadhve yam pipṛthāty aṃhaḥ
children.translated_text: The one whom you gods aid in the winning of prize, whom you protect, whom you carry across distress,

children.text: yo vo gopīthe na bhayasya veda te syāma devavītaye turāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the one who knows no fear under your guardianship: may we be such swift ones for the winning of divine favor.

children.text: Chapter 873
uṣāsānaktā bṛhatī supeśasā dyāvākṣāmā varuṇo mitro aryamā
children.translated_text: I call <s>Uṣasānaktā</s>, the two great and beautiful ones, Heaven and Earth, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>.

children.text: indraṃ huve marutaḥ parvatāṁ apa ādityān dyāvāpṛthivī apaḥ svaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I call <s>Indra</s>, the <s>Maruts</s>, the mountains, the waters, the <s>Ādityas</s>, Heaven and Earth, the waters, and the heavenly light.

children.text: dyauś ca naḥ pṛthivī ca pracetasa ṛtāvarī rakṣatām aṃhaso riṣaḥ
children.translated_text: May Heaven and Earth, discerning and upholding <s>ṛta</s>, protect us from distress and injury.

children.text: mā durvidatrā nirṛtir na īśata tad devānām avo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: Let not ill-distributing <s>Nirṛti</s> have power over us; today we choose that aid of the gods.

children.text: viśvasmān no aditiḥ pātv aṃhaso mātā mitrasya varuṇasya revataḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Aditi</s>, the rich mother of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, protect us from every distress.

children.text: svarvaj jyotir avṛkaṃ naśīmahi tad devānām avo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: May we attain the sunlight, the harmless light; today we choose that aid of the gods.

children.text: grāvā vadann apa rakṣāṃsi sedhatu duṣṣvapnyaṃ nirṛtiṃ viśvam atriṇam
children.translated_text: Let the speaking pressing-stone drive away the demons, the bad dream, <s>Nirṛti</s>, and every devourer.

children.text: ādityaṃ śarma marutām aśīmahi tad devānām avo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: May we reach the shelter of the <s>Ādityas</s> and the <s>Maruts</s>; today we choose that aid of the gods.

children.text: endro barhiḥ sīdatu pinvatām iḍā bṛhaspatiḥ sāmabhir ṛkvo arcatu
children.translated_text: Let <s>Indra</s> sit on the sacred grass; let <s>Iḍā</s> swell; let <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, rich in praise, worship with chants.

children.text: supraketaṃ jīvase manma dhīmahi tad devānām avo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: Let us set in mind a well-marked thought for living; today we choose that aid of the gods.

children.text: divispṛśaṃ yajñam asmākam aśvinā jīrādhvaraṃ kṛṇutaṃ sumnam iṣṭaye
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, make our sacrifice touch heaven, make the rite swift, and make it gracious for the desired boon.

children.text: prācīnaraśmim āhutaṃ ghṛtena tad devānām avo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: It is turned forward with its rays and invoked with ghee; today we choose that aid of the gods.

children.text: upa hvaye suhavam mārutaṃ gaṇam pāvakam ṛṣvaṃ sakhyāya śambhuvam
children.translated_text: I call near the easily invoked host of the <s>Maruts</s>, bright, lofty, beneficent, and fit for friendship.

children.text: rāyas poṣaṃ sauśravasāya dhīmahi tad devānām avo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: Let us set our thought on the growth of wealth and on good renown; today we choose that aid of the gods.

children.text: apām peruṃ jīvadhanyam bharāmahe devāvyaṃ suhavam adhvaraśriyam
children.translated_text: We bring the swelling of the waters, life-giving and grain-bestowing, divine, easily invoked, the beauty of the rite.

children.text: suraśmiṃ somam indriyaṃ yamīmahi tad devānām avo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: We seek <s>Soma</s>, bright-rayed and powerful; today we choose that aid of the gods.

children.text: sanema tat susanitā sanitvabhir vayaṃ jīvā jīvaputrā anāgasaḥ
children.translated_text: May we win that through good winning and gains, living, with living sons, free from guilt.

children.text: brahmadviṣo viṣvag eno bharerata tad devānām avo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: Let those who hate sacred utterance carry guilt away on every side; today we choose that aid of the gods.

children.text: ye sthā manor yajñiyās te śṛṇotana yad vo devā īmahe tad dadātana
children.translated_text: You who are the sacrificial ones of <s>Manu</s>, listen; what we ask of you, O gods, grant that.

children.text: jaitraṃ kratuṃ rayimad vīravad yaśas tad devānām avo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: Grant victorious resolve, fame rich in wealth and heroes; today we choose that aid of the gods.

children.text: mahad adya mahatām ā vṛṇīmahe 'vo devānām bṛhatām anarvaṇām
children.translated_text: Today we choose the great aid of the great gods, the mighty ones who cannot be withstood.

children.text: yathā vasu vīrajātaṃ naśāmahai tad devānām avo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: So that we may attain wealth born with heroes; today we choose that aid of the gods.

children.text: maho agneḥ sam idhānasya śarmaṇy anāgā mitre varuṇe svastaye
children.translated_text: May we, guiltless, be in the shelter of great <s>Agni</s> as he is kindled, with <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, for well-being.

children.text: śreṣṭhe syāma savituḥ savīmani tad devānām avo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
children.translated_text: May we be in the best impulse of <s>Savitṛ</s>; today we choose that aid of the gods.

children.text: ye savituḥ satyasavasya viśve mitrasya vrate varuṇasya devāḥ
children.translated_text: All you gods who are within the ordinance of <s>Savitṛ</s> of true impulse, and within that of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>,

children.text: te saubhagaṃ vīravad gomad apno dadhātana draviṇaṃ citram asme ||
children.translated_text: bestow on us fortunate treasure, rich in heroes and cows, and splendid wealth.

children.text: savitā paścātāt savitā purastāt savitottarāttāt savitādharāttāt
children.translated_text: <s>Savitṛ</s> is behind; <s>Savitṛ</s> is before; <s>Savitṛ</s> is above; <s>Savitṛ</s> is below.

children.text: savitā naḥ suvatu sarvatātiṃ savitā no rāsatāṃ dīrgham āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Savitṛ</s> impel us toward completeness on every side; may <s>Savitṛ</s> grant us long life.

children.text: Chapter 874
namo mitrasya varuṇasya cakṣase maho devāya tad ṛtaṃ saparyata
children.translated_text: Homage to the eye of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; worship that truth for the great god.

children.text: dūredṛśe devajātāya ketave divas putrāya sūryāya śaṃsata ||
children.translated_text: Praise <s>Sūrya</s>, the far-seeing sign, god-born, the son of heaven.

children.text: sā mā satyoktiḥ pari pātu viśvato dyāvā ca yatra tatanann ahāni ca
children.translated_text: May that true utterance protect me on every side, where heaven and the days have spread themselves out.

children.text: viśvam anyan ni viśate yad ejati viśvāhāpo viśvāhod eti sūryaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Everything else that moves enters into rest; all the waters are present, and every day <s>Sūrya</s> rises.

children.text: na te adevaḥ pradivo ni vāsate yad etaśebhiḥ patarai ratharyasi
children.translated_text: No godless one from of old stands in your way when you drive your chariot with the swift, flying steeds.

children.text: prācīnam anyad anu vartate raja ud anyena jyotiṣā yāsi sūrya ||
children.translated_text: One expanse follows the former one; with another light you go upward, O <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: yena sūrya jyotiṣā bādhase tamo jagac ca viśvam ud iyarṣi bhānunā
children.translated_text: With that light by which, O <s>Sūrya</s>, you drive away darkness and raise up the whole moving world with your radiance,

children.text: tenāsmad viśvām anirām anāhutim apāmīvām apa duṣṣvapnyaṃ suva ||
children.translated_text: with that drive away from us every weakness, every lack of offering, disease, and bad dream.

children.text: viśvasya hi preṣito rakṣasi vratam aheḍayann uccarasi svadhā anu
children.translated_text: For, set in motion for all, you guard the ordinance of the whole world; without provoking anger you rise according to your own law.

children.text: yad adya tvā sūryopabravāmahai taṃ no devā anu maṃsīrata kratum ||
children.translated_text: Since today we address you, O <s>Sūrya</s>, may the gods approve that resolve of ours.

children.text: taṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī tan na āpa indraḥ śṛṇvantu maruto havaṃ vacaḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Heaven-and-Earth</s>, the waters, <s>Indra</s>, and the <s>Maruts</s> hear this invocation, this word of ours.

children.text: mā śūne bhūma sūryasya saṃdṛśi bhadraṃ jīvanto jaraṇām aśīmahi ||
children.translated_text: May we not be empty in the sight of <s>Sūrya</s>; living, may we attain old age in good fortune.

children.text: viśvāhā tvā sumanasaḥ sucakṣasaḥ prajāvanto anamīvā anāgasaḥ
children.translated_text: Every day, with good minds and clear sight, with offspring, free from disease and guilt,

children.text: udyantaṃ tvā mitramaho dive dive jyog jīvāḥ prati paśyema sūrya ||
children.translated_text: as you rise day by day, mighty as <s>Mitra</s>, may we, living long, look upon you, O <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: mahi jyotir bibhrataṃ tvā vicakṣaṇa bhāsvantaṃ cakṣuṣe cakṣuṣe mayaḥ
children.translated_text: Bearing great light, discerning and shining, a joy for every eye,

children.text: ārohantam bṛhataḥ pājasas pari vayaṃ jīvāḥ prati paśyema sūrya ||
children.translated_text: as you mount above the great power, may we, living, look upon you, O <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: yasya te viśvā bhuvanāni ketunā pra cerate ni ca viśante aktubhiḥ
children.translated_text: By your beacon all beings move forth and enter in with the nights.

children.text: anāgāstvena harikeśa sūryāhnāhnā no vasyasā vasyasod ihi ||
children.translated_text: In guiltlessness, O golden-haired <s>Sūrya</s>, rise for us day after day with ever better welfare.

children.text: śaṃ no bhava cakṣasā śaṃ no ahnā śam bhānunā śaṃ himā śaṃ ghṛṇena
children.translated_text: Be auspicious to us with sight, auspicious with day, auspicious with radiance, auspicious through cold, and auspicious through warmth.

children.text: yathā śam adhvañcham asad duroṇe tat sūrya draviṇaṃ dhehi citram ||
children.translated_text: As it may be auspicious on the road and auspicious in the dwelling, set that splendid wealth here, O <s>Sūrya</s>.
