children.text: asmākaṃ devā ubhayāya janmane śarma yacchata dvipade catuṣpade
children.translated_text: O gods, grant shelter for both births of ours, for the two-footed and for the four-footed.

children.text: adat pibad ūrjayamānam āśitaṃ tad asme śaṃ yor arapo dadhātana ||
children.translated_text: For what eats, drinks, is strengthened, and has been fed, establish that here for us as well-being and health, free from harm.

children.text: yad vo devāś cakṛma jihvayā guru manaso vā prayutī devaheḍanam
children.translated_text: Whatever heavy offense against the gods we have committed with the tongue, or through the impulse of the mind,

children.text: arāvā yo no abhi ducchunāyate tasmin tad eno vasavo ni dhetana ||
children.translated_text: or whatever ungenerous foe plots harm against us, place that guilt upon him, O <s>Vasus</s>.

children.text: Chapter 875
asmin na indra pṛtsutau yaśasvati śimīvati krandasi prāva sātaye
children.translated_text: In this renowned, forceful contest, O <s>Indra</s>, aid us at the battle-cry for the winning of prize.

children.text: yatra goṣātā dhṛṣiteṣu khādiṣu viṣvak patanti didyavo nṛṣāhye ||
children.translated_text: Where, in the winning of cows, among the bold assailants, the missiles fly everywhere in man-conquering battle,

children.text: sa naḥ kṣumantaṃ sadane vy ūrṇuhi goarṇasaṃ rayim indra śravāyyam
children.translated_text: uncover for us in the dwelling a prosperous, cow-streaming, renowned wealth, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: syāma te jayataḥ śakra medino yathā vayam uśmasi tad vaso kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: May we be your prosperous allies as you conquer, O <s>Śakra</s>; as we desire, do that for us, O <s>Vasu</s>.

children.text: yo no dāsa āryo vā puruṣṭutādeva indra yudhaye ciketati
children.translated_text: Whoever, whether <s>Dāsa</s> or <s>Ārya</s>, O much-praised <s>Indra</s>, godless, has set his mind on battle against us...

children.text: asmābhiṣ ṭe suṣahāḥ santu śatravas tvayā vayaṃ tān vanuyāma saṃgame ||
children.translated_text: With us, may your enemies be easy to overcome; with you, may we conquer them in the encounter.

children.text: yo dabhrebhir havyo yaś ca bhūribhir yo abhīke varivovin nṛṣāhye
children.translated_text: He who is to be invoked by few and also by many, who in the clash finds broad space for manly power,

children.text: taṃ vikhāde sasnim adya śrutaṃ naram arvāñcam indram avase karāmahe ||
children.translated_text: that conquering, renowned man, <s>Indra</s>, we make turn hither today for our aid in the fight.

children.text: svavṛjaṃ hi tvām aham indra śuśravānānudaṃ vṛṣabha radhracodanam
children.translated_text: For I have heard of you as self-strong, O <s>Indra</s>, as driving off the foe, O bull, as urging on the needy.

children.text: pra muñcasva pari kutsād ihā gahi kim u tvāvān muṣkayor baddha āsate ||
children.translated_text: Release yourself from around <s>Kutsa</s> and come here; why should one such as you sit bound by the testicles?

children.text: Chapter 876
yo vām parijmā suvṛd aśvinā ratho doṣām uṣāso havyo haviṣmatā
children.translated_text: That encircling, well-turning chariot of yours, O <s>Aśvins</s>, is to be invoked by the offerer with oblation at night and at dawn.

children.text: śaśvattamāsas tam u vām idaṃ vayam pitur na nāma suhavaṃ havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: That most constant and easy-to-call chariot of yours we now invoke, like the name of a father.

children.text: codayataṃ sūnṛtāḥ pinvataṃ dhiya ut purandhīr īrayataṃ tad uśmasi
children.translated_text: Set gracious words in motion; swell our thoughts; send forth abundant insight: that is what we desire.

children.text: yaśasam bhāgaṃ kṛṇutaṃ no aśvinā somaṃ na cārum maghavatsu nas kṛtam ||
children.translated_text: Make for us a glorious share, O <s>Aśvins</s>; make us, among the generous, like the lovely <s>soma</s>.

children.text: amājuraś cid bhavatho yuvam bhago 'nāśoś cid avitārāpamasya cit
children.translated_text: You two become a share even for the worn-out; you are protectors even of the helpless, even of the lowest one.

children.text: andhasya cin nāsatyā kṛśasya cid yuvām id āhur bhiṣajā rutasya cit ||
children.translated_text: Even of the blind, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, even of the thin and wasted, even of the injured, they say that you two are physicians.

children.text: yuvaṃ cyavānaṃ sanayaṃ yathā ratham punar yuvānaṃ carathāya takṣathuḥ
children.translated_text: You fashioned aged <s>Cyavāna</s> young again, as one refits a chariot, so that he might move about.

children.text: niṣ ṭaugryam ūhathur adbhyas pari viśvet tā vāṃ savaneṣu pravācyā ||
children.translated_text: You carried the son of <s>Tugra</s> out from the waters; all these deeds of yours are to be proclaimed at the soma-pressings.

children.text: purāṇā vāṃ vīryā pra bravā jane 'tho hāsathur bhiṣajā mayobhuvā
children.translated_text: I will proclaim among the people your ancient heroic powers; and then, as physicians bringing delight, you showed yourselves gracious.

children.text: tā vāṃ nu navyāv avase karāmahe 'yaṃ nāsatyā śrad arir yathā dadhat ||
children.translated_text: Those powers of yours we now call upon anew for aid; O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, let this worshiper place trust in them as he should.

children.text: iyaṃ vām ahve śṛṇutam me aśvinā putrāyeva pitarā mahyaṃ śikṣatam
children.translated_text: This call is addressed to you; hear me, O <s>Aśvins</s>. Teach and help me, like two fathers for a son.

children.text: anāpir ajñā asajātyāmatiḥ purā tasyā abhiśaster ava spṛtam ||
children.translated_text: From the curse of that kinless, unknowing, alien-minded hostility of old, keep me away.

children.text: yuvaṃ rathena vimadāya śundhyuvaṃ ny ūhathuḥ purumitrasya yoṣaṇām
children.translated_text: With your chariot you brought to <s>Vimada</s> the young bride of <s>Purumitra</s>.

children.text: yuvaṃ havaṃ vadhrimatyā agacchataṃ yuvaṃ suṣutiṃ cakrathuḥ purandhaye ||
children.translated_text: You came to the call of <s>Vadhrimatī</s>; you made an easy birth for <s>Purandhi</s>.

children.text: yuvaṃ viprasya jaraṇām upeyuṣaḥ punaḥ kaler akṛṇutaṃ yuvad vayaḥ
children.translated_text: For <s>Kali</s>, the inspired singer who had reached old age, you made young life again.

children.text: yuvaṃ vandanam ṛśyadād ud ūpathur yuvaṃ sadyo viśpalām etave kṛthaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You raised up <s>Vandana</s> from his collapse; you at once made <s>Viśpalā</s> able to go forward.

children.text: yuvaṃ ha rebhaṃ vṛṣaṇā guhā hitam ud airayatam mamṛvāṃsam aśvinā
children.translated_text: You two strong ones, O <s>Aśvins</s>, lifted up <s>Rebha</s>, hidden in a cave and near death.

children.text: yuvam ṛbīsam uta taptam atraya omanvantaṃ cakrathuḥ saptavadhraye ||
children.translated_text: You made protection for <s>Atri</s> even in the heated pit, and help for <s>Saptavadhri</s> in distress.

children.text: yuvaṃ śvetam pedave 'śvināśvaṃ navabhir vājair navatī ca vājinam
children.translated_text: You gave to <s>Pedu</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>, the white horse, a racer with nine-and-ninety powers of prize-winning.

children.text: carkṛtyaṃ dadathur drāvayatsakham bhagaṃ na nṛbhyo havyam mayobhuvam ||
children.translated_text: You gave a much-praised one, a companion in the rush, invoked by men and bringing delight, like <s>Bhaga</s>.

children.text: na taṃ rājānāv adite kutaś cana nāṃho aśnoti duritaṃ nakir bhayam
children.translated_text: O royal ones, O sons of <s>Aditi</s>, no distress from anywhere reaches that man, no evil and no fear.

children.text: yam aśvinā suhavā rudravartanī purorathaṃ kṛṇuthaḥ patnyā saha ||
children.translated_text: That is the man whom you, O easily invoked <s>Aśvins</s> of <s>Rudra</s>-like paths, make foremost in the chariot together with his wife.

children.text: ā tena yātam manaso javīyasā rathaṃ yaṃ vām ṛbhavaś cakrur aśvinā
children.translated_text: Come with that chariot swifter than thought, the chariot which the <s>Ṛbhus</s> fashioned for you, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: yasya yoge duhitā jāyate diva ubhe ahanī sudine vivasvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: At its yoking the daughter of heaven is born, and both days of <s>Vivasvat</s> arise as fair days.

children.text: tā vartir yātaṃ jayuṣā vi parvatam apinvataṃ śayave dhenum aśvinā
children.translated_text: Come along those courses with conquering force; you made the cow swell for <s>Śayu</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>, and opened the mountain.

children.text: vṛkasya cid vartikām antar āsyād yuvaṃ śacībhir grasitām amuñcatam ||
children.translated_text: By your powers you released even the quail that had been swallowed inside the mouth of the wolf.

children.text: etaṃ vāṃ stomam aśvināv akarmātakṣāma bhṛgavo na ratham
children.translated_text: This praise-song for you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, we have made; we have fashioned it like the <s>Bhṛgus</s> fashioned a chariot.

children.text: ny amṛkṣāma yoṣaṇāṃ na marye nityaṃ na sūnuṃ tanayaṃ dadhānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: We have adorned it like a maiden for a young man, like one constantly holding a son, a child.

children.text: Chapter 877
rathaṃ yāntaṃ kuha ko ha vāṃ narā prati dyumantaṃ suvitāya bhūṣati
children.translated_text: Where is your chariot going? Who, O heroes, adorns the shining one of yours for good fortune?

children.text: prātaryāvāṇaṃ vibhvaṃ viśe viśe vastor vastor vahamānaṃ dhiyā śami ||
children.translated_text: It goes forth in the morning, far-reaching, carried to every clan, morning after morning, by thought and ritual effort.

children.text: kuha svid doṣā kuha vastor aśvinā kuhābhipitvaṃ karataḥ kuhoṣatuḥ
children.translated_text: Where indeed are you at night, where at dawn, O <s>Aśvins</s>? Where do you make your approach, and where have you settled?

children.text: ko vāṃ śayutrā vidhaveva devaram maryaṃ na yoṣā kṛṇute sadhastha ā ||
children.translated_text: Who prepares a resting-place for you, like a widow for her brother-in-law, like a young woman for a man at the common seat?

children.text: prātar jarethe jaraṇeva kāpayā vastor vastor yajatā gacchatho gṛham
children.translated_text: In the morning you are praised with a song of praise; morning after morning, worshipful ones, you go to the house.

children.text: kasya dhvasrā bhavathaḥ kasya vā narā rājaputreva savanāva gacchathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For whom are you eager, for whom, O heroes? Like two princes, to whose soma-pressings do you go?

children.text: yuvām mṛgeva vāraṇā mṛgaṇyavo doṣā vastor haviṣā ni hvayāmahe
children.translated_text: Seeking you like hunters after two wild animals, we call you down with oblation at night and at dawn.

children.text: yuvaṃ hotrām ṛtuthā juhvate nareṣaṃ janāya vahathaḥ śubhas patī ||
children.translated_text: You two answer the priestly invocation in due season; lords of splendor, you bring help for the people.

children.text: yuvāṃ ha ghoṣā pary aśvinā yatī rājña ūce duhitā pṛcche vāṃ narā
children.translated_text: Indeed <s>Ghoṣā</s>, going about, O <s>Aśvins</s>, a king's daughter, said: 'I ask you, O heroes:

children.text: bhūtam me ahna uta bhūtam aktave 'śvāvate rathine śaktam arvate ||
children.translated_text: be present for me by day, and be present by night; give strength to the horse-owner, the chariot-rider, and the runner.'

children.text: yuvaṃ kavī ṣṭhaḥ pary aśvinā rathaṃ viśo na kutso jaritur naśāyathaḥ
children.translated_text: You two, most wise ones, attend the chariot, O <s>Aśvins</s>; you did not abandon <s>Kutsa</s>, the singer, as clans do not abandon their own.

children.text: yuvor ha makṣā pary aśvinā madhv āsā bharata niṣkṛtaṃ na yoṣaṇā ||
children.translated_text: Around you two, O <s>Aśvins</s>, the bee carries honey in its mouth, like an adorned young woman.

children.text: yuvaṃ ha bhujyuṃ yuvam aśvinā vaśaṃ yuvaṃ śiñjāram uśanām upārathuḥ
children.translated_text: You aided <s>Bhujyu</s>; you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, aided <s>Vaśa</s>; you aided <s>Śiñjāra</s> and <s>Uśanā</s>.

children.text: yuvo rarāvā pari sakhyam āsate yuvor aham avasā sumnam ā cake ||
children.translated_text: Your friendships gather round with eager sound; through your aid I seek favor and good will.

children.text: yuvaṃ ha kṛśaṃ yuvam aśvinā śayuṃ yuvaṃ vidhantaṃ vidhavām uruṣyathaḥ
children.translated_text: You protected <s>Kṛśa</s>; you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, protected <s>Śayu</s>; you protected the worshiper and the widow.

children.text: yuvaṃ sanibhya stanayantam aśvināpa vrajam ūrṇuthaḥ saptāsyam ||
children.translated_text: For those seeking gain, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you opened the thundering enclosure with seven mouths.

children.text: janiṣṭa yoṣā patayat kanīnako vi cāruhan vīrudho daṃsanā anu
children.translated_text: The young woman was born; the little one flew forth, and the plants spread out according to their wondrous powers.

children.text: āsmai rīyante nivaneva sindhavo 'smā ahne bhavati tat patitvanam ||
children.translated_text: Toward this one they stream like rivers into a hollow; for this day that lordly power comes to him.

children.text: jīvaṃ rudanti vi mayante adhvare dīrghām anu prasitiṃ dīdhiyur naraḥ
children.translated_text: They weep over the living one; at the sacrifice the men shape and discern the long course ahead.

children.text: vāmam pitṛbhyo ya idaṃ sam erire mayaḥ patibhyo janayaḥ pariṣvaje ||
children.translated_text: The women have set this lovely thing in motion for the fathers, happiness for their husbands, for an embrace.

children.text: na tasya vidma tad u ṣu pra vocata yuvā ha yad yuvatyāḥ kṣeti yoniṣu
children.translated_text: We do not know that of him; now declare it plainly, how the young man dwells in the wombs of the young woman.

children.text: priyosriyasya vṛṣabhasya retino gṛhaṃ gamemāśvinā tad uśmasi ||
children.translated_text: We desire to reach that house, O <s>Aśvins</s>, of the dear, ruddy, seed-bearing bull.

children.text: ā vām agan sumatir vājinīvasū ny aśvinā hṛtsu kāmā ayaṃsata
children.translated_text: Your good favor has come to us, O rich-in-prizes ones; O <s>Aśvins</s>, these desires have settled down in our hearts.

children.text: abhūtaṃ gopā mithunā śubhas patī priyā aryamṇo duryāṃ aśīmahi ||
children.translated_text: You have become herdsmen, a pair, lords of beauty; may we attain the dear dwelling of <s>Aryaman</s>.

children.text: tā mandasānā manuṣo duroṇa ā dhattaṃ rayiṃ sahavīraṃ vacasyave
children.translated_text: Rejoicing in the dwellings of <s>Manu</s>, place wealth with heroic men for the one who praises,

children.text: kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ suprapāṇaṃ śubhas patī sthāṇum patheṣṭhām apa durmatiṃ hatam ||
children.translated_text: make a ford easy to cross and easy to drink from, O lords of beauty; strike away ill will, the post standing in the paths.

children.text: kva svid adya katamāsv aśvinā vikṣu dasrā mādayete śubhas patī
children.translated_text: Where today, in which settlements, O <s>Aśvins</s>, O wonder-workers, lords of beauty, do you delight?

children.text: ka īṃ ni yeme katamasya jagmatur viprasya vā yajamānasya vā gṛham ||
children.translated_text: Who has held them back? To whose house have they gone, to that of which inspired priest or of which sacrificer?

children.text: Chapter 878
samānam u tyam puruhūtam ukthyaṃ rathaṃ tricakraṃ savanā ganigmatam
children.translated_text: Come to that same much-invoked, praise-worthy, three-wheeled chariot at the <s>soma</s>-pressings,

children.text: parijmānaṃ vidathyaṃ suvṛktibhir vayaṃ vyuṣṭā uṣaso havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: the wide-ranging, rite-worthy one; at the dawning of the dawns we call it with well-spoken hymns.

children.text: prātaryujaṃ nāsatyādhi tiṣṭhathaḥ prātaryāvāṇam madhuvāhanaṃ ratham
children.translated_text: You two mount the morning-yoked chariot, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, the morning-going chariot that carries honey.

children.text: viśo yena gacchatho yajvarīr narā kīreś cid yajñaṃ hotṛmantam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: By it you go among the sacrificing peoples, O men, even to the sacrifice furnished with a hotṛ, O <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: adhvaryuṃ vā madhupāṇiṃ suhastyam agnidhaṃ vā dhṛtadakṣaṃ damūnasam
children.translated_text: Whether you go to the adhvaryu with honeyed hands and skillful fingers, or to the fire-kindler, firm in skill and attentive to the house,

children.text: viprasya vā yat savanāni gacchatho 'ta ā yātam madhupeyam aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: or to the pressings of the inspired priest, from there come here, O <s>Aśvins</s>, for the honey-drink.

children.text: Chapter 879
asteva su prataraṃ lāyam asyan bhūṣann iva pra bharā stomam asmai
children.translated_text: Like an archer shooting a shaft farther on, like one adorning, carry forward the hymn for him.

children.text: vācā viprās tarata vācam aryo ni rāmaya jaritaḥ soma indram ||
children.translated_text: O inspired priests, with speech overcome the speech of the hostile man; O singer, with <s>soma</s> delight <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: dohena gām upa śikṣā sakhāyam pra bodhaya jaritar jāram indram
children.translated_text: With the milking of the cow teach your friend; O singer, awaken <s>Indra</s>, the lover.

children.text: kośaṃ na pūrṇaṃ vasunā nyṛṣṭam ā cyāvaya maghadeyāya śūram ||
children.translated_text: Like a vessel filled with treasure and set down, draw the hero down for the giving of bounty.

children.text: kim aṅga tvā maghavan bhojam āhuḥ śiśīhi mā śiśayaṃ tvā śṛṇomi
children.translated_text: Why indeed do they call you a generous patron, O <s>Maghavan</s>? Sharpen me; I hear that you are one who sharpens.

children.text: apnasvatī mama dhīr astu śakra vasuvidam bhagam indrā bharā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let my inspired thought be rich in reward, O <s>Śakra</s>; O <s>Indra</s>, bring us fortune that finds wealth.

children.text: tvāṃ janā mamasatyeṣv indra saṃtasthānā vi hvayante samīke
children.translated_text: People standing firm call loudly to you, O <s>Indra</s>, in my contests, in the clash of battle.

children.text: atrā yujaṃ kṛṇute yo haviṣmān nāsunvatā sakhyaṃ vaṣṭi śūraḥ ||
children.translated_text: There the man with oblation makes you his ally; the hero does not desire friendship with one who presses no <s>soma</s>.

children.text: dhanaṃ na syandram bahulaṃ yo asmai tīvrān somāṁ ā sunoti prayasvān
children.translated_text: Like flowing, abundant wealth is the zealous man who presses strong <s>somas</s> for him.

children.text: tasmai śatrūn sutukān prātar ahno ni svaṣṭrān yuvati hanti vṛtram ||
children.translated_text: For him, early in the morning, he casts down well-struck enemies; the young one slays <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: yasmin vayaṃ dadhimā śaṃsam indre yaḥ śiśrāya maghavā kāmam asme
children.translated_text: In <s>Indra</s> we have placed our praise, in the bounteous one who has lodged our desire within himself.

children.text: ārāc cit san bhayatām asya śatrur ny asmai dyumnā janyā namantām ||
children.translated_text: Though far away, let his enemy be afraid of him; let the born powers bow down before him.

children.text: ārāc chatrum apa bādhasva dūram ugro yaḥ śambaḥ puruhūta tena
children.translated_text: Drive the enemy away, far off into the distance, O fierce one; with that strength, O much-invoked one,

children.text: asme dhehi yavamad gomad indra kṛdhī dhiyaṃ jaritre vājaratnām ||
children.translated_text: place barley and cattle among us, O <s>Indra</s>; make inspired thought rich in prizes for the singer.

children.text: pra yam antar vṛṣasavāso agman tīvrāḥ somā bahulāntāsa indram
children.translated_text: When the strong-pressed, sharp <s>somas</s>, abundant to the brim, have entered <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: nāha dāmānam maghavā ni yaṃsan ni sunvate vahati bhūri vāmam ||
children.translated_text: the bounteous one does not restrain the giver; for the one who presses <s>soma</s> he carries much desirable wealth.

children.text: uta prahām ati dīvyā jayāti kṛtaṃ yac chvaghnī vicinoti kāle
children.translated_text: And he wins even beyond the gambler's throw, when the dice-player chooses the winning cast at the proper time.

children.text: yo devakāmo na dhanā ruṇaddhi sam it taṃ rāyā sṛjati svadhāvān ||
children.translated_text: For the god-loving man who does not hold back wealth, the self-powered one pours forth riches all together.

children.text: gobhiṣ ṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudham puruhūta viśvām
children.translated_text: With cattle may we cross over this evil-minded want, and with barley all hunger, O much-invoked one.

children.text: vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanāny asmākena vṛjanenā jayema ||
children.translated_text: With kings may we win the foremost prizes, with our own company.

children.text: bṛhaspatir naḥ pari pātu paścād utottarasmād adharād aghāyoḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Bṛhaspati</s> protect us from behind, and also from the north and from below, from the harmful one.

children.text: indraḥ purastād uta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, from the front and also from the middle, as a friend make broad room for his friends.

children.text: Chapter 880
acchā ma indram matayaḥ svarvidaḥ sadhrīcīr viśvā uśatīr anūṣata
children.translated_text: My thoughts, finding the light, all moving together and eager, have sung toward <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: pari ṣvajante janayo yathā patim maryaṃ na śundhyum maghavānam ūtaye ||
children.translated_text: They embrace the bounteous one for aid, as women embrace a husband, a handsome youth.

children.text: na ghā tvadrig apa veti me manas tve it kāmam puruhūta śiśraya
children.translated_text: My mind does not go away from one like you; on you alone, O much-invoked one, I have set my desire.

children.text: rājeva dasma ni ṣado 'dhi barhiṣy asmin su some 'vapānam astu te ||
children.translated_text: Like a king, O wondrous one, sit down upon the sacred grass; at this good <s>soma</s> let your drinking-place be here.

children.text: viṣūvṛd indro amater uta kṣudhaḥ sa id rāyo maghavā vasva īśate
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is the overcomer of want and also of hunger; that bounteous one alone rules riches and wealth.

children.text: tasyed ime pravaṇe sapta sindhavo vayo vardhanti vṛṣabhasya śuṣmiṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For him these seven rivers in the lowland increase the vigor of the mighty bull.

children.text: vayo na vṛkṣaṃ supalāśam āsadan somāsa indram mandinaś camūṣadaḥ
children.translated_text: Like birds settling on a well-leafed tree, the exhilarating <s>somas</s> have sat down in the cup for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: praiṣām anīkaṃ śavasā davidyutad vidat svar manave jyotir āryam ||
children.translated_text: Their front flashed with might; he found the sun, the noble light, for <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: kṛtaṃ na śvaghnī vi cinoti devane saṃvargaṃ yan maghavā sūryaṃ jayat
children.translated_text: Like a gambler choosing the winning throw in play, when <s>Maghavan</s> won the gathered sun,

children.text: na tat te anyo anu vīryaṃ śakan na purāṇo maghavan nota nūtanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: no other, O <s>Maghavan</s>, neither ancient nor new, could match that heroic deed of yours.

children.text: viśaṃ viśam maghavā pary aśāyata janānāṃ dhenā ava cākaśad vṛṣā
children.translated_text: <s>Maghavan</s> has lain around clan after clan; the bull has made the voices of men shine forth.

children.text: yasyāha śakraḥ savaneṣu raṇyati sa tīvraiḥ somaiḥ sahate pṛtanyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: The one whom <s>Śakra</s> gladdens at the pressings withstands the fighter by means of the sharp <s>somas</s>.

children.text: āpo na sindhum abhi yat sam akṣaran somāsa indraṃ kulyā iva hradam
children.translated_text: As waters flow together toward the river, the <s>somas</s> flow toward <s>Indra</s>, like channels into a pool.

children.text: vardhanti viprā maho asya sādane yavaṃ na vṛṣṭir divyena dānunā ||
children.translated_text: The inspired priests increase at the great one's seat, as rain increases barley with its heavenly gift.

children.text: vṛṣā na kruddhaḥ patayad rajassv ā yo aryapatnīr akṛṇod imā apaḥ
children.translated_text: Like an angry bull he flew through the spaces, he who made these waters the wives of the noble one.

children.text: sa sunvate maghavā jīradānave 'vindaj jyotir manave haviṣmate ||
children.translated_text: For the <s>soma</s>-presser, for the swift giver, <s>Maghavan</s> found the light for <s>Manu</s>, the oblation-bearer.

children.text: uj jāyatām paraśur jyotiṣā saha bhūyā ṛtasya sudughā purāṇavat
children.translated_text: Let the axe rise up together with the light; may the milch-cow of <s>ṛta</s> be abundant as of old.

children.text: vi rocatām aruṣo bhānunā śuciḥ svar ṇa śukraṃ śuśucīta satpatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the ruddy one shine forth with his pure radiance; may the bright lord of good people shine like the sun.

children.text: gobhiṣ ṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudham puruhūta viśvām
children.translated_text: By cows may we cross over this evil-mindedness, and by barley all hunger, O much-invoked one.

children.text: vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanāny asmākena vṛjanenā jayema ||
children.translated_text: May we be foremost with kings in winning riches; may we conquer with our own troop.

children.text: bṛhaspatir naḥ pari pātu paścād utottarasmād adharād aghāyoḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Bṛhaspati</s> protect us from behind, and also from the north and from below, from the harm-doer;

children.text: indraḥ purastād uta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Indra</s> protect us from the front and from the middle; as a friend, may he make wide room for his friends.

children.text: Chapter 881
ā yātv indraḥ svapatir madāya yo dharmaṇā tūtujānas tuviṣmān
children.translated_text: Let <s>Indra</s>, good lord, come for exhilaration, he who, mighty, is urged on according to sacred order;

children.text: pratvakṣāṇo ati viśvā sahāṃsy apāreṇa mahatā vṛṣṇyena ||
children.translated_text: striking forward, he surpasses all powers with boundless and great virility.

children.text: suṣṭhāmā rathaḥ suyamā harī te mimyakṣa vajro nṛpate gabhastau
children.translated_text: Your chariot is firmly set, your two bay horses are well-reined; the <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt), O lord of men, is fixed in your hand.

children.text: śībhaṃ rājan supathā yāhy arvāṅ vardhāma te papuṣo vṛṣṇyāni ||
children.translated_text: Swiftly, O king, come here by the good path; when you have drunk, let us magnify your virile powers.

children.text: endravāho nṛpatiṃ vajrabāhum ugram ugrāsas taviṣāsa enam
children.translated_text: Let the fierce, powerful bearers bring here the lord of men, the <s>vajra</s>-armed, terrible one,

children.text: pratvakṣasaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ satyaśuṣmam em asmatrā sadhamādo vahantu ||
children.translated_text: the forward-striking bull of true force, to us for shared exhilaration.

children.text: evā patiṃ droṇasācaṃ sacetasam ūrja skambhaṃ dharuṇa ā vṛṣāyase
children.translated_text: Thus, O bull, you desire the lord who is companion of the Soma trough, mindful, the support of nourishment in the foundation.

children.text: ojaḥ kṛṣva saṃ gṛbhāya tve apy aso yathā kenipānām ino vṛdhe ||
children.translated_text: Make strength; seize it together. In you there are powers, so that you may grow as lord of those who pour.

children.text: gamann asme vasūny ā hi śaṃsiṣaṃ svāśiṣam bharam ā yāhi sominaḥ
children.translated_text: Let riches come to us. Come to the praised one, bearing a good blessing; come to the Soma-presser.

children.text: tvam īśiṣe sāsminn ā satsi barhiṣy anādhṛṣyā tava pātrāṇi dharmaṇā ||
children.translated_text: You are lord; sit on this <s>barhis</s> (sacrificial grass). By sacred order your vessels are unassailable.

children.text: pṛthak prāyan prathamā devahūtayo 'kṛṇvata śravasyāni duṣṭarā
children.translated_text: The first invocations of the gods went forth separately; they made renowned deeds hard to cross.

children.text: na ye śekur yajñiyāṃ nāvam āruham īrmaiva te ny aviśanta kepayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those worshipful ones who could not board the sacrificial ship sank down like the lame in a flood.

children.text: evaivāpāg apare santu dūḍhyo 'śvā yeṣāṃ duryuja ā yuyujre
children.translated_text: So let the later, foolish enemies be far away, those whose badly yoked horses have been yoked;

children.text: itthā ye prāg upare santi dāvane purūṇi yatra vayunāni bhojanā ||
children.translated_text: but let those who stand foremost nearby come for giving, where there are many insights and enjoyments.

children.text: girīṃr ajrān rejamānāṁ adhārayad dyauḥ krandad antarikṣāṇi kopayat
children.translated_text: He held up the mountains and the plains as they trembled; heaven roared and he shook the midspaces.

children.text: samīcīne dhiṣaṇe vi ṣkabhāyati vṛṣṇaḥ pītvā mada ukthāni śaṃsati ||
children.translated_text: He props apart the two matching bowls; having drunk the bull's exhilaration, he recites the hymns.

children.text: imam bibharmi sukṛtaṃ te aṅkuśaṃ yenārujāsi maghavañchaphārujaḥ
children.translated_text: I bear this well-made hook of yours, by which, O bountiful one, you break open the hoof-breaking foes.

children.text: asmin su te savane astv okyaṃ suta iṣṭau maghavan bodhy ābhagaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In this pressing let there be a dwelling for you; the Soma has been pressed. At the rite, O bountiful one, be awake and take your share.

children.text: gobhiṣ ṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudham puruhūta viśvām
children.translated_text: By cows may we cross over this evil-mindedness, and by barley all hunger, O much-invoked one.

children.text: vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanāny asmākena vṛjanenā jayema ||
children.translated_text: May we be foremost with kings in winning riches; may we conquer with our own troop.

children.text: bṛhaspatir naḥ pari pātu paścād utottarasmād adharād aghāyoḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Bṛhaspati</s> protect us from behind, and also from the north and from below, from the harm-doer;

children.text: indraḥ purastād uta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Indra</s> protect us from the front and from the middle; as a friend, may he make wide room for his friends.

children.text: Chapter 882
divas pari prathamaṃ jajñe agnir asmad dvitīyam pari jātavedāḥ
children.translated_text: From heaven <s>Agni</s> was first born; from us <s>Jātavedas</s> was born a second time.

children.text: tṛtīyam apsu nṛmaṇā ajasram indhāna enaṃ jarate svādhīḥ ||
children.translated_text: A third time, within the waters, man-minded and unceasing, the devout one kindles him and praises him.

children.text: vidmā te agne tredhā trayāṇi vidmā te dhāma vibhṛtā purutrā
children.translated_text: We know your threefold, three forms, O <s>Agni</s>; we know your stations, spread out in many places.

children.text: vidmā te nāma paramaṃ guhā yad vidmā tam utsaṃ yata ājagantha ||
children.translated_text: We know your highest name, which is hidden; we know that source from which you came.

children.text: samudre tvā nṛmaṇā apsv antar nṛcakṣā īdhe divo agna ūdhan
children.translated_text: The man-minded, man-seeing one kindled you in the sea, within the waters, O <s>Agni</s>, in the udder of heaven.

children.text: tṛtīye tvā rajasi tasthivāṃsam apām upasthe mahiṣā avardhan ||
children.translated_text: The mighty ones strengthened you, standing in the third realm, in the lap of the waters.

children.text: akrandad agni stanayann iva dyauḥ kṣāmā rerihad vīrudhaḥ samañjan
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> cried out, thundering like heaven, licking the earth and anointing the plants.

children.text: sadyo jajñāno vi hīm iddho akhyad ā rodasī bhānunā bhāty antaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Just born, when kindled, he immediately shone forth; between the two worlds he shines with his radiance.

children.text: śrīṇām udāro dharuṇo rayīṇām manīṣāṇām prārpaṇaḥ somagopāḥ
children.translated_text: Liberal among splendors, support of riches, furtherer of inspired thoughts, guardian of <s>Soma</s>,

children.text: vasuḥ sūnuḥ sahaso apsu rājā vi bhāty agra uṣasām idhānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the good one, son of strength, king in the waters, shines forth before the dawns when kindled.

children.text: viśvasya ketur bhuvanasya garbha ā rodasī apṛṇāj jāyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: The beacon of all, the embryo of the world, as he was born he filled both heaven and earth.

children.text: vīḍuṃ cid adrim abhinat parāyañ janā yad agnim ayajanta pañca ||
children.translated_text: Going forth, he split even the firm rock, when the five peoples worshipped <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: uśik pāvako aratiḥ sumedhā marteṣv agnir amṛto ni dhāyi
children.translated_text: Eager, purifying, a messenger, wise, immortal <s>Agni</s> was set among mortals.

children.text: iyarti dhūmam aruṣam bharibhrad uc chukreṇa śociṣā dyām inakṣan ||
children.translated_text: He lifts up tawny smoke, bearing it aloft, and with his bright flame he reaches the sky.

children.text: dṛśāno rukma urviyā vy adyaud durmarṣam āyuḥ śriye rucānaḥ
children.translated_text: Visible like gold, he has shone widely; an unassailable life, he gleams for beauty.

children.text: agnir amṛto abhavad vayobhir yad enaṃ dyaur janayat suretāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, immortal, came into being with vital powers, when well-seeded heaven generated him.

children.text: yas te adya kṛṇavad bhadraśoce 'pūpaṃ deva ghṛtavantam agne
children.translated_text: Whoever today, O god <s>Agni</s> of auspicious flame, makes for you a ghee-filled cake,

children.text: pra taṃ naya prataraṃ vasyo acchābhi sumnaṃ devabhaktaṃ yaviṣṭha ||
children.translated_text: lead him onward toward better wealth; turn your favor toward the god-devoted man, O youngest one.

children.text: ā tam bhaja sauśravaseṣv agna uktha uktha ā bhaja śasyamāne
children.translated_text: Share with him in good renown, O <s>Agni</s>; share in each hymn as it is being praised.

children.text: priyaḥ sūrye priyo agnā bhavāty uj jātena bhinadad uj janitvaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: He becomes dear in the sun and dear in <s>Agni</s>; by birth and by begettings he breaks upward.

children.text: tvām agne yajamānā anu dyūn viśvā vasu dadhire vāryāṇi
children.translated_text: Day after day, O <s>Agni</s>, worshippers have placed all desirable treasures in you.

children.text: tvayā saha draviṇam icchamānā vrajaṃ gomantam uśijo vi vavruḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeking wealth together with you, the <s>Uśij</s>s opened the cattle-filled pen.

children.text: astāvy agnir narāṃ suśevo vaiśvānara ṛṣibhiḥ somagopāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s>, kind to men and guardian of <s>Soma</s>, has been praised by the seers.

children.text: adveṣe dyāvāpṛthivī huvema devā dhatta rayim asme suvīram ||
children.translated_text: Without hatred let us call upon <s>Heaven-and-Earth</s>; O gods, place in us wealth rich in good heroes.

children.text: Chapter 883
pra hotā jāto mahān nabhovin nṛṣadvā sīdad apām upasthe
children.translated_text: The great <s>hotṛ</s> (invoking priest) was born, knower of the firmament; dwelling among men, he sat in the lap of the waters.

children.text: dadhir yo dhāyi sa te vayāṃsi yantā vasūni vidhate tanūpāḥ ||
children.translated_text: He who was placed there as a support, protector of the body, directs the vital powers and goods for the worshipper.

children.text: imaṃ vidhanto apāṃ sadhasthe paśuṃ na naṣṭam padair anu gman
children.translated_text: Worshipping this one in the seat of the waters, they followed his tracks like those of a lost beast.

children.text: guhā catantam uśijo namobhir icchanto dhīrā bhṛgavo 'vindan ||
children.translated_text: The wise <s>Bhṛgus</s>, the <s>Uśij</s>s, seeking him with homage, found him hidden and moving in secret.

children.text: imaṃ trito bhūry avindad icchan vaibhūvaso mūrdhany aghnyāyāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Trita</s>, desiring greatly, found this one on the head of the cow of <s>Vaibhūvasu</s>.

children.text: sa śevṛdho jāta ā harmyeṣu nābhir yuvā bhavati rocanasya ||
children.translated_text: Born and increasing welfare, he becomes in the houses the young navel of the shining realm.

children.text: mandraṃ hotāram uśijo namobhiḥ prāñcaṃ yajñaṃ netāram adhvarāṇām
children.translated_text: With acts of homage the <s>Uśij</s>s made him the pleasing Hotar, the forward-leading guide of the sacrifice and of the rites,

children.text: viśām akṛṇvann aratim pāvakaṃ havyavāhaṃ dadhato mānuṣeṣu ||
children.translated_text: the guest of the clans, the purifier, the oblation-bearer, establishing him among human beings.

children.text: pra bhūr jayantam mahāṃ vipodhāṃ mūrā amūram purāṃ darmāṇam
children.translated_text: They led forward the great conquering one, rich in insight, the unfoolish breaker of strongholds,

children.text: nayanto garbhaṃ vanāṃ dhiyaṃ dhur hiriśmaśruṃ nārvāṇaṃ dhanarcam ||
children.translated_text: the embryo of the woods; they set up the thought, golden-bearded, like a swift horse, winning wealth.

children.text: ni pastyāsu trita stabhūyan parivīto yonau sīdad antaḥ
children.translated_text: In the dwellings <s>Trita</s>, grown strong, sat within, enclosed in the womb.

children.text: ataḥ saṃgṛbhyā viśāṃ damūnā vidharmaṇāyantrair īyate nṝn ||
children.translated_text: From there, gathering the clans, the household lord goes among men by ordinances and guiding reins.

children.text: asyājarāso damām aritrā arcaddhūmāso agnayaḥ pāvakāḥ
children.translated_text: His ageless, pure fires are set in the houses like oars, with smoke as their flame.

children.text: śvitīcayaḥ śvātrāso bhuraṇyavo vanarṣado vāyavo na somāḥ ||
children.translated_text: White-rayed, swift, and active, sitting in the woods, they are like winds, like pressed <s>Somas</s>.

children.text: pra jihvayā bharate vepo agniḥ pra vayunāni cetasā pṛthivyāḥ
children.translated_text: With his tongue <s>Agni</s> bears the quivering flame; with his mind he brings forth the insights of the earth.

children.text: tam āyavaḥ śucayantam pāvakam mandraṃ hotāraṃ dadhire yajiṣṭham ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Āyus</s> placed him there, shining and pure, the pleasing Hotar, most fit for sacrifice.

children.text: dyāvā yam agnim pṛthivī janiṣṭām āpas tvaṣṭā bhṛgavo yaṃ sahobhiḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Heaven</s> and <s>Earth</s> gave birth to that <s>Agni</s>; the waters, <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, and the <s>Bhṛgus</s> fashioned him with their powers.

children.text: īḍenyam prathamam mātariśvā devās tatakṣur manave yajatram ||
children.translated_text: <s>Mātariśvan</s> and the gods fashioned him first, worthy of praise, for <s>Manu</s>, as one fit to be worshipped.

children.text: yaṃ tvā devā dadhire havyavāham puruspṛho mānuṣāso yajatram
children.translated_text: You whom the gods made the oblation-bearer, whom men much desire, worthy of worship,

children.text: sa yāmann agne stuvate vayo dhāḥ pra devayan yaśasaḥ saṃ hi pūrvīḥ ||
children.translated_text: at the journey, O <s>Agni</s>, give strength to the one who praises; going toward the gods, gather many glories of old.

children.text: Chapter 884
jagṛbhmā te dakṣiṇam indra hastaṃ vasūyavo vasupate vasūnām
children.translated_text: We have grasped your right hand, O <s>Indra</s>, desiring wealth, O lord of goods and of riches.

children.text: vidmā hi tvā gopatiṃ śūra gonām asmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: For we know you as lord of cows, O hero, guardian of cattle; give us splendid, virile wealth.

children.text: svāyudhaṃ svavasaṃ sunīthaṃ catuḥsamudraṃ dharuṇaṃ rayīṇām
children.translated_text: Self-armed, self-powerful, well-guiding, reaching the four seas, foundation of riches,

children.text: carkṛtyaṃ śaṃsyam bhūrivāram asmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: to be celebrated and praised, rich in many gifts: give us splendid, virile wealth.

children.text: subrahmāṇaṃ devavantam bṛhantam uruṃ gabhīram pṛthubudhnam indra
children.translated_text: Rich in sacred utterance, accompanied by gods, great, wide, deep, and broad-based, O <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: śrutaṛṣim ugram abhimātiṣāham asmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: famed among seers, fierce, overcoming hostile assaults: give us splendid, virile wealth.

children.text: sanadvājaṃ vipravīraṃ tarutraṃ dhanaspṛtaṃ śūśuvāṃsaṃ sudakṣam
children.translated_text: Ever victorious, rich in inspired heroes, overcoming, eager for prize, swelling and skillful,

children.text: dasyuhanam pūrbhidam indra satyam asmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: slayer of <s>Dasyus</s>, fort-breaker, true <s>Indra</s>: give us splendid, virile wealth.

children.text: aśvāvantaṃ rathinaṃ vīravantaṃ sahasriṇaṃ śatinaṃ vājam indra
children.translated_text: Rich in horses, chariots, and heroes, possessing thousands and hundreds, a prize, O <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: bhadravrātaṃ vipravīraṃ svarṣām asmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: with blessed host, inspired heroes, and winning the sun: give us splendid, virile wealth.

children.text: pra saptagum ṛtadhītiṃ sumedhām bṛhaspatim matir acchā jigāti
children.translated_text: My thought goes forth to <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, rich in seven cows, true-minded, wise,

children.text: ya āṅgiraso namasopasadyo 'smabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Āṅgirasa</s> who is to be approached with homage: give us splendid, virile wealth.

children.text: vanīvāno mama dūtāsa indraṃ stomāś caranti sumatīr iyānāḥ
children.translated_text: My desiring messengers, the hymns, go to <s>Indra</s>, seeking his favor,

children.text: hṛdispṛśo manasā vacyamānā asmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: touching the heart and being spoken with the mind: give us splendid, virile wealth.

children.text: yat tvā yāmi daddhi tan na indra bṛhantaṃ kṣayam asamaṃ janānām
children.translated_text: What I ask of you, O <s>Indra</s>, grant that to us: a great dwelling, unequalled among peoples.

children.text: abhi tad dyāvāpṛthivī gṛṇītām asmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> proclaim that aloud: give us splendid, virile wealth.

children.text: Chapter 885
aham bhuvaṃ vasunaḥ pūrvyas patir ahaṃ dhanāni saṃ jayāmi śaśvataḥ
children.translated_text: I became the ancient lord of wealth; I continually win treasures.

children.text: māṃ havante pitaraṃ na jantavo 'haṃ dāśuṣe vi bhajāmi bhojanam ||
children.translated_text: Creatures call on me as on a father; I distribute food to the worshipper.

children.text: aham indro rodho vakṣo atharvaṇas tritāya gā ajanayam aher adhi
children.translated_text: I am <s>Indra</s>; I strengthened the side and breast of <s>Atharvan</s>; I brought forth the cows for <s>Trita</s> from the serpent.

children.text: ahaṃ dasyubhyaḥ pari nṛmṇam ā dade gotrā śikṣan dadhīce mātariśvane ||
children.translated_text: I took manly power away from the <s>Dasyus</s>, teaching the cow-stalls to <s>Dadhīca</s> and <s>Mātariśvan</s>.

children.text: mahyaṃ tvaṣṭā vajram atakṣad āyasam mayi devāso 'vṛjann api kratum
children.translated_text: For me <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> fashioned the iron thunderbolt; in me the gods placed their resolve.

children.text: mamānīkaṃ sūryasyeva duṣṭaram mām āryanti kṛtena kartvena ca ||
children.translated_text: My battle-front is hard to cross, like that of the sun; they come to me with deed and with work accomplished.

children.text: aham etaṃ gavyayam aśvyam paśum purīṣiṇaṃ sāyakenā hiraṇyayam
children.translated_text: I have won this cattle-rich, horse-rich, fattened, golden-hued herd with the arrow.

children.text: purū sahasrā ni śiśāmi dāśuṣe yan mā somāsa ukthino amandiṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: I bestow many thousands on the worshipper, when the hymn-singing <s>Somas</s> have exhilarated me.

children.text: aham indro na parā jigya id dhanaṃ na mṛtyave 'va tasthe kadā cana
children.translated_text: I am <s>Indra</s>; I have never lost wealth, nor have I ever yielded to death.

children.text: somam in mā sunvanto yācatā vasu na me pūravaḥ sakhye riṣāthana ||
children.translated_text: Press <s>Soma</s> for me and ask for wealth; do not, O <s>Pūrus</s>, come to harm in friendship with me.

children.text: aham etāñchāśvasato dvā dvendraṃ ye vajraṃ yudhaye 'kṛṇvata
children.translated_text: I struck those two who were boasting, those who made a thunderbolt for battle against <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: āhvayamānāṁ ava hanmanāhanaṃ dṛḍhā vadann anamasyur namasvinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When they challenged me, I smote them blow upon blow; though firm and arrogant, the proud became submissive.

children.text: abhīdam ekam eko asmi niṣṣāḍ abhī dvā kim u trayaḥ karanti
children.translated_text: Against this one alone, I alone am victorious; against two also; what can three do?

children.text: khale na parṣān prati hanmi bhūri kim mā nindanti śatravo 'nindrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like grain on a threshing floor I beat down the many; why do the non-<s>Indra</s> foes revile me?

children.text: ahaṃ guṅgubhyo atithigvam iṣkaram iṣaṃ na vṛtraturaṃ vikṣu dhārayam
children.translated_text: I made food for <s>Guṅgu</s> and <s>Atithigva</s>; I sustained nourishment among the clans, overcoming obstruction.

children.text: yat parṇayaghna uta vā karañjahe prāham mahe vṛtrahatye aśuśravi ||
children.translated_text: When, for <s>Parṇayaghna</s> or for <s>Karañjaha</s>, I became renowned for the great slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: pra me namī sāpya iṣe bhuje bhūd gavām eṣe sakhyā kṛṇuta dvitā
children.translated_text: For me <s>Namī Sāpya</s> became ready for food and enjoyment; in search of cows, make friendship with him in twofold form.

children.text: didyuṃ yad asya samitheṣu maṃhayam ād id enaṃ śaṃsyam ukthyaṃ karam ||
children.translated_text: When I magnified his missile in the battles, then I made him praiseworthy and worthy of hymn.

children.text: pra nemasmin dadṛśe somo antar gopā nemam āvir asthā kṛṇoti
children.translated_text: In this one <s>Soma</s> has appeared forth within; the guardian makes this one stand manifest.

children.text: sa tigmaśṛṅgaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ yuyutsan druhas tasthau bahule baddho antaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Desiring to fight, the sharp-horned bull stood fast against deceit, bound within the broad enclosure.

children.text: ādityānāṃ vasūnāṃ rudriyāṇāṃ devo devānāṃ na mināmi dhāma
children.translated_text: I do not diminish the domain of the <s>Ādityas</s>, the <s>Vasus</s>, or the <s>Rudriyas</s>, a god among gods.

children.text: te mā bhadrāya śavase tatakṣur aparājitam astṛtam aṣāḍham ||
children.translated_text: They fashioned me for auspicious might, unconquered, unhurt, and not to be overcome.

children.text: Chapter 886
ahaṃ dāṃ gṛṇate pūrvyaṃ vasv aham brahma kṛṇavam mahyaṃ vardhanam
children.translated_text: I give ancient wealth to the singer; I make sacred utterance for my own increase.

children.text: aham bhuvaṃ yajamānasya coditāyajvanaḥ sākṣi viśvasmin bhare ||
children.translated_text: I became the impeller of the sacrificer, a witness against the non-sacrificer in every contest.

children.text: māṃ dhur indraṃ nāma devatā divaś ca gmaś cāpāṃ ca jantavaḥ
children.translated_text: Creatures of heaven, earth, and the waters have set upon me the divine name <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: ahaṃ harī vṛṣaṇā vivratā raghū ahaṃ vajraṃ śavase dhṛṣṇv ā dade ||
children.translated_text: I set loose the two bay steeds, the virile and swift ones; I take up the thunderbolt for might with boldness.

children.text: aham atkaṃ kavaye śiśnathaṃ hathair ahaṃ kutsam āvam ābhir ūtibhiḥ
children.translated_text: I shattered <s>Atka</s> for the seer with blows; I aided <s>Kutsa</s> with these protections.

children.text: ahaṃ śuṣṇasya śnathitā vadhar yamaṃ na yo rara āryaṃ nāma dasyave ||
children.translated_text: I am the shatterer of <s>Śuṣṇa</s>; I struck down the destructive restraint, so that he did not hand over the name <s>Ārya</s> to the <s>Dasyu</s>.

children.text: aham piteva vetasūṃr abhiṣṭaye tugraṃ kutsāya smadibhaṃ ca randhayam
children.translated_text: Like a father, for aid, I subdued the <s>Vetasus</s>, and for <s>Kutsa</s> I subdued <s>Tugra</s> and <s>Smadibha</s>.

children.text: aham bhuvaṃ yajamānasya rājani pra yad bhare tujaye na priyādhṛṣe ||
children.translated_text: I became lordly for the sacrificer, when I came forward in the contest, like one irresistible for the pressing battle.

children.text: ahaṃ randhayam mṛgayaṃ śrutarvaṇe yan mājihīta vayunā canānuṣak
children.translated_text: I subdued <s>Mṛgaya</s> for <s>Śrutarvan</s>, when he would not heed any guidance at all.

children.text: ahaṃ veśaṃ namram āyave 'karam ahaṃ savyāya paḍgṛbhim arandhayam ||
children.translated_text: I made <s>Veśa</s> bow down for <s>Āyu</s>; I subdued <s>Paḍgṛbhi</s> for <s>Savya</s>.

children.text: ahaṃ sa yo navavāstvam bṛhadrathaṃ saṃ vṛtreva dāsaṃ vṛtrahārujam
children.translated_text: I am he who, as the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, crushed <s>Navavāstva Bṛhadratha</s>, the <s>Dāsa</s>, like <s>Vṛtra</s>,

children.text: yad vardhayantam prathayantam ānuṣag dūre pāre rajaso rocanākaram ||
children.translated_text: when he was growing and spreading continuously, making light far beyond the expanse.

children.text: ahaṃ sūryasya pari yāmy āśubhiḥ praitaśebhir vahamāna ojasā
children.translated_text: I go around the sun with the swift ones, carried by the steeds of <s>Etaśa</s> with power.

children.text: yan mā sāvo manuṣa āha nirṇija ṛdhak kṛṣe dāsaṃ kṛtvyaṃ hathaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the human Soma-presser called to me at the cleansing, I set apart the <s>Dāsa</s> to be dealt with by blows.

children.text: ahaṃ saptahā nahuṣo nahuṣṭaraḥ prāśrāvayaṃ śavasā turvaśaṃ yadum
children.translated_text: I, the sevenfold smiter, stronger than the <s>Nahuṣas</s>, by my might made <s>Turvaśa</s> and <s>Yadu</s> renowned.

children.text: ahaṃ ny anyaṃ sahasā sahas karaṃ nava vrādhato navatiṃ ca vakṣayam ||
children.translated_text: With force I struck down another, a doer of violence, and the nine and ninety who were swelling up.

children.text: ahaṃ sapta sravato dhārayaṃ vṛṣā dravitnvaḥ pṛthivyāṃ sīrā adhi
children.translated_text: I, the bull, held the seven streaming channels, the running veins upon the earth.

children.text: aham arṇāṃsi vi tirāmi sukratur yudhā vidam manave gātum iṣṭaye ||
children.translated_text: I, of good resolve, spread out the floods; in battle, for the desired aim, I found a path for <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: ahaṃ tad āsu dhārayaṃ yad āsu na devaś cana tvaṣṭādhārayad ruśat
children.translated_text: I held in those places what even the god <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> had not held there, the shining desirable thing.

children.text: spārhaṃ gavām ūdhassu vakṣaṇāsv ā madhor madhu śvātryaṃ somam āśiram ||
children.translated_text: In the udders and bellies of the cows was the honey of honey, the refreshing Soma mixed with milk.

children.text: evā devāṁ indro vivye nṝn pra cyautnena maghavā satyarādhāḥ
children.translated_text: Thus <s>Indra</s>, <s>Maghavan</s>, true in bounty, encompassed gods and men by his impelling power.

children.text: viśvet tā te harivaḥ śacīvo 'bhi turāsaḥ svayaśo gṛṇanti ||
children.translated_text: All those deeds of yours, O bay-horsed and powerful one, the bold, self-renowned men praise.

children.text: Chapter 887
pra vo mahe mandamānāyāndhaso 'rcā viśvānarāya viśvābhuve
children.translated_text: Sing forth for the great one, exhilarated by the Soma draught, for <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, the all-creating one,

children.text: indrasya yasya sumakhaṃ saho mahi śravo nṛmṇaṃ ca rodasī saparyataḥ ||
children.translated_text: for <s>Indra</s>, whose well-offered mighty strength, fame, and manly power <s>Heaven-and-Earth</s> honor.

children.text: so cin nu sakhyā narya ina stutaś carkṛtya indro māvate nare
children.translated_text: That very <s>Indra</s>, the heroic lord, praised through friendship, acts for a man like me.

children.text: viśvāsu dhūrṣu vājakṛtyeṣu satpate vṛtre vāpsv abhi śūra mandase ||
children.translated_text: In all yoke-tasks and prize-winning deeds, O lord of the good, in the fight with <s>Vṛtra</s> and in the waters, O hero, you are exhilarated.

children.text: ke te nara indra ye ta iṣe ye te sumnaṃ sadhanyam iyakṣān
children.translated_text: Who are your men, O <s>Indra</s>, who are yours for power, who seek to win your shared favor?

children.text: ke te vājāyāsuryāya hinvire ke apsu svāsūrvarāsu pauṃsye ||
children.translated_text: Who have urged you on for prize and lordly might, who for manly power in the waters and in the good fields?

children.text: bhuvas tvam indra brahmaṇā mahān bhuvo viśveṣu savaneṣu yajñiyaḥ
children.translated_text: You have become great through sacred formulation, O <s>Indra</s>; you have become worthy of sacrifice at all Soma-pressings.

children.text: bhuvo nṝṃś cyautno viśvasmin bhare jyeṣṭhaś ca mantro viśvacarṣaṇe ||
children.translated_text: You have become the impeller of men in every contest, and the highest inspired word, O lord of all peoples.

children.text: avā nu kaṃ jyāyān yajñavanaso mahīṃ ta omātrāṃ kṛṣṭayo viduḥ
children.translated_text: Now indeed, greater than the winners of sacrifice, the peoples know your great measure.

children.text: aso nu kam ajaro vardhāś ca viśved etā savanā tūtumā kṛṣe ||
children.translated_text: Now indeed you are ageless and growing; all these Soma-pressings you make swell.

children.text: etā viśvā savanā tūtumā kṛṣe svayaṃ sūno sahaso yāni dadhiṣe
children.translated_text: All these Soma-pressings you make swell, O son of strength, which you yourself have established.

children.text: varāya te pātraṃ dharmaṇe tanā yajño mantro brahmodyataṃ vacaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For your chosen vessel, for the established order, the sacrifice, the mantra, the sacred utterance, and the upraised word are stretched forth.

children.text: ye te vipra brahmakṛtaḥ sute sacā vasūnāṃ ca vasunaś ca dāvane
children.translated_text: Those inspired priests, makers of sacred formulation for you at the pressing, are together for the giving of goods and treasure.

children.text: pra te sumnasya manasā pathā bhuvan made sutasya somyasyāndhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: By the path of thought they have come before your favor, in the exhilaration of the pressed Soma draught.

children.text: Chapter 888
mahat tad ulbaṃ sthaviraṃ tad āsīd yenāviṣṭitaḥ praviveśithāpaḥ
children.translated_text: Great was that covering, firm was that by which, once entered into it, you penetrated the waters.

children.text: viśvā apaśyad bahudhā te agne jātavedas tanvo deva ekaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The one god saw all your bodies in many places, O <s>Agni Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: ko mā dadarśa katamaḥ sa devo yo me tanvo bahudhā paryapaśyat
children.translated_text: Who saw me? Which god was he who looked upon my bodies spread in many places?

children.text: kvāha mitrāvaruṇā kṣiyanty agner viśvāḥ samidho devayānīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Where do <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> dwell? Where are all the godward kindlings of <s>Agni</s>?

children.text: aicchāma tvā bahudhā jātavedaḥ praviṣṭam agne apsv oṣadhīṣu
children.translated_text: We sought you in many places, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, O <s>Agni</s>, entered into the waters and the plants.

children.text: taṃ tvā yamo acikec citrabhāno daśāntaruṣyād ati rocamānam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Yama</s> noticed you, O brightly shining one, blazing beyond the ten inner hiding-places.

children.text: hotrād ahaṃ varuṇa bibhyad āyaṃ ned eva mā yunajann atra devāḥ
children.translated_text: From the office of hotar I came away in fear, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, lest the gods yoke me here.

children.text: tasya me tanvo bahudhā niviṣṭā etam arthaṃ na ciketāham agniḥ ||
children.translated_text: These bodies of mine are lodged in many places; I, <s>Agni</s>, did not understand this matter.

children.text: ehi manur devayur yajñakāmo 'raṅkṛtyā tamasi kṣeṣy agne
children.translated_text: Come; <s>Manu</s>, devoted to the gods and desiring sacrifice, has made ready. Will you dwell in darkness, O <s>Agni</s>?

children.text: sugān pathaḥ kṛṇuhi devayānān vaha havyāni sumanasyamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Make easy the paths that lead to the gods; carry the oblations, being well-disposed.

children.text: agneḥ pūrve bhrātaro artham etaṃ rathīvādhvānam anv āvarīvuḥ
children.translated_text: The former brothers of <s>Agni</s>, seeking this purpose, have gone along the road like charioteers on a path.

children.text: tasmād bhiyā varuṇa dūram āyaṃ gauro na kṣepnor avije jyāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, from fear, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, I came far away, like a wild ox avoiding the bowman's shot from the bowstring.

children.text: kurmas ta āyur ajaraṃ yad agne yathā yukto jātavedo na riṣyāḥ
children.translated_text: We shall make your life ageless, O <s>Agni</s>, so that, once yoked, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, you will not be harmed.

children.text: athā vahāsi sumanasyamāno bhāgaṃ devebhyo haviṣaḥ sujāta ||
children.translated_text: Then, well-disposed, you shall carry the share of the oblation to the gods, O well-born one.

children.text: prayājān me anuyājāṃś ca kevalān ūrjasvantaṃ haviṣo datta bhāgam
children.translated_text: Give me the fore-offerings and after-offerings alone, the nourishing share of the oblation.

children.text: ghṛtaṃ cāpāṁ puruṣaṃ cauṣadhīnām agneś ca dīrgham āyur astu devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May there be ghee, the essence of the waters and of the plants, and long life for <s>Agni</s>, O gods.

children.text: tava prayājā anuyājāś ca kevala ūrjasvanto haviṣaḥ santu bhāgāḥ
children.translated_text: Your fore-offerings and after-offerings alone shall be nourishing shares of the oblation.

children.text: tavāgne yajño 'yam astu sarvas tubhyaṃ namantām pradiśaś catasraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Yours, O <s>Agni</s>, let this whole sacrifice be; let the four quarters bow to you.

children.text: Chapter 889
viśve devāḥ śāstana mā yatheha hotā vṛto manavai yan niṣadya
children.translated_text: All gods, instruct me, so that, chosen as hotar here, I may sit for <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: pra me brūta bhāgadheyaṃ yathā vo yena pathā havyam ā vo vahāni ||
children.translated_text: Tell me my allotted share, and the path by which I may carry the oblation to you.

children.text: ahaṃ hotā ny asīdaṃ yajīyān viśve devā maruto mā junanti
children.translated_text: I have sat down as hotar, more fit for sacrifice; all the gods and the <s>Maruts</s> impel me.

children.text: ahar ahar aśvinādhvaryavaṃ vām brahmā samid bhavati sāhutir vām ||
children.translated_text: Day after day, O <s>Aśvins</s>, your adhvaryu officiates; the brahman, the kindling, and the oblation are yours.

children.text: ayaṃ yo hotā kir u sa yamasya kam apy ūhe yat samañjanti devāḥ
children.translated_text: This one, who indeed is the <s>Hotar</s>, him I somehow perceive as belonging to <s>Yama</s>, when the gods make him ready.

children.text: ahar ahar jāyate māsi māsy athā devā dadhire havyavāham ||
children.translated_text: Day after day he is born, month after month; then the gods established him as the oblation-bearer.

children.text: māṃ devā dadhire havyavāham apamluktam bahu kṛcchrā carantam
children.translated_text: The gods established me as the oblation-bearer, though I had slipped away and was passing through many hardships.

children.text: agnir vidvān yajñaṃ naḥ kalpayāti pañcayāmaṃ trivṛtaṃ saptatantum ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s>, knowing, set in order our sacrifice, fivefold, three-formed, and seven-threaded.

children.text: ā vo yakṣy amṛtatvaṃ suvīraṃ yathā vo devā varivaḥ karāṇi
children.translated_text: I will worship immortality for you, rich in heroes, so that, O gods, I may make broad space for you.

children.text: ā bāhvor vajram indrasya dheyām athemā viśvāḥ pṛtanā jayāti ||
children.translated_text: I would place the thunderbolt in the arms of <s>Indra</s>; then may he conquer all these battles.

children.text: trīṇi śatā trī sahasrāṇy agniṃ triṃśac ca devā nava cāsaparyan
children.translated_text: Three hundred, three thousand, and thirty and nine gods worshipped <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: aukṣan ghṛtair astṛṇan barhir asmā ād id dhotāraṃ ny asādayanta ||
children.translated_text: They sprinkled him with ghee, spread the sacred grass for him, and then seated him as <s>Hotar</s>.

children.text: Chapter 890
yam aicchāma manasā so 'yam āgād yajñasya vidvān paruṣaś cikitvān
children.translated_text: The one whom we sought with the mind, this one has come, knowing the sacrifice and discerning its portions.

children.text: sa no yakṣad devatātā yajīyān ni hi ṣatsad antaraḥ pūrvo asmat ||
children.translated_text: May he, most fit for sacrifice, worship for us among the divine powers; for he, the earlier one, shall sit down within before us.

children.text: arādhi hotā niṣadā yajīyān abhi prayāṃsi sudhitāni hi khyat
children.translated_text: The <s>Hotar</s> has succeeded; seated, more fit for sacrifice, let him look upon the well-arranged offerings.

children.text: yajāmahai yajñiyān hanta devāṁ īḍāmahā īḍyāṁ ājyena ||
children.translated_text: Let us sacrifice to the worshipful gods; come now, let us praise the praiseworthy ones with ghee.

children.text: sādhvīm akar devavītiṃ no adya yajñasya jihvām avidāma guhyām
children.translated_text: Today he has made our divine service successful; we have found the secret tongue of the sacrifice.

children.text: sa āyur āgāt surabhir vasāno bhadrām akar devahūtiṃ no adya ||
children.translated_text: He has come to life, clothed in fragrance; today he has made our invocation of the gods auspicious.

children.text: tad adya vācaḥ prathamam masīya yenāsurāṁ abhi devā asāma
children.translated_text: Today may I win the first utterance of speech, by which, with the gods, we may overcome the <s>Asuras</s>.

children.text: ūrjāda uta yajñiyāsaḥ pañca janā mama hotraṃ juṣadhvam ||
children.translated_text: O givers of strength, O worshipful ones, O five peoples, enjoy my office of <s>Hotar</s>.

children.text: pañca janā mama hotraṃ juṣantāṃ gojātā uta ye yajñiyāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the five peoples enjoy my office of <s>Hotar</s>, those born of the cow and those fit for sacrifice.

children.text: pṛthivī naḥ pārthivāt pātv aṃhaso 'ntarikṣaṃ divyāt pātv asmān ||
children.translated_text: May Earth protect us from earthly distress; may the midspace protect us from heavenly distress.

children.text: tantuṃ tanvan rajaso bhānum anv ihi jyotiṣmataḥ patho rakṣa dhiyā kṛtān
children.translated_text: Stretching the thread, follow the light of the airy realm; guard the luminous paths made by inspired thought.

children.text: anulbaṇaṃ vayata joguvām apo manur bhava janayā daivyaṃ janam ||
children.translated_text: Weave it without knots, repeatedly calling upon the waters; become <s>Manu</s>, and generate the divine people.

children.text: akṣānaho nahyatanota somyā iṣkṛṇudhvaṃ raśanā ota piṃśata
children.translated_text: Fasten the axle-bands, stretch them out, O Soma-ones; make the reins, weave them, and adorn them.

children.text: aṣṭāvandhuraṃ vahatābhito rathaṃ yena devāso anayann abhi priyam ||
children.translated_text: Carry on both sides the eight-banded chariot by which the gods brought the beloved one near.

children.text: aśmanvatī rīyate saṃ rabhadhvam ut tiṣṭhata pra taratā sakhāyaḥ
children.translated_text: The stony stream is flowing; hold together, stand up, and cross over, friends.

children.text: atrā jahāma ye asann aśevāḥ śivān vayam ut taremābhi vājān ||
children.translated_text: Here let us leave behind those who are inauspicious; may we cross over to auspicious prizes.

children.text: tvaṣṭā māyā ved apasām apastamo bibhrat pātrā devapānāni śantamā
children.translated_text: <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> knows the wondrous powers, most skilful among craftsmen, bearing vessels most auspicious for the gods' drinking.

children.text: śiśīte nūnam paraśuṃ svāyasaṃ yena vṛścād etaśo brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Now he sharpens the iron axe with which <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> will cut down <s>Etaśa</s>.

children.text: sato nūnaṃ kavayaḥ saṃ śiśīta vāśībhir yābhir amṛtāya takṣatha
children.translated_text: Now, O poets, sharpen the true implements, the chisels with which you fashion for immortality.

children.text: vidvāṃsaḥ padā guhyāni kartana yena devāso amṛtatvam ānaśuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Knowing, make the hidden paths by which the gods attained immortality.

children.text: garbhe yoṣām adadhur vatsam āsany apīcyena manasota jihvayā
children.translated_text: They placed the calf in the womb, in the mouth of the women, with hidden mind and with the tongue.

children.text: sa viśvāhā sumanā yogyā abhi siṣāsanir vanate kāra ij jitim ||
children.translated_text: He, well-disposed at all times, seeking to win what is fit, the singer indeed gains victory.

children.text: Chapter 891
tāṃ su te kīrtim maghavan mahitvā yat tvā bhīte rodasī ahvayetām
children.translated_text: That fame of yours, O <s>Maghavan</s>, is yours through greatness, when the two world-halves, afraid, called upon you.

children.text: prāvo devāṁ ātiro dāsam ojaḥ prajāyai tvasyai yad aśikṣa indra ||
children.translated_text: You protected the gods and overcame the might of the <s>Dāsa</s>; for this offspring you gave instruction, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: yad acaras tanvā vāvṛdhāno balānīndra prabruvāṇo janeṣu
children.translated_text: When you moved about, increasing by your own body, proclaiming your powers among the people, O <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: māyet sā te yāni yuddhāny āhur nādya śatruṃ nanu purā vivitse ||
children.translated_text: that was only your wondrous power; the battles they speak of are not such, for neither today nor before have you found an enemy.

children.text: ka u nu te mahimanaḥ samasyāsmat pūrva ṛṣayo 'ntam āpuḥ
children.translated_text: Who now among the seers before us has reached the limit of your greatness as a whole,

children.text: yan mātaraṃ ca pitaraṃ ca sākam ajanayathās tanvaḥ svāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: when you generated mother and father together from your own body?

children.text: catvāri te asuryāṇi nāmādābhyāni mahiṣasya santi
children.translated_text: Four are your mighty names, inviolable names of the great bull.

children.text: tvam aṅga tāni viśvāni vitse yebhiḥ karmāṇi maghavañ cakartha ||
children.translated_text: You indeed know all those by which you performed your deeds, O <s>Maghavan</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ viśvā dadhiṣe kevalāni yāny āvir yā ca guhā vasūni
children.translated_text: You alone hold all the riches, those that are manifest and those that are hidden in secret.

children.text: kāmam in me maghavan mā vi tārīs tvam ājñātā tvam indrāsi dātā ||
children.translated_text: Do not pass beyond my desire, O <s>Maghavan</s>; you are the knower, you, O <s>Indra</s>, are the giver.

children.text: yo adadhāj jyotiṣi jyotir antar yo asṛjan madhunā sam madhūni
children.translated_text: He who set light within light, who mingled the sweet things with sweetness,

children.text: adha priyaṃ śūṣam indrāya manma brahmakṛto bṛhadukthād avāci ||
children.translated_text: then the dear strong hymn to <s>Indra</s> was spoken by the maker of prayer, by <s>Bṛhaduktha</s>.

children.text: Chapter 892
dūre tan nāma guhyam parācair yat tvā bhīte ahvayetāṃ vayodhai
children.translated_text: Far away is that secret name among those turned away, by which the strength-givers, afraid, called upon you.

children.text: ud astabhnāḥ pṛthivīṃ dyām abhīke bhrātuḥ putrān maghavan titviṣāṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You propped up earth and heaven face to face, O <s>Maghavan</s>, blazing against the sons of your brother.

children.text: mahat tan nāma guhyam puruspṛg yena bhūtaṃ janayo yena bhavyam
children.translated_text: Great is that secret, far-reaching name by which you generated what has been and what will be.

children.text: pratnaṃ jātaṃ jyotir yad asya priyam priyāḥ sam aviśanta pañca ||
children.translated_text: When his beloved, ancient-born light was born, the five dear ones entered together.

children.text: ā rodasī apṛṇād ota madhyam pañca devāṁ ṛtuśaḥ sapta sapta
children.translated_text: It filled heaven and earth, and also the middle space; the five gods, season by season, seven and seven,

children.text: catustriṃśatā purudhā vi caṣṭe sarūpeṇa jyotiṣā vivratena ||
children.translated_text: with the thirty-four, he sees in many ways, with a uniform and unveiled light.

children.text: yad uṣa aucchaḥ prathamā vibhānām ajanayo yena puṣṭasya puṣṭam
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Uṣas</s>, you shone as the first of the shining ones, by which you generated the nourishment of the nourished,

children.text: yat te jāmitvam avaram parasyā mahan mahatyā asuratvam ekam ||
children.translated_text: when your nearer kinship belonged to the farther one, great was the single lordly power of the great one.

children.text: vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ samane bahūnāṃ yuvānaṃ santam palito jagāra
children.translated_text: The grey-haired one swallowed the shining one in the gathering of many, though it was still young.

children.text: devasya paśya kāvyam mahitvādyā mamāra sa hyaḥ sam āna ||
children.translated_text: Behold the god's inspired work in its greatness: today he has died, though yesterday he breathed.

children.text: śākmanā śāko aruṇaḥ suparṇa ā yo mahaḥ śūraḥ sanād anīḍaḥ
children.translated_text: By power the powerful red, fair-winged one, the hero who from of old has had no nest, goes toward greatness.

children.text: yac ciketa satyam it tan na moghaṃ vasu spārham uta jetota dātā ||
children.translated_text: What he has perceived, that is true and not vain; he is the winner and giver of desirable wealth.

children.text: aibhir dade vṛṣṇyā pauṃsyāni yebhir aukṣad vṛtrahatyāya vajrī
children.translated_text: By these he took bull-like manly powers, by which the thunderbolt-bearer poured himself forth for the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: ye karmaṇaḥ kriyamāṇasya mahna ṛtekarmam ud ajāyanta devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those gods were born beyond ordinary work from the greatness of the work being done.

children.text: yujā karmāṇi janayan viśvaujā aśastihā viśvamanās turāṣāṭ
children.translated_text: With an ally, generating works, all-powerful, slayer of reviling, all-minded, and swiftly victorious.

children.text: pītvī somasya diva ā vṛdhānaḥ śūro nir yudhādhamad dasyūn ||
children.translated_text: Having drunk of <s>Soma</s>, growing toward heaven, the hero drove the <s>Dasyus</s> out of battle.

children.text: Chapter 893
idaṃ ta ekam para ū ta ekaṃ tṛtīyena jyotiṣā saṃ viśasva
children.translated_text: This one is yours, and another is beyond; with the third light enter together.

children.text: saṃveśane tanvaś cārur edhi priyo devānām parame janitre ||
children.translated_text: At the resting-place of the body be beautiful; be dear to the gods in the highest birth.

children.text: tanūṣ ṭe vājin tanvaṃ nayantī vāmam asmabhyaṃ dhātu śarma tubhyam
children.translated_text: May your body, O prize-winner, leading the body, establish fair protection for us and shelter for you.

children.text: ahruto maho dharuṇāya devān divīva jyotiḥ svam ā mimīyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Unharmed, for the great support of the gods, may you measure out your own light as in heaven.

children.text: vājy asi vājinenā suvenīḥ suvita stomaṃ suvito divaṃ gāḥ
children.translated_text: You are prize-winning; with the prize-winner, well-guiding, well-aided, go to the hymn, well-aided go to heaven.

children.text: suvito dharma prathamānu satyā suvito devān suvito 'nu patma ||
children.translated_text: Well-aided, follow the first true ordinances; well-aided follow the gods, well-aided follow the paths.

children.text: mahimna eṣām pitaraś caneśire devā deveṣv adadhur api kratum
children.translated_text: Even the Fathers did not rule over their greatness; the gods placed resolve among the gods.

children.text: sam avivyacur uta yāny atviṣur aiṣāṃ tanūṣu ni viviśuḥ punaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They spread out together, and the things that they made shine entered again into their bodies.

children.text: sahobhir viśvam pari cakramū rajaḥ pūrvā dhāmāny amitā mimānāḥ
children.translated_text: With their powers they circled all the realm, measuring out the ancient, immeasurable abodes.

children.text: tanūṣu viśvā bhuvanā ni yemire prāsārayanta purudha prajā anu ||
children.translated_text: In their bodies they held all the worlds; they stretched them forth in many ways through the generations.

children.text: dvidhā sūnavo 'suraṃ svarvidam āsthāpayanta tṛtīyena karmaṇā
children.translated_text: The sons established the <s>Asura</s>, knower of the sun-world, in two ways, by a third act.

children.text: svām prajām pitaraḥ pitryaṃ saha āvareṣv adadhus tantum ātatam ||
children.translated_text: The Fathers placed their own offspring, their paternal power, among the lower ones, a thread stretched out.

children.text: nāvā na kṣodaḥ pradiśaḥ pṛthivyāḥ svastibhir ati durgāṇi viśvā
children.translated_text: As by a boat across floods and the regions of the earth, may we pass beyond all hardships with blessings.

children.text: svām prajām bṛhaduktho mahitvāvareṣv adadhād ā pareṣu ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaduktha</s>, by his greatness, placed his own offspring among those nearer and those farther away.

children.text: Chapter 894
mā pra gāma patho vayam mā yajñād indra sominaḥ
children.translated_text: May we not stray from the path, nor from the sacrifice, O <s>Indra</s>, we who have <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: mānta sthur no arātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May hostile powers not stand within us.

children.text: yo yajñasya prasādhanas tantur deveṣv ātataḥ
children.translated_text: That thread which is the accomplisher of the sacrifice, stretched out among the gods,

children.text: tam āhutaṃ naśīmahi ||
children.translated_text: that invoked one may we attain.

children.text: mano nv ā huvāmahe nārāśaṃsena somena
children.translated_text: Now we call the mind back with <s>Nārāśaṃsa</s> <s>Soma</s>,

children.text: pitṝṇāṃ ca manmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: and with the thoughts of the Fathers.

children.text: ā ta etu manaḥ punaḥ kratve dakṣāya jīvase
children.translated_text: Let your mind come back again, for resolve, for skill, for living,

children.text: jyok ca sūryaṃ dṛśe ||
children.translated_text: and for seeing the sun for a long time.

children.text: punar naḥ pitaro mano dadātu daivyo janaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the Fathers, the divine race, give mind back to us;

children.text: jīvaṃ vrātaṃ sacemahi ||
children.translated_text: may we accompany the living company.

children.text: vayaṃ soma vrate tava manas tanūṣu bibhrataḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, under your vow, bearing mind in our bodies,

children.text: prajāvantaḥ sacemahi ||
children.translated_text: may we, rich in offspring, keep company.

children.text: Chapter 895
yat te yamaṃ vaivasvatam mano jagāma dūrakam
children.translated_text: Whatever far-off place your mind has gone to, to <s>Yama Vaivasvata</s>,

children.text: tat ta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
children.translated_text: that we turn back to you here, for dwelling and for living.

children.text: yat te divaṃ yat pṛthivīm mano jagāma dūrakam
children.translated_text: Whatever far-off place your mind has gone to, whether heaven or earth,

children.text: tat ta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
children.translated_text: that we turn back to you here, for dwelling and for living.

children.text: yat te bhūmiṃ caturbhṛṣṭim mano jagāma dūrakam
children.translated_text: Whatever far-off place your mind has gone to, to the four-cornered earth,

children.text: tat ta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
children.translated_text: that we turn back to you here, for dwelling and for living.

children.text: yat te catasraḥ pradiśo mano jagāma dūrakam
children.translated_text: Whatever far-off place your mind has gone to, to the four directions,

children.text: tat ta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
children.translated_text: that we turn back to you here, for dwelling and for living.

children.text: yat te samudram arṇavam mano jagāma dūrakam
children.translated_text: Whatever far-off place your mind has gone to, to the billowing ocean,

children.text: tat ta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
children.translated_text: that we turn back to you here, for dwelling and for living.

children.text: yat te marīcīḥ pravato mano jagāma dūrakam
children.translated_text: Whatever far-off place your mind has gone to, to the rays and the descending slopes,

children.text: tat ta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
children.translated_text: that we turn back to you here, for dwelling and for living.

children.text: yat te apo yad oṣadhīr mano jagāma dūrakam
children.translated_text: Whatever far-off place your mind has gone to, to the waters or to the plants,

children.text: tat ta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
children.translated_text: that we turn back to you here, for dwelling and for living.

children.text: yat te sūryaṃ yad uṣasam mano jagāma dūrakam
children.translated_text: Whatever far-off place your mind has gone to, to the sun or to the dawn,

children.text: tat ta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
children.translated_text: that we turn back to you here, for dwelling and for living.

children.text: yat te parvatān bṛhato mano jagāma dūrakam
children.translated_text: Whatever far-off place your mind has gone to, to the great mountains,

children.text: tat ta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
children.translated_text: that we turn back to you here, for dwelling and for living.

children.text: yat te viśvam idaṃ jagan mano jagāma dūrakam
children.translated_text: Whatever far-off place your mind has gone to, to this whole moving world,

children.text: tat ta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
children.translated_text: that we turn back to you here, for dwelling and for living.

children.text: yat te parāḥ parāvato mano jagāma dūrakam
children.translated_text: Whatever far-off place your mind has gone to, to the farthest distances,

children.text: tat ta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
children.translated_text: that we turn back to you here, for dwelling and for living.

children.text: yat te bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca mano jagāma dūrakam
children.translated_text: Whatever far-off place your mind has gone to, to what has been and what is to be,

children.text: tat ta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
children.translated_text: that we turn back to you here, for dwelling and for living.

children.text: Chapter 896
pra tāry āyuḥ prataraṃ navīya sthātāreva kratumatā rathasya
children.translated_text: Stretch life forward, farther, newly, like the driver with the purposeful chariot.

children.text: adha cyavāna ut tavīty artham parātaraṃ su nirṛtir jihītām ||
children.translated_text: Then, though slipping, let him rise toward his goal; let <s>Nirṛti</s> go far away.

children.text: sāman nu rāye nidhiman nv annaṃ karāmahe su purudha śravāṃsi
children.translated_text: Now with song we make treasure for wealth, and food, and many noble renowns.

children.text: tā no viśvāni jaritā mamattu parātaraṃ su nirṛtir jihītām ||
children.translated_text: May the singer take pleasure in all these for us; let <s>Nirṛti</s> go far away.

children.text: abhī ṣv aryaḥ pauṃsyair bhavema dyaur na bhūmiṃ girayo nājrān
children.translated_text: May we become noble through manly powers, as heaven is above earth, as mountains are above the plains.
