children.text: tā no viśvāni jaritā ciketa parātaraṃ su nirṛtir jihītām ||
children.translated_text: May the singer recognize all these for us; let <s>Nirṛti</s> go far away.

children.text: mo ṣu ṇaḥ soma mṛtyave parā dāḥ paśyema nu sūryam uccarantam
children.translated_text: O <s>Soma</s>, do not give us over to death; may we now see the sun rising.

children.text: dyubhir hito jarimā sū no astu parātaraṃ su nirṛtir jihītām ||
children.translated_text: Let old age, apportioned by days, be ours; let <s>Nirṛti</s> go far away.

children.text: asunīte mano asmāsu dhāraya jīvātave su pra tirā na āyuḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Asunīti</s>, hold the mind among us for living; prolong our life well.

children.text: rārandhi naḥ sūryasya saṃdṛśi ghṛtena tvaṃ tanvaṃ vardhayasva ||
children.translated_text: Let us delight in the sight of the sun; with ghee increase the body.

children.text: asunīte punar asmāsu cakṣuḥ punaḥ prāṇam iha no dhehi bhogam
children.translated_text: O <s>Asunīti</s>, place sight again among us; set breath again here, and enjoyment for us.

children.text: jyok paśyema sūryam uccarantam anumate mṛḍayā naḥ svasti ||
children.translated_text: May we see the rising sun for a long time; O <s>Anumati</s>, be gracious to us with well-being.

children.text: punar no asum pṛthivī dadātu punar dyaur devī punar antarikṣam
children.translated_text: Let <s>Pṛthivī</s> give our life-breath back to us; let divine <s>Dyauḥ</s> give it back; let the midspace give it back.

children.text: punar naḥ somas tanvaṃ dadātu punaḥ pūṣā pathyāṃ yā svastiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Soma</s> give our body back to us; let <s>Pūṣan</s> give back the path that is well-being.

children.text: śaṃ rodasī subandhave yahvī ṛtasya mātarā
children.translated_text: May the two worlds, the well-related youthful mothers of <s>ṛta</s>, bring welfare

children.text: bharatām apa yad rapo dyauḥ pṛthivi kṣamā rapo mo ṣu te kiṃ canāmamat ||
children.translated_text: for the kinsman. Carry away whatever injury there is, O <s>Dyauḥ</s>, O <s>Pṛthivī</s>, O broad earth; let nothing whatever harm you.

children.text: ava dvake ava trikā divaś caranti bheṣajā
children.translated_text: Away with the twofold one, away with the threefold one; medicines move from heaven.

children.text: kṣamā cariṣṇv ekakam bharatām apa yad rapo dyauḥ pṛthivi kṣamā rapo mo ṣu te kiṃ canāmamat ||
children.translated_text: The solitary one moves upon earth. Carry away whatever injury there is, O <s>Dyauḥ</s>, O <s>Pṛthivī</s>, O broad earth; let nothing whatever harm you.

children.text: sam indreraya gām anaḍvāhaṃ ya āvahad uśīnarāṇyā anaḥ
children.translated_text: Together with <s>Indra</s>, set in motion the cow, the draught-ox, which brought the wagon of the <s>Uśīnarāṇī</s>.

children.text: bharatām apa yad rapo dyauḥ pṛthivi kṣamā rapo mo ṣu te kiṃ canāmamat ||
children.translated_text: Whatever harm of the <s>Bharatas</s>, whatever harm <s>Dyauḥ</s>, <s>Pṛthivī</s>, and the ground have made disappear, let nothing at all of yours be harmed.

children.text: Chapter 897
ā janaṃ tveṣasaṃdṛśam māhīnānām upastutam
children.translated_text: We have come to the man terrible to behold, praised among the mighty,

children.text: aganma bibhrato namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: bearing homage.

children.text: asamātiṃ nitośanaṃ tveṣaṃ niyayinaṃ ratham
children.translated_text: To <s>Asamāti</s>, who consumes enemies, fierce, whose chariot is driven onward,

children.text: bhajerathasya satpatim ||
children.translated_text: to the good lord of <s>Bhajeratha</s>.

children.text: yo janān mahiṣāṁ ivātitasthau pavīravān
children.translated_text: He who stood over peoples as over buffaloes, possessing a chariot-rim,

children.text: utāpavīravān yudhā ||
children.translated_text: and even without a chariot-rim in battle.

children.text: yasyekṣvākur upa vrate revān marāyy edhate
children.translated_text: Under whose command <s>Ikṣvāku</s>, rich and liberal, prospers,

children.text: divīva pañca kṛṣṭayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: as the five peoples do in heaven.

children.text: indra kṣatrāsamātiṣu rathaproṣṭheṣu dhāraya
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, in the lordships among the <s>Asamātis</s>, hold him on the backs of chariots,

children.text: divīva sūryaṃ dṛśe ||
children.translated_text: like the sun in heaven, for sight.

children.text: agastyasya nadbhyaḥ saptī yunakṣi rohitā
children.translated_text: For <s>Agastya</s>, from the waters you yoke the two ruddy coursers;

children.text: paṇīn ny akramīr abhi viśvān rājann arādhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O king, you have trodden down the <s>Paṇis</s>, all the ungenerous ones.

children.text: ayam mātāyam pitāyaṃ jīvātur āgamat
children.translated_text: This one is mother, this one is father; this one has come as the life-force.

children.text: idaṃ tava prasarpaṇaṃ subandhav ehi nir ihi ||
children.translated_text: This is your creeping forth, O <s>Subandhu</s>; come here, go out from here.

children.text: yathā yugaṃ varatrayā nahyanti dharuṇāya kam
children.translated_text: As they bind a yoke with straps for firmness,

children.text: evā dādhāra te mano jīvātave na mṛtyave 'tho ariṣṭatātaye ||
children.translated_text: so have I held your mind fast for life, not for death, and also for freedom from harm.

children.text: yatheyam pṛthivī mahī dādhāremān vanaspatīn
children.translated_text: As this great earth has held fast these forest trees,

children.text: evā dādhāra te mano jīvātave na mṛtyave 'tho ariṣṭatātaye ||
children.translated_text: so have I held your mind fast for life, not for death, and also for freedom from harm.

children.text: yamād ahaṃ vaivasvatāt subandhor mana ābharam
children.translated_text: From <s>Yama Vaivasvata</s> I have brought back <s>Subandhu</s>'s mind,

children.text: jīvātave na mṛtyave 'tho ariṣṭatātaye ||
children.translated_text: for life, not for death, and also for freedom from harm.

children.text: nyag vāto 'va vāti nyak tapati sūryaḥ
children.translated_text: Downward the wind blows; downward the sun burns.

children.text: nīcīnam aghnyā duhe nyag bhavatu te rapaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Downward the inviolable cow gives milk; downward let your injury become.

children.text: ayam me hasto bhagavān ayam me bhagavattaraḥ
children.translated_text: This hand of mine is blessed; this hand of mine is still more blessed.

children.text: ayam me viśvabheṣajo 'yaṃ śivābhimarśanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: This one is all-healing; this one has an auspicious touch.

children.text: Chapter 898
idam itthā raudraṃ gūrtavacā brahma kratvā śacyām antar ājau
children.translated_text: This sacred utterance, just so, is Rudra's, spoken with praise, with will and power amid the contest;

children.text: krāṇā yad asya pitarā maṃhaneṣṭhāḥ parṣat pakthe ahann ā sapta hotṝn ||
children.translated_text: when the best fathers of this one, exultant for greatness, crossed in the <s>Paktha</s> land and slew the seven Hotṛs.

children.text: sa id dānāya dabhyāya vanvañcyavānaḥ sūdair amimīta vedim
children.translated_text: He, winning for a deceptive giver, shaking himself loose, measured out the altar with good gifts;

children.text: tūrvayāṇo gūrtavacastamaḥ kṣodo na reta itaūti siñcat ||
children.translated_text: overcoming, most praiseworthy in speech, he poured the seed here, like a flood.

children.text: mano na yeṣu havaneṣu tigmaṃ vipaḥ śacyā vanutho dravantā
children.translated_text: In those invocations where the sharp thought and the inspired poets run with power,

children.text: ā yaḥ śaryābhis tuvinṛmṇo asyāśrīṇītādiśaṃ gabhastau ||
children.translated_text: he of great manliness, with arrows, took the direction into his hand.

children.text: kṛṣṇā yad goṣv aruṇīṣu sīdad divo napātāśvinā huve vām
children.translated_text: When the black one sat among the ruddy cows, I call you, O <s>Aśvins</s>, sons of heaven;

children.text: vītam me yajñam ā gatam me annaṃ vavanvāṃsā neṣam asmṛtadhrū ||
children.translated_text: enjoy my sacrifice; come to my food, loving it, with unforgetting guidance.

children.text: prathiṣṭa yasya vīrakarmam iṣṇad anuṣṭhitaṃ nu naryo apauhat
children.translated_text: His renowned heroic deed, performed, the man now drove away as it pressed forward;

children.text: punas tad ā vṛhati yat kanāyā duhitur ā anubhṛtam anarvā ||
children.translated_text: again he tears away what had been borne after the young daughter's, irresistible.

children.text: madhyā yat kartvam abhavad abhīke kāmaṃ kṛṇvāne pitari yuvatyām
children.translated_text: When at the middle the deed came to be at the encounter, as desire was made in the youthful father,

children.text: manānag reto jahatur viyantā sānau niṣiktaṃ sukṛtasya yonau ||
children.translated_text: then the two departing left the seed of the mind, poured upon the height in the womb of the well-made thing.

children.text: pitā yat svāṃ duhitaram adhi ṣkan kṣmayā retaḥ saṃ jagmāno ni ṣiñcat
children.translated_text: When the father mounted his own daughter and, coming together on earth, poured down the seed,

children.text: svādhyo 'janayan brahma devā vāstoṣpatiṃ vratapāṃ nir atakṣan ||
children.translated_text: the self-wise gods generated the sacred utterance; they fashioned <s>Vāstoṣpati</s>, guardian of the vow.

children.text: sa īṃ vṛṣā na phenam asyad ājau smad ā paraid apa dabhracetāḥ
children.translated_text: He, a bull in battle, cast away foam from it; from us the small-minded one went away,

children.text: sarat padā na dakṣiṇā parāvṛṅ na tā nu me pṛśanyo jagṛbhre ||
children.translated_text: running, not with the right foot; turned away, those dappled ones did not seize me.

children.text: makṣū na vahniḥ prajāyā upabdir agniṃ na nagna upa sīdad ūdhaḥ
children.translated_text: Swiftly, like a bearer with his offspring's support, like <s>Agni</s>, the naked one sat by the udder;

children.text: sanitedhmaṃ sanitota vājaṃ sa dhartā jajñe sahasā yavīyut ||
children.translated_text: he won fuel and also the prize; he was born a supporter, younger through strength.

children.text: makṣū kanāyāḥ sakhyaṃ navagvā ṛtaṃ vadanta ṛtayuktim agman
children.translated_text: Swiftly the <s>Navagvas</s> came to the young maiden's friendship, speaking truth and arriving at the yoking of truth;

children.text: dvibarhaso ya upa gopam āgur adakṣiṇāso acyutā dudukṣan ||
children.translated_text: the twice-great ones, who came to the cowherd, without gifts and unfallen, wished to milk.

children.text: makṣū kanāyāḥ sakhyaṃ navīyo rādho na reta ṛtam it turaṇyan
children.translated_text: Swiftly came the newer friendship of the young maiden, like bounty, the seed, hastening only to truth;

children.text: śuci yat te rekṇa āyajanta sabardughāyāḥ paya usriyāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: when they worshipped your bright treasure, the milk of the cow that gives together.

children.text: paśvā yat paścā viyutā budhanteti bravīti vaktarī rarāṇaḥ
children.translated_text: When, separated afterward from the cattle, they awaken, so the speaking speaker, delighting, says;

children.text: vasor vasutvā kāravo 'nehā viśvaṃ viveṣṭi draviṇam upa kṣu ||
children.translated_text: the singers, by the wealth of the wealthy one, without fault, approach all treasure at once.

children.text: tad in nv asya pariṣadvāno agman purū sadanto nārṣadam bibhitsan
children.translated_text: Then indeed his attendants of the assembly came, sitting many, wishing to split the seat;

children.text: vi śuṣṇasya saṃgrathitam anarvā vidat puruprajātasya guhā yat ||
children.translated_text: the unbridled one found what was bound together by <s>Śuṣṇa</s>, hidden from the much-born one.

children.text: bhargo ha nāmota yasya devāḥ svar ṇa ye triṣadhasthe niṣeduḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Bharga</s> indeed is also his name, O gods; those who, like the sun, sat in the threefold seat;

children.text: agnir ha nāmota jātavedāḥ śrudhī no hotar ṛtasya hotādhruk ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> indeed is also his name, <s>Jātavedas</s>; hear us, O Hotar, undeceiving priest of truth.

children.text: uta tyā me raudrāv arcimantā nāsatyāv indra gūrtaye yajadhyai
children.translated_text: And those two bright Rudra-like ones of mine, the <s>Nāsatyas</s>, and <s>Indra</s>, I call for praise and sacrifice,

children.text: manuṣvad vṛktabarhiṣe rarāṇā mandū hitaprayasā vikṣu yajyū ||
children.translated_text: delighting in a strewn barhis like <s>Manu</s>, the two ready for the rite, with pleasing offerings among the clans.

children.text: ayaṃ stuto rājā vandi vedhā apaś ca vipras tarati svasetuḥ
children.translated_text: This praised king, the sage and singer, crosses the waters as a wise one by his own bridge;

children.text: sa kakṣīvantaṃ rejayat so agniṃ nemiṃ na cakram arvato raghudru ||
children.translated_text: he made <s>Kakṣīvant</s> tremble; he made <s>Agni</s> shake like the rim, the wheel of a swift horse.

children.text: sa dvibandhur vaitaraṇo yaṣṭā sabardhuṃ dhenum asvaṃ duhadhyai
children.translated_text: He is the twofold kinsman, the <s>Vaitaraṇa</s>, the sacrificer, to milk the jointly-yielding, horseless cow;

children.text: saṃ yan mitrāvaruṇā vṛñja ukthair jyeṣṭhebhir aryamaṇaṃ varūthaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: when, with hymns, <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> are joined together with the oldest protections of <s>Aryaman</s>.

children.text: tadbandhuḥ sūrir divi te dhiyandhā nābhānediṣṭho rapati pra venan
children.translated_text: A kinsman of that one is the inspired patron, thought-holding in heaven; <s>Nābhānediṣṭha</s> utters aloud, moving forth;

children.text: sā no nābhiḥ paramāsya vā ghāhaṃ tat paścā katithaś cid āsa ||
children.translated_text: that navel of ours is the highest, or indeed I was somehow after that.

children.text: iyam me nābhir iha me sadhastham ime me devā ayam asmi sarvaḥ
children.translated_text: This is my navel; here is my assembly-seat; these are my gods; I am this whole thing.

children.text: dvijā aha prathamajā ṛtasyedaṃ dhenur aduhaj jāyamānā ||
children.translated_text: The twice-born, first-born of truth: this cow, being born, milked it out.

children.text: adhāsu mandro aratir vibhāvāva syati dvivartanir vaneṣāṭ
children.translated_text: Then the pleasant one, the restless brilliant one, casts down, moving on two tracks, victorious in the woods;

children.text: ūrdhvā yacchreṇir na śiśur dan makṣū sthiraṃ śevṛdhaṃ sūta mātā ||
children.translated_text: when the line stands upward, like a child, swiftly the mother has brought forth the firm, strengthening one.

children.text: adhā gāva upamātiṃ kanāyā anu śvāntasya kasya cit pareyuḥ
children.translated_text: Then the cows went after the young woman's approach, beyond the reach of some exhausted one.

children.text: śrudhi tvaṃ sudraviṇo nas tvaṃ yāḍ āśvaghnasya vāvṛdhe sūnṛtābhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Hear us, O you rich in good wealth; you, by true words, have grown strong for the horse-slaying one.

children.text: adha tvam indra viddhy asmān maho rāye nṛpate vajrabāhuḥ
children.translated_text: Then know us, O <s>Indra</s>, for great wealth, O king of men, thunderbolt-armed one.

children.text: rakṣā ca no maghonaḥ pāhi sūrīn anehasas te harivo abhiṣṭau ||
children.translated_text: Protect us, the generous ones; guard the patrons, unharmed, in your help, O bay-horsed one.

children.text: adha yad rājānā gaviṣṭau sarat saraṇyuḥ kārave jaraṇyuḥ
children.translated_text: Then, when the two kings moved in the quest for cows, the swift, eager one came to the singer.

children.text: vipraḥ preṣṭhaḥ sa hy eṣām babhūva parā ca vakṣad uta parṣad enān ||
children.translated_text: The inspired one became dearest among them; he shall carry them beyond and ferry them across.

children.text: adhā nv asya jenyasya puṣṭau vṛthā rebhanta īmahe tad ū nu
children.translated_text: Now, in the prosperity of this conqueror, we uselessly call aloud; that indeed is ours.

children.text: saraṇyur asya sūnur aśvo vipraś cāsi śravasaś ca sātau ||
children.translated_text: His swift son is a horse; you are also the inspired one in the winning of fame.

children.text: yuvor yadi sakhyāyāsme śardhāya stomaṃ jujuṣe namasvān
children.translated_text: If you two, for friendship with us, have gladly accepted the reverent hymn for the host,

children.text: viśvatra yasminn ā giraḥ samīcīḥ pūrvīva gātur dāśat sūnṛtāyai ||
children.translated_text: in which all songs are gathered together everywhere, may an ancient path serve for true speech.

children.text: sa gṛṇāno adbhir devavān iti subandhur namasā sūktaiḥ
children.translated_text: He, being praised with waters and rich in gods, as a good kinsman with homage and hymns,

children.text: vardhad ukthair vacobhir ā hi nūnaṃ vy adhvaiti payasa usriyāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: has grown through praises and words; for now the milk of the ruddy cow spreads out.

children.text: ta ū ṣu ṇo maho yajatrā bhūta devāsa ūtaye sajoṣāḥ
children.translated_text: So do you great worshipful gods become united in goodwill for our aid.

children.text: ye vājāṁ anayatā viyanto ye sthā nicetāro amūrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: You who, setting out, brought prizes, you who stood as discerning ones, not foolish.

children.text: Chapter 899
ye yajñena dakṣiṇayā samaktā indrasya sakhyam amṛtatvam ānaśa
children.translated_text: Those who, joined with sacrifice and <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial gift), attained the friendship of <s>Indra</s> and immortality,

children.text: tebhyo bhadram aṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for them may there be good fortune for you <s>Aṅgirases</s>; receive the wise <s>Mānava</s>.

children.text: ya udājan pitaro gomayaṃ vasv ṛtenābhindan parivatsare valam
children.translated_text: Those fathers who drove up wealth rich in cows and, by truth, broke open <s>Vala</s> in the year's course,

children.text: dīrghāyutvam aṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may long life be yours, O <s>Aṅgirases</s>; receive the wise <s>Mānava</s>.

children.text: ya ṛtena sūryam ārohayan divy aprathayan pṛthivīm mātaraṃ vi
children.translated_text: Those who, by truth, made the sun ascend, and spread out wide in heaven and the mother earth,

children.text: suprajāstvam aṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may good offspring be yours, O <s>Aṅgirases</s>; receive the wise <s>Mānava</s>.

children.text: ayaṃ nābhā vadati valgu vo gṛhe devaputrā ṛṣayas tacchṛṇotana
children.translated_text: This <s>Nābhā</s> speaks pleasantly in your house; O sons of gods, O seers, hear it.

children.text: subrahmaṇyam aṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May good sacred utterance be yours, O <s>Aṅgirases</s>; receive the wise <s>Mānava</s>.

children.text: virūpāsa id ṛṣayas ta id gambhīravepasaḥ
children.translated_text: The seers indeed were various in form; they indeed were deeply trembling.

children.text: te aṅgirasaḥ sūnavas te agneḥ pari jajñire ||
children.translated_text: They, the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, they the sons, were born around <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: ye agneḥ pari jajñire virūpāso divas pari
children.translated_text: Those who were born around <s>Agni</s>, various in form, around heaven,

children.text: navagvo nu daśagvo aṅgirastamo sacā deveṣu maṃhate ||
children.translated_text: the ninefold and the tenfold, most <s>Aṅgiras</s>-like, together with the gods are magnified.

children.text: indreṇa yujā niḥ sṛjanta vāghato vrajaṃ gomantam aśvinam
children.translated_text: Joined with <s>Indra</s>, the singers released the enclosure rich in cows and horses.

children.text: sahasram me dadato aṣṭakarṇyaḥ śravo deveṣv akrata ||
children.translated_text: They, the <s>Aṣṭakarṇyas</s>, giving me a thousand, made fame among the gods.

children.text: pra nūnaṃ jāyatām ayam manus tokmeva rohatu
children.translated_text: Let this one now be born; let him grow like <s>Manu</s> in his offspring.

children.text: yaḥ sahasraṃ śatāśvaṃ sadyo dānāya maṃhate ||
children.translated_text: He who at once is magnified for the gift of a thousand and a hundred horses.

children.text: na tam aśnoti kaścana diva iva sānv ārabham
children.translated_text: No one reaches him, as one grasps the ridge of heaven.

children.text: sāvarṇyasya dakṣiṇā vi sindhur iva paprathe ||
children.translated_text: The <s>dakṣiṇā</s> of <s>Sāvarṇya</s> has spread out like the river <s>Sindhu</s>.

children.text: uta dāsā pariviṣe smaddiṣṭī goparīṇasā
children.translated_text: And the <s>Dāsas</s> around <s>Viśa</s>, by our allotment rich in cattle,

children.text: yadus turvaś ca māmahe ||
children.translated_text: we have magnified <s>Yadu</s> and <s>Turvaśa</s>.

children.text: sahasradā grāmaṇīr mā riṣan manuḥ sūryeṇāsya yatamānaitu dakṣiṇā
children.translated_text: May the thousand-giving village chief <s>Manu</s> not come to harm; may his <s>dakṣiṇā</s>, striving with the sun, come on.

children.text: sāvarṇer devāḥ pra tirantv āyur yasminn aśrāntā asanāma vājam ||
children.translated_text: May the gods lengthen the life of <s>Sāvarṇi</s>, in whom, unwearied, we may win the prize.

children.text: Chapter 900
parāvato ye didhiṣanta āpyam manuprītāso janimā vivasvataḥ
children.translated_text: Those from afar who sought kinship, dear to <s>Manu</s>, born from <s>Vivasvat</s>,

children.text: yayāter ye nahuṣyasya barhiṣi devā āsate te adhi bruvantu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: those gods who sit on the sacred grass of <s>Yayāti Nahuṣya</s>, let them speak on our behalf.

children.text: viśvā hi vo namasyāni vandyā nāmāni devā uta yajñiyāni vaḥ
children.translated_text: For all your names are worthy of homage and praise, O gods, and yours are fit for sacrifice.

children.text: ye stha jātā aditer adbhyas pari ye pṛthivyās te ma iha śrutā havam ||
children.translated_text: You who were born from <s>Aditi</s>, from the waters, and from the earth, hear my call here.

children.text: yebhyo mātā madhumat pinvate payaḥ pīyūṣaṃ dyaur aditir adribarhāḥ
children.translated_text: Those for whom the mother, heaven, <s>Aditi</s>, stone-seated, swells sweet milk and nectar,

children.text: ukthaśuṣmān vṛṣabharān svapnasas tāṁ ādityāṁ anu madā svastaye ||
children.translated_text: the strong in hymns, bull-like and self-shining <s>Ādityas</s>, may exhilarations follow them for well-being.

children.text: nṛcakṣaso animiṣanto arhaṇā bṛhad devāso amṛtatvam ānaśuḥ
children.translated_text: Seeing men, unwinking, worthy of honor, the great immortal gods have attained immortality.

children.text: jyotīrathā ahimāyā anāgaso divo varṣmāṇaṃ vasate svastaye ||
children.translated_text: Light-charioted, free from serpent-magic, guiltless, they clothe the height of heaven for well-being.

children.text: samrājo ye suvṛdho yajñam āyayur aparihvṛtā dadhire divi kṣayam
children.translated_text: The sovereigns, well-growing, who came to the sacrifice and, without turning aside, took up their dwelling in heaven,

children.text: tāṁ ā vivāsa namasā suvṛktibhir maho ādityāṁ aditiṃ svastaye ||
children.translated_text: them I worship with homage and fair praises: the great <s>Ādityas</s> and <s>Aditi</s>, for well-being.

children.text: ko va stomaṃ rādhati yaṃ jujoṣatha viśve devāso manuṣo yati ṣṭhana
children.translated_text: Who will prosper the hymn of yours which you have enjoyed, O all gods, while you stand among men?

children.text: ko vo 'dhvaraṃ tuvijātā araṃ karad yo naḥ parṣad aty aṃhaḥ svastaye ||
children.translated_text: Who, O mighty-born ones, will make your rite sufficient, who will carry us beyond distress for well-being?

children.text: yebhyo hotrām prathamām ā yeje manuḥ samiddhāgnir manasā sapta hotṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: Those for whom <s>Manu</s>, with kindled fire and with seven priests in mind, performed the first hotar-service,

children.text: ta ādityā abhayaṃ śarma yacchata sugā naḥ karta supathā svastaye ||
children.translated_text: those <s>Ādityas</s>, grant us fearless shelter; make our paths easy by good roads for well-being.

children.text: ya īśire bhuvanasya pracetaso viśvasya sthātur jagataś ca mantavaḥ
children.translated_text: Those wise ones who rule the world and are minded over all that stands and moves,

children.text: te naḥ kṛtād akṛtād enasas pary adyā devāsaḥ pipṛtā svastaye ||
children.translated_text: those gods, protect us today from sin done and not done, for well-being.

children.text: bhareṣv indraṃ suhavaṃ havāmahe 'ṃhomucaṃ sukṛtaṃ daivyaṃ janam
children.translated_text: In battles we call on <s>Indra</s>, easy to invoke, the divine helper, releaser from distress, accomplished in good work,

children.text: agnim mitraṃ varuṇaṃ sātaye bhagaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī marutaḥ svastaye ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Bhaga</s> for winning, and <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> and the <s>Maruts</s> for well-being.

children.text: sutrāmāṇam pṛthivīṃ dyām anehasaṃ suśarmāṇam aditiṃ supraṇītim
children.translated_text: May we climb aboard the well-protecting earth, the unharmed heaven, good-sheltering <s>Aditi</s> of excellent guidance,

children.text: daivīṃ nāvaṃ svaritrām anāgasam asravantīm ā ruhemā svastaye ||
children.translated_text: the divine boat, well-oared, guiltless and not leaking, for well-being.

children.text: viśve yajatrā adhi vocatotaye trāyadhvaṃ no durevāyā abhihrutaḥ
children.translated_text: O all worshipful ones, speak for our aid; protect us from the hostile assault of the evil-minded.

children.text: satyayā vo devahūtyā huvema śṛṇvato devā avase svastaye ||
children.translated_text: With your true divine invocation we would call on you, O listening gods, for help and well-being.

children.text: apāmīvām apa viśvām anāhutim apārātiṃ durvidatrām aghāyataḥ
children.translated_text: Drive away sickness, every failure of invocation, hostility, the hard-to-distribute malice of the harmful one.

children.text: āre devā dveṣo asmad yuyotanoru ṇaḥ śarma yacchatā svastaye ||
children.translated_text: O gods, keep hatred far away from us; grant us broad shelter for well-being.

children.text: ariṣṭaḥ sa marto viśva edhate pra prajābhir jāyate dharmaṇas pari
children.translated_text: Unharmed is the mortal who prospers in every way; he is born forth with offspring around <s>dharma</s> (sacred order),

children.text: yam ādityāso nayathā sunītibhir ati viśvāni duritā svastaye ||
children.translated_text: the one whom you <s>Ādityas</s> lead with good guidance beyond all dangers, for well-being.

children.text: yaṃ devāso 'vatha vājasātau yaṃ śūrasātā maruto hite dhane
children.translated_text: The one whom the gods help in the winning of prizes, whom the <s>Maruts</s> help in the winning of heroes when wealth is set forth,

children.text: prātaryāvāṇaṃ ratham indra sānasim ariṣyantam ā ruhemā svastaye ||
children.translated_text: may we mount that early-going chariot, O <s>Indra</s>, winning gain and not suffering harm, for well-being.

children.text: svasti naḥ pathyāsu dhanvasu svasty apsu vṛjane svarvati
children.translated_text: May there be well-being for us on roads and in deserts; well-being in the waters, in the enclosure rich in sunlight;

children.text: svasti naḥ putrakṛtheṣu yoniṣu svasti rāye maruto dadhātana ||
children.translated_text: well-being for us in wombs that produce sons; establish well-being for wealth, O <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: svastir iddhi prapathe śreṣṭhā rekṇasvaty abhi yā vāmam eti
children.translated_text: For well-being is indeed best at the forward path, rich in treasure, coming toward what is desirable.

children.text: sā no amā so araṇe ni pātu svāveśā bhavatu devagopā ||
children.translated_text: May she protect us at home and in the wilderness; easy to enter, may she be guarded by the gods.

children.text: evā plateḥ sūnur avīvṛdhad vo viśva ādityā adite manīṣī
children.translated_text: Thus the thoughtful son of <s>Plati</s>, O all <s>Ādityas</s>, O <s>Aditi</s>, has strengthened you,

children.text: īśānāso naro amartyenāstāvi jano divyo gayena ||
children.translated_text: the ruling immortal men; the heavenly people have been praised by <s>Gaya</s>.

children.text: Chapter 901
kathā devānāṃ katamasya yāmani sumantu nāma śṛṇvatām manāmahe
children.translated_text: How, on the journey of the gods, and of which one, shall we remember the kindly name of those who listen?

children.text: ko mṛḍāti katamo no mayas karat katama ūtī abhy ā vavartati ||
children.translated_text: Who will show mercy? Which one will make gladness for us? Which help will turn itself toward us?

children.text: kratūyanti kratavo hṛtsu dhītayo venanti venāḥ patayanty ā diśaḥ
children.translated_text: Intentions seek intention; thoughts in the hearts seek thought; the seeking ones fly out to the directions.

children.text: na marḍitā vidyate anya ebhyo deveṣu me adhi kāmā ayaṃsata ||
children.translated_text: No other merciful one is found besides these; among the gods my desires have been set.

children.text: narā vā śaṃsam pūṣaṇam agohyam agniṃ deveddham abhy arcase girā
children.translated_text: With song I worship the manly <s>Pūṣan</s>, not to be concealed, and <s>Agni</s>, kindled by the gods,

children.text: sūryāmāsā candramasā yamaṃ divi tritaṃ vātam uṣasam aktum aśvinā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Sūryā</s> and <s>Māsa</s>, <s>Candramas</s>, <s>Yama</s> in heaven, <s>Trita</s>, <s>Vāta</s>, <s>Uṣas</s>, night, and the <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: kathā kavis tuvīravān kayā girā bṛhaspatir vāvṛdhate suvṛktibhiḥ
children.translated_text: How shall the poet, rich in heroes, <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, be magnified with what song and with fair praises?

children.text: aja ekapāt suhavebhir ṛkvabhir ahiḥ śṛṇotu budhnyo havīmani ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Aja Ekapāt</s> hear with hymns easy to invoke; may <s>Ahi Budhnya</s> hear at the oblation.

children.text: dakṣasya vādite janmani vrate rājānā mitrāvaruṇā vivāsasi
children.translated_text: At the proclamation of <s>Dakṣa</s>, in birth and sacred ordinance, you worship the two kings <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: atūrtapanthāḥ pururatho aryamā saptahotā viṣurūpeṣu janmasu ||
children.translated_text: <s>Aryaman</s>, whose path is not overcome and whose chariot is manifold, is the sevenfold <s>hotar</s> (priest) among forms of birth.

children.text: te no arvanto havanaśruto havaṃ viśve śṛṇvantu vājino mitadravaḥ
children.translated_text: May those vigorous ones, hearing the invocation, all hear our call, racers of measured course,

children.text: sahasrasā medhasātāv iva tmanā maho ye dhanaṃ samitheṣu jabhrire ||
children.translated_text: they who by themselves, in the gathering for prize and wisdom, have won great wealth in battles.

children.text: pra vo vāyuṃ rathayujam purandhiṃ stomaiḥ kṛṇudhvaṃ sakhyāya pūṣaṇam
children.translated_text: With hymns set forth <s>Vāyu</s>, whose chariot is yoked, and thoughtful <s>Pūṣan</s> for friendship,

children.text: te hi devasya savituḥ savīmani kratuṃ sacante sacitaḥ sacetasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: for under the impulse of the god <s>Savitṛ</s> they, attentive and of one mind, follow inspired purpose.

children.text: triḥ sapta sasrā nadyo mahīr apo vanaspatīn parvatāṁ agnim ūtaye
children.translated_text: For aid we call the thrice seven flowing rivers, the great waters, the forest trees, the mountains, and <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: kṛśānum astṝn tiṣyaṃ sadhastha ā rudraṃ rudreṣu rudriyaṃ havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛśānu</s>, the stones, <s>Tiṣya</s> in the common seat, and <s>Rudra</s>, the Rudra-like one among the <s>Rudras</s>.

children.text: sarasvatī sarayuḥ sindhur ūrmibhir maho mahīr avasā yantu vakṣaṇīḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Sarasvatī</s>, <s>Sarayu</s>, and <s>Sindhu</s>, with their waves, great and mighty, come with help to the floodplains.

children.text: devīr āpo mātaraḥ sūdayitnvo ghṛtavat payo madhuman no arcata ||
children.translated_text: O divine waters, mothers, givers of good things, pour out for us milk rich in ghee and sweet as honey.

children.text: uta mātā bṛhaddivā śṛṇotu nas tvaṣṭā devebhir janibhiḥ pitā vacaḥ
children.translated_text: And may mother <s>Bṛhaddivā</s> hear us; may <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, father with the divine births, hear our word.

children.text: ṛbhukṣā vājo rathaspatir bhago raṇvaḥ śaṃsaḥ śaśamānasya pātu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Ṛbhukṣan</s>, <s>Vāja</s>, lord of the chariot, <s>Bhaga</s>, and joyous <s>Śaṃsa</s> protect us as we praise.

children.text: raṇvaḥ saṃdṛṣṭau pitumāṁ iva kṣayo bhadrā rudrāṇām marutām upastutiḥ
children.translated_text: Joyous in sight, like a dwelling rich in food, is the favorable praise of the <s>Rudras</s> and the <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: gobhiḥ ṣyāma yaśaso janeṣv ā sadā devāsa iḍayā sacemahi ||
children.translated_text: May we be famed among people with cattle; may we always attend the gods with refreshment.

children.text: yām me dhiyam maruta indra devā adadāta varuṇa mitra yūyam
children.translated_text: The thought which you, O <s>Maruts</s>, <s>Indra</s>, O gods, and you, <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Mitra</s>, have given me,

children.text: tām pīpayata payaseva dhenuṃ kuvid giro adhi rathe vahātha ||
children.translated_text: make that thought swell like a cow with milk. Perhaps you will carry our songs upon the chariot.

children.text: kuvid aṅga prati yathā cid asya naḥ sajātyasya maruto bubodhatha
children.translated_text: Perhaps indeed, somehow, you <s>Maruts</s> will take notice of this kinsman of ours,

children.text: nābhā yatra prathamaṃ saṃ nasāmahe tatra jāmitvam aditir dadhātu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: at the navel where we first came together; there may <s>Aditi</s> establish kinship for us.

children.text: te hi dyāvāpṛthivī mātarā mahī devī devāñ janmanā yajñiye itaḥ
children.translated_text: For those two great mothers, <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, goddesses worthy of sacrifice by divine birth,

children.text: ubhe bibhṛta ubhayam bharīmabhiḥ purū retāṃsi pitṛbhiś ca siñcataḥ ||
children.translated_text: bear both worlds with their supports, and pour forth many seeds together with the fathers.

children.text: vi ṣā hotrā viśvam aśnoti vāryam bṛhaspatir aramatiḥ panīyasī
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, the desirable and most praiseworthy devotion, spreads over all the priestly offices and all desirable wealth,

children.text: grāvā yatra madhuṣud ucyate bṛhad avīvaśanta matibhir manīṣiṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: where the pressing-stone is called sweetly-sounding and great, and thoughtful sages have made it shine with their thoughts.

children.text: evā kavis tuvīravāṁ ṛtajñā draviṇasyur draviṇasaś cakānaḥ
children.translated_text: Thus the poet, rich in heroes, knowing the truth, desiring wealth and delighting in wealth,

children.text: ukthebhir atra matibhiś ca vipro 'pīpayad gayo divyāni janma ||
children.translated_text: the inspired one here, with recitations and thoughts, has made <s>Gaya</s> swell the heavenly births.

children.text: evā plateḥ sūnur avīvṛdhad vo viśva ādityā adite manīṣī
children.translated_text: Thus the thoughtful son of <s>Plati</s>, O all <s>Ādityas</s>, O <s>Aditi</s>, has strengthened you,

children.text: īśānāso naro amartyenāstāvi jano divyo gayena ||
children.translated_text: the ruling immortal men; the heavenly people have been praised by <s>Gaya</s>.

children.text: Chapter 902
agnir indro varuṇo mitro aryamā vāyuḥ pūṣā sarasvatī sajoṣasaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, <s>Indra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Vāyu</s>, <s>Pūṣan</s>, and <s>Sarasvatī</s> together in accord,

children.text: ādityā viṣṇur marutaḥ svar bṛhat somo rudro aditir brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Ādityas</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the <s>Maruts</s>, the broad sunlight, <s>Soma</s>, <s>Rudra</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, and <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>;

children.text: indrāgnī vṛtrahatyeṣu satpatī mitho hinvānā tanvā samokasā
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, true lords in the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>, urging each other on, sharing one body and one dwelling,

children.text: antarikṣam mahy ā paprur ojasā somo ghṛtaśrīr mahimānam īrayan ||
children.translated_text: filled the great midspace with strength, while <s>Soma</s>, bright with ghee, set his greatness in motion.

children.text: teṣāṃ hi mahnā mahatām anarvaṇāṃ stomāṁ iyarmy ṛtajñā ṛtāvṛdhām
children.translated_text: For the greatness of those great, irresistible ones, knowers of truth and increasers of truth, I send forth hymns,

children.text: ye apsavam arṇavaṃ citrarādhasas te no rāsantām mahaye sumitryāḥ ||
children.translated_text: who are rich in wondrous gifts and make the swelling ocean flow; may they grant us great friendship.

children.text: svarṇaram antarikṣāṇi rocanā dyāvābhūmī pṛthivīṃ skambhur ojasā
children.translated_text: Golden spaces, mid-regions, shining realms, heaven and earth: with strength they propped up the earth.

children.text: pṛkṣā iva mahayantaḥ surātayo devā stavante manuṣāya sūrayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like nourishing gifts, greatly honoring and bountiful, the gods, as inspired ones, are praised for mankind.

children.text: mitrāya śikṣa varuṇāya dāśuṣe yā samrājā manasā na pra yucchataḥ
children.translated_text: Instruct the generous worshipper for <s>Mitra</s> and for <s>Varuṇa</s>, the two universal kings who do not let their purpose slip from their mind,

children.text: yayor dhāma dharmaṇā rocate bṛhad yayor ubhe rodasī nādhasī vṛtau ||
children.translated_text: whose great domain shines through <s>dharma</s> (sacred order), and by whose protection both world-halves are enclosed.

children.text: yā gaur vartanim paryeti niṣkṛtam payo duhānā vratanīr avārataḥ
children.translated_text: The cow that goes around the prepared track, milking out milk, has not ceased from the ordinances.

children.text: sā prabruvāṇā varuṇāya dāśuṣe devebhyo dāśaddhaviṣā vivasvate ||
children.translated_text: Speaking thus, may she serve <s>Varuṇa</s>, the pious giver; may she serve the gods with oblation, and <s>Vivasvat</s>.

children.text: divakṣaso agnijihvā ṛtāvṛdha ṛtasya yoniṃ vimṛśanta āsate
children.translated_text: The heaven-dwellers, with <s>Agni</s> as their tongue, increasing <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), sit touching the womb of <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: dyāṃ skabhitvy apa ā cakrur ojasā yajñaṃ janitvī tanvī ni māmṛjuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having propped up heaven, they made the waters by their power; having generated the <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice), they cleansed their own bodies.

children.text: pari kṣitā pitarā pūrvajāvarī ṛtasya yonā kṣayataḥ samokasā
children.translated_text: The two parents, dwelling around us, first-born and unfailing, abide in one home in the womb of <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: dyāvāpṛthivī varuṇāya savrate ghṛtavat payo mahiṣāya pinvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, joined in vow for <s>Varuṇa</s>, swell ghee-rich milk for the mighty one.

children.text: parjanyāvātā vṛṣabhā purīṣiṇendravāyū varuṇo mitro aryamā
children.translated_text: <s>Parjanya</s> and <s>Vāta</s>, bulls with fertilizing moisture, <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>,

children.text: devāṁ ādityāṁ aditiṃ havāmahe ye pārthivāso divyāso apsu ye ||
children.translated_text: the gods, the <s>Ādityas</s>, and <s>Aditi</s> we call, those who are earthly, those heavenly, and those in the waters.

children.text: tvaṣṭāraṃ vāyum ṛbhavo ya ohate daivyā hotārā uṣasaṃ svastaye
children.translated_text: We seek <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, <s>Vāyu</s>, the <s>Ṛbhus</s> who exert themselves, the two divine <s>Hotṛs</s>, and <s>Uṣas</s> for well-being.

children.text: bṛhaspatiṃ vṛtrakhādaṃ sumedhasam indriyaṃ somaṃ dhanasā u īmahe ||
children.translated_text: We seek <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, destroyer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, wise-minded, and mighty <s>Soma</s>, for the winning of wealth.

children.text: brahma gām aśvaṃ janayanta oṣadhīr vanaspatīn pṛthivīm parvatāṁ apaḥ
children.translated_text: Generating sacred utterance, the cow, the horse, the herbs, the forest trees, the earth, the mountains, and the waters,

children.text: sūryaṃ divi rohayantaḥ sudānava āryā vratā visṛjanto adhi kṣami ||
children.translated_text: raising the sun in heaven, O liberal ones, and releasing the noble vows upon the earth.

children.text: bhujyum aṃhasaḥ pipṛtho nir aśvinā śyāvam putraṃ vadhrimatyā ajinvatam
children.translated_text: You two <s>Aśvins</s> rescued <s>Bhujyu</s> from distress; you revived <s>Śyāva</s>, son of <s>Vadhrimatī</s>.

children.text: kamadyuvaṃ vimadāyohathur yuvaṃ viṣṇāpvaṃ viśvakāyāva sṛjathaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You carried <s>Kamadyu</s> for <s>Vimada</s>; you released <s>Viṣṇāpu</s> for <s>Viśvakā</s>.

children.text: pāvīravī tanyatur ekapād ajo divo dhartā sindhur āpaḥ samudriyaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Pāvīravī</s>, the thunderer, <s>Aja Ekapād</s>, the supporter of heaven, the river, and the oceanic waters,

children.text: viśve devāsaḥ śṛṇavan vacāṃsi me sarasvatī saha dhībhiḥ purandhyā ||
children.translated_text: may all the gods hear my words, and <s>Sarasvatī</s> with inspired thoughts and abundance.

children.text: viśve devāḥ saha dhībhiḥ purandhyā manor yajatrā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ
children.translated_text: May all the gods, with inspired thoughts and abundance, worthy of <s>Manu</s>'s worship, immortal and knowing <s>ṛta</s>,

children.text: rātiṣāco abhiṣācaḥ svarvidaḥ svar giro brahma sūktaṃ juṣerata ||
children.translated_text: companions of gift, companions in overcoming, finders of heaven's light, accept the songs, the sacred utterance, and the hymn.

children.text: devān vasiṣṭho amṛtān vavande ye viśvā bhuvanābhi pratasthuḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> has praised the immortal gods who have extended themselves over all beings.

children.text: te no rāsantām urugāyam adya yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May they grant us wide-ranging wealth today; do you always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 903
devān huve bṛhacchravasaḥ svastaye jyotiṣkṛto adhvarasya pracetasaḥ
children.translated_text: I call the gods of great fame for well-being, makers of light, wise guardians of the rite,

children.text: ye vāvṛdhuḥ prataraṃ viśvavedasa indrajyeṣṭhāso amṛtā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: those immortal ones, headed by <s>Indra</s>, all-knowing and increasing <s>ṛta</s>, who have grown ever further.

children.text: indraprasūtā varuṇapraśiṣṭā ye sūryasya jyotiṣo bhāgam ānaśuḥ
children.translated_text: Impelled by <s>Indra</s>, instructed by <s>Varuṇa</s>, they have attained their share of the light of the sun.

children.text: marudgaṇe vṛjane manma dhīmahi māghone yajñaṃ janayanta sūrayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Among the troop of the <s>Maruts</s>, in the contest, let us set our thought; the inspired patrons generate the sacrifice for the generous giver.

children.text: indro vasubhiḥ pari pātu no gayam ādityair no aditiḥ śarma yacchatu
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> with the <s>Vasus</s> protect our household; may <s>Aditi</s> with the <s>Ādityas</s> grant us shelter.

children.text: rudro rudrebhir devo mṛḍayāti nas tvaṣṭā no gnābhiḥ suvitāya jinvatu ||
children.translated_text: May divine <s>Rudra</s> with the <s>Rudras</s> be gracious to us; may <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> with the goddesses quicken us toward good guidance.

children.text: aditir dyāvāpṛthivī ṛtam mahad indrāviṣṇū marutaḥ svar bṛhat
children.translated_text: <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, great <s>ṛta</s>, <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the <s>Maruts</s>, and the lofty heaven-light,

children.text: devāṁ ādityāṁ avase havāmahe vasūn rudrān savitāraṃ sudaṃsasam ||
children.translated_text: the gods, the <s>Ādityas</s>, we call for help, along with the <s>Vasus</s>, the <s>Rudras</s>, and well-working <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: sarasvān dhībhir varuṇo dhṛtavrataḥ pūṣā viṣṇur mahimā vāyur aśvinā
children.translated_text: <s>Sarasvān</s> with inspired thoughts, <s>Varuṇa</s> firm in vow, <s>Pūṣan</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, greatness, <s>Vāyu</s>, and the two <s>Aśvins</s>,

children.text: brahmakṛto amṛtā viśvavedasaḥ śarma no yaṃsan trivarūtham aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the immortal makers of sacred utterance, all-knowing, shall extend to us shelter, triple-protected, from distress.

children.text: vṛṣā yajño vṛṣaṇaḥ santu yajñiyā vṛṣaṇo devā vṛṣaṇo haviṣkṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the sacrifice be virile; let the worshipful ones be virile; let the gods be virile; let the makers of oblation be virile.

children.text: vṛṣaṇā dyāvāpṛthivī ṛtāvarī vṛṣā parjanyo vṛṣaṇo vṛṣastubhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, rich in <s>ṛta</s>, be virile; let <s>Parjanya</s> be virile, and those praised with virile hymns.

children.text: agnīṣomā vṛṣaṇā vājasātaye purupraśastā vṛṣaṇā upa bruve
children.translated_text: For the winning of strength I call near <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, virile, much-praised, virile.

children.text: yāv ījire vṛṣaṇo devayajyayā tā naḥ śarma trivarūthaṃ vi yaṃsataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those two virile ones who have been stirred by divine worship, may they extend to us triple-protected shelter.

children.text: dhṛtavratāḥ kṣatriyā yajñaniṣkṛto bṛhaddivā adhvarāṇām abhiśriyaḥ
children.translated_text: Firm in vow, sovereign, perfecting the sacrifice, wide-shining, the adornments of the rites,

children.text: agnihotāra ṛtasāpo adruho 'po asṛjann anu vṛtratūrye ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Agni</s>-hotars, attaining <s>ṛta</s>, undeceiving, released the waters after the overcoming of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: dyāvāpṛthivī janayann abhi vratāpa oṣadhīr vanināni yajñiyā
children.translated_text: Generating <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, the vows, the waters, the herbs, and the worshipful forest trees,

children.text: antarikṣaṃ svar ā paprur ūtaye vaśaṃ devāsas tanvī ni māmṛjuḥ ||
children.translated_text: the gods filled the midspace and the heaven-light for aid, and cleansed their own bodies at will.

children.text: dhartāro diva ṛbhavaḥ suhastā vātāparjanyā mahiṣasya tanyatoḥ
children.translated_text: The supporters of heaven, the skillful-handed <s>Ṛbhus</s>, <s>Vāta</s> and <s>Parjanya</s> of the mighty thunderer,

children.text: āpa oṣadhīḥ pra tirantu no giro bhago rātir vājino yantu me havam ||
children.translated_text: may the waters and herbs carry forward our songs; may <s>Bhaga</s>, gift, and the prize-winning ones come to my call.

children.text: samudraḥ sindhū rajo antarikṣam aja ekapāt tanayitnur arṇavaḥ
children.translated_text: The ocean, the rivers, the airy realm, the midspace, <s>Aja Ekapād</s>, the thunderer, and the flood,

children.text: ahir budhnyaḥ śṛṇavad vacāṃsi me viśve devāsa uta sūrayo mama ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Ahir Budhnya</s> hear my words, and all the gods, and my inspired patrons too.

children.text: syāma vo manavo devavītaye prāñcaṃ no yajñam pra ṇayata sādhuyā
children.translated_text: May we be your human followers for divine feasting; lead our sacrifice forward straight and rightly.

children.text: ādityā rudrā vasavaḥ sudānava imā brahma śasyamānāni jinvata ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Ādityas</s>, <s>Rudras</s>, <s>Vasus</s>, liberal ones, quicken these sacred utterances as they are being recited.

children.text: daivyā hotārā prathamā purohita ṛtasya panthām anv emi sādhuyā
children.translated_text: The two divine <s>Hotṛs</s>, first household priests, I follow rightly along the path of <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: kṣetrasya patim prativeśam īmahe viśvān devāṁ amṛtāṁ aprayucchataḥ ||
children.translated_text: We seek the lord of the field, the neighbor, and all the immortal, unforgetting gods.

children.text: vasiṣṭhāsaḥ pitṛvad vācam akrata devāṁ īḍānā ṛṣivat svastaye
children.translated_text: The <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s>, like fathers, have made their speech, praising the gods like seers for well-being.

children.text: prītā iva jñātayaḥ kāmam etyāsme devāso 'va dhūnutā vasu ||
children.translated_text: Like pleased kinsmen, coming according to desire, O gods, shake wealth down for us.

children.text: devān vasiṣṭho amṛtān vavande ye viśvā bhuvanābhi pratasthuḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> has praised the immortal gods who have extended themselves over all beings.

children.text: te no rāsantām urugāyam adya yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May they grant us wide-ranging wealth today; do you always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 904
imāṃ dhiyaṃ saptaśīrṣṇīm pitā na ṛtaprajātām bṛhatīm avindat
children.translated_text: Our father found this inspired thought, seven-headed, born of <s>ṛta</s>, lofty.

children.text: turīyaṃ svij janayad viśvajanyo 'yāsya uktham indrāya śaṃsan ||
children.translated_text: The all-generating <s>Ayāsya</s> brought forth the fourth hymn, proclaiming praise to <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: ṛtaṃ śaṃsanta ṛju dīdhyānā divas putrāso asurasya vīrāḥ
children.translated_text: Proclaiming <s>ṛta</s>, shining straight, the sons of heaven, heroes of the mighty lord,

children.text: vipram padam aṅgiraso dadhānā yajñasya dhāma prathamam mananta ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, bearing the inspired station, thought upon the first seat of the sacrifice.

children.text: haṃsair iva sakhibhir vāvadadbhir aśmanmayāni nahanā vyasyan
children.translated_text: Chattering with friends like swans, loosening stone-built bonds,

children.text: bṛhaspatir abhi kanikradad gā uta prāstaud uc ca vidvāṁ agāyat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, roaring over the cows, also praised aloud and, knowing, sang forth.

children.text: avo dvābhyām para ekayā gā guhā tiṣṭhantīr anṛtasya setau
children.translated_text: With two as aids, and beyond with one, the cows stood hidden on the bridge of falsehood.

children.text: bṛhaspatis tamasi jyotir icchann ud usrā ākar vi hi tisra āvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, seeking light in the darkness, brought forth the ruddy cows; he uncovered the three dawns.

children.text: vibhidyā puraṃ śayathem apācīṃ nis trīṇi sākam udadher akṛntat
children.translated_text: Having split the stronghold that lay turned downward, he cut out the three together from the ocean.

children.text: bṛhaspatir uṣasaṃ sūryaṃ gām arkaṃ viveda stanayann iva dyauḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s> found the dawn, the sun, the cow, and the song, thundering like heaven.

children.text: indro valaṃ rakṣitāraṃ dughānāṃ kareṇeva vi cakartā raveṇa
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, with his roar as with a hand, cut apart <s>Vala</s>, the guardian of the milch cows.

children.text: svedāñjibhir āśiram icchamāno 'rodayat paṇim ā gā amuṣṇāt ||
children.translated_text: Seeking the milk-mixture with sweat-anointed helpers, he made the <s>Paṇi</s> cry out and took the cows away.

children.text: sa īṃ satyebhiḥ sakhibhiḥ śucadbhir godhāyasaṃ vi dhanasair adardaḥ
children.translated_text: He, with true and shining friends, broke open the cow-holding, metal-like enclosure with wealth-winning powers.

children.text: brahmaṇaspatir vṛṣabhir varāhair gharmasvedebhir draviṇaṃ vy ānaṭ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, with bulls, with boars, and with heat-sweats, spread out the treasure.

children.text: te satyena manasā gopatiṃ gā iyānāsa iṣaṇayanta dhībhiḥ
children.translated_text: They, going toward the cows with a truthful mind, urged on the lord of cows with their thoughts.

children.text: bṛhaspatir mithoavadyapebhir ud usriyā asṛjata svayugbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, together with the mutually faultless and self-yoked ones, released the bright cows.

children.text: taṃ vardhayanto matibhiḥ śivābhiḥ siṃham iva nānadataṃ sadhasthe
children.translated_text: Strengthening him with auspicious thoughts, the roaring one like a lion in the common seat,

children.text: bṛhaspatiṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ śūrasātau bhare bhare anu madema jiṣṇum ||
children.translated_text: may we rejoice, in every contest and every prize-fight, in <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, the bull, the victorious one.

children.text: yadā vājam asanad viśvarūpam ā dyām arukṣad uttarāṇi sadma
children.translated_text: When he won the prize of every form and mounted to heaven and the higher seats,

children.text: bṛhaspatiṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vardhayanto nānā santo bibhrato jyotir āsā ||
children.translated_text: they strengthened <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, the bull, being many and bearing light in their mouths.

children.text: satyām āśiṣaṃ kṛṇutā vayodhai kīriṃ ciddhy avatha svebhir evaiḥ
children.translated_text: Make the blessing true, O givers of life; for you help even the singer with your own aids.

children.text: paścā mṛdho apa bhavantu viśvās tad rodasī śṛṇutaṃ viśvaminve ||
children.translated_text: Let all hostile powers fall behind and away; hear this, O two worlds, movers of all.

children.text: indro mahnā mahato arṇavasya vi mūrdhānam abhinad arbudasya
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, by his greatness, split the head of great <s>Arbuda</s> of the flood.

children.text: ahann ahim ariṇāt sapta sindhūn devair dyāvāpṛthivī prāvataṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: He slew the serpent and set loose the seven rivers; O gods, O <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s>, protect us.

children.text: Chapter 905
udapruto na vayo rakṣamāṇā vāvadato abhriyasyeva ghoṣāḥ
children.translated_text: Like water-filled birds guarding themselves, the roaring voices sounded like those of the cloud.

children.text: giribhrajo normayo madanto bṛhaspatim abhy arkā anāvan ||
children.translated_text: The hymns approached <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, like waves breaking from the mountains and rejoicing.

children.text: saṃ gobhir āṅgiraso nakṣamāṇo bhaga ived aryamaṇaṃ nināya
children.translated_text: The <s>Aṅgiras</s>, drawing near with the cows, led him on, as <s>Bhaga</s> would lead <s>Aryaman</s>.

children.text: jane mitro na dampatī anakti bṛhaspate vājayāśūṃr ivājau ||
children.translated_text: Like <s>Mitra</s> among people, he anoints the wedded pair; O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, speed the swift ones as in the contest.

children.text: sādhvaryā atithinīr iṣirā spārhāḥ suvarṇā anavadyarūpāḥ
children.translated_text: The kindly ritual guests, vigorous, desirable, golden, and of faultless form,

children.text: bṛhaspatiḥ parvatebhyo vitūryā nir gā ūpe yavam iva sthivibhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, having forced his way through the mountains, brought the cows out, like barley from the firm husks.

children.text: āpruṣāyan madhuna ṛtasya yonim avakṣipann arka ulkām iva dyoḥ
children.translated_text: Sprinkling the womb of honey and truth, the song dropped down like a firebrand from heaven.

children.text: bṛhaspatir uddharann aśmano gā bhūmyā udneva vi tvacam bibheda ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, raising the cows from the stone, split the earth like water splitting a hide.

children.text: apa jyotiṣā tamo antarikṣād udnaḥ śīpālam iva vāta ājat
children.translated_text: With light he drove the darkness from the midspace, as wind drives the scum from water.

children.text: bṛhaspatir anumṛśyā valasyābhram iva vāta ā cakra ā gāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, feeling along <s>Vala</s>, made the cows turn out, as wind turns a cloud.

children.text: yadā valasya pīyato jasum bhed bṛhaspatir agnitapobhir arkaiḥ
children.translated_text: When <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, with fire-hot songs, split the jaw of swollen <s>Vala</s>,

children.text: dadbhir na jihvā pariviṣṭam ādad āvir nidhīṃr akṛṇod usriyāṇām ||
children.translated_text: he took what was enclosed as teeth take the tongue; he made visible the treasures of the ruddy cows.

children.text: bṛhaspatir amata hi tyad āsāṃ nāma svarīṇāṃ sadane guhā yat
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s> perceived that name of these bright ones which was hidden in the secret seat.

children.text: āṇḍeva bhittvā śakunasya garbham ud usriyāḥ parvatasya tmanājat ||
children.translated_text: Like breaking the embryo from a bird's egg, he drove the ruddy cows out from the mountain by his own power.

children.text: aśnāpinaddham madhu pary apaśyan matsyaṃ na dīna udani kṣiyantam
children.translated_text: He looked around at the honey bound up in stone, like a fish, helpless, dwelling in water.

children.text: niṣ ṭaj jabhāra camasaṃ na vṛkṣād bṛhaspatir viraveṇā vikṛtya ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s> drew it out from there, like a cup from a tree, cutting it apart with a roar.

children.text: soṣām avindat sa svaḥ so agniṃ so arkeṇa vi babādhe tamāṃsi
children.translated_text: He found the dawn, he found the sun, he found <s>Agni</s>; with the song he drove away the darknesses.

children.text: bṛhaspatir govapuṣo valasya nir majjānaṃ na parvaṇo jabhāra ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s> drew forth the marrow from <s>Vala</s>, whose body was cows, as from a joint.

children.text: himeva parṇā muṣitā vanāni bṛhaspatinākṛpayad valo gāḥ
children.translated_text: As frost strips leaves and forests, so <s>Vala</s> made the cows pitiable through <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: anānukṛtyam apunaś cakāra yāt sūryāmāsā mitha uccarātaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He made what could not be imitated and not repeated, when sun and moon rise separately from one another.

children.text: abhi śyāvaṃ na kṛśanebhir aśvaṃ nakṣatrebhiḥ pitaro dyām apiṃśan
children.translated_text: Like a dark horse with ornaments, the fathers adorned heaven with stars.

children.text: rātryāṃ tamo adadhur jyotir ahan bṛhaspatir bhinad adriṃ vidad gāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They placed darkness in night and light in day; <s>Bṛhaspati</s> split the rock and found the cows.

children.text: idam akarma namo abhriyāya yaḥ pūrvīr anv ā nonavīti
children.translated_text: We have made this homage to the cloud-born one, who, from of old, keeps calling to us.

children.text: bṛhaspatiḥ sa hi gobhiḥ so aśvaiḥ sa vīrebhiḥ sa nṛbhir no vayo dhāt ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, for he is with cows, with horses, with heroes, and with men, should grant us vigor.

children.text: Chapter 906
bhadrā agner vadhryaśvasya saṃdṛśo vāmī praṇītiḥ suraṇā upetayaḥ
children.translated_text: Fair are the sights of <s>Agni</s> of <s>Vadhryaśva</s>; lovely his guidance, easy to enjoy, and near at hand.

children.text: yad īṃ sumitrā viśo agra indhate ghṛtenāhuto jarate davidyutat ||
children.translated_text: When friendly peoples kindle him in front, he, invoked with ghee, blazes and flashes.

children.text: ghṛtam agner vadhryaśvasya vardhanaṃ ghṛtam annaṃ ghṛtam v asya medanam
children.translated_text: Ghee is the growth of <s>Agni</s> of <s>Vadhryaśva</s>; ghee is his food, and ghee his fattening.

children.text: ghṛtenāhuta urviyā vi paprathe sūrya iva rocate sarpirāsutiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Invoked with ghee, he has spread out widely; fed with clarified butter, he shines like the sun.

children.text: yat te manur yad anīkaṃ sumitraḥ samīdhe agne tad idaṃ navīyaḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever face of yours <s>Manu</s>, whatever kindly one, kindled, O <s>Agni</s>, this here is newer.

children.text: sa revacchoca sa giro juṣasva sa vājaṃ darṣi sa iha śravo dhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Shine richly with that; accept the songs; reveal the prize, and place fame here.

children.text: yaṃ tvā pūrvam īḍito vadhryaśvaḥ samīdhe agne sa idaṃ juṣasva
children.translated_text: You whom <s>Vadhryaśva</s>, praised in former time, kindled, O <s>Agni</s>, accept this now.

children.text: sa na stipā uta bhavā tanūpā dātraṃ rakṣasva yad idaṃ te asme ||
children.translated_text: Be our protector of settlement and also protector of the body; guard the gift that is here from us to you.

children.text: bhavā dyumnī vādhryaśvota gopā mā tvā tārīd abhimātir janānām
children.translated_text: Be brilliant, O descendant of <s>Vadhryaśva</s>, and a herdsman; let the attack of men not overcome you.

children.text: śūra iva dhṛṣṇuś cyavanaḥ sumitraḥ pra nu vocaṃ vādhryaśvasya nāma ||
children.translated_text: Like a hero, bold and shaking foes, as a good friend, I now proclaim the name of <s>Vadhryaśva</s>.

children.text: sam ajryā parvatyā vasūni dāsā vṛtrāṇy āryā jigetha
children.translated_text: You have conquered the goods of the plains and mountains, the <s>Dāsa</s> obstacles and the <s>Ārya</s> ones.

children.text: śūra iva dhṛṣṇuś cyavano janānāṃ tvam agne pṛtanāyūṃr abhi ṣyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like a hero, bold and moving among peoples, you, O <s>Agni</s>, should overcome those eager for battle.

children.text: dīrghatantur bṛhadukṣāyam agniḥ sahasrastarīḥ śatanītha ṛbhvā
children.translated_text: This <s>Agni</s> has long threads, great refreshment, a thousand extensions, a hundred paths, and skill.

children.text: dyumān dyumatsu nṛbhir mṛjyamānaḥ sumitreṣu dīdayo devayatsu ||
children.translated_text: Brilliant among brilliant men, being cleansed by men, shine among the god-seeking friends.

children.text: tve dhenuḥ sudughā jātavedo 'saścateva samanā sabardhuk
children.translated_text: In you, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, the easily milked cow attaches herself, as if secure, sharing the same prosperity.

children.text: tvaṃ nṛbhir dakṣiṇāvadbhir agne sumitrebhir idhyase devayadbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, are kindled by men rich in gifts, by good friends, by those who seek the gods.

children.text: devāś cit te amṛtā jātavedo mahimānaṃ vādhryaśva pra vocan
children.translated_text: Even the immortal gods, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, proclaimed your greatness, O <s>Vādhryaśva</s>.

children.text: yat saṃpṛccham mānuṣīr viśa āyan tvaṃ nṛbhir ajayas tvāvṛdhebhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the human clans came together asking, you conquered with the men who strengthened you.

children.text: piteva putram abibhar upasthe tvām agne vadhryaśvaḥ saparyan
children.translated_text: Like a father carrying a son in his lap, <s>Vadhryaśva</s> served you, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: juṣāṇo asya samidhaṃ yaviṣṭhota pūrvāṃ avanor vrādhataś cit ||
children.translated_text: Accepting his kindling, O youngest one, you also protected the former men, even as they grew strong.

children.text: śaśvad agnir vadhryaśvasya śatrūn nṛbhir jigāya sutasomavadbhiḥ
children.translated_text: Again and again <s>Agni</s> of <s>Vadhryaśva</s> conquered the enemies with men who had pressed soma.

children.text: samanaṃ cid adahaś citrabhāno 'va vrādhantam abhinad vṛdhaś cit ||
children.translated_text: You burned even an equal foe, O bright-shining one, and struck down even the swelling one, though grown strong.

children.text: ayam agnir vadhryaśvasya vṛtrahā sanakāt preddho namasopavākyaḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>Agni</s> of <s>Vadhryaśva</s>, the slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, has been kindled from of old with reverent utterance.

children.text: sa no ajāmīṃr uta vā vijāmīn abhi tiṣṭha śardhato vādhryaśva ||
children.translated_text: Stand over our enemies, whether unrelated or related, and over those who are defiant, O <s>Vādhryaśva</s>.

children.text: Chapter 907
imām me agne samidhaṃ juṣasveḍas pade prati haryā ghṛtācīm
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, enjoy this kindling of mine, rich in ghee, at the place of <s>Iḍā</s>.

children.text: varṣman pṛthivyāḥ sudinatve ahnām ūrdhvo bhava sukrato devayajyā ||
children.translated_text: On the height of the earth, in the fair daylight of the days, stand upright, O wise one, for the worship of the gods.

children.text: ā devānām agrayāveha yātu narāśaṃso viśvarūpebhir aśvaiḥ
children.translated_text: Let <s>Narāśaṃsa</s>, the foremost guide of the gods, come here with horses of every form.

children.text: ṛtasya pathā namasā miyedho devebhyo devatamaḥ suṣūdat ||
children.translated_text: On the path of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), with homage, the thoughtful one, most divine for the gods, has seated them well.

children.text: śaśvattamam īḍate dūtyāya haviṣmanto manuṣyāso agnim
children.translated_text: Men rich in oblations continually praise <s>Agni</s> for the work of a messenger.

children.text: vahiṣṭhair aśvaiḥ suvṛtā rathenā devān vakṣi ni ṣadeha hotā ||
children.translated_text: With the best-bearing horses and a well-turned chariot, carry the gods here, and sit down as <s>hotar</s> (invoking priest).

children.text: vi prathatāṃ devajuṣṭaṃ tiraścā dīrghaṃ drāghmā surabhi bhūtv asme
children.translated_text: Let the god-loved <s>barhis</s> (sacrificial grass) spread out wide across, long in length, fragrant, for us.

children.text: aheḍatā manasā deva barhir indrajyeṣṭhāṁ uśato yakṣi devān ||
children.translated_text: With an unangered mind, O divine <s>barhis</s>, worship the willing gods, with <s>Indra</s> as eldest.

children.text: divo vā sānu spṛśatā varīyaḥ pṛthivyā vā mātrayā vi śrayadhvam
children.translated_text: Touch the higher ridge of heaven, or spread yourselves out by the measure of the earth.

children.text: uśatīr dvāro mahinā mahadbhir devaṃ rathaṃ rathayur dhārayadhvam ||
children.translated_text: O eager doors, with great greatness support the divine chariot, as chariot-drivers support a chariot.

children.text: devī divo duhitarā suśilpe uṣāsānaktā sadatāṃ ni yonau
children.translated_text: O goddesses, daughters of heaven, finely fashioned, <s>Uṣas</s> and <s>Naktā</s>, sit down in your seat.

children.text: ā vāṃ devāsa uśatī uśanta urau sīdantu subhage upasthe ||
children.translated_text: May the gods, eager for you, O eager goddesses, sit in your broad lap, O fortunate ones.

children.text: ūrdhvo grāvā bṛhad agniḥ samiddhaḥ priyā dhāmāny aditer upasthe
children.translated_text: The pressing-stone is raised; great <s>Agni</s> is kindled in the dear dwellings in the lap of <s>Aditi</s>.

children.text: purohitāv ṛtvijā yajñe asmin viduṣṭarā draviṇam ā yajethām ||
children.translated_text: As two household priests and season-priests in this sacrifice, more knowing than others, bring wealth here for worship.

children.text: tisro devīr barhir idaṃ varīya ā sīdata cakṛmā vaḥ syonam
children.translated_text: O three goddesses, sit upon this broader <s>barhis</s>; we have made it pleasant for you.

children.text: manuṣvad yajñaṃ sudhitā havīṃṣīḍā devī ghṛtapadī juṣanta ||
children.translated_text: As in <s>Manu</s>'s rite, may the well-placed offerings be enjoyed by the goddess <s>Iḍā</s>, she whose feet are rich in ghee.

children.text: deva tvaṣṭar yaddha cārutvam ānaḍ yad aṅgirasām abhavaḥ sacābhūḥ
children.translated_text: O god <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, when you attained lovely form, when you became a companion of the <s>Aṅgirases</s>,

children.text: sa devānām pātha upa pra vidvāṁ uśan yakṣi draviṇodaḥ suratnaḥ ||
children.translated_text: then, knowing the path of the gods, approach and worship, eager, O giver of wealth, rich in good treasures.

children.text: vanaspate raśanayā niyūyā devānām pātha upa vakṣi vidvān
children.translated_text: O <s>Vanaspati</s>, fastened with the rope, knowing the path of the gods, carry it near.

children.text: svadāti devaḥ kṛṇavaddhavīṃṣy avatāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī havam me ||
children.translated_text: May the god sweeten the offerings and make them ready; may <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> aid my call.

children.text: āgne vaha varuṇam iṣṭaye na indraṃ divo maruto antarikṣāt
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, bring <s>Varuṇa</s> for our offering, <s>Indra</s> from heaven, and the <s>Maruts</s> from the midspace.

children.text: sīdantu barhir viśva ā yajatrāḥ svāhā devā amṛtā mādayantām ||
children.translated_text: May all the worshipful ones sit upon the <s>barhis</s>; with <s>svāhā</s>, may the immortal gods rejoice.

children.text: Chapter 908
bṛhaspate prathamaṃ vāco agraṃ yat prairata nāmadheyaṃ dadhānāḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, when they sent forth the first beginning of speech, giving names,

children.text: yad eṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yad aripram āsīt preṇā tad eṣāṃ nihitaṃ guhāviḥ ||
children.translated_text: whatever was best and faultless among them, that hidden thing became manifest through loving impulse.

children.text: saktum iva titaunā punanto yatra dhīrā manasā vācam akrata
children.translated_text: Where the wise, cleansing speech like barley with a sieve, fashioned it with the mind,

children.text: atrā sakhāyaḥ sakhyāni jānate bhadraiṣāṃ lakṣmīr nihitādhi vāci ||
children.translated_text: there friends recognize their friendships; auspicious fortune is set upon their speech.

children.text: yajñena vācaḥ padavīyam āyan tām anv avindann ṛṣiṣu praviṣṭām
children.translated_text: By sacrifice they followed the track of speech; they found her entered among the seers.

children.text: tām ābhṛtyā vy adadhuḥ purutrā tāṃ sapta rebhā abhi saṃ navante ||
children.translated_text: Having brought her, they distributed her in many places; the seven singers together praise her.

children.text: uta tvaḥ paśyan na dadarśa vācam uta tvaḥ śṛṇvan na śṛṇoty enām
children.translated_text: One person, though seeing, has not seen speech; another, though hearing, does not hear her.

children.text: uto tvasmai tanvaṃ vi sasre jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Yet to another she has opened her body, like a well-dressed, loving wife to her husband.

children.text: uta tvaṃ sakhye sthirapītam āhur nainaṃ hinvanty api vājineṣu
children.translated_text: They say that one is firm and well nourished in friendship; they do not urge him on even in contests for prizes.

children.text: adhenvā carati māyayaiṣa vācaṃ śuśruvāṁ aphalām apuṣpām ||
children.translated_text: This one moves with barren illusion; though he has heard speech, he has heard her fruitless and flowerless.

children.text: yas tityāja sacividaṃ sakhāyaṃ na tasya vācy api bhāgo asti
children.translated_text: Whoever has abandoned a friend who knows companionship has no share even in speech.

children.text: yad īṃ śṛṇoty alakaṃ śṛṇoti nahi praveda sukṛtasya panthām ||
children.translated_text: When he hears her, he hears in vain; for he does not know the path of good action.

children.text: akṣaṇvantaḥ karṇavantaḥ sakhāyo manojaveṣv asamā babhūvuḥ
children.translated_text: Friends with eyes and ears have proved unequal in the swift courses of the mind.

children.text: ādaghnāsa upakakṣāsa u tve hradā iva snātvā u tve dadṛśre ||
children.translated_text: Some appear like ponds reaching to the mouth; others to the armpit; and some, as it were, show themselves after bathing.

children.text: hṛdā taṣṭeṣu manaso javeṣu yad brāhmaṇāḥ saṃyajante sakhāyaḥ
children.translated_text: When the <s>brāhmaṇas</s> (sacred formulators), as friends, sacrifice together in what is shaped by the heart and in the impulses of the mind,

children.text: atrāha tvaṃ vi jahur vedyābhir ohabrahmāṇo vi caranty u tve ||
children.translated_text: there some leave you behind through their knowledge, while others, lacking <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation), wander here and there.

children.text: ime ye nārvāṅ na paraś caranti na brāhmaṇāso na sutekarāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Those who move neither forward nor farther away are neither <s>brāhmaṇas</s> nor soma-pressers.

children.text: ta ete vācam abhipadya pāpayā sirīs tantraṃ tanvate aprajajñayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They, having come upon speech in an evil way, weave a poor thread without understanding.

children.text: sarve nandanti yaśasāgatena sabhāsāhena sakhyā sakhāyaḥ
children.translated_text: All friends rejoice in the friend who has come with fame, victorious in the assembly.

children.text: kilbiṣaspṛt pituṣaṇir hy eṣām araṃ hito bhavati vājināya ||
children.translated_text: For them he becomes a remover of guilt and a winner of nourishment; he is well placed for the prize.

children.text: ṛcāṃ tvaḥ poṣam āste pupuṣvān gāyatraṃ tvo gāyati śakvarīṣu
children.translated_text: One sits nourishing the <s>ṛc</s> verses; another sings the <s>gāyatra</s> among the <s>śakvarī</s> verses.

children.text: brahmā tvo vadati jātavidyāṃ yajñasya mātrāṃ vi mimīta u tvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Another, the <s>brahmā</s> priest, speaks the knowledge born of sacred formulation; another measures out the measure of the sacrifice.

children.text: Chapter 909
devānāṃ nu vayaṃ jānā pra vocāma vipanyayā
children.translated_text: Now with insight we shall proclaim the births of the gods.

children.text: uktheṣu śasyamāneṣu yaḥ paśyād uttare yuge ||
children.translated_text: When the <s>uktha</s> hymns are being recited, may one see this in a later age.

children.text: brahmaṇas patir etā saṃ karmāra ivādhamat
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s> fashioned these, like a smith with his bellows.

children.text: devānām pūrvye yuge 'sataḥ sad ajāyata ||
children.translated_text: In the earliest age of the gods, being was born from non-being.

children.text: devānāṃ yuge prathame 'sataḥ sad ajāyata
children.translated_text: In the first age of the gods, being was born from non-being.

children.text: tad āśā anv ajāyanta tad uttānapadas pari ||
children.translated_text: From that the quarters were born; from that, from around <s>Uttānapad</s>.

children.text: bhūr jajña uttānapado bhuva āśā ajāyanta
children.translated_text: The earth was born from <s>Uttānapad</s>; from the earth the quarters were born.

children.text: aditer dakṣo ajāyata dakṣād v aditiḥ pari ||
children.translated_text: From <s>Aditi</s> <s>Dakṣa</s> was born, and from <s>Dakṣa</s> <s>Aditi</s> in turn.

children.text: aditir hy ajaniṣṭa dakṣa yā duhitā tava
children.translated_text: For <s>Aditi</s> was indeed born, O <s>Dakṣa</s>, she who is your daughter.

children.text: tāṃ devā anv ajāyanta bhadrā amṛtabandhavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: After her the gods were born, blessed ones, kinsmen of immortality.

children.text: yad devā adaḥ salile susaṃrabdhā atiṣṭhata
children.translated_text: When you gods stood there in the waters, closely gathered together,

children.text: atrā vo nṛtyatām iva tīvro reṇur apāyata ||
children.translated_text: then from you, as from dancers, a sharp dust rose up.

children.text: yad devā yatayo yathā bhuvanāny apinvata
children.translated_text: When the gods, like ascetics, filled out the worlds,

children.text: atrā samudra ā gūḍham ā sūryam ajabhartana ||
children.translated_text: then you brought forth the sun, hidden away in the ocean.

children.text: aṣṭau putrāso aditer ye jātās tanvas pari
children.translated_text: The eight sons of <s>Aditi</s>, who were born from her body,

children.text: devāṁ upa prait saptabhiḥ parā mārtāṇḍam āsyat ||
children.translated_text: she approached the gods with seven of them; she cast <s>Mārtāṇḍa</s> away.

children.text: saptabhiḥ putrair aditir upa prait pūrvyaṃ yugam
children.translated_text: With seven sons <s>Aditi</s> approached the former age.

children.text: prajāyai mṛtyave tvat punar mārtāṇḍam ābharat ||
children.translated_text: For offspring and for death she brought <s>Mārtāṇḍa</s> back again.

children.text: Chapter 910
janiṣṭhā ugraḥ sahase turāya mandra ojiṣṭho bahulābhimānaḥ
children.translated_text: The fierce one was born for strength and swift power, gladdening, strongest, and greatly self-exalting.

children.text: avardhann indram marutaś cid atra mātā yad vīraṃ dadhanad dhaniṣṭhā ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Maruts</s> strengthened <s>Indra</s> there, when the mother, richest in gifts, bore the hero.

children.text: druho niṣattā pṛśanī cid evaiḥ purū śaṃsena vāvṛdhuṣ ṭa indram
children.translated_text: Settling down treacheries, even <s>Pṛśni</s>, with these aids, magnified <s>Indra</s> through much praise.

children.text: abhīvṛteva tā mahāpadena dhvāntāt prapitvād ud aranta garbhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like those hemmed in by a great stride, the embryos rose up out of darkness and confinement.

children.text: ṛṣvā te pādā pra yaj jigāsy avardhan vājā uta ye cid atra
children.translated_text: Your lofty feet went forth when you wished to advance; the prizes, and all that was there, increased.

children.text: tvam indra sālāvṛkān sahasram āsan dadhiṣe aśvinā vavṛtyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, took a thousand <s>Sālāvṛkas</s> upon your mouth; the two <s>Aśvins</s> turned back.

children.text: samanā tūrṇir upa yāsi yajñam ā nāsatyā sakhyāya vakṣi
children.translated_text: Together, as the swift one, you go to the sacrifice; O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, bring him near for friendship.

children.text: vasāvyām indra dhārayaḥ sahasrāśvinā śūra dadatur maghāni ||
children.translated_text: In the <s>Vasavyā</s> rite, O <s>Indra</s>, you held firm; the two <s>Aśvins</s>, O hero, gave gifts by the thousand.

children.text: mandamāna ṛtād adhi prajāyai sakhibhir indra iṣirebhir artham
children.translated_text: Gladdening from <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), O <s>Indra</s>, you sought the aim for offspring with your impelling friends.

children.text: ābhir hi māyā upa dasyum āgān mihaḥ pra tamrā avapat tamāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: For with these powers you came against the <s>Dasyu</s>; you cast down the ruddy mists and the darknesses.

children.text: sanāmānā cid dhvasayo ny asmā avāhann indra uṣaso yathānaḥ
children.translated_text: You shattered even the ancient ones for this man; O <s>Indra</s>, you brought down the dawns as before.

children.text: ṛṣvair agacchaḥ sakhibhir nikāmaiḥ sākam pratiṣṭhā hṛdyā jaghantha ||
children.translated_text: With lofty friends, according to your desires, you came; together you struck down the dear strongholds.

children.text: tvaṃ jaghantha namucim makhasyuṃ dāsaṃ kṛṇvāna ṛṣaye vimāyam
children.translated_text: You struck down <s>Namuci</s> the plunderer, the <s>Dāsa</s> who worked illusion against the seer.

children.text: tvaṃ cakartha manave syonān patho devatrāñjaseva yānān ||
children.translated_text: You made pleasant paths for <s>Manu</s>, roads going straight to the gods as if by a clear course.

children.text: tvam etāni papriṣe vi nāmeśāna indra dadhiṣe gabhastau
children.translated_text: You have filled these things; in your names, as lord, O <s>Indra</s>, you have held them in your hands.

children.text: anu tvā devāḥ śavasā madanty uparibudhnān vaninaś cakartha ||
children.translated_text: The gods rejoice after you because of your might; you made the forest trees with roots above.

children.text: cakraṃ yad asyāpsv ā niṣattam uto tad asmai madhv ic cachadyāt
children.translated_text: When his wheel was set down in the waters, let that too pour sweetness for him.

children.text: pṛthivyām atiṣitaṃ yad ūdhaḥ payo goṣv adadhā oṣadhīṣu ||
children.translated_text: The udder set upon the earth, you placed as milk among the cows and among the plants.

children.text: aśvād iyāyeti yad vadanty ojaso jātam uta manya enam
children.translated_text: They say, 'It came from the horse'; and one thinks him born from vital force.

children.text: manyor iyāya harmyeṣu tasthau yataḥ prajajña indro asya veda ||
children.translated_text: It came from wrath; he stood in the houses. <s>Indra</s> knows from where he was born.

children.text: vayaḥ suparṇā upa sedur indram priyamedhā ṛṣayo nādhamānāḥ
children.translated_text: The fair-winged birds, the <s>Priyamedha</s> seers, sat down near <s>Indra</s>, pleading.

children.text: apa dhvāntam ūrṇuhi pūrdhi cakṣur mumugdhy asmān nidhayeva baddhān ||
children.translated_text: Uncover the darkness; fill our sight; release us as men bound like a hidden treasure.

children.text: Chapter 911
vasūnāṃ vā carkṛṣa iyakṣan dhiyā vā yajñair vā rodasyoḥ
children.translated_text: Whether you wish to sacrifice while ploughing for goods, or by insight, or by sacrifices for the two worlds,

children.text: arvanto vā ye rayimantaḥ sātau vanuṃ vā ye suśruṇaṃ suśruto dhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: or whether horses rich in wealth are at the winning, or those famed ones have set down the well-heard prize,
