children.text: hava eṣām asuro nakṣata dyāṃ śravasyatā manasā niṃsata kṣām
children.translated_text: may the mighty lord of these reach heaven; with fame-seeking mind may he settle upon the earth.

children.text: cakṣāṇā yatra suvitāya devā dyaur na vārebhiḥ kṛṇavanta svaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: There, looking toward good guidance, the gods make their own protections, as heaven does with its coverings.

children.text: iyam eṣām amṛtānāṃ gīḥ sarvatātā ye kṛpaṇanta ratnam
children.translated_text: This is the song of those immortals, of all who bestow treasure.

children.text: dhiyaṃ ca yajñaṃ ca sādhantas te no dhāntu vasavyam asāmi ||
children.translated_text: Accomplishing thought and sacrifice, may they set for us unmatched wealth.

children.text: ā tat ta indrāyavaḥ panantābhi ya ūrvaṃ gomantaṃ titṛtsān
children.translated_text: Let the <s>Indra</s>-loving singers praise that of yours, those who seek to cross to the broad, cow-rich one.

children.text: sakṛtsvaṃ ye puruputrām mahīṃ sahasradhārām bṛhatīṃ dudukṣan ||
children.translated_text: Those who would milk for themselves the great, many-childed, broad one with a thousand streams, even once,

children.text: śacīva indram avase kṛṇudhvam anānataṃ damayantam pṛtanyūn
children.translated_text: with power make <s>Indra</s> for aid, unbent and subduing his battle-seeking foes.

children.text: ṛbhukṣaṇam maghavānaṃ suvṛktim bhartā yo vajraṃ naryam purukṣuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Make him the <s>Ṛbhukṣan</s>, the bountiful one, well-praised, the bearer of the manly thunderbolt, rich in many goods.

children.text: yad vāvāna purutamam purāṣāḍ ā vṛtrahendro nāmāny aprāḥ
children.translated_text: When <s>Indra</s>, greatly loving, most manifold, anciently victorious, <s>Vṛtrahan</s>, filled out his names,

children.text: aceti prāsahas patis tuviṣmān yad īm uśmasi kartave karat tat ||
children.translated_text: the mighty lord of overpowering strength was perceived; whatever we wish him to do, may he do that.

children.text: Chapter 912
pra su va āpo mahimānam uttamaṃ kārur vocāti sadane vivasvataḥ
children.translated_text: Let the singer proclaim your highest greatness, O waters, in the dwelling of <s>Vivasvat</s>.

children.text: pra sapta sapta tredhā hi cakramuḥ pra sṛtvarīṇām ati sindhur ojasā ||
children.translated_text: Seven by seven they have gone forth in threefold fashion; the <s>Sindhu</s> surpasses the flowing rivers in might.

children.text: pra te 'radad varuṇo yātave pathaḥ sindho yad vājāṁ abhy adravas tvam
children.translated_text: O <s>Sindhu</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s> dug out paths for you to travel, when you rushed toward the prizes.

children.text: bhūmyā adhi pravatā yāsi sānunā yad eṣām agraṃ jagatām irajyasi ||
children.translated_text: From the earth's slope you go by your ridge, when you impel the foremost of these moving streams.

children.text: divi svano yatate bhūmyopary anantaṃ śuṣmam ud iyarti bhānunā
children.translated_text: Your sound stretches in heaven above the earth; with radiance you raise up endless force.

children.text: abhrād iva pra stanayanti vṛṣṭayaḥ sindhur yad eti vṛṣabho na roruvat ||
children.translated_text: Like rains thundering from a cloud, the <s>Sindhu</s> comes, roaring like a bull.

children.text: abhi tvā sindho śiśum in na mātaro vāśrā arṣanti payaseva dhenavaḥ
children.translated_text: Toward you, O <s>Sindhu</s>, the mothers stream like a child, lowing like milch cows with their milk.

children.text: rājeva yudhvā nayasi tvam it sicau yad āsām agram pravatām inakṣasi ||
children.translated_text: Like a warrior king you lead them into the channels, when you reach the forefront of these downward-running streams.

children.text: imam me gaṅge yamune sarasvati śutudri stomaṃ sacatā paruṣṇy ā
children.translated_text: O <s>Gaṅgā</s>, <s>Yamunā</s>, <s>Sarasvatī</s>, and <s>Śutudrī</s>, join in this hymn of mine with <s>Paruṣṇī</s>.

children.text: asiknyā marudvṛdhe vitastayārjīkīye śṛṇuhy ā suṣomayā ||
children.translated_text: With <s>Asiknī</s>, <s>Marudvṛdhā</s>, and <s>Vitastā</s>, O <s>Ārjīkīyā</s>, listen together with <s>Suṣomā</s>.

children.text: tṛṣṭāmayā prathamaṃ yātave sajūḥ susartvā rasayā śvetyā tyā
children.translated_text: With <s>Tṛṣṭāmā</s> first, united for the journey, with <s>Susartū</s>, <s>Rasā</s>, <s>Śvetī</s>, and that <s>Tyā</s>,

children.text: tvaṃ sindho kubhayā gomatīṃ krumum mehatnvā sarathaṃ yābhir īyase ||
children.translated_text: you, O <s>Sindhu</s>, go in the same chariot with <s>Kubhā</s>, <s>Gomatī</s>, <s>Krumu</s>, and <s>Mehatnū</s>, with those by which you travel.

children.text: ṛjīty enī ruśatī mahitvā pari jrayāṃsi bharate rajāṃsi
children.translated_text: Straight-running, dark and gleaming in greatness, she bears the expanses and the realms around.

children.text: adabdhā sindhur apasām apastamāśvā na citrā vapuṣīva darśatā ||
children.translated_text: Unharmed is <s>Sindhu</s>, most active among the waters, like a bright mare, visible in her forms.

children.text: svaśvā sindhuḥ surathā suvāsā hiraṇyayī sukṛtā vājinīvatī
children.translated_text: <s>Sindhu</s> has good horses, a good chariot, fair garments, golden, well made, and rich in steeds.

children.text: ūrṇāvatī yuvatiḥ sīlamāvaty utādhi vaste subhagā madhuvṛdham ||
children.translated_text: Wool-clad, youthful, rich in soft growth, she also puts on a fortunate garment that swells with honey.

children.text: sukhaṃ rathaṃ yuyuje sindhur aśvinaṃ tena vājaṃ saniṣad asminn ājau
children.translated_text: <s>Sindhu</s> yoked a pleasant, horse-drawn chariot; with it she would win the prize in this contest.

children.text: mahān hy asya mahimā panasyate 'dabdhasya svayaśaso virapśinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For the great majesty of the unharmed, self-renowned, far-spreading one is praised.

children.text: Chapter 913
ā va ṛñjasa ūrjāṃ vyuṣṭiṣv indram maruto rodasī anaktana
children.translated_text: At the daybreaks, O <s>Maruts</s>, adorn <s>Indra</s> and <s>Rodasī</s> with the nourishment that comes to you.

children.text: ubhe yathā no ahanī sacābhuvā sadaḥ sado varivasyāta udbhidā ||
children.translated_text: May both days be our companions, and may the ever-opening seat after seat make broad room for us.

children.text: tad u śreṣṭhaṃ savanaṃ sunotanātyo na hastayato adriḥ sotari
children.translated_text: Press out that best <s>savana</s> (soma pressing); the stone, like a horse held in hand, is at the presser.

children.text: vidaddhy aryo abhibhūti pauṃsyam maho rāye cit tarute yad arvataḥ ||
children.translated_text: It finds the noble one's overpowering manly strength; it even wins great wealth when it has horses.

children.text: tad iddhy asya savanaṃ viver apo yathā purā manave gātum aśret
children.translated_text: For that pressing of his has opened the waters, as of old it took a path for <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: goarṇasi tvāṣṭre aśvanirṇiji prem adhvareṣv adhvarāṁ aśiśrayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: In the cow-rich, <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>-fashioned, horse-cleansing rite, they have eagerly taken refuge in the sacrifices.

children.text: apa hata rakṣaso bhaṅgurāvata skabhāyata nirṛtiṃ sedhatāmatim
children.translated_text: Strike away the <s>Rakṣases</s>, O breakers; prop away <s>Nirṛti</s>, and drive off hostile intent.

children.text: ā no rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ sunotana devāvyam bharata ślokam adrayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Press out for us wealth rich in every hero; bring a godward song, O stones.

children.text: divaś cid ā vo 'mavattarebhyo vibhvanā cid āśvapastarebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: From heaven itself come to you who are stronger in power, and from the wide one to you who are swifter in horse-work.

children.text: vāyoś cid ā somarabhastarebhyo 'gneś cid arca pitukṛttarebhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: From <s>Vāyu</s> himself to those more eager for soma, from <s>Agni</s> himself, sing to those who prepare the drink better.

children.text: bhurantu no yaśasaḥ sotv andhaso grāvāṇo vācā divitā divitmatā
children.translated_text: Let the pressing stones win fame for us and press the soma, with speech heavenly and luminous.

children.text: naro yatra duhate kāmyam madhv āghoṣayanto abhito mithasturaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There the men milk the desired honey, calling out all around, driving one another on.

children.text: sunvanti somaṃ rathirāso adrayo nir asya rasaṃ gaviṣo duhanti te
children.translated_text: The stones, like chariot-warriors, press the soma; seeking cows, they milk out its sap.

children.text: duhanty ūdhar upasecanāya kaṃ naro havyā na marjayanta āsabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They milk the udder for sprinkling, as men cleanse offerings with their mouths.

children.text: ete naraḥ svapaso abhūtana ya indrāya sunutha somam adrayaḥ
children.translated_text: You have become these men of good work, O stones, who press soma for <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: vāmaṃ vāmaṃ vo divyāya dhāmne vasu vasu vaḥ pārthivāya sunvate ||
children.translated_text: Choice after choice is yours for the heavenly station; treasure after treasure is yours for the earthly presser.

children.text: Chapter 914
abhrapruṣo na vācā pruṣā vasu haviṣmanto na yajñā vi jānuṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Like clouds sprinkling rain, with rain-shedding speech, rich in goods, like sacrifices bearing oblation and known afar,

children.text: sumārutaṃ na brahmāṇam arhase gaṇam astoṣy eṣāṃ na śobhase ||
children.translated_text: you deserve the prayer as if it were full of the <s>Maruts</s>; I have praised the troop, and you shine among them.

children.text: śriye maryāso añjīṃr akṛṇvata sumārutaṃ na pūrvīr ati kṣapaḥ
children.translated_text: The young warriors made their adornments for beauty, like nights well accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s> passing beyond many nights.

children.text: divas putrāsa etā na yetira ādityāsas te akrā na vāvṛdhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: These sons of heaven have not gone astray; like <s>Ādityas</s>, they have grown by their own power.

children.text: pra ye divaḥ pṛthivyā na barhaṇā tmanā riricre abhrān na sūryaḥ
children.translated_text: When by themselves they have surpassed heaven and earth in greatness, like the sun surpassing the clouds,

children.text: pājasvanto na vīrāḥ panasyavo riśādaso na maryā abhidyavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: they are powerful like heroes, praiseworthy, destroyers of enemies, like young men shining against foes.

children.text: yuṣmākam budhne apāṃ na yāmani vithuryati na mahī śratharyati
children.translated_text: At your foundation, as at the course of waters, the great one trembles and shakes apart.

children.text: viśvapsur yajño arvāg ayaṃ su vaḥ prayasvanto na satrāca ā gata ||
children.translated_text: This all-formed sacrifice has turned hither toward you; come here all together, rich in offerings.

children.text: yūyaṃ dhūrṣu prayujo na raśmibhir jyotiṣmanto na bhāsā vyuṣṭiṣu
children.translated_text: You are yoked to the poles like teams with reins, bright with light at the daybreaks.

children.text: śyenāso na svayaśaso riśādasaḥ pravāso na prasitāsaḥ paripruṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like hawks, self-renowned and enemy-slaying, like streams sent forth, released and flowing all around.

children.text: pra yad vahadhve marutaḥ parākād yūyam mahaḥ saṃvaraṇasya vasvaḥ
children.translated_text: When you drive from afar, O <s>Maruts</s>, you are possessors of the great enveloping treasure.

children.text: vidānāso vasavo rādhyasyārāc cid dveṣaḥ sanutar yuyota ||
children.translated_text: Knowing treasures and what is to be won, O <s>Vasus</s>, drive hatred far away, to a distance.

children.text: ya udṛci yajñe adhvareṣṭhā marudbhyo na mānuṣo dadāśat
children.translated_text: The man who, in an elevated sacrifice, standing firm in the rites, gives worship to the <s>Maruts</s>, not like a mere mortal,

children.text: revat sa vayo dadhate suvīraṃ sa devānām api gopīthe astu ||
children.translated_text: he gains rich vitality and heroic strength; let him be also in the protection of the gods.

children.text: te hi yajñeṣu yajñiyāsa ūmā ādityena nāmnā śambhaviṣṭhāḥ
children.translated_text: For they are worthy of sacrifice in sacrifices, strong, known by the name <s>Āditya</s>, most beneficent.

children.text: te no 'vantu rathatūr manīṣām mahaś ca yāmann adhvare cakānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May they protect our inspired thought in the rush of the chariot, delighting in the great course at the rite.

children.text: Chapter 915
viprāso na manmabhiḥ svādhyo devāvyo na yajñaiḥ svapnasaḥ
children.translated_text: Like inspired poets with their thoughts, self-devoted, like god-seeking men with sacrifices and good works,

children.text: rājāno na citrāḥ susaṃdṛśaḥ kṣitīnāṃ na maryā arepasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like kings, brilliant and fair to behold, like faultless young men among the peoples.

children.text: agnir na ye bhrājasā rukmavakṣaso vātāso na svayujaḥ sadyaūtayaḥ
children.translated_text: Like <s>Agni</s> with blazing splendor, golden-breasted, like the winds, self-yoked and immediately bright,

children.text: prajñātāro na jyeṣṭhāḥ sunītayaḥ suśarmāṇo na somā ṛtaṃ yate ||
children.translated_text: like well-guiding elders who know the way, of good shelter, like somas going toward truth.

children.text: vātāso na ye dhunayo jigatnavo 'gnīnāṃ na jihvā virokiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: Like winds, shaking and eager to move, like the tongues of fires shining widely,

children.text: varmaṇvanto na yodhāḥ śimīvantaḥ pitṝṇāṃ na śaṃsāḥ surātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like warriors in armor, strong-armed, like the praises of the Fathers, rich in good gifts.

children.text: rathānāṃ na ye 'rāḥ sanābhayo jigīvāṃso na śūrā abhidyavaḥ
children.translated_text: Like the spokes of chariots, sharing one nave, like victorious heroes shining against foes,

children.text: vareyavo na maryā ghṛtapruṣo 'bhisvartāro arkaṃ na suṣṭubhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like desirable young men sprinkling ghee, like loud singers with a well-praised chant.

children.text: aśvāso na ye jyeṣṭhāsa āśavo didhiṣavo na rathyaḥ sudānavaḥ
children.translated_text: Like horses, foremost and swift, like chariot-seekers, generous givers,

children.text: āpo na nimnair udabhir jigatnavo viśvarūpā aṅgiraso na sāmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: like waters hastening through low channels with upsurging floods, many-formed like the <s>Aṅgirases</s> with their chants.

children.text: grāvāṇo na sūrayaḥ sindhumātara ādardirāso adrayo na viśvahā
children.translated_text: Like pressing stones, wise ones with <s>Sindhu</s> as mother, like stones that split open all day long,

children.text: śiśūlā na krīḍayaḥ sumātaro mahāgrāmo na yāmann uta tviṣā ||
children.translated_text: like playful little children with good mothers, like a great host on its march and in its brilliance.

children.text: uṣasāṃ na ketavo 'dhvaraśriyaḥ śubhaṃyavo nāñjibhir vy aśvitan
children.translated_text: Like the signs of dawns, ornaments of the sacrifice, seeking beauty, they adorned themselves with decorations.

children.text: sindhavo na yayiyo bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ parāvato na yojanāni mamire ||
children.translated_text: Like rivers going forth, with gleaming vision, from afar they measured out the distances.

children.text: subhāgān no devāḥ kṛṇutā suratnān asmān stotṝn maruto vāvṛdhānāḥ
children.translated_text: Make us fortunate, O gods, rich in good treasures; make us, your singers, grow strong, O <s>Maruts</s>.

children.text: adhi stotrasya sakhyasya gāta sanāddhi vo ratnadheyāni santi ||
children.translated_text: Go toward the friendship of the hymn, for from of old your treasure-bestowals have existed.

children.text: Chapter 916
apaśyam asya mahato mahitvam amartyasya martyāsu vikṣu
children.translated_text: I have seen the greatness of this great immortal among mortal settlements.

children.text: nānā hanū vibhṛte sam bharete asinvatī bapsatī bhūry attaḥ ||
children.translated_text: It bears many jaws; the two carry them together, devouring and gulping, eating much.

children.text: guhā śiro nihitam ṛdhag akṣī asinvann atti jihvayā vanāni
children.translated_text: Its head is hidden in a secret place, its eyes set apart; without drinking, it eats the forests with its tongue.

children.text: atrāṇy asmai paḍbhiḥ sam bharanty uttānahastā namasādhi vikṣu ||
children.translated_text: They bring coverings to him with their feet, their hands stretched upward in reverence among the clans.

children.text: pra mātuḥ prataraṃ guhyam icchan kumāro na vīrudhaḥ sarpad urvīḥ
children.translated_text: Desiring the farther secret of his mother, the youth crept through the broad plants like a child.

children.text: sasaṃ na pakvam avidacchucantaṃ ririhvāṃsaṃ ripa upasthe antaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In the lap of the foe he found him shining, licking like one who is ripe and prepared.

children.text: tad vām ṛtaṃ rodasī pra bravīmi jāyamāno mātarā garbho atti
children.translated_text: I proclaim this truth to you two, O <s>Rodasi</s>: the embryo, being born, consumes its mothers.

children.text: nāhaṃ devasya martyaś ciketāgnir aṅga vicetāḥ sa pracetāḥ ||
children.translated_text: I, a mortal, do not understand the god; <s>Agni</s> indeed is discerning, he is fully aware.

children.text: yo asmā annaṃ tṛṣv ādadhāty ājyair ghṛtair juhoti puṣyati
children.translated_text: Whoever places food for us among the swift ones and offers with clarified butters and ghee, he prospers.

children.text: tasmai sahasram akṣabhir vi cakṣe 'gne viśvataḥ pratyaṅṅ asi tvam ||
children.translated_text: For him, O <s>Agni</s>, I look out with a thousand eyes; you face every side, turned toward all.

children.text: kiṃ deveṣu tyaja enaś cakarthāgne pṛcchāmi nu tvām avidvān
children.translated_text: What sin have you committed among the gods, O <s>Agni</s>? Not knowing, I now ask you.

children.text: akrīḍan krīḍan harir attave 'dan vi parvaśaś cakarta gām ivāsiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Playing and not playing, the tawny one ate what was to be eaten; like a knife with a cow, he cut it joint by joint.

children.text: viṣūco aśvān yuyuje vanejā ṛjītibhī raśanābhir gṛbhītān
children.translated_text: The forest-born one yoked horses pointing in different directions, seized with straight reins and halters.

children.text: cakṣade mitro vasubhiḥ sujātaḥ sam ānṛdhe parvabhir vāvṛdhānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s>, well-born with the good powers, looked forth; he grew together, increasing through his joints.

children.text: Chapter 917
agniḥ saptiṃ vājambharaṃ dadāty agnir vīraṃ śrutyaṃ karmaniṣṭhām
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> gives a steed that brings the prize; <s>Agni</s> gives a renowned hero, steadfast in action.

children.text: agnī rodasī vi carat samañjann agnir nārīṃ vīrakukṣim purandhim ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, moving between heaven and earth, sets them in order; <s>Agni</s> gives a woman rich in sons and bearing heroes in her womb.

children.text: agner apnasaḥ samid astu bhadrāgnir mahī rodasī ā viveśa
children.translated_text: Let the kindling of <s>Agni</s>, rich in work, be auspicious; <s>Agni</s> has entered the great heaven and earth.

children.text: agnir ekaṃ codayat samatsv agnir vṛtrāṇi dayate purūṇi ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> urges the solitary one on in battles; <s>Agni</s> cuts down many obstructions.

children.text: agnir ha tyaṃ jarataḥ karṇam āvāgnir adbhyo nir adahaj jarūtham
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has reached the ear of the aging man; <s>Agni</s> burned the feebleness out from the waters.

children.text: agnir atriṃ gharma uruṣyad antar agnir nṛmedham prajayāsṛjat sam ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> protected <s>Atri</s> within from the heat; <s>Agni</s> joined <s>Nṛmedha</s> with offspring.

children.text: agnir dād draviṇaṃ vīrapeśā agnir ṛṣiṃ yaḥ sahasrā sanoti
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> grants wealth adorned with heroes; <s>Agni</s> wins thousands for the seer.

children.text: agnir divi havyam ā tatānāgner dhāmāni vibhṛtā purutrā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has stretched the oblation up to heaven; the abodes of <s>Agni</s> are borne in many places.

children.text: agnim ukthair ṛṣayo vi hvayante 'gniṃ naro yāmani bādhitāsaḥ
children.translated_text: The seers call upon <s>Agni</s> with hymns; men in distress call upon <s>Agni</s> on the journey.

children.text: agniṃ vayo antarikṣe patanto 'gniḥ sahasrā pari yāti gonām ||
children.translated_text: The birds flying in the midspace call upon <s>Agni</s>; <s>Agni</s> goes around thousands of cows.

children.text: agniṃ viśa īḍate mānuṣīr yā agnim manuṣo nahuṣo vi jātāḥ
children.translated_text: The human clans who are descended from <s>Manu</s> and <s>Nahuṣa</s> praise <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: agnir gāndharvīm pathyām ṛtasyāgner gavyūtir ghṛta ā niṣattā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> is the Gandharvan path of truth; the cow-pasture of <s>Agni</s> is set down in ghee.

children.text: agnaye brahma ṛbhavas tatakṣur agnim mahām avocāmā suvṛktim
children.translated_text: The <s>Rbhus</s> fashioned sacred speech for <s>Agni</s>; we have proclaimed a great, well-spoken hymn to <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: agne prāva jaritāraṃ yaviṣṭhāgne mahi draviṇam ā yajasva ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, youngest one, protect the singer; O <s>Agni</s>, win great wealth in the sacrifice.

children.text: Chapter 918
ya imā viśvā bhuvanāni juhvad ṛṣir hotā ny asīdat pitā naḥ
children.translated_text: He who, offering all these beings, sat down as seer and Hotr, like our father,

children.text: sa āśiṣā draviṇam icchamānaḥ prathamacchad avarāṁ ā viveśa ||
children.translated_text: seeking wealth through blessing, passed first and entered the lower regions.

children.text: kiṃ svid āsīd adhiṣṭhānam ārambhaṇaṃ katamat svit kathāsīt
children.translated_text: What indeed was the foundation? What was the beginning? Which thing was it, and how was it?

children.text: yato bhūmiṃ janayan viśvakarmā vi dyām aurṇon mahinā viśvacakṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: From which <s>Viśvakarman</s>, generating the earth, unfolded heaven by his greatness, all-seeing.

children.text: viśvataścakṣur uta viśvatomukho viśvatobāhur uta viśvataspāt
children.translated_text: With eyes on every side, with face on every side, with arms on every side, and with feet on every side,

children.text: sam bāhubhyāṃ dhamati sam patatrair dyāvābhūmī janayan deva ekaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the one god blows together with his arms and with his wings, generating heaven and earth.

children.text: kiṃ svid vanaṃ ka u sa vṛkṣa āsa yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ
children.translated_text: What indeed was the wood, and what was that tree, from which they fashioned heaven and earth?

children.text: manīṣiṇo manasā pṛcchated u tad yad adhyatiṣṭhad bhuvanāni dhārayan ||
children.translated_text: Let the wise ask in their mind about that on which he stood when he upheld the worlds.

children.text: yā te dhāmāni paramāṇi yāvamā yā madhyamā viśvakarmann utemā
children.translated_text: Those highest abodes of yours, and those lower ones, those middle ones too, O <s>Viśvakarman</s>, and these here:

children.text: śikṣā sakhibhyo haviṣi svadhāvaḥ svayaṃ yajasva tanvaṃ vṛdhānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: teach them to your friends at the oblation, O self-powerful one; sacrifice by yourself, increasing your own body.

children.text: viśvakarman haviṣā vāvṛdhānaḥ svayaṃ yajasva pṛthivīm uta dyām
children.translated_text: O <s>Viśvakarman</s>, strengthened by the oblation, sacrifice by yourself to earth and to heaven.

children.text: muhyantv anye abhito janāsa ihāsmākam maghavā sūrir astu ||
children.translated_text: Let other people round about be bewildered; here let <s>Maghavan</s>, the patron, be ours.

children.text: vācas patiṃ viśvakarmāṇam ūtaye manojuvaṃ vāje adyā huvema
children.translated_text: For aid today we would invoke the lord of speech, <s>Viśvakarman</s>, swift as thought, in the contest.

children.text: sa no viśvāni havanāni joṣad viśvaśambhūr avase sādhukarmā ||
children.translated_text: May he, beneficent to all and skillful in work, gladly accept all our invocations for our help.

children.text: Chapter 919
cakṣuṣaḥ pitā manasā hi dhīro ghṛtam ene ajanan nannamāne
children.translated_text: The father of the eye, wise in mind, generated ghee from these two as they bowed down.

children.text: yaded antā adadṛhanta pūrva ād id dyāvāpṛthivī aprathetām ||
children.translated_text: When the ancient boundaries were made firm, then heaven and earth spread out.

children.text: viśvakarmā vimanā ād vihāyā dhātā vidhātā paramota saṃdṛk
children.translated_text: <s>Viśvakarman</s>, broad-minded, creator, arranger, highest one and beholder, is beyond the sky.

children.text: teṣām iṣṭāni sam iṣā madanti yatrā saptaṛṣīn para ekam āhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: With their wished-for nourishment they rejoice where, beyond, they say the seven seers are one.

children.text: yo naḥ pitā janitā yo vidhātā dhāmāni veda bhuvanāni viśvā
children.translated_text: He who is our father, begetter, and arranger, who knows the abodes and all the worlds,

children.text: yo devānāṃ nāmadhā eka eva taṃ sampraśnam bhuvanā yanty anyā ||
children.translated_text: who alone is the name-giver of the gods: to him the other beings go with their questions.

children.text: ta āyajanta draviṇaṃ sam asmā ṛṣayaḥ pūrve jaritāro na bhūnā
children.translated_text: Those former seers and singers sacrificed to him together for wealth, as if to a being not yet born.

children.text: asūrte sūrte rajasi niṣatte ye bhūtāni samakṛṇvann imāni ||
children.translated_text: Seated in the unillumined and illumined realm, they made all these beings together.

children.text: paro divā para enā pṛthivyā paro devebhir asurair yad asti
children.translated_text: Beyond heaven, beyond this earth, beyond the gods and the <s>Asuras</s>, whatever exists:

children.text: kaṃ svid garbham prathamaṃ dadhra āpo yatra devāḥ samapaśyanta viśve ||
children.translated_text: what first embryo did the waters hold, where all the gods saw one another?

children.text: tam id garbham prathamaṃ dadhra āpo yatra devāḥ samagacchanta viśve
children.translated_text: The waters held that very first embryo, where all the gods came together.

children.text: ajasya nābhāv adhy ekam arpitaṃ yasmin viśvāni bhuvanāni tasthuḥ ||
children.translated_text: On the navel of the unborn one the one thing was set, in which all the worlds stood.

children.text: na taṃ vidātha ya imā jajānānyad yuṣmākam antaram babhūva
children.translated_text: You do not know him who produced these beings; something else has come between you.

children.text: nīhāreṇa prāvṛtā jalpyā cāsutṛpa ukthaśāsaś caranti ||
children.translated_text: Covered with mist, babblers and life-greedy reciters of hymns go about.

children.text: Chapter 920
yas te manyo 'vidhad vajra sāyaka saha ojaḥ puṣyati viśvam ānuṣak
children.translated_text: O <s>Manyu</s>, whoever has honored your missile, your thunderbolt, nourishes strength and force in every way.

children.text: sāhyāma dāsam āryaṃ tvayā yujā sahaskṛtena sahasā sahasvatā ||
children.translated_text: With you as ally, made strong by strength, powerful with power, may we overcome both <s>Dāsa</s> and <s>Ārya</s>.

children.text: manyur indro manyur evāsa devo manyur hotā varuṇo jātavedāḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Manyu</s> is <s>Indra</s>; <s>Manyu</s> indeed was the god; <s>Manyu</s> is the Hotr, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and <s>Jātavedas</s>.

children.text: manyuṃ viśa īḍate mānuṣīr yāḥ pāhi no manyo tapasā sajoṣāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The human clans praise <s>Manyu</s>; protect us, O <s>Manyu</s>, in harmony with fervor.

children.text: abhīhi manyo tavasas tavīyān tapasā yujā vi jahi śatrūn
children.translated_text: Come near, O <s>Manyu</s>, stronger than the strong; yoked with ardor, strike the enemies apart.

children.text: amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhā ca viśvā vasūny ā bharā tvaṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Slayer of foes, slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, and slayer of <s>Dasyus</s>, bring all goods to us.

children.text: tvaṃ hi manyo abhibhūtyojāḥ svayaṃbhūr bhāmo abhimātiṣāhaḥ
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Manyu</s>, have overpowering might; you are self-born, wrathful, and victorious over assaults.

children.text: viśvacarṣaṇiḥ sahuriḥ sahāvān asmāsv ojaḥ pṛtanāsu dhehi ||
children.translated_text: Ruling over all peoples, overcoming and mighty, place strength in us amid the battles.

children.text: abhāgaḥ sann apa pareto asmi tava kratvā taviṣasya pracetaḥ
children.translated_text: Being without a share, I have gone away and stand apart from your will, O discerning mighty one.

children.text: taṃ tvā manyo akratur jihīḍāhaṃ svā tanūr baladeyāya mehi ||
children.translated_text: I, lacking resolve, have offended you, O <s>Manyu</s>; come to me with your own body for the giving of strength.

children.text: ayaṃ te asmy upa mehy arvāṅ pratīcīnaḥ sahure viśvadhāyaḥ
children.translated_text: I am this worshipper of yours; come near to me, turned hither, O overpowering one, support of all.

children.text: manyo vajrinn abhi mām ā vavṛtsva hanāva dasyūṃr uta bodhy āpeḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Manyu</s>, wielder of the vajra, turn fully toward me; let us slay the <s>Dasyus</s>, and be mindful of your ally.

children.text: abhi prehi dakṣiṇato bhavā me 'dhā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanāva bhūri
children.translated_text: Come forward; be on my right side, and then we shall smite many <s>Vṛtras</s>.

children.text: juhomi te dharuṇam madhvo agram ubhā upāṃśu prathamā pibāva ||
children.translated_text: I offer to you the foremost foundation of honey; let us both drink first in secret.

children.text: Chapter 921
tvayā manyo saratham ārujanto harṣamāṇāso dhṛṣitā marutvaḥ
children.translated_text: With you, O <s>Manyu</s>, mounted in the same chariot, rejoicing, bold, and accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>,

children.text: tigmeṣava āyudhā saṃśiśānā abhi pra yantu naro agnirūpāḥ ||
children.translated_text: let the men, sharp-arrowed and sharpening their weapons, go forth against them, having the form of <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: agnir iva manyo tviṣitaḥ sahasva senānīr naḥ sahure hūta edhi
children.translated_text: Like <s>Agni</s>, O <s>Manyu</s>, blazing, be strong; invoked, become our army-leader, O overpowering one.

children.text: hatvāya śatrūn vi bhajasva veda ojo mimāno vi mṛdho nudasva ||
children.translated_text: Having slain the enemies, distribute the prize; measuring out strength, drive away the hostile powers.

children.text: sahasva manyo abhimātim asme rujan mṛṇan pramṛṇan prehi śatrūn
children.translated_text: Overpower the assault against us, O <s>Manyu</s>; breaking, crushing, utterly crushing, advance against the enemies.

children.text: ugraṃ te pājo nanv ā rurudhre vaśī vaśaṃ nayasa ekaja tvam ||
children.translated_text: Your fierce force has surely not been checked; as master, you bring them under control, you who are single-born.

children.text: eko bahūnām asi manyav īḍito viśaṃ viśaṃ yudhaye saṃ śiśādhi
children.translated_text: You alone, O <s>Manyu</s>, are praised by many; sharpen each clan for battle.

children.text: akṛttaruk tvayā yujā vayaṃ dyumantaṃ ghoṣaṃ vijayāya kṛṇmahe ||
children.translated_text: With you as our ally, unharmed, we make a shining battle-cry for victory.

children.text: vijeṣakṛd indra ivānavabravo 'smākam manyo adhipā bhaveha
children.translated_text: Maker of victory, like <s>Indra</s>, unopposed, O <s>Manyu</s>, be our overlord here.

children.text: priyaṃ te nāma sahure gṛṇīmasi vidmā tam utsaṃ yata ābabhūtha ||
children.translated_text: Dear is your name, O overpowering one; we sing it forth. We know that spring from which you arose.

children.text: ābhūtyā sahajā vajra sāyaka saho bibharṣy abhibhūta uttaram
children.translated_text: Born together with prosperity, O vajra-bearing archer, you bear superior conquering power.

children.text: kratvā no manyo saha medy edhi mahādhanasya puruhūta saṃsṛji ||
children.translated_text: By your will, O <s>Manyu</s>, come together with might for us; O much-invoked one, unite us with great wealth.

children.text: saṃsṛṣṭaṃ dhanam ubhayaṃ samākṛtam asmabhyaṃ dattāṃ varuṇaś ca manyuḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Manyu</s> give us the wealth, combined and gathered from both sides.

children.text: bhiyaṃ dadhānā hṛdayeṣu śatravaḥ parājitāso apa ni layantām ||
children.translated_text: Let the enemies, placing fear in their hearts, defeated, sink down and hide away.

children.text: Chapter 922
satyenottabhitā bhūmiḥ sūryeṇottabhitā dyauḥ
children.translated_text: The earth is propped up by truth; heaven is propped up by the sun.

children.text: ṛtenādityās tiṣṭhanti divi somo adhi śritaḥ ||
children.translated_text: By <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order) the <s>Ādityas</s> stand; <s>Soma</s> is set upon heaven.

children.text: somenādityā balinaḥ somena pṛthivī mahī
children.translated_text: By <s>Soma</s> the <s>Ādityas</s> are strong; by <s>Soma</s> the earth is great.

children.text: atho nakṣatrāṇām eṣām upasthe soma āhitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And <s>Soma</s> is placed in the lap of these stars.

children.text: somam manyate papivān yat sampiṃṣanty oṣadhim
children.translated_text: A man thinks he has drunk <s>Soma</s> when they press the plant.

children.text: somaṃ yam brahmāṇo vidur na tasyāśnāti kaścana ||
children.translated_text: But of the <s>Soma</s> that the priests know, no one at all partakes.

children.text: ācchadvidhānair gupito bārhataiḥ soma rakṣitaḥ
children.translated_text: Hidden by coverings, guarded by the great ones, O protected <s>Soma</s>,

children.text: grāvṇām icchṛṇvan tiṣṭhasi na te aśnāti pārthivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: you stand listening to the pressing-stones; no earthly man partakes of you.

children.text: yat tvā deva prapibanti tata ā pyāyase punaḥ
children.translated_text: When the gods drink you, O god, from that you swell again.

children.text: vāyuḥ somasya rakṣitā samānām māsa ākṛtiḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vāyu</s> is the guardian of <s>Soma</s>; the month is the maker of its equal measures.

children.text: raibhy āsīd anudeyī nārāśaṃsī nyocanī
children.translated_text: <s>Raibhī</s> was the attendant gift, <s>Nārāśaṃsī</s> the leading song.

children.text: sūryāyā bhadram id vāso gāthayaiti pariṣkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: The auspicious garment of <s>Sūryā</s>, adorned with song, goes forth.

children.text: cittir ā upabarhaṇaṃ cakṣur ā abhyañjanam
children.translated_text: Thought was her cushion; sight was her ointment.

children.text: dyaur bhūmiḥ kośa āsīd yad ayāt sūryā patim ||
children.translated_text: Heaven and earth were her chest when <s>Sūryā</s> went to her husband.

children.text: stomā āsan pratidhayaḥ kurīraṃ chanda opaśaḥ
children.translated_text: The hymns were the cross-pieces; the metres were the adornment and the covering.

children.text: sūryāyā aśvinā varāgnir āsīt purogavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For <s>Sūryā</s>, the <s>Aśvins</s> were the suitors, and <s>Agni</s> was the forerunner.

children.text: somo vadhūyur abhavad aśvināstām ubhā varā
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> became the wooer; the two <s>Aśvins</s> were both suitors,

children.text: sūryāṃ yat patye śaṃsantīm manasā savitādadāt ||
children.translated_text: when <s>Savitṛ</s>, in his mind, gave <s>Sūryā</s>, assenting, to her husband.

children.text: mano asyā ana āsīd dyaur āsīd uta cchadiḥ
children.translated_text: Her mind was the wagon; heaven was also the canopy.

children.text: śukrāv anaḍvāhāv āstāṃ yad ayāt sūryā gṛham ||
children.translated_text: The two bright oxen were yoked when <s>Sūryā</s> went to the house.

children.text: ṛksāmābhyām abhihitau gāvau te sāmanāv itaḥ
children.translated_text: Your two oxen were fashioned by <s>Ṛc</s> and <s>Sāman</s>; they were the two chants from here.

children.text: śrotraṃ te cakre āstāṃ divi panthāś carācāraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Your two ears were the wheels; in heaven was the moving road.

children.text: śucī te cakre yātyā vyāno akṣa āhataḥ
children.translated_text: Pure were your wheels as you went; the vital breath was fixed as the axle.

children.text: ano manasmayaṃ sūryārohat prayatī patim ||
children.translated_text: <s>Sūryā</s> mounted the mind-made wagon, going forth to her husband.

children.text: sūryāyā vahatuḥ prāgāt savitā yam avāsṛjat
children.translated_text: <s>Sūryā</s>'s bridal procession went forth, which <s>Savitṛ</s> had sent out.

children.text: aghāsu hanyante gāvo 'rjunyoḥ pary uhyate ||
children.translated_text: In the <s>Aghās</s> the cows are slaughtered; in the <s>Arjunīs</s> she is carried around.

children.text: yad aśvinā pṛcchamānāv ayātaṃ tricakreṇa vahatuṃ sūryāyāḥ
children.translated_text: When you two <s>Aśvins</s>, asking, came with the three-wheeled bridal car of <s>Sūryā</s>,

children.text: viśve devā anu tad vām ajānan putraḥ pitarāv avṛṇīta pūṣā ||
children.translated_text: all the gods recognized that of yours; <s>Pūṣan</s>, as a son, chose you two as parents.

children.text: yad ayātaṃ śubhas patī vareyaṃ sūryām upa
children.translated_text: When you two, lords of beauty, came to <s>Sūryā</s> as the one to be chosen,

children.text: kvaikaṃ cakraṃ vām āsīt kva deṣṭrāya tasthathuḥ ||
children.translated_text: where was your one wheel? Where did you stand for the direction?

children.text: dve te cakre sūrye brahmāṇa ṛtuthā viduḥ
children.translated_text: Your two wheels, O <s>Sūryā</s>, the priests know according to the seasons.

children.text: athaikaṃ cakraṃ yad guhā tad addhātaya id viduḥ ||
children.translated_text: But the one wheel that is hidden, only the true knowers know it clearly.

children.text: sūryāyai devebhyo mitrāya varuṇāya ca
children.translated_text: To <s>Sūryā</s>, to the gods, to <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>,

children.text: ye bhūtasya pracetasa idaṃ tebhyo 'karaṃ namaḥ ||
children.translated_text: to those discerning ones of what has come to be, I have made this homage.

children.text: pūrvāparaṃ carato māyayaitau śiśū krīḍantau pari yāto adhvaram
children.translated_text: These two move before and after by their power, two children playing as they go around the sacrifice.

children.text: viśvāny anyo bhuvanābhicaṣṭa ṛtūṃr anyo vidadhaj jāyate punaḥ ||
children.translated_text: One looks upon all beings; the other is born again, setting the seasons in order.

children.text: navo navo bhavati jāyamāno 'hnāṃ ketur uṣasām ety agram
children.translated_text: Being born, he becomes new again and again; the sign of the days goes at the head of the dawns.

children.text: bhāgaṃ devebhyo vi dadhāty āyan pra candramās tirate dīrgham āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Arriving, he apportions the share to the gods; the moon extends a long lifetime.

children.text: sukiṃśukaṃ śalmaliṃ viśvarūpaṃ hiraṇyavarṇaṃ suvṛtaṃ sucakram
children.translated_text: Mount the fair <s>kiṃśuka</s> and <s>śalmali</s> car, all-formed, golden-colored, well-covered, and well-wheeled.

children.text: ā roha sūrye amṛtasya lokaṃ syonam patye vahatuṃ kṛṇuṣva ||
children.translated_text: Mount, O <s>Sūryā</s>, the world of immortality; make the bridal journey pleasant for your husband.

children.text: ud īrṣvātaḥ pativatī hy eṣā viśvāvasuṃ namasā gīrbhir īḍe
children.translated_text: Rise up from here; for this woman now has a husband. I praise <s>Viśvāvasu</s> with homage and songs.

children.text: anyām iccha pitṛṣadaṃ vyaktāṃ sa te bhāgo januṣā tasya viddhi ||
children.translated_text: Seek another, one dwelling in her father's house, a visible one; she is your share by birth, know that.

children.text: ud īrṣvāto viśvāvaso namaseḍā mahe tvā
children.translated_text: Rise up from here, O <s>Viśvāvasu</s>; with reverence we praise you greatly.

children.text: anyām iccha prapharvyaṃ saṃ jāyām patyā sṛja ||
children.translated_text: Seek another marriageable maiden; release this wife to be joined with her husband.

children.text: anṛkṣarā ṛjavaḥ santu panthā yebhiḥ sakhāyo yanti no vareyam
children.translated_text: Let the paths be free from harm and straight, by which our companions go to the bridal choice.

children.text: sam aryamā sam bhago no ninīyāt saṃ jāspatyaṃ suyamam astu devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Aryaman</s> lead us together, and may <s>Bhaga</s> lead us together; O gods, may household union be well yoked.

children.text: pra tvā muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśād yena tvābadhnāt savitā suśevaḥ
children.translated_text: I release you from the noose of <s>Varuṇa</s>, with which gracious <s>Savitṛ</s> bound you.

children.text: ṛtasya yonau sukṛtasya loke 'riṣṭāṃ tvā saha patyā dadhāmi ||
children.translated_text: In the womb of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), in the world of good deed, I place you unharmed together with your husband.

children.text: preto muñcāmi nāmutaḥ subaddhām amutas karam
children.translated_text: From here I release you, not from there; from there I make you firmly bound.

children.text: yatheyam indra mīḍhvaḥ suputrā subhagāsati ||
children.translated_text: So that this woman, O bounteous <s>Indra</s>, may be rich in sons and fortunate.

children.text: pūṣā tveto nayatu hastagṛhyāśvinā tvā pra vahatāṃ rathena
children.translated_text: May <s>Pūṣan</s> lead you from here, taking your hand; may the two <s>Aśvins</s> carry you forward by chariot.

children.text: gṛhān gaccha gṛhapatnī yathāso vaśinī tvaṃ vidatham ā vadāsi ||
children.translated_text: Go to the house, so that you may be mistress of the house; as one in command, speak in the gathering.

children.text: iha priyam prajayā te sam ṛdhyatām asmin gṛhe gārhapatyāya jāgṛhi
children.translated_text: Here may what is dear to you prosper together with offspring; in this house keep watch for the <s>gārhapatya</s> (householder's fire and estate).

children.text: enā patyā tanvaṃ saṃ sṛjasvādhā jivrī vidatham ā vadāthaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With this husband join your body; then, grown old, you two shall speak in the gathering.

children.text: nīlalohitam bhavati kṛtyāsaktir vy ajyate
children.translated_text: It becomes blue and red; the attachment of sorcery is made visible.

children.text: edhante asyā jñātayaḥ patir bandheṣu badhyate ||
children.translated_text: Her kinsmen prosper; the husband is bound in bonds.

children.text: parā dehi śāmulyam brahmabhyo vi bhajā vasu
children.translated_text: Give away the bridal covering; distribute the wealth among the <s>Brahmins</s>.

children.text: kṛtyaiṣā padvatī bhūtvy ā jāyā viśate patim ||
children.translated_text: This sorcery, becoming footed, enters the husband in the form of the wife.

children.text: aśrīrā tanūr bhavati ruśatī pāpayāmuyā
children.translated_text: Her body becomes devoid of beauty, shining with that evil thing.

children.text: patir yad vadhvo vāsasā svam aṅgam abhidhitsate ||
children.translated_text: When the husband seeks to cover his own limb with the bride's garment.

children.text: ye vadhvaś candraṃ vahatuṃ yakṣmā yanti janād anu
children.translated_text: Those consumptions that follow the bride's lovely procession from the people,

children.text: punas tān yajñiyā devā nayantu yata āgatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: may the sacrifice-worthy gods lead them back to where they came from.

children.text: mā vidan paripanthino ya āsīdanti dampatī
children.translated_text: May waylayers not find the two spouses as they sit down.

children.text: sugebhir durgam atītām apa drāntv arātayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: By easy paths may they pass beyond the difficult way; let hostile powers run away.

children.text: sumaṅgalīr iyaṃ vadhūr imāṃ sameta paśyata
children.translated_text: This bride is auspicious; gather around and look at her.

children.text: saubhāgyam asyai dattvāyāthāstaṃ vi paretana ||
children.translated_text: Having given her good fortune, go away, each to your own house.

children.text: tṛṣṭam etat kaṭukam etad apāṣṭhavad viṣavan naitad attave
children.translated_text: This is sharp, this is bitter, like apāṣṭha, poisonous; it is not to be eaten.

children.text: sūryāṃ yo brahmā vidyāt sa id vādhūyam arhati ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Brahman</s>-priest who knows <s>Sūryā</s>, he alone is worthy of the bridal office.

children.text: āśasanaṃ viśasanam atho adhivikartanam
children.translated_text: The cutting to pieces, the dismembering, and also the slicing apart:

children.text: sūryāyāḥ paśya rūpāṇi tāni brahmā tu śundhati ||
children.translated_text: Look at the forms of <s>Sūryā</s>; the <s>Brahman</s>-priest purifies them.

children.text: gṛbhṇāmi te saubhagatvāya hastam mayā patyā jaradaṣṭir yathāsaḥ
children.translated_text: I take your hand for good fortune, so that you may grow old with me as your husband.

children.text: bhago aryamā savitā purandhir mahyaṃ tvādur gārhapatyāya devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Bhaga</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Savitṛ</s>, and <s>Purandhi</s>, the gods, have given you to me for householdership.

children.text: tām pūṣañchivatamām erayasva yasyām bījam manuṣyā vapanti
children.translated_text: O <s>Pūṣan</s>, send her forth as the most auspicious one, in whom human beings sow seed,

children.text: yā na ūrū uśatī viśrayāte yasyām uśantaḥ praharāma śepam ||
children.translated_text: she who, desiring, opens her thighs to us, in whom, desiring, we thrust the penis.

children.text: tubhyam agre pary avahan sūryāṃ vahatunā saha
children.translated_text: At first they carried <s>Sūryā</s> around to you together with the bridal procession.

children.text: punaḥ patibhyo jāyāṃ dā agne prajayā saha ||
children.translated_text: Give the wife back to husbands, O <s>Agni</s>, together with offspring.

children.text: punaḥ patnīm agnir adād āyuṣā saha varcasā
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> has given the wife back together with life span and splendor.

children.text: dīrghāyur asyā yaḥ patir jīvāti śaradaḥ śatam ||
children.translated_text: Long-lived is the man who is her husband; may he live a hundred autumns.

children.text: somaḥ prathamo vivide gandharvo vivida uttaraḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> first found her; the <s>Gandharva</s> found her next.

children.text: tṛtīyo agniṣ ṭe patis turīyas te manuṣyajāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> was your third husband; your fourth husband is the man born among humans.

children.text: somo dadad gandharvāya gandharvo dadad agnaye
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> gave her to the <s>Gandharva</s>; the <s>Gandharva</s> gave her to <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: rayiṃ ca putrāṃś cādād agnir mahyam atho imām ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> gave wealth and sons, and then this woman, to me.

children.text: ihaiva stam mā vi yauṣṭaṃ viśvam āyur vy aśnutam
children.translated_text: Stay right here; do not separate; enjoy the whole span of life.

children.text: krīḍantau putrair naptṛbhir modamānau sve gṛhe ||
children.translated_text: Playing with sons and grandsons, rejoicing in your own house.

children.text: ā naḥ prajāṃ janayatu prajāpatir ājarasāya sam anaktv aryamā
children.translated_text: May <s>Prajāpati</s> generate offspring for us; may <s>Aryaman</s> unite us until old age.

children.text: adurmaṅgalīḥ patilokam ā viśa śaṃ no bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||
children.translated_text: Enter the world of your husband without ill omen; be auspicious for our bipeds and auspicious for our quadrupeds.

children.text: aghoracakṣur apatighny edhi śivā paśubhyaḥ sumanāḥ suvarcāḥ
children.translated_text: Be of kindly eye, not slaying your husband, gracious to the cattle, well-minded, bright with splendor.

children.text: vīrasūr devakāmā syonā śaṃ no bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||
children.translated_text: Bearing heroes, loving the gods, pleasant, be auspicious for our bipeds and auspicious for our quadrupeds.

children.text: imāṃ tvam indra mīḍhvaḥ suputrāṃ subhagāṃ kṛṇu
children.translated_text: Make this woman, O bounteous <s>Indra</s>, rich in sons and fortunate.

children.text: daśāsyām putrān ā dhehi patim ekādaśaṃ kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: Place ten sons in her; make her husband the eleventh.

children.text: samrājñī śvaśure bhava samrājñī śvaśrvām bhava
children.translated_text: Be queen over your father-in-law; be queen over your mother-in-law.

children.text: nanāndari samrājñī bhava samrājñī adhi devṛṣu ||
children.translated_text: Be queen over your husband's sisters; be queen over your husband's brothers.

children.text: sam añjantu viśve devāḥ sam āpo hṛdayāni nau
children.translated_text: Let all the gods anoint us together; let the waters join our hearts.

children.text: sam mātariśvā saṃ dhātā sam u deṣṭrī dadhātu nau ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Mātariśvan</s>, let <s>Dhātṛ</s>, and also <s>Deṣṭrī</s> set us together.

children.text: Chapter 923
vi hi sotor asṛkṣata nendraṃ devam amaṃsata
children.translated_text: The soma-pressers have been released; they did not honor <s>Indra</s> as a god.

children.text: yatrāmadad vṛṣākapir aryaḥ puṣṭeṣu matsakhā viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Where <s>Vṛṣākapi</s>, the noble one, my friend amid prosperities, exhilarated himself; <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: parā hīndra dhāvasi vṛṣākaper ati vyathiḥ
children.translated_text: For you run away, O <s>Indra</s>, greatly disturbed because of <s>Vṛṣākapi</s>.

children.text: no aha pra vindasy anyatra somapītaye viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: You do not, they say, find another place for soma-drinking; <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: kim ayaṃ tvāṃ vṛṣākapiś cakāra harito mṛgaḥ
children.translated_text: What has this <s>Vṛṣākapi</s> done to you, the tawny beast,

children.text: yasmā irasyasīd u nv aryo vā puṣṭimad vasu viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: that you are angry with him now, O noble one, or over rich goods? <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: yam imaṃ tvaṃ vṛṣākapim priyam indrābhirakṣasi
children.translated_text: This <s>Vṛṣākapi</s> whom you, O <s>Indra</s>, protect as dear:

children.text: śvā nv asya jambhiṣad api karṇe varāhayur viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: may a dog indeed bite him, or a boar, on the ear; <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: priyā taṣṭāni me kapir vyaktā vy adūduṣat
children.translated_text: The ape has ruined my dear, well-fashioned things, making them open and scattered.

children.text: śiro nv asya rāviṣaṃ na sugaṃ duṣkṛte bhuvaṃ viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: I would tear off his head; I would not be easy ground for the evildoer. <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: na mat strī subhasattarā na suyāśutarā bhuvat
children.translated_text: No woman is better seated than I, nor better fitted.

children.text: na mat praticyavīyasī na sakthy udyamīyasī viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: None is more responsive than I, nor raises the thighs higher. <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: uve amba sulābhike yathevāṅga bhaviṣyati
children.translated_text: O mother, O easily won one, it will surely be just as it will be.

children.text: bhasan me amba sakthi me śiro me vīva hṛṣyati viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: My buttocks, mother, my thighs, my head are all quivering. <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: kiṃ subāho svaṅgure pṛthuṣṭo pṛthujāghane
children.translated_text: What, O fair-armed, fair-fingered, broad-backed, broad-thighed one...

children.text: kiṃ śūrapatni nas tvam abhy amīṣi vṛṣākapiṃ viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Why, wife of the hero, are you angry with us over <s>Vṛṣākapi</s>? <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: avīrām iva mām ayaṃ śarārur abhi manyate
children.translated_text: This mischievous archer regards me as if I were without a hero.

children.text: utāham asmi vīriṇīndrapatnī marutsakhā viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Yet I am possessed of heroes, the wife of <s>Indra</s>, the friend of the <s>Maruts</s>; <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: saṃhotraṃ sma purā nārī samanaṃ vāva gacchati
children.translated_text: In former times a woman used to go to the common invocation, to the shared gathering.

children.text: vedhā ṛtasya vīriṇīndrapatnī mahīyate viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: The heroic wife, the wife of <s>Indra</s>, as establisher of truth, is magnified; <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: indrāṇīm āsu nāriṣu subhagām aham aśravam
children.translated_text: Among these women I have heard <s>Indrāṇī</s> called fortunate.

children.text: nahy asyā aparaṃ cana jarasā marate patir viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: For her husband never dies of old age, nor is there any other beyond her; <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: nāham indrāṇi rāraṇa sakhyur vṛṣākaper ṛte
children.translated_text: I do not rejoice, O <s>Indrāṇī</s>, without my friend <s>Vṛṣākapi</s>.

children.text: yasyedam apyaṃ haviḥ priyaṃ deveṣu gacchati viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: His kinship and dear oblation go among the gods; <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: vṛṣākapāyi revati suputra ād u susnuṣe
children.translated_text: O wife of <s>Vṛṣākapi</s>, wealthy one, rich in good sons and good daughters-in-law,

children.text: ghasat ta indra ukṣaṇaḥ priyaṃ kācitkaraṃ havir viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: let <s>Indra</s> eat your bulls, the dear oblation that accomplishes something; <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: ukṣṇo hi me pañcadaśa sākam pacanti viṃśatim
children.translated_text: For me they cook fifteen bulls together, and twenty as well.

children.text: utāham admi pīva id ubhā kukṣī pṛṇanti me viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: And I eat the fat; both my bellies fill me; <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: vṛṣabho na tigmaśṛṅgo 'ntar yūtheṣu roruvat
children.translated_text: Like a bull with sharp horns, bellowing among the herds,

children.text: manthas ta indra śaṃ hṛde yaṃ te sunoti bhāvayur viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: the draught is good for your heart, O <s>Indra</s>, which the worshipper presses for you; <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: na seśe yasya rambate 'ntarā sakthyā kapṛt
children.translated_text: He is not master whose member dangles between the thighs.

children.text: sed īśe yasya romaśaṃ niṣeduṣo vijṛmbhate viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: He is master whose hairy part gapes as he sits; <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: na seśe yasya romaśaṃ niṣeduṣo vijṛmbhate
children.translated_text: He is not master whose hairy part gapes as he sits.

children.text: sed īśe yasya rambate 'ntarā sakthyā kapṛd viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: He is master whose member dangles between the thighs; <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: ayam indra vṛṣākapiḥ parasvantaṃ hataṃ vidat
children.translated_text: This <s>Vṛṣākapi</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, found the slaughtered beast with its appendage.

children.text: asiṃ sūnāṃ navaṃ carum ād edhasyāna ācitaṃ viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: He found the knife, the slaughtering place, the new cauldron, and the fuel heaped up; <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: ayam emi vicākaśad vicinvan dāsam āryam
children.translated_text: Here I go, looking around, discerning the <s>Dāsa</s> and the <s>Ārya</s>.

children.text: pibāmi pākasutvano 'bhi dhīram acākaśaṃ viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: I drink among those who press the cooked offering; I have looked upon the steadfast one; <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: dhanva ca yat kṛntatraṃ ca kati svit tā vi yojanā
children.translated_text: The wilderness and the cutting-place: how many yojanas apart are they?

children.text: nedīyaso vṛṣākape 'stam ehi gṛhāṁ upa viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Come nearer, O <s>Vṛṣākapi</s>; come home, to the houses; <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: punar ehi vṛṣākape suvitā kalpayāvahai
children.translated_text: Come back, O <s>Vṛṣākapi</s>; let us arrange good fortune together.

children.text: ya eṣa svapnanaṃśano 'stam eṣi pathā punar viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: You who drive away sleep, you go home again by the road; <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: yad udañco vṛṣākape gṛham indrājagantana
children.translated_text: When, coming from the north, O <s>Vṛṣākapi</s>, you came to the house of <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: kva sya pulvagho mṛgaḥ kam agañ janayopano viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: where was that spotted beast? To whom did the procreator go? <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: parśur ha nāma mānavī sākaṃ sasūva viṃśatim
children.translated_text: A human woman named <s>Parśu</s> bore twenty together at one birth.

children.text: bhadram bhala tyasyā abhūd yasyā udaram āmayad viśvasmād indra uttaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: Good, indeed, became the fortune of her whose belly labored; <s>Indra</s> is higher than all.

children.text: Chapter 924
rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinam ā jigharmi mitram prathiṣṭham upa yāmi śarma
children.translated_text: I approach the <s>rakṣas</s>-slaying, prize-winning one; I go to <s>Mitra</s>, the most widely established, for shelter.

children.text: śiśāno agniḥ kratubhiḥ samiddhaḥ sa no divā sa riṣaḥ pātu naktam ||
children.translated_text: Sharpened <s>Agni</s>, kindled by sacred powers, let him protect us by day and from harm by night.

children.text: ayodaṃṣṭro arciṣā yātudhānān upa spṛśa jātavedaḥ samiddhaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Jātavedas</s>, iron-toothed and kindled, touch the <s>yātudhānas</s> with your flame.

children.text: ā jihvayā mūradevān rabhasva kravyādo vṛktvy api dhatsvāsan ||
children.translated_text: With your tongue seize the foolish gods; put the flesh-eaters, cut off, into your mouth.

children.text: ubhobhayāvinn upa dhehi daṃṣṭrā hiṃsraḥ śiśāno 'varam paraṃ ca
children.translated_text: Set both tusks upon both sides, violent and sharpened, on the lower and on the upper.

children.text: utāntarikṣe pari yāhi rājañ jambhaiḥ saṃ dhehy abhi yātudhānān ||
children.translated_text: And go around in the midspace, O king; with your jaws crush the <s>yātudhānas</s>.

children.text: yajñair iṣūḥ saṃnamamāno agne vācā śalyāṁ aśanibhir dihānaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, bending your arrows with sacrifices, anointing their barbs with speech and with thunderbolts,

children.text: tābhir vidhya hṛdaye yātudhānān pratīco bāhūn prati bhaṅdhy eṣām ||
children.translated_text: with those pierce the <s>yātudhānas</s> in the heart; break their arms as they turn toward us.

children.text: agne tvacaṃ yātudhānasya bhinddhi hiṃsrāśanir harasā hantv enam
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, split the skin of the <s>yātudhāna</s>; let the fierce thunderbolt slay him with heat.

children.text: pra parvāṇi jātavedaḥ śṛṇīhi kravyāt kraviṣṇur vi cinotu vṛkṇam ||
children.translated_text: Break his joints, O <s>Jātavedas</s>; let the flesh-eater, greedy for flesh, cut apart the severed one.

children.text: yatredānīm paśyasi jātavedas tiṣṭhantam agna uta vā carantam
children.translated_text: Wherever now you see him, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, standing, O <s>Agni</s>, or moving,

children.text: yad vāntarikṣe pathibhiḥ patantaṃ tam astā vidhya śarvā śiśānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: or flying by paths in the midspace, shoot him with the arrow, sharpened like an archer.

children.text: utālabdhaṃ spṛṇuhi jātaveda ālebhānād ṛṣṭibhir yātudhānāt
children.translated_text: And pierce the one who has been caught, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, away from the grasping <s>yātudhāna</s> with spears.

children.text: agne pūrvo ni jahi śośucāna āmādaḥ kṣviṅkās tam adantv enīḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, blazing, strike him down first; let the raw-flesh eaters and devourers eat him.

children.text: iha pra brūhi yatamaḥ so agne yo yātudhāno ya idaṃ kṛṇoti
children.translated_text: Declare here, O <s>Agni</s>, which one he is, the <s>yātudhāna</s> who does this.

children.text: tam ā rabhasva samidhā yaviṣṭha nṛcakṣasaś cakṣuṣe randhayainam ||
children.translated_text: Seize him with the kindling, youngest one; expose him to the sight of the man-seeing powers.

children.text: tīkṣṇenāgne cakṣuṣā rakṣa yajñam prāñcaṃ vasubhyaḥ pra ṇaya pracetaḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, with your sharp eye guard the sacrifice; lead it forward to the <s>Vasus</s>, O wise one.

children.text: hiṃsraṃ rakṣāṃsy abhi śośucānam mā tvā dabhan yātudhānā nṛcakṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Burn fiercely against the harmful <s>rakṣases</s>; let the man-watching <s>yātudhānas</s> not deceive you.

children.text: nṛcakṣā rakṣaḥ pari paśya vikṣu tasya trīṇi prati śṛṇīhy agrā
children.translated_text: O man-seeing one, look around for the <s>rakṣas</s> among the clans; break its three foremost points.

children.text: tasyāgne pṛṣṭīr harasā śṛṇīhi tredhā mūlaṃ yātudhānasya vṛśca ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, break its ribs with heat; cut the root of the <s>yātudhāna</s> into three.

children.text: trir yātudhānaḥ prasitiṃ ta etv ṛtaṃ yo agne anṛtena hanti
children.translated_text: Let the <s>yātudhāna</s> fall three times into your bond, the one who strikes truth with untruth, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: tam arciṣā sphūrjayañjātavedaḥ samakṣam enaṃ gṛṇate ni vṛṅdhi ||
children.translated_text: Flashing with flame, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, bind him down face to face before the singer.

children.text: tad agne cakṣuḥ prati dhehi rebhe śaphārujaṃ yena paśyasi yātudhānam
children.translated_text: Set that eye, O <s>Agni</s>, upon the roaring hoof-breaker, with which you see the <s>yātudhāna</s>.

children.text: atharvavaj jyotiṣā daivyena satyaṃ dhūrvantam acitaṃ ny oṣa ||
children.translated_text: Like <s>Atharvan</s>, with divine light, burn down the ignorant one who injures truth.

children.text: yad agne adya mithunā śapāto yad vācas tṛṣṭaṃ janayanta rebhāḥ
children.translated_text: If today, O <s>Agni</s>, a pair of curses, or if roaring men have produced a sharpened speech,

children.text: manyor manasaḥ śaravyā jāyate yā tayā vidhya hṛdaye yātudhānān ||
children.translated_text: the arrow that is born from wrath and from the mind: with that pierce the <s>yātudhānas</s> in the heart.

children.text: parā śṛṇīhi tapasā yātudhānān parāgne rakṣo harasā śṛṇīhi
children.translated_text: Cut down the <s>yātudhānas</s> far away with heat; far away, O <s>Agni</s>, cut down the <s>rakṣas</s> with heat.

children.text: parārciṣā mūradevāñchṛṇīhi parāsutṛpo abhi śośucānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With your flame cut down the foolish gods far away; blazing, burn against the life-drinkers.

children.text: parādya devā vṛjinaṃ śṛṇantu pratyag enaṃ śapathā yantu tṛṣṭāḥ
children.translated_text: Let the gods today hear the crooked deed from afar; let the eager curses go back against him.

children.text: vācāstenaṃ śarava ṛcchantu marman viśvasyaitu prasitiṃ yātudhānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let arrow-like words reach the speech-thief in the vital spot; let the yātudhāna (sorcerer) enter the snare of all.

children.text: yaḥ pauruṣeyeṇa kraviṣā samaṅkte yo aśvyena paśunā yātudhānaḥ
children.translated_text: The yātudhāna who smears himself with human flesh, and he who does so with horse-flesh, with the flesh of cattle,

children.text: yo aghnyāyā bharati kṣīram agne teṣāṃ śīrṣāṇi harasāpi vṛśca ||
children.translated_text: who carries off the milk of the inviolable cow: O <s>Agni</s>, cut off their heads with your heat.

children.text: saṃvatsarīṇam paya usriyāyās tasya māśīd yātudhāno nṛcakṣaḥ
children.translated_text: May the man-watching yātudhāna not consume the year-old milk of the reddish cow.

children.text: pīyūṣam agne yatamas titṛpsāt tam pratyañcam arciṣā vidhya marman ||
children.translated_text: Whichever one would sate himself with that nectar, O <s>Agni</s>, pierce him, turned toward you, in the vital spot with your flame.

children.text: viṣaṃ gavāṃ yātudhānāḥ pibantv ā vṛścyantām aditaye durevāḥ
children.translated_text: Let the yātudhānas drink the poison of the cows; let the ill-doers be cut off for <s>Aditi</s>.

children.text: parainān devaḥ savitā dadātu parā bhāgam oṣadhīnāṃ jayantām ||
children.translated_text: Let the god <s>Savitṛ</s> send them far away; let them go far, deprived of their share in the plants.

children.text: sanād agne mṛṇasi yātudhānān na tvā rakṣāṃsi pṛtanāsu jigyuḥ
children.translated_text: From of old, O <s>Agni</s>, you crush the yātudhānas; the rākṣasas have not conquered you in battles.

children.text: anu daha sahamūrān kravyādo mā te hetyā mukṣata daivyāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Burn after the overpowering flesh-eaters; let them not escape your divine missile.

children.text: tvaṃ no agne adharād udaktāt tvam paścād uta rakṣā purastāt
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, protect us from below and from the north; you protect us from behind and also from the front.

children.text: prati te te ajarāsas tapiṣṭhā aghaśaṃsaṃ śośucato dahantu ||
children.translated_text: May those ageless, hottest flames of yours burn the evil-speaker as he blazes against you.

children.text: paścāt purastād adharād udaktāt kaviḥ kāvyena pari pāhi rājan
children.translated_text: From behind, from in front, from below, and from the north, guard us all around as a seer by your inspired wisdom, O king.

children.text: sakhe sakhāyam ajaro jarimṇe 'gne martāṁ amartyas tvaṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: O friend, as an ageless one, preserve your friend for old age; O <s>Agni</s>, immortal one, preserve us mortals.

children.text: pari tvāgne puraṃ vayaṃ vipraṃ sahasya dhīmahi
children.translated_text: Around you, O <s>Agni</s>, we set as a fortress the inspired son of strength,

children.text: dhṛṣadvarṇaṃ dive dive hantāram bhaṅgurāvatām ||
children.translated_text: bold in color, day after day the slayer of the <s>Bhaṅgurāvats</s>.

children.text: viṣeṇa bhaṅgurāvataḥ prati ṣma rakṣaso daha
children.translated_text: With poison burn the <s>Bhaṅgurāvats</s> and the rākṣasas in return,

children.text: agne tigmena śociṣā tapuragrābhir ṛṣṭibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, with your sharp flame and with spears whose tips are burning.

children.text: praty agne mithunā daha yātudhānā kimīdinā
children.translated_text: Burn against them in pairs, O <s>Agni</s>, the yātudhānas together with the <s>kimīdins</s>.

children.text: saṃ tvā śiśāmi jāgṛhy adabdhaṃ vipra manmabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: I sharpen you with watchful, uncheated thoughts, O inspired one.

children.text: praty agne harasā haraḥ śṛṇīhi viśvataḥ prati
children.translated_text: Strike back fury with fury, O <s>Agni</s>; break it from every side.

children.text: yātudhānasya rakṣaso balaṃ vi ruja vīryam ||
children.translated_text: Shatter the strength and the might of the yātudhāna rākṣasa.

children.text: Chapter 925
haviṣpāntam ajaraṃ svarvidi divispṛśy āhutaṃ juṣṭam agnau
children.translated_text: In <s>Agni</s>, the oblation-drinking, ageless, light-winning one, touching heaven, invoked and beloved,

children.text: tasya bharmaṇe bhuvanāya devā dharmaṇe kaṃ svadhayā paprathanta ||
children.translated_text: for his support, for the world, and for <s>dharma</s> (cosmic order), the gods spread him out by their own power.

children.text: gīrṇam bhuvanaṃ tamasāpagūḍham āviḥ svar abhavaj jāte agnau
children.translated_text: The swallowed world, hidden by darkness, became manifest as light when <s>Agni</s> was born.

children.text: tasya devāḥ pṛthivī dyaur utāpo 'raṇayann oṣadhīḥ sakhye asya ||
children.translated_text: For friendship with him, the gods set in motion the earth, heaven, the waters, and the plants.

children.text: devebhir nv iṣito yajñiyebhir agniṃ stoṣāṇy ajaram bṛhantam
children.translated_text: Now, impelled by the sacrificial gods, I will praise <s>Agni</s>, ageless and great,

children.text: yo bhānunā pṛthivīṃ dyām utemām ātatāna rodasī antarikṣam ||
children.translated_text: who by his radiance stretched out the earth, heaven, this world, the two realms, and the midspace.

children.text: yo hotāsīt prathamo devajuṣṭo yaṃ samāñjann ājyenā vṛṇānāḥ
children.translated_text: He who was the first Hotṛ, beloved of the gods, whom they anointed with ghee when choosing him,

children.text: sa patatrītvaraṃ sthā jagad yacchvātram agnir akṛṇoj jātavedāḥ ||
children.translated_text: that <s>Agni Jātavedas</s> made whatever is winged, swift, standing, and moving into something refreshing.

children.text: yaj jātavedo bhuvanasya mūrdhann atiṣṭho agne saha rocanena
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, O <s>Agni</s>, you stood upon the head of the world together with radiance,

children.text: taṃ tvāhema matibhir gīrbhir ukthaiḥ sa yajñiyo abhavo rodasiprāḥ ||
children.translated_text: then we approach you with thoughts, songs, and recitations; you became worthy of sacrifice and filled the two worlds.

children.text: mūrdhā bhuvo bhavati naktam agnis tataḥ sūryo jāyate prātar udyan
children.translated_text: At night <s>Agni</s> becomes the head of the world; from him the sun is born, rising in the morning.

children.text: māyām ū tu yajñiyānām etām apo yat tūrṇiś carati prajānan ||
children.translated_text: This indeed is the wondrous power of the sacrificial ones: that the swift one, knowing, moves through the waters.

children.text: dṛśenyo yo mahinā samiddho 'rocata diviyonir vibhāvā
children.translated_text: Visible, kindled by greatness, he shone forth, heaven-born and radiant.

children.text: tasminn agnau sūktavākena devā havir viśva ājuhavus tanūpāḥ ||
children.translated_text: In that <s>Agni</s>, with a well-spoken hymn, all the gods offered the body-protecting oblation.

children.text: sūktavākam prathamam ād id agnim ād iddhavir ajanayanta devāḥ
children.translated_text: The gods first generated the well-spoken word, then <s>Agni</s>, then the oblation.

children.text: sa eṣāṃ yajño abhavat tanūpās taṃ dyaur veda tam pṛthivī tam āpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: He became their sacrifice, protecting the body; heaven knows him, earth knows him, and the waters know him.

children.text: yaṃ devāso 'janayantāgniṃ yasminn ājuhavur bhuvanāni viśvā
children.translated_text: The <s>Agni</s> whom the gods generated, in whom all beings offered,

children.text: so arciṣā pṛthivīṃ dyām utemām ṛjūyamāno atapan mahitvā ||
children.translated_text: he, straightening himself with flame, heated this earth and heaven by his greatness.

children.text: stomena hi divi devāso agnim ajījanañchaktibhī rodasiprām
children.translated_text: For by praise the gods in heaven generated <s>Agni</s>, with powers, filling the two worlds.

children.text: tam ū akṛṇvan tredhā bhuve kaṃ sa oṣadhīḥ pacati viśvarūpāḥ ||
children.translated_text: They made him threefold for existence; he cooks the plants of every form.

children.text: yaded enam adadhur yajñiyāso divi devāḥ sūryam āditeyam
children.translated_text: When the sacrificial gods placed him in heaven as the <s>Āditya</s> sun,

children.text: yadā cariṣṇū mithunāv abhūtām ād it prāpaśyan bhuvanāni viśvā ||
children.translated_text: when the two moving companions came into being, then they saw all beings.

children.text: viśvasmā agnim bhuvanāya devā vaiśvānaraṃ ketum ahnām akṛṇvan
children.translated_text: The gods made <s>Vaiśvānara Agni</s> a beacon of the days for every being,

children.text: ā yas tatānoṣaso vibhātīr apo ūrṇoti tamo arciṣā yan ||
children.translated_text: he who stretches out the shining dawns and the waters, driving away darkness with his flame as he goes.

children.text: vaiśvānaraṃ kavayo yajñiyāso 'gniṃ devā ajanayann ajuryam
children.translated_text: The sacrificial poets, the gods, generated unaging <s>Vaiśvānara Agni</s>,

children.text: nakṣatram pratnam aminac cariṣṇu yakṣasyādhyakṣaṃ taviṣam bṛhantam ||
children.translated_text: the ancient moving constellation, the mighty, great overseer of the wondrous rite.

children.text: vaiśvānaraṃ viśvahā dīdivāṃsam mantrair agniṃ kavim acchā vadāmaḥ
children.translated_text: With mantras we address <s>Vaiśvānara Agni</s>, the poet blazing every day,

children.text: yo mahimnā paribabhūvorvī utāvastād uta devaḥ parastāt ||
children.translated_text: the god who by his greatness has encompassed the broad realms, both from below and from above.

children.text: dve srutī aśṛṇavam pitṝṇām ahaṃ devānām uta martyānām
children.translated_text: I have heard of two courses of the fathers, and also of gods and mortals.

children.text: tābhyām idaṃ viśvam ejat sam eti yad antarā pitaram mātaraṃ ca ||
children.translated_text: By those two this whole world trembles and comes together, all that lies between father and mother.

children.text: dve samīcī bibhṛtaś carantaṃ śīrṣato jātam manasā vimṛṣṭam
children.translated_text: The two meeting ones carry the one who moves, born from the head and searched out by the mind.

children.text: sa pratyaṅ viśvā bhuvanāni tasthāv aprayucchan taraṇir bhrājamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Facing this way, the shining, swift one stands among all beings without neglect.

children.text: yatrā vadete avaraḥ paraś ca yajñanyoḥ kataro nau vi veda
children.translated_text: Where the lower and the higher speak, which of the two worshipful ones has known us?

children.text: ā śekur it sadhamādaṃ sakhāyo nakṣanta yajñaṃ ka idaṃ vi vocat ||
children.translated_text: The friends have reached the common feast and attained the sacrifice; who will proclaim this?

children.text: katy agnayaḥ kati sūryāsaḥ katy uṣāsaḥ katy u svid āpaḥ
children.translated_text: How many fires are there, how many suns, how many dawns, and how many waters indeed?

children.text: nopaspijaṃ vaḥ pitaro vadāmi pṛcchāmi vaḥ kavayo vidmane kam ||
children.translated_text: I do not speak to you in jest, O fathers; I ask you, O poets, so that we may know.

children.text: yāvanmātram uṣaso na pratīkaṃ suparṇyo vasate mātariśvaḥ
children.translated_text: As far as the face of the dawns extends, there fair-winged <s>Mātariśvan</s> dwells in the mother.

children.text: tāvad dadhāty upa yajñam āyan brāhmaṇo hotur avaro niṣīdan ||
children.translated_text: So long does the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> priest, coming to the sacrifice, set it down, sitting lower than the <s>Hotr</s>.

children.text: Chapter 926
indraṃ stavā nṛtamaṃ yasya mahnā vibabādhe rocanā vi jmo antān
children.translated_text: Praise <s>Indra</s>, the most manly one, by whose greatness he drove apart the luminous realms and the ends of the earth.

children.text: ā yaḥ paprau carṣaṇīdhṛd varobhiḥ pra sindhubhyo riricāno mahitvā ||
children.translated_text: He, supporter of peoples, filled the wide spaces with his protections, surpassing the rivers in greatness.

children.text: sa sūryaḥ pary urū varāṃsy endro vavṛtyād rathyeva cakrā
children.translated_text: That <s>Indra</s>, like the sun, has turned the broad spaces round, as a charioteer turns the wheels on the road.

children.text: atiṣṭhantam apasyaṃ na sargaṃ kṛṣṇā tamāṃsi tviṣyā jaghāna ||
children.translated_text: With his brilliance he struck down the black darknesses, which stood fast like a stream that would not move on.

children.text: samānam asmā anapāvṛd arca kṣmayā divo asamam brahma navyam
children.translated_text: For him make the same, unobstructed chant upon the earth, a new <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulation), unequaled from heaven.

children.text: vi yaḥ pṛṣṭheva janimāny arya indraś cikāya na sakhāyam īṣe ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, the noble one, has discerned his births as if upon a back; he does not leave his companion to want.

children.text: indrāya giro aniśitasargā apaḥ prerayaṃ sagarasya budhnāt
children.translated_text: For <s>Indra</s> the songs, whose streams are not checked, sent forth the waters from the bottom of the ocean.

children.text: yo akṣeṇeva cakriyā śacībhir viṣvak tastambha pṛthivīm uta dyām ||
children.translated_text: By his powers, as if with a wheel upon an axle, he propped up the earth on every side, and heaven as well.

children.text: āpāntamanyus tṛpalaprabharmā dhuniḥ śimīvāñcharumāṁ ṛjīṣī
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s>, whose anger reaches the waters, bearing his pressed delight, roaring, strong, sharp, and impetuous,

children.text: somo viśvāny atasā vanāni nārvāg indram pratimānāni debhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: has gone through all the forests with his rush; no measures of <s>Indra</s> have come near to him.

children.text: na yasya dyāvāpṛthivī na dhanva nāntarikṣaṃ nādrayaḥ somo akṣāḥ
children.translated_text: Neither heaven and earth, nor the wasteland, nor the midspace, nor the mountains can match that <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: yad asya manyur adhinīyamānaḥ śṛṇāti vīḍu rujati sthirāṇi ||
children.translated_text: When his fury is set in motion, it breaks what is firm and shatters the strong things.

children.text: jaghāna vṛtraṃ svadhitir vaneva ruroja puro aradan na sindhūn
children.translated_text: Like an axe in the forest he struck down <s>Vṛtra</s>; he shattered the forts and opened the rivers.

children.text: bibheda giriṃ navam in na kumbham ā gā indro akṛṇuta svayugbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> split the mountain like a new jar, and with his own yoke-fellows he made the cows come forth.

children.text: tvaṃ ha tyad ṛṇayā indra dhīro 'sir na parva vṛjinā śṛṇāsi
children.translated_text: You, O wise <s>Indra</s>, bent that away by force; like a blade at the joint you cut through crooked things.

children.text: pra ye mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma yujaṃ na janā minanti mitram ||
children.translated_text: Those people who violate the ordinance of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, who wrong a friend as one might a companion,

children.text: pra ye mitram prāryamaṇaṃ durevāḥ pra saṃgiraḥ pra varuṇam minanti
children.translated_text: those evil-minded ones who transgress against <s>Mitra</s>, against <s>Aryaman</s>, against the gatherings, and against <s>Varuṇa</s>,

children.text: ny amitreṣu vadham indra tumraṃ vṛṣan vṛṣāṇam aruṣaṃ śiśīhi ||
children.translated_text: upon the unfriendly ones sharpen the crushing, ruddy, bull-like weapon, O bull <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: indro diva indra īśe pṛthivyā indro apām indra it parvatānām
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is lord of heaven; <s>Indra</s> is lord of earth. <s>Indra</s> is lord of the waters; <s>Indra</s> indeed is lord of the mountains.

children.text: indro vṛdhām indra in medhirāṇām indraḥ kṣeme yoge havya indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is lord of growths; <s>Indra</s> is lord of the wise. <s>Indra</s> is invoked in security and in striving; <s>Indra</s> receives the oblation.

children.text: prāktubhya indraḥ pra vṛdho ahabhyaḥ prāntarikṣāt pra samudrasya dhāseḥ
children.translated_text: From the eastern realms <s>Indra</s> has surpassed them, from the growing days, from the midspace, from the foundation of the sea,

children.text: pra vātasya prathasaḥ pra jmo antāt pra sindhubhyo ririce pra kṣitibhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: from the breadth of the wind, from the end of the earth; he has surpassed the rivers and surpassed the settlements.

children.text: pra śośucatyā uṣaso na ketur asinvā te vartatām indra hetiḥ
children.translated_text: Like the beacon of the blazing dawn, let your missile, O <s>Indra</s>, turn irresistibly.

children.text: aśmeva vidhya diva ā sṛjānas tapiṣṭhena heṣasā droghamitrān ||
children.translated_text: Released from heaven like a stone, strike the treacherous friends with your hottest shaft.
