children.text: amīṣāṃ cittam pratilobhayantī gṛhāṇāṅgāny apve parehi
children.translated_text: Bewildering the minds of those men, seizing their bodily limbs, O <s>Apvā</s>, go away.

children.text: abhi prehi nir daha hṛtsu śokair andhenāmitrās tamasā sacantām ||
children.translated_text: Go against them; burn them completely with griefs in their hearts. Let the enemies cling to blind darkness.

children.text: pretā jayatā nara indro vaḥ śarma yacchatu
children.translated_text: Go forth, conquer, O men; may <s>Indra</s> grant you shelter.

children.text: ugrā vaḥ santu bāhavo 'nādhṛṣyā yathāsatha ||
children.translated_text: Let your arms be fierce and irresistible, as you are.

children.text: Chapter 941
asāvi somaḥ puruhūta tubhyaṃ haribhyāṃ yajñam upa yāhi tūyam
children.translated_text: The <s>Soma</s> has been pressed for you, O much-invoked one; come quickly with the two bays to the sacrifice.

children.text: tubhyaṃ giro vipravīrā iyānā dadhanvira indra pibā sutasya ||
children.translated_text: For you the songs, rich in inspired men, have set themselves in motion; O <s>Indra</s>, drink of the pressed draught.

children.text: apsu dhūtasya harivaḥ pibeha nṛbhiḥ sutasya jaṭharam pṛṇasva
children.translated_text: Drink here, O bay-horsed one, of the <s>Soma</s> washed in the waters and pressed by men; fill your belly.

children.text: mimikṣur yam adraya indra tubhyaṃ tebhir vardhasva madam ukthavāhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The stones have mixed it for you, O <s>Indra</s>; with these, O bearer of hymns, grow strong in exhilaration.

children.text: progrām pītiṃ vṛṣṇa iyarmi satyām prayai sutasya haryaśva tubhyam
children.translated_text: I send forth to the strong bull the real, eager draught of the pressed <s>Soma</s>, O bay-horsed one, for you.

children.text: indra dhenābhir iha mādayasva dhībhir viśvābhiḥ śacyā gṛṇānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, gladden yourself here with the streams of praise, lauded with all thoughts and powers.

children.text: ūtī śacīvas tava vīryeṇa vayo dadhānā uśija ṛtajñāḥ
children.translated_text: With your aid, O powerful one, and through your heroic power, the inspired men, knowing the truth, have taken on strength.

children.text: prajāvad indra manuṣo duroṇe tasthur gṛṇantaḥ sadhamādyāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With offspring, O <s>Indra</s>, in the dwelling of Man, the companions in the feast stood praising.

children.text: praṇītibhiṣ ṭe haryaśva suṣṭoḥ suṣumnasya pururuco janāsaḥ
children.translated_text: Through your guidances, O bay-horsed one, the people rich in splendor have extended themselves in favor and good praise.

children.text: maṃhiṣṭhām ūtiṃ vitire dadhānā stotāra indra tava sūnṛtābhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Holding your greatest aid, the singers, O <s>Indra</s>, have spread it wide with your gracious words.

children.text: upa brahmāṇi harivo haribhyāṃ somasya yāhi pītaye sutasya
children.translated_text: Approach the sacred formulas, O bay-horsed one; come with your two bays for the drinking of the pressed <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: indra tvā yajñaḥ kṣamamāṇam ānaḍ dāśvāṁ asy adhvarasya praketaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, the sacrifice has reached you, ready and fit, the giver, the sign of this rite.

children.text: sahasravājam abhimātiṣāhaṃ suteraṇam maghavānaṃ suvṛktim
children.translated_text: They adorn with songs the prize-winning, foe-overpowering, pressing-impelled <s>Maghavan</s>, praised with fair verses,

children.text: upa bhūṣanti giro apratītam indraṃ namasyā jarituḥ pananta ||
children.translated_text: unmatched <s>Indra</s>; the reverent songs of the singer praise him.

children.text: saptāpo devīḥ suraṇā amṛktā yābhiḥ sindhum atara indra pūrbhit
children.translated_text: The seven divine waters, kindly and uninjured, by which, O <s>Indra</s>, breaker of forts, you crossed the river,

children.text: navatiṃ srotyā nava ca sravantīr devebhyo gātum manuṣe ca vindaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and the ninety-nine flowing streams: you found a path for the gods and for Manu.

children.text: apo mahīr abhiśaster amuñco 'jāgar āsv adhi deva ekaḥ
children.translated_text: You released the great waters from the curse; alone as god you kept watch over them.

children.text: indra yās tvaṃ vṛtratūrye cakartha tābhir viśvāyus tanvam pupuṣyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, by those powers which you exercised in the battle with <s>Vṛtra</s>, may you nourish your body for all life.

children.text: vīreṇyaḥ kratur indraḥ suśastir utāpi dhenā puruhūtam īṭṭe
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is a heroic resolve, well-praised; and the voice of praise seeks the much-invoked one.

children.text: ārdayad vṛtram akṛṇod u lokaṃ sasāhe śakraḥ pṛtanā abhiṣṭiḥ ||
children.translated_text: He broke <s>Vṛtra</s>, made open space; <s>Śakra</s>, a helper, overcame the battles.

children.text: śunaṃ huvema maghavānam indram asmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau
children.translated_text: Let us call kindly on generous <s>Indra</s> in this contest for booty, the best of men in the winning of prizes,

children.text: śṛṇvantam ugram ūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||
children.translated_text: the fierce one who listens for aid in battles, who slays the <s>Vṛtras</s>, the conqueror of treasures.

children.text: Chapter 942
kadā vaso stotraṃ haryata āva śmaśā rudhad vāḥ
children.translated_text: When, O good one, will the pleasing hymn come down to you, restraining the reins?

children.text: dīrghaṃ sutaṃ vātāpyāya ||
children.translated_text: The long-pressed draught is for <s>Vātāpya</s>.

children.text: harī yasya suyujā vivratā ver arvantānu śepā
children.translated_text: His two bay steeds, well-yoked, spread apart; the coursers follow the guiding strap,

children.text: ubhā rajī na keśinā patir dan ||
children.translated_text: both like two braided lines, long-maned; the lord drove them on.

children.text: apa yor indraḥ pāpaja ā marto na śaśramāṇo bibhīvān
children.translated_text: When <s>Indra</s> drove the two away, like a mortal fearful and not resting,

children.text: śubhe yad yuyuje taviṣīvān ||
children.translated_text: when the mighty one yoked them for splendor.

children.text: sacāyor indraś carkṛṣa āṃ upānasaḥ saparyan
children.translated_text: With the pair <s>Indra</s> ploughed; worshipping, he came up to the wagon,

children.text: nadayor vivratayoḥ śūra indraḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, the hero, between the two unbridled streams.

children.text: adhi yas tasthau keśavantā vyacasvantā na puṣṭyai
children.translated_text: He who stood above the two long-maned, far-stretching ones, as for increase,

children.text: vanoti śiprābhyāṃ śipriṇīvān ||
children.translated_text: wins with his two lips, he who has beautiful lips.

children.text: prāstaud ṛṣvaujā ṛṣvebhis tatakṣa śūraḥ śavasā
children.translated_text: The lofty-powerful hero, with lofty ones, made his praise; by his might he fashioned it,

children.text: ṛbhur na kratubhir mātariśvā ||
children.translated_text: like <s>Ṛbhu</s> by skill, like <s>Mātariśvan</s>.

children.text: vajraṃ yaś cakre suhanāya dasyave hirīmaśo hirīmān
children.translated_text: He who made the thunderbolt for the easily slain dasyu, golden-mouthed, golden,

children.text: arutahanur adbhutaṃ na rajaḥ ||
children.translated_text: with unhurt jaw, a wonder like the shining realm.

children.text: ava no vṛjinā śiśīhy ṛcā vanemānṛcaḥ
children.translated_text: Shake off our crooked sins with the hymn; may we win the hymnless ones.

children.text: nābrahmā yajña ṛdhag joṣati tve ||
children.translated_text: A sacrifice without sacred formulation does not find separate favor in you.

children.text: ūrdhvā yat te tretinī bhūd yajñasya dhūrṣu sadman
children.translated_text: When your threefold one rose upright in the seats upon the poles of the sacrifice,

children.text: sajūr nāvaṃ svayaśasaṃ sacāyoḥ ||
children.translated_text: the pair, of one accord, joined the self-renowned boat.

children.text: śriye te pṛśnir upasecanī bhūcchriye darvir arepāḥ
children.translated_text: For your splendor <s>Pṛśni</s> became the sprinkling vessel; for your splendor the ladle was spotless,

children.text: yayā sve pātre siñcasa ut ||
children.translated_text: with which you pour out in your own bowl.

children.text: śataṃ vā yad asurya prati tvā sumitra itthāstaud durmitra itthāstaut
children.translated_text: Whether <s>Sumitra</s> praised you thus a hundred times in lordly fashion, or <s>Durmitra</s> praised you thus,

children.text: āvo yad dasyuhatye kutsaputram prāvo yad dasyuhatye kutsavatsam ||
children.translated_text: when you aided <s>Kutsa</s>'s son in the slaying of the dasyu, when you aided <s>Kutsa</s>'s child in the slaying of the dasyu.

children.text: Chapter 943
ubhā u nūnaṃ tad id arthayethe vi tanvāthe dhiyo vastrāpaseva
children.translated_text: Both of you now seek that very aim; you spread out your thoughts like two weavers making a garment.

children.text: sadhrīcīnā yātave prem ajīgaḥ sudineva pṛkṣa ā taṃsayethe ||
children.translated_text: You have gone forth together for the journey; like refreshments on a good day, you stretch yourselves hither.

children.text: uṣṭāreva pharvareṣu śrayethe prāyogeva śvātryā śāsur ethaḥ
children.translated_text: Like bearers in the rushing streams you take your place; like two harnessed ones with a driving lash, you come as instructors.

children.text: dūteva hi ṣṭho yaśasā janeṣu māpa sthātam mahiṣevāvapānāt ||
children.translated_text: For you stand among people with fame, like messengers; do not stand away from us, like buffaloes from the watering-place.

children.text: sākaṃyujā śakunasyeva pakṣā paśveva citrā yajur ā gamiṣṭam
children.translated_text: Come to the sacred formula, yoked together like the two wings of a bird, bright-colored like beasts.

children.text: agnir iva devayor dīdivāṃsā parijmāneva yajathaḥ purutrā ||
children.translated_text: Shining like <s>Agni</s> for the gods, you sacrifice in many places like those who range all around.

children.text: āpī vo asme pitareva putrogreva rucā nṛpatīva turyai
children.translated_text: Be close to us, like a father to a son, fierce with splendor, like two kings for aid.

children.text: iryeva puṣṭyai kiraṇeva bhujyai śruṣṭīvāneva havam ā gamiṣṭam ||
children.translated_text: Like nourishment for thriving, like a ray for enjoyment, like obedient ones, come to our call.

children.text: vaṃsageva pūṣaryā śimbātā mitreva ṛtā śatarā śātapantā
children.translated_text: Like two of the same lineage, nourished by <s>Pūṣan</s>, like two friends in truth, hundredfold and going by hundreds.

children.text: vājevoccā vayasā gharmyeṣṭhā meṣeveṣā saparyā purīṣā ||
children.translated_text: Lofty with strength in the contest, standing in the heat, like rams with service and refreshment.

children.text: sṛṇyeva jarbharī turpharītū naitośeva turpharī parpharīkā
children.translated_text: Like two sickles, seizing and cutting, like restless cutters, like the swift one, cutting and splitting.

children.text: udanyajeva jemanā maderū tā me jarāyv ajaram marāyu ||
children.translated_text: Like those born of water, advancing in exhilaration, these, aging for me, are ageless though mortal.

children.text: pajreva carcaraṃ jāram marāyu kṣadmevārtheṣu tartarītha ugrā
children.translated_text: Like a lively lover, though subject to age, you two fierce ones cross over needs as over food.

children.text: ṛbhū nāpat kharamajrā kharajrur vāyur na parpharat kṣayad rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: O offspring of <s>Ṛbhu</s>, with sharp speed and sharp-going force, like the wind you quiver as lord of riches.

children.text: gharmeva madhu jaṭhare sanerū bhagevitā turpharī phārivāram
children.translated_text: Like honey in the warm vessel, in the belly, full of old strength, like fortune gained, cutting through the broad enclosure.

children.text: patareva cacarā candranirṇiṅ manaṛṅgā mananyā na jagmī ||
children.translated_text: Like a flying one it has moved about, moon-bright in appearance; thought-reaching, it has gone like a mindful one.

children.text: bṛhanteva gambhareṣu pratiṣṭhām pādeva gādhaṃ tarate vidāthaḥ
children.translated_text: Like a firm standing-place in deep waters, like a foot finding a ford, you two know how to cross.

children.text: karṇeva śāsur anu hi smarātho 'ṃśeva no bhajataṃ citram apnaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like ears, as teachers, you remember indeed; like a share, apportion to us wondrous skill.

children.text: āraṅgareva madhv erayethe sāragheva gavi nīcīnabāre
children.translated_text: Like two bees you set the honey in motion, like two honey-seekers at a cow with downward udder.

children.text: kīnāreva svedam āsiṣvidānā kṣāmevorjā sūyavasāt sacethe ||
children.translated_text: Like laborers sweating sweat, you attend, as the earth attends with strength from good pasture.

children.text: ṛdhyāma stomaṃ sanuyāma vājam ā no mantraṃ sarathehopa yātam
children.translated_text: May we prosper in praise; may we win the prize. Come near to our hymn with your chariot, O companions.

children.text: yaśo na pakvam madhu goṣv antar ā bhūtāṃśo aśvinoḥ kāmam aprāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Like ripe fame, honey has appeared among the cows; the portion of the <s>Aśvins</s> has fulfilled desire.

children.text: Chapter 944
āvir abhūn mahi māghonam eṣāṃ viśvaṃ jīvaṃ tamaso nir amoci
children.translated_text: The great bounty of these men has become manifest; every living being has been released from darkness.

children.text: mahi jyotiḥ pitṛbhir dattam āgād uruḥ panthā dakṣiṇāyā adarśi ||
children.translated_text: The great light, given by the fathers, has come; the broad path of <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial gift) has appeared.

children.text: uccā divi dakṣiṇāvanto asthur ye aśvadāḥ saha te sūryeṇa
children.translated_text: High in heaven stand those who possess <s>dakṣiṇā</s>, those who give horses, together with the sun.

children.text: hiraṇyadā amṛtatvam bhajante vāsodāḥ soma pra tiranta āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those who give gold share in immortality; those who give garments, O <s>Soma</s>, extend their life.

children.text: daivī pūrtir dakṣiṇā devayajyā na kavāribhyo nahi te pṛṇanti
children.translated_text: Divine fulfillment is <s>dakṣiṇā</s>, worship of the gods; it is not for the miserly, for they do not satisfy the gods.

children.text: athā naraḥ prayatadakṣiṇāso 'vadyabhiyā bahavaḥ pṛṇanti ||
children.translated_text: But many men who present <s>dakṣiṇā</s> satisfy them, through fear of blame.

children.text: śatadhāraṃ vāyum arkaṃ svarvidaṃ nṛcakṣasas te abhi cakṣate haviḥ
children.translated_text: With human eyes they look upon the hundred-streamed, wind-swift, heaven-finding hymn-offering.

children.text: ye pṛṇanti pra ca yacchanti saṃgame te dakṣiṇāṃ duhate saptamātaram ||
children.translated_text: Those who give and hand things over at the gathering milk <s>Dakṣiṇā</s>, the seven-mothered one.

children.text: dakṣiṇāvān prathamo hūta eti dakṣiṇāvān grāmaṇīr agram eti
children.translated_text: The man with <s>dakṣiṇā</s> comes first when called; the man with <s>dakṣiṇā</s>, as leader of the village, goes at the front.

children.text: tam eva manye nṛpatiṃ janānāṃ yaḥ prathamo dakṣiṇām āvivāya ||
children.translated_text: Him alone I consider the lord of men, the one who was first to bring forward <s>dakṣiṇā</s>.

children.text: tam eva ṛṣiṃ tam u brahmāṇam āhur yajñanyaṃ sāmagām ukthaśāsam
children.translated_text: Him they call the seer, him indeed the <s>brahman</s> (sacred formulator), the sacrificer, the <s>sāman</s>-singer, the reciter of hymns.

children.text: sa śukrasya tanvo veda tisro yaḥ prathamo dakṣiṇayā rarādha ||
children.translated_text: He knows the three bodies of the bright one, the man who first found favor through <s>dakṣiṇā</s>.

children.text: dakṣiṇāśvaṃ dakṣiṇā gāṃ dadāti dakṣiṇā candram uta yaddhiraṇyam
children.translated_text: <s>Dakṣiṇā</s> gives a horse; <s>dakṣiṇā</s> gives a cow; <s>dakṣiṇā</s> gives the shining ornament and also gold.

children.text: dakṣiṇānnaṃ vanute yo na ātmā dakṣiṇāṃ varma kṛṇute vijānan ||
children.translated_text: <s>Dakṣiṇā</s> wins food, which is our very self; the one who understands makes <s>dakṣiṇā</s> his armor.

children.text: na bhojā mamrur na nyartham īyur na riṣyanti na vyathante ha bhojāḥ
children.translated_text: The generous do not die, nor do they go to futility; the generous do not fail, nor are they distressed.

children.text: idaṃ yad viśvam bhuvanaṃ svaś caitat sarvaṃ dakṣiṇaibhyo dadāti ||
children.translated_text: This whole world, this heavenly realm and all, gives everything to those who possess <s>dakṣiṇā</s>.

children.text: bhojā jigyuḥ surabhiṃ yonim agre bhojā jigyur vadhvaṃ yā suvāsāḥ
children.translated_text: The generous won the fragrant seat in the beginning; the generous won the bride who is well clothed.

children.text: bhojā jigyur antaḥpeyaṃ surāyā bhojā jigyur ye ahūtāḥ prayanti ||
children.translated_text: The generous won the drink within the liquor; the generous won those who go when they are not summoned.

children.text: bhojāyāśvaṃ sam mṛjanty āśum bhojāyāste kanyā śumbhamānā
children.translated_text: They groom a swift horse for the generous man; for the generous man a maiden adorns herself.

children.text: bhojasyedam puṣkariṇīva veśma pariṣkṛtaṃ devamāneva citram ||
children.translated_text: This house of the generous man is like a lotus pool, adorned and beautiful like a divine dwelling.

children.text: bhojam aśvāḥ suṣṭhuvāho vahanti suvṛd ratho vartate dakṣiṇāyāḥ
children.translated_text: Well-drawing horses carry the generous man; the auspicious chariot of <s>dakṣiṇā</s> rolls onward.

children.text: bhojaṃ devāso 'vatā bhareṣu bhojaḥ śatrūn samanīkeṣu jetā ||
children.translated_text: May the gods help the generous man in contests; the generous man is a conqueror of enemies in battles.

children.text: Chapter 945
kim icchantī saramā predam ānaḍ dūre hy adhvā jaguriḥ parācaiḥ
children.translated_text: With what desire, O <s>Saramā</s>, have you come here? The road is far, and the paths go far away.

children.text: kāsmehitiḥ kā paritakmyāsīt kathaṃ rasāyā ataraḥ payāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: What intention was there toward us? What circling approach was there? How did you cross the waters of <s>Rasā</s>?

children.text: indrasya dūtīr iṣitā carāmi maha icchantī paṇayo nidhīn vaḥ
children.translated_text: As the messenger of <s>Indra</s>, impelled, I wander, seeking your great treasures, O <s>Paṇis</s>.

children.text: atiṣkado bhiyasā tan na āvat tathā rasāyā ataram payāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: The crossing did not protect us through fear; leaping across in that way, I crossed the waters of <s>Rasā</s>.

children.text: kīdṛṅṅ indraḥ sarame kā dṛśīkā yasyedaṃ dūtīr asaraḥ parākāt
children.translated_text: What sort is <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Saramā</s>? What is his appearance, whose messenger you have come from far away?

children.text: ā ca gacchān mitram enā dadhāmāthā gavāṃ gopatir no bhavāti ||
children.translated_text: Let him come here; we shall make friendship with him. Then he will become the herdsman of our cows.

children.text: nāhaṃ taṃ veda dabhyaṃ dabhat sa yasyedaṃ dūtīr asaram parākāt
children.translated_text: I do not know him as one to be deceived; he deceives others, he whose messenger I have come from far away.

children.text: na taṃ gūhanti sravato gabhīrā hatā indreṇa paṇayaḥ śayadhve ||
children.translated_text: The deep, flowing waters do not hide him. Struck down by <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Paṇis</s>, you shall lie there.

children.text: imā gāvaḥ sarame yā aicchaḥ pari divo antān subhage patantī
children.translated_text: These cows, O <s>Saramā</s>, which you have sought, fly around the ends of heaven, fortunate one.

children.text: kas ta enā ava sṛjād ayudhvy utāsmākam āyudhā santi tigmā ||
children.translated_text: Who will release them to you without fighting? Besides, our weapons are sharp.

children.text: asenyā vaḥ paṇayo vacāṃsy aniṣavyās tanvaḥ santu pāpīḥ
children.translated_text: Let your words, O <s>Paṇis</s>, be without an army; let your sinful bodies be unable to shoot.

children.text: adhṛṣṭo va etavā astu panthā bṛhaspatir va ubhayā na mṛḍāt ||
children.translated_text: Let this path to you be irresistible; <s>Bṛhaspati</s> will not be gracious to you in either way.

children.text: ayaṃ nidhiḥ sarame adribudhno gobhir aśvebhir vasubhir nyṛṣṭaḥ
children.translated_text: This treasure, O <s>Saramā</s>, has a rock for its bottom; it is enclosed with cows, horses, and goods.

children.text: rakṣanti tam paṇayo ye sugopā reku padam alakam ā jagantha ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Paṇis</s>, who are good guardians, protect it. In vain, tracker, you have come upon a worthless path.

children.text: eha gamann ṛṣayaḥ somaśitā ayāsyo aṅgiraso navagvāḥ
children.translated_text: The seers will come here, inspired by <s>Soma</s>: <s>Ayāsya</s>, the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, and the <s>Navagvas</s>.

children.text: ta etam ūrvaṃ vi bhajanta gonām athaitad vacaḥ paṇayo vamann it ||
children.translated_text: They divided this broad place of the cows; then the <s>Paṇis</s> uttered this speech.

children.text: evā ca tvaṃ sarama ājagantha prabādhitā sahasā daivyena
children.translated_text: And so you have come here, O <s>Saramā</s>, driven on by divine force.

children.text: svasāraṃ tvā kṛṇavai mā punar gā apa te gavāṃ subhage bhajāma ||
children.translated_text: I will make you a sister; do not go back. O fortunate one, we will allot to you a share of the cows.

children.text: nāhaṃ veda bhrātṛtvaṃ no svasṛtvam indro vidur aṅgirasaś ca ghorāḥ
children.translated_text: I do not know brotherhood, nor sisterhood; <s>Indra</s> knows, and the terrible <s>Aṅgirases</s>.

children.text: gokāmā me acchadayan yad āyam apāta ita paṇayo varīyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Seeking the cows, they urged me on when I came. Depart from here, O <s>Paṇis</s>, to a wider place.

children.text: dūram ita paṇayo varīya ud gāvo yantu minatīr ṛtena
children.translated_text: Far from here, O <s>Paṇis</s>, is the wider place; let the cows go forth, diminishing your store through truth,

children.text: bṛhaspatir yā avindan nigūḍhāḥ somo grāvāṇa ṛṣayaś ca viprāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the hidden cows which <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, <s>Soma</s>, the pressing stones, and the inspired seers found.

children.text: Chapter 946
te 'vadan prathamā brahmakilbiṣe 'kūpāraḥ salilo mātariśvā
children.translated_text: They spoke first concerning guilt against the brahman: the boundless one, the flood, and <s>Mātariśvan</s>,

children.text: vīḍuharās tapa ugro mayobhūr āpo devīḥ prathamajā ṛtena ||
children.translated_text: the firm bearers, fierce heat, the bringer of delight, and the divine waters, first-born through <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).

children.text: somo rājā prathamo brahmajāyām punaḥ prāyacchad ahṛṇīyamānaḥ
children.translated_text: King <s>Soma</s> was the first to give back the brahman's wife, without becoming angry.

children.text: anvartitā varuṇo mitra āsīd agnir hotā hastagṛhyā nināya ||
children.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Mitra</s> were followers after him; <s>Agni</s>, the <s>Hotṛ</s> (invoking priest), led her by the hand.

children.text: hastenaiva grāhya ādhir asyā brahmajāyeyam iti ced avocan
children.translated_text: The claim upon her is to be taken by the hand itself, if they say, 'This woman is the brahman's wife.'

children.text: na dūtāya prahye tastha eṣā tathā rāṣṭraṃ gupitaṃ kṣatriyasya ||
children.translated_text: She did not remain for a dispatched messenger; in that way the kingdom of the kṣatriya is guarded.

children.text: devā etasyām avadanta pūrve saptaṛṣayas tapase ye niṣeduḥ
children.translated_text: The gods of old spoke about her, and the seven seers who sat down for austerity:

children.text: bhīmā jāyā brāhmaṇasyopanītā durdhāṃ dadhāti parame vyoman ||
children.translated_text: A brahman's wife, when brought near as another's wife, is fearsome; she sets an unbearable burden in the highest heaven.

children.text: brahmacārī carati veviṣad viṣaḥ sa devānām bhavaty ekam aṅgam
children.translated_text: The <s>brahmacārin</s> (Vedic student) goes about, eager among the peoples; he becomes a single limb of the gods.

children.text: tena jāyām anv avindad bṛhaspatiḥ somena nītāṃ juhvaṃ na devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Through him <s>Bṛhaspati</s> found his wife, whom <s>Soma</s> had led away, as the gods found the sacrificial ladle.

children.text: punar vai devā adaduḥ punar manuṣyā uta
children.translated_text: The gods indeed gave her back, and human beings gave her back too;

children.text: rājānaḥ satyaṃ kṛṇvānā brahmajāyām punar daduḥ ||
children.translated_text: the kings, making truth effective, gave back the brahman's wife.

children.text: punardāya brahmajāyāṃ kṛtvī devair nikilbiṣam
children.translated_text: Having given back the brahman's wife and made themselves free from guilt before the gods,

children.text: ūrjam pṛthivyā bhaktvāyorugāyam upāsate ||
children.translated_text: they enjoy the nourishment of the earth and worship the wide-ranging one.

children.text: Chapter 947
samiddho adya manuṣo duroṇe devo devān yajasi jātavedaḥ
children.translated_text: Kindled today in the dwelling of man, O god <s>Jātavedas</s>, you sacrifice to the gods.

children.text: ā ca vaha mitramahaś cikitvān tvaṃ dūtaḥ kavir asi pracetāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bring here those of friendly greatness, O discerning one; you are the messenger, the sage, the far-seeing one.

children.text: tanūnapāt patha ṛtasya yānān madhvā samañjan svadayā sujihva
children.translated_text: O <s>Tanūnapāt</s>, going on the paths of <s>ṛta</s>, anointing with honey by your own power, O good-tongued one,

children.text: manmāni dhībhir uta yajñam ṛndhan devatrā ca kṛṇuhy adhvaraṃ naḥ ||
children.translated_text: strengthening our thoughts with insights and strengthening the sacrifice, make our rite reach the gods.

children.text: ājuhvāna īḍyo vandyaś cā yāhy agne vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ
children.translated_text: Being invoked, worthy of praise and honor, come here, O <s>Agni</s>, together with the <s>Vasus</s> in shared delight.

children.text: tvaṃ devānām asi yahva hotā sa enān yakṣīṣito yajīyān ||
children.translated_text: You are the mighty <s>Hotṛ</s> of the gods; impelled and most worthy of sacrifice, worship them.

children.text: prācīnam barhiḥ pradiśā pṛthivyā vastor asyā vṛjyate agre ahnām
children.translated_text: The ancient <s>barhis</s> (sacrificial grass) is spread toward the regions of the earth, at the front of the days of this dwelling.

children.text: vy u prathate vitaraṃ varīyo devebhyo aditaye syonam ||
children.translated_text: It unfolds wider and more broadly, pleasant for the gods and for <s>Aditi</s>.

children.text: vyacasvatīr urviyā vi śrayantām patibhyo na janayaḥ śumbhamānāḥ
children.translated_text: Let the spacious doors open wide in breadth, like wives adorning themselves for their husbands.

children.text: devīr dvāro bṛhatīr viśvaminvā devebhyo bhavata suprāyaṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O divine doors, great and all-sustaining, become easy passages for the gods.

children.text: ā suṣvayantī yajate upāke uṣāsānaktā sadatāṃ ni yonau
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣasānaktā</s>, making the pressing prosper and worshipping nearby, sit down in your own seat,

children.text: divye yoṣaṇe bṛhatī surukme adhi śriyaṃ śukrapiśaṃ dadhāne ||
children.translated_text: two heavenly women, great and beautifully golden, placing bright, dappled splendor upon yourselves.

children.text: daivyā hotārā prathamā suvācā mimānā yajñam manuṣo yajadhyai
children.translated_text: The two divine <s>Hotṛs</s>, first and fair-spoken, measuring out the sacrifice so that man may worship,

children.text: pracodayantā vidatheṣu kārū prācīnaṃ jyotiḥ pradiśā diśantā ||
children.translated_text: urging the poets in the assemblies, point out the ancient light toward the region.

children.text: ā no yajñam bhāratī tūyam etv iḍā manuṣvad iha cetayantī
children.translated_text: Let <s>Bhāratī</s> come swiftly to our sacrifice; let <s>Iḍā</s>, awakening here in human fashion, come.

children.text: tisro devīr barhir edaṃ syonaṃ sarasvatī svapasaḥ sadantu ||
children.translated_text: Let the three goddesses, <s>Sarasvatī</s> and the skillful ones, sit upon this pleasant <s>barhis</s>.

children.text: ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī janitrī rūpair apiṃśad bhuvanāni viśvā
children.translated_text: He who fashioned these two, heaven and earth, the mothers, and all beings with their forms,

children.text: tam adya hotar iṣito yajīyān devaṃ tvaṣṭāram iha yakṣi vidvān ||
children.translated_text: to that god <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, O <s>Hotṛ</s>, inspired today and knowing, offer worship here, most worthy of sacrifice.

children.text: upāvasṛja tmanyā samañjan devānām pātha ṛtuthā havīṃṣi
children.translated_text: Release the offerings on the gods' path, according to the seasons, anointing them with your own self.

children.text: vanaspatiḥ śamitā devo agniḥ svadantu havyam madhunā ghṛtena ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Vanaspati</s>, the divine immolator, and the god <s>Agni</s> sweeten the oblation with honey and ghee.

children.text: sadyo jāto vy amimīta yajñam agnir devānām abhavat purogāḥ
children.translated_text: Newly born, <s>Agni</s> at once measured out the sacrifice and became the forerunner of the gods.

children.text: asya hotuḥ pradiśy ṛtasya vāci svāhākṛtaṃ havir adantu devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: At the direction of this <s>Hotṛ</s>, in the speech of <s>ṛta</s>, let the gods eat the oblation made with <s>svāhā</s>.

children.text: Chapter 948
manīṣiṇaḥ pra bharadhvam manīṣāṃ yathā yathā matayaḥ santi nṛṇām
children.translated_text: O thoughtful ones, bring forward inspired thought, in whatever ways men's intentions exist.

children.text: indraṃ satyair erayāmā kṛtebhiḥ sa hi vīro girvaṇasyur vidānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let us impel <s>Indra</s> with true, accomplished acts, for he is the hero, eager for songs and knowing.

children.text: ṛtasya hi sadaso dhītir adyaut saṃ gārṣṭeyo vṛṣabho gobhir ānaṭ
children.translated_text: For the insight from the seat of <s>ṛta</s> has shone; the bull born in the cattle-stall has bellowed together with the cows.

children.text: ud atiṣṭhat taviṣeṇā raveṇa mahānti cit saṃ vivyācā rajāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: He rose up with strength and with a roar; he stretched apart even the great realms.

children.text: indraḥ kila śrutyā asya veda sa hi jiṣṇuḥ pathikṛt sūryāya
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> surely knows this by hearing; he is the victorious maker of a path for the sun.

children.text: ān menāṃ kṛṇvann acyuto bhuvad goḥ patir divaḥ sanajā apratītaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Unshaken, making a passage for the cow, he became lord of the cow, lord of heaven, ancient and unopposed.

children.text: indro mahnā mahato arṇavasya vratāminād aṅgirobhir gṛṇānaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, by his greatness, praised with the <s>Aṅgirases</s>, broke the ordinances of the great flood.

children.text: purūṇi cin ni tatānā rajāṃsi dādhāra yo dharuṇaṃ satyatātā ||
children.translated_text: He stretched out many spaces and upheld the support in truth.

children.text: indro divaḥ pratimānam pṛthivyā viśvā veda savanā hanti śuṣṇam
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> knows the measure of heaven and earth and all the soma-pressings; he smites <s>Śuṣṇa</s>.

children.text: mahīṃ cid dyām ātanot sūryeṇa cāskambha cit kambhanena skabhīyān ||
children.translated_text: He stretched out even the great heaven with the sun, and, mightier than the prop, propped it with a support.

children.text: vajreṇa hi vṛtrahā vṛtram astar adevasya śūśuvānasya māyāḥ
children.translated_text: With the thunderbolt the <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer struck down <s>Vṛtra</s> and the deceits of the swelling godless one.

children.text: vi dhṛṣṇo atra dhṛṣatā jaghanthāthābhavo maghavan bāhvojāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Here, bold one, with boldness you smashed them; then, O <s>Maghavan</s>, you became strong in your arms.

children.text: sacanta yad uṣasaḥ sūryeṇa citrām asya ketavo rām avindan
children.translated_text: When the dawns joined with the sun, his bright signs found delight.

children.text: ā yan nakṣatraṃ dadṛśe divo na punar yato nakir addhā nu veda ||
children.translated_text: When the star was seen no more from heaven, whence it went no one now knows for certain.

children.text: dūraṃ kila prathamā jagmur āsām indrasya yāḥ prasave sasrur āpaḥ
children.translated_text: Far indeed went those first waters of theirs, which flowed forth at <s>Indra</s>'s impulse.

children.text: kva svid agraṃ kva budhna āsām āpo madhyaṃ kva vo nūnam antaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Where is their beginning, where their bottom, O waters? Where now is your middle, where your end?

children.text: sṛjaḥ sindhūṃr ahinā jagrasānāṁ ād id etāḥ pra vivijre javena
children.translated_text: You released the rivers that had been swallowed by the serpent; then these waters rushed forth with speed.

children.text: mumukṣamāṇā uta yā mumucre 'dhed etā na ramante nitiktāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Longing to be freed, and then freed indeed, these streams, once let loose, did not remain confined.

children.text: sadhrīcīḥ sindhum uśatīr ivāyan sanāj jāra āritaḥ pūrbhid āsām
children.translated_text: Flowing together and eager, they went toward the river like women, as if toward their ancient lover, the fort-breaker who had driven them forth.

children.text: astam ā te pārthivā vasūny asme jagmuḥ sūnṛtā indra pūrvīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Your earthly riches have come home to us; many fair words have reached us, O <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: Chapter 949
indra piba pratikāmaṃ sutasya prātaḥsāvas tava hi pūrvapītiḥ
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, drink according to your desire of the pressed soma; the morning pressing is yours, for you drink first.

children.text: harṣasva hantave śūra śatrūn ukthebhiṣ ṭe vīryā pra bravāma ||
children.translated_text: Exult, hero, for striking down enemies; with hymns we proclaim your heroic powers.

children.text: yas te ratho manaso javīyān endra tena somapeyāya yāhi
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, the chariot of yours that is swifter than thought: with that come for the drinking of soma.

children.text: tūyam ā te harayaḥ pra dravantu yebhir yāsi vṛṣabhir mandamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let your bay steeds run quickly hither, those bulls with which you go, rejoicing.

children.text: haritvatā varcasā sūryasya śreṣṭhai rūpais tanvaṃ sparśayasva
children.translated_text: With the tawny splendor of the sun, with your best forms, touch your body with radiance.

children.text: asmābhir indra sakhibhir huvānaḥ sadhrīcīno mādayasvā niṣadya ||
children.translated_text: Called by us, your friends, O <s>Indra</s>, sit down in one accord and be exhilarated.

children.text: yasya tyat te mahimānam madeṣv ime mahī rodasī nāviviktām
children.translated_text: That greatness of yours, in your raptures, these two great worlds, heaven and earth, did not contain.

children.text: tad oka ā haribhir indra yuktaiḥ priyebhir yāhi priyam annam accha ||
children.translated_text: To that dwelling, with your yoked bay steeds, O <s>Indra</s>, go with your beloved ones toward the beloved food.

children.text: yasya śaśvat papivāṃ indra śatrūn anānukṛtyā raṇyā cakartha
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, having drunk as ever, made your enemies unable to match you and fit only for battle.

children.text: sa te purandhiṃ taviṣīm iyarti sa te madāya suta indra somaḥ ||
children.translated_text: This soma, pressed for your exhilaration, sets in motion for you munificence and mighty force.

children.text: idaṃ te pātraṃ sanavittam indra pibā somam enā śatakrato
children.translated_text: This is your bowl, won from of old, O <s>Indra</s>; drink the soma with it, O <s>Śatakratu</s>.

children.text: pūrṇa āhāvo madirasya madhvo yaṃ viśva id abhiharyanti devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The full draught is of the intoxicating sweetness which all the gods eagerly desire.

children.text: vi hi tvām indra purudhā janāso hitaprayaso vṛṣabha hvayante
children.translated_text: For the many peoples call on you in many ways, O <s>Indra</s>, beneficent in purpose, O bull.

children.text: asmākaṃ te madhumattamānīmā bhuvan savanā teṣu harya ||
children.translated_text: May these pressings of ours become sweetest for you; take delight in them.

children.text: pra ta indra pūrvyāṇi pra nūnaṃ vīryā vocam prathamā kṛtāni
children.translated_text: I will proclaim, O <s>Indra</s>, your former heroic deeds, and now the first acts accomplished.

children.text: satīnamanyur aśrathāyo adriṃ suvedanām akṛṇor brahmaṇe gām ||
children.translated_text: With true anger you split open the rock; you made the cow easy to find for the sacred formulation.

children.text: ni ṣu sīda gaṇapate gaṇeṣu tvām āhur vipratamaṃ kavīnām
children.translated_text: Sit down among the hosts, O <s>Gaṇapati</s>; they call you the most inspired seer among poets.

children.text: na ṛte tvat kriyate kiṃ canāre mahām arkam maghavañ citram arca ||
children.translated_text: Apart from you nothing at all is done, even far away; O <s>Maghavan</s>, honor the great, wondrous chant.

children.text: abhikhyā no maghavan nādhamānān sakhe bodhi vasupate sakhīnām
children.translated_text: Look upon us, O <s>Maghavan</s>, as we are in need; as friend, be aware of your friends, O lord of wealth.

children.text: raṇaṃ kṛdhi raṇakṛt satyaśuṣmābhakte cid ā bhajā rāye asmān ||
children.translated_text: Make battle for us, battle-maker with true force; even from what is not apportioned, allot us wealth.

children.text: Chapter 950
tam asya dyāvāpṛthivī sacetasā viśvebhir devair anu śuṣmam āvatām
children.translated_text: May heaven and earth, of one mind, together with all the gods, assist this force of his,

children.text: yad ait kṛṇvāno mahimānam indriyam pītvī somasya kratumāṁ avardhata ||
children.translated_text: when, making manifest his mighty Indra-power, having drunk the soma, he grew strong with insight.

children.text: tam asya viṣṇur mahimānam ojasāṃśuṃ dadhanvān madhuno vi rapśate
children.translated_text: May <s>Viṣṇu</s> with his might measure out this greatness of his, holding the honeyed draught.

children.text: devebhir indro maghavā sayāvabhir vṛtraṃ jaghanvāṁ abhavad vareṇyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With the gods as his companions, generous <s>Indra</s>, after slaying <s>Vṛtra</s>, became the chosen one.

children.text: vṛtreṇa yad ahinā bibhrad āyudhā samasthithā yudhaye śaṃsam āvide
children.translated_text: When, bearing weapons against <s>Vṛtra</s>, the serpent, you stood together for battle and for the winning of praise,

children.text: viśve te atra marutaḥ saha tmanāvardhann ugra mahimānam indriyam ||
children.translated_text: all the <s>Maruts</s> there, together in their own persons, strengthened your fierce Indra-power and greatness.

children.text: jajñāna eva vy abādhata spṛdhaḥ prāpaśyad vīro abhi pauṃsyaṃ raṇam
children.translated_text: As soon as he was born, he drove away rivals; the hero foresaw the manly battle.

children.text: avṛścad adrim ava asyadaḥ sṛjad astabhnān nākaṃ svapasyayā pṛthum ||
children.translated_text: He cut open the rock, released the waters, and by his good work propped up the broad vault of heaven.

children.text: ād indraḥ satrā taviṣīr apatyata varīyo dyāvāpṛthivī abādhata
children.translated_text: Then <s>Indra</s> at once stretched forth his powers; he made heaven and earth wider.

children.text: avābharad dhṛṣito vajram āyasaṃ śevam mitrāya varuṇāya dāśuṣe ||
children.translated_text: Exultant, he brought down the iron thunderbolt, helpful to <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, and the worshipper.

children.text: indrasyātra taviṣībhyo virapśina ṛghāyato araṃhayanta manyave
children.translated_text: At that moment, before <s>Indra</s>'s swelling powers, the hostile ones hastened toward his wrath.

children.text: vṛtraṃ yad ugro vy avṛścad ojasāpo bibhrataṃ tamasā parīvṛtam ||
children.translated_text: when the fierce one, with might, cut apart <s>Vṛtra</s>, who held the waters and was wrapped in darkness.

children.text: yā vīryāṇi prathamāni kartvā mahitvebhir yatamānau samīyatuḥ
children.translated_text: When the two, striving with greatness, met after doing their first heroic deeds,

children.text: dhvāntaṃ tamo 'va dadhvase hata indro mahnā pūrvahūtāv apatyata ||
children.translated_text: then <s>Indra</s>, invoked of old, by his greatness cast down the gloomy darkness and stretched himself forth.

children.text: viśve devāso adha vṛṣṇyāni te 'vardhayan somavatyā vacasyayā
children.translated_text: Then all the gods increased your bull-like powers with soma-filled praise.

children.text: raddhaṃ vṛtram ahim indrasya hanmanāgnir na jambhais tṛṣv annam āvayat ||
children.translated_text: The serpent <s>Vṛtra</s> was broken by <s>Indra</s>'s blow; like <s>Agni</s> with his jaws, he consumed the food eagerly.

children.text: bhūri dakṣebhir vacanebhir ṛkvabhiḥ sakhyebhiḥ sakhyāni pra vocata
children.translated_text: With many skills, with spoken words and verses, with friendships, proclaim your friendships.

children.text: indro dhuniṃ ca cumuriṃ ca dambhayañchraddhāmanasyā śṛṇute dabhītaye ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, subduing <s>Dhuni</s> and <s>Cumuri</s>, listens with trusting mind for <s>Dabhīti</s>.

children.text: tvam purūṇy ā bharā svaśvyā yebhir maṃsai nivacanāni śaṃsan
children.translated_text: Bring here many prizes rich in steeds, with which, through your inspired thoughts, you declare the summonses.

children.text: sugebhir viśvā duritā tarema vido ṣu ṇa urviyā gādham adya ||
children.translated_text: By easy paths may we cross all hardships; find for us today a broad ford.

children.text: Chapter 951
gharmā samantā trivṛtaṃ vy āpatus tayor juṣṭim mātariśvā jagāma
children.translated_text: The hot draughts spread out on every side through the threefold rite; <s>Mātariśvan</s> came to the enjoyment of the two.

children.text: divas payo didhiṣāṇā aveṣan vidur devāḥ sahasāmānam arkam ||
children.translated_text: Seeking the milk of heaven, they entered; the gods knew the chant equal in force.

children.text: tisro deṣṭrāya nirṛtīr upāsate dīrghaśruto vi hi jānanti vahnayaḥ
children.translated_text: Three <s>Nirṛtis</s> attend on the one who points the way; the far-hearing carriers know distinctly.

children.text: tāsāṃ ni cikyuḥ kavayo nidānam pareṣu yā guhyeṣu vrateṣu ||
children.translated_text: The poets perceived their foundation in the distant, hidden ordinances.

children.text: catuṣkapardā yuvatiḥ supeśā ghṛtapratīkā vayunāni vaste
children.translated_text: The beautifully formed young woman with four braids, with a ghee-bright face, clothes herself in manifestations.

children.text: tasyāṃ suparṇā vṛṣaṇā ni ṣedatur yatra devā dadhire bhāgadheyam ||
children.translated_text: In her two strong <s>Suparṇas</s> sat down, where the gods placed their allotted share.

children.text: ekaḥ suparṇaḥ sa samudram ā viveśa sa idaṃ viśvam bhuvanaṃ vi caṣṭe
children.translated_text: One <s>Suparṇa</s> entered the ocean; he looks out over this whole world of beings.

children.text: tam pākena manasāpaśyam antitas tam mātā reḍhi sa u reḍhi mātaram ||
children.translated_text: With an unripe mind I saw him close at hand; his mother licks him, and he in turn licks his mother.

children.text: suparṇaṃ viprāḥ kavayo vacobhir ekaṃ santam bahudhā kalpayanti
children.translated_text: The inspired poets, with their words, fashion the one <s>Suparṇa</s>, though he is single, in many ways.

children.text: chandāṃsi ca dadhato adhvareṣu grahān somasya mimate dvādaśa ||
children.translated_text: Keeping the metres in the sacrifices, they measure out the twelve cups of soma.

children.text: ṣaṭtriṃśāṃś ca caturaḥ kalpayantaś chandāṃsi ca dadhata ādvādaśam
children.translated_text: Fashioning thirty-six and four, and keeping the metres, they extend them up to the twelfth.

children.text: yajñaṃ vimāya kavayo manīṣarksāmābhyām pra rathaṃ vartayanti ||
children.translated_text: Having measured out the <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice), the poets, with insight, set the chariot in motion by means of the <s>ṛc</s> and the <s>sāman</s>.

children.text: caturdaśānye mahimāno asya taṃ dhīrā vācā pra ṇayanti sapta
children.translated_text: Fourteen are his greatnesses; the seven inspired ones lead him forward with speech.

children.text: āpnānaṃ tīrthaṃ ka iha pra vocad yena pathā prapibante sutasya ||
children.translated_text: Who here will proclaim the ford to be reached, the path by which they drink fully of the pressed soma?

children.text: sahasradhā pañcadaśāny ukthā yāvad dyāvāpṛthivī tāvad it tat
children.translated_text: The chants are fifteenfold in a thousand ways; as far as heaven and earth extend, so far indeed is that.

children.text: sahasradhā mahimānaḥ sahasraṃ yāvad brahma viṣṭhitaṃ tāvatī vāk ||
children.translated_text: The greatnesses are thousandfold, a thousand in number; as far as the sacred formulation is spread, so far extends speech.

children.text: kaś chandasāṃ yogam ā veda dhīraḥ ko dhiṣṇyām prati vācam papāda
children.translated_text: What inspired man knows the yoking of the meters? Who has attained speech upon the ritual seats?

children.text: kam ṛtvijām aṣṭamaṃ śūram āhur harī indrasya ni cikāya kaḥ svit ||
children.translated_text: Whom among the officiating priests do they call the eighth hero? Who indeed has perceived the two bay steeds of <s>Indra</s>?

children.text: bhūmyā antam pary eke caranti rathasya dhūrṣu yuktāso asthuḥ
children.translated_text: Some go around the end of the earth; others stand harnessed to the poles of the chariot.

children.text: śramasya dāyaṃ vi bhajanty ebhyo yadā yamo bhavati harmye hitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: They divide among these the share of labor, when <s>Yama</s> is set in the mansion.

children.text: Chapter 952
citra icchiśos taruṇasya vakṣatho na yo mātarāv apyeti dhātave
children.translated_text: Wondrous indeed is the growth of the young child, who does not go to his two mothers for support.

children.text: anūdhā yadi jījanad adhā ca nu vavakṣa sadyo mahi dūtyaṃ caran ||
children.translated_text: If, without nursing, he was brought to birth, then at once he grew great, carrying out a mighty embassy.

children.text: agnir ha nāma dhāyi dann apastamaḥ saṃ yo vanā yuvate bhasmanā datā
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, indeed, was given his name, the most active giver, he who joins himself to the forests and consumes them into ash.

children.text: abhipramurā juhvā svadhvara ino na prothamāno yavase vṛṣā ||
children.translated_text: With his tongue he presses against them, of good rite, like a bull thrusting forward toward pasture.

children.text: taṃ vo viṃ na druṣadaṃ devam andhasa indum prothantam pravapantam arṇavam
children.translated_text: For you I praise that god of the draught, <s>Indu</s>, like a bird sitting on wood, swelling and pouring forth a flood.

children.text: āsā vahniṃ na śociṣā virapśinam mahivrataṃ na sarajantam adhvanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With his mouth he is like a carrier with flame, richly streaming, like one of great ordinance coursing along the paths.

children.text: vi yasya te jrayasānasyājara dhakṣor na vātāḥ pari santy acyutāḥ
children.translated_text: Around you, the ageless one as you rush and burn, the winds remain unshaken, as around a blazing fire.

children.text: ā raṇvāso yuyudhayo na satvanaṃ tritaṃ naśanta pra śiṣanta iṣṭaye ||
children.translated_text: The gladdening ones come, like warriors to a champion; they seek <s>Trita</s> and urge him onward for the offering.

children.text: sa id agniḥ kaṇvatamaḥ kaṇvasakhāryaḥ parasyāntarasya taruṣaḥ
children.translated_text: He indeed is <s>Agni</s>, most closely joined with <s>Kaṇva</s>, friend of <s>Kaṇva</s>, noble, overcoming both the farther and the nearer foe.

children.text: agniḥ pātu gṛṇato agniḥ sūrīn agnir dadātu teṣām avo naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Agni</s> protect the singer; may <s>Agni</s> protect the patrons; may <s>Agni</s> grant us their aid.

children.text: vājintamāya sahyase supitrya tṛṣu cyavāno anu jātavedase
children.translated_text: To the most prize-winning, overpowering, well-fathered <s>Jātavedas</s>, moving swiftly among the vigorous ones,

children.text: anudre cid yo dhṛṣatā varaṃ sate mahintamāya dhanvaned aviṣyate ||
children.translated_text: to him who, even in the waterless waste, wins the best thing by boldness, and for whom the bow is stretched for the greatest prize.

children.text: evāgnir martaiḥ saha sūribhir vasu ṣṭave sahasaḥ sūnaro nṛbhiḥ
children.translated_text: Thus <s>Agni</s>, the good son of strength, is praised among mortals together with generous patrons, as wealth by men.

children.text: mitrāso na ye sudhitā ṛtāyavo dyāvo na dyumnair abhi santi mānuṣān ||
children.translated_text: They are like well-established friends, seekers of <s>ṛta</s>; like the heavens with their splendors, they encompass human beings.

children.text: ūrjo napāt sahasāvann iti tvopastutasya vandate vṛṣā vāk
children.translated_text: "O child of strength, powerful one," thus the bull-like speech of the praiser reveres you.

children.text: tvāṃ stoṣāma tvayā suvīrā drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: We shall praise you; through you, rich in good heroes, may we establish a longer, further-reaching life.

children.text: iti tvāgne vṛṣṭihavyasya putrā upastutāsa ṛṣayo 'vocan
children.translated_text: Thus, O <s>Agni</s>, the sons of <s>Vṛṣṭihavya</s>, the seers who praised you, have spoken.

children.text: tāṃś ca pāhi gṛṇataś ca sūrīn vaṣaḍ vaṣaḍ ity ūrdhvāso anakṣan namo nama ity ūrdhvāso anakṣan ||
children.translated_text: Protect them, and the singers and patrons; standing upright they have uttered "vaṣaṭ, vaṣaṭ," and standing upright they have uttered "homage, homage."

children.text: Chapter 953
pibā somam mahata indriyāya pibā vṛtrāya hantave śaviṣṭha
children.translated_text: Drink the soma for great might; drink, O strongest one, for the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: piba rāye śavase hūyamānaḥ piba madhvas tṛpad indrā vṛṣasva ||
children.translated_text: Drink, being invoked, for wealth and power; drink of the sweetness, be satisfied, O <s>Indra</s>, and grow strong.

children.text: asya piba kṣumataḥ prasthitasyendra somasya varam ā sutasya
children.translated_text: Drink, O <s>Indra</s>, the choice portion of this pressed soma, rich in food and set forth.

children.text: svastidā manasā mādayasvārvācīno revate saubhagāya ||
children.translated_text: Bestowing well-being, gladden yourself in mind; turn hither for splendid good fortune.

children.text: mamattu tvā divyaḥ soma indra mamattu yaḥ sūyate pārthiveṣu
children.translated_text: May the heavenly <s>Soma</s> exhilarate you, O <s>Indra</s>; may the one pressed among earthly places exhilarate you.

children.text: mamattu yena varivaś cakartha mamattu yena niriṇāsi śatrūn ||
children.translated_text: May that by which you made broad space exhilarate you; may that by which you drive out enemies exhilarate you.

children.text: ā dvibarhā amino yātv indro vṛṣā haribhyām pariṣiktam andhaḥ
children.translated_text: Let <s>Indra</s>, the bull, come here to the double-spread <s>barhis</s>, with his two bay steeds, to the sprinkled draught.

children.text: gavy ā sutasya prabhṛtasya madhvaḥ satrā khedām aruśahā vṛṣasva ||
children.translated_text: At the cow-rich pressing, at the presented sweetness, overcome weariness altogether, O ruddy-haired one, and grow strong.

children.text: ni tigmāni bhrāśayan bhrāśyāny ava sthirā tanuhi yātujūnām
children.translated_text: Flashing down the sharp, glittering weapons, loosen the firm defenses of the sorcery-driving foes.

children.text: ugrāya te saho balaṃ dadāmi pratītyā śatrūn vigadeṣu vṛśca ||
children.translated_text: For you, the fierce one, I give force and strength; meeting the enemies, cut them down in the contests.

children.text: vy arya indra tanuhi śravāṃsy oja sthireva dhanvano 'bhimātīḥ
children.translated_text: Spread out noble fame, O <s>Indra</s>, and strength; stretch the hostile powers like the firm string of a bow.

children.text: asmadryag vāvṛdhānaḥ sahobhir anibhṛṣṭas tanvaṃ vāvṛdhasva ||
children.translated_text: Growing toward us with your powers, unassailed, make your body grow.

children.text: idaṃ havir maghavan tubhyaṃ rātam prati samrāḍ ahṛṇāno gṛbhāya
children.translated_text: This oblation, O <s>Maghavan</s>, has been given to you; receive it, O sovereign, without anger.

children.text: tubhyaṃ suto maghavan tubhyam pakvo 'ddhīndra piba ca prasthitasya ||
children.translated_text: For you the soma has been pressed, O <s>Maghavan</s>; for you it has been prepared. Eat, O <s>Indra</s>, and drink of what has been set forth.

children.text: addhīd indra prasthitemā havīṃṣi cano dadhiṣva pacatota somam
children.translated_text: Eat, O <s>Indra</s>, these offerings that have been set forth; take delight, and consume the prepared soma.

children.text: prayasvantaḥ prati haryāmasi tvā satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bearing refreshments, we turn eagerly toward you; may the desires of the sacrificer come true.

children.text: prendrāgnibhyāṃ suvacasyām iyarmi sindhāv iva prerayaṃ nāvam arkaiḥ
children.translated_text: I send forth a fair-spoken hymn to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, driving it with songs like a boat on the river.

children.text: ayā iva pari caranti devā ye asmabhyaṃ dhanadā udbhidaś ca ||
children.translated_text: By this may the gods move around us, those who give wealth to us and break treasures open.

children.text: Chapter 954
na vā u devāḥ kṣudham id vadhaṃ dadur utāśitam upa gacchanti mṛtyavaḥ
children.translated_text: The gods have not given hunger itself as death; deaths come even upon one who has eaten.

children.text: uto rayiḥ pṛṇato nopa dasyaty utāpṛṇan marḍitāraṃ na vindate ||
children.translated_text: Moreover, wealth does not fail for the one who gives freely, while the ungenerous man finds no one to show mercy.

children.text: ya ādhrāya cakamānāya pitvo 'nnavān san raphitāyopajagmuṣe
children.translated_text: The man who, though possessing food, hardens himself against the poor man longing for food, worn down, and coming near,

children.text: sthiram manaḥ kṛṇute sevate puroto cit sa marḍitāraṃ na vindate ||
children.translated_text: makes his mind firm against him; even when he has one before him, he finds no one to show mercy.

children.text: sa id bhojo yo gṛhave dadāty annakāmāya carate kṛśāya
children.translated_text: He alone is generous who gives to the lean man who comes to his house, desiring food.

children.text: aram asmai bhavati yāmahūtā utāparīṣu kṛṇute sakhāyam ||
children.translated_text: It becomes sufficient for him when help is called for on the way, and in later times he makes a friend.

children.text: na sa sakhā yo na dadāti sakhye sacābhuve sacamānāya pitvaḥ
children.translated_text: He is no friend who does not give of his food to a friend, to the companion who stays beside him.

children.text: apāsmāt preyān na tad oko asti pṛṇantam anyam araṇaṃ cid icchet ||
children.translated_text: Let one go away from him; that is no home. Let one seek another who gives freely, even if he is a stranger.

children.text: pṛṇīyād in nādhamānāya tavyān drāghīyāṃsam anu paśyeta panthām
children.translated_text: The stronger man should indeed give to the one who begs; he should look ahead to the longer path.

children.text: o hi vartante rathyeva cakrānyam anyam upa tiṣṭhanta rāyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For riches turn like the wheels of a chariot, coming now to one man and now to another.

children.text: mogham annaṃ vindate apracetāḥ satyam bravīmi vadha it sa tasya
children.translated_text: The foolish man obtains food in vain; I speak the truth: it is indeed his death.

children.text: nāryamaṇam puṣyati no sakhāyaṃ kevalāgho bhavati kevalādī ||
children.translated_text: He does not nourish <s>Aryaman</s>, nor a friend; eating alone, he becomes one whose sin is alone.

children.text: kṛṣann it phāla āśitaṃ kṛṇoti yann adhvānam apa vṛṅkte caritraiḥ
children.translated_text: The plowshare, ploughing, makes food ready, when with its going it opens up the path.

children.text: vadan brahmāvadato vanīyān pṛṇann āpir apṛṇantam abhi ṣyāt ||
children.translated_text: The speaking priest is more desirable than one who does not speak; the friend who fills should surpass the one who does not fill.

children.text: ekapād bhūyo dvipado vi cakrame dvipāt tripādam abhy eti paścāt
children.translated_text: The one-footed has strode farther than the two-footed; the two-footed comes after the three-footed from behind.

children.text: catuṣpād eti dvipadām abhisvare sampaśyan paṅktīr upatiṣṭhamānaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The four-footed comes at the call of the two-footed, looking upon the rows as it stands near.

children.text: samau ciddhastau na samaṃ viviṣṭaḥ sammātarā cin na samaṃ duhāte
children.translated_text: Even two hands alike have not entered upon the same work; even two cows of the same mother do not milk equally.

children.text: yamayoś cin na samā vīryāṇi jñātī cit santau na samam pṛṇītaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Even of twins the powers are not equal; even kinsmen, though kin, do not bestow alike.

children.text: Chapter 955
agne haṃsi ny atriṇaṃ dīdyan martyeṣv ā
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, blazing among mortals, you strike down the devourer

children.text: sve kṣaye śucivrata ||
children.translated_text: in your own dwelling, O you of pure ordinances.

children.text: ut tiṣṭhasi svāhuto ghṛtāni prati modase
children.translated_text: You rise up when well invoked; you rejoice in the ghee-offerings

children.text: yat tvā srucaḥ samasthiran ||
children.translated_text: when the ladles have gathered around you.

children.text: sa āhuto vi rocate 'gnir īḍenyo girā
children.translated_text: He, being invoked, shines forth, <s>Agni</s>, worthy of praise with song;

children.text: srucā pratīkam ajyate ||
children.translated_text: his face is anointed with the ladle.

children.text: ghṛtenāgniḥ sam ajyate madhupratīka āhutaḥ
children.translated_text: With ghee <s>Agni</s> is anointed; invoked, honey-faced,

children.text: rocamāno vibhāvasuḥ ||
children.translated_text: he shines, the radiant one rich in light.

children.text: jaramāṇaḥ sam idhyase devebhyo havyavāhana
children.translated_text: As you are kindled, you blaze up, O oblation-bearer for the gods;

children.text: taṃ tvā havanta martyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: mortals call upon you.

children.text: tam martā amartyaṃ ghṛtenāgniṃ saparyata
children.translated_text: Mortals worship that immortal <s>Agni</s> with ghee,

children.text: adābhyaṃ gṛhapatim ||
children.translated_text: the unconquerable lord of the house.

children.text: adābhyena śociṣāgne rakṣas tvaṃ daha
children.translated_text: With your unconquerable flame, O <s>Agni</s>, burn away the demon;

children.text: gopā ṛtasya dīdihi ||
children.translated_text: as guardian of <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), shine brightly.

children.text: sa tvam agne pratīkena praty oṣa yātudhānyaḥ
children.translated_text: So you, O <s>Agni</s>, with your face, burn toward the sorceries,

children.text: urukṣayeṣu dīdyat ||
children.translated_text: shining in the broad dwellings.

children.text: taṃ tvā gīrbhir urukṣayā havyavāhaṃ sam īdhire
children.translated_text: You, wide-dwelling oblation-bearer, they have kindled with songs,

children.text: yajiṣṭham mānuṣe jane ||
children.translated_text: the most worthy of sacrifice among the human people.

children.text: Chapter 956
iti vā iti me mano gām aśvaṃ sanuyām iti
children.translated_text: Thus, or so, is my mind: 'May I win a cow and a horse';

children.text: kuvit somasyāpām iti ||
children.translated_text: have I perhaps drunk of <s>Soma</s>?

children.text: pra vātā iva dodhata un mā pītā ayaṃsata
children.translated_text: Like winds they have shaken me forward; the drunk draughts have lifted me up;

children.text: kuvit somasyāpām iti ||
children.translated_text: have I perhaps drunk of <s>Soma</s>?

children.text: un mā pītā ayaṃsata ratham aśvā ivāśavaḥ
children.translated_text: The drunk draughts have lifted me up like swift horses a chariot;

children.text: kuvit somasyāpām iti ||
children.translated_text: have I perhaps drunk of <s>Soma</s>?

children.text: upa mā matir asthita vāśrā putram iva priyam
children.translated_text: My thought has come near me like a lowing cow to her dear calf;

children.text: kuvit somasyāpām iti ||
children.translated_text: have I perhaps drunk of <s>Soma</s>?

children.text: ahaṃ taṣṭeva vandhuram pary acāmi hṛdā matim
children.translated_text: Like a carpenter shaping a chariot-seat, I fashion the thought around with my heart;

children.text: kuvit somasyāpām iti ||
children.translated_text: have I perhaps drunk of <s>Soma</s>?

children.text: nahi me akṣipac canācchāntsuḥ pañca kṛṣṭayaḥ
children.translated_text: Not even the five peoples, however much they look, have reached my side;

children.text: kuvit somasyāpām iti ||
children.translated_text: have I perhaps drunk of <s>Soma</s>?

children.text: nahi me rodasī ubhe anyam pakṣaṃ cana prati
children.translated_text: Not even both worlds together match even one wing of mine;

children.text: kuvit somasyāpām iti ||
children.translated_text: have I perhaps drunk of <s>Soma</s>?

children.text: abhi dyām mahinā bhuvam abhīmām pṛthivīm mahīm
children.translated_text: In greatness I have encompassed heaven; I have encompassed this great earth;

children.text: kuvit somasyāpām iti ||
children.translated_text: have I perhaps drunk of <s>Soma</s>?

children.text: hantāham pṛthivīm imāṃ ni dadhānīha veha vā
children.translated_text: Now I will set down this earth, either here or there;

children.text: kuvit somasyāpām iti ||
children.translated_text: have I perhaps drunk of <s>Soma</s>?

children.text: oṣam it pṛthivīm ahaṃ jaṅghanānīha veha vā
children.translated_text: I will at once strike the earth, either here or there;

children.text: kuvit somasyāpām iti ||
children.translated_text: have I perhaps drunk of <s>Soma</s>?

children.text: divi me anyaḥ pakṣo 'dho anyam acīkṛṣam
children.translated_text: One wing of mine is in heaven; I have drawn the other downward;

children.text: kuvit somasyāpām iti ||
children.translated_text: have I perhaps drunk of <s>Soma</s>?

children.text: aham asmi mahāmaho 'bhinabhyam udīṣitaḥ
children.translated_text: I am great among the great, raised up to the navel of the sky;

children.text: kuvit somasyāpām iti ||
children.translated_text: have I perhaps drunk of <s>Soma</s>?

children.text: gṛho yāmy araṃkṛto devebhyo havyavāhanaḥ
children.translated_text: Adorned for the gods as oblation-bearer, I go to the house;

children.text: kuvit somasyāpām iti ||
children.translated_text: have I perhaps drunk of <s>Soma</s>?

children.text: Chapter 957
tad id āsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭhaṃ yato jajña ugras tveṣanṛmṇaḥ
children.translated_text: That indeed was the eldest thing among beings, from which the fierce one of blazing manly force was born.

children.text: sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūn anu yaṃ viśve madanty ūmāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Newly born, he at once drives away enemies; all powers rejoice after him.

children.text: vāvṛdhānaḥ śavasā bhūryojāḥ śatrur dāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhāti
children.translated_text: Growing by might, with abundant strength, he sets fear for the foe, for the <s>Dāsa</s>.

children.text: avyanac ca vyanac ca sasni saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣu ||
children.translated_text: He has won what was hidden and what was manifest; your offerings bow together in the exhilarations.

children.text: tve kratum api vṛñjanti viśve dvir yad ete trir bhavanty ūmāḥ
children.translated_text: In you all place their will, when these exhilarations become twice and three times over.

children.text: svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā sam adaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Sweeter than the sweet, with sweetness release; with honey contend for that honeyed thing.

children.text: iti ciddhi tvā dhanā jayantam made made anumadanti viprāḥ
children.translated_text: For thus, in every exhilaration, the inspired poets approve you as one winning wealth.

children.text: ojīyo dhṛṣṇo sthiram ā tanuṣva mā tvā dabhan yātudhānā durevāḥ ||
children.translated_text: O stronger, bold one, stretch out firm strength; let not the evil <s>Yātudhānas</s> deceive you.

children.text: tvayā vayaṃ śāśadmahe raṇeṣu prapaśyanto yudhenyāni bhūri
children.translated_text: Through you may we prevail in battles, looking forth upon many things to be fought for.

children.text: codayāmi ta āyudhā vacobhiḥ saṃ te śiśāmi brahmaṇā vayāṃsi ||
children.translated_text: With words I urge on your weapons; with sacred formulation I sharpen your powers.

children.text: stuṣeyyam puruvarpasam ṛbhvam inatamam āptyam āptyānām
children.translated_text: I would praise the one of many forms, the skillful <s>Ṛbhvan</s>, the most intimate among intimates.

children.text: ā darṣate śavasā sapta dānūn pra sākṣate pratimānāni bhūri ||
children.translated_text: By might he makes visible the seven streams; he masters many measures.

children.text: ni tad dadhiṣe 'varam paraṃ ca yasminn āvithāvasā duroṇe
children.translated_text: You have set down that, lower and higher, in the dwelling where you aided with help.

children.text: ā mātarā sthāpayase jigatnū ata inoṣi karvarā purūṇi ||
children.translated_text: You set the two mothers in motion and in place; then you drive on many deeds.

children.text: imā brahma bṛhaddivo vivaktīndrāya śūṣam agriyaḥ svarṣāḥ
children.translated_text: These sacred formulations of <s>Bṛhaddiva</s> proclaim foremost strength for <s>Indra</s>, winning the sun.

children.text: maho gotrasya kṣayati svarājo duraś ca viśvā avṛṇod apa svāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The self-ruling one holds the greatness of the cattle-stall and has opened all his own doors.

children.text: evā mahān bṛhaddivo atharvāvocat svāṃ tanvam indram eva
children.translated_text: Thus great <s>Bṛhaddiva Ātharvaṇa</s> has spoken of his own body as <s>Indra</s> himself.

children.text: svasāro mātaribhvarīr ariprā hinvanti ca śavasā vardhayanti ca ||
children.translated_text: The spotless sisters, moving in the mother, impel him and strengthen him with might.

children.text: Chapter 958
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ sam avartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patir eka āsīt
children.translated_text: <s>Hiraṇyagarbha</s> arose in the beginning; once born, he was the one lord of what exists.

children.text: sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyām utemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
children.translated_text: He upheld this earth and heaven; to which god shall we offer with oblation?

children.text: ya ātmadā baladā yasya viśva upāsate praśiṣaṃ yasya devāḥ
children.translated_text: He who gives self and gives strength, whose command all beings and the gods attend,

children.text: yasya chāyāmṛtaṃ yasya mṛtyuḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
children.translated_text: whose shadow is immortality and whose shadow is death: to which god shall we offer with oblation?

children.text: yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣato mahitvaika id rājā jagato babhūva
children.translated_text: He who by his greatness became the one king of the breathing and blinking world,

children.text: ya īśe asya dvipadaś catuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
children.translated_text: who rules over this two-footed and four-footed world: to which god shall we offer with oblation?

children.text: yasyeme himavanto mahitvā yasya samudraṃ rasayā sahāhuḥ
children.translated_text: By whose greatness these snowy mountains stand, and whose they call the ocean together with the <s>Rasā</s>,

children.text: yasyemāḥ pradiśo yasya bāhū kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
children.translated_text: whose are these quarters, whose arms they are: to which god shall we offer with oblation?

children.text: yena dyaur ugrā pṛthivī ca dṛḍhā yena sva stabhitaṃ yena nākaḥ
children.translated_text: By whom the mighty heaven and the earth were made firm, by whom the heavenly world was propped up, by whom the vault of heaven was fixed,

children.text: yo antarikṣe rajaso vimānaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
children.translated_text: who in the midspace is the measurer of the realm: to which god shall we offer worship with oblation?

children.text: yaṃ krandasī avasā tastabhāne abhy aikṣetām manasā rejamāne
children.translated_text: Whom the two roaring worlds, upheld by his aid, looked toward with their mind while they trembled,

children.text: yatrādhi sūra udito vibhāti kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
children.translated_text: where above them the risen sun shines forth: to which god shall we offer worship with oblation?

children.text: āpo ha yad bṛhatīr viśvam āyan garbhaṃ dadhānā janayantīr agnim
children.translated_text: When the great waters came through all things, bearing the embryo and giving birth to <s>Agni</s>,

children.text: tato devānāṃ sam avartatāsur ekaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
children.translated_text: from them arose the single life-force of the gods: to which god shall we offer worship with oblation?

children.text: yaś cid āpo mahinā paryapaśyad dakṣaṃ dadhānā janayantīr yajñam
children.translated_text: He who by his greatness looked over the waters, which held skill and gave birth to sacrifice,

children.text: yo deveṣv adhi deva eka āsīt kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
children.translated_text: who alone was the god above the gods: to which god shall we offer worship with oblation?

children.text: mā no hiṃsīj janitā yaḥ pṛthivyā yo vā divaṃ satyadharmā jajāna
children.translated_text: Let him not harm us, the begetter of the earth, or he who, true in <s>dharma</s>, begot heaven,

children.text: yaś cāpaś candrā bṛhatīr jajāna kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
children.translated_text: and who begot the shining, mighty waters: to which god shall we offer worship with oblation?

children.text: prajāpate na tvad etāny anyo viśvā jātāni pari tā babhūva
children.translated_text: O <s>Prajāpati</s>, no one other than you has encompassed all these beings that have been born.

children.text: yatkāmās te juhumas tan no astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
children.translated_text: Whatever desires are ours as we pour offerings to you, let that be ours; may we become lords of riches.

children.text: Chapter 959
vasuṃ na citramahasaṃ gṛṇīṣe vāmaṃ śevam atithim adviṣeṇyam
children.translated_text: I praise him like precious wealth, the one of wondrous greatness, lovely, auspicious, a guest whom none should hate.

children.text: sa rāsate śurudho viśvadhāyaso 'gnir hotā gṛhapatiḥ suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: He bestows good support and all-sustaining heroic power: <s>Agni</s>, the <s>Hotṛ</s> and lord of the house.

children.text: juṣāṇo agne prati harya me vaco viśvāni vidvān vayunāni sukrato
children.translated_text: Accepting it, O <s>Agni</s>, turn toward my speech, knowing all the ways, O wise-minded one.

children.text: ghṛtanirṇig brahmaṇe gātum eraya tava devā ajanayann anu vratam ||
children.translated_text: Clad in ghee, send forth a path for the sacred utterance; the gods generated you according to your ordinance.

children.text: sapta dhāmāni pariyann amartyo dāśad dāśuṣe sukṛte māmahasva
children.translated_text: Going around the seven abodes as an immortal, give to the giver; magnify the doer of good.

children.text: suvīreṇa rayiṇāgne svābhuvā yas ta ānaṭ samidhā taṃ juṣasva ||
children.translated_text: With heroic wealth, O <s>Agni</s>, self-born, favor the one who has reached you with kindling.

children.text: yajñasya ketum prathamam purohitaṃ haviṣmanta īḍate sapta vājinam
children.translated_text: They praise the first household priest, the banner of sacrifice, rich in oblations, the sevenfold racer.

children.text: śṛṇvantam agniṃ ghṛtapṛṣṭham ukṣaṇam pṛṇantaṃ devam pṛṇate suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: They praise <s>Agni</s>, who hears, the ghee-backed bull, the god who fills the worshipper with heroic power.

children.text: tvaṃ dūtaḥ prathamo vareṇyaḥ sa hūyamāno amṛtāya matsva
children.translated_text: You are the first messenger, most worthy of choice; being invoked, rejoice for immortality.

children.text: tvām marjayan maruto dāśuṣo gṛhe tvāṃ stomebhir bhṛgavo vi rurucuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Maruts</s> cleansed you in the house of the giver; the <s>Bhṛgus</s> made you shine with hymns.

children.text: iṣaṃ duhan sudughāṃ viśvadhāyasaṃ yajñapriye yajamānāya sukrato
children.translated_text: Milking nourishment, the good-milking and all-sustaining one, for the sacrifice-loving sacrificer, O wise-minded one,

children.text: agne ghṛtasnus trir ṛtāni dīdyad vartir yajñam pariyan sukratūyase ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, dripping with ghee, shining through the three <s>ṛtas</s>, go around the path of sacrifice for good intention.

children.text: tvām id asyā uṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu dūtaṃ kṛṇvānā ayajanta mānuṣāḥ
children.translated_text: At the brightenings of this dawn, human beings worshipped you, making you the messenger.

children.text: tvāṃ devā mahayāyyāya vāvṛdhur ājyam agne nimṛjanto adhvare ||
children.translated_text: The gods strengthened you for great honor, O <s>Agni</s>, as they wiped the ghee in the rite.

children.text: ni tvā vasiṣṭhā ahvanta vājinaṃ gṛṇanto agne vidatheṣu vedhasaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Vasiṣṭhas</s>, praising, called you down, the strong racer, O <s>Agni</s>, wise ones in the assemblies.

children.text: rāyaspoṣaṃ yajamāneṣu dhāraya yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: Sustain wealth and increase among the sacrificers; may you all always protect us with blessings.

children.text: Chapter 960
ayaṃ venaś codayat pṛśnigarbhā jyotirjarāyū rajaso vimāne
children.translated_text: This <s>Vena</s> has impelled the one with a dappled womb, whose womb is light, in the measured space of the realm.

children.text: imam apāṃ saṃgame sūryasya śiśuṃ na viprā matibhī rihanti ||
children.translated_text: At this meeting-place of the waters, the inspired sages touch this child of the sun with their thoughts.

children.text: samudrād ūrmim ud iyarti veno nabhojāḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ haryatasya darśi
children.translated_text: From the ocean <s>Vena</s> raises up the wave; born in the cloud, the back of the golden one is seen.

children.text: ṛtasya sānāv adhi viṣṭapi bhrāṭ samānaṃ yonim abhy anūṣata vrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: He has shone upon the summit of <s>ṛta</s>, in the highest station; the inspired ones have sung toward the common womb.

children.text: samānam pūrvīr abhi vāvaśānās tiṣṭhan vatsasya mātaraḥ sanīḍāḥ
children.translated_text: The many mothers, longing for the same calf and sharing one nest, stand together.

children.text: ṛtasya sānāv adhi cakramāṇā rihanti madhvo amṛtasya vāṇīḥ ||
children.translated_text: Moving upon the summit of <s>ṛta</s>, they touch the voices of honey, of immortality.

children.text: jānanto rūpam akṛpanta viprā mṛgasya ghoṣam mahiṣasya hi gman
children.translated_text: Knowing the form, the inspired sages fashioned it, for they came to the cry of the beast, of the buffalo.

children.text: ṛtena yanto adhi sindhum asthur vidad gandharvo amṛtāni nāma ||
children.translated_text: Going by <s>ṛta</s>, they stood upon the river; the <s>Gandharva</s> found the immortal names.

children.text: apsarā jāram upasiṣmiyāṇā yoṣā bibharti parame vyoman
children.translated_text: The <s>Apsaras</s>, smiling upon her lover, a woman, bears him in the highest heaven.

children.text: carat priyasya yoniṣu priyaḥ san sīdat pakṣe hiraṇyaye sa venaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Moving in the beloved one's wombs, being beloved, that <s>Vena</s> sits on the golden wing.

children.text: nāke suparṇam upa yat patantaṃ hṛdā venanto abhy acakṣata tvā
children.translated_text: When, as a fair-winged bird, you flew near the heavenly vault, those who longed with their heart saw you,

children.text: hiraṇyapakṣaṃ varuṇasya dūtaṃ yamasya yonau śakunam bhuraṇyum ||
children.translated_text: golden-winged, the messenger of <s>Varuṇa</s>, the restless bird in the abode of <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: ūrdhvo gandharvo adhi nāke asthāt pratyaṅ citrā bibhrad asyāyudhāni
children.translated_text: The <s>Gandharva</s> stood upright above in heaven, facing this way and bearing his bright weapons.

children.text: vasāno atkaṃ surabhiṃ dṛśe kaṃ svar ṇa nāma janata priyāṇi ||
children.translated_text: Wearing a fragrant garment for the sight, like the sun, he generated dear names.

children.text: drapsaḥ samudram abhi yaj jigāti paśyan gṛdhrasya cakṣasā vidharman
children.translated_text: The drop goes toward the ocean, seeing according to order with the eye of the eagle.

children.text: bhānuḥ śukreṇa śociṣā cakānas tṛtīye cakre rajasi priyāṇi ||
children.translated_text: A shining ray, flashing with bright flame, has made dear things in the third realm.

children.text: Chapter 961
imaṃ no agna upa yajñam ehi pañcayāmaṃ trivṛtaṃ saptatantum
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, come to this sacrifice of ours, five-paced, threefold, and seven-threaded.

children.text: aso havyavāḍ uta naḥ purogā jyog eva dīrghaṃ tama āśayiṣṭhāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Be our oblation-carrier and forerunner; you have lain long in the long darkness.

children.text: adevād devaḥ pracatā guhā yan prapaśyamāno amṛtatvam emi
children.translated_text: From the godless one, as a god going secretly with clear knowledge, I go on, seeing immortality ahead.

children.text: śivaṃ yat santam aśivo jahāmi svāt sakhyād araṇīṃ nābhim emi ||
children.translated_text: When I, being unpropitious, leave what is auspicious, from my own friendship I go to the fire-stick, the navel.

children.text: paśyann anyasyā atithiṃ vayāyā ṛtasya dhāma vi mime purūṇi
children.translated_text: Seeing the guest of another branch, I have measured out the many abodes of <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: śaṃsāmi pitre asurāya śevam ayajñiyād yajñiyam bhāgam emi ||
children.translated_text: I proclaim welfare to the father, the <s>Asura</s>; from the non-sacrificial I go to the sacrificial share.

children.text: bahvīḥ samā akaram antar asminn indraṃ vṛṇānaḥ pitaraṃ jahāmi
children.translated_text: For many years I have labored within this; choosing <s>Indra</s>, I leave the father.

children.text: agniḥ somo varuṇas te cyavante paryāvard rāṣṭraṃ tad avāmy āyan ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s>, <s>Soma</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s> move away from you; turning around the kingdom, I have gone seeking it.

children.text: nirmāyā u tye asurā abhūvan tvaṃ ca mā varuṇa kāmayāse
children.translated_text: Those <s>Asuras</s> have become without magic; and you, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, desire me.

children.text: ṛtena rājann anṛtaṃ viviñcan mama rāṣṭrasyādhipatyam ehi ||
children.translated_text: By <s>ṛta</s>, O king, separating falsehood, come to the overlordship of my kingdom.

children.text: idaṃ svar idam id āsa vāmam ayam prakāśa urv antarikṣam
children.translated_text: This is the sun; this indeed was lovely; this is the brightness, the broad midspace.

children.text: hanāva vṛtraṃ nirehi soma haviṣ ṭvā santaṃ haviṣā yajāma ||
children.translated_text: Let us slay <s>Vṛtra</s>; come forth, O <s>Soma</s>. Though you are an oblation, we worship you with oblation.

children.text: kaviḥ kavitvā divi rūpam āsajad aprabhūtī varuṇo nir apaḥ sṛjat
children.translated_text: The poet, by his poetcraft, set his form in heaven; <s>Varuṇa</s>, whose powers had not appeared before, sent forth the waters.
