children.text: kṣemaṃ kṛṇvānā janayo na sindhavas tā asya varṇaṃ śucayo bharibhrati ||
children.translated_text: Making security, like women or like rivers, those bright ones carry around his color.

children.text: tā asya jyeṣṭham indriyaṃ sacante tā īm ā kṣeti svadhayā madantīḥ
children.translated_text: They attend upon his highest power; those waters, rejoicing by their own law, dwell near him.

children.text: tā īṃ viśo na rājānaṃ vṛṇānā bībhatsuvo apa vṛtrād atiṣṭhan ||
children.translated_text: Choosing him as clans choose a king, they, fearful, stood away from <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: bībhatsūnāṃ sayujaṃ haṃsam āhur apāṃ divyānāṃ sakhye carantam
children.translated_text: They call the swan the companion of the fearful ones, moving in the friendship of the heavenly waters.

children.text: anuṣṭubham anu carcūryamāṇam indraṃ ni cikyuḥ kavayo manīṣā ||
children.translated_text: The sages, with inspired insight, recognized <s>Indra</s>, who is repeatedly celebrated according to the anuṣṭubh.

children.text: Chapter 962
ahaṃ rudrebhir vasubhiś carāmy aham ādityair uta viśvadevaiḥ
children.translated_text: I move with the <s>Rudras</s> and the <s>Vasus</s>; I move with the <s>Ādityas</s> and with all the gods.

children.text: aham mitrāvaruṇobhā bibharmy aham indrāgnī aham aśvinobhā ||
children.translated_text: I uphold both <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; I uphold <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>; I uphold both <s>Aśvins</s>.

children.text: ahaṃ somam āhanasam bibharmy ahaṃ tvaṣṭāram uta pūṣaṇam bhagam
children.translated_text: I uphold the swelling <s>Soma</s>; I uphold <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, and <s>Pūṣan</s>, and <s>Bhaga</s>.

children.text: ahaṃ dadhāmi draviṇaṃ haviṣmate suprāvye yajamānāya sunvate ||
children.translated_text: I bestow wealth on the sacrificer who offers oblation, on the worshipper who presses soma well.

children.text: ahaṃ rāṣṭrī saṃgamanī vasūnāṃ cikituṣī prathamā yajñiyānām
children.translated_text: I am the sovereign queen, the gatherer of treasures, the knowing one, first among those worthy of sacrifice.

children.text: tām mā devā vy adadhuḥ purutrā bhūristhātrām bhūry āveśayantīm ||
children.translated_text: The gods have distributed me in many places, making me of many stations and causing me to enter many things.

children.text: mayā so annam atti yo vipaśyati yaḥ prāṇiti ya īṃ śṛṇoty uktam
children.translated_text: Through me one eats food, whoever sees, whoever breathes, whoever hears what is spoken.

children.text: amantavo māṃ ta upa kṣiyanti śrudhi śruta śraddhivaṃ te vadāmi ||
children.translated_text: Though unthinking, they dwell near me. Hear, you who are heard: I tell you what deserves trust.

children.text: aham eva svayam idaṃ vadāmi juṣṭaṃ devebhir uta mānuṣebhiḥ
children.translated_text: I myself speak this, dear to gods and to human beings alike.

children.text: yaṃ kāmaye taṃ tam ugraṃ kṛṇomi tam brahmāṇaṃ tam ṛṣiṃ taṃ sumedhām ||
children.translated_text: Whomever I love, I make him mighty: I make him a <s>brahman</s> (priest), a seer, a wise man.

children.text: ahaṃ rudrāya dhanur ā tanomi brahmadviṣe śarave hantavā u
children.translated_text: I stretch the bow for <s>Rudra</s>, so that his arrow may strike down the hater of sacred speech.

children.text: ahaṃ janāya samadaṃ kṛṇomy ahaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ā viveśa ||
children.translated_text: I make battle for the people; I have entered heaven and earth.

children.text: ahaṃ suve pitaram asya mūrdhan mama yonir apsv antaḥ samudre
children.translated_text: I give birth to the father on the head of this world; my womb is within the waters, in the ocean.

children.text: tato vi tiṣṭhe bhuvanānu viśvotāmūṃ dyāṃ varṣmaṇopa spṛśāmi ||
children.translated_text: From there I spread forth through all beings, and I touch that heaven with my height.

children.text: aham eva vāta iva pra vāmy ārabhamāṇā bhuvanāni viśvā
children.translated_text: I myself blow forth like the wind, setting all worlds in motion.

children.text: paro divā para enā pṛthivyaitāvatī mahinā sam babhūva ||
children.translated_text: Beyond heaven and beyond this earth, so great have I become in majesty.

children.text: Chapter 963
na tam aṃho na duritaṃ devāso aṣṭa martyam
children.translated_text: Not distress, nor sin, O gods, reaches the mortal

children.text: sajoṣaso yam aryamā mitro nayanti varuṇo ati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: whom <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s>, acting in harmony, lead beyond hatreds.

children.text: taddhi vayaṃ vṛṇīmahe varuṇa mitrāryaman
children.translated_text: For this we choose from you, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>:

children.text: yenā nir aṃhaso yūyam pātha nethā ca martyam ati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: that by it you protect a mortal from distress and lead him beyond hatreds.

children.text: te nūnaṃ no 'yam ūtaye varuṇo mitro aryamā
children.translated_text: Now let <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s> be here for our help;

children.text: nayiṣṭhā u no neṣaṇi parṣiṣṭhā u naḥ parṣaṇy ati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: most guiding in guidance, most carrying in rescue, carry us beyond hatreds.

children.text: yūyaṃ viśvam pari pātha varuṇo mitro aryamā
children.translated_text: You encompass and protect the whole world, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>.

children.text: yuṣmākaṃ śarmaṇi priye syāma supraṇītayo 'ti dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we, well-led, be within your beloved shelter, beyond hatreds.

children.text: ādityāso ati sridho varuṇo mitro aryamā
children.translated_text: O <s>Ādityas</s>, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>, take us beyond traps;

children.text: ugram marudbhī rudraṃ huvemendram agniṃ svastaye 'ti dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: we call fierce <s>Rudra</s> with the <s>Maruts</s>, <s>Indra</s>, and <s>Agni</s> for well-being, beyond hatreds.

children.text: netāra ū ṣu ṇas tiro varuṇo mitro aryamā
children.translated_text: Be our leaders now, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>, across and beyond.

children.text: ati viśvāni duritā rājānaś carṣaṇīnām ati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O kings of peoples, carry us beyond all misfortunes, beyond hatreds.

children.text: śunam asmabhyam ūtaye varuṇo mitro aryamā
children.translated_text: For good fortune and for our help, may <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s>

children.text: śarma yacchantu sapratha ādityāso yad īmahe ati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and the <s>Ādityas</s> grant us spacious shelter, when we ask, beyond hatreds.

children.text: yathā ha tyad vasavo gauryaṃ cit padi ṣitām amuñcatā yajatrāḥ
children.translated_text: As in that old time, O <s>Vasus</s>, O worshipful ones, you released even the cow tied at <s>Gauri</s>'s foot,

children.text: evo ṣv asman muñcatā vy aṃhaḥ pra tāry agne prataraṃ na āyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: so now release us from distress; carry our life farther across, O <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: Chapter 964
rātrī vy akhyad āyatī purutrā devy akṣabhiḥ
children.translated_text: Night has looked forth, approaching in many places with the eyes of a goddess.

children.text: viśvā adhi śriyo 'dhita ||
children.translated_text: She has put on all her beauties.

children.text: orv aprā amartyā nivato devy udvataḥ
children.translated_text: The immortal goddess has filled the broad spaces, the low places and the high places.

children.text: jyotiṣā bādhate tamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: With light she drives away darkness.

children.text: nir u svasāram askṛtoṣasaṃ devy āyatī
children.translated_text: The goddess, approaching, has set her sister <s>Uṣas</s>, the Dawn, aside from her work;

children.text: aped u hāsate tamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and darkness too will depart.

children.text: sā no adya yasyā vayaṃ ni te yāmann avikṣmahi
children.translated_text: Tonight, O one under whose coming we have settled down,

children.text: vṛkṣe na vasatiṃ vayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: like birds into their dwelling in a tree,

children.text: ni grāmāso avikṣata ni padvanto ni pakṣiṇaḥ
children.translated_text: the villages have settled down; the footed creatures have settled down; the winged creatures have settled down;

children.text: ni śyenāsaś cid arthinaḥ ||
children.translated_text: even the seeking hawks have settled down.

children.text: yāvayā vṛkyaṃ vṛkaṃ yavaya stenam ūrmye
children.translated_text: Drive away the she-wolf and the wolf; drive away the thief, O wave-like Night.

children.text: athā naḥ sutarā bhava ||
children.translated_text: Then be easy for us to cross.

children.text: upa mā pepiśat tamaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vyaktam asthita
children.translated_text: Darkness has come close to me, black and clearly seen, standing there.

children.text: uṣa ṛṇeva yātaya ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Uṣas</s>, drive it away like a debt.

children.text: upa te gā ivākaraṃ vṛṇīṣva duhitar divaḥ
children.translated_text: Like cows, I have brought your hymn near to you; choose it, O daughter of heaven,

children.text: rātri stomaṃ na jigyuṣe ||
children.translated_text: O Night, as one chooses a song of praise for a conqueror.

children.text: Chapter 965
mamāgne varco vihaveṣv astu vayaṃ tvendhānās tanvam puṣema
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, let my radiance be present in invocations; kindling you, may we nourish our bodies.

children.text: mahyaṃ namantām pradiśaś catasras tvayādhyakṣeṇa pṛtanā jayema ||
children.translated_text: Let the four regions bow to me; with you as overseer, may we win the battles.

children.text: mama devā vihave santu sarva indravanto maruto viṣṇur agniḥ
children.translated_text: Let all the gods be on my side in invocation, with <s>Indra</s>, the <s>Maruts</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: mamāntarikṣam urulokam astu mahyaṃ vātaḥ pavatāṃ kāme asmin ||
children.translated_text: Let the midspace become a broad realm for me; let the wind blow for me in this desire.

children.text: mayi devā draviṇam ā yajantām mayy āśīr astu mayi devahūtiḥ
children.translated_text: May the gods bring wealth to me by sacrifice; may blessing be in me, and divine invocation in me.

children.text: daivyā hotāro vanuṣanta pūrve 'riṣṭāḥ syāma tanvā suvīrāḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the former divine <s>Hotṛs</s> win favor; may we be unharmed in body and rich in heroes.

children.text: mahyaṃ yajantu mama yāni havyākūtiḥ satyā manaso me astu
children.translated_text: Let them sacrifice for me; let the oblations that are mine be offered. Let the intention of my mind be true.

children.text: eno mā ni gāṃ katamac canāhaṃ viśve devāso adhi vocatā naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May I not fall into any guilt at all; O all gods, speak for us.

children.text: devīḥ ṣaḍ urvīr uru naḥ kṛṇota viśve devāsa iha vīrayadhvam
children.translated_text: O six broad goddesses, make wide space for us; O all gods, show your heroic strength here.

children.text: mā hāsmahi prajayā mā tanūbhir mā radhāma dviṣate soma rājan ||
children.translated_text: May we not be deprived of offspring or of our own bodies; may we not fail before the hater, O king <s>Soma</s>.

children.text: agne manyum pratinudan pareṣām adabdho gopāḥ pari pāhi nas tvam
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, driving back the fury of others, unharmed guardian, protect us all around.

children.text: pratyañco yantu nigutaḥ punas te 'maiṣāṃ cittam prabudhāṃ vi neśat ||
children.translated_text: Let those who are bound and turned against us go back again to you; may he destroy their awakened intention.

children.text: dhātā dhātṝṇām bhuvanasya yas patir devaṃ trātāram abhimātiṣāham
children.translated_text: <s>Dhātṛ</s>, creator among creators, who is lord of the world, the god, the protector, overcoming hostile designs

children.text: imaṃ yajñam aśvinobhā bṛhaspatir devāḥ pāntu yajamānaṃ nyarthāt ||
children.translated_text: May both <s>Aśvins</s>, <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, and the gods protect this sacrifice and the sacrificer from harm.

children.text: uruvyacā no mahiṣaḥ śarma yaṃsad asmin have puruhūtaḥ purukṣuḥ
children.translated_text: May the far-ranging buffalo, much-invoked and rich in many gifts, grant us broad shelter at this call.

children.text: sa naḥ prajāyai haryaśva mṛḍayendra mā no rīriṣo mā parā dāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Be gracious to our offspring, O bay-horsed <s>Indra</s>; do not injure us, do not abandon us.

children.text: ye naḥ sapatnā apa te bhavantv indrāgnibhyām ava bādhāmahe tān
children.translated_text: Let those who are our rivals become far away; with <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> we drive them off.

children.text: vasavo rudrā ādityā uparispṛśam mograṃ cettāram adhirājam akran ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Vasus</s>, <s>Rudras</s>, and <s>Ādityas</s> have made the fierce watcher, the over-king, one who touches from above.

children.text: Chapter 966
nāsad āsīn no sad āsīt tadānīṃ nāsīd rajo no vyomā paro yat
children.translated_text: Then there was neither non-being nor being; there was no realm of air, nor the heaven beyond it.

children.text: kim āvarīvaḥ kuha kasya śarmann ambhaḥ kim āsīd gahanaṃ gabhīram ||
children.translated_text: What covered it? Where was it? In whose shelter? Was there water, deep and unfathomable?

children.text: na mṛtyur āsīd amṛtaṃ na tarhi na rātryā ahna āsīt praketaḥ
children.translated_text: There was no death then, nor immortality; there was no sign of night or of day.

children.text: ānīd avātaṃ svadhayā tad ekaṃ tasmāddhānyan na paraḥ kiṃ canāsa ||
children.translated_text: That One breathed, windless, by its own power; apart from it there was nothing else beyond.

children.text: tama āsīt tamasā gūḍham agre 'praketaṃ salilaṃ sarvam ā idam
children.translated_text: Darkness was hidden by darkness in the beginning; all this was an undifferentiated flood.

children.text: tucchyenābhv apihitaṃ yad āsīt tapasas tan mahinājāyataikam ||
children.translated_text: That One, which was covered by emptiness, was born through the greatness of heat.

children.text: kāmas tad agre sam avartatādhi manaso retaḥ prathamaṃ yad āsīt
children.translated_text: Desire came upon it in the beginning, the first seed of mind.

children.text: sato bandhum asati nir avindan hṛdi pratīṣyā kavayo manīṣā ||
children.translated_text: Searching in their heart with insight, the sages found the bond of being in non-being.

children.text: tiraścīno vitato raśmir eṣām adhaḥ svid āsīd upari svid āsīt
children.translated_text: Their cord was stretched crosswise: was there something below, was there something above?

children.text: retodhā āsan mahimāna āsan svadhā avastāt prayatiḥ parastāt ||
children.translated_text: There were seed-bearers; there were powers. Self-power was below, impulse was above.

children.text: ko addhā veda ka iha pra vocat kuta ājātā kuta iyaṃ visṛṣṭiḥ
children.translated_text: Who really knows? Who here can declare from where it was born, from where this creation came?

children.text: arvāg devā asya visarjanenāthā ko veda yata ābabhūva ||
children.translated_text: The gods are later than the sending forth of this world; so who knows from where it arose?

children.text: iyaṃ visṛṣṭir yata ābabhūva yadi vā dadhe yadi vā na
children.translated_text: From where this creation arose, whether he established it or whether he did not,

children.text: yo asyādhyakṣaḥ parame vyoman so aṅga veda yadi vā na veda ||
children.translated_text: he who is its overseer in the highest heaven, he surely knows, or perhaps he does not know.

children.text: Chapter 967
yo yajño viśvatas tantubhis tata ekaśataṃ devakarmebhir āyataḥ
children.translated_text: The sacrifice, stretched out on every side with threads, was extended by a hundred divine rites.

children.text: ime vayanti pitaro ya āyayuḥ pra vayāpa vayety āsate tate ||
children.translated_text: These fathers who came sit at the stretched fabric, weaving: 'weave forward, weave back.'

children.text: pumāṁ enaṃ tanuta ut kṛṇatti pumān vi tatne adhi nāke asmin
children.translated_text: A man stretches it out and cuts it off; a man has spread it upon this heaven.

children.text: ime mayūkhā upa sedur ū sadaḥ sāmāni cakrus tasarāṇy otave ||
children.translated_text: These rays have taken their seat at the place; they made the <s>Sāmans</s> into shuttles for weaving.

children.text: kāsīt pramā pratimā kiṃ nidānam ājyaṃ kim āsīt paridhiḥ ka āsīt
children.translated_text: What was the measure? What was the counterpart? What was the foundation? What was the ghee? What was the enclosing stick?

children.text: chandaḥ kim āsīt praugaṃ kim ukthaṃ yad devā devam ayajanta viśve ||
children.translated_text: What was the meter, what the prauga, what the uktha, when all the gods sacrificed to the god?

children.text: agner gāyatry abhavat sayugvoṣṇihayā savitā sam babhūva
children.translated_text: <s>Gāyatrī</s> became the yoke-fellow of <s>Agni</s>; <s>Savitṛ</s> was joined with <s>Uṣṇih</s>.

children.text: anuṣṭubhā soma ukthair mahasvān bṛhaspater bṛhatī vācam āvat ||
children.translated_text: With <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>, <s>Soma</s> became mighty through the ukthas; by <s>Bṛhatī</s>, <s>Bṛhaspati</s> protected speech.

children.text: virāṇ mitrāvaruṇayor abhiśrīr indrasya triṣṭub iha bhāgo ahnaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Virāj</s> was the splendor of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; <s>Triṣṭubh</s> was <s>Indra</s>'s share of the day here.

children.text: viśvān devāñ jagaty ā viveśa tena cākﾱpra ṛṣayo manuṣyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Jagatī</s> entered all the gods; by it the seers and human beings fashioned the rite.

children.text: cākﾱpre tena ṛṣayo manuṣyā yajñe jāte pitaro naḥ purāṇe
children.translated_text: By it the seers and human beings fashioned the rite, when the sacrifice was born, our ancient fathers.

children.text: paśyan manye manasā cakṣasā tān ya imaṃ yajñam ayajanta pūrve ||
children.translated_text: I think I see with the mind as with an eye those who first performed this sacrifice.

children.text: sahastomāḥ sahachandasa āvṛtaḥ sahapramā ṛṣayaḥ sapta daivyāḥ
children.translated_text: Together with stomas, together with meters, enclosed, together with measures, the seven divine seers

children.text: pūrveṣām panthām anudṛśya dhīrā anvālebhire rathyo na raśmīn ||
children.translated_text: having looked along the path of the earlier ones, the wise took hold of it like charioteers taking the reins.

children.text: Chapter 968
apa prāca indra viśvāṁ amitrān apāpāco abhibhūte nudasva
children.translated_text: Drive away, O <s>Indra</s>, all hostile men in front; overpowering them, thrust away those who are turned behind.

children.text: apodīco apa śūrādharāca urau yathā tava śarman madema ||
children.translated_text: Drive away those from the north, O hero, and those below, so that we may rejoice in your broad shelter.

children.text: kuvid aṅga yavamanto yavaṃ cid yathā dānty anupūrvaṃ viyūya
children.translated_text: Will the barley-owners perhaps give even barley, after winnowing it and distributing it in order?

children.text: ihehaiṣāṃ kṛṇuhi bhojanāni ye barhiṣo namovṛktiṃ na jagmuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Here, here make their foods ready, for those who have not come to the reverent turning toward the sacred grass.

children.text: nahi sthūry ṛtuthā yātam asti nota śravo vivide saṃgameṣu
children.translated_text: For no firm support comes at the proper seasons, nor has fame been won in the gatherings.

children.text: gavyanta indraṃ sakhyāya viprā aśvāyanto vṛṣaṇaṃ vājayantaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Desiring cows, the inspired poets seek <s>Indra</s> for friendship; desiring horses, they urge on the bull for the prize.

children.text: yuvaṃ surāmam aśvinā namucāv āsure sacā
children.translated_text: O <s>Aśvins</s>, you two drank the surā-drink together with <s>Namuci</s> the Asura.

children.text: vipipānā śubhas patī indraṃ karmasv āvatam ||
children.translated_text: Having drunk deeply, O lords of beauty, you aided <s>Indra</s> in his deeds.

children.text: putram iva pitarāv aśvinobhendrāvathuḥ kāvyair daṃsanābhiḥ
children.translated_text: Like two parents helping a son, O both <s>Aśvins</s>, you helped <s>Indra</s> with poetic powers and marvels.

children.text: yat surāmaṃ vy apibaḥ śacībhiḥ sarasvatī tvā maghavann abhiṣṇak ||
children.translated_text: When you drank the surā-drink by your powers, <s>Sarasvatī</s> tended you, O bountiful one.

children.text: indraḥ sutrāmā svavāṁ avobhiḥ sumṛḍīko bhavatu viśvavedāḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> <s>Sutrāman</s>, self-powerful, with his aids, kindly and all-knowing, be gracious.

children.text: bādhatāṃ dveṣo abhayaṃ kṛṇotu suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||
children.translated_text: May he drive away hatred and make fearlessness; may we be lords of excellent heroic strength.

children.text: tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma
children.translated_text: May we be in the good favor of that worshipful one, in auspicious good-mindedness.

children.text: sa sutrāmā svavāṁ indro asme ārāc cid dveṣaḥ sanutar yuyotu ||
children.translated_text: May that <s>Sutrāman</s>, self-powerful <s>Indra</s>, drive hostility far away from us, completely.

children.text: Chapter 969
ījānam id dyaur gūrtāvasur ījānam bhūmir abhi prabhūṣaṇi
children.translated_text: Heaven, rich in praised goods, favors the sacrificer; earth adorns herself for the sacrificer.

children.text: ījānaṃ devāv aśvināv abhi sumnair avardhatām ||
children.translated_text: The two divine <s>Aśvins</s> have increased the sacrificer with their favors.

children.text: tā vām mitrāvaruṇā dhārayatkṣitī suṣumneṣitatvatā yajāmasi
children.translated_text: We sacrifice to you two, <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, upholders of peoples, impelled by good favor.

children.text: yuvoḥ krāṇāya sakhyair abhi ṣyāma rakṣasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Through your friendships may we overcome the attacks of the <s>Rakṣases</s>.

children.text: adhā cin nu yad didhiṣāmahe vām abhi priyaṃ rekṇaḥ patyamānāḥ
children.translated_text: And now, when we desire your beloved wealth, striving after the dear possession,

children.text: dadvāṁ vā yat puṣyati rekṇaḥ sam v āran nakir asya maghāni ||
children.translated_text: whether one gives it or the wealth prospers, let his gifts not be shut off.

children.text: asāv anyo asura sūyata dyaus tvaṃ viśveṣāṃ varuṇāsi rājā
children.translated_text: Another heaven is produced there, O Asura; you, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, are king of all.

children.text: mūrdhā rathasya cākan naitāvatainasāntakadhruk ||
children.translated_text: The head of the chariot has taken pleasure; not so far does guilt reach the injurer.

children.text: asmin sv etacchakapūta eno hite mitre nigatān hanti vīrān
children.translated_text: In this, indeed, this purified offense, set within <s>Mitra</s>, strikes down the bound heroes.

children.text: avor vā yad dhāt tanūṣv avaḥ priyāsu yajñiyāsv arvā ||
children.translated_text: Whether help was placed in bodies, or help among beloved, worshipful things, bring it near.

children.text: yuvor hi mātāditir vicetasā dyaur na bhūmiḥ payasā pupūtani
children.translated_text: For your mother <s>Aditi</s>, discerning, has purified you two with milk, like heaven and earth.

children.text: ava priyā didiṣṭana sūro ninikta raśmibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Grant the beloved things; the sun has washed them clean with his rays.

children.text: yuvaṃ hy apnarājāv asīdataṃ tiṣṭhad rathaṃ na dhūrṣadaṃ vanarṣadam
children.translated_text: For you two, rulers of the waters, have sat down upon the standing chariot, like ones seated on the pole, seated in the wood.

children.text: tā naḥ kaṇūkayantīr nṛmedhas tatre aṃhasaḥ sumedhas tatre aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let those, stirring for us, O <s>Nṛmedhas</s>, be there against distress; O <s>Sumedhas</s>, be there against distress.

children.text: Chapter 970
pro ṣv asmai puroratham indrāya śūṣam arcata
children.translated_text: Sing forth strength for this <s>Indra</s>, whose chariot goes before him.

children.text: abhīke cid u lokakṛt saṃge samatsu vṛtrahāsmākam bodhi coditā nabhantām anyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||
children.translated_text: Even in combat, in the clash of battles, he makes open space and slays <s>Vṛtra</s>; be our impeller. May the bowstrings of the others snap upon their bows.

children.text: tvaṃ sindhūṁ avāsṛjo 'dharāco ahann ahim
children.translated_text: You released the rivers downward; you struck down the serpent.

children.text: aśatrur indra jajñiṣe viśvam puṣyasi vāryaṃ taṃ tvā pari ṣvajāmahe nabhantām anyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||
children.translated_text: You were born without an enemy, O <s>Indra</s>; you prosper every desirable thing. We embrace you. May the bowstrings of the others snap upon their bows.

children.text: vi ṣu viśvā arātayo 'ryo naśanta no dhiyaḥ
children.translated_text: Let all hostile powers of the enemy disappear far away from our thoughts.

children.text: astāsi śatrave vadhaṃ yo na indra jighāṃsati yā te rātir dadir vasu nabhantām anyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||
children.translated_text: You have cast the weapon against the foe who wishes to kill us, O <s>Indra</s>; whatever gift and wealth you have given, may the bowstrings of the others snap upon their bows.

children.text: yo na indrābhito jano vṛkāyur ādideśati
children.translated_text: The person who points us out on every side to the wolf-like enemy, O <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: adhaspadaṃ tam īṃ kṛdhi vibādho asi sāsahir nabhantām anyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||
children.translated_text: put him down beneath our feet; you are a repeller, a conqueror. May the bowstrings of the others snap upon their bows.

children.text: yo na indrābhidāsati sanābhir yaś ca niṣṭyaḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever attacks us, O <s>Indra</s>, whether a kinsman or one from outside,

children.text: ava tasya balaṃ tira mahīva dyaur adha tmanā nabhantām anyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||
children.translated_text: drive his strength away and beyond, like great heaven by its own power. May the bowstrings of the others snap upon their bows.

children.text: vayam indra tvāyavaḥ sakhitvam ā rabhāmahe
children.translated_text: We, desiring you, O <s>Indra</s>, take hold of friendship with you.

children.text: ṛtasya naḥ pathā nayāti viśvāni duritā nabhantām anyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||
children.translated_text: Lead us by the path of truth through all difficulties. May the bowstrings of the others snap upon their bows.

children.text: asmabhyaṃ su tvam indra tāṃ śikṣa yā dohate prati varaṃ jaritre
children.translated_text: For us, O <s>Indra</s>, bestow that excellent one which yields each desired gift to the singer.

children.text: acchidrodhnī pīpayad yathā naḥ sahasradhārā payasā mahī gauḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the great cow, her udder unbroken, with a thousand streams, swell us with milk.

children.text: Chapter 971
ubhe yad indra rodasī āpaprāthoṣā iva
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Indra</s>, you filled both heaven and earth, like the dawns,

children.text: mahāntaṃ tvā mahīnāṃ samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnāṃ devī janitry ajījanad bhadrā janitry ajījanat ||
children.translated_text: the divine mother bore you, great among the great, sovereign of peoples; the auspicious mother bore you.

children.text: ava sma durhaṇāyato martasya tanuhi sthiram
children.translated_text: Stretch down firmly the mortal man who is hard to strike and hostile.

children.text: adhaspadaṃ tam īṃ kṛdhi yo asmāṁ ādideśati devī janitry ajījanad bhadrā janitry ajījanat ||
children.translated_text: Put him beneath our feet, the one who points us out; the divine mother bore you, the auspicious mother bore you.

children.text: ava tyā bṛhatīr iṣo viśvaścandrā amitrahan
children.translated_text: Shake down those broad, all-bright refreshments, O smiter of foes.

children.text: śacībhiḥ śakra dhūnuhīndra viśvābhir ūtibhir devī janitry ajījanad bhadrā janitry ajījanat ||
children.translated_text: By your powers, O <s>Śakra</s>, shake them down, O <s>Indra</s>, with all your aids; the divine mother bore you, the auspicious mother bore you.

children.text: ava yat tvaṃ śatakratav indra viśvāni dhūnuṣe
children.translated_text: When you, O hundred-powered <s>Indra</s>, shake down all things,

children.text: rayiṃ na sunvate sacā sahasriṇībhir ūtibhir devī janitry ajījanad bhadrā janitry ajījanat ||
children.translated_text: bring wealth for the soma-presser, with thousandfold aids; the divine mother bore you, the auspicious mother bore you.

children.text: ava svedā ivābhito viṣvak patantu didyavaḥ
children.translated_text: Let the missiles fall away all around from us, like drops of sweat in every direction.

children.text: dūrvāyā iva tantavo vy asmad etu durmatir devī janitry ajījanad bhadrā janitry ajījanat ||
children.translated_text: Let evil-mindedness go away from us like the threads of dūrvā grass; the divine mother bore you, the auspicious mother bore you.

children.text: dīrghaṃ hy aṅkuśaṃ yathā śaktim bibharṣi mantumaḥ
children.translated_text: For, thoughtful one, you bear your power like a long goad.

children.text: pūrveṇa maghavan padājo vayāṃ yathā yamo devī janitry ajījanad bhadrā janitry ajījanat ||
children.translated_text: With your foremost step, O <s>Maghavan</s>, drive us onward, as <s>Yama</s> drives the birds; the divine mother bore you, the auspicious mother bore you.

children.text: nakir devā minīmasi nakir ā yopayāmasi mantraśrutyaṃ carāmasi
children.translated_text: We do not diminish the gods; we do not hold them away. We act in obedience to the heard mantra.

children.text: pakṣebhir apikakṣebhir atrābhi saṃ rabhāmahe ||
children.translated_text: With wings and with side-wings, here we take hold together.

children.text: Chapter 972
yasmin vṛkṣe supalāśe devaiḥ saṃpibate yamaḥ
children.translated_text: In the well-leafed tree where <s>Yama</s> drinks together with the gods,

children.text: atrā no viśpatiḥ pitā purāṇāṁ anu venati ||
children.translated_text: there may our father, lord of the clan, seek after the ancient ones.

children.text: purāṇāṁ anuvenantaṃ carantam pāpayāmuyā
children.translated_text: As he was seeking after the ancient ones, moving along an evil path,

children.text: asūyann abhy acākaśaṃ tasmā aspṛhayam punaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I looked upon him with resentment; for that reason I longed for him again.

children.text: yaṃ kumāra navaṃ ratham acakram manasākṛṇoḥ
children.translated_text: O young one, the new chariot which you made with the mind, without wheels,

children.text: ekeṣaṃ viśvataḥ prāñcam apaśyann adhi tiṣṭhasi ||
children.translated_text: single-poled, facing forward on every side, you mount while looking upon it.

children.text: yaṃ kumāra prāvartayo rathaṃ viprebhyas pari
children.translated_text: O young one, the chariot which you set in motion around the inspired poets,

children.text: taṃ sāmānu prāvartata sam ito nāvy āhitam ||
children.translated_text: after it the sāman turned onward, placed here together as if in a boat.

children.text: kaḥ kumāram ajanayad rathaṃ ko nir avartayat
children.translated_text: Who gave birth to the young one? Who rolled out the chariot?

children.text: kaḥ svit tad adya no brūyād anudeyī yathābhavat ||
children.translated_text: Who indeed could tell us today how the gift to be given came into being?

children.text: yathābhavad anudeyī tato agram ajāyata
children.translated_text: As the gift to be given came into being, from that the foremost part was born.

children.text: purastād budhna ātataḥ paścān nirayaṇaṃ kṛtam ||
children.translated_text: In front the bottom was stretched out; behind, the way out was made.

children.text: idaṃ yamasya sādanaṃ devamānaṃ yad ucyate
children.translated_text: This is called <s>Yama</s>'s seat, fashioned by the gods.

children.text: iyam asya dhamyate nāḍīr ayaṃ gīrbhiḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: This pipe of his is blown; this one is adorned with songs.

children.text: Chapter 973
keśy agniṃ keśī viṣaṃ keśī bibharti rodasī
children.translated_text: The long-haired one bears fire; the long-haired one bears poison; the long-haired one bears heaven and earth.

children.text: keśī viśvaṃ svar dṛśe keśīdaṃ jyotir ucyate ||
children.translated_text: The long-haired one shows all the sunlit world; the long-haired one is called this light.

children.text: munayo vātaraśanāḥ piśaṅgā vasate malā
children.translated_text: The <s>Munis</s>, girdled with wind, wear soiled tawny garments.

children.text: vātasyānu dhrājiṃ yanti yad devāso avikṣata ||
children.translated_text: They follow the rush of the wind, when the gods have entered them.

children.text: unmaditā mauneyena vātāṁ ā tasthimā vayam
children.translated_text: Made ecstatic by <s>muni</s>-hood, we have mounted the winds.

children.text: śarīred asmākaṃ yūyam martāso abhi paśyatha ||
children.translated_text: You mortals see only our bodies here.

children.text: antarikṣeṇa patati viśvā rūpāvacākaśat
children.translated_text: He flies through the midspace, looking upon all forms.

children.text: munir devasya devasya saukṛtyāya sakhā hitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The <s>Muni</s> is the friend set in place for the good work of each god.

children.text: vātasyāśvo vāyoḥ sakhātho deveṣito muniḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Muni</s> is the horse of the wind, the companion of <s>Vāyu</s>, and then, impelled by the gods,

children.text: ubhau samudrāv ā kṣeti yaś ca pūrva utāparaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he dwells in both oceans, the eastern and the western.

children.text: apsarasāṃ gandharvāṇām mṛgāṇāṃ caraṇe caran
children.translated_text: Moving in the track of the <s>Apsarases</s>, the <s>Gandharvas</s>, and the wild beasts,

children.text: keśī ketasya vidvān sakhā svādur madintamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the long-haired one, knowing insight, is a sweet and most intoxicating friend.

children.text: vāyur asmā upāmanthat pinaṣṭi smā kunannamā
children.translated_text: <s>Vāyu</s> churned it for him; <s>Kunannamā</s> ground it for him.

children.text: keśī viṣasya pātreṇa yad rudreṇāpibat saha ||
children.translated_text: When the long-haired one drank with <s>Rudra</s> from the cup of poison.

children.text: Chapter 974
uta devā avahitaṃ devā un nayathā punaḥ
children.translated_text: And what has been laid low, O gods, you gods raise up again.

children.text: utāgaś cakruṣaṃ devā devā jīvayathā punaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And the one who has committed sin, O gods, you gods bring back to life again.

children.text: dvāv imau vātau vāta ā sindhor ā parāvataḥ
children.translated_text: These two winds are blowing: one from the ocean, the other from afar.

children.text: dakṣaṃ te anya ā vātu parānyo vātu yad rapaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Let one wind blow vital strength to you; let the other blow away whatever disease there is.

children.text: ā vāta vāhi bheṣajaṃ vi vāta vāhi yad rapaḥ
children.translated_text: Bring here the medicine, O wind; blow away whatever disease there is, O wind.

children.text: tvaṃ hi viśvabheṣajo devānāṃ dūta īyase ||
children.translated_text: For you are the healer of all, and you go as the messenger of the gods.

children.text: ā tvāgamaṃ śantātibhir atho ariṣṭatātibhiḥ
children.translated_text: I have come to you with powers of peace, and also with powers that keep harm away.

children.text: dakṣaṃ te bhadram ābhārṣam parā yakṣmaṃ suvāmi te ||
children.translated_text: I have brought auspicious vigor to you; I drive disease away from you.

children.text: trāyantām iha devās trāyatām marutāṃ gaṇaḥ
children.translated_text: May the gods protect him here; may the host of the <s>Maruts</s> protect him.

children.text: trāyantāṃ viśvā bhūtāni yathāyam arapā asat ||
children.translated_text: May all beings protect him, so that this man may be free from injury.

children.text: āpa id vā u bheṣajīr āpo amīvacātanīḥ
children.translated_text: The waters indeed are healing; the waters drive away disease.

children.text: āpaḥ sarvasya bheṣajīs tās te kṛṇvantu bheṣajam ||
children.translated_text: The waters are healers of everything; may they make a remedy for you.

children.text: hastābhyāṃ daśaśākhābhyāṃ jihvā vācaḥ purogavī
children.translated_text: With the two hands, the ten-branched ones, and with the tongue, the leader of speech,

children.text: anāmayitnubhyāṃ tvā tābhyāṃ tvopa spṛśāmasi ||
children.translated_text: with those two that bring no sickness, with those two we touch you.

children.text: Chapter 975
tava tya indra sakhyeṣu vahnaya ṛtam manvānā vy adardirur valam
children.translated_text: In your friendships, O <s>Indra</s>, the carriers, thinking on truth, split open <s>Vala</s>.

children.text: yatrā daśasyann uṣaso riṇann apaḥ kutsāya manmann ahyaś ca daṃsayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There, rendering service, you released the Dawns and the waters for <s>Kutsa</s>; by your thought you displayed the serpent's powers.

children.text: avāsṛjaḥ prasvaḥ śvañcayo girīn ud āja usrā apibo madhu priyam
children.translated_text: You released the streams; you drove the lowing cows up from the mountains; you drank the dear sweetness.

children.text: avardhayo vanino asya daṃsasā śuśoca sūrya ṛtajātayā girā ||
children.translated_text: By this wondrous power you strengthened the forest-trees; the sun shone out through the song born of truth.

children.text: vi sūryo madhye amucad rathaṃ divo vidad dāsāya pratimānam āryaḥ
children.translated_text: The sun loosened his chariot in the middle of heaven; the <s>Ārya</s> found a countermeasure against the <s>Dāsa</s>.

children.text: dṛḍhāni pipror asurasya māyina indro vy āsyac cakṛvāṁ ṛjiśvanā ||
children.translated_text: With <s>Ṛjiśvan</s>, <s>Indra</s> split apart the firm things of <s>Pipru</s>, the artful <s>Asura</s>.

children.text: anādhṛṣṭāni dhṛṣito vy āsyan nidhīṃr adevāṁ amṛṇad ayāsyaḥ
children.translated_text: Boldly he split open treasures that could not be assailed; <s>Ayāsya</s> struck down the godless ones.

children.text: māseva sūryo vasu puryam ā dade gṛṇānaḥ śatrūṃr aśṛṇād virukmatā ||
children.translated_text: Like the sun by the month, he took the stronghold's treasure; being praised, with shining power he shattered the enemies.

children.text: ayuddhaseno vibhvā vibhindatā dāśad vṛtrahā tujyāni tejate
children.translated_text: With an army needing no battle, the mighty slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>, cleaving apart, flashes against things to be broken.

children.text: indrasya vajrād abibhed abhiśnathaḥ prākrāmacchundhyūr ajahād uṣā anaḥ ||
children.translated_text: At <s>Indra</s>'s thunderbolt the snorting foe was afraid; <s>Śundhyu</s> strode forward, and <s>Uṣas</s> abandoned her wagon.

children.text: etā tyā te śrutyāni kevalā yad eka ekam akṛṇor ayajñam
children.translated_text: These are those famous deeds of yours alone: one by one you made the non-sacrificer powerless.

children.text: māsāṃ vidhānam adadhā adhi dyavi tvayā vibhinnam bharati pradhim pitā ||
children.translated_text: You set the ordering of the months in heaven; through you the father bears the rim that was split apart.

children.text: Chapter 976
sūryaraśmir harikeśaḥ purastāt savitā jyotir ud ayāṁ ajasram
children.translated_text: The sunbeam, golden-haired, is in front; <s>Savitṛ</s> raises up unfailing light.

children.text: tasya pūṣā prasave yāti vidvān saṃpaśyan viśvā bhuvanāni gopāḥ ||
children.translated_text: At his impulse <s>Pūṣan</s>, knowing, goes as guardian, looking upon all beings.

children.text: nṛcakṣā eṣa divo madhya āsta āpaprivān rodasī antarikṣam
children.translated_text: This one, seeing men, stands in the middle of heaven, having filled heaven, earth, and the midspace.

children.text: sa viśvācīr abhi caṣṭe ghṛtācīr antarā pūrvam aparaṃ ca ketum ||
children.translated_text: He looks upon all the ghee-rich ones, facing every way, and upon the earlier and later sign between.

children.text: rāyo budhnaḥ saṃgamano vasūnāṃ viśvā rūpābhi caṣṭe śacībhiḥ
children.translated_text: He is the foundation of wealth, the gathering-place of goods; with his powers he looks upon all forms.

children.text: deva iva savitā satyadharmendro na tasthau samare dhanānām ||
children.translated_text: Like the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, true in law, like <s>Indra</s>, he has stood in the contest for riches.

children.text: viśvāvasuṃ soma gandharvam āpo dadṛśuṣīs tad ṛtenā vy āyan
children.translated_text: The waters, having seen <s>Viśvāvasu</s>, the <s>Soma</s>-Gandharva, went apart by that truth.

children.text: tad anvavaid indro rārahāṇa āsām pari sūryasya paridhīṃr apaśyat ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, rejoicing, followed that track of theirs; he looked around the enclosures of the sun.

children.text: viśvāvasur abhi tan no gṛṇātu divyo gandharvo rajaso vimānaḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Viśvāvasu</s> sing that for us, the heavenly Gandharva, who measures the airy realm.

children.text: yad vā ghā satyam uta yan na vidma dhiyo hinvāno dhiya in no avyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whether it is true, or whether it is what we do not know, may he, impelling thoughts, protect these thoughts of ours.

children.text: sasnim avindac caraṇe nadīnām apāvṛṇod duro aśmavrajānām
children.translated_text: He found the prize in the course of the rivers; he opened the doors of the stone enclosures.

children.text: prāsāṃ gandharvo amṛtāni vocad indro dakṣam pari jānād ahīnām ||
children.translated_text: The Gandharva proclaimed their immortal things; <s>Indra</s> fully came to know the skill of the serpents.

children.text: Chapter 977
agne tava śravo vayo mahi bhrājante arcayo vibhāvaso
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, your great fame and strength shine forth; your flames blaze, O radiant one.

children.text: bṛhadbhāno śavasā vājam ukthyaṃ dadhāsi dāśuṣe kave ||
children.translated_text: O broad-beamed poet, by your might you place the laudable prize for the worshipper.

children.text: pāvakavarcāḥ śukravarcā anūnavarcā ud iyarṣi bhānunā
children.translated_text: With pure radiance, bright radiance, undiminished radiance, you rise up with your light.

children.text: putro mātarā vicarann upāvasi pṛṇakṣi rodasī ubhe ||
children.translated_text: As a son moving among his two mothers, you sit near and fill both heaven and earth.

children.text: ūrjo napāj jātavedaḥ suśastibhir mandasva dhītibhir hitaḥ
children.translated_text: O child of strength, <s>Jātavedas</s>, set in place with fair praises, rejoice in our thoughts.

children.text: tve iṣaḥ saṃ dadhur bhūrivarpasaś citrotayo vāmajātāḥ ||
children.translated_text: In you the nourishments have set themselves together, many-formed, bright in aid, and born in beauty.

children.text: irajyann agne prathayasva jantubhir asme rāyo amartya
children.translated_text: Ruling, O <s>Agni</s>, spread yourself among creatures; grant wealth to us, O immortal one.

children.text: sa darśatasya vapuṣo vi rājasi pṛṇakṣi sānasiṃ kratum ||
children.translated_text: You shine forth with a visible form; you fill the enduring power of insight.

children.text: iṣkartāram adhvarasya pracetasaṃ kṣayantaṃ rādhaso mahaḥ
children.translated_text: You are the maker of the rite, the discerning one, dwelling in the great bounty of favor.

children.text: rātiṃ vāmasya subhagām mahīm iṣaṃ dadhāsi sānasiṃ rayim ||
children.translated_text: You establish a fortunate gift of lovely goods, great nourishment, and enduring wealth.

children.text: ṛtāvānam mahiṣaṃ viśvadarśatam agniṃ sumnāya dadhire puro janāḥ
children.translated_text: People have placed before them <s>Agni</s>, true to order, a mighty bull visible to all, for favor.

children.text: śrutkarṇaṃ saprathastamaṃ tvā girā daivyam mānuṣā yugā ||
children.translated_text: Through song, through human generations, they have placed you, the divine one, wide-renowned and hearing our call.

children.text: Chapter 978
agne acchā vadeha naḥ pratyaṅ naḥ sumanā bhava
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, speak here toward us; facing us, be kindly disposed.

children.text: pra no yaccha viśas pate dhanadā asi nas tvam ||
children.translated_text: Bestow good things for us; O lord of the clans, you are our giver of wealth.

children.text: pra no yacchatv aryamā pra bhagaḥ pra bṛhaspatiḥ
children.translated_text: May <s>Aryaman</s> bestow for us; may <s>Bhaga</s> bestow; may <s>Bṛhaspati</s> bestow.

children.text: pra devāḥ prota sūnṛtā rāyo devī dadātu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May the gods bestow, and may divine <s>Sūnṛtā</s> give us wealth.

children.text: somaṃ rājānam avase 'gniṃ gīrbhir havāmahe
children.translated_text: For help we call King <s>Soma</s> and <s>Agni</s> with songs,

children.text: ādityān viṣṇuṃ sūryam brahmāṇaṃ ca bṛhaspatim ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Ādityas</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>Sūrya</s>, the brahman-priest, and <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: indravāyū bṛhaspatiṃ suhaveha havāmahe
children.translated_text: We call here <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>, and <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, easy to invoke,

children.text: yathā naḥ sarva ij janaḥ saṃgatyāṃ sumanā asat ||
children.translated_text: so that every one of our people, in assembly, may be kindly disposed.

children.text: aryamaṇam bṛhaspatim indraṃ dānāya codaya
children.translated_text: Urge <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, and <s>Indra</s> toward giving,

children.text: vātaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarasvatīṃ savitāraṃ ca vājinam ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Vāta</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>Sarasvatī</s>, and the prize-winning <s>Savitṛ</s>.

children.text: tvaṃ no agne agnibhir brahma yajñaṃ ca vardhaya
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Agni</s>, with the fires, increase our <s>brahma</s> (sacred formulation) and our <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice).

children.text: tvaṃ no devatātaye rāyo dānāya codaya ||
children.translated_text: You urge us toward divine worship, toward wealth, and toward giving.

children.text: Chapter 979
ayam agne jaritā tve abhūd api sahasaḥ sūno nahy anyad asty āpyam
children.translated_text: This singer, O <s>Agni</s>, has come into relation with you, O son of strength; for there is no other kinship.

children.text: bhadraṃ hi śarma trivarūtham asti ta āre hiṃsānām apa didyum ā kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: For your shelter is auspicious and threefold-protecting; keep the flaming missile of injuries far away.

children.text: pravat te agne janimā pitūyataḥ sācīva viśvā bhuvanā ny ṛñjase
children.translated_text: Forth go your births, O <s>Agni</s>, longing for the father; like an ally you adorn all the worlds.

children.text: pra saptayaḥ pra saniṣanta no dhiyaḥ puraś caranti paśupā iva tmanā ||
children.translated_text: May our steeds and our thoughts go forward and win; by themselves they go before like herdsmen.

children.text: uta vā u pari vṛṇakṣi bapsad bahor agna ulapasya svadhāvaḥ
children.translated_text: And you, O self-powered <s>Agni</s>, surround what is to be consumed from the abundant thicket of ulapa grass.

children.text: uta khilyā urvarāṇām bhavanti mā te hetiṃ taviṣīṃ cukrudhāma ||
children.translated_text: And the barren lands become fields; let us not provoke your mighty missile.

children.text: yad udvato nivato yāsi bapsat pṛthag eṣi pragardhinīva senā
children.translated_text: When you go over the heights and the lowlands, devouring, you move apart like a ravening army.

children.text: yadā te vāto anuvāti śocir vapteva śmaśru vapasi pra bhūma ||
children.translated_text: When the wind blows after your flame, like a barber you shave the earth as if it were a beard.

children.text: praty asya śreṇayo dadṛśra ekaṃ niyānam bahavo rathāsaḥ
children.translated_text: His ranks are seen in front: many chariots following a single course.

children.text: bāhū yad agne anumarmṛjāno nyaṅṅ uttānām anveṣi bhūmim ||
children.translated_text: When, O <s>Agni</s>, rubbing your arms, you pursue the earth, whether bent downward or lying open.

children.text: ut te śuṣmā jihatām ut te arcir ut te agne śaśamānasya vājāḥ
children.translated_text: Let your powers move forth, let your flame move forth, let your prizes move forth, O <s>Agni</s>, as you are praised.

children.text: ucchvañcasva ni nama vardhamāna ā tvādya viśve vasavaḥ sadantu ||
children.translated_text: Rise high; bow down as you grow. Let all the <s>Vasus</s> sit around you today.

children.text: apām idaṃ nyayanaṃ samudrasya niveśanam
children.translated_text: This is the going-down of the waters, the resting-place of the ocean.

children.text: anyaṃ kṛṇuṣvetaḥ panthāṃ tena yāhi vaśāṁ anu ||
children.translated_text: Make for yourself another path from here; go by that, following the cow.

children.text: āyane te parāyaṇe dūrvā rohantu puṣpiṇīḥ
children.translated_text: At your coming and at your going away, may flowering dūrvā grasses grow.

children.text: hradāś ca puṇḍarīkāṇi samudrasya gṛhā ime ||
children.translated_text: And the pools and lotuses are these houses of the ocean.

children.text: Chapter 980
tyaṃ cid atrim ṛtajuram artham aśvaṃ na yātave
children.translated_text: Even that <s>Atri</s>, straight in accord with <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order), like a horse for a journey,

children.text: kakṣīvantaṃ yadī punā rathaṃ na kṛṇutho navam ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Kakṣīvant</s>, when you make him new again like a chariot.

children.text: tyaṃ cid aśvaṃ na vājinam areṇavo yam atnata
children.translated_text: Even that horse, like a prize-winning steed, whom the dustless ones stretched out,

children.text: dṛḍhaṃ granthiṃ na vi ṣyatam atriṃ yaviṣṭham ā rajaḥ ||
children.translated_text: untie like a firm knot: <s>Atri</s>, the youngest, up to the expanse.

children.text: narā daṃsiṣṭhāv atraye śubhrā siṣāsataṃ dhiyaḥ
children.translated_text: O men most wondrous in deeds, you two bright ones have sought inspired thoughts for <s>Atri</s>.

children.text: athā hi vāṃ divo narā puna stomo na viśase ||
children.translated_text: Then indeed, O men, your hymn comes again from heaven, as for a clan.

children.text: cite tad vāṃ surādhasā rātiḥ sumatir aśvinā
children.translated_text: Known is that gift of yours, O richly bountiful <s>Aśvins</s>, that favorable grace.

children.text: ā yan naḥ sadane pṛthau samane parṣatho narā ||
children.translated_text: When you two, O men, carry us across to the broad common dwelling.

children.text: yuvam bhujyuṃ samudra ā rajasaḥ pāra īṅkhitam
children.translated_text: You two came to <s>Bhujyu</s>, tossed in the ocean, beyond the realm,

children.text: yātam acchā patatribhir nāsatyā sātaye kṛtam ||
children.translated_text: with winged ones, O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, having made rescue for attainment.

children.text: ā vāṃ sumnaiḥ śaṃyū iva maṃhiṣṭhā viśvavedasā
children.translated_text: With your favors, like <s>Śaṃyū</s>, may you two most bountiful, all-knowing men come to us.

children.text: sam asme bhūṣataṃ narotsaṃ na pipyuṣīr iṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Together, O men, adorn for us streams of nourishment, like overflowing springs.

children.text: Chapter 981
ayaṃ hi te amartya indur atyo na patyate
children.translated_text: For this immortal drop of yours rushes like a horse,

children.text: dakṣo viśvāyur vedhase ||
children.translated_text: skillful, of all life, for the ordainer.

children.text: ayam asmāsu kāvya ṛbhur vajro dāsvate
children.translated_text: This inspired skill among us is a thunderbolt for the giver,

children.text: ayam bibharty ūrdhvakṛśanam madam ṛbhur na kṛtvyam madam ||
children.translated_text: this bears the upright-pointed exhilaration, like a craftsman, the exhilaration worthy of work.

children.text: ghṛṣuḥ śyenāya kṛtvana āsu svāsu vaṃsagaḥ
children.translated_text: The eager one, made for the eagle, set among his own, kin by descent,

children.text: ava dīdhed ahīśuvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: has shone downward, with serpents as reins.

children.text: yaṃ suparṇaḥ parāvataḥ śyenasya putra ābharat
children.translated_text: The one which <s>Suparṇa</s>, from afar, the son of the eagle, brought,

children.text: śatacakraṃ yo 'hyo vartaniḥ ||
children.translated_text: which has a hundred wheels, whose path is serpentine.

children.text: yaṃ te śyenaś cārum avṛkam padābharad aruṇam mānam andhasaḥ
children.translated_text: The lovely, harmless, ruddy measure of the pressed juice, which your eagle brought in his foot,

children.text: enā vayo vi tāry āyur jīvasa enā jāgāra bandhutā ||
children.translated_text: by this extend vigor and life for living; by this let kinship stay awake.

children.text: evā tad indra indunā deveṣu cid dhārayāte mahi tyajaḥ
children.translated_text: Thus, O <s>Indra</s>, by the drop, even among the gods, great force is sustained.

children.text: kratvā vayo vi tāry āyuḥ sukrato kratvāyam asmad ā sutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: By resolve extend vigor and life, O strong in resolve; by resolve this has been pressed for us.

children.text: Chapter 982
imāṃ khanāmy oṣadhiṃ vīrudham balavattamām
children.translated_text: I dig up this herb, the creeper strongest in power,

children.text: yayā sapatnīm bādhate yayā saṃvindate patim ||
children.translated_text: by which one drives away a rival wife, by which one wins a husband.

children.text: uttānaparṇe subhage devajūte sahasvati
children.translated_text: O broad-leaved one, fortunate, urged by the gods, powerful one,

children.text: sapatnīm me parā dhama patim me kevalaṃ kuru ||
children.translated_text: drive my rival wife far away; make my husband mine alone.

children.text: uttarāham uttara uttared uttarābhyaḥ
children.translated_text: I am higher, higher than the high, higher than the higher ones;

children.text: athā sapatnī yā mamādharā sādharābhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: then let the rival wife who is mine be lower, lower than the lower ones.

children.text: nahy asyā nāma gṛbhṇāmi no asmin ramate jane
children.translated_text: I do not take her name, nor does she delight in this household.

children.text: parām eva parāvataṃ sapatnīṃ gamayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: We send the rival wife far away, to the farthest distance.

children.text: aham asmi sahamānātha tvam asi sāsahiḥ
children.translated_text: I am the overpowering one; now you are the overcomer.

children.text: ubhe sahasvatī bhūtvī sapatnīm me sahāvahai ||
children.translated_text: Let both of us, having become powerful, overcome my rival wife.

children.text: upa te 'dhāṃ sahamānām abhi tvādhāṃ sahīyasā
children.translated_text: I have set the overpowering one upon you; I have set the stronger one over you.

children.text: mām anu pra te mano vatsaṃ gaur iva dhāvatu pathā vār iva dhāvatu ||
children.translated_text: Let your mind run after me as a cow after her calf, as water runs along its path.

children.text: Chapter 983
araṇyāny araṇyāny asau yā preva naśyasi
children.translated_text: O <s>Araṇyānī</s>, O <s>Araṇyānī</s>, you there, who seem to vanish,

children.text: kathā grāmaṃ na pṛcchasi na tvā bhīr iva vindatīm ||
children.translated_text: why do you not ask after the village? Does fear, as it were, not find you?

children.text: vṛṣāravāya vadate yad upāvati ciccikaḥ
children.translated_text: When the ciccika bird answers the bellowing bull with its cry,

children.text: āghāṭibhir iva dhāvayann araṇyānir mahīyate ||
children.translated_text: driving on as if with clappers, <s>Araṇyānī</s> is magnified.

children.text: uta gāva ivādanty uta veśmeva dṛśyate
children.translated_text: And it sounds as if cows were eating; and it appears as if a house were there.

children.text: uto araṇyāniḥ sāyaṃ śakaṭīr iva sarjati ||
children.translated_text: And at evening <s>Araṇyānī</s> seems to send out carts.

children.text: gām aṅgaiṣa ā hvayati dārv aṅgaiṣo apāvadhīt
children.translated_text: This one calls a cow; this one has cut wood.

children.text: vasann araṇyānyāṃ sāyam akrukṣad iti manyate ||
children.translated_text: Dwelling in <s>Araṇyānī</s> at evening, one thinks, 'someone has cried out.'

children.text: na vā araṇyānir hanty anyaś cen nābhigacchati
children.translated_text: But <s>Araṇyānī</s> does not kill, if no other person approaches.

children.text: svādoḥ phalasya jagdhvāya yathākāmaṃ ni padyate ||
children.translated_text: Having eaten of sweet fruit, one lies down according to desire.

children.text: āñjanagandhiṃ surabhim bahvannām akṛṣīvalām
children.translated_text: Fragrant with ointment, sweet-smelling, rich in food, untilled,

children.text: prāham mṛgāṇām mātaram araṇyānim aśaṃsiṣam ||
children.translated_text: I have proclaimed <s>Araṇyānī</s>, mother of wild animals.

children.text: Chapter 984
śrat te dadhāmi prathamāya manyave 'han yad vṛtraṃ naryaṃ viver apaḥ
children.translated_text: I place trust in your first wrath, when, O manly one, you struck <s>Vṛtra</s> and released the waters.

children.text: ubhe yat tvā bhavato rodasī anu rejate śuṣmāt pṛthivī cid adrivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When both worlds tremble after you from your force, even the earth, O stone-wielder.

children.text: tvam māyābhir anavadya māyinaṃ śravasyatā manasā vṛtram ardayaḥ
children.translated_text: With your powers of <s>māyā</s> (wondrous skill), O faultless one, you crushed the <s>māyin</s> (wondrous power-worker) <s>Vṛtra</s> with a mind seeking fame.

children.text: tvām in naro vṛṇate gaviṣṭiṣu tvāṃ viśvāsu havyāsv iṣṭiṣu ||
children.translated_text: Men choose you in quests for cattle, you in all oblations and sacrifices.

children.text: aiṣu cākandhi puruhūta sūriṣu vṛdhāso ye maghavann ānaśur magham
children.translated_text: Attend to these patrons, O much-invoked one, those grown strong who have attained bounty, O generous one.

children.text: arcanti toke tanaye pariṣṭiṣu medhasātā vājinam ahraye dhane ||
children.translated_text: They praise the vigorous prize-winning one in contests over child and offspring, in the winning of reward, in unwearied wealth.

children.text: sa in nu rāyaḥ subhṛtasya cākanan madaṃ yo asya raṃhyaṃ ciketati
children.translated_text: He indeed longs for well-borne wealth, he who understands this impetuous exhilaration of his.

children.text: tvāvṛdho maghavan dāśvadhvaro makṣū sa vājam bharate dhanā nṛbhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Grown strong through you, O generous one, the sacrificing patron quickly carries off prize and wealth with his men.

children.text: tvaṃ śardhāya mahinā gṛṇāna uru kṛdhi maghavañchagdhi rāyaḥ
children.translated_text: Praised by greatness for the host, make broad space, O generous one; have power for wealth.

children.text: tvaṃ no mitro varuṇo na māyī pitvo na dasma dayase vibhaktā ||
children.translated_text: You are gracious to us like <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, a wondrous wise distributor, like a giver of food.

children.text: Chapter 985
suṣvāṇāsa indra stumasi tvā sasavāṃsaś ca tuvinṛmṇa vājam
children.translated_text: Having pressed well, O <s>Indra</s>, we praise you, and having won, O mighty in men, the prize.

children.text: ā no bhara suvitaṃ yasya cākan tmanā tanā sanuyāma tvotāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Bring us the good guidance which one desires; protected by you, may we win it for ourselves and our offspring.

children.text: ṛṣvas tvam indra śūra jāto dāsīr viśaḥ sūryeṇa sahyāḥ
children.translated_text: High are you, O <s>Indra</s>, born a hero; with the sun you overcame the <s>Dāsa</s> peoples.

children.text: guhā hitaṃ guhyaṃ gūḍham apsu bibhṛmasi prasravaṇe na somam ||
children.translated_text: Hidden in secret, concealed, we bear it in the waters, like <s>soma</s> at its outpouring.

children.text: aryo vā giro abhy arca vidvān ṛṣīṇāṃ vipraḥ sumatiṃ cakānaḥ
children.translated_text: Or, noble one, sing forth the songs; as a knowing inspired sage, desiring the good favor of the seers,

children.text: te syāma ye raṇayanta somair enota tubhyaṃ rathoḍha bhakṣaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: may we be those who gladden you with <s>soma</s>-draughts, with these portions brought to you by the chariot, O chariot-borne one.

children.text: imā brahmendra tubhyaṃ śaṃsi dā nṛbhyo nṛṇāṃ śūra śavaḥ
children.translated_text: These sacred utterances, O <s>Indra</s>, I proclaim to you; give heroic might to men, O hero among men.

children.text: tebhir bhava sakratur yeṣu cākann uta trāyasva gṛṇata uta stīn ||
children.translated_text: With them be of one resolve among those in whom you take pleasure; and protect the singer and the faithful patrons.

children.text: śrudhī havam indra śūra pṛthyā uta stavase venyasyārkaiḥ
children.translated_text: Hear the call, O heroic <s>Indra</s>, from afar; you are praised with <s>Vena</s>'s songs.

children.text: ā yas te yoniṃ ghṛtavantam asvār ūrmir na nimnair dravayanta vakvāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the eloquent streams have entered your ghee-filled seat, like a wave rushing down the slopes.

children.text: Chapter 986
savitā yantraiḥ pṛthivīm aramṇād askambhane savitā dyām adṛṃhat
children.translated_text: <s>Savitṛ</s> fastened the earth with his restraints; in the unsupported space <s>Savitṛ</s> made the heaven firm.

children.text: aśvam ivādhukṣad dhunim antarikṣam atūrte baddhaṃ savitā samudram ||
children.translated_text: Like a horse he milked the roaring midspace; <s>Savitṛ</s> bound the sea where it cannot be overcome.

children.text: yatrā samudra skabhito vy aunad apāṃ napāt savitā tasya veda
children.translated_text: Where the propped-up sea opened out, the Child of the Waters, <s>Savitṛ</s>, knows that place.

children.text: ato bhūr ata ā utthitaṃ rajo 'to dyāvāpṛthivī aprathetām ||
children.translated_text: From there came the earth; from there the realm arose; from there heaven and earth spread out without limit.

children.text: paścedam anyad abhavad yajatram amartyasya bhuvanasya bhūnā
children.translated_text: After this, another worshipful form came into being through the being of the immortal world.

children.text: suparṇo aṅga savitur garutmān pūrvo jātaḥ sa u asyānu dharma ||
children.translated_text: The fair-winged <s>Garuḍmat</s> of <s>Savitṛ</s> was born first; he indeed follows this law of his.

children.text: gāva iva grāmaṃ yūyudhir ivāśvān vāśreva vatsaṃ sumanā duhānā
children.translated_text: Like cows to the village, like warriors their horses, like a lowing cow her calf, kindly and giving milk,

children.text: patir iva jāyām abhi no ny etu dhartā divaḥ savitā viśvavāraḥ ||
children.translated_text: may the lord, the sustainer of heaven, <s>Savitṛ</s> who is desirable to all, come down to us like a husband to his wife.

children.text: hiraṇyastūpaḥ savitar yathā tvāṅgiraso juhve vāje asmin
children.translated_text: O <s>Savitṛ</s>, as <s>Hiraṇyastūpa</s>, an <s>Aṅgiras</s>, invokes you in this contest for prize,

children.text: evā tvārcann avase vandamānaḥ somasyevāṃśum prati jāgarāham ||
children.translated_text: so, praising you and revering you for help, I keep watch for you as for the pressed shoot of <s>soma</s>.

children.text: Chapter 987
samiddhaś cit sam idhyase devebhyo havyavāhana
children.translated_text: Even when kindled, you blaze up, O carrier of oblations to the gods.

children.text: ādityai rudrair vasubhir na ā gahi mṛḍīkāya na ā gahi ||
children.translated_text: Come to us with the <s>Ādityas</s>, the <s>Rudras</s>, and the <s>Vasus</s>; come to us for gracious mercy.

children.text: imaṃ yajñam idaṃ vaco jujuṣāṇa upāgahi
children.translated_text: Accepting this sacrifice and this word, come near.

children.text: martāsas tvā samidhāna havāmahe mṛḍīkāya havāmahe ||
children.translated_text: We mortals call you as you are kindled with fuel; we call you for gracious mercy.

children.text: tvām u jātavedasaṃ viśvavāraṃ gṛṇe dhiyā
children.translated_text: I praise you, <s>Jātavedas</s>, desirable to all, with inspired thought.

children.text: agne devāṁ ā vaha naḥ priyavratān mṛḍīkāya priyavratān ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, bring the gods who delight in sacred observances to us, for gracious mercy, those who delight in sacred observances.

children.text: agnir devo devānām abhavat purohito 'gnim manuṣyā ṛṣayaḥ sam īdhire
children.translated_text: The god <s>Agni</s> became the household priest of the gods; men, the seers, kindled <s>Agni</s> together.

children.text: agnim maho dhanasātāv ahaṃ huve mṛḍīkaṃ dhanasātaye ||
children.translated_text: I call <s>Agni</s> in the great winning of wealth, the gracious one for the winning of wealth.

children.text: agnir atrim bharadvājaṃ gaviṣṭhiram prāvan naḥ kaṇvaṃ trasadasyum āhave
children.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> protected <s>Atri</s>, <s>Bharadvāja</s> eager for cattle, our <s>Kaṇva</s>, and <s>Trasadasyu</s> in battle.

children.text: agniṃ vasiṣṭho havate purohito mṛḍīkāya purohitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, the household priest, calls upon <s>Agni</s> for gracious mercy, the priest upon the priest.

children.text: Chapter 988
śraddhayāgniḥ sam idhyate śraddhayā hūyate haviḥ
children.translated_text: By faith <s>Agni</s> is kindled; by faith the oblation is offered.

children.text: śraddhām bhagasya mūrdhani vacasā vedayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: With speech we make <s>Śraddhā</s> known upon the head of <s>Bhaga</s>.

children.text: priyaṃ śraddhe dadataḥ priyaṃ śraddhe didāsataḥ
children.translated_text: Dear, O <s>Śraddhā</s>, to the giver; dear, O <s>Śraddhā</s>, to the one who wishes to give,

children.text: priyam bhojeṣu yajvasv idam ma uditaṃ kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: dear among generous patrons and sacrificers: make this utterance of mine fulfilled.

children.text: yathā devā asureṣu śraddhām ugreṣu cakrire
children.translated_text: As the gods placed faith among the mighty <s>Asuras</s>,

children.text: evam bhojeṣu yajvasv asmākam uditaṃ kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: so, among generous patrons and sacrificers, make our utterance fulfilled.

children.text: śraddhāṃ devā yajamānā vāyugopā upāsate
children.translated_text: The gods and the sacrificing patrons, guarded by <s>Vāyu</s>, attend upon <s>Śraddhā</s>.

children.text: śraddhāṃ hṛdayyayākūtyā śraddhayā vindate vasu ||
children.translated_text: They attend with the heart's intention; through faith one finds wealth.

children.text: śraddhām prātar havāmahe śraddhām madhyandinam pari
children.translated_text: We call upon <s>Śraddhā</s> in the morning; we call upon <s>Śraddhā</s> around midday.

children.text: śraddhāṃ sūryasya nimruci śraddhe śrad dhāpayeha naḥ ||
children.translated_text: We call upon <s>Śraddhā</s> at the setting of the sun; O <s>Śraddhā</s>, cause us to have faith here.

children.text: Chapter 989
śāsa itthā mahāṁ asy amitrakhādo adbhutaḥ
children.translated_text: Rule in just this way; you are great, devourer of enemies, wondrous.

children.text: na yasya hanyate sakhā na jīyate kadācana ||
children.translated_text: His ally is not slain and is never overcome.

children.text: svastidā viśas patir vṛtrahā vimṛdho vaśī
children.translated_text: Giver of well-being, lord of the clans, <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer, disperser of foes, masterful,

children.text: vṛṣendraḥ pura etu naḥ somapā abhayaṅkaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: may bull-like <s>Indra</s>, the <s>soma</s>-drinker who makes fearlessness, go before us.

children.text: vi rakṣo vi mṛdho jahi vi vṛtrasya hanū ruja
children.translated_text: Strike the demons apart; strike the foes apart; break apart the jaws of <s>Vṛtra</s>.

children.text: vi manyum indra vṛtrahann amitrasyābhidāsataḥ ||
children.translated_text: Strike apart the wrath, O <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer, of the hostile one who seeks to attack.

children.text: vi na indra mṛdho jahi nīcā yaccha pṛtanyataḥ
children.translated_text: Strike our foes apart, O <s>Indra</s>; cast down those who would fight us.

children.text: yo asmāṁ abhidāsaty adharaṃ gamayā tamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Whoever seeks to attack us, send him down to the lower darkness.

children.text: apendra dviṣato mano 'pa jijyāsato vadham
children.translated_text: Drive away, O <s>Indra</s>, the mind of the hater; drive away the blow of the one who seeks to conquer.

children.text: vi manyoḥ śarma yaccha varīyo yavayā vadham ||
children.translated_text: Grant a wider shelter from wrath; ward off the blow.

children.text: Chapter 990
īṅkhayantīr apasyuva indraṃ jātam upāsate
children.translated_text: Restlessly moving, eager for action, they attend upon <s>Indra</s> at his birth,

children.text: bhejānāsaḥ suvīryam ||
children.translated_text: sharing in excellent heroic power.

children.text: tvam indra balād adhi sahaso jāta ojasaḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, were born from strength, from force, from might.

children.text: tvaṃ vṛṣan vṛṣed asi ||
children.translated_text: You, O bull, are truly the bullish one.

children.text: tvam indrāsi vṛtrahā vy antarikṣam atiraḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, are the <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer; you crossed beyond the midspace.

children.text: ud dyām astabhnā ojasā ||
children.translated_text: You propped up heaven with your might.

children.text: tvam indra sajoṣasam arkam bibharṣi bāhvoḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, bear the song as your companion in your two arms,

children.text: vajraṃ śiśāna ojasā ||
children.translated_text: sharpening the <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt) with might.

children.text: tvam indrābhibhūr asi viśvā jātāny ojasā
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, are the overcomer of all beings by might.

children.text: sa viśvā bhuva ābhavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: You have become lord over all the worlds.

children.text: Chapter 991
soma ekebhyaḥ pavate ghṛtam eka upāsate
children.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> flows for some; others attend upon ghee.

children.text: yebhyo madhu pradhāvati tāṃś cid evāpi gacchatāt ||
children.translated_text: Those for whom honey runs forth, to them too may he go.

children.text: tapasā ye anādhṛṣyās tapasā ye svar yayuḥ
children.translated_text: Those who through austerity are unassailable, those who through austerity went to heaven,

children.text: tapo ye cakrire mahas tāṃś cid evāpi gacchatāt ||
children.translated_text: those who performed great austerity: to them too may he go.

children.text: ye yudhyante pradhaneṣu śūrāso ye tanūtyajaḥ
children.translated_text: Those heroes who fight in battles, those who abandon their bodies,

children.text: ye vā sahasradakṣiṇās tāṃś cid evāpi gacchatāt ||
children.translated_text: or those who give a thousand gifts: to them too may he go.

children.text: ye cit pūrva ṛtasāpa ṛtāvāna ṛtāvṛdhaḥ
children.translated_text: Those former guardians of <s>ṛta</s> (truth-order), possessed of <s>ṛta</s>, increasers of <s>ṛta</s>,

children.text: pitṝn tapasvato yama tāṃś cid evāpi gacchatāt ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Yama</s>, to the fathers rich in austerity: to them too may he go.

children.text: sahasraṇīthāḥ kavayo ye gopāyanti sūryam
children.translated_text: The thousand-guiding seers who protect the sun,

children.text: ṛṣīn tapasvato yama tapojāṁ api gacchatāt ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Yama</s>, to the seers rich in austerity, born of austerity, may he go.

children.text: Chapter 992
arāyi kāṇe vikaṭe giriṃ gaccha sadānve
children.translated_text: O poverty, one-eyed and misshapen, go to the mountain, O ever-following one.

children.text: śirimbiṭhasya satvabhis tebhiṣ ṭvā cātayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: With the powers of <s>Śirimbiṭha</s>, with those we drive you away.

children.text: catto itaś cattāmutaḥ sarvā bhrūṇāny āruṣī
children.translated_text: Driven from here, driven from there, all embryos, O reddish one,

children.text: arāyyam brahmaṇas pate tīkṣṇaśṛṅgodṛṣann ihi ||
children.translated_text: drive away poverty, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>; sharp-horned and stone-toothed, come here.

children.text: ado yad dāru plavate sindhoḥ pāre apūruṣam
children.translated_text: That piece of wood which floats on the far side of the river, without a person...

children.text: tad ā rabhasva durhaṇo tena gaccha parastaram ||
children.translated_text: Take hold of that, O hard-to-strike one; with it go to the farther shore.

children.text: yaddha prācīr ajagantoro maṇḍūradhāṇikīḥ
children.translated_text: When the forward-going ones came inward, the <s>Maṇḍūradhāṇikīs</s>,

children.text: hatā indrasya śatravaḥ sarve budbudayāśavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the enemies of <s>Indra</s> were struck down, all of them as fleeting as bubbles.

children.text: parīme gām aneṣata pary agnim ahṛṣata
children.translated_text: They led this cow around; they carried <s>Agni</s> around.

children.text: deveṣv akrata śravaḥ ka imāṁ ā dadharṣati ||
children.translated_text: They made fame among the gods. Who will dare attack this one?

children.text: Chapter 993
agniṃ hinvantu no dhiyaḥ saptim āśum ivājiṣu
children.translated_text: Let our thoughts impel <s>Agni</s>, like a swift racehorse in contests.

children.text: tena jeṣma dhanaṃ dhanam ||
children.translated_text: By him may we win wealth after wealth.

children.text: yayā gā ākarāmahe senayāgne tavotyā
children.translated_text: By that army, O <s>Agni</s>, by your aid, with which we draw the cows toward us,

children.text: tāṃ no hinva maghattaye ||
children.translated_text: impel that for us toward bounty.

children.text: āgne sthūraṃ rayim bhara pṛthuṃ gomantam aśvinam
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, bring stout wealth, broad, rich in cattle and horses.

children.text: aṅdhi khaṃ vartayā paṇim ||
children.translated_text: Break open the hollow; turn away the <s>Paṇi</s>.

children.text: agne nakṣatram ajaram ā sūryaṃ rohayo divi
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, raise the undecaying star, the sun, into heaven,

children.text: dadhaj jyotir janebhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: setting light for human beings.

children.text: agne ketur viśām asi preṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭha upasthasat
children.translated_text: O <s>Agni</s>, you are the banner of the clans, dearest and best where you are set nearby.

children.text: bodhā stotre vayo dadhat ||
children.translated_text: Awaken for the praise-song, bestowing vital strength.

children.text: Chapter 994
imā nu kam bhuvanā sīṣadhāmendraś ca viśve ca devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Now let us master these worlds, <s>Indra</s> and all the gods together.

children.text: yajñaṃ ca nas tanvaṃ ca prajāṃ cādityair indraḥ saha cīkﾱpāti ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s>, together with the <s>Ādityas</s>, protect our sacrifice, our body, and our offspring.

children.text: ādityair indraḥ sagaṇo marudbhir asmākam bhūtv avitā tanūnām ||
children.translated_text: With the <s>Ādityas</s>, with his troop and with the <s>Maruts</s>, let <s>Indra</s> become protector of our bodies.

children.text: hatvāya devā asurān yad āyan devā devatvam abhirakṣamāṇāḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the gods went to slay the <s>Asuras</s>, guarding the godhead of the gods,

children.text: pratyañcam arkam anayañchacībhir ād it svadhām iṣirām pary apaśyan ||
children.translated_text: with their powers they brought the chant back, and then they beheld their own impelling strength.

children.text: Chapter 995
sūryo no divas pātu vāto antarikṣāt
children.translated_text: May <s>Sūrya</s> protect us from heaven, <s>Vāta</s> from the midspace,

children.text: agnir naḥ pārthivebhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and <s>Agni</s> from earthly things.

children.text: joṣā savitar yasya te haraḥ śataṃ savāṁ arhati
children.translated_text: Be gracious, O <s>Savitar</s>; that radiance of yours is worth a hundred impulses.

children.text: pāhi no didyutaḥ patantyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: Protect us from the falling lightning bolt.

children.text: cakṣur no devaḥ savitā cakṣur na uta parvataḥ
children.translated_text: May the god <s>Savitar</s> be sight for us; may the mountain also be sight for us.

children.text: cakṣur dhātā dadhātu naḥ ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Dhātṛ</s> set sight in us.

children.text: cakṣur no dhehi cakṣuṣe cakṣur vikhyai tanūbhyaḥ
children.translated_text: Place sight in us for seeing, sight for our bodies to behold.

children.text: saṃ cedaṃ vi ca paśyema ||
children.translated_text: May we look upon this together and in every direction.

children.text: susaṃdṛśaṃ tvā vayam prati paśyema sūrya
children.translated_text: May we behold you clearly, O <s>Sūrya</s>.

children.text: vi paśyema nṛcakṣasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May we see clearly, O you who are the sight of men.

children.text: Chapter 996
ud asau sūryo agād ud ayam māmako bhagaḥ
children.translated_text: That sun has risen; this fortune of mine has risen.

children.text: ahaṃ tad vidvalā patim abhy asākṣi viṣāsahiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Knowing this, I, strong and conquering, have gained power over my husband.

children.text: ahaṃ ketur aham mūrdhāham ugrā vivācanī
children.translated_text: I am the banner; I am the head; I am formidable, one who speaks with authority.

children.text: mamed anu kratum patiḥ sehānāyā upācaret ||
children.translated_text: Let my husband follow my intention and attend upon me as one who has prevailed.

children.text: mama putrāḥ śatruhaṇo 'tho me duhitā virāṭ
children.translated_text: My sons are slayers of enemies, and my daughter is sovereign.

children.text: utāham asmi saṃjayā patyau me śloka uttamaḥ ||
children.translated_text: And I myself am victorious; my fame with my husband is supreme.

children.text: yenendro haviṣā kṛtvy abhavad dyumny uttamaḥ
children.translated_text: That oblation by which <s>Indra</s>, having performed the rite, became the highest in splendor,

children.text: idaṃ tad akri devā asapatnā kilābhuvam ||
children.translated_text: that has now been performed, O gods; I have surely become without a rival wife.

children.text: asapatnā sapatnaghnī jayanty abhibhūvarī
children.translated_text: Rivalless, slayer of rival wives, victorious, overpowering,

children.text: āvṛkṣam anyāsāṃ varco rādho astheyasām iva ||
children.translated_text: I have taken away the brilliance and favor of the other women, as from those standing weakly.

children.text: sam ajaiṣam imā ahaṃ sapatnīr abhibhūvarī
children.translated_text: I have completely conquered these rival wives, overpowering them,

children.text: yathāham asya vīrasya virājāni janasya ca ||
children.translated_text: so that I may rule over this hero and over the people.

children.text: Chapter 997
tīvrasyābhivayaso asya pāhi sarvarathā vi harī iha muñca
children.translated_text: Guard this man of keen, growing power; release your two bay horses here from the chariot on every side.

children.text: indra mā tvā yajamānāso anye ni rīraman tubhyam ime sutāsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, do not let other sacrificers detain you; these pressed juices are for you.

children.text: tubhyaṃ sutās tubhyam u sotvāsas tvāṃ giraḥ śvātryā ā hvayanti
children.translated_text: Pressed for you, and to be pressed for you, the songs call you with praise.

children.text: indredam adya savanaṃ juṣāṇo viśvasya vidvāṁ iha pāhi somam ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, enjoying this pressing today, knowing all, drink the <s>soma</s> here.

children.text: ya uśatā manasā somam asmai sarvahṛdā devakāmaḥ sunoti
children.translated_text: The man who, with eager mind and whole heart, desiring the god, presses <s>soma</s> for him,

children.text: na gā indras tasya parā dadāti praśastam ic cārum asmai kṛṇoti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> does not give away his cows; he makes what is praised and lovely for him.

children.text: anuspaṣṭo bhavaty eṣo asya yo asmai revān na sunoti somam
children.translated_text: But the rich man who does not press <s>soma</s> for him becomes exposed to his reproach.

children.text: nir aratnau maghavā taṃ dadhāti brahmadviṣo hanty anānudiṣṭaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Maghavan</s> leaves him without treasures; unbidden, he strikes down the hater of sacred speech.

children.text: aśvāyanto gavyanto vājayanto havāmahe tvopagantavā u
