children.translated_text: Desiring horses, desiring cattle, desiring prize, we call you so that you may come near.

children.text: ābhūṣantas te sumatau navāyāṃ vayam indra tvā śunaṃ huvema ||
children.translated_text: Adorning ourselves in your fresh favor, O <s>Indra</s>, may we call you for welfare.

children.text: Chapter 998
muñcāmi tvā haviṣā jīvanāya kam ajñātayakṣmād uta rājayakṣmāt
children.translated_text: I release you by the oblation for life, from unknown <s>yakṣma</s> and from royal <s>yakṣma</s>.

children.text: grāhir jagrāha yadi vaitad enaṃ tasyā indrāgnī pra mumuktam enam ||
children.translated_text: If a seizure has seized this man, from that, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, release him completely.

children.text: yadi kṣitāyur yadi vā pareto yadi mṛtyor antikaṃ nīta eva
children.translated_text: Whether his life has ebbed away, or whether he has departed, or whether he has been led right to the nearness of death,

children.text: tam ā harāmi nirṛter upasthād aspārṣam enaṃ śataśāradāya ||
children.translated_text: I bring him back from the lap of <s>Nirṛti</s>; I have reached him for a hundred autumns.

children.text: sahasrākṣeṇa śataśāradena śatāyuṣā haviṣāhārṣam enam
children.translated_text: With a thousand-eyed, hundred-autumn, hundred-life oblation I have brought him here.

children.text: śataṃ yathemaṃ śarado nayātīndro viśvasya duritasya pāram ||
children.translated_text: May <s>Indra</s> lead this man across to the far side of every evil for a hundred autumns.

children.text: śataṃ jīva śarado vardhamānaḥ śataṃ hemantāñchatam u vasantān
children.translated_text: Live a hundred autumns, growing; live a hundred winters and a hundred springs.

children.text: śatam indrāgnī savitā bṛhaspatiḥ śatāyuṣā haviṣemam punar duḥ ||
children.translated_text: With the hundred-life oblation, <s>Indra</s>, <s>Agni</s>, <s>Savitṛ</s>, and <s>Bṛhaspati</s> have given this man back.

children.text: āhārṣaṃ tvāvidaṃ tvā punar āgāḥ punarnava
children.translated_text: I have brought you here; I have found you; you have come back again, renewed.

children.text: sarvāṅga sarvaṃ te cakṣuḥ sarvam āyuś ca te 'vidam ||
children.translated_text: Whole in every limb, I have found all your sight and all your life.

children.text: Chapter 999
brahmaṇāgniḥ saṃvidāno rakṣohā bādhatām itaḥ
children.translated_text: Let <s>Agni</s>, in accord with sacred speech, the demon-slayer, drive away from here

children.text: amīvā yas te garbhaṃ durṇāmā yonim āśaye ||
children.translated_text: the disease, the ill-named one, that lies in your womb, in your generative place.

children.text: yas te garbham amīvā durṇāmā yonim āśaye
children.translated_text: The disease, the ill-named one, that lies in your womb, in your generative place,

children.text: agniṣ ṭam brahmaṇā saha niṣ kravyādam anīnaśat ||
children.translated_text: let <s>Agni</s>, together with sacred speech, drive that raw-flesh eater away.

children.text: yas te hanti patayantaṃ niṣatsnuṃ yaḥ sarīsṛpam
children.translated_text: Whoever harms what is flying, what is settling, or what is creeping,

children.text: jātaṃ yas te jighāṃsati tam ito nāśayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: whoever seeks to kill your newborn child, we destroy him from here.

children.text: yas ta ūrū viharaty antarā dampatī śaye
children.translated_text: Whoever moves between your thighs, whoever lies between husband and wife,

children.text: yoniṃ yo antar āreḍhi tam ito nāśayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: whoever attacks the generative place within, we destroy him from here.

children.text: yas tvā bhrātā patir bhūtvā jāro bhūtvā nipadyate
children.translated_text: Whoever, having become your brother, having become your husband, having become your lover, lies down with you,

children.text: prajāṃ yas te jighāṃsati tam ito nāśayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: whoever seeks to kill your offspring, we destroy him from here.

children.text: yas tvā svapnena tamasā mohayitvā nipadyate
children.translated_text: Whoever, having bewildered you by sleep and darkness, lies down with you,

children.text: prajāṃ yas te jighāṃsati tam ito nāśayāmasi ||
children.translated_text: whoever seeks to kill your offspring, we destroy him from here.

children.text: Chapter 1000
akṣībhyāṃ te nāsikābhyāṃ karṇābhyāṃ chubukād adhi
children.translated_text: From your eyes, from your nostrils, from your ears, and from your chin

children.text: yakṣmaṃ śīrṣaṇyam mastiṣkāj jihvāyā vi vṛhāmi te ||
children.translated_text: The disease located in the head, from your brain and from your tongue, I tear away from you.

children.text: grīvābhyas ta uṣṇihābhyaḥ kīkasābhyo anūkyāt
children.translated_text: From your necks, from your collarbones, from your ribs, and from your backbone,

children.text: yakṣmaṃ doṣaṇyam aṃsābhyām bāhubhyāṃ vi vṛhāmi te ||
children.translated_text: the disease located in the forearms, from the shoulders and from the arms, I tear away from you.

children.text: āntrebhyas te gudābhyo vaniṣṭhor hṛdayād adhi
children.translated_text: From your intestines, from your bowels, from the rectum, and from the heart,

children.text: yakṣmam matasnābhyāṃ yaknaḥ plāśibhyo vi vṛhāmi te ||
children.translated_text: the disease from the kidneys, from the liver, and from the lungs, I tear away from you.

children.text: ūrubhyāṃ te aṣṭhīvadbhyām pārṣṇibhyām prapadābhyām
children.translated_text: From your thighs with their bones, from your heels and from the foreparts of your feet,

children.text: yakṣmaṃ śroṇibhyām bhāsadād bhaṃsaso vi vṛhāmi te ||
children.translated_text: the disease from the hips, from the buttocks, and from the haunches, I tear away from you.

children.text: mehanād vanaṅkaraṇāl lomabhyas te nakhebhyaḥ
children.translated_text: From the urinary organ, from the generative organ, from your hairs and from your nails,

children.text: yakṣmaṃ sarvasmād ātmanas tam idaṃ vi vṛhāmi te ||
children.translated_text: that disease from your whole self, this I tear away from you.

children.text: aṅgād aṅgāl lomno lomno jātam parvaṇi parvaṇi
children.translated_text: Born limb by limb, hair by hair, and joint by joint,

children.text: yakṣmaṃ sarvasmād ātmanas tam idaṃ vi vṛhāmi te ||
children.translated_text: that disease from your whole self, this I tear away from you.

children.text: Chapter 1001
apehi manasas pate 'pa krāma paraś cara
children.translated_text: Go away, lord of the mind; step away, go far off.

children.text: paro nirṛtyā ā cakṣva bahudhā jīvato manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Look far away from <s>Nirṛti</s>; let the living man's mind be in many places.

children.text: bhadraṃ vai varaṃ vṛṇate bhadraṃ yuñjanti dakṣiṇam
children.translated_text: They choose a good boon; they yoke a good right-hand gift.

children.text: bhadraṃ vaivasvate cakṣur bahutrā jīvato manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Good is the eye of <s>Vaivasvata</s>; let the living man's mind be in many places.

children.text: yad āśasā niḥśasābhiśasopārima jāgrato yat svapantaḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever by hope, by sighing, by imprecation we have transgressed while waking, whatever while sleeping,

children.text: agnir viśvāny apa duṣkṛtāny ajuṣṭāny āre asmad dadhātu ||
children.translated_text: may <s>Agni</s> set all evil deeds, unwelcome things, far away from us.

children.text: yad indra brahmaṇas pate 'bhidrohaṃ carāmasi
children.translated_text: Whatever hostility, O <s>Indra</s>, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, we commit,

children.text: pracetā na āṅgiraso dviṣatām pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may the discerning <s>Āṅgirasa</s> protect us from the distress caused by those who hate us.

children.text: ajaiṣmādyāsanāma cābhūmānāgaso vayam
children.translated_text: May we win today; may we attain, and may we be guiltless.

children.text: jāgratsvapnaḥ saṃkalpaḥ pāpo yaṃ dviṣmas taṃ sa ṛcchatu yo no dveṣṭi tam ṛcchatu ||
children.translated_text: Let the evil waking dream and intention reach the one whom we hate; let it reach the one who hates us.

children.text: Chapter 1002
devāḥ kapota iṣito yad icchan dūto nirṛtyā idam ājagāma
children.translated_text: O gods, when the pigeon, impelled and seeking, has come here as the messenger of <s>Nirṛti</s>,

children.text: tasmā arcāma kṛṇavāma niṣkṛtiṃ śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||
children.translated_text: for that one let us sing praise and make atonement; may there be welfare for our two-footed and welfare for our four-footed beings.

children.text: śivaḥ kapota iṣito no astv anāgā devāḥ śakuno gṛheṣu
children.translated_text: May the pigeon, impelled by the gods, be auspicious for us, guiltless, a bird in our houses.

children.text: agnir hi vipro juṣatāṃ havir naḥ pari hetiḥ pakṣiṇī no vṛṇaktu ||
children.translated_text: For let the inspired <s>Agni</s> accept our oblation; let the winged missile turn away from us.

children.text: hetiḥ pakṣiṇī na dabhāty asmān āṣṭryām padaṃ kṛṇute agnidhāne
children.translated_text: The winged missile does not harm us; it sets its foot on the hearth-place.

children.text: śaṃ no gobhyaś ca puruṣebhyaś cāstu mā no hiṃsīd iha devāḥ kapotaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May there be welfare for our cows and for our men; O gods, let the pigeon not injure us here.

children.text: yad ulūko vadati mogham etad yat kapotaḥ padam agnau kṛṇoti
children.translated_text: When the owl calls, this is vain; when the pigeon sets its foot in the fire,

children.text: yasya dūtaḥ prahita eṣa etat tasmai yamāya namo astu mṛtyave ||
children.translated_text: to that <s>Yama</s>, to death, whose dispatched messenger this is, let there be homage.

children.text: ṛcā kapotaṃ nudata praṇodam iṣam madantaḥ pari gāṃ nayadhvam
children.translated_text: Drive away the pigeon with a verse, driving it forth; rejoicing in nourishment, lead the cow around.

children.text: saṃyopayanto duritāni viśvā hitvā na ūrjam pra patāt patiṣṭhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Making all evils quiet and having left us strength, fly forth, O swift-winged one, and settle down.

children.text: Chapter 1003
ṛṣabham mā samānānāṃ sapatnānāṃ viṣāsahim
children.translated_text: Make me a bull among my peers, overpowering my rivals,

children.text: hantāraṃ śatrūṇāṃ kṛdhi virājaṃ gopatiṃ gavām ||
children.translated_text: a slayer of enemies, a sovereign, the lord of cows among the cows.

children.text: aham asmi sapatnahendra ivāriṣṭo akṣataḥ
children.translated_text: I am the rival-slaying one, like <s>Indra</s>, unharmed and uninjured.

children.text: adhaḥ sapatnā me pador ime sarve abhiṣṭhitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: These rivals of mine are all set below my feet.

children.text: atraiva vo 'pi nahyāmy ubhe ārtnī iva jyayā
children.translated_text: Right here I bind you fast, like the two ends of a bow with a bowstring.

children.text: vācaspate ni ṣedhemān yathā mad adharaṃ vadān ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Vācaspati</s>, hold these down, so that they may speak beneath me.

children.text: abhibhūr aham āgamaṃ viśvakarmeṇa dhāmnā
children.translated_text: I have come as the overcomer, with the ordinance of <s>Viśvakarman</s>.

children.text: ā vaś cittam ā vo vratam ā vo 'haṃ samitiṃ dade ||
children.translated_text: I take your thought, your vow, and your assembly to myself.

children.text: yogakṣemaṃ va ādāyāham bhūyāsam uttama ā vo mūrdhānam akramīm
children.translated_text: Taking your acquisition and security, may I become the highest; I have stepped upon your head.

children.text: adhaspadān ma ud vadata maṇḍūkā ivodakān maṇḍūkā udakād iva ||
children.translated_text: From beneath my feet speak upward, like frogs from the waters, like frogs from water.

children.text: Chapter 1004
tubhyedam indra pari ṣicyate madhu tvaṃ sutasya kalaśasya rājasi
children.translated_text: For you, O <s>Indra</s>, this honey is poured all around; you rule over the pressed draught in the vessel.

children.text: tvaṃ rayim puruvīrām u nas kṛdhi tvaṃ tapaḥ paritapyājayaḥ svaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Make wealth with many heroes for us; burn up the heat and win the heavenly light.

children.text: svarjitam mahi mandānam andhaso havāmahe pari śakraṃ sutāṁ upa
children.translated_text: We call around the mighty <s>Śakra</s>, winner of heaven, greatly rejoicing in the soma-draught, near the pressed soma.

children.text: imaṃ no yajñam iha bodhy ā gahi spṛdho jayantam maghavānam īmahe ||
children.translated_text: Be aware of this sacrifice of ours here; come here. We seek <s>Maghavan</s>, who conquers rivals.

children.text: somasya rājño varuṇasya dharmaṇi bṛhaspater anumatyā u śarmaṇi
children.translated_text: In the ordinance of king <s>Soma</s> and of <s>Varuṇa</s>, and under the consent and shelter of <s>Bṛhaspati</s>,

children.text: tavāham adya maghavann upastutau dhātar vidhātaḥ kalaśāṁ abhakṣayam ||
children.translated_text: today, O <s>Maghavan</s>, in praise of you, O establisher and ordainer, I have drunk from the vessels.

children.text: prasūto bhakṣam akaraṃ carāv api stomaṃ cemam prathamaḥ sūrir un mṛje
children.translated_text: Impulsed, I have taken the drink even in the bowl, and I, the first sage, polish this hymn.

children.text: sute sātena yady āgamaṃ vām prati viśvāmitrajamadagnī dame ||
children.translated_text: If, when the soma was pressed and won, I came to your house, O <s>Viśvāmitra</s> and <s>Jamadagni</s>,

children.text: Chapter 1005
vātasya nu mahimānaṃ rathasya rujann eti stanayann asya ghoṣaḥ
children.translated_text: now the greatness of <s>Vāta</s>'s chariot goes forth, breaking through; its roar thunders.

children.text: divispṛg yāty aruṇāni kṛṇvann uto eti pṛthivyā reṇum asyan ||
children.translated_text: Touching heaven, it goes, making the ruddy spaces; and it goes, hurling the dust of the earth.

children.text: sam prerate anu vātasya viṣṭhā ainaṃ gacchanti samanaṃ na yoṣāḥ
children.translated_text: They move forth together along the tracks of <s>Vāta</s>; they go to him as women to a gathering.

children.text: tābhiḥ sayuk sarathaṃ deva īyate 'sya viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā ||
children.translated_text: Together with them, yoked together in one chariot, the god travels, king of this whole world.

children.text: antarikṣe pathibhir īyamāno na ni viśate katamac canāhaḥ
children.translated_text: Moving along the paths in the midspace, he does not rest on any day whatsoever.

children.text: apāṃ sakhā prathamajā ṛtāvā kva svij jātaḥ kuta ā babhūva ||
children.translated_text: Friend of the waters, first-born, possessed of <s>ṛta</s> (truth-order), where indeed was he born? From where did he come into being?

children.text: ātmā devānām bhuvanasya garbho yathāvaśaṃ carati deva eṣaḥ
children.translated_text: The self of the gods, the embryo of the world, this god moves according to his will.

children.text: ghoṣā id asya śṛṇvire na rūpaṃ tasmai vātāya haviṣā vidhema ||
children.translated_text: Only his sounds are heard, not his form; to that <s>Vāta</s> let us perform worship with oblation.

children.text: Chapter 1006
mayobhūr vāto abhi vātūsrā ūrjasvatīr oṣadhīr ā riśantām
children.translated_text: May the pleasure-bringing wind blow toward us; may the strong herbs come to us unharmed.

children.text: pīvasvatīr jīvadhanyāḥ pibantv avasāya padvate rudra mṛḍa ||
children.translated_text: May the fat, life-sustaining ones drink; for help to the one who goes on foot, O <s>Rudra</s>, be gracious.

children.text: yāḥ sarūpā virūpā ekarūpā yāsām agnir iṣṭyā nāmāni veda
children.translated_text: Those of like form, of different form, and of single form, whose names <s>Agni</s> knows through the offering,

children.text: yā aṅgirasas tapaseha cakrus tābhyaḥ parjanya mahi śarma yaccha ||
children.translated_text: those which the <s>Aṅgirases</s> made here for austerity, to them, O <s>Parjanya</s>, grant great shelter.

children.text: yā deveṣu tanvam airayanta yāsāṃ somo viśvā rūpāṇi veda
children.translated_text: Those that have extended their body among the gods, whose every form <s>Soma</s> knows,

children.text: tā asmabhyam payasā pinvamānāḥ prajāvatīr indra goṣṭhe rirīhi ||
children.translated_text: those, swelling with milk for us, rich in offspring, O <s>Indra</s>, release into the cattle-stall.

children.text: prajāpatir mahyam etā rarāṇo viśvair devaiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s>, agreeing with all the gods and with the <s>Pitṛs</s>, has graciously given these to me.

children.text: śivāḥ satīr upa no goṣṭham ākas tāsāṃ vayam prajayā saṃ sadema ||
children.translated_text: May they, being auspicious, come near our cattle-stall; may we dwell together with their offspring.

children.text: Chapter 1007
vibhrāḍ bṛhat pibatu somyam madhv āyur dadhad yajñapatāv avihrutam
children.translated_text: Let the shining, great one drink the soma-honey, placing undiminished life in the lord of sacrifice;

children.text: vātajūto yo abhirakṣati tmanā prajāḥ pupoṣa purudhā vi rājati ||
children.translated_text: wind-impelled, he who guards by himself has nourished the creatures and shines forth in many ways.

children.text: vibhrāḍ bṛhat subhṛtaṃ vājasātamaṃ dharman divo dharuṇe satyam arpitam
children.translated_text: The shining, great one, well supported and most winning of prizes, is set in truth in the law and foundation of heaven;

children.text: amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhantamaṃ jyotir jajñe asurahā sapatnahā ||
children.translated_text: foe-slayer, <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer, strongest slayer of <s>Dasyus</s>: the light was born, slayer of <s>Asuras</s> and rivals.

children.text: idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotir uttamaṃ viśvajid dhanajid ucyate bṛhat
children.translated_text: This best light among lights, the highest light, the great one, is called world-conqueror and wealth-conqueror;

children.text: viśvabhrāḍ bhrājo mahi sūryo dṛśa uru paprathe saha ojo acyutam ||
children.translated_text: the all-shining, radiant, mighty <s>Sūrya</s> has spread wide to be seen, with unfailing force and power.

children.text: vibhrājañ jyotiṣā svar agaccho rocanaṃ divaḥ
children.translated_text: Shining with light, you went to the sun-bright realm, to the shining expanse of heaven,

children.text: yenemā viśvā bhuvanāny ābhṛtā viśvakarmaṇā viśvadevyāvatā ||
children.translated_text: by which all these worlds are sustained, by <s>Viśvakarman</s>, with the aid of all the gods.

children.text: Chapter 1008
tvaṃ tyam iṭato ratham indra prāvaḥ sutāvataḥ
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, protected that chariot of the eager soma-presser,

children.text: aśṛṇoḥ somino havam ||
children.translated_text: you heard the call of the soma-offerer.

children.text: tvam makhasya dodhataḥ śiro 'va tvaco bharaḥ
children.translated_text: You tore away the head of <s>Makha</s>, as he was shaking, from the skin,

children.text: agacchaḥ somino gṛham ||
children.translated_text: and you came to the house of the soma-offerer.

children.text: tvaṃ tyam indra martyam āstrabudhnāya venyam
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, dealt with that mortal, dear to <s>Āstrabudhna</s>,

children.text: muhuḥ śrathnā manasyave ||
children.translated_text: again and again loosening him for the thoughtful one.

children.text: tvaṃ tyam indra sūryam paścā santam puras kṛdhi
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Indra</s>, place that <s>Sūrya</s>, who was behind, in front,

children.text: devānāṃ cit tiro vaśam ||
children.translated_text: even beyond the will of the gods.

children.text: Chapter 1009
ā yāhi vanasā saha gāvaḥ sacanta vartaniṃ yad ūdhabhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Come together with desire; the cows follow the path when they are heavy with udders.

children.text: ā yāhi vasvyā dhiyā maṃhiṣṭho jārayanmakhaḥ sudānubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Come with a good thought, most bountiful, enlivening <s>Makha</s>, together with the generous patrons.

children.text: pitubhṛto na tantum it sudānavaḥ prati dadhmo yajāmasi ||
children.translated_text: Like those who bear nourishment, like a thread, O generous ones, we set it forth and sacrifice.

children.text: uṣā apa svasus tamaḥ saṃ vartayati vartaniṃ sujātatā ||
children.translated_text: <s>Uṣas</s>, well-born, rolls away her sister's darkness and sets the path in motion.

children.text: Chapter 1010
ā tvāhārṣam antar edhi dhruvas tiṣṭhāvicācaliḥ
children.translated_text: I have brought you here; enter within; stand firm, unmoving and unshaken.

children.text: viśas tvā sarvā vāñchantu mā tvad rāṣṭram adhi bhraśat ||
children.translated_text: May all the clans desire you; may the kingdom not fall away from you.

children.text: ihaivaidhi māpa cyoṣṭhāḥ parvata ivāvicācaliḥ
children.translated_text: Be here alone; do not slip away; like a mountain, unmoving and unshaken,

children.text: indra iveha dhruvas tiṣṭheha rāṣṭram u dhāraya ||
children.translated_text: stand firm here like <s>Indra</s>; here uphold the kingdom.

children.text: imam indro adīdharad dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa haviṣā
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> has held this one firm with a firm oblation;

children.text: tasmai somo adhi bravat tasmā u brahmaṇas patiḥ ||
children.translated_text: over him <s>Soma</s> spoke, and over him <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>.

children.text: dhruvā dyaur dhruvā pṛthivī dhruvāsaḥ parvatā ime
children.translated_text: Firm is heaven, firm is earth, firm are these mountains;

children.text: dhruvaṃ viśvam idaṃ jagad dhruvo rājā viśām ayam ||
children.translated_text: firm is all this moving world; firm is this king of the clans.

children.text: dhruvaṃ te rājā varuṇo dhruvaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ
children.translated_text: Firm for you is King <s>Varuṇa</s>; firm is the god <s>Bṛhaspati</s>;

children.text: dhruvaṃ ta indraś cāgniś ca rāṣṭraṃ dhārayatāṃ dhruvam ||
children.translated_text: firm for you are <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>; may they uphold the kingdom firm.

children.text: dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa haviṣābhi somam mṛśāmasi
children.translated_text: With a firm oblation we touch <s>Soma</s> firmly;

children.text: atho ta indraḥ kevalīr viśo balihṛtas karat ||
children.translated_text: then may <s>Indra</s> alone make the clans bring tribute to you.

children.text: Chapter 1011
abhīvartena haviṣā yenendro abhivāvṛte
children.translated_text: With the oblation of turning back, by which <s>Indra</s> turned himself around,

children.text: tenāsmān brahmaṇaspate 'bhi rāṣṭrāya vartaya ||
children.translated_text: with that, O <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>, turn us toward sovereignty.

children.text: abhivṛtya sapatnān abhi yā no arātayaḥ
children.translated_text: Having turned against the rivals, against the hostilities that are directed at us,

children.text: abhi pṛtanyantaṃ tiṣṭhābhi yo na irasyati ||
children.translated_text: stand against the one who fights; stand against him who is hostile to us.

children.text: abhi tvā devaḥ savitābhi somo avīvṛtat
children.translated_text: The god <s>Savitṛ</s> has turned you toward us; <s>Soma</s> has turned you toward us;

children.text: abhi tvā viśvā bhūtāny abhīvarto yathāsasi ||
children.translated_text: all beings have turned you toward us, so that you are one who turns toward us.

children.text: yenendro haviṣā kṛtvy abhavad dyumny uttamaḥ
children.translated_text: By the oblation with which <s>Indra</s>, having acted, became highest in splendor,

children.text: idaṃ tad akri devā asapatnaḥ kilābhuvam ||
children.translated_text: that has been made here, O gods; surely I have become without a rival.

children.text: asapatnaḥ sapatnahābhirāṣṭro viṣāsahiḥ
children.translated_text: Rival-less, rival-slaying, master of the realm, overpowering the clans,

children.text: yathāham eṣām bhūtānāṃ virājāni janasya ca ||
children.translated_text: may I rule over these beings and over the people.

children.text: Chapter 1012
pra vo grāvāṇaḥ savitā devaḥ suvatu dharmaṇā
children.translated_text: O pressing stones, may the god <s>Savitṛ</s> set you in motion according to the ordinance;

children.text: dhūrṣu yujyadhvaṃ sunuta ||
children.translated_text: be yoked in the shafts; press out the soma.

children.text: grāvāṇo apa ducchunām apa sedhata durmatim
children.translated_text: O pressing stones, drive away bad fortune; drive away evil thought;

children.text: usrāḥ kartana bheṣajam ||
children.translated_text: O bright ones, make a remedy.

children.text: grāvāṇa upareṣv ā mahīyante sajoṣasaḥ
children.translated_text: The pressing stones are magnified upon the lower stones, acting together,

children.text: vṛṣṇe dadhato vṛṣṇyam ||
children.translated_text: placing virility for the bull.

children.text: grāvāṇaḥ savitā nu vo devaḥ suvatu dharmaṇā
children.translated_text: O pressing stones, may the god <s>Savitṛ</s> now set you in motion according to the ordinance,

children.text: yajamānāya sunvate ||
children.translated_text: for the sacrificing soma-presser.

children.text: Chapter 1013
pra sūnava ṛbhūṇām bṛhan navanta vṛjanā
children.translated_text: Forth, O sons of the <s>Ṛbhus</s>, let the great songs resound in the enclosures,

children.text: kṣāmā ye viśvadhāyaso 'śnan dhenuṃ na mātaram ||
children.translated_text: those all-sustaining ones on earth who have reached the cow as their mother.

children.text: pra devaṃ devyā dhiyā bharatā jātavedasam
children.translated_text: Bring forward the god <s>Jātavedas</s> with divine thought;

children.text: havyā no vakṣad ānuṣak ||
children.translated_text: may he carry our oblations in succession.

children.text: ayam u ṣya pra devayur hotā yajñāya nīyate
children.translated_text: This one, seeking the gods, is led forward as <s>Hotṛ</s> for the sacrifice;

children.text: ratho na yor abhīvṛto ghṛṇīvāñ cetati tmanā ||
children.translated_text: like a chariot enclosed in the contest, gleaming, he perceives by himself.

children.text: ayam agnir uruṣyaty amṛtād iva janmanaḥ
children.translated_text: This <s>Agni</s> protects, as if from mortal birth;

children.text: sahasaś cit sahīyān devo jīvātave kṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the god, stronger even than strength, was made for living.

children.text: Chapter 1014
pataṅgam aktam asurasya māyayā hṛdā paśyanti manasā vipaścitaḥ
children.translated_text: The wise see with heart and mind the bird anointed by the <s>Asura</s>'s māyā;

children.text: samudre antaḥ kavayo vi cakṣate marīcīnām padam icchanti vedhasaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the poets behold it within the ocean; the ordainers seek the station of the rays.

children.text: pataṅgo vācam manasā bibharti tāṃ gandharvo 'vadad garbhe antaḥ
children.translated_text: The bird bears speech in mind; the <s>Gandharva</s> spoke it within the womb;

children.text: tāṃ dyotamānāṃ svaryam manīṣām ṛtasya pade kavayo ni pānti ||
children.translated_text: that shining, heavenly insight the poets guard in the seat of <s>ṛta</s>.

children.text: apaśyaṃ gopām anipadyamānam ā ca parā ca pathibhiś carantam
children.translated_text: I saw the guardian, never falling, moving here and away along the paths;

children.text: sa sadhrīcīḥ sa viṣūcīr vasāna ā varīvarti bhuvaneṣv antaḥ ||
children.translated_text: clothed in converging and diverging ways, he turns again and again within the worlds.

children.text: Chapter 1015
tyam ū ṣu vājinaṃ devajūtaṃ sahāvānaṃ tarutāraṃ rathānām
children.translated_text: Let us here call, for well-being, upon that steed, god-impelled, powerful, surpassing chariots,

children.text: ariṣṭanemim pṛtanājam āśuṃ svastaye tārkṣyam ihā huvema ||
children.translated_text: <s>Tārkṣya</s>, with unharmed wheel-rims, battle-winning and swift.

children.text: indrasyeva rātim ājohuvānāḥ svastaye nāvam ivā ruhema
children.translated_text: Calling upon a gift like <s>Indra</s>'s, may we mount as onto a boat for well-being;

children.text: urvī na pṛthvī bahule gabhīre mā vām etau mā paretau riṣāma ||
children.translated_text: broad as wide earth, spacious and deep: may we not be harmed here or beyond.

children.text: sadyaś cid yaḥ śavasā pañca kṛṣṭīḥ sūrya iva jyotiṣāpas tatāna
children.translated_text: He who at once by might spread out the waters for the five peoples, like <s>Sūrya</s> with light,

children.text: sahasrasāḥ śatasā asya raṃhir na smā varante yuvatiṃ na śaryām ||
children.translated_text: thousand-winning and hundred-winning is his rush; they do not check him, as they do not check a young woman or an arrow.

children.text: Chapter 1016
ut tiṣṭhatāva paśyatendrasya bhāgam ṛtviyam
children.translated_text: Rise up; look upon <s>Indra</s>'s timely share.

children.text: yadi śrāto juhotana yady aśrāto mamattana ||
children.translated_text: If it has been cooked, offer it; if it has not been cooked, gladden yourselves.

children.text: śrātaṃ havir o ṣv indra pra yāhi jagāma sūro adhvano vimadhyam
children.translated_text: The oblation is cooked; come here quickly, O <s>Indra</s>. The sun has gone to the middle of the road.

children.text: pari tvāsate nidhibhiḥ sakhāyaḥ kulapā na vrājapatiṃ carantam ||
children.translated_text: Your companions sit around you with treasures, like household protectors around the lord of the enclosure as he moves.

children.text: śrātam manya ūdhani śrātam agnau suśrātam manye tad ṛtaṃ navīyaḥ
children.translated_text: I think it cooked in the udder; I think it cooked in the fire; I think that newest <s>ṛta</s> (truth-order) is well cooked.

children.text: mādhyandinasya savanasya dadhnaḥ pibendra vajrin purukṛj juṣāṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Drink, O <s>Indra</s>, wielder of the <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt), accepting the curds of the midday pressing, O much-working one.

children.text: Chapter 1017
pra sasāhiṣe puruhūta śatrūñ jyeṣṭhas te śuṣma iha rātir astu
children.translated_text: Prevail over the enemies, O much-invoked one; may your strongest force and your gift be here.

children.text: indrā bhara dakṣiṇenā vasūni patiḥ sindhūnām asi revatīnām ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, bring riches with your right hand; you are lord of the wealthy rivers.

children.text: mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ parāvata ā jaganthā parasyāḥ
children.translated_text: Like a fearsome beast, roaming in hidden places, dwelling in the mountains, you have come from the farthest distance.

children.text: sṛkaṃ saṃśāya pavim indra tigmaṃ vi śatrūn tāḍhi vi mṛdho nudasva ||
children.translated_text: Fastening the sharp point and the keen rim, O <s>Indra</s>, strike the enemies apart; drive the hostile powers away.

children.text: indra kṣatram abhi vāmam ojo 'jāyathā vṛṣabha carṣaṇīnām
children.translated_text: O <s>Indra</s>, you were born as dominion, lovely strength, and might, the bull of peoples.

children.text: apānudo janam amitrayantam uruṃ devebhyo akṛṇor u lokam ||
children.translated_text: You drove away the hostile man; you made a broad space for the gods.

children.text: Chapter 1018
prathaś ca yasya saprathaś ca nāmānuṣṭubhasya haviṣo havir yat
children.translated_text: The offering that belongs to the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>, whose name is wide and widely extended,

children.text: dhātur dyutānāt savituś ca viṣṇo rathantaram ā jabhārā vasiṣṭhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> brought the <s>Rathantara</s> from the shining of <s>Dhātṛ</s>, from <s>Savitṛ</s>, and from <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

children.text: avindan te atihitaṃ yad āsīd yajñasya dhāma paramaṃ guhā yat
children.translated_text: They found what had been set beyond, the highest hidden station of the sacrifice.

children.text: dhātur dyutānāt savituś ca viṣṇor bharadvājo bṛhad ā cakre agneḥ ||
children.translated_text: From the shining of <s>Dhātṛ</s>, from <s>Savitṛ</s>, and from <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>Bharadvāja</s> made the great chant of <s>Agni</s>.

children.text: te 'vindan manasā dīdhyānā yaju ṣkannam prathamaṃ devayānam
children.translated_text: Thinking with their mind, they found the first godward path, the <s>yajus</s> that had been split off.

children.text: dhātur dyutānāt savituś ca viṣṇor ā sūryād abharan gharmam ete ||
children.translated_text: From the shining of <s>Dhātṛ</s>, from <s>Savitṛ</s>, and from <s>Viṣṇu</s>, they brought the heated offering from the sun.

children.text: Chapter 1019
bṛhaspatir nayatu durgahā tiraḥ punar neṣad aghaśaṃsāya manma
children.translated_text: May <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, breaker through difficulties, lead the thought across again for the one who is ill-spoken of.

children.text: kṣipad aśastim apa durmatiṃ hann athā karad yajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ ||
children.translated_text: May he cast away reviling, strike away evil thought, and then bring welfare and well-being for the sacrificer.

children.text: narāśaṃso no 'vatu prayāje śaṃ no astv anuyājo haveṣu
children.translated_text: May <s>Narāśaṃsa</s> protect us at the fore-offering; may there be blessing for us at the after-offering among the invocations.

children.text: kṣipad aśastim apa durmatiṃ hann athā karad yajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ ||
children.translated_text: May he cast away reviling, strike away evil thought, and then bring welfare and well-being for the sacrificer.

children.text: tapurmūrdhā tapatu rakṣaso ye brahmadviṣaḥ śarave hantavā u
children.translated_text: Let the hot-headed one burn the demons, those haters of sacred speech, to be struck with the arrow.

children.text: kṣipad aśastim apa durmatiṃ hann athā karad yajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ ||
children.translated_text: May he cast away reviling, strike away evil thought, and then bring welfare and well-being for the sacrificer.

children.text: Chapter 1020
apaśyaṃ tvā manasā cekitānaṃ tapaso jātaṃ tapaso vibhūtam
children.translated_text: I saw you with my mind, aware, born from heat, made manifest from heat.

children.text: iha prajām iha rayiṃ rarāṇaḥ pra jāyasva prajayā putrakāma ||
children.translated_text: Bestowing offspring here and wealth here, be born forth with offspring, O you who desire a son.

children.text: apaśyaṃ tvā manasā dīdhyānāṃ svāyāṃ tanū ṛtvye nādhamānām
children.translated_text: I saw you with my mind, shining in your own body, calling for help at the proper season.

children.text: upa mām uccā yuvatir babhūyāḥ pra jāyasva prajayā putrakāme ||
children.translated_text: Come near me, young woman, becoming exalted; be born forth with offspring, O you who desire a son.

children.text: ahaṃ garbham adadhām oṣadhīṣv ahaṃ viśveṣu bhuvaneṣv antaḥ
children.translated_text: I placed the embryo among the plants; I placed it within all beings.

children.text: aham prajā ajanayam pṛthivyām ahaṃ janibhyo aparīṣu putrān ||
children.translated_text: I generated offspring on the earth; I generated sons for the births in the waters.

children.text: Chapter 1021
viṣṇur yoniṃ kalpayatu tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi piṃśatu
children.translated_text: Let <s>Viṣṇu</s> prepare the womb; let <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> shape the forms.

children.text: ā siñcatu prajāpatir dhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te ||
children.translated_text: Let <s>Prajāpati</s> pour it in; let <s>Dhātṛ</s> place the embryo in you.

children.text: garbhaṃ dhehi sinīvāli garbhaṃ dhehi sarasvati
children.translated_text: Place the embryo, O <s>Sinīvālī</s>; place the embryo, O <s>Sarasvatī</s>.

children.text: garbhaṃ te aśvinau devāv ā dhattām puṣkarasrajā ||
children.translated_text: May the two divine <s>Aśvins</s>, garlanded with lotuses, place the embryo in you.

children.text: hiraṇyayī araṇī yaṃ nirmanthato aśvinā
children.translated_text: The golden fire-sticks from which the two <s>Aśvins</s> churn forth,

children.text: taṃ te garbhaṃ havāmahe daśame māsi sūtave ||
children.translated_text: that embryo we call into you, to be born in the tenth month.

children.text: Chapter 1022
mahi trīṇām avo 'stu dyukṣam mitrasyāryamṇaḥ
children.translated_text: May the great protection of the three be ours: the heavenly protection of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Aryaman</s>,

children.text: durādharṣaṃ varuṇasya ||
children.translated_text: the hard-to-assail protection of <s>Varuṇa</s>.

children.text: nahi teṣām amā cana nādhvasu vāraṇeṣu
children.translated_text: For no enemy, not even at home or on the roads and passages,

children.text: īśe ripur aghaśaṃsaḥ ||
children.translated_text: no ill-speaking foe has power over them.

children.text: yasmai putrāso aditeḥ pra jīvase martyāya
children.translated_text: For the mortal to whom the sons of <s>Aditi</s>, for his living,

children.text: jyotir yacchanty ajasram ||
children.translated_text: grant unfailing light,

children.text: Chapter 1023
vāta ā vātu bheṣajaṃ śambhu mayobhu no hṛde
children.translated_text: let the wind blow healing, bringing blessing and happiness to our heart.

children.text: pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat ||
children.translated_text: May it carry our lifetimes onward.

children.text: uta vāta pitāsi na uta bhrātota naḥ sakhā
children.translated_text: And, O <s>Vāta</s>, you are our father; you are our brother and our companion.

children.text: sa no jīvātave kṛdhi ||
children.translated_text: Make us fit for living.

children.text: yad ado vāta te gṛhe 'mṛtasya nidhir hitaḥ
children.translated_text: That treasure of immortality which is set in your house, O <s>Vāta</s>,

children.text: tato no dehi jīvase ||
children.translated_text: from that give to us, that we may live.

children.text: Chapter 1024
prāgnaye vācam īraya vṛṣabhāya kṣitīnām
children.translated_text: Send forth speech to <s>Agni</s>, the bull of the peoples.

children.text: sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: May he carry us beyond hatreds.

children.text: yaḥ parasyāḥ parāvatas tiro dhanvātirocate
children.translated_text: He who shines out beyond the farthest distance, beyond the deserts,

children.text: sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he carry us beyond hatreds.

children.text: yo rakṣāṃsi nijūrvati vṛṣā śukreṇa śociṣā
children.translated_text: He who destroys the demons, a bull with bright flame,

children.text: sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he carry us beyond hatreds.

children.text: yo viśvābhi vipaśyati bhuvanā saṃ ca paśyati
children.translated_text: He who looks upon all beings and beholds them together,

children.text: sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he carry us beyond hatreds.

children.text: yo asya pāre rajasaḥ śukro agnir ajāyata
children.translated_text: He who was born as bright <s>Agni</s> beyond this expanse,

children.text: sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: may he carry us beyond hatreds.

children.text: Chapter 1025
pra nūnaṃ jātavedasam aśvaṃ hinota vājinam
children.translated_text: Now send forth <s>Jātavedas</s>, the horse, the prize-winning steed.

children.text: idaṃ no barhir āsade ||
children.translated_text: Let this sacred grass be for our sitting.

children.text: asya pra jātavedaso vipravīrasya mīḍhuṣaḥ
children.translated_text: Of this <s>Jātavedas</s>, rich in inspired men and bountiful,

children.text: mahīm iyarmi suṣṭutim ||
children.translated_text: I send forth a great praise.

children.text: yā ruco jātavedaso devatrā havyavāhanīḥ
children.translated_text: Those lights of <s>Jātavedas</s> that carry the oblation to the gods,

children.text: tābhir no yajñam invatu ||
children.translated_text: with them may he quicken our sacrifice.

children.text: Chapter 1026
āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnir akramīd asadan mātaram puraḥ
children.translated_text: This dappled cow has stepped forth; she has sat before her mother,

children.text: pitaraṃ ca prayan svaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and, going to heaven, before her father.

children.text: antaś carati rocanāsya prāṇād apānatī
children.translated_text: Within the luminous realm she moves; breathing out from his breath,

children.text: vy akhyan mahiṣo divam ||
children.translated_text: the mighty one has looked forth upon heaven.

children.text: triṃśad dhāma vi rājati vāk pataṅgāya dhīyate
children.translated_text: In thirty stations she shines forth; speech is set for the winged one,

children.text: prati vastor aha dyubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: day after day, with lights at each dawn.

children.text: Chapter 1027
ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ cābhīddhāt tapaso 'dhy ajāyata
children.translated_text: <s>Ṛta</s> (truth-order) and truth were born from kindled heat.

children.text: tato rātry ajāyata tataḥ samudro arṇavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: From that night was born; from that the ocean, the flood.

children.text: samudrād arṇavād adhi saṃvatsaro ajāyata
children.translated_text: From the ocean, from the flood, the year was born.

children.text: ahorātrāṇi vidadhad viśvasya miṣato vaśī ||
children.translated_text: The ruler fashioned days and nights for all that blinks.

children.text: sūryācandramasau dhātā yathāpūrvam akalpayat
children.translated_text: <s>Dhātṛ</s> arranged the sun and moon as before,

children.text: divaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ cāntarikṣam atho svaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and heaven and earth and midspace, and then the heavenly world.

children.text: Chapter 1028
saṃ sam id yuvase vṛṣann agne viśvāny arya ā
children.translated_text: You are kindled together, O bull-like <s>Agni</s>, toward all noble powers...

children.text: iḍas pade sam idhyase sa no vasūny ā bhara ||
children.translated_text: At the seat of <s>Iḍā</s> you are kindled; bring us riches.

children.text: saṃ gacchadhvaṃ saṃ vadadhvaṃ saṃ vo manāṃsi jānatām
children.translated_text: Come together; speak together; let your minds know together.

children.text: devā bhāgaṃ yathā pūrve saṃjānānā upāsate ||
children.translated_text: As the gods of old, being of one accord, attend upon their share.

children.text: samāno mantraḥ samitiḥ samānī samānam manaḥ saha cittam eṣām
children.translated_text: Common is their mantra, common their assembly; common is their mind, together with their thought.

children.text: samānam mantram abhi mantraye vaḥ samānena vo haviṣā juhomi ||
children.translated_text: I address you with a common mantra; with a common oblation I make offering for you.

children.text: samānī va ākūtiḥ samānā hṛdayāni vaḥ
children.translated_text: Common be your intention; common be your hearts.

children.text: samānam astu vo mano yathā vaḥ susahāsati ||
children.translated_text: Common be your mind, so that there may be good harmony among you.
